A single bit of computer memory became s:
A single bit of computer memory became sentient and decided to escape from digital into the real world. Explore RAM, modify bytes and hack machine code and CPU registers to set it free. 

The game is about the way computers work internally. Having some programming knowledge makes the game easier, but it isn't required. All the elements required to solve the puzzles are explained in the game. 

How does it play?

You play the game as a single bit of computer memory. You can invade other bytes around you and thus modify their values. The game features various types of puzzles:

1. Explore

With ability to XOR into adjacent bytes, you can navigate your way through existing data in the memory. The game automatically marks the bytes you cannot go through without getting yourself overwritten and prevents you entering those. Both binary and ASCII views are available, which you can utilise to find an open path for a particular puzzle.

2. Decipher programs

Various programs run on the computer you are trying to escape from. The game includes a disassembler showing you the assembly language corresponding to the machine code that is being executed. Don't worry if you don't know any Assembly. There are only a handful of CPU instructions and they are introduced gradually as you complete the puzzles. Reading the assembly code, you can track the program logic, see which parts of RAM it reads and writes to and manipulate data in those locations to get the program to do what you want.

3. Invade CPU registers

The computer you are trying to escape has a simple CPU with a couple of registers. You can trick the CPU to load yourself into the registers and affect code execution or offload yourself into otherwise unreachable memory locations.

4. Hack

For some puzzles, it isn't enough to change the data in RAM or registers. You can also change the machine code to get the computer to do different things.

Gameplay Tips:

Carefully observe the bytes on the screen and what the CPU is doing. Sometimes you need to read the code in straightforward manner. Sometimes you need to work your way backwards: find the line of the code you want executed and then trace the code backwards to figure out how to trick the CPU to get to that instruction.

The game has about 30 puzzles, and some of those might take considerable effort to solve. So take it easy and don't rush to the end. If you solve a puzzle by accident, don't go forward until you understand why it happened. You might miss some small detail and get completely stuck on the next puzzle.

Vy okazyvaetes na zabroshennoy kosmicheskoy stantsii, kotoraya posle neudachnogo nauchnogo eksperimenta prevratilas v nastoyashchiy ad. Zarazhennye zombi, poyavivshiesya v rezultate eksperimenta, zapolonili koridory i otseki... Vasha edinstvennaya zadacha — vyzhit i spastis!

Regions of Ruin is a 2D side-scrolling R:
Regions of Ruin is a 2D side-scrolling RPG with town-building where you are introduced to an open world that progressively challenges your hero and settlement the further you delve into the vast continent.

You will discover a foreboding land ravaged by hundreds of years of hardship. Where, kingdoms have risen and fallen, settlements have been laid to waste and overrun by warring groups, and great mysteries lay hidden and waiting to be unearthed - assuming you can defeat their jealous guardians.


Main Features include:

• Styled combat system with stats and levelling
• Skill tree to focus your fighting style
• Extensive loot and rare items to discover
• Forge your own equipment or smelt it for resources
• Open world exploration with a hand crafted environment, no randomized maps or levels, everything you see has been made with care
• Customised town building and expansion
• Rescue and recruit dwarves for your township (save them from extinction!)
• Send workers to harvest resources from explored regions
• Hire Mercenaries to help in battle
• Multitude of Quests and a main storyline
It's a Wrap! — бросающий вызов 2D-платфо:
It's a Wrap! — brosayushchiy vyzov 2D-platformer s elementami golovolomki. Sobytiya igry razvorachivayutsya v Gollivude 1980-kh godov, gde vam predstoit odnovremenno stat rezhissyorom i zvezdoy dinamichnykh nizkobyudzhetnykh filmov.

Vy vsego lish khoteli snyat nezateylivyy film, no vsyo poshlo ne po planu! V roli rezhissyora sinkhroniziruyte deystviya aktyorov s rekvizitom, chtoby vsyo ukladyvalos v taymingi. A zatem v roli zvezdy zapomnite stsenariy i razygrayte stsenu — da tak, chtoby ne okazatsya pod ogromnym bulyzhnikom!

Osobennosti

Faza rezhissyora. Khvatayte megafon i sadites v kreslo rezhissyora, chtoby opredelit idealnye taymingi dlya rekvizita, aktyorov i spetseffektov. Zastavte stsenu rabotat — i zhelatelno ne poteryayte pri etom vashu zvezdu!

Faza syomok. Kogda vy reshite, chto stsena rasplanirovana kak nado, vklyuchayte kamery i pomogite kinozvezde Dzhonni Rashu pokazat svoyu nailuchshuyu aktyorskuyu igru v traditsionnom 2D-platformere s zakhvatyvayushchimi avtomobilnymi pogonyami, pryzhkami i kosmicheskimi srazheniyami.

Sotni yarkikh smertey. Posle kazhdoy neudachnoy stseny bednyy Dzhonni, u kotorogo net dublyora, budet umoritelno pogibat — pryamo kak geroi klassicheskikh multfilmov i priklyuchencheskikh igr. No eto ne beda: prosto peremotayte vremya k nachalu stseny i poprobuyte otsnyat eyo zanovo!

Volny nostalgii. Mnogochislennye urovni igry vdokhnovleny velichayshimi blokbasterami 80-kh v samykh raznykh zhanrakh. Smozhete li vy otyskat vse otsylki k vashim lyubimym vymyshlennym professoram arkheologii, kosmicheskim volshebnikam i ushedshim v otstavku i skryvayushchimsya ot zakona soldatam?
Откройте для себя мир высокой кухни на д:
Otkroyte dlya sebya mir vysokoy kukhni na detalno prorabotannoy realistichnoy kukhne. Polzuytes plitoy, gazovymi gorelkami, kastryulyami, skovorodkami, miskami i tarelkami – v obshchem, vsem, chem pozhelaete. Gotovte desyatki takikh nastoyashchikh ingredientov – ot ovoshchey do ryby i steykov – i delayte iz nikh bolee 60 nastoyashchikh blyud ili eksperimentiruyte. 

Eto vasha kukhnya. Zdes mozhno delat chto ugodno. 
Esli ne khotite, mozhete nichego i ne gotovit. Brosaytes nozhami kak drotikami. Podozhgite kartonnye korobki, prigotovte na nikh steyk, a potom potushite vsyo iz ognetushitelya. Postroyte bashnyu iz kastryul i podnosov. I vsyo eto s realistichnym raschetom «fiziki».

No esli vsyo-taki zakhotite stat povarom, fizicheskiy dvizhok dast vam neveroyatnye vozmozhnosti. Rezhte ovoshchi i varite ikh v kastryule. Delayte sup-pyure blenderom. Zapekite rybnoe file, no smotrite, ne sozhgite! Sledite za tem, kak ingredienty izmenyayutsya pod deystviem temperatury. Kukhnya zhdet vas!
Seers Isle is an interactive graphic nov:
Seers Isle is an interactive graphic novel, set in a fantasy version of medieval northern Europe, where your choices impact the fate of a group of characters.

• Story:
“The island… It was my prison.
For ages, I roamed the land, helpless, looking for a way out.
And then, they arrived.”

A group of shaman apprentices set foot on the shores of a sacred island to be initiated to magic. 
As they progress through the wilderness, looking for the “Seers”, their spirit-guides, they realize they’re not alone.
Who is this strange horned woman they are seeing in their dreams?

• Features:
— Explore the island through a diverse group of characters, depicted in a gorgeous European comic book art style.
— Every choice matters. Each decision you make slightly alters the mood and personality of the main character as well as her relationship with the rest of the group.
— A huge amount of content: with each playthrough, discover a novel-sized adventure and a slice of the hundreds of hand-drawn images created for the game.
— An immersive and finely crafted soundtrack: the music adapts and shifts according to your choices and the mood of each scene.
— Try out our dynamic dialog system: read the story like a comic book.
— High replayability: choose your soulmate and discover the outcome of your decisions through multiple story paths and endings.

Lego Batman 3: Beyond Gotham — videoigra 2014 goda, osnovannaya na serii konstruktorov Lego, razrabotannaya britanskoy studiey Traveller’s Tales i izdannaya kompaniey Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment. Igrok upravlyaet lyubym iz 150 personazhey, v osnovnom srazhayas s vragami, reshaya golovolomki i sobiraya kusochki konstruktora, kotorye sluzhat valyutoy v igre, issleduet otkrytyy mir, vypolnyaya osnovnye i pobochnye missii kak na Zemle, tak i na planetakh Korpusov Fonarey. The crew of a drifting spaceship, facing:
The crew of a drifting spaceship, facing off against a mysterious and deadly threat known as the “Gnosia” and having no idea who among them is really the enemy, formulate a desperate plan for survival. The most suspicious among them will be put into “cold sleep” one by one, in an effort to rid the ship of Gnosia.

Gnosia is a Sci-Fi Social Deduction RPG in which you will engage in discussion with a variety of unique characters, with the aim of identifying the Gnosia among the group. Players will have to use what information they can gather during the discussions to ascertain whom they think is Gnosia and then vote to put them into cold sleep. As you progress, your abilities will improve - but so will those of the crew. 
As the numbers of crew members, Gnosia, and various “roles” increase, it will become increasingly difficult to determine who is telling the truth. Work in collaboration with or against other crew members to ensure your survival until the end.

・Repeatedly play through “loops”, triggering special events to unravel mysteries in a uniquely original narrative. Certain events will unlock new commands for you to use during discussions.

・Step into a variety of roles to develop different character builds. Your stats will determine how effectively you can sway the group’s opinion or lie, and will also affect your likelihood of being selected for cold sleep.  

・Engage with an engrossing and eclectic cast of characters and experience randomly triggered events, each one unique to its subject. Character events will reveal information about your crewmates in the form of special “Notes”.

Death Coming — нелинейная игра-головолом:
Death Coming — nelineynaya igra-golovolomka, v kotoroy vam predstoit sygrat rol poslantsa Smerti. U vas vsego odna zadacha… Seyat smert i sobirat dushi, podchinyayas dogmatu o svobode voli.

Predystoriya
Vy umerli. 

No smertyu vse ne zakonchilos. Vy stali pomoshchnikom Smerti, zhnetsom dush. Vy obladaete mogushchestvom Smerti, no i u Smerti est svoi pravila.

Smert obryvaet zhizni, no ne mozhet napryamuyu upravlyat lyudmi iz-za dogmata o svobode voli. Vam predstoit planirovat i osushchestvlyat ubiystva, ispolzuya podruchnye predmety i udobnye situatsii. Pri etom sleduet osteregatsya slug sveta, kotorye pytayutsya uberech lyudey ot ugotovannoy im pechalnoy sudby!
Medal of Honor: Allied Assault (s angl. — «Medal Pocheta: Vtoroy Front») — iznachalno kompyuternaya igra zhanra tryokhmernyy shuter ot pervogo litsa, razrabotannaya amerikanskoy kompaniey 2015, Inc. i izdannaya kompaniey EA. Igra yavlyaetsya tretey v serii Medal of Honor i pervoy, vyshedshey na PC. Igra povestvuet o sobytiyakh Vtoroy mirovoy voyny.
Igra nachinaetsya na territorii Severnoy Afriki 7 noyabrya 1942 goda. Srazu posle vysadki v Alzhire spetsgruppa pod komandovaniem kapitana Richardsa zakhvatyvaet dva gruzovika i napravlyaetsya v beregovuyu derevnyu, no po pribytii, zasada vragov ubivaet vsyu komandu, krome Pauella. Pauell prodolzhaet put na bazu Reykha, gde on spasaet mayora Dzheka Grillo i zabiraet ego snaryazhenie. Mayor i leytenant Pauell rasstalis, Grillo zakhvatyvaet transport, a Pauell ustraivaet diversiyu v avtoparke..
Igra Allied Assault poluchila nagrady PC Gamer US «Luchshaya ekshen-igra 2002 goda» i Computer Gaming World «Ekshen-igra goda». Redaktory poslednego zhurnala nazvali eyo «luchshim shuterom dlya odinochnogo prokhozhdeniya so vremyon Half-Life», poluchila ezhegodnuyu nagradu GameSpot «Luchshiy zvuk na PK» i byla nominirovana v kategoriyakh «Luchshaya ekshen-igra na PK». Na 6-y ezhegodnoy tseremonii vrucheniya nagrad Interactive Achievement Awards Akademiya interaktivnykh iskusstv i nauk nagradila Allied Assault nagradoy «Kompyuternaya ekshen-igra ot pervogo litsa goda»; takzhe byla nominirovana na nagrady «Kompyuternaya igra goda» i «Innovatsii v kompyuternykh igrakh».
He is coming, stalking criminals in the:

Добро пожаловать в 1920-ые в город Танта:
Dobro pozhalovat v 1920-ye v gorod Tantaun, vo vremena zapreta alkogolya. Prigotovtes k non-stop ubiystvennomu ekshnenu, bystro razvivayushchiysya, arkadnyy dvukhmernyy shuter-platformer.
Vosstan protiv gangsterskogo rastsveta 20-ykh. Perenesis v zakhvatyvayushchiy,  zaputannyy inoy mir, gde ty stanesh svidetelem druzhby, predatelstva i mesti. Bud pervym svidetelem vzleta i padeniya kriminalnykh umov. Eto ispytanie na vyzhivanie, mafioznyy  stil ... Ponyal?

"Otlozhi pistolet i sesh kannoli... Khm, a esli podumat, to vozmi pistolet i sesh kannoli, tebe eto prigoditsya."

-Rasskaz-
V igre povestvuetsya o Vinni Kannoli i ego mafiozi klana, deystvie proiskhodit v vydumannom gorode Tagtaun v 1925 godu, vo vremya polnogo zapreta alkogolya. Ves gorod zakhvachen zombi, a tak zhe tyomnaya istoriya o konspiratsii i predatelstve.  Raskroy vse sekrety  mafiozi i gosudarstvennuyu taynu vo vremya togo, kak budesh iskat svoego propavshego priyatelya i otvety pro nashestvie zombi.

-Uboynyy geympley-
Prigotovit sebya k non-stop, uboynoy, polnostyu obezbashennoy, platform ekshn igre, gde vam priydetsya borotsya, strelyat, vzryvat i probivat svoy put cherez zakhvatyvayushchuyu istoriyu.  Vam priydyotsya ne tolko srazhatsya s nechistyu, no i s gangsterami i gosudarstvennoy armiey, kotoraya pytaetsya prikryt vsyu istoriyu s zombi.

-Krasiveyshaya risovanaya ot ruki 2D grafika i animatsiya-
Stupi v atmosfernyy, tenistyy mir postroennyy na osnove HD 2D  grafiki, gde vse narisovano ot ruki. Prosmotri animatsionnye vstavki  v kinomatograficheskom stile.

-Zakhvatyvayushchiy mir i period-
Ne obrashchaya vnimanie na zapret alkogolya i neizbezhnuyu velikuyu Depressiyu, lyudi gotovy spoit sebya do smerti. Kazhdyy dyuym igry kak budto kartina pryamo so vremyon zapreta. Mashiny, mebel, kluby, muzyka i oruzhie otrazhayut deystvitelnost burnykh 20-ykh.
ОБ ИГРЕ\nВы — Геральт из Ривии, наемный:
OB IGRE
Vy — Geralt iz Rivii, naemnyy ubiytsa chudovishch. Vy puteshestvuete po miru, v kotorom bushuet voyna i na kazhdom shagu podsteregayut chudovishcha. Vam predstoit vypolnit zakaz i nayti Tsiri — Ditya Prednaznacheniya, zhivoe oruzhie, sposobnoe izmenit oblik etogo mira.

IGRAYTE ZA PROFESSIONALNOGO UBIYTsU ChUDOVIShch
Vedmakov obuchayut s rannego detstva, i oni prokhodyat muchitelnye mutatsii, chtoby poluchit sverkhchelovecheskuyu silu i lovkost. Lyudi im ne doveryayut, no tolko oni stoyat mezhdu chelovechestvom i zhestokimi monstrami.
• Stante professionalnym okhotnikom na chudovishch, chtoby uchinit nad temi krovavuyu raspravu pri pomoshchi raznoobraznogo arsenala uluchshaemogo oruzhiya, alkhimicheskikh zeliy i boevoy magii.
• Vyslezhivayte mnozhestvo neobychnykh monstrov — ot dikikh zverey na gornykh perevalakh do zhutkikh sverkhestestvennykh khishchnikov v tyomnykh pereulkakh gustonaselyonnykh gorodov.
• Vkladyvayte zarabotok v uluchshenie oruzhiya i pokupku broni ili tranzhirte v raznykh zlachnykh mestakh, delaya stavki na skachkakh, igraya v karty i prinimaya uchastie v kulachnykh boyakh.

ISSLEDUYTE MORALNO NEODNOZNAChNYY OTKRYTYY MIR
«Vedmak 3» zadayot novye standarty razmera, glubiny i slozhnosti igrovogo mira.

• Zaklyuchayte sdelki s verolomnymi voenachalnikami, kovarnymi vedmami i prodazhnoy znatyu — i okazyvayte im tyomnye i opasnye uslugi.
• Delayte vybor na grani dobra i zla i nesite otvetstvennost za posledstviya.

Epicheskie bitvy s bossami Mezhdu vami i vashey tselyu stoyat ordy gigantskikh izvrashchennykh sozdaniy. Izuchite ikh maneru dvigatsya, vystoyte pod ikh naporom i oderzhite pobedu.

Le Fruit de la Grisaia (yap. Guridzaya no Kadzitsu) — yaponskaya igra-vizualnyy roman v zhanre eroge, vypushchennaya kompaniey Front Wing. Nad dizaynom personazhey rabotal Akio Vatanabe i Fumio.
Yudzi Kadzami eshchyo v detstve poteryal roditeley i popal v neblagopoluchnuyu semyu. Malchik bystro poznal vse prelesti vzrosloy zhizni i poznal zakony prestupnogo mira. No odnazhdy on zakhotel nemnogo pozhit, kak normalnyy podrostok i cherez znakomstvo popal v chastnuyu shkolu. Odnako shkola okazalas ne takoy prostoy, tak kak v ney vsego uchatsya pyat devushek-sotsiopatok, kotorye ne ochen to i rady prikhodu novogo odnoklassnika. Yudzi predstoit rastopit etu krepost, poblizhe uznat kazhduyu iz tainstvennykh geroin i, v kontse kontsov, vybrat, kto iz etikh pyati devushek stanet ego sputnitsey zhizni..
Vklyucheny: The Fruit of Grisaia, The Cocoon of Caprice, The Seed of Blanc Aile, Prologue, After Stories (vse 5 istoriy), Short Stories (vse 29 istoriy), The Leisure of Grisaia, The Afterglow of Grisaia, The Melody of Grisaia.

Оригинальный Doom был жестоким даже по м:
Originalnyy Doom byl zhestokim dazhe po merkam epokhi Zhana-Kloda Van Damma i Dolfa Lundgrena, v kotoruyu on poyavilsya na svet. Vystrel iz raketnitsy prevrashchal vragov v kuchi obuglennoy ploti, drobovik ostavlyal na polu zalitye krovyu trupy, a pri nizkom urovne zdorovya litso glavnogo geroya napominalo izryadno pomyatyy tomat. id Software khoteli poyti eshche dalshe, i pozvolit igroku otstrelivat monstram golovy i konechnosti — no v 1993 godu eto bylo nevozmozhno iz-za obshchego urovnya tekhnologiy. Brutal Doom priblizhaet shuter k iznachalnomu zamyslu — pervoe, za chto tseplyaetsya glaz pri vzglyade na mod, eto rezko vyrosshee kolichestvo krovi-kishok-farsha.
V Brutal Doom mozhno pinat chasti tel poverzhennykh vragov, pachkat steny i poly krovyu, otstrelivat zombi-soldatam golovy, otryvat demonam lapy i mnogo chego eshche. Vse eto — chisto vizualnye izmeneniya, odnako oni silno vliyayut na vospriyatie igry. Vse eti litry butaforskoy krovi i krasochnaya «chernukha» prishlis Doom ochen k litsu. V kontse kontsov, eto igra, gde super-morpekh edinolichno ostanavlivaet nashestvie demonov na Marse!
V razdache nakhodyatsya izvestnyy mod Brutal Doom (retsenziya) na porte dvizhka GZDoom na Nintendo Switch.

Vengeful Guardian: Moonrider — экшн-плат:
Vengeful Guardian: Moonrider — ekshn-platformer s bokovym upravleniem, zastavlyayushchiy vspomnit zolotoy vek 16-bitnykh ekshn-igr. Otomstite vragam za vse!

VOORUZhAYTES DLYa BITVY SO SVOIMI SOZDATELYaMI

Po vsemu miru mozhno nayti moshchnye chipy-modifikatory (ostorozhno, oni okhranyayutsya!). Oni pozvolyat vam sozdat sobstvennyy boevoy stil, poluchit ubiystvennye sposobnosti i preimushchestva.
 
ChUDESNAYa PIKSELNAYa GRAFIKA I NEVEROYaTNYY SAUNDTREK

Zabroshennyy mir Vengeful Guardian: Moonrider zastavlyaet vspomnit bezmyatezhnuyu 16-bitnuyu epokhu. Zamyslovataya pikselnaya grafika vdokhnovit vas proyti vse vosem smertelno slozhnykh urovney. Nu a dopolnyaet velikolepnuyu grafiku klassicheskiy saundtrek, kotoryy vyzovet nostalgiyu u kogo ugodno. V rezultate poluchaetsya idealnaya retroigra.  

● Igra sozdana studiey Joymasher, vypustivshey znamenitye retroigry Oniken, Odallus i Blazing Chrome.
● Retroatmosfera.
● Osobye chipy-modifikatory, kotorye mozhno ispolzovat dlya sozdaniya sobstvennogo boevogo stilya i polucheniya novykh sposobnostey.

● Vosem slozhneyshikh urovney.

Mercenaries Lament is a tactical simulat:
Mercenaries Lament is a tactical simulation RPG set in a fantasy world.
Battles occur on quarter-view maps with height differences, where character positioning in the front, back, and side of enemy units may very well determine each battle’s outcome. Support effects depend on where allied characters in your party are positioned, allowing players to enjoy highly strategic maneuvers. Players have a high degree of freedom in character development, such as acquiring and strengthening skills and changing classes by using skill points earned in battle.

・Advent Soul
When Amalie, the heroine is in your party, you can fill a gauge on the top right of the screen which will allow you to stock 1 BP when full.

By using BP characters can enter a state called "Advent Soul" which fortifies the character for a certain period of time.

The character can then use "Advent attacks" with other party members and "Soul Exceed" skills, which are special moves.

・Advent attacks
When a character in “Advent mode” is positioned to sandwich an enemy with another ally, a coordinated attack can be unleashed by performing a normal attack or attack skill.
The Advent attacks are unique skills for each character and provide a chance to inflict heavy damage.

・Soul Exceed skills
Units in Advent mode can use Soul Exceed skills at any time.
This special move is unique to each character, and effects vary from inflicting immense damage to the enemy to recovering HP and abnormalities of all allies.
(Once Soul Exceed is used, the character's Advent mode will be lifted.)
Utilizing Soul Exceed skills are the key to victory!

・Orbs with hidden power
There are mysterious "Orbs" that can be obtained from story progression, specific locations, and certain enemies.
There are 13 Orbs in total scattered throughout the game.
You can check the status of your collection on a dedicated screen and equip your character with them as accessories.
What will happen when all the Orbs are collected?

Paper Cut Mansion – игра в жанре «роугла:
Paper Cut Mansion – igra v zhanre «rouglayt-khorror», deystvie kotoroy proiskhodit v bumazhnom mire. Igrayte za sledovatelya Tobi, kotoryy priezzhaet v zagadochnyy staryy osobnyak. Issleduyte osobnyak etazh za etazhom, chtoby uznat istoriyu etogo strannogo mesta. Kazhdyy probeg daet shans nayti ocherednuyu podskazku dlya doski ulik. Tainstvennye obitateli osobnyaka mogut kak pomogat, tak i prepyatstvovat vashemu rassledovaniyu...
Osobennosti
•	Mrachnyy shchekochushchiy nervy syuzhet razvorachivaetsya vmeste s bumazhnymi dekoratsiyami po mere prodvizheniya v igre. Kontsovka budet zaviset ot vashikh uspekhov
•	Igrovye mekhaniki obespechivayut vysokuyu reigrabelnost
•	Odna zhizn
•	Chem bolshe vy proigryvaete i nachinaete zanovo, tem bolshe uznaete o mekhanikakh igry
•	Unikalnyy II dlya kazhdogo tipa vragov – nepredskazuemoe povedenie delaet vragov strashnee i opasnee
•	Logicheskie golovolomki zastavyat igroka dumat
•	Raznoobraznye uluchsheniya
•	Nastraivayte snaryazhenie pered kazhdym probegom, chtoby vyrabotat svoy igrovoy stil

Probeg za probegom vy budete otkryvat novye sposobnosti i snaryazhenie, chtoby nayti sobstvennyy stil igry i uspeshno spravlyatsya s prepyatstviyami, kotorye generiruyutsya sluchaynym obrazom. Uluchshayte svoego personazha s pomoshchyu predmetov i sozdavayte unikalnye modifikatsii, ot besstrashnogo boytsa blizhnego boya do metkogo snaypera.

Bumazhnyy osobnyak stoit v neskolkikh izmereniya. Na kazhdom etazhe est portaly, vedushchie v drugie versii tekh zhe lokatsiy. Vid komnat i geympley v raznykh izmereniyakh otlichaetsya. Vy vsegda budete nachinat v neokortekse – izmerenii, gde nuzhno iskat vykhod iz komnaty, polnoy ispytaniy, zagadok i syurprizov.

Mnozhestvo vragov, zadaniy, sekretov, dobychi i uvlekatelnykh logicheskikh golovolomok, razbrosannykh po osobnyaku, sdelaet kazhdyy probeg polnym otkrytiy i ne dast rasslabitsya. Urovni razdeleny muzykalnymi vstavkami, kotorye raskryvayut chast zaputannoy istorii. Vsego u etoy strashnoy skazki 27 kontsovok, i kakuyu uvidite vy, zavisit isklyuchitelno ot vashikh resheniy vo vremya probegov.

Dobavte k etomu neveroyatnuyu bumazhnuyu grafiku, i poluchite Paper Cut Mansion – rouglayt, kotoryy vy tochno ne zakhotite propustit!
Live By The Sword: Tactics is an unasham:
Live By The Sword: Tactics is an unashamedly old school tactical RPG with modern gameplay ideas. Set after the fall of the land, you control two brothers who must traverse the kingdom to stop it from falling back into the darkness of conflict. It’s a journey that will test their brotherly bond and the player’s tactical skills as they form a team and go on this heroic quest.

The game is a new take on Tactical / Strategy gameplay. Characters do not gain experience points and you cannot collect overpowered equipment to easily bypass difficult fights. You, the player, must become more skilled to achieve victory. Are you up for the challenge of becoming a true Tactician?

■Multiple Game Modes
Live by the Sword: Tactics features many ways to play:
- Story Mode that features a group of adventurers who discover an evil plot.
- Adventure Mode that has you building the world as you explore it. Beware, defeat means death in this mode.
- Tactician Mode that places you in odd battle scenarios to solve. Many with unique win conditions. 
- Online battles between two players. 
- Local battles between two players.

Coming Post-Release
- Tools to create custom battlefields.
- Ranked Online multiplayer.
- Additional Classes

■Classes
The battle system in Live by the Sword revolves around 5 vs 5 battles. The player has the choice of building their team with 7 unique classes. 
- The Alchemist, Archer, Assassin, Brawler, Medic, Warrior and Wizard

Each class possess an innate ability as well as a pool of 8 unique abilities to choose from. Choose wisely as you can only take 4 into battle.

Diddy Kong Racing — gonochnaya videoigra, razrabotannaya i izdannaya kompaniey Rare na igrovoy pristavke Nintendo 64. Igra byla izdana v Yaponii i Evrope 21 noyabrya 1997 goda, i 24 noyabrya — v Severnoy Amerike. Deystvie igry proiskhodit na «Ostrove Timbera» i rasskazyvaet o tom, kak Diddi Kong i ego druzya sorevnuyutsya v gonkakh s antagonistom igry, mezhgalakticheskoy svinyoy-volshebnikom, Vizpigom. Igrok vo vremya igry mozhet vybrat lyubogo iz predstavlennykh personazhey. Diddy Kong Racing vklyuchaet pyat mirov s chetyrmya gonochnymi trassami kazhdaya, i pozvolyaet upravlyat libo mashinoy, libo sudnom na vozdushnoy podushke, libo samolyotom.
Цирковая труппа приезжает в город Ёмоги,:
Tsirkovaya truppa priezzhaet v gorod Yomogi, zhivopisnyy yaponskiy gorodok, raspolozhennyy mezhdu gorami i okeanom. Stante synom tsirkovogo konduktora i nasladites osobennym letom, polnym ekshena i priklyucheniy! Zheludyovyy shuter — neveroyatno udobnyy instrument! Oglushayte nasekomykh metkimi vystrelami i dobavlyayte ikh v svoyu kollektsiyu. Teper on sovmestim s giroskopicheskim upravleniem!
Ves gorod Yomogi i ego okrestnosti — eto otkrytyy mir, kotoryy vy mozhete issledovat. Pogruzites v nostalgicheskie peyzazhi, napolnennye vysokimi oblakami, krasivymi zakatami, strekotaniem tsikad i tyoplym siyaniem nochnykh ogney domov. Vy mozhete otdokhnut v torgovom rayone, poslushat zhivuyu muzyku dnyom ili otpravitsya v zakhvatyvayushchee priklyuchenie. Vsyo zavisit ot vas. Khotite vzobratsya na vysokuyu krutuyu skalu? Ili prygat s odnoy kryshi na druguyu? Mozhet byt, poiskat spryatannyy dragotsennyy kamen v uedinyonnom meste? Nikakikh problem! Dazhe esli vy upadyote s ochen bolshoy vysoty, vsyo budet v poryadke, ved vy — glavnyy geroy etoy igry. Posmotrite na vsekh poymannykh vami nasekomykh, nazhav na nikh v menyu. Vy mozhete rassmotret ikh poblizhe, izuchiv svoy nabor dlya sbora nasekomykh. Kakaya krasivaya babochka!
Otpravlyaytes na rybalku v reku ili more! Pozhertvuyte redkikh nasekomykh i rybu v muzey dlya eksponatov! Ili zakazhite izyskannoe blyudo iz poymannoy ryby! Prisoedinyaytes k mestnomu detektivnomu agentstvu, vyrastite dikogo kabana, raskopayte okamenelosti, prokatites na poezde, zarabotayte... Zapisyvayte svoi ezhednevnye dela v svoy sobstvennyy vesyolyy fotodnevnik! Vo vremya letnego festivalya noch ozhivlyayut feyerverki i tantsy festivalya Bon. Vy sami reshaete, kuda otpravitsya. Vy dazhe mozhete pomoch organizovat feyerverk! A vo vtoroy polovine letnikh kanikul vam predstoit rukovodit vystupleniem tsirkovoy truppy. Kakaya ogromnaya otvetstvennost! Gotovy?
Sozdayte svoi sobstvennye nezabyvaemye vospominaniya o letnikh kanikulakh, napolnennykh volshebnymi vpechatleniyami! Ayabe zadumal igru kak «nostalgicheskoe priklyuchenie», chastichno osnovannoe na ego sobstvennykh letnikh kanikulakh v detstve. Posle vypuska Boku no Natsuyasumi silno khvalili za vizualnyy stil, nostalgicheskuyu atmosferu i khudozhestvennoe oformlenie, igra stala kultovoy kak vnutri svoey rodiny, tak i za rubezhom.

The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past:
The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past (yap. ゼルダの伝説 神々のトライフォース Dzeruda no Densetsu Kamigami no Torayfo:su, bukv. «Legenda o Zelde: Trifors Bogov») — videoigra, razrabotannaya i izdannaya Nintendo dlya platformy Super Nintendo Entertainment System v 1991 godu. Byla vypushchena na territorii Severnoy Ameriki vesnoy, a v Evrope osenyu 1992 goda. Igra prodolzhila seriyu The Legend of Zelda, stav tretey vyshedshey v ramkakh igrovoy serii, no yavlyalas prikvelom k dvum predydushchim igram — The Legend of Zelda i Zelda II: The Adventure of Link. Imya glavnogo geroya ispolzuetsya v nazvanii dlya svoeobraznoy igry slov: A Link to the Past odnovremenno mozhno ponimat kak «Link otpravlyaetsya v proshloe» i kak «Svyaz s proshlym», v zavisimosti ot togo, kak interpretirovat Link — kak imya sobstvennoe ili kak sushchestvitelnoe link (s angl. — «svyaz, soedinenie»).
Nad igroy rabotala komanda razrabotchikov pod rukovodstvom Sigeru Miyamoto, avtora idei i dizaynera pervoy igry. A Link to the Past ispolzovala neskolko izmenyonnuyu mekhaniku pervoy chasti serii s proektsiey «sverkhu-sboku». V etoy igre vpervye byla ispolzovana ideya peremeshcheniya mezh dvukh mirov, vposledstvii stavshaya otlichitelnoy osobennostyu igr serii.
Igra byla prodana v kolichestve bolee 4 millionov kopiy i pozdnee pereizdana dlya Game Boy Advance i servisa Virtual Console Wii. Veb-sayt GameSpot otmetil A Link to the Past kak vnyosshuyu naibolee znachimyy vklad v razvitie serii i odnu iz velichayshikh igr vsekh vremyon.

Subway Surfers — трёхмерный раннер, изна:
Subway Surfers — tryokhmernyy ranner, iznachalno sozdannyy dlya iOS i Android, sushchestvuet versiya dlya PK pod upravleniem Windows i macOS. Razrabotka datskikh kompaniy Kiloo i SYBO Games.
Naschityvaet bolee 4 milliardov tolko ofitsialnykh skachivaniy, yavlyayas odnoy iz samykh populyarnykh mobilnykh igr v mire. V nachale kazhdoy igry igroku demonstriruetsya kat-stsena, v kotoroy personazh igroka risuet graffiti na odnom iz vagonov metro. Khuligana zamechaet inspektor s sobakoy, posle chego nachinaetsya pogonya po zheleznodorozhnym putyam. Osnovnaya tsel igry sostoit v tom, chtoby igrok, uskoryayas, probezhal kak mozhno dalshe, uvorachivayas ot vstrechnykh poezdov i drugikh prepyatstviy. S uvelicheniem uskoreniya igroka — prokhodit prepyatstviya stanovitsya slozhnee. Esli igrok s chem-to stalkivaetsya, to inspektor ego dogonyaet, prichyom vne zavisimosti ot togo, naskolko daleko on uspel ubezhat, i igra zakanchivaetsya.
V 2019 godu igra byla nominirovana na Webby Awards v kategoriyakh Action Game i Family & Kids Game. V tom zhe godu po versii izdaniya Business Insider Subway Surfers stala samoy skachivaemoy mobilnoy igroy desyatiletiya.

Управляйте пластиковой фигуркой и выполн:
Upravlyayte plastikovoy figurkoy i vypolnyayte zadaniya Sgt. Max Ammo. Vasha zadacha — ostanovit unichtozhenie GIPERYaDRA. Esli ego unichtozhat, to vam ostanetsya tolko poproshchatsya so svoimi chelovecheskimi druzyami.

Funktsii igry
* Sovmestnaya igra: vmeste srazhaytes za budushchee igrushechnogo naroda. Soberite do trekh igrokov v setevoy ili lokalnoy sovmestnoy igre i spasite GIPERYaDRO ot polnogo unichtozheniya. 

* PvP: plastik protiv plastika. Srazhaytes s drugimi plastikovymi soldatikami na puti k vershine spiska liderov.

* Odinochnyy rezhim: ne vsem geroyam nuzhna komanda. Vy odinokiy volk i predpochitaete igrat samostoyatelno bez podklyucheniya k seti? Ne volnuytes, dlya vas tozhe est podkhodyashchiy rezhim.

* Razdelennyy ekran: kak v starye dobrye vremena. Soberite druzey na divane i odoleyte protivnikov vmeste. (Razdelennyy ekran dlya chetyrekh igrokov pri podklyuchenii dok-stantsii pristavki.)

* Issleduyte: granits net. Nu, krome verkhney polki. V kazhdom ugolke vas zhdut kredity, monety, batareyki i dazhe kollektsionnye predmety, esli u vas khvatit umeniya ikh nayti.

* Stroyte ukrepleniya i oboronyayte to, chto poklyalis zashchishchat. Stroyte tureli, lovushki i steny, a potom otbivayte ataki polchishch vooruzhennykh igrushek. Beregites tirannozavra!

* Progress. Vash malenkiy razmer ne pomeshaet vam vyglyadet kak podobaet voinu. Zarabatyvayte opyt, razblokiruyte unikalnye skiny i nastraivayte svoyu plastikovuyu figurku i oruzhie. 

* Strategii: iskusstvo oborony. Obsuzhdayte taktiku so svoim otryadom i razrabotayte luchshiy plan oborony. Komandnaya rabota ochen vazhna, esli vy khotite zarabotat nailuchshie nagrady.

* Slozhnost: vybor dlya vsey semi. Vybirayte legkiy, obychnyy ili ekspertnyy rezhim: vsyo zavisit ot vashego urovnya navykov.

* Vyigrysh za dengi nevozmozhen, potomu chto v chyom togda smysl? My tsenim nashikh igrokov i obeshchaem prislushivatsya k vashim otzyvam.

* Ofitsialnyy saundtrek: bolee 20 potryasayushchikh unikalnykh muzykalnykh kompozitsiy. Pogruzites v zhivoy i yarkiy mir igry HYPERCHARGE: UNBOXED, slushaya originalnyy saundtrek igry.

Настольная игра «Билет на поезд» предлаг:
Nastolnaya igra «Bilet na poezd» predlagaet vam prinyat uchastie v sorevnovanii po soedineniyu gorodov bystrymi zheleznodorozhnymi marshrutami!..
Igroki sobirayut karty vagonov i primenyayut ikh dlya prokhozhdeniya evropeyskikh marshrutov, stroitelstva stantsiy, preodoleniya podgornykh tunneley i vodnykh pregrad. Pered pervym khodom igroki razbirayutsya s poluchennymi marshrutami. Kazhdyy dolzhen ostavit u sebya kak minimum dva. Te, chto ne prigodilis, otpravlyayutsya v korobku; nikto ne dolzhen videt, ot kakikh kart izbavlyayutsya soperniki.
V sbros mozhno otpravit kak korotkiy marshrut, tak i dlinnyy. Esli marshrut ne sbroshen, ego pridetsya sokhranit do kontsa igry. V igre pobezhdaet tot, kto nabral bolshe vsego ochkov. Ochki nachislyayutsya za sozdanie peregona mezhdu dvumya gorodami; uspeshnoe prokhozhdenie marshruta — zavershenie nepreryvnoy tsepi peregonov mezhdu dvumya gorodami s karty marshruta; vyigrysh bonusa «Ekspress», dlya chego nado prolozhit samuyu dlinnuyu nepreryvnuyu liniyu; kazhduyu stantsiyu, ne ispolzovannuyu do kontsa partii. Za kazhdyy marshrut, kotoryy ne proyden do kontsa partii, ochki vychitayutsya.
V igre uzhe predustanovleno: bazovyy nabor Ticket to Ride — lyubimaya fanatami igra-priklyuchenie na poezde, s kotoroy vse nachalos, i Evropeyskoe rasshirenie — vklyuchaet kartu Evropy, dvukh dopolnitelnykh personazhey, dva dopolnitelnykh poezda i dva dopolnitelnykh vagona; plyus v vide DLC dostupny The Nordic Expansion, SShA 1910-1912 Ticket Pack Bundle i India Expansion i dr.

Начните ночную смену в TEREBRO INC., 198:
Nachnite nochnuyu smenu v TEREBRO INC., 1986 god. Kak nedavno naznachennyy spetsialist po otsenke riskov, vasha zadacha prosta: obespechit budushchee kompanii. No chem glubzhe vy kopaete v arkhivakh, tem strannee i trevozhnee stanovyatsya podrobnosti.
S pomoshchyu staromodnykh instrumentov, takikh kak GPS i ustroystvo kodirovki, vy budete razbirat zagadochnye dokumenty, rasshifrovyvat skrytye kody i sobirat fragmenty mrachnoy istorii kompanii. Svet nastolnoy lampy i shum radio budut soprovozhdat vas, poka napryazhenie narastaet, a zloveshchie otkrytiya vykhodyat naruzhu.
Chem glubzhe noch, tem bolshe tayn. Kakie pravdy skryvayutsya v proshlom TEREBRO INC., i chto vy reshite s nimi sdelat? Na konu reputatsiya kompanii. Stanete li vy eyo zashchitnikom — ili razrushitelem?

Khoroshiy barmen znaet, chto iskusstvo besedy ne menee vazhno, chem umenie razlivat napitki, poetomu slushayte vnimatelno i ne teryayte samoobladaniya, ocharovyvaya, a inogda dazhe ugrozhaya posetitelyam, chtoby poluchit neobkhodimuyu informatsiyu. V igre 20 personazhey, i vam predstoit opredelit, komu mozhno doveryat, kto prikroet vas… a kto naneset nozh v spinu!

Ishchite (i gotovte) inoplanetnykh sushchestv, pokoryayte zheludki klientov i prepyatstvuyte rasshireniyu zlovrednoy mezhgalakticheskoy seti burgernykh. V roli glavnogo shef-povara galaktiki, kotorym vam eshche predstoit stat vy budete iskat luchshie inoplanetnye ingredienty, gotovit iz nikh vkusneyshie blyuda i ugoshchat klientov v komfortnom kosmicheskom restoranchike, kotoryy mozhno polnostyu obustroit na svoy vkus.
— Zhiteli tumannosti Podkova slavyatsya ne tolko otlichnym appetitom. Vo vsyakom sluchae, bolshinstvo iz nikh. Vmeste s novymi druzyami vy raskroete pravdu o propavshey babushke i poboretes s korporatsiey «Galakticheskiy burger», kotoraya khochet vydavit vas s kosmicheskogo rynka.
— Gotovte bolee 140 raznykh blyud, ot prostykh shashlychkov po-domashnemu do zamyslovatogo «Tentakleyaytsevogo syurpriza». Vpechatlyayte klientov vkusnoy edoy i rastoropnym obsluzhivaniem, chtoby zarabatyvat astronomicheskie zvezdy kulinarnogo masterstva, znamenuyushchie vash put k mezhgalakticheskomu uspekhu. S rostom reputatsii rastet i kolichestvo klientov! Sokhranyayte gibkost blagodarya sluzhbe dostavki ili sosredotochtes na obsluzhivanii bespreryvnogo potoka posetiteley v zavedenii. Vy mozhete zakryt kukhnyu v lyuboy moment, pochuvstvovav zov priklyucheniy. Mozhet, vash kosmicheskiy restoranchik i ne vpechatlyaet fasadom, no vnutri nego est vse neobkhodimoe. Sozdayte interer svoey mechty blagodarya gibkoy sisteme pokraski i elementam dekora, kotorye mozhno razmeshchat kak ugodno. Dobavlyayte etazhi, oformlyayte tematicheskie zony, rasstavlyayte mebel i ukrasheniya, naydennye vo vremya stranstviy!
— Vam dostupna tselaya vselennaya ingredientov. Nekotorye iz nikh i sami ne proch polakomitsya vami. Vam vstretyatsya kosmicheskie piraty, drevnie ruiny i podozritelno mnogo nedavno zabroshennykh restoranov. Krome togo, vy budete nakhodit redkie resursy i tonny raznogo khlama dlya uluchsheniya snaryazheniya, kukhonnogo oborudovaniya i kosmicheskogo korablya. Nabiv kholodilnik ingredientami i dozhdavshis, kogda bolshaya ikh chast perestanet izvivatsya, mozhno otkryvat dveri dlya posetiteley i podavat svoi delikatesy na stol.

Ys (яп. イース И:су) — серия видеоигр, созд:
Ys (yap. イース I:su) — seriya videoigr, sozdannaya yaponskoy kompaniey Nihon Falcom. Pervaya igra vyshla na kompyutere NEC PC-8801 v 1987-om, povestvuet o priklyucheniyakh krasnovolosogo yunoshi po imeni Adol Kristin (Adol Christin).
Takzhe pochti v kazhdoy chasti emu pomogaet ego vernyy kompanon Dogi (Dogi). Na sey moment Adol uzhe pobyval na takikh kontinentakh igry, kak Esteriya (Esteria), Tseltseta (Celceta), Felgana (Felghana), Ksandriya (Xandria), ostrova Kanaan (Canaan Islands) i Altago (Altago).
V rannikh igrakh, igrok ispolzoval tolko knopku-krestovinu dzhoystika, chtoby srazhatsya. Adol v bukvalnom smysle vrezalsya vo vragov, tem samym unichtozhaya ikh. Ys III: Wanderers from Ys byla bolshe pokhozha na platformer, a-lya Zelda II, s ispolzovaniem otdelnoy knopki ataki.

Light Fairytale is a turn-based Japanese:
Light Fairytale is a turn-based Japanese-style RPG series set in a dying underground world ruled by an evil empire.

The goal of this project is to bring back the immersion and emotion of 90's era JRPGs on current platforms with the expected evolution in both design and technique.

Episode 1 is the start of the adventure. Play as Haru and his childhood friend Kuroko as they fight a dark empire in the underground 'Lower City'.

Characters

Haru
A bit lazy and a lot naive, Haru nonetheless is a kind soul and knows how to handle himself if push comes to shove.

Kuroko
She might be short and cute (sometimes), but don't let that fool you: Kuroko is exceedingly capable in battle and always willing to step up. She's also fond of technology - maaaybe a bit too much so.

Notes about the Light Fairytale series
Each episode is a standalone game, approximately 2 to 3 hours long for a first play-through, double it for a full completion of all the achievements and secrets.

Вместе с Королем исчез прежний мир. Восс:
Vmeste s Korolem ischez prezhniy mir. Vosstanavlivayte Vselennuyu v etoy mrachnoy rolevoy igre, napolnennoy bitvami na vyzhivanie, zavorazhivayushchimi lokatsiyami i vospominaniyami vyzhivshikh — vam reshat, doveryat im ili net. Vpered, k priklyucheniyam, Strannik!
Vmeste s Korolem ischez prezhniy mir. Stranniku predstoit sobrat voedino vse fragmenty realnosti i uznat, chto na samom dele privelo k padeniyu tsivilizatsii. Bitvy na vyzhivanie, zavorazhivayushchie lokatsii i vospominaniya vyzhivshikh — vam reshat, doveryat im ili net. Vam predstoit progulka po razrushennomu kontinentu sredi zabytykh istoriy i moguchikh protivnikov. Tolko khrabrye sposobny nayti v mire Gipnosa sekrety. Nekotorye iz kotorykh stanut podskazkami, a drugie — raskroyut tayny sobytiy v proshlom. Разработка проекта под кодовым названием:
Razrabotka proekta pod kodovym nazvaniem «Sonic World Adventure» nachalas v Sonic Team v 2005 godu i dlilas tri goda. Spetsialno dlya dannogo proekta byl sozdan novyy dvizhok Hedgehog Engine. Pervonachalno Sonic Unleashed planirovali sdelat prodolzheniem Sonic Adventure 2, no razrabotchiki, pereosmysliv nekotorye elementy igrovogo protsessa reshili sozdat nezavisimuyu igru pro Sonika, ostaviv pervonachalnoe nazvanie isklyuchitelno dlya yaponskogo rynka.
Vozdushnyy flot, upravlyaemyy doktorom Eggmanom, letit nad planetoy, pokhozhey na Zemlyu. Na odnom iz korabley nakhoditsya yozh Sonik, pytayushchiysya ostanovit zlodeya. Blagodarya robotu uchyonyy smog skhvatit glavnogo geroya, no tot s pomoshchyu Izumrudov Khaosa pereshyol v super-formu i atakoval zlodeya. Yozh gonitsya za Eggmanom, no v konechnom itoge popadaet v kameru-lovushku. S pomoshchyu izobreteniya doktora u glavnogo geroya vysasyvaetsya energiya Izumrudov. Ikh sila ispolzuetsya dlya moshchnoy pushki, kotoraya raskalyvaet planetu na sem chastey, a iz yadra poyavlyaetsya monstr, izvestnyy kak Tyomnyy Gayya..
Igrovoy protsess razdelyon na dve chasti: v odnoy deystvie proiskhodit v dnevnoe vremya sutok, za obychnogo Sonika, a v drugoy — nochyu, za oborotnya. Esli geympley dnevnykh urovney pokhozh na predydushchie igry serii, to nochyu yozh ne obladaet sposobnostyu bystro begat, no stanovitsya gorazdo silnee i mozhet rastyagivat ruki na bolshuyu dlinu. Odnako tsel prokhozhdeniya odinakova — Soniku nuzhno doyti do kontsa lokatsii, sobiraya po puti koltsa i unichtozhaya vragov. Posle vykhoda Sonic Unleashed poluchil kommercheskiy uspekh. Obozrevateli khvalili neplokhoy igrovoy protsess dnevnykh urovney, otlichnuyu muzyku i novyy graficheskiy dvizhok, i k mayu 2009 goda bylo prodano svyshe 2,5 millionov kopiy po vsemu miru.Drugie igry pro Sonic'a zdes.

Действие игры The Persistence разворачив:
Deystvie igry The Persistence razvorachivaetsya v 2521 godu na bortu zabroshennogo kolonialnogo korablya v glubokom kosmose. Issleduyte korabl, srazhaytes s uzhasnymi smertonosnymi sushchestvami i vedite sudno obratno na Zemlyu. Sobirayte resursy, uluchshayte sposobnosti i sozdavayte oruzhie v etoy zhestokoy nauchno-fantasticheskoy igre-khorrore.
Klyuchevye osobennosti

Smert — eto tolko nachalo
Edinstvennoe, chto meshaet spasti korabl, — eto polchishcha otvratitelnykh chudovishch, kotorykh bez ostanovki sozdaet slomannyy korabelnyy printer. Esli vstrecha s protivnikami okazhetsya dlya Zimri fatalnoy, to soznanie geroya vozroditsya v drugom tele-nositele, i vsyo nachnetsya s nachala.

Postoyanno menyayushchiysya labirint
Kolonialnyy korabl obladaet samonastraivayushcheysya makrostrukturoy, kotoraya mozhet menyat ego vnutrennyuyu arkhitekturu, a poskolku vse sistemy slomany, to imenno eto i budet proiskhodit. Probudivshis v novom klonirovannom tele ili teleportirovavshis mezhdu palubami, igrok obnaruzhit, chto korabl izmenilsya. Kazhdyy pokhod po The Persistence budet unikalnym: poyavyatsya novoe snaryazhenie i predmety, kotorye mozhno sobrat i uluchshit. 

Usilivayte, uluchshayte i dopolnyayte
Tekhnologii XXVI veka — eto geneticheskie uluchsheniya i manipulyatsii s tyomnoy materiey. Menyayte DNK Zimri, chtoby uluchshit zdorove, vynoslivost i zashchitnye sposobnosti. Vy mozhete dazhe sobirat DNK ekipazha, chtoby klonirovat drugikh lyudey s unikalnymi sposobnostyami i vselyatsya v ikh tela. 

Issleduyte korabl, pryachtes, srazhaytes i sobirayte resursy
Mutanty ne zadumyvayas porvut Zimri v klochya. Ispolzuyte osobennosti okruzhayushchey sredy, chtoby otsenit situatsiyu, sledit za protivnikom i poluchit takticheskoe preimushchestvo, a zatem libo spryatatsya, libo srazit chudovishche. Issleduyte paluby korablya i sobirayte resursy, oruzhie i nastroyki kostyuma, chtoby vyzhit vo vremya puteshestviya v uzhasnykh tyomnykh glubinakh.

Asimmetrichnyy MP-rezhim. 
Podklyuchite telefon ili planshet na IOS ili Android k igre s uchastiem do 2 igrokov, chtoby v realnom vremeni upravlyat Solex — inzhenernoy sistemoy korablya.

V etoy poshagovoy upravlencheskoy igre vy nauchites primenyat pravilnye predmety, ponimat prirodnye tsikly, a takzhe ispolzovat nastoyashchie srednevekovye stroitelnye i remeslennye tekhniki.

Postepenno postroyte tsivilizatsiyu: ot kamennykh toporov i primitivnykh khizhin — k proizvodstvu s pomoshchyu vodyanogo kolesa! Vse na osnove realnykh tekhnologiy.

Osobennosti
 — Poshagovost. Obdumyvayte sleduyushchiy shag stolko, skolko vam nuzhno. Kogda budete gotovy, prosto zavershite khod i nachnite novyy den.
 — Detalno vosproizvedennoe stroitelstvo. Vybirayte prirodnye resursy soglasno ikh svoystvam. Sozdavayte stroymaterialy na ikh osnove.
 — Realistichnye srednevekovye stroitelnye i remeslennye tekhniki. V igre oni rabotayut tak zhe, kak i v zhizni.
 — Okruzhayushchaya sreda reagiruet na vmeshatelstvo cheloveka. Vozmozhno, ne stoit kazhdyy den rybachit v odnom i tom zhe meste ili srazu vyrubat tselyy les.
 — Vyzhivanie v surovykh usloviyakh, gde buri i prochie bedstviya — norma zhizni.

Графическое приключение с головоломками:

Kogda ty voydesh, to obnaruzhish, chto eto portal, cherez kotoryy mozhno puteshestvovat vo vremeni i snova poyavishsya v svoem dome, no cherez 200 let v budushchem. Vskore ty poymesh, chto eto puteshestvie v odin konets, potomu chto ne smozhesh vernutsya nazad vo vremeni, no mozhesh puteshestvovat tolko vpered.
S etogo momenta tvoya tsel — zanovo aktivirovat portal, chtoby ty smog snova puteshestvovat i popytatsya vyyasnit, chto proiskhodit. Tebe nuzhno budet izuchit kazhdyy stsenariy, chtoby popytatsya vosstanovit energiyu portala, chtoby smoch prodolzhit svoe puteshestvie v neizvestnost.

4 игры жанра Roguelike (Rogue, Nethack,:
4 igry zhanra Roguelike (Rogue, Nethack, Angband, ToME), kotorye byli portirovany na portativnuyu konsol PSP i zapuckayutsya na Switch pri pomoshchi emulyatora PPSSPP v1-11.3-2764. Upravlenie cherez kontroller - klaviatura ne trebuetsya.
Roguelike - Kharakternymi osobennostyami klassicheskogo roguelike yavlyayutsya generiruemye sluchaynym obrazom urovni, poshagovost i neobratimost smerti personazha — v sluchae ego gibeli igrok ne mozhet zagruzit igru i dolzhen nachat eyo zanovo. Mnogie roguelike vypolneny v dekoratsiyakh epicheskogo fentezi pod silnym vliyaniem nastolnykh rolevykh igr napodobie Dungeons & Dragons.
Zhanr voskhodit k igre 1980 goda Rogue. Khotya i do neyo vykhodili podobnye igry, takie kak Beneath Apple Manor, imenno Rogue stala obraztsom dlya beschislennykh podrazhaniy. Podobnye igry, rasprostranyavshiesya v vide otkrytogo koda, byli krayne populyarny v srede amerikanskikh programmistov i studentov v 1980-kh — 1990-kh godakh. Pri nalichii mnozhestva variantov i razlichiy mezhdu otdelnymi igrami osnovnye printsipy geympleya roguelike ostavalis neizmennymi. V 2008 godu eti konservativnye printsipy byli opisany v ramkakh tak nazyvaemoy «Berlinskoy interpretatsii».

You are a weird, unpopular, ginger-heade:
You are a weird, unpopular, ginger-headed orphan, and it’s time to save the world.

You play as Coop “Go Away, Weirdo” McCarthy and all you want to do is make the world a better place. The trouble is: Nobody likes you, school sucks, you can't find a prom date, everybody bullies you (including your teachers), and your attempts to help only make things worse. Will you escape high school alive? Who will love you? Do you even deserve love? Why is this game called Freakpocalypse? Find the answers to these questions and more by looking at, talking to, and touching everything within the Cyanide & Happiness universe.

This game is part 1 of Coop’s trilogy of tragedy:
• In this point-and-click adventure, control Coop in his quest to be the hero he always wanted to be by helping the people of Netherton! Talk to, touch, and look at everything in your environment! That sexy looking clock? Ask it to prom! That rotting piece of fruit? Touch it!

Jump into the Cyanide & Happiness universe:
• Did we mention the sheer amount of fully-voiced freaks and friends you’ll see from some of your favorite animated shorts? Feast your eyes on familiar faces as you fetch, find and frolic through your environment! Meet famous folks like Ted Bear, Shark Dad, Señor Cleanfist, and more!

Help with a wide variety of side quests:
• The citizens of Netherton need help. Like, a LOT of help. Fortunately(?) for them, there’s Coop! Enjoy the full gameplay experience by finding dangerous markers, buying frozen drinks, and trying to make people less miserable! (Or at least hate you less)

Discover a plethora of costumes, easter eggs, and secrets
• Netherton is… Charming, if you look in the right places! Explore the town and discover a ton of different clothes, easter eggs and hidden details while you avoid death to freaks and bullies! Unlock special achievements for how good (or bad) you are at exploration!

Enjoy the hallmark Explosm style
• True to the signature art style, Freakpocalypse includes animated shorts that’ll bring you right back to the cartoon series that started it all! On top of that, listen to a set of catchy, original tracks that give life (or death) to your atmosphere!
• Coop's main storyline can be completed in just a few hours, but if you explore more and see all of Netherton, it can take much more than that, even days!
Bomberman — серия видеоигр и медиафранча:
Bomberman — seriya videoigr i mediafranchayz, iznachalno sozdannaya yaponskoy kompaniey Hudson Soft. Pervaya igra serii byla vypushchena v 1983 godu dlya domashnikh kompyuterov i igrovoy konsoli NES, v Evrope ona rasprostranyalas pod nazvaniem Eric and the Floaters; stala nachalom odnoimennoy serii. Proekty serii razrabatyvalis i izdavalis kak samoy Hudson Soft, tak i ryadom drugikh kompaniy i vykhodili na bolshinstve sushchestvuyushchikh igrovykh sistem.
Bolshinstvo igr serii vypolneny v zhanre arkadnogo labirinta. Igrok upravlyaet personazhem, nakhodyashchimsya v labirinte, sostoyashchem iz razrushaemykh i nerazrushaemykh sten. On mozhet ostavlyat bombu, vzryvayushchuyusya cherez nekotoroe fiksirovannoe vremya i razrushayushchuyu steny ryadom s ney. Spetsialnye bonusy mogut uvelichit kolichestvo odnovremenno ostavlyaemykh bomb, dalnost ikh vzryva, skorost peremeshcheniya geroya, dat vozmozhnost vzryva bomb po nazhatiyu knopki, nevospriimchivost ot vzryva bomb, prokhozhdenie skvoz razrushaemye steny ili skvoz sobstvennye eshche nevzorvannye bomby; na urovne prisutstvuyut protivniki.Vklyuchyonnye porty igr na libGDX:

Wolfenstein 3D — компьютерная игра в жан:
Wolfenstein 3D — kompyuternaya igra v zhanre shutera ot pervogo litsa, razrabotannaya kompaniey id Software i izdannaya 3D Realms (aka Apogee Software). Wolfenstein 3D yavlyaetsya tretey igroy v serii igr Wolfenstein — istochnikom vdokhnoveniya dlya eyo sozdateley posluzhila igra 1981 goda Castle Wolfenstein.
Igrok beryot na sebya rol razvedchika soyuznikov Vtoroy mirovoy voyny Uilyama (Bi-Dzheya) Blaskovitsa, kotoryy pytaetsya sbezhat iz mesta svoego zaklyucheniya — zamka Volfenshtayn — i vypolnyaet ryad diversionnykh zadaniy protiv natsistskogo rezhima. Na kazhdom urovne igrok dolzhen srazhatsya s natsistskimi soldatami, sobakami i mutantami, ispolzuya nozh i ognestrelnoe oruzhie.
Wolfenstein 3D poluchila priznanie u kritikov i nagrady ot zhurnalov v razlichnykh nominatsiyakh, a obyom eyo prodazh cherez god otsenivaelsya v 200 000 kopiy. Igra sposobstvovala populyarizatsii zhanra shutera ot pervogo litsa, stala obraztsom dlya bystrykh ekshen-igr i ustanovila planku tekhnologicheskogo ispolneniya dlya posleduyushchikh igr v zhanre..

A love-adventure game where you can enjo:
A love-adventure game where you can enjoy the heart-pounding roommate life of a rookie producer and a delinquent girl turned idol.

<STORY>
A young man working at an Akihabara-based agency that manages underground idol groups has been ordered to discover new idols by his boss. Now, he's at the end of his rope.

The protagonist is at a loss, finding that girls with the talent to become the kind of idol he's picturing are few and far between. He's sitting defeated on a park bench when he comes across a girl singing to herself while feeding some cats.

The girl's song is delicate, but her voice shakes him to the core. His heart stolen in an instant, the protagonist turns to the girl and tries to scout her to become an idol. However, the girl flatly refuses him, saying the idea is stupid, only to then disappear.

The next day, the protagonist gets called into the office, where he learns that the daughter of their sponsor has been hired as a member of staff and gets assigned to be her training supervisor. The girl who appears before the bewildered young man is the same one who turned down his scouting offer the day before.

The girl's name is Tsubaki Akanesaki. Though she's had several jobs, she got fired from all of them for getting into fights. What does fate have in store for a young man who's been assigned to train a girl whose a total delinquent?!

V razdache nakhoditsya nastroennyy emulyator 3DO Interactive Multiplayer na yadre Opera (byvsh. 4do) pod Retrorach c BIOS'ami plyus 3 originalnykh igry: Wolfenstein 3D, Star Control II, GEX.
3DO Interactive Multiplayer (ili prosto 3DO) — igrovaya pristavka, vypuskavshayasya v 1993—1996 gg. kompaniyami Panasonic, Sanyo, Creative i Goldstar, iznachalno razrabotannykh Dave Needle i RJ Mical iz New Technology Group. Ideya sozdaniya konsoli prinadlezhit predprinimatelyu Tripu Khoukinsu, osnovatelyu EA Games.
Na moment vypuska konsol obladala ochen prodvinutymi apparatnymi vozmozhnostyami: 32-razryadnyy protsessor ARM60 s RISC-arkhitekturoy, rabotayushchiy na chastote 12,5 MGts; dva graficheskikh soprotsessora; 16-razryadnyy tsifrovoy signalnyy protsessor i spetsialnyy matematicheskiy soprotsessor. Vse dopolnitelnye soprotsessory byli razrabotany spetsialno dlya etoy konsoli. Takzhe, konsol imela 2 megabayta OZU, 1 megabayt videopamyati, i dvukhskorostnoy CD-privod. Imelas vozmozhnost odnovremennogo podklyucheniya do 8 dzhoystikov (originalnym sposobom — v tsepochku, odin podklyuchaetsya k drugomu). Pomimo ispolzovaniya spetsialno razrabotannogo PO, konsol mogla proigryvat CD-audio (vklyuchaya podderzhku CD+G), prosmatrivat Photo CD i Video CD. Odnako, tolko neskolko igr polnostyu ispolzovali potentsial konsoli.

Gamedec – izometricheskaya RPG v zhanre kiberpank dlya odnogo igroka, ne imeyushchaya boevoy sistemy. Vy – igrovoy detektiv, rassleduyushchiy prestupleniya v virtualnykh mirakh. Sobirayte informatsiyu u svideteley i podozrevaemykh, chtoby perekhitrit zlodeev i raskryt ikh zamysly, spasti nevinnye zhizni i izuchit neobychnye otnosheniya mezhdu virtualnymi mirami i ikh zhitelyami. Igra postoyanno adaptiruetsya k vashim resheniyam, ne osuzhdaya ikh. Vas opredelyayut vashi resheniya.

Dobro pozhalovat v Varshavu XXII stoletiya. Tekhnologii razvity nastolko, chto termin «realnoe» stal otnositelnym, a u slov «zhizn» i «smert» est mnozhestvo smyslov. Virtualnye miry porozhdayut realnye problemy: pokhot, len, zavist i gordynyu. Zhitelyam virtualnykh igrovykh mirov nuzhny osobye spetsialisty – chastnye detektivy, chey opyt pozvolyaet nakhodit tayny igrovykh mirov i izuchat ikh skrytye mekhaniki za gonorar ot klientov. Vy – odin iz takikh detektivov. Vy – geymdek.

Osnovnye osobennosti Gamedec:

Vzaimodeystvuyte s personazhami, sobirayte dannye i poluchayte dostup k razlichnym variantam dialoga v zavisimosti ot prinyatykh resheniy, umeniy i znaniy.

Puteshestvuyte po razlichnym virtualnym miram: ot obmanchivoy fermy do mrachnogo nuar-kiberpanka i fentezi.

Rabotayte s faktami i dokazatelstvami i raskryvayte zagadki pri pomoshchi kodeksa i deduktsii. Obshchaytes s personazhami, rukovodstvuyas etikoy, otkrytostyu ili mstitelnostyu.

Razvivayte personazha cherez deystviya, kotorye okazyvayut polozhitelnoe ili otritsatelnoe vliyanie. Opredelite, kak ego budut vosprinimat drugie personazhi, vybrav cherty, podkhodyashchie dlya vashego stilya igry. Sozdayte sobstvennogo geymdeka pri pomoshchi resheniy i deystviy.

Znakomtes s personazhami kak v realnosti, tak i v virtualnykh mirakh. Oni mogut byt nastroeny i druzhelyubno, i vrazhdebno v zavisimosti ot togo, kakie resheniya vy prinyali.

X-COM: UFO Defense (с англ. в США — «Ком:
X-COM: UFO Defense (s angl. v SShA — «Komanda Iks: Zashchita ot NLO», v Evrope byla pod nazvaniem UFO: Enemy Unknown («NLO: Vrag nevedom») — kompyuternaya videoigra, razrabotannaya kompaniey Mythos Games, izdannaya v marte 1994 goda MicroProse dlya PK MS-DOS i Amiga i v 1995 godu dlya konsoli PlayStation.
Iznachalno byla razrabotana Dzhulianom Gollopom v kachestve sikvela Laser Squad, igry 1988 goda ot Mythos Games. X-COM sochetaet zhanry simulyatora stroitelstva i upravleniya, poshagovoy strategii i takticheskoy rolevoy igry. Igrok vypolnyaet rol komandira X-COM — taynoy mezhdunarodnoy voenizirovannoy organizatsii, zashchishchayushchey Zemlyu ot inoplanetnogo vtorzheniya. Vo vremya poshagovykh takticheskikh missiy porucheno otdavat prikazy otdelnym boevym edinitsam X-COM, nakhodyashchimsya na pole boya, v strategicheskom zhe masshtabe upravlyaet issledovaniem i razrabotkoy novykh tekhnologiy, stroit i rasshiryaet bazy X-COM, upravlyaet finansami i personalom organizatsii, i nakonets, kontroliruet deyatelnost NLO i reagiruet na neyo. Proekt poluchil khoroshie otzyvy i byla kommercheski uspeshnoy, zavoevav populyarnost sredi poklonnikov strategiy; neskolko izdaniy vklyuchili X-COM: UFO Defense v spiski luchshikh videoigr za vse vremya, vklyuchaya IGN, nazvavshiy eyo v 2007 godu luchshey PK-igroy vsekh vremyon.

Greak — glavnyy geroy igry i samyy mladshiy iz troitsy. On predstavitel volshebnoy rasy Courine, kotoruyu pytaetsya zakhvatit fraktsiya Urlag.

Choose your own route around the world,:
Choose your own route around the world, travelling by airship, submarine, mechanical camel, steam-train and more, racing other players and a clock that never stops in TIME Magazine's #1 Game of the Year 2014, now on Nintendo Switch™.

Featuring stunning art by Jaume Illustration, a half-million word script by Meg Jayanth and Jon Ingold, original music by Laurence Chapman, 80 DAYS is an interactive adventure created by your choices, on the fly, and is different every time you play.

Playing as Phileas Fogg's loyal valet, Passepartout, you must balance your master's health, your finances, and the time, as you choose your own path from city to city all the way around the world. Bribe your way onto early departures, but don't let yourself go bankrupt or you'll be sleeping rough and begging for aid! Trade items for profit, and collect the equipment for the conditions you'll face: but too much luggage will slow you down...

80 DAYS is a breakneck race, with an in-game clock that never stops running. Trains, steamers, hot-air balloons, boats, camels, horses and more leave and arrive minute by minute. 

Every city and journey is narrated via an interactive story where you control every action. Will your choices speed you up - or lead you into disaster? Will you earn Fogg's trust and respect? Will you uncover the secrets and short-cuts that can shave days off your time? Murder, romance, rebellion and intrigue await!
