The Swords of Ditto: Mormo's Curse — nezamyslovataya igra v zhanre Action RPG. Igraya za raznykh personazhey, vy stanete geroem udivitelnykh sobytiy, srazhayas protiv kovarnoy kolduni Mormo! V etom krasochnom mire opasnosti tayatsya na kazhdom shagu; vam predstoit khrabro srazhatsya v podzemelyakh, uluchshat svoego geroya v zacharovannykh derevnyakh i nayti istochnik zla, oskvernyayushchiy ostrov! Dostavayte iz nozhen legendarnyy Mech Ditto, priglashayte druzey i otpravlyaytes v nezabyvaemoe priklyuchenie navstrechu ocharovatelnym personazham, neobychnoy dobyche i geroicheskim srazheniyam!

Tsepochka udivitelnykh priklyucheniy: kazhdoe priklyuchenie stanovitsya legendoy i otlichaetsya ot predydushchego, a vse vmeste oni spletayutsya v udivitelnuyu istoriyu, chto budet peredavatsya iz pokoleniya v pokolenie! Deyaniya, uspekh i neudachi kazhdogo geroya povliyayut na istoriyu i na tekh, kto budet sleduyushchim: naprimer, eto otrazitsya na sposobnosti k poisku oruzhiya ili vosstanovlenii dobychi posle neudach gore-geroev.
 
Odinochnoe prokhozhdenie i mnogopolzovatelskiy rezhim: srazhaytes s Mormo i ee armiey zla v odinochku ili prizovite k oruzhiyu svoego khrabrogo druga i vpishite svoi imena v istoriyu, igraya v lokalnom mnogopolzovatelskom rezhime. Esli vy chuvstvuete, chto nedostatochno silny dlya priklyucheniya, ne boytes — vas spaset chudodeystvennaya sila obyatiy! 
 
Oruzhie, predmety i stikery: ispolzuyte traditsionnuyu kombinatsiyu «mech + luk» ili zhe zapustite v protivnika vinilovuyu plastinku-frisbi. Ili magicheskuyu klyushku dlya golfa. Ili ogromnuyu nebesnuyu stupnyu? V borbe s Mormo vse sredstva khoroshi! Legiony tmy, zavidev vas, brosyatsya nautek. Sobirayte i ispolzuyte stikery, chtoby prokachat kharakteristiki vashego geroya, uluchshit snaryazhenie i stat dostatochno silnym dlya izgnaniya zloy kolduni!
 
Osnovnye zadaniya i sekretnye missii: vy sami tvorite istoriyu! Srazhaytes v tekh podzemelyakh, kotorye vam nravyatsya, vypolnyayte dopolnitelnye missii v temnykh tonnelyakh i glubokikh katakombakh ili s samogo pervogo dnya broste vyzov Mormo.
Unbound: Worlds Apart – захватывающий ат:
Unbound: Worlds Apart – zakhvatyvayushchiy atmosfernyy platformer-golovolomka, narisovannyy vruchnuyu. Ego deystvie razvorachivaetsya vo vselennoy, gde vse miry soedineny portalami. Vy upravlyaete Soli, odarennym rebenkom s magicheskim darom, chto mozhet otkryvat portaly i upravlyat unikalnymi svoystvami kazhdogo mira, takimi kak obratnaya gravitatsiya, manipulyatsii so vremenem, supersila i mnogoe drugoe.

Ispolzuya svoi novye navyki, Soli otpravlyaetsya v put po opasnym i zagadochnym miram, kazhdyy iz kotorykh napolnen taynami i prepyatstviyami. Vy dolzhny ispolzovat vse sposobnosti Soli, chtoby pobedit bezzhalostnoe zlo, razryvayushchee realnost, i parallelno uznat shokiruyushchuyu pravdu o krakhe vashego mira.

Igrovoy protsess
V Unbound: Worlds Apart vashi refleksy, reaktsiya i navyki igry v platformery budut podvergnuty strozhayshey proverke. Igraya za Soli, vy smozhete issledovat ogromnye miry, polnye tayn, sekretov i razblokiruemykh navykov, kotorye pomogut otkryvat kartu po mere vashego prodvizheniya.

Po puti vy vstretite mnozhestvo strannykh, chudesnykh i kovarnykh personazhey, u kazhdogo iz kotorykh est svoya bogataya predystoriya, i s kotorymi mozhno vstupit v dialog. Vypolnyaya ikh kvesty ili slushaya ikh rasskazy o nadezhde i skorbi, vy uznaete bolshe o velikoy vselennoy mirov Unbound i portalakh, chto ikh soedinyayut.

Osobennosti:
• 10 raznykh portalov s unikalnymi mekhanikami
• Yarkiy, detalizirovannyy mir, narisovannyy vruchnuyu
• Platformer na reaktsiyu s novymi navykami, kotorye nuzhno razblokirovat
• Golovolomki, lovushki, monstry i bossy, kotorye zastavyat popotet
• Nasyshchennye i interesnye narrativ, lor i personazhi
• Potaynye sekrety, kvesty i raznye veshchitsy, kotorye mozhno sobirat
«Я усталый, старый клоун,\nЯ машу мечом:
«Ya ustalyy, staryy kloun,
Ya mashu mechom kartonnym,
I v luchakh moey korony
Umiraet svetoch dnya…» ©
Luchshie druzya, Sok i Shut razrabatyvayut ochen khitryy plan, chtoby ukrast «Korolevskiy brilliant»!..
Chtoby ispolnit svoy plan, oni obyazany pokazat improvizirovannoe teatralnoe predstavlenie i prevzoyti vse ostalnye vystupleniya, vklyuchaya stsenu svoikh sopernikov, Khofnara i Boka. Tolko predstaviv luchshiy spektakl vo vsyom vladenii oni poluchat priglashenie na Korolevskoe teatralnoe predstavlenie, v Korolevskom dvortse, gde korol khranit svoy samyy-samyy dragotsennyy kamen.
Oni otpravyatsya v grandioznoe priklyuchenie po fenteziynomu korolevstvu, vstretyat mnozhestvo strannykh personazhey, ustroyat improvizirovannye vystupleniya — i spoyut ot vsego serdtsa! Po puti neprednamerenno otkroyut dlya sebya svobodu i radost muzykalnogo teatra. Soydyot li para so svoego porochnogo puti, ili sdelaet vsyo vozmozhnoe, chtoby razbogatet?
Stolen Realm – это пошаговая ролевая стр:
Stolen Realm – eto poshagovaya rolevaya strategiya v neobychnom mire, iz kotorogo byli ukradeny tselye fragmenty v vide gorodov, lesov, shakht i podzemeliy. Gruppe druzey pridetsya nayti sledy drevney magii, vyuchit zaklinaniya, progulyatsya po zakoldovannym mestam i vernut pokhishchennye oskolki mira na svoi mesta.
Odnako perekhitrit zlykh protivnikov budet ochen slozhno i igrokam pridetsya postroit svoy sobstvennyy volshebnyy dom..
Poshagovyy igrovoy protsess podderzhivaet sovmestnoe prokhozhdenie na shesterykh strategov, vybirayushchikh tot ili inoy klass: Volshebnika, Vora ili Boytsa. Kazhdyy personazh imeet svoi kharakteristiki i drevo navykov, a s pomoshchyu gibkoy nastroyki umeniy mozhno sostavit predpochitaemyy «bild» geroya. Naprimer, pri ispolzovanii svetonosnogo mecha poluchaemyy vami uron osleplyaet vashikh zhe protivnikov!
Уютный и милый симулятор с открытым миро:
Uyutnyy i milyy simulyator s otkrytym mirom gorodskoy zhizni s myagkim yumorom i prichudlivym sharmom, gde vy raspakovyvaete korobki, obustraivaete kvartiru, znakomites s sosedyami i postepenno stanovites chastyu zhivogo megapolisa — Garland.
Issleduyte gorod, berite na sebya razlichnye podrabotki i rabotayte s mestnymi soobshchestvami, chtoby uluchshit vash rayon prozhivaniya. Aktsent na nebolshikh, no znachimykh deystviyakh pridaet igre rasslablyayushchee oshchushchenie, pobuzhdaya k spokoynomu i vdumchivomu podkhodu kazhdogo igrovogo dnya.
Gorod naselyon 22 zhitelyami so svoimi lichnostyami, iz kotorykh 18 dostupny dlya romanticheskikh otnosheniy. Vy mozhete podruzhitsya ili porugatsya s nimi etikh personazhey cherez spetsialnye sobytiya, nablyudaya za tem, kak razvorachivayutsya ikh tshchatelno vypisannye istorii!..
Напившись до зюзиков с байкером-волшебни:
Napivshis do zyuzikov s baykerom-volshebnikom, ty, glavnyy geroy nashey istorii, prosnulsya s privideniem v svoey posteli! Ee prizrachnyy khvost prikovan tsepyu k tvoey noge, i ona tak zhe napugana, kak i ty! Vy mozhete tryastis, bitsya, krichat, pinat i orat skolko ugodno, no est tolko odin sposob osvoboditsya ot etikh strannykh uz. Ty dolzhen v nee vlyubitsya. Chuvstvo ne obyazatelno dolzhno byt vzaimnym.
 
Stoit li vlyublyatsya v togo, kto tebya brosit? U tebya kogda-nibud byl vybor? Mozhesh li ty khotya by popytatsya poveselitsya, poka vse eto dlitsya? Ili prosto slishkom slozhno pustit vse na samotek?
Постарайтесь остаться человеком в мире м:
Postaraytes ostatsya chelovekom v mire mashin. Vam predstoit igrat za Linu — poslednyuyu taksistku Los-Okhosa. Vasha luchshaya podruga propala, u vas net ni deneg, ni kryshi nad golovoy, i vam ostaetsya tolko kolesit po ulitsam chuzhogo goroda. Vybirayte passazhirov, reshayte, kak sebya s nimi vesti, chtoby bolshe o nikh uznat. Podderzhivayte reyting, chtoby ne ostatsya bez raboty. Pomogayte drugim, no ne zabyvayte o svoikh chuvstvakh, vozmozhno, kto-to pomozhet i vam. 


V mire, gde pravyat mashiny, slozhno ostavatsya chelovekom.  

Znakomtes. Slushayte istorii passazhirov. I glavnoe — budte chelovekom! 

Prilozhenie Neo Cab pomogaet vybirat passazhirov i pokazyvaet dorogu. Obshchaytes s klientami, poka vy edete po marshrutu. Zabottes o svoem reytinge, chtoby ne vyletet s raboty. Uchites ne postupatsya svoimi chuvstvami radi deneg ili iz zhelaniya ugodit drugim. I postaraytes reshit, chto vazhnee: vashe dushevnoe zdorove ili zvezdnyy reyting?

Nakhodite podkhod: ishchite sposoby vyzvat doverie — u kazhdogo passazhira svoya istoriya. 

Raskryvayte tayny Los-Okhosa: chtoby vyzhit, Lina postoyanno kolesit po gorodu. V doroge ona smozhet uznat nemalo tayn. 

Ishchite balans mezhdu svoimi emotsiyami i nuzhdami passazhira: kazhdyy paks deystvuet na Linu po-svoemu, i sledit za ee dushevnym zdorovem pridetsya vam — kak i za ee dokhodami i reytingom.  

Naydite svoyu dorogu: Neo Cab — razvetvlennaya istoriya, sozdannaya takimi avtorami, kak Li Aleksandr, Kim Beleyr, Bruno Dias, Dunkan Fayf, Rola Rodzhers i Robin Sloun.
Wild West Crops — это мини-метроидвания:
Wild West Crops — eto mini-metroidvaniya v stile retro, rasskazyvayushchaya istoriyu El Gatito, krutogo kota, kotoryy boretsya s mutantami-rasteniyami, chtoby spasti Myautaun.

Odnazhdy mirnoy nochyu, pokhozhey na lyubuyu druguyu noch v Myautaune, na gorodskie plantatsii vnezapno upal gigantskiy radioaktivnyy meteorit, prevrativ posevy v mutantov, voznamerivshikhsya unichtozhit vse vokrug sebya. Teper El Gatito dolzhen spasti gorod ot etoy uzhasnoy rastitelnoy ugrozy!

Igraya za El Gatito, vy budete puteshestvovat po mnogochislennym lokatsiyam perioda Dikogo Zapada v poiskakh moshchnykh predmetov, kotorye pomogut vam pobedit svoikh vragov.


Kharakteristiki
* Razlichnye stseny Dikogo Zapada
* Krasochnaya 8-bitnaya grafika
* Likhaya muzyka v stile Dikogo Zapada
* Razlichnye spetsialnye predmety s poleznymi sposobnostyami
* Epicheskie srazheniya s bossami
«Профессор Лейтон и загадочный городок»:
«Professor Leyton i zagadochnyy gorodok» — pervaya priklyuchencheskaya igra v serii o pokhozhdeniyakh professora Leytona, razrabotannaya i vypushchennaya v Yaponii studiey Level-5, a za predelami Yaponii izdannaya kompaniey Nintendo.
Syuzhet povestvuet o professore arkheologii Khershele Leytone i ego uchenike Lyuke Traytone. Leytona, kak izvestnogo syshchika, priglashayut v gorodok Seynt-Mistir dlya rassledovaniya dela o zagadochnom zaveshchanii barona Avgusta, kotoryy zaveshchal vsyo svoyo nasledstvo tomu, kto otyshchet nekoe «Zolotoe yabloko». Igrok, upravlyaya professorom, issleduet gorodok, obshchaetsya s ego zhitelyami i pytaetsya raskryt taynu zagadochnogo nasledstva. Gorozhane ochen chasto zadayut neznakomtsam zagadki, kotorye igroku prikhoditsya reshat. Izryadnoe kolichestvo igrovogo vremeni udeleno imenno resheniyu zagadok.
Proekt byl polozhitelno otsenyon kritikami, poluchil nagrady, emu soputstvoval krupnyy kommercheskiy uspekh. Igra byla teplo vstrechena igrovoy pressoy; reytingi na saytakh-agregatorakh GameRankings i Metacritic sostavili 86,17% i 85/100 sootvetstvenno, resursy khvalili igru za uspeshnuyu kombinatsiyu zhanrov. Vneshniy vid igry, v chastnosti evropeyskiy stil, koloritnye personazhi i kachestvennye animatsionnye roliki, byl vysoko otsenyon bolshinstvom zhurnalistov. «Besshovnoe sliyanie golovolomok, priklyucheniy i uvlekatelnoy istorii», — tak otozvalsya portal GameSpot. Na territorii Yaponii bylo prodano svyshe milliona kopiy igry, i posle perevoda na angliyskiy v mire prodali eshchyo bolee tryokh millionov, tem samym Professor Layton and the Curious Village zanimaet 17 mesto sredi samykh prodavaemykh igr na Nintendo DS i vtoroe sredi igr, vyshedshikh v 2007 godu.
Layton's Mystery Journey Katrielle and the Millionaires' Conspiracy sm. zdes.
Главная героиня по имени Фэй, будучи пре:
Glavnaya geroinya po imeni Fey, buduchi predstavitelnitsey drevnego roda okhotnikov na demonov, vmeste so svoimi druzyami zanimaetsya rassledovaniem strannykh yavleniy, svyazannykh s demonami i zhutkimi misticheskimi ritualami.
Boi v Demonschool predstavleny v vide poshagovoy taktiki, a v pereryvakh mezhdu boyami igroki budut zhit obychnoy zhiznyu studentov, vystraivat vzaimootnosheniya. Vozmozhnost zavodit romany u takzhe nikto ne otbiraet!..
Изо дня в день вы ведете однообразную од:
Izo dnya v den vy vedete odnoobraznuyu odinokuyu zhizn v kholodnom, perenaselennom, stremitelno razrastayushchemsya gorode. Vmeste s bezlikoy tolpoy vy kazhdyy den otpravlyaetes na rabotu v gigantskuyu korporatsiyu i sidite v ofise do pozdney nochi, a ot raboty vas otvlekayut tolko bessmyslennye soobshcheniya na mobilnom. Vy ne ponimaete, zachem vse eto. No odnazhdy — kogda vy vnov otpravlyaetes na rabotu — vse menyaetsya. 

Mosaic — mrachnoe, atmosfernoe syurrealisticheskoe priklyuchenie ob odinochestve v gorode i o tom, kak strashno byt vintikom v gigantskoy, ne poddayushcheysya osmysleniyu mashine. 

Studiya Krillbite Studio, izuchavshaya detskie koshmary v igre Among the Sleep, teper reshila obratitsya k chudovishchnomu odinochestvu vzrosloy zhizni.
Catie in MeowmeowLand — это классическая:
Catie in MeowmeowLand — eto klassicheskaya yumoristicheskaya priklyuchencheskaya igra v zhanre "ukazhi i shchelkni". Syuzhet razvorachivaetsya v chudesnom i strannom mire, polnom koshek i smeshnykh personazhey.

Keyti gulyala v svoem sadu, kogda poyavilsya strannyy belyy kotik. Devochka poshla za nim i ochutilas v strannom mire pod nazvaniem "Myaulyandiya". Teper ey nuzhno nayti dorogu domoy. Pomogite Keyti spravitsya s etoy zadachey!

* Myaulyandiya — eto strannyy mir, gde vy vstretites s neozhidannymi personazhami v samykh nepredskazuemykh situatsiyakh.
* Pomogayte Keyti reshat originalnye golovolomki i gotovtes k vnezapnym i absurdno smeshnym situatsiyam.
* Minuyte bolshe 24 chudesnykh, narisovannykh ot ruki 2D-peyzazhey, vstrette bolshe sotni zabavnykh personazhey i polyubuytes ocharovatelnoy 2D-animatsiey, kotoraya idet v obshchey slozhnosti bolshe dvukh chasov.
* Poslushayte originalnye smeshnye golosa vsekh personazhey i unikalnuyu muzyku.
* Nikakikh skuchnykh tablichek s tekstom: vse personazhi obshchayutsya v vynoskakh, vypolnennykh v stile lineynogo risunka.

Pri podderzhke finansirovaniya slovatskogo khudozhestvennogo soveta
Станьте загадочным героем, оказавшимся в:
Stante zagadochnym geroem, okazavshimsya v lovushke podzemnogo, i (kazalos by!), zabroshennogo mira. Chtoby raskryt vse ego tayny, vam predstoit podnyatsya po ego nedr, stalkivayas so vsyo bolee slozhnymi ispytaniyami: issleduyte chyornye dyry, kotorye perenesut vas v dikovinnye mesta, upravlyayte svoimi skudnymi resursami i sozdavaya podruchnykh-robotov, kotorye pomogut vam v vashem priklyuchenii! Smozhete li vy raskryt pravdu, skrytuyu v tenyakh Podzemelya, i nayti svyot, chto prolozhit put na poverkhnost?..
Uluchshayte svoego personazha, ispolzuya opyt i sluchaynye predmety, kotorye vy obnaruzhite v svoikh issledovaniyakh. Kazhdoe prokhozhdenie podarit vam svezhiy opyt: vospolzuytes uluchshennymi navykami, uchas im po mere prodvizheniya pod zemlyoy, chtoby vsyo bolee umelo reshat postavlennye zadachi.
Intriguyushche povestvovatelnoe priklyuchenie: pogruzites v mrachnoe tyomnoe priklyuchenie, gde kazhdyy vash shag priblizhaet k vykhodu na poverkhnost!
Музыкальная игра, наполненная 385 тщател:
Muzykalnaya igra, napolnennaya 385 tshchatelno otobrannymi kompozitsiyami izo vsekh igr serii FINAL FANTASY.

♪ Bolshaya podborka muzyki iz FINAL FANTASY
Igra vklyuchaet v sebya populyarnye kompozitsii iz 46 raznykh igr, v tom chisle noveyshuyu muzyku iz osnovnoy serii FFI - FFXV, remeykov, pobochnykh igr i albomov na kompakt-diskakh.
Naslazhdaytes zakhvatyvayushchimi bitvami, yarkimi emotsiyami, a takzhe prekrasnoy muzykoy i videoklipami.

♪ Voydite v ritm 
Nazhimayte knopki v takt muzyke, chtoby sovershat razlichnye deystviya na trekh raznykh tipakh stsen. Blagodarya prostomu upravleniyu i chetyrem raznym urovnyam slozhnosti igra dostupna lyubomu polzovatelyu bez podgotovki.
Vdobavok, vy mozhete igrat vmeste s drugom na odnoy konsoli, ispolzuya kontroller Joy-Con™.

♪ Igra cherez Internet s podderzhkoy do 4 igrokov
Predstavlyaem burnye setevye bitvy Multi Battle, v kotorykh vse igrayut so vsemi! Sryvayte plany sopernikov i tshchatelno obdumyvayte svoi deystviya, chtoby izmenit rasklad sil v svoyu polzu i oderzhat pobedu.
Zakonchiv bitvu, ne zabudte obmenyatsya kartami ProfiCard!

♪ Soberite komandu mechty iz 104 raznykh geroev.
Poznakomtes s "kavaynymi" versiyami klassicheskikh personazhey i monstrov iz zamechatelnoy rolevoy serii, gotovykh tantsevat pod vashu muzyku. Soberite i natreniruyte svoyu komandu, chtoby pobezhdat na lyubykh stsenakh.

♪ Naslazhdaytes muzykoy i video
V igre takzhe predusmotreny rezhimy pleera i kinoteatra, pozvolyayushchie spokoyno slushat muzyku i smotret videoklipy v svoe udovolstvie.
Вместе с Orbitblazers ты поучаствуешь в:
Vmeste s Orbitblazers ty pouchastvuesh v futuristicheskikh sportivnykh gonkakh vysshego klassa, kotorykh tebe v podobnom vide eshche ne dovodilos vstrechat! 
Ty smozhesh s golovokruzhitelnoy skorostyu skolzit po futuristicheskim trassam i preodolevat vse prepyatstviya na svoem puti! Ty budesh gospodstvovat na gonochnom treke kak v rezhime odinochnoy igry, tak i v rezhime igry vdvoem.
Jump-’n’-Roll… Jump-’n’-Drive… Jump-’n’ Fly…  Jump-’n’ Shoot!...
Orbitblazers – eto stremitelnyy i trebovatelnyy arkadnyy gonochnyy sport. Sadis za shturval svoego kosmicheskogo korablya i pokazhi, na chto ty sposoben! Kuvyrkaysya, ezdi, skolzi ili leti po voskhititelnym kosmicheskim dorogam! Preodolevay vse prepyatstviya i, esli ponadobitsya, prolozhi svoy put k pobede! Prygay s platformy na platformu, nakhodya pri etom vozmozhnost bystro i bezopasno preodolevat slozhnye uchastki marshruta. Skolzi po raznoobraznym tsvetovym polyam i soberi kak mozhno bolshe poleznykh predmetov. Potomu chto dobratsya do finisha ty smozhesh, tolko esli ty dostatochno khorosh.
Arkadnoe igrovoe udovolstvie chistoy vody!
•	V odnopolzovatelskom rezhime ty kataeshsya po 4 galaktikam s obshchim kolichestvom trekov bolee 20, chtoby dostich samogo bystrogo vremeni ili maksimalno vozmozhnogo kolichestva ochkov!
•	V mnogopolzovatelskom rezhime ty odnovremenno srazhaeshsya za pobedu s drugim igrokom! 
•	Naslazhdaysya plavnostyu grafiki i fantasticheskimi vizualnymi effektami!   
Onlayn reytingi igrokov! 
•	Pokazhi miru, naskolko ty khorosh, i sorevnuysya s luchshimi igrokami! Brosay vyzov svoim protivnikam i pobey vse rekordy!
Ty gotov prinyat vyzov?
•	Nachni pryamo seychas i pokazhi, na chto ty sposoben!
ТРОГДОР! — это весёлая аркадная игра, ос:
TROGDOR! — eto vesyolaya arkadnaya igra, osnovannaya na pokhozhdeniyakh personazha-drakona Trogdora iz Strong Bad Email. Trogdor davit krestyan i szhigaet doma, izbegaya pri etom rytsarey i luchnikov.
V rolyakh (v poryadke poyavleniya): Trogdor, Peres, Khakvort, Stiv, Krasnyy i siniy rytsari, Siamskie luchniki, Strong Plokhoy, Kerrek. A nochyu est vremya dlya... Trogdora!
Khotya v originalnuyu igru po-prezhnemu mozhno igrat v onlayne na sovremennykh ustroystvakh blagodarya HTML5, imenno etot proekt napravlen na rasshirenie originalnoy versii novymi funktsiyami i mnogoplatformennymi bibliotekami, kotorye pozvolyayut nativno portirovat ee na shirokiy spektr sistem: PSP, Wii U, Wii, Gamecube, 3DS, PS Vita, PK i Nintendo Switch.
Соберите своих друзей или в одиночку при:
Soberite svoikh druzey ili v odinochku prisoedinyaytes k proslavlennomu kosmicheskomu flotu v etoy vesyoloy astroigre!
Cmozhete li vy spravitsya s katastrofoy i uderzhivat svoy korabl dostatochno dolgo, chtoby spastis ot vrazheskikh zakhvatchikov? Remontiruyte sistemy, tushite pozhary, vooruzhayte torpedami oruzhie, izbegayte smertelnykh solnechnykh vspyshek, kloniruyte druzey — eto obychnaya zhizn Katastronavta!
«Maskerada» – takticheskaya rolevaya igra. Boy v rezhime realnogo vremeni mozhno postavit na pauzu. Po khodu razvitiya syuzheta etoy sagi o taynakh masok, vam pridetsya ne raz brosit vyzov khitroumnym buntovshchikam i feyam.

Prekrasnyy gorod Chitte della Ombre rasterzan na chasti grazhdanskoy voynoy, ego zhiteli ne znayut very. Tolko pesni o deyaniyakh cheloveka khranyat ego nasledie posle smerti. Te, kto obladayut khotya by maloy tolikoy vlasti, delayut vse, chto ot nikh zavisit, daby pesni ikh zhili v vekakh. Maskeriny, daruyushchie ikh nositelyam vlast nad stikhiyami i razrushitelnuyu magiyu, tolko podlivayut masla v ogon. 

Imenno maskeriny sozdali kulturu neravenstva, v kotoroy vse bogatstva i vlast nakhodyatsya v rukakh zhadnykh gildiy. Pravyashchiy klass, maskerada, vladeet maskami, a prostolyudiny, kontadani, vynuzhdeny zhit v nishchete. Vosstanie, podnyatoe kontadani, pokhitivshimi maski u bogachey, privelo k zatyazhnoy grazhdanskoy voyne i rostu nedoveriya mezhdu zhitelyami Chitte. 

Znamenityy sledovatel Ombre, Chichero Gavar, pyat let tomu nazad byl izgnan za prestuplenie. No seychas ego prizyvayut v Ombre, chtoby raskryt zagadochnoe pokhishchenie diplomata Razitofa Azrusa. K rassledovaniyu prisoedinyayutsya chleny maskerady. Vseobshchaya atmosfera podozreniya meshaet soratnikam doveryat drug drugu, i vse zhe im pridetsya polozhitsya na tovarishchey, ved v Ombre zreet novyy zagovor. 

OSOBENNOSTI:

• Srazhaytes v svoem tempe: takticheskaya pauza pozvolyaet v goryachke boya rasstavit svoy otryad i splanirovat ataki soyuznikov.
• Primenyayte metki: nalozhite na svoikh protivnikov metki stikhiy i aktiviruyte ikh pri pomoshchi drugikh stikhiy. 
• Naslazhdaytes estetikoy frantsuzskikh komiksov: trekhmernye personazhi velikolepno smotryatsya na fone priglushennykh tonov ulits i domov.
• Poluchayte udovolstvie ot ozvucheniya: vse dvenadtsat chasov syuzhetnoy linii ozvucheny takimi professionalnymi akterami kak Mettyu Merser i Dzhennifer Kheyl.
Bear With Me, сериальная бродилка в стил:
Bear With Me, serialnaya brodilka v stile nuar, vozvrashchaetsya! Vstrechayte prikvel Bear With Me: The Lost Robots s uchastiem Flinta, brata Ember, i syshchika Teda I. Bera.

Posetite podzemele Peyper-siti, gde zhdut novye personazhi i predystoriya pervykh tryokh glav igry Bear With Me.

Geroyam nuzhno nayti uliki dlya raskrytiya eshchyo bolee zloveshchey tayny. Igra Bear With Me polna doprosov, perepalok i golovolomok; v ney priyatnaya muzyka, interesnaya istoriya i dvukhmernaya grafika v stile nuar. Reshite sudbu geroev!
Poor Molly! A sculptor’s apprentice curs:
Poor Molly! A sculptor’s apprentice cursed into a snake-haired Medusa – and so, every living thing she goes near instantly turns into a stone statue. Every living thing! Enemies and friends, bosses and shopkeepers, monsters and allies, even animals and small insects, they all turn to stone.

Molly’s quest takes her through a series of mystical temples, as she struggles with loneliness and alienation. Inside these temples, gravity is “local”. Molly’s “down” is calculated from the surface she’s currently standing on, which means she can easily walk up walls, or upside down in the ceiling. This allows the level design to twist in on itself, and curl into labyrinths that are physically impossible. Petrified enemies accompany gravity puzzles and non-euclidean architecture, in M. C. Escher scavenger hunts.
Urban Cards - свежий взгляд на жанр созд:
Urban Cards - svezhiy vzglyad na zhanr sozdaniya kolod, gde vasha tsel - zarabatyvat dengi bystree chem vash opponent, ne zabyvaya o svoyom dolge i vragakh.
V dannom rogalike kartochnykh srazheniy vy srazites s akulolyudom, razrabotchikami, kreditorami, gangsterami kazino... I, nakonets, protivostoite ugnetayushchey vlasti Pravitelstva.

Sama igra yavlyaetsya satiroy s 3 fraktsiyami i igrovymi stilyami na vybor.

Oper: tsarstvo generalnogo direktora-millionera, kostyuma trudogolika i opasnoy akuley ulybki rostovshchika. Khot on i osleplyon shchedrymi bonusami, budte ostorozhny s ego svirepym appetitom k dolgam.

Akibara: dolina tekhnologiy kontroliruemaya geymerami, khakerami i neonovymi ognyami. Zdes na dannykh drugikh lyudey delayutsya sostoyaniya bitkoinov, za etim vsem prismatrivaet starshiy brat.

Gaztaun: odnovremenno s upravleniem ulitsami, bednye i zabytye zhiteli umeyut sabotirovat svoego protivnika, vorovat u ego biznesa. Eta fraktsiya "sdelay ili umri" ne uklonyaetsya ot zdorovoy dozy fizicheskogo nasiliya dlya dostizheniya svoikh tseley.

Osobennosti:
Soberite i otredaktiruyte svoyu kolodu iz razlichnykh 138 kart.
Vyberite iz tryokh raznykh fraktsiy so svoimi nachalnymi kolodami: Oper, Akibara, Gaztaun.
Tshchatelno upravlyayte razlichnymi tipami imeyushchikhsya kart: Biznesy, Rabochie, Prispeshniki, Deystviya i Predmety.
Primite vyzov i prolozhite put po protsedurno-sgenerirovannoy kampanii s 20+ Sobytiyami i mnozhestvom chasov reigrabelnosti.
Bolee desyatka vragov budet stoyat na vashem puti k uspekhu, ot bossov band do otaku i kreditorov. Prigotovtes svergnut samogo bolshogo moshennika sredi nikh - Pravitelstvo!
Soberite 30+ spetsialnykh predmetov, kotorye pomgut vam zarabotat eshchyo bolshe deneg!
Igrayte protiv drugikh lyudey 1 na 1!
Используйте все средства, чтобы помочь о:
Ispolzuyte vse sredstva, chtoby pomoch otryadu nevolnykh geroev perezhit napadenie na rodnoy gorod i vystoyat, nesmotrya ni na chto, v takticheskoy RPG na ulitsakh okkupirovannoy Varshavy 1944-go.
Verbuyte muzhchin i zhenshchin, soldat i grazhdanskikh, molodezh i starikov i ispolzuyte ikh unikalnye navyki, znaniya i sposobnosti, chtoby protivostoyat vragu. Znakomtes s vykhodtsami iz vsekh sloev obshchestva, obedinennykh v popytke svergnut okkupantov.
— Uchites raznoplanovym navykam, kotorye pozvolyat vam atakovat s flangov, vzryvat prepyatstviya, otstrelivat odinochnykh vragov i zamanivat vrazheskie voyska v zony, gde vashi tshchatelno splanirovannye ataki nanesut maksimum urona.
Расслабляющая игра-песочница, в которой:
Rasslablyayushchaya igra-pesochnitsa, v kotoroy vy stanete proektirovat i ukrashat sobstvennye komnaty. Vybirayte iz 11 razlichnykh form i razmerov, chtoby sozdavat spalnyu vashey mechty, uyutnuyu gostinuyu, stilnuyu kukhnyu i igrovuyu detskuyu komnatu.
Bolee 500 predmetov mebeli i ukrasheniy, a takzhe bolee 30 uzorov oboev i napolnykh pokrytiy — u vas budet vse neobkhodimoe dlya sozdaniya idealnogo stilya. My Cozy Room — idealnoe mesto, chtoby raskryt svoy tvorcheskiy potentsial, ili prosto veselo provesti vremya!
Nachnite ukrashat uyutnuyu komnatu svoey mechty uzhe segodnya!
Популярная приключенческая головоломка M:
Populyarnaya priklyuchencheskaya golovolomka Mr. DRILLER DrillLand teper vykhodit i na Zapade dlya Nintendo Switch™!

Белый Храм, что веками стоял на страже з:
Belyy Khram, chto vekami stoyal na strazhe zakona v Korolevstve uzhe ne spravlyaetsya s ugrozoy, i vynuzhden obratitsya za pomoshchyu k prestupniku. Elias – metis-polukrovka, v chikh zhilakh techyot krov Koshmarov okazyvaetsya edinstvennoy nadezhdoy chelovechestva. Magicheskaya skorlupa, kotoraya vekami zashchishchala ot vraga, unichtozhena. Polchishcha koshmarnykh sushchestv zapolonili mir, i terroriziruyut ego zhiteley.
Igrayte za Eliasa, issleduyte zemli Korolevstva, srazhaytes s polchishchami koshmarnykh sozdaniy i mogushchestvennymi bossami, nakhodite sekrety, pomogayte popavshim v bedu lyudyam — i ostanovite nadvigayushchuyusya katastrofu..
- Приключение, которое переживаешь сердц:
- Priklyuchenie, kotoroe perezhivaesh serdtsem: pri sozdanii Last Day of June my vdokhnovlyalis pesney Stivena Uilsona “Drive Home.” Interaktivnoe priklyuchenie Last Day of June rasskazyvaet igrokam glubokuyu i proniknovennuyu istoriyu.

- Poeziya v dvizhenii: pogruzites v atmosferu lyubvi i grusti, kotoroy pronizan etot zhivopisnyy mir. Zdes vy pochuvstvuete i krasotu zhizni, i bol poteri.

- Sochuvstvie cherez perezhivaniya: Karl, dvizhimyy gorem i polnyy reshimosti spasti lyubimuyu Dzhun, soprovozhdaet vas v ee posledniy den. No po mere razvitiya istoriya igrok iz nablyudatelya stanovitsya personazhem, vsyo bolshe uchastvuyushchim v istorii.

- Zagadki, menyayushchie sudbu: prozhivite posledniy den Dzhun, puteshestvuya v proshloe cherez ee kartiny, i popytaytes tak reshit polnye emotsiy zagadki, chtoby rokovaya poslednyaya poezdka domoy zakonchilas po-drugomu.

- Interaktivnyy rasskaz: istoriya Karla i Dzhun zavisit ot klyuchevykh momentov, kogda prinimayutsya resheniya, sposobnye izmenit ikh zhizn. No igroki mogut stolknutsya s nezhdannymi posledstviyami svoikh resheniy, kotorye sozdayut novye dilemmy – a mozhet byt, i novye vozmozhnosti.

Ona stala samoy prodavaemoy igroy dlya svoey platformy (vsego bylo prodano bolee 11 millionov kopiy) i odnoy iz samykh prodavaemykh v istorii igr na tot moment — v kontse 2007 goda ona byla vnesena v Knigu rekordov Ginnessa.
Angloyazychnye versii tut.
Этот необычный Full Motion Video-квест п:
Etot neobychnyy Full Motion Video-kvest proiskhodit vo vremya globalnoy pandemii vo Frantsii, i rasskazyvaet istoriyu Vinsenta — pisatelya, kotoryy sbezhal iz goroda, chtoby rabotat nad novoy knigoy. Strannye povtoryayushchiesya sny tolkayut ego na poiski istiny, skryvayushcheysya za zagadkoy derevni. Issleduya staryy zamok, on nakhodit sposob pereklyuchatsya mezhdu nochyu i dnem, i ego nachinaet presledovat strashnyy monstr — Nochnoy strazh.
Smozhet li on nayti otvety? Chto nakhoditsya za vorotami Tangeyzera? Kto ili chto takoe Nochnoy strazh? Chto oznachayut strannye poslaniya, kotorye on postoyanno nakhodit?
The World After — eto sovershenno novaya nauchno-fantasticheskaya priklyuchencheskaya igra v zhanre point and click, sozdannaya dizaynerami i khudozhnikami-kinematografistami vo vremya lokdauna, obyavlennogo iz-za pandemii vo Frantsii v 2020 godu, eta igra — idealnoe sochetanie staroy shkoly mekhaniki point and click i sovremennykh kinematograficheskikh tekhnologiy.
«Успех означает умение терпеть одно пора:
«Uspekh oznachaet umenie terpet odno porazhenie za drugim, ne teryaya voli k pobede.» ©
Kachestvenno novyy dvizhok s vektornoy grafikoy pozvolil sozdat dlya igry bolee adaptivnyy i chetkiy interfeys. V chetvertoy versii igry sokhranilis vse funktsii proshlykh seriy i dobavilos mnozhestvo novykh funktsiy: reportazhi v SMI, koalitsionnye pravitelstva, chrezvychaynye polnomochiya, trekhpartiynye sistemy, a takzhe usovershenstvovannaya simulyatsiya, kotoraya uchityvaet inflyatsiyu, korruptsiyu, takie ponyatiya sovremennoy politiki, kak kolichestvennoe smyagchenie, vertoletnye dengi, bezuslovnyy bazovyy dokhod, i temy sovremennoy povestki, naprimer, natelnye kamery dlya politseyskikh, prava transgenderov i mnogoe-mnogoe drugoe.
Democracy 4 — eto idealnaya pesochnitsa dlya proverki vashikh politicheskiy idey. Nam vsyo vremya kazhetsya, chto nashi politiki bespolezny i sami my gorazdo luchshe spravilis by s upravleniem stranoy. No naskolko eto pravda? Odnim glazom sledya za byudzhetom, drugim — za oprosami obshchestvennogo mneniya, odnovremenno podstrakhovyvayas na sluchay terroristicheskoy ataki, vy obnaruzhite, chto ostavatsya u vlasti i pytatsya izmenit obshchestvo k luchshemu — eto zadacha potrudnee, chem vy sebe predstavlyali. Legalizatsiya narkotikov — eto khoroshaya ideya? A razdacha pulemetov politsii? Polnyy zapret abortov? Krupnye investirovaniya v zelyonye istochniki energii? Srabotaet li bezuslovnyy bazovyy dokhod? Smozhete li vy ostatsya u vlasti, vdvoe sokrativ pensii dlya finansirovaniya voenki? Est tolko odna igra, kotoraya pomozhet vam eto uznat!
Esli khotite prevratit svoyu stranu v kapitalisticheskiy ray, otmenit vse nalogi i gosudarstvennye raskhody na obshchestvennye nuzhdy — pozhaluysta. Eto mozhet srabotat, a mozhet i net, v zavisimosti ot togo, kak vy spravites s podobnoy situatsiey. S drugoy storony, esli vy khotite natsionalizirovat zheleznye dorogi, energeticheskie kompanii, ogranichit zarplaty direktorov, zapretit vladenie neskolkimi domami i vvesti bezuslovnyy dokhod, vy smozhete i eto. Modeliruyte naibolee veroyatnye posledstviya vashikh deystviy v kratkosrochnoy i dolgosrochnoy perspektivakh.
V konechnom itoge, Democracy 4 — eto simulyator, v kotoroy nuzhno ne prosto vyigrat vybory, no eshchyo i uspeshno upravlyat schastlivymi lyudmi. Nastoyashchaya zadacha igry — sozdat takoe soobshchestvo, kotorym vy smozhete po-nastoyashchemu gorditsya!..Igry Suzerain i Realpolitiks sm. zdes.
Профессиональная борьба и фэнтезийная ро:
Professionalnaya borba i fenteziynaya rolevaya igra obedinyayutsya v neveroyatnom priklyuchenii s chudesneyshe bogatoy pikselnoy grafikoy. Rendi «Macho» Sevidzh i mnozhestvo drugikh legend pomogut vam prolozhit put k slave i za predelami ringa.
Puteshestvie etogo geroya — ne prosto epicheskiy kvest, eto — WrestleQuest!..
Вдохновленная реальными культами мира, S:
Vdokhnovlennaya realnymi kultami mira, Sagebrush — eto priklyuchencheskaya, osnovannaya na povestvovanii igra s deystviem ot pervogo litsa, kotoraya vveryaet igroku missiyu poiska istiny, rassledovaniya tragicheskikh obstoyatelstv massovogo samoubiystva chlenov kulta Perfect Heaven.

Deystvie proiskhodit v shtate Nyu-Meksiko, igroku predstoit issledovat rancho Black Sage, byvshiy dom ottsa Dzheymsa, pochitaemogo proroka kulta Perfect Heaven, chtoby dokopatsya do pravdy.

Kharakteristiki: 
 * Zakhvatyvayushchiy lou-fay 3D-mir
 * Bolshaya territoriya dlya izucheniya
 * Kharakternaya atmosfernaya zvukovaya dorozhka
 * Igra sozdana pod vpechatleniem o mirovykh apokalipticheskikh kultakh
Совершите полное ярких эмоций дорожное п:
Sovershite polnoe yarkikh emotsiy dorozhnoe puteshestvie vmeste s Luizoy, kotoraya pytaetsya nauchit syna Mitcha vyzhivat v zhestokom mire SShA kontsa 60-kh godov.
 
 Kakovo byt materyu?
 
 Chto takoe khorosho i chto takoe plokho? Otvetit na etot vopros vsegda nelegko, no eshchyo slozhnee, esli vy — ne dostigshaya 30 let mat-odinochka s soobrazitelnym vosmiletnim synom. Kazhdoe prinyatoe nami reshenie za dolyu sekundy mozhet izmenit nashi zhizni navsegda — i povliyat na to, kakimi tsennostyami budet rukovodstvovatsya Mitch i kakim on v itoge vyrastet.
 
 Pochemu my stali takimi?
 
 Vyyasnite, chto povliyalo na zhizn Luizy, i prinimayte vazhnye resheniya, kotorye ne pod silu prinyat nikomu drugomu. Pokazhite Mitchu vsyo neobkhodimoe, chtoby on vyros nezavisimym, vospitannym i dostatochno khrabrym, chtoby preodolet v zhizni vse trudnosti.
 
 U vsego est svoi posledstviya
 
 Resheniya DEYSTVITELNO imeyut znachenie! Razvitie kharaktera vzrosleyushchego Mitcha otslezhivaetsya pri pomoshchi [b]tryokh pokazateley, menyayushchikhsya pri kazhdom vashem vybore: Nravstvennost, Uverennost i Otkrytost[/b]. Eti znacheniya opredelyat final, k kotoromu pridyot Mitch — [b]vsego v igre 9 razlichnykh kontsovok![/b]
 
 U vsekh est svoya istoriya
 
 60-e gody vydalis vesma likhimi. «Leto lyubvi», voyna vo Vetname, mnozhestvo tekh, kto vyzhil i kto proigral v velikoy istoricheskoy gonke.
 Canned Heat «Proekhalis po strane», poka Bob Dilan sprashival, «Kakovo eto?» — ne imet doma i zhit na ulitse.
 Puteshestvuyte po strane i vstrechayte personazhey, kotorye mogut pomoch ili pomeshat Luize dostich eyo tseley. Sredi nikh — nekotorye iz naibolee protivorechivykh organizatsiy, o kotorykh vse pozabyli.
Экшен-адвенчура, основанная на мультсери:
Ekshen-advenchura, osnovannaya na multseriale Dragons: The Nine Realms (spin-off «Kak priruchit drakona»).
Deystvie proiskhodit v sovremennom mire cherez 1300 let posle sobytiy «The Hidden World». V nem rasskazyvaetsya o gruppe detey, kotorykh roditeli priveli v ogromnuyu treshchinu, vyzvannuyu kometoy, i raskryvayut pravdu o drakonakh.
Issleduyte devyat mirov, prokachivaete drakona i protivostoite opasnym protivnikam!
Руины любого поселения — это тихий памят:
Ruiny lyubogo poseleniya — eto tikhiy pamyatnik ego poslednikh dney. Ruiny Oakmarsha ne stali isklyucheniem. Ikh govoryashchaya tishina i pyl, pokryvayushchaya kovrom ostanki nebolshoy derevushki pod Koventri!
Vashe imya Ebigeyl Blekvud i, kak by eto pomyagche prepodnesti… vy umerli pri neyasnykh obstoyatelstvakh okolo soroka let nazad. No, chto interesney, po eshchyo menee ponyatnym prichinam spustya 40 let vy probudilis v forme prizraka rovno na tom meste, gde byli pokhoroneny.
Semeynoe pomeste vse eshchyo na meste, no vashikh rodstvennikov v nyom sovsem net. V nyom voobshche net ni edinoy zhivoy dushi!.. Po krayney mere, tak vam kazhetsya na pervykh porakh...
Below Zero — это подводное приключение в:
Below Zero — eto podvodnoe priklyuchenie v inoplanetnom okeanicheskom mire. Vstrechayte novuyu glavu vo vselennoy Subnautica, razrabotannuyu studiey Unknown Worlds.

Vernutsya na planetu 4546B

Otpravtes v podvodnuyu ekspeditsiyu v kholodnom arkticheskom regione planety 4546B. Vooruzhivshis lish smekalkoy i skromnym naborom spasatelnogo oborudovaniya, vam predstoit rassledovat sobytiya, proizoshedshie s vashey sestroy...

Dokopatsya do pravdy

Posle zagadochnogo proisshestviya Alterra v speshke pokinula planetu. Ves region useyan zabroshennymi nauchnymi stantsiyami. Chto proizoshlo s uchenymi, kotorye zhili i rabotali zdes? Zhurnaly, veshchi i khranilishcha dannykh, rasseyannye mezhdu oblomkami, pozvolyayut vzglyanut na kartinu proisshestviya s drugoy storony. Raspolagaya ogranichennymi resursami, vam pridetsya improvizirovat, chtoby vyzhit.

Nayti neizuchennye biomy

Plavayte pod siyayushchimi golubymi svodami Izvilistykh mostov. Voskhishchaytes ogromnymi sverkayushchimi kristallami v kristallicheskikh peshcherakh. Komanda CyberConnect2 iznachalno zadumala sdelat bolshuyu franshizu, razdelyonnuyu na neskolko igr, i reshala: «Esli uzh brat igrokov masshtabom, tak po polnoy programme». V rezultate, pomimo «virtualnoy» offlayn-MMO, v ramkakh kotoroy razvivayutsya osnovnye igrovye sobytiya, nas privetstvuet virt glavnogo geroya — rabochiy stol ego kompyutera, lichnyy pochtovyy yashchik, novostnye sayty i forumy. Prichyom eto ne dekoratsii, kak v nekotorykh sovremennykh igrakh, sushchestvuyushchie prosto dlya galochki, a zhivaya i postepenno napolnyayushchayasya informatsiey ekosistema, deystvuyushchaya po sovremennym printsipam vsemirnoy pautiny.
Sobytiya .hack rasskazyvayut nam o parne po imeni Khaseo, poklonnike novoy setevoy MMO The World. Nachav igrat, on sumel dostich nemalykh vysot, a zatem sluchilas strashnaya beda — odna iz nemnogikh ego podrug po igre, devushka po imeni Sino, podverglas napadeniyu drugogo igroka i vpala v komu. V nastoyashchuyu komu. Kak okazalos, etot sluchay ne edinichnyy, no kompaniya CyberConnect2 ne speshit predavat stol shchepetilnye dela oglaske. Sobravshis s silami, Khaseo reshaet nayti tainstvennogo ubiytsu i raspravitsya s nim. Vsego-to nuzhno stat uzhasom, letyashchim na krylyakh nochi i porazhayushchim ubiytsu za ubiytsey — tekh igrokov, kotorye prikhodyat s tselyu pookhotitsya ne na monstrov i NPC, a na personazhey drugikh igrokov — poka ne doberyotsya do samogo mogushchestvennogo i tainstvennogo iz nikh, Tray-Edzha..

A Mystical Game in the Canadian Far north:
Set off on a mystical journey to the Canadian Far North with Inua - a Story in Ice and Time, a point & click narrative adventure spanning multiple eras.
Meet Taïna, a present-day reporter determined to discover the truth behind the disappearance of the Terror, one of the ship of the Franklin expedition whose goal was to explore the Arctic in the 19th century. Her destiny is mysteriously linked to that of Peter, a young filmmaker covering a military expedition in the 1950s and Simon, a sailor of the Franklin expedition struggling to keep his crew alive.

Navigate through time to discover what links them together. Search for ideas, instill them in the characters' minds and guide them toward Nanurluk, the mythical polar bear who lived 10 000 years ago.

A Mystical Time Travel Experience:
Go on an adventure in the far North of Canada, navigate through the ages, and interact with the past to change the present. In Inua, you’ll need to unravel space-time to solve mysteries and guide the characters on their journey. Move from scene to scene, era to era, and uncover events of the past, unearthing new ideas that influence the characters' minds. Help Simon, Peter, and Taïna overcome the obstacles standing in their way, and change the course of history.

A Historical Saga:
The original and supernatural scenario of Inua is based on a very real story: that of the Franklin expedition, a British mission in the 19th century to explore the Arctic that resulted in shipwreck, disease, and mutiny. The fate of this expedition is still largely unknown. Gather clues and discover its history!

Inua - a Story in Ice and Time:
- A fantasy tale based on incredible historical facts.
- An extraordinary story inspired by Inuit tales and legends, with support from Inuit writer Thomassie Mangiok and advisors Billy Gauthier and Monica Ittusardjuat.
- A game designed by the creators of Bury Me, My Love, and Vignettes, adapted from the original story by Nathalie Frassoni and Frédéric Bouvier, with the breathtaking artistic direction of Delphine Fourneau from the Klondike collective.

STILL THERE – psikhologicheskoe priklyuchenie s tekhnicheskimi golovolomkami, stremnym II, mrachnym yumorom i neotstupayushchey bolyu ot poteri. Ubegayte ot svoego proshlogo k neizvestnosti i zabveniyu, popivaya prevoskhodnyy italyanskiy kofe.

OTKROYTE ISTINU
Signal bedstviya navsegda menyaet razmerennyy poryadok zhizni smotritelya kosmicheskogo mayaka i sostavlyayushchego emu kompaniyu II. Sporte, sochuvstvuyte i izlivayte dushu personazham v nasyshchennykh i uvlekatelnykh dialogakh. Vas zhdet klassicheskaya nauchno-fantasticheskaya misteriya s chelovecheskim litsom.

REShAYTE SLOZhNYE ZAGADKI
Vam otvedena rol Karla Khamby, edinstvennogo operatora stantsii «Bento», chya zadacha – zanimatsya remontom i obsluzhivaniem klyuchevykh sistem stantsii na paru s Gorkim, iskusstvennym intellektom stantsii. Izuchayte oborudovanie, chtoby ponyat, kak ustroena stantsiya. Pishite otchety svoim maloadekvatnym nachalnikam. Raskroyte svoe istinnoe prednaznachenie.

UBIVAYTE VREMYa
Ishchite, chem zanyat sebya v pereryve mezhdu rabochimi zadachami. Pytaytes obygrat Gorkogo v shakhmaty, zabottes o mestnoy tuatare i pererabatyvayte otkhody zhiznedeyatelnosti v «izyskannye blyuda». Na «Bento» vy naydete mnozhestvo interesnykh sposobov vzaimodeystviya prakticheski s lyubymi obektami.
Ritual: Crown of Horns – это настоящая к:
Ritual: Crown of Horns – eto nastoyashchaya krovavaya boynya, dinamichnyy ekshn, deystvie kotorogo razvrachivaetsya na alternativnom Dikom Zapade, prevrativshemsya v logovo demonov i filial ada na zemle. Vdokhnovlennaya arkadami igra povestvuet o neobychnom soyuze okhotnika za golovami, kotoryy vozvrashchaetsya s togo sveta s zhazhdoy otomstit svoim ubiytsam, i vedmy, kotoraya pomogaet emu moshchnymi ritualami, a takzhe presleduet sobstvennye tseli. 

Otbivaytes ot polchishch vragov, poka vedma provodit ritual. Vybirayte iz tselogo arsenala oruzhiya i zaklinaniy. Otkryvayte novye instrumenty i mogushchestvennye predmety, kotorye usilyat vashego personazha. Puteshestvuyte po Divnomu Zapadu, podbirayte sebe zadaniya i planiruyte marshrut, chtoby nakonets-to osushchestvit svoyu mest!

Igra Ritual: Crown of Horns osnovana na razvitii navykov - zdes vazhnee bystro reagirovat i prinimat pravilnye resheniya na khodu, chem davit na knopki i bezdumno brosatsya na vragov.
«Бенди и тёмное возрождение» — хоррор на:
«Bendi i tyomnoe vozrozhdenie» — khorror na vyzhivanie ot pervogo litsa i dolgozhdannoe prodolzhenie «Bendi i chernilnaya mashina». Igrayte ot litsa Odri, issleduya glubiny zhutkoy animatsionnoy studii, v kotoroy vse perevernulos vverkh dnom. Chtoby otyskat put obratno v realnyy mir, vam pridetsya srazhatsya s zapyatnannymi chernilami vragami, razgadyvat golovolomki i uvorachivatsya ot vechno skryvayushchegosya Chernilnogo demona.
Nevozmozhno predskazat, kto ili chto budet skryvatsya za sleduyushchim uglom v etom polurazrushennom tsarstve teney i chernil.
Raskroyte pravdu. Sbegite iz studii. No, prezhde vsego, boytes Chernilnogo demona… i vyzhivete.

Umerev pri zagadochnykh obstoyatelstvakh, Penni prosypaetsya i obnaruzhivaet, chto ey nado podmenit SMERT! Ona poluchaet novuyu silu: sposobnost peremeshchatsya mezhdu mirami zhivykh i mertvykh! Eta sposobnost — i nemnogo smekalki — prigoditsya ey, chtoby raskryt taynu svoey gibeli v golovolomnoy igre-platformere. Prygayte po platformam, reshayte zagadki i pomogite upokoitsya mertvym, vselyayas v zhivykh i zastavlyaya ikh tantsevat pod svoyu dudku. Vsyo eto zhdet vas v umoritelnom priklyuchenii ot Zoink Games, stsenariy kotorogo napisal obladatel premii Aysnera Rayan Nort (Ryan North).

- Peremeshchaytes mezhdu mirami zhivykh i mertvykh.
- Vselyaytes v zhivykh: upravlyayte ikh telami i chitayte mysli, chtoby reshat zagadki.
- Stante Smertyu: rabota vremennaya, no seychas vlast upravlyat zhiznyu i smertyu v vashikh rukakh.
- Pogruzites v yarkiy i zhivoy mir v stile knig s obemnymi kartinkami i proydite originalnyy syuzhet do kontsa!
Откройте для себя свободу снайперской ст: Otkroyte dlya sebya svobodu snayperskoy strelby v peredovom snayperskom shutere, deystvie kotorogo prokhodit vo vremya Vtoroy mirovoy voyny. Vas zhdut takticheskie boi s vidom ot tretego litsa, vybor geympleya i neveroyatnye dalnie vystrely v khode kampanii po osvobozhdeniyu Italii ot iga fashizma.
Что бы случилось, если бы Солнце вдруг н:
Chto by sluchilos, esli by Solntse vdrug neobyasnimo ischezlo, chtoby vernutsya snova — cherez neskolko chasov? Provedite rassledovanie vmeste so svoim tovarishchem, II Moti, raskryvayte zagovory, otkroyte drevnie religii, puteshestvuyte po miru.
«Vybory, kotorye imeyut znachenie, i pogasshee Solntse» — eto epicheskaya tekstovaya priklyuchencheskaya igra v serii «Choices That Matter», soderzhashchaya okolo 600000 slov i 2400 raznykh igrovykh vyborov! Kazhdyy raz, kogda vy zavershaete odnu iz 10 syuzhetnykh arok, vy mozhete uznat, skolko drugikh igrokov zakanchivayut syuzhet v tom zhe meste, chto i vy. Vy pobyvaete v raznykh stranakh i mestakh, ustanovite blizkie otnosheniya s raznymi personazhami i, v konechnom itoge, dostignete finala, v kotorom vasha sudba i sudba vashego II-kompanona, Moti budet ochen, ochen razlichna.
Eto — vashe puteshestvie, i tolko vash vybor pomozhet raskryt pravdu. Ved Solntse uzhe zashlo..
Vklyucheny 3 chasti Choices That Matter:
Мир и спокойствие в Розантике вновь под:
Mir i spokoystvie v Rozantike vnov pod ugrozoy

Nad Rozantikoy, bezmyatezhnym i prekrasnym ostrovom, snova navisla strashnaya ugroza. V volshebnom shchite, chto otdelyaet Rozantiku ot Skverny, mnozhatsya treshchiny, i skvoz nikh vse chashche prosachivayutsya zhazhdushchie zakhvatit ostrov sozdaniya zla. Po chistoy sluchaynosti Flinn obnaruzhivaet odnu iz takikh treshchin i osoznaet, chto ego dolg — zashchitit Rozantiku ot vtorzheniya Skverny. V etom emu pomozhet ego vernaya soratnitsa Deks — dukh-khranitel ostrova. Vmeste im predstoit srazitsya s drevnim zlom i ego povelitelem.

Klassicheskiy ekshen-platformer v 2D

Flynn: Son of Crimson — ekshen-platformer v 2D, v kotorom vas zhdet mnozhestvo otkrytiy i priklyucheniy na puti k osvoeniyu moshchi aloy energii. Pomogite Flinnu i Deks spasti Rozantiku ot vtorzheniya Skverny.

Flinn i Deks

Deks, vasha soratnitsa i zashchitnitsa, vsegda gotova priyti na pomoshch v trudnuyu minutu — srazhaytes bok o bok s ney radi budushchego Rozantiki. Deks sposobna kak unichtozhat pregrady na vashem puti, tak i proryvatsya skvoz polchishcha vragov. Luchshe druga Flinnu ne syskat!

Flinna i Deks svyazyvayut uzy druzhby, vzaimopomoshchi i iskrenney lyubvi, i ugroza Skverny zastavlyaet ikh bez razdumiy rinutsya v boy.

Issleduyte Rozantiku i mir Skverny 

Vas zhdet Rozantika i ee raznoobraznye oblasti, polnye drevnikh tayn i zagadok. Srazhaytes, sobirayte artefakty i otkryvayte novye puti. 

Skverna — mir tmy i nenavisti, stremyashchiysya zakhlestnut i unichtozhit Rozantiku. Vam pridetsya otpravitsya v etot chuzhoy mir, chtoby srazitsya s ego pravitelem, vlastitelem Skverny Zilokom, i ego vooruzhennoy kinzhalami voitelnitsey Roziey.
Glyph is a cute, physics-based adventure:
Glyph is a cute, physics-based adventure starring a mech-scarab and his trusted guide, Anobi, challenged with rebuilding an ancient civilization buried under the desert sand. Jump, double-jump, smash and glide through the air in this vertical platformer with amazing controls.

Истории девять персонажей пересекаются,:
Istorii devyat personazhey peresekayutsya, kogda troe iz nikh otpravlyayutsya na Posledniy rubezh i dvoe bessledno ischezayut. Odin personazh vozvrashchaetsya iz Rubezha, no govorit, chto ne pomnit, chto tam proizoshlo. Komu verit? Kto govorit pravdu, a kto lzhet? Kto drug, a kto — vrag?

Osnovnye osobennosti:
Strategicheskie poshagovye boi s uchetom balansa. Boi proiskhodyat na tom zhe pole, po kotoromu vy peredvigaetes, pri nachale bitvy ekran ne pereklyuchaetsya.
Sistema polozhitelnykh i negativnykh effektov: naprimer, igroki ne mogut ubezhat, esli nakhodyatsya pod deystviem effekta «Zastryal».
Ispolzuya dvoynye i troynye dzin-tekhniki, chleny otryada mogut kombinirovat ataki vmeste i delat ikh silnee.
V strategicheskikh tselyakh rasstavlyayte v boyu lovushki i nanosite uron vragam, kogda oni ne zhdut.
Kontsovka v igre ne odna.
Igrok-vrag (ili vragi) mozhet menyatsya.

Jin Conception — igra na odnogo igroka, v kotoroy nuzhno razobratsya, kto zdes drug, a kto vrag.
Одной ненастной ночью мальчик-лампочка п:
Odnoy nenastnoy nochyu malchik-lampochka prosnulsya ot uzhasnogo koshmara i obnaruzhil, chto v dom probralos zlo. Vsya ego semya ischezla, a v temnote koposhatsya uzhasnye monstry. Emu neobkhodimo sobrat vsyu svoyu smelos i ispolzovat svoyu steklyannuyu golovu, chtoby spasti rodnykh.
Bulb Boy — khorror-advenchura o malchike so svetyashcheysya golovoy (i o lampochke). Razgadyvayte golovolomki, srazhaytes so zlobnymi monstrami i razberites v zaputannoy istorii. I ne zabudte spasti ot vsepogloshchayushchey tmy dedushku, staruyu kerosinovuyu lampu i sobaku-motylka.
Cris Tales — прекрасная инди-игра, сдела:
Cris Tales — prekrasnaya indi-igra, sdelannaya s bolshoy lyubovyu k klassicheskim yaponskim rolevym igram, no na novyy maner. Oglyanites na proshloe, deystvuyte v nastoyashchem i smotrite, kak vash vybor menyaet budushchee, i vsyo na odnom ekrane! Prisoedinyaytes k tolko chto probuzhdyonnomu magu vremeni po imeni Crisbell (Krisbell) i eyo fantasticheskim sputnikam v mire, kotoryy zhdyot nezavidnoe budushchee. Moguchaya Imperatritsa Vremeni i eyo sily grozyatsya ustroit kataklizm, chto razorvyot Crystallis (Kristallis) i ostalnye chetyre korolevstva v etom regione.

Daby ostanovit Imperatritsu Vremeni i izmenit budushchee etikh zemel, vy otpravites v zhutkoe puteshestvie po korolevstvam, povstrechaete i povedyote za soboy silnykh soyuznikov, kotorye pomogut v boyu. Izuchite ikh sposobnosti i unikalnuyu vremennuyu magiyu glavnoy geroini, chtoby odolet groznykh vragov: otpravte ikh v proshloe i srazites s ikh bolee slabymi, eshchyo ne razvitymi versiyami, ili v budushchee, gde vrag umryot ot yada, primenyonnogo v nastoyashchem, ili razrabotayte sobstvennuyu strategiyu v zdeshney unikalnoy boevoy sisteme.

Po mere togo kak rastyot sila Crisbell, vam nuzhno budet delat vybor s daleko idushchimi posledstviyami dlya vstrechennykh vami lyudey, i posledstviya budut vliyat na igrovoy mir v realnom vremeni. U kazhdogo personazha, vraga i dazhe korolevstva est proshloe, nastoyashchee i neskolko variantov budushchego, zavisyashchego ot vashikh deystviy. Krasivaya, vruchnuyu narisovannaya dvukhmernaya grafika animirovana pokadrovo i napolnyaet zhiznyu polnyy vozmozhnostey igrovoy mir na protyazhenii bolee chem 20 chasov igry.

V igre Cris Tales vas zhdyot unikalnoe sochetanie razvetvlyonnykh syuzhetov, innovatsionnykh boyov i klassicheskikh rolevykh elementov. Eto volnuyushchee i nezabyvaemoe perezhivanie togo, kak nashi deystviya otzyvayutsya vo vremeni.
From legendary creator Mr. Yasuhiro Wada: From legendary creator Mr. Yasuhiro Wada (TOYBOX Inc.) comes Happy Birthdays: a sandbox game in which players create cube-shaped worlds that give rise to diverse and unique lifeforms. With careful experimentation, players can shape the geography and alter the temperature of the world to create the conditions for life and witness the birth of an entire ecosystem!
Хардкорная ритмическая roguelike игра, у: Khardkornaya ritmicheskaya roguelike igra, udostoennaya mnozhestva nagrad! Peremeshchaytes v takt muzyke, chtoby prodvigatsya po postoyanno menyayushchemusya podzemelyu, srazhayas s tantsuyushchimi skeletami, zombi, drakonami i drugimi monstrami. Rubites pod epichnyy saundtrek Denni Baranovski ili pesni iz sobstvennoy kollektsii MP3!
История двух молодых людей, которые восс:
Istoriya dvukh molodykh lyudey, kotorye vosstanavlivayut svoy rodnoy gorod i ishchut skrytuyu pravdu. Vas zhdut poshagovye boi i sistema sinteza — prostaya, no uvlekatelnaya. Krome togo, vy smozhete upravlyat magazinom, issledovat sluchaynye podzemelya i ne tolko!
Gorod Khollfeyn nekogda raspolagalsya na granitse trekh provintsiy i protsvetal za schet torgovli i dobychi resursov. Odnako posle zagadochnoy katastrofy bolshinstvo ego zhiteley ischezlo, a sam gorod stal zapretnoy zonoy. So vremenem ogranicheniya v gorode byli snyaty, i nachalis raboty po ego vosstanovleniyu. Vospolzovavshis etoy vozmozhnostyu, yunosha i devushka, kogda-to izgnannye iz Khollfeyna, vozvrashchayutsya v mesta, kotorye nazyvali svoim domom.
Vstretivshis v rodnom gorode, oni vmeste otpravlyayutsya v puteshestvie na poiski istiny, ne podozrevaya o vstrechakh i otkroveniyakh, kotorye ikh zhdut...
Carebotz is a twin-stick arena shooter g: Carebotz is a twin-stick arena shooter game spiced with metroidvania elements. You control BIBZ, a little maintenance droid. Collect the tons of blueprints, navigate the tight corridors, customize your toolset, learn to take advantage of gravity, upgrade, repair and encounter many different types of enemies! The journey is full of secrets, surprises. Discover the factory carefully as danger lurks everywhere, avoid deadly obstacles using your hover engine. The levels require investigation, and often patience and exploration are the key to survival.
Любимые драконы Буб и Боб возвращаются!:
Lyubimye drakony Bub i Bob vozvrashchayutsya! S Bubble Bobble 4 Friends vas zhdyot sleduyushchaya chast legendarnoy serii ot kompanii Taito Corp.
V odinochku ili v sovmestnom rezhime do chetyryokh igrokov proydite vmeste so svoim drakonom, plyuyushchimsya puzyryami, cherez 100 urovney, chtoby dat otpor zlomu volshebniku Bonneru i ego prispeshnikam. S pomoshchyu puzyrey mozhno ne tolko izyashchno lovit vragov. Ikh takzhe mozhno ispolzovat v kachestve transporta dlya svoego drakona, chtoby popast na vysokie uchastki.
Sobirayte osobye puzyri, chtoby poluchit novye sposobnosti, naprimer molnii ili vzryvnye puzyri, ili uluchshit ikh. Otkryvayte beskonechnoe mnozhestvo novykh strategiy dlya puteshestviya po miram i optimalnogo ispolzovaniya vozdushnykh potokov. V kachestve bonusa prisutstvuet originalnaya arkada Bubble Bobble 1986 goda, kotoraya ne tolko smogla zavoevat serdtsa igrokov po vsemu miru, no i do sikh por zastavlyaet fanatov napevat ee melodiyu.
Prazdnik dlya fanatov — i udovolstvie dlya vsey semi!..
Смертельно увлекательная головоломка, в:
Smertelno uvlekatelnaya golovolomka, v kotoroy vy upravlyaete manyakom-ubiytsey Cherepomordym. Puteshestvuyte po sotnyam izometricheskikh golovolomok v roli psikha, obezglavlivaya, razdavlivaya i protykaya naskvoz svoikh uglovatykh zhertv v etoy parodii na filmy uzhasov 80-kh godov.

Vzglyanite na uzhastik s vyvorachivaniem kishok pod novym uglom, nakhodyas v roli bezmolvnogo cherepolitsego manyaka, kalechashchego i ubivayushchego yazvitelnykh ozabochennykh podrostkov, zloupotreblyayushchikh narkotikami. Ni odin podrostok ne chuvstvuet sebya v bezopasnosti v etom letnem khorror-blokbastere 1984 goda!

Eksklyuzivnaya konsolnaya versiya Butcher’s Cut — samaya bolshaya i krovavaya iz VSEKh versiy Slayaway Camp! Eshche bolshe golovolomok! Eshche bolshe ubiyts! Eshche bolshe krovi!

OSOBENNOSTI:
Bolee 300 dyavolskikh urovney-golovolomok.
Bolee 60 ubiyts, s kotorymi mozhno ustroit veseluyu boynyu!
Svyshe 90 zverstv s shokiruyushchimi stsenami ubiystva.
Dostupna skhema upravleniya dlya sensornogo ekrana (v portativnom rezhime Nintendo Switch™)
Nastoyashchiy prazdnik dlya paltsev! Igrayte s pomoshchyu sensornogo ekrana ili v portativnom rezhime.
V glavnykh rolyakh Mark Mir v roli Cherepomordogo i Derek Mirs v roli Dzhessiki.
В начале 50-х гг. Джо Данн, владелец бок:
V nachale 50-kh gg. Dzho Dann, vladelets bokserskogo kluba, nayden mertvym. V eto zhe vremya ego voskhodyashchaya zvezda, Robert Yel, kotoryy dolzhen vzoyti na ring i uchastvovat v samom vazhnom boe v svoey karere, propadaet pri zagadochnykh obstoyatelstvakh. Sonya Dann, doch Dzho, beret na sebya rukovodstvo klubom i dolzhna spravitsya s finansovymi trudnostyami. Ona nanimaet chastnogo detektiva Dzhona Blekseda, chtoby rassledovat ischeznovenie Yelya i nayti ego. Eto mrachnoe delo privedet nashego detektiva v samye temnye i mrachnye glubiny Nyu-Yorka.
BLACKSAD: Under The Skin s antropomorfnymi personazhami i prekrasno vossozdannym stilem 50-kh godov obeshchaet priklyuchenie v mrachnoy atmosfere detektivnogo romana, kharakternoy dlya komiksov odnoimennoy serii.
Vedite rassledovanie po-svoemu. Ispolzuyte svoi koshachi sposobnosti, chtoby obnaruzhivat novye uliki. Prinimayte resheniya, kotorye povliyayut na razvitie kharaktera Blekseda i na razvyazku vsego dela.

Kharakteristiki:

•Ofitsialnaya, sovershenno novaya istoriya dlya «BLEKSEDA» v unikalnoy vselennoy etoy serii komiksov, velikolepno vossozdannoy v igre.

•Narrativnaya igra v zhanre detektiva s geympleem, sochetayushchim v sebe rassledovaniya, golovolomki, Quick Time Event (QTE) i mnogovariantnye dialogi.

• Situatsii vybora, kotorye napryamuyu vliyayut na razvitie vashego geroya i kontsovku istorii.

• Bolee 30 novykh personazhey, a takzhe drugie, uzhe izvestnye, u kazhdogo iz kotorykh est svoya istoriya i pobochnye kvesty.

• Ogromnyy mir v soprovozhdenii dzhazovogo saundtreka, dostoynogo luchshikh gollivudskikh filmov nuar.

• Igra, kotoraya privedet v vostorg kak lyubiteley priklyuchencheskikh igr svoim geympleem i povestvovaniem, tak i fanatov komiksa, kotorye vnov otkroyut dlya sebya personazhey i vizualnyy stil etoy unikalnoy vselennoy.
После окончания обучения в колледже, Лар:
Posle okonchaniya obucheniya v kolledzhe, Lara Kroft otpravlyaetsya v ekspeditsiyu k ostrovam u beregov Yaponii v Treugolnik Drakona, schitayushchiysya protivopolozhnostyu Bermudskogo treugolnika. Spustya tri dnya korabl popadaet v shtorm, i burya razlamyvaet sudno na dve poloviny, otdelyaya Laru ot ostalnoy komandy. Devushka popadaet na tainstvennyy ostrov Yamatay, v pribrezhnoy zone kotorogo pokoyatsya drevnie korabli vikingov, bombardirovshchiki B-25, galeony XVII veka i voennye katera 1940-kh.
Eyo podveshivayut vverkh nogami v peshchere i ostavlyayut, sochtya pogibshey...
«Tomb Raider: Definitive Edition» rasskazyvaet napryazhyonnuyu i zakhvatyvayushchuyu istoriyu o tom, kak Lare Kroft, robkoy yunoy baryshne prishlos stolknutsya s vrazhdebnoy sredoy i nauchitsya vyzhivat tam, gde drugie umirali. «Theme Hospital» («Частная клиника» или:
«Theme Hospital» («Chastnaya klinika» ili «Psikhushka») — ekonomicheskiy simulyator, sozdannyy kompaniey Bullfrog Productions i vypushchennyy v prodazhu Electronic Arts v 1997 godu. Zadacha igroka — sozdat bolnitsu i upravlyat eyu. Kak i bolshinstvo drugikh igr ot Bullfrog, Theme Hospital soderzhit v sebe izryadnuyu dozu ekstsentrichnogo yumora. Igra yavlyaetsya tematicheskoy naslednitsey drugoy igry ot Bullfrog, Theme Park.
Deystvie igry razvorachivaetsya v bolnitse. Ot igroka trebuetsya sozdat usloviya dlya privlecheniya patsientov (u kotorykh dovolno zabavnye nedugi, bolezni i zarazy). V igre prisutstvuet dolya chyornogo yumora. Nesmotrya na to, chto igra zavisit ot togo, kak budet sebya vesti personal bolnitsy, igrok ne mozhet upravlyat imi napryamuyu. U igroka, vprochem, est vozmozhnost podbora lyubogo sotrudnika v shtat bolnitsy i svoboda ikh peremeshcheniya po zdaniyu. Silno nadoedlivykh patsientov mozhno prognat iz bolnitsy (skandalistov — chtoby ne meshali normalnoy rabote, i patsientov pri smerti — chtoby ne portili statistiku).
Patsientov privlekaet otchasti reputatsiya bolnitsy i tsena lecheniya. Diagnoz i lechenie bolnykh dayot ne tolko pritok finansov bolnitse, no i yavlyayutsya neobkhodimymi deystviyami dlya vypolneniya usloviy urovnya. Vse bolezni v igre vymyshlennye i nesut na sebe otpechatok «chyornogo yumora»; zdes est razdutaya golova, nevidimost, dlinnyy yazyk, neobychnaya prostuda, i drugie. Tak kak ne vse bolezni yavlyayutsya izvestnymi, bolnitse neobkhodimy kabinety i oborudovanie dlya ikh izucheniya. Bolee prodvinutye urovni igry vklyuchayut v sebya epidemii, gde igroku neobkhodimo eyo ostanovit, putyom izlecheniya zarazhyonnykh patsientov i vaktsinatsii drugikh. Est takzhe momenty, gde nekotorym patsientam neobkhodimo ekstrenno okazat pomoshch za opredelyonnyy period vremeni. I sushchestvuyut zemletryaseniya, povrezhdayushchie oborudovanie. Po okonchanii kazhdogo goda igroku predostavlyayutsya nagrady za upravlenie bolnitsey.

Set long after humanity has polluted thi:
Set long after humanity has polluted this planet, groundwater is undrinkable and seeing a living plant is considered a luxury. Most people live in megacities that rely on the labor of poor masses to sustain a modern standard of living for the few at the top. With the Earth scorched, water is liquid gold, and control of it is the truest form of power. Forced to cope with a permanent water shortage, ordinary people persist and toil in the hope that if they work hard enough, they too can someday swim every morning in the refreshing pools of the Gardens.

We follow the story of Josephine Lace, a young hydraulic engineer eager to climb the corporate ladder and claim a spot at the top. Until the day when that promising future is ripped away from her, leaving her half-dead and homeless, she becomes hellbent on taking down the system that ruined her and left her without a heart. Along the way she meets a diverse group of people sympathetic to her cause, every one with secrets of their own. With their help, perhaps she will find redemption, love, and most of all - vengeance.

VENGEFUL HEART FEATURES:
-Story rich in social commentary with both grim and humoristic undertones
-Synthwave soundtrack that makes you nostalgic for the time that never was
-Gorgeous art reminiscent of PC-98 with a personal touch
-Story branches with wildly different outcomes

A demon possessed you one year ago. Since that day, you unwillingly tore a trail of bloodshed through New York City. Waking up on a stormy rooftop, you meet your saviors: the Unavowed, an ancient society dedicated to stopping evil. Life as you knew it is over, but by joining them you have a chance to reverse some of the damage you’ve done—and, if you choose wisely, to redeem yourself.

Shape your hero: Name the playable character, choose their gender, and pick from three origin stories to customize the protagonist.

Choose your party: Select two out of four companions to join you on missions across the boroughs of New York City. Each member of the Unavowed has a unique personality and skillset, providing different solutions to the obstacles you’ll encounter. 

Follow your conscience: Difficult choices await. In Unavowed’s subtly branching storyline, your decisions could come back to help you… or haunt you.

Play how you want: Controls refined for Nintendo Switch™ allow you to play comfortably with either the Joy-Con™ controllers or the touch screen.

Прошло около века с тех пор, как человеч:
Proshlo okolo veka s tekh por, kak chelovechestvo nachalo razvivat svoi sverkhestestvennye sily, nazyvaemym «sverkhsposobnostyami». Bolshinstvo ispolzovali svoi sily, chtoby nesti poleznyy vklad v obshchestvo, no byli i te, kto zloupotreblyal imi — kak i te, kto ne mog ikh kontrolirovat.
Chtoby aktivno reagirovat na takie intsidenty, pravitelstvo uchredilo «Gruppu po borbe s opasnymi talantami (GUBOT)», pravookhranitelnoe agentstvo, sostoyashchee iz trenirovannykh sverkhsensorikov. Odnako, kolichestvo intsidentov prodolzhalo rezko uvelichivatsya do stepeni nekontroliruemosti. Nasha istoriya nachinaetsya v 2023-m godu s byvshego chlena GUBOT, kotoryy poteryal eti sposobnosti v rezultate neschastnogo sluchaya.
Vam budet naznachen ezhenedelnyy grafik obucheniya dlya razvitiya sil 7 izbrannykh uchenikov, a «osnovnye» kharakteristiki, takie kak vynoslivost i rassuditelnost, budut uluchshatsya v zavisimosti ot vybrannoy imenno vami uchebnoy programmy dlya nikh.

Star Fox 64 (яп. スターフォックス64 Сута: Фоккус:
Star Fox 64 (yap. スターフォックス64 Suta: Fokkusu Rokudzyu:yon) — vtoraya igra v serii Star Fox, razrabotannaya Nintendo dlya konsoli Nintendo 64. V Yaponii reliz sostoyalsya 27 aprelya 1997 goda, v Severnoy Amerike — 1 iyulya 1997, a v Evrope i Avstralii pod nazvaniem «Lylat Wars» 20 oktyabrya 1997 goda.
Igrok upravlyaet kosmicheskim korablyom Arwing, pilotiruemym Foksom MakKlaudom. V nekotorykh missiyakh transportnym sredstvom sluzhit sukhoputnyy tank Landmaster, a takzhe podvodnaya lodka Blue Marine. Struktura urovney lineyna, igrok nepreryvno dvizhetsya vperyod, imeya vozmozhnost peremeshchatsya v predelakh ekrana vpravo-vlevo i vverkh-vniz, otstrelivaetsya ot vragov i podbiraet bonusy. V nekotorykh poedinkakh s bossami i v srazheniyakh so Star Wolf rezhim igry menyaetsya: polnaya svoboda peredvizheniya na ogranichennom uchastke prostranstva. Bronyu i lazernuyu pushku mozhno sovershenstvovat, podbiraya sootvetstvuyushchie bonusy.
Sobytiya razvorachivayutsya v vymyshlennoy zvyozdnoy sisteme Laylet, protiv kotoroy vedyot voynu sumasshedshiy uchyonyy Andross. Nekogda on byl izgnan na mrachnuyu planetu Venom i teper, po syuzhetu, sobiralsya postavit na koleni svoikh starykh vragov i podchinit sebe vsyo zhivoe. V svoyo vremya komanda nayomnikov Star Fox byla po porucheniyu federalnoy planety Kornerii issledovala strannuyu aktivnost, proiskhodyashchuyu na Venome, no byla unichtozhena Androssom, blagodarya predatelstvu odnogo iz eyo chlenov — Pigmy Dengara...
Место действия: зловещий лес в польской:
Mesto deystviya: zloveshchiy les v polskoy glubinke. Den - tvoe vremya. Sozdavay oruzhie, stav lovushki, ukreplyay ubezhishcha, sobiray vse, chto mozhno, ved gryadet noch i vlast tmy. Pryachsya v ubezhishche i molis, chtob bystree vzoshlo solntse.

Proberis cherez mrak Temnolesya, raskryv zhutchayshie tayny ego obiteteley i postaraysya bezhat s zarazhennoy territorii, poka tsely tvoe telo i razum.

OSOBENNOSTI
- Zabud o skrimerakh: napryazhenie v igre narastaet postepenno,i atmosfera uzhasa sozdaetsya bez deshevykh priemov.

- Smena dnya i nochi: den – vremya issledovat zarazhennyy les, a noch – tryastis ot strakha v ubezhishche.

- Sluchaynaya generatsiya karty i sobytiy: v kazhdom prokhozhdenii igrovoy mir budet neskolko inym.

- Sozdanie predmetov: v lesu polno materialov, kotorye pomogut uluchshit ubezhishche, sdelat oruzhie, lovushki i essentsii.

Вы будете играть за Стэнли, а еще вы не:
Vy budete igrat za Stenli, a eshche vy ne budete igrat za Stenli. Vy budete delat vybor, no vybor budut delat i za vas. Igra zakonchitsya, no igra nikogda ne zakonchitsya. Protivorechie na protivorechii, vse pravila igrostroya slomany, i ne raz. Vy tut ne dlya togo, chtoby vyigryvat. The Stanley Parable — eto igra, kotoraya igraet vami. 

Chto novogo? 

The Stanley Parable: Ultra Deluxe — uluchshennaya i pereosmyslennaya versiya vsem polyubivsheysya i vysoko otsenennoy kritikami The Stanley Parable 2013-go goda. 

Vse, za chto vy tak polyubili original, vse tak zhe na meste, my vernuli vam vash 2013-yy. No The Stanley Parable: Ultra Deluxe dobavlyaet v etu formulu mnogo novogo, rasshiryaya mir igry — vas zhdut novye vozmozhnosti vybora i novye sekrety, kotorye nuzhno raskryt. Labirint stal tolko bolshe. 

Ko vsemu prochemu my vizualno prokachali igru do sovremennykh graficheskikh standartov, skrupulezno sokhraniv vizualnyy ton originala. V igru takzhe byli dobavleny spetsialnye vozmozhnosti, takie kak lokalizatsiya vnutriigrovykh nadpisey, nastroyki dlya stradayushchikh daltonizmom i vsyacheskie preduprezhdeniya o razlichnom kontente. 

I, kak i prezhde, na protyazhenii vsey istorii vas budet soprovozhdat rasskazchik v ispolnenii nepodrazhaemogo Kevana Braytinga. 

V The Stanley Parable: Ultra Deluxe vse po-staromu, kak vy pomnite, no v to zhe vremya nemnogo ne tak. My zhe uzhe byli zdes, pravda? A Stenli vse takoy zhe, kak togda? A mozhet, eto vy izmenilis?
Здесь вы меняете мир, меняя его цвет. В: Zdes vy menyaete mir, menyaya ego tsvet. V poiskakh ischeznuvshey materi vy issleduete opasnyy seryy mir i nakhodite tsvetnye oblomki. Prepyatstviya ischezayut, esli ikh tsvet sovpadaet s tsvetom fona. Tak poluchayutsya golovolomki - opasnye, zagadochnye, raznotsvetnye.

Features

- Uncover three different endings, and dig to the heart of the mansion and the strange secrets it and your captors hold
- Solve puzzles and challenges reminiscent of escape-the-room games in a variety of unsettling and bizarre scenarios
- A tense, atmospheric adventure that relies on puzzles and plot instead of combat or chase sequences

The Team

Leonor Parra: Founder of Vertical Reach and the artist making The Tartarus Key as atmospheric and unsettling as possible. Hates jump scares and vowed to make a game that's downright spooky without them!

Kevin Colegate: The programmer in charge of making a game that plays as smoothly as you remember the classics being! A lover of retro games, he hopes The Tartarus Key surprises people with its blend of authentic vibes and puzzles.

Josie Brechner: As a composer, sound designer, and technical implementer, Josie has been creating music and audio experiences for games, film, dance, and interactive theater projects since 2012. As an independent musician, she toured the US and performed internationally, combining sample-based electronic sounds with analog instrumentation. She recently completed a Masters in Scoring for Film and Multimedia from New York University.

Хардкорный паркур!\n \nCyber Hook — дина:
Khardkornyy parkur!
 
Cyber Hook — dinamichnyy 3D-platformer, v kotorom tebe ponadobyatsya navyki parkura i kryuk, chtoby pokoryat samye nepristupnye steny, i lazernyy palets-pistolet, chtoby ustranyat vragov i prepyatstviya. Promchis po yarkomu miru v stile retroveyv, chtoby ispytat na prochnost navyki parkura, no bud nacheku: odin nevernyy pryzhok — i tebe konets.

OSOBENNOSTI
 
Intensivnyy parkur
Dinamichnyy igrovoy protsess, osnovannyy na parkure, kotoryy pogruzhaet v napryazhennuyu atmosferu ispytaniy v 3D-vselennoy. Pokoryay samye nepristupnye steny i ne zevay: gravitatsiya besserdechna.
 
Podruchnye sredstva
Ispolzuy kryuk, chtoby peremeshchatsya mezhdu urovnyami, tseplyayas za bloki, i otstrelivay vragov lazernym paltsem-pistoletom.
 
Gibkost igry
Upravlyay vremenem, chtoby spastis ot neminuemoy gibeli i otkryvay novye dvizheniya, chtoby prokhodit ispytaniya. V Cyber Hook ty mozhesh prolozhit svoy sobstvennyy put k pobede, narushaya zakony fiziki i podchinyaya sebe dizayn urovney.
 
Izobilie urovney
Bolee 70 urovney, chtoby ispytat tvoi navyki parkura.
 
Globalnyy reyting
Ishchi svoy sobstvennyy put na vershinu reytinga i nablyuday za igroy drugikh, chtoby vybrat luchshuyu strategiyu prokhozhdeniya urovney.
Действие игры происходит в будущем. Вы —:
Deystvie igry proiskhodit v budushchem. Vy — nayomnik, pilotiruyushchego sverkhtekhnologichnyy istrebitel Raptor, vypolnyaya mezhplanetnye missii po unichtozheniyu konkurentov korporatsii MegaCorps: vash istrebitel Raptor predstavlyaet soboy kombinatsiyu reaktivnykh istrebiteley Eurofighter Typhoon (deltovidnoe krylo i aerodinamicheskaya skhema «Utka») i F-15 Eagle (fyuzelyazh i dvoynoy khvost).
I vot, nad sedoy ravninoy zemnoy inoplanetnoy poverkhnosti gordo reet nash kosmokorablik, postrelivayushchiy v supostatov iz bortovykh pushek, zhgushchiy supostatovy doma napalmom i bombami, nu, a do kuchi eshchyo i obchishchayushchiy supostatovu kaznu posredstvom uvorovyvaniya vsyakikh bonusov. Letayushchikh zlodeev ugoshchaem iz razlichnykh pushek i lazerov, zdaniya i vsyakikh rozhdyonnykh polzat — tanki tam, zenitnye ustanovki, korabliki — bombim i zakidyvaem raketami. Sovershenstvovat svoi orudiya spravedlivoy borby s zakhvatchikami i okkupantami rodnoy zemli mozhno v pereryve mezhdu missiyami — v sootvetstvii s zarabotannymi chestnym dengami. Lyubiteley otpuskat gashetku tolko posle smerti bossa zhdyot nebolshoe razocharovanie — raskhod energii korablya na podobnye shalosti meshaet vosstanovleniyu energeticheskogo shchita, kotoryy, mezhdu prochim, zashchishchaet nezhnuyu i chuvstvitelnuyu obshivku zvezdolyota ot zhestokostey vneshnego mira, snaryadov i pul.
«Raptor» — otlichnaya igra: bystraya, vesyolaya i ne osobo zagruzhayushchaya osnovnoy mozg vysokimi myslyami o tom, kuda my letim i zachem my strelyaem — letim kuda prikazhut i strelyaem kuda skazhut. Otklyuchites na paru chasov, pomeditiruyte vmeste s «Zovom Teney»!

NIChTO NE PROISKhODIT BEZ PRIChINY...

Kak palomnik, vy vozglavite ego puteshestvie, kotoroe dolzhno priblizit vas k smyslu bytiya, a takzhe razyskat i otomstit ubiytse vashego opekuna. 

POSTAPOKALIPTIChESKIY MIR ROBOTOV
V Ultreïa u vas budet vozmozhnost posetit unikalnyy mir, polnyy robotov. Sotni razlichnykh robotov zhivut na poverkhnosti, kotoraya napominaet videniya iz postapokalipticheskikh istoriy - sobirayas, sredi prochego, v gorode Maunt-Sent-Trua. 

Odnako pod zemley obitayut sushchestva, kotorye sushchestvuyut vo tme i pronizany eyu. V svoem puteshestvii vy budete issledovat poverkhnost planety, podzemnye khody i mnogoe drugoe!

KLASSIChESKOE PRIKLYuChENIE S MRAChNOY I UGRYuMOY ATMOSFEROY
Vse, chto vy lyubite v igrakh zhanra point 'n click - sbor predmetov i vzaimodeystvie s nimi, reshenie slozhnykh i neobychnykh golovolomok, obshchenie s NPC s bolshim kolichestvom dialogov i uvlekatelnyy syuzhet. 

Vse eto proiskhodit v mrachnom mire, podcherknutom spetsificheskim graficheskim stilem i prekrasnym originalnym saundtrekom ot Yann Latour.

Klyuchevye osobennosti:
- Vdokhnovlennaya atmosferoy klassicheskikh priklyuchencheskikh igr 
- Uvlekatelnyy syuzhet, polnyy filosofii i poiska smysla
- 50 lokatsiy, 20 neigrovykh personazhey i bolee 1000 replik dialoga
- Zakhvatyvayushchie i slozhnye golovolomki, kotorye nuzhno reshit
- Temnye i mrachnye vizualnye effekty i zvukovoe oformlenie s originalnym saundtrekom ot Yanna Latura
Психологический хоррор от первого лица с:
Psikhologicheskiy khorror ot pervogo litsa s napryazhennym geympleem i uzhasayushchey istoriey! Chto by vy sdelali, esli by prosnulis v tyomnoy zapertoy komnate s okrovavlennymi rukami? Vam predstoit igrat za Luku i perezhit adskie pytki MADiSON — demona, kotoryy zastavlyaet vas sovershat chudovishchnye veshchi dlya prodolzheniya mnogoletnego krovavogo rituala. Udastsya li vam zavershit etot zloveshchiy obryad?
— U kazhdogo personazha budet svoya zhutkaya istoriya, yarko dopolnyayushchaya osnovnoe povestvovanie. Budte krayne ostorozhny i postaraytes ne privlekat k sebe lishnego vnimaniya. Vy budete ne odni.
— Kazhdoe prokhozhdenie budet otlichatsya ot predydushchego blagodarya raznoobraziyu sluchaynykh sobytiy i menyayushchikhsya golovolomok
— Ispolzuyte fotoapparat, chtoby perezhit eti pytki ili okunutsya v nikh glubzhe. Proyavlyayte sdelannye fotografii i raskroyte uzhasayushchuyu sut etogo mira.
— Grafika i vysokokachestvennyy zvuk pomogut vam v polnoy mere ispytat zhutkuyu atmosferu!
CARRION — хоррор, в котором вам предстои: CARRION — khorror, v kotorom vam predstoit okazatsya v roli khishchnika, amorfnogo sushchestva neizvestnogo proiskhozhdeniya. Vyslezhivayte i pozhirayte vsekh, kto prichasten k vashemu zatocheniyu, seya strakh i paniku v kazhdom ugolke laboratorii. Rastite, evolyutsioniruyte i obretayte vse novye sokrushitelnye sposobnosti na svoem puti k svobode i krovavomu vozmezdiyu.
Set in a distant future where the world:
Set in a distant future where the world has been ravaged by war, Harmonia is a sci-fi visual novel about a robot boy and a human girl who come to form a special bond. A touching story that has been well-received the world over now comes to the Nintendo Switch™ system!

Now fully voiced!
Protagonist Rei, as well as twenty-six background characters, are all given voices for the first time. Be swept up anew by passionate performances from star voice actors!

Text in three languages!
The text can be set to Japanese, English, or Simplified Chinese (audio only available in Japanese). This includes in-game text, options, and the digital manual. Language settings can be changed at any time.

Summary
In the distant future, the Earth has been ravaged by an immense war, leaving the human population dwindling. In this ruined world, a humanoid robot boy, designated Phiroid, awakens in a disused facility. 
Prior to the war, Phiroids were the purest form of human scientific achievement, imbued with all five senses and emotive functionality. Designed as partners for humans, they promised to make life better for all humanity. 
When this boy-type Phiroid awakens, however, he quickly realizes that he is missing his emotive functions. Harboring an innate need for human contact, and to regain his missing emotions, he sets out into the devastated earth.
Having walked for countless days, he eventually loses consciousness, only to be saved by a lone girl. Thinking that he is human, the girl takes good care of him. As this Phiroid boy lives alongside this girl, little by little, he comes to learn about emotions.

*There are no choice-based story branches in this game.
