Мы приняли трудное решение прекратить пр:
My prinyali trudnoe reshenie prekratit prodazhu HyperBrawl Tournament na etoy platforme 30 sentyabrya 2022. S 30 sentyabrya 2022 onlayn-rezhim perestanet rabotat.
Esli vy priobreli tsifrovuyu versiyu igry, ona ostanetsya u vas v biblioteke. Odnako nekotorye funktsii budut neaktivny.
— V onlayn-rezhime (s podklyucheniem cherez internet) igroki ne smogut voyti v igru.
— V oflayn-rezhime (bez podklyucheniya k internetu) igrokam budut dostupny vse igrovye oflayn-rezhimy, naprimer, Kampaniya ili Arkada. Odnako igroki ne smogut poluchat ili otkryvat kontent, a takzhe povyshat uroven.
My ochen blagodarny nashemu soobshchestvu za podderzhku i za to, chto vy s nami.

STANTE LEGENDARNYM BOYTsOM V HYPERBRAWL
Velichayshie geroi vselennoy sobralis, chtoby prinyat uchastie v bitve veka, — legendarnom turnire HyperBrawl! Vooruzhennye unikalnym oruzhiem, oni zhazhdut slavy! Srazites na arenakh s tremya drugimi igrokami po lokalnoy seti ili onlayn v etom arkadnoy sportivnoy igre s elementami faytinga.

OSVOYTE GIPERKRIVUYu
Tolko elitnye chempiony vselennoy mogut ovladet etim neveroyatnym navykom. Giperkrivaya pozvolyaet vam vzyat myach pod svoy kontrol vo vremya poleta, chtoby «magicheskim» obrazom oboyti sopernikov i prepyatstviya i zabit legendarnye goly, kotorye vozmozhny tolko v HyperBrawl. 

ISPOLZUYTE GIPERSILU
Kazhdaya kletka vashego organizma propitana legendarnoy gipersiloy. Ispolzuyte ee, chtoby provodit sokrushitelnye ataki, kotorye v bukvalnom smysle vykinut vashikh vragov s areny s neveroyatnoy siloy.

VSE GEROI V SBORE
Znamenitye v svoikh mirakh geroi sobirayutsya iz samykh otdalennykh ugolkov vselennoy, chtoby prinyat uchastie v turnire HyperBrawl. Vybirayte iz 12 geroev v trekh klassakh, snaryadite ikh smertelnymi kombinatsiyami iz pushek i raskraste ikh bronyu v pobednye kraski. 

OPASNYE ARENY
Otpravtes skvoz prostranstvo i vremya na areny HyperBrawl, kotorye raspolozhilis na rodnykh planetakh geroev. Nasladites vidami vozvyshennogo stadiona Khrom Siti v stile kiberpanka, drevnim stadionom v Stilkhendzhe ili demonicheskim Dvorom Azdricha. Kazhdaya arena napolnena opasnymi prepyatstviyami i lovushkami, kotorye delayut kazhduyu igru eshche bolee zakhvatyvayushchey i nepredskazuemoy.
Война не прекращается уже тысячу лет. Пр:
Voyna ne prekrashchaetsya uzhe tysyachu let. Prichinoy neprimirimogo protivostoyaniya mezhdu lyudmi i elfami stala Palka Istiny. No skazano, chto prishestvie Novichka ochen skoro izmenit khod voyny. Prorochestvo sbyvaetsya. Vashe puteshestvie nachinaetsya.

Eta istoriya v luchshikh traditsiyakh South Park pridumana i ozvuchena Treem Parkerom i Mettom Stounom. Vy otpravites v epicheskoe priklyuchenie, chtoby stat po-nastoyashchemu krutym geroem. Prisoedinyaytes k Stenu, Kaylu, Kartmanu i Kenni i stante spasitelem Yuzhnogo parka.
Стань принцессой волшебного замка!\n\nPr:
Stan printsessoy volshebnogo zamka!

Pretty Princess Party na Nintendo Switch™ umchit tebya v volshebnuyu stranu, gde zakoldovannyy zamok zhdet vozvrashcheniya khozyayki. Nauchis byt printsessoy i ukras zamok po svoemu vkusu! Sozday geroinyu i podberi dlya nee plate, tufelki i prichesku, a potom sygray v shest zamechatelnykh mini-igr, chtoby nauchitsya ukrashat torty, tantsevat i ezdit verkhom. Verni zamku utrachennoe velikolepie i poluchi nagradu!

Uspekh v mini-igrakh otkroet novye kostyumy i podarit sotni predmetov dlya 20 komnat tvoego zamka — vsego v igre mozhno poluchit bolshe 1300 ukrasheniy! Kogda komnaty budut gotovy, ty smozhesh sfotografirovat ikh i pokazat druzyam, chto takoe korolevskaya roskosh! Dazhe proydya etu volshebnuyu skazku do kontsa, ty smozhesh vypolnyat dopolnitelnye zadaniya, chtoby komnaty i fotografii vsegda udivlyali svoey noviznoy.
Doraemon: Story of Seasons продолжает ис:
Doraemon: Story of Seasons prodolzhaet istoriyu Nobi i ego druzey! Populyarnyy simulyator fermera s chetvertvekovoy istoriey i uchastiem kultovogo personazha yaponskoy animatsii — Doraemon — poluchil prodolzhenie, stav eshche raznoobraznee, chem prezhde!
Sazhayte semena, razvodite zhivotnykh i puskayte v khod poleznye ustroystva Doraemon. Eta ocharovatelno kavaynaya istoriya nikogo ne ostavit ravnodushnym!
Как двуногая медуза справляется с семейн:
Kak dvunogaya meduza spravlyaetsya s semeynym krizisom pri pomoshchi bochek alkogolya, tonn narkotikov, kilometrov seksa, ramsov i mnozhestva strannykh sushchestv v tyomnoy dekadentskoy zemle, polnoy vsyakikh gryaznykh delishek?..
Posle togo, kak vas brosila zhena, Meduu (eto vy) otpravlyaetes v blizhayshiy bar, chtoby utopit svoyo gore v vine. No to, chto nachinalos kak ocherednoy semeynyy krizis vskore stanet neozhidannym, syurrealistichnym i vesma izvrashchennym puteshestviem — v okruzhenii eshchyo bolee strannykh poputchikov…
Мистический мир Oaken лежит вне времени:
Misticheskiy mir Oaken lezhit vne vremeni i prostranstva. Na vetvyakh Velikogo duba (Great Oak) naselyayushchie ego lesnye dukhi izdrevle prislushivayutsya k tainstvennomu golosu, kotoryy oni nazyvayut Pesnyu duba (Oak Song).
I kogda etot golos umolkaet, mezhdu obitatelyami dreva nachinaetsya rasprya, kotoraya libo istselit Velikiy dub, libo okonchatelno ego unichtozhit.

- Kampaniya, orientirovannaya na otdelnykh geroev i sochetayushchaya v sebe elementy kak «rogalika», tak i kollektsionnoy kartochnoy igry.
- Misticheskiy mir, naselennyy dukhami i vdokhnovlennyy mifologiey drevnikh keltov.
- Protsedurno-sgenerirovannyy mir so mnozhestvom urovney, bossov i razlichnogo roda sobytiy.
- Originalnye srazheniya na setke polya boya, gde vazhnuyu rol igraet raspolozhenie vashikh otryadov.
- Gibkaya sistema uluchsheniy vashikh dukhov i dostupnykh im char.
- Legko osvoit, slozhno pokorit, no uroven slozhnosti vybiraete vy sami.
Shoot, jump, and slide your way through:
Shoot, jump, and slide your way through a ruined, mysterious, dog-filled world as you fight to save humanity from the clutches of a rogue AI named Daddy. Acquire new weapons, upgrade them to be more powerful, collect secrets, meet bizarre characters, and explore the ruins of a destroyed world.


After a catastrophic event on Earth, humanity is directed underground and into pods for their safety. You are told that the surface world is dangerous and uninhabitable, and inside the pods is the only safe place to be. But when you are launched from the underground in a freak accident, you realize that the surface is just fine and there's more to this world than you thought. The surface is teeming with life, except... they all seem to be dogs. And some of them talk.


Explore a world where all the living creatures seem to be some variety of dog

Slide to dodge through enemies and projectiles

Uncover secrets and abilities to help you on your journey

Traverse difficult platforming and combat challenges

Collect and upgrade various powerful weapons

Take on a multitude of powerful bosses

Pet dogs

Stark 1bit pixel art

Full original chiptune score
Prehistoric Dude — это мини-игра в стиле:
Prehistoric Dude — eto mini-igra v stile metroidvaniya vo epokhu kamennogo veka, rasskazyvayushchaya istoriyu o Dude, druzhelyubnom peshchernom cheloveke, kotoryy lyubit vetchinu! Issleduyte 3 razlichnykh stsenariya v poiskakh vkusnogo obeda dlya Dude! Srazhaytes s vragami, preodolevayte prepyatstviya, osvaivayte novye navyki i delayte Dude eshche silnee!

Otpravlyaytes v priklyuchenie, chtoby pomoch emu vernut svoy obed, kotoryy byl ukraden gigantskim dinozavrom! Emu pridetsya stolknutsya so mnogimi opasnymi vragami, puteshestvuya po peshcheram i lesam, chtoby poluchit nekotorye instrumenty i bonusy. Vasha zadacha — pomoch emu v etom puteshestvii.

Kharakteristiki:
* 3 razlichnykh stsenariya v atmosfere kamennogo veka,
* alternativnye puti dlya izucheniya,
* zapominayushchayasya chiptyunovaya muzyka i yarkaya grafika v 8-bitnom stile,
* 7 razlichnykh spetsialnykh predmetov s poleznymi sposobnostyami.
Загадочная история раскрывается на почто:
Zagadochnaya istoriya raskryvaetsya na pochtovykh otkrytkakh, ispisannykh nevidimymi chernilami...

Otpravtes v puteshestvie v proshloe v debyutnoy igre ot Stave Studios, OVER THE ALPS. Ne vydat sebya, uyti ot politsii i uchastvovat v gonkakh po Shveytsarii 1939 goda: vse eto zhdet vas v shpionskom trillere vremen Vtoroy mirovoy voyny.

Issleduyte vse ukromnye ugolki interaktivnogo narrativa ot Dzhona Ingolda, avtora 80 Days i Heaven's Vault, gde lyuboe vashe deystvie budet imet posledstviya.

Opisanie:
- interaktivnyy narrativ, napolnennyy ekshenom, priklyucheniyami i nostalgiey.

- Prekrasno oformlennye peyzazhi, naveyannye starinnymi plakatami.

- Vychislyayte, kto drug, a kto vrag, iz vsego mnogoobraziya personazhey.

- Vyberite svoy marshrut na karte s realnymi mestami.
Откройте новые миры вместе с шустрым ёжи:
Otkroyte novye miry vmeste s shustrym yozhikom Sonikom, kotoryy otpravlyaetsya na poiski propavshikh Izumrudov Khaosa i popadaet na drevniy ostrov, naselyonnyy prichudlivymi sushchestvami. Pokoryayte novye vysoty, razvivayte neveroyatnuyu skorost, svobodno peremeshchaytes po pyati ogromnym ostrovam Zvezdopada, ishchite sekrety, prygayte po platformam, obretite silu Drevnikh i srazites s mogushchestvennymi i zagadochnymi nepriyatelyami! Vas zhdyot sovershenno novyy vid igr o Sonike!

Platformer s otkrytym mirom
Probegites po gustym lesam, velichestvennym vodopadam i zasushlivym pustynyam pyati masshtabnykh ostrovov, kazhdyy iz kotorykh predlagaet unikalnye ispytaniya i tait mnozhestvo sekretov.
 
Neogranichennaya skorost
Otkroyte ostrova Zvezdopada na skorosti, kotoraya dostupna lish Soniku. Svobodno peredvigaytes po prostornym lokatsiyam, vypolnyayte pobochnye zadaniya, reshayte golovolomki, vzbiraytes na ogromnye sooruzheniya, rybachte i naveshchayte starykh druzey.
 
Ispytaniya v kiberprostranstve
Po vsemu ostrovu razbrosany portaly, kotorye vedut pryamikom v kiberprostranstvo. Proydite skvoz nikh i proverte svoi navyki na tryokhmernykh polosakh prepyatstviy, kotorymi slavyatsya igry o Sonike.
 
Kiberneticheskie bitvy
Ostrova Zvezdopada naselyayut strannye sushchestva, kotorykh Sonik eshchyo ni razu ne vstrechal. Vospolzuytes sovershenno novoy boevoy sistemoy i drevom navykov, chtoby uchastvovat v strategicheskikh bitvakh. Chereduyte priyomy vrode ukloneniya, parirovaniya, kontrataki, kombo i novoy sposobnosti «Krugovoy ryvok» dlya pobedy nad zagadochnymi vragami i velikanami.
 
Intriguyushchee i napolnennoe taynami priklyuchenie
Pomogite Soniku otkryt sekrety ruin drevney tsivilizatsii, zakhvachennykh polchishchami robotov. Sleduyte ukazaniyam bestelesnogo golosa, chtoby nayti otvety na svoi voprosy, spasti druzey i zashchitit zagadochnykh obitateley ostrovov Zvezdopada ot kolossalnoy mekhanizirovannoy ugrozy.
От создателей Life is Strange и Vampyr!\:
Ot sozdateley Life is Strange i Vampyr!
Syuzhetnoe priklyuchenie pro devushku po imeni Polli, kotoraya obnaruzhivaet u sebya dar yasnovideniya i blagodarya emu svyazyvaetsya s mirom bogov Reverie (mechtatelnost, gryozy).
Okazavshis tam, Polli prevrashchaetsya v boginyu Garmoniyu. Ey predstoit opredelit, kakoe iz zhivushchikh v etom mire chelovecheskikh stremleniy (Slava, Blazhenstvo, Vlast, Khaos, Svyaz, Istina) budet pravit nad ostalnymi.
Zaglyadyvayte v budushchee i prinimayte resheniya, kotorye dolzhny budut vosstanovit balans mezhdu realnym mirom i mirom bogov, v konechnom itoge opredelit dalneyshuyu sudbu vsego chelovechestva..
Henchman Story is an interactive story w:
Henchman Story is an interactive story where you play as a beleaguered henchman working for a bumbling supervillain.

It’s thankless work. Week in and week out, you put on your purple spandex and get the crap beaten out of you by much stronger, much cooler people wearing much fancier spandex. But the checks clear, and Lord Bedlam offers healthcare, so a job’s a job, right?

Even henchmen have bills to pay, and sometimes, even henchmen can make choices that change everything.

Features:
- Superhero Satire: A comedic take on the world of superheroes that revels in the ridiculous nature of its setting, and showcases a colourful, comic book aesthetic.

- Colourful Characters: Find friends, enemies and even romance amongst a lively cast of villains, heroes and fellow henchmen.

- Meaningful Choices: Your decisions directly influence the story - leading to eleven endings, determining the fate of its characters, and if you play your cards right, you might even earn a promotion!

- Full Voice Acting: Starring a talented cast of professional actors that have been featured in anime, video games and more!
Исследуйте огромный средневековый мир, у:
Issleduyte ogromnyy srednevekovyy mir, unichtozhayte razlichnykh mekhanicheskikh sushchestv, chtoby uluchshit boevye navyki i priyomy.


Attu — obychnyy robot-fermer, zhivushchiy v nebolshom domike posredi polya podsolnukhov. Ego zhizn byla prostoy, no priyatnoy, poka na derevnyu ne napala banda razboynikov, kotorye unesli s soboy zapasy maslyanoy smazki i sozhgli ego dom.
K schastyu, Attu smog sbezhat v les, prikhvativ s soboy staryy mech.

Otkroyte dlya sebya ogromnyy vzaimosvyazannyy mir s bolshim vyborom protivnikov, bossov, navykov, ekipirovki. Vyberite, kakim putyom poyti i s kakim vragom srazitsya. Poprobuyte odolet zlo i nayti put domoy.

Osobennosti:
- Srednevekovye roboty, upravlyaemye rybami!
- Dinamicheskaya boevaya sistema s mechami, granatami, uvorotami i drugimi spetsialnymi atakami
- Razlichnaya ekipirovka, pozvolyayushchaya izmenyat vneshniy vid i kharakteristiki personazha
- Vozmozhnost issledovat ogromnyy vzaimosvyazannyy mir s bolshim vyborom vragov
- Raznoobraznoe risovannoe okruzhenie
- Lut, mnogo luta!
- Skrytye predmety
- Sekretnye oblasti
Dark Sauce is a cubical platforming game:
Dark Sauce is a cubical platforming game that delivers everything the true gamer needs: colourful 3D graphics with voxels, challenging levels, memorable NPCs, dungeons, dragons and valuable loot!

Delve deep into the dungeon full with villainous monsters and lethal traps. Mountains of gold will be your reward, but beware — ancient and dangerous dragon relentlessly guards them.

Take this challenge if you dare. You'll have to overcome complex levels and take down the powerful dragon, who keeps gold treasures safe. And one more thing — you don't have any super-abilities. You are just a small piggy who ventured deep into the dark and dangerous dungeon. Try to survive it!
Исследуйте два мира: тот, который вы зна:
Issleduyte dva mira: tot, kotoryy vy znaete i alternativnuyu realnost, nakhodyashchuyusya za Zerkalnym zalom. Otkroyte sekret drevnego sushchestva, izvestnogo kak Dyavol. Otkroyte istoriyu neschastnykh vlyublennykh i ne dayte Dyavolu izbavitsya ot magicheskikh tsepey i vtorgnutsya v nash mir.

Vo vremya puteshestviya po izmereniyam vy budete prokhodit khitroumno razrabotannye mini-igry i iskat skrytye obekty ili igrat v spetsialnye mini-igry v kachestve alternativy. A prezhde vsego, vy podruzhites s miloy i umnoy obezyankoy, kotoraya spodvignet vas na etu avantyuru.
Inner Ashes – сюжетная игра с повествова:
Inner Ashes – syuzhetnaya igra s povestvovaniem ot pervogo litsa, v kotoroy igrok ispytyvaet na sebe, kak bolezn Altsgeymera vliyaet na lyudey i na ikh vospominaniya, na primere volnuyushchey istorii ottsa i docheri, izlozhennoy v forme fantasticheskikh epizodov.

Sparklite — это динамичная приключенческ:
Sparklite — eto dinamichnaya priklyuchencheskaya igra, deystvie kotoroy razvorachivaetsya v neobychnoy strane Geodii. Srazhaytes v bitvakh s vidom sverkhu, ispolzuya tselyy arsenal ustroystv, oruzhiya i snaryazheniya. Issleduyte vse opasnye ugolki protsedurno sgenerirovannogo mira, nizvergnite titanov shakhterskoy industrii i ovladeyte siloy Sparklite!

Sparklite — svyazuyushchaya nit mira Geodii... Eto zhiznennaya sila planety i mestnye obitateli nauchilis ispolzovat ee. Posle obrabotki sinyaya siyayushchaya ruda stanovitsya istochnikom ne ochen moshchnoy, no vozobnovlyaemoy energii. Khrabretsy ili zhadiny mogut poglotit ee, chtoby stat obladatelyami moshchnoy sily, odnako posledstviya etogo vesma serezny. Samozvanyy Baron Geodii, zhelaya dostich svoikh tseley, reshil dokopatsya do samogo yadra Sparklite. Baron dobyvaet ogromnoe kolichestvo Sparklite, na sile kotorogo rabotayut ego moguchie voennye mashiny, no ispolzovannyy Sparklite zagryaznyaet i izvrashchaet mir. Zhivotnye prevratilis v agressivnykh monstrov, a okruzhayushchiy mir medlenno pogibaet.

U yadra Sparklitepostradavshey Geodii est sobstvennyy zashchitnyy mekhanizm. Periodicheski yadro vyzyvaet Raskol, kotoryy perestraivaet mir, prepyatstvuya usiliyam Barona. Ada — nasha geroinya — dolzhna ostanovit Barona, poka on ne poluchil yadro i silu dlya sozdaniya novogo mira, v kotorom on budet obladat neodolimoy moshchyu. Ada — khrabryy mekhanik. Ona ispolzuet vse svoi umeniya, chtoby pobedit pomoshchnikov Barona, nakhodyashchikhsya v pyati unikalnykh oblastyakh. Ade pridetsya sotrudnichat so strannymi i prekrasnymi obladatelyami Geodii, esli ona khochet stolknutsya s Baronom i polozhit konets ego smertonosnym planam, poka ne stalo slishkom pozdno. 

Nashey geroine pridetsya otpravitsya vo vse oblasti mira, chtoby pokonchit s shakhtami Barona, poka eshche ne pozdno...

Klyuchevye funktsii
•	Potryasayushchiy vizualnyy ryad: izyashchnaya pikselnaya grafika, vdokhnovlennaya klassicheskimi igrami.
•	Issleduyte mir igry Sparklite: pyat prekrasnykh biomov, sgenerirovannykh protsedurno.
•	Sobirayte sobstvennyy arsenal: izobretayte ustroystva, chtoby reshat golovolomki i pobezhdat vragov.
•	Srazhaytes s bossami: vykhodite na boy protiv shakhterskoy imperii Barona i uzhasnykh titanov-gremlinov.

Чем Flowing Lights отличается от других:
Chem Flowing Lights otlichaetsya ot drugikh arkadnykh shuterov?
Elementami golovolomki! Ty smozhesh ne tolko nasladitsya strelboy po monstram, no i porabotat golovoy. Chem slozhnee zadachi, tem bolshe udovolstviya ot ikh resheniya!

V chem zaklyuchaetsya sut elementov golovolomki?
Kazhdyy boy zaduman kak golovolomka, dlya resheniya kotoroy trebuetsya osobaya taktika. Blagodarya unikalnoy fizike i sisteme relefa snaryady dvizhutsya podobno kaplyam vody, chto sozdaet novye uvlekatelnye situatsii. Tsel igry — ne prosto unichtozhit vsekh vragov, a nayti vernuyu taktiku! Eto mozhet potrebovat neskolkikh popytok, i oshibki yavlyayutsya estestvennoy chastyu protsessa, poetomu igra Flowing Lights razrabotana tak, chtoby eksperimentirovat bylo legko i prosto. Boy mozhno nachat snachala v lyuboy moment bez kakikh-libo shtrafov.

Tselevaya auditoriya:
Nauchitsya igrat v Flowing Lights legko, a vot stat profi neprosto. Eta igra dlya tekh, kto ne boitsya slozhnostey. Za pobedu v kazhdom boyu mozhno poluchit odin iz 4 rangov: C, B, A i S. Dazhe opytnym igrokam pridetsya postaratsya, chtoby dostich ranga A ili S, ved dlya etogo neobkhodimo zavershit vse kombo. V to zhe vremya blagodarya podskazkam i rezhimu obucheniya igra budet interesna i novichkam.

Osobennosti:
— Elementy golovolomki delayut igru interesnoy i nepredskazuemoy
— Arkadnyy geympley v stile retro: plavnyy, vyverennyy i uvlekatelnyy
— Unikalnyy, osnovannyy na fizike igrovoy protsess, gde gravitatsiya igraet rol tretego izmereniya
— 200 tshchatelno produmannykh boev. Kazhdyy boy unikalen i soderzhit dopolnitelnye ispytaniya
— Blagodarya bonusam, kombo, rangam i onlayn-tablitsam liderov igru interesno prokhodit snova i snova

Вы попали в грязную, закостенелую антиут:
Vy popali v gryaznuyu, zakosteneluyu antiutopiyu pryamikom iz 80-kh v roli toy samoy videomerzosti, o kotoroy preduprezhdali vlasti. Vy — polzayushchiy po asfaltu giperparazit s shchupaltsami; ozloblennyy prishelets, voruyushchiy tela. A pochemu by i net?! Zarazhaya khudshie proyavleniya samogo potryasnogo desyatiletiya, vy dolzhny probitsya k vershine pop-kulturnoy pishchevoy tsepi, chtoby nazhat bolshuyu krasnuyu knopku i ustroit yadernyy apokalipsis. Budte besposhchadny, peremeshchayas po protsedurno sgenerirovannym surovym ulitsam beznadezhnogo budushchego v etom roguelike twin-stick shutere.

'Da zdravstvuet novaya plot!'
Vy tolko posmotrite na vse eti sochnye meshki s myasom, kotorye propadayut zrya! V roli giperparazita vy mozhete effektivnee ispolzovat ikh, zakhvatyvaya tela svoimi shchupaltsami, pogloshchaya nositeley i ikh razlichnye sposobnosti. Kak tolko nositel umret, vy smozhete pokinut ego brennoe telo. No odno popadanie v uyazvimogo parazita, i igre konets igre, tak chto prodolzhayte zakhvatyvat drugie tela.

'V zdorovom tele zdorovyy dukh'
V vashem rasporyazhenii bolee 60 razlichnykh personazhey so svoimi unikalnymi atakami i sposobnostyami. Otkryvayte i zakhvatyvayte ikh! Pobedite elitnogo predstavitelya klassa, zaberite ego mozg i prinesite ego Vito — prodavtsu s neutolimoy zhadnostyu. Ispolzuyte odnu iz ego kapsul dlya khraneniya mozga, chtoby razblokirovat personazha za vashi chestno ukradennye dengi. Est dazhe khranilishche dlya uzhe otkrytykh personazhey, kotorykh mozhno ispolzovat v posleduyushchikh igrakh.

'Dauntaun, dolzhno byt, samoe druzhelyubnoe mesto na zemle…'
Blagodarya protsedurnoy generatsii neizvestno, chto zhdet vas v temnykh podvorotnyakh. V igre dostupno 5 razlichnykh aktov so svoim naborom personazhey, kotorykh mozhno otkryt i zakhvatit. Takzhe v igre polnym-polno sekretov vnutri sekretov, kotorye mozhno issledovat vo vremya mnogochislennykh povtornykh prokhozhdeniy. No beregite shchupaltsa dlya vstrech s bossami, tak kak oni byut bolno!

Pribavte gromkost!

Представленный в пиксельной графике и ус:
Predstavlennyy v pikselnoy grafike i ustanovit v budushchem post-apokalipticheskom nastroyki, Convoy yavlyaetsya otryad na osnove takticheskikh rogalik v ego yadre. Vy puteshestvuete s boevymi mashinami i konvoem cherez pustyr, chtoby nayti chasti, neobkhodimye dlya remonta slomannogo kosmicheskogo korablya. Vo vremya puteshestviya vy budete stalkivatsya s chuzhimi v randomizirovannykh stsenariyakh, podbiraya radiosignaly.

V zavisimosti ot vybora vy delaete, signaly mogut privesti libo k takticheskomu boyu, tekst na osnove dialoga ili sluchaynoy osnove rolevoy igry. Kakoy by vybor vy delaete, vy dolzhny derzhat svoy konvoy i ego gruz v bezopasnosti ot reyderov, chastnikov i drugikh vragov. Derzhite modernizatsiyu vashikh transportnykh sredstv, tak kak smert yavlyaetsya postoyannoy v konvoe.

Kharakteristiki

- Novyy vzglyad na takticheskiy boy: Combat igraet v realnom vremeni, kak vysokoskorostnoy avtomobilnoy pogoni, gde nuzhno raspolozhit bloki i ispolzovat sposobnosti, chtoby obespechit ikh maksimalnuyu effektivnost.
- Exploration platit: Vy stolknetes s mnozhestvom razlichnykh radiosignalov, kazhdyy s sobytiem teksta na osnove. Chto ne ubivaet, to mozhet nagradit vas s nagrablennym.
- Polnostyu nastraivaemye edinitsy izmereniya: Kazhdyy blok mozhet byt modernizirovan i osnashchen razlichnymi vidami oruzhiya i sposobnostey, chto pozvolyaet nastroit ikh dlya vashikh nuzhd.
- randomizirovannye planety: Kazhdaya igra Prokhodnoy predusmotreny razlichnymi osnovnye i pobochnye tseli, sobytie, vybor i razlichnye posledstviya vashikh deystviy.
- Kholodnaya voyna povorot zharko: Tri fraktsii boryutsya za kontrol nad planetoy, vashi deystviya chashu vesov balansa delaet Vas vragom dlya vsekh. Poskolku kazhdaya fraktsiya rastet v sile, vy dolzhny idti v nogu.
- Permadeath v yadre: Znaya odno nevernoe dvizhenie mozhet privesti k opredelennym put smerti vy postoyanno na krayu.
Симулятор алхимика, в котором вы физичес:
Simulyator alkhimika, v kotorom vy fizicheski vzaimodeystvuete s ingredientami i instrumentami v protsesse varki zeliy. Pridumyvayte novye retsepty, privlekayte klientov i eksperimentiruyte! Na vas rasschityvaet ves gorod!
— Izuchite iskusstvo zelevareniya: sostavte plan prigotovleniya zelya. Nachnite s osnovy: voda, maslo ili... chto-to eshche. Izmelchite ingredienty, tshchatelno peremeshayte ikh v kotle, razogrev ugli, i varite do gotovnosti. Pozdravlyaem s pervym zelem! Bylo legko, pravda? A teper poprobuyte prigotovit chto-nibud poslozhnee!
— Eksperimentiruyte i izobretayte novye retsepty: tshchatelno splaniruyte svoy marshrut po Alkhimicheskoy karte, i vy smozhete svarit zele s kombinatsiey iz razlichnykh effektov. No ne zabyvayte o zdravom smysle: vryad li naydetsya pokupatel na yadovitoe tselebnoe zele... verno? Ili vse zhe naydetsya?
— Prodavayte zelya: kazhdyy den v vashu lavku budut prikhodit pokupateli v poiskakh resheniya svoikh problem. Tolko ot vas zavisit, kak vy budete pomogat im, i vse vashi resheniya budut imet posledstviya. Sotrudnichayte s gildiyami, druzhite s izvestnymi lichnostyami (ili vrazhduyte s nimi), poluchayte bogatstvo i vliyanie – i togda odnazhdy, vozmozhno, vy reshite sudbu vsego goroda.
— Pokupayte ingredienty ili vyrashchivayte sobstvennye: kazhdomu alkhimiku nuzhny ingredienty. Vy mozhete kupit ikh u stranstvuyushchikh torgovtsev: eto mozhet byt dorogo, no udachnyy torg mozhet sekonomit vam neskolko monet. A mozhno prosto vyrastit ikh u sebya v sadu!
— Pridumayte svoy stil: khotite pridat osobyy vid vashim zelyam? Net problem! Forma butylki, etiketka, ikonka i tsveta – vsyo poddaetsya nastroyke! Vy dazhe mozhete dat svoemu zelyu sobstvennoe nazvanie i opisanie. Akkuratno rasstavte zelya na polkakh v lavke... ili nebrezhno razbrosayte ikh povsyudu – vsyo zavisit ot vas! Kto my takie, chtoby vam sovetovat? Razvlekaytes!

Unikalnye sobytiya i stsenarii

Выступая в качестве окончательного празд:
Vystupaya v kachestve okonchatelnogo prazdnovaniya desyatiletiya, razzhigayushchikh mozgovykh deystviy ot pervogo litsa, Q.U.B.E. 10 -ya godovshchina dobavlyaet izyskannye vizualnye effekty, polnostyu pererabotannye i peresmotrennye razdely geympleya i tseluyu novuyu glavu v novyy vzglyad na klassicheskiy golovolomku, polnostyu vosstanovlennyy s nulya.

В маленьком городке в Австрийских Альпах: V malenkom gorodke v Avstriyskikh Alpakh doch mera vpadaet v komu posle neschastnogo sluchaya. Absolute Tactics: Daughters of Mercy — у:
Absolute Tactics: Daughters of Mercy — uvlekatelnoe poshagovoe rolevoe priklyuchenie, razvivayushchee idei klassicheskikh takticheskikh igr. V Absolute Tactics vas zhdet mnozhestvo raznoobraznykh personazhey, ogromnye bossy-monstry i mrachnyy, okhvachennyy voynoy mir. Vmeste s glavnym geroem Khaksli i ego psom Maksom vam predstoit sobrat komandu vernykh soyuznikov i dat otpor zagadochnoy armii vtorzheniya.

Upravlyayte boevymi edinitsami i ispolzuyte ikh unikalnye vozmozhnosti, chtoby sokrushit vraga. Vasha strategiya dolzhna uchityvat raspolozhenie boytsov na pole boya, razlichnye skhemy ataki i unikalnye navyki kazhdogo personazha. Doroga k pobede budet neprostoy, ved na vashem puti uzhe podzhidayut smertonosnye vragi, lovushki, golovolomki i prepyatstviya.

Spisok osobennostey
• 25 syuzhetnykh i 11 dopolnitelnykh kart, v tom chisle rezhim ordy i dostupnyy posle zaversheniya osnovnoy igry kontent!
• Tri bazovykh i odin dopolnitelnyy uroven slozhnosti, dostupnyy tolko posle prokhozhdeniya igry — zdes vam nikogda ne stanet skuchno.
• Ogromnye vozmozhnosti strategicheskogo i rolevogo otygrysha: voennye urovni s desyatkami boevykh edinits, odnovremenno deystvuyushchikh na pole boya, lovushki, elementy golovolomok i ispolzovanie relefa!
• Dostupnyy dlya novichkov igrovoy protsess, osnovannyy na klassakh, sochetaetsya s shirokimi vozmozhnostyami modifikatsii, kotorye priyatno udivyat opytnykh lyubiteley takticheskikh igr. 21 individualnyy klass i vozmozhnost sozdavat dualnye klassy otkryvayut prakticheski beskonechnoe chislo vozmozhnykh kombinatsiy.
• Otkryvayte uluchsheniya, sobirayte trofei, vypolnyayte zadaniya i znakomtes s novymi yarkimi personazhami na puti k slave i pobede.
Психологический ужас стремления к удовле:
Psikhologicheskiy uzhas stremleniya k udovletvoreniyu na granitse dvukh perepletayushchikhsya mirov. Intriguyushchiy syuzhet s eroticheskimi i okkultnymi temami upravlyaet personazhem igroka cherez viktorianskiy osobnyak Elverton i izvrashchennuyu zemlyu, vdokhnovlennuyu proizvedeniyami Lavkrafta i kartin Zdzislava Beksinskogo.

ISTORIYa
Dzhonatan Mun poluchaet pismo ot svoey zheny, kotoraya propala bez vesti god. Sleduya informatsii iz poslaniya, on napravlyaetsya v uedinennyy osobnyak, gde proiskhodit elfiycha, okkultnaya tseremoniya.
Otkryvayutsya vorota v drugoy mir - profana, izvrashchennaya zemlya Lushtkhaa.

DVA MIRA
Dvigaytes kak v viktorianskom osobnyake, tak i v Lusst'ghaa - chuzhdoe izmerenie, napolnennoe potustoronnimi sushchestvami. Lusst'ghaa byl pokhozh na nashu zemlyu, poka mestnye sushchestva ne reshili polnostyu degenerirovat po sobstvennomu zhelaniyu. Cherez eksperimenty oni transformirovali svoi tela, chtoby oni nikogda ne perestavali ispytyvat plotskie naslazhdeniya. Sotni let proshli s tekh por, kogda eta metamorfoza i Lushtkhaa teper prevratilis v zemlyu, zarosshuyu chuzhdoy rastitelnostyu i polnye chudovishch, izvivayushchikhsya v beskonechnom ekstaze.

FUNKTsII
- Eroticheskie i okkultnye temy
- Mirovoy dizayn, vdokhnovlennyy proizvedeniyami Lovecraft, Giger & Zdzisław Beksiński
- Izuchenie viktorianskogo osobnyaka i mira Lushtkhaa
- Ispolzovanie portalov dlya perekhoda mezhdu dvumya alternativnymi realiyami
- Poisk skrytykh predmetov, chtoby razblokirovat rasskazy o bitve, uznayte bolshe o predystorii igry
- Sbezhat ot sushchestv Lyusstkhia
- Originalnyy saundtrek izvestnogo kompozitora (Drako Nared)

OPISANIE SODERZhANIYa
Eta igra mozhet soderzhat kontent, ne sootvetstvuyushchiy vsem vozrastam, ili mozhet ne podkhodit dlya prosmotra na rabote: nagota ili seksualnoe soderzhanie, chastoe nasilie ili gora, obshchiy zrelyy kontent
Dungeon Warfare — сложная игра по страте:
Dungeon Warfare — slozhnaya igra po strategicheskoy oborone bashen, gde vy stanovites lordom podzemeliy dlya zashchity svoikh vladeniy ot zhadnykh avantyuristov-grabiteley.

Po mere togo kak vy uspeshno ochishchaete podzemelya ot nazoylivykh zakhvatchikov, vy poluchaete dostup ko vsyo bolee moshchnym lovushkam i izoshchryonnym prisposobleniyam.
Unichtozhayte vragov, chtoby nabiratsya opyta i postoyanno uluchshat svoi lovushki. 
 
Osobennosti igry 
 
* 26 unikalnykh lovushek s 3 urovnyami obnovleniy dlya kazhdoy.
* Passivnye obnovleniya dlya lovushek.
* Bolee 40 urovney, sozdannykh vruchnuyu.
* 22 tipa vragov.
* Vozmozhnost sozdat sobstvennyy uroven slozhnosti, sochetaya 12 run dlya uboynykh rezhimov igry.

* Zapustite ogromnuyu glybu, smetayushchuyu vsyo na svoyom puti.

* Rasstavte lovushki, kotorye bezzhalostno sbrosyat moguchikh voinov v kromeshnuyu chyornuyu bezdnu.
* Obedinite dlya borby sobstvennye sily, ispolzuya portaly dlya prizyva podkrepleniya i nachala khaotichnoy potasovki.

Vivid Knight – приключенческая игра в жа:
Vivid Knight – priklyuchencheskaya igra v zhanre Roguelike, v kotoroy nuzhno spasti druzey, prevrashchennykh v dragotsennye kamni, i sobrat ikh sposobnosti voedino, chtoby sozdat neprevzoydennuyu komandu!
Issleduyte postoyanno menyayushcheesya podzemele, nakhodite dragotsennosti i ispolzuyte ikh, chtoby pobedit Chernuyu vedmu!


◆Vasha tsel – samoe serdtse podzemelya!
Issleduyte podzemele, kotoroe menyaet oblik pri kazhdom prokhozhdenii, sokrushite Chernuyu vedmu, podzhidayushchuyu vas v samoy glubine podzemelya, i osvobodite svoikh druzey iz kamennogo plena!


◆Sobirayte kamni!
Sobirayte kamni (yunity), razbrosannye po vsemu podzemelyu, i dobavlyayte ikh v svoyu komandu. Poluchayte dublikaty kamney, chtoby povysit ikh parametry!

◆Sozdayte svoy sobstvennyy unikalnyy rytsarskiy orden!
Kogda vy dobavlyaete kamni v svoyu komandu, aktiviruyutsya moshchnye sposobnosti simvolov. Peremeshivayte i obedinyayte tsveta i simvoly sobrannykh kamney, chtoby aktivirovat razlichnye effekty i sozdat svoyu unikalnuyu komandu!
Razlichnye kombinatsii simvolov dayut raznye effekty, poetomu eksperimentiruyte s raznymi skhemami, chtoby sobrat komandu, podkhodyashchuyu imenno dlya vashego stilya igry!


◆Ispolzuyte dragotsennye kamni dlya usileniya svoey komandy!
Igroki mogut ispolzovat magicheskie sily i instrumenty, spryatannye v dragotsennykh kamnyakh, chtoby podderzhat svoyu komandu v boyu.
Strategicheski ispolzuyte dragotsennye kamni, chtoby pobedit vragov, napadayushchikh na vas v podzemele!

◆Mnozhestvo aksessuarov
V podzemele mozhno nayti razlichnye aksessuary.
Aksessuary dayut razlichnye effekty, usilivayushchie moshch vashey komandy.
Vyberite podkhodyashchie aksessuary dlya svoey komandy, i u vas poyavitsya shans spravitsya s Chernoy vedmoy!
Весёлый платформер про мускулистого кота:
Vesyolyy platformer pro muskulistogo kota-bodibildera, srazhayushchegosya s inoplaneTyanami i poedayushchego.. Ramyon!.. Igra sdelana odnim chelovekom s izryadnoy doley yaponskogo anime-bezumiya.
Prigotovtes nasladitsya sumasshedshim 2D-platformennym priklyucheniem s Kinniku Neko v glavnoy roli! Vas budut soprovozhdat druzya, Lemon i Keyta, kotorye eshchyo ne byli zakhvacheny zlymi sushchestvami iz kosmosa. No beregites!.. Svirepyy general Pitayya vmeste so svoimi dvumya prispeshnikami otnyud ne oblegchit vam zadachu! Raskroyte namereniya zloy tsivilizatsii v nashey istorii, polnoy yumora, druzhby, doramy i ekshona, vsyo v vizualnoy estetike, tipichnoy dlya traditsionnoy yaponskoy animatsii.
You’ve been hired by the Hyperspace Deli:
You’ve been hired by the Hyperspace Delivery Service to make a delivery to planet Miridian V.

Located on the other side of explored space, the trip to Miridian V will be a dangerous yet lucrative journey full of mad robots and unpredictable stellar phenomenon.
Can you and your crew survive the trip? Will you die from the dreaded Telunian flu? Hyperspace Delivery Service offers an exciting and strategically challenging journey where you must manage your fuel, oxygen, food, and various other supplies to make your delivery within the target time.

Choose what kind of captain you will be. Work the trade routes, learn to use your crews’ unique attributes, mine for fuel, search for abandoned supplies, fight robot space pirates on the ground in retro FPS, experience thrilling space battles from the bridge of your space ship in retro 3D space shooting action.

Can you make it to Miridian V? See you on the next delivery!

Features:
-Retro pixel art graphics
-Name your very own space ship
-Trade with aliens
-Shop at orbiting space stations
-Manage your food, fuel, oxygen, ship repairs, credits, and much more to keep your ship running and crew alive
-Name your crew members and watch them live or die by your decisions
-Original soundtrack using Adlib sound card inspired sounds
-Choose your play style. Work the trade routes, mine for fuel, work missions, and so much more.
-Fight robot pirates in retro FPS game-play
-Directly control your space ship to fend off pirate attacks
-Dodge asteroids!
-Perma-death hard mode
-Help space citizens or leave them to suffer
-Simple to understand with a quick core game loop which offers pick up and play style gaming
Ghostrunner — эта жестокая игра-слэшер о:
Ghostrunner — eta zhestokaya igra-slesher ot pervogo litsa s superdinamichnym syuzhetom, razvorachivayushchimsya v mrachnom kiberpankovom mire futuristicheskoy sverkhkonstruktsii. Vzbiraytes vverkh po bashne Dkharma, stavshey poslednim ubezhishchem chelovechestva posle vsemirnoy katastrofy. Proydite put snizu doverkhu, vstrettes s tiranom Kimasterom i vozdayte emu po zaslugam.

Ulitsy etogo goroda-bashni okhvacheny nasiliem. Vash zheleznyy kulak i prenebrezhenie k chelovecheskoy zhizni dolzhny razrushit ustanovlennye Kimasterom poryadki.

Kolichestvo resursov umenshaetsya, i mesto, gde teplyatsya ostatki zhizni, vse bolshe pogruzhaetsya v okhotu na slabykh i khaos. Priblizhaetsya posledniy boy — popytka predotvratit okonchatelnoe vymiranie chelovechestva.

Vy vladeete kholodnym oruzhiem luchshe, chem kto-libo iz zhivshikh na Zemle, i vragi vsegda prevoskhodyat vas chislom, no ne umeniem. Potroshite vragov monomolekulyarnym mechom-katanoy, uklonyaytes ot pul blagodarya svoim sverkhestestvennym refleksam i primenyayte raznoobraznye spetsialnye tekhniki, chtoby pobedit v boyu.

Mekhanika boya «odin udar — odna smert» delaet skhvatki dinamichnymi i intensivnymi. Ispolzuyte svoyu prevoskhodnuyu podvizhnost (i chasto vstrechayushchiesya kontrolnye tochki), chtoby bez strakha vstupit v beskonechnyy tanets so smertyu.

Igra Ghostrunner predlagaet unikalnyy rezhim odinochnoy igry: dinamichnoe zhestokoe srazhenie v originalnoy atmosfere, v kotoroy nauchnaya fantastika sochetaetsya s postapokalipticheskoy tematikoy. Igra rasskazhet vam istoriyu mira, kotoryy ostalsya v proshlom i obitateli kotorogo vynuzhdeny postoyanno srazhatsya, chtoby vyzhit.
«Billion Road» отправит вас в путешестви:
«Billion Road» otpravit vas v puteshestvie po realnym prefekturam i gorodam vsey Strany voskhodyashchego solntsa, gde vasha tsel — stat samym bogatym! Do 4-kh igrokov mogut sorevnovatsya lokalno.
Zakhvati rynok Yaponii i dominiruy v mire biznesa — kak nastoyashchiy magnat!..
Дружба не знает границ! В таинственном п:
Druzhba ne znaet granits! V tainstvennom priklyuchenii dlya odnoy ili dvukh poni tebe predstoit ukrotit buystvuyushchuyu magiyu, kotoraya perevorachivaet mir s nog na golovu!
Strannaya magiya perevorachivaet Ekvestriyu s nog na golovu! Tebe predstoit otpravitsya v tainstvennoe priklyuchenie dlya odnoy i dvukh poni i spasti vsekh s pomoshchyu sily druzhby! Vse poni sobralis vmeste! S nimi ty raskroesh taynu magii, kotoraya prevrashchaet telefony v pitstsu, perevorachivaet vse vverkh dnom i raskrashivaet mir vokrug v strannye tsveta!
Igrayte za Sanni, Khitch, Izzi, Pipp, Zipp ili Misti, i ispolzuy svoi sposobnosti, chtoby issledovat Zefirnye gory. V etom sverkayushchem gorode tebe predstoit znakomitsya s pegasami, iskat kollektsionnye predmety i fotografirovatsya so svoimi lyubimymi poni! A eshche tebya zhdet ogromnoe kolichestvo ukrasheniy i aksessuarov, chtoby podcherknut tvoy stil, i umoritelnye mini-igry s druzyami, naprimer, «Fotosessiya Pipp», «Khitch beret sled» i «Dostavka smuzi Sanni».
Prishla pora navesti poryadok v Zefirnykh gorakh!Pervuyu igru, Priklyuchenie v bukhte Meritaym sm. tam.
Unspeakable evil has returned to the leg: Unspeakable evil has returned to the legendary city of Baldur's Gate. A call for adventurers echoes through the embattled land. Cunning warriors and bold magic users are desperately needed to reclaim Baldur's Gate from a dark sorcery that threatens all in its path.
На пустынной луне Лориане от долгого сна: Na pustynnoy lune Loriane ot dolgogo sna probudilsya Mertvoskafandr. Ona vooruzhyona, gotova k boyu i nichegoshenki ne pomnit. No nachinaetsya chto-to novoe...
Тёмная и тяжёлая адвенчура, главной темо:
Tyomnaya i tyazhyolaya advenchura, glavnoy temoy kotoroy yavlyaetsya depressiya, a osnovnoe vnimanie udelyaetsya psikhologicheskoy istorii narisovannogo glavnogo geroya i animirovannoy karandashnoy estetike.
Issleduyte mrachnuyu okruzhayushchuyu sredu, nazhimayte na mnozhestvo triggerov, stalkivaytes s napryazhennymi stsenami i popytaytes uznat bolshe o mestnoy kulture.
Vklyucheny 2 glavy igry.
Demon Skin — это брутальный Hack&Slash в:
Demon Skin — eto brutalnyy Hack&Slash v surovom mire temnogo fentezi, sochetayushchiy v sebe unikalnye mekhaniki srazheniy, elementy RPG, faytinga i dazhe platformera. Blagodarya gibkoy boevoy sisteme kazhdyy igrok smozhet podobrat svoyu unikalnuyu taktiku prokhozhdeniya, umelo kombiniruya raznye vidy oruzhiya i boevye stoyki dlya maksimalnoy effektivnosti srazheniy.

V mire, gde tma pronikla dazhe v samye otdalennye ugolki vselennoy, protivostoyat ey mogut tolko Stranniki — chleny mogushchestvennogo ordena, srazhayushchiesya so Zlom i obladayushchie sverkhchelovecheskoy bozhestvennoy siloy. Odin iz Strannikov stanovitsya svidetelem zloveshchego rituala po vosstanovleniyu mogushchestvennogo drevnego artefakta. Pytayas prervat ritual, on popadaet v potok vysvobozhdennoy artefaktom energii i mgnovenno prevrashchaetsya v demona!

Strannik zhazhdet vernut svoy prezhniy oblik, no dlya etogo nuzhen artefakt, a on ukraden. Geroyu predstoit nayti ego, sraziv po puti mnozhestvo vragov...

Drugie osobennosti:

Mnogogrannaya boevaya sistema. 
Povyshayte svoyo masterstvo, osvaivaya razlichnye stoyki dlya molnienosnogo parirovaniya atak i naneseniya maksimalnogo urona s effektnymi dobivaniyami! 

Razvetvlennaya prokachka. 
Nakaplivayte opyt, chtoby izuchat novye kombo-udary i uluchshat zdorove, vynoslivost i silu ataki!

Desyatki vidov vragov. 
Ot skeletov, zombi i paukov do oborotney, yashcherov i golemov — bitva s kazhdym iz nikh trebuet osobogo podkhoda!

Obshirnyy arsenal dlya unichtozheniya monstrov.

Sobirayte resursy: razbivayte lampy. Unichtozhayte konteynery. Podryvayte kamni. Ishchite v shakhtakh materialy, kotorye mozhno ispolzovat vmesto oruzhiya ili dlya sozdaniya lovushek.

Nakhodite uluchsheniya: usovershenstvovannye lovushki. Prokachannoe oruzhie. Bolshe resursov. Vy smozhete otyskat 50 uluchsheniy, kazhdoe iz kotorykh daet osobye usileniya i menyaet geympley.

Sluchaynaya generatsiya: karta shakhty, usileniya i bitvy s monstrami menyayutsya s kazhdoy novoy igroy!

Rezhim sna: sbegite iz shakhty, chtoby otkryt novoe beskonechnoe ispytanie.

You are Sprocket, an adorable ferret on:
You are Sprocket, an adorable ferret on a remote space station. Escape your playpen and make your way to the shuttlebay with the most stuff!

Widget Satchel is a thrilling adventure for one little thief, with fiendish puzzles, joyous platforming, and dozens of hidden collectables. As you stumble deeper though the station evading your human caretakers, you steal things like widgets and socks. And you stash them, because you’re a ferret.

Every widget you collect adds to the weight of your satchel, making it a little harder to reach the next platform or avoid the station’s maintenance bots. Stash enough widgets, and you can use them to fabricate doohickeys, which help you unlock new paths and previously out of reach areas. It’s a ferretroidvania!

But don't worry: You may lose some widgets (or your socks!), but Sprocket can't get hurt and there is no "game over." And nothing is blocking your path to the shuttlebay, so the game is only as challenging as you want it to be.

It's up to you: race though the station at top speed, or meander around knocking over piles of junk and hitting bots with your wrench. Or… gather up all your ferret-y determination to stash away each widget, discover every trinket, and try on all 30+ pairs of socks -- including a Nintendo Switch™-exclusive pair of “Joy-Sock” that match your Joy-Con™ colors!

Even after you finish the game, the adventure isn't over. Escape your playpen again (and again) to pursue different challenges. Ferret out all those hard-to-reach areas for a higher widget count, knock around more junk for a greater mischief score, or zoom through the station for a faster finish time.

The more you play, the more of the game's 20+ unique “feats” you're likely to accomplish, and the more you’ll discover about the station, its human crew, and the Expedition they’re a part of.

Just remember: Commander Key misses you, and is waiting patiently for you to return to her…

Fanatskaya khoumbryu-igra s novymi fichami i uluchsheniyami, sozdannaya po motivam Dr. Mario ( «Doktora Mario») — videoigry v zhanre golovolomki, razrabotannaya Nintendo Research & Development 1 i vypushchennaya kompaniey Nintendo dlya 8-mibnoy platformy NES i portativnoy Game Boy v 1990 godu.
Dr. Mario yavlyaetsya igroy v zhanre golovolomki tipa «tri v ryad», v kotoroy Mario beryot na sebya rol vracha, brosaya dvukhtsvetnye pilyuli v butylku, predstavlyayushchuyu igrovoe pole. S pomoshchyu pilyul igroku neobkhodimo obezvredit tri raznovidnosti virusov, pomeshchyonnye v sosud. Po manere i stilyu Dr. Mario pokhozha na Tetris. Kazhdaya pilyulya sostoit iz dvukh raznotsvetnykh polovinok, itogo v igre ispolzuyutsya pilyuli shesti tsvetovykh kombinatsiy, po tri odnotsvetnykh i raznotsvetnykh. Vrashchaya pilyuli, igrok dolzhen sostavlyat ryady iz virusa i tryokh elementov odinakovogo s nim tsveta.
Sostavlennaya konstruktsiya ischezaet, osvobozhdaya mesto dlya prodolzheniya igry i unichtozheniya ostavshikhsya virusov. Uroven schitaetsya proydennym, esli obezvrezheny vse virusy.

Burnhouse Lane — eto istoriya ob Endzhi Uezer, sidelke, chto odnoy nogoy v mogile. Chtoby spasti svoyu zhizn, ey nuzhno vypolnit pyat nevozmozhnykh zadaniy. Eto istoriya o smerti, druzhbe i neumirayushchey nadezhde na to, chto vsegda est radi chego zhit, nesmotrya na vse nevzgody.

Novyy khorror ot studii Harvester Games, sozdateley The Cat Lady (2012), Downfall (2016) i Lorelai (2019), zastavit vas po polnoy prochuvstvovat gnetushchuyu atmosferu, smeyatsya, plakat i zadumatsya o zhizni, kotoruyu my chasto prinimaem kak dolzhnoe.

V Burnhouse Lane sochetayutsya elementy klassicheskikh kvestov, interaktivnykh istoriy i boevye mekhaniki gde patronov vsegda ne khvataet, vragi krayne opasny i kazhdyy vystrel na ves zolota.
Стреляй. Качай. Лутай. Повторяй. Преодол: Strelyay. Kachay. Lutay. Povtoryay. Preodolevayte izmenchivyy labirint krysh neboskrebov. Slushayte ritm bolshogo goroda i deystvuyte emu v takt. Vsyo v etom mire – i vragi, i vashe oruzhie, i sama zhizn – dvizhutsya v ritm. Chtoby vyyti pobeditelem, vam predstoit stat s ritmom odnim tselym.
There was an urban legend. Write your tr:
There was an urban legend. Write your troubles down on a note. Hold it in your hand at midnight and pray. “God, please help me…” Then God will hear your plea and change your fate.

A young girl wakes up, groggy and in an unknown room. A talking dog appears before her and she becomes startled by his revelation: They are gods and it is their duty to change the fate of any humans that ask for their help. Letters appear in the mail and with pen in hand she begins her job.

Dive deep into the story and learn about those that seek out your help but, remember, changing someone’s fate will affect others. Experience each story, edit letters and solve puzzles; perhaps the young girl’s memory will return, but what will she learn about herself and her mission?

WILL: A Wonderful World features a fantastical tale and cast. A quiet nerd stuck in a hopeless, one-sided crush. An impoverished artist who’s lost all hope and contemplates suicide. A rookie police officer who burns with justice and hopes for his first big case. A young woman desperately chasing her dream against all odds. Even a stray cat who would be satisfied with some dried fish to eat! You must guide their fates, find the links between the storylines and find the best path for all of those in need.

Features:
● Redesigned to perfectly tell the tale on Nintendo Switch™.
● Read stories and use deduction to determine how to alter the fate of the game’s cast.
● Each decision opens up the story and may even impact the plotlines of others.
● Progress through the game and also learn more about the two gods, the mysterious girl and her companion.
● Enjoy punchy music and beautifully drawn stills and animations.
Разыграйте фильм о кайдзю в роли мэра го:
Razygrayte film o kaydzyu v roli mera goroda Floatio, kotoromu porucheno sderzhivat podavlyayushchuyu silu ataki kaydzyu s pomoshchyu (beznadezhno) prevoskhodyashchikh vooruzhennykh sil. Zashchitite svoy gorod, poka pyat unikalnykh i razrushitelnykh kaydzyu nabirayut silu s kazhdoy atakoy. K sozhaleniyu, oni nelzya ubit, no mozhno zamedlit i zastavit otstupit... poka.

Monstry dvizhutsya k blizhayshemu zdaniyu, i uchenye rasschitali tochnye shansy togo, kuda oni mogut poyti dalshe. Stroyte zhertvennye armeyskie bazy i aerodromy, chtoby otvlekat kaydzyu. Esli standartnykh metodov nedostatochno, razvernite eksperimentalnoe oruzhie, takoe kak zamorazhivayushchie luchi i transformiruyushchie mekhanizmy, chtoby derzhat ikh v strakhe. Ili vy vsegda mozhete postavit tanki i reaktivnye samolety na puti monstrov, chtoby zamedlit ikh (ne volnuytes, u nas est khoroshiy strakhovoy polis). Esli vse vashi usiliya poterpyat neudachu, ne stydites i begite! Budte gotovy evakuirovat laboratoriyu, ispolzuya transportnye sredstva, lodki ili samolety, kogda kaydzyu podberutsya slishkom blizko.

Vypolnyayte zadaniya so vsego mira, srazhayas s Kaydzyu v bolee chem 15-chasovoy syuzhetnoy kampanii. Na protyazhenii vsey kampanii u vas budet vozmozhnost poluchit preimushchestvo s pomoshchyu uluchshaemykh boevykh edinits ACE i personalizirovannoy kolody proekta. Proverte svoyu smekalku v takticheskikh golovolomkakh, komanduyte desyatkami yunitov v krupnomasshtabnykh stsenariyakh i otrazhayte neodnokratnye ataki v oboronitelnykh missiyakh, odnovremenno razvivaya svoy gorod ekonomicheski. A esli vam khochetsya bolshego, proverte svoi komandnye navyki v ezhenedelnykh ispytaniyakh!

Zashchitite svoy gorod v takticheskom srazhenii s pomoshchyu pushechnykh tankov, reaktivnykh samoletov i mnogogo drugogo... neobychaynoy ognevoy moshchi.
Srazites s pyatyu raznymi kaydzyu, kazhdyy iz kotorykh obladaet unikalnymi navykami i potentsialom mutatsii.
naslazhdaytes igrovym protsessom, osnovannym na povestvovanii, s mnozhestvom dialogov mezhdu istoricheskimi personazhami na protyazhenii kazhdoy operatsii.
Delayte vse, chtoby ostanovit monstrov, v tom chisle zhertvuyte svoimi yunitami i zdaniyami.
A Dark Room is an innovative text-based:
A Dark Room is an innovative text-based adventure that harkens back to the magic of Zork, adding a modern spin on a classic genre and time in gaming. 

It challenges the player’s perceptions, actions and imagination. Visually clean, A Dark Room presents text and cues with limited visual flourishes, but the experience that takes shape is full of depth and environmental storytelling. Audio is also important, portraying a dark world that the player can only imagine.

It is a game that draws players in, allowing them to perceive the intriguing world in their own way. What starts as a dark room with limited interactive options evolves into a complex story and resource management challenge.

Adapted especially for the platform, you can play with physical controls or the touch screen; exclusive to this version of the game is an enhanced user interface and local co-op play.

A Dark Room is an experience, and a story, unlike any other.

EXPERIENCE SOMETHING UNIQUE\n“Cosmic Top:
EXPERIENCE SOMETHING UNIQUE
“Cosmic Top Secret” is the weird, but official, term NATO uses for top confidentiality. A fitting name for this game since it needed military clearance to be released!
Cosmic Top Secret won multiple awards for the innovative ways it engages players in deeply documented plots. The game even inspired the creation of a life-size event at the Cold War Museum of Denmark.

- “a fascinating means of storytelling” - Indie Game Reviewer
- “beautiful, abstract papercraft art designs” - GameSpot
- “will linger with you long after the credits roll.” - The Indie Game Website

SPIES, SOLDIERS & POLITICIANS
Meet people who made history - spies, army leaders, math geniuses, fighter pilots and more - from both sides of the Iron Curtain and with incredible, absurd or thrilling stories.

FIRST COMPUTERS & NUCLEAR THREAT
Discover fascinating programs and devices designed to outsmart the enemy in a tense context of international espionage and fear of atomic war. This is the dawn of new technologies.

DEEPLY PERSONAL, YET RELATABLE STORY
“Like a million others, I’m an ordinary 'kid of the Cold War'. Just a very curious one with parents working in Intelligence services. By getting to know me and my family better, you might see yourself and even feel the itch to investigate your loved ones!” - Trine Laier (T)

PUBLISHED BY Nakana.io
“We gather games that share a strong experience to remember. We’d never seen anything like Cosmic Top Secret before!” - Mikaël Bourget, founder of the publishing label.
Homo Machina – 2D-игра, вдохновлённая ра:
Homo Machina – 2D-igra, vdokhnovlyonnaya rabotami uchyonogo-avangardista Fritsa Kana. Ona otpravit vas v bezumnoe priklyuchenie, gde nuzhno reshat fantasticheskie golovolomki i znakomitsya s rabotoy chelovecheskogo tela, kotoroe predstavleno v vide zavoda 1920-kh godov.

Vam predstoit stolknutsya s izoshchryonnym mekhanizmom iz nervov, sosudov i klapanov. Vasha zadacha – obespechit bespereboynuyu rabotu chelovecheskogo tela v techenie dnya. Vsya igra podelena na takie melkie dela, kak otkryt glaza, prozhevat buterbrod ili poslushat muzyku. Ne volnuytes — intuitivnyy igrovoy protsess ne pozvolit vam ni v chyom zaputatsya.

Frits Kan odnim iz pervykh zanyalsya nauchno-populyarnymi rabotami s illyustratsiyami. On pridumal, kak obyasnit lyudyam ustroystvo chelovecheskogo tela prostym yazykom. V Homo Machina osovremenennaya retro-grafika. A ostroumnye dialogi mezhdu rasseyannym nachalnikom i Zhozian, ego prilezhnoy pomoshchnitsey, ne dadut vam rasslabitsya, poka telo-zavod ne zarabotaet kak chasy. 

Homo Machina – novaya igra studii Darjeeling, avtorov Californium. V eyo sozdanii takzhe prinyali uchastie nemetsko-frantsuzskiy telekanal Arte i studiya Feierabend.

V obraze Emili Patterson, docheri odnogo iz pokhishchennykh uchenykh, vam predstoit provesti rassledovanie, proyti po sledu prestupnika i narushit ego zlobnye plany po zakhvatu vsego mira.
Fueled Up – веселая кооперативная экшн-а:
Fueled Up – veselaya kooperativnaya ekshn-arkada, v kotoroy kosmicheskiy korabl podvergaetsya napadeniyu ogromnogo inoplanetnogo osminoga. I eto ne vse: na puti zvezdoleta otkryvayutsya smertelnye chervotochiny, nachinayut idti asteroidnye dozhdi, a vse sistemy korablya dayut sboy. Nam predstoit vzyat na sebya roli inzhenerov-spasateley, reanimirovat korabl i perepravit ego v bezopasnoe mesto.
Intensivnyy geympley stavit pered igrokami mnozhestvo zadach: chinit proboiny v korpuse, tushit pozhary, sledit za sostoyaniem reaktora. V rezhime kooperativa igrayut chetyre chlena ekipazha, chto otkroet dostup k dopolnitelnym zadaniyam i novym urovnyam slozhnosti. Problema lish v tom, chto kosmonavty ochen neuklyuzhi, i vse ikh deystviya tolko usugublyayut polozhenie na korable.
Zdes ochen vazhna komandnaya rabota, odnako svoyu leptu vnosit i element sluchaynosti, tak chto nuzhno ne tolko planirovat svoi deystviya, no i momentalno reagirovat v sluchae opasnosti.

Etot Ad ne takoy kak vse drugie. On naselen vsyakimi lichnostyami, s kotorymi pridetsya znakomitsya i, vooruzhivshis skillom moguchego blogera, reshat ikh problemy. Inache nikak. Na to on i Ad.

Woven is a relaxing adventure puzzle gam:
Woven is a relaxing adventure puzzle game with laidback gameplay. 

You play as Stuffy, a well-meaning but rather clumsy stuffed animal that wanders the world alone. Quickly you discover Glitch, a metal firefly that has lost its memory and identity. 

Find lost memories and discover secret caves, in an effort to unravel the mystery of their history. 

To do so, Stuffy will need to change shape.  By solving rhythm-puzzle machines, you unlock new shapes for Stuffy, and changing shape gives Stuffy new abilities. Elephant legs may be strong, but rabbit legs can jump. 

Stuffy can also change colour, to solve riddles or hide from dangers. 

You set out to explore a world made out of fabric, where stuffed animals once lived in peace. Everything appears to be well at first glance, but the world is not all it seems to be. Metal machines seem to have invaded the world. Are they here to destroy the woollen world? There are questions that need answering; why is Stuffy all alone? Why is Glitch here? 

Features
Your Stuffy, your style. Customize Stuff, with different body parts and fabrics.
A fully voiced narrated story.  
Over a hundred different hidden fabrics to discover. 
Mix and match, a selection of different animal blueprints each with their own skillset. 
Experience a fully handcrafted world.
Multiple worlds, each with their own unique ambiance, soundtrack and story.
An epic adventure, told through rhyme.
And much more.

Refine your heroic identity throughout the game - changing everything about how your hero looks, all the way down to your hero's body type, between any mission.

Sync and Vigilance actions add life to the battlefield when characters perform additional actions out of sequence, triggered by special conditions. When a character performs an action, sync actions allow other characters to take part or enhance that action, like a character creating a distraction to remove the target's Evade defense before an attack lands. Positioning your team to take advantage of these extra actions can be critical to the success of a mission.

Red Rope: Don’t Fall Behind is an arduou:
Red Rope: Don’t Fall Behind is an arduous challenge, a cathartic ritual that only the most valiant players will be able to carry out, be they fearless lonely travellers or couples with a strong elective affinity.
Explore the Labyrinth, get acquainted with its bizarre inhabitants, its secrets and its rules. Face enemies, traps, puzzles and ferocious bosses. To escape the Labyrinth you will have but one weapon: the rope that binds you together.

Key Features:
- Play with a friend or try alone. It won’t be easy either way.
- You are trapped in the Labyrinth: more than 100 hand-designed levels full of tension, action and mystery separate you from the exit.
- The rope is the only weapon at your disposal.
- Battle dozens of unpredictable enemies, learn their moves and plan yours. No tactics means death.
- Solve puzzles: carefully observe and exploit the many mechanisms.
- Discover a world packed with symbols to decipher and bizarre inhabitants.
- Defeat 4 mini-bosses and 5 bosses on the path to triumph.
- Climb the global chart but beware: every action has consequences.
- The game continues beyond the screen: communication and complicity are paramount.
- At least 10 hours of gameplay. Or 100 if you are not up to the challenge.
- A true hardcore experience: only a few will succeed.
- BEAT THE GAME AND BECAME AN INHABITANT OF THE LABYRINTH

Давным-давно бедный мальчик Ханс жил с м:
Davnym-davno bednyy malchik Khans zhil s materyu vozle lesa. Na den rozhdeniya on ne poluchil ni sladostey, ni podarkov. On tak rasstroilsya, chto reshil pokinut dom v poiskakh luchshey doli. Na proshchanie mama otdala emu dedushkinu trost, nemnogo syra i tri zolotykh. Khans poshel v les na poiski priklyucheniy. Skoro opustilas noch, i malchik tak ispugalsya, chto reshil vernutsya. No vdrug emu pregradil put chudakovatyy kobold, i Khans reshil posledovat za nim v zamok. Kobold skazal Khansu, chto tot poluchit mnogo bogatstv, esli proydet prostoe ispytanie... ugadav ego imya. Khansu, zapertomu v zamke, pridetsya perezhit priklyuchenie, polnoe volshebstva, uzhasa i zagadok, chtoby stat novym grafom Lukanorom.

Sostavte Khansu kompaniyu v volshebnom mire, otpravivshis v nepovtorimoe priklyuchenie, polnoe syurprizov i prepyatstviy. Рогалик с проработанным нарративом. Реиг:
Rogalik s prorabotannym narrativom. Reigrabelnost — eto chast istorii, kotoraya budet raskryvatsya postepenno s kazhdym novym prokhozhdeniem. Stanovyas silnee, vy budete uznavat bolshe pro personazhey, ikh motivatsiyu i sekrety mira, gde oni okazalis zaperty.
Otkryvayte desyatki sposobnostey dlya chetyryokh personazhey. Uluchshayte vash proverennyy bild i eksperimentiruyte s novymi kombinatsiyami zaklinaniy, chtoby pobedit 12 moguchikh bossov. Stanovites silnee s kazhdoy novoy popytkoy, chtoby v odin den srazitsya s vragom na ravnykh. Kazhdyy zabeg proverit vashu skorost reaktsii i navyki.
Zodiaki — eto 12 zakalyonnykh v boyakh khraniteley, skitayushchikhsya po 4 miram. V bitve s nimi zapomnite ikh ataki, zaklinaniya i patterny, a takzhe postaraytes uznayte ikh predystoriyu, chtoby ponyat prichinu, po kotoroy oni srazhayutsya s vami.
Super Chariot это двухмерный платформер:
Super Chariot eto dvukhmernyy platformer dlya Nintendo Switch™ s dvumya rezhimami igry — odinochnym i kooperativnym. Glavnye geroi igry — otvazhnaya printsessa i ee vozlyublennyy, kotorye puskayutsya v puteshestvie po fantasticheskomu podzemnomu miru... 
Ikh zadacha — protashchit telegu s grobom usopshego korolya cherez 25 krasochnykh urovney i ne soyti s uma ot postoyannykh pridirok ego prizraka.
Originalnyy igrovoy protsess i innovatsionnyy fizicheskiy dvizhok podaryat vam more priklyucheniy i adrenalina, a nagradoy za vashu smelost stanut gory sokrovishch!

Provodite Ego Vysochestvo v posledniy put: protashchite telegu s grobom usopshego korolya cherez beskonechnye katakomby. Telegu mozhno tolkat, tashchit, razgonyat i raskachivat. Igrayte v odinochku ili s drugom, glavnoe — pomogite otvazhnoy printsesse i ee vozlyublennomu nayti idealnoe mesto, gde korol smozhet pochit vechnym snom!

Blagodarya bolshim kolesam telega mozhet preodolevat rasseliny, podnimatsya v goru i sovershat massu drugikh opasnykh manevrov. Sobirayte sokrovishcha, ishchite vykhod i ne dayte kovarnym vragam zabrat u vas vashu dobychu! Khvatit li u vas masterstva, lovkosti i smelosti, chtoby proyti vse urovni Super Chariot nesmotrya na mnozhestvo smertelnykh opasnostey?
Pomogayte drug drugu, i vy smozhete sdelat ne tolko eto, no i mnogoe drugoe...

• Igrayte s drugom po lokalnoy seti — v rezhime TV ili nastolnom rezhime na Nintendo Switch™
• Vas zhdut neveroyatnye ispytaniya — pomogayte drug drugu, esli khotite vyzhit!
• Volshebnye dvukhmernye miry s kuchey unikalnykh personazhey i predmetov
• 25 urovney s massoy potaynykh khodov i gorami sokrovishch — minimum 60 chasov igry vam obespecheno

Добро пожаловать в мир Талисмана. Эти зе:
Dobro pozhalovat v mir Talismana. Eti zemli polny opasnykh kvestov, vragov i ispytaniy. Odnako im soputstvuet nezabyvaemoe priklyuchenie. Litsenzirovannaya tsifrovaya adaptatsiya priklyuchencheskoy nastolnoy igry v zhanre fentezi.

Otpravlyaytes v priklyuchenie po Talismanu, gde vy naydete smertelnykh chudovishch, zagadochnykh neznakomtsev i volshebnye predmety. Priglasite do 5 druzey v bitvu dlya igry lokalno ili po seti, libo ispolzuyte rezhim igry po ocheredi na odnom ustroystve. Povyshayte uroven i razvivayte navyki, prodvigayas k tsentru polya.

Vyberite odnogo iz geroev, kazhdyy iz kotorykh obladaet unikalnymi silnymi i slabymi storonami, a takzhe osobymi umeniyami. Tshchatelno vybirayte, kto otpravitsya v priklyuchenie, poskolku navyki geroya mogut otkryt vam dorogu k Korone Poveleniy, volshebnomu artefaktu, v kotorom zaklyuchena sila, sposobnaya unichtozhit vsekh vragov i sdelat nosyashchego ee pravitelem korolevstva.

V versiyu Talismana dlya Nintendo Switch™ takzhe vklyucheny tri dopolneniya: «Gorod», «Svyashchennyy zapas» i «Marsh Stuzhi». Izuchite novyy region v «Gorode», stan svidetelem bitvy mezhdu svetom i tmoy v «Svyashchennyy zapas» i srazites so Snezhnoy korolevoy v «Marshe Stuzhi»! Dopolneniya mozhno aktivirovat ili otklyuchit otdelno, chtoby vy mogli igrat tak, kak zakhochetsya! 

Vash put k Korone Poveleniy budet ne iz legkikh. Chtoby perezhit vstrechayushchiesya opasnosti, vam potrebuyutsya otvaga, terpenie i udachnye broski kostey.

Kazhdoe podzemele generiruetsya sluchaynym obrazom, poetomu kazhdaya igra unikalna! Na kazhdom khodu edinstvennoe reshenie, kotoroe vy mozhete prinyat, — idti vpravo ili vniz! Issleduyte kartochnoe podzemele i srazhaytes s moguchimi vragami, poluchayte blagosloveniya v svyashchennykh svyatilishchakh ili pokupayte novye mogushchestvennye artefakty u lavochnika!

Путешествуй к центрам планет: погрузись:
Puteshestvuy k tsentram planet: pogruzis gluboko pod zemlyu, unichtozhaya bloki udarami myacha. Kolichestvo vystrelov v kazhdom raunde ogranicheno, a nekotorye bloki prikrepleny k stene, tak chto dlya vyigrysha vazhny strategiya i pritselnye udary. Vybey kak mozhno bolshe blokov, poluchay kristally za uluchsheniya i pogruzhenie vse glubzhe.
Vyberi uluchsheniya, idealno podkhodyashchie tvoemu stilyu igry i strategii, naprimer: uvelichenie kolichestva myachey, bolshe vystrelov na raund, khranenie bolshego kolichestva kristallov. Veselo prygaya, dvigaysya skvoz avtomaticheski sozdannye planety k ikh yadram, ot odnoy k drugoy.

Postroy sbalansirovannyy plan: rasschitannye otskoki i nepredskazuemye skachki; blagodarya takomu sochetaniyu igra delaetsya neveroyatno uvlekatelnoy i ocharovatelnoy. V ekstravagantnom, minimalisticheskom mire s originalnym kislotno-kosmicheskim saundtrekom vam budet priyatno padat vse nizhe i nizhe.

You are Captain Thomas Welmu, a Spacefle:
You are Captain Thomas Welmu, a Spacefleet science officer, lost on the other side of the galaxy. Dark forces are en route to Earth to destroy our planet - and you are carrying the only thing that can stop them.

Race back home across the galaxy. Collect new friends on your journey. Make new enemies. You won't be able to save everyone. Who will you leave behind? Which civilizations will you save - or destroy - along the way? The decisions are all up to you.

You are... the Captain!

Travel the Galaxy!
Will you plot the shortest route home or take a detour to use an experimental new technology with a wormhole? Is a distant distress signal worth investigating or should you use your time to raise funds to upgrade your engine?
It's All Up to You, Captain.

Explore new worlds!
Will you interfere with a pre-space civilization? Will you discover the terrible secret at a covert military base? Will you deliver a dying life-form's brain back to its people? Or use it to upgrade your ship?

Engage in epic space battles! Or avoid them entirely?
The galaxy is a dangerous place. Will you shower aggressive encounters with a barrage of Type 2 Vacuum Rockets? Or let them taste the wrath of your freshly polished Plasma Gun? ...or will you choose to slip by and hope nobody notices?

Repair and upgrade your ship!
Those pesky pirates have damaged your sweetheart. Should you go cheap and repair her yourself? Or spend the money and let the professionals do it right? Is it time to buy a brand new Shield Buster? Or perhaps a couple of convenient nuclear warheads?

Collect new friends or make new enemies!
Will you sacrifice a friend for the greater good? Will you rat out an undercover cop for a chance to get home quickly? Will you keep a life-changing truth from someone so they'll hang out and be your friend?

A galaxy full of tough choices!
Will you gain access to the vault with explosives or is there a less intrusive way? Will you figure out how to pull off an undercover heist using a new consciousness transmitter? Ever wanted to try escaping an automated maximum-security prison in space? Will you look fabulous in tight pink swimwear?

Когда Герол находит Чилию, таинственную:
Kogda Gerol nakhodit Chiliyu, tainstvennuyu volshebnuyu devushku, spasshuyu ego razrushennyy voynoy gorod ot razrusheniya, ona, kazhetsya, poteryala vsyakuyu pamyat o svoem geroicheskom podvige. Ne pomnya o ee prezhney zhizni i silakh, on reshaet vzyat ee k sebe. Teper vy, kak Gerol, dolzhny vospityvat Chiliyu v techenie chetyrekh let, planirovat ee povsednevnuyu zhizn i pomogat ey razvivat kharakter i navyki! 

Klyuchevye osobennosti.

- Planiruyte den Chilii. Sostavte ee raspisanie v sootvetstvii s ee sezonnymi tselyami ili predpochitaemymi kharakteristikami. Kakie by zadachi ili zanyatiya ona ni brala na sebya, eto povliyaet na to, kakim chelovekom ona stanet. Sledite za tem, chtoby ne utomit i ne naskuchit ey, ot etogo mozhet postradat ee uspevaemost vo vremya zanyatiy ili raboty. 
- Raskroyte tayny proshlogo ee Chilii. Ne imeya vospominaniy o svoem proshlom, teper vy dolzhny pomoch Chilii vspomnit, kto ona i otkuda. Dolzhna zhe byt prichina, po kotoroy Boginya odarila ee svoimi blagosloveniyami. 
- Naydite nastoyashchuyu lyubov. Vospitanie rebenka mozhet byt nelegkim delom, poetomu ne zabyvayte iskat i svoe sobstvennoe schaste. Vy mozhete nayti lyubov v samykh neozhidannykh mestakh ili s temi lyudmi, kotorykh menshe vsego ozhidaete, ved nekotorye druzya ili "vragi" mogut prevratitsya v lyubovnikov. 
- Otpravlyaytes v gorod. Nuzhno otdokhnut ot napryazhennoy raboty strazhnika? Pochemu by ne issledovat korolevstvo i ne poznakomitsya s ego zhitelyami? Provedite vremya na ploshchadi, u dvortsovykh vorot ili otdokhnite v bare, a esli vam zakhochetsya izmenit vneshnost, otpravlyaytes v salon krasoty i shveynuyu masterskuyu! Kto znaet, kogo vy vstretite, i kakie priklyucheniya zhdut vas za predelami vashego doma? 
- Pomogite Lair Land.  Voyna zakonchilas, no korolevstvo eshche ne vosstanovilos. Pomogite obshchestvennosti Lair Land vosstanovit gorod i ego dostoprimechatelnosti, poka zhiteli medlenno opravlyayutsya ot poter, s kotorymi im prishlos stolknutsya. Osteregaytes, voyna, vozmozhno, i zakonchilas, no zlo vse eshche taitsya, i monarkhiya, pokhozhe, v opasnosti.
“I know what you’re thinking: Why keep g:
“I know what you’re thinking: Why keep getting up, day in and day out, even though your life is going nowhere?”

Notorious: Widely considered to be one of the bleakest and best-written experiences in indie gaming, Actual Sunlight challenges you to confront the life of Evan Winter: An overweight, lonely and severely depressed young professional.

Fear the words, not the reading: Presented almost entirely in text, a mixture of sharp observation and pitch black humor captures your interest from provocative beginning to shattering conclusion.

Prepare yourself: Actual Sunlight is a uniquely unforgettable adventure that will etch itself into you as one of the most difficult, haunting and beautiful experiences you have ever had as a gamer.
Patrick's Parabox — это заслужившая неск:
Patrick's Parabox — eto zasluzhivshaya neskolko nagrad igra s golovolomkami, v kotoroy raskryvaetsya unikalnaya rekursivnaya sistema s korobkami vnutri korobok vnutri korobok vnutri korobok. Nauchites manipulirovat strukturoy igrovogo mira, pomeshchaya korobki v korobki i vyvodya korobki iz korobok. Porazmyshlyayte nad tem, chto proizoydet, esli korobka okazhetsya vnutri samoy sebya, i nauchites ispolzovat beskonechnost sebe na polzu. Issleduyte mnozhestvo mekhanik i neobychnykh rekursivnykh sobytiy, pogruzhayas v sistemu vsyo glubzhe. Gotovtes: korobok budet mnogo.

V igre bolshe 350 sozdannykh vruchnuyu golovolomok, kotorye zastavyat vas kak sleduet zadumatsya, no v to zhe vremya posluzhat provodnikami v garmonichnuyu sistemu. V kazhdoy golovolomke — svoya ideya; ni odna zadacha ne sozdana prosto dlya kolichestva.

Umirotvoryayushchiy, probuzhdayushchiy lyubopytstvo saundtrek ot kompozitora Pristsilly Snou zvuchit po-novomu vsyakiy raz, kogda poyavlyaetsya novaya mekhanika.

Igra Patrick's Parabox poluchila nagradu Excellence in Design vo vremya Independent Games Festival v 2020. Takzhe igra pretendovala na pobedu vo vremya festivalya IndieCade 2019 i poluchila nagradu IndieCade Developers Choice.
Хватайте попкорн, приглашайте друзей и у:
Khvatayte popkorn, priglashayte druzey i uchastvuyte v bezumnykh boyakh, v kotorykh pobeda dostigaetsya i schastlivoy sluchaynostyu, i ottochennym navykom strelby.  Druzya ne mogut priyti? Ne vopros! Mozhno igrat s neznakomtsami po seti.
Vyberite geroya: ot surovogo kosmicheskogo bortsa do smertonosnogo motylka-ubiytsy i pukhlenkogo inoplanetyanina, kotoryy voobshche ne ponimaet, chto on tut zabyl. U kazhdogo personazha svoy nabor navykov i stil igry. Opredelite, kto vam bolshe nravitsya, i nachnite rvat druzey i blizkikh na chasti na potekhu galakticheskoy publike.

Shou nachinaetsya! Srazhaytes i umirayte v pryamom efire na vidu u tysyach zriteley. Gladiatorskie boi ne shchadyat nikogo. Publika likuet! Kommentator otpuskaet shutochki nad vashim triko! I vsem veselo! (Po krayney mere tem, kto eshche stoit na nogakh.)
I ezhu ponyatno, chto vy prishli pobezhdat, poetomu zabudte o kakom-to tam dobrosovestnom povedenii ili zakonakh fiziki. Teleportiruytes, stanovites nevidimym, zapuskayte puli rikoshetom ot sten ili prostrelivayte eti steny. Delayte vse, chto mozhete, lish by vystoyat. V lyubvi, kak na voyne i kosmicheskikh gladiatorskikh boyakh, vse sredstva khoroshi.

OSOBENNOSTI:

- Stremitelnye i nepredskazuemye setevye boi dlya 2–4 igrokov
- Igrayte sidya na divane, po seti ili vse srazu!
- Kucha aren s unikalnymi opasnymi zonami i pravilami
- Mnozhestvo moshchnykh mutatorov, menyayushchikh realnost i perevorachivayushchikh igru s nog na golovu.

Magic is powerful, but it is not free. E:
Magic is powerful, but it is not free. Every spell you cast requires a little bit of your life energy to spark it. Cast enough spells and you will extinguish your very soul. This means you need to be strategic when fighting, balancing the cost of magic with the risk of taking damage from your enemies.

How each spell manifests in the world depends on what divine power you choose to combine it with. For example, the Evoke Force spell will cause the ground to erupt with a series of sharp ice crystals, summon a thunderous lightning strike, or barrage the ground with a meteor shower – all depending on what the spell is combined with.

Use the magic spells at your disposal to defeat the demons spilling out from the underworld. In Ort, time is frozen whenever you stand still. This means you have the opportunity to plan your attacks and be strategic.

Like any RPG, you will be slaying enemies to collect loot and experience. The items you pick up will improve your magical abilities, though some come with curses... As you level up, you will learn additional magic spells to use against your enemies.

Ort is varied and expansive, an open world for you to explore. Choose the order of the quests you pursue, or just explore to meet new characters. The final battle is available whenever you choose, but... Are you strong enough?

Play as a novice mage, forced to take on the responsibility of saving the world and those that are important to you. Quests can be completed to gain access to new areas, save and unlock allies, gain items and powers, and more. Replays are encouraged because small decisions can have permanent and significant consequences, leading to different game outcomes.

Vse nachinaetsya s pesni o lyubvi v retro-igre, a uzhe vskore eto vylivaetsya v zakhvatyvayushchuyu poezdku s neozhidannymi povorotami i alternativnymi kontsovkami. Vse eto yavlyaetsya chastyu smeshnogo stsenariya porozhdennogo blagodarya buynoy fantazii Aleksa Fachiana v soprovozhdenii legendarnogo saundtreka Ratvadera!

Podozhdite, chto novogo v Wunderling DX?

Spasibo za vopros! Wunderling DX — eto poslednyaya versiya igry poluchivshey priznanie kritikov Wunderling (2020), s mnozhestvom novykh urovney, predmetov, syuzhetnykh segmentov i ranee vypushchennym obnovleniem kontenta «Kohlrabi's Ruin» s usovershenstvovannym geympleem. Posle priobreteniya igry vy smozhete besplatno ustanovit dannoe obnovlenie.

Ot imeni Bitwave Games (ranee Retroid) zhelaem vam udachnoy igry!
It's a puzzle action strategy game with:
It's a puzzle action strategy game with some lovely contraptions to really make you ponder. A beautifully balanced mix of difficulty and fun.

The game revolves around getting little balls from the emitter to their home in the goal. Blocking their way are a heap of obstacles and some helpful elements coloured red or blue. So simple ... yet so tricky.

Падение метеорита наделило щенков сверхс:

Учиться колдовству - тяжкий труд, в особ: Uchitsya koldovstvu - tyazhkiy trud, v osobennosti dlya Belly MakFey, pervokursnitsy shkoly Khagmor. Prepodavateli eyo ne zhaluyut, odnoklassniki ignoriruyut, a vakhtyorsha s kukharkoy i podavno na neyo zub tochat. Nu i v dobavok ko vsemu, devochke katastroficheski ne vezyot! Vot kak segodnya, naprimer: vsego navsego, khotela Bella poduchit svoyo ognennoe zaklinanie, a vyshlo tak, chto eyo podstavili za provokatsiyu vazhnogo volshebnogo rituala, i, pod ugrozoy otchisleniya, v srochnom poryadke zastavili ego vosstanavlivat. Etim tyomnym, kholodnym vecherom, kogda po vsey shkole buystvuet nechist, i sama smert dezhurit v koridorakh, nashey neschastnoy pervokursnitse dazhe nevdomyok, kak seryozno ona vlipla. U neyo ostalos vsego neskolko chasov, chtoby razyskat ingredienty Valpurgievogo zelya!
Ада - неохотная искательница приключений:
Ada - neokhotnaya iskatelnitsa priklyucheniy, kotoraya prinimaet vyzov provesti noch v izvestnom proklyatom osobnyake Sunshine Manor, gde ey predstoit vstretit prizrakov, demonov i drugie krovavye uzhasy, a takzhe poznakomitsya s strannymi personazhami, unikalnymi ispytaniyami i miloy, no pugayushchey atmosferoy.

Puteshestvuyte mezhdu mirom smertnykh i demonicheskim mirom, perekhitrite zloveshchego Tenevogo cheloveka i razgadyvayte kovarnye golovolomki, issleduya osobnyak. Naslazhdaytes potryasayushchey grafikoy v stile piksel-art, vypolnennoy vruchnuyu, i saundtrekom, vdokhnovlennym 80-mi, kotorye idealno sochetayutsya, chtoby sozdat zakhvatyvayushche uzhasayushchiy opyt.

Raskroyte mrachnye tayny osobnyaka i otpravtes v uvlekatelnoe puteshestvie, sochetayushchee v sebe uzhas, komediyu i nemnogo retro-sharma.

Вы — единственный парень в женском общеж:
Vy — edinstvennyy paren v zhenskom obshchezhitii! «Know, or Know Lady» — eto Full Motion View-simulyator romantiki s zhivymi aktrisami, v kotorom vy, po nelepoy ironii sudby stanovites edinstvennym parnem v zhenskoy obshchazhke: okunites v lyubovnoe gnezdo, polnoe komediynykh priklyucheniy ot pervogo litsa, gde vsyudu tsaryat sladostrastnyy khaos.
Pod neustannym obayaniem gruppy ocharovatelnykh devushek ostanetes li vy verny svoey lyubimoy? Ili, mozhet byt, po privychke gordo voskliknite: «Damy!.. Srochno perestante otvlekat menya ot uchyoby!» — legendu vashey zhizni zdes vam i predstoit napisat.
Спасите мир в этом магическом музыкально:
Spasite mir v etom magicheskom muzykalno-ritmichnom rolevom vizualnom priklyuchenii Magical Girl! Vashi svyazi stanovyatsya siloy. Davayte vmeste otkroem dver v mir gryoz!..
Eta istoriya proiskhodit v zhizni obychnoy uchenitsy mladshikh klassov sredney shkoly, Yumemi Nanakhosi, kotoraya zhivet v Khosimaki, malenkom prigorode u morya. I vdrug, sovershenno neozhidanno, v eyo rutinnoy zhizni poyavlyaetsya Yumemi Kirara, printsessa «Malenkoy zvezdy», chya sobstvennaya planeta byla razrushena monstrom po imeni «Muma»!
После событий Crysis пришельцы вернулись: Posle sobytiy Crysis prisheltsy vernulis na planetu, terzaemuyu klimaticheskimi kataklizmami. Oni prevratili Nyu-York v dymyashchiesya ruiny, a teper sobirayutsya istrebit vse chelovechestvo. I tolko vy mozhete ostanovit ikh vtorzhenie. Oblachites v uluchshennyy nanokostyum versii 2.0 i ispolzuyte sverkhprochnuyu bronyu, nechelovecheskuyu silu i vozmozhnost maskirovki, chtoby prisposobitsya k usloviyam izmenivshegosya mira i oderzhat pobedu. Uluchshayte svoy nanokostyum i oruzhie v rezhime realnogo vremeni i otkryvayte novye sposobnosti, chtoby pobedit v bitve za vyzhivanie chelovechestva.
Обыкновенная школа, обыкновенное нашеств:
Obyknovennaya shkola, obyknovennoe nashestvie zombi – i kuchka vyzhivshikh... khotya naschet vyzhivshikh eshche babka nadvoe skazala...

V etot raz rech ne o prepyatstviyakh, a o nastoyashchey pogone. Ne day zombi poymat sebya. Kidaysya v nikh predmetami – i postaraysya popast v golovu prezhde, chem tebya nachnut kusat. Da, i ne zabud sobrat poteryannye zapisi zvukovogo dnevnika i vyyasnit, otkuda v vash gorodok pronikla eta zaraza.
