I and Me - platforma-golovolomka. Chtoby igrat v igru, neobkhodimo odnovremenno upravlyat dvumya kotami.
Oba geroya budut vypolnyat odni i te zhe deystviya. Vam neobkhodimo parallelno kontrolirovat kazhdogo iz nikh, chtoby skoordinirovat vypolnenie imi missii.
V igre 4 glavy, osnovannykh na chetyrekh sezonakh goda, s 92 glavami.
Zachastuyu vam pridetsya khoroshenko dumat, a v nekotorykh mestakh proyavit chudesa gibkosti.
Zvukovaya dorozhka uspokoit vashi nervy muzykoy fortepiano s orkestrom, v kazhdom sezone budet svoya muzykalnaya tema.
Детально проработанное сюжетное приключе:
Detalno prorabotannoe syuzhetnoe priklyuchenie s uchastiem malenkogo sklizkogo sushchestva i ego zashchitnika - okhotnika za golovami.
Povestvovanie razvorachivaetsya v obshirnoy bashne v stile stimpank, gde igroki poperemenno igrayut za personazhey, izvestnykh kak Malenkiy Dros i Kapitan, ispolzuya ikh razlichnye silnye i slabye storony. Igrovoy protsess vklyuchaet v sebya reshenie golovolomok, stolknoveniya s vragami i skrytnoe peremeshchenie po ogromnomu, zaputannomu intereru bashni.
Skolzkoe malenkoe sushchestvo i svoenravnyy okhotnik za golovami neokhotno obedinyatsya, chtoby vyzhit. Vmeste oni dolzhny podnyatsya vverkh cherez rushashchuyusya Bashnyu, kotoroy pravit kovarnyy alkhimik. Po puti mozhno vstretit mnozhestvo strannykh personazhey, tainstvennye sokrovishcha, kotorye nuzhno sobrat, i znaniya! Ispolzuyte sposobnosti oboikh personazhey, chtoby proyti cherez Bashnyu. Prygayte, izvivaytes i skryvaytes, igraya za Malenkogo Drosa, i srazhaytes s zhutkimi vragami, igraya za Kapitana.

Shiftlings is a colorful puzzle platform:
Shiftlings is a colorful puzzle platformer with a twist! You’re controlling two quirky custodians who are tethered together; one large and one small. Play alone or work together with a friend to run, bounce and swap size through 55 challenging levels.

Each level challenges you to utilize various mechanics to avoid traps and reach the objective. Collectible cola bottles add replay value by opening up new levels and challenges to experience. 

Warning: Use your wits to turn the tether into an advantage. Failure to comply may lead to hilarious results.

Уно (Uno, с испанского «один»), в значит:
Uno (Uno, s ispanskogo «odin»), v znachitelnoy stepeni sovpadaet s populyarnoy evropeyskoy kartochnoy igroy mau-mau, izvestnoy takzhe kak «sto odno», ili «cheshskiy durak», «durak angliyskiy», «faraon», «pentagon», poluchivshey znachitelnoe rasprostranenie v seredine XX veka. Zapatentovana v 1971 godu Merlom Robbinsom.
UNO vozvrashchaetsya v obnovlennom formate i vykhodit na Nintendo Switch. V igre poyavlyayutsya novye funktsii i dopolnitelnye pravila. Neobkhodimost vystraivat novye strategii sdelaet protsess eshche uvlekatelnee!

Dobro pozhalovat v Neon Apex! Lish luchshie iz luchshikh (i ne tolko lyudi) mogut uchastvovat v gonkakh, tak chto pobedu pridetsya vyryvat na beshennykh skorostyakh i v krutykh povorotakh.
Mail Time – это расслабляющее приключени:

«Лего Звёздные Войны: Полная Сага» — вид:
«Lego Zvyozdnye Voyny: Polnaya Saga» — videoigra v zhanre priklyuchencheskogo ekshena, razrabotannaya studiey Traveller's Tales, pozdnee smenivshaya nazvanie na TT Games Studios. Syuzhet okhvatyvaet pervye shest epizodov sagi Star Wars. Igra predstavlyaet soboy obedinyonnuyu versiyu dvukh igr — Lego Star Wars: The Video Game i Lego Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy s uluchshennoy grafikoy i dopolnitelnym kontentom. Igra byla anonsirovana LucasArts 25 maya 2007 goda, k 30-letiyu «Zvyozdnykh voyn». Reliz sostoyalsya 6 noyabrya 2007 goda na konsolyakh sedmogo pokoleniya — Xbox 360, PlayStation 3, Nintendo Wii i Nintendo DS. Zatem posledoval vykhod versii dlya PC v 2009 godu i Mac OS X v 2010 godu. Mobilnaya versiya byla vypushchena v 2013 godu dlya iOS i v 2015 godu dlya Android.
V The Complete Saga igrok upravlyaet personazhami ot tretego litsa v tryokhmernykh lokatsiyakh, oformlennykh po motivam konstruktorov Lego Star Wars. Geympley sochetaet elementy priklyuchencheskogo ekshena, platformera i golovolomok. Syuzhet okhvatyvaet sobytiya ot peregovorov Torgovoy federatsii nad Nabu do ataki povstantsev na vtoruyu Zvezdu Smerti nad Endorom. Igra v komediynoy forme pereskazyvaet sobytiya filmov cherez kat-stseny bez dialogov. Vsego v igre 36 osnovnykh syuzhetnykh urovney, 20 missiy okhotnikov za golovami, 6 bonusnykh urovney i arkadnye mini-igry. Byla uluchshena grafika, a takzhe obnovlyonny vizualnye effekty, osveshchenie i modeli personazhey. Na kazhdom urovne igrok beryot pod upravlenie odnogo iz personazhey filmov, obladayushchego osobymi sposobnostyami.
V izdanii izdanii Knigi rekordov Ginnessa dlya geymerov 2009 goda igra zanyala 23-e mesto v spiske velichayshikh videoigr vsekh vremyon, i nominirovana na premiyu «Lyubimaya videoigra» na tseremonii Kids' Choice Awards 2012 goda.Eshchyo LEGO-igry, i Star Wars na Switch.

Fight your way through a constantly chan:
Fight your way through a constantly changing tower to solidify your eternal legacy!

You find yourself trapped in a mysterious tower – one that transforms its very structure every 24 hours.
The legacy of your epic struggle shall be carved into the hearts of those who challenge you like an epitaph. 
Surpass countless poor fallen souls and make your way to the heretofore unseen top.

Journey to the top and unravel the mystery hidden within the tower!

▼An auto-generated dungeon that changes daily
This 2D action game is set in Tokoyo – the Tower of Perpetuity – a constantly changing and devilishly deceptive auto-generated dungeon crawling with fiendish monsters and brutal traps. The Tower of Perpetuity is automatically regenerated by the game server every 24 hours (in real-world time), allowing for players around the world to take on the same dungeon each day, and for one day only. Different traps and gimmicks await you each day, and you must compete against other players while battling your way through. The dungeon contains various differing branches, offering a certain degree of free choice and randomization.

▼Light social elements
Social features utilizing the network have been implemented in the game, in which a gravestone will be placed where a player meets their end, appearing in other players’ games along with their “relics” and “last words”. Take advantage of the different special skills afforded to each character and compete with other players as you struggle to surpass the countless bodies of your less fortunate rivals and fight your way through the impregnable dungeon.

Croc: Legend of the Gobbos (alternativnoe nazvanie — Croc! Pau-Pau Island, yap. クロック!パウパウアイランド) — videoigra v zhanre 3D-platformera, razrabotannaya britanskoy kompaniey Argonaut Software i vpervye vypushchennaya kompaniyami Fox Interactive v SShA i Evrope i MediaQuest v Yaponii dlya Playstation, Sega Saturn, Windows v 1997 godu.
Deystvie razvorachivaetsya na nebolshoy gruppe ostrovov, naselyonnykh mirolyubivymi gobbosami — malenkimi pushistymi khvostatymi sushchestvami. V odin solnechnyy den korol gobbosov uvidel, chto k beregam ego ostrova pribilo nebolshuyu korzinu. Kogda korol so svoimi poddannymi vytashchil korzinu na sushu, to okazalos, chto v ney nakhoditsya malenkiy krokodilchik. Krokodilchik, kotorogo mestnye zhiteli nazvali Krokom, ros vmeste s gobbosami, nesmotrya na to, chto s vozrastom on stal v neskolko raz krupnee ikh.
No odnazhdy spokoystvie ostrovov gobbosov bylo narusheno vtorzheniem zlodeya Barona Dante vmeste s sonmom ego prispeshnikov — demonov Dantinisov. Dante plenil bólshuyu chast gobbosov, v tom chisle i ikh korolya, odnako, Kroku udalos spastis. Teper on — edinstvennaya nadezhda na spasenie gobbosov, emu predstoit oboyti vse ostrova odin za drugim i ostanovit Barona Dante i ego mnogochislennykh pomoshchnikov!
Proekt — tryokhmernyy platformer v stile igr Super Mario 64 ili Crash Bandicoot. Protagonist igry — antropomorficheskiy krokodilchik Krok, kotoryy mozhet peredvigatsya po tryokhmernym lokatsiyam v lyubom napravlenii, khotya i v predelakh, ogranichennykh neprokhodimymi gorami ili stenami. Krok umeet prygat, srazhat vzmakhom khvosta vragov ili obrushivatsya na nepriyatelya ili obekty sverkhu. Na kazhdom urovne nakhodyatsya razbivaemye yashchiki, khranyashchie v sebe bonusnye obekty ili gobbosov.
V etom HD-remastere dlya Nintendo Switch budet uluchshennaya grafika vysokogo razresheniya, sovremennaya mekhanika upravleniya s obnovlyonnoy kameroy i retro-videorezhimy, vossozdayushchie autentichnyy igrovoy protsess.Sbornik «Croc's World», 5 igr sm. tam.
MofuMofu Sensen — безумно мрачный класси:
MofuMofu Sensen — bezumno mrachnyy klassicheskiy arkadnyy 2D-fayting v tyomnom stile, polnostyu razrabotannyy nezavisimoy yaponskoy studiey BURNSOUCOU, v kotorom predstavleny antropomorfnye personazhi v raznykh superkostyumakh, srazhayushchikhsya v otchayannykh boyakh za pobedu!
Imeyutsya pyat tipov osnovnykh atak plyus 5 osobykh: slabaya ataka, srednyaya ataka, silnaya ataka, spetsialnaya ataka i brosok, u kazhdogo takzhe est 5 svoikh sobstvennykh spetspriyomov. Auto Advancing Guard (AAG), sistema, avtomaticheski razdelyayushchaya rasstoyanie mezhdu protivnikami pri zashchite v zavisimosti ot velichiny shkaly AAG. Eto pozvolyaet ispolzovat improvizirovannuyu taktiku, kotoraya predotvrashchaet odnoobrazie v sparringe, i prednaznachen dlya togo, chtoby vse, ot novichkov do prodvinutykh igrokov, khoteli srazhatsya chestno i s azartom!

Возрождение тактической фэнтезийной роле:
Vozrozhdenie takticheskoy fenteziynoy rolevoy igry!.. Srazhaytes s sudboy, otpravlyayas v korolevskoe priklyuchenie, chtoby vernut sebe poteryannuyu vlast, vmeste s nadezhnymi soyuznikami.
Unicorn Overlord sochetaet v sebe zhanr takticheskikh rolevykh igr s issledovaniem mira i innovatsionnoy boevoy sistemoy, sozdavaya epicheskiy fenteziynyy opyt — v kultovom stile Vanillaware (13 Sentinels: Aegis Rim).
Ты — заключённый в камере. Вы хотите беж: Ty — zaklyuchyonnyy v kamere. Vy khotite bezhat. No deystvitelno li eto vasha tsel? Centum vyglyadit, kak ocherednoy khorror v zhanre point & click, no pod prostoy poverkhnostyu skryvaetsya nechto sovershenno inoe..
Погрузитесь в тайны человеческой природы:
Pogruzites v tayny chelovecheskoy prirody i uznayte, chto skryvaetsya v teni.

Osobennosti igry
- Nelineynoe povestvovanie: kazhdyy vash vybor opredelyaet razvitie igry.
- Mnozhestvo syuzhetnykh razvilok i 34 kontsovki.
- Vam predstoit zabotitsya ne tolko o resursakh dlya svoego otryada, no i eshchyo o fizicheskom i psikhologicheskom sostoyanii boytsov.
- Vzglyanite na tovarishchey po oruzhiyu cherez prizmu vzaimootnosheniy v gruppe.
- Puteshestvuyte i izuchayte nedruzhelyubnyy mir, pogibshiy v ogne vulkanov.
- Sobirayte resursy i sozdavayte vsyo neobkhodimoe v puti.
- 34 raznye kontsovki

Otkryvayte dlya sebya chto-to novoe v kazhdom priklyuchenii (polnoe uspeshnoe prokhozhdenie zanimaet bolee 2 chasov). Vas zhdut 34 varianta finala.

Kontrol nad fizicheskim i psikhicheskim sostoyaniem otryada
Vam predstoit ne tolko podbirat ekipirovku i zabotitsya o propitanii tovarishchey, no i ne dat im soyti s uma ili vpast v depressiyu. Ishchite i sobirayte neobkhodimye dlya vyzhivaniya resursy, chtoby uberech svoy otryad.

Kharakternye personazhi
Postignite vse tonkosti vzaimootnosheniy mezhdu otvazhnoy predvoditelnitsey otryada Petroy (Petra), pragmatichnym boytsom Sinkhom (Sinh), yunoy optimistichnoy uchenitsey Kali (Kali) i ostorozhnym razvedchikom Nadirom (Nadir) i vmeste doberites do kraya sveta.

Bezradostnoe budushchee
Cherez 200 let posle nachala geologicheskogo apokalipsisa mir prevratilsya v vyzhzhennuyu pustynyu. Udastsya li vam perezhit vse kaprizy vzbesivsheysya pogody: pepelnye buri, seruyu purgu i kislotnye dozhdi?
The Spectrum Retreat — увлекательная игр:
The Spectrum Retreat — uvlekatelnaya igra-golovolomka ot pervogo litsa v nedalekom budushchem. Vy prosypaetes v otele The Penrose — uyutnom, no kakom-to strannom meste, skryvayushchem vas ot vneshnego mira. I pochemu vam kazhetsya, chto mezhdu vami i etim mestom est kakaya-to osobaya svyaz.

Issleduya potryasayushchiy otel v stile art-deko, vy raskroete i ego sekrety, i tayny, okruzhayushchie vashe prebyvanie tam. Na puti k pravde vas zhdut «tsvetnye» i neveroyatnye «fizicheskie» zagadki, a takzhe popytki skryt ot drugikh svoi istinnye namereniya.
Be transported back to lazy summer days:
Be transported back to lazy summer days and less stressful times alone or with up to 4 friends. Master the momentum based rolling and gliding controls, and spread the chill vibes in more than 20 colourful levels over 5 sun-drenched environments;
- Lazy summer beaches of Temaki Sands
- Overgrown city scape of Maple City
- Chill bubbling rapids of Konichiwa Falls
- Glistening ice caps of Narwhal Station
- Sugar rush inducing Pudding Valhalla

All across 2 relaxing gameplay modes, ‘Target Test’ and ‘Sweet Rush’. Soar through the open skies collecting sweets, nabbing powerups and uncovering hidden routes and top it off with a perfect landing. For these bonnie fish the goal is not winning but enjoying the great weather, chill vibes and relaxing days while they last.
Full Tilt! Pinball — компьютерная игра,:
Full Tilt! Pinball — kompyuternaya igra, iznachalno razrabotannaya kompaniey Cinematronics i izdannaya Maxis Software v 1995 godu, simulyator nastolnoy igry «pinbol» dlya platformy PC s Windows.
Pinbol «Zvyozdnyy yunga» (3D Pinball for Windows – Space Cadet) — vstroennaya igra v OS Windows, razrabotannaya dizaynerom Microsoft Devidom Plammerom i yavlyayushchayasya slegka izmenyonnoy versiey «Zvyozdnogo yungi» iz originalnoy Full Tilt! Pinball. Vpervye poyavilas v Windows NT 4.0 (vkhodila takzhe v sostav Microsoft Plus! dlya Windows 95) i vposledstvii byla vklyuchena v Windows 2000, Windows ME i Windows XP.
Vo vremya igry igrok upravlyaete flipperami (levym i pravym). S pomoshchyu nikh neobkhodimo otbivat sharik, popadaya v razlichnye misheni. V nachale igry dayotsya tri sharika, po mere prokhozhdeniya igrok dolzhen kopit shariki i podnimatsya v zvanii. Vsego v igre 9 urovney, kotorym sootvetstvuyut zvaniya: nizshee zvanie — Yunga, s kotorogo nachinaetsya igra, vysshee — Admiral flota. Chem vyshe zvanie, tem vyshe priz. Povyshaya zvanie, vy poluchaete dostup k bolee slozhnym missiyam!Drugie pinbol-igry na Switch.
BORIS THE ROCKET - симулятор усатого сов:
BORIS THE ROCKET - simulyator usatogo sovetskogo raketchika vremen Kholodnoy voyny. U vas budet vozmozhnost v odinochku zashchitit svoyu neobyatnuyu Rodinu. Vam predstoit borotsya s morozom i koznyami medvedya, khlebat sgushchenku, chtoby vyzhit i svoevremenno adaptirovatsya k bystro menyayushcheysya obstanovke.

Polnoe pogruzhenie v dramaticheskuyu obstanovku vremyon Kholodnoy voyny, to vremya, kogda dolg pered Rodinoy vazhnee lichnogo mneniya, a tvoyo brennoe telo polnostyu prinadlezhit gosudarstvu. Ved imenno v takikh usloviyakh stanovyatsya nastoyashchimi geroyami i patriotami svoey strany. 
Ne day pogubit svoyu Rodinu i dostoyno otvet vragu! Umri, no sdelay! Ved u sovetskogo cheloveka dazhe smert ne yavlyaetsya opravdaniem!

• Mozhno prokachat organizm Borisa, chto neosporimo uluchshit kachestvo vypolnyaemoy im sluzhby. Nesmotrya na to, chto Boris i tak v ochen khoroshey forme, kak izvestno, net predela sovershenstvu!
• Progress ne stoit na meste, a izobretatelnosti vraga mozhno tolko pozavidovat. Ozhidayte prodolzhitelnyy grad iz raznoobraznogo  vysokotekhnologichnogo metalla vdobavok so smertonosnym yadernym zaryadom.
• Izgotavlivayte zhiznenno neobkhodimoe zele. Ved edinstvennoe, chto mozhet ostanovit medvedya, - eto butylka VODY. Pripasite paru butylok: odnu dlya sebya i odnu dlya vashego novogo tayozhnogo druga!
• Eto kak minimum to, chto zastavit vraga vas uvazhat, a kak maksimum zastavit ego zamolchat navsegda. Chudo inzhenernoy mysli, kombinatsiya adskoy sily i velikolepiya - mezhkontinentalnaya ballisticheskaya raketa "STEPAN".
The ancient evil has been banished, the:
The ancient evil has been banished, the princess rescued and the Knight retires - but something is wrong. You awake falling to your death - probably - from the top of the mysterious underworld spire. Regain your memories and save the world - most likely - again. Go forth Holy Diver it’s - definitely - all up to you.

Good Night, Knight is a humorous twist on stories you likely already know from fantasy books and games, set in a pixel medieval world. With a range of unique and peculiar knights, creatures and many different story events Good Night, Knight offers a truly unusual experience.

This charming 16-bit sneak-and-slash adventure is a mechanically-deep dungeon crawler featuring robust stealth, stamina management, a dynamic field-of-view system, versatile items, resource management, and much more to discover! 


- Strategic heavy-hitting combat: Skill, timing, and good positioning are key to your survival.
- Double the fun in the co-op mode. Click the orb in your tent and play with your friend!
- Robust stealth elements: Sneak, peek around corners, with the help of the dynamic field-of-view system and learn where enemies are patrolling to catch them off-guard. Or hack-and-slash your way through them all!
- Procedurally generated dungeons: Randomly generated areas and a mix of hand-made scenarios makes each campaign unique and interesting.
- Huge amounts of loot to find and equip: Mix and match gear, potions, and curses to find your preferred playstyle.
- Risk/Reward management: Choose between retreating to rest or venturing onwards for extra rewards.
- Extra challenges: Enable many different extra challenge modifiers for even more rewards, but don't get too greedy!
- Prepare yourself for battle: Food, ingredients, and provisions help you stay in top shape during battles. Gather resources during combat, and manage how much to spend during preparations.
- No permadeath: Progress is saved while advancing through the campaign. And just like real life, death can still be very costly.
- Optional Ironman mode: In this game mode, if you die, everything is lost! Only for the toughest Knights!
Сюжет игры развивается в 1930-х годах. М:
Syuzhet igry razvivaetsya v 1930-kh godakh. Molodaya dampir (poluvampirsha-poluzhenshchina) Reyn, rabotayushchaya na tainstvennuyu organizatsiyu obshchestvo «Brimstoun» (angl. Brimstone Society), otpravlyaetsya na pervye zadaniya. Sobytiya razvorachivayutsya v tryokh chastyakh: «Mortton, Luiziana», «Argentina» i «Natsistskaya Germaniya».
Snachala geroinya vmeste s eyo nastavnitsey Mins, dampirom iz «Brimstouna», popadaet v gorod Mortton, shtat Luiziana. Ikh vizit svyazan s novostyami o nekoy infektsii, okhvativshey mestnuyu derevnyu, v chyom devushki vposledstvii ubezhdayutsya, stalkivayas s zhivymi mertvetsami i mutantami — byvshimi mestnymi zhitelyami i neobychnymi paukoobraznymi nasekomymi, kotorykh zhiteli prozvali «maresrekami»..
Kim is a lovely 8 year old girl that liv:
Kim is a lovely 8 year old girl that lives in a peaceful insular island with her grandmother. Abandoned by her mother not long after birth, she must put grievances aside to focus on something of utter importance 

The pink heart on the cheeks is their birthmark and the protection of Village, their duty. 
Following a trail of brainwashed minions and high-tech robot soldiers, she would soon find herself in the middle of a world-domination plot carried on by an evil secret society!

Unveil Kim's story as she tries to save the day!
Discover secret items, unlock secret levels and get special powers!
Slash your way through several unique enemies! Also...boss battles!

BIG, maze-like dungeons, spanning from mysterious forests to top-secret underwater labs!
«Русалка из Зеннора» — изначально старин:
«Rusalka iz Zennora» — iznachalno starinnaya kornuollskaya (grafstva i unitarnoy edinitsy yugo-zapada Anglii) narodnaya skazka, kotoraya beret svoyo nachalo v derevne Zennor, primerno v 10 km k severu ot Penzansa ~1400 let nazad. Starinnaya legenda rasskazyvaet istoriyu tainstvennoy zhenshchiny, kotoraya inogda poseshchala mestnuyu prikhodskuyu tserkov; odnazhdy odin molodoy chelovek prosledil za ney do doma, i bolshe ikh oboikh nikogda ne videli. Zatem v voskresene rusalka yavilas gruppe mestnykh moryakov, prosya ikh podnyat yakor, chtoby vpustit v dom, s tem zhe rezultatom.
V kornuollskikh legendakh rusalki nesut v sebe dukhovnuyu simvoliku i vosprinimayutsya chut bolee pozitivno, chem vo mnogikh drugikh kulturakh, vklyuchaya russkuyu. Naprimer, v «Ordinaliyakh», trilogii srednevekovykh pes-misteriyakh kontsa XIV veka, napisannykh preimushchestvenno na srednekornuollskom yazyke s latinskimi stsenicheskimi ukazaniyami dvoystvennaya priroda Khrista sravnivaetsya s rusalkoy: «On vpolne mozhet byt i poluchelovekom i polubogom. Chelovek — eto rovno polovina rusalki, napolovinu zhenshchina s golovy do serdtsa; takov i Iisus».
Pogruzites v mrachnuyu, no nasyshchennuyu vizualnuyu novellu o pagubnoy oderzhimosti yunoy devushki svoim onii-chanom (starshim bratom) ot ebi-hime!..
Laylak gluboko neschastna. Ignoriruemaya svoimi chereschur chyorstvymi roditelyami i podvergayushchayasya travle odnoklassnikov, yunaya devushka pogruzhaetsya v puchinu odinochestva. Krome Eyslin, podrugi s vesyolym nravom, i missis Khuri, shkolnogo psikhologa, nikto osobo ne tyanetsya s ney razgovarivat, dumaya, chto dazhe oni s ney obkhoditelny lish iz zhalosti. Laylak chuvstvuet, chto mozhet doveryat lish svoemu starshemu bratu Dzhessi. Dva mesyatsa nazad on pereekhal iz ikh malenkoy derevushki v Kornuolle v burnuyu stolitsu — London, chtoby postupat v vuz. Devushka tak silno toskuet po bratu, chto vse eyo mysli v itoge skhodyatsya lish na nyom odnom. S kazhdym dnyom Laylak vsyo silnee i silnee zatsiklivaetsya, i v konechnom itoge strashnaya oderzhimost grozitsya polnostyu poglotit eyo..
Experience the legacy!\nYour mysterious:
Experience the legacy!
Your mysterious uncle left nothing but a letter in his wake, telling you to solve his final puzzle to obtain his heritage… but is there more to this than meets the eye?

Use your wits!
You will need to use your skills of deduction, combination, recollection and observation to overcome the various challenges in the game.

Discover the secrets!

Ведьма похитила принца и принцессу. Вы —:
Vedma pokhitila printsa i printsessu. Vy — pridvornyy volshebnik, kotorogo razdelili nadvoe, chtoby vy spasli srazu oboikh. Vot tolko dlya etogo nuzhno nauchitsya upravlyat polovinami vashego tela.
S pomoshchyu serii korotkikh platformennykh urovney, zanimayushchikh strogo odin ekran, «Ambidekstro» nauchit vas upravlyat srazu dvumya personazhami kazhdoy rukoy po otdelnosti. Vy nauchites razdelyat vnimanie i budete prokhodit vsyo bolee slozhnye urovni, kotorye iznachalno kazalis vam zubodrobitelno trudnymi.
Lovecraft’s Untold Stories - экшн роглай:
Lovecraft’s Untold Stories - ekshn roglayt. Vy issleduete urovni v sluchaynom poryadke, syuzhet igry sozdan po motivam proizvedeniy Lavkrafta. V igre vy nakhodite informatsiyu, chtoby pobedit Velikikh Drevnikh!

Igra Lovecraft’s Untold Stories sozdana po motivam proizvedeniy G.F. Lavkrafta. Kazhdyy personazh sleduet svoey linii rassledovaniya, i kazhdaya provedet ego po raznym lokatsiyam, nachinaya, naprimer, ot starogo osobnyaka do zabroshennogo gospitalya, ili dzhungley. Urovni sozdayutsya v sluchaynom poryadke: kazhdyy raz, kogda vy igraete, vse budet po-drugomu. Takzhe oni variruyutsya v zavisimosti ot personazha, kotorym vy igraete. Naydite predmety i podskazki, chtoby raskryt sekrety i nachat novye istorii!
A group of scientists interrogate an ali:
A group of scientists interrogate an alien discovered at the heart of a global pandemic. Work with your team, make decisions and uncover the alien’s true intentions.

Inspired by classic adventure games and modern dialogue systems, Bithell Games has created another single session story which respects your time and your intelligence.

Key Features

* A one-sitting game for adults in search of a polished new world to discover.
* Developed by the award-winning team behind Thomas Was Alone and Subsurface Circular.
* Social dynamics and greater choice enhance this twist on classic text-based adventures.
* Responsive soundtrack by Dan Le Sac.
* Atmospheric use of HD Rumble.
* Art Gallery showcasing the development of this new story.
* Unlockable ‘Mr Commentary’, our next generation take on a developer’s commentary.
Ys Memoire: The Oath in Felghana — это H:
Ys Memoire: The Oath in Felghana — eto HD-remaster vyshedshey v 2010 godu Ys: The Oath in Felghana, kotoraya byla remeykom originalnoy Ys III: Wanderers of Ys 1989 goda.
Novaya versiya predlagaet mnozhestvo uluchsheniy:
The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask (yap. ゼルダの伝説 ムジュラの仮面 Dzeruda no Densetsu Mudzyura no Kamen) — videoigra v zhanre ekshn-priklyucheniya, razrabotannaya i opublikovannaya Nintendo dlya igrovoy pristavki Nintendo 64, vpervye byla vypushchena v Yaponii 27 aprelya 2000 goda, vsego bylo prodano 3 milliona kopiy. V tom zhe dvukhtysyachnom godu osenyu sostoyalis relizy igry v Amerike i Evrope.
Majora’s Mask — shestaya chast serii videoigr The Legend of Zelda i vtoraya 3D-igra serii. Majora’s Mask otlichaetsya bolee produmannym, mrachnym i glubokim syuzhetom, chem eyo predshestvennitsa — Ocarina of Time. Glavnyy geroy Link okazyvaetsya v strane Termina, a ne v privychnom Khayrule, osnovnom meste deystviya bolshinstva igr serii. Zagadochnyy demon v maske, izvestnyy kak Cherepysh, zastavlyaet Lunu soyti s orbity i obrushitsya na Terminu. Link ispolzuet puteshestvie vo vremeni, chtoby snova i snova vozvrashchatsya na tri dnya nazad do krusheniya, chtoby popytatsya predotvratit ego. Majora’s Mask byla khorosho prinyata kritikami, kotorykh privlekli uluchshennaya grafika i glubokiy, mrachnyy syuzhet.Pervuyu igru, nativnyy port The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time sm. tut. Drugie varianty versiy Majora's Mask.
Приключенческая ролевая игра с механикой:
Priklyuchencheskaya rolevaya igra s mekhanikoy vremennoy petli. Siffrin i eyo druzya byli svyazany sudboy, chtoby polozhit konets tiranicheskomu pravleniyu zlogo korolya. I kogda pobeda uzhe byla pochti v ikh rukakh, proiskhodit tragediya, chasy sbrasyvayutsya, a geroyam prikhoditsya nachinat vsyo snachala.
S kazhdym tsiklom Siffrin poluchaet novyy vzglyad na okruzhayushchiy mir, otkryvaya novye resheniya k golovolomkam i vybiraya nailuchshie varianty v dialogakh.
Ekipiruyte vospominaniya v kachestve dospekhov, molites bogu peremen, chtoby uluchshit vozmozhnosti vashey komandy v kazhdom novom tsikle, i broste vyzov smertelnym vragam v igre «kamen, nozhnitsy, bumaga»!
«Три поросёнка», с англ. Three Little Pi:
«Tri porosyonka», s angl. Three Little Pigs — odna iz samykh populyarnykh detskikh skazok; eyo syuzhet voskhodit k angliyskomu folkloru — literaturnye versii «Tryokh porosyat» izvestny s XIX veka i vkhodyat, v chastnosti, v knigu «Detskie stishki i istorii» («Nursery Rhymes and Nursery Tales»), izdannuyu v Londone v 1890 godu literaturovedom Dzheymsom Orchardom Kholivellom-Fillipsom.

A stack of news article sits on your des:
A stack of news article sits on your desk, two stampers on each side - green to approve, red to reject. Your reporting team is hacking away in the background as corporate music plays through the loudspeaker. It's time to make decisions. Will you endorse nationalized healthcare, even though your love interest is worried about increased wait times? Will you demonize the new synthetic alcoholic drink, even though your boss stressed they are an important investor? Will you support current government, as tensions grow between the neighboring country?

After work, you emerge on the streets of Novistan, shaped by the very news you publish. Perhaps you will see more graffiti, angry bums or even a riot? Or perhaps you will turn the nation into peaceful utopia, filled with cameras and drones watching your every step? How will your channel address tragic events about to happen? Will you agree to meet the clandestine group of truthtellers, or stop to watch the Prime Minister's speech? 

On the way home you meet with three main characters: Evie, your co-worker and immigrant, worried about her health and growing xenophobic sentiment; your brother Justin, an aspiring comedian struggling with impostor syndrome and social anxiety; finally Rudy, a single father trying to provide for his little girl and keep his store afloat, while a mega-mart opens up next door. Each day provides a glimpse into their life and how the media shapes their beliefs. 

But every Headliner deserves to relax at home from the stress of the job. Listen to the radio and unwind on the comfy couch bought with hard-earned cash, as you watch the city burn outside the window. Perhaps splurge on treats to feed your doggo? Adopt a drone? Have your brother over for dinner? Or maybe keep your doors locked, hoarding every penny, as your apartment slowly fills with piles of cash? 

After good night's sleep, it's time to once again face to boss, new articles, a growing sense of responsibility, and.... power.

Видеоигра-платформер, повествующая о при:
Videoigra-platformer, povestvuyushchaya o priklyucheniyakh myshonka Mikki Mausa, razrabotannaya kompaniey Sega Studios Australia i izdannaya Sega i Disney Interactive Studios dlya PlayStation Network i Xbox Live Arcade i PC v 2013 godu, Feral Interactive vypustil igru dlya macOS 24 iyulya 2014 goda. Yavlyaetsya odinnadtsatoy igroy serii Illusion i remeykom igry Castle of Illusion Starring Mickey Mouse 1990 goda.
Geympley skhoden s eyo predshestvennikom i zaklyuchaetsya primerno v sleduyushchem. Antropomorfnyy myshonok Mikki Maus peremeshchaetsya po urovnyam, unichtozhaet vragov i sobiraet poleznye predmety; v kontse nekotorykh urovney nakhodyatsya bossy. Tsel igry — spasti vozlyublennuyu Mikki, Minni, iz plena neizvestnogo zlodeya. V bolshinstve urovney nuzhno vypolnyat kakoe-libo zadanie, k primeru, otyskivat kakoy-libo predmet. Urovni v igre imeyut skhodstva s originalnoy igroy. Naprimer, eto zakoldovannyy les, fabrika morozhenogo i t. d. Bolshinstvo protivnikov-monstrov i bossov takzhe pereshli v remeyk iz originalnoy igry. Protivnikov mozhno unichtozhat posredstvom pryzhka sverkhu, bossy zhe trebuyut opredelyonnoy taktiki.
Na sayte Metacritic srednyaya otsenka igre sostavila 72 balla dlya PlayStation 3 i 67 balla dlya konsoli Xbox 360. Predstavitel sayta IGN otsenil proekt na 6,7 balla, khvalya razrabotchikov za idei. Otsenku v 7 ballov dal retsenzent iz sayta GameSpot: emu ponravilas sama zadumka razrabotchikov i eyo realizatsiya. Kritik iz Official Xbox Magazine postavil vysokuyu otsenku Castle of Illusion Starring Mickey Mouse — 8 ballov iz 10.

* Proydi vse komnaty s zagadkami, dostigni interaktivnogo finala, i tebe otkroyutsya sekretnye komnaty. Preodolev ikh, ty smozhesh uvidet alternativnuyu kontsovku.

Peremeshchaysya po lokatsiyam so sverkhskorostyu blagodarya svoim moshchnym broskam kryukom! Spokoyno pritselivaysya i brosay gigantskiy yakor v zolotye koltsa, tem samym peredvigayas po urovnyam na vysokoy skorosti i s lovkostyu i provornostyu, kotorye prosto neobkhodimy, chtoby uklonyatsya ot prepyatstviy i vrazheskikh pul. 
Strelyay na 360° iz svoego Blazma-pistoleta! Obezvred vsekh vragov s pomoshchyu lovkikh pul, tolko s pylu s zharu!
Pokrasuysya na polnuyu blagodarya sposobnosti zamedlyat dvizhenie! Priostanovi techenie vremeni, chtoby poluchshe pritselitsya ili provernut krutoy tryuk – mozhesh delat eto chastenko, ved dannaya sposobnost "perezaryazhaetsya" ochen bystro i delaet tebya na minimum 200% kruche.

Proryvaysya skvoz sluchaynym obrazom smontirovannye kosmicheskie korabli! Vse urovni unikalny, tak kak kazhdyy iz nikh vdumchivo postroen iz soten sozdannykh vruchnuyu komnat, razlichnym obrazom modifitsirovannykh, napolnennykh neobychnymi sokrovishchami i naselennykh sluchayno vybrannymi volnami vragov. 
Istrebi piratskikh lordov iz klana Klastera! Kormi svoe sozdanie-kompas, kotoroe v blagodarnost ukazhet mestonakhozhdenie bossov, posle chego obezvred ikh i prinesi trofei domoy. Tvoi protivniki – ne kakie-to tam kosmicheskie prostachki, tak chto ubedis, chto gotov srazitsya s nimi! 
Sobiray redkie relikvii i mogushchestvennye bonusnye kartochki! Vse sobrannye toboy sokrovishcha sozdayut tvoyu legendu – razblokiruy novye bonusy, uluchshayushchie osnashchenie personazha, pri povyshenii svoego urovnya, pokupay postoyanno deystvuyushchie uluchsheniya na Chernom Rynke, nakaplivay relikvii i pishi svoyu istoriyu! 
Kto stanet luchshim piratom segodnyashnego dnya? Posorevnuysya v luchshikh pokazatelyakh scheta i vremeni v ezhednevnykh i ezhenedelnykh konkursakh!

Button City is a colorful low poly narrative adventure game about friendship and community. Enter a pastel diorama world inspired by 90’s nostalgia and filled with cute characters to befriend. Complete quirky quests around town, play arcade games, collect fun costumes, solve puzzles and more as you follow a story about growing up and saving the things that are important to you. 

• Explore a beautiful and lovingly crafted world in a low poly art style.
• Befriend a cast of charming animal characters.
• Complete fun and silly side quests at your own pace.
• Master arcade games to unlock new game modes and prize items!

Igroki vvodyat svoi soobrazheniya (kak pravilo, izdevatelskie) po povodu togo, chto na samom dele narisovano, posle chego kazhdyy — dazhe zriteli, nablyudayushchie za tem, chem zanimayutsya igroki, kotorykh mogut byt tysyachi — golosuyut, reshaya, kakoy iz otvetov, po ikh mneniyu, pravilnyy.

Drawful 2 — igra, v kotoruyu mozhet igrat kazhdyy, i v ney nikto ne razocharuetsya!

Primechanie: eta igra prednaznachena dlya neskolkikh igrokov, nakhodyashchikhsya v odnom i tom zhe meste, no striming pozvolyaet uchastvovat v ney i udalennym igrokam.
When the Wizard of Darkness awakened, it:

Мицуки переезжает из глубинки в Токио, ч:
Mitsuki pereezzhaet iz glubinki v Tokio, chtoby postupit v spetsializirovannuyu shkolu v nadezhde sdat vstupitelnye ekzameny v universitet sleduyushchey vesnoy. Odnako vskore on obnaruzhivaet, chto drugie ego odnoklassniki otnosyatsya k nemu kak k sotsialnomu izgoyu, poskolku na segodnyashniy den on samyy starshiy v shkole. Podruzhitsya s kem-to nevozmozhno, i Mitsuki obrekaet sebya na uedinennoe, odinokoe sushchestvovanie…

Tak prodolzhalos do tekh por, poka on ne vstretil mat-odinochku, Khimuro Kyoko, kotoraya, kak okazalos, zhivet v tom zhe zhilom komplekse, chto i on. Mitsuki predlagaet pomoch Kyoko nyanchitsya s ee docheryu Tama. Kyoko, v svoyu ochered, pomogaet Mitsuki podgotovitsya k predstoyashchim ekzamenam. V techenie goda oni sblizilis - snachala kak druzya, a zatem kak nechto bolshee.

Kharakteristiki:
* Primerno 80 000 slov v istorii (okolo 5-6 chasov chteniya)

Новое детище в серии «Spirit Hunter»! В:
Novoe detishche v serii «Spirit Hunter»! V okrestnostyakh Tokio nakhoditsya chastnaya akademiya «Akademiya Konoekhara», istoriya kotoroy naschityvaet uzhe bolee 100 let. Khodyat slukhi, chto v etu akademiyu kazhdye 10 let pronikayut mertvye i rasprostranyayut proklyatie. Primerno v kontse leta na territorii akademii neskolko studentov umirayut zagadochnoy smertyu. Politseyskoe rassledovanie ne smoglo vyyavit kriminalny kharakter prestupleniya, a sredi studentov stali rasprostranyatsya slukhi, chto eto «delo ruk mertvetsov», i «chto ikh zabrali dukhi».
Chtoby vernut spokoystvie v akademiyu, direktor prosit semyu Kudzho, izdavna spetsializiruyushchikhsya na sverkhestestvennykh yavleniyakh, rassledovat eto delo. Glava semi Kudzho soglashaetsya, i pronikaet v akademiyu pod vidom vremennogo, zamenyayushchego uchitelya…
Igrat predstoit za geroya pervoy chasti serii (vmeste kak so starymi, tak i s novymi personazhami), a sam geympley, v osnovnom, ne izmenilsya po sravneniyu s pervoy chastyu. Vremya ot vremeni vy budete stalkivatsya so sverkhestestvennym v smertelnoy skhvatke i, kak i ranshe, vam nuzhno budet ispolzovat razlichnye predmety i uzhe sobrannuyu informatsiyu dlya togo, chtoby vyzhit.Spirit Hunter: Death Mark / Spirit Hunter: NG sm. zdes.

Действие The Legend of Arcadieu происход:
Deystvie The Legend of Arcadieu proiskhodit v misticheskom korolevstve vnutri kompyuternoy igry. Vsyo nachinaetsya s togo, chto vy sluchayno zakhodite v igru i stanovites velikim legendarnym geroem. Teper vam nuzhno nayti dorogu domoy.

S pomoshchyu simpatichnoy magini i krasivoy voitelnitsy vy dolzhny srazitsya s ordoy privlekatelnykh monstrov, chtoby vstretit svoyu sudbu. Issleduyte volshebnyy mir, napolnennyy mnozhestvom krasivykh devushek, satiroy na glupye RPG i mnozhestvom romanticheskikh variantov na vybor.

V komplekt vkhodyat obe igry: The Legend of Arcadieu i The Legend of Arcadieu 2. Kazhdaya igra predlagaet neskolko kontsovok v zavisimosti ot vybora, kotoryy vy delaete po khodu priklyucheniya.

Shin Megami Tensei III: Nocturne HD REMA:
Shin Megami Tensei III: Nocturne HD REMASTER (真・女神転生III NOCTURNE, «Reinkarnatsiya istinnoy Bogini: Noktyurn») — eto postapokalipticheskaya yaponskaya rolevaya videoigra, razrabotanaya Atlus, tretya igra v serii Shin Megami Tensei — tsentralnoy serii vo franshize Megami Tensei. Igra byla khorosho prinyata igrovymi izdaniyami, kotorye khvalili igrovoy protsess i atmosferu, v to vremya kak eyo slozhnaya slozhnost chasto stanovilas predmetom kritiki, no inogda i pokhvaly.
Noktyurn sleduet za uchenikom sredney shkoly v sovremennom Tokio, kotoryy prevrashchaetsya v demonicheskogo Demi-demona posle togo, kak mir podvergaetsya Zachatiyu, apokalipticheskomu sobytiyu, vyzvannomu zloveshchim kultom, chtoby vyzvat vozrozhdenie mira v novoy forme. Kogda Tokio prevratilsya v Vikhrevoy Mir, napolnennyy demonami, Demi-demon stanovitsya instrumentom dlya skhem Prichin, sushchestv, kotorye stremyatsya peredelat mir po svoemu obrazu, i Lyutsifera, povelitelya demonov. V igrovom protsesse ispolzuetsya poshagovaya boevaya sistema, osnovannaya na ispolzovanii slabykh mest, i sistema verbovki demonov, pozvolyayushchaya igroku nabirat demonov iz mira Vikhrya, chtoby oni srazhalis vmeste s nimi..
Obnovlyonnoe izdanie pod nazvaniem HD REMASTER na Nintendo Switch, osnovannoe na redaktsii Maniax Chronicle Edition vklyuchaet v sebya ozvuchennye roliki i dopolnitelnye optsii slozhnosti — novyy uroven slozhnosti «Miloserdnyy» byl vklyuchen v kachestve ustupki sovremennym igrovym tendentsiyam; naryadu s etim, byli perepisany nekotorye dialogi.Shin Megami Tensei V sm. tut.
Adventure calls... but you don't always:
Adventure calls... but you don't always have time to spend hours optimizing your character sheet or managing your inventory! One Deck Dungeon lets you jump right in to bashing down doors, rolling dice, and squashing baddies with style. Get a full roguelike game experience, boiled down to its essence, and captured in a single deck of cards and a handful of dice!

One Deck Dungeon is a dungeon crawling adventure game. Each time you play, choose one or two of these 9 brave heroes:

• Mage - There's rarely a problem in the dungeon she can't solve with a spell.
• Warrior - Her favorite dungeon activity is squashing her opponents immediately.
• Rogue - Watch in awe as she dispatches monsters with style.
• Archer - Accurate, brilliant, catastrophically deadly.
• Paladin - She seeks out danger and shields her allies from deadly enemies.
• Caliana - This faerie has decided that dungeoneering looks fun! Don't let her get bored...
• Fanatic - A righteous Sentinel is here to smite evil wherever it may lurk!
• Witch - Her chaotic magic hammer is ready to smash glooping oozes into glooping puddles!
• Mist - This breach mage has crossed over from the world of Aeon's End to help defend Mynerva.

There are 7 dangerous challenges to face:

• Dragon’s Cave - The thick-skinned wyvern who occupies this dungeon prefers her heroes on the crispy side.
• Yeti’s Cavern - If you can survive the freezing winds and biting cold, an abominable snowman awaits.
• Hydra’s Reef - Chop off one head, and another appears! This regenerating venomous monstrosity is a slippery foe.
• Lich’s Tomb - Hordes of undead foes, evil curses, and magical wards. What could possibly go wrong?
• Minotaur’s Maze - Abandon all hope, ye who enter here!
• Cinder Plains - The Hellhound awaits those reckless enough to venture here...
• Phoenix's Den - Only the bravest heroes can handle the heat!

All cards in One Deck Dungeon have many colorful boxes. Roll your dice, and attempt to fill in as many boxes as possible. For every one you don't fill, you’ll suffer consequences in hearts and time! Once you complete an encounter you'll be able to learn a new skill, acquire a new item, or gain experience to level up your hero. Descend the dungeon and face the boss for the final challenge!

After every game, your heroes make progress toward unlocking up to 15 new talents, building up their power for future games.

Once you know your way around the dungeon, a game takes about 15 minutes. It might take a little longer if you're learning, or a lot shorter if you jump into a pit of spikes.

Warning: do not jump into a pit of spikes.

Welcome to the world of One Deck Dungeon. Adventure awaits!
«Бродячие Боги» — искреннее непочтительн:
«Brodyachie Bogi» — iskrennee nepochtitelnoe pereosmyslenie grecheskoy mifologii, sochetayushchee v sebe sovremennyy muzykalnyy teatr s videoigrami, v kotorykh personazhi i istoriya zanimayut tsentralnoe mesto.
V fenteziynom novatorskom mire, gde grecheskie bogi zhivut skryto sredi nas, Greys darovana sila Muzy vovlekat drugikh v muzykalnye nomera… sila, kotoraya ey ponadobitsya, chtoby uznat pravdu o smerti svoego predshestvennika, prezhde chem istechet vremya. Raskroyte taynu posledney muzy, prinimaya resheniya v prekrasno illyustrirovannom rolevom myuzikle. Napolnennaya pesnyami gorodskaya fenteziynaya saga, v kotoroy vash vybor opredelyaet, kak Sudby napravyat vas.
Priklyucheniya, pesni — i lyubov zhdut!..
Based on the #1 Best Selling Nintendo 3D:
Based on the #1 Best Selling Nintendo 3DS™ game.

After a strange virus spreads across an Arctic island you are left alone to survive.

Scavenge for food, drink, medical supplies, weapons, ammunition, clothes, fuel and other useful equipment.

Find shelters, vehicles and other interesting locations to help you survive during day and night.

Features Single Player, Local Play and Internet Multiplayer (Worldwide with anyone plus Game Chat).

Go scavenging, fishing and hunting with friends or alone, it's up to you how you survive.
Один человек и его оружие. Станьте таинс:
Odin chelovek i ego oruzhie. Stante tainstvennym koldunom, chto vyshel na opasnoe zadanie i nameren iskorenit vse zlo. Polozhite palets na spuskovoy kryuchok i otpravlyaytes seyat khaos skvoz prostranstvo i vremya, kak v zolotye dni polnykh do kraev adrenalina shuterov ot pervogo litsa. Vas zhdut dolgie chasy uvlekatelneyshey rezni. Itak, vpered!

Issleduyte 60 obshirnykh urovney v pyati mirakh — ot bazy v antarkticheskikh ldakh do peskov Egipta, dvorov i kladbishch srednevekovykh zamkov. Nakhodite klyuchi, chtoby otkryvat zapertye ranee dveri, otyskivayte tayniki s boepripasami i zolotom, polzuytes liftami i skrytymi knopkami, chtoby popadat v novye mesta. 

Srazhaytes s polchishchami vragov — ot letayushchikh demonov do pyatietazhnykh robotov. Zapachkayte steny i dveri ikh krovyu i oblomkami. Uklonyaytes ot pul i snaryadov, produmyvayte strategiyu boya, uznavayte, kakim oruzhiem luchshe vsego voevat s tem ili inym zlodeem. Izuchite vragov i vsegda budte na shag vperedi nikh, chtoby vyzhit na urovnyakh. Beytes s megabossami na ogromnykh arenakh, chtoby prokhodit igrovye miry.

Rasshiryayte arsenal novym oruzhiem, kotoroe budete nakhodit po puti — ot moshchnykh klinkov do ogromnykh «pushek». Sobirayte i razvivayte svoe lyubimoe snaryazhenie, uchites ubivat effektivno. Vas zhdut 38 vidov oruzhiya — izuchite ego sekrety i nanosite maksimalnyy uron! Sobirayte boepripasy i rasstrelivayte vragov ocheredyami, stavte ognennye steny, zapuskayte v protivnikov sgustki magicheskoy energii — sokrushayte vsekh, komu khvatilo gluposti vstat na vashem puti.

Razvivayte svoego geroya tak, kak nravitsya vam: raspredelyayte ochki uluchsheniy i privilegiy po vashim lyubimym navykam s kazhdym povysheniem urovnya. Uluchshayte zaklinaniya i oruzhie, chtoby sozdat svoego unikalnogo personazha, i ispolzuyte ikh po maksimumu, chtoby dostoyno proyavit sebya na vysokikh urovnyakh slozhnosti.
Воздушный мир был мирной страной, где в:
Vozdushnyy mir byl mirnoy stranoy, gde v radostnoy garmonii zhili i fei Vesennego Korolevstva, i ogry Zimnego. Mudryy Sovet upravlyal obeimi liniyami s pomoshchyu dobrozhelatelnykh sil Kristalla Sveta. No odnazhdy, kak i bylo predskazano Prorochestvom, zloy bog Loki razbil kristall na desyat chastey, otraviv zemlyu ogrov. Posleduyushchie zhestokie snezhnye buri bez oslablyayushchego tepla Kristalla unichtozhili bolshuyu chast vyzhivshikh, a ostavshiesya, ustavshie i izmuchennye, stali bezmozglymi rabami zlogo diktatora.
Vy feya — poslednyaya nadezhda Strany Fey, a znachit, i vsego Vozdushnogo Mira. Vashi syostry bezhali v posledniy bastion tvoey rodni, i vasha missiya — vernut vse desyat razbitykh chastey Kristalla Sveta, pobedit Loki i ispolnit Prorochestvo!..
Dungeons of Aether — это пошаговая ролев:
Dungeons of Aether — eto poshagovaya rolevaya igra-podzemele, razrabotannaya Nick ‘ampersandbear’ Blackwood iz komandy Aether Studios. V to vremya kak Rivals of Aether izvestna svoimi boyami v realnom vremeni, Dungeons of Aether pozvolit vam deystvovat v svoem tempe — no legche ot etogo ne budet! Kazhdyy sdelannyy vami vybor mozhet privesti vas libo glubzhe v podzemelya, libo k prezhdevremennoy konchine. Vynesete li vy sunduk s sokrovishchami ili vas samikh vynesut v sosnovom yashchike?

Osobennosti igry:
- Poznakomtes s chetyrmya NOVYMI GEROYaMI iz mira Aether, kazhdyy so svoimi unikalnymi navykami i zapominayushchimsya kharakterom.
- Igrayte v REZhIM ISTORII i otpravlyaytes v stimpank-gorod Julesvale, chtoby brosit vyzov obshirnym peshcheram pod nim.
- Issleduyte kazhdyy BIOM PODZEMELYa, pogruzhayas v Shakhty Julesvale, Ognennye Peshchery, Podzemnyy Oazis i Kristalnye Pustoshi, sobiraya po puti zapisi dlya Dnevnika.
- Broste vyzov PODZEMELYaM ISPYTANIY, esli vy ishchete slozhnost nastoyashchego roguelike, chtoby proverit svoi navyki v sluchayno sgenerirovannykh podzemelyakh.
После неожиданного поворота событий, быв:
Posle neozhidannogo povorota sobytiy, byvshiy geroy Kokott menyaet professiyu i nachinaet rabotaet v magazine tushyonogo myasa, boryas za pobedu v konkurse-festivale, gde vse uchastniki vystavlyayut napokaz svoe masterstvo prigotovleniya produktov. Odnako, ottachivaya svoi kulinarnye navyki vmeste so svoimi kollegami, Kokot obnaruzhivaet, chto ikh dragotsennoe varevo prevrashchaetsya v nevkusnuyu edu!
Sotrudnichayte s 3 druzyami ili s II, chtoby sobirat ingredienty v podzemelyakh i gotovit vkusnye shtuki. Est tolko odna problema... Vozmozhno, sredi vas skryvaetsya predatel, kotoryy razrushit vse vashi plany na prekrasnyy uzhin!
Igroki delyatsya na odnu iz dvukh grupp: Personal i Shpiony. Kazhdaya gruppa rabotaet nad vypolneniem opredelennykh usloviy dlya pobedy. Tsel personala — prigotovit vkusnoe tushenoe myasko, otpravlyayas v podzemelya v poiskakh ingredientov i amuletov, kotorye vmeste v opredelyonnom sochetanii mogut prinesti vysokie bally na konkurse. Zadacha shpiona — pomeshat usiliyam vsekh ostalnykh. Nekotorye ingredienty zapreshcheno dobavlyat v kastryulyu, inache blyudo prevratitsya v uzhasnuyu burdu. Konechnaya tsel shpiona — vsyo-taki pronesti v kastryulyu zapreshchennye ingredienty, ne vyzvav podozreniy so storony ostalnykh. On takzhe mozhet rasprostranyat lozhnye slukhi, chtoby vyzvat u personala podozreniya drug k drugu.
Earthfall™ это 4-игрок кооператив шутер,: Earthfall™ eto 4-igrok kooperativ shuter, gde vy obedinitsya s druzyami ili igrat v odinochku, chtoby spasti mir ot vtorzheniya inostrantsev. Poisk bolee 20 razlichnykh vidov oruzhiya, ili ispolzovat 3D printery dlya pechati sobstvennykh! Avtomaticheskie bashni, razvertyvaemye barrikady ili ustanovlennye orudiya pozvolyayut nastroit oboronu, chtoby napravit protivnika v zony ubiystv. Bitva svoy put cherez 16 epicheskikh urovney, kotorye rasskazyvayut prodolzhayushchuyusya istoriyu borby chelovechestva, chtoby vyzhit. Kazhdoe prokhozhdenie yavlyaetsya unikalnym opytom, s dinamicheskimi ikru i reaktivnymi vragami dlya maksimalnogo znacheniya vosproizvedeniya.
Cultist Simulator – игра о конце света и:
Cultist Simulator – igra o kontse sveta i zhazhde zapretnykh znaniy. Igrayte za iskatelya nechestivykh tayn v atmosfere 1920-kh godov, zabytykh bogov i smertelnykh sekretov. Ishchite znaniya, vlast, krasotu ili mest. Ili prosto posmotrite, kakogo tsveta etot mir, esli snyat s nego kozhu.

V etoy syuzhetnoy kartochnoy roguelike-igre to, chto vy nakhodite, menyaet vas navsegda. Kazhdyy mig, kazhdyy sdelannyy vybor ne prosto vedut istoriyu dalshe – oni ee izmenyayut.

Stante znatokom nezrimykh tayn. Vspominayte lishayushchie rassudka ritualy iz svoikh snov. Sozdavayte instrumenty i prizyvayte dukhov. Podchinyayte sebe nevinnykh. Stante vestnikom novogo veka.

• Uvlekatelnaya igra v dukhe roguelike – kazhdyy raz s novoy istoriey.
Cultist Simulator ne vedet vas za ruku. Eksperimentiruyte, umirayte i pobedite smert s sistemoy naslediya. So vremenem vy uznaete dostatochno, chtoby postavit igru na koleni.

• Zakhvatyvayushchiy syuzhet – sobirayte karty i rasskazhite svoyu istoriyu.
Ogromnyy syuzhet ot avtora Fallen London i Sunless Sea – ego khvatilo by na uvesistyy roman. Igra vedet vas dorogami zdorovykh ambitsiy, nezdorovykh appetitov i koshchunstva, i vasha istoriya mozhet zakonchitsya po-raznomu.

Salt and Sanctuary легко сочетает стреми:

Странствуйте по сюрреалистичным мирам, п: Stranstvuyte po syurrealistichnym miram, polnym chudnykh personazhey, bitv s bossami i tayn. Smozhete li vy vybratsya iz zakoulkov Korolevstva Beloy Bestii? Ona vas zhdyot. Otpravtes v glubinnoe stranstvie po svoemu podsoznaniyu, issleduya ego neznakomye oblasti. Prinimayte resheniya i prokladyvayte svoy sobstvennyy put skvoz tmu i svet. No pomnite: mnogoe tut ne to, chem kazhetsya.
Весёлое комедийное приключение, одержимо:
Vesyoloe komediynoe priklyuchenie, oderzhimoe lyagushkami s lyagushachimi bitvami, prichudlivymi kvestami i samoy materyu-lyagushkoy.

Space Crew: Legendary Edition — это стра:
Space Crew: Legendary Edition — eto strategicheskiy simulyator vyzhivaniya dlya odnogo igroka, kotoryy brosit vam naislozhneyshiy vyzov!
Vy — kapitan Obedinennykh sil oborony, upravlyayushchiy sobstvennym kosmicheskim korablem. Nanimayte chlenov ekipazha, osnashchayte korabl i otpravlyaytes borozdit galaktiku, chtoby zashchitit Zemlyu ot tainstvennykh inoplanetyan, izvestnykh kak fazmidy! Prigotovtes k ispytaniyam. Ne vse chleny ekipazha vyzhivut. Mnogie zadaniya budut smertelno opasnymi. Stante legendami galaktiki! 

«Androidy v zasade»
«Androidy v zasade» — novaya syuzhetnaya kampaniya, kotoraya poyavitsya v Space Crew. Armiya androidov, kotoraya prezhde podderzhivala Obedinennye sily oborony, obernulas protiv vas! Vam predstoit puteshestvie v novuyu zvezdnuyu sistemu s novymi vrazheskimi boytsami i korablyami, gde pobedonosnye kapitany smogut poluchit novoe snaryazhenie, uluchsheniya i dizayny. Uchtite, chto androidy i fazmidy igrayut po raznym pravilam, tak chto vam pridetsya pereosmyslit vse svoi taktiki.

Zadaniya s vysadkoy
V NOVYKh zadaniyakh s vysadkoy, kotorye vstrechayutsya v obeikh kampaniyakh Space Crew, vy smozhete pokinut svoy korabl i vmeste s eshche tremya chlenami ekipazha issledovat avanposty i krupnye sudna. Chtoby vyzhit, vybirayte podkhodyashchikh dlya vysadki chlenov ekipazha: vam pridetsya izuchat mestnost, razgadyvat golovolomki ili dazhe srazhatsya... inogda eshche i na vremya!

Legendarnye chleny ekipazha
Legendarnomu izdaniyu — legendarnyy ekipazh! Soberite komandu mechty, razyskivaya i spasaya legendarnykh chlenov ekipazha s potryasayushchimi sposobnostyami i uluchshennymi kharakteristikami. U vas ne poluchitsya prosto nanyat takikh chlenov ekipazha: nayti ikh mozhno tolko vo vremya zadaniy s vysadkoy i spasatelnykh operatsiy. Eshche odin sposob ikh poluchit — ispolzovat kody, kotorye razygryvayutsya v razlichnykh konkursakh soobshchestva.
Присоединяйтесь к Пикселю в его путешест:
Prisoedinyaytes k Pikselyu v ego puteshestvii cherez istoriyu videoigr, teleportiruyas iz odnoy znamenitoy konsoli ushedshego pokoleniya v druguyu. Emu pridetsya prygat, uvorachivatsya i khitrit, chtoby ne popastsya v lovushki, reshat golovolomki i raspravlyatsya s mnogochislennymi vragami, kotorye pritailis na kazhdom shagu.

No eto eshchyo ne vsyo! Super Life of Pixel vpervye predstavlyaet sistemu «osobykh kollektsiy»: vas zhdut eshchyo shest tshchatelno otrestavrirovannykh starykh konsoley, kotorye Pikselyu pridyotsya pokorit na puti k slave.

Nazhmite na knopku — vperedi nostalgiya i more veselya!
Сражайтесь с ордами зомби и монстров в р:
Srazhaytes s ordami zombi i monstrov v rolevoy igre s poluotkrytym mirom The Last Kids on Earth and the Staff of Doom, kotoraya rasskazyvaet novuyu istoriyu v postapokalipticheskom gorodke Ueykfild. Igraya za vyzhivshikh podrostkov Dzheka, Kvinta, Dzhun ili Dirka, vy issleduete kishashchie zombi ulitsy, chtoby pomeshat Malondre, mogushchestvennomu protivniku, poluchit Posokh sudby. Prizovite charodeya Bardla, voitelnitsu Skaelku i drugikh soyuznikov na pomoshch v bitve. Do 4 igrokov mogut vmeste prokhodit syuzhetnuyu liniyu v sovmestnom rezhime ili srazhatsya s polchishchami vragov v rezhime «Orda». Smozhete li vy pobedit gigantskikh bossov iz multseriala, v tom chisle sovershenno novogo vraga Malondre?
 
Vyberite svoego personazha
Igrayte za krutogo uragannogo Dzheka, uchenogo-samouchku Kvinta, klassnuyu i sarkastichnuyu Dzhun ili Dirka, parnya-silacha, kotoryy lyubit ukhazhivat za svoim sadom. Igrayte maksimum s tremya chlenami semi ili druzyami v sovmestnom rezhime i pochuvstvuyte sebya poslednimi podrostkami na Zemle!

Stante legendoy
Nachnite kak vyzhivshiy sorvanets i naydite podkhodyashchie chertezhi i resursy - teper vy gotovy masterit! Uluchshayte svoe oborudovanie, sposobnosti, domik na dereve i mashinu dlya begstva «Big Mama» do legendarnykh urovney moshchnosti.

Prizyvayte soyuznikov
Vozmozhno, vy poslednie podrostki na Zemle, no ne tolko vy boretes za vyzhivanie! Prizovite sobachego monstra Rovera, rogatogo ogra Biggana, voitelnitsu Skaelku i vladeyushchego mechom charodeya Bardla. Vy dazhe mozhete uluchshit ataki soyuznikov, radius urona, skorost i mnogoe drugoe.
ВСТРЕЧАЙТЕ АРКАДНЫЙ КОСМИЧЕСКИЙ ШУТЕР НО:
VSTREChAYTE ARKADNYY KOSMIChESKIY ShUTER NOVOGO POKOLENIYa
Redout: Space Assault posadit vas za shturval sverkhorbitalnogo istrebitelya-razvedchika, v 2395 god — epokhu kolonizatsii Marsa: Vas zhdet samoe dinamichnoe, epicheskoe i zakhvatyvayushchee arkadnoe kosmicheskoe srazhenie, kotoroe kogda-libo poyavlyalos dlya. Perekhitrite, pereigrayte, preodoleyte i prevzoydite svoikh sopernikov v molnienosnykh, polnykh adrenalina odnopolzovatelskikh kosmicheskikh bataliyakh.

Vy — Leon Barret, pilot-as sil bezopasnosti Poseydona. Segodnya, kogda chelovechestvo boretsya za svoe vyzhivanie na opalennoy zharoy, pustynnoy Zemle, i v promerzlykh, tesnykh koloniyakh Luny, my — korporatsiya «Poseydon», — pytaemsya otkryt lyudyam put k kolonizatsii Marsa. Vasha zadacha — podderzhivat zakon i poryadok. Unichtozhayte buntovshchikov i kosmicheskikh piratov, obespechte bezopasnost nashikh uchenykh i pomogite v ikh issledovaniyakh, zashchitite nashikh sotrudnikov ot mnogochislennykh ugroz.

Proletayte skvoz gigantskie asteroidnye rudniki, sbivayte bespilotniki i istrebiteli myatezhnikov, zakladyvayte bokovye virazhi, ukhodya ot ognya protivnika, obrushivayte na tsel sverkhmoshchnye raketnye zalpy! I konechno zhe gonyayte na golovokruzhitelnykh skorostyakh s drugimi pilotami i kosmicheskimi musorshchikami — prosto tak, veselya radi.

Kazhdoe vypolnennoe zadanie prinosit vam karty i zhetony, s pomoshchyu kotorykh mozhno uluchshit korpus, shchity, rakety i energeticheskoe oruzhie vashego korablya. Uluchshit nastolko, chto vy v odinochku smozhete raspravitsya s ogromnymi boevymi korablyami, predopredelyaya khod voyny. 

V zhernovakh mezhplanetnoy voyny, gde net khoroshikh i plokhikh, Leonu predstoit rasti po sluzhebnoy lestnitse, uznat, chto takoe «neobkhodimoe zlo», ponyat istinnuyu tsenu chesti i, v itoge, vo chto obkhodyatsya printsipy.

OSOBENNOSTI
Rezhim karery — osvoyte vse navyki, kotorye potrebuyutsya vam dlya vyzhivaniya i pobed vo vselennoy Redout. 43 zadaniy stanut proverkoy vashikh sposobnostey i rasskazhut istoriyu, kotoruyu vam eshche ne dovodilos slyshat.
Mnozhestvo dinamichnykh mirov — neobychnye mesta, grandioznye yavleniya i epicheskie bitvy za kazhdyy rubezh.

Ваш тюремный космический корабль потерпе:
Vash tyuremnyy kosmicheskiy korabl poterpel krushenie v odnom iz samykh opasnykh iz kogda-libo sushchestvovavshikh mirov. Posmotrite vokrug: mertsaet kristalno chistaya voda, teni dvigayutsya i tantsuyut, a na gorizonte vidneetsya potryasayushchaya inoplanetnaya arkhitektura!
Deystvie igry proiskhodit v budushchem okolo 2215 goda. Korabl poterpel krushenie v gorakh na neissledovannoy lyudmi planete Na Pali, v khode kotorogo pogibli bolshinstvo lyudey, byvshikh na bortu. Kogda Vorteks Raykers, popavshiy v anomalno silnoe gravitatsionnoe pole Na Pali, terpit krushenie, skaardzhi pronikayut v razbityy korabl, ubivaya vsekh naydennykh vyzhivshikh..
Sega Saturn (яп. セガサターン Сэга Сата:н) — и:
Sega Saturn (yap. セガサターン Sega Sata:n) — igrovaya pristavka s razryadnostyu 32 bita. Ona byla vypushchena 22 noyabrya 1994 goda v Yaponii.
Sega i yaponskaya kompaniya Hitachi sozdali sovmestnoe predpriyatie po razrabotke novogo protsessora dlya Saturn, rezultatom chego stalo sozdanie protsessora SuperH RISC Engine (ili SH-2) v kontse togo zhe goda. Apparatnaya konfiguratsiya Saturn osnovyvalas na ispolzovanii dvukh protsessorov SH-2. Dva graficheskikh protsessora. Pervyy, VDP1 otvechal za generatsiyu spraytov, poligonov, nanesenie tekstur i tonirovanie po metodu Guro. Vtoroy, VDP2 — za fon, prozrachnost, vrashchenie igrovogo polya i prokrutku, ikh tsvetovaya pamyat podderzhivala 15-bitnyy ili 24-bitnyy tsvet (ot 32768 do 16700000 tsvetov), vidimoe razreshenie do 704×480 pikseley. Dvukhskorostnoy CD-ROM-privod pristavki obsluzhivalsya sobstvennym protsessorom Hitachi SH-1, rabotavshim na chastote 20 MGts, zvuk obespechivalsya kontrollerom Motorola 68EC000 i protsessorom Yamaha FH1.
No.. Saturn prosto ne povezlo. Ona byla khoroshey konsolyu, vozmozhno, operedivshey svoyo vremya, mir okazalsya k ney ne gotov; v tom chisle ne byli gotovy sozdateli igr vmeste s samoy Sega. Sistema zapomnilas khoroshimi igrami, slozhnym apparatnym dizaynom, no v to zhe vremya ogranichennoy podderzhkoy so storony storonnikh razrabotchikov. Pristavka ne dostigla uspekha v SShA — posle debyuta Nintendo 64 v 1996 godu, Saturn bystro poteryala rynok, prodavshis vsego v kolichestve 9,26 millionov ekzemplyarov, i eyo proizvodstvo bylo polnostyu prekrashcheno v 1998 godu.V razdache nakhoditsya Yaba Sanshiro, standalone-derivativ Lakka Linux-versii emulyatora Sega Saturn na baze yadra uoYabause ot miyaxDev plyus 23 sovmestimykh igry. Etot emulyator zagruzhaetsya kak otdelnaya operatsionnaya sistema.
Emulyator Zebra Engine (inzhekt ch/z Guardian Force) tut; zdes nakhoditsya emulyator Dreamcast (Flycast na Retroarch).
Teacup — это короткая и добрая нарративн:
Teacup — eto korotkaya i dobraya narrativno-priklyuchencheskaya igra, v tsentre vnimaniya kotoroy issledovaniya i nelineynyy progress.

Vy igraete za Tikap — «Chashechku» — zastenchivuyu, zamknutuyu moloduyu lyagushku, kotoraya lyubit pit chay i chitat, v chest nee i nazvana igra. Za den do chaepitiya, kotoroe Tikap sobralas provodit u sebya doma, ona ponimaet, chto u nee sovershenno zakonchilsya chay. Tak chto ey predstoit otpravitsya v glub ee rodnogo lesa, chtoby nayti podkhodyashchie travy dlya popolneniya chaynykh zapasov.

V etom priklyuchenii vy vstretites s ocharovatelnymi lesnymi obitatelyami. Nekotorye razgovorchivy, nekotorye svarlivy, no vse oni s radostyu vyslushayut vashu istoriyu.

Issleduyte etot velikolepnyy akvarelnyy mir, napolnennyy druzhelyubnymi zhivotnymi, uvlekatelnymi mini-igrami, golovolomkami i prekrasnoy umirotvoryayushchey dikoy prirodoy.

Black Skylands — это первая игра в стиле:
Black Skylands — eto pervaya igra v stile stimpank, sochetayushchaya v sebe elementy otkrytogo mira, «pesochnitsy», vertikalnogo shutera i kvesta.
 
Vy igraete za Evu, khrabruyu i gorduyu devushku, kotoraya khochet otomstit bezzhalostnym ubiytsam, unichtozhivshim vse, chto bylo ey dorogo. The Blue Colony was a place of opportuni:
The Blue Colony was a place of opportunity, a capitalist metropolis where hard work, determination and a keen eye for business could punch you a one-way ticket to the top of the illustrious Sky City. . . That was until the Virus hit. Now the elite are hunted by flesh-eating monster that were once their former workers.

You play as Nicole, a mother desperate to get her daughter out of the terrifying slum at the bottom of the bottom in the Blue Colony. Your task is not an easy one, the slum has been hit hardest by the outbreak and zombies are not the only thing stalking you from the shadows.

Only the strongest will survive, the Red Colony has already been massacred by the deadly zombie horde but there is still a chance in Sky City! Help Nicole rescue her daughter and face the dark secrets of her past as you sneak, fight and solve puzzles in this survival horror indie game.

- Top notch Japanese voice acting.
- Anime character design.
- Twisted, unfair and dark story.
- Blood, gore and horror!
- 2DTCT (2D Tear-Clothes-Technology).
- Graphic Novel style narrative with classic survival horror gameplay.
- Can be played both as a sequel or a prequel to Red Colony.
Откройте новое приключение в мире, насел:
Otkroyte novoe priklyuchenie v mire, naselennom robotami. Nasha planeta zastryala v stile “retro”, poskolku vse razumnye sushchestva tainstvennym obrazom ischezli ranshe, chem sumeli izobresti televizory s ploskim ekranom. Zato oni sumeli izobresti sotni vidov robotov, kotorye stali vypolnyat za lyudey vsyu rabotu.

No teper planeta — eto bezzhiznennaya pustynya, i lish odin gorod do sikh por soprotivlyaetsya techeniyu vremeni. Ukrytyy steklyannym kupolom, on funktsioniruet lish blagodarya staraniyam naselyayushchikh ego robotov. Otpravlennyy na svalku Robot otkazyvaetsya prinimat svoyu sudbu i pytaetsya vernutsya obratno. Odnako teper on - vrag dlya Goroda. U Robota ne bylo by shansov protiv svoikh byvshikh tovarishchey, esli by ne unikalnaya vozmozhnost vzlamyvat drugie mekhanizmy i perekhvatyvat upravlenie. Kakoe by prepyatstvie ni vstavalo by u nego na puti, poblizosti vsegda est mashiny s nuzhnymi instrumentami v zapase.

Tak chto delo za malym: preodolet vse prepyatstviya i nayti sledy chelovechestva, kotoromu prodolzhayut sluzhit obitateli Goroda. Ostalsya li khot kto-nibud v zhivykh?


Klyuchevye osobennosti:

Puteshestvie v odinochku
Lyudi ischezli davnym-davno, brosiv svoikh vernykh pomoshchnikov. Nesmotrya na vse staraniya robotov, Gorod razvalivaetsya. Ostalsya li khot kto-to, kto poymet nashego otvazhnogo Robota i pomozhet ispravit situatsiyu?

Vragi — vashi instrumenty
Malenkiy Robot mozhet reshit lyubuyu problemu s pomoshchyu umeniya perekhvatyvat kontrol lyuboy mashiny. Pust derutsya drug s drugom, pomogayut vam v puteshestvii, ili reshayut zagadki. Obitateli Goroda rady predlozhit vam svoi uslugi, pust i protiv svoey voli

Stilnoe budushchee
Vizualnyy stil igry osnovan na illyustratsiyakh klassicheskikh knig pro budushchee. Raz uzh eto posledniy gorod planety, nikto ne budet vozrazhat, esli on tselikom pokryt zolotom, pravda?

Ne tolko Gorod
Ot podzemnykh fabrik po proizvodstvu gigantskikh voennykh mashin do zolotykh ulits Goroda, vashe puteshestvie provedet vas cherez tselyy region, kazhdyy rayon kotorogo otlichaetsya ot ostalnykh
Корабль робота Z3-L1 совершил аварийную:
Korabl robota Z3-L1 sovershil avariynuyu posadku na negostepriimnoy planete Dimidium, napolnennoy inoplanetnymi landshaftami i vrazhdebnoy sredoy. Chtoby sbezhat i vernutsya domoy, Z3-L1 (/zeli/) dolzhen sobrat uliki, nayti sily i obnaruzhit artefakty, neobkhodimye dlya remonta kosmicheskogo korablya. Brodite po planete v etoy issledovatelskoy igre v stile Metroidvanii, gde okruzhayushchaya sreda - vash vrag!

Igra Two Parsecs From Earth, kak sverkhrazumnyy kosmicheskiy robot, udivitelno interaktivna i adaptivna dlya vas! Vyberite 3 sposobnosti vo vremya issledovaniya i provedite svoe priklyuchenie 8 razlichnymi sposobami v sootvetstvii s sobstvennymi resheniyami v soprovozhdenii muzyki, kotoraya adaptiruetsya k vyboru vashikh sposobnostey. Kak tolko priklyuchenie zakonchitsya, u vas budet vozmozhnost povtorit ego snova v unikalnom rezhime «Novaya igra+», integrirovannom v syuzhet!

Kharakteristiki:
* Platformennaya 2D-igra v stile Metroidvanii
* Vybirayte sredi 3x2 sposobnostey, no vash vybor otklyuchit druguyu sposobnost do kontsa igry.
* 8 sposobov zavershit igru v zavisimosti ot vybora sposobnostey.
* Muzyka, kotoraya adaptiruetsya k vyboru vashikh sposobnostey.
* Rezhime «Novaya igra+» dlya igry s drugimi sposobnostyami i dostizheniya 100%-go rezultata.

Originalnaya Jazz Jackrabbit 2 predstavlyaet soboy kompyuternuyu igru v zhanre platformer, proizvodstva Epic MegaGames i Orange Games, yavlyayushcheysya prodolzheniem seriala Jazz Jackrabbit o priklyucheniyakh krolika Dzhazza (Jazz). Капитан Натаниэль Джозеф Коготь по причи:
Kapitan Nataniel Dzhozef Kogot po prichine zagovora okazyvaetsya zatochyonnym v tyurme LaRoka. V kamere on nakhodit zapisku i chast karty, ostavlennye nekim Edvardom Tobinom, v kotorykh rasskazyvaetsya ob Amulete Zhizni — misticheskom artefakte, daruyushchem bessmertie. Vybravshis iz kamery, Kogot ishchet i sobiraet vse kamni, neobkhodimye dlya vossozdaniya amuleta, i zaodno mstit vsem svoim obidchikam!
Captain Claw («Kapitan Kogot» / «Kapitan Klyk») — 2D ekshn-platformer, sozdannyy kompaniey Monolith Production (Blood, No One Lives Forever, Tron 2.0, F.E.A.R, Middle-earth: Shadow of Mordor) v 1997 godu dlya PK s Microsoft Windows. V igre syuzhetnye urovni, kazhdye 2 iz nikh imeyut sobstvennyy anturazh, kotrye zakanchivayutsya osobennym bossom.
«Kapitan Kogot» poluchil khoroshie otzyvy: Allgame dal Claw vesma polozhitelnyy otzyv, sravniv ee uvlekatelnost s franshizami Super Mario i Crash Bandicoot. GameSpot postavil Claw otsenku 7,7, zayaviv, chto eto — «luchshiy sovremennyy sayd-skroller, dostupnyy dlya PK». Kolin Uilyamson iz PC Gamer pokhvalil grafiku, Kreyg Madzhaski iz WorldVillage takzhe khvalil igru i postavil ey otsenku 4/5. Deniel Bernshteyn iz Gamasutra nazval ispolzovanie zvuka v igre primerom otlichnogo immersivnogo okruzheniya. V retrospektivnoy retsenzii Entoni Berch iz Destructoid polozhitelno napisal, chto Claw «dostupna i vesela».
Nesmotrya na svoy uspekh, igra izvestna svoey vysokoy slozhnostyu. Ona schitaetsya kultovoy klassikoy za svoy unikalnyy stil, chuvstvo priklyucheniya i krasivuyu grafiku.

Step inside a heart-warming tale of love:
Step inside a heart-warming tale of love, family, and the ties that bind us all together. With gorgeous visuals and a haunting soundtrack, the classic romantic adventure game comes to the Nintendo Switch™!

Восстань, охотник на демонов. Время приш:
Vosstan, okhotnik na demonov. Vremya prishlo! Vse te gody, chto provel ty, istreblyaya demonov v mire smertnykh, ne ochistili tvoyu dushu. Grekhi tvoi vystavleny na obozrenie, ty priznan vinovnym i prigovoren k vechnym mukam. Preispodnyaya zhdet tebya!

Igra Demon Pit, vdokhnovlennaya dinamichnymi FPS 1990-kh godov, — eto napryazhennyy arkadnyy shuter na arene. Vooruzhivshis arsenalom dalnoboynogo oruzhiya i kryukom dlya dush, vy dolzhny otbivat ataki beskonechnykh voln demonov v postoyanno menyayushchemsya okruzhenii. Skolko vy proderzhites, prezhde chem oni razorvut vashu plot i pozhrut dushu?
Srazhaytes s 10 raznovidnostyami adskikh otrodiy.
Dayte otpor orde demonov, ispolzuya 7 vidov oruzhiya.
Ispolzuyte kryuk dushi, chtoby bystro peremeshchatsya po arene i uklonyatsya ot legiona vragov.
Peredvigaytes, chtoby ne stat zhertvoy menyayushchegosya okruzheniya i ego opasnostey.
Postoyanno ubivayte, chtoby podderzhivat mnozhitel i pretendovat na bessmertie v tablitse liderov.
Физический платформер — без кнопки прыжк:
Fizicheskiy platformer — bez knopki pryzhka! Khodite, prygayte, karabkaytes i parkurte, upravlyaya kazhdoy nogoy zaputavshegosya robota-malysha. Prevratites iz malysha v kuvyrkayushchegosya akrobata v rezhime istorii, ili podelites mnogonogim robotom s druzyami, chtoby dobavit v svoyu zhizn khaosa!..
Pomogi veselym oranzhevym astronavtam provesti krutye nauchnye eksperimenty na raznykh planetakh, puteshestvuya po kosmosu. Pytaytes v odinochku — ili obedinite usiliya vmeste s dvumya druzyami!
В мире, где органическая жизнь давно исч:
V mire, gde organicheskaya zhizn davno ischezla, ReSetna probuzhdaetsya iskusstvennym intellektom APEX, chtoby protivostoyat rastushchey ugroze tainstvennogo Signala. Etot Signal seet khaos, narushaet balans mira i svodit robotov s uma. Boevoy robot s peredovymi tekhnologiyami, ReSetna, dolzhna raskryt pravdu ob etom yavlenii i ustranit ego vliyanie. Vmeste so svoim vernym dron-kompanonom IXA, ReSetna puteshestvuet po razrushennomu miru, raskryvaya tayny Proekta Voznesenie, srazhayas s moshchnymi vragami i raskryvaya tyomnye stranitsy proshlogo.
— Boevoy ekshen-platformer: srazites s robotami Optigenami, vzlomannymi Signalom, ispytayte sebya v epicheskikh bitvakh s bossami i issleduyte 7 slozhnykh zon! Nastroyte stil igry s uluchsheniyami v stile Tetrisa i sozdayte moshchnye sposobnosti! Cila v vashikh rukakh blagodarya sisteme uluchsheniy s pomoshchyu chipov – modulnoy setke, vdokhnovlyonnoy Tetrisom. Ona pozvolyaet vam uluchshat navyki, oruzhie i umeniya vyzhivaniya. Vstavlyayte chipy, chtoby usilit boevye sposobnosti, mobilnost, zashchitu i navyki vzloma, adaptiruya stil igry k lyubomu vyzovu.
Арракис («Дюна») — планета с суровым пус:
Arrakis («Dyuna») — planeta s surovym pustynnym klimatom, vazhnaya lish odnim: v peskakh vstrechayutsya mestorozhdeniya tsennogo veshchestva — Pryanosti, ili spáysa (angl. spice). Igrok beryot na sebya rol komandira armiy odnoy iz tryokh galakticheskikh dinastiy-«domov»: Atréydesov, Órdosov ili Kharkónnenov. Dinastii Atreydesov i Kharkonnenov vzyaty iz romana; dom Ordosov ni v odnom iz romanov tsikla «Khroniki Dyuny» ne figuriroval, no byl opisan v «Entsiklopedii Dyuny».
Po syuzhetu, imperator Frederik IV iz doma Korrino otchayanno nuzhdaetsya v sbore Pryanosti, chtoby vyplatit ves svoy dolg, voznikshiy v rezultate mezhdousobnykh voyn s chlenami semi. Zadacha igroka — stat polnopravnym khozyainom Dyuny; dlya etogo nuzhno zavoevat tselevuyu territoriyu, podelyonnuyu na devyat sektorov.
Погрузитесь в мрачное приключение мальчи:
Pogruzites v mrachnoe priklyuchenie malchika s protezom na litse i tyazhelym proshlym. V pervom epizode pod nazvaniem "Strannye sosedi" Salli-kromsali i ego otets pereezzhayut v novuyu kvartiru, vstrechayut samykh raznykh zhiltsov zdaniya i ponimayut, chto chut ne stali sviditelyami prestupleniya. Oni i ne podozrevali, chto nevzgody tolko nachinayutsya...

Rasputayte zloveshchuyu taynu istorii Salli, chtoby otyskat pravdu, skrytuyu zavesoy tmy.

Osobennosti
* Intriguyushchiy syuzhet nadolgo zaderzhitsya v vashey pamyati
* Obshchaytes s mertvymi blagodarya portativnoy igrovoy pristavke Gear Boy
* Sdelano odnim-edinstvennym razrabotchikom, vklyuchaya grafiku, dizayn i muzyku
* Igra rodilas blagodarya multfilmam  1990-kh godov i nochnym koshmaram razrabotchika
* Ekstsentrichnye personazhi, poni, tusnya pod metall i eshche mnogo interesnogo
Боги покинули Мидгард. Некогда процветаю:
Bogi pokinuli Midgard. Nekogda protsvetayushchaya zemlya, perepolnennaya mificheskimi zveryami i sushchestvami, nachala gnit iznutri, proklyataya nevedomymi silami. Izbrannye Odinom khraniteli mira ushli. Bez nikh, edinstvennykh zashchitnikov, Stareyshee derevo ispolzuyut vo zlo i portyat. Teper ostatki nadezhdy vozlagayutsya na Estru, doch poslednego velikogo lidera chelovechestva.

Puteshestvie Estry po Midgardu, s uporom na povestvovanie, napolneno skandinavskimi mifami, zagadochnymi povorotami i posledovatelnymi resheniyami. Igroki budut obshchatsya s razlichnymi personazhami i delitsya otkrytiyami Estry, ved ona postepenno uznaet bolshe o proshlom svoey semi i o nadvigayushcheysya tme, rasprostranyayushcheysya po miru.

Interaktivnaya istoriya
Po doroge Estru zhdut mnogo trudnykh resheniy i nenadezhnykh personazhey, kotorye mogut sbit ee s puti. Ee istoriya zavisit ot umeniya igroka otlichat fakty ot vymysla i pravilnoe ot nepravilnogo. Izbegayte srazheniy, pomogayte tovarishcham, spasayte svoikh lyudey, no pomnite, chto Estra budet zhit so vsemi prinyatymi vami resheniyami.

Golovolomki
Po puti igrokam predstoit reshat postepenno uslozhnyayushchiesya golovolomki, kotorye raskroyut interesnye sekrety, fantasticheskie sposobnosti i taynye prokhody. Mozhno postepenno nabivat shishki, no terpenie v etom dele prosto neobkhodimo. Ne kazhdaya golovolomka dopuskaet oshibki, i vy vpolne mozhete uspeshno provalit razgadku. Otvety, kotorye vy ishchete, mogut byt poteryany, esli vy primete nepravilnoe reshenie.

Boy
Mozhno oboytis i bez nasiliya, no esli drugogo vybora ne ostalos, to boy ATONE — eto izyashchnyy tanets mecha i topora. Boy osnovan na zhanre ritm-igr i mekhanike takikh izvestnykh predstaviteley etogo zhanra, kak Guitar Hero i Dance Dance Revolution. Poetomu muzyka yavlyaetsya vazhnym komponentom igry, i kazhdyy boy imeet svoyu sobstvennuyu pesnyu.

Muzyka
Muzyka i zvukovoy dizayn ATONE napisany avstraliyskim muzykantom Luminist (nastoyashchee imya: Dzheyms Shuar), kotoryy tyazheluyu sintezatornuyu partituru sochetaet s iskazhennymi tsifrovym sposobom zvukami instrumentov opredelennogo perioda.
Rose is half human and half dragon. One:
Rose is half human and half dragon. One day, she wanders into a world called "Tree of time" with her nanny, Fairy.

It is said that there’s a powerful treasure deep under the dungeon. In order to return back to their village through the power of the treasure, they decided to face the challenges of the dungeon!

If Rose is defeated during the adventure, she will lose all items and her level will be reset. And because the dungeon transforms every time you challenge it, the quests will never be the same. Your courage and growth will be the key to clear the dungeon!

Features:

One choice, one victory: This game is turn-based. Both Rose and the enemies take turns moving. Players can think about what to do on their next turn. Wisdom and courage will bring you “small victories”, and these will eventually bring you “huge victories”. 

The "Fang" system: Rose can wear Fangs of monsters and gain their abilities. There are more than 200 kinds of monsters. You can seek the strongest combination and arrange your Fangs however you like.

The "Brave" system: Rose powers up when there are no obstacles around you within 8 squares. This overturns the “battling within the passage” theory of the Roguelike game.

This game also has the Ranking function, Item Warehouse, Monster's Database, Achievement, Mini Puzzle, and Dungeon for Advanced Players.
Мир стоит на краю катастрофы. Знаменитос:
Mir stoit na krayu katastrofy. Znamenitosti pokazali svoe istinnoe litso i zloveshchie namereniya: oni promyvayut lyudyam mozgi, chtoby zakhvatit vlast na planete. Tolko odin chelovek mozhet nas spasti — vysochennyy kitayskiy sirota Shak Fey Khun. Shak proshel obuchenie u mastera kun-fu i teper dolzhen otpravitsya v samye opasnye ugolki planety, chtoby srazhatsya so zlom. Takova ego sudba, ved on — izbrannyy.

Shakil O’Nil vozvrashchaetsya, chtoby «svesti schety za 94-y god» v sovershenno novoy versii legendarnoy Shaq Fu! V etom nostalgicheskom dvukhmernom boevike igroki vozmut pod svoe upravlenie nepobedimogo Bolshogo Dizelya i raskidayut ego rukami tselye armii prisluzhnikov Gollivuda i Ada. 

•	Seyte khaos i vershite pravosudie, posetite trushchoby Kitaya, plantatsii Yuzhnoy Ameriki, ulitsy Los-Andzhelesa, ostrov Fidzhi i dazhe samoe peklo ada.
•	Slushayte golos nepodrazhaemogo Shakila O’Nila.
•	Srazhaytes s mogushchestvennymi inozemnymi znamenitostyami. Bitvy s bossami ne ostavyat vas ravnodushnymi!

Here Be Dragons is a satirical turn-base:
Here Be Dragons is a satirical turn-based strategy game featuring a unique "living map" graphics, where you lead a group of crazed captains.

Christopher Columbus discovered the Americas in 1492. In 10 weeks. With 100 men. With 3 ships. This is a LIE!

Firstly, someone had to defeat Kraken and tritons. Someone had to vanquish the Leviathan. Someone had to banish all the ghost ships. The information about these deeds is missing from the archives, and you can’t find it in any great statesmen’s memoir. The knowledge of the “Avant Armada” was completely erased by some bloody officials.

Features:
