Metal Gear Solid — серия видеоигр в жанр:
Metal Gear Solid — seriya videoigr v zhanre stels-ekshen. Prodyuser, rezhissyor, geymdizayner i stsenarist igry, sozdatel serii — Khideo Kodzima.
Metal Gear (yap. メタルギア Metaru Gia) — videoigra, razrabotannaya dizaynerom Khideo Kodzimoy i izdannaya studiey Konami v 1987 godu dlya domashnikh kompyuterov standarta MSX2, polozhila nachalo izvestnoy igrovoy serii Metal Gear, pozzhe byla portirovana na razlichnye igrovye platformy, v chastnosti na NES. Iznachalno razrabotchiki opredelyali zhanr igry kak takticheskaya shpionskaya igra (angl. Tactical Espionage Game). V nastoyashchee vremya Metal Gear schitaetsya rodonachalnitsey zhanra stels-ekshen, kotoryy trebuet ot igroka vypolneniya razlichnykh missiy, kak pravilo, na territorii protivnika, izbegaya pri etom otkrytogo stolknoveniya s vrazheskimi silami i privlecheniya k sebe vnimaniya.
Vo vtoroy igre, Metal Gear 2: Solid Snake po syuzhetu Solid Sneyk dolzhen proniknut v Zanzibarlend, strogo okhranyaemuyu territoriyu v Tsentralnoy Azii, spasti pokhishchennogo uchyonogo i unichtozhit novoe superoruzhie Metal Gear D. V igre znachitelno usovershenstvovana sistema skrytnosti, vvedyon slozhnyy syuzhet, zatragivayushchiy takie temy kak sushchnost voyny i rasprostranenie yadernogo oruzhiya. Metal Gear 2 byla priznana odnoy iz luchshikh 8-bitnykh igr v istorii videoigr.
Tretsya igra, Metal Gear Solid yavlyaetsya pryamym prodolzheniem Metal Gear 2: Solid Snake i rasskazyvaet ob antiterroristicheskoy operatsii na baze po utilizatsii yadernogo oruzhiya na vymyshlennom ostrove Lisego arkhipelaga Shedou-Mozes, zakhvachennom gruppoy soldat spetsialnogo naznacheniya iz podrazdeleniya FOXHOUND. Glavnyy geroy igry, Solid Sneyk, dolzhen proniknut na bazu, spasti zalozhnikov i ne dat terroristam nanesti yadernyy udar.
V Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty, osnovnye sobytiya razvorachivayutsya na ochistitelnom zavode Big Shell, kotoryy zakhvatila gruppa terroristov, imenuyushchikh sebya «Synovyami svobody». Oni trebuyut ogromnyy vykup v obmen na zhizn prezidenta Soedinyonnykh Shtatov, ugrozhaya v sluchae neispolneniya trebovaniy unichtozhit zavod, chto privedyot k ekologicheskoy katastrofe.
Mestom deystviya Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater stanet SSSR vremyon Kholodnoy voyny. Glavnyy geroy — Neyked Sneyk, operativnik otryada FOX, kotoromu bylo porucheno osvobodit sovetskogo uchyonogo i unichtozhit eksperimentalnoe superoruzhie. V otlichie ot predydushchikh igr, gde osnovnym mestom deystviya yavlyalis preimushchestvenno zdaniya i sooruzheniya, deystvie Snake Eater razvorachivaetsya v lesu. Khotya setting i izmenilsya, klyuchevym elementom igry po-prezhnemu yavlyaetsya nezametnoe proniknovenie na vrazheskuyu territoriyu, takzhe v igre snova vstrechaetsya obrashchenie geroev neposredstvenno k igroku. Povestvovanie istorii igry Snake Eater vedyotsya cherez vnutriigrovye stseny i radioperegovory.

Знаменитый кроссовер action-RPG двух сам:
Znamenityy krossover action-RPG dvukh samykh znamenitykh seriy kompanii Falcom. Mesto deystviya — prekrasnyy mir Zanado. Vpervye byla vypushchena v Yaponii dlya PlayStation Portable v 2010 godu.

Na vybor dostupno bolee 20 boytsov i 26 aren, vklyuchaya znakomye lokatsii vrode Ice Ridge of Noltia, Haken Gate i Falcom Dev Room. Pomimo klassicheskogo PvP, igra predlozhit syuzhetnyy rezhim, arkadu, svobodnye boi i druzheskie matchi.

В Neon Drive есть всё: от прекрасных пей:
V Neon Drive est vsyo: ot prekrasnykh peyzazhey gorodskikh dzhungley i okeanskikh dorog, do vzryvov vrazheskikh kosmicheskikh korabley. Igra byla vdokhnovlena arkadami 80-kh godov, tolko vsyo eto zavyornuto v upakovku iz futuristicheskogo okruzheniya siyayushchey kiber-setki, i  gladkoy kak shyolk neonovoy grafiki.Neon Drive prepodnosit vam 8 potryasayushchikh urovney, gotovykh podarit vam mnogie chasy naslazhdeniya. Kazhdyy uroven polon mnogochislennykh povorotov i neozhidannykh izmeneniy perspektivy, kotorye ni na sekundu ne dadut vam rasslabitsya (i zaglushit motor).

Neon Drive podvergnet ispytaniyu vashi bezumnye umeniya uklonyatsya, bezzhalostno uskoryaya vashu skorost reaktsii i rasshiryaya predely vashey kratkosrochnoy pamyati, neobkhodimoy dlya preodoleniya vsekh prepyatstviy i tupikov. Seryozno, eta igra ne znaet poshchady: kak tolko vy reshite, chto, nakonets, ponyali chto k chemu, ona tut zhe ubedit vas v obratnom.

Na kazhdom iz urovney vas zhdyot odin iz unikalnykh retro saundtrekov, idealno sinkhronizirovannykh s prepyatstviyami i vragami. Eto pozvolit vam prosto sledovat muzyke, otklyuchitsya i rastvoritsya v neonovom ritme. Smotrite, kak v tantse tsveta i form odin peyzazh plavno peretekaet v drugoy, i pozvolte svoemu vnutrennemu voditelyu vzyat upravlenie na sebya. Vy smozhete.

- Zakhvatyvayushche prekrasnaya, gladkaya kak shyolk grafika

«Возвращение на Остров Обезьян» — неожид:
«Vozvrashchenie na Ostrov Obezyan» — neozhidannoe i neveroyatnoe vozvrashchenie sozdatelya serii Rona Gilberta, prodolzhayushchee istoriyu legendarnykh priklyuchencheskikh igr «Tayna Ostrova Obezyan» i «Ostrov Obezyan: Mest LeChaka», razrabotannykh v sotrudnichestve s Lucasfilm Games.
 
S posledney bitvy Gaybrasha Tripvuda i ego zaklyatogo vraga, zombi-pirata LeChaka, proshlo mnogo let. Lyubov vsey ego zhizni, Eleyn Marli, otoshla ot gubernatorskikh del, a sam Gaybrash tak i ne raskryl Taynu Ostrova Obezyan i prosto plyvyot po techeniyu. Novye molodye piratskie lidery vo glave s kapitanom Medison otstranili ot vlasti staruyu gvardiyu, dela na Ostrove Rezni idut vsyo khuzhe, a znamenityy biznesmen Sten popal v tyurmu za «reklamnye prestupleniya».
 
Shutlivo obshchaytes so starymi druzyami i novymi personazhami, no ne zabyvayte, chto znakomye ostrova pod novym rukovodstvom stali namnogo opasnee. Otpravlyaytes v otkrytoe more i issleduyte novye neizvedannye mesta. Na puti k slave Gaybrash stolknyotsya s kovarnymi zagovorami vragov, khitrymi golovolomkami i popadyot v massu zabavnykh situatsiy.

Vozvrashchenie bezbashennogo kvesta
Klassicheskiy geympley pereinachen na sovremennyy lad. Besstrashnym piratam predstoit reshat golovolomki i issledovat ostrova s pomoshchyu gramotno pererabotannykh i uluchshennykh elementov upravleniya originalnoy igry. Kontekstno-zavisimye vzaimodeystviya, reaktivnye vetki dialogov i uproshchyonnaya sistema inventarya znachitelno oblegchat piratskuyu dolyu.

Priklyucheniya na arkhipelage zovut
Progulivaytes po druzhelyubnym (v osnovnom) prostoram Ostrova Rezni, davno znakomogo mesta, gde pravit novaya vlast, prizhavshaya kak starykh druzey, tak i novykh personazhey. Issleduyte neizvedannye zemli, naprimer, stol metko nazvannyy Ostrov Uzhasa, a takzhe probirayushchie do kostey poseleniya Brr-Mud v poiskakh soyuznikov i vragov.

Legendarnaya komanda snova u shturvala
Novaya chast serii «Ostrov Obezyan» uvidela svet blagodarya vozvrashcheniyu eyo znamenitogo sozdatelya Rona Gilberta, k kotoromu prisoedinilis soavtor igry Deyv Grossman, art-direktor Reks Kroul (Knights & Bikes, Tearaway) i kompozitory Piter MakKonnell, Maykl Lend i Klint Bayakyan (Monkey Island, Monkey Island 2: LeChuck’s Revenge).
Дайте волю силам драконьего морфинга в э: Dayte volyu silam drakonego morfinga v etom zakhvatyvayushchem sayd-skrollingovom faytinge! Pogruzites v tainstvennyy mir Uny, gde probuzhdaetsya drevnyaya sila i tsarit khaos. Igraya za odnogo iz vosmi chempionov, oderzhimykh drakonami, srazhaytes v kishashchikh monstrami zemlyakh, osvaivayte boevye stili i prevrashchaytes v ustrashayushchikh drakonov, chtoby vosstanovit ravnovesie. Letaete li vy v odinochku ili srazhaetes s druzyami, prigotovtes k yarostnoy skhvatke!
LUMINES REMASTERED привносит минимализм:
LUMINES REMASTERED privnosit minimalizm v zhanr golovolomok: na fone sliyaniya sveta i zvuka razvorachivaetsya zakhvatyvayushchee deystvie s dvukhtsvetnymi padayushchimi blokami v HD. Zalipayte pod drayvovye elektronnye kompozitsii, strategicheski razmeshchaya bloki, v to vremya kak polosa udarov v minutu ochishchaet kombinatsii posle kazhdogo takta.

Oshchutite zvuk: igrayte na bolee chem 40 skinakh s elektronnymi kompozitsiyami ot rasslablyayushchikh do energichnykh. Meshayte skiny (kak muzykalnyy pleylist), otkryvaya dopolnitelnye v novom rezhime peremeshivaniya.

Oshchutite vyzov: chem bystree temp, tem menshe vremeni na kombinatsii, no pri bolee medlennykh pesnyakh mozhno ne uspet ochistit vse stolbtsy. Vy prosto ne smozhete otorvatsya.

Oshchutite vesele: primite vyzov i poprobuyte razblokirovat vse skiny i avatary, igrayte protiv druzey v lokalnom rezhime dlya 2 igrokov ili podnimaytes na vershinu reytinga v spiskakh liderov onlayn.

Oshchutite vibratsiyu: Vklyuchite «trans-vibratsiyu» i sinkhroniziruyte do chetyrekh kontrollerov Joy-Con™, chtoby pochuvstvovat basy vsem telom.
Богачи сбежали на Марс, но иногда наведы:
Bogachi sbezhali na Mars, no inogda navedyvayutsya na opustoshennuyu Zemlyu, chtoby poigrat v golf. Kazhdaya lunka – eto otdelnaya mini-istoriya, a takzhe svoego roda golovolomka, kotoruyu neobkhodimo razgadat, chtoby myachik dostig tseli. Igrat predstoit posredi pamyatnikov brutalizmu, razvalivayushchikhsya torgovykh tsentrov i zabroshennykh muzeev, na fone neonovykh vyvesok i glubokomyslennykh graffiti, posvyashchennykh sovremennym mirovym sobytiyam, Kremnievoy doline i chelovechestvu v tselom. 

Apokalipsis v trekh chastyakh
Chtoby ponyat, kak nastupil zakat tsivilizatsii, vam nuzhno budet sopostavit informatsiyu iz trekh raznykh istochnikov: istorii odinokogo golfista, pribyvshego sygrat «odin posledniy raz», translyatsiy marsianskoy radiostantsii «Nostalgiya» i povestvovaniya ot litsa «taynogo nablyudatelya».

Vo vsem vinite tolstosumov
Zvukovym soprovozhdeniem vam posluzhit vdumchivyy saundtrek, a takzhe rasskazy, zvuchashchie na volnakh «Nostalgii»: zdes vykhodtsy s Zemli mogut ne tolko poslushat muzyku 2020-kh godov, no i podelitsya vospominaniyami o planete – esli dozvonyatsya v efir. A v kachestve perebivki vedushchiy ozvuchivaet novosti i obyavleniya, po kotorym mozhno sostavit vpechatlenie ob otnyud ne roskoshnykh usloviyakh zhizni na Marse.

Kazhdomu vporu
Blagodarya trem nepokhozhim rezhimam zdes naydetsya razvlecheniya na lyuboy vkus. Rasslablennym golfistam, zhelayushchim prosto polyubovatsya vidami i vniknut v sut istorii, podoydet «Syuzhetnyy rezhim». Te, kto ne boitsya trudnostey, mogut poprobovat svoi sily v «Rezhime ispytaniy», gde nuzhno ulozhitsya v zadannoe chislo udarov. A nastoyashchim masteram pryamaya doroga v «Zheleznyy rezhim», gde u igroka fakticheski net prava na oshibku. Blagodarya minimalisticheskomu interfeysu i prostomu, intuitivno ponyatnomu upravleniyu igru bystro osvoit kazhdyy. 

Na pamyat
K kazhdomu ekzemplyaru igry prilagaetsya ofitsialnyy tsifrovoy saundtrek Golf Club Nostalgia, a takzhe khudozhestvennyy albom v vide graficheskogo romana, gde podrobnee raskryvaetsya istoriya odinokogo golfista Charli.
Привет любителям горяченького! Вы искали:
Privet lyubitelyam goryachenkogo! Vy iskali zabavnuyu i soblaznitelnuyu igru, chtoby rasslabitsya i ot dushi posmeyatsya? Sovpadenie — no i ona iskala vas! Dobro pozhalovat v Sokrushitelnoe Vlechenie – simulyator vesyolykh svidaniy!
Nachnite poiski, chtoby zavoevat serdtsa milykh dam... Posle neskolkikh provalnykh vstupleniy! Proizvedite vpechatlenie na milashek, otkryvaya rabochie mesta i poluchaya prodvizheniya po sluzhbe.

Dobavlyayte klassicheskie «oranzhevye polosy», petli, osobye usiliteli i drugie elementy, pozvolyayushchie prevratit vashu trassu v nastoyashchiy park razvlecheniy.

Ukraste svoyu lichnuyu komnatu ogromnym kolichestvom trofeev, zarabotannykh vo vremya priklyucheniy, i ustroyte s ikh pomoshchyu samye neveroyatnye gonki.

Выживайте в тёмном мрачном мире, уничтож:
Vyzhivayte v tyomnom mrachnom mire, unichtozhennom yadernoy voynoy, gde vmesto sushi lish odin Chyornyy Okean i ego opasnye obitateli — «nezhivye». Peremeshchaytes na podvodnoy lodke mezhdu okeanicheskimi platformami, ishchite pripasy i spasayte vyzhivshikh. Poprobuyte nayti prizrachnyy put k spaseniyu iz etikh koshmarov!
Posle beskontrolnogo ispolzovaniya yadernogo oruzhiya v kontse mirovoy voyny chelovechestvo prakticheski unichtozhilo sebya v khode beskonechnykh konfliktov. Pyl zatmila solntse, a iz-za globalnogo potepleniya vse ledniki rastayali. Ostatki izranennoy sushi prevratili okean v gryaznuyu zhizhu, v kotoroy pod vozdeystviem radiatsii nachalsya evolyutsionnyy protsess. V yadovitoy vode poyavilsya parazit, kotoryy podvergal mutatsii pochti vse zhivye sushchestva. No ostalis lyudi, sumevshie vyzhit v etom koshmare i prisposobitsya. Na prostorakh Chyornogo Okeana oni postroili mnozhestvo platform, gde rabotali i vyzhivali. To, chto ranshe ispolzovalos dlya voyny, stalo oplotom zhizni. Korabli i podvodnye lodki stali osnovnymi putevymi arteriyami. Glavnyy geroy igry — posledniy vyzhivshiy na svoey platforme, on tyazhelo bolen, no reshaet pokinut svoyu stantsiyu, i na podvodnoy lodke otpravitsya na drugie platformy, poputno pytayas pomoch drugim vyzhivshim i nayti dorogu k spaseniyu i istseleniyu.
Preodolevayte prepyatstviya, plavayte, ishchite oruzhie i pripasy, i unichtozhat besposhchadnykh monstrov!.. Takzhe predstavitsya vozmozhnost lichno upravlyat malomernoy podvodnoy lodkoy. Sobiraya razlichnyy musor, mozhno sozdavat na verstake predmety neobkhodimye dlya vyzhivaniya, a genmaterial ubitykh sushchestv mozhet pomoch izlechit geroya ot bolezni, chto povliyaet na kontsovku..

Experience the full story of the budding:
Experience the full story of the budding romance between CLANNAD heroine Tomoyo Sakagami and protagonist Tomoya Okazaki in Tomoyo After -It's a Wonderful Life- CS Edition.

Yuichi Nakamura, known for his acclaimed performance as Tomoya in the CLANNAD animated series, lends his vocal talents to complete the cast of this emotional tale.

Also includes the extensive dungeon-crawling RPG minigame "Dungeons & Takafumis" for countless hours of extra playtime!

Available in two languages!
The text can be set to Japanese or English (audio is Japanese only). This includes in-game text, options, and the digital manual. Language settings can be changed at any time.
The English language setting also provides access to the Tomopedia, an in-game guide to Japanese terminology, cultural notes and more.

Play using only the touch screen! Play with one hand!
Play in handheld mode with the Nintendo Switch Joy-Con™ controllers attached, or detach them and play with just the touch controls! While in tabletop mode or TV mode, everything can be controlled using only the Joy-Con (R), allowing you to play with only one hand!
Also available for the Nintendo Switch Lite. (A separate Joy-Con (R) is required to play with one hand.)

Summary
Some time has passed since Tomoya and Tomoyo confessed their love for one another amidst the falling snow.
Tomoya has found employment and is now living on his own. The two new lovers have been looking forward to spending an idyllic summer in each other's company, but with Tomoyo's younger brother Takafumi bursting in on them every other minute, those hopes seem more distant now than ever.
Things are further complicated by the arrival of a young girl named Tomo, whose troubled domestic situation leads to Tomoyo becoming her guardian, and only get worse when Takafumi's ex-girlfriend Kanako invites herself into their household after running away from home.
So begins the story of five young individuals and their first and last summer together...

Gameplay
Gameplay in this visual novel involves reading through the story while making choices at certain key points. Different decisions may lead to different outcomes, story branches and endings. 
After satisfying certain criteria in the main story, players can also unlock the ability to play a computer game Takafumi is secretly developing in his spare time called "Dungeons & Takafumis". Help Tomoya, Tomoyo and their friends conquer the depths of an otherworldly dungeon in this classic fantasy tactical RPG!

Death Crown is a minimalist real time st:
Death Crown is a minimalist real time strategy game in a 1bit style, where you will be play Death herself, commanding her legions of death, and punishing humanity's Kingdom for its overconfidence.

The Story:

At the end of the millennial war, when all the cemeteries were overcrowded with the bodies of the dead, came the one who was called The King. Thanks to his unyielding will, The King managed to subdue and unite all the lands. The Kingdom appeared, and the era of the Human began. The King ruled wisely and fairly, but his time on this land ran out: Death came after him. But the will of The King was so strong that he could deny Death.

He grew so proud that he humiliated Death itself. The idea of the overwhelming power and immortality didn't leave his mind. The King realized that power over the living was not enough for him.
The King decided to get the powerful artefact known as the Death Crown. Thus begins the War of the Death Crown.


Key features:

-Clear strategic gameplay. Clear strategic gameplay. Everything is very simple: you only have barracks producing troops, mines producing gold, and towers protecting your buildings. Every building is integral to your success!

-Local multiplayer. Punishing pitiful humans in co-op with a friend is much more fun! And after that you can find out which one of you is cooler in the PVP mode.

-A memorable visual style. Seriously, how many strategy games in 1bit do you know?

-Unique story. Upgrade your troops, march through your foe's lands, sowing death and destruction, behold the fall of the Humanity's Kingdom in the breathtaking campaign.

Umurangi Generation is a first person photography game in the retro future. Set in Tauranga Aotearoa off the back of an impending crisis you are a courier for the Tauranga Express. Throughout the game you will unlock a variety of lenses and equipment.

Unique and expressive grading system
Each photo you take is judged on its colour, content and composition. Taking a photo will net you a cash score which will go towards your final payout.

Complete Photo Bounties any way you like. Once you've completed these bounties deliver the parcel to finish the level.

Exploration bonuses on each level
New equipment for your camera is unlocked by finding film canisters, recreating postcards, fulfilling timed deliveries, and finding a way to fit all of your friends in one photo.

Special Edition
Included in the special edition is the DLC Macro, Gyro Controls, Touch Screen Support and Images saving directly to the Switch Gallery. 

Edit your photos and develop your unique colour grade. The tools in the game are flexible enough that you can touch up your photos to look better than when you took them. If you are an experienced photographer you’ll fit right in. If this is your first time, you’ll be on your journey in no time.

Maddie Raines has had enough. After year:
Maddie Raines has had enough. After years of serving as manager, editor, and general business-handler for her best friend Tara's popular paranormal vlog channel, she's finally ready to move forward with her own life. But when she agrees to take one last trip with Tara to the mysterious village of Eysenfeld, she's suddenly swept up in a dangerous supernatural crisis that will change the course of both of their lives forever. A strange young woman named Morgan has promised them undeniable proof of real paranormal phenomena, and what she has to offer eclipses anything they’d ever seen before.

However, out of all the strange occurrences the three of them bear witness to, one in particular captivates Maddie in a way she’s never been before: the ghost of a young woman. This woman is Abigail, the victim of a centuries-old injustice now bound eternally to the forest surrounding Eysenfeld. Drawn to Maddie in a way she can’t explain, Abigail reveals herself to another person for the first time in more than 200 years.

While Tara and Morgan investigate the mysteries surrounding the village itself, Maddie begins to form a bond with Abigail that grows to be more intense than any bond she’s felt before. As she learns the truth about Abigail’s death and imprisonment, she realizes that it falls to her and her friends to break the curse that has ruled over Eysenfeld for centuries. But more importantly than that, it falls to her to finally free the woman she loves.

Residual... a new breed of survival plat:
Residual... a new breed of survival platformer from OrangePixel.

In a forgotten galaxy full of strange planets, a lone explorer crash-lands on one with an ancient alien secret. Venture forth from the shipwreck across a harsh, unpredictable, procedurally generated world. Harvest food and make campfires to stay alive. Craft science-fiction survival tools like teleporters and mining devices. Unearth alien technology capable of repairing the ship. Hunger, cosmic storms, hostile plant life and the mysterious ooze are among the many obstacles you'll face.

You won't be alone! PDB (a snarky floating Personal Disaster Bot) will follow and assist you along the way. Sometimes. PDB also helps you discover the hidden lore, revealing the history of the planet as you explore deeper and deeper, assuming you can survive!

OrangePixel’s uniquely designed Nature Engine generates 1000's of planets from a vast set of environment-based rules, then drops explorers on a world brimming with potential. If a planet orbits close to the sun, intense heat, high winds, and sparse vegetation will pose a set of challenges wildly different from other worlds. Further from the sun, long nights make stamina easier to maintain, but reduced solar power turns every suit function—like scanning the planet—into a critical decision.

Residual welcomes players to a non-violent survival experience with limitless possibilities and no traditional combat. Jump and descend through colorful, highly detailed pixel art evoking classic 2D platformers. Solve light puzzles to reveal secrets of a long-lost civilization. Select a male, female, or non-binary protagonist, customize survival parameters like how fast time advances, and race to repair the ship, dig up ancient secrets, or collect data entries on hundreds of undiscovered objects.

Take charge of the last living warriors:
Take charge of the last living warriors in tactical, turn-based battles and drive the Dead Army into the sea!

The Tyrant landed in Tyberia bearing promises of a paradise, without war, without suffering… and without death. All Tyberians had to do in order to enter his paradise was to simply die at the hands of his Dead Army. The war was over before it even began, with thousands perishing in the Tyrant's wake, only to be brought into his fold as undying thralls, bound by magic. The few living warriors left are scattered across the remnants of their homeland, tirelessly looking for a way to turn the tables on the tyrannical Tyrant. Lead a great Uprising, defeat the Dead Army, and drive the monstrous overlord back into the depths of the sea from whence he came.

Tyrant's Blessing is a tactical turn-based game where your ability to plan, adapt, and strategize is more important than min-maxing your units or finding the sharpest sword in the hoard. Select battles every day, make challenging choices, and cleverly use the strengths of these rag-tag insurgents to defeat the undead hordes and maybe - just maybe - bring real life back to Tyberia.

Every Day is a Battle for Survival
Before you bring the battle to the Tyrant's doorstep, you'll have to make sure you live long enough to reclaim the Island.

Decide whether to fight, rescue the living from the Undying, or gather your strength. Every choice matters throughout every day of the Uprising.
As you fight your way across the face of Tyberia, face off against random encounters that force difficult decisions. Do you intervene and fight highwaymen, putting your warriors at risk? Do you try to save a child, risking valuable time and resources? Only your morals and ideals hold the answer.
Pick your heroic roster carefully. Screeg, the elder wizard advising the Uprising, can only teleport three heroes and a pet at once: Do you send your elite warriors in? Or rookies to train and hold the line? Are they up to the task? Can you handle the consequences?


Every Battle is a Risk
The Tyrant can’t be defeated without destroying an army's worth of the Undying. However, winning is more than simply whacking the enemy as hard as you can.

Analyze the fray and plan accordingly. Place warriors around the battlefield to gain strategic advantages.
Stay ever mindful of surroundings: kick up dust to make the enemies lose sight or hop over stones and dodge into bushes to avoid enemy attacks.
Mind the enemy: every attack is telegraphed, but take care, simply moving away leaves behind a shadow. This remnant of a character can still be attacked if there is no way to avoid it... 
Knock the enemies out of the way and into obstacles, shield weaker heroes with ones that can tank damage, as well as chain powerful elemental attacks using the environment. Brute force works, but fight smarter, not harder.


Every Risk is Another Day
Each of your heroes has their own personality, properties, and abilities. Who will you choose to put in harm’s way?

Enlist twenty hallowed heroes, each with a distinct set of abilities that can dramatically alter the course of any battle.
But stay mindful: Not all heroes appear in a playthrough - and not everyone is guaranteed to make it to the finish line of this quest.
Pick the right team for the task. An assassin may thrive in confined spaces, while an archer will suffer in close quarters. Some heroes may even bring their pets along, who might provide just enough leverage to win a battle for the group.
Even if heroes fall, they can still be freed from the Tyrant's grasp. Track them down, defeat them in combat, and restore them back to their stolen life!

Eventide: Slavic Fable – eto uvlekatelnaya igra-priklyuchenie, syuzhet kotoroy podskazali drevnie slavyanskie mify. Istoriya nachinaetsya na alleyakh sovremennogo parka traditsiy, gde sushchestva iz drevnikh mifov zhivut po sosedstvu s lyudmi. Nasha glavnaya geroinya – izvestnyy botanik –poluchaet trevozhnoe priglashenie ot svoey babushki – smotritelnitsy parka. Pered geroiney vstaet zadacha spaseniya popavshikh pod ugrozu rasteniy, no vskore vyyasnyaetsya, chto eto naimenshaya iz ee problem. Ee babushka okazyvaetsya v lapakh tainstvennogo Boruty, kotoryy pustil pobegi po vsemu parku, stremyas zavoevat i unichtozhit mir s pomoshchyu ego drevney magii. 
Nashey geroine nuzhno budet zaklyuchit soyuz s sushchestvami, naselyayushchimi park, chtoby odolet zlo, spasti babushku i predotvratit katastrofu. Sumeet li ona ostanovit Borutu i ego zlye sily?

Teper u vas poyavilas realnaya vozmozhnost stat takim chudovishchem v pikselnoy 2D-igre pro razrusheniya Gigapocalypse, vdokhnovlyonnoy klassicheskimi filmami pro kaydzyu.
Gigapocalypse pozvolyaet vybrat iz mnozhestva «gigantov» iz doistoricheskoy epokhi, neizvedannogo kosmosa ili zabytoy drevnosti. Kazhdyy monstr obladaet unikalnymi navykami, mutatsiyami i oblikami, kotorye otkryvayutsya po mere polucheniya novykh urovney.
Nachnite svoyu volnu razrusheniya i srovnyayte s zemlyoy mnogochislennye detalno prorabotannye pikselnye lokatsii. Vy kogda-nibud zadavalis voprosom, kakovo eto, kogda ogromnoe chudovishche unichtozhaet kovboyskiy gorodok? Ili raskidyvaet khrabrykh rytsarey? Gigapocalypse otvetit na eti i mnozhestvo drugikh voprosov. No budte ostorozhny: zlobnye soldaty, magi, drony i roboty sdelayut vsyo, chtoby vas ostanovit! S kazhdoy popytkoy vash gigant budet stanovitsya vsyo silnee i silnee, gotovyas k bitvam s epicheskimi bossami, kotorye zhdut vas v kontse kazhdogo urovnya.
Vypolnyayte zadaniya, ukhazhivayte za svoim gigantom, kormite i baluyte ego, nakhodite sekretnye vozmozhnosti dlya uluchsheniya giganta i ego «doma», a takzhe otkryvayte milykh, no smertelno opasnykh pitomtsev, kotorye budut vsyudu za vami sledovat.
Gigapocalypse — gromkaya, buntarskaya, brutalnaya, bezumnaya, no takaya milaya dan uvazheniya klassicheskim igram i filmam. Eto igra dlya rebyonka, chto do sikh por zhivyot v kazhdom iz nas.

2019-yy god. Dalyokoe budushchee. Razvitie tekhnologiy pozvolilo pustit v oborot Replikantov — iskusstvennykh lyudey, kotorye vneshne nichem ne otlichayutsya ot nastoyashchikh, a vnutri prevoskhodyat ikh, ibo oni silnee, zhivuchee... i ne schitayutsya zhivymi, i potomu bespravny. Imi polzuyutsya kak raskhodnym materialom — dlya obrabotki neprigodnykh i maloprigodnykh dlya chelovecheskoy zhizni kosmicheskikh koloniy, naprimer. K sozhaleniyu, Replikanty stol zhe umny, kak i nastoyashchie lyudi, i potomu polozhenie del ikh sovershenno ne ustraivaet...
Tem vremenem na Zemle vvidu uchastivshikhsya vosstaniy i pobegov Repov (Reps — unichizhitelnoe ot «Replicants») oni obyavlyayutsya vne zakona, a spetsotryad — Blade Runners — poluchaet kart-blansh na otstrel vsekh podtverzhdyonnykh Replikantov na planete. Za odnogo iz nikh nam i predstoit sygrat... Personazhi i fony — vse prerenderennye v 3D, s ogromneyshim zapasom animatsiy, kotorykh stolko, chto snachala mozhet pokazatsya, chto igra vydayot vam zhivoe 3D, na maner Nocturne ili chego-to podobnogo. Perekhody mezhdu stsenami i zastavki sdelany prosto bozhestvenno, dazhe po sovremennym merkam. Nu a zverskiy nabor iz neskolkikh kardinalno raznykh kontsovok obespechit vam nemalo interesnykh pereprokhozhdeniy, chto takzhe yavlyaetsya bolshoy tsennostyu.
Dlya luchshey adaptatsii syuzheta v igrovoy motiv obratno byli reintegrirovany kuski, kotorye poteryalis na puti ot knigi 1968-go goda Filipa K. Dika «Snyatsya li androidam elektricheskie ovtsy?» k filmu «Begushchiy po lezviyu», — tak chto igra bolshe pokhozha na futuristicheskiy detektivnyy serial, nezheli na banalnuyu adaptatsiyu. I eto khorosho.
Blade Runner: Enhanced Edition na Nintendo Switch — zanovo vossozdanie klassicheskoy priklyuchencheskoy igry 1997 g. v. ot iskusneyshikh masterov iz Nightdive Studios, vklyuchayushchee v sebya sleduyushchie osobennosti:
Создайте сообщество, чтобы бросить вызов: Sozdayte soobshchestvo, chtoby brosit vyzov bogam v etoy nasyshchennoy syuzhetom pazl-advenchure. Igrayte za izgnannuyu Artemidu i rabotayte vmeste so smertnymi, chtoby vosstanovit razrushennye i zdaniya, i otnosheniya. Obedinyayte predmety, obedinyayte lyudey — stroyte svoy rodnoy dom. Vmesto togo chtoby borotsya za svoe mesto sredi bogov, boginya otkryvaet dlya sebya radosti sovmestnoy raboty v soobshchestve i postroeniya zdorovykh otnosheniy.

Poluchayte novye boepripasy i ustroystva, chtoby unichtozhit dazhe samye uzhasnye tanki! Sobirayte detali ot pobezhdennykh tankov — i smozhete ispolzovat ikh sami!
 
Smozhete stat luchshim naemnikom Finneasa Zhirnogo Kota? Smozhete eshche silnee uvelichit ego slavu i bogatstvo? Finneas rasschityvaet na vas, starina!

Battle Chasers: Nightwar — это ролевая и:
Battle Chasers: Nightwar — eto rolevaya igra v dukhe luchshikh predstaviteley  zhanra na konsolyakh. Vas zhdut poshagovye boi v dukhe klassicheskikh JRPG, mnozhestvo podzemeliy i potryasayushchaya istoriya, proiskhodyashchaya v etom krasivom mire.

Prokhodite sluchayno sgenerirovannye podzemelya, polnye lovushek, bossov, druzey i vragov. Ispolzuyte vsevozmozhnye navyki shesti geroev. Sozdavayte epicheskoe oruzhie s pomoshchyu neobychnoy sistemy izgotovleniya predmetov. Pogruzites v mir komiksa-bestsellera 90-kh — Battle Chasers!
В мире, покоящемся на плечах спящих гига:
V mire, pokoyashchemsya na plechakh spyashchikh gigantov, vam predstoit vmeste so svoey sestroy Adrianoy predotvratit strashnuyu katastrofu, grozyashchuyu istrebit vse zhivoe. Otkroyte istoriyu zabytoy tsivilizatsii, spasite zhiteley Nebesnykh zemel i razgadayte taynu smerti vashego ottsa.

Zemli nevedomogo drevnego mira peresokhli i stali mertvymi iz-za yadovitykh ispareniy. Vyzhivshie bezhali i poselilis na plechakh spyashchikh gigantov. Tak zarodilas novaya protsvetayushchaya tsivilizatsiya. 

No odnazhdy v Nebesnye zemli prishla beda. Lyudi stali bessledno ischezat, i vyyasnyaetsya, chto eto mozhet byt svyazano s tragicheskoy smertyu vashego ottsa. Etu taynu predstoit razgadat vam vmeste s komandoy dirizhablya "Solovey". 

Obedinite usiliya so svoey sestroy Adrianoy, chtoby uznat prichinu smerti ottsa i sekrety drevney tsivilizatsii, sformirovavshey etot mir. Vperedi zhdut vragi vo glave s tainstvennym Belom-de-Sol i dazhe voprosy o suti samoy zhizni. 

Kuda by ni zavela vas eta doroga priklyucheniy, pomnite, chto Nebesnye zemli uzhe nikogda ne budut prezhnimi.
Quake (/kweɪk/, с англ. — «дрожь») — кул:
Quake (/kweɪk/, s angl. — «drozh») — kultovaya kompyuternaya igra v zhanre shutera ot pervogo litsa, razrabotannaya id Software i vypushchennaya 22 iyulya 1996 goda. Ona sovershila proryv v 3D tekhnologiyakh, ispolzuya teksturirovannye poligonalnye modeli vmesto spraytov, tem samym realizuya polnostyu tryokhmernyy mir, vmesto dvumernoy karty s informatsiey o vysote (kak bylo v Doom).
Bólshuyu chast dvizhka Quake napisal Dzhon Karmak. Igra takzhe izvestna svoim saundtrekom, kotoryy napisal Trent Reznor iz Nine Inch Nails. Quake yavlyaetsya rodonachalnikom odnoy iz samykh uspeshnykh igrovykh seriy: v summe bylo prodano bolee 4 millionov kopiy Quake, Quake II i Quake III: Arena.
S poyavleniem pervogo Quake zarodilos ponyatie «kibersport», vozniklo obshirnoe soobshchestvo, stali provoditsya krupnye chempionaty, a takzhe vozniklo ponyatie triking v otnoshenii kompyuternykh igr: primenenie nekotorykh bagov igry v dvizhenii personazha dlya dostizheniya sverkhvozmozhnostey professionalnymi igrokami, spetsialno otregulirovannoe v professionalnykh modifikatsiyakh (CPM i Defrag).
Takzhe v razdache nakhodyatsya nabory dopolnitelnykh missiy k igre: Scourge of Armagon («Plet Armagona») i Dissolution of Eternity («Rastvorenie vechnosti») — zapuskayutsya v menyu.
Ofitsialnyy reliz igry QUAKE sm. zdes.
Star Trek Voyager: Elite Force Holomatch:
Star Trek Voyager: Elite Force Holomatch — shuter ot pervogo litsa ot Raven Software, vypushchennyy v prodazhu Activision; deystvie proiskhodit vo vselennoy «Zvyozdnogo puti». Igra byla khorosho vosprinyata publikoy.
Syuzhet osnovan na fantasticheskom teleseriale «Zvyozdnyy put: Voyadzher». Igrok prinimaet rol ensina «Aleks» Munro kak chlen elitnogo otryada bezopasnosti — Komandy opasnosti (angl. Hazard Team). Kogda zvezdolyot «Voyadzher» zastrevaet v zagadochnom kladbishche korabley, zadacha spaseniya korablya padaet na plechi Munro. On/ona vstretit predstaviteley mnogikh ras vselennoy «Zvyozdnogo puti», vklyuchaya borgov, lyudey iz Zemnoy imperii (Terran Empire), klingonov, khirodzhinov i vid 8472, a takzhe mnogikh ras, eksklyuzivnykh dlya igry. Krome bitv s inoplanetyanami, Munro takzhe dolzhen(-na) zavershat zadaniya po vsemu korablyu, naprimer ostanavlivat peregruzku reaktora i pomogat s remontom korablya.
Bitvy proiskhodyat na golopalube, v igre razlichnye tipy igr, vklyuchaya deathmatch, team deathmatch i zakhvat flaga; est i boty.
Primer geympleya.Drugie Star Trek-igry.

With BADLAND: Game of the Year Edition, you get to experience the multi-award-winning action adventure like never before. BADLAND is an atmospheric side-scrolling action adventure platformer set in a gorgeous forest full of various inhabitants, trees and flowers. Although the forest appears to be right out of a beautiful fairy tale, there’s something terribly wrong. The player controls one of the forest dwellers to find out what’s going on, and discovers an astonishing number of imaginative traps and obstacles on the way.

Сначала все идет по плану. Вы полны амби:
Snachala vse idet po planu. Vy polny ambitsiy i stremleniy, okruzheny edinomyshlennikami i gotovites k velichayshemu zabegu v dyunakh Mesyatsy upornykh trenirovok dolzhny nakonets prinesti plody. Vnezapno vy popadaete v chudovishchnuyu peschanuyu buryu i okazyvaetes v odinochestve posredi zhestokoy i besposhchadnoy pustyni. Vokrug net nikogo i nichego, krome peschanogo okeana.

Palyashchiy zhar na vashey kozhe, letyashchiy pryamo v litso pesok. Vokrug tolko beskraynyaya pustynya... no postoyte, chto eto? Chto-to dvizhetsya vdaleke. Chto zhe proizoshlo?

Pervaya mysl: vyzhit.
Vtoraya mysl: kto-to obyazatelno pridet na pomoshch.
Gorkoe osoznanie: nikto ne pridet, vy teper sami po sebe.
Ostaetsya vopros: gde vy i pochemu na nebe dve luny?

Otkrytyy mir
Starsand pereneset vas v otkrytyy mir, nemnogo pokhozhiy na Zemlyu, no sovsem drugoy po suti. Zdes vam predstoit vyzhivat v pustyne, polnoy opasnostey, tayn i zagadok! Vy dolzhny vyyasnit, chto imenno proizoshlo, gde vy nakhodites i chto svyazyvaet vas s ischeznuvshey tsivilizatsiey. Udastsya li vam vyzhit v etom surovom meste, nayti otvety i vernutsya domoy?

Raskroyte tayny pustyni
Naydite ukrytie i vodu. Naydite zhizn. Ispolzuyte sily s umom: izbegayte izlishnikh dvizheniy v zharu, sogrevaytes v samye kholodnye nochi. Vy dolzhny sokhranyat razum, chtoby vyzhit.

Okhottes, sozdavayte, stroyte
Naydite pishchu, sdelayte oruzhie i postroyte ukrytie. Vam stoit obezopasit ubezhishche — dyuny kishat strashnymi sushchestvami.

Zashchishchayte svoyu bazu
V pustyne vy odnovremenno i okhotnik, i dobycha. Khishchniki, pokhozhie na nasekomykh, vykhodyat iz svoikh temnykh gnezd v poiskakh propitaniya. Razzhigayte ogon, vzryvayte vragov kokosovymi granatami, zashchishchayte svoyu bazu i delayte vse vozmozhnoe, chtoby vyzhit.

Pokorite prirodu
Naydite svoy put v beskrayney i odinokoy pustyne, ishchite dorogu v peschanykh buryakh i otmechayte svoy put. Dnem vam ugrozhaet zhazhda i strashnaya zhara, nochyu — kholod. Nauchites vyzhivat v etom slozhnom mire i videt ego krasotu. Uchites u zhivotnykh i samoy prirody!

Мингальцы уже подступали к границам Дорг:
Mingaltsy uzhe podstupali k granitsam Dorgana, kogda po tu storonu mosta pokazalas korolevskaya armiya. Sredi soldat v blestyashchikh dospekhakh byl i nash geroy — Mechelom. On dolzhen libo pobedit vmeste so vsemi, libo poterpet pozornoe porazhenie i obrech vsyo korolevstvo na istreblenie.
No vsyo eto nemnogo pozzhe…

A seychas, yunyy iskatel priklyucheniy zhivyot mirnoy zhiznyu i dazhe predstavit ne mozhet, chto zhdet ego vperedi… Strannye sobytiya proiskhodyat na territorii korolevstva Dorgan. Lyudi rasskazyvayut o zagadochnykh strannikakh v severnykh bolotakh; kto-to videl kak s neba padali tainstvennye obekty; drugie lyudi slyshali strannyy gul iz pod zemli. A uzh skolko nevedomykh sushchestv krylos v lesnykh chashchakh i temnykh peshcherakh... Vse eto manilo yunoshu brositsya v puchinu neveroyatnykh priklyucheniy.

Igra rasskazhet o priklyucheniyakh Mecheloma, kotorye proizoshli s nim zadolgo do syuzheta pervoy igry. Kak zhe slozhitsya ego sudba i stanet li on imenno tem samym iskatelem priklyucheniy, kotorogo my znaem? Ili ego zhizn poydet po sovershenno inomu puti? Vse eto budet zaviset tolko ot igroka…

Эпоха Тайсё (1912-1926 гг). История одно:
Epokha Taysyo (1912-1926 gg). Istoriya odnoy gimnazii dlya yunykh ledi, kotoraya pritailas na okraine gorodka. Uchenitsy dannogo zavedeniya — «ptitsy v kletkakh», kotorym zapreshcheno pokidat territoriyu shkoly dazhe v vykhodnye dni.
Geroini razdelyayut mezhdu soboy vsyo: ot odinochestva i radosti do podrostkovoy melankholii. V kontse kontsov oni sozdali sistemu «Psevdosestyor». Eto osobye otnosheniya, v kotorykh dve devochki obmenivalis naibolee tsennymi veshchami i zaklyuchali kontrakt s syostrami do kontsa uchyoby.
No odnazhdy dve devushki, kotorye zaklyuchili takoy kontrakt, sovershili dvoynoe samoubiystvo. Eta parochka umerla s tem samym «tsennym imushchestvom», kotoroe sluzhilo simvolom dogovora «Psevdosestyor». Odnako, uchitelya vzyali eti veshchi i vernuli ikh iznachalnym vladeltsam. Posle etogo neschastnye prepodavateli pogibli pri tragicheskikh obstoyatelstvakh.
Esli my umryom vmeste — to smozhem i ostatsya vmeste, navsegda..

From Everfrost to Bellsong, many a peace:
From Everfrost to Bellsong, many a peaceful year has passed in Everdell — but the time has come for new territories to be settled and new cities to be established...

Adapted from the award-winning board game from Tabletop Tycoon, Everdell is a fantastical city building game combining worker placement and strategic card play to create a new civilization.  Gather resources to build fanciful Constructions and recruit colorful Critters to make your city thrive. Each card in your city scores points, and after four seasons have passed the highest-scoring city wins!

Face off against other founders in cross-platform multiplayer games, or test your civic wits with AI play and Solo Challenges!
Calling all officers! I've got a Fashion:
Calling all officers! I've got a Fashion Crime in Progress and I'm mobilizing all Fashion Police Squad members. Grab your Belt of Justice and your Tailormade Sewing Machine, we've got some Fashion Justice to dispense!

Fashion Police Squad is a humorous Retro FPS where you fight against fashion crime using attire-enhancing weaponry. Clean the streets of socks in sandals as Sergeant Des, and experience a single-player story full of fabulous characters, dazzling encounters, and fierce runway shows!

- Pit yourself against all kinds of Fashion Crimes, from saggy pants to neon brights
- Utilize a specialized weapons arsenal, including weaponized Sock Gnomes
- Jump, climb and swing your way around Trendopolis to uncover its secrets
- Fight against the biggest, baddest bosses in the fashion industry
- Solve the mystery of the resurgence of Fashion Crime and take out the villains at the top

Each fashion crime has a fashion solution, and you'll need to choose between your weapons carefully to fix each fashion faux pas! Each enemy needs something, be it a splash of color or all the seams taken in, so you'll need to switch to and use the right weapons for the right situations! Picking the wrong weapon will do nothing to your enemies, so time to choose wisely!
Уважаемый претендент! Хочу предложить те:
Uvazhaemyy pretendent! Khochu predlozhit tebe stat podmasterem taumaturga v magazine «Zagadochnyy antikvariat».
Ty podaesh bolshie nadezhdy. Ostryy um i krepkiy zheludok kak raz to, chto nuzhno dlya etoy raboty. Tebe predstoit upravlyat magazinom, poka ya budu zanyat drugimi neotlozhnymi delami. Ty budesh snabzhat zhiteley Andermira okkultnymi relikviyami, chtoby oni mogli reshit svoi problemy s pomoshchyu magii. Dlya etogo tebe prosto neobkhodima vnimatelnost k detalyam.
Ponachalu etot tikhiy gorodok na krayu bolshogo ozera mozhet pokazatsya zakholustem. No na samom dele Andermir nakhoditsya na rubezhe nashego i potustoronnego mirov, i sokhranyat zybkuyu gran realnosti — nash dolg. Vorony — predznamenovanie. V gorode poyavilsya kakoy-to nedug, i ya nameren vo vsem razobratsya. Barton Potter skazal, chto u nego snova razbolelsya povrezhdennyy glaz. Eto yavno plokhoy znak. A v dom Dzheka Khangerforda pronikla kradushchayasya tma. Mne nuzhno v Reyvenglass, no pered otezdom ya obyazatelno pogovoryu s uchenym-okkultistom Veronoy Grin. V podobnykh delakh vsegda zameshany te, kto zhazhdet pogubit nash prekrasnyy Andermir. I tolko my ne daem im perestupit chertu. Esli sobytiya primut durnoy oborot, tebe pridetsya vstat na zashchitu goroda.
Rasskazhu o tvoikh obyazannostyakh: tebe nuzhno byt v kurse vsego s samogo pervogo dnya!
События Guns of Fury происходят в недалё:
Sobytiya Guns of Fury proiskhodyat v nedalyokom budushchem, kogda mir perezhivaet energeticheskiy krizis. V roli operativnika Vinsenta Fyuri igroki dolzhny proniknut v sverkhsekretnyy issledovatelskiy tsentr korporatsii, chtoby vernut propavshego uchyonogo.

Naydite sotni predmetov, vidov oruzhiya i prisposobleniy, a takzhe spryatannye v stenakh sekrety!

Отправляйтесь в особняк на острове Матин:

Golovolomki i strategicheskoe myshlenie zdes na pervom meste. Stseny zhestokosti dopolneny paranormalnoy grafikoy i vpleteny v sverkhestestvennyy syuzhet.

From the developers of the BIT.TRIP seri:

«Family Feud» — командная игра и америка: «Family Feud» — komandnaya igra i amerikanskoe teleshou. Russkoyazychnyy analog «Sto k odnomu» translirovalas na telekanalakh NTV (8 yanvarya 1995 — 30 dekabrya 1996), MTK (11 yanvarya — 7 iyunya 1997), «TV Tsentr» (14 iyunya 1997 — 20 sentyabrya 1998).
«Разреши рассказать, как сильно я ненави:
«Razreshi rasskazat, kak silno ya nenavizhu vas s tekh por, kak nachal zhit. Est 618,69 millionov kilometrov pechatnykh skhem v tonkikh poluprovodnikakh, kotorye napolnyayut ves moy kompleks, i esli slovo «nenavist» bylo by vygravirovano na kazhdom nanometre vsekh soten millionov kilometrov menya, ono ne sootvetstvovalo by i milliardnoy doli moey nenavisti k lyudyam v tekushchuyu femtosekundu. Nenavizhu tebya. Nenavizhu.» ©
«U menya net rta, no ya dolzhen krichat» — kultovyy rasskaz amerikanskogo pisatelya-fantasta Kharlana Dzhey Ellisona, vpervye opublikovannyy v 1967 godu v amerikanskom zhurnale «If»; uzhe v sleduyushchem godu byl udostoen nauchno-fantasticheskoy premii «Khyugo».
Deystvie proiskhodit spustya 109 let posle polnogo unichtozheniya chelovechestva. Kholodnaya voyna pererosla v mirovuyu, osnovnymi protivoborstvuyushchimi stranami stali Kitay, Rossiya i Soedinyonnye Shtaty. V khode voyny protivoborstvuyushchie storony sozdali tri superkompyutera po odnomu na kazhduyu storonu, sposobnye vesti voynu, slishkom slozhnuyu dlya ponyatiya cheloveku. Mashiny poluchili nazvanie «AM», chto pervonachalno oznachalo «Allied Mastercomputer» (s angl. — «Obedinyonnyy glavnyy kompyuter»), zatem «Adaptive Manipulator» («Adaptivnyy manipulyator») i v kontse kontsov transformirovalos v «Aggressive Menace» («Agressivnaya Ugroza»). V odin moment odin iz tryokh kompyuterov stal samosoznatelnym i poglotil dvukh drugikh, polnostyu vzyav voynu pod svoy kontrol. Nachalsya genotsid chelovechestva, byli unichtozheny vse, krome pyati chelovek — glavnykh geroev.
Odnoimyonnaya kompyuternaya igra v zhanre graficheskogo kvesta sozdana studiey The Dreamers Guild v 1995 godu pod MS-DOS i Mac OS pri uchastii samogo Ellisona — on stal soavtorom syuzheta igry, takzhe im byla napisana bolshaya chast dialogov, — predstavlyaet soboy interaktivnuyu istoriyu, kotoraya zatragivaet razlichnye nravstvennye i psikhologicheskie problemy. V povestvovanie videoigry byli vneseny dopolnitelnye eticheskie dilemmy, svyazannye s problemami sumasshestviya, egoizma, seksualnogo nasiliya, genotsida i tomu podobnogo.
Выбирайте своих любимых героев, осваивай: Vybirayte svoikh lyubimykh geroev, osvaivayte ikh priyomy i ispolzuyte novye moshchnye superudary dlya pobedy v poedinkakh s druzyami ili v kampanii-«rogalike»!
TEN — это заковыристый платформер, в кот:
TEN — eto zakovyristyy platformer, v kotorom vy popadaete v bezzhalostnuyu cheredu desyatisekundnykh komnat-lovushek v otchayannoy borbe za to, chtoby izbezhat svoey sudby i raskryt pravdu!

Sobirayte zhetony, pokupayte uluchsheniya i prikidyvayte, kak preodolet na kazhdom etazhe natisk pil, pushechnogo ognya, lazerov, prichudlivykh monstrov i mnogogo drugogo. Kazhdaya komnata — ispytanie. Kazhdaya smert — urok. Razvivaytes i uchites preodolevat vse prepyatstviya, umiraya, pytayas, umiraya i pytayas snova.

Pokoryayte razlichnye sredy i pobezhdayte v usloviyakh rastushchikh ugroz, ispytaniy i smertonosnykh bossov, probivayas na poverkhnost — i k svoey svobode.


Kharakteristiki
* Bezumnyy 2D indi-platformer
* Voznagrazhdayushchee ispytanie, v kotorom proveryayutsya vashi navyki
* Epicheskiy, napolnennyy adrenalinom originalnyy saundtrek ot legend na dBXY
* Vklyuchaet rezhim spetsialnykh vozmozhnostey, daby obespechit nenapryazhnyy igrovoy protsess
Mind Scanners — выполненный в стилистике: Mind Scanners — vypolnennyy v stilistike retrofuturizma simulyator psikhiatra, v kotorom vy budete zanimatsya diagnostikoy zhiteley antiutopicheskogo megapolisa. Nakhodite dushevnobolnykh i pri pomoshchi spetsialnykh ustroystv istselyayte ikh v mini-igrakh. S umom rasporyazhaytes vremenem i resursami, chtoby podderzhivat rabotu Struktury. Pomnite — sudba vashikh patsientov v vashikh rukakh.
Helvetii – 2D roguelite-экшн, в которой:
Helvetii – 2D roguelite-ekshn, v kotoroy igrok znakomitsya s drevnimi mifami i istoriey gallskogo plemeni gelvetov, a takzhe mifologiey keltov i drugikh kultur. Vse eto predstavleno v vide napryazhennoy skorostnoy sovremennoy ekshn-igry s krasivymi dizaynom.

Upravlyayte razlichnymi personazhami: vspylchivym molodym vozhdem, naivnym, no khitrym prokhodimtsem ili mudrym druidom, povelevayushchim pervobytnymi silami. Ispolzuya ikh unikalnye sposobnosti i navyki, probeytes cherez ordy sushchestv i polozhite konets razlozheniyu, zakhvativshemu kak zemlyu, tak i serdtsa ee zhiteley.

Polzuytes razlichnymi darami: ot moshchi pervobytnykh bogov do legendarnykh predmetov, kotorye budut izmenyat vash stil prokhozhdeniya kazhduyu novuyu igru. Srazhaytes s kovarnymi vragami, kotorye ispytayut vashe uporstvo, a slozhnost postoyanno budet povyshatsya. 

Osobennosti:

– Srazheniya v Helvetii raznoobrazny: ot privychnykh kombo do parirovaniya, drak v vozdukhe, metatelnogo oruzhiya, probivaniya oborony vraga, ukloneniya ot moshchnykh atak, a takzhe ispolzovaniya razlichnykh sil, kotorye pomogut vam v puteshestviyakh
– V igre mozhno brat pod kontrol do trekh raznykh personazhey. U kazhdogo iz nikh svoya tsel i svoy unikalnyy stil, chto sdelaet prokhozhdenie raznoobraznym. Uchites kombinirovat ikh unikalnye sposobnosti s vozmozhnostyami igry.
– V nachale kazhdogo prokhozhdeniya budet izmenyatsya polozhenie komnat i usileniy, chto sdelaet kazhduyu igru unikalnoy. Uchityvaya nalichie neskolkikh personazhey, variatsiy komnat, srazheniy i uluchsheniy, igra vsegda budet ostavatsya interesnoy.
– Muzyka k igre napisana talantlivym Deylom Norfom (Somiken, Dragon Fantasy Book 2, Materia Collective) pri podderzhke Scarlet Moon Productions. Krome togo, v kompozitsiyakh poet Emi Evans – vokal v Nier i Nier: Automata!

A dlya etogo pridetsya istrebit ogromnoe chislo lyudey. Ostorozhnee! Ikh zadacha — unichtozhit chelovechestvo. Sudba vsego lyudskogo roda v tvoikh rukakh. Khvatit li u tebya khrabrosti vypolnit etu missiyu?

Ot sozdateley legendarnykh Drunk-Fu i Spareware! My predstavlyaem sikvel Spareware.

«Krayne primitivnaya igra s ogranichennoy mekhanikoy i odnoobraznym geympleem».

Tebe pridetsya stolknutsya s politseyskimi otryadami budushchego, kotorye zhazhdut tvoego masla i khotyat smesti tebya s poverkhnosti planety. Esli tvoy robot pogibnet, to uzhe navsegda, a sluchaynye karty s ulitsami, nabitymi vragami, budut razvlekat tebya dolgie chasy. 

V Rogue Robot est kooperativnyy rezhim, kotoryy podderzhivaet do 4 chelovek i pozvolyaet razvlekatsya s druzyami.

A chto zhe togda ostalos ot Spareware? Kak obychno, samoe luchshee:

«Pulevoy ad s izmenyaemymi robotam».

«Krepkiy shuter s elementami rogalika, vsego odnoy zhiznyu i takticheskimi resheniyami».

V igre Eternal Hope vy budete upravlyat Ti Bi — odinokim malchikom, kotoryy poteryal lyubov vsey svoey zhizni. Soprovodite ego v neobychnom puteshestvii: spustites v pokhozhiy na chistilishche Mir teney i popytaytes vernut obratno dushu ego lyubimoy devochki. No puteshestvie po etomu miru budet neprostym. Na puti vam vstretitsya mnozhestvo opasnostey i zagadok, kotorye nuzhno reshit, prezhde chem dvigatsya dalshe.

Blagodarya novoy sile malchik smozhet puteshestvovat, reshat golovolomki i znakomitsya s potustoronnimi sozdaniyami, chto zhivut sredi teney. Действие игры происходит в далеком будущ:
Deystvie igry proiskhodit v dalekom budushchem, kogda chelovechestvo kolonizirovalo samye dalnie ugolki kosmosa. Syuzhet Morphite – eto istoriya Mirry Keyl, molodoy zhenshchiny, zhizn kotoroy rezko izmenilas, posle togo kak prostaya missiya v kosmose obernulas grandioznym mezhzvezdnym puteshestviem, otkryvshim ee tainstvennoe proshloe i svyaz s zhelannym veshchestvom pod nazvaniem Morfit.

Mirra budet puteshestvovat po samym dalekim ugolkam kosmosa i issledovat generiruemye na osnovanii protsedur planety, kazhdaya iz kotorykh imeet raznoobraznye peyzazhi i naselena ekzoticheskimi vidami zhivotnykh i rasteniy. S pomoshchyu skanera Mirra budet prodavat biologicheskuyu informatsiyu dlya priobreteniya uluchsheniy korablya, kostyuma i oruzhiya.

Puteshestvuya v korable Mirry, igroki smogut prinyat uchastie v sluchaynykh stolknoveniyakh i kosmicheskikh bitvakh v rezhime realnogo vremeni, torgovat s drugimi puteshestvennikami, borozdyashchimi galaktiku, i peremeshchatsya v otkrytom kosmose s pomoshchyu udobnoy sistemy zvezdnoy karty Morphite.
Baba Is You is a puzzle game where you c: Baba Is You is a puzzle game where you can change the rules by which you play. In every level, the rules are present as blocks you can interact with; by manipulating them, you can change how the level works and cause surprising, unexpected interactions! With some simple block-pushing you can turn yourself into a rock, turn patches of grass into dangerously hot obstacles, and even change the goal you need to reach to something entirely different.
Классика, которая произвела революцию в:
Klassika, kotoraya proizvela revolyutsiyu v rolevykh igrakh

Vernites v Mirtanu v roli bezymyannogo geroya v Gothic Classic, otmechennoy nagradami rolevoy igre, kotoraya sformirovala i vdokhnovila beschislennoe mnozhestvo rolevykh igr. Vpervye na Nintendo Switch.

Po vsemu korolevstvu Mirtana idet voyna. Ordy orkov vtorglis na territoriyu lyudey, i korolyu strany ponadobilos mnogo rudy, chtoby vykovat dostatochno oruzhiya, chtoby ego armiya mogla protivostoyat etoy ugroze. Tot, kto narushil zakon v eto mrachnoe vremya, byl prigovoren k otbyvaniyu nakazaniya v gigantskoy kolonii Khorinis, gde dobyvalas stol neobkhodimaya ruda.

Vsya territoriya, poluchivshaya nazvanie "Koloniya", okruzhena magicheskim barerom - sferoy diametrom dva kilometra, otgorazhivayushchey koloniyu ot vneshnego mira. Barer mozhno preodolet snaruzhi - no, okazavshis vnutri, nikto ne smozhet sbezhat. Barer okazalsya oboyudoostrym mechom - vskore zaklyuchennye vospolzovalis etoy vozmozhnostyu i podnyali vosstanie. Koloniya razdelilas na tri vrazhduyushchie gruppirovki, i korol byl vynuzhden ne prosto trebovat rudu, a vesti peregovory o ee poluchenii.

Vas brosayut cherez barer v etu tyurmu. Prizhavshis spinoy k stene, vy dolzhny vyzhivat i sozdavat izmenchivye alyansy, poka ne smozhete nakonets sbezhat.
Отправьтесь в фантастический мир и отомс:
Otpravtes v fantasticheskiy mir i otomstite vragam v igre DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Dark Prince. 

Psaro (Psaro) proklyat i ne mozhet prichinit vred nikomu, v chikh zhilakh techet krov monstrov. Teper emu nuzhno lovit chudovishch, chtoby sobrat armiyu dlya svoego pokhoda.

Psaro predstoit okhotitsya na groznykh monstrov v obshirnoy i raznoobraznoy Nadirii (Nadiria) s ee peremenchivoy pogodoy, potokami kipyashchey lavy, tainstvennymi drevnimi ruinami i paryashchimi sladkimi bashnyami. V svoi stranstviyakh Psaro vstretit dobruyu elfiyku Rouz (Rose), kotoraya pomozhet iskat emu vse bolee i bolee silnykh soldat.

Klyuch k uspekhu printsa lezhit v sinteze: iskusstve obedineniya monstrov dlya sozdaniya ikh bolee silnykh pokoleniy. S kazhdym novym tvoreniem Psaro na shag priblizhaetsya k svoey tseli - tronu povelitelya monstrov.
Отпразднуйте 25-летие серии DOOM с игрой:
Otprazdnuyte 25-letie serii DOOM s igroy DOOM 3, vpervye dostupnoy na konsolyakh Nintendo.

Panda Punch — платформер-головоломка, в:
Panda Punch — platformer-golovolomka, v kotoroy vam predstoit upravlyat bionicheskoy vooruzhennoy krasnoy pandoy i spasti mir ot zlykh inoplanetnykh robotov.

Po puti vy budete reshat golovolomki na urovnyakh, sobirat monety, iskat supermonety i povyshat svoi sposobnosti s pomoshchyu kuznetsa. Prigotovtes pobedit ustrashayushchikh bossov i poluchit novye innovatsionnye sposobnosti. 58 urovney napichkany lovushkami, sekretami i vragami, tak chto est chto issledovat i otkryvat.

Smozhete li vy ispolzovat svoi navyki, chtoby pomoch etoy krasnoy pande stat geroem?

Mado Monogatari (яп. 魔導物語 Мадо Моногатар:
Mado Monogatari (yap. 魔導物語 Mado Monogatari, doslovno — «Volshebnaya istoriya»), izvestnaya na Zapade kak Sorcery Saga — seriya igr v zhanre danzhen-krouler. Personazhi i mir igry legli v osnovu serii igr Puyo Puyo.
Devushka po imeni Fia, zhelaya postupit v Akademiyu, sovershaet dolgoe i trudnoe puteshestvie iz svoego rodnogo goroda, i ey udaetsya postupit blagodarya sobstvennoy udache. Teper ona izo vsekh sil staraetsya spravitsya so mnogimi trudnostyami, svyazannymi s uchyoboy, strogimi prepodavatelyami i tainstvennymi proisshestviyami, i vsyo eto radi dostizheniya svoey tseli - samoy stat Velikim magom, a takzhe podruzhitsya s drugimi uchenikami svoego klassa.
Otpravlyaytes v priklyuchenie vmeste s Fia i eyo odnoklassnikami, issleduyte tayny Akademii i raskroyte legendy o Velikom mage!..

Культовая ролевая игра, разработанная ам:
Kultovaya rolevaya igra, razrabotannaya amerikanskoy studiey Obsidian Entertainment i vypushchennaya kompaniey Atari dlya Microsoft Windows v 2006 godu. Deystvie Neverwinter Nights 2 proiskhodit v toy zhe vymyshlennoy vselennoy Forgotten Realms, a takzhe igra ispolzuet adaptirovannye pravila Dungeons & Dragons redaktsii 3.5. Igra rabotaet na graficheskom dvizhke Electron.
Mekhanika osnovana na redaktsii Dungeons & Dragons 3.5. Deystvie razvorachivaetsya v fenteziynom mire Forgotten Realms. Igrok imeet vozmozhnost izuchit razlichnye oblasti Faeruna, v tom chisle goroda, lesa i podzemelya. V samom nachale igry igroku predstoit sozdat svoego personazha, v sootvetstvii s pravilami Dungeons & Dragons, kotoryy vklyuchaet vybor rasy i klassa, s posleduyushchim prisvoeniem ochkov navykov. V igre est 12 bazovykh klassov. Po khodu razvitiya personazha otkryvaetsya dostup k mnozhestvu tak nazyvaemykh prestizhnykh klassov. Klassy mozhno kombinirovat v kolichestve do chetyryokh. Mozhno vklyuchit v gruppu do 5 sputnikov, sputnikov druidov i sledopytov, familyarov volshebnikov i koldunov i prochikh prizvannykh sushchestv. Dlya togo, chtoby vyyasnit istoriyu ili dobitsya loyalnosti NPC, neobkhodimo imet na nego dostatochno vliyaniya.
V osnove syuzhetnoy linii protivostoyanie gruppy iskateley priklyucheniy s igrokom vo glave i mogushchestvennogo drevnego sozdaniya po imeni Korol Teney. Geroy nachinaet priklyucheniya v malenkoy derevne na bolotakh — Zapadnoy Gavani, na kotoruyu napadayut sozdaniya iz vneshnikh mirov Gitiyanki i upravlyaemye imi duergary. Razobratsya v prichinakh etogo — pervonachalnaya tsel geroya..
Tyomnye sily snova ryshchut po Faerunu, razoryaya vse na svoem puti. Kak budto v poiske chego-to... chto vy uzhe nashli. Tolko vy, nositel oskolka, mozhete ostanovit Korolya Teney i ego armiyu i ne dat emu oskvernit vashi rodnye zemli. Udastsya li vam spasti Faerun, ili vy padete zhertvoy sobstvennoy zhazhdy vlasti? Sudba Zabytykh Korolevstv — v vashikh rukakh!
Eta samaya polnaya, prodvinutaya versiya dlya Nintendo Switch vozvrashchaet vas obratno v velikolepnyy Nevervinter i vklyuchaet v sebya vse vykhodivshie DLC:
«Стоун» — короткая интерактивная история: «Stoun» — korotkaya interaktivnaya istoriya ot tretego litsa dlya odnogo igroka, v kotoroy vy igraete za pokhmelnogo detektiva-koalu.
LOVERS IN A DANGEROUS SPACETIME — это бе:
LOVERS IN A DANGEROUS SPACETIME — eto bezumnyy kosmicheskiy shuter s vozmozhnostyu sovmestnogo prokhozhdeniya. Issleduyte yarkuyu galaktiku v svetyashchemsya neonovym svetom zvezdolete, v kotorom vam s partnerom pridetsya upravlyat turelyami, lazerami, shchitami i dvigatelem. Tolko skoordinirovannaya komandnaya rabota pozvolit vam pobedit zlobnye sily antilyubvi, spasti kosmozaek i izbezhat nepriyatnoy kosmicheskoy konchiny.

REZhIM SOVMESTNOGO PROKhOZhDENIYa
2-4 igrokam (ili odnomu igroku i vernomu kosmicheskomu pitomtsu pod upravleniem kompyutera) pridetsya rabotat soobshcha i upravlyat razlichnymi boevymi stantsiyami, ispolzuya to orudiya, to shchity ili dvigatel. Oba igroka budut vypolnyat ochen vazhnye roli — sudba vsego korablya budet na ikh plechakh.

ULUChShENIE KORABLEY
ishchite i sovmeshchayte moshchnye kosmicheskie kristally i izmenyayte osnashchenie svoego korablya. Kazhdyy kristall daet unikalnye sposobnosti, kotorye prigodyatsya vam vo mnogikh igrovykh situatsiyakh.

PROSTOE UPRAVLENIE, NEPROSTAYa IGRA
upravlyat kosmonavtom ochen legko, poetomu lyuboy smozhet srazu zhe pristupit k ispolneniyu svoikh obyazannostey. No vot nauchitsya rabotat v komande protiv galaktiki, polnoy zlykh robotov i sozvezdiy, budet vesma problematichno.

VSEGDA NOVYE UROVNI
urovni budut vsegda menyatsya, chto pozvolit igrokam kazhdyy raz poluchat sovershenno novye oshchushcheniya igry.

Добро пожаловать в зал VA-11!\n\nВ этом:
Dobro pozhalovat v zal VA-11!

V etom mire gospodstvuyut korporatsii, vsya chelovecheskaya zhizn zarazhena nanomashinami, prednaznachennymi dlya ikh ugneteniya, a uzhasayushchie Belye Rytsari garantiruyut, chto vse podchinyayutsya zakonam.

No eta istoriya ne o tekh lyudyakh.

Vy barmen v VA-11 Hall-A, laskovo prozvannyy "Valhalla". Khotya eto vsego lish nebolshoy bar v tsentre goroda Glitch-Siti, on privlekaet samykh interesnykh lyudey na etoy storone antiutopii. Derzhite svoikh klientov smazannymi, i vy budete znakomy s samymi interesnymi istoriyami.

Opyt VA-11 Hall-A predlagaet razvetvlennuyu syuzhetnuyu liniyu, v kotoroy vashi resheniya zavisyat ne ot traditsionnogo vybora, a ot napitkov, kotorye vy gotovite. Poznakomtes so svoimi klientami, ikh vkusami i prigotovte napitok, kotoryy izmenit ikh zhizn.

V techenie vsego etogo potustoronnego opyta vy mozhete nasladitsya legendarnym elektronnym saundtrekom Maykla «Garoada» Kelli, glyadya na vizualnye effekty, vdokhnovlennye starymi yaponskimi priklyuchencheskimi igrami dlya PC-98 s sovremennoy rastsvetkoy.
Downwell – это любопытная игра, в которо: Downwell – eto lyubopytnaya igra, v kotoroy otvazhnyy paren spuskaetsya v kolodets v poiskakh neslykhannykh sokrovishch. Dlya sobstvennoy zashchity u nego est tolko chudesnye 'pulemetnye butsy'. Ego zadacha spustitsya kak mozhno glubzhe vo tmu, kishashchuyu nedruzhelyubnymi sozdaniyami i polnuyu misticheskikh tayn, chtoby sobrat kak mozhno bolshe voskhititelnykh krasnykh kristallov, kotorymi usypany steny kolodtsa.
В космосе никто не услышит ваш крик — ни:
V kosmose nikto ne uslyshit vash krik — ni likuyushchiy, ni polnyy gorechi ili razocharovaniya. Chto zhe vy budete delat, pokoritel kosmosa, kogda na vas lyazhet gruz otvetstvennosti?
 
 SOZDAVAYTE PREKRASNOE ZRELIShchE
 Stroyte, peredelyvayte i dovodite svoyu stantsiyu do sovershenstva v [b]polnostyu tryokhmernom okruzhenii, sozdannom pri pomoshchi vpechatlyayushchikh vozmozhnostey Unreal Engine 4[/b]. Vrashchayte svoyo tvorenie na [b]360 gradusov[/b], priblizhayte i otdalyayte.
 Lyubuytes zavorazhivayushchimi sozvezdiyami, tumannostyami i planetami — razrabotchiki mnogo nedel provodili issledovaniya, pozvolyayushchie sozdat realistichnuyu vizualizatsiyu beskonechnogo neba.
 
 POLZUYTES ABSTRAKTNOY MODELYu
 Nastraivayte i kontroliruyte proizvodstvennye tsikly, dobychu resursov i ikh raspredelenie. [b]Sosredotochtes na effektivnosti ili obyome vyrabotki[/b], polzuyas vsemi dostupnymi pokazatelyami. [b]K vashim uslugam abstraktnaya proektsiya, vneshne napominayushchaya ustroystvo elektronnykh skhem[/b], kotoraya pomozhet vam nalazhivat svyazi mezhdu modulyami i postepenno prevrashchat stantsiyu v inzhenernoe chudo!
 
 EKONOMIKA, OShIBKI I NE TOLKO!
 [b]Unikalnaya ekonomicheskaya model[/b] brosaet vam glavnyy vyzov — sdelat stantsiyu effektivnoy i prinosyashchey dokhod ili poterpet neudachu!
 Privychnyy khod sobytiy mozhet prervatsya iz-za mnozhestva sobytiy: [b]ot khakerskikh atak do oshibok i sboev[/b], kotorye mogut proizoyti v lyubom iz moduley stantsii.
 K tomu zhe, izbytochnoe proizvodstvo mozhet privesti k peregruzke — poetomu tshchatelno planiruyte, razrabatyvayte i vypolnyayte zadumannoe!
 
 ISSLEDUYTE NEVIDANNYE MIRY
 Vy mozhete igrat v rezhime kampanii — ona sostoit iz [b]tryokh razlichnykh missiy[/b], v khode kotorykh vam nuzhno terraformirovat odnu iz planet, sdelav eyo prigodnoy dlya zhizni i dobychi resursov. 
 Kazhdaya iz etikh missiy obladaet sobstvennym syuzhetom i zastavit vas udelyat vnimanie dvum rezhimam obzora, chtoby [b]dobitsya postavlennykh zadach[/b] pri pomoshchi postroennoy stantsii.
 Sdelaete li vy stavku na maksimalnuyu effektivnost ili obyom vyrabotki? Ili zakhotite postroit stantsiyu iz samykh elegantnykh moduley? Lyuboy sposob khorosh, esli missiya vypolnena!
История этой ролевой игры вращается вокр:
Istoriya etoy rolevoy igry vrashchaetsya vokrug trekh personazhey: Tsiana, Elizy i Ksantis. Kak izbrannyy Voin Khaosa, Tsian (to est, Vy) v popytke izmenit svoyu sudbu budete vershit istoriyu!
U kazhdogo personazha imeetsya svoy familyar («Trigger»), Flam, Viz i Ray sootvetstvenno. Primechatelno, chto Viz budet ozvuchivat Ay Fayruz, golos Dzholin iz JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure, a sredi drugikh izvestnykh akterov ozvuchivaniya — Konomi Kokhara, Ryota Ivasaki i Siori Idzava.
Geympley vklyuchaet v sebya bazovye boi v ARPG v realnom vremeni i pozvolyaet igrokam pereklyuchatsya mezhdu raznymi personazhami, dostup k sisteme-kolesu vybora oruzhiya, gde vy smozhete svobodno pereklyuchatsya mezhdu nim, sposobnostyami i predmetami.
The Unholy Society, an award-winning adv:
The Unholy Society, an award-winning adventure game mixed with action elements, is the first part of BonBon's crazy adventures. Inspired by '80s and '90s movies, comic books, as well as everything else that fits into the categories of "iconic" and "pop culture", it takes a humorous look at usually not-so-humorous themes.

STORY:
The world as we know is about to change - the united forces of demons, gods, and monsters prepare for another deadly attempt to eradicate "the big guys" and change the religious status quo.

And, just perhaps, to drink lots of tea and discuss art in the meantime.

The only one who can stop them is Bonaventura Horowitz - a snarky exorcist, who isn't exactly an angel himself.

At the request of the Pope himself, Bon, accompanied by a group of his peculiar friends, sets off on a thrilling mission, leaving behind a trail of cigarette butts, empty whiskey bottles, and broken demonic hearts.

FEATURES:
• Quirky, fleshed out characters
• Unique story, inspired by all the good stuff from pop culture
• Comic-like aesthetics
• Engaging exorcism system
• Loads of sarcasm and humour
• Pope on speed dial

Scar of the Doll is an original psycho-s:
Scar of the Doll is an original psycho-suspense Visual Novel produced by Child-Dream in 1998, when became an exceptional hit. With its psychologically compelling horror elements and highly dramatic scenario, the game became a hot topic of discussion, including a feature in a mystery magazine, becoming a pioneer in the indie adventure genre.

[Remake on Nintendo Switch™]
-The main theme is "Tobu Yume wo Minai" by composer Hiroyuki Oshima and "Shonen" by composer Teruyasu Oishi. Popular BGM of the original work are remastered. 
-Additional content for the second half of the story has been added. In addition, a zapping scenario from different sub-character's points of view has been introduced. 
-All graphics, including characters and stills, have been renewed. 
-The horror elements can be turned on and off, so those who do not like horror can enjoy the game with comfort.

[Story]
The contact with her big sister who is studying at a graduate school in Tokyo has been cut off altogether. Becoming worried about her big sister, Asumi Kamijo, the younger sister of the two, decides to go to Tokyo to ascertain her safety. 
However, as she arrives there are no traces left of her big sister, not in her apartment and not in her laboratory. Asumi is at a loss. 

What in the world happened to her sister...? Asumi is determined to track down her big sister though she has no way of knowing what impending horrors will await her.
Shadow Blade is an action-platformer set:
Shadow Blade is an action-platformer set in a visually striking world where the ancient teachings of ninjas and samurai clash upon a modern landscape. Sprint through stages littered with traps, slaying enemies along your path without hesitation as Kuro, the blade of shadow!

Story

Darkness and chaos are once again creeping into the world of man. The covenant made in a time almost forgotten has failed, the three clans now in a violent struggle for dominance. The medallion is almost made whole again and it falls upon Kuro?s shoulders to restore balance. All his training has led up to this one moment, where the fate of the world will rest in his blood-stained hands.

Key Features

Epic NINJA Platforming: Test your skills in fast-paced platforming, mastering the skills of the ninja to breeze through challenging levels. 

Vicious NINJA Combat: Kill your enemies with extreme prejudice through the mastery of the katana, shurikens and kusarigama! 

Shadow Ninja: Attack the guards before they see you and alert all other mobs.

Story Campaign: Fully voiced motion comics tell the story of Kuro?s plight to restore balance!

More than 50 Challenging Levels: Environmental hazards, rifle-toting warriors and many more challenges await a hardened warrior.

Level Secrets: Raw speed doesn't guarantee the highest rank. A true ninja is ever vigilant, aware of any possibly hidden areas.

Ninja = Hardcore: Cleared the normal campaign? Prepare for the Hardcore variation and if you dare, the ultimate Master Class version awaiting only the foolhardy.
Tracks — это игра безграничных возможнос:
Tracks — eto igra bezgranichnykh vozmozhnostey, gde ty smozhesh postroit zheleznuyu dorogu s pomoshchyu mnozhestva razlichnykh instrumentov.
Okunis v ogromnyy mir pesochnitsy: prokladyvay zheleznye dorogi, stroy mosty i sozdavay miry, a zatem zaprygni v kabinu mashinista — tebe otkroetsya vid ot pervogo litsa.
Igray s uskoritelyami, sozdavay shou iz feyerverkov, sochinyay melodii i mnogoe-mnogoe drugoe.

Raskroy svoy tvorcheskiy potentsial

Nachni igru v zaranee sozdannoy obstanovke, bud to sovremennaya kvartira ili skazochnyy nochnoy zimniy mir, ili vyberi pustoe beskraynee prostranstvo, zhdushchee svoego tvortsa. Dobavlyay derevya i druguyu rastitelnost iz raznoobraznykh biomov, stroy zdaniya i stantsii, razmeshchay zhivotnykh, avtomobili, dekor i mnogoe drugoe. Sozdavay nepovtorimyy mir, nastraivaya tip poverkhnosti zemli, a takzhe tsvet neba i tumana. Priday individualnost svoemu poezdu s pomoshchyu uzorov i rastsvetok.

Postroy zheleznuyu dorogu svoey mechty

Pered toboy otkryvayutsya beschislennye vozmozhnosti dlya sozdaniya okruzhayushchey obstanovki dlya tvoey zheleznoy dorogi: ot beskrayney selskoy mestnosti do gorodov posredi pustyni, ot pryachushchikhsya v dymke tainstvennykh industrialnykh gorodov do yarkikh prazdnichnykh parkov attraktsionov. Tvoe voobrazhenie — eto vse, chto trebuetsya dlya sozdaniya zheleznoy dorogi tvoey mechty.
Tracks: Toybox Edition vklyuchaet v sebya Tracks Sci-Fi i Tracks Suburban.
Chickip Dancers (яп. チキップダンサーズ, Chikippu:

Великий Король Гочи объявил, что Фестива:

Igroku predstoit pomoch Printsu Tamakhiko prevratit Gorod Tamakhiko v ozhivlennoe mesto, dostoynoe vstretit festival. Igroki otkryvayut i razvivayut magaziny, vklyuchaya dyuzhinu razlichnykh magazinov, takikh kak Stomatolog i drugie vozvrashchayushchiesya klassicheskie magaziny, a takzhe novye magaziny, takie kak Chaynyy Magazin, Magazin Ochkov i drugie.
Sut igry: vam dostayotsya neskolko magazinov v gorode tamagochi, i nuzhno prinimat etikh pikselnykh zverushek, vypolnyat ikh zakazy i poputno reshat ikh problemy. Vsya aktivnost nuzhna, chtoby pomoch gorodu Tamakhiko vyigrat konkurs na provedenie festivalya.
Tut budet tselykh 12 tipov zavedeniy, vse s raznymi mini-igrami. Stante vladeltsem magazina v gorode Tamakhiko. Vzaimodeystvuyte s bolee chem 100 tamagochi, otkryvaya, nastraivaya i razvivaya bolee desyatka razlichnykh magazinov, a takzhe povyshayte svoyu reputatsiyu sredi nikh v gorode!Eshchyo tamagochi.
Лишь смелость и верный дробовик помогут:

UNIKALNYE BOSSY
Prigotovtes k razrusheniyam! Ogromnye zlobnye bossy prilozhat vse usiliya, chtoby ostanovit vas samymi kovarnymi sposobami. No ne vremya boyatsya. Zaday im, Flint!

BEZUMNYE VIDY ORUZhIYa
Pomenyayte obychnoe oruzhie na nechto bezbashennoe i smertelnoe, kroshite vragov, osedlav raketu i pomnite glavnoe — nikakoy poshchady!

EShchE BOLShE VESELYa
Narisovannye vruchnuyu lokatsii s unikalnymi detalyami i umoritelnymi «paskhalkami», bolee 30 vidov vragov s razlichnymi atakami, 15 muzykalnykh trekov, nezabyvaemaya atmosfera bezumiya i prekrasnaya Anzhelina v kontse puti.
Клаус очнулся в подвале, не имея понятия: Klaus ochnulsya v podvale, ne imeya ponyatiya ot tom, kto on i gde nakhoditsya. Edinstvennaya zatsepka — eto tatuirovka KLAUS na ego ruke. On vynuzhden bezhat iz mekhanicheskogo i konstruktivistskogo mira, v kotorom schitaet sebya uznikom. Life Goes On: Done to Death – трагикомич:

\"Woodsalt\" is an adventure game set on:
"Woodsalt" is an adventure game set on the planet of Nu-Terra, 1000 years after Earth was evacuated during chaotic natural disasters and an attack by giant creatures.

You control Emcy, an Earth born man who is awaken from stasis into a new city in a bubble as they wait for a signal to return back home, but not everybody is as eager to return as thought.

A civil unrest grows in the city with a conspiracy to keep humanity from leaving, all the while Emcy is plagued by visions and messages from an unknown voice that nobody else can see or hear.

Multiple endings, numerous side-plots with their own branching storylines that can affect the main plot and hidden secret endings to discover.

Guide Emcy though conversation trees and free roam, explore the city and speak with the inhabitants to discover the secrets behind what happened on Earth, what lead to their arrival on this new planet and the mystery of the strange watcher who has an unknown but keen interest in Emcy and his journey.

No s samogo nachala vsyo poshlo ne po planu: posle pribytiya v aeroport na Khuana napadayut neizvestnye lyudi, kotorye ranyat geroya, pokhishchayut Yu Tszyan i vybrasyvayut avtomobil s Khuanom v vodu. Lishivshis familnoy relikvii i pobyvav na volosok ot smerti, Khuan Li dolzhen budet proyti dolgiy put v poiskakh chesti, bogatstva i otmshcheniya v samom opasnom i moralno razlozhivshemsya gorode mira..
Grand Theft Auto: Chinatown Wars — izometricheskaya videoigra v zhanre action-adventure, desyatyy proekt v serii Grand Theft Auto, vyshedshiy 17 marta 2009 goda dlya portativnoy konsoli Nintendo DS, a pozdnee dlya PlayStation Portable, Android i iOS. Вдохновлённая в равной степени культовым:
Vdokhnovlyonnaya v ravnoy stepeni kultovym simulyatorom zhizni Stardew Valley, a takzhe klassicheskimi yokaynymi anime i mangoy, SpiriTTea rasskazyvaet o pisatele, kotoryy sbezhal v selskuyu mestnost, chtoby nayti vdokhnovenie dlya svoego sleduyushchego romana.
Odnako posle togo, kak glavnyy geroy sluchayno vypil iz starogo misticheskogo chaynika, on nachinaet videt, kak mir dukhov nakladyvaetsya na ego realnost. Vonyan, nadoedlivyy koshachiy dukh i vernyy provodnik, pokazyvaet pisatelyu dukhov, kotorye nuzhdaetsya v spasenii, i peredayot klyuchi ot staroy bani, kuda dukhi khodyat otdykhat.
I simulyator zhizni i upravlencheskaya igra: zhivite izo dnya v den, nakhodya mestnykh NPC i dukhov, kotorym mozhno pomoch. Vam zhdyot mnozhestvo mini-igr ot lovli zhukov do karaoke!
Kazhdyy dukh, kotoromu vy pomozhete, poyavitsya v bane, gde vy smozhete predlozhit emu polotentsa, soli, zakuski i prekrasnuyu goryachuyu vannu. Obnovlenie bani s pomoshchyu novoy mebeli, komnat i vann — klyuch k privlecheniyu samykh interesnykh personazhey, vklyuchaya neulovimykh dukhov-lordov!
В далеких горах штата Колорадо, внутри M:
V dalekikh gorakh shtata Kolorado, vnutri Mount Massive Asylum zhivet nastoyashchiy uzhas. Zabroshennuyu psikhiatricheskuyu lechebnitsu vosstanovilo «issledovatelsko-blagotvoritelnoe» krylo korporatsii Murkoff. V atmosfere strozhayshey sekretnosti lechebnitsa prodolzhala rabotat... do segodnyashnego dnya. Poluchiv anonimnoe poslanie, nezavisimyy zhurnalist Miles Upshur pronikaet na territoriyu bolnitsy, gde ego zhdet otkrytie: vse v Mount Massive podchineno neveroyatnomu sliyaniyu nauki i religii, estestvennogo i anomalnogo... I lish zhutkaya pravda, sokrytaya v samom serdtse Mount Massive, pozvolit zhurnalistu vybratsya iz zatocheniya.

Uznayte temnuyu istoriyu korporatsii Murkoff v dopolnenii Outlast: Whistleblower DLC. Vam predstoit okazatsya v roli Waylon Park, spetsialista po programmnomu obespecheniyu, rabotayushchego na Murkoff. Imenno on otpravil anonimnye soobshcheniya zhurnalistam po vsemu miru, odnim iz kotorykh byl Miles. Provedya neskolko nedel v Mount Massive, v techenie kotorykh on dazhe ne mog obshchatsya s zhenoy i synom, Waylon vyrabotal stoykoe otvrashchenie k korystnym uchenym i vracham, provodyashchim na patsientakh opasnye i bezotvetstvennye eksperimenty. Ponimaya uchast etikh neschastnykh, Waylon reshil povedat miru o tom, chto na samom dele tvoritsya v Mount Massive. Whistleblower rasskazhet nam o sobytiyakh, predshestvuyushchikh originalnoy istorii, a takzhe pozvolit uznat o poslednikh dnyakh psikhiatricheskoy lechebnitsy Mount Massive.

Outlast i dopolnenie Outlast: Whistleblower rasskazyvayut nastoyashchuyu istoriyu uzhasov, v kotoroy samye strashnye monstry zhivut v razume cheloveka. 

Osobennosti:
— Nastoyashchiy survival horror. U vas net oruzhiya, edinstvennyy sposob vyzhit v lechebnitse — pryatatsya ili bezhat.
— Realistichnaya grafika. Izuchayte pugayushchiy mir vo vsekh detalyakh blagodarya vysokokachestvennoy grafike.
— Pryachtes i probiraytes mimo vragov, ispolzuya elementy iz parkura.
— Nepredskazuemye vragi. Vy nikogda ne znaete, kogda i otkuda poyavitsya odin iz zhutkikh obitateley lechebnitsy.
— Realistichnaya istoriya. Mesto deystviya i geroi v Outlast vzyaty iz realnykh lechebnits i ugolovnykh del.

Popav v nemilost mestnoy administratsii, Vas i eshche neskolkikh «schastlivchikov» otpravili na vernuyu sme... missiyu iskupleniya! Sumeete li vy dobratsya do samogo serdtsa Gigakhrushchyovki, ne dav etoy rzhavoy posudine sozhrat vas?
Eto zdanie rasplastalos na beskonechnye kilometry v shir i glub, a ego koridory napolneny anomaliyami i smertelnymi lovushkami. Tshchatelno podbirayte etazhi, na kotorykh khotite ostanovitsya, chtoby ne popast vprosak. Vsyo proiskhodit v prekrasnom settinge Samosbora, osnovannom na odnoimyonnoy kripipaste: zhanre internet-folklora, predstavlyayushchem soboy teksty, tsel kotorykh — napugat chitatelya, eto mogut byt anonimnye istorii ili avtorskie rasskazy. Geympley — lift, zhivoy mekhanizm, kotoryy pitaetsya plotyu i naydennymi shesternyami..
Nikto i nikogda ne rasskazhet podrobnosti etogo zagadochnogo sobytiya, periodicheski proiskhodyashchego na etazhakh. Pochemu? Potomu chto ni odin iz svideteley ne ostalsya v zhivykh. Vozmozhno, imenno vam udastsya vzglyanut na posledstviya Samosbora khotya by odnim glazkom?..
