On the edge of Terran space lies Halcyon:
On the edge of Terran space lies Halcyon 6, a derelict starbase left behind by a mysterious precursor race. Your mission is to reclaim the derelict station and rebuild it.
A mysterious alien force is making a beeline towards Earth and this starbase is the best chance for the New Terran Federation to establish new alliances, research new technologies and otherwise figure out a way to stop the impending invasion.

Using only the resources you can salvage from the derelict station and gathered from nearby star systems, it’s up to you to rebuild the starbase to lead the Terran Republic’s scientific research, exploration and diplomatic efforts on the edge of known space.

Features:
- Base Building: spend resources to build station facilities (rooms) to enhance your production and technological capabilities, or build ships to help you control more territory
- Exploration: assign your fleets to nearby star clusters, where they can handle emerging enemy threats, do missions for alien factions or secure bonus resources
- Crew Management: assign crew to station facilities to greatly improve their output efficiency, or to ships where they can contribute in unique ways to combat, missions and events
- Deep Tactical Combat: fight tactical ship or ground battles to resolve hostile events, create a foothold in the sector and ultimately defeat the enemy mothership!
- Story Events: based on game criteria like rooms-built, alien diplomacy scores or officer traits/skills, the game will produce story events (often with multiple choice outcomes) that can lead to combat, time-related applied bonuses/negatives, officer attribute changes or any number of crazy in-game stories.

\"an experience everyone should play thr:
"an experience everyone should play through at least once" - Nintendo World Report

Meet fascinating characters on your quest to complete the imperfect Circle. New partners bring unique abilities and their own personality to roll with...
In this 3-5 hours adventure, full of ups and downs but always playful and rewarding, the Circle learns about itself and you, along with it.

• "The perfect mix of platform-puzzling goodness, and deep, profound story-telling." Cubed3

• “It is a minimalist romantic tale that plumbs the depth of human emotion, examining angst and anxiety and impermanence. For a game populated by talking trees, circles and balloons, it depicts a universally human story in a genuinely lovely way.” Pure Nintendo

• “Visually, the game is simple yet striking. The clever use of the minimal color palette makes for stunning environments that are both varied and memorable.” COGconnected

• “Journey of the Broken Circle is a unique and special type of game.” Nintendo World Report

DEVELOPED BY Lovable Hat Cult
“It’s a game about this little something that always seems to be missing…a better job, a nicer place to live, an ideal relationship… We wanted to tell a story of self-discovery in a fun, universal and relatable way. We probably also wanted to answer our own questions: would the Circle find what it was looking for? Or how would it all end?” - Andrea & Patrick from the Copenhagen-based studio.

PUBLISHED BY Nakana.io
“We gather games that share a strong experience to remember. We hope you’ll enjoy the sweet and tasteful food for thought served by Journey of the Broken Circle!” - Mikaël Bourget, founder of the publishing label.

With the dawn of the internet the digita:
With the dawn of the internet the digital universe experienced exponential growth. The citizens basked in their new wealth and power, with access to previously unimaginable knowledge. For a while it seemed as if anything was possible.

This golden age did not last. Knowledge became corrupt, much of it was lies dressed up as truth. Fear, paranoia and hate infected the world with Programs becoming jealous of the resources allocated to others. Throughout this turmoil the real threat went by unseen.

A silent invader watched and waited, planning its attack. The war that followed was brief and devastating. Now there is but one hope. A hero must reboot the system, to turn it "Off And On Again" resetting time to before the corruption ever began. Are you that Hero?

Off And On Again tells the story of a hero tasked with rebooting time. The game world is created and destroyed during play, with the hero having the ability to turn parts of the world off and on again. You will be required to use both brains and skill to overcome the enemies and obstacles in your path.

Добро пожаловать в Bahlam — затонувший г:
Dobro pozhalovat v Bahlam — zatonuvshiy gorod drevnikh bogov v yuzhnoy chasti Atlanticheskogo okeana. Perezhiv zhutkoe korablekrushenie, Nikolay Bernstein — morskoy arkheolog i avantyurist — prikhodit v sebya na glubine 11 000 metrov nizhe urovnya morya. On tyazhelo ranen i ne po svoey vole okazyvaetsya soedinen so sverkhestestvennoy sistemoy-kompanonom. Pytayas raskryt tayny proiskhodyashchego, nash geroy nachinaet issledovat zateryannyy gorod, postepenno osoznavaya, chto za kazhdym ego shagom nablyudaet nechto nevidannoe i zloveshchee.


ZNAKOMTES: WOZAN
Na puti domoy vas zhdet vstrecha s rudokopami iz mirnogo plemeni Wozan — oni boyatsya drevnikh bogov i mechtayut vernutsya na poverkhnost s tekh samykh por, kak ikh predkov porabotili 5000 let nazad. Nekotorye iz nikh smogli bezhat ot svoikh pleniteley i osnovat taynye kolonii v glubine zatonuvshikh ruin, drugie zhe po-prezhnemu vynuzhdeny stradat pod gnetom zlobnykh vrazhdebnykh sushchestv, zakhvativshikh gorod posle vnezapnogo ischeznoveniya drevnikh bogov.


OTKRYTYY MIR
Vas zhdet po-nastoyashchemu nelineynyy igrovoy protsess v zhanre metroidvaniya, pyat razlichnykh igrovykh oblastey so mnozhestvom golovolomok i lovushek, stychki s groznymi bossami, a takzhe plennye sushchestva Wozan, kotorykh vam predstoit osvobodit. Vasha sistema-kompanon postepenno nanosit proydennye uchastki na kartu, a ee poleznye sposobnosti — vzlom, skanirovanie mestnosti i telekinez — pomogayut vam upravlyat okruzheniem.


TEKhNOLOGII I NAVYKI
Issleduyte Bahlam kak khotite — karabkaytes, polzayte i nyryayte bez kakikh-libo ogranicheniy. Po mere prodvizheniya vy smozhete nayti drevnee oruzhie, uluchsheniya dlya vashego kostyuma i protokoly vzloma dlya droida — vashi vozmozhnosti budut postoyanno rasshiryatsya. Vse snaryazhenie v igre tshchatelno sbalansirovano, i dlya preodoleniya tekh ili inykh opasnostey ili golovolomok vam pridetsya gramotno ego ispolzovat.


LOKALNAYa KOOPERATIVNAYa IGRA
V rezhime kooperativnoy igry vy smozhete issledovat drevnie glubiny vmeste s drugom, kotoryy vozmet pod svoe upravlenie neuyazvimuyu sistemu-kompanona. Pomogayte drug drugu, reshayte golovolomki i vyrvites iz polnogo opasnostey goroda Bahlam. Etot rezhim takzhe predostavlyaet unikalnuyu vozmozhnost dlya komandnogo skorostnogo prokhozhdeniya igry.

Build a loyal band of followers and surv:
Build a loyal band of followers and survive the journey across a broken world. Barely.

Take on the role of a powerful leader and mystic. Empowered with the gifts of technopathy, the ability to sense and affect electrical currents. 

You are the last hope to a band of outcastes and refugees. Lead them across the randomly generated wastelands. Pick fights with greedy slavers and crazy machines using the turn-based card combat. Can you survive long enough to reach the mysterious Crypt?

- Card-based tactical combat system
- New procedurally generated maps each game
- Find loot and recruit followers to build your deck 
- Unlock new content across multiple playthroughs
- More than 300 cards for you to discover
- Indian infused electronica soundtrack

Nowhere Prophet is a single-player card game with procedurally generated maps, high difficulty and permadeath. At its heart are two distinct parts of gameplay: Travel and combat.

During travel you navigate across a procedurally generated map. Make sure your convoy has enough resources to travel as you pick your route. On your journey you will encounter strange places and even stranger people. You will be thrust into situations that put the fate of your followers in your hands. 

If you're lucky enough to gain some rewards, maybe for helping someone - or robbing them, then you can invest those to improve your decks. Recruit more followers to have more and different units to put into battle. Equip your prophet or level up and learn new skills to have access to stronger action cards in combat.

You will have to overcome some enemies to keep your convoy and resources together. And sometimes you may even want to pick a fight for righteousness or just for loot. Once in battle the game changes to the turn-based card game mode. 

Play convoy cards to put your followers onto the field and position them so you can overcome your enemy. Or play action cards to dramatically change the battlefield. But be careful: If you're wounded you will have to find a safe place to heal. And if one of your followers takes too many wounds, they are lost forever.

Nowhere Prophet is set on a far off planet called Soma. Your story begins many years after the Crash, a complete technological collapse. Civilization has broken down and the lack of resources made everyone turn either bandit or madman.

In this world inspired by Indian culture, you lead a convoy of outcastes. These desperate men and woman following your vision of a better future. Under your guidance, they travel with you through the wastelands. Your goal is the Crypt, a mystical place that promises untainted technology and safety. 

If you can survive long enough to find it.

Gameplay in a nutshell:
- You are a cultist intent on destroying the universe by summoning the Ancient One. 
- You can play on your own or with up to 3 friends in couch co-op.
- You have 6 rounds to build up the required stats needed to use the ritual items, but you will need to figure out which stats those are through some trial and error.
- You can visit 1 location per round and attempt the Lovecraftian stories at that location, to improve your stats.
- Finally, put your stats to the test as you try to summon the Ancient One.
- Will everyone pass or fail or will one of you betray the rest and grab all the glory?

Ogre — eto poshagovaya strategiya o vysokotekhnologichnoy voyne, v kotoroy vam nuzhno budet proyavit navyki taktiki i strategicheskoe myshlenie. Eto ofitsialnaya adaptatsiya legendarnogo nastolnogo vargeyma ot kompanii Steve Jackson Games, razrabotannaya otmechennoy nagradami studiey Auroch Digital.
Na polyakh srazheniy blizhayshego budushchego nemalo opasnoy tekhniki, no est boevaya edinitsa, ot kotoroy predpochitayut derzhatsya na bezopasnoy distantsii dazhe soyuzniki. I nazyvaetsya ona «Ogr». Eti tanki pod upravleniem II nastolko opasny, chto kazhdyy sposoben zamenit tselyy batalon obychnykh tankov i pekhoty.
V beskonechnoy mirovoy voyne srazhaetsya samaya raznaya tekhnika: mashiny na vozdushnoy podushke, tanki, morpekhi, obychnaya pekhota i chudovishchnye «Ogry». Vam predstoit vzyat komandovanie na sebya i zavoevat gospodstvo na izedennykh radiatsiey polyakh voyny budushchego.
Подросток, способный оживить любой труп,:
Podrostok, sposobnyy ozhivit lyuboy trup, kotorogo on kasaetsya, okazyvaetsya vovlechennym v drugoe delo ob ubiystve, kogda vladelets solidnoy korporatsii umiraet pri zagadochnykh obstoyatelstvakh.

Odnako na etot raz on vynuzhden obedinitsya s gruppoy detishek s takimi zhe strannymi sposobnostyami, kak i ego sobstvennye. K sozhaleniyu, ego novye tovarishchi po komande mogut byt bolee opasnymi, chem ubiytsa, na kotorogo oni okhotyatsya.

Kazhdomu est chto skryvat, a proshloe nikogda ne ostaetsya skrytym nadolgo. Doprashivayte podozrevaemykh, issleduyte dom bogatogo pokoynika i raskryvayte sekrety drugikh, pytayas skryt svoi sobstvennye.


Kharakteristiki

* Razgadayte taynu
* Potryasayushchaya grafika v stile anime
* Polnaya ozvuchka na angliyskom yazyke
* Originalnaya muzyka

Tomoyo priezzhaet na plyazhnyy kurort svoey babushki Umi v nadezhde otlichno provesti leto, nakonets zabyt o proshlom i izmenit svoyu zhizn k luchshemu.

Odnako, kak vsegda, chto-to idet ne tak…
Pokhozhe, chto letnie kanikuly poshli ko dnu, tak i ne uspev nachatsya.

«Undertale Yellow» — неофициальный фанат:
«Undertale Yellow» — neofitsialnyy fanatskiy rolevoy prikvel k Undertale, vypushchennyy na sots. platforme Game Jolt dlya Microsoft Windows PK 9-go dekabrya 2023 goda, razrabotannyy komandoy Team Undertale Yellow, i rasskazyvaet o rebyonke po imeni Klover (Klever), obladayushchem zhyoltoy dushoy iz Undertale, kotoryy otpravlyaetsya v neznakomoe puteshestvie na poverkhnost posle popadaniya v podzemnyy mir, naselyonnyy monstrami. Igra poluchila polozhitelnye otzyvy.
Vo vremya srazheniy igrok upravlyaet serdtsem, predstavlyayushchim dushu cheloveka, uklonyayas ot atak protivnikov v stile bullet hell. V otlichie ot Undertale, tsvet dushi ne menyaetsya po mere prokhozhdeniya igry. Odnako nekotorye srazheniya s bossami vvodyat mekhaniki, izmenyayushchie dvizhenie, sposobnosti i vneshniy vid dushi. Deystvie Undertale Yellow razvorachivaetsya v mire Undertale, gde monstry byli zaklyucheny pod goroy Ebott magicheskim zaklinaniem posle porazheniya v voyne protiv lyudey. Spustya mnogo let korol monstrov Azgor sobral pyat iz semi chelovecheskikh dush, neobkhodimykh dlya razrusheniya barera, otdelyayushchego Podzemele ot poverkhnosti. Istoriya sleduet za rebyonkom po imeni Klover, voploshchayushchim chertu «spravedlivosti», kotoryy otpravlyaetsya v Podzemele, chtoby rassledovat ischeznovenie pyati lyudey.Igry Undertale i Deltarune sm. tam.

На протяжении сотен лет Горные шаманы ис:
Na protyazhenii soten let Gornye shamany ispolzovali sily Astralnoy proektsii dlya puteshestviy na ogromnye rasstoyaniya. No Mey otlichaetsya ot drugikh: eyo svyazyvayut puty, ogranichivayushchie stranstviya dushi. Kogda prikhodit vremya sovershit palomnichestvo kak obryad vzrosleniya, Mey vynuzhdena otkazatsya ot polyota i otpravitsya v dolgiy put.
Prisoedinyaytes k Mey v ee neprostom ispytanii i pomogite ey proyti slozhnyy, no uvlekatelnyy put, preodolevaya prepyatstviya, otdelyayushchie vas ot tseli. Osvoyte sem raznykh Aza — umeniy, menyayushchikh vzaimodeystvie vashego dukha s okruzhayushchim mirom. Ishchite sekrety, sokrovishcha i skrytye tropy — i vashe lyubopytstvo budet voznagrazhdeno!
Trogatelnyy, i v to zhe vremya slozhnyy platformer na tochnost. Ispolzuyte sily Astralnoy proektsii, chtoby sovershit opasnoe palomnichestvo i povzroslet. Osvoyte tonkosti upravleniya, proydite ispytaniya i pozvolte svoey dushi dovesti vas do kontsa puti. Pomogite Mey proyti put vzrosleniya v etom trogatelnom platformere na tochnost, kotoryy podoydet i novichkam, i tem, kto lyubit slozhnye ispytaniya.
Door Kickers: Action Squad — это сумасше:
Door Kickers: Action Squad — eto sumasshedshiy oldskulnyy 2D-ekshn, kotoryy dayot vam vozmozhnost primerit na sebya rol operativnika SWAT i otpravlyaet v samuyu gushchu sobytiy i na borbu s plokhimi parnyami v Nouer-Siti, SShA.

Vybirayte snaryazhenie, vybivayte dveri i budte gotovy ko vsemu. Adaptiruytes i molnienosno reagiruyte na proiskhodyashchee, a esli ponadobitsya — smelo perezapuskayte uroven i probuyte novuyu strategiyu. Sderzhivayte otdachu i rasschityvayte vremya perezaryadki, ispolzuyte distantsiyu i ukrytiya, chtoby poluchit preimushchestvo, i ne zabyvayte pro takticheskuyu podderzhku, chtoby popolnit zdorove i amunitsiyu, a takzhe podumayte, nuzhno li spasti vashego neputyovogo naparnika. Kopite zarabotannye ochki, chtoby ispolzovat osobuyu sposobnost i vikhrem pronestis cherez slozhnuyu poslednyuyu komnatu.

Esli stanet slishkom slozhno, mozhno pozvat na pomoshch druga!

Osobennosti igry
• Vysoko detalizirovannaya retro-grafika.

• Vozmozhnost lokalnogo i setevogo kooperativnogo     prokhozhdeniya.
В игре BATTLESTAR GALACTICA Deadlock™ вы:
V igre BATTLESTAR GALACTICA Deadlock™ vy okazhetes v tsentre sobytiy Pervoy voyny s Saylonami, v kotoroy vam pridetsya proyavit vse svoi takticheskie sposobnosti.

American Fugitive — классический экшн с:
American Fugitive — klassicheskiy ekshn s otkrytym mirom i izometricheskim vidom. 

V tikhom gorodke Redrok kipit prestupnaya zhizn.
Vy — Uill Rayli. Ne angel, no i ne ubiytsa. Posle obvineniya v khladnokrovnom ubiystve ottsa vas perepolnyaet skorb i zhazhda mesti. Vy sbegaete, chtoby nayti vinovnogo.

Na vole vam predstoit smeshatsya s tolpoy i naladit svyazi s prestupnym mirom, ostavayas na shag vperedi politsii.

Deystvie igry, napolnennoy nostalgiey po filmam i igram proshlogo, proiskhodit na yuge strany v 1980-e.

Vremya rabotaet protiv vas, a PRAVOSUDIE NE VSEGDA ZAKONNO.

OSNOVNYE OSOBENNOSTI:

⯈ KLASSIChESKIY EKShN V SOVREMENNOY OBRABOTKE. Vas zhdet boynya v izometricheskom vide, velikolepnaya trekhmernaya grafika, razrushaemoe okruzhenie, volnuyushchiy syuzhet i grandioznye pogoni na avtomobilyakh.

⯈ POLNOTsENNYY EKShN NA OSNOVE ORIGINALNOGO STsENARIYa. Vy raskroete tayny, stolknetes s obmanom i korystyu, pogruzites v peripetii i povoroty syuzheta, vstretite pravonarushiteley i pravozashchitnikov vsekh mastey.

⯈ ZAVORAZhIVAYuShchIY OTKRYTYY MIR. Peredvigaytes peshkom ili na kolesakh po okrugu Redrok, naslazhdayas prekrasnym obrazchikom amerikanskogo gorodka iz 80-kh. 

⯈ ShANS POZhIT KAK PRESTUPNIK. Grabte doma, ugonyayte mashiny, vooruzhaytes do zubov. Tolko ne popadites!

⯈ TRENIROVKA NAVYKOV VOZhDENIYa. Pedal v pol! Ispytayte sebya v gonkakh i tryukakh, otmechennykh dlya prokhozhdeniya po vsemu miru, na lyubom iz mnozhestva dostupnykh vidov transporta.

⯈ MNOGOOBRAZIE ZANYaTIY. Sokhranyayte bditelnost vsegda: vypolnyaya zadaniya ot kriminalnykh avtoritetov, razyskivaya tayniki, obchishchaya doma i magaziny ili sbyvaya proizvedeniya iskusstva. Prodazhnye kopy poydut na vse, lish by snova upech vas za reshetku!
Абсурдный экшн-платформер, которая очару:
Absurdnyy ekshn-platformer, kotoraya ocharuet vas svoim lyogkim vaybom, a zatem osharashit neozhidannoy slozhnostyu. Vy mnogo raz popadyotes v lovushki bashni i stanete zhertvoy eyo chudovishch, prezhde chem sumeete vybratsya naruzhu, v derevnyu, i tam nakonets sokhranit svoy progress.
Otpravtes v puteshestvie vmeste s chertovski obayatelnym i obvorozhitelno samovlyublyonnym rytsarem Fon Vanstom, kotoryy ugodil v zagadochnuyu bashnyu bez shtanov, bez oruzhiya i bez malo-malskogo plana pobega. K schastyu, predostavit pomoshch i dopolnitelnuyu uboynuyu silu emu gotovy zabavnye sputniki. V etoy igre kazhdyy zabeg tsenen: posle smerti Vanst budet perenositsya obratno na verkhushku sluchayno generiruemoy bashni i nachinat vsyo zanovo.
Poprobuyte sbezhat iz uzhasnoy, zhutko smeshnoy i verolomno menyayushcheysya bashni v multyashnom priklyuchenii dlya geroyskikh geroev s neshutochnym chuvstvom yumora! «Lucky Tower Ultimate» pooshchryaet improvizatsiyu i umenie uchitsya na oshibkakh. Eksperimentiruyte s golovolomkami i protivnikami, a takzhe zapominayte khitrosti bashni, esli khotite vyzhit.
Super Lone Survivor is a remake of the o:
Super Lone Survivor is a remake of the original game with extra content and features, rebuilt in a new engine. There's improved lighting and shaders and additional layers of parallax scrolling. The game contains a new 4:3 presentation option and the original art has been extended in height to support this taller aspect ratio.

There is new content exclusive to the game, a number of hidden areas, two new sidequests, new foods to craft, secret endings, new enemy types and new combat tools. There are also now difficulty settings. The game includes remastered audio in higher quality, and many new songs.

For new players, or those who want to delve deeper into the world of Lone Survivor.

Otpravtes v epicheskoe puteshestvie po shesti velikolepnym narisovannym vruchnuyu lokatsiyam, kazhdaya iz kotorykh svyazana zakhvatyvayushchey istoriey, rasskazannoy cherez katstseny i vnutriigrovye dialogi. Razblokiruyte novykh personazhey, oruzhie i otkroyte put k Beskonechnoy arene!
Скерская дева — это игра-«ужастик» в сти:
Skerskaya deva — eto igra-«uzhastik» v stile vyzhivaniya ot pervogo litsa, deystvie kotoroy proiskhodit v udalennom ot tsivilizatsii otele s krovavoy i zhutkoy istoriey, pozaimstvovannoy iz britanskogo folklora. Vooruzhivshis tolko zashchitnym zvukovym ustroystvom, vy budete ispolzovat taktiku stels, chtoby izbezhat smerti sredi kulta vragov II, osnovannykh na zvuke.

Ideya igry, deystvie kotoroy proiskhodit v 1898 godu, naveyana budorazhashchim uelskim rasskazom Elizabet Uilyams. Eto istoriya semeynoy imperii, dvizhimoy pytkami, rabstvom, piratstvom i sverkhestestvennymi taynami, kotorye tsaryat na territorii otelya.

-	3D-sistema II, osnovannaya na zvuke, kak osnovnoy mekhanizm vyzhivaniya
-	Sliyanie psikhologicheskogo, goticheskogo i britanskogo uzhasov
-	Realistichnye vizualnye effekty, zakhvatyvayushchaya okruzhayushchaya sreda i zhutkaya atmosfera
-	Znamenitye uelskie gimny v ispolnenii Tii Kalmaru, ot golosa kotoroy probiraet drozh
-	Novaya interpretatsiya uelskoy narodnoy pesni «Y Ferch o'r Sger» («Skerskaya deva»)

Shipped is an adorable party game where:
Shipped is an adorable party game where up to 8 players compete in sea skirmishes. Choose your favorite girl and navigate the sea. Your ship can’t break, so first learn how to maneuver. With simple controls, it’s easy to start but hard to master.

To win, you must push your opponents to crash on land or out of the screen. Or just shoot them. To do that, grab ammo crates. If you’re out of cannonballs, use your cannon and blow air to push enemies or deflect incoming fire. Remember to keep up with the movement of the camera - if your ship goes off-screen, it will instantly explode!

With five different modes, you’ll never get bored playing Shipped. If you’re short on friends to play, you can always add AI-controlled players or try the challenging single-player arcade mode. 

Features: 

Local multiplayer for 2-8 players.
Arcade single-player mode or AI-controlled players for solo play.
Five different game modes: Cruise, Chase, Race, Yincana, Sumo.
Fun and straightforward mechanics. 
Lovely characters, colorful graphics, and a pleasant soundtrack. 
Over 95% positive reviews from PC players!
OmegaBot – напряженный экшн-сайдскроллер:
OmegaBot – napryazhennyy ekshn-saydskroller s neprostymi bossami-robotami. Igraya za OmegaBota, dobyvayte moshchnoe oruzhie i prolozhite im sebe dorogu v razrushennom mire, polnom smertonosnykh mashin. V OmegaBot, lishitsya energii – znachit umeret.

A esli risknete soyti s protorennykh dorozhek, to smozhete nayti raznye sekrety i dazhe druzey, kotorye pomogut vam snyat proklyatie, porazivshee eti zemli.

Вы — первоклассный дровосек? Правда?.. З:
Vy — pervoklassnyy drovosek? Pravda?.. Zaydite v tsifrovoy les i proverte eto!.. Otkroyte klassicheskuyu igru v etoy versii dlya Nintendo Switch. Rubite deverya, sorevnuytes s druzyami i stante samym drovosekovym drovsekom!..
Timberman vklyuchaet ispytaniya dlya odnogo igroka, gde vy mozhete ispytat svoi umeniya i otkryt 56 personazhey, a takzhe lokalnye rezhimy dlya igry s druzyami! Khvatayte topor i rubite derevya v trekh unikalnykh igrovykh rezhimakh:
Lyubimaya versiya shutera nomer 1 v mire!.. Igra «Counter-Strike: Source» sochetaet v sebe triumfalnuyu komandnuyu slazhennost «Counter-Strike» s peredovoy tekhnologiey dvizhka Source. Obladayushchiy sootvetstvuyushchey poslednim dostizheniyam tekhnicheskoy mysli grafikoy, polnostyu obnovlennym zvukom i realnoy fizikoy, «Counter-Strike: Source» prosto dolzhen zanyat pochetnoe mesto v kollektsii kazhdogo poklonnika zhanra «ekshen».
Kak i v originalnoy versii igry, v Counter-Strike: Source drug drugu protivostoyat komanda kontr-terroristov (CT, spetsnaza) i komanda terroristov (T) v serii raundov. Kazhdyy raund vyigryvaetsya posredstvom vypolneniya opredelyonnoy missii, takoy kak podryv bomby ili spasenie zalozhnikov, libo posle unichtozheniya vsekh chlenov vrazheskoy komandy. Igrovoy protsess analogichen takovomu v Counter-Strike. Bolshinstvo vidov oruzhiya takzhe identichno Counter-Strike za isklyucheniem shchita, kotoryy byl dostupen tolko kontr-terroristam.Counter-Strike 1.6 (na Xash3D) sm. zdes.
Inspector Waffles was hoping his worst d:
Inspector Waffles was hoping his worst days were behind him, but the murder of a high-profile industrialist CEO beloved by the citizens of Cat Town raises new questions and fears.

Being the best inspector on the CTPD, Waffles has no choice: he's gotta push past the painful memories, don his well-worn overcoat, and prepare to get his paws dirty.

A detective story reminiscent of the old school classics, Inspector Waffles provides plenty of peculiar mystery, a story full of intrigue, and a slew of characters to interrogate, all wrapped into beautifully simple pixel-art. Will you be able to sniff out every clue and nab the murderer?

A REAL TREAT, SEE?
* A brilliant feline detective in a world full of anthropomorphic cats, dogs, and maybe other species. It’s pixel-animal madness, I tell ya.
* A beautiful jazzy soundtrack, full of notes and music and harmony pleasing to your ears and brain.
* Chock full of dry humor and puns about cats and dogs. Seriously, I couldn’t think of any more puns to include. The pun supply is exhausted.
Вы — экскурсовод новейшего магического п: Vy — ekskursovod noveyshego magicheskogo parka razvlecheniy, i vasha zadacha — pomoch 20 unikalnym gostyam vyzhit sredi mnozhestva monstrov-maskotov i v razlichnykh smertelno opasnykh podzemelyakh. Pomogayte svoey komande iz 4 geroev — vybirayte dlya nikh strategi, remontiruyte oruzhie i ne dayte im pogibnut! Eta ekstsentrichnaya istoriya o printsesse, rabotnikakh po sovmestitelstvu i pikselnykh chelovechkakh podarit vam nezabyvaemye vpechatleniya... za svoyu tsenu.
Мама куда-то ушла, и крошечному мышонку: Mama kuda-to ushla, i kroshechnomu myshonku pridetsya provesti vykhodnye doma v kompanii neadekvatnogo ottsa. Emu nuzhno vesti sebya khorosho, inache PAPA razozlitsya..
Matchpoint: Tennis Championships — это с:
Matchpoint: Tennis Championships — eto sovremennaya igra o tennise, kotoraya pozvolyaet perezhit priblizhennyy k realnosti opyt tennisnoy igry na korte. V igre est gluboko prorabotannyy rezhim karery i unikalnaya sistema sopernikov.

Igra fokusiruetsya na takticheskom realizme, pozitsionirovanii i pritselivanii, blagodarya chemu igrok smozhet prodvigat svoyu superzvezdu v pravilnom napravlenii, maksimalno effektivno ispolzuya udary.

LEGENDS EDITION vklyuchaet polnuyu versiyu igry MATCHPOINT - TENNIS CHAMPIONSHIPS i eksklyuzivnoe DLC LEGENDS, v kotorom predstavleny dva dopolnitelnykh igroka - legendy tennisa Tommi Khaas i Tim Khenman.

 – Sozdayte sobstvennuyu zvezdu tennisa v 3D. Vybirayte obraz, naryad i igrovoy stil blagodarya tselomu naboru nastroek, vklyuchaya realno sushchestvuyushchie tekhniki: udar levoy ili pravoy rukoy, odnoruchnyy ili dvuruchnyy bekkhend.

 – Oderzhivayte pobedy na korte, stav professionalnym igrokom v tennis.V igre Matchpoint — Tennis Championships vy vstretite 16 deystvuyushchikh zvezd mezhdunarodnogo tennisa, vklyuchaya Nika Kirosa, Keya Nisikori i  Amandu Anisimovu.

 – Nastroyte svoego sportsmena i dobavte aksessuary. V igre est mnozhestvo predmetov — ot raketok do odezhdy — ot takikh proizvoditeley tennisnoy produktsii, kak Babolat, YONEX, HEAD i mnogikh drugikh. Razblokiruyte osoboe snaryazhenie, vyigryvaya sostyazatelnye matchi.

 – Osvoyte vse tipy udarov v stile bolshikh turnirov. Opredelite rezultat obmena udarami zaranee, vybrav luchshuyu tekhniku: kruchenyy udar, ploskaya podacha, svecha ili rezanyy udar.

Crazy Taxi (яп. クレイジータクシー Кюрэйдзи: Таку:
Crazy Taxi (yap. クレイジータクシー Kyureydzi: Takusi, s angl. — «Bezumnoe taksi») — videoigra v zhanre avtosimulyatora, razrabotannaya podrazdeleniem kompanii Sega Hitmaker i izdana Sega v 1999 godu dlya igrovykh avtomatov Sega Naomi. Sozdatelem Crazy Taxi stal dizayner Kendzi Kanno, vystupivshiy v roli prodyusera i rukovoditelya. Po ego slovam, v novom dlya nego proekte on khotel pokazat vse trudnosti raboty obychnogo taksista. Rukovoditel takzhe khotel otkazatsya ot metoda «100 ien za 3 minuty», primenyaemogo v arkadnykh igrakh togo vremeni. A chtoby «pozvolit igroku igrat dolshe», razrabotchiki reshili sozdat mini-igru «Crazy Box» i uvelichit gorod dlya konsolnykh versiy. Vazhnoy osobennostyu Crazy Taxi yavlyaetsya igrovoy protsess. V otlichie ot drugikh avtosimulyatorov, dlya igry byla pridumana sistema navigatsii, kotoraya pomogaet igroku v poiske konechnogo punkta. Etot metod byl pozzhe zapatentovan Sega v 2001 godu, odnako on vpervye ispolzovalsya v Harley-Davidson & L.A. Riders, izdannoy v 1997 godu.
V sozdanii muzyki prinimali uchastie gruppy Bad Religion i Offspring. Ikh muzyka zvuchit na arkadnykh avtomatakh i portakh dlya Dreamcast, PlayStation 2, GameCube, Android i iOS. Takzhe v igre ispolzuetsya skrytaya reklama razlichnykh kompaniy: Pizza Hut, Tower Records, Fila, Levi’s i Kentucky Fried Chicken. Deystvie Crazy Taxi proiskhodit v kaliforniyskom gorode San-Frantsisko. Ot igroka trebuetsya perevozit passazhirov i dovezti ikh v punkt naznacheniya za opredelyonnoe vremya, vypolnyaya razlichnye manyovry na doroge dlya bolshego polucheniya deneg. Sushchestvuet takzhe vozmozhnost prokhodit mini-igry i obuchenie.
Crazy Taxi byla polozhitelno otsenena kritikami i imela kommercheskiy uspekh. Vse zhurnalisty khvalili igru za neobychnyy igrovoy protsess, grafiku i muzykalnoe soprovozhdenie. Igra ne raz pereizdavalas v statuse «bestsellera».

Broste vyzov tme
Vy — poslednyaya nadezhda mira, okazavshegosya posredi voyny mezhdu Nebesami i Preispodney. Vooruzhites kontrollerom Joy-Con™ ili Pro i vyberite geroya odnogo iz semi klassov v dukhe temnogo fentezi, kazhdyy iz kotorykh mozhet pokhvastat unikalnym stilem istrebleniya demonov.

Bezgranichnye vozmozhnosti dlya povtornogo prokhozhdeniya
So zlom nevozmozhno raspravitsya raz i navsegda. Probuete li vy novye urovni slozhnosti, prokhodite li syuzhetnuyu kampaniyu, ishchite li idealnoe kombo, popolnyaete li kollektsiyu snaryazheniya, ubivaete li monstrov v sluchaynykh podzemelyakh ili zanovo pokoryaete Sanktuariy s kazhdym sezonom — dlya vas vsegda naydetsya novoe ispytanie.

Soberite neprevzoydennyy arsenal

Whatever they did to you last night, they did it. And now it’s too late for apologies, you need to get to the bottom of this…
Rocky style.

ABOUT TO HELL WITH THE UGLY
Finalist in the 2023 IGF awards in “Excellence in Visual Arts” and showcased in the Day of the Devs 10th anniversary, To Hell With the Ugly is an adventure game set in a 1950s LA film noir setting. 

Play as Rock Bailey, a blond and handsome young man who systematically refuses all advances made to him. To the dismay of everybody around him, he stubbornly saves himself until the day he turns 20.
Everything changes when he is drugged and kidnapped outside the Zooty Slammer jazz club and wakes up in a strange hospital. They stole something from him, something very personal, and he wants revenge. Help Rocky get to the bottom of this mystery and find out the truth behind it.

To Hell with the Ugly is an adventure game with a focus on narration. Rocky has already lost part of his pride, he won’t shy away from combat if it takes him closer to the revenge he seeks. With his journalist partner Gary, they will have to gather clues from crime scenes and use them to make assumptions and solve puzzles, explore all the nooks and crannies of 1950s LA and let their fists do the talking in turn-based combat. 

GAMEPLAY
To unravel this mystery, you must:

- Investigate Los Angeles in the 50s, explore its darkest corners, meet the locals and immerse yourself in this film noir atmosphere

- Fight for your freedom, let the fists talk in turn-based combats based on timing, precision and amazingly beautiful hair

- Gather clues and information, investigate crime scenes, and make the right choices to solve mysteries.

SETTING
A film noir set in 1950s LA
Explore 1950s LA like you’ve never seen it before, in this homage to noir movies. Discover the hidden side of the city, a sordid / gruesome investigation centered on the disappearance of the most beautiful inhabitants and human experimentations. 

A stunning art direction
A breathtaking 2D world combined with fully animated cinematics and an incredible, bold art direction that bring the city of Los Angeles to life. 

It’s jazz all the way down
What best describes 1950s LA than jazz music? 
Carry out your investigation to the smooth rhythm of the jazzy soundtrack of To Hell With the Ugly!

Boris Vian reimagined
To Hell With the Ugly is an adaptation of Boris Vian’s satiric work of the same name, reimagined for the 21st century. Delve into the absurd and acclaimed work of the famous French author, brought to you by La Poule Noire and ARTE France.

Black Future ’88 — это 2D-шутер c элемен:
Black Future ’88 — eto 2D-shuter c elementami roguelike i boevika v zhanre sintipank. Vzberites po izmenyayushcheysya bashne, chtoby ubit ee obezumevshego khozyaina prezhde... chem u vas vzorvetsya serdtse. Strelyayte, rubite, proryvaytes i izuchayte navyki, chtoby raspravlyatsya s volnami smertelnykh lovushek, robotov-ubiyts i ogromnykh smotriteley v alternativnom mire 1988 goda.

Mir sodrogaetsya ot yadernogo kataklizma, za kotorym stoit Dunkan, arkhitektor bashni. Pervuyu bombu on sbrosil letom 1988 goda, a k dekabryu ikh bylo uzhe ne schest. Posle etogo my perestali vesti otschet vremeni, i potomu dlya nas vse eshche idet 1988 god. Bolshinstvo vyzhivshikh posle pervoy ataki umret ot posledovavshikh smertonosnykh potopov. Eto vremena posle: zdes ne sushchestvuet mesyatsev i nedel — est lish minuty, otdelyayushchie tebya ot smerti. 

Vozmite na sebya rol odnogo iz vyzhivshikh i prorubite sebe put k vershine bashni, chtoby raspravitsya s arkhitektorom i prekratit beskonechnyy dozhd iz yadernykh bomb. Vzoydite, chtoby umeret. Umrite, chtoby vyzhit.

Smertelnoe voskhozhdenie: vzbiraytes po postoyanno menyayushcheysya bashne i borites za vyzhivanie, izbegaya ognya, lazerov i drugikh opasnostey.

Mir v zhanre sintipank: okazhites v unikalnoy retrokiberpank-antiutopii i prorvites cherez 5 razlichnykh territoriy, kazhdaya iz kotorykh skryvaet svoi vyzovy i opasnosti.

Vybor za vami: igrayte za odnogo iz 5 personazhey. Vse oni obladayut unikalnymi preimushchestvami i nedostatkami.

Razrushayte druzhbu: proverte vashi um i refleksy na paru s drugom v unikalnom lokalnom sovmestnom rezhime.

Ubivayte smotriteley: raspravlyaytes s unikalnymi bossami, okhranyayushchimi kazhdyy svoyu territoriyu.

Dym-mashiny i lazernye luchi: pridite na perestrelku s pushkoy i lazernym mechom. Vam dostupno 50 unikalnykh vidov oruzhiya, kazhdoe so svoimi osobennostyami.

Prisposablivaytes, chtoby vyzhit: umelyy vybor i sochetanie usileniy i proklyatiy iz 30 dostupnykh — eto edinstvennyy sposob vyzhit, kogda vse, vklyuchaya vashe serdtse, pytaetsya vas ubit.

Ezhednevnye ispytaniya: prokhodite ezhednevnye ispytaniya i sravnivayte svoi rezultaty s dostizheniyami drugikh igrokov v tablitse liderov. Borites ne tolko za vyzhivanie, no i za prevoskhodstvo!

Sonic Jump (яп. ソニックジャンプ Соникку Дзямпу,:
Sonic Jump (yap. ソニックジャンプ Sonikku Dzyampu, s angl. — «Sonik: Pryzhok») — videoigra v zhanre platformera iz serii Sonic the Hedgehog, vypushchennaya na mobilnykh telefonakh v 2005 godu i rasprostranyavshayasya cherez servisy Sonic Cafe i Sega Mobile. Pozdnee igra byla perenesena na ustroystva s podderzhkoy operatsionnykh sistem iOS i Android.
Geympley Sonic Jump nasleduet igrovuyu mekhaniku starykh igr serii, vypushchennykh v 1990-e gody, odnako peredvizhenie po urovnyam proiskhodit posredstvom vertikalnogo skrollinga, a igrovoy personazh samostoyatelno prygaet po platformam. Po syuzhetu doktor Eggman pokhitil kamni Izumrudy Khaosa, chtoby zakhvatit s ikh pomoshchyu mir, i postroil sem robotov, kotorye mogut pobedit ezha Sonika. Glavnyy geroy, vmeste so svoimi druzyami, sobiraetsya razrushit kovarnye plany uchyonogo.
Posle vykhoda Sonic Jump byla polozhitelno otsenena pressoy i stala kommercheski uspeshnoy. Zhurnalisty khvalili platformer za grafiku i zvuk.Drugie igry o Sonic'e na Switch.

Tomodachi Life — социальная видеоигра-си:
Tomodachi Life — sotsialnaya videoigra-simulyator, iznachalno razrabotannaya Nintendo SPD i izdannaya Nintendo dlya portativnoy konsoli Nintendo 3DS v 2013-om godu; v ney rasskazyvaetsya o povsednevnom vzaimodeystvii personazhey Mii (nazyvaemykh «ostrovityanami»). Oni zavodyat druzey, reshayut povsednevnye problemy i obshchayutsya s igrokom. Po vsemu miru bylo prodano bolee 6,69 millionov kopiy, igra yavlyaetsya odinnadtsatoy samoy prodavaemoy igroy na konsol Nintendo 3DS.
«Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream» — vozvrashchenie Nintendo k prichudlivomu zhanru simulyatora zhizni, kotoryy pokoril igrokov svoey nepredskazuemoy sotsialnoy dinamikoy. Igra sosredotochena na zaselenii virtualnogo ostrova personazhami Mii, nastraivaemymi avatarami, kotorye mogut predstavlyat semyu, druzey, znamenitostey ili sovershenno originalnye tvoreniya. V otlichie ot traditsionnykh igr-simulyatorov, gde igroki zanimayutsya mikromenedzhmentom, eta igra predostavlyaet personazham zamechatelnuyu avtonomiyu, pozvolyaya im razvivat predpochteniya, formirovat svyazi i zanimatsya deyatelnostyu, otrazhayushchey ikh zadannye cherty lichnosti.
Sistema sozdaniya personazhey predlagaet bespretsedentnuyu glubinu nastroyki Mii, vklyuchaya novye parametry nastroyki litsa naryadu s klassicheskim podkhodom «smeshivay i sopostavlyay». Igroki mogut potratit znachitelnoe vremya na dorabotku kazhdoy detali, ot rasstoyaniya mezhdu glazami do vysoty golosa, ili otvetit na bystryy oprosnik, kotoryy generiruet polnyy profil lichnosti. Kazhdomu Mii prisvaivayutsya cherty, kotorye vliyayut na to, kak oni vzaimodeystvuyut s drugimi, kakuyu edu oni lyubyat i k kakim zanyatiyam oni tyagoteyut v svobodnoe vremya.
Kak tolko personazhi zaselyayut ostrov, oni nachinayut svoyu avtonomnuyu rutinu. Dvizhok simulyatsii obrabatyvaet kombinatsii lichnostey, chtoby opredelit sovmestimost mezhdu Mii, chto privodit k formirovaniyu druzhby, sopernichestva i romanticheskikh otnosheniy, kotorye voznikayut organichno. Personazhi mogut obrashchatsya za sovetom po povodu priznaniya v chuvstvakh, uregulirovaniya sporov ili vybora karernogo puti, no konechnye rezultaty zavisyat ot ikh individualnogo temperamenta i sotsialnogo okruzheniya. Sistema otnosheniy rabotaet na osnove mnogourovnevoy mekhaniki sovmestimosti, kotoraya odnovremenno uchityvaet mnozhestvo faktorov lichnosti. Mii s obshchitelnym, energichnym kharakterom mozhet stolknutsya s zamknutym, vdumchivym personazhem, ili oni mogut idealno dopolnyat drug druga v zavisimosti ot vtorostepennykh chert. Eti sotsialnye raschety sozdayut po-nastoyashchemu udivitelnye stsenarii, kogda personazhi, ot kotorykh vy ozhidali druzhby, stanovyatsya sopernikami, ili maloveroyatnye pary rastsvetayut v samye stabilnye otnosheniya na ostrove.
Personazhi vyrazhayut svoi potrebnosti i zhelaniya cherez oblachka mysley i pryamye razgovory. Oni mogut zhazhdat opredelennoy edy, khotet novye predmety odezhdy ili prosit pomoshchi v razreshenii mezhlichnostnykh konfliktov. Igra predstavlyaet eti momenty v vide interaktivnykh vinetok, gde igroki mogut nablyudat ili vliyat na iskhody. Nekotorye situatsii razygryvayutsya kak mini-igry, v to vremya kak drugie razvorachivayutsya cherez vybor dialoga, kotoryy uvazhaet ustanovlennuyu lichnost kazhdogo Mii, a ne navyazyvaet predopredelennye otvety.
Ezhednevnyy ritm Tomodachi Life vrashchaetsya vokrug proverki vashego ostrovnogo soobshchestva, chtoby uvidet, kakie sobytiya proizoshli. Personazhi prosypayutsya, edyat, zanimayutsya khobbi i obshchayutsya s sosedyami v sootvetstvii so svoim raspisaniem i nastroeniem. Simulyatsiya prodolzhaetsya dazhe pri zakrytoy igre, chto oznachaet, chto vernuvshiesya igroki obnaruzhivayut novye otnosheniya, razreshennye konflikty ili neozhidannye sobytiya, kotorye proizoshli vo vremya ikh otsutstviya. Igra otslezhivaet mnogochislennye statisticheskie dannye o zhizni kazhdogo Mii, ego lyubimykh blyudakh, blizhayshikh druzyakh, romanticheskoy istorii i lichnykh dostizheniyakh. Eti detali nakaplivayutsya v bogatye istorii personazhey, kotorye delayut dlitelnye igrovye sessii pokhozhimi na khroniku evolyutsii realnogo soobshchestva. Osobye sobytiya, takie kak kontserty, konkursy talantov i prazdnovaniya, preryvayut povsednevnye rutiny, sozdavaya zapominayushchiesya momenty, podcherkivayushchie individualnye lichnosti.
Igra sokhranyaet firmennuyu estetiku Nintendo s chistoy, krasochnoy grafikoy, kotoraya stavit vo glavu ugla vyrazhenie personazhey, a ne fotorealizm. Litsa Mii animiruyutsya preuvelichennymi reaktsiyami, kotorye chetko peredayut emotsii, v to vremya kak okruzhenie otlichaetsya yarkim, privlekatelnym dizaynom, sootvetstvuyushchim legkomyslennomu tonu. Khudozhestvennoe napravlenie podcherkivaet chitaemost i ocharovanie, garantiruya, chto dazhe perepolnennye stseny ostayutsya legko vosprinimaemymi s pervogo vzglyada. Zvukovoy dizayn dopolnyaet vizualnyy stil energichnoy fonovoy muzykoy i kharakternymi zvukovymi effektami, kotorye podcherkivayut deystviya personazhey. Sintezirovannyy golos kazhdogo Mii otrazhaet zadannye nastroyki vysoty i tona, sozdavaya slyshimuyu individualnost dazhe pri otobrazhenii dialogov v vide teksta. A saundtrek adaptiruetsya k razlichnym zanyatiyam i vremeni sutok, podderzhivaya oshchushchenie zhivogo ritma simulyatsii, ne stanovyas povtoryayushchimsya vo vremya dlitelnykh igrovykh sessiy.

Jet Kave Adventure brings everything you:
Jet Kave Adventure brings everything you love about 2.5D platformers. Enjoy the skill-based action, challenging boss fights, clever secrets and thrilling set-pieces in a game where the Stone Age and science fiction collide.

Meet Kave, the jet-powered caveman. A has-been chief banished by his own tribe, he stumbles upon… a jetpack! The device turns him into the only prehistoric man who stands a chance against “the alien invader” – a rather unlikable guy from the sky who’ll readily kick off a disastrous volcanic eruption just so he can repair his spaceship. So begins Kave’s quest to save the whole island and prove his worth to the tribe.

Who needs double jumps when you’ve got a jetpack?! This piece of extraterrestrial tech is a real game changer – both for Kave and the player. Master jet-fueled platforming and fly over pitfalls, smash through walls, knock out enemies, and manipulate objects as you halt the alien threat once and for all.

GAME FEATURES:
●	Save the island and Kave’s honor in a playful “Stone fiction” adventure
●	Jetpack through 36 colorful levels riddled with hazards and rich with secrets
●	Use your trusty club and alien jetpack to smack and whack 30 types of enemies
●	Show what you’re made of in breakneck flight sequences and boss fights
●	Master jet-fueled platforming to find collectibles and upgrade your gear
●	Enjoy a 2.5D adventure platformer tailor-made for Nintendo Switch™!
Antiquarian Thomasina Bateman is writing:
Antiquarian Thomasina Bateman is writing a book on the barrows of England, documenting the treasures she finds buried within. When an intriguing letter summons her to the small village of Bewlay, tucked away in the remote countryside, she sets off by train with her assistant a day behind.

Upon her arrival, however, the mysterious man who summoned her is nowhere to be found. Her assistant never arrives. A stubborn landowner refuses access to the barrow, and the locals are wary of this woman who is traveling alone and (gasp!) wears trousers.

The excavation of Hob’s Barrow is off to a rocky start. And then Thomasina starts having strange dreams…

Features:
-A dark, complex and evolving storyline featuring interwoven elements from real English folklore.
-Traditional point and click adventure game puzzles and interactions, with an easy modern interface.
-A cast of intriguing characters, from suspicious villagers to sickly vicars to lordly landowners, all with their own unique stories and motives.
-A distinct folk horror tone and grounding.
-Evocative pixel-art graphics, featuring cut-scenes and engaging animations.
-A suitably atmospheric original soundtrack from The Machine. The Demon. - one half of the duo behind the award-winning "Football Game" soundtrack.
-Fiends in the furrows, the smell of damp soil, and a cat or two.

Попробуйте пережить ужасные события 1917:
Poprobuyte perezhit uzhasnye sobytiya 1917 goda v simulyatore vyzhivaniya v okopakh Pervoy mirovoy s elementami khorrora. Vzglyanite na voynu glazami soldata, okazavshegosya v tylu vraga.

Uznayte dusherazdirayushchuyu istoriyu i perezhivite koshmar voyny, vooruzhivshis odnim lish okopnym svistkom. Nakhodite podskazki, kotorye pomogut orientirovatsya v transheyakh i izbegat vstrechi s vragom, i postaraytes vernutsya k seme. 

Zdes glavnoe — eto slyshat, a osnovnym orudiem geroya igry yavlyaetsya okopnyy svistok. Poduyte v nego, i on izdast zvuk, za kotorym vam stoit posledovat. No budte ostorozhny, ved on legko mozhet vydat vashu pozitsiyu, esli vragi tozhe uslyshat svist. Krome togo, vragi vas mogut uslyshat, kogda vy bezhite, lomaete chto-to ili khodite po derevyannomu pokrytiyu, kotoroe skripit pod nogami.

Pered vami KhARDKORNYY simulyator vyzhivaniya s elementami psikhologicheskogo khorrora, gde nuzhno nakhodit i sobirat podskazki, chtoby sbezhat iz okopov — proch ot uzhasov voyny.

Game Introduction\nThe line between the:
Game Introduction
The line between the animal and the plant world has become blurred, and the food chain has been completely disrupted. Humans, upon making this incredible discovery, have set up outposts along the border of the aggressive plants' habitat for investigations, defense, and in preparation for what may come. You take the role of a soldier on the front lines charged with confronting this strange new enemy.

The Order of Things... Disrupted
"Many years in the future, humanity looks upward in despair at plants, now standing atop the food chain. How could they have been so arrogant..."
Only when plants began sprouting arms and legs and developing self-awareness did humanity truly begin to understand the menace that these once photosynthesis-dependent creatures posed. No one could understand how the plants took this large evolutionary leap in such a short time, something that took their animal counterparts millions of years to accomplish. One thing is certain, now is the time for humanity to make their stand in order to stay at the top of the food chain.

Gameplay
As one of the first explorers of the newly discovered plant empire, you must continuously drive deeper and deeper into the enemy's lair. Defeat bizarre and colorful fruits while retrieving new gear, weapons, and resources to defend yourself and expand your base camp.
If you're unable to defeat the overwhelming destructive force of the plant army alone, invite a few friends to lend a hand and help you discover the secrets behind this strange new world.

Game Features
- Rougelike elements with random zones, treasures, and monsters
- Loads of special weapons and items
- Unique and incredibly detailed art style
- Expand your camp and unlock new features
- Solo campaign and local multiplayer
«Каждый век имеет своё средневековье.» ©:
«Kazhdyy vek imeet svoyo srednevekove.» ©
Iskusstvo chasto imitiruet smert. Shagnite zhe v zhivoy zhivopisnyy igrovoy mir, vdokhnovlennyy illyuminirovannymi rukopisyami i ksilogravyurami, i vy okazhetes v srednevekovoy Evrope, stoyashchey na poroge masshtabnykh religioznykh i politicheskikh potryaseniy shestnadtsatogo veka.
Vmeste s talantlivym zhivopistsem Andreasom Malerom, vy stolknyotes s krovavymi ubiystvami, zharkimi skandalami i gryaznymi intrigami, gremevshimi v starinnykh Bavarskikh Alpakh.
Мрачное повествование переплетается с ге:
Mrachnoe povestvovanie perepletaetsya s geympleem v priklyuchencheskom retro-stile «point & click». Kombiniruyte predmety, vzaimodeystvuyte s kompyuterami i reshayte golovolomki v napryazhennoy atmosfere.
V dalekom budushchem, na bortu kosmicheskogo korablya, kotoryy, kak kazhetsya, pokinut ekipazhem, Dzhon Marachek vykhodit iz stazisa. Emu pridetsya doyti do predela svoikh fizicheskikh i psikhicheskikh vozmozhnostey, chtoby rasputat okruzhayushchie ego tayny. Dzhon ispytyvaet neveroyatnuyu bol, ego zhena i doch propali. A vremeni ostaetsya vse menshe, v to vremya kak korabl Groomlake vse glubzhe pogruzhaetsya v sinie metanovye oblaka, burlyashchie nad Neptunom..
Некоторые страшные тайны страшные секрет:
Nekotorye strashnye tayny strashnye sekrety, imeyut razdrazhayushchuyu svoystvo snova vypolzat na svet, starayas izbezhat zabveniya. No Sara Pennington, samyy opytnyy agent nedremlyushchego Sekretnogo Ordena, gotova dat im otpor.

Sare, chlenu ordena Grifonov, predstoit samoe bolshoe i slozhnoe priklyuchenie. Tainstvennyy klan drakonov obnaruzhil artefakt davno zabytogo proshlogo, i teper tayna, skrytaya v etoy relikvii, mozhet poglotit mir v tom vide, kotoryy my znaem. Vam nuzhno ostanovit eto chudovishchnoe vtorzhenie, ispolzuya svoyu soobrazitelnost i pomoshch tovarishchey. Vashe rassledovanie i poisk informatsii o proiskhozhdenii etoy bedy zavedet vas v samye otdalennye mesta prostranstva i vremeni. Pokazhite vsemu miru, chto on po prezhnemu v bezopasnosti, a orden grifonov po-prezhnemu stoit na strazhe.
Первая игра, «Katawa Shoujo» (яп. かたわ少女:
Pervaya igra, «Katawa Shoujo» (yap. かたわ少女 Katava Syo:dzyo, literaturnyy perevod «Devushki s ogranichennymi vozmozhnostyami») — vizualnyy roman, razrabotannyy studiey Four Leaf Studios i vypushchennyy 4 yanvarya 2012 goda pod svobodnoy litsenziey Creative Commons CC-BY-NC-ND.
Syuzhet povestvuet istoriyu yunoshi i pyati devushek s razlichnymi travmami, kak fizicheskimi, tak i psikhologicheskimi. Igrovoy interfeys traditsionen dlya vizualnykh romanov — s tekstovym polem i spraytami personazhey.
Khisao Nakay — uchenik sredney shkoly i uchitsya v ney posledniy god. Odnazhdy on nakhodit v shkafchike pismo ot neizvestnogo otpravitelya i prikhodit v ukazannoe mesto vstrechi. Avtorom pisma okazyvaetsya devushka, kotoraya lyubit ego, no pri razgovore s ney on teryaet soznanie. Ochnuvshis v bolnitse, on uznaet, chto prichinoy ego obmoroka yavlyaetsya neozhidanno proyavivshaya sebya bolezn serdtsa — aritmiya. Posle dolgogo lecheniya v bolnitse ot aritmii, on vynuzhdenno perevoditsya v shkolu Yamaku, gde, nesmotrya na trudnosti, obretaet druzey i lyubov.
Vtoraya igra, «Katawa Shoujo Prealpha Repair Project» — eto otdelnaya lyubitelskaya fanatskaya modifikatsiya s neskolko izmenyonnym syuzhetom, i rekomenduetsya k prochteniyu uzhe posle prokhozhdeniya originala.Eshchyo vizualnykh novell na Switch (renpy).
Проложите путь сквозь орды тьмы и сразит:

Prevoskhodyashchiy po chislennosti vrag okruzhaet vas so vsekh storon — vam pridetsya vynut mech iz nozhen, sobrat v kulak vsyu svoyu volyu i i probit ognem i mechom put cherez nedruzhelyubnye zemli. Za isklyucheniem, pozhaluy, torgovtsa — on druzhelyuben k vam i blagodaren za biznes.

Для того чтобы разобраться что же случил:
Dlya togo chtoby razobratsya chto zhe sluchilos v laboratorii Robotec vam predstoit popast v podzemnuyu laboratoriyu Ascendo kuda i vedet sled, kotoryy obnaruzhila Sara v pamyati robota DR12.

Vam pridetsya razgadyvat golovolomki, borotsya s neponyatnymi sushchestvami i nakonets uznat PRAVDU ne tolko o tom chto zhe sluchilos v laboratoriyakh, no i o tom kto takaya na samom dele Sara.

V igre u geroya est portativnaya teleport pushka, kotoraya mozhet zamorazhivat, podzhigat, polivat vodoy i peremeshchat obekty.

Ispytayte sebya i uznayte pravdu
В этой причудливой и шустрой игре в жанр:
V etoy prichudlivoy i shustroy igre v zhanre «kvest» vas zhdyot Asfaliya — volshebnyy mir, kotoromu ugrozhaet vulkan. Vmeste s Charli vy vstretite zamechatelnykh personazhey, reshite mnogo vesyolykh golovolomok i soberyote kuchu priyatnykh glazu nakleek! Igra s zakhvatyvayushchey istoriey dlya vsey semi.
Vy smozhete issledovat interesnye mesta i vstretit tam chudakovatykh personazhey. Ikh komichnye problemy s lyogkostyu reshatsya resheniem neslozhnykh golovolomok! Nuzhno budet vnimatelno issledovat okruzhenie i obshchatsya s obitatelyami Asfalii, chtoby predotvratit izverzhenie vulkana!
Dialogi napolneny yumorom, ironiey i raznoobraznymi otsylkami, chtoby vzroslym tozhe bylo interesno prokhodit cherez eto puteshestvie. V Asfalii naydyotsya mesto dlya vsekh! Asfalia natselena na detey ot 6 let, no vzroslym budet ne menee interesno igrat v neyo iz-za obiliya yumora.
Возьмите на себя роль известного детекти:

Otkryvayte glubokie trevozhnye sekrety, reshayte zanyatnye golovolomki i proleyte svet na zamysly temnogo kulta. No vsyo eto — pod vliyaniem slaboumiya, sindroma, sposobnogo zastavit vas ne doveryat dazhe samomu sebe..
Smozhete li vy spravitsya s posledstviyami svoey dementsii? Budte vernym provodnikom dlya bolnogo detektiva. Ne pozvolyayte nikakoy bolezni sbit vas s puti..
3428 год нашей эры, Японское Королевство:
3428 god nashey ery, Yaponskoe Korolevstvo, ostrov Tokio. Prishla mirnaya epokha, nastupivshaya posle IV Mirovoy voyny. Tem ne menee, razryv mezhdu lyudmi ne byl preodolen. Voznikaet sovershenno novyy vid sporta, v kotorom v storony kachestve oruzhiya ispolzuetsya tolko svoyo chuvstvo ritma!.. Mir, v kotorom kazhdyy mozhet stremitsya k silneyshey pozitsii.
PHRASEFIGHT — eto igra, v kotoroy vy stanete pobezhdaete drug druga — v ritme!.. Atakuyte vovremya pod muzyku, i tochnost raschyota vashego nazhatiya reshit iskhod!..
Sygrayte v dva osnovnykh rezhima igry, «League Fight», gde vy vyigryvaete seriyu bitv protiv II, i «svobodnyy boy», v kotorom vy mozhete svobodno ustanavlivat razlichnye usloviya, i srazhatsya vdvoyom.
Кроссплатформенная даммаку-игра с открыт:
Krossplatformennaya dammaku-igra s otkrytym iskhodnym kodom v stile ShootEmUp, fan-igry v serii Touhou Project. Kak i ofitsialnye igry iz serii, Taisei — arkadnyy shuter v podzhanre «pulevoy ad», gde osnovnoy upor sdelan na izbeganie mnozhestva vrazheskikh snaryadov, dvizhushchikhsya uzorami po vsemu ekranu. Tōhō Project — eto seriya indi-igr (takzhe izvestnaya kak «dodzin» na yaponskom), izvestnaya svoim ansamblem personazhey i zapominayushchimisya saundtrekami. Ona sozdana v osnovnom odnim khudozhnikom, izvestnym kak ZUN, i imeet razreshitelnuyu litsenziyu.
Taisei ne yavlyaetsya polnym «klonom» Tōhō i rasskazyvaet originalnuyu istoriyu so svoey sobstvennoy muzykoy, grafikoy, igrovoy mekhanikoy i kodovoy bazoy. Khotya nekotoroe znanie Tōhō polezno, geympleem mozhno naslazhdatsya i bez predvaritelnogo znakomstva s seriey.
— Syuzhet, dialogi, i kontsovki byli polnostyu perepisany.
— Polnostyu originalnoe muzykalnoe soprovozhdenie, blizkoe po stilyu k ofitsialnym igram Touhou, mnozhestvo novykh zvukovykh effektov.
— Bolshie izmeneniya v geymplee, kasayushchiesya kak sposobnostey glavnykh geroin, tak i urovney s bossami.
— Mnozhestvo spraytov byli zameneny na novye, i vse bossy teper polnostyu animirovanny!Drugie Touhou-igry tut.

Tuda otpravlyayutsya mnogochislennye iskateli priklyucheniy, otshelniki, mechtateli i lyubiteli porazmyshlyat o vysokom v spokoynoy obstanovke. \"Kata - a way or form to memorize and i:
"Kata - a way or form to memorize and improve combat moves"

Katana Kata - is a souls-like game, where not only your timing matters, but also directions of strikes.

You will fight your way through a bunch of enemies on different locations to kill the former apprentices of your master and fix his mistakes of the past.

You will die a lot, but as any apprentice learn their way through the kata with mistakes, you will learn your way through every enemy on your path.

You will try different weapons until you find what better suits your fighting style.

Your fighting skills will grow, but true mastery is in your head in knowing your enemies and nuances of fight.

The core of the fight in Katana Kata is in combination of strikes, blocks, parry and dodge - pretty easy to learn, but with a lot of nuances to master, so even after a lot of deaths and repetition every fight can feel different.

«Rekviem Re minor» K.626, s lat. «zaupokoynaya messa» — poslednee i nezavershyonnoe prizhiznennoe muzykalnoe proizvedenie Volfganga Amadeya Motsarta, nad kotorym on rabotal vplot do samoy konchiny — s 22 noyabrya do smertelnoy nochi s 4 na 5 dekabrya 1791 goda — traurnaya liturgicheskaya sluzhba, napisannaya na kanonicheskiy latinskiy tekst, chast «Dies Irae», dnya gneva, t. e. Strashnogo suda — sekventsiyu v katolicheskoy messe, odin iz samykh populyarnykh grigorianskikh raspevov. Eyo tekst na latyni proiskhodit ot 18-y i 19-y stans. Posle smerti sochinenie zavershili Yozef Eybler i Frants Ksaver Zyusmayer, no tem ne menee «Rekviem» yavlyaetsya odnim iz naibolee izvestnykh proizvedeniy Motsarta, i rassmatrivaetsya kak odno iz vazhneyshikh tvoreniy velikogo kompozitora.
V iyule 1791 goda Motsart poluchil neobychnyy zakaz: k nemu v dom prishyol neizvestnyy poslannik v chyornom i na usloviyakh sekretnosti sdelal zakaz. Motsart soglasilsya na rabotu i poluchil avans 50 ili 100 dukatov. Stolko zhe kompozitor dolzhen byl poluchit po okonchanii raboty. Kak vyyasnilos pozzhe, Rekviem byl zakazan grafom Frantsem fon Valzeggom dlya ispolneniya v pamyat o svoey supruge, Anne fon Flamberg, umershey v fevrale 1791 goda. Vyyasnilos i imya posrednika, neposredstvenno sdelavshego zakaz maestro: im byl upravlyayushchiy grafa Loytgeb. Graf fon Valzegg byl lyubitelem muzyki, i sam igral na fleyte i na violoncheli, chasto ispolnyal u sebya doma razlichnye sochineniya i teatralnye predstavleniya raznykh avtorov, odnako emu khotelos, chtoby ego tozhe schitali kompozitorom, i poetomu on neodnokratno vydaval zakazannye u raznykh masterov sochineniya za sobstvennye: perepisyval sobstvennoy rukoy partitury, poluchennye ot avtora, i uzhe potom otdaval ikh raspisyvat na partii. Pri pervom ispolnenii «Rekviema» Valzeggom 14 dekabrya 1793 goda na partiture bylo ukazano: «Rekviem sochineniya grafa fon Valzegga», Requiem composito del conte Walsegg. Pochti na vsekh polotnakh, otrazhayushchikh poslednie chasy zhizni Motsarta izobrazhaetsya imenno ispolnenie Rekviema.
V etom pereizdanii proslavlennoy igry 2008-go goda budet: polnaya prorabotka dialogov s realnymi istoricheskimi personazhami, intrigi i istoricheskie zapisi, litsenzirovannaya muzyka Volfganga Amadeya v nastoyashchey Prage, tochno smodelirovannoy po kartam togo vremeni i desyatki khitroumnykh golovolomok dlya prokhozhdeniya — v polnom 3D!..

Соединенные Штаты Америки, 1830 год. Уси:
Soedinennye Shtaty Ameriki, 1830 god. Usilivaetsya vliyanie Novogo Sveta – industriya na podeme, obostryaetsya borba za kontrol nad transportnymi arteriyami Severnoy Ameriki. 

V «Railway Empire» vy sozdadite slozhnuyu i shirokuyu zheleznodorozhnuyu set, priobretete bolee 40 razlichnykh poezdov, smodelirovannykh s isklyuchitelnoy detalizatsiey, a takzhe kupite ili postroite zheleznodorozhnye stantsii, zdaniya tekhnicheskogo obsluzhivaniya, fabriki i turisticheskie dostoprimechatelnosti, chtoby vasha set puteshestviy byla vperedi konkurentov. Vam takzhe nuzhno budet nanimat i upravlyat svoey rabochey siloy, esli vy khotite obespechit effektivnoe obsluzhivanie poezdov, a takzhe razrabotat bolee 300 tekhnologiy, nachinaya ot mekhanicheskikh uluchsheniy do samikh poezdov i zakanchivaya infrastrukturoy na rabochem meste i rasshirennymi udobstvami, poskolku vy prokhodite cherez pyat epokh tekhnologicheskikh innovatsiy.

Tem ne menee, vy ne mozhete prosto postroit i issledovat svoy put k vershine - konkurentsiya nikogda ne spit, i chtoby sokhranit svoy biznes na pravilnom puti, vam pridetsya vyzhit protiv trekh konkuriruyushchikh magnatov. Chtoby dostich vershiny, vam, vozmozhno, pridetsya pribegnut k bolee zhestkoy taktike, kogda vy atakuete i sabotiruete svoikh protivnikov posredstvom reydov i promyshlennogo shpionazha.

V igre «Railway Empire - Nintendo Switch™ Edition» vy smozhete rasshiryat svoyu zheleznodorozhnuyu set i upravlyat ey, gde by vy ni nakhodilis. Vy takzhe poluchite dostup k dopolneniyam «Meksika», «Velikie ozera» i «Cherez Andy», a eto — novye stsenarii na regionalnykh kartakh, saundtreki, lokomotivy, a takzhe dopolnitelnye rezhimy «Noch» i «Sneg».

Kharakternaya cherta:
- Izvlekayte vygodu iz ogromnogo ekonomicheskogo potentsiala Soedinennykh Shtatov, shag za shagom prodvigayas ot odnogo poberezhya do drugogo.     
- Bolee 40 detalno vossozdannykh lokomotivov i bolee 30 razlichnykh vagonov. Umelo ispolzuyte ikh preimushchestva i nedostatki dlya dostizheniya tseli.  
- Borites za vyzhivanie i ustranyayte sopernikov po biznesu. Vam budut protivostoyat tri konkuriruyushchie kompanii. Sabotiruyte ikh rabotu pri pomoshchi naletchikov i shpionov.
- Vklyuchaet v sebya dopolnitelnye materialy: «Meksika», «Velikie ozera» i «Cherez Andy».

Kogda personazh dvizhetsya vpered, trekhmernye peyzazhi vokrug nego menyayutsya: igrok slovno nakhoditsya v tom zhe mire, chto i personazh, i vmeste s nim perezhivaet fantasticheskoe priklyuchenie.
"

Po suti, Big Drunk Satanic Massacre - eto shuter s obiliem elementov RPG. 
(Dlya spravki: RPG - eto ne protivotankovyy granatomyot)
Deystvie igry proiskhodit v Adu. Lu, glavnyy geroy, dolzhen razdobyt bukhla i spasti samuyu goryachuyu tsypochku iz lap tolstogo klouna. V igre chetyre glavy, v kazhdoy predstavlen novyy kvartal Ada, k primeru, adskoe kafe bystrogo pitaniya Big Wac, trushchoby skeletov ili Rayon krasnykh fonarey. Na kazhdom urovne nuzhno ubit mestnogo Bossa. Kazhdyy boss obladaet unikalnymi sposobnostyami i mnogostupenchatoy sistemoy boya, tak chto odolet ikh neprosto.

U igroka est vybor mezhdu shestyu vidami oruzhiya i odnoy magicheskoy sposobnostyu. Glavnaya osobennost igry: Lu popravlyaet zdorove vypivkoy. Chem bolshe on pet, tem bolshe povyshaetsya uroven alkogolya v krovi. Pravda, eto mozhet vliyat na nego kak v polozhitelnuyu, tak i otritsatelnuyu storonu.

S trudom predstavlyaesh budni syna Satany? Da tak, nichego osobennogo... Bezuderzhnaya pokhot, klinicheskiy alkogolizm i bezbashennaya strelba — nu, vse kak obychno.
Spasay Ad! Stop-stop... Chego? Ty ne oslyshalsya - Ad! Eto sovsem ne to zharkoe mestechko, kakim ty ego pomnish - ego zakhvatilo samoe strashnoe zlo. Lyudi. Oni prevratili tvoyu tsitadel poroka v balagan, i tolko ty mozhesh ikh ostanovit!

Chto ty poluchaesh vzamen? S etim vse otlichno: nashego geroya zhdut velikolepnye urovni, smes boli i absurda i grandioznye bossy.

Igray za pravilnoe zlo - tsel nashego geroya spasti «printsessu», samuyu otvyaznuyu dyavolitsu v Adu.

V igre prisutstvuyut stseny nasiliya, krov i raschlenyonka.

Вы — Чужеземец. Некогда вы дрейфовали по:

Следуйте за командой звездолета Spacehea:

Usileniya, mnozhestvo vidov oruzhiya, ocharovatelnye unikalnye personazhi i podderzhka otdelnogo soobshchestva idealno soedinyayutsya v unikalnuyu igru, na razrabotku kotoroy ushli gody.

Osobennosti

• Mnozhestvo zakhvatyvayushchikh igrovykh rezhimov — klassicheskiy 12-urovnevyy rezhim «Priklyuchenie» s razblokiruemymi relikviyami i predmetami, neprostoy «Beskonechnyy» rezhim s unikalnoy mekhanikoy i ekonomikoy, rezhim «Shtorm» s postepennym uvelicheniem slozhnosti i khaosa.
• Ezhednevnyy kontent — prodemonstriruyte svoi boevye navyki i nablyudayte za rostom svoego reytinga sredi drugikh okhotnikov v ezhednevnom rezhime, v kotorom vse uchastvuyut v odinakovom sluchaynom sorevnovanii. 
• Divannyy sovmestnyy rezhim — do 2 igrokov mogut obedinyatsya v komandu v lokalnoy mnogopolzovatelskoy igre, chtoby sozdavat novye strategii i boevuyu taktiku (podderzhka kontrollerov Joy-Con™ i kontrollera Nintendo Switch™ Pro).
• Progressivnyy originalnyy saundtrek v stile «chiptyun» — zazhigatelnye treki usilyat vashi vpechatleniya ot srazheniya s polchishchami Dyukanov.
• Srazheniya s silnymi vragami i mini-bossami — osteregaytes silneyshikh komandirov Dyukanov, kotorye postarayutsya unichtozhit vas i vashu komandu.
• Moshchnye vidy oruzhiya, sozdavaemye soobshchestvom — issleduyte asteroidnoe podzemele Nemesida, napolnennoe ogromnym kolichestvom razlichnogo oruzhiya, nekotoroe iz kotorykh sozdano uchastnikami igrovogo soobshchestva Relic Hunters.
• Vnutriigrovye dostizheniya — otslezhivayte i razblokiruyte dostizheniya v khode razlichnykh slozhnostey i zadaniy.

Wipeout, стилизованно «wipE’out\"» — фут:
Wipeout, stilizovanno «wipE’out"» — futuristicheskaya gonochnaya igra, razrabotannaya i izdannaya kompaniey Psygnosis v 1995 godu dlya PlayStation i DOS, v 1996 godu portirovannaya na Sega Saturn. Deystvie igry proiskhodit v 2052 godu vo vremya sorevnovaniy gonochnoy ligi F3600. Igroki upravlyayut antigravitatsionnymi korablyami, uchastvuya v gonkakh na trassakh po vsemu miru i ispolzuya razlichnoe oruzhie i bonusy.
Razrabotka igry nachalas vo vtoroy polovine 1994 goda i zanyala okolo 14 mesyatsev. Ideya voznikla vo vremya razgovora mezhdu Nikom Burkombom i Dzhimom Bauersom, a dizayn byl razrabotan studiey The Designers Republic. Muzyku k igre napisal valliyskiy kompozitor CoLD SToRAGE, takzhe v ney igrayut kompozitsii ot Leftfield, The Chemical Brothers i Orbital. Dlya versii Sega Saturn dopolnitelnye treki napisali Rob Lord i Mark Bandola.
Wipeout poluchila vysokie otsenki kritikov za originalnost, grafiku i muzykalnoe soprovozhdenie, otmechali slozhnost upravleniya. Originalnaya igra stala odnim iz klyuchevykh proektov dlya PlayStation i polozhila nachalo uspeshnoy serii. Wipeout okazala znachitelnoe vliyanie na igrovuyu industriyu, populyarizirovala elektronnuyu muzyku sredi geymerov i ustanovila novye standarty v vizualnom dizayne videoigr.
Zero Zero Zero Zero — это уникальный 1-б:
Zero Zero Zero Zero — eto unikalnyy 1-bitnyy platformer nizkogo razresheniya, brosayushchiy vyzov igrokam na mnozhestve urovney, kotorye potrebuyut navykov i tshchatelnogo manevrirovaniya. Uvilivay, strelyay i prygay cherez sluchayno vybrannye urovni po mere prodvizheniya k pobede ili gibeli.

Plavnyy, effektnyy saundtrek, pod kotoryy mozhno igrat, preodolevaya opasnosti i vragov.

Khvatit li u tebya snorovki, chtoby zavershit vse 100 urovney?

Kharakteristiki
* Bystryy, slozhnyy, no chestnyy igrovoy protsess.
* 100 neprostykh urovney.
* Sprinterskiy rezhim, v kotorom igroki mogut srazhatsya drug s drugom, chtoby vyyasnit, kto yavlyaetsya nastoyashchim profi zhanra 1-bitnykh platformerov.
* Sluchayno vybrannye urovni, kotorye poyavlyayutsya posle kazhdoy smerti i zaversheniya urovnya.
* Grafika s nizkim razresheniem v sochetanii s potryasayushchim elektronnym saundtrekom Levi Bonda.
Skelittle — это незамысловатая красочная:
Skelittle — eto nezamyslovataya krasochnaya komandnaya igra, sozdannaya, chtoby razvlechsya s druzyami i v krugu semi. 
Brosayte drug drugu vyzov v seriyakh po 15 mini-igr i otkryvayte predmety, chtoby sozdavat sobstvennye igrovye seansy v rezhime «pesochnitsy».

Prevratite svoy dom v gigantskuyu igrovuyu ploshchadku!
Skelittles — eto kroshechnye igrushki, sbezhavshie iz svoikh korobok iz-pod gotovykh zavtrakov. Igrayte s nimi, prevrashchaya povsednevnuyu obstanovku v ogromnuyu igrovuyu ploshchadku!
Ubegayte ot strashnogo robota-pylesosa, voruyte lyubimyy korm svoego psa i sbrasyvayte druzey na samoe dno vanny. Kazhdaya iz mini-igr osobennaya i imeet svoi zabavnye zadaniya. 

Sozdavayte sobstvennye neveroyatnye igry!
Chem dolshe vy igraete, tem bolshe otkroete predmetov, kotorye mozhno primenyat v rezhime «pesochnitsy».
Ispolzuyte ikh, chtoby sozdavat sobstvennye neveroyatnye igry! Kak naschet igry v futbol, gde u kazhdogo igroka est reaktivnyy ranets? Igry v basketbol na ldu? Ili bezumnogo sostyazaniya v peyntbol v inversionnykh botinkakh? V mire Skelittle vozmozhno vse!

Osobennosti igry
• 15 krasochnykh i nezamyslovatykh mini-igr s razlichnym geympleem i graficheskoy sredoy.
• Rezhim «pesochnitsy» s bolee chem 50 predmetami. Otkryvayte ikh i sozdavayte sobstvennye igry!
• Rezhimy odinochnoy i komandnoy igry (1–4 igroka). Igrayte v odinochku protiv kompyutera ili priglasite druzey i rodnykh prisoedinitsya k vam v bezumnom igrovom seanse na divane.
• Prostota v ispolzovanii. Igry ochen legkie i podkhodyat dazhe detyam!
• Velikolepnaya multiplikatsionnaya grafika, blagodarya kotoroy serye budni zaigrayut yarkimi kraskami.
Big Crown: Showdown — это игра, в которо:
Big Crown: Showdown — eto igra, v kotoroy druzya stanovyatsya vragami, boryas mezhdu soboy za koronu v lokalnom (do 4-kh igrokov) i setevom mnogopolzovatelskom boyu. Deystvie razvorachivaetsya v trekh strannykh mirakh, polnykh srednevekovykh priklyucheniy. Izbegayte popadaniya v opasnye situatsii ili vvyazyvaytes v ozhestochennye boi, pytayas sbit protivnikov s kursa na 15 bezumnykh marshrutakh etoy neveroyatnoy korolevskoy bitvy!

OSNOVNYE OSOBENNOSTI:

• Legko osvaivaemaya tekhnika vedeniya boya: Big Crown Showdown — eto priyatnyy i legkiy geympley, dostupnyy dlya igrokov vsekh vozrastov i urovney navykov. Boi, dlya uchastiya v kotorykh dostatochno nazhatiya vsego odnoy knopki, daryat nezabyvaemuyu glubinu vpechatleniy — vy zakhotite vernutsya v igru snova!

• Bespreryvno rabotayushchaya kamera: V igre Big Crown Showdown ispolzuetsya unikalnaya sistema, v ramkakh kotoroy kamera dvizhetsya vdol marshruta, ne ostanavlivayas ni na sekundu, chto zastavit vas vse vremya nakhoditsya v dvizhenii na vstrechu novym priklyucheniyam. Net vremeni na otdykh, kogda kamera podstegivaet sobytiya!

• Klassicheskaya platformennaya igra: V Big Crown Showdown boi — ne glavnoe. Igra sochetaet v sebe khaoticheskie boevye epizody i momenty zateylivogo platforminga, zastavlyaya vas dvigatsya i reagirovat ochen bystro. Na kazhdom marshrute vas podsteregaet mnozhestvo smertelno opasnykh prepyatstviy!
Её наследие живо! Отправляйтесь в приклю:
Eyo nasledie zhivo! Otpravlyaytes v priklyucheniya s obnovlennymi igrami iz serii Tomb Raider, sobrannymi v kollektsiyu Darkness Trilogy.
Vklyuchyonnye igry:
Симулятор жизни о радости садоводства и: Simulyator zhizni o radosti sadovodstva i malenkikh udovolstviyakh, kotorye sleduyut za nim. Rybalka, vyrashchivanie rasteniy, torgovlya ili prosto obshchenie s novymi druzyami — zdes vas zhdet udivitelnoe i uyutnoe priklyuchenie.
Хучубу хочет съесть... вас. Но как знает:
Khuchubu khochet sest... vas. No kak znaet lyuboy lyudoed, luchshe byt povarom, a ne blyudom.

Tur po ostrovu
Na start, vnimanie… marsh gotovit na bolee chem 20 urovnyakh kampanii na ostrove! Otpravlyaytes v dzhungli, khramy, na plyazhi i v izvergayushchiysya vulkan!

Zagadochnaya kulinariya
Chtoby ukrotit appetit Khuchubu, nuzhno ne tolko gotovit. Obgonite Shipastoe brevno sudby™, odoleyte vse volny turistov i bossov na arene v dzhunglyakh i proydite drugie ispytaniya.

Vudu-kukhnya
Tainstvennye sily vudu — idealnyy ingredient uspekha. Eta magiya pozvolyaet delat ryvok, razmeshchat tselitelnye totemy i dazhe dyshat ognem. V mnogopolzovatelskom rezhime kazhdyy shef mozhet vybrat raznye sposobnosti, podkhodyashchie ego stilyu.

Festival edy ili gastronomicheskoe srazhenie

Увлекательную приключенческую игру Doubl:
Uvlekatelnuyu priklyuchencheskuyu igru Double Cross, gde vam predstoit primerit na sebya rol agenta RAZLOMa Zakhry, razrabotala studiya 13AM Games. Sredi drugikh ee izvestnykh igr chislitsya zasluzhivshaya mnozhestvo nagrad Runbow. «RAZLOM» rasshifrovyvaetsya kak «Regulirovshchiki Antisotsialnykh Zatey i Letalnykh Opasnostey Mezh mirami». Zadacha etoy kompanii — sledit za poryadkom mezhdu vsemi izmereniyami. Nedavno na shtab RAZLOMa napali, i teper igrokam predstoit rassledovat novoe delo. Vooruzhivshis razrabotannym v RAZLOMe oborudovaniem, oni budut strelyat, uvorachivatsya, srazhatsya i rassledovat prestupleniya v dalekikh izmereniyakh. Vo vremya puteshestviy oni soberut vse neobkhodimye uliki, chtoby priblizitsya k razgadke, uznat, kto zhe napal na RAZLOM, a takzhe spasti kazhduyu versiyu vselennoy.

OSOBENNOSTI IGRY
• Igroki mogut nastraivat stil sobstvennoy igry, sobiraya uluchshator i ispolzuya ego, chtoby povysit svoy uroven i razblokirovat snaryazhenie agentov RAZLOMa.
• Polnyy priklyucheniy igrovoy protsess i sistema uluchsheniy, blagodarya kotorym igroki smogut vybirat, kak i v kakom poryadke prokhodit urovni
• Unikalnaya mekhanika «protonnoy rogatki», kotoraya pozvolyaet primenyat samye raznye dvizheniya na razlichnykh urovnyakh. U igroka budet vozmozhnost khvatat i shvyryat predmety i vragov
• Razlichnye ataki i kombo, kotorye mozhno uluchshat
• Zaputannaya istoriya, kotoraya vovlechet uchastnikov v reshenie zagadki i puteshestviya mezh izmereniyami, gde im predstoit poznakomitsya so mnozhestvom razlichnykh personazhey
• Elegantnaya vysokokachestvennaya 2D-grafika, kotoraya napominaet o kultovykh igrakh i stile anime
Ведьмы ждут не дождутся наконец переехат: Vedmy zhdut ne dozhdutsya nakonets pereekhat v Koldovskie kushchi: les, v kotorom — esli verit starym skazkam — polnym-polno volshebnykh sushchestv i rasteniy! No, pribyv v novyy dom, kolduni tut zhe ponimayut: chto-to ne tak. Khodyachikh rasteniy sovsem nemnogo, a lesnye dukhi i vovse kuda-to propali! Khotya vedmy i osharasheny takim otkrytiem, eshchyo ne vsyo poteryano. Pustiv v khod uporstvo, smekalku i magiyu, vedmy eshchyo mogut vernut Koldovskim kushcham byloe velichie pyshnogo lesa!
Vaporum: Lockdown — это приквел Vaporum,:
Vaporum: Lockdown — eto prikvel Vaporum, rolevaya igra ot pervogo litsa s peredvizheniem po setke i originalnoy obstanovkoy v stile stimpank, vdokhnovlennaya klassikoy zhanra. Uznayte istoriyu Elli Teller – uchenoy, izo vsekh sil pytayushcheysya perezhit katastrofu, proizoshedshuyu na stantsii Vaporum.

• Boi v realnom vremeni ot pervogo litsa
• Unikalnyy rezhim ostanovki vremeni
• Golovolomki i prodolzhitelnye tseli urovney
• Rolevaya sistema s primeneniem razlichnykh ustroystv
• Uyma lokatsiy dlya issledovaniya, gory dobychi i obshirnaya kastomizatsiya personazha
• Syuzhet, polnyy tayn i zagadok
• Polnostyu ozvuchennye personazhi
• Realistichnaya atmosfera stimpanka
 
Vy stolknetes s opasnymi vragami, nadelennymi unikalnymi umeniyami i atakami. Chtoby ikh odolet, pridetsya ispolzovat razlichnye oruzhiya, ustroystva, usiliteli i smekalku.
 
K schastyu, vash arsenal polon moshchnykh igrushek. Razlichnye tipy oruzhiya dlya lyuboy situatsii, sinergeticheskaya bronya, ustroystva, pozvolyayushchie prizvat armiyu minonov ili upravlyat okruzheniem, usiliteli, i mnogoe drugoe.
 
Prigotovtes reshat golovolomki i vybiratsya iz razlichnykh peredryag s pomoshchyu interaktivnykh elementov, kotorye proveryat vashu smekalku i refleksy. Obshchaya syuzhetnaya liniya budet postroena na poiske resheniya dlya glavnogo prepyatstviya, a otdelnye ego elementy budut razbrosany po razlichnym urovnyam. Vy uznaete mnogo novogo o mire i ego obitatelyakh blagodarya ozvuchennym dialogam, audiodnevnikam i zapiskam.
Перейти или умереть!\nAIR BOUNCE - THE J:

Присоединяйся к отважному сэру Луталоту:

Proydi vse chetyre podzemelya, otkryvaya novye sposobnosti i nakhodya novye predmety, kotorye smogut pomoch seru Lutalotu pobedit vragov. 

Knightin'+ — eto klassicheskaya priklyuchencheskaya igra, vdokhnovlennaya mnogimi udivitelnymi shedevrami 90-kh godov.

Kharakteristiki:
 * Klassicheskiy igrovoy stsenariy 
 * Ironichnyy syuzhet (kotoryy ni v koem sluchae ne dolzhen vosprinimatsya vserez)
 * Stilnaya pikselnaya grafika
 * Slushay zapominayushchiysya saundtrek na protyazhenii vsego priklyucheniya!
Запрыгивай в уютного робота и отправляйс:
Zaprygivay v uyutnogo robota i otpravlyaysya v opasnoe puteshestvie po inoplanetnomu miru, kotoryy kishit opasnymi tvaryami. No inache nikak, ved koteyke nuzhno spasti svoego kapitana i ego korabl! Chudo sovremennoy nauki i koshachi instinkty provedut tebya cherez uzkie tonneli i podvodnye perekhody, a eshche pomogut nayti novoe oruzhie i predmety. Gato Roboto — kiska v zone riska!

Issleduy zaputannyy avanpost gde-to v dalekoy-dalekoy galaktike i raskroy pravdu ob uzhasnykh sobytiyakh, kotorye tam tvorilis.

Stalnoy dospekh pomozhet krushit vragov i vydelyvat neveroyatnye kulbity — i, samo soboy, on silno prigoditsya pri vstreche so strazhami etoy bazy.

Vylezay iz robota, chtoby probratsya v uzkie tonneli i dobyt tsennye predmety — u koshki ved devyat zhizney, chto mozhet poyti ne tak?

Dobyvay novoe oruzhie i predmety, chtoby popast v nedostupnye ranshe mesta — i vse eto velikolepie otrisovano vruchnuyu!
Кристиан Уайтхед, также известный под пс:
Kristian Uaytkhed, takzhe izvestnyy pod psevdonimom «The Taxman», — avstraliyskiy dizayner videoigr i programmist-razrabotchik, naibolshee priznanie poluchivshiy za sozdanie obnovlennykh portov rannikh igr serii Sega Sonic the Hedgehog i rabotu vedushchim razrabotchikom originalnoy igry serii Sonic Mania. On takzhe razrabotal neskolko remeykov klassicheskikh igr pro Sonika, remastery Sonic Origins, Freedom Planet 2.
Igra Sonic Nexus — eto khoumbryu, sozdannoe komandoy Nexus Team pod rukovodstvom Slingerland. V igre ispolzovalsya dvizhok Retro Sonic ot The Taxman, kotoryy prisoedinilsya k proektu v 2008 godu. Razrabotka igry nachalas letom 2006 goda, bylo vypushcheno tri demo-versii: dva na vystavke Sonic lyubitelskikh igr i odin letom 2008 goda, poluchila bolshoe priznanie mnozhestva fan-kritikov, naprimer, kak «absolyutnoe sovershenstvo klassicheskogo stilya Sonika».
V 2011 godu The Taxman obyavil, chto komanda Retro Sonic XG (RSXG) obedinyaetsya s Sonic Nexus (SN), nachav delat sovmestno igru Retro Sonic Nexus (RSN). K sozhaleniyu, v dalneyshem i ona byla zabroshena.
Ot sozdatelya Xeodrifter i Mutant Mudds!..
Shest podzemeliy s raznoy tematikoy, kishashchikh vragami i lovushkami, i kazhdoe slozhnee predydushchego. Intuitivnoe i bystroe upravlenie, rabotayushchee s plavnoy chastotoy 60 kadrov v sekundu.
Raznoobraznyy sostav igrabelnykh rytsarey i blagorodnykh dam: v tom chisle: ser Redmur, ledi Stedfast, Maks Mutant Madds i Skullakhad, dopolnitelnye zhizni, uvelichenie sily rytsarya, talismany udachi, neuyazvimye dospekhi, snizhenie naloga na smert i razrushitelnye zaklinaniya pobedy!..

Лирическая осенняя юри-новелла о горе и:
Liricheskaya osennyaya yuri-novella o gore i preodolenii nevzgod. Soberite «karakuli» Ell, chtoby uznat bolshe i podruzhitsya s zagadochnoy devushkoy.
Poseshchenie mogily ottsa na Khellouin nikogda ne vkhodilo v eyo plany, no po neobyasnimym prichinam Ell tyanet na gorodskoe kladbishche. Nadeyas nayti podobie kontsa istorii, ona prikhodit k ego mogile s bloknotom, prizhatym k grudi. Sidya naprotiv nadgrobiya, Ell vpervye za mnogo let myslenno razgovarivaet so svoim ottsom; utopaya v potoke vospominaniy, zakryvaet glaza i sosredotachivaetsya na svoyom dykhanii.
Dnevnoy svet uzhe uskolzaet, no prezhde chem Ell ukhodit, k ney priblizhaetsya strannaya neznakomka..
