Удерживайте свой магазин на плаву, варит:
Uderzhivayte svoy magazin na plavu, varite zelya i khodite na svidanki. Zadacha slozhnaya, trebuet umeniya planirovat i delat neskolko del odnovremenno. Ne spravites – budete zhit v korobke!
Primite rol Silvii – mnogoobeshchayushchey molodoy devushki. Ona energichna, dobrodushna i naporista. Silviya uvlekaetsya zelevareniem, i tak poluchilos, chto dyadya ostavil ey v nasledstvo magazin. Otlichnaya vozmozhnost nachat kareru zelevara-realizatora!
No schaste dlilos nedolgo. Prishla chernoknizhnitsa, i povesila na Silviyu gigantskiy dolg dyadi. Esli Silviya ego ne pogasit, to okazhetsya na ulitse i budet zhit v korobke. Edinstvennyy sposob ostatsya na plavu – pobedit v sorevnovanii zelevarov i zarabotat denezhnyy priz. Dlya etogo nashey geroine — i vam, — i govoryashchey sove pridetsya postaratsya..
V etom spetsialnom izdanii Masterwork Edition dlya Nintendo Switch dobavlena golosovaya ozvuchka, beskonechnyy rezhim, novye urovni slozhnosti «Cozy» i «Capitalism» i mnogoe drugoe!
Grimshade tells the story of the company:
Grimshade tells the story of the company of heroes, by a twist of fate involved in the cycle of events unfolding in the world of Ree'fah. Numerous dreadful monsters infested the forest around the city of Brann and high walls could no longer protect residents from the attacks. The menacing army of the neighbouring kingdom suddenly landed on the outskirts of the city, wreaking havoc. There is no hope for salvation — the strength of the defenders is running low, but the King and his loyal Champions had vanished.

Lead the group of the adventurers on a journey and explore a varied and intricate world, meet new characters and reveal plot-related secrets. Remember, beauty is deceptive — danger lurks everywhere. Test your skills in challenging turn-based battles, adjusting your combat tactics and optimal team combinations for each foe you met on the way.

Key Features:
- Seven memorable characters, including Kiba, the dark child, Charlie, the talking sniper badger, Alister, the brave guy with an Ether gauntlet, and Ruby, the princess of the thieves. Each of them has their role (sometimes more than one) on the battlefield and their own mission on a big journey.

- The character development system is based on equipment: each piece of armour, weapon or accessory gives a unique skill to a particular hero, expanding their range of attack types and defensive boosts. Find, trade for, or craft new equipment to improve your characters and make them versatile and adaptable.

- Complex tactical turn-based battles: a variety of elaborate enemies won't let you complete the whole game using a single tactic or invincible team build. Choose wisely the squad you take in a fight — proper positioning and awareness are essential to your success struggling against powerful foes.

- The vivid and diverse world of Ree'fah: immerse yourself in the hand-painted fantasy universe of Grimshade and discover an impressive history in more than 20 hours of an exciting journey.
Gas Station Simulator - это все о ремонт:
Gas Station Simulator - eto vse o remonte, razvitii i ekspluatatsii zapravochnoy stantsii u shosse posredi pustyni. Svoboda vybora,neskolko podkhodov k upravleniyu biznesom i borba s davleniem vneshnikh faktorov - klyuchevye sostavlyayushchie etoy igry.
Kupite zabroshennuyu zapravochnuyu stantsiyu v pustoshi i vernite ey byluyu slavu. Izbavites ot musora i bitoy mebeli, pochinite steny, pokraste i ukraste eto mesto po svoemu vkusu.
Tolko ne tratte vse svoi dengi na vneshniy vid srazu, vy ved kupili zapravku. Remontiruyte oborudovanie, pokupayte to, chto ne podlezhit remontu, i nachinayte obsluzhivat svoikh klientov, chtoby zarabatyvat dengi na dalneyshie obnovleniya i uluchsheniya.
Vam ne nuzhno ostavatsya malenkim. Vy mozhete rasshirit svoyu zapravochnuyu stantsiyu, chtoby obsluzhivat bolshe klientov. Krome togo, zapravka - eto ne tolko prodazha topliva. Vy mozhete rasshirit spektr uslug kotorye vy predlagaete svoim klientam i takim obrazom privlekaete  ikh vse bolshe i bolshe.
V vashem rasporyazhenii razlichnye varianty uluchsheniy. Ot nebolshikh, takikh kak tualety, prostoy magazin, chtoby popolnit vash dokhod do bolshikh, kak tselaya masterskaya po remontu avtomobiley. Est dovolno mnogo variantov, i bolshinstvo uluchsheniy mogut sami po sebe rasshireny. Zdes tak mnogo vsego, chto vy mozhete sdelat. 
Odno delo vosstanovit vashu zapravochnuyu stantsiyu, a drugoe - pridat ey individualnost. Igra predlagaet shirokiy spektr optsiy dlya togo, chto vy uzhe postroili, i mnozhestvo dekora dlya dalneyshego uvelicheniya unikalnosti mesta. Nekotorye dekoratsii mozhno kupit, drugie nuzhno priobretat vo vremya igry. Rech idet ne tolko o tom, chtoby zapravochnaya stantsiya vyglyadela krasivo. Chem effektnee vyglyadit vasha AZS, tem bolshe klientov budet privlecheno.
Obsluzhivanie klientov - klyuch k uspeshnoy rabote vashey AZS. Vse oni ozhidayut chto ikh mashiny zapolnyatsya i ikh pokupki sdelayutsya srazu, i oni ne tak terpelivy, dazhe kogda delo dokhodit do remonta svoikh avto. Vy budete imet delo s sereznym defitsitom vremeni i dolzhny planirovat vypolnenie razlichnykh zadach na vremya, kogda budet menee napryazhenno. Pravilnyy taym-menedzhment i vybor pravilnykh prioritetov stanovitsya ochen vazhnym, kogda delo dokhodit do podderzhaniya klientov dovolnymi.
«Пернатые копы» — это нуарная сатира, ко:
«Pernatye kopy» — eto nuarnaya satira, kotoraya vossozdaet nastroenie i atmosferu chyorno-belogo kino 40-kh godov, i, kak v luchshikh chyorno-belykh filmakh i krutykh detektivakh, ona nastolko nelitsepriyatna i beznadezhna, chto podavat ee mozhno tolko s izryadnoy dozoy tsinichnogo yumora. Eto — dikiy rasskaz o lyubvi, smerti, pernatykh rytsaryakh i spasenii!..
Klovill byl postroen kak rayskoe mesto, gde khishchniki i zhertvy mogut zhit v mire i protsvetanii. No mechta ostavalas vsego lish mechtoy, poka Klovill medlenno stanovilsya samym temnym ugolkom vsey dikoy prirody.
Приведите войска к победе в современной:
Privedite voyska k pobede v sovremennoy versii klassicheskoy igry RISK s uluchshennoy 3D-grafikoy, individualnymi pravilami i takticheskim igrovym protsessom. Igrayte doma ili v doroge, priglasiv do chetyrekh chelovek, ili v odinochku po seti s sopernikami po vsemu miru.

Novyy vzglyad na klassicheskie pravila: vyberite standartnuyu igru s pravilami obraztsa 2010 goda ili sygrayte korotkuyu partiyu v rezhime «Zakhvat stolits».

Sovremennaya karta srazheniya: rukovodite voyskami iz vysokotekhnologichnogo komandnogo tsentra i poluchayte sovety po taktike, kotorye pomogut vypolnit postavlennuyu zadachu.

Vpechatlyayushchie nagrady: za uspekhi v igre vy mozhete razblokirovat zakhvatyvayushchie videoroliki tankovykh, vozdushnykh i drugikh srazheniy.

Ispytayte sebya v seti: proverte svoi navyki v igre protiv sopernikov so vsego mira ili srazites za verkhnie pozitsii v lige.
Tricky doors — это затягивающая игра, ко:
Tricky doors — eto zatyagivayushchaya igra, kotoraya predlagaet mnozhestvo zagadok. Proyavite smekalku, chtoby vybratsya iz kazhdoy komnaty.

Tricky doors — point-and-click igra v zhanre escape the room, s bolshim kolichestvom uvlekatelnykh mini-igr i slozhnykh kvestov. 

Vam otkroetsya mnozhestvo samykh raznykh dverey. Za kazhdoy vas zhdut vrazhdebnye i druzhelyubnye miry, privychnye i ekzoticheskie peyzazhi. Zadacha lish odna — pokinut cherez portal ocherednoe mesto, kuda zabrosit vas igra. 
Reshayte golovolomki i nakhodite spryatannye predmety. Mnogie iz nikh budut vam znakomy. Nekotorye vy uvidite vpervye. Poluchitsya li u vas s ikh pomoshchyu nayti vykhod — zavisit tolko ot vashey soobrazitelnosti. Broste vyzov svoey nakhodchivosti!

Mnozhestvo velikolepnykh lokatsiy i prekrasnaya grafika
Unikalnye istorii pobega
Uvlekatelnyy poisk predmetov
Brosayushchie vyzov mini-igry
Budet interesno kak novichkam, tak i opytnym igrokam
Jotun – это рисованная вручную приключен:
Jotun – eto risovannaya vruchnuyu priklyuchencheskaya ekshn-igra v mire skandinavskoy mifologii. V igre Jotun vy igraete za Toru, voina-vikinga, kotoraya umerla besslavnoy smertyu i dolzhna dokazat bogam, chto dostoyna Valkhally. 

Issleduyte obshirnye oblasti skandinavskogo chistilishcha, chtoby nayti runy i osvobodit yotunov – gigantskikh skandinavskikh elementaley. Srazites s nimi pri pomoshchi lish bolshoy dvuruchnoy sekiry, blagosloveniy bogov i svoikh umeniy! Vpechatlyáy bogov! 

Osobennosti:
nasladites krasivoy animatsiey, risovannoy vruchnuyu. 
Srazites s pyatyu epicheskimi yotunami – gigantskimi skandinavskimi elementalyami.
Issleduyte devyat obshirnykh misticheskikh urovney, napolnennykh mifologiey vikingov.
Prizovite sily, darovannye bogami vikingov.
Ispytayte svoi navyki v novom rezhime «Valkhalla», predstavlyayushchem bolee yarostnye versii moguchikh yotunov!
Survive the warm \"welcome\" of the musi: Survive the warm "welcome" of the music-loving aliens. Unlock new means of entertaining them. New planets to visit and conquer with your tune! Keep sharp on that Rally but don't be too worried, there is always an Encore! Take it to the extreme!
Играйте за Вайолет, бесстрашного космиче:
Igrayte za Vayolet, besstrashnogo kosmicheskogo issledovatelya, zastryavshego na etoy neizvestnoy planete, i vashego moshchnogo soyuznika, Suychi, letayushchego robota, kotoryy mozhet brosat bomby, sluzhit platformoy, davat sovety o tom, kak nayti skrytye sokrovishcha i mnogoe drugoe.
Prozhivite epicheskoe priklyuchenie v vrazhdebnom mire, polnom opasnostey, gde vam pridetsya prodemonstrirovat svoi navyki. Dokazhite svoyu tsennost svoim oruzhiem i masterstvom pryzhkov v etom ekshn-platformere. K schastyu, vy ne odinoki. Vas budet soprovozhdat vnushitelnyy dron, kotoryy pomozhet vam reshat golovolomki, neobkhodimye dlya prodvizheniya v priklyuchenii. Ego imya — Suychi, i u nego est ochen poleznye sposobnosti, takie kak sluzhenie letayushchey platformoy dlya dostizheniya vysokikh mest, zapusk osobykh bomb, kotorye mogut prokatyvatsya po samym slozhnym mestam, ili pomoshch v poiske skrytykh obektov dlya uluchsheniya vashego zdorovya i drugikh sekretov.
Dragon Quest Heroes I и II для Nintendo:
Dragon Quest Heroes I i II dlya Nintendo Switch — eto dilogiya igr, kotoraya vklyuchaet v sebya Dragon Quest Heroes: The World Tree’s Woe and The Blight Below (Dragon Quest Heroes: Yami Ryu to Sekaiju no Shiro) plyus Dragon Quest Heroes II: Twin Kings and the Prophecy's End (Dragon Quest Heroes II: Futago no Oh to Yogen no Owari), a takzhe dopolnitelnogo igrovogo personazha Ragnara Makrayana (ozvuchivaet Tomokadzu Sugita) iz Dragon Quest IV: Chapters of the Chosen (Dragon Warrior IV), novogo monstra-bossa Malrota iz Dragon Quest II: Luminaries of the Legendary Line (Dragon Warrior II), i geympleynye uluchsheniya s regulirovkoy slozhnosti, a takzhe ves prezhde otdelno zagruzhaemyy kontent.
Mesto deystviya pervoy igry — mirnaya strana Elzayz. Lyudi i monstry zhili v garmonii, poka poslednie tainstvennym obrazom ne prishli v yarost! Chelovechestvo razom bylo okruzheno armiey monstrov, ispolzuya vsyo vozmozhnoe, chtoby vyzhit. Zatem otkrylos sleduyushchee: vinovaty podlye plany Velasko pogruzit mir vo tmu, vzyav pod kontrol vsekh monstrov, osvobodiv temnogo drakona Shadrota, Povelitelya Nochi...
Vo vtoroy igre sobytiya razvivayutsya davnym-davno posle etogo, cherez mnogo let posle dolgoy i uzhasnoy voyna. Kogda ona, nakonets, zakonchilas, lyudi vsego mira zaklyuchili torzhestvennyy dogovor — nikogda bolshe ne voevat s monstrami. Mir byl razgranichen na sem tsarstv, i tsaril tam mir tysyachu let. No odnazhdy, dvoyurodnye bratya i rytsari-stazhery Lazarel i Tereza pribyvayut v korolevstvo Kharba, vdali ot svoego dunisskogo doma. Oni i podozrevayut, chto dunisskaya armiya sobiraetsya vtorgnutsya snova vo glave so svoim starym drugom, printsem Tsezarem..Drugie igry serii Dragon Quest.
Куда приведет вас карта сокровищ Лаки? С:
Kuda privedet vas karta sokrovishch Laki? Skachite kak Laki na svoem vernom mustange — Spirit i nachnite novoe dikoe priklyuchenie v Miradero. Tam est polnostyu otkrytaya granitsa s zakhvatyvayushchimi kvestami i dikoy prirodoy dlya issledovaniya. Vy obyazatelno poluchite massu udovolstviya, kogda ryadom s vami besstrashnye luchshie druzya Laki: Abigayl i Pru! 

Vam nuzhno budet umet orientirovatsya v opasnostyakh tak zhe, kak i konyukh Khendriks, kotoryy slishkom zainteresovan v vashey okhote za sokrovishchami. Svyaz mezhdu Laki i Spirit stanovitsya vse silnee i eto znachit, chto vmeste s priyatelyami vy gotovy stat nastoyashchim pogranichnym ekspertom. Druzhba, vospitanie i issledovaniya — vot klyuch, chtoby razgadat taynu i perekhitrit zlodeya Khendriksa.

Eto zakhvatyvayushchaya i polnaya priklyucheniy zhizn v derevne. Prokatites po pyati razlichnym regionam Miradero, otkryvaya predmety dlya sbora, skrytye tropy i zhivotnykh – kak druzhelyubnykh, tak i opasnykh. Pomogayte gorozhanam, vzyav na sebya rabotu po ekspress-dostavke i spaseniyu zhivotnykh. Ispolzuyte kameru, chtoby zapechatlet krasotu peyzazha i skachite verkhom na Spirit k pobede v zakhvatyvayushchikh skachkakh.

Kogda pridet vremya rasslablyatsya, izmenyayte svoy vneshniy vid s pomoshchyu veshchey i predmetov, kotorye vy nashli v svoikh priklyucheniyakh ili otpravlyaytes v konyushni Miradero, chtoby ukhazhivat za Spirit i obnimat ego. Chem krepche budet vasha svyaz, tem dalshe Spirit smozhet peresech velikuyu granitsu. Smozhete li vy nayti i zashchitit nastoyashchee sokrovishche Miradero?

• Bud Laki — zvezda v novom priklyuchenii Spirit 

• SVYaZ SO SPIRIT — ukhazhivayte za svoim vernym mustangom i obnimayte ego

• POKAZhITE SVOY STIL — ispolzuyte veshchi i predmety, kotorye vy sobiraete, chtoby polnostyu izmenit vneshniy vid Laki i sdelat ego unikalnym

• ZhIVITE SVOEY ZhIZNYu — spasayte zhivotnykh, pomogayte gorozhanam, fotografiruyte i mnogoe drugoe!
Прокатись по крышам, рассекай по песчаны:
Prokatis po krysham, rassekay po peschanym dyunam, prygay cherez palmy i stan professionalnym gonshchikom-kaskaderom v igre Urban Trial Playground!

Deystvie etoy novoy igry-motogonki proiskhodit na solnechnykh i koloritnykh plyazhakh Kalifornii. V igre mnozhestvo tryukov, pryzhkov, salto i razlichnykh kombo. Eto igra skorosti, balansa i stilya! 

Razdelnoe upravlenie perednimi i zadnimi tormozami pozvolyaet igrokam vypolnyat stoppi i frontflipy, a takzhe uspeshno spravlyatsya s zanosami na trasse!

Vpechatlyayushchie, napolnennye solntsem peyzazhi i legkaya atmosfera igry - otlichnoe mesto dlya zakhvatyvayushchikh dukh tryukov, kuvyrkov perez palmy i perevorotov v zolotykh dyunakh.

IGRAY NA RAZLIChNYKh UROVNYaKh
Vse urovni igry Urban Trial Playground spetsialno razrabotany dlya vypolneniya vashikh luchshikh priemov, a takzhe ikh kombinatsiy, za kotorye mozhno poluchit dopolnitelnye ochki.

STAN ABSOLYuTNYM ChEMPIONOM
Igra Urban Trial Playground byla sozdana spetsialno dlya lyubiteley adrenalina i fanatikov fristayla. Kombiniruyte tryuki po-raznomu i zarabatyvayte ochki, chtoby popast v lidery!

RAZNYE REZhIMY IGRY
Rezhimy "Fristayl" i "Na vremya" imeyut onlayn reyting igrokov dlya vsekh 50+ urovney. Prigotovsya zachishchat ukrytiya prestupnikov, nakhodit i obezvrezhivat bomby, osvobozhdat zalozhnikov, sovershat aresty i blyusti poryadok.

– Vynudi protivnikov sdatsya bez chrezmernogo nasiliya. Predupreditelnyy vystrel, pertsovyy ballonchik, rukopashnyy boy - eti i drugie sposoby pomogut sklonit pravonarushitelya sdatsya.

– Otdavay prikazy svoemu naparniku Riku Dzhonsu. Prikroy ego v slozhnykh situatsiyakh i mozhet v sleduyushchiy raz on spaset tebe zhizn. 

– Sluchayno raspolozhennye protivniki, zalozhniki i uliki sdelayut kazhdoe prokhozhdenie unikalnym. Ikh raspolozhenie menyaetsya pri kazhdom perezapuske urovnya, chto privodit k novym stolknoveniyam i vozmozhnostyam.

– Ty poluchish dostup k pervoklassnoy ekipirovke, kotoraya vklyuchaet v sebya svetoshumovuyu granatu, detektor dvizheniya i mnogoe drugoe. Ispolzuya razlichnoe snaryazhenie, nakhodi novyy podkhod k missiyam dlya nailuchshego rezultata.

– Ty stolkneshsya s razlichnymi narushitelyami zakona: nachinaya ot melkikh prestupnikov, zakanchivaya organizovannymi prestupnymi gruppirovkami i terroristami. Kazhdyy vid prestupnikov obladaet raznymi vidami oruzhiya, navykami strelby i patternom povedeniya.

– Takticheskiy geympley. Postaraysya ne popastsya vragu na glaza, ne trat zrya patrony i ne podnimay lishniy shum.

– Vo vremya prokhozhdeniya missiy ochki nachislyayutsya v rezhime realnogo vremeni. Agressivnyy stil igry privedet k poteryam ochkov, i ty ne smozhesh otkryt dostup k sleduyushchemu urovnyu. Ne speshi, k kazhdoy missii nuzhen svoy podkhod.

– V igre dostupen rezhim sovmestnoy igry. Prokhodi missii s drugom, chtoby zarabotat pobolshe ochkov, nu i, konechno, poveselitsya.

Любите «Змейку»? Тогда собирайте героев,:
Lyubite «Zmeyku»? Togda sobirayte geroev, uvelichivaya svoyu kolonnuyu armiyu, i zashchishchayas ot monstrov! U kazhdogo urovnya est tselevye pokazateli tsepochki geroev. Kak tolko on budet dostignut, vas otpravyat na sleduyushchiy uroven: tut est mnogo shtuk, kotorye budut korrektirovatsya v zavisimosti ot vashego urovnya, vklyuchaya faktory zdorovya i nanosimogo urona, dlitelnost usileniy i oslableniy, kolichestvo i silu monstrov, i tak dalee.
Monstry sluchayno dropayut oruzhiya. Raznye geroi mogut byt osnashcheny razlichnym vooruzheniem, naprimer, Gromopalkoy. Krutoy posokh, kotoryy zastavit vashego volshebnika vyzyvat uzhasnyy grom, porazhayushchiy vsekh vragov vokrug! Est baffy i debaffy — veroyatnost, chto ataka oruzhiem aktiviruet opredelennoe usilenie na nyom samom, ili oslablenie na protivnike.
Ledyanoy mech mozhet zamorazhivat vragov.
Интереснейшая ролевая игра в стиле «иссл:
Interesneyshaya rolevaya igra v stile «issledovanie podzemeliy» v sovremennom ispolnenii, no s silnym dukhom staroy shkoly. Gruppa uznikov prigovorena k vernoy smerti v ssylke na izolirovannoy gore Grimrok za zhutkie prestupleniya, kotorye oni, mozhet byt, i ne sovershali. No ne vedali ikh karateli, chto gora pronizana drevnimi tunnelyami, podzemelyami i grobnitsami davno ischeznuvshikh tsivilizatsiy. Teper, esli oni khotyat kogda-libo snova uvidet dnevnoy svet i obresti svobodu, sbrodnaya gruppa izgnannikov dolzhna splotitsya v komandu i spustitsya cherez nutro gory, uroven za urovnem.
Igra vozvrashchaet staromodnye ispytaniya, takie kak takticheskie bitvy v realnom vremeni i peremeshcheniya po setke, khitroumno zapryatannye pereklyuchateli i sekretnye mesta, a takzhe smertelnye lovushki i zhutkikh monstrov. «Legendy Mrachnoy gory» stavyat aktsent na golovolomkakh i issledovanii tak, chto razum i vospriyatie igroka — gorazdo bolee vazhnye instrumenty, nezheli samyy ostryy iz mechey, kakoy tolko mozhet byt. A esli ty zakalennyy v izuchenii podzemeliy veteran i zhazhdesh eshche bolshikh ispytaniy, to zapasaysya listami v kletochku i vklyuchay rezhim «Oldschool», chtoby otklyuchit takuyu izlishnyuyu roskosh, kak avtomaticheskaya karta. Gotovy li vy risknut i rasputat tayny gory Grimrok?

Issleduyte neizvestnuyu prirodu, uchites, vlyublyaytes, nakhodite neobychnykh sushchestv i stalkivaytes s posledstviyami sobstvennogo vybora. Ot vashikh resheniy napryamuyu zavisyat kak zhizni vashikh druzey, tak i sudba vsey kolonii. Kakoy mir vy postroite? Smozhete li voobshche vyzhit? I pochemu vam kazhetsya, chto nechto podobnoe uzhe proiskhodilo?

Stanovlenie cheloveka na chuzhoy planete

U vas vperedi tselaya zhizn. Posvyatite li vy ee obucheniyu v shkole ili issledovaniyu neznakomoy, no prityagatelnoy flory i fauny? Izobretete li vy novye kosmicheskie tekhnologii ili budete zhit v garmonii s prirodoy? Budete li srazhatsya s gigantskimi chudishchami ili vospityvat budushchie pokoleniya? Akvarelnyy mir Vertumny zhdet vas.

I proshloe, i budushchee odinakovo vazhny

Vse, chemu vy uchites, vse, chto s vami sluchaetsya, delaet vas i vashu koloniyu silnee. Vas zhdut i vzlety, i padeniya. Vazhnye momenty stanovleniya (vospominaniya, resheniya, otnosheniya) stanut kollektsionnymi kartami, kotorye vy smozhete nosit s soboy. S kazhdym sezonom budut poyavlyatsya novye prepyatstviya. Boevye karty, kotorye vy budete poluchat s opytom, pomogut vam preodolet pregrady v otnosheniyakh, obuchenii, issledovanii planety ili vyzhivanii. Kazhdoe reshenie sygraet rol — v etoy zhizni ili v sleduyushchey.

Skolko u vas budet zhizney?

Kosmos khranit v sebe mnozhestvo tayn. I vasha sposobnost pomnit proshlye zhizni — odna iz nikh. Vasha istoriya mozhet zavershitsya kak ugodno. Tak skolko zhe vam ponadobitsya zhizney, chtoby spasti i koloniyu, i planetu? Nu chto, vy gotovy roditsya zanovo?

DREAM. DIE. WAKE. REPEAT.\n\nDreamscaper:
DREAM. DIE. WAKE. REPEAT.

Dreamscaper is a Roguelite blending elements from brawlers, top-down shooters, and dungeon crawlers. Every slumber is a different dungeon in an ever-changing world with a multitude of unique events and challenges. Play as Cassidy, dive into her subconscious and take on the surreal nightmares she wrestles with in order to save her from a dark fate.

- FEATURES -  

Lean into the nightmares and make the rush of permadeath your ally.

Use lucid powers to manipulate the elements, warp space, and even control time itself.

Battle bosses that embody Isolation, Fear, Negativity, Loss, and more.

Upgrade a multitude of surreal items and discover powerful artifacts.

 Live Cassidy's waking life and uncover the mystery of her story.

- MASTER DEEP COMBAT SYSTEMS -   

A rich, expansive combat system that rewards skilled play. Use careful positioning, exact timing and quick reflexes to defeat foes with an abundance of combat options.

Each weapon class in Dreamscaper is unique, from rending the earth below your nightmares to whipping a yo-yo into their faces. You’ll have a myriad of ways to approach combat.
Enemies and bosses in Dreamscaper are representations of Cassidy's most negative emotions. Vanquish those deadly foes to clear the dark miasma surrounding her.

 - OVERCOME THE NIGHTMARE - 

Adventure through beautiful, haunting dreams to discover untold secrets, vanquish nightmares, and upgrade your gear all while uncovering Cassidy’s story as you plunge through her subconscious. Each dream is another peek into Cassidy’s memories and experiences.

Live Cassidy's waking life and forge friendships with the people around her. Empower Cassidy with their hopes and memories to dispel the darkness of her nightmares.

V igre osveshcheny problemy neblagopoluchnoy semi, v kotoroy kto-to opuskaet ruki, a kto-to pytaetsya iz poslednikh sil chto to ispravit.
Glavnymi personazhami yavlyayutsya Mariya i ee syn Andrey. Posle gibeli muzha, Mariya vykhodit zamuzh vtoroy raz, za Olega, pytayas sozdat polnotsennuyu semyu dlya svoego syna. No bytovye problemy pogloshchayut novogo muzha i on nakhodit uteshenie v alkogole. A vskore i domashnee nasilie stanovitsya obychnym delom.

Terpenie i bezdeystvie Marii, takoe privychnoe i udobnoe dlya vsekh krome malenkogo Andryushi, privodit zhizn semi k predelnoy tochke, kogda ey nuzhno prinimat smeloe reshenie.
Синематографический визуальный роман от:
Sinematograficheskiy vizualnyy roman ot masterov iz SPRITE, pogruzhayushchiy v emotsionalnoe puteshestvie dvukh molodykh zhenshchin, preodolevayushchikh lichnye trudnosti i dukhovnyy rost vdvoyom. V tsentre nashey istorii Sakasita Mina i Seyno Ran stalkivayutsya vmeste v otdalyonnom primorskom domike. Mina nachinaet svoy put kak novenkaya uchenitsa v elitnoy starshey shkole. Chuvstvuya sebya ne v svoey tarelke sredi sverkhobespechennykh sverstnikov, ona zamykaetsya i izoliruetsya, provodya bolshuyu chast vremeni v komnate, okruzhennoy sukhotsvetami. Mirovospriyatie devushki stanovitsya podobno uroborosu, a emotsionalnoe sostoyanie ukhudshaetsya den oto dnya vsledstvie izbeganiya vsyacheskikh sotsialnykh vzaimodeystviy i formiruyushchikhsya v svyazi s etim psikhologicheskikh problem.
V otlichie ot Miny, Seyno — «serebryanaya lozhechka», chto vsegda sledovala za roditelskimi nastavleniyami. Nesmotrya na izbytochnyy materialnyy komfort, ponimanie poverkhnostnogo kharaktera v lichnykh otnosheniyakh i otsutstvie nastoyashchey, iskrenney zaboty so storony vsekh okruzhayushchikh privodit devushku k poiskam peremen v svoey zhizni, gde ona vstrechaet Min. Zdes puti obeikh peresekayutsya i situatsiya stanovitsya katalizatorom vzaimnogo istseleniya emotsionalnykh ran, nakhodya uteshenie i ponimanie drug v druge v takoy stepen, chto ranshe schitali polnostyu nedostizhimym..

Sygrayte vo vse litsenzirovannye turniry za lyubogo iz 128 luchshikh igrokov v snuker. V ikh chislo vkhodyat Ronni O’Sallivan, Mark Selbi, Din Tszyunkhuey i takie legendy, kak Ken Doerti i Dzhimmi Uayt.

NEVIDANNYY UROVEN REALIZMA
Samyy realistichnyy simulyator snukera v istorii: s «kartinkoy» i kommentariem televizionnogo kachestva, «nastoyashchey» fizikoy i prodvinutym iskusstvennym intellektom.

STANTE LEGENDOY
Perepisyvayte istoriyu i beyte rekordy v roli vashego lyubimogo igroka ili nachnite novoe puteshestvie kak vypusknik akademii Q-School.

IGRA S DRUGIMI IGROKAMI PO SETI I OFLAYN
Vybirayte lyuboy iz mnozhestva oflayn- i onlayn-rezhimov: ot bystrykh partiy s avtomaticheskim podborom sopernika do globalnykh setevykh turnirov, prokhodyashchikh v to zhe vremya, chto i nastoyashchie turniry pod egidoy World Snooker. A eshche zdes est nastraivaemye partii v klassicheskiy snuker, «s shestyu krasnymi» i «shut-aut» dlya oflayn- i onlayn-rezhimov.
Армелло – это дерзкое и смелое приключен:
Armello – eto derzkoe i smeloe priklyuchenie, kotoroe sochetaet tri stilya igry: kartochnuyu taktiku, strategiyu nastolnykh igr i rolevuyu sistemu. 

V kachestve geroya odnogo iz klanov Armello vy budete vypolnyat zadaniya, sostavlyat plany, nanimat agentov, issledovat territorii, izgonyat monstrov, tvorit zaklinaniya i bitsya s drugimi igrokami za odnu glavnuyu tsel – shturmovat dvorets i stat Korolem ili Korolevoy Armello. Korolevstvo Armello stol zhe prekrasno, skol i opasno: ispytaniya, Gady i bandity pryachutsya za kazhdym uglom, a rasprostranenie zarazheniya, izvestnogo kak Gnil, ne ostavlyaet ni odno zhivoe sushchestvo netronutym.
Degrees of Separation — это совместная 2:
Degrees of Separation — eto sovmestnaya 2D igra-golovolomka, v kotoroy Ember i Raym upravlyayut razdelyayushchey ikh zagadochnoy siloy, preodolevaya pregrady i uznavaya vse bolshe o svoikh perepletayushchikhsya sudbakh.

Igrokov zhdet chudesnaya istoriya ot Krisa Evellona. Blagodarya sposobnostyam Ember i Rayma upravlyat siloy tepla i kholoda, neveroyatnye peyzazhi nachnut ozhivat, pomogaya razgadat zagadki, voznikayushchie pered nimi vo vremya puteshestviy. Eti dvoe nauchatsya deystvovat soobshcha s pomoshchyu svoikh unikalnykh talantov.
Более ста островов для исследования в от: Bolee sta ostrovov dlya issledovaniya v otkrytom mire. Zavodite druzey, varite zelya, priruchayte dukhov i ispytayte svoi sily v kartochnykh srazheniyakh, chtoby stat nastoyashchim masterom alkhimii!
Прочувствуйте адреналин в официальной ви:
Prochuvstvuyte adrenalin v ofitsialnoy videoigre chempionata Monster Energy Supercross 2017 g.!
Kataytes po ofitsialnym trassam za gonshchikov iz distsiplin 250SX i 450SX, primite uchastie v samom zakhvatyvayushchem sostyazanii!
Кооперативная головоломка с асимметричны:
Kooperativnaya golovolomka s asimmetrichnym geympleem pro pobeg iz poezda!
Kontseptsiya How 2 Escape: poka odin igrok na konsoli zapert v vagone poezda i pytaetsya vybratsya, drugoy — ispolzuya besplatnoe prilozhenie-kompanon dlya iOS i Android — ishchet dlya tovarishcha poleznuyu informatsiyu. Na schetu kazhdaya sekunda: u kazhdogo svoi ogranicheniya po vremeni. Esli ono istechyot, to igre konets. Chem dolshe uchastniki budut tyanut s resheniem zadachki, tem tumannee budet stanovitsya razgadka.
Dlya prokhozhdeniya golovolomok v How 2 Escape ot igrokov potrebuetsya logika, koordinatsiya, nablyudatelnost i, v pervuyu ochered, obshchenie i vzaimodeystvie drug s drugom!
Почувствуйте драйв Motocross в единствен: Pochuvstvuyte drayv Motocross v edinstvennoy ofitsialnoy igre po chempionatu! V zakhvatyvayushchey MXGP3 — The Official Motocross Videogame vas zhdet polnostyu obnovlennyy igrovoy protsess! Sorevnuytes na 18 ofitsialnykh trassakh i v nezabyvaemoy MXoN, poprobuyte vsekh gonshchikov i mototsikly s 2016 MXGP i sezonov MX2, a takzhe vpervye prokatites na 10 mototsiklakh 2-stroke! Izmenyayte svoego gonshchika i mototsikl s pomoshchyu bolee chem 300 ofitsialnykh komponentov!
Super Squidlit imitates the Game Boy™ Co:
Super Squidlit imitates the Game Boy™ Color's capabilities and limitations for a squishy adventure! The colorful world of Squishu and its invertebrate inhabitants need your help! Play as Plip and your old foe, Skwit Skwot, as you set sail to banish a great evil.

- Squip your way through the islands of Squishu as Plip, a wee squidlit that can double jump to ink on things below you!

- Plip's new roll tackle lets you manipulate foes and gain a burst of speed!

- Blast your way through enemies as the wizardly Skwit Skwot, GOD EMPEROR, in ray-casting 3D RPG levels!

- Meet lots of goofy Squidlits!

Like the first Squidlit game did with the Game Boy™, Super Squidlit adheres to the limitations of the Game Boy™ Color:
* No more than 10 sprites in a horizontal line
* No more than 40 sprites at any time
* 3 colors per sprite
* 160 x 144 pixel resolution
* 4 sound channels for music and SFX
* All sounds were recorded on a real Game Boy™ Color!

Can you guide Plip and Skwit Skwot to victory and save Squishu?
Everything is out to get poor Mike. Port:
Everything is out to get poor Mike. Portals that slice him to bits. Demons with giant swords. Scary eyeballs. Killer statues. And other, horrible things, that we can't mention in this family-friendly description.

Only your platforming skills can keep Mike alive!

- Explore a massive non-linear spaceship, with like, a million secret areas.

- Dying is actually fun! You will only feel bad for Mike a little bit.

- Multiple endings! Unravel Mike’s enigmatic past and discover his true fate!

- Epic boss encounters!

- Fully voice acted!

*No actual Mikes were harmed in the making of this title.
Vampire: The Masquerade - Shadows of New:
Vampire: The Masquerade - Shadows of New York predstavlyaet soboy otdelnoe dopolnenie k VtM: Coteries of New York. V to vremya kak Coteries znakomit igroka s mirom, izobrazhennym v 5-m izdanii znamenitoy nastolnoy igry, Shadows rasskazyvaet bolee lichnuyu i unikalnuyu istoriyu.

- Vizualnaya novella o lichnykh i politicheskikh strakhakh.
- Vzglyanite na znakomyy gorod s sovershenno novoy tochki zreniya. Novye personazhi, novye lokatsii i novyy originalnyy saundtrek.
- Igrayte za chlena klana Lasombra. Pogruzites v teni i obshchaytes s obitatelyami potustoronnego mira
- Sozdayte sobstvennyy razum i sobstvennuyu sudbu. Vashi resheniya povliyayut na vashe myshlenie. A vashe myshlenie – na to, kakoy put vy vyberete.
- Issleduyte ulitsy Bolshogo yabloka. Nablyudayte za uvlekatelnymi stsenami gorodskoy zhizni, stroyte otnosheniya s ekstsentrichnymi mestnym zhitelyami. Odnogo prokhozhdeniya budet yavno nedostatochno.
Гараж. Соединенные смертью.\n\nГараж - э:
Garazh. Soedinennye smertyu.

Garazh - eto krovavyy shuter v stile bi muvi epokhi vkhs. Tebe predstoit igrat za byvshego narkotorgovtsa Butcha, kotoryy v odinochku protivostoit ordam zhivykh mertvetsov.

Issleduy vse temnye ugolki podzemnoy parkovki i otkroy prokhod v potustoronniy mir, kuda nikogda ne pronikal dnevnoy svet. 

Nakhodi novoe oruzhie i ovladey im, chtoby vyzhit. Razgaday taynu etogo proklyatogo mesta i tvarey, kotorye ego naselyayut.
Let the race for the title of the best c:
Let the race for the title of the best car mechanic begin!

Pick up your tools and work your magic in order to bring old, rusty wrecks back to their former glory.

Hours of blood, sweat, customising, and repairs will allow you to create the ultimate beast of a vehicle, capable of facing the rest of the best in a series of gruelling races!

Features:

• Repair
Buy and repair your favourite vehicles - from the petite Tiny to the luxurious Vette! Change the engine, add some nitro, reduce weight, and much more.

• Customization
Add some personality to your ride! Woo the judges with a splash of colour, some cool decals or brand new rims and spoilers.

• Tuning
Play around with various settings that will influence your car’s performance. Adjust gear ratios, change the size of the turbocharger, balance the brake strength and find the perfect balance for your driving style.

• Race
After everything’s ready and you're ready to go, take your car for the final drive at the Mechanic Battle Tournament. Race against other drivers, take part in an elimination challenge or push your speed limits during hot laps - all for that sweet, sweet money and even better cars!
Эффективно сжигайте лишние объёмы с помо:
Effektivno szhigayte lishnie obyomy s pomoshchyu trenirovki myshts i aerobnykh uprazhneniy!.. Sochetaya vysokointensivnuyu trenirovku, prisedaniya i skruchivaniya myshts zhivota s aerobnymi uprazhneniyami, takimi kak boks, dzhazovyy tanets, samba i aerobika, eta fitnes-igra predlagaet vam polnotsennuyu programmu uprazhneniy s dzhoykonami, doma!
45 tipov dvizheniy, napravlennykh na trenirovku myshts i anaerobnye uprazhneniya, takie kak vypady, pryzhki i skruchivaniya, pozvolyaya realizovat metody HIIT spetsialno na Nintendo Switch.
Aerobnye uprazhneniya, takie kak tantsy i boks! Nabor vklyuchaet v sebya 20 tipov aerobnykh uprazhneniy «Ritm-Fit» v techenie dlitelnogo perioda vremeni, privodyashchiy telo v ritm. Poprobuyte neobychnye tantsy, takie kak «Parapara» i «Otagey», chtoby razvlechsya!
A velikolepnye yaponskie aktery ozvuchki (seyyu) budut podderzhivat vash dukh! Pyat instruktorov s raznymi kharakterami ne tolko dayut poleznye sportivnye sovety: kak pravilno dvigatsya, stavit ruki i nogi, no takzhe zamotiviruyut vas i v nuzhnyy moment podderzhat v vashey povsednevnoy deyatelnosti.Videotreyler.
DISTRAINT: Deluxe Edition — психологичес:
DISTRAINT: Deluxe Edition — psikhologicheskaya priklyuchencheskaya 2D-igra v zhanre uzhasov, rasskazyvayushchaya istoriyu Praysa, molodogo cheloveka, kotoryy zakhvatyvaet kvartiru pozhiloy zhenshchiny. Posle zakhvata ee doma ot ego chelovechnosti ne ostalos i sleda. Tak nachinaetsya rasskaz o ego raskayanii...

Probiraytes po raznym mestam, izuchaya predystoriyu Praysa i ego motivy, kotorye priveli ego na etot temnyy put. 

Prodvigaytes po mrachnoy istorii, reshaya legkie golovolomki v razlichnykh stsenariyakh i situatsiyakh!

Kharakteristiki:
 * bokovaya prokrutka 2D-grafiki s dinamicheskoy prorisovannoy grafikoy;
 * atmosfernaya muzyka i zvukovoy dizayn;
 * minimalistichnyy interfeys, chtoby vashe vnimanie ne otvlekalos ot proiskhodyashchego;
 * unikalnaya istoriya, polnaya intriguyushchikh povorotov.

DISTRAINT 2:
Iskuplenie... Nadezhda... Mozhno li obresti zanovo eti ponyatiya posle prodazhi svoey dushi v presleduyushchem proshlom?

Ty - Prays, chelovek, kotoryy prodal svoyu chelovechnost, chtoby poluchit partnerstvo v vedushchey kompanii McDade, Bruton & Moore. Sobiray predmety i reshay golovolomki, chtoby prozhit istoriyu i vyyasnit, smozhet li Prays vernut svoyu poteryannuyu dushu.

DISTRAINT 2 prodolzhaet sobytiya pervoy igry. Eto zloveshchaya istoriya o vosstanovlenii nadezhdy i poiske tseli prednaznacheniya.

Kharakteristiki:
* Bokovaya prokrutka s unikalnoy risovannoy 2D-grafikoy
* Atmosfernyy saundtrek
* Minimalistichnyy i effektnyy interfeys
* Pogruzis v slozhnuyu istoriyu, polnuyu intriguyushchikh povorotov i personazhey
* Vklyuchaet kratkoe rezyume DISTRAINT 1
1520 год, XVI век. Всё началось с того,:
1520 god, XVI vek. Vsyo nachalos s togo, kak vy otkryli prislannoe pismo. Napisannoe vashim pokoynym lendlordom, ono podrobno opisyvaet, chto vy teper yavlyaetes naslednikom ego tainstvennogo osobnyaka. Vy otpravlyaetes na ostrov, na kotorom etot strannyy tip provel svoi poslednie gody, i tak nachinaetsya vashe puteshestvie v samye glubokie tayny magii i drevnego okkultizma!
Orientirovannaya na povestvovanie, nasha igra proverit vash um i nervy. Prosmatrivayte stranitsy lavkraftovskoy istorii, vzaimodeystvuyte s kartami i reshayte golovolomki, vstrechayushchiesya na puti. Proydite po sledam bezumnogo starika, chtoby raskryt samye glubokie tayny syuzheta, napolnennogo uzhasom i magiey.
Igra «49 Keys» byla adaptirovana avtorom odnoimennogo bestsellera 2022 goda, Mikele Buonano. Poluchiv vostorzhennye otzyvy kritikov, ona voshla v spisok luchshikh igr-knig Italii vsekh vremyon.
Rogue («роуг») — видеоигра, написанная в:
Rogue («roug») — videoigra, napisannaya v 1980 godu Mayklom Toyem, Glennom Vichmanom i Kenom Arnoldom. Eyo osnovnoy temoy yavlyaetsya issledovanie podzemeliy. Ona byla neobychayno populyarnoy na universitetskikh Unix-sistemakh v nachale 1980-kh godov i porodila tselyy zhanr, izvestnyy kak «Roguelike» (Rogue-podobnye igry, t.n. «rogaliki»).
Brogue — izvestnaya sovremennaya otkrytaya, besplatnaya i svobodnaya igra v zhanre rogalik, sozdannaya Brayanom Uokerom. Kak i v ego predshestvennike, Rogue, tsel Brogue sostoit v tom, chtoby igrok (predstavlennyy personazhem «@») spustilsya na 26-y etazh Dungeons of Doom, zabral Amulet Yendora i vernulsya na poverkhnost. U igrokov takzhe est vozmozhnost uglubitsya v podzemele, chtoby nabrat bolshe ochkov. Eta zadacha uslozhnyaetsya nalichiem monstrov i lovushek v protsedurno generiruemom podzemele.
Razrabotka igry nachalas v 2009 godu, a eyo interfeys, dizayn i grafika personazhey poluchili vysokuyu otsenku za ikh odnovremennuyu gibkost, mnogochislennye vozmozhnosti, prostotu vospriyatiya i krasotu.
Remothered: Tormented Fathers – кинемато:
Remothered: Tormented Fathers – kinematografichnyy survival horror..

Istoriya nasyshchena originalnymi syuzhetnymi povorotami, kotorye ne ostavyat igroka ravnodushnym. V Remothered psikhologiya igraet vazhnuyu rol: geroi i zlodei ne vpisyvayutsya v ramki stereotipov, a gran mezhdu dobrom i zlom razmyta. Razvitie igry skhozhe s povestvovaniem filma: igrok otozhdestvlyaet sebya s personazhem. Saundtrek za avtorstvom Nobuko Tody i Luki Balboni lish usilivaet zhutkuyu atmosferu igry.

Rozmari Rid, privlekatelnaya zhenshchina 35 let, poseshchaet osobnyak doktora Feltona, byvshego notariusa, stradayushchego ot tainstvennogo neduga. Geroinyu vstrechaet miss Gloriya, sidelka, zabotyashchayasya o starike. Kogda Rozmari raskryvaet svoi lichnost i istinnye namereniya, koshmar nachinaetsya.

OSOBENNOSTI

Remothered: Tormented Fathers — pervaya chast dolgozhdannoy trilogii igr ot 3-go litsa. Pautina lzhi, v kotoroy smeshalis ubiystva i strasti. Nezabyvaemye oshchushcheniya dlya vsekh lyubiteley uzhasov s elementami vyzhivaniya.

Mnozhestvo putey vyzhivaniya: mnogochislennye kombinatsii igrovykh mekhanik dostupny kazhdomu igroku. Tikhoe prokhozhdenie, shumnoe prokhozhdenie, vozmozhnost deystvovat strategicheski ili zhe prosto bezhat i pryatatsya. 

Obmanyvayte presledovateley ili zapirayte ikh v razlichnykh chastyakh osobnyaka. Napadayte na obidchikov i uluchshayte svoi predmety. Vnimatelno izuchayte povedenie vraga i ego put, no ne priblizhaytes k nemu. Dvigaytes slovno ten, ne popadayas nikomu na glaza. Ili smeshivayte vse perechislennoe.

Psikhologicheskiy syuzhet: geroi istorii — samye obyknovennye lyudi, obrashchayushchiesya v koshmarnykh chudovishch.

Kinematografichnye stseny: blagodarya chutkomu rukovodstvu Krisa Derrila istoriya slovno ozhivaet, raskryvaya igroku slozhnykh i prorabotannykh personazhey.

Audiopodskazki: prislushivaytes k saundtreku i obemnomu zvuku, chtoby ponyat, naskolko blizko k vam podobralis presledovateli.

Nikakikh polosok zhizni: tolko vzglyanuv na sebya vy smozhete ponyat vashe tekushchee sostoyanie.

Realistichnye golovolomki: okruzhenie i personazhi prorabotany i vypolneny maksimalno pravdopodobno.

Zagruzka v realnom vremeni: issleduyte osobnyak, ne otvlekayas na skuchnye zagruzochnye ekrany.
Знаменитый дизайнер игр Роберта Уильямс:
Znamenityy dizayner igr Roberta Uilyams vozrozhdaet Kolossalnuyu Peshcheru kak retro-golovolomku v stile "nazhmi i klikni". Osnovyvayas na originalnom dizayne 1970-kh godov Uilla Kroutera i Dona Vudsa, nachale igr v zhanre priklyucheniy, eto 3D-obnovlenie sokhranyaet svoy vintazhnyy sharm, adaptiruya ego dlya sovremennykh geymerov.

Otpravlyaytes v vechnoe puteshestvie po obshirnoy sisteme peshcher, polnykh sokrovishch, sushchestv, labirintov i golovolomok, oshelomlyayushchikh um. Velikiy prapredok priklyuchencheskikh igr proverit vas i razvlechet vashi navyki resheniya problem, poka vy ne raskroete ego syuzhet i sekrety. Cherez khitroe metodom prob i oshibok vy budete probiratsya cherez uzkie prokhody, vstrechat vpechatlyayushchie peshchery, sobirat inventar, nakhodit sokrovishcha, protivostoyat atakam gnomov, sledya za schetom, poka vash fonar ne pogasnet.

Eta perelomnaya igra schitaetsya odnoy iz samykh vliyatelnykh v istorii, ustanovivshey standarty, kotorye stali normoy v zhanre priklyuchencheskikh igr. Eyo portirovali prakticheski na kazhdyy kompyuter i konsol, v neyo igrali milliony, ona vdokhnovila mnozhestvo drugikh igr, knig, filmov i teleshou.

S eyo slozhnymi i zakhvatyvayushchimi golovolomkami eta issledovatelskaya igra ne otpustit vas. Issleduyte 14 razlichnykh regionov, polnykh magii, skrytykh sekretov, zakhvatyvayushchikh vidov i sushchestv, obitayushchikh v peshcherakh. Kazhdaya zona predlagaet unikalnyy i volshebnyy opyt; vy budete v vostorge chasami.

• Prostoe, intuitivnoe upravlenie "nazhmi i klikni"
• Zakhvatyvayushchie, krasochnye i pogruzhayushchie regiony
• Slozhnye logicheskie golovolomki
• Idealnoe sochetanie slozhnosti i nagrady
• Zhivopisnye podzemnye peyzazhi s skrytymi sekretami
• Igra, kotoraya neveroyatno veselaya i uvlekatelnaya

I, naskolko eta igra propitana istoriey i mifami igr, est i prichina, po kotoroy ona vyderzhala ispytanie vremenem i stala tak silno perepletena s igrovoy kulturoy. Eto veselo! Eto tvorcheskoe. Eto stimuliruet myshlenie i slozhnoe. Eto i prosto, i slozhno. Eto fantasticheskiy dizayn.

Otpravlyaytes v Kolossalnuyu Peshcheru i issleduyte eyo glubiny. Ne zabudte vash fonar!
Хоррор-рогалик, отличающийся эксперимент:
Khorror-rogalik, otlichayushchiysya eksperimentalnym khudozhestvennym stilem i glubokimi zagadkami.
Vstrettes litsom k litsu s uzhasami, kotorye skryvaet vash dom za kazhdym uglom, i uznayte, kto na samom dele «Chelovek bez kozhi»!
Guild of Darksteel – зрелищный платформе:
Guild of Darksteel – zrelishchnyy platformer s bokovoy prokrutkoy v mire temnogo fentezi, polnom detaley i nyuansov.

Otpravlyaytes v mrachnoe priklyuchenie v roli Sellsword – bessmertnogo voina, vstupivshego v gildiyu Darksteel v poiskakh smysla zhizni.

Stante odnim iz bessmertnykh naemnikov i issleduyte zagadochnye tonneli pod gorodom Ravenrock.

Osobennosti igry
Zakhvatyvayushchie boi: prodvinutaya boevaya sistema daet shans pobedit lyubogo, kto vstanet na vashem puti. Otkryvayte kombinatsii i povyshayte ikh uroven. Svyazyvayte ataki i ishchite strategiyu boya, kotoraya prineset pobedu.

Zhivoy i podvizhnyy mir: izuchayte gorod Ravenrock i obshchaytes s ego zhitelyami. Zdes u kazhdogo personazha est svoya istoriyu, vdykhayushchaya zhizn v mir Guild of Darksteel. V etom mire vam zapomnyatsya i druzya, i vragi.

Glubokaya i nebanalnaya istoriya: Guild of Darksteel rasskazyvaet zakhvatyvayushchuyu istoriyu o borbe za vlast i poiskakh sebya v dukhe takoy klassiki, kak Flashback i Vagrant Story. Ee personazhi prinimayut nelegkie resheniya, pomnya o smerti... ili bessmertii.

Potryasayushchie khudozhestvennye resheniya: mir Guild of Darksteel – eto mrachnyy, no vyrazitelnyy piksel-art na fone zloveshchey i intriguyushchey muzyki. Unikalnaya i smelaya tsvetovaya palitra zadaet idealnyy ton dlya togo, chtoby izuchat pritaivshuyusya pod gorodom tmu.
Проснувшись одним обыкновенным утром, вы:
Prosnuvshis odnim obyknovennym utrom, vy obnaruzhivaete, chto prevratilis v zhuka, a vash drug Dzhozef arestovan.  

Dlya ego spaseniya i poiska otvetov na voprosy vam pridetsya stolknutsya s mirom, kotoryy, ravno kak i vy, preterpel neveroyatnye izmeneniya.

Kogda-to privychnoe okruzhenie prevratilos v polosu prepyatstviy. Vperedi put, prolegayushchiy cherez samye ukromnye ugolki i shcheli. 

Ispolzuyte smekalku, chtoby dobratsya do istiny i vernutsya k prezhney zhizni.

Mir vzglyadom zhuka: mnogoe otkroetsya vam s sovershenno novoy storony.
Neprostye golovolomki: ishchite podskazki i preodolevayte prepyatstviya.
Unikalnye mekhaniki dvizheniya: ispolzuyte preimushchestva kroshechnogo tela i lipkikh lapok.

V kachestve elitnogo agenta kompanii okhotnikov na privideniy "Prodidzhium", vy dolzhny ispolzovat shirokiy vybor oruzhiya, apgreydov i magicheskikh relikviy, chtoby zashchitit chelovechestvo ot ord sverkhestestvennykh sozdaniy pod nachalom printsessy Amanet. V razdache nakhodyatsya 5 khoumbryu igr-klonov Tetris, Pac-Man, Snake, Pong i Space Invaders, napisannykh na C# s vozmozhnostyu sozdavat svoi.
Si sharp — obektno-orientirovannyy yazyk programmirovaniya obshchego naznacheniya, razrabotan v 1998 godu gruppoy inzhenerov kompanii Microsoft pod rukovodstvom Andersa Kheylsberga i Skotta Viltaumota kak yazyk razrabotki prilozheniy dlya platformy Microsoft .NET Framework i .NET, vposledstvii standartizirovan kak ECMA-334 i ISO/IEC 23270.
C# otnositsya k seme yazykov s C-podobnym sintaksisom, ego sintaksis naibolee blizok k C++ i Java. Yazyk imeet staticheskuyu tipizatsiyu, podderzhivaet polimorfizm, peregruzku operatorov, v tom chisle operatorov yavnogo i neyavnogo privedeniya tipa, delegaty, atributy, sobytiya, peremennye, svoystva, obobshchyonnye tipy i metody, iteratory, anonimnye funktsii s podderzhkoy zamykaniy, LINQ, isklyucheniya, kommentarii v formate XML. Perenyav mnogoe ot svoikh predshestvennikov — yazykov C++, Delphi, Modula, Smalltalk i Java — S#, opirayas na praktiku ikh ispolzovaniya, isklyuchaet nekotorye modeli, zarekomendovavshie sebya kak problematichnye pri razrabotke programmnykh sistem: naprimer, C# v otlichie ot C++ ne podderzhivaet mnozhestvennoe nasledovanie klassov, v to zhe vremya dopuskaya mnozhestvennuyu realizatsiyu interfeysov.

Eto borba semerykh magov za obladanie legendarnym artefaktom — Svyatym Graalem, kotoryy ispolnit lyuboe zhelanie pobeditelya i, takim obrazom, izmenit ego sudbu. Kazhdyy mag s momenta svoego nachala uchastiya v voyne prizyvaet slugu — odnu iz velikikh geroicheskikh dush proshlogo ili budushchego - srazhayushchegosya na storone svoego khozyaina.
Est sem slug, vse oni prinadlezhat k raznym boevym klassam: mechnik (Seyber), luchnik (Archer), kopeyshchik (Lanser), vsadnik (Rayder), berserker, ubiytsa (Assasin) i mag (Kaster). Bitva vedetsya do tekh por, poka ne ostanetsya odna para mastera i slugi. Emiya Shiro protiv sobstvennoy voli prizyvaet mechnitsu — slugu, postavivshuyu sebe tsel dobratsya do Graalya lyubym putyom. Odnako, on ne zhelaet uchastvovat v bitve, tak kak v proshloy voyne poteryal vsekh svoikh rodnykh.

LEGO Ninjago: Shadow of Ronin («Ten Ronina») — videoigra po motivam LEGO Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu, iznachalno vypushchennaya na Nintendo 3DS i PlayStation Vita. Pozdnee ona byla vypushchena kak prilozhenie dlya iOS i Android. Sobytiya etoy igry proiskhodyat mezhdu sezonami №4 i №5.
V Nindzyago novaya ugroza, i imya ey — Ronin. On vozglavlyaet armiyu zlykh samuraev i s pomoshchyu drevnego oruzhiya, izvestnogo kak Obsidianovaya Glefa, kradet u nindzya vospominaniya. Vam predstoit pomoch nindzya vernut ukradennye vospominaniya i sily, pomeshav Roninu ispolnit kovarnyy zamysel, kotoryy navlechet na Nindzyago eshche bolshuyu bedu. Vas zhdut znakomye po serialu peyzazhi, vklyuchaya Khram lda i Yadovituyu top, zagadochnyy novyy ostrov, a takzhe vizit v Spindzyago, gde nindzya treniruyutsya pod nadzorom velikogo senseya Dareta i senseya Vu.

The original Fabled Lands gamebooks, wri:
The original Fabled Lands gamebooks, written by Dave Morris and Jamie Thomson, and beloved by many, have been transformed into an epic, digital adventure of interactive fiction with a massive game world. Be anyone you want: explorer, merchant, priest, scholar, thief, wizard, or soldier of fortune. Buy ships, goods, and townhouses, join a temple, risk desperate adventures in the wilderness, or embroil yourself in court intrigues and the sudden violence of city backstreets. Undertake missions that will earn you allies and enemies, or remain a free agent and choose your own objectives. With hundreds of quests and locations to explore, the choices are all yours.

EXPLORE THE FABLED LANDS

Open World
Revolution rages in a war-torn kingdom. You can join forces with the king to restore his throne - or look for profit in the pay of the dictator. Use fighting skills or sorcery, bribery or skulduggery to survive the assassins in city backstreets. Descend to the sewers of Yellowport to defeat the vile rat-king. Retrieve the golden net of the gods from the Repulsive Ones deep beneath the sea - and use the rewards of your victories to travel beyond the boundaries of the known in the world of Harkuna. Your journeys will bring you foes and friends, danger and triumph, fortune and fame - and more adventures than you thought.

Loot and Riches
Amass wealth, honours and power that will take you on voyages to uncharted regions. You can sail the high seas to distant ports. Plunder ancient treasures and do battle with the legions of darkness in the hall of the death-god. Penetrate the labyrinth of lies and sinister secrets of the scheming merchants of Golnir.

CHOOSE YOUR PATH

An old-school RPG
A solitaire role playing game in a pick your own adventure style like no other. Explore a giant open-ended world, where you can truly travel, investigate, and meddle with things, when and as you see fit to do so.

Create YOUR Character
Write your own story! You can be a warrior, using weapons and combat skills to strike down all opponents; a mystical mage, skilled in sorcery; a clever rogue, acquiring wealth by theft and trickery; a daring wayfarer, probing and charting the forgotten reaches of the wilderness; a priest, fighting dark monsters with the holy fires of faith; or a troubadour, charming all you meet on your many fabulous exploits.

Tactical Combat
Hideous dangers await travellers in this savage land. Brigands, trolls, golems, flying heads, assassins, vampires, kelpies, demons, abominable cults, the undead, and many more - all of them will vanquish the unsuspecting adventurer.

SURVIVE AGAINST ALL ODDS
Permadeath

Would you like to raise the stakes? Experience Ironman mode, where every decision is irreversible and your character dies once and for all.

Temples
Choose a deity and obtain its blessing. But remember: once an initiate, if you are to renounce a god or a goddess there is a price. Do you want to reconsider?

Ships
Buy your own ship: upgrade it and recruit a crew - their abilities might prove the difference when surviving a storm or vicious buccaneers. Fill your ship with valuable cargo and find where to sell it for profit.

\"Late Shift” — криминальный триллер FMV:
"Late Shift” — kriminalnyy triller FMV, v kotorom mnogoe postavleno na kon. Posle togo, kak ego nasilno vtyanuli v ograblenie pribylnogo auktsionnogo doma, studentu-matematiku Mettu prikhoditsya dokazyvat svoyu nevinovnost v zhestokom londonskom ograblenii. Kazhdyy tvoy vybor s samogo nachala igry i vplot do ee kontsa budet imet posledstviya. Odno malenkoe reshenie mozhet polnostyu izmenit iskhod etoy igry v stile "vyberi svoe priklyuchenie" — iskhod, u kotorogo est sem variantov.

Ty okazheshsya v tsentre zakhvatyvayushchego kriminalnogo trillera v stile igry zhivogo deystviya, snyatogo po proizvedeniyu Sherloka Kholmsa (film 2009 goda), gde tebya ozhidaet bolee chem 180 tochek prinyatiya resheniy. Chto ty sdelaesh — ugonish mashinu ili ubezhish? Budesh podchinyatsya prikazam ili sabotiruesh plan? Na prinyatie resheniy u tebya est vsego neskolko sekund, poka film prodolzhaet idti bez pauz i povtoreniya kadrov.

Snyatoe v full HD, kinematograficheskoe priklyuchenie "Late Shift” stiraet linii, razgranichivayushchie film, igru i interaktivnoe povestvovanie.

Ностальгия поражает воображение благодар:
Nostalgiya porazhaet voobrazhenie blagodarya etomu vdokhnovlennomu v 90-kh godakh staromu shkolnomu zapadnomu gusenitsu RPG, v kotorom vy upravlyaete gruppoy iz semi personazhey!

Ego sistema dvizheniy, osnovannaya na povorote na 90 gradusov, napominaet klassiku zhanra dungeon crawler.

Bolshaya istoriya vrashchaetsya vokrug gruppy geroev igroka (izgotovlennykh po individualnomu zakazu ili predvaritelno sdelannykh) i ikh poiska relikvii proshedshikh dney - Yantarnoy korony - obekta, pozvolyayushchego ego vladeltsu kontrolirovat velikuyu silu, proklyatuyu zlymi silami, chtoby byt zabytoy, vycherknut iz istorii. Predpolozhitelno, on prinadlezhit pravyashchemu korolyu po pravu rozhdeniya, i s prodolzhayushchimsya vtorzheniem ogrov, korolevstvo otchayanno nuzhdaetsya v tom, chtoby perezhit natisk.

Okunites v obshirnyy mir Amberlanda, so mnozhestvom bashen, zamkov, peshcher i podzemeliy, spryatannykh za kazhdym uglom. Raskroyte vsyu kartu s pomoshchyu Gildii naezdnikov na grifonakh. Pomogite mnogim obespokoennym dusham v poiskakh pravilnogo priklyuchencheskogo etiketa i pozhinayte plody. Srazites s mnozhestvom raznykh protivnikov, ot nedoplachennykh alebardov do groznykh paukoobraznykh i drakonov. Smelye bolota, zamerzshie tundry, palyashchie pustyni i mnogoe drugoe, puteshestvuya po miru, ot kraya do kraya. Delayte vse vozmozhnoe, chtoby raskryt, ponyat i v konechnom itoge stat ... Legendy Amberlenda.

Эта история происходит в Донороке, в гос: Eta istoriya proiskhodit v Donoroke, v gosudarstve Noktum. Posle ischeznoveniya korolya Noktuma Astera v mire votsarilsya khaos. Otnosheniya mezhdu monstrami, mongami i snovidtsami absolyutno nestabilny, i Donorok, zemlya, na kotoruyu stol silno povliyala eta smuta, malo-pomalu zakhvatyvaet zemli v sosednikh regionakh.
Добро пожаловать в Виктусию, где почтенн:
Dobro pozhalovat v Viktusiyu, gde pochtennye chleny Brigady boevykh shef-povarov masterski razbirayutsya s monstrami i prevrashchayut ikh v prekrasnye blyuda! Shefy so vsey Viktusii dolzhny prilozhit nemalo usiliy, chtoby pobedit v sorevnovanii i stat chlenami Brigady. Pomogite Mine i Trashu oboyti drugikh konkursantov na turnire. Chtoby stat brigadirom, vam nuzhno umet okhotitsya na monstrov s pomoshchyu kombo-atak i gotovit iz svezhepoluchennykh ingredientov slozhnye blyuda, kotorye ponravyatsya sudyam. I vse eto nado uspet vypolnit za ogranichennoe vremya.

«Dobavka» vozmozhnostey
•	Yarkie illyustratsii i otlichnoe ozvuchivanie pomogli sozdat dvukh neobychnykh shefov, chtoby vy mogli igrat za nikh v prekrasnoy kampanii, kotoraya sochetaet v sebe starye dobrye zhanry «Izbey ikh vsekh» i «Tri v ryad» s doley rolevykh elementov. 
•	Za Ziggi, shefa-nekromanta, teper mozhno igrat v lokalnoy  i  svobodnoy igrakh i rezhimakh «Bit posudu!» i «Vyzhivanie». 
•	Esli i etogo vam malo, to s dobavleniem lokalnoy igry vy mozhete proverit sebya v bitvakh protiv brigadirov vashikh druzey! Vmeste s Minoy, Trashem i dazhe Ziggi uchastvuyte v epicheskikh bitvakh, gde imenno vy ustanavlivaete pravila. Kto zhe pobedit?
•	Vy mozhete proverit svoe kulinarnoe masterstvo v osobykh rezhimakh: «Ezhednevnoe kulinarnoe sorevnovanie», «Obsluzhivanie na skorost», «Bit posudu!», a takzhe novykh turnirnykh tablitsakh rezhima «Vyzhivanie», gde mozhno pokhvastatsya svoimi kulinarnymi tvoreniyami.
•	Ottochite svoi navyki v novom rezhime svobodnoy igry i naydite neprevzoydennye kulinarnye sochetaniya.
•	Soberite kollektsiyu zamechatelnykh illyustratsiy Brigady boevykh shef-povarov v novoy galeree.

Zhizn Stena vykhodit iz-pod kontrolya. Prizrachnyy nekogda mir stanovitsya yarkoy, pulsiruyushchey realnostyu s tselymi tolpami demonov, gotovymi na vse, chtoby probitsya skvoz vashu zashchitu. Shvyryayte zaklinaniya i lovushki pryamo posredi kombo-udarov, poprobuyte proyti po tonkoy grani mezhdu khaosom i kontrolem. V etom novom dinamichnom ekshene vash samyy strashnyy vrag — eto vy sami.

Syuzhet

Vy igraete za Stena — on tipichnyy predstavitel srednego klassa, ofisnyy plankton, zhivushchiy skuchnoy do bezobraziya zhiznyu, kotoraya vnezapno vstaet s nog na golovu. Vam predstoit otkryt novuyu realnost i razobratsya vo vsem, puteshestvuya po yarkomu demonicheskomu miru. V Phantom Trigger chetyre kontsovki.

Igrovoy protsess

V Phantom Trigger smeshalis elementy sleshera, rolevoy igry i roglayka: v osnove lezhat starye dobrye kombo, k nim dobavlyayutsya zaklinaniya i lovushki, parovoziki iz monstrov, podzhiganie bossov i ryvki ot odnogo kombo k drugomu.

In Shelter Generations you embark upon u:
In Shelter Generations you embark upon unique journeys in the wild that present varied challenges and familial love – it’s a memorable experience wherever you play.

There are two games included in this special digital collection. Shelter 2 (with the Mountains DLC included) follows the life of a mother Lynx; it’s a journey of parenthood in which nurturing your cubs is paramount for survival.  You need to hunt for food and utilise maternal instincts such as calling the cubs closer, making sure they drink water from rivers, and lifting and carrying them from harm’s way. You need to raise them safely until they reach adulthood, with a different experience and circumstances each time you play.

Paws: A Shelter 2 Game is a standalone experience based within the same world. In this poetic adventure you need to explore and survive the wilds as a cub, interacting with the environment and forging a surprising alliance. It features puzzles, a special soundtrack and plenty of memorable moments.

Shelter Generations also includes the official soundtracks of both Shelter 2 and Paws: A Shelter 2 Game; you can enjoy the music at any time. In addition there are two ‘living book’ experiences to take you further into the Shelter world – ‘Fables From the Den’ and ‘The Lonesome Fog’.

Shelter Generations offers a unique gaming experience on the Nintendo Switch™.

Features:

●	Shelter 2 – Play as a mother Lynx, raising and protecting your cubs in a beautiful but challenging world
●	Paws: A Shelter 2 Game – Guide a cub through detailed landscapes in a unique narrative adventure
●	Perfect for headphones – Listen to the full soundtracks for both Shelter 2 and Paws
●	Go further into the story - Read and experience two ‘living books’, each telling a unique tale
●	Play in the TV, Desktop and Portable modes
●	A Nintendo Switch™ console exclusive
В галактике миллионы миров. Но лишь один:
V galaktike milliony mirov. No lish odin iz nikh — tvoy dom.

My sobiralis sovershit korotkiy ispytatelnyy polet do alfy Tsentavra i obratno. No pervyy v mire eksperimentalnyy giperdvigatel vyshel iz stroya. Izranennaya, nepodgotovlennaya k takomu komanda zastryala na drugom kontse vselennoy na razvalivayushchemsya na kuski korable v polnoy izolyatsii ot ostalnogo chelovechestva. Edinstvennyy sposob vernutsya — dvigatsya vpered.

Issleduy postoyanno menyayushchuyusya vselennuyu. Zaklyuchay soyuzy s udivitelnymi inoplanetnymi rasami — ot blagorodnykh rytsarey Volfaksa do zhestokikh rabovladeltsev iz imperii Ilittsa. Ottachivay masterstvo svoego ekipazha vo vsem: ot arkheologii i issledovaniy do diplomatii. Poznavay zakony vrazhdebnoy vselennoy i prinimay neprostye resheniya, kotorye mogut navsegda izmenit ee. Sdelay vse vozmozhnoe, chtoby vernutsya na Zemlyu.

Long Journey Home podarit beskonechnuyu svobodu otkrytogo kosmosa. S novoy otkrytoy sistemoy zadaniy okonchatelnoe reshenie vsegda za toboy. Otvezti popavshego v pereplet Glukkta domoy ili sdat ego tvoim novym druzyam-rabotorgovtsam? Pytatsya druzhit so vsemi ili polozhitsya na soyuz s silneyshimi rasami i nadeyatsya, chto oni ne predadut? Sovershay pryzhok za pryzhkom, prinimay neprostye resheniya, gotovsya nesti otvetstvennost za ikh posledstviya i pomni: nichto v etoy vselennoy ne povtoritsya.

Odna tsel. Beskonechnye priklyucheniya.

Kuda privedet tvoy put?

Noel the Mortal Fate is an adventure tit:
Noel the Mortal Fate is an adventure title which started serialization as a free game in 2016 and later spawned comics and novels. 
This version of the game has been remade for a console experience, with updated UI, story and dialogue. It follows the story from the prologue through Season 7 of the series where the real battle begins for Noel and her companions.
Furthermore it now supports full HD and so can be enjoyed in TV Mode as the epic story unfolds.
This version also features Season 3.5, a bonus season which takes place between the Burrows and Jillian storylines.

■Game System
Gameplay is made up of Adventure sections where you can experience the deep story and Game sections where you can enjoy various gimmicks and action sequences.
With simple, intuitive controls and challenging but fair puzzles, players will be able to focus on the story as they progress through the game.

■Plot Summary
The story takes place in the fictional town of Lhaplus.
Noel Cerquetti, the daughter of a prestigious family, takes part in a piano competition to decide the pianist for the city’s memorial ceremony, fancying herself the clear winner.
Little does she know that the competition was rigged by a mysterious party, and would lead her down a tragic path.
Racked by guilt, she nevertheless agrees to a contract with the devil Caron, in order to get revenge on those who wronged her by sacrificing herself.
The events that follow will drag Noel into the growing darkness that surrounds Lhaplus, where she will experience first hand the grief and hatred of those who have been caught up in the machinations of devils.

Beholder — otmechennaya nagradami igra v zhanre priklyucheniya-antiutopii — vykhodit na Nintendo Switch™!

Vy kogda-nibud mechtali stat domoupravlyayushchim v totalitarnom gosudarstve, chtoby shpionit za vsemi i donosit na vsekh? V Beholder vasha mechta stanet realnostyu!
