Adios is a cinematic first-person game a:
Adios is a cinematic first-person game about sticking to a complicated decision.

You're a pig farmer in Kansas. It's October. Cold, crisp mornings are the norm, and you have decided that you're no longer okay with letting the mob use your pigs to dispose of bodies. When your old friend - a hitman - arrives with his assistant to deliver another body, you finally screw up the courage to tell them that you're done.

Your friend doesn't want you to stop. He knows that there's no such thing as quitting, so he'll try to convince you that you're making a mistake. You spend the day together, doing chores and exploring the nooks and crannies of an authentic environment in the American Midwest alongside the man who will be forced to kill you, if he can't convince you to stay.

How you respond will determine the rest of your life.

Adios means goodbye.
Герой игры – человек ищущий суть необычн:
Geroy igry – chelovek ishchushchiy sut neobychnykh sobytiy. Odnazhdy on poluchaet pismo s prosboy o pomoshchi iz ochen glukhoy derevni, zateryannoy v glubine lesov. Geroy otpravlyaetsya v put, no priklyucheniya vstretyat ego eshchyo do pribytiya na mesto. Zhiteley derevni derzhat v strakhe zveri, prichyom ne prostye – misticheskie. U nikh svetyatsya krasnym glaza, ikh bessilen poymat dazhe okhotnik.

Prezhde chem popast vglub skryvayushchikh taynu lesov, pridyotsya uglubitsya i v samu zhizn obitateley. Zdes ne rabotayut prostye denezhnye otnosheniya. Za bolshinstvo uslug pridetsya dogovarivatsya. Kto i chto konkretno videl, pochemu podozrevayut nechistuyu silu, chto eto voobshche za naselyonnyy punkt? Vse li podderzhat vashe rassledovanie? Kto okazhetsya soyuznikom, a kto vragom? Vsyo eto vy smozhete nablyudat prodvigayas po syuzhetu. Vas zhdut nemalo interesnykh zadach, dialogov, raskryvayushchikh personazhey.

Zhanr igry – priklyuchenie. Vy, vmeste s geroem, budete razgadyvat taynu. Rassledovanie vynudit reshat razlichnye zadachi, dlya kotorykh ponadobitsya vzaimodeystvie s personazhami.

• Autentichnye personazhi, s kotorymi pridetsya obshchatsya.
• Atmosfernye lokatsii udalennykh poseleniy.
• Uvlekatelnye zagadki, trebuyushchie izucheniya mestnosti i zhiteley.
• V lesakh mozhno vstretit kak otshelnika, tak i vedmu. Kto drug, a kto vrag?
• Issleduyte otkrytyy mir igry.
• Priklyucheniya v atmosfere mistiki.
Slinki is a hard-as-nails 2.5D action-pl: Slinki is a hard-as-nails 2.5D action-platformer where your own prosthetic arm is the ultimate multipurpose weapon: Use it as a bladed boomerang to control the population of mutated critters, pull levers towards you to get through puzzles and zip-line across grappling surfaces. Furthermore, instead of having your weapon return to you, why not return to it instead with the power of Slinki's slingshot? All this to find out what happened to the once peaceful forest you used to live in.
Doodle Derby— гоночный платформер с дьяв:
Doodle Derby— gonochnyy platformer s dyavolskoy fizikoy, vdokhnoveniem dlya kotorogo posluzhili bitvy igrushek iz vashikh detskikh zapasov. V naimenee realistichnoy gonochnoy igre vozmozhno vsyo! Vo Doodle Derby vy stroite trassy, a potom stremites dostich tseli urovnya. Dostroyte dobavochnye uchastki trassy i ispytayte svoyu sudbu! Ne poluchaetsya? Perestroyte trassu. 

Vo Doodle Derby est kampaniya dlya odnogo igroka s bezumnymi golovolomkami, a takzhe mnogopolzovatelskie rezhimy, kotorye proveryat vashu druzhbu na prochnost.

Stroit trassy vo Doodle Derby bystro i legko. Vybirayte iz 40 samykh bezumnykh elementov trassy, kotorye vy kogda-libo videli. Blagodarya beskonechnym sochetaniyam elementov vse urovni unikalny.

V mnogopolzovatelskom rezhime vam nuzhno pridumat sobstvennyy plan i rasstroit chuzhie. (Naprimer, podvesnym sharom, volshebnoy palochkoy ili prosto dlanyu gospodney). Poka kto-to ne dobralsya do finisha, igroki ne vykhodyat iz tsikla sozidaniya i razrusheniya. Perekhitrite sopernikov, postroiv skrytye puti ili proyaviv nebyvaluyu zhestokost. Pobezhdaet samyy kovarnyy igrok. 
Osobennosti:
•	Uvlekatelnaya kampaniya dlya odnogo igroka.
•	Rezhim setevoy i lokalnoy mnogopolzovatelskoy igry (do 4 igrokov)
•	Uchastvuyte v gonkakh i stroyte poperemenno samye epichnye i bezumnye urovni, poka ne doberetes do finisha.
•	Konstruktor urovney Doodle Derby: stroyte sobstvennye urovni, a zatem broste vyzov druzyam i proverte, spravyatsya li oni!
•	Chudovishchnye obezyany! Rakety! Pirani! NLO! Okolo 40 chastey trass i 60 millionov (ne podtverzhdeno!) sochetaniy!
•	Bezbashennoe zvukovoe soprovozhdenie
•	Mnogo sekretov, kotorye mozhno nayti. Vozmozhnost otkryt novye mashinki, prepyatstviya i urovni! 
•	Razrushaemoe okruzhenie, vklyuchaya klubniku i drugie frukty.
•	Nastolko krutoy fon, kotoryy mogli narisovat tolko deti — chto oni i sdelali.
В этой творческой игре-головоломке новог: V etoy tvorcheskoy igre-golovolomke novogo tipa igroki obshchayutsya, vzaimodeystvuyut drug s drugom i s pomoshchyu voobrazheniya razgadyvayut prostye i slozhnye golovolomki, preobrazuya bumazhnykh personazhey v novye formy. Igrayte v odinochku ili s drugom v osnovnom rezhime, zatem soberites kompaniey do 4 chelovek, chtoby razgadyvat dinamichnye golovolomki i sorevnovatsya v mini-igrakh.
В Англии в 1985 году частный детектив Ма:
V Anglii v 1985 godu chastnyy detektiv Maylz Uindem sleduet za zatsepkoy, svyazannoy s tainstvennoy smertyu ego docheri, kotoraya privodit ego na ostrov Velvet. No, pribyv na ostrov, on vskore zamechaet, chto mestnye zhiteli vedut sebya stranno. V deystvitelnosti, rastet vrazhdebnost po otnosheniyu k detektivu, kotoraya, kazhetsya, stanovitsya silnee s kazhdoy minutoy.
Vskore situatsiya obostryaetsya, i Maylz okazyvaetsya v borbe za svoyu zhizn..
Войди в мир Охотников на троллей, сыграй: Voydi v mir Okhotnikov na trolley, sygray za Dzhima Leyka-mladshego, ostanovi trollya-obmanshchika Porgona i ne day svershitsya ego kovarnym planam! Tebe na pomoshchyu pridet Kler v kooperativnoy igre, a takzhe mnozhestvo drugikh lyubimykh personazhey, vmeste s kotorymi tebe pridetsya vstretitsya s silami zla i ostanovit Tempokalipsis! Uluchshay dospekhi, sovershenstvuy sposobnosti i stan silnee, chem byl kogda-libo!Sudba vselennoy v tvoikh rukakh!
Ministry of Broadcast — однопользователь:
Ministry of Broadcast — odnopolzovatelskiy platformer s kinematografichnym syuzhetom, v kotorom atmosfera v dukhe «1984» Oruella sochetaetsya s elementami sovremennykh realiti-shou. Polno chernogo yumora, sarkazma i absurdnosti sistemy kak takovoy!

Slovno v odnochase vyrosshaya Stena razdelila stranu nadvoe, otrezav cheloveka ot semi. Chtoby uvidet rodnykh snova, nash ryzhiy geroy reshaet stat uchastnikom pravitelstvennogo teleshou «Stena», kotoroe daet konkursantam vozmozhnost vybratsya na druguyu storonu i obresti svobodu. No, prokhodya prepyatstviya lagerya, paren vskore ponimaet, kak imenno rabotaet Rezhim i eto shou. Obeshchanie svobody oborachivaetsya ne tem, chem kazalos.

FUNKTsII
* Kinematografichnyy platformer: Poka geroy begaet, prygaet, razbivaetsya i prokhodit areny, vokrug razvorachivaetsya syuzhet. Bolshaya chast istorii raskryvaetsya cherez organichno vstroennye animatsii, elementy sredy i bormotanie neigrovykh personazhey, ot kotorykh vy uklonyaetes, probegaya mimo.
* Interfeys, vstroennyy v sredu: Vmesto togo chtoby zagromozhdat ekran indikatorami, poloskami opyta i mini-kartami, my vklyuchili vsyu informatsiyu, kotoraya ponadobitsya igroku, v mir igry. Tonkie i konkretnye podskazki po mekhanike i syuzhetu vstroeny v art, tak chto igroku nuzhno byt osobenno vnimatelnym, chtoby geroy vyzhil na kazhdoy arene i ne perelomal nogi.
* Golovolomki: Chtoby proyti areny, vam ponadobitsya smekalka, a poroy i kaplya zhestokosti. Dlya resheniya bolshinstva golovolomok nuzhno vzaimodeystvovat s okruzhayushchey sredoy: ispolzovat inertsiyu geroya dlya peremeshcheniya platform, povernut rychag-drugoy. V kakoy-to moment, vozmozhno, pridetsya pozhertvovat parochkoy NPC, chtoby peresech osobenno nepriyatnuyu yamu s kolyami.
* Syuzhet i atmosfera: Plutovskoy yumor, pervoklassnyy sarkazm i smeshnye prodelki organichno sochetayutsya s mrachnymi, tyazhelymi motivami antiutopii.
Осваивай новаторскую механику строительс:
Osvaivay novatorskuyu mekhaniku stroitelstva «kirpichik za kirpichikom» v LEGO® Bricktales i ispolzuy voobrazhenie dlya resheniya golovolomok. Smotri, kak tvoi tvoreniya ozhivayut v prekrasnom mire LEGO, gde na kazhduyu problemu naydetsya stroitelnoe reshenie.  

Otpravlyaysya v epichnoe krugosvetnoe puteshestvie po fantasticheskim biomam, lyubuysya sobrannymi po kirpichiku dioramami i vdokhnovlyaysya, chtoby pomoch svoemu dedushke otstroit staryy park razvlecheniy. Malenkiy robot-pomoshchnik vsegda budet ryadom. Tvoy put budet prolegat cherez gustye dzhungli, vysushennye solntsem pustyni, ozhivlennyy gorod, groznyy srednevekovyy zamok i tropicheskie Karibskie ostrova. Pomogay minifigurkam v raznykh mirakh, reshaya golovolomki, i razblokiruy novye navyki, chtoby eshche glubzhe izuchit eti chudesnye kraya i raskryt mnozhestvo spryatannykh tam tayn.  

Kazhdaya diorama predlagaet raznoobraznye stroyploshchadki s polnoy svobodoy intuitivnogo stroitelstva «kirpichik za kirpichikom»: ot chisto dekorativnykh postroek vrode prilavka ili muzykalnogo avtomata, do funktsionalnykh golovolomok po zakonam fiziki, takikh kak stroitelstvo podemnogo krana ili giroplana. Na kazhdoy ploshchadke u tebya budet nabor kirpichikov dlya resheniya konkretnoy zadachi. Sposob resheniya zavisit tolko ot tebya. Krome syuzhetnykh golovolomok i zadaniy, v parke razvlecheniy est dopolnitelnye postroyki – attraktsiony, kotorye mozhno menyat po svoemu vkusu!   

Osobennosti:  

Vokrug sveta s LEGO: Otpravlyaysya v neozhidannoe epichnoe krugosvetnoe puteshestvie s zabavnymi dialogami i veselymi sekretami.  

Krasivye dioramy mirov: Issleduy biomy pyati raznykh mirov s tsentrom v parke razvlecheniy – vse iz kirpichikov LEGO.  

Stroy po-novomu: Poprobuy intuitivnoe stroitelstvo «kirpichik za kirpichikom» v videoigre LEGO i nablyuday, kak tvoi tvoreniya ozhivayut v trekhmernom mire.   

Mnozhestvo predmetov, kotorye mozhno sobirat:  Ishchi predmety v raznykh dioramakh i ispolzuy ikh dlya pokupki novykh aksessuarov ili naborov tsvetov kirpichikov dlya rezhima pesochnitsy.  

Rekomenduemyy vozrast — 12+
Захватывающее погружение в мир элиты, об:
Zakhvatyvayushchee pogruzhenie v mir elity, obolstitelnykh zhenshchin i korrumpirovannykh politseyskikh, gde vse reshaet tolko tot, u kogo est vlast. Dobro pozhalovat v novuyu seriyu igr v zhanre HOPA, sozdannuyu v traditsiyakh luchshikh filmov o politseyskikh.

Dobro pozhalovat v volshebnyy gorod palm, yakht i naslazhdeniya ot zhizni. Mesto, gde igroki v poker besplatno parkuyut sverkayushchie Lamborgini na mestakh parkovki dlya invalidov. Vam predstoit stat opytnym detektivom i pomoch vashemu partneru Dyuku raskryt zagadochnoe delo ob ubiystve.

Bogataya dinastiya, vzorvavshayasya yakhta, dvoe vyzhivshikh, podozritelnye sledy yada v tele, i vy posredi vsey etoy putanitsy.

Naydite uliki, doprosite svideteley, proanaliziruyte sobrannye obraztsy, podgotovte dokazatelstva — zastavte ubiytsu raskryt eshche bolshuyu skhemu.

Postoyannaya opasnost, glamurnoe okruzhenie i unikalnyy ritm shikarnogo, no pri etom smertelno opasnogo goroda, vyzyvayut nostalgiyu po takim televizionnym khitam, kak «Politsiya Mayami», «Politseyskiy iz Beverli Khillz» i «C.S.I.: Mesto prestupleniya».
Перенеситесь в мир Ys и откройте для себ:
Perenesites v mir Ys i otkroyte dlya sebya odnu iz velichayshikh yaponskikh igr v zhanre A-RPG.

Vsled za razrushitelnym vtorzheniem demonov Bogini-bliznetsy pri pomoshchi magii perenesli zhiteley Ys v nebesa. Poka demony vozvodili Bashnyu Dyavola, chtoby dobratsya do novoy obiteli lyudey, Bogini ischezli. Bud vy moguchim voinom ili iskusnym magom, vam predstoit nayti Bogin v Bashne Dyavola. Ispolzuyte svoy vernyy mech i zaklinaniya, chtoby ochistit zemli predkov ot zla.

- 3 igrabelnykh personazha so svoimi naborami navykov i sposobnostey.
- Neskolko neveroyatnykh landshaftov.
- 4 igrovykh rezhima: Story, Time Attack, Arena i Speedrun Mode 
- Blood Level Option.
- Mnogochislennye artefakty i moshchnye relikvii.
- Potryasayushchiy art.

Zakhvatyvayushchaya istoriya, dinamichnyy saundtrek i epichnye skhvatki s bossami; Ys Origin — po-prezhnemu odna iz luchshikh igr v zhanre action-RPG vsekh vremen!
Жмите на газ и преодолейте 3000 км, кото:
Zhmite na gaz i preodoleyte 3000 km, kotorye lezhat pered vami!
Na sklonakh gor, na prostorakh prirodnogo parka, v pustyne ili na beregu morya — zashchishchayte vashu pozitsiyu v bolee chem 250 gonkakh, sredi kotorykh est chempionaty, zadaniya i ispytaniya.

Sozertsayte svoyu kollektsiyu avtomobiley, priobretennykh v gonkakh, v svoem prekrasno oborudovannom garazhe. Porsche 718 Boxster, 918 Spyder, 911 GT2RS, Dodge Viper, Lotus 3-Eleven, McLaren 720s… V Gear Club Unlimited 2 vas zhdut bolee 50 litsenzirovannykh avto, v tom chisle samye prestizhnye marki v mire.
Personaliziruyte ikh i sdelayte unikalnymi! Vizualno — s pomoshchyu pokraski i smeny kuzova i v plane povedeniya na trasse blagodarya nastroykam dvigatelya.

No vy — nichto bez svoego kluba! Sozdayte klub i upravlyayte im vmeste s druzyami, nabirayte luchshikh pilotov i sostyazaytes s klubami-sopernikami so vsego mira, vzoydite na samye vysokie stupenki podiuma i naslazhdaytes eksklyuzivnym kontentom, prednaznachennym tolko dlya luchshikh iz vas.

Granits bolshe net. Gonyayte po trassam svobodno!

Kharakteristiki

• Ogromnaya igrovaya territoriya, gde mozhno proekhat 3000 km po dorogam i uchastvovat v 250 gonkakh na 4 raznoobraznykh i detalizirovannykh landshaftakh.
• Prestizhnye avto i 51 bolid iz chisla luchshikh marok v mire, kotorye dostupny v nachale igry! Porsche, Lotus, McLaren, Koenigsegg ili Bugatti — vybor za vami. 
• Vypolnite zadaniya v syuzhetnom rezhime i spasite semeynuyu komandu ot bankrotstva, brosaya vyzovy kharizmatichnym pilotam raznoobraznykh natsionalnostey.
• Igrok mozhet sozdat svoy klub i upravlyat im, nabiraya luchshikh pilotov, kotorye vstrechayutsya po puti, a takzhe sorevnovatsya s klubami-sopernikami, chtoby uvidet imya svoey komandy v verkhnikh strochkakh tablitsy liderov.
• Igrok upravlyaet svoim garazhom i mozhet oborudovat ego po svoemu vkusu! To zhe samoe kasaetsya i avto — ikh mozhno personalizirovat kak vizualno, tak i v plane povedeniya na trasse!
• V odinochku ili v kompanii: osoboe vnimanie v igre udeleno mnogopolzovatelskomu rezhimu, pozvolyayushchemu 4 igrokam sostyazatsya po lokalnoy seti na razdelennom ekrane.
Исследуйте, стройте, собирайте удивитель:
Issleduyte, stroyte, sobirayte udivitelnye mekhanizmy i pokoryayte neizvedannye inoplanetnye miry v priklyuchencheskoy pesochnitse s aktsentom na fiziku i konstruirovanie.

Tolko ot vas zavisit, chto vy soberete iz ogromnogo nabora blokov. Mashinu? Tank? Mozhet byt, samolet? Pokupayte novye zapchasti, izgotavlivayte ikh i podbirayte s poverzhennykh vragov. Stante luchshim issledovatelem v galaktike!

Rezhimy odinochnoy igry
• Srazhaytes s vragami, vypolnyayte zadaniya i poluchayte povysheniya v rezhime «Kampaniya».
• Issleduyte mir (s vragami ili bez nikh) i stroyte v svoe udovolstvie v rezhime tvorchestva.
• Sozdayte samuyu bystruyu mashinu i pobeyte svoi proshlye rekordy v rezhime «Kulak».
Сейчас нелегкие времена: одного из ваших:
Seychas nelegkie vremena: odnogo iz vashikh druzey pokhitili. Vam predstoit osvobodit ego: s Bratstvom shutki plokhi, i zlodei zaplatyat za svoi postupki.

Khvatayte oruzhie, berite pivo i vpered, cherez ordy vragov. V etoy klassicheskoy strelyalke vy – chlen Bratstva, kotoryy ne ostavlyaet druzey v bede.

Osobennosti:
- 20 urovney, na kazhdom po 3 zadaniya
- 5 raznovidnostey kastomizatsii, bolee 4 predmetov v kazhdoy iz nikh
- Lokalnyy kooperativ
- Krutoe oruzhie i granaty. Spalite vse na svoem puti!
- 8 bossov, odolet kotorykh ne tak-to prosto
- Prevoskhodnyy saundtrek, kotoryy nikogo ne ostavit ravnodushnym
Попробуйте выбраться из таинственной вре:
Poprobuyte vybratsya iz tainstvennoy vremennoy petli! Sovershite puteshestvie v mrachnye glubiny svoego soznaniya i zaglyanite v samye potayonnye ugolki dushi. Vyyasnite, kakie sekrety khranit etot zabytyy bogom gorodishko.
Novyy den — novaya borba s vnutrennimi demonami. Pytayas razobratsya v proizoshedshem, vy poznakomites s lyudmi, kotorye takzhe stalkivayutsya s neprostymi perezhivaniyami, i, vozmozhno, uznaete samye sokrovennye tayny.
Udastsya li vam razgadat zagadku vremennoy anomalii? Smozhete li nayti v sebe sily, chtoby voznestis nad zhiznennymi nevzgodami i nachat stroit svetloe budushchee?
The Room Three («Комната Три») — это инд: The Room Three («Komnata Tri») — eto indi-igra i misticheskaya golovolomka, razrabotannaya nezavisimoy britanskoy studiey Fireproof Studios. Igra byla iznachalno vypushchena v noyabre 2015 goda dlya ustroystv s operatsionnoy sistemoy iOS, a pozzhe dlya mobilnykh ustroystv Android i personalnykh kompyuterov. Sut The Room Three svoditsya k tomu, chto igrok dolzhen izuchat pomeshcheniya starinnogo pomestya, predmety i mebel na nalichie taynikov i skrytykh golovolomok, tak kak eto edinstvennyy sposob vybratsya ot tuda.
After a respected member of Parliament i:
After a respected member of Parliament is found murdered, it’s up to you to go on the search for the killer, the notorious Mr. Hyde! Step into the shoes of an inspector from Scotland Yard, and dive deep into the case to try to find out why Sir Danvers Crew has been killed. Search beautiful Hidden Object scenes in The Mysterious Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde! Can you crack the case and discover the horrifying truth?

- Immersive atmosphere
- Fun detective mini games
- Discover a horrifying secret!
Экшн-платформер об обезьяне, которая отп:
Ekshn-platformer ob obezyane, kotoraya otpravlyaetsya v glubiny dzhungley, ne ostanavlivayas ni pered chem, chtoby nayti svoego lyubimogo druga-cheloveka, kotoryy otpravilsya na poiski i tak i ne vernulsya (veroyatno, v poiskakh sokrovishch, zhadina). Vy budete issledovat postoyanno menyayushchiesya podzemelya, khramy, sklepy i drugie zagadochnye mesta, gde vy naydete vsevozmozhnykh strannykh vragov i mnozhestvo oruzhiya i zaklinaniy, kotorye vy mozhete kazhdyy raz kombinirovat.
Ne vse sushchestva obyazatelno vrazhdebny vam! Po puti vstrechayte personazhey, kotorye poteryalis, popali v lovushku ili, mozhet byt, prosto otdykhayut tam. Pomogite im, i vy mozhete stat druzyami!
JellyCar (изначально известная как Jello:
JellyCar (iznachalno izvestnaya kak JelloCar) — eto fizicheskiy 2D-platformer na izmenyayushchey svoi razmery mashinke, razrabotannyy Timom «Walaber» Fittsrandolfom; iznachalno vypushchennyy nezavisimo cherez Xbox Live Indie Games, a zatem perenesennyy na drugie ustroystva.
V igre prisutstvuet prorabotannaya fizika myagkogo tela, chto pridaet ey uznavaemyy kharakternyy igrovoy stil i geympley. V dalneyshem, seriya byla podkhvachena rabotodatelem Fittsrandolfa, Disney Interactive Studios, kotoraya pozzhe vypustila sikvely etoy igry.Ofitsialnuyu Switch-igru JellyCar Worlds sm. zdes.
Когда что-то ужасно не заладилось на экс:
Kogda chto-to uzhasno ne zaladilos na ekskursii po mestam s prizrakami, Freyya s druzyami okazalas v strannom neumolimom alternativnom mire, zhelayushchem ikh smerti. Voydite v rol Freyi, ishchushchey vykhod i otkryvshey vozmozhnost perematyvat vremya, chto daet ey shans probovat novye sposoby i prinimat razlichnye resheniya na puti k spaseniyu.

Issleduyte atmosfernoe tsarstvo tayn, v kotorom igrovoy protsess s pikselnoy grafikoy sochetaetsya s narisovannymi vruchnuyu portretami personazhey. Reshayte golovolomki i prodelyvayte golovokruzhitelnye posledovatelnosti deystviy, raskryvayte sekrety zloveshchego parallelnogo izmereniya i issleduyte glubokie otnosheniya so sputnikami Freyi. Sblizit li ikh uzhas etogo opyta ili razluchit navsegda?

Kharakteristiki

• Puteshestvuyte po temnomu, no krasivomu miru, v kotorom pikselnaya grafika sochetaetsya s narisovannymi vruchnuyu portretami.
• Ispolzuyte to, chto vy uznali iz smerti, chtoby otkryt alternativnye puti vyzhivaniya.
• Naydite obkhodnye puti i soedinite zatsepki, chtoby vyrvatsya.
• Izuchite strannye otnosheniya i sdelayte vybor, kotoryy povliyaet na istoriyu.
Feel like solving three-dimensional ridd:
Feel like solving three-dimensional riddles to a frenetic electronic soundtrack? Let Vectronom inject its colorful madness into your life! It’s easy to get into the groove but can you stick to the beat?

A CAPTIVATING ATMOSPHERE
Welcome to the psychedelic world of Vectronom: experience waves of color and a pulsing geometric path that changes with the beat... All set to a hypnotic electronic soundtrack. There’s only one thing to do: turn up the volume and go with the flow.

SOLVE PUZZLES AT THE SPEED OF SOUND
Find your path through an ever-changing world, keeping the rhythm with every move you make. Think it sounds easy? The highly intuitive and addictive gameplay will keep you moving through daunting challenges... But how long will you last when the challenges get trickier and trickier? Better play to find out!

PLAY ON YOUR OWN OR WITH FRIENDS
Set off on a solo campaign with just your headphones for company, or invite a few friends to join the party! ♪ UNTZ! UNTZ! UNTZ! ♪

Co-produced and published by ARTE, Vectronom is the first video game from independent studio Ludopium. The prototype was developed in the Franco-German accelerator program Spielfabrique. The game has already won several awards, including “Best Game” at the Indie Arena Booth at Gamescom 2018 and GDC’s “Best in Play” 2019. 

FEATURES
• A challenging solo campaign that will completely entrance you

Fly solo or with up to three other loyal:
Fly solo or with up to three other loyal crewmates as you boldly go where no-one has gone (and survived to talk about it) before. Obtain and upgrade new weapons and systems for your ship as you venture deep into a procedurally generated universe filled with increasingly grumpy and murder-y enemies. Map your unique path through the stars, but remember that the stakes are super high – one wrong move and it’s game over.

Up to 4 Players With Local Or Online Co-Op
Space is big and cold, yet still somehow full of things trying to shoot you. You’re free to embark on a trek through the stars on your own, but you can also unite with up to three fellow officers for either local or online co-op!

Every Game Is Unique
With randomized maps, items, enemies and encounters, no two games are ever alike. Prove you’re a space commander of exceptional calibre by adapting your strategies to survive every unpredictable threat, while making best use of your awesome arsenal of weapons and upgrades!

Easy To Understand, Tough To Master
She can’t take much more, captain! You’ll be master of your ship in no time, but only the canniest captain can tame the entire galaxy. With gameplay that players themselves have shaped through alpha and beta releases, This Means Warp is a thrilling yet cruel mistress. Remember – in space, no-one can hear you cry like a little baby.

KEY FEATURES
Huge Variety – Procedurally generated challenges create endless dynamic experiences that demand that you constantly adapt your strategy and make the most of the available resources!

Deep, Strategic Combat – Think on your feet as you contend with hectic, real-time battles where you must not only beat your foes, but also keep your ship in one piece!

Crewmates Aplenty – Team up with pals or recruit a varied cast of AI crewmates to have your back as the galaxy tries its best to devour you.

Issleduyte mir, nakhodya kristally, otkryvayte klassy, izuchayte sposobnosti i sozdavayte neobychnuyu strategiyu prokhozhdeniya igry, sposobnuyu pobedit samykh slozhnykh bossov etogo zagadochnogo mira. Issleduyte mir, naydite vse volshebnye kristally i ispolnite drevnee prorochestvo, chtoby vosstanovit balans v strane Sekvoy... Ili, vozmozhno, vy predpochitaete vysledit kazhdogo monstra i pobedit vse samykh silnykh bossov v mire. Ili predpochitaete otpravitsya v samye dalnie ugolki mestnykh zemel, i raskryt velichayshie tayny mirozdaniya?
Vybor zdes tolko za vami, kak i dolzhno byt v khoroshey rolevoy igre! Govoryat, chto te, kto otklonitsya ot generalnoy linii, budut nakazany, ubity — ili chto eshchyo khuzhe.. Mozhet byt, dlya vashego zhe blaga vy budete prodolzhat sobirat sebe kristalliki, kak i vse ostalnye.
No gde zhe togda vo vsyom etom budet nezabyvaemoe priklyuchenie?

Poyavlenie korablya, podem mayaka, kazhdaya raskrytaya vami zagadka otkryvaet novye chudesa i mesta dlya issledovaniya. No preduprezhdaem srazu, eto zakhvatyvayushchee dukh krasochnoe mesto, v kotorom vy okazalis, ne vsegda yavlyaetsya tem, chem mozhet pokazatsya. Etot intriguyushchiy kartinnyy mir soderzhit dazhe bolshe zagadok, chem zadumyval sam khudozhnik.

ISTORIYa
Praga
20 iyulya 1945 g.

Razrushennyy voynoy gorod.
Razrushennye zdaniya, sgorevshie tserkvi, i vse dolzhno bylo byt smyto s litsa zemli navsegda. Zdes zhivet izolirovannyy ot vneshnego mira khudozhnik. Chem uzhasnee stanovilis posledstviya voyny, tem bolshey oderzhimostyu on risoval prekrasnye peyzazhi, kontrastiruyushchie s uzhasami za oknom. Odnazhdy nochyu v dome poyavilas zagadochnaya figura, kazalos by, iz niotkuda. Neznakomets medlenno oboshel komnatu, osmatrivaya kartiny. Zatem on sel pered khudozhnikom i predlozhit emu sdelku: vozmozhnost voyti v odno iz ego sobstvennykh tvoreniy, podalshe ot voyny. No neobkhodimo budet nayti vykhod obratno do polunochi, inache ego dusha okazhetsya v lovushke navsegda. Chuvstvuya sebya odinokim, na grani bezumiya, terroriziruemyy zapakhom smerti, pronikayushchim s ulits, khudozhnik pozhal ruku tainstvennomu muzhchine, prinimaya sdelku.
Cherez neskolko mgnoveniy dom opustel.

KLYuChEVYE OSOBENNOSTI
- Unikalnyy khudozhestvennyy stil i syurrealistichnaya atmosfera
- Podborka khitrykh golovolomok, kotorye ispytayut vashu nakhodchivost
- Postoyanno menyayushchiysya mir, kotoryy razvivaetsya po mere prodvizheniya
- Skrytye tayny
В роли сценаристки-неудачницы Джунон про:
V roli stsenaristki-neudachnitsy Dzhunon prozhivite perelomnyy den. Ozhivite proshloe, izmenite nastoyashchee i primite budushchee — ili uzrite pechalnyy konets ee istorii.

V 36 let zhizn Dzhunon poshla pod otkos: karera zastoporilas, lichnaya zhizn razvalivaetsya, ona emotsionalno istoshchena. Situatsiya dostigaet apogeya, kogda ee vyzyvayut v otdelenie neotlozhnoy pomoshchi, gde v kriticheskom sostoyanii nakhoditsya ee mat, s kotoroy oni davno otdalilis. Eto perelomnyy den v zhizni Dzhunon, i, esli nichego ne izmenitsya, on mozhet stat dlya nee poslednim.

Ozhivite proshloe
Pogruzites v vospominaniya Dzhunon i soberite voedino istoriyu ee proshlogo, v tom chisle tragicheskuyu taynu, chto lezhit v osnove vsego.

Izmenite nastoyashchee

Primite budushchee

Across the Grooves is an interactive gra:
Across the Grooves is an interactive graphic novel, set in a magical realism universe, where your decisions affect the destiny of Alice, the main character, drastically changing her reality and allowing her to explore alternative destinies by modifying her past.

• Story:
Alice lives an uneventful life. She's in a long term relationship, has a stable office job and a nice apartment in the center of Bordeaux. One day, Ulysse, her ex-lover, comes back into her life through an old vinyl record she receives in the mail. When she puts it for a spin on turntable, she is thrown back into her own past, forced to relive old events. When she comes back to the present, her reality has changed and her fiancé no longer knows her, as if they never met.

Determined to bring her life back on track, Alice packs up and embarks on a hunt across Europe, following the tracks of Ulysse while trying to uncover the origins of the record. However, her journey gradually turns into a quest of self-discovery as she explores new parallel realities each time she puts the needle in the groove.

• Features:
— A hand-crafted adventure — With each playthrough, discover a novel-sized adventure and a slice of the hundreds of hand-drawn images created for the game.
— Every choice matters — Each decision you make slightly alters the personality of the main character, Alice.
— Discover and explore — Travel across European cities, meet colorful characters and solve the mystery, all depicted in gorgeous European comic book art style.
— Immersive and finely crafted soundtrack — The music adapts and shifts according to your choices and the mood of each scene.
— Dynamic dialogue system — Read the story like a comic book.
— High replayability — Choose Alice’s fate and discover the outcome of your decisions through multiple story paths and endings.

Noble Armada: Lost Worlds is a strategy:
Noble Armada: Lost Worlds is a strategy title based on the Noble Armada miniatures game. Set in the Fading Suns Universe, where the suns themselves are dying, humanity battles to revive its lost greatness, or just take what is left. The five great Royal Houses dominate human space as they battle each other for control of the greatest resource... humanity itself.

In Noble Armada: Lost Worlds, players take on the role of a noble in one of the five Royal houses, vying against rival fleets and houses for control of human space. They battle pirates, barbarians, heretics and others in their quest for supremacy. Noble Armada is a game of broadsides and boarding actions, as players maneuver their ships to line up their best shots, fire off broadsides of fiery energy and then board their enemies to end the battle with desperate boarding actions. As they travel from planet to planet, making allies and building up their fleets, they also gain the experience they need to make their crews and marines truly formidable.

Award winning survival horror experience:

You wake up in an abandoned hospital with nothing. No memory. No clues. No way out. What the hell is going on?

Deranged puzzles lead you through a twisted maze of locked doors. You find a flashlight, weapons, pills, and ammunition - all convieniently placed along your path.

Who is orchestrating this nightmare? Will you discover the truth? Will you escape? Will you survive?
Тоталитаризм — политический режим, котор:
Totalitarizm — politicheskiy rezhim, kotoryy stremitsya k polnomu totalnomu kontrolyu gosudarstva nad vsemi storonami zhizni obshchestva. V politologii pod totalitarnoy modelyu ponimaetsya teoriya o tom, chto fashizm, stalinizm, natsizm i, vozmozhno, ryad drugikh sistem yavlyayutsya raznovidnostyami odnoy sistemy — totalitarizma.
Through the Darkest of Times — eto igra, sobytiya kotoroy razvorachivayutsya vo vremya rastsveta totalitarnogo Tretego Reykha. Vas zhdyot istoriya soprotivleniya, kotoroe pytaetsya borotsya s rezhimom, pri etom ne pogibnuv ot ruk spetsialnykh sluzhb. Razrabotchiki Paintbucket Games, Yorg Fridrikh i Sebastyan Shults iznachalno poznakomilis v Yager Development i nachali planirovat igru po istorii v 2017 godu. Igra byla anonsirovana v aprele 2018 goda pri finansirovanii Medienboard Berlin-Brandenburg, a 29 oktyabrya 2018 goda bylo podtverzhdeno izdatelskoe soglashenie mezhdu Paintbucket Games i HandyGames. Khudozhestvennyy stil igry byl vdokhnovlen nemetskim ekspressionizmom 1920-kh godov.
Na Metacritic igra poluchila 71 ball iz 100 na osnove otzyvov 24 kritikov. Povestvovanie v tselom vysoko otseneno, no kritiki poschitali, chto istoriya igry slishkom zhestokaya.

Takzhe my smozhem issledovat sushu i more, otkryvat novye tropy i osvobozhdat dikikh zhivotnykh, chtoby vosstanovit kraski mira i raskryt trogatelnuyu istoriyu proshchaniya.

A story of a repair robot who during the:
A story of a repair robot who during the weekend, instead of enjoying his free time watching a speedball game on a planet nearby, has to go to work and fix a malfunction in one of the corporate buildings, as he’s usually the one to be called in such cases.
By accident, he discovers a corporate management plot regarding a new project related to the department of power. Unfortunately, the conspirators notice they are being overheard. Toolboy attempts to escape by solving more puzzles, and the more he solves, the more skills as superpowers he gains. Our bot also has an ally in the form of an old computer disconnected from the main system. Toolboy uses special information points to communicate with him and to get more clues.

Toolboy is an old-style platform game inspired by the classics, you will find here game mechanisms from such all-time classics games.
Toolboy has 4 superpowers that launch on successive levels
- Remote control as a Controller
Power that allows to control some devices by changing their direction of rotation.
- Cube
Toolboy can turn himself into a cube that looks like an element of scenery, this disguise allows him to
to hide from drones scanning the area.
- SpeedRun
A super run that our Hero uses while speedrunning between levels to escape in from the enemies.
- Magnetic Walk
Skill that allows to move large objects, mainly containers, which can be used as climbing and jumping surfaces.

По мотивами любимого анимационного мульт:
Po motivami lyubimogo animatsionnogo multfilma «Pyos-samuray»!..
Derevnya Kakamucho podverglas napadeniyu koshachikh armiy syoguna. Prisoedinyaytes k Khenku, psu-samurayu v mire koshek, i ego druzyam, chtoby raskryt zloveshchiy zagovor i spasti polozhenie v samurayskom stile.
Kak tolko oni podumali, chto bitva okonchena, Khenk i Dzhimbo vynuzhdeny vernutsya v boy, na etot raz stolknuvshis s samim mogushchestvennym syogunom. Da, imenno tak: lider mira "Lap Yarosti" zagadochnym obrazom peremenilsya. Ego tsel - sokrushit duet i derevni pod ikh zashchitoy svoimi koshachimi armiyami.
Vam predstoit ovladet navykami samuraya, zashchitit Kakamucho, spasti druzey Khenka i vyyasnit, kto stoit za etim zlym zagovorom.

Kurokami-sama's Feast is a horror-advent:
Kurokami-sama's Feast is a horror-adventure visual novel following an unlucky trio who find themselves hunting monsters to be turned into gourmet dishes for the powerful (and woefully famished) being known as Kurokami-sama. Using Kurokami-sama's ear to listen in on people's innermost thoughts, and wielding Kurokami-sama's arm to strike back at the supernatural, you will come face to face with the darkness that lurks beneath the veil of mundane society. Will our heroes find a way to escape Kurokami-sama's clutches before it's too late?

During your encounters with monsters and otherworldly entities, you'll have access to a parameter called spiritual energy, which can be used to read minds and launch devastating attacks. Clever use of this resource is the key to overcoming the many trials and tribulations that await you in the world of Kurokami-sama's Feast.

Cruel and stunningly beautiful in equal measure, Kurokami-sama is the supernatural being who forces the protagonist into her service. Hoping to regain enough of her strength to break free from the magical barrier that binds her, Kurokami-sama commands you to procure cooking ingredients from the countless monsters that infest the city. Will you obey her, find a means to defeat her yourself... or perhaps make an attempt to seduce her? The choice is yours.

Featuring a wide and varied roster of supernatural entities, Kurokami-sama's Feast will pit you against monsters from comparatively recent urban legends, such as the Aka Manto and the Kunekune, as well as more ancient beasts of folklore like the Keukegen or the Sazae-oni. Beings of western and Chinese origin, such as the Boogeyman and the Onromaki, also make an appearance.

Супер-скоростные гонки и полные адренали:
Super-skorostnye gonki i polnye adrenalina priklyucheniya, perenesennye s arkadnykh avtomatov na konsoli!

За пеленой тьмы и безумия таится заветна:
Za pelenoy tmy i bezumiya taitsya zavetnaya slava. V etom krovavom ekshen-platformere, vdokhnovlennom klassicheskimi igrami, golovy bukvalno poletyat s plech. Lish samye silnye i iskusnye boytsy utseleyut v bitvakh protiv chudovishchnykh sozdaniy.

Ispolzuyte raznoobraznye orudiya ubiystva i sposobnosti, chtoby ispytat sebya v skhvatkakh s ogromnymi zloveshchimi bossami. Issleduyte izvrashchennyy, obyatyy tmoy i bezumiem mir v dukhe Lavkrafta. Nastraivayte priklyuchenie po sobstvennomu vkusu blagodarya elementam RPG: ot vneshnosti personazha do navykov, kharakteristik i oruzhiya.

Bogatstvo i pochet zhdut geroev, kotorye gotovy prolivat za nikh krov i vypuskat kishki.

OSNOVNYE OSOBENNOSTI:
* Vam predostavlen tselyy arsenal orudiy dlya ubiystva: khlysty, mechi, kinzhaly, topory, luki i drugoe. U vsekh vidov oruzhiya raznye kharakteristiki i vozmozhnosti — ubivayte tvarey tak, kak vam bolshe nravitsya! Chto vy vyberete: magicheskiy posokh, kotoryy porazhaet vragov vspyshkami energii, ili ogromnyy mech?
* Izuchayte detalno prorisovannyy pikselnyy mir, sozdannyy v zhanre metroidvaniya i naselennyy zhutkimi lavkraftianskimi sozdaniyami, i naslazhdaytes mrachnoy atmosferoy i urovnyami, sozdannymi vruchnuyu.
* Igrayte tak, kak vam nravitsya, nastraivaya personazha blagodarya elementam RPG. Menyayte ego vneshnost i vybirayte navyki, kharakteristiki i oruzhie.
* Sobirayte dobychu v bitvakh i puteshestviyakh. Ispolzuyte ee, chtoby uluchshit oruzhie.
* Zaglyanite v razlichnye ugolki etogo kovarnogo mira! Posetite mirnuyu derevnyu s torgovtsami, les, khramovuyu temnitsu, paryashchie ostrova, proklyatyy khram i samu preispodnyuyu — Elderand.
* Raspravy zhdut bolee 60 vidov vragov i bolee desyatka bossov.
* Ishchite pozabytye poslaniya i vsevozmozhnye zapiski, ostavlennye vashimi predshestvennikami. Uznayte bolshe o tme, chto poglotila etot surovyy kray.
Динамичный платформер-рогалик, где вы уп:

Otkryvayte moshchnye predmety, razblokiruyte novye talanty i razgadyvayte tayny Geksiuma, srazhayas za vozvrashchenie kontrolya nad podzemelem, kotoraya bolshe ne podchinyaetsya svoemu sozdatelyu.
Vysokaya reigrabelnost: eksperimentiruyte s novymi strategiyami i rasstanovkoy komnat kazhdyy raz, kogda vy vkhodite v Geksium!
Всемогущий Лягушачий бог пообещал вам да:

It's a dwarf's story!\n\nAs the veins of:
It's a dwarf's story!

As the veins of his city are depleted and the valley is deserted of its inhabitants, rumors of taverns come to Ruggnar's ears. Abandoned places contain incredible treasures that are just waiting to be pickep up.
Equipped with his bag and a few candles, he goes on an adventure to make his fortune!

Really useful candles!

Ruggnar has a limited amount of candles to help him in these dark places. Help him to manage his supply.
Seeing the path ahead of you, activating certain mechanisms or simply lighting up: it's up to you to find the perfect use for each candle!
And if you throw one, remember to pick it up. It might come in useful soon!

Sneaky traps!

There are no enemies to kill here, but many traps are in your way. 
Hidden by the darkness, you may find yourself face to face with an axe, a fireball or other nasty things. 
Don't worry, move carefully, use your candles and everything will be fine. After all, Ruggnar is very agile for a dwarf and he gets up quite easily after an accident.
Observe your surroundings, listen to the noises around you, throw your candles. The traps are there. It's up to you to avoid them!

Customize Ruggnar!

Throughout your journey, unlock new abilities.
Visit the merchant to learn the secrets contained in ancient grimoires to improve your candles and equipment, or to buy the latest items in stock.
Need a change? Many beard dyes, armors and helmets are hidden. Find them and create your own style!

And much more!

- Explore every corner with smooth controls
- Hand-forged story mode
- Procedural generation to extend the experience
- Discover the story behind this humorous adventure
- Pierre-Alain de Garrigues (PADG, french voice over) and Jordan Harrelson (english voice over) lend their talents to Ruggnar so he can swear louder and louder!

Хотите незабываемо провести время? Есть:

Hitchhiker — это игра, действие которой:
Hitchhiker — eto igra, deystvie kotoroy razvorachivaetsya vdol zabroshennykh shosse, gde vam predstoit raskryt taynu svoego proshlogo. Vam otvoditsya rol avtostopshchika, poteryavshego pamyat i konechnuyu tsel svoego puteshestviya. Vam pridetsya lovit poputnye mashiny, chtoby peresech prichudlivye i prekrasnye landshafty v popytkakh rassledovat zagadochnoe ischeznovenie blizkogo cheloveka. Sredi voditeley vy vstretite absolyutno raznykh lyudey — ot surovykh fermerov do vozvrashchayushchikhsya so smeny ofitsiantok, — i vse oni mogut podelitsya s vami interesnymi istoriyami. S poyavleniem zatsepok i svyazey vy poymete, chto vse proiskhodyashchee — ne to, chem kazhetsya na pervyy vzglyad.

V khode puteshestviya vam predstoit rasputat klubok sobytiy iz svoego proshlogo i stolknutsya s predstoyashchimi opasnostyami. Hitchhiker — eto dorozhnoe priklyuchenie, posvyashchennoe issledovaniyu neizvestnogo v poiskakh sebya.

• Lovite poputnye mashiny i naslazhdaytes prichudlivymi i prekrasnymi peyzazhami. Vas zhdut pyat poezdok s pyatyu neznakomtsami, kotorye izmenyat vashe vospriyatie realnosti… I, vozmozhno, sam vzglyad na zhizn.
• Razgadyvayte golovolomki, svyazannye s okruzhayushchey sredoy, i ishchite podskazki, chtoby raskryt svoe zagadochnoe proshloe.
• Resheniya, kotorye predstoit prinyat v razgovorakh s voditelyami, pomogut raskryt vashi mrachnye tayny.
Explore a beautifully realized universe:
Explore a beautifully realized universe rendered in a style that is unique and compelling.

Engage in space exploration, conquest, plant growth and bio mechanical evolution. Conquer asteroids in deep space and use their resources to grow and nurture semi-organic plants and creatures to do your bidding. Plan your strategy against AI opponents that all vie for the same resources and offer fierce opposition.

Eufloria is easy to learn, and enjoyable to master. It’s a game for everyone. Try it now!

Воспротивься своему наследию в этом экше:
Vosprotivsya svoemu naslediyu v etom ekshen-ferme-rogalike! Ukhazhivay za fermoy dnyom i zashchishchaem urozhay ot vragov nochyu! Davay Volteru, mladshemu synu Drakulu, novye sposobnosti i issleduy novye rasteniya dlya svoey fermy. Donesi do svoego ottsa: veganskaya zhizn – ne splosh kislye shchi!
Voltaire: «The Vegan Vampire» – eto smes ekshena, fermy i rogalika. Deystvie proiskhodit v Transilvanii, na rodine Drakuly i ego mladshego syna-buntarya, Voltera. Molodoy vampir prozrel i pomenyal svoi vzglyady. Homebody is a nostalgic survival horror:
Homebody is a nostalgic survival horror puzzle game where you catch up with old friends and try not to get murdered.

Emily and her college buddies have gathered at a remote rental house to watch the Perseid meteor shower. They try to rekindle the bonds they once had, but lingering emotional wounds and social anxieties leave Emily feeling more alone than ever. When the power suddenly goes out, it’s almost a relief. But under the cover of darkness, a mysterious killer picks them off one by one. If Emily can’t find a way out, she’ll be trapped in this nightmare forever.

Evade the killer, solve the house’s devious puzzles, and reconnect with your friends. Escaping the house may seem impossible at first, but with each attempt to put the pieces together, the bloodstained picture becomes more and more clear.

A Nostalgic Trip
Inspired by retro horror games and classic 80s slasher films, Homebody sets the scene for a thrilling evening. This retro-but-modern game pulls players through a deeply strange and emotional experience.

An Unsettling Getaway
Emily and her friends gather for the annual viewing of the Perseid meteor shower. But with relationships strained and anxieties high, what should be a relaxing weekend quickly goes awry, turning even darker as a mysterious killer picks them off. 

Just One Night Together… or Is It?
After a bloody night, Emily wakes back up in the foyer. Realizing something is horribly wrong, Emily must find an escape, no matter what it takes. Learn more about Emily’s relationships with choice-driven dialogue. Stealthily explore the house, moving quietly and hiding in closets to evade the killer’s responsive AI. Death may be inevitable, but knowledge never dies. Use an in-game journal to track the clues and puzzle solutions, piecing together this mysterious event.

Devious Shifting Puzzles
With continually changing challenges in the house, puzzles will require strategic and creative thinking to solve. But be careful and work quickly, time continues to tick on and the unpredictable killer stalks the house looking for Emily and her friends.

Добро пожаловать в Колумбию 1980-х годов:
Dobro pozhalovat v Kolumbiyu 1980-kh godov. El-Patron stroit narkoimperiyu, rasshireniyu kotoroy ne v silakh pomeshat nikto. Blagodarya svoemu vliyaniyu i vzyatkam narkobaron peremanil na svoyu storonu politseyskikh, voennykh i dazhe politikov. Spustya gody slukhi o Medelinskom kartele doshli do Ameriki.
Narcos: Rise of the Cartels pereskazyvaet sobytiya pervogo sezona seriala ot Netflix, kotoryy povestvuet o vzlyote i padenii El-Patrona. Vstante na storonu narkodeltsov ili UBN. Issleduyte znakomye po serialu mesta i sygrayte reshayushchuyu rol v klyuchevykh sobytiyakh istorii, kotorye opredelyat iskhod voyny.
Sobirayte komandu iz personazhey razlichnykh klassov, prisoedinyaytes k glavnym geroyam istorii, uluchshayte navyki i uchastvuyte v zhestokikh poshagovykh srazheniyakh, gde u lyubogo deystviya posledstviya. Gramotno upravlyayte resursami i polzuytes strategicheskoy kartoy, chtoby rasshirit narkoimperiyu ili dat ey boy.

Вам предстоит решить множество головолом:
Vam predstoit reshit mnozhestvo golovolomok chto by uznat strashnuyu taynu katastrofy na AES. Igra pereneset vas v 1986 god, na Chernobylskuyu atomnuyu stantsiyu. Vam pridetsya pobyvat v shkure odnogo iz uchenykh sekretnoy laboratorii, baziruyushcheysya v glubinakh ChAES. Uspeyte spastis so stantsii, poka ne slishkom pozdno! Chernobyl - eto opasnoe mesto. Na puti u vas budut stoyat slozhnye golovolomki, mutanty, anomalii i bezumtsy! Uznayte strashnuyu taynu, kto zhe vse taki povinen v sluchivshemsya? Prinimayte slozhnye resheniya, kotorye opredelyat ne tolko vashu sudbu, no i sudby tysyach lyudey, okazavshikhsya pod udarom strashnoy katastrofy! Kazhdoe reshenie prinyatoe v igre mozhet stoit vashey zhizni.

Osobennosti igry:
*Tri unikalnye kontsovki
*Shest igrovykh glav
*Slozhnye golovolomki
*Atmosfernyy saundtrek
*Nepovtorimyy igrovoy dizayn
Afterimage — это нарисованный от руки дв:
Afterimage — eto narisovannyy ot ruki dvumernyy priklyuchencheskiy boevik s dinamichnymi srazheniyami, nastroykami personazha, nelineynymi urovnyami i uvlekatelnym syuzhetom, razvorachivayushchimsya na ruinakh vymyshlennogo mira. Cherez mnogo let posle kataklizma pod nazvaniem «Unichtozhenie», edva ne polozhivshego konets chelovecheskoy tsivilizatsii, poteryavshaya pamyat devushka Rene prikhodit v sebya na ruinakh stolitsy. Chtoby vernut vospominaniya i spasti nastavnika, ona otpravlyaetsya v puteshestvie, zapustiv ryad sobytiy, kotorym predstoit opredelit budushchee mira.

V igre:
•         Nelineynyy mir: raskryvayte tayny, pokhoronennye gluboko pod razvalinami nekogda edinogo ogromnogo mira Engardin. Vam povstrechaetsya bolee 50 neigrovykh personazhey, kazhdyy so svoey istoriey i zadachey, i vy smozhete uznat bolshe o roli etikh personazhey v Engardine, vypolnyaya pobochnye zadaniya.
•         Vam predstoit srazitsya bolee chem so 170 tipami vragov, vklyuchaya 30 slozhnykh bitv s bossami.
•         Rolevaya mekhanika predusmatrivaet mnozhestvo parametrov dlya razvitiya personazha: bolee 200 predmetov amunitsii, v tom chisle 6 klassov osnovnogo i dopolnitelnogo vooruzheniya, broni i prinadlezhnostey. Vkladyvayte bally talanta v povyshenie kharakteristik i unikalnye navyki vladeniya oruzhiem kazhdogo klassa.
•         Opredelite sudbu mira: v igre neskolko kontsovok, zavisyashchikh ot deystviy Rene, kotoraya izmenyaet budushchee Engardina.
•         Potryasayushchaya dvumernaya animatsiya, kazhdyy kadr kotoroy narisovan ot ruki.
•         Otkryvayte novye sposobnosti, predostavlyayushchie unikalnye vozmozhnosti v issledovanii i v boyu, primenyayte ikh dlya dostupa k novym zonam i obkhodnym putyam, pobezhdayte vsyo bolee opasnykh vragov!
•         Bolee 40 originalnykh orkestrovykh kompozitsiy, sozdannykh gruppoy Aurogon Sound Team i zapisannykh orkestrom International Master Philharmonic Orchestra i drugimi ispolnitelyami.
\"Каждый слышал о легендарном короле Арт:
"Kazhdyy slyshal o legendarnom korole Arture i ego davnem sopernike Lanselote.

Snedaemyy zavistyu, Lanselot vyzval korolya na poedinok. Ekskalibur, vernyy mech Artura, raskololsya na chasti. Ot nego ostalas lish rukoyat i krestovina. 

Artur zaklyuchil dogovor s feey Morganoy i brosil oblomki mecha v vodu. No Artura predali, i on okazalsya zatochyon v zagrobnom korolevstve Avalon. 

Po prikazu korolya volshebnik Merlin dolzhen nayti naslednika Artura, sobrat vse 15 oblomkov Ekskalibura i vernut Artura v mir zhivykh."

V igre vossozdan vsemirno izvestnyy frantsuzskiy tematicheskiy park.

Pochuvstvuyte sebya geroem arturiany i otpravlyaytes v neveroyatnoe puteshestvie, chtoby nayti vse 15 oblomkov Ekskalibura i osvobodit korolya.

Sovershite puteshestvie vo vremeni i srazites s groznymi vragami: dayte otpor svirepym vikingam, vstupite v boy na arene antichnogo amfiteatra, stante rytsarem i oderzhivayte pobedy na zhestokikh turnirakh.

Issleduyte park Pyui-dyu-Fu, vossozdannyy do melchayshikh detaley: nakhodite podskazki, chtoby proyti osnovnuyu kampaniyu, ili vypolnyayte dopolnitelnye zadaniya na istoricheskuyu tematiku.

Sozdayte svoy avatar i vyberite, kakim budet vashe sobstvennoe priklyuchenie v Pyui-dyu-Fu.

Bolee 15 ispytaniy i mnozhestvo tsennykh nakhodok zhdut vas v unikalnom puteshestvii po antichnosti i Srednim vekam."
Resolutiion — это динамичная игра в жанр:
Resolutiion — eto dinamichnaya igra v zhanre action-adventure, sozdannaya dvumya zlobnymi bratyami iz Germanii. Prisoedinyaytes k gruppe brodyag v igre s prekrasnoy pikselnoy grafikoy, gryaznymi shutochkami, glubokimi ideyami i krutym saundtrekom na 20 chasov igrovogo vremeni. Vas zhdut zhestokie bitvy, issledovaniya, nagrady i neprostaya istoriya. Kem vy stanete? Igrokom ili igrushkoy? V Imperii Beskonechnosti vse ne to, chem kazhetsya.

Issleduyte raskolotyy mir budushchego, sobirayte neobychnye orudiya, istorii i proshloe po kusochkam: predannyy drug, razrushennaya semya i voyna mirov.

Chtoby razreshit taynu Kolybeley, vy pogruzites v puchinu, gde vas zhdut tsinichnye bogi, mashiny s chuvstvami, fanatiki, protivniki evolyutsii i mokhnatye sozdaniya. Etomu miru vse ravno, sbivaet li on vas s tolku ili ubivaet... oy, smotrite! Kotik!

*20 ch. igrovogo vremeni.
*Issleduyte zloveshchiy mir v stile kiberpank, gde vse ne to, chem kazhetsya.
*Pogruzites v mrachnuyu istoriyu, stante geroem ili zlodeem.
*Otkryvayte novye sposobnosti i pobezhdayte vragov.
*Vyzhivayte v surovykh bitvakh i krushite zhutkikh bossov.
*Naslazhdaytes krutym saundtrekom v stile kiberpank.

Ashland Dossier — шпионский триллер, нап:
Ashland Dossier — shpionskiy triller, napolnennyy elementami poshagovoy taktiki skrytnosti i priklyuchencheskoy rolevoy igry. Ispolzuyte svoyu khitrost, lovkost i smekalku, chtoby na etot raz navsegda pokonchit s natsistskoy chumoy. Vperedi vas zhdet smertelnoe protivostoyanie, poskolku vrag snova ugrozhaet vvergnut mir v puchinu uzhasnoy i bessmyslennoy voyny.
Posle Vtoroy mirovoy voyny mnogim natsistam udalos proskolznut skvoz shcheli i bezhat za granitsu. Kak krysy, oni razbezhalis po miru, chtoby spryatatsya v teni, verya, chto dlinnaya ruka pravosudiya nikogda ne dostignet ikh. Odnako eto odno fatalnoe zabluzhdenie.
V kontse 1950-kh godov byla obrazovana chastnaya sledstvennaya organizatsiya. INCU (Mezhdunarodnaya gruppa po borbe s natsistskoy prestupnostyu) imeet v vidu tolko odnu konkretnuyu tsel: nayti takikh prestupnikov i vernut ikh dlya spravedlivogo suda.
Vy vozmete na sebya rol ofitsera, kotoryy ishchet gruppu samykh otyavlennykh negodyaev. V proshlom vse oni sovershili osobo tyazhkie prestupleniya, kotorye do sikh por ostayutsya beznakazannymi. Vasha tsel — nayti ikh sled, sobrat vse vozmozhnye uliki i, nakonets, privlech ikh k otvetstvennosti.
Khotya legche skazat, chem sdelat. Est eshche odna novaya sila, kotoraya tolko chto poyavilas iz niotkuda — Eshlend. K sozhaleniyu, eti lyudi ne ostanovyatsya ni pered chem v svoem reshitelnom stremlenii pomoch beglym natsistam...
Dose Eshlenda vklyuchaet v sebya:
- napryazhennye operatsii, vklyuchayushchie vyyavlenie, presledovanie i evakuatsiyu podozrevaemogo,
- bogatyy lor i predystoriya razvorachivayushchikhsya sobytiy,
- skrupuleznyy analiz informatsii, dokazatelstv i pokazaniy svideteley,
- dve igrovye vremennye shkaly: 1960-1964 i 1941-1945,
- unikalnye personazhi, neozhidannye povoroty syuzheta, neskolko kontsovok,
- glubokiy i realistichnyy vzglyad na pravdivye uzhasy Vtoroy mirovoy voyny.
Выращивайте собственные миры и укрепляйт:
Vyrashchivayte sobstvennye miry i ukreplyayte svoyu svyaz s nimi. V etoy priklyuchencheskoy «pesochnitse» s elementami upravleniya zhiznyu vam predstoit izmenit mir k luchshemu i vernut Vechnomu drevu ego byluyu slavu.

Miry Alarii postepenno uvyadayut. Vechnoe drevo, na chikh beschislennykh vetvyakh pokoilos tseloe mnozhestvo mirov, sovsem zavyalo — ot nego ostalsya lish sazhenets. Nikto ne znaet, kak ego vyrastit. Nikto, krome vas. Vy slyshite pesn Solntsa, raznosyashchuyusya po nebu. Vy slyshite, chto shepchet dozhd, prolivayas na zemlyu. Vy — posledniy predstavitel pokoleniya alkhimikov, chya zadacha — rastit i zashchishchat Vechnoe drevo!

Klyuchevye osobennosti 

Otkryvayte dlya sebya nasyshchennyy i nepovtorimyy mir — v svoem sobstvennom tempe.
Nakhodite unikalnye mesta, gde tsvetut fantasticheskie rasteniya i vodyatsya nevidannye zveri. Kak vam bolshe nravitsya provodit vremya? Sobirayte kamni i tsvety, lovite rybu i zhukov, issleduyte peshchery, reshayte golovolomki... Tolko vy opredelyaete, chem vam zanimatsya!

Sozdavayte miry!
Osvaivayte alkhimiyu, vyrashchivayte mirovye semena i sozdavayte sovershenno novye miry s nepovtorimymi kharakteristikami. Sledite za svoimi mirami, vdykhayte v nikh zhizn i smotrite, kak pod vashey opekoy oni budut menyatsya u vas na glazakh i obretat novye osobennosti! Vy mozhete sozdavat luga, pustyni, ledyanye miry i… em-m… alkhimiya — ne sovsem tochnaya nauka, poetomu inogda vas mogut zhdat syurprizy.

Znakomtes s novymi lyudmi i sozdavayte soobshchestva!
Vy smozhete znakomitsya s unikalnymi personazhami, uznavat o nikh i dazhe pomogat. Nakhodite im zhilishche ili rabotu ili darite aksessuary i ukrasheniya.

Stroyte gorod mechty
V Grow vas zhdut desyatki razlichnykh postroek, s pomoshchyu kotorykh mozhno postroit gorod mechty. Rasstavlyayte i ukrashayte ikh kak zakhotite: nikto ne obespechit vam domashniy uyut luchshe vas samikh! 

Prekrasnyy saundtrek
Muzyka ot kompozitora saundtrekov k videoigram i anime Kevina Penkina.

Tayny! 
Ruiny, peshchery, skrytye oblasti… doberites do samogo serdtsa Vechnogo dreva i zanovo obretite davno utrachennye znaniya.
Космоопера, научно-фантастическое приклю:
Kosmoopera, nauchno-fantasticheskoe priklyuchenie s elementami upravleniya resursami, v kotorom vam predstoit igrat za razumnyy kosmicheskiy korabl!..
V mire «Dolgogo puteshestviya» razumnye korabli vekami nakhodilis vne zakona. No blagodarya vernoy komande i golograficheskomu pomoshchniku K.O.R.G.I. transportnomu sredstvu udavalos ostavatsya nepoymannym. Teper zhe protagonist beryotsya za lyubuyu rabotu, chtoby stat blizhe k svobode.
Vam predstoit stranstvovat po kosmosu, brat na bort novykh tovarishchey i vydavat im zadaniya. U kazhdogo passazhira svoi silnye i slabye storony, poetomu k raspredeleniyu missiy neobkhodimo podoyti s umom. Krome togo, vazhno zabotitsya o blagosostoyanii soyuznikov.
Eta igra — pervaya rabota studii Crispy Creative, kotoruyu osnoval Kaylan Kouts, byvshiy UI-dizayner kompanii Obsidian; v eyo komandu takzhe vkhodyat byvshie sotrudniki staroy Telltale Games.
Действие игры происходит в 1983 году в н:
Deystvie igry proiskhodit v 1983 godu v nebolshom gorode Saylent Khill, raspolozhennom v shtate Men, SShA. 32-letniy pisatel Garri Meyson otpravlyaetsya v gorod vmeste so svoy priyomnoy docheryu Sheril, chtoby provesti tam otpusk. Pri podezde k gorodu mashinu pisatelya obgonyaet politseyskiy mototsikl Sibil Bennet, no na sleduyushchem povorote Garri vidit ego na obochine oprokinutym. Otvlyokshis na nego, Garri slishkom pozdno zamechaet vnezapno voznikshuyu devochku na doroge. Pytayas izbezhat stolknoveniya, on rezko povorachivaet rul, popadaet v avariyu i teryaet soznanie..
Silent Hill — videoigra 1999 goda v zhanre survival horror, davshaya nachalo odnoimyonnoy serii videoigr. Razrabotana komandoy Team Silent — gruppoy v sostave Konami Computer Entertainment Tokyo i vypushchena Konami eksklyuzivno dlya igrovoy pristavki PlayStation. V Silent Hill ispolzuetsya vid ot 3-go litsa, vse lokatsii vypolneny v tryokhmernoy grafike. Chtoby skryt graficheskie nedostatki, obuslovlennye tekhnicheskimi ogranicheniyami PlayStation, razrabotchiki ispolzovali «effekt tumana», vposledstvii stavshego otlichitelnoy chertoy mira Saylent Khill. V otlichie ot bolee rannikh igr zhanra survival horror, v kotorykh glavnymi geroyami, kak pravilo, byli spetsagenty s khoroshey boevoy podgotovkoy, personazh Silent Hill — obychnyy chelovek. V igre prisutstvuet pyat raznykh kontsovok, vklyuchaya odnu shutochnuyu.
Silent Hill poluchila polozhitelnye otzyvy kritikov i byla kommercheski uspeshnoy. Igra schitaetsya odnoy iz samykh znachimykh sredi zhanra survival horror, tak kak v plane zapugivaniya igroka sposobstvovala perekhodu ot priyomov filmov kategorii «B» k psikhologicheskomu aspektu uzhasov.
Присоединяйтесь к эпическому аркадному п:

No eto eshche ne vsyo — my takzhe vklyuchili syuda 10 kultovykh sportivnykh igr, takie kak darts, futbol, bilyard, bouling i mnogie drugie, kotorye obychno vstrechayutsya v izvestnykh arkadnykh zavedeniyakh po vsemu miru.

The Hand of Merlin — пошаговая rogue-lit: The Hand of Merlin — poshagovaya rogue-lite RPG, gde legenda o Korole Arture stalkivaetsya s uzhasom iz kosmosa. Flamecraft — это уютный карточный симуля:
Flamecraft — eto uyutnyy kartochnyy simulyator, kotoryy pogruzit vas v mir volshebstva. Stante khranitelem plameni i pomogite obresti dom ocharovatelnym masteram-drakonam. Zacharuyte gorodskie lavki, pomestite v nikh kartochki drakonov, i skazochnyy torgovyy kvartal ozhivet u vas na glazakh.

Esli vy spravites, to zavoyuete titul mastera plameni! Stante khranitelem plameni i perenesites v krasochnyy uyutnyy mir, gde zhivut drakony!
В путешествии по таинственному миру меч:
V puteshestvii po tainstvennomu miru mech pozvolit ne tolko srazhatsya, no i tvorit osobye chary dlya resheniya muzykalnykh golovolomok. Pogruzis v videoigru, gde vazhny dazhe fazy Luny, i pomogi stranstvuyushchey monakhine vypolnit ee pechalnuyu missiyu.
 Superbrothers: Sword & Sworcery EP soderzhit tselyy albom muzyki izvestnogo kompozitora Dzhima Gatri. Khudozhestvennym oformleniem i dizaynom zanimalas studiya Superbrothers Inc., a programmirovaniem – volshebniki videoigr iz kanadskoy kompanii Capy (Toronto).

\"ANGEL WHISPER\", released by Child-Dre:
"ANGEL WHISPER", released by Child-Dream in 1999, became a major topic of conversation with its system of playing the posthumous game while browsing actual websites, raising the question, "Did this really happen?". Its conclusion, seemingly predicting the modern era of 2023, led to mixed opinions and, along with the psychological horror "Scars of the Doll", it became a pioneering presence in indie Visual Novel.

This is more than just a video game trailer; it's a personal plea to you.
Due to circumstances, I am making this request alongside the release of the game.
Would you play this video game until the very end?
In 1999, my father, game designer Hiroaki Yushima, abruptly vanished from our lives, leaving behind a single video game.
"ANGEL WHISPER"... this is that video game.

Please, I need your help.
Will you uncover the truth... on my behalf?

[From the Creator]
This game, in 2023, was refined at the request of my friend's daughter, Mise Yushima.

The truth behind the disappearance of the original creator, Hiroaki Yushima, remains unclear to this day. No suicide note or clues were left behind, only this game, "ANGEL WHISPER." 
The creators cannot be held responsible for any events that may occur as a result of playing this video game.

[Story]
"Why did he leave behind this game and disappear?"

Game creator Yushima suddenly vanished from this world, and the only thing left behind was a single game, "ANGEL WHISPER."

The content depicted in the posthumous work was an event Yushima experienced in 1998. He joined a certain game company and began producing a game based on Nostradamus's prophecy of the end of the world. However, in the midst of production, a mysterious incident occurred, and he lost his colleagues.

Within the game, the protagonist Yushima, while advancing development at the game company, chases after the mystery of the incident. Soon, Yushima confronts an inexplicable entity.

What was Yushima pursuing, and what kind of incident did he get entangled in? Why did he leave behind this work? Play until the end, and discover his final intentions.

Something stirs in the darkness of the u:
Something stirs in the darkness of the underground mausoleum. A terracotta figurine cracks and a soul stirs within, awakened by the energy of the Tao. You wake, surrounded by eight thousand of your terracotta comrades. A curse has been placed upon the army of the first emperor, save yourself… meaning  you are the only one who can lift it and bring peace to one of the greatest spiritual wonders of ancient China.


Terracotta is an action-adventure game based on China's seminal Qin dynasty. Though ruling only for fifteen years, the first imperial dynasty laid the foundations of a state that would endure for over two thousand years. Experience the splendor and drama, as China transforms from a patchwork of warring states to a united empire. Witness the creation of the first Great Wall of China and the grand victories that preserved its legacy.



Explore the Twin Realms

As the sole uncursed warrior of the emperor's Terracotta Army, you'll have to master your ability to channel the Tao, switching between the realms of Yin and Yang to free your fellow soldiers from the spiritual blight.


Shift between the realms of Yin and Yang, within the tomb of the Qin Emperor and his afterlife, looping between death and the afterlife to overcome cursed challenges.
Yin is the domain of solitude and tranquility. The dark, desolate tomb is a fortress, where you can strategize, prepare, and alter the layout to aid your journey.
Yang is the realm of the afterlife, light, and action. Execute combat strategies, evade foes, and overcome the tomb’s defenders to find the source of the curse placed upon the rest of the terracotta.


Solve the Mystery of the Curse

You are one of eight thousand warriors bound to protect the Qin Emperor in his afterlife. Your comrades are not your enemies, even if they do not think so at the moment…


Master your ability to channel the light of Yin, not only for switching realms but also for manipulating surroundings.
Awaken ancient mechanisms and descend into the underworld, overcoming foes through speed and agility, instead of only using brute force.
Defeat nine brutal bosses, requiring the mastery of the nine phases of Qi: The universal energy that forms all parts of living beings.

Witness the Rise of China


The Qin dynasty laid the foundations of China that would endure two thousand years. As an awakened terracotta warrior, you have the opportunity to observe it from within.

Experience an art style based on the timeless aesthetics of guo hua, traditional Chinese painting.
Immerse yourself in the afterlife of the Terracotta Army with a soundtrack inspired by traditional instruments classified through the ancient Chinese ba yin.
Save your fellow eight thousand strong warriors, each with iconic individual appearances - just like the real Terracotta Army!




TERRACOTTA is a project funded by Red.es and the European Regional Development Fund (ERDF) through the Red.es Program to promote the videogame industry. These grants are co-funded by the Spanish ERDF Pluri-Regional Operative Program (POPE) 2014-2020.
Brain Show: Who is the smartest one in y:
Brain Show: Who is the smartest one in your crew?

Brain Show is a quiz game spiced with some mean, but harmless humour. Immerse in the world of classic game shows: choose your categories, answer questions, eliminate rivals in various challenges, and prove yourself to be the smartest one in the pack!

Up to 8 players
Over 5 000 questions in 41 categories

Charismatic, funny (and a little cringy) host commenting your actions.

Controls in Brain Show were designed on a test group consisting of my chihuahua and a blind, 22 years old cat. So don’t worry if some of your friends have never played any game in their lives, someone drank one too many, or you have this one peculiar fellow in the group… You just hand out pads, launch the game and have fun from the get-go. No manual or explanation needed!

Welcome to a TV game show for people who are ashamed to admit that they have always dreamt about participating in one! Stand on a stage, take part in various challenges, such as the Stealing Points Round or Eliminations, play for a stake, and get annoyed by the weird host (because there is no game show without someone like me!).
And since we’re talking about me. I admit, I will throw some shade at you, but also tell you a good word (if you deserve it!). Always remember – my only purpose is to bring you loads of laughs (and a little bit of cringe).

Game available in English and Polish.

Get Brain Show and join the fun!

About Ember\n\nBack in the earliest days:
About Ember

Back in the earliest days, there was no sun and the world was dark. The heavens opened up and stars fell like beacons into the pitch black world, and they were known as “Embers”. Powerful and wise druids of a primordial race, “the Lightbringers," roamed the land searching for this luminous matter. They performed a ritual of awakening to call the “Embers” out of their deep sleep. Suddenly the world became bright, and the veil of darkness was lifted. The Embers were the embodiment of magical flame, light, and life, but as word spread about the sheer power of the Embers, they came to be hunted and captured…and so the War for Ember began…


Gameplay overview

A passion project 10 years in the making, Ember is a homage to classic role-playing games (RPG). Enter the world of Ember as a resurrected “Lightbringer” summoned to protect the dying Embers as the world is on the brink of collapse. Beginning in the Deep Barrows, traverse vast environments divided between above ground and underground realms – ranging from lush forests to dry deserts and dark abysses – to reach the City of Light. See how the story unfolds through encounters with strangers by making pivotal decisions about your own destiny.


Key features

• Classic-style RPG with 30+ hours of epic adventure
• Epic storytelling filled with fascinating characters, lore, adventure, and humor
• Over 70 quests with diverse gameplay enabling players to choose their path
• Engaging party-based real-time combat system with tactical pause
• Over 65 combat skills for the player to use in customized battle party strategy
• Encounter hundreds of NPCs with their own tales to tell
• In-depth crafting system, from baking bread to forging magic weapons and armor
• A beautiful seamless open world with over 20 handcrafted outdoor environments and dark dungeons that feature puzzles, traps, weather changes and day / night cycles 
• Adventure with different companions with their own backstories and quests
Станьте владельцем собственного магазина:
Stante vladeltsem sobstvennogo magazina v fentezi-mire proshlogo v igre Winkeltje: The Little Shop! Stroyte, ukrashayte, sozdavayte, prodavayte i stante khozyainom sobstvennogo magazina v beskonechnoy upravlencheskoy igre.

- Igrayte v svoem tempe i otkroyte svoy magazin, kogda budete gotovy k rabochemu dnyu.

Ukrashenie

Pokazhite svoi navyki dizayna intererov, rasstavlyaya mebel i vitriny v lyubom poryadke. Khorosho ukrashayte magazin, chtoby privlekat pokupateley.

- Mnozhestvo raznoobraznoy mebeli, ot stolov i vitrin do prilavkov, skladskikh palletov i masterskikh.

Rasshirenie

Rasshiryayte magazin, kogda nakopite dostatochno sredstv. Stante sobstvennym arkhitektorom pri stroitelstve magazina mechty.

- Pridumayte planirovku magazina i razmeshchenie dverey, okon i proemov.

Sozdanie tovarov

Fermerstvo

Uvelichte zapasy edy v magazine i vyrashchivayte vkusnye artishoki, tsvetnuyu kapustu, kartoshku i drugie kultury v sobstvennom ogorode.

Sotrudniki

Nanimayte sotrudnikov, chtoby oni pomogali vam, kogda del slishkom mnogo dlya odnogo cheloveka.

Мрачная ролевая экшн-адвенчура, действие:
Mrachnaya rolevaya ekshn-advenchura, deystvie kotoroy razvorachivaetsya posle katastroficheskoy Epokhi Odinochestva, gde maski stali edinstvennoy zashchitoy ot Proklyatiya Likov. Otpravlyaytes v zemli Yariva, broste vyzov eyo opasnostyam i naydite istochnik napasti.
Proklyatie Likov — mir, gde pokazat svoyo litso znachit mgnovenno pogibnut. Chelovechestvo okazalos na grani vymiraniya. Spustya 264 let Epokhi Odinochestva poyavilsya simvol spaseniya — Maski. Nikto ne znaet, otkuda vzyalos Proklyatie, no smelchaki vsyo ravno lezut v samoe ego serdtse, gde, byt mozhet, skryty otvety na vse voprosy.
Stanete li vy tem, kto osvobodit mir ot proklyatiya, ili zhe podchinite ego svoey vole?
Vybor vsegda za vami.Eshchyo lou-poli 3D igr, pokhozhikh na epokhu PS1-PSX.
Ролевая новелла, которая сочетает в себе:
Rolevaya novella, kotoraya sochetaet v sebe nasyshchennoe povestvovanie, dinamichnyy ekshn i glubokoe razvitie personazhey. Vozmite na sebya dvoynuyu rol yasnoglazykh Illyuminatorov, kotorye treniruyutsya, chtoby stat legendarnymi Arboreyndzherami — khranitelyami sveta v mire, balansiruyushchem na grani teney.
Srazhaytes s tmoy v bitvakh v realnom vremeni, napolnennykh vzryvnymi kombo-atakami, pereklyucheniem personazhey na letu i menyayushchimi igru navykami sinergii, osvaivayte boevye stili kak Fansii, tak i Aliny i nastroyte svoy stil s pomoshchyu strategicheskikh naborov navykov.
Issleduyte Inliksaland, yarkiy skazochnyy mir, polnyy magicheskikh sushchestv, tainstvennykh sekretov i opasnykh vragov, izvestnykh kak Darkrittery. To, chto nachinaetsya kak bezzabotnoe puteshestvie, bystro prevrashchaetsya v zakhvatyvayushchuyu istoriyu o tainstvennoy devushke, upavshey s neba.
Noctuary predlagaet kak emotsionalnuyu glubinu, tak i vysokuyu reigrabelnost: otkroyte dlya sebya lichnye istorii sopartiytsev, raskroyte sokrytye taynye znaniya i sformiruyte svoy put Zashchitnika sveta!.. Otvette na prizyv, zashchitite svet i napishite legendu v etoy gremuchey smesi proniknovennogo rolevogo ekshena s vizualnoy novelloy.
Одни спасают принцесс, другие — целый ми:
Odni spasayut printsess, drugie — tselyy mir. A zdes vy spasaete svoyo urchashchee puziko!.. Ne zhdite, poka odoleet golod. Otpravlyaytes v uvlekatelnoe puteshestvie, polnoe priklyucheniy, neozhidannykh vstrech, ispytaniy i zabavnykh mekhanik.
Issleduyte mir, polnyy zagadok, ekstsentrichnykh personazhey i strannykh problem. Kopayte, kachaytes i begayte po tshchatelno prorabotannomu miru, gde syurprizy zhdut vas za kazhdym uglom!
Слоны — это могучие защитники мира, появ:
Slony — eto moguchie zashchitniki mira, poyavlyayushchiesya na svet iz zvezd odin raz v tysyacheletie. Nastupila era slonenka Yono. Odnako Yono eshche tak molod, i v korolevstve, gde pravyat feodalnye otnosheniya, nezhit v vide skeletov Bonvayts i robotizirovannyy Mekani, nelegko izbezhat nepriyatnostey.

Yono i Nebesnyy Slon — eto bolshoe priklyuchenie, v kotorom vas zhdut tshchatelno razrabotannye golovolomki, poiski sokrovishch i mir, polnyy lyudey. Igrayte za slonenka, kotoromu nuzhno spasti sovershenno novyy dlya nego mir. Uznayte bogatuyu istoriyu korolevstva, gde lyudi, zombi i roboty zhivut bok o bok.

Osobennosti
• Ispolzuyte khobot slona, chtoby reshat golovolomki i raskryvat sekrety. Nabirayte vozdukh, vodu i drugie predmety dlya sozdaniya razlichnykh effektov.

• Issleduyte lesa i peshchery, chtoby otyskat sokrovishcha i apgreydy.
• Obsudite asketicheskuyu dobrodetel s nezhityu, ekzistentsializm i svobodu voli s robotami, politicheskuyu filosofiyu i istochniki sily i vlasti s lyudmi.
• Soberite vse drevnie teksty, chtoby uznat tayny istorii mira, etapy razvitiya chelovecheskogo roda i to, kak na eto povliyali slony.

DRAW CHILLY - чертовски аркадная игра,:
DRAW CHILLY  - chertovski arkadnaya igra, gde ty v roli Vladimira vytyagivaesh gorod so dna Chistilishcha, vypolnyaya poruchenie svoikh rabotodateley - Vsadnikov Apokalipsisa.

Otryad glupykh, no smelykh i chistykh serdtsem mekhanikov, vo glave s Vladimirom srazhaetsya s obezyanami, proryvayas vverkh po etazham, chtoby vernut iz Chistilishcha oshibochno popavshikh syuda klientov - bossov - obratno k Zhnetsam dlya ikh vernogo raspredeleniya v Ad.

Uluchshaya gorod, usilivaya otryad i Vladimira, ty uznaesh chasti istorii kazhdogo iz glavnykh protivnikov, uvidish stseny iz proshlogo Vladimira i poznakomishsya s Vsadnikami, kotorye v nashey Vselennoy dobry i obladayut chuvstvom yumora.

Eta pikselnaya arkadnaya 2d igra predostavit tebe vozmozhnost ochen mnogo begat vlevo i vpravo, no u igry est i drugie, bolee znachimye, osobennosti.

- Sobiraya tsyplyat i vyrabatyvaya energiyu osobym nezhestokim sposobom, ty uluchshaesh gorod i otkryvaesh umeniya. Gorod predostavlyaet tebe pomoshchnikov v vide NPC i chlenov otryada, a umeniya pozvolyayut Vladimiru effektno raspravlyatsya s protivnikami. Naprimer, mozhno vyzvat rozovogo chervya, zamedlit protivnikov, a zatem udarit po nim ogromnym gaechnym klyuchom.
- Poluchaya za kazhdyy proydennyy etazh VladKoiny, ty dopolnitelno prokachivaesh umeniya i navyki samogo Vladimira, usilivaya ego.
- Gruznye tsyplyata s yashchikami dostavyat tebe tem bolshe novykh umeniy, tem bystree ty podnimaesh gorod i nagonyaesh ikh v beskonechnom kolodtse, v kotorom proiskhodit deystvie.
- Vsadniki Apokalipsisa ne tolko pomogayut v bitve, kogda ty prizyvaesh ikh posle polnoy zaryadki Magnita, no i prepodnosyat Dary Vsadnikov - osobye usileniya, svyazannye s bossami.

Izuchayte osobye navyki: otprygivayte ot sten, dvigaytes so skorostyu molnii i ispolzuyte silu magicheskikh kristallov dlya razrushitelnogo udara-melnitsy!
