Sanni nakhoditsya na perepute. Ona znaet, chto skoro vse izmenitsya. No ona poka ne znaet kak. Ona snova brosaet vzglyad na dogovor. Khoroshaya novost v tom, chto ona teper gordaya vladelitsa semeynogo restorana. A kakaya plokhaya? On vidal i luchshie dni. 
Stuk v dver vozveshchaet o pribytii ee teti, guu-ma. 
Da, skoro vse izmenitsya. No opredelyat eti izmeneniya budut neznakomye lyudi, kotorykh ona videla tolko na vytsvetshikh fotografiyakh.

Otpravlyaysya v puteshestvie, polnoe otkrytiy

Tsel Sanni i ee guu-ma — spasti semeynyy restoran, kotoryy perezhivaet ne luchshie vremena. V poiskakh sekretov uspekha, kotorye pomogut vernut tolpy posetiteley, im nuzhno navestit zabytykh rodstvennikov. No eto budet neprosto. Dolgaya doroga vmeste s pozhiloy tetey stanet dlya geroini nastoyashchim ispytaniem, gde vse kulturnye razlichiya vyplyvut na poverkhnost. Tolko prinimaya slozhnye resheniya na svoem puti, Sanni smozhet uznat, chto zhe prigotovila dlya nee sudba.

Ne sezzhay s dorogi

Skolko Sanni sebya pomnit, Sendi vsegda byla vazhnoy chastyu ikh semi. Vmeste oni preodoleli mnogo trudnostey i proekhali bolshie rasstoyaniya. No teper mashina razvalivaetsya na chasti, i Sanni ponadobitsya pomoshch v reshenii etoy problemy. Tolko blagodarya ostorozhnoy ezde i regulyarnym proverkam Sendi smozhet dostavit Sanni k ee tseli.

Osnovnye osobennosti
•	Napisannoe avtorom Yen Ooy, eto uvlekatelnoe priklyuchenie proiskhodit v nostalgicheskoy atmosfere Kitaya 1990-kh godov.
•	Sygray svoyu rol v trogatelnoy interaktivnoy istorii, gde tvoi resheniya budut opredelyat sudbu Sanni.
•	Vyrazitelnaya animatsiya i yarkiy saundtrek pomogut tebe proniknutsya dukhom Guanduna.
•	Ty obyazatelno polyubish kharizmatichnykh personazhey, u kazhdogo iz kotorykh unikalnyy kharakter i interesnaya istoriya.
•	Mashine nuzhen ukhod — sledi za raskhodom topliva, iznosom shin i sostoyaniem dvigatelya.
Tyrian — известный вертикальный скроллер:
Tyrian — izvestnyy vertikalnyy skroller-shutepam, razrabotannyy kompaniey Eclipse Productions, pozzhe stavshey World Tree Games i vypushchennyy v 1995 godu izdatelem Epic Megagames dlya MS-DOS. Originalnaya versiya sostoyala iz tryokh epizodov, versiya 2.0 soderzhit novyy chetvyortyy epizod, a v 1999 godu igra poluchila vse vyshedshie patchi i novyy, pyatyy epizod.
Syuzhet nachinaetsya v 20031 godu. Glavnyy geroy — pilot Trent Khokinz — zanimaetsya poiskom prigodnykh dlya zhilya mest na planetakh, nedavno podvergshikhsya terraformirovaniyu. Ego poslednee naznachenie — planeta Tirian, raspolozhennaya okolo territoriy Khazudra — yashcheropodobnoy rasy. Odnazhdy Khazudra Byus Kvezillak, luchshiy drug Trenta, byl podstrelen dronom, bystro ischeznuvshim v nebe. Umiraya, Byus govorit Trentu, chto eto rabota korporatsii Maykrosol, upravlyayushchey terraformirovaniem na Tiriane. Oni reshili ubrat Byusa, potomu chto on znal o «gravitiume» — minerale na Tiriane, sposobnom kontrolirovat gravitatsiyu.
Maykrosol khochet ispolzovat gravitium, chtoby mnogokratno usilit boesposobnost svoikh voennykh korabley, sdelav ikh pochti neuyazvimymi. Oni takzhe pytayutsya ustranit vsekh, kto znaet o sushchestvovanii minerala. Trent — sleduyushchaya tsel v ikh spiske. Byus sovetuet Trentu popytatsya dobratsya do Savary, svobodnogo mira. Trent dobyvaet malenkiy korabl i otbyvaet tuda..
Kompozitor igry — Aleksandr Brendon!..
Данная сборка представляет собой саму иг:
Dannaya sborka predstavlyaet soboy samu igru The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim dlya Nintendo Switch adaptirovannuyu na russkiy yazyk iz yaponskogo regiona i integrirovannye mody posle konvertatsii, dlya raboty na Switch. Alternativnaya Oblegchyonnaya versiya NSP sborki, povyshena stabilnost i proizvoditelnost, obnovleny plaginy do poslednikh aktualnykh versiy, dobavleny dopolnitelnye plaginy. Izmenena ikonka igry na alternativnuyu dlya vizualnogo otlichiya. Vozmozhna ustanovka v NAND. Vklyucheny obnovleniya Anniversary Edition kotorye udalos adaptirovat pod Switch.
Dannaya sborka sdelana otdelnoy razdachey, t.k. u neyo drugoy region, i sootvetstvenno Tittle ID. Sokhraneniya s predydushchikh sborok igra ne uvidit. Perenesti ikh mozhno, tem ne menee ne rekomenduetsya. Kazhdaya sborka sobiraetsya v individualnuyu strukturu esp i bsa, poetomu pri popytke igrat v versii raznykh sborok neizbezhno vozniknovenie nekotorykh bagov. Rekomenduetsya nachalo novoy igry.
Poskolku igra yaponskogo regiona, mozhno stavit parallelno drugoy versii sborok, ili prosto chistuyu igru bez modov.
Fenteziynaya saga The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim®, poluchivshaya bolee 200 nagrad «Igra goda», prikhodit na Nintendo Switch. Prozhivite druguyu zhizn v drugom mire… gde ugodno i kogda ugodno.
Srazhaytes s drevnimi drakonami, pokoryayte gornye piki, postroyte dom i zavedite semyu, ovladeyte professiey, magiey ili obuchites ratnomu delu. Mir igry budet dinamicheski podstraivatsya pod vas. Igrayte tak, kak vam khochetsya, i svoimi deystviyami opredelyayte obraz svoego personazha.
Ustanovka: Vsyo chto nuzhno, eto prosto ustanovit NSP fayl tak, kak vy privykli, naprimer cherez DBI. Takzhe obratite vnimanie, imeetsya fayl zaglushka PsD.nsp. On nuzhen dlya togo, chto by ne vyskakivalo soobshchenie o ne ustanovlennom pakete russkoy ozvuchki.

Sokoball Dreams is a stunningly immersiv:

With its simple yet elegant design and intuitive controls, this game is sure to delight players of all skill levels and provide hours of challenging and engaging gameplay.

The game's minimalist approach to design is truly impressive, with each level featuring only the essential elements needed to create an intriguing and challenging puzzle. Players must navigate a variety of obstacles and challenges, using their wit and problem-solving skills to move boxes to their designated locations with the least possible moves. As they progress through the game, the puzzles become increasingly complex, testing the limits of players' abilities and forcing them to think outside the box in order to succeed.

One of the most impressive aspects of Sokoball Dreams is its commitment to creating a truly immersive experience for players. From the serene and enchanting soundtrack to the stunning graphics and minimalist design, every element of the game is carefully crafted to draw players into the world of Sokoball Dreams and keep them fully engaged throughout each level. The game's intuitive controls also make it easy for players to jump right in and start playing, while the increasing challenge level ensures that they will stay engaged and interested in the game for hours on end.

Overall, Sokoball Dreams is a must-play for anyone who loves challenging puzzle games with immersive and engaging gameplay. With its elegant design, intuitive controls, and stunning visuals, this game is sure to become a favorite of puzzle enthusiasts everywhere. So why wait? Start playing Sokoball Dreams today and see just how far your problem-solving skills can take you!
We should talk is a short-form narrative:
We should talk is a short-form narrative game that will make you think carefully about the words you choose. Can your relationship survive the night?

Using a unique narrative choice mechanic, players craft sentences in response to the in-game characters in We should talk. Through this careful choice of words, players express themselves as they discuss ongoing problems about life and romance with their in-game partner over text messages, while also chatting with friends and strangers at their favorite local bar about what’s on their mind. The combination of words they choose impacts the conversations they have, how genuinely they can connect with their partner, and whether their relationship can survive the night.

No Longer Home is a game about letting g:
No Longer Home is a game about letting go of the life you've built due to circumstances beyond your control. Immerse yourself in the lives of Bo and Ao and learn about their dreams, frustrations and fears. Welcome the magic of the everyday and somewhat extraordinary.

Bo and Ao are graduating university and preparing to leave the flat they’ve lived in together for a year. Thanks to visa limitations, Ao is forced to return to Japan, leaving Bo in England. Disillusioned by post-educational life and shoved aside by a government who doesn’t want them there, both are trying to come to terms with their uncertain futures. And deep under their South London flat, something grows...

As they pack their belongings in the home they've shared, they'll unleash more than just memories

Wander through an intimate flat and examine the everyday belongings of Bo and Ao. Have BBQs, play video games, and stay up late just talking in bed. Follow the day to day activities and conversations of two queer, non-binary students and their friends. Get to know Lu, the multi-eyed, animal-like new flatmate.

A semi-autobiographical game
No Longer Home was born when the developers were similarly forced apart after university, and decided to stay in touch by working on a game together. Development duo Hana and Cel chose this project as a way to explore and express the emotions that came with saying goodbye.

seriala, poka vnezapno ne uznala o svoem uvolnenii ot nachalnika, kotoryy paru minut
spustya strannym obrazom okazyvaetsya pogibshim. Teper Onor — geroinya sobstvennoy istorii
o zagadochnom ubiystve. Reshiv vosstanovit svoe dobroe imya, ona obedinyaet usiliya vmeste s
razvedyvatelnym robotom SCOUT, kotorogo nakhodit srazu posle proisshestviya. I vot na stsenu

sozdannykh bespodobnym Khato Moa, avtorom vizualnoy novelly Hatoful Boyfriend.

The Magister – RPG о загадочном убийстве:
The Magister – RPG o zagadochnom ubiystve s kartochnymi bitvami.

Sobirayte i nastraivayte kolodu dlya bitv ili ispolzuyte «takticheskuyu diplomatiyu», chtoby reshat delo mirom.

Sobirayte uliki i ishchite motivy, chtoby raskryt taynu gibeli proshlogo magistra i nayti prestupnika.
Osobennosti igry
Zagadochnoe ubiystvo kazhdyy raz proiskhodit po novomu – prokhozhdenie ne pomozhet! Sobytiya, uliki, motivy i ubiytsa menyayutsya s kazhdym prokhozhdeniem. Tolko vy smozhete nayti prestupnika.

Takticheskie kartochnye boi: vashi boevye i razgovornye navyki zavisyat ot kart v kolode. Vybirayte iz takikh kart, kak «Serdtsestop», «Yadovityy udar», «Plokhaya shutka» i «Dolgiy razgovor» – i mnogikh drugikh.

Blagodarya bolee 600 realnykh bolezney, simptomam, diagnosticheskim analizam, lecheniyu i drugimi vidami zabolevaniy, Bio Inc.: Redemption pugayushche realistichen. On budet ocharovyvat vas v techenie neskolkikh chasov, okunaya vas v mikroskopicheskiy mir!
Bio Inc.: Redemption vklyuchaet v sebya dve novye kampanii! Vyberite Smert i issleduyte svoyu temnuyu storonu, bezzhalostno pytayte svoyu zhertvu, ispolzuya muchitelnuyu kombinatsiyu bolezney i zabolevaniy. Vyberite Zhizn — geroicheski igrayte v kachestve medika, vyyavlyayte i lechite bolezni, poka ne stanet slishkom pozdno dlya vashego patsienta. Kazhdaya kampaniya sostoit iz 9 sluchaev s chetyrmya razlichnymi slozhnostyami s novym II, kotoryy obespechit vam mnozhestvo chasov uvlekatelnoy igry.
История начинается на Земле, вы идёте на:
Istoriya nachinaetsya na Zemle, vy idyote na tseremoniyu nagrazhdeniya Protektorov — alyansa iz shesti ras, zashchishchayushchego Zemlyu i drugie planety ot piratov i vsevozmozhnykh ugroz. Vo vremya tseremonii proiskhodit katastrofa, ogromnye shchupaltsa razrushayut planetu, igrok zabiraet manipulyator materii i sbegaet na kosmicheskom korable. V kontse kontsov korabl priblizhaetsya k obitaemoy planete. I tak nachinayutsya priklyucheniya, kotorye uvlekut igroka v puteshestviya po Vselennoy. Starbound soderzhit i kvesty, i syuzhetnye linii, kotorye priobretayutsya na baze vyzhivshikh posle razrusheniya rodnoy planety.Kosmicheskiy korabl vystupaet v roli transporta dlya igroka dlya issledovaniya galaktiki. Teleport pozvolyaet igroku spuskatsya na planety, na orbite kotorykh stoit korabl, a takzhe k drugim teleportam..
Planety, kotorye issleduet igrok, protsedurno sgenerirovany. Kazhdaya planeta obladaet osobennostyami i razlichnymi temami. V kachestve zerna dlya generatsii planety ispolzuyutsya ikh koordinaty. Esli eti koordinaty soobshchit drugomu igroku, tot smozhet posetit planetu drugogo igroka. Kazhdaya planeta osobenna: pomimo raznogo tipa poverkhnosti takzhe prisutstvuyut sluchayno sgenerirovannye derevya, pogoda, tsikl den/noch, sila gravitatsii, vneshnost i sposobnosti vragov, materialy, tsveta materialov, derevev i zdaniy. Kak i vse prochee, oruzhie, kotoroe mozhet byt naydeno v razlichnykh konteynerakh — takzhe sgenerirovano sluchayno. Vsego v igre mozhet byt ≈ 1 000 000 otlichayushchikhsya mechey i ognestrelnogo oruzhiya.

Not every game can be rated solely by sc: Not every game can be rated solely by screenshots. It's like a human's essence that can’t be measured by a staged photo. And thus Glittering Sword is not that kind of game that some may think judging by screenshots or trailer. On the first glance it looks like typical action-adventure, like many other classic titles from the 90's. Glittering Sword is full with the spiritual references to these classical gaming brands, and it’s shiny and balanced graphical setting helps the player to dive into the memorable adventure. Best way to describe this game by phrase: «fantasy adventure set in a cozy world with Sokoban-style puzzles». Here, each screen is the individual location with traps, enemies, portals and switches, and the player needs to learn the exact order of completing things the right way. The more you play Glittering Sword, the harder it gets with traps being more and more deadly, and the enemies become tougher. We hope that players who are addicted to adventure games will fall in love with this small but very entertaining game.

Не просто ещё одна цифровая адаптация по: Ne prosto eshchyo odna tsifrovaya adaptatsiya populyarnoy nastolno-rolevoy igry. Eto poistine neobychnoe tvorenie, kotoroe cherpaet vdokhnovenie iz mnozhestva nastolnykh igr, sozdavaya pri etom sovershenno novyy mir i igrovuyu sistemu. Razrabotchiki Ludogram, sozdavshie etot proekt, s lyubovyu i vnimaniem k detalyam perenesli atmosferu klassicheskikh nastolnykh RPG v tsifrovoy format, sokhraniv vsyo eyo ocharovanie, s samogo nachala pogruzhaya igroka v mir, slovno sozdannyy dlya nastoyashchey nastolnoy igry. Personazhi, predstavlennye v vide miniatyur, razmeshchayutsya na igrovom pole, a protivniki poyavlyayutsya v vide kartonnykh vyrezok, kotorye ozhivayut, slovno v rukakh opytnogo mastera igry. Kazhdaya lokatsiya vyglyadit, budto eyo sozdal uvlechyonnyy poklonnik Dungeons & Dragons dlya posledney sessii svoey gruppy. Analogovaya estetika pronizyvaet vsyu igru, sozdavaya illyuziyu togo, chto vy mozhete protyanut ruku k ekranu i vzaimodeystvovat s igrovymi elementami. Sozdayotsya oshchushchenie, chto vy mozhete vzyat svoego personazha, peredvinut ego po stolu i povalit vragov, kak v nastoyashchey nastolnoy igre, masterski vossozdayot atmosferu nastolnoy RPG, pozvolyaya igrokam pogruzitsya v mir, kotoryy oni sozdayut vmeste.

Eta prekrasno narisovannaya i animirovannaya, polnostyu ozvuchennaya priklyuchencheskaya igra do kraev napolnena uzhasayushchimi voobrazhenie shutkami da pribautkami. 
Vdokhnovlennaya filmami studii «Khammer Films», viktorianskimi detektivami i komik-truppoy «Monti Payton», eto, pozhaluy, samaya britanskaya igra v istorii!
Восхитительно безумная игра о подземелья:

Chtoby nayti gnyozda nezhiti, nuzhno izuchat burlyashchie gorodskie sotsseti, a chtoby nayti slabye mesta demonov, nuzhno delat s nimi selfi. S pomoshchyu grimuarov i shkolnykh pripasov mozhno usovershenstvovat vernuyu khokkeynuyu klyushku dlya ubiystva nezhiti, a takzhe razvit spyashchie volshebnye navyki. Welcome to Mars, adventurer! You have be:
Welcome to Mars, adventurer! You have been selected to join the latest Mars colonization mission, establishing a permanent human presence on the enigmatic Red Planet. Your assignment is at Mars Base, located in the scenic Erebus Montes region on the Amazonis Planitia. Your job? Make sure that our nascent colony can sustain itself through agriculture. Achieve the impossible and convert the harsh Martian soil into arable land, to grow everything the colonists need to survive. If successful, you'll mark the beginning of Human-Martian  history.
However, never forget that you'll be working tens of millions of kilometers away from Earth. Resupply is not an option for the most dangerous gardening job ever.


The scenic Erebus Montes region is located in one of the most fascinating regions of Mars, with a rich geological history. Mars Base will be tasked with digging into this rich history and help humanity understand our next home a little better.

The base is a living organism, with dozens of facilities. You will have access to all the necessary essentials upon landing, including crafting facilities, research labs, solar power plants, and your trusty greenhouses.
Every colonist has something to share. Be sure to interact with your fellow expedition members to learn their stories and see if you can't help them with their tasks. Teamwork!
More colonists will join you at the base every two Earth years, bringing with them more job expertise and assisting in growing Mars Base. See it grow from an outpost to humanity's first extraterrestrial city!


As the expedition's main botanist, you'll be responsible for turning a dead planet into a living one, a planter at a time. The other colonists will certainly appreciate your tireless labor to keep them fed and alive.

Martian soil can be toxic and barren, so botanists have to get creative. Starting with raw resources supplied by fellow colonists on a daily basis, you'll be able to gradually turn this sterile land into something much more suited for life to thrive.
A colonist does not live on “poo-tatoes” alone. Expand agriculture endeavors to provide a variety of crops and provide them with all the necessary micronutrients. Scurvy is not fun - and positively lethal when in the red variety instead of yellow.
Utilize a broad range of tools to succeed, from modular planters that can be combined in an infinite variety of configurations to autonomous robots to automate much of the labor.

Mars is more than just humanity's first foothold in the stars. It is also endless wind-swept plains and cyclopean mountains above ground, gigantic pyroducts and vast caverns below, as well as the most hostile environment humanity has set foot upon. Grow your crops, pack them for the journey, and venture out beyond the safe perimeter of Mars Base to explore the Red Planet!

If you brave the dust storms on the surface and the undiscovered mysteries of the underground, you will gain access to valuable resources for crafting tools and supplies. You might even help further the mission's scientific research goals while you're at it.
Crafting is essential. Bring back those resources and see what can be made to help you survive the challenges of Mars - or grow your agricultural projects instead!
During down time, don your iconic chef hat and whip up Martian-cooked meals with freshly grown produce, race Mars rovers for research, or build rockets to explore other celestial bodies beyond the red horizon.
Settle into your assigned living space - a fully customizable home base - to catch up on sleep after a hard day’s work. We would like all colonists to remember that, on Mars, while sleep may be optional, work is not.

No eto mificheskoe mesto mozhno takzhe rassmatrivat kak metaforu chelovecheskoy zhizni. Ved tyazhkiy gruz proshlykh oshibok, izo dnya v den napolnyayushchiy serdtse chuvstvom viny i bezyskhodnosti, mozhet prevratit zhizn v nastoyashchee voploshchenie Kartagry.
Debyutnyy proekt dlya yaponskoy studii Innocent Grey, spetsializiruyushcheysya na sozdanii vizualnykh novell s elementami detektiva, dramy i psikhologicheskogo khorrora. Blagodarya produmannoy istorii, mrachnoy atmosfere, obiliyu zhutkikh stsen, a takzhe krasivomu artu i otlichnomu saundtreku, igra bystro zavoevala izvestnost na rodine. Istoriya razvorachivaetsya v poslevoennoy Yaponii serediny XX-go veka. Byvshiy politseyskiy Shugo Takashiro, posle poteri raboty vynuzhdennyy zarabatyvat na khleb chastnym syskom, poluchaet prosbu o rozyske ischeznuvshey pyat let nazad devushki po imeni Yura Kozuki. Kazalos by, vsyo prosto i logichno: nuzhno nayti «poteryashku» i privesti eyo domoy k roditelyam.
No vnezapno situatsiya perevorachivaetsya s nog na golovu. Otets propavshey devushki i po sovmestitelstvu zakazchik rassledovaniya vdrug priznayotsya, chto Yura davno mertva. A vsya zateya s poiskami yavlyaetsya lish farsom, prizvannym udovletvorit kapriz ego vtoroy docheri — Kazuny Kozuki. Delo v tom, chto Kazuna do sikh por ne smogla smiritsya so smertyu svoey sestry. Ona schitaet, chto Yura mozhet byt eshchyo zhiva — i otchayanno khochet popytatsya otyskat eyo.

OSOBENNOSTI

STAR DA UDAL

PEREChNITsY OBEDINYaYuTSYa!

Membrane is a creative-action puzzle gam:
Membrane is a creative-action puzzle game in which you build, bend and break the world around you while experimenting to create your own solutions. Bendy bridges, wobbly ladders and shaky structures are just the beginning of what you'll make to test the limits of this weird, day-glo world! 

Membrane was designed to allow creative space for the player to interact and build their own unique solutions. The puzzles are NOT designed to rely on deception or a single solution, lock & key approach to test players. Instead the game was built to reward creativity and experimentation from the player. Get your thinking cap on friends!

***A tale of naked bravery, complete at last! ***
Only the dark lord stands between one middle aged-man and his quest for true love!
Become Yamada-kun, a 36 year old programmer at a major games company who hates his job, as he transforms himself into the star of his own delusional dungeon-delving video game! 
And don’t forget your quest for the love of your charming neighbour, Maria! Will love conquer all?

Spring 2020 will see a gigantic update for Dandy Dungeon, originally released in June 2019!
The update will see ‘Dandy Dungeon II: The Phantom Bride’ added to the base game, completing our brave hero’s tale at last!
 
[What is Dandy Dungeon?]
*A rogue-like with simple mechanics and hard-core depth!
*Oodles of content: more than 90 dungeon types, over 560 weapons & armour and 260+ monsters
*Experience a unique harmony of chip-tunes and humming?! Over 130 tracks! 
*Heaven’s Door: a 99 floor, post-game challenge dungeon!
*Collaborations galore! Meet RPG composer Nobuo Uematsu and Touhou Project’s Zun too!
 
[GAME SYSTEM]
Truth be told, Dandy Dungeon’s simplistic exterior belies a game with many hidden depths. Winning or losing is all down to the player. You’ll need to know all about the magic-reflecting Magic Barrier, the inescapable wrath of Thunderall, the all-powerful draw of the Magnet, the penetrating attack of the spear, the all-powerful blow of the axe and the like in order to conquer the game’s dungeons.
Dungeon crawling is simply a matter of tracing a single path through each floor, but it’s not as simple as all that! We crammed every inch of the game’s 5x5 grid-based roguelike dungeons with variety!

[HUMMING MUSIC]
Middle-aged man music...? Middle-aged jingles?!
Yamada’s world is full of weird and wonderful sounds, from the start of a dungeon, the discovery of a danger zone, levelling up and Yamada’s mysterious shouts of ‘Arabesque!’.　
Wundabaraba baba scat tunes for the boss monsters, the Indian programming genius’ tune, and let’s not forget that song from the Mysterious Hard Labor Zone… Who on earth greenlit all these oddball tunes?
The comic-prince of chiptunes, Keichi Sugiyama joins forces with Enka BOSSA’s founder and singer, Caorinho Fujiwara to create an audio experience you won’t find elsewhere! And mystery singer Nagasa Bonus, whose smooth voice flows over the chiptunes of  the English version’s theme song:  ”Retrograde life”.

[STORY]
36 year old Yamada-kun is a programmer at a major games company who hates his job. Deep into every night, alone in his apartment, he works on his own game: a delusional dungeon delving RPG where he is the hero; Brave Yamada! 
Then,oOne day, he falls in love at first sight with his new neighbor Maria-chan and in an effort to nurture these feelings, adds Princess Maria into his delusional dungeon game! 
Will Yamada-kun and Maria-chan find love?
Is destiny pre-programmed, or randomly generated? Is love a bug or a feature?

Super Metroid — action-платформер, метро:
Super Metroid — action-platformer, metroidvaniya, deystvie kotorogo prokhodit na vymyshlennoy planete Zebes, yavlyayushcheysya bolshim otkrytym mirom s oblastyami, svyazannymi dveryami i liftami. Igrok upravlyaet Samus Aran, kotoraya ishchet lichinku metroida, ukradennuyu liderom Kosmicheskikh Piratov Ridli. Po puti igrok sobiraet uluchsheniya, kotorye uvelichivayut bronyu i vooruzhenie Samus, a takzhe predostavlyayut ey spetsialnye sposobnosti: k primeru, Kosmicheskiy Skachok, kotoryy pozvolyaet podskakivat neogranichennoe kolichestvo raz, chtoby preodolet bolshie distantsii. Eti sposobnosti pozvolyayut Samus poluchat dostup k oblastyam, kotorye byli ranee nedostupny.
Super Metroid (yap. スーパーメト イド Su:pa: Metoroydo) — priklyuchencheskaya videoigra, tretya igra v serii Metroid. Super Metroid byla razrabotana Nintendo Research & Development 1, programmirovalas Intelligent Systems, i opublikovana Nintendo dlya Super Nintendo Entertainment System. Igra byla vypushchena v Yaponii 19 marta 1994 goda, v Severnoy Amerike 18 aprelya 1994 goda.
Professionalnaya kritika vosprinyala Super Metroid obshchim odobreniem, i na sayte Game Rankings igra poluchila konsolidirovannuyu otsenku v 95,50%, stav na 7 mesto sredi igr s samymi vysokimi otsenkami.
Действие происходит в Гонконге в 2052 го:
Deystvie proiskhodit v Gonkonge v 2052 godu. Igra nachinaetsya s zastavki v kitayskom adu, na kotorom nekaya tolpa grobovshchikov nesyot grob i memorialnye pamyatki devushki po imeni Vi Ming. Tut zhe ryadom s nimi idyot sama Vi Ming, pri etom vedya svoy myslennyy monolog. Tut zhe devushka ostanavlivaetsya, a szadi neyo podkhodit tainstvennyy muzhskoy siluet s nozhom v rukakh. Tikho podkradyvayas, tainstvennaya lichnost khvataet moloduyu devushku i pererezaet ey nozhom gorlo, posle chego ta padaet.
Nachinaetsya fleshbek za 24 chasa do sobytiy prologa. Khana i Glas dobirayutsya do zdaniya Lama chtoby nayti ikh informatora Dzina, u kotorogo est informatsiya po povodu poslednego prebyvaniya docheri mistera Lama, Vi Ming, za kotoruyu geroi okhotyatsya, chtoby potrebovat u eyo ottsa vykup v razmere 90 millionov dollarov, chto pozvolit Khane osvoboditsya ot kontrakta s triadami i poluchit dolgozhdannuyu svobodu…
Pogruzites v etot zakhvatyvayushchiy triller s revolyutsionnoy tekhnologiey Motion FX, gde vy upravlyaete v dinamichnykh mirakh. Kto vyzhivet? A kto — net?..Vtoraya chast zdes. Versiyu s russkoy ozvuchkoy i tekstom sm. tut.
Маленькая история о том, какими испытани:
Malenkaya istoriya o tom, kakimi ispytaniyami mogut byt, kazalos by, povsednevnye melochi. Pomogite devushke kupit moloko, stav pervym, kto ne razocharuet eyo.
Igra predstavlyaet soboy nebolshuyu igru, osveshchayushchuyu ne to zabavnuyu abstraktsiyu i igru slov, ne to boleznennye psikhologicheskie epizody. Utverzhdenie o tom, chto istoriya osnovana na realnykh sobytiyakh, budet slishkom konkretnym, tak chto proshche sdelat vid, chto eto prosto nabor abstraktsiy i igry slov.
What Remains of Edith Finch — это сборни:
What Remains of Edith Finch — eto sbornik strannykh rasskazov ob odnoy seme iz shtata Vashington.

Edit Finch pytaetsya ponyat, pochemu ostalas edinstvennoy predstavitelnitsey svoego roda. Issleduya ogromnyy familnyy osobnyak, vy slovno poznakomites s kazhdym ee rodstvennikom i perezhivete tot den, kotoryy stal poslednim dlya ocherednogo chlena semeystva Finch, — ot dalekogo proshlogo do nashikh dney.

Geympley i atmosfera vsekh istoriy takie zhe raznye, kak kharaktery samikh Finchey. Neizmennym ostaetsya lish igra ot pervogo litsa i to, chto kazhdyy rasskaz zakanchivaetsya smertyu chlena semi.

V konechnom schete, eto igra o tom, naskolko mal i neznachitelen chelovek v sravnenii s okruzhayushchim ego beskraynim i nepostizhimym mirom.

Igra sozdana gruppoy Giant Sparrow — razrabotchikami priklyuchencheskoy igry-raskraski The Unfinished Swan («Lebedinyy eskiz»).

Imp of the Sun — нелинейный экшн-платфор:
Imp of the Sun — nelineynyy ekshn-platformer v 2D, sochetayushchiy v sebe dinamichnye boi i puteshestviya po zakhvatyvayushchemu miru, vdokhnovlennomu vershinami And, dzhunglyami Amazonki i peruanskoy kulturoy.

Vy igraete za Nina — besa, rozhdennogo iz posledney iskry Solntsa. On otpravlyaetsya v put, chtoby nayti i odolet chetyrekh Khraniteley, vernut Solntsu ego silu i polozhit konets Vechnomu zatmeniyu, prezhde chem tma okonchatelno poglotit mir.

Zhizn nevozmozhna bez sily Solntsa, kotoruyu Khraniteli ukrali mnogo vekov nazad i spryatali v raznykh ugolkakh Imperii. Iz svoey posledney iskry Solntse sozdal besa po imeni Nin i otpravil ego v put, chtoby vernut svet i vosstanovit balans v Imperii.

Vy porozhdenie Solntsa, napolnennoe siloy ognya. Sovershenstvuyte svoi navyki v uluchshennom igrovom protsesse s plavnymi dvizheniyami i boyami, zavyazannymi na kombo-udarakh. Puteshestvuyte po Imperii Solntsa, otkryvayte novye umeniya, stanovites silnee i unichtozhte chetyrekh Khraniteley.

Otkroyte dlya sebya chetyre oblasti Imperii: belosnezhnye piki And, zarosli v dzhunglyakh Amazonki, issokhshie bezzhalostnye pustyni i temnye nedra podzemnogo mira. Kazhdaya lokatsiya i kazhdoe sushchestvo produmany i narisovany vruchnuyu s uvazheniem k tsivilizatsiyam, kotorye nekogda naselyali territoriyu Peru.

Nashi predki veli khroniki s pomoshchyu artefaktov, nyne izvestnykh kak «kipu». Otyshchite vse kipu, chtoby uznat istoriyu Vechnogo zatmeniya, i soberite kollektsiyu unikalnykh taynykh predmetov, sozdannykh po obrazu nastoyashchikh relikviy andskikh kultur. Stranstvuyte po Imperii Solntsa i pobezhdayte besposhchadnykh bossov s unikalnoy predystoriey i kompleksnymi boevymi mekhanikami; vybor sleduyushchego bossa vsegda za vami.

Osobennosti
- Uluchshennyy igrovoy protsess s plavnymi dvizheniyami i boyami, zavyazannymi na kombo-udarakh.
- Unikalnyy stil i saundtreki, vdokhnovlennye Peru i nastoyashchimi artefaktami andskikh kultur.
- Srazites s pyatyu besposhchadnymi bossami s unikalnoy predystoriey i kompleksnymi boevymi mekhanikami; vybor sleduyushchego bossa vsegda za vami.
- Sovershenstvuyte svoi navyki boya i peredvizheniya, chtoby poluchit polnyy kontrol nad besom i ego silami.

SuperTux — игра с открытым исходным кодо:
SuperTux — igra s otkrytym iskhodnym kodom, vo mnogom vdokhnovlyonnaya klassicheskim platformerom Super Mario, rasprostranyayushchayasya pod litsenziey GNU GPL. Iznachalno, avtory igry — Bill Kendrik i Ingo Runke; periodicheski vykhodyat novye versii SuperTux blagodarya aktivnoy komande odnoimyonnykh razrabotchikov.
Vam dlya spaseniya svoey vozlyublennoy, Penni, neobkhodimo proyti mnozhestvo urovney, preodolevaya prepyatstviya i uvorachivayas ot vragov. Personazhem vystupaet talisman OS Linux pingvin Taks, nakhodyashchiysya v odnom iz tryokh sostoyaniy s sootvetstvuyushchimi stepenyami zhivuchesti, ot kotorykh zavisit kolichestvo soprikosnoveniy s vragami ili opasnymi prepyatstviyami do proigrysha urovnya: malenkiy Taks — 1 soprikosnovenie, bolshoy — 2, bolshoy v golovnom ubore (strelyayushchiy ili obladayushchiy drugim svoystvom) — 3. Nekotorye vragi likvidiruyutsya naprygivaniem na nikh sverkhu ili udarom snizu cherez oporu, po kotoroy oni peredvigayutsya. Sobrannye monetki pozvolyayut Taksu, v sluchae proigrysha urovnya, nachat ego ne s nachala, a s bolee dalnego proydennogo mesta, otmechennogo kolokolchikom (kontrolnaya tochka). Pri nedostatke monet na schyote ves uroven pridyotsya prokhodit zanovo.
Italyanskaya gazeta Punto Informatico v iyule 2007 goda nazvala SuperTux kachestvenno sdelannym produktom s priyatnoy atmosferoy i fonovoy muzykoy. Portal Softonic otmetil prostotu igrovogo protsessa SuperTux, svoystvennuyu otlichnym klassicheskim igram. Marius Nestor, avtor obzorov sayta Softpedia, otsenil SuperTux kak zabavnuyu i uvlekatelnuyu igru s krasivoy grafikoy dlya igrokov lyubogo vozrasta.Super Tux Kart (port STK) sm. zdes.
Donut County – сюжетная головоломка с ре:
Donut County – syuzhetnaya golovolomka s realnoy fizikoy, gde igrok upravlyaet postepenno razrastayushcheysya dyroy v zemle. Obshchaytes s simpatichnymi personazhami, kradite u nikh vsyakiy khlam – i sbrasyvayte v glubokuyu dyru.

Chto odnomu khlam, drugomu – klad
Enoty zakhvatili Donut County s pomoshchyu distantsionno upravlyaemykh dyr dlya krazhi musora. Vy igraete za enota BK, dyrovoda, kotoryy radi duratskikh prizov zatyagivaet v dyru svoikh druzey i ikh doma.

Provalivshis v odnu iz sobstvennykh dyr,  BK vstrechaet tam svoyu luchshuyu podrugu Miru i drugikh zhiteley  Donut County. Vse oni zastryali na glubine 999 futov pod zemley… i trebuyut otvetov!

Dyry vsyo bolshe
- IZUChAYTE unikalnye doma personazhey i ikh okrestnosti.
- PEREDVIGAYTE dyru, kotoraya stanovitsya bolshe s kazhdym pogloshchennym predmetom.
- SOVMEShchAYTE predmety i dobivaytes samykh neozhidannykh effektov: varite sup, razvodite krolikov, zapuskayte feyerverki i tak dalee.
- KATAPULTIRUYTE predmety nazad iz dyry. Tak mozhno reshat golovolomki… ili okonchatelno dolamyvat veshchi.
- POGLOShchAYTE vsyo! Dyra ne ostanovitsya, poka v ney ne ischeznet ves okrug.

Igru Donut County sozdal Ben Esposito, proektirovshchik igr What Remains of Edith Finch i The Unfinished Swan. Eto rezultat shesti let samostoyatelnoy razrabotki, mnogikh desyatkov pogloshchennykh ponchikov (chisto v issledovatelskikh tselyakh) i odnoy sudbonosnoy vstrechi s enotom.
Как гласит шотландская легенда, те, чьи:
Kak glasit shotlandskaya legenda, te, chi sokrovennye zhelaniya ne mogut byt udovletvoreny zemnymi sredstvami, dolzhny otyskat Devu Plodorodiya. V obmen na ikh trud ona udovletvorit ikh zhelaniya. Sleduya godami za slukhami i lozhnymi podskazkami vy otyskali vkhod v ruiny, i pered vami predstala Deva. Nakonets-to, zhelanie budet ispolneno...
Ispolzuyte kolodu kart, predstavlyayushchikh komnaty i koridory, chtoby rasshiryat labirint ruin. Probivayte put s pomoshchyu avtoboya, sobiraya kak mozhno bolshe Glimura s proklyatykh obitateley, poka tma ne poglotit svet vashego fakela.
Zasluzhite milost Devy Plodorodiya, otyshchite relikvii dlya torgovli s Kvochkoy, Vulverom i drugimi personazhami shotlandskikh predaniy, chtoby popolnit i uluchshit svoyu kolodu, i nadeytes, chto vy budete dostatochno silny, chtoby protivostoyat Smotritelyu, kogda nakonets doberetes do nego.
Яркая пойнт-клик адвенчура о восьмилетне:
Yarkaya poynt-klik advenchura o vosmiletnem malchike, kotoryy zhivyot so svoey ekstsentrichnoy semey, sozdannaya po brazilskomu multserialu «Brat Dzhorela».
Dzhorel - rebyonok s shelkovistymi volosami, chto delaet ego samym populyarnym parnem v gorode. Odnako shou vrashchaetsya ne vokrug nego, a ego mladshego brata, zastenchivogo i bezymyannogo malchika, kotorogo prosto zvali «brat Dzhorela». Syuzhet vrashchaetsya vokrug besporyadkov, proiskhodyashchikh v obychnoy brazilskoy atmosfere kontsa 80-kh, sredi syurrealisticheskikh i bessmyslennykh priklyucheniy.
Clustertruck — платформер, в котором вы:
Clustertruck — platformer, v kotorom vy mchites vdol shosse na neveroyatnoy skorosti!  
Vam predstoit s pomoshchyu lovkosti i akrobaticheskikh tryukov prokhodit bezumnye urovni v igre, gde «nelzya kasatsya pola», — verkhom na nepredskazuemykh gruzovikakh, nesushchikhsya s ogromnoy skorostyu!
Chem dalshe, tem trudnee stanovitsya igrat: poyavlyayutsya kachayushchiesya moloty, lazery i ognemyoty!   

Vam budut otkryvatsya takie umeniya, kak kryuk-«koshka», strelyayushchaya gruzovikami pushka i upravlenie vremenem!
Трогательное приключение, полное волнующ:
Trogatelnoe priklyuchenie, polnoe volnuyushchikh otkrytiy: ptenets-sirota po imeni Ptychk pytaetsya razgadat taynu sobstvennogo proiskhozhdeniya. Otpravlyaytes v volshebnoe puteshestvie vmeste s veselym ptentsom, obozhayushchim pet: vas zhdet potryasayushchaya pikselnaya grafika i krasivye animatsii v mire, s kotorym vy vzaimodeystvuete s pomoshchyu muzyki! Chirikayte, chtoby upravlyat platformami, i poyte dlya zhiteley lesa — izuchayte novye noty, kotorye pomogut vam pobezhdat v zakhvatyvayushchikh muzykalnykh srazheniyakh protiv obitateley obshirnogo nezabyvaemogo mira.

Volshebnaya skazka

Pytayas luchshe uznat samogo sebya, Ptychk povstrechaet na svoem puti desyatki veselykh lesnykh sozdaniy, obshchatsya s kotorymi — odno udovolstvie! Vas zhdut zakhvatyvayushchie lesnye dostoprimechatelnosti, oformlennye v pikselnom stile: kazhdyy ugolok lesa rasskazhet vam svoyu istoriyu.

Platformer s muzykalnym upravleniem

Lesnye obitateli nuzhdayutsya v vashey pomoshchi: razyshchite spryatannye po vsemu lesu muzykalnye noty. Dobrye postupki otkroyut dostup k novym muzykalnym nomeram, kotorye garmonichno vpletutsya v igrovoy saundtrek, ozhivlyaya atmosferu skazochnogo mira.

Napryazhennye muzykalnye bitvy

Razuchivayte novye noty i ispolnyayte zazhigatelnye muzykalnye partii, brosayushchie vyzov vashemu chuvstvu ritma. Poyte vmeste s khorom: nazhimayte knopki-noty sinkhronno s muzykoy, chtoby pet v unison!

Obshirnyy igrovoy mir s kuchey sekretov

Stante provodnikom Ptychka po svyazannym mezhdu soboy urovnyam zhivogo mira, napolnennogo sekretnymi lokatsiyami. Sobirayte perya, razbrosannye po vsemu lesu, i razyskivayte ikh vladeltsev, chtoby uznat eshche bolshe tayn o proshlom etogo volshebnogo mira.

The Mortuary Assistant — strashnaya simulyator-advenchura pro prostogo rabotnika morga. V morg postupayut novye tela, za kotorymi predstoit nablyudat protagonistu, razbirayas v proyavleniyakh demonicheskikh sil.

Zabiraya na issledovanie umershikh, geymery budut vnimatelno nablyudat za reaktsiyami na eksperimenty, kotorye reshaetsya osushchestvit vash personazh. V oskvernennykh organizmakh nakhodyatsya potustoronnie sushchnosti, zhelayushchie vyrvatsya na svobodu i podchinit sebe fiziologicheskikh nositeley.Eto originalnaya versiya igry, repak s mashinnym perevodom sm. tam.

This is The Zodiac Speaking - eto osnovannyy na faktakh psikhologicheskiy triller dlya odnogo igroka, sozdannyy na osnovanii istorii Zodiaka, odnogo iz samykh izvestnykh, nikogda ne poymannykh seriynykh ubiyts. SYGRAYTE V THIS IS THE ZODIAC SPEAKING I:

    • Ispytayte istoriyu s tochki zreniya vyzhivshego v napadenii seriynogo ubiytsy, spravtes s travmoy i provedite rassledovanie, kotoroe privedet vas k istine Zodiaka
    • Otkroyte dlya sebya detali, svyazannye s ubiystvami, posetite mesta, vdokhnovlennye originalnymi stsenami prestupleniya, ispytayte nastoyashchie seansy terapii, kotorye pomogut vam spravitsya s travmoy
    • Otkroyte dlya sebya tri raznykh zaversheniya, kazhdoe iz kotorykh prodiktovano vashimi resheniyami pri rassledovanii.

Поздравляем, уважаемый будущий сотрудник:
Pozdravlyaem, uvazhaemyy budushchiy sotrudnik s resheniem proyti sobesedovanie na dolzhnost [UDALENO] v Kvark! My khvalim vas za vashi bezuprechnye navyki prinyatiya resheniy, kotorye polozhitelno otrazyatsya na vashey obshchey otsenke. Poka vy zhdyote svoy besplatnyy obed iz baziliko-slivochnogo sousa, pelmeney i 110 grammov togo, chto, nesomnenno, yavlyaetsya steykom iz govyazhey vyrezki, my podgotovili dlya vas korotkuyu prezentatsiyu o tom, chego vy mozhete ozhidat ot raboty na nashem predpriyatii pomimo chuvstva gordosti za to, chto vy pomogaete zashchishchat svoyu stranu i razvivat vsyo chelovechestvo.
Zdes, v Kvark my ochen serezno otnosimsya k bezopasnosti. Nashi gornodobyvayushchie, proizvodstvennye i issledovatelskie obekty kruglosutochno okhranyayutsya vysokokvalifitsirovannymi sotrudnikami SB, imeyushchimi dostup k shirokomu spektru oruzheynykh sredstv, kotorye pomogayut im spravlyatsya s lyubymi nepredvidennymi situatsiyami, nachinaya ot besporyadkov, sprovotsirovannykh gryaznymi imperialisticheskimi lazutchikami, do [UDALENO]. Budte uvereny, chto my prinimaem vse vozmozhnye mery predostorozhnosti, chtoby eti opasnye vzryvoopasnye instrumenty ne popali v vashi ruki.
Bezopasnost na rabochem meste — nash glavnyy prioritet, i my s gordostyu soobshchaem vam, chto proshlo [UDALENO] minut s momenta poslednego intsidenta s travmoy na rabochem meste na nashikh obektakh. My sdelaem vsyo vozmozhnoe, chtoby sderzhat opasnye elementy, kotorye my ispolzuem v nashikh issledovaniyakh, vklyuchaya radioaktivnye izotopy. Vnesite i svoy vklad, pomogaya nam podderzhivat bezopasnost vashego rabochego mesta, soobshchayte o lyubykh podozritelnykh obektakh, kotorye vy smozhete obnaruzhit svoemu rukovoditelyu. Ne pytaytes obrashchatsya k nim samostoyatelno, tak kak kontakt s takimi veshchestvami mozhet imet krayne nepredvidennye posledstviya.
My zabotimsya o blagopoluchii nashikh sotrudnikov! Interery nashikh obektov byli sproektirovany tak, chtoby obespechit neobkhodimye sensornye stimuly, i kazhdaya rabochaya zona byla oborudovana mashinami, gde vy mozhete kupit prokhladitelnye napitki. Sotrudnikam vydelyaetsya [UDALENO] sekund pereryva v den, kotorye oni mogut provesti polnostyu po svoemu usmotreniyu. Pomnite, chto perekury budut vychitatsya iz vashego obedennogo pereryva.
Boites radiatsii? Ne nuzhno boyatsya! Nash podzemnyy obekt byl postroen s bolshoy ostorozhnostyu, chtoby obespechit maksimalno vozmozhnuyu zashchitu s ekranirovaniem, a takzhe svesti k minimumu riski zatrat, svyazannykh s utechkami radiatsii i narusheniyami usloviy soderzhaniya radioaktivnykh elementov. Vam budet priyatno uslyshat, chto veroyatnost takogo narusheniya sostavlyaet menee [UDALENO] protsentov!.. Kvark — za bezopasnost natsii i vashe svetloe budushchee!

Problema v tom, chto on... ne odin. Ego po pyatam presleduet svikhnuvshiysya ubiytsa, i nashemu geroyu nuzhno nabratsya khrabrosti, chtoby vyyasnit, pochemu on zdes i kak otsyuda sbezhat.
Новая жизнь ждёт вас в Ханивуде! Построй:

Vas pribilo k beregam ostrova, i pod vashim nachalom okazyvaetsya skromnyy uchastok zemli. Vremya zakatat rukava, zapastis instrumentom i prinyatsya za stroitelstvo fermy, zhit na kotoroy predstoit ne lyudyam, no tselym pokoleniyam. Echoes of Plum Grove — simpatichnyy simulyator fermy, v kotorom vashi resheniya imeyut posledstviya.. Chto posadit, chem zapastis na zimu, s kem podruzhitsya – vse eto budet vliyat ne tolko na sam gorodok Khanivud, no i na sudbu tselogo ostrova. S prikhodom zimy igrokov zhdut novye opasnye ispytaniya. Na konu vyzhivanie, poetomu vam predstoit vozdelyvat zemlyu, rybachit, gotovit edu, masterit predmety, sobirat resursy i delat mnogoe drugoe, chtoby perezhit morozy i stuzhu. Esli ne podgotovitsya dolzhnym obrazom, vasha dinastiya mozhet prervatsya eshche do togo, kak vy nachnete raskryvat tayny ostrova. Pust vasha osnovnaya zadacha – vyzhivanie, v Khanivude umeyut veselitsya na slavu. Vas zhdut nezabyvaemye prazdniki i torzhestva.

Mario Kart 64 (яп. マリオカート64 Марио Ка:то:
Mario Kart 64 (yap. マリオカート64 Mario Ka:to Rokudzyu:yon) — gonochnaya videoigra, razrabotannaya podrazdeleniem Nintendo Entertainment Analysis and Development i vypushchennaya Nintendo eksklyuzivno dlya konsoli Nintendo 64 v 1996-om godu. Igra vklyuchaet v sebya 4 kubka, po chetyre trassy v kazhdom. Proydya sorevnovanie na maksimalnoy slozhnosti, igrok otkryvaet dlya sebya novyy ekstra-uroven, v kotorom mozhno bylo proyti te zhe samye trassy, no v zerkalnom otobrazhenii.
Krome standartnogo sostyazaniya, prisutstvuyut rezhimy odinochnoy gonki i bitvy. Dlya bitvy otvoditsya 4 spetsialnykh areny. Tselyu etogo rezhima yavlyaetsya unichtozhenie tryokh vozdushnykh sharikov u kazhdogo protivnika. Lishivshiysya vsekh sharikov igrok prevrashchaetsya v bob-omb, kotoraya takzhe mozhet peredvigatsya po arene, i podryvat ostavshikhsya na ney igrokov.
Mozhno igrat odnim iz vosmi lyubimykh personazhey, na vash vybor:
Shapeshifting Detective — это игра-голов:
Shapeshifting Detective — eto igra-golovolomka v zhanre nuar s polnomasshtabnym video, sverkhestestvennymi elementami i taynoy ubiystva. Vy yavlyaetes detektivom i mozhete rassledovat ubiystvo, prevrashchayas v lyubogo personazha. Dazhe v sleduyushchuyu zhertvu.  

Dorota Shou mertva. I glavnye podozrevaemye — eto tri gadalki na kartakh taro s neveroyatnoy sposobnostyu predskazat ubiystvo — ili sovershit ego. Vasha zadacha zaklyuchaetsya v tom, chtoby uznat, chto eshche im izvestno, no oni ne budut raskryvat svoi temnye sekrety komu popalo... K schastyu, vy mozhete byt tem, kem khotite.

V igre imeetsya bolee 1600 videorolikov vysokogo razresheniya, prostoy interfeys dlya doprosa s unikalnoy mekhanikoy dlya udaleniya i vozmozhnost sluchaynogo vybora ubiytsy v nachale igry. Razrabotano sozdatelyami i mirovymi rekordsmenami igry «Infektsionnoe bezumie doktora Dekkera».

● Prevrashchenie: v vashem rasporyazhenii devyat drugikh personazhey, chtoby rassledovat prestuplenie, manipulirovat otnosheniyami so raznykh storon i uznat vtoruyu polovinu istorii.
● Napryazhenie: rassleduyte ili predotvratite ubiystvo, no ne popadites. Lyuboy iz trekh sluchaynykh ubiyts pomogaet svesti k minimumu spoylery.
● Vopros vybora: poymat ubiytsu, spasti zhertv, naladit i razorvat otnosheniya — ili net. 
● Reshenie problem: vozmozhno li poluchit etot zhiznenno vazhnyy klyuch k razgadke samostoyatelno? Poprobuyte prevratitsya v nachalnika politsii. Ne kazhetsya li vam, chto varianty dialoga — lovushka? Udalite ikh. 
● 100% polnomasshtabnoe video: kompleksnaya igra s bespereboynymi polnomasshtabnymi videorolikami i otvetami ot pervogo litsa.
● Sobytiya-katalizatory: ne vo vsekh perekhodakh imeyutsya lish dva varianta. Zagonite kogo-libo v ugol, i u nego mozhet poyavitsya neskolko sposobov deystviy.

Beach Buggy Racing 2: Island Adventure — dinamichnaya i khaotichnaya gonka s razdelyonnym ekranom i polzovatelskimi pravilami. Lyubuyu chast igry mozhno proyti v odinochku ili s druzyami: i syuzhetnoe priklyuchenie, i chempionaty, i adrenalinovye gonki, i masterskie «Zanosnye ataki».

Rather than make a direct sequel to thei:

The game systems have been completely revamped and powered up with lots of new additions, including a deep character customization system that lets you mold and shape your character into the ultimate hero that works best for you! 

But that's not all! The new Burst Combo system rewards you for finishing off enemies and bosses up close and personal, and the Dowsing ability triggers the HD rumble when you get close to one of the many hidden items/areas in the game.

The classic pixel style graphics have also been completely redone to blur the line between 8-bit and 16-bit and take you back to the golden age of 2D action games!

THE STORY SO FAR\n\nBilly Blaze, eight y:
THE STORY SO FAR

Billy Blaze, eight year-old genius, working diligently in his backyard clubhouse has created an interstellar starship from old soup cans, rubber cement, and plastic tubing.  While his folks are out on the town and the babysitter has fallen asleep, Billy travels into his backyard workshop, dons his brother's football helmet, and transforms into...

COMMANDER KEEN --- defender of Earth!

In his ship, the Bean-with-Bacon Megarocket, Keen dispenses galactic justice with an iron hand!


THIS EPISODE: "Keen Dreams"

We find young Billy discussing matters of paramount importance with his mother.

"I just saved the Earth, Mom," said Billy. "I don't have to eat vegetables."

"Sure, dear," said Billy's mom. "I bet Neil Armstrong never complained about HIS mashed potatoes."

"I bet Neil Armstrong never travelled to Vorticon VI and defeated the Grand Intellect, either," Billy mumbled at his plate.  He sat there, legs dangling, staring at his offensive, starch-laden foe.

After a pointed remark about the quality of the mashed potatoes, Billy was sent to his room.

"Stupid vegetables," he grumbled, his eyelids growing heavy.

Soon Billy was fast asleep.


Suddenly he woke up, and his bed was atop a hill. On either side of his bed were giant potatoes wearing metal helmets and carrying bayonets.

"Come with us now, Captain Keen," said the first.

"You've been brought here by the Dream Machine," said the second.

"Boobus Tuber, our king and boss--"

"--is now your master, come with us!"

Billy frowned, grabbed his football helmet off his bedpost, and started to put it on.

"First of all, spuds," Billy said, pushing down on the helmet.  "That's COMMANDER Keen. Second of all, who do you think you are?"

"We're Tater Troopers, it's plain to see," said the first.

"So, get--"

Keen reached under his pillow and retrieved his Vorticon Hyperpistol.  He moved it from "Stun," past "Disrupt," all the way up to "Fry to Delicate Brown."

"How about a walk on the fried side boys?" Keen said.


Two BZZAPs later, Keen pouted.

"Aw, nuts. My Hyperpistol's empty," he said.


Just then, a child in chains ran up to him.

"Keen, oh, Keen, oh, Captain Keen!  Save us from the Dream Machine!" he said.

"That's COMMANDER Keen!" the young genius corrected.

"Whatever.  Save us!" said the child.

So Billy hopped out of bed and started on his quest to defeat King Boobus Tuber and destroy the Dream Machine!

A life turned upside down after an encou:

<STORY>
A young man is dazing off while working the night shift at a convenience store, when a girl stops in to ask for a meat bun.
The one next to her appears to be her boyfriend, and after doing their shopping, the two of them link arms affectionately and take off.
Just when the young man is thinking how nice it would be to have a girlfriend, a pair of girls in ninja cosplay show up.

The girls just stare at the shop goods without buying anything in particular.
Even worse, they're even chatting about ninja techniques or something along those lines.
When he calls out to them to prevent theft, it becomes apparent that they have no money.

Despite suspecting that they might try to steal something, he gives in and buys a bento for the two desperately pleading girls.

The life of that young man is turned upside down from the moment of his encounter with the two young women.

ShockWave Flash, впоследствии Small Web:
ShockWave Flash, vposledstvii Small Web Format — format faylov dlya flesh-igr, animatsii, vektornoy grafiki, video i audio v internete. Kartinka, sokhranyonnaya v etom formate, masshtabiruetsya bez vidimykh iskazheniy, videorolik imeet nebolshoy razmer, proiskhodit bolee bystraya zagruzka video fayla i ego vosproizvedenie. Pervonachalno format byl razrabotan v 1995 godu amerikanskoy kompaniey FutureWave Software. V dekabre 1996 goda kompaniyu FutureWave Software priobrela kompaniya Macromedia, a programmu FutureSplash Animator pereimenovali v Macromedia Flash. Kompaniya Macromedia uzhe imela sobstvennyy produkt Macromedia Shockwave. Macromedia stala ispolzovat plagin Shockwave i dlya podklyucheniya drugikh produktov, vklyuchaya Flash. Poetomu tip MIME dlya Flash nazvali application/x-shockwave-flash, a faylovoe rasshirenie SPL zamenili na SWF (sokrashchenie ot «Shockwave Flash»). V dekabre 2005 goda kompaniyu Macromedia poglotila Adobe.
«Masyánya» — komediyno-satiricheskaya seriya flesh-multfilmov, sozdannaya peterburzhskim khudozhnikom Olegom Kuvaevym o zabavnykh personazhakh iznachalno studencheskogo vozrasta, bolee izvestnykh pod svoimi prozvishchami — Masyanya, Khryúndel i Lokhmátyy. Pozzhe personazhi povzrosleli. Vsekh osnovnykh personazhey ozvuchil Oleg Kuvaev. «Magazinchik BO!» — avtorskiy proekt Olega Kuvaeva i Ekateriny Gorelovoy, flesh-serial rossiyskoy studii «Mult.ru». Serial vypuskalsya s 2003 goda. «Ézhi i Petrúchcho» — art-proekt Andreya Andrianova (s 1997), pozdnee — seriya odnoimyonnykh multfilmov (2005, animator Masha Yakushina), razmeshchyonnykh na sayte Olega Kuvaeva.

Labyrinth of Zangetsu — это 3D-RPG с под:
Labyrinth of Zangetsu — eto 3D-RPG s podzemelyami ot Acquire. Glavnye geroi — komanda opytnykh voinov so vsego mira, zadacha kotorykh — pobedit razrastayushchuyusya armiyu chernilnykh chudishch.

Mir, zapyatnannyy Chernilami razrusheniya
Deystvie istorii razvorachivaetsya v Ido — gorode utrenney luny, zhiteli kotorogo stolknulis s bedstviem pod nazvaniem «Chernila razrusheniya». Estetika goroda napominaet o srednevekovoy Yaponii. Po suti gorod — eto krepost, zashchishchennaya moshchnym magicheskim barerom. Etot barer napryamuyu svyazan s lunoy. Blagodarya emu zhiteli zashchishcheny ot porchi.

Vragi, kotorykh nuzhno odolet
Chernilnye chudishcha poyavilis iz-za porchi, kotoruyu nesut s soboy Chernila razrusheniya. Natknuvshis na Chernila, zhivoe sushchestvo vpadaet v bezumie, prevrashchaetsya v demona ili umiraet. Esli zhe Chernila kosnutsya mertvogo, to on vosstanet i prisoedinitsya k armii chernilnykh chudishch, chya edinstvennaya tsel — unichtozhat vsyo zhivoe i okutyvat mir tmoy. Vasha tsel — odolet tmu i osvobodit zemli ot koshmarnykh monstrov. Chernilnye chudishcha budut predstavat pered vami vo mnogikh formakh: vy stolknetes s demonami i yaponskimi yokayami, a takzhe s vosstavshimi mertvetsami, kotorye prisoedinilis k armii tmy, poetomu krepites: vrag budet strashen!

Klyuchevye osobennosti
- Unikalnaya grafika: risunki ot ruki, chernye chernila i mazki kistyu, po estetike napominayushchie traditsionnuyu yaponskuyu kalligrafiyu.
- 6 gotovykh geroev, kotorymi mozhno upravlyat, a takzhe vozmozhnost sozdat sobstvennykh personazhey s unikalnymi kharakteristikami i sposobnostyami.
- Strashnye vragi, napominayushchie geroev yaponskogo folklora — yokaev (prizrakov, chudovishch i demonov).
- Poshagovye srazheniya s razlichnymi chernilnymi chudishchami v samykh opasnykh oblastyakh. 3 geroya «pervoy linii», kotorye vstupayut v srazhenie i atakuyut, a takzhe 3 geroya «vtoroy linii», kotorye zashchishchayut, podderzhivayut i pariruyut udary.
- Uvlekatelnyy syuzhet i obshchaya istoriya, kotoraya otrazit uspekhi vashey igry i pozvolit porazmyslit nad oshibkami.
- Atmosfernyy saundtrek, zvuchanie kotorogo navevaet mysli o traditsionnoy yaponskoy muzyke i pomogaet eshche bolshe pogruzitsya v syuzhet.
Lugaru («лугарý», фонетическое произноше: Lugaru («lugarý», foneticheskoe proiznoshenie frantsuzskogo slovosochetaniya «loup-garou», «vervolf») The Rabbit’s Foot — tyomno-fenteziynyy zhestokiy i mrachnyy boevoy 3D-ekshn s elementami stelsa: igrok upravlyaet Tyornerom, antropomorfnym krolikom, iskusno vladeyushchim boevymi navykami. Ispolzuya shirokiy spektr spetstekhnik, Tyorner srazhaetsya s volkami i vrazhdebnymi krolikami na stepnykh, zasnezhennykh i pustynnykh territoriyakh.

Игра на стыке жанров roguelite, стрелялк:
Igra na styke zhanrov roguelite, strelyalki i pokhoda po podzemelyam zastavit vas srazhatsya s udivitelnymi vragami. V Straimium Immortaly vam predstoit pobedit groznuyu imperatritsu. K vashim uslugam raketnyy ranets i ogromnyy arsenal oruzhiya i usileniy. Podvizhnost, tochnoe upravlenie, massa nagrad — vse eto pomozhet vam vyzhit v Kubikuse.

Osobennosti
Etot mir unikalen: udivitelnoe napolnennoe chudovishchami okruzhenie Kubikusa sozdaetsya kazhdyy raz zanovo.
Potustoronniy mir v pikselyakh: staraya tekhnika beret na vooruzhenie novye kraski!
Letite bystro i khvatayte pushku pobolshe — ot ionnogo lazera do metatelya molniy, bolshe 25 vidov uluchshaemogo oruzhiya i bolshe 50 predmetov.
Dazhe nindzya pozaviduet: vy smozhete ispolzovat raznoobraznye sposobnosti shinobi.
Nokautiruyte gigantskikh negodyaev: spasite galaktiku ot zakhvatchikov, pobezhdaya ogromnykh chudovishch!
Srazhaytes, kak vam nravitsya, pri pomoshchi otkryvaemykh klassov, mutatorov, chitov i shapok. Chtoby privnesti pobolshe raznoobraziya, mozhno nastroit protsess generatsii urovney i ikh razmer. Est rezhimy boya s bossami, nashestviya i drugie.
Mnozhestvo pokazateley: sledite za svoim rostom v tablitsakh liderov, za dostizheniyami, chitayte entsiklopediyu vragov, bossov, oruzhiya, predmetov i mnogogo drugogo.
Барселона, 1977. Прикованный к инвалидно:
Barselona, 1977. Prikovannyy k invalidnoy kolyaske byvshiy politseyskiy stanovitsya svidetelem ubiystva i obedinyaetsya s molodoy ambitsioznoy zhurnalistkoy, chtoby dokopatsya do istiny. Vooruzhivshis fotokameroy, binoklem i ratsiey, uznayte tayny goroda pryamo so svoego balkona v etom neodnoznachnom detektive.

Poka odnazhdy v dozhdlivuyu noch ne stanovites svidetelem ubiystva. V stremlenii raskryt pravdu vy neozhidanno dlya sebya obedinyaetes s molodoy ambitsioznoy zhurnalistkoy Melindoy i vmeste nachinaete rassledovanie. 

Sovmestnymi usiliyami vam udastsya raskryt taynu i i uznat sekrety mestnykh zhiteley.

Sozdateli igry, vdokhnovlennye klassicheskimi nuarnymi detektivami i igrami, vrode Firewatch ot Capo Santo, vlozhili v nee mnogo lyubvi.

* Raskroyte ubiystvo s neobychnym syuzhetom
* Poznakomtes s tseloy gruppoy yarkikh antropomorfnykh personazhey v krasivom atmosfernom mire
* Rassleduyte delo s pomoshchyu binoklya, fotokamery i ratsii i uznayte tayny mestnykh zhiteley pryamo so svoego balkona
* Vossozdayte khronologiyu sobytiy, chtoby uznat, kto ubiytsa
* Rassprosite vsekh, kogo vstretite, bud to svyashchennik, artistka ili vorchlivaya starukha
* Pogruzites v unikalnuyu atmosferu Barselony 70-kh
* V etoy igre personazhi, mir i istoriya vazhnee lovkosti i masterstva
MegaZeux — это GPL-2.0 система создания:
MegaZeux — eto GPL-2.0 sistema sozdaniya igr (GCS), napisannaya Endryu Poyntonom v 1994 godu; virtualnaya platforma dlya sozdaniya 2D-igr, analogichnaya takim, naprimer, kak RPG Maker.
On dayot vozmozhnsot polzovatelyam sozdavat svoi sobstvennye igry, ispolzuya prostoy yazyk programmirovaniya i vizualnyy redaktor.
Iznachalno v MegaZeux po umolchaniyu vklyuchena igra Caverns of Zeux, kotoraya sluzhit primerom togo, chto mozhno sozdavat s pomoshchyu etoy sistemy.
Adventure Academia: The Fractured Contin:
Adventure Academia: The Fractured Continent (Akademiya priklyucheniy: Raskolotyy kontinent) — polnotsennaya RPG-strategiya v mire Class of Heroes! Sozday svoyu gruppu uchenikov v fenteziynom korolevstve! Privedi ikh k pobede nad ordami monstrov!

Vooruzhivshis drevney relikviey, peredavaemoy iz pokoleniya v pokolenie — Ruler Orb (Sferoy pravitelya) — i zaruchivshis podderzhkoy loyalnykh uchenikov shkoly Obsidian High, tebe nuzhno budet razrabotat strategiyu, nabrat voinov i srazhatsya do polnoy pobedy nad ordami monstrov, ugrozhayushchikh rodnomu krayu. Vozmi na sebya komandovanie i prokladyvay put… za pravdu, raz i navsegda!

Osnovnye funktsii

Vyberi lyubuyu iz 10 raznykh ras! - Vyberi pol, cherty kharaktera, kharakteristiki lichnosti i sposobnosti chlenov tvoey komandy.

Vseokhvatyvayushchaya istoriya, razvorachivayushchayasya s kazhdym zavershennym kvestom!

Takticheskaya igrovoy protsess na osnove setki: vedi svoyu komandu v realnom vremeni, srazhayas na pole boya.

Sistema upravleniya komandoy: upravlyay, perebrasyvay i kontroliruy svoyu gruppu i ee statistiku.

Vooruzhi svoikh uchenikov! - Po puti ty naydesh snaryazhenie i oruzhie, chtoby povysit uroven i usilit zashchitu svoikh personazhey, i smozhesh ego kupit.

Unikalnye vstrechi s ispolinskim bossom: na kazhdom etape nuzhno preodolet bossa, ispolzuya raznye sposobnosti i varianty napadeniya.
Join the macaw Regina and the tyrannosau: Join the macaw Regina and the tyrannosaurus Mac on their adventure as they try to escape a lifeless research lab. The only way out? To find the golden Floppy discs on which the memory of the lab’s computer system U64 is stored so that it can help the duo to find an exit. Regina & Mac is a 3D platformer that stands in the tradition of the classics from the late 90s and offers a fair challenge even for genre aficionados.

Potata is a puzzle-platformer adventure:
Potata is a puzzle-platformer adventure story about a little girl’s magical journey through a world filled with good and evil. Play as the oddly-named Potata, a novice witch who is still getting a handle on her powers. Help Potata save her village from stinky spores, evil mushrooms, spiders, and other dark forest spirits.
The game world is inhabited by fantastic creatures, each with their own personality and story. Learn what secrets your village is hiding and make new friends — or maybe new enemies.
Gameplay involves traditional platformer mechanics, puzzles, boss battles, conversations with village inhabitants and forest exploration. Some careful thought is necessary, and the hardest moments may leave you racking your brain to find the solution.

Neobychnaya nakhodka izmenila zhizn devushki. S etogo momenta Elis stanovitsya vovlechyonnoy v vechnuyu borbu Tmy i Plameni i dolzhna spasti svoy fenteziynyy mir ot unichtozheniya.

Tma i plamya. Rozhdennyy ognem – priklyuchencheskaya igra-kvest s poiskom predmetov, mini-igrami i golovolomkami, rasskazyvayushchaya o neobychnom fenteziynom mire – Plodorodnykh zemlyakh – oazisakh v beskonechnykh pustynyakh. 

Molodaya devushka Elis nashla strannuyu shkatulku s yaytsom, iz kotorogo poyavilas ognennaya ptitsa i, kak budto, vselilas v devushku, ostaviv vyzhzhennyy risunok na ruke, sama zhe devushka pri etom posedela. S etogo momenta Elis stanovitsya vovlechyonnoy v vechnuyu borbu Tmy i Plameni. Za devushkoy nachalas okhota – neponyatnye soldaty razyskivali eyo, otets smog uberech Elis ot nikh, no eto stoilo emu zhizni. Devushke prishlos pokinut svoy dom i otpravitsya k edinstvennomu rodnomu cheloveku – dyade, o sushchestvovanii kotorogo ona tolko chto uznala. Vmeste im predstoit proyti mnozhestvo ispytaniy v raznykh ugolkakh Plodorodnykh Zemel, vstretyatsya s neobychnymi narodami i rasami, skrytsya ot priblizhayushcheysya opasnosti, reshit mnozhestvo golovolomok i stolknutsya s velikim zlom, ugrozhayushchim vsemu ikh fenteziynomu miru. Smozhet li Elis obuzdat silu plameni, darovannuyu ey sudboy, i spasti svoi zemli ot prevrashcheniya v pustynyu smerti?

Legendarnaya rolevaya igra vozvrashchaetsya spustya 30 let — na Nintendo Switch! Seriya «Cosmic Fantasy» — kosmicheskaya RPG, vypushchennaya iznachalno dlya PC Engine CD-ROM i Mega CD s 1990 godu. Rolevye igry s animatsionnymi epizodami byli redkostyu v to vremya, a novyy mir, lichnosti personazhey i istoriya zavoevali sebe strastnuyu armiyu fanatov.
Novatorskaya rolevaya igra s animirovannymi vstavkami! Multiplikatsionnye epizody v klyuchevykh chastyakh igry v kachestve vizualnykh stsen sdelalo etu seriyu ochen neobychnoy v zhanre rolevykh igr, i byla odnoy iz pervykh, kto primenil FMV v stile anime vnutri geympleya. A vysokokachestvennyy stsenariy i ispolnenie i segodnya vpechatlyaet novykh igrokov.
Vo vremya obychnogo polyota, molodoy kosmicheskiy okhotnik CSC, Kompaniya Kosmicheskoy Bezopasnosti) po imeni Yuu (ozv. Minami Takayama) obnaruzhivaet signal bedstviya, iskhodyashchiy s planety Norg. Khotya poseshchenie Norga i ne vkhodilo v ego plany, Yuu prizemlyaetsya na planetu i nachinaet rassledovanie vmeste so svoimi tovarishchami Monmo (Yumi Takada), zhivym mototsiklom, pokhozhim na tanuki, i Mamoy, kosmicheskim korablem s iskusstvennym intellektom. Vy vstretite zhiteley Norga, v tom chisle Sayu, ochen krasivuyu devushku, i Nyano (Seyko Nakano), govoryashchego kota s planety Siam-u.
Uznayte o legendarnom geroe Titanise, kto neskolko pokoleniy nazad izgnal zlogo demona Morgana s etoy planety, ved zlodey vernulsya, chtoby popytatsya nakazat potomkov Titanisa. Smozhete li vy spasti polozhenie?..

Vy vystupite v roli sera Alberta Uiksa i dostopochtimogo Klarensa Bakstera, dvukh issledovateley 19-go veka, kotorym vypala chest uchastvovat v eksperimentalnom polete na Mars na «Uzhasayushchem korable Ee Velichestva».

Kogda zakanchivaetsya ugol dlya parovogo dvigatelya, koshka na korable sryvaet navigatsionnuyu kartu, a chay ostyvaet, stanovitsya yasno, chto mezhzvezdnoe puteshestvie — eto ne prosto progulka po parku. Ponadobyatsya navyki odnovremenno dvukh igrokov, bok o bok rabotayushchikh nad voznikayushchimi problemami, chtoby dobratsya do Marsa v tselosti i sokhrannosti.

9 Clues: The Secret of Serpent Creek — э:
9 Clues: The Secret of Serpent Creek — eto originalnaya priklyuchencheskaya igra-golovolomka so skrytymi obektami i unikalnym detektivnym rezhimom. Eta zakhvatyvayushchaya tayna sochetaet v sebe elementy klassicheskogo uzhasa i surovogo realizma, a takzhe stilya nuar 50-kh godov. 
K chastnomu detektivu po paranormalnym yavleniyam obratilas ego znakomaya — izvestnyy reporter Khelen Khanter. Ee golos zvuchal otdalenno i ispuganno v golosovoy pochte. Ona nakhoditsya v pribrezhnom gorode Serpent-Krik i ey srochno nuzhna pomoshch. Odnako posle pribytiya v Serpent-Krik detektiv ne nakhodit nikakikh sledov Khelen. Ochen stranno, chto ulitsy goroda kishat zmeyami, a zhiteli khodyat kak vo sne. Zemlya sotryasaetsya ot silnykh tolchkov. Vo vremya raboty v Serpent-Krik detektiv vypolnit nastoyashchuyu issledovatelskuyu rabotu v poiske ulik i ikh sootnosheniy, chtoby uznat sekrety mest prestupleniya v novom rezhime detektiva!
Когда закончится снегопад, маленькая дат:
Kogda zakonchitsya snegopad, malenkaya datskaya derevnya Tinglev izmenitsya navsegda. Voydite v rol Gerdy, chya zhizn polnostyu perevernulas, kogda ee rodina okazalas okkupirovana vo vremya Vtoroy mirovoy voyny. Vybirayte, kuda idti, kak postupat i komu doveryat v etoy kamernoy syuzhetnoy rolevoy igre, vdokhnovlennoy realnymi sobytiyami. Kak daleko vy zaydete, chtoby zashchitit dorogikh vam lyudey?
«Gerda: ogonek sredi zimy» — eto istoriya o sostradanii, obshchnosti i otvage, vdokhnovlennaya realnymi sobytiyami. Poznakomtes s neznakomoy storonoy proshlogo i rasskazhite sobstvennuyu istoriyu. V etoy trogatelnoy syuzhetnoy igre vam predstoit upravlyat Gerdoy — medsestroy, chya zhizn izmenilas za odnu noch. Eta istoriya razvorachivaetsya ne na linii fronta, a v uyutnoy datskoy derevushke, gde devushka zhila s samogo rozhdeniya. Ispolzuya smekalku i empatiyu, Gerda dolzhna spasti dorogikh ey lyudey, ne postupayas svoimi printsipami.
Vo vremya voyny kazhdoe reshenie okazyvaetsya slozhnym i mozhet izmenit vse. Vybirayte svoy put v igre, smeshivayushchey issledovanie mestnosti, dialogi i upravlenie resursami i otnosheniyami. V etoy syuzhetnoy rolevoy igre cherty vashey lichnosti stanut vashimi navykami, a svyazi s drugimi lyudmi opredelyat razvitie istorii.

Neobychnye personazhi: kak uzhe izvestnye, tak i sovershenno novye.

Nastali nespokoynye vremena. Plemya doliny obrashchaetsya k vashim silam predskazyvat budushchee i prosit soveta.

Sudba plemeni zavisit ot vashikh prorochestv. Porazmyslite nad kazhdym sozvezdiem ili pozvolte zvezdam voyti v vashe soznanie. Vy — Proritsatel, i vam suzhdeno prochitat budushchee.

Osobennosti igry
Smotrite v nebo so svyashchennoy skaly, risuyte sozvezdiya i chitayte poslaniya zvezd.

Uznayte svoy narod i pomogite emu preodolet neuryaditsy.
Vybirayte otvety pravilno: v vashikh rukakh nastoyashchee i budushchee vashego plemeni. Ot vashikh slov zavisit ikh blagopoluchie ili pogibel.

«MARVEL MaXimum Collection» — не просто:
«MARVEL MaXimum Collection» — ne prosto sbornik, a tseloe nostalgicheskoe puteshestvie po istorii supergeroyskikh videoigr, daryashchiy fanatam vsekh pokoleniy vnov perezhit kazhdyy pikselnyy udar, pautinku i epicheskoe kombo, kotorye sdelali ikh kultovymi!
Kollektsiya vklyuchaet shest kultovykh proektov, okhvatyvayushchikh arkadnye avtomaty, 8-bitnye i 16-bitnye konsoli, vozvrashchaya dukh originalov i davaya sovremennym igrokam vozmozhnost ispytat lyubimykh supergeroev v obnovlyonnykh priklyucheniyakh. V sbornik voshli: X-Men: The Arcade Game s kooperativom do shesti igrokov, Captain America and The Avengers na arkadakh i konsolyakh, kultovyy krossover Spider-Man/Venom: Maximum Carnage, sikvel Venom/Spider-Man: Separation Anxiety, mobilnye versii Spider-Man/X-Men: Arcade’s Revenge i legendarnyy 8-bitnyy shuter Silver Surfer.
Kazhdaya igra poluchila sovremennye uluchsheniya: sokhranenie v lyuboy moment, peremotka, filtry CRT i scanline. Takzhe vklyucheny originalnye instruktsii-manualy, reklamnye materialy i muzyka iz vsekh versiy!
Spisok vklyuchyonnykh igr:
\"Air Twister — новое творение легендарн:
"Air Twister — novoe tvorenie legendarnogo razrabotchika arkad Yu Sudzuki! Vozmite na sebya rol printsessy Arki i srazhaytes protiv prichudlivykh zakhvatchikov, chtoby spasti svoyu planetu ot razrusheniya. Vam predstoit stolknutsya s polchishchami raznoobraznykh vragov i neprostymi bossami. 

Oprobuyte raznoobraznoe oruzhie, spetsialnye priemy i osobye rezhimy igry.

V bitve vas budet soprovozhdat zavorazhivayushchiy saundtrek v stile rok-opery, napisannyy izvestnoy gollandskoy ispolnitelnitsey Valensia."
Исследуйте кошмарную среду, ищите припас: Issleduyte koshmarnuyu sredu, ishchite pripasy i srazhaytes s nezhityu v Outbreak - khardkornoy igre uzhasov na vyzhivanie. Chasy nikogda ne ostanavlivayutsya, kogda vy pytaetes upravlyat chrezvychayno ogranichennym inventarem s ordami ubiyts na okhote. Vybirayte mezhdu priobreteniem dopolnitelnogo oruzhiya, lechebnykh predmetov ili neobkhodimymi instrumentami dlya prodvizheniya. Igrayte v rezhimakh kampanii i natiska v odinochku ili s drugom v lokalnom kooperativnom rezhime, vklyuchaya vozmozhnost dlya tovarishchey po komande AI. Takzhe ispytayte malenkie vinetki uzhasov vyzhivshikh v rezhime Koshmarov. U tebya tolko odna zhizn. Sdelayte eto v schet!
Добро пожаловать в город Омико — дом Tai:
Dobro pozhalovat v gorod Omiko — dom Taiko no Tatsujin: Rhythm Festival! Etot gorod tselikom i polnostyu napolnen vsemi lyubimymi elementami Taiko. Vmeste so starym drugom DON-tyan i novym znakomym Kumo-kyun vy otpravites v priklyuchenie, kotoroe sdelaet iz vas mastera barabanov tayko!

V igre dostupny 76 pesen, vklyuchaya Gurenge, Feel Special i Into the Night, a ukreplyayushchaya podderzhka pomozhet vam eshche bolshe prokachat navyki igry na barabanakh!

Uchastvuyte v reytingovykh setevykh matchakh i sorevnuytes s igrokami so vsego mira!
Est i drugie rezhimy, kotorye vam tochno ponravyatsya. Naprimer, v «Orkestre DON-tyan» igroki vchetverom dolzhny uspeshno davat kontserty, a v «Bolshoy voyne barabanov» vam ponadobitsya sobrat kolodu igrushek dlya tayko-bitv!

Poveselites kak sleduet, igraya v Taiko — v odinochku ili s druzyami!
Вы помните, как одолели демона и спасли:
