Отправьтесь в захватывающее приключение:
Otpravtes v zakhvatyvayushchee priklyuchenie vmeste s Agatoy, devochkoy, razryvayushcheysya mezhdu lyubovyu k zhivotnym i ikh myasu. S ney vam predstoit poznat religiyu i sozdat svoyu - "myasoedenie", daby ubedit zhivotnykh, chto samopozhertvovanie est sekret vechnogo schastya.

- Sozdayte sobstvennuyu religiyu kusochek za kusochkom v neveroyatno krasochnom mire, narisovannom ot ruki.
- Razreshayte protivorechivye voprosy, glyadya na nikh glazami rebyonka v satiricheskoy istorii, kotoraya zavedyot vas v tyomnye ugolki povsednevnoy zhizni.
- Vzaimodeystvuyte s razlichnymi personazhami psikhopaticheskoy vselennoy i uznavayte ikh istorii v khode svoego priklyucheniya.
- Issleduyte bezumnyy mir i razblokiruyte okolo tridtsati taynykh dostizheniy.
- Igrayte, kak vam udobno, legko pereklyuchayas mezhdu upravleniem s sensornogo ekrana i s kontrollera.
Погрузитесь в воспаленный сон и откройте: Pogruzites v vospalennyy son i otkroyte dlya sebya ego abstraktnyy mir. Uznayte o razrushenii vashego mira i prisposobtes k nemu. Deystvuyte ostorozhno. Na kazhdom shagu vas podsteregaet zlobnyy virus. Izbegayte chernil, i vse budet khorosho. Budte otkryty i gotovy ko vsemu. Vidte vraga v kazhdom cheloveke, dazhe v samom naimenee podozritelnom. Esli vy chuvstvuete predatelstvo, pomnite, chto likhoradka mozhet prevratit v polnogo neadekvata dazhe silnogo i sovershenno zdorovogo cheloveka. Vospalennyy razum teryaet zdravyy smysl... Postaraytes spasti khotya by odnogo cheloveka. Pomnite, chto inogda vylozhitsya dazhe na 100 % byvaet nedostatochno. Ne pozvolyayte likhoradke zakhvatit vash razum. Ne dayte chernilam izmenit sebya... OSOBENNOSTI - Atmosfera mira, pokhozhego na bredovyy son bolnogo. - Neprostye zagadki, trebuyushchie osobogo podkhoda. - Neobychnoe, intriguyushchee i gipnotiziruyushchee okruzhenie. - Mrachnyy i slozhnyy syuzhet, povestvuemyy avtorom ot vsego serdtsa.
In order to expand your home, and build:
In order to expand your home, and build up the nearby town, you're going to need coins. What better way to earn those coins than by running a shop! Explore the islands and caves collecting everything from poop to flowers to sell to the local villagers. Once you have some seeds you can dive into Farming, or many of the other activities on the islands including, Crafting, Fishing, Mining and Questing.

Once you have some spare coin talk to Frank to commission new buildings in town, with each building bringing unique Upgrades, Shops, Quests and even New Areas to explore, you'll have plenty to keep you busy!

- EXPLORE: With each area that you explore there are new items to find, collect, sell and even wear. Around every corner there is a chance to find hidden treasure, so you'll want to explore every chance you get.

- DUNGEON : Dive into the dungeon and battle monsters on 10 epic levels, take on the boss if you dare.

- MULTIPLAYER: You don't have to go alone on this new adventure, invite up to 9 friends to join you online. From shopkeeping to taming and exploring, everything is better with friends.

- CUSTOMIZATION: There are 10 characters to choose from, the Fox, Bunny, Bear, Dragon, Cat, Bird, Badger, Chipmunk, Horse and Dog. Each character has a unique appearance and for all the characters there are over 400 skins and over 150+ dye-able clothing items to customize your character unique to you.

- SHOPKEEPING: Found a flower or rock you think your customers will love? Open your shop between 12:00 and 18:00 and watch the money roll in. There are 1000+ items to sell in your shop, from raw materials to crafted items.

- QUESTING: Don't go too far, the townsfolk will need your help rebuilding their town, especially when a natural disaster strikes. Help build up the town and local buildings introducing new quests, areas and items along the way. There are over 700 quests with a minimum of 30 hours of content to explore, don't worry if you finish all the quests there are new ones every season.

- FARMING: Dig up seeds with flowers and vegetables in the wild or talk to Sammy the Seed Seller to purchase new seeds. Use your hoe to till the soil, then make sure to water it every day until your crops are ready to harvest. After a couple of days, harvest your crops and then cook them up or wrap them in a bouquet to sell in your shop.

- FISHING: There is water everywhere! So it's no surprise that the villagers on these islands like to fish. Whether it's dawn or dusk there is a large variety of fish to catch.

- RAISE ANIMALS: What farm is complete without animals? Talk to Frank about building your first Chicken Coop and Barn. In Garden Paws you can raise and tend to many animals including Chicks, Ducks, Calves, Alpacas, Foxes, Ferrets, Goats, Sheep, Horses, Rabbits and more. All of your larger mature animals can also be mounts to help you get around faster if you want a break from gliding around.

- CRAFTING: There are over 600 crafting recipes, including various chests, furniture and building pieces. You can keep your farm classic with wooden decorations or glam it up with crystal furniture and glass walls. Your Farm, your style! There are over 60 wallpapers and hundreds of items to keep you building all night.

- COOKING: There are multiple cooking stations to make your favorite treats, whether it's grilled fish, pies or salads you can take your shop to the next level by selling your delicious dishes.

- BUILD YOUR HOME: Work with Frank at the local construction shop to upgrade the home your grandparents left you, when they set off to travel the world. Want something bigger or in another location? Build some foundations and walls to build anything from a small fishing shack to a large castle!

- BUILD UP THE TOWN: In Garden Paws you'll have the opportunity to commission new buildings, bringing in new townsfolk and seeing the town grow due to your efforts.
Gallic Wars is a Roguelike tactical stra:
Gallic Wars is a Roguelike tactical strategy game. Fast gameplay, crazy rag-doll physics and challenging rouge-like approach to strategy. Fight your way through roman legions. DEPLOY your troops, PLAN their movement, use magic and items to give yourself an edge, and WIN.

Features: 
- One of a kind approach to the strategy genre
- Cartoony style - a true eye candy! 
- Fast gameplay
- Powerful magic and mighty generals
- Ragdoll physics - everyone likes ragdoll physics!
- Easy to play, hard to master!
In Reknum you play the rol of the prince:
In Reknum you play the rol of the princess Cheri, who must advance through 6 different completely explorable zones, loot chests with crystals that will increase her passive skills in order to advance.
Each zone introduces different elements which must be evaluated in order to be able to advance, to examine how to advance, to examine the behavior of the enemies and to fight bosses.

KEY FEATURES
•        2 Different weapons
•        New auto upgrade passive skill system
•        6 different exploration zones with lot of looting
•        Hardcore platform based levels
•        Autosave feature
•        Hardcore fastfight bosses
•        8 to 16bit graphics
•        8bit to modern soundtrack
Благодаря простым правилам и минималисти:
Blagodarya prostym pravilam i minimalistichnomu dizaynu vy pomozhete voditelyam preodolevat khaotichnye chasy pik po vsemu miru. Upravlyayte svetoforom i pomogayte voditelyam proezzhat po razlichnym gorodskim magistralyam, takim kak Parizh, Tokio, Stambul ili Las-Vegas.
Nachni borotsya s khaosom vo vsem mire!
Vklyuchaet rezhim daltonizma.
Пробейтесь на наивысший уровень, спасаяс: Probeytes na naivysshiy uroven, spasayas ot navodneniya. Sobirayte dopolnitelnye punkty i vybivayte milliony v bonusnykh zonakh. Vy igraete ne obychnym sharikom ― u nego spetsialnye vozmozhnosti. Razgonite ego do maksimalnoy skorosti i poluchayte bonusy. Otkroyte novye, bolee vysokie urovni, a kogda navodnenie vas nastignet i vy okazhetes v vode, vospolzuytes «reaktivnyy pryzhkom» (jet jump) i vzveytes nad vvoznoy gladyu. Pomnite, pri pogruzhenii v vodu elektricheskoe napryazhenie sharika povyshaetsya. Snizhayte ego do urovnya 0% v spetsialnykh portakh. Padaete i vidite, chto voda uzhe blizko? Ispolzuyte spasatelnyy puzyr i dayte sebe shans! Igrayte dalshe, beyte rekordy. Vy gotovy k takomu vyzovu? Navodnenie uzhe blizko!
Используйте газонных гномов, чтобы косит: Ispolzuyte gazonnykh gnomov, chtoby kosit travu na svoyom zadnem dvore i kidat veshchi! Udivitelno veselo!
Sphinx and The Cursed Mummy — это самобы:
Sphinx and The Cursed Mummy — eto samobytnoe priklyuchenie s vidom ot 3-go litsa, v osnovu kotorogo legla mifologiya drevnego Egipta. Puteshestvuyte po miru pri pomoshchi volshebnykh portalov i sorvite zlodeyskie plany Seta. Ostryy um, lovkost i osobye umeniya pomogut Sfinksu preuspet v etom puteshestvii. Esli zhe ponadobitsya deystvovat nezametno, na pomoshch Sfinksu pridet Mumiya, ego drug i geroy ponevole. Otyskav pokhishchennye egipetskie korony, obladayushchie volshebnymi svoystvami, Sfinks sumeet ostanovit Seta i spasti mir.

Osobennosti:
Igrayte za Sfinksa i ispolzuyte raznoobraznye navyki, chtoby srazhatsya so smertonosnymi mificheskimi sushchestvami i lovko izbegat opasnykh lovushek. Oslablyayte vragov i zakhvatyvayte ikh sposobnosti pri pomoshchi osobykh zhukov, chtoby primenyat ikh samostoyatelno.

Upravlyayte Mumiey, kogda v sile i boevykh navykakh net neobkhodimosti. Skrytnost i neordinarnye umeniya pomogayut Mumii izbegat vstrech s protivnikami, reshat golovolomki i sryvat plany vragov.

Vzaimodeystvuyte s sotnyami unikalnykh i neobychnykh sushchestv, sredi kotorykh naydutsya kak vragi, tak i soyuzniki.

Chudesnaya grafika, chto vdykhaet zhizn v mir, sozdannyy na osnove egipetskikh legend.

Uvlekatelnyy syuzhet i zamechatelnyy igrovoy protsess.
Бегите, избегая врагов и препятствий, в:
Begite, izbegaya vragov i prepyatstviy, v polnoy mere ispolzuya raznye navyki kazhdogo personazha Sisters Royale! Vse poluchennye bally konvertiruyutsya v ochki.
Sisters Royale: Five Sisters Under Fire sm. zdes.
Вдохновлённая настольной игрой, отмеченн:
Vdokhnovlyonnaya nastolnoy igroy, otmechennoy mnozhestvom nagrad, Arkham Horror: Mother’s Embrace — eto detektivnaya igra s poshagovoy sistemoy boya, deystvie kotoroy razvorachivaetsya v kultovoy vselennoy G. F. Lavkrafta. Pogruzites v originalnuyu istoriyu, napisannuyu stsenaristami Fantasy Flight Interactive, i okazhites v fantasticheskoy Amerike 1920-kh godov.

1926 god. Professor astronomii naydena myortvoy v svoyom osobnyake. Vsyo ukazyvaet na to, chto ona stala zhertvoy chudovishchnogo ubiystva. Vyberite odnogo iz 12 kultovykh geroev, kazhdyy iz kotorykh obladaet unikalnymi navykami, i soberite komandu sledovateley, chtoby prolit svet na etu zagadochnuyu istoriyu.

Ishchite uliki, provodite doprosy i prodvigaytes po istorii, sostoyashchey iz devyati glav. V khode rassledovaniya vy posetite znamenitye mesta iz vselennoy G. F. Lavkrafta, vklyuchaya Miskatonikskiy universitet, psikhiatricheskuyu bolnitsu goroda Arkkhem i opasnye topi. 

Po mere priblizheniya k razgadke tayny vashemu otryadu predstoit stolknutsya s prichudami nauki, koshmarami nayavu i strashnym kultom, chi bezumnye plany prizvany polozhit konets vsemu zhivomu. Ispolzuyte obshirnyy arsenal oruzhiya blizhnego i dalnego boya, a takzhe mogushchestvennye predmety i razrushitelnye zaklinaniya v borbe s vashimi protivnikami v poshagovykh srazheniyakh, pytayas pri etom ne soyti s uma.

Vo vremya stolknoveniy s Lavkraftovskimi uzhasami psikhicheskoe sostoyanie vashikh sledovateley budet ukhudshatsya, chto mozhet vyzvat u nikh emotsionalnye travmy, okazyvayushchie vliyanie na rassledovanie. Sledite za svoim dushevnym sostoyaniem i prinimayte vernye resheniya... Velikie Drevnie gotovyatsya k vozvrashcheniyu.
Help George as he searches for his lost:
Help George as he searches for his lost love Samantha (wind is a heck of a thing when you’re a little piece of fabric)! Overcome puzzles and obstacles in this hand-drawn textile world and unfold George’s whimsically narrated tale.

Features:

Копай-копай-копай! За любовь, за славу,:
Kopay-kopay-kopay! Za lyubov, za slavu, za zvonkuyu monetu!
Skorostnaya arkada pro zemlekopov: s syuzhetom, sokrovishchami i bitvoy s bossom!
Mir byl takim bezmyatezhnym. My zhili v nashem milom domike i kazhdyy den nemnogo kopalis v gryazi. No vse izmenilos v tot den, kogda OGROMNYY ZLOBNYY KROT ukral moyu lyubimuyu.
Podderzhite menya? Pomozhete dokopatsya do lyubvi vsey moey zhizni?
Beregites padayushchikh bulyzhnikov, kolev, pautiny, dinamita, lavy i letuchikh myshey!
Plan takoy: kopaem, nakhodim sokrovishcha, vytaskivaem ikh naverkh, delaem dengi!
Ya Zemlekop. Ya lyublyu kopatsya v zemle. Mne nuzhno spasti svoyu lyubimuyu.

Osobennosti igry
- Samaya krutaya igra pro zemlekopov s novoy arkadnoy mekhanikoy.

Новая ролевая игра в мире знаменитой сер:
Novaya rolevaya igra v mire znamenitoy serii mangi i anime ONE PIECE v chest 25-y godovshchiny serii!..
Znamenityy pirat Manki D. Luffi, bolee izvestnyy pod imenem Luffi Solomennaya Shlyapa, i ego komanda otpravlyayutsya v plavanie po Novomu Miru v poiskakh novykh ostrovov i novykh priklyucheniy. No popadayut v shtorm i terpyat korablekrushenie. Vony vybrasyvayut piratov na bereg tsvetushchego tropicheskogo ostrova, vokrug kotorogo postoyanno bushuyut buri. Ostavshiysya v odinochestve Luffi nachinaet novoe priklyuchenie, v kotorom emu predstoit nayti svoikh druzey i pokinut ostrov. Ego zhdut novye groznye protivniki, ustrashayushchaya moshch sil prirody i mnogoe drugoe!
Igrayte za raznykh chlenov komandy Solomennoy Shlyapy v klassicheskoy RPG v mire populyarnogo anime ONE PIECE!..One Piece: Pirate Warriors 4 + 13 DLC / Pirate Warriors 3 / Unlimited World Red Deluxe Edition sm. zdes.
В Druidwalker зима не за горами. Лес пог:
V Druidwalker zima ne za gorami. Les pogruzhaetsya v son. Vy - druid, gotovyashchiy les k spyachke. Kuda privedut vas tropinki iz opavshikh listev?

Druidwalker - eto eksperimentalnaya igra: vy ne poluchite podskazok v nachale igry. Vam pridetsya vzaimodeystvovat s ney i razbiratsya vo vsem po khodu igry.

Kharakteristiki:
- Puteshestvuyte po lesu, vstrechayte zhivotnykh; dvigaytes v svoem sobstvennom tempe, speshit nekuda.

- Korotkiy, rasslablyayushchiy opyt bez davleniya
Сыграйте в видеоигровую адаптацию полюби:
Sygrayte v videoigrovuyu adaptatsiyu polyubivsheysya nastolnoy igry! «Korni: Igra o sile i vlasti v lesu» — voenno-priklyuchencheskaya igra, gde do 4-kh igrokov srazhayutsya za kontrol nad obshirnym lesnym massivom.
Podlaya Markisa de Kote zakhvatila les, namerevayas prisvoit ego bogatstva. Mnogie zhiteli lesa obedinilis pod ee gnetom. Soyuz stremitsya ukrepit svoi pozitsii i podorvat vlast koshek. V etom dele Soyuz mozhet zaruchitsya pomoshchyu stranstvuyushchikh Brodyag, kotorye sposobny peremeshchatsya po samym opasnym lesnym tropam. I khotya nekotorye iz nikh razdelyayut chayaniya i mechty Soyuza, stranniki dostatochno stary, chtoby pomnit bolshikh khishchnykh ptits, kotorye kogda-to kontrolirovali lesa.
Tem vremenem na okraine nadmennaya i vzdornaya Dinastiya nashla novogo komandira, na kotorogo vozlozheny nadezhdy kak na lidera fraktsii, kotoryy vosstanovit ikh drevnee neotemlemoe pravo na les.
Погрузитесь в дистопический мир из 2084-:
Pogruzites v distopicheskiy mir iz 2084-go goda, gde korrumpirovannye mega-korporatsii vladeyut vsem, a prostye lyudi — nichem. Vy reshaete, chto khvatit eto terpet. Vy bolshe ne khotite byt kolyosikom v dusherazdirayushchey sisteme bespraviya, bezzakoniya, i beryotes za oruzhie protiv (kazalos by) vsemogushchego vraga!..
V etom ran-end-gan rouglayt-shuter-platformere, vdokhnovlyonnom kiberpankom mir kontroliruetsya tekhnokraticheskimi elitami, stremyashchimisya k tsifrovomu bessmertiyu i preodoleniyu dryakhlosti svoikh chelovecheskikh tel — i oni ne ostanovyatsya ni pered chem, chtoby dostich svoey tseli.
Borites s nimi na sluchayno sgenerirovannykh urovnyakh v velikolepnom retro-pikselnom shutere v stile 16-bit, slushaya potryasayushchiy saundtrek, unichtozhaya vragov iz bolee chem 60 orudiy. Uluchshayte svoego personazha, nakhodite osobye predmety, razblokiruyte dopolnitelnykh soyuznikov, kotorye pomogut vam. Vasha ochered prisoedinitsya k Velikomu Vosstaniyu!
Исследуйте полную жизни планету Глизе. К:
Issleduyte polnuyu zhizni planetu Glize. Kogda-to eyo naselyala drevnyaya rasa. Teper eta planeta stala domom dlya razumnykh tvoreniy toy tsivilizatsii — diokekov. Khotya Drevnie ischezli, diokeki prodolzhali zhit v mire. No odnazhdy zlobnye khiltsiki nachali napadat na ikh poseleniya, seya khaos i razrusheniya. I kogda na stsenu vykhodit eshchyo bolee zloveshchaya sila, molodoy diokek po imeni Astor otpravlyaetsya v puteshestvie. On oboydyot vsyu planetu, chtoby raskryt taynu zagadochnogo ischeznoveniya svoikh Sozdateley tysyachi let nazad. Vozmozhno, oni ostavili posle sebya klyuch k spaseniyu ego naroda.
Izuchayte novye ataki, poluchayte novye sposobnosti i kombo, otkryvayte novye magicheskie sily i sobirayte legendarnoe oruzhie, razbivaya ordy vragov. Prolozhite put k Monolitu — drevnemu monumentu, tayashchemu v sebe ogromnuyu silu. I protivostante samomu istochniku navisshey nad planetoy ugrozy. Prisoedinyaytes k puteshestviyu Astora i spasite planetu!
— Napryazhyonnye srazheniya s 16 razlichnymi tipami vragov i 10 vnushitelnymi bossami. Bolee 20 chasov na prokhozhdenie osnovnogo syuzheta i dopolnitelnykh zadaniy.

Switch between various seasons on the fly, shoot and slash with your magic melee crossbow and snatch loot to unveil the mystery of the 5th seasons. ACTION PLATFORMER! A thrilling adventure with engaging RPG elements, clever puzzles and pixel perfect platforming.
После окончания обучения в колледже, Лар:
Posle okonchaniya obucheniya v kolledzhe, Lara Kroft otpravlyaetsya v ekspeditsiyu k ostrovam u beregov Yaponii v Treugolnik Drakona, schitayushchiysya protivopolozhnostyu Bermudskogo treugolnika. Spustya tri dnya korabl popadaet v shtorm, i burya razlamyvaet sudno na dve poloviny, otdelyaya Laru ot ostalnoy komandy. Devushka popadaet na tainstvennyy ostrov Yamatay, v pribrezhnoy zone kotorogo pokoyatsya drevnie korabli vikingov, bombardirovshchiki B-25, galeony XVII veka i voennye katera 1940-kh.
Eyo podveshivayut vverkh nogami v peshchere i ostavlyayut, sochtya pogibshey...
«Tomb Raider: Definitive Edition» rasskazyvaet napryazhyonnuyu i zakhvatyvayushchuyu istoriyu o tom, kak Lare Kroft, robkoy yunoy baryshne prishlos stolknutsya s vrazhdebnoy sredoy i nauchitsya vyzhivat tam, gde drugie umirali. Imeya v svoyom rasporyazhenii tolko chutyo i instinkty, Lara dolzhna vyyti za predely chelovecheskoy vynoslivosti, raskryt tyomnye tayny zabytogo ostrova, na kotoryy eyo zabrosila sudba, i srazitsya za svoyo pravo vyrvatsya iz myortvoy khvatki etogo mesta, sbezhav otsyuda.
V versiyu dlya Nintendo Switch vklyucheny vse vykhodivshie ranee 24 DLC (Tomb of the Lost Adventurer; Aviatrix, Guerrilla, Hunter, Demolition, Mountaineer, Sure-shot Skins; Animal Instinct, Agility Skill, Headshot Reticle, Pistol Burst, Pistol Silencer; Shanty Town, Caves & Cliffs, 1939, Shipwrecked Multiplayer Map Packs; Scavenger Bandit, Scavenger Scout, Fisherman, Scavenger Executioner Multiplayer Characters; Outfit Pack 1-2, Adventure Pack i Multiplayer Map Pack Bundle) plyus bonusnyy kontent v vide vnutriigrovogo komiksa «Tomb Raider: The Beginning ot Dark Horse», vstroennogo tsifrovogo mini-artbuka «Tomb Raider: The Art of Survival», seriya videorolikov ot razrabotchikov «Final Hours of Tomb Raider», a takzhe byl uluchshen vizual i nekotorye geympleynye elementy, dobavlena podderzhka HD Rumble i tacha.Tomb Raider IV-V-VI (The Last Revelation / Chronicles / The Angel of Darkness) / Tomb Raider I-III (+ Unfinished Business) / TR II (2) The Dagger of Xian + Golden Mask / TombRaider III (3) Adventures of Starring Lara Croft + The Lost Artifact Remastered i The Lara Croft Collection: The Guardian of Light - The Temple of Osiris sm. tut.
Олдовый аркадный платформер в ретро-стил:
Oldovyy arkadnyy platformer v retro-stile, gde vas zhdut moshchnye ataki i opasnye vragi!
Molodoy geroy popal v alternativnuyu realnost, tuda, gde roboty zakhvatili mir, i u vas est vsego odin shans ostanovit nastuplenie Kontsa sveta!
Загадочный бог рока воскресил души велич:
Zagadochnyy bog roka voskresil dushi velichayshikh muzykantov vselennoy, chtoby oni srazhalis emu na potekhu. Nadelyonnye novymi telami i sposobnostyami, muzykanty budut uchastvovat v ego igre, srazhayas drug s drugom za muzykalnoe pervenstvo na mirovoy arene.

God of Rock sochetaet ritmichnyy igrovoy protsess s boevoy mekhanikoy v napryazhyonnykh poedinkakh. Vybirayte iz dyuzhiny unikalnykh boytsov, kazhdyy s unikalnym vneshnim vidom, mekhanikoy i garmonichnymi atakami. Chtoby oslabit protivnika, nazhimayte noty v takt pesne, delayte obychnye dvizheniya i nabirayte ochki, a zatem potratte ikh, chtoby sdelat eks-ataku i spetsialnye dvizheniya, nanosya uron i uslozhnyaya treki. Nakonets, prikonchite vraga sokrushitelnoy superatakoy! V khode srazheniya muzykalnaya kompozitsiya budet postepenno uslozhnyatsya, poka ne ostanetsya tolko odin boets.

Osobennosti igry
• Srazhaytes v takt: uchastvuyte v ozhestochyonnykh muzykalnykh bitvakh etogo sorevnovatelnogo ritmichnogo faytinga.

• Bez ogranicheniya sposobnostey: treki budut stanovitsya vsyo slozhnee, poka ne ostanetsya lish odin boets. 

• Bolee 40 originalnykh pesen, kazhdaya so svoimi unikalnymi i slozhnymi trekami dlya osvoeniya. 

• Vasha stsena — ves mir. Upravlyayte 12 nepokhozhimi drug na druga personazhami, kazhdyy so svoim stilem igry, na 8 dinamicheskikh stsenakh, raspolozhennykh v raznykh ugolkakh vselennoy.

Igrovye rezhimy
• Syuzhetnyy: sleduyte za lyubimym personazhem po razvetvlyonnomu syuzhetu i sorevnuytes s drugimi muzykantami, chtoby perezhit vsekh.

• Trenirovochnyy: osvoyte samye slozhnye fragmenty kazhdoy pesni i popraktikuytes v vypolnenii osobykh dvizheniy v takt.

• Redaktor trekov: vnesite svoy vklad v lyubimye treki, dobavlyaya i udalyaya noty po svoemu usmotreniyu.

• Lokalnaya igra i setevoy multipleer s reytingom: srazites s igrokami po lokalnoy seti ili cherez Internet v obychnom ili reytingovom mnogopolzovatelskom rezhime.
ClassiCube — это свободная игра-песочниц:
ClassiCube — eto svobodnaya igra-pesochnitsa s otkrytym iskhodnym kodom, osnovannaya na idee klassicheskoy versii «Minecraft Classic».

Sygrat v brauzernuyu versiyu, chtoby imet predstavlenie, chto takoe «ClassiCube» mozhno tut.

В Godlike Burger вы будете играть за сме:
V Godlike Burger vy budete igrat za smertonosnogo shef-povara, kotoryy gotovit luchshie burgery vo Vselennoy. Vash sekretnyy ingredient? Posetiteli! Upravlyayte restoranom, gotovte sochnye burgery i kroshite inoplanetyan. No ostorozhnee: khoroshiy svidetel — eto svidetel pod sousom!

V techenie dnya raznye inoplanetyane zaglyadyvayut v kosmicheskiy restoran, chtoby poprobovat te samye vkusneyshie burgery. Nu, ili umeret i stat farshem. Morozilki-to sami sebya ne napolnyat, verno? Vy mozhete raspravlyatsya s nimi napryamuyu, polagayas lish na vernyy tesak, ili vospolzovatsya arsenalom raznoobraznykh lovushek — podoyti k voprosu tvorcheski.

Po nocham u vas budet vremya uluchshit kukhonnuyu utvar i lovushki, zapasti ingredienty i prigotovit sekretnye sousy. Est chuvstvo, chto politsiya nachala chto-to podozrevat? Pora peregnat svoy letayushchiy restoran k drugoy planete. Ili pozhertvovat na razvitie rodnoy politsii! V popytkakh sozdat luchshuyu burgernuyu v galaktike na dokuchlivykh kopov net vremeni!

Osnovnye osobennosti

-Gotovte luchshie burgery i prevratite prostuyu zabegalovku v samyy znamenityy restoran Vselennoy. Chem bolshe prestizha, tem bolshe posetiteley, bolshe planet dlya biznesa i bolshe deneg, v kontse kontsov!
-Ubivayte posetiteley s pomoshchyu lovushek, yadov i starogo dobrogo tesaka!
-Uluchshayte kukhnyu i izuchayte vkusy raznykh inoplanetyan. Naydite retsept idealnogo burgera.
-Issleduyte galaktiku. U kazhdogo vida inoplanetyan est svoi silnye i slabye storony.
-Ne popadites! Ne ostavlyayte svideteley i ne vyzyvayte podozreniy u politsii. Budte umnee i khitree.
-Po nocham vy smozhete, kak i lyuboy poryadochnyy restorator, navesti poryadok i podgotovitsya k novomu dnyu. Gotovte sousy, zapasayte ingredienty i uluchshayte lovushki, oruzhie i kukhonnuyu utvar.
-Reshayte zadaniya i razbiraytes s desyatkami problem: ot zasorivshikhsya tualetov i meteoritnykh dozhdey do atak zombi.

Wii U (Вии-Ю), кодовое название Project:
Wii U (Vii-Yu), kodovoe nazvanie Project Café — igrovaya konsol, razrabotannaya kompaniey Nintendo, yavlyaetsya preemnikom Wii. Sistema byla predstavlena na press-konferentsii Nintendo 7 iyunya 2011 goda na vystavke E3-2011, prototip byl predstavlen na E3-2012, a vypushchena pristavka byla v noyabre 2012 goda. Eyo proizvodstvo bylo prekrashcheno 31 yanvarya 2017 goda, v svyazi s vykhodom Nintendo Switch.
DuckTales — videoigra po motivam odnoimyonnogo multseriala, razrabotannaya yaponskoy studiey Capcom i vyshedshaya 14 sentyabrya 1989 goda. V osnovu syuzheta igry polozhen odnoimyonnyy disneevskiy multserial «Utinye istorii». Vpervye byla vypushchena 14 sentyabrya 1989 goda v SShA dlya Nintendo Entertainment System, pozdnee byla takzhe pereizdana na portativnoy igrovoy sisteme Gameboy.
Studiey Capcom, sovmestno so studiey WayForward v avguste 2013 goda byl vypushchen remaster originalnoy igry «DuckTales: Remastered» dlya PC i igrovykh pristavok PlayStation 3, Xbox 360 i WiiU. Pomimo obnovlyonnoy grafiki, razrabotchiki perenesli v igru mnozhestvo melkikh detaley iz originala, pererabotav i mestami rasshiriv urovni. Slozhnost igry takzhe byla zametno izmenena — v Duck Tales na NES tri urovnya slozhnosti ne imeli nikakikh sushchestvennykh otlichiy mezhdu soboy, krome togo chto v bolee lyogkoy versii bylo uvelicheno kolichestvo kolonok zdorovya, 6 vmesto 3 standartnykh. V remeyke na slozhnosti Easy dayutsya neogranichennye popytki, a na Normal i Hard — vsego dve, kotorye ochen legko poteryat. Krome etogo, byla dobavlena dopolnitelnaya «sekretnaya» slozhnost — Extreme. Takzhe byli dobavleny dva novykh urovnya, kotorykh ne bylo v originalnoy igre: vstupitelnyy — dengokhranilishche Skrudzha MakDaka, i finalnyy — v zherle vulkana Vezuviy, gde po syuzhetu obitaet Magika de Gipnoz. Ozvuchivaniem Skrudzha MakDaka v igre zanyalsya Alan Yang, britanskiy aktyor dublyazha originalnogo multseriala. Na rol Magiki byla priglashena Dzhun Forey, takzhe iz originalnogo sostava. V «Utinykh Istoriyakh» mnogo skhozhego s seriey Megaman: yarkaya grafika, chyotkoe upravlenie so svoeobraznoy dinamikoy — Skrudzh ispolzuet svoyu trost v kachestve oruzhiya, instrumenta i dlya pryzhkov. Ona prisutstvuet v etoy razdache.Videotreyler.
Катайтесь по удивительным мирам вместе с:
Kataytes po udivitelnym miram vmeste s Ay-aem i ego druzyami, chtoby ostanovit bezumnogo uchenogo doktora Zlobuina, kotoryy khochet vzorvat ostrov Dzhungley! Osobennosti:

Изучите крохотный островок, затерянный н:
Izuchite krokhotnyy ostrovok, zateryannyy na pokrytoy slizyu planete. Posmotrite, skoro li vam nadoest postoyannaya reklama korporatsiy, poobshchaytes s drugimi teggerami, ukradite kakuyu-nibud khren i paru serdechek zaodno. Chto vas zhdet? Stanete korolem ostrova, pokroete graffiti kazhdyy dyuym svobodnoy poverkhnosti? Proniknite v korporatsiyu «GLYuK», pomeshaete ey kachat sliz? Ili prosto spalite vse k chertu?

* Pokhuligante vslast, sidya v bezopasnosti za kompyuterom.

Battle Brothers — это тактическая пошаго:
Battle Brothers — eto takticheskaya poshagovaya RPG, deystvie kotoroy razvorachivaetsya v surovom srednevekovom fantaziynom mire, gde vam predstoit upravlyat naemnicheskoy kompaniey. Vy reshaete, kuda otpravitsya, kogo nanyat ili s kem srazhatsya, kakie kontrakty brat i kak snaryazhat vashikh lyudey na prostorakh otkrytogo protsedurno sgenerirovannogo mira. Smozhete li vy privesti ikh k pobede cherez cheredu krovavykh bitv?

Igrovoy protsess imeet dve sostavlyayushchie: strategicheskaya karta mira i takticheskie srazheniya. Na karte mire vashe peremeshchenie nichem ne ogranicheno: vy mozhete puteshestvovat, chtoby zaklyuchat kontrakty, kotorye prinesut vam khoroshiy dokhod, nakhodit mesta, gde mozhno razzhitsya dobychey, stoyashchikh presledovaniya vragov ili goroda, gde mozhno popolnit zapasy i nanyat lyudey. Zdes zhe vy osushchestvlyaete upravlenie svoimi naemnikami, povyshaete ikh uroven i snaryazhaete v boy. Kak tolko vy stolknetes s vrazhdebnoy gruppoy, igra pereklyuchitsya na takticheskuyu kartu, gde i proiskhodit boy v vide detalnogo poshagovogo srazheniya.

Upravlyayte srednevekovoy naemnicheskoy kompaniey v otkrytom protsedurno sgenerirovannom mire.
- Primite uchastie v slozhnykh poshagovykh boyakh s istoricheskim snaryazheniem i zhestokimi raneniyami.
- Voskresheniya net. Vse personazhi, pogibshie v boyu, ostanutsya mertvymi — esli tolko ne vosstanut v vide nezhiti.
- Kazhdyy personazh imeet svoyu sobstvennuyu istoriyu i unikalnye talanty. Kak naschet zaikayushchegosya krysolova, zhadnogo okhotnika na vedm ili opustivshegosya spivshegosya aristokrata?
- Razvitie personazha ne ogranicheno strogoy klassovoy sistemoy. Kazhdyy geroy poluchaet opyt v boyu, mozhet povyshat uroven i priobretat moshchnye navyki.
- Snaryazhenie — nashe vsyo. Kazhdoe oruzhie daet vam unikalnye sposobnosti — razrubayte shchity toporami, oglushayte vragov palitsami, sozdavayte stenu iz kopiy s pomoshchyu pik ili raskalyvayte dospekhi boevym molotom.
- Vse protivniki imeyut unikalnoe snaryazhenie, umeniya i osobennosti povedeniya v boyu.
- Dinamichnaya sistema igrovykh sobytiy s atmosfernymi skhvatkami i neprostymi resheniyami za predelami polya boya.
- Tri krizisa na pozdney stadii igry — voyna dvoryanskikh domov, vtorzhenie zelenokozhikh i nashestvie nezhiti — dobavlyayut novuyu ugrozu.

BECOME THE "CLEANER"
Become a dead body disposal specialist!
As a “cleaner” you need to get rid of the body and make sure there is no evidence left behind.
Remember, you’re on a clock. Think fast, use proper tools, and don’t mess up…
Leave one smear of blood and you’re in trouble. All of this in a low-poly noir style.

HIDE BODIES BEFORE IT IS TOO LATE!
Hide the body in a locker, dump it off the coast or put it in a barrel full of acid, the choice is yours!
Start with some simple cleanups, work your way up by completing new orders.
No jobs are the same, but each one requires you to be quick and professional!

GET INTO THE WORLD OF CRIME
Develop your own style, accept jobs from the cops to the mafia, and find a unique way to complete each one of them.
Meet new characters on your way up. Follow the storyline full of plot twists, low-poly bloody scenes, wicked sense of humour and tons of references.
Always stay sharp, expect the unexpected, and of course... leave no evidence.

VARIOUS MECHANICS
Can’t open the door? Get that lockpick out and work that lock.
Use a mop, a brush soaked in some soap, or a nearby hose to make the mess disappear.
You should probably use some luminol to expose some hidden blood stains as well…
Cuz the police won’t miss those!
Then just leave carrying the corpse in a body bag like nothing ever happened.

THERE IS NO TIME FOR FEAR
Every order is not just a body to ditch, but also a race against time.
Any blood stains left behind will only lead you to one place…
Fuck up one order for the mafia, and you better start digging your own grave.
Body Of Evidence is full of dangers, and if you want to exist in this business, don’t let the fear beat you.

Countless heroes have tried and failed t:
Countless heroes have tried and failed to destroy the ancient spell that holds the castle walls. Meanwhile, hundreds of monsters are roaming inside, guarding the sword shards — the last known thing to be capable of defeating the demonic castle owner, thus shattering its magical structure.

Although you are not alone — some help could be obtained from the merchants, who, for reasons not truly understood, offer their services right inside the lair of evil. Though, it seems to be only a matter of time for them to disappear...

Plan your every step carefully, because save points aren't a thing in a rogue-lite game! There is, however, another option. There are two difficulty modes: PAL/NTSC. If the game feels too unforgiving, you can tone down the difficulty, lowering the framerate to 50 (PAL). Note, though, that music and sounds become more evil at the 83% of their original pitch.

Just like in old NES™ games, you need to input 13 characters to get back to your game session. Still, the powers of evil prevent you from saving anything much more than the artefacts you've found…

Where the Water Tastes Like Wine is a Na:
Where the Water Tastes Like Wine is a Narrative-Adventure game about traveling, sharing stories, and surviving manifest destiny. Featuring gorgeous hand-drawn illustrations, Where the Water Tastes Like Wine combines 2D visuals with a 3D overworld US map.

Players wander across a folkloric Depression era United States at their own pace, meeting strangers with their own stories to tell. Through these interactions, players will be able to collect unique stories which can then be re-told to unlock new interactions. In this way the in-game stories themselves act as a currency to progress through the game, and it’s up to the player to pair the right story with the unique needs of each of the characters that you will encounter throughout your travels. Only through these right pairings will characters reveal their true selves, and bestow you with the most powerful stories, the true ones which reveal something about their own lives. In Where The Water Tastes Like Wine, stories organically take on a life of their own as they grow larger and transform as they're told- and re-told.

Issleduyte i rassleduyte
Spasenie mira — delo vazhnoe, no lyubomu geroyu inogda nuzhno otdokhnut i zanyatsya chem-to drugim. Vse tri dnya vremennoy petli v vashem rasporyazhenii: issleduyte shkolu i uznavayte, chem zanimayutsya ucheniki i prepodavateli. Vstupite v klub po interesam

• V klube lyubiteley alternativnoy muzyki vy smozhete vstupit v modnuyu molodyozhnuyu rok-gruppu.
• Klub lyubiteley iskusstva pozvolit vam proyavit tvorcheskuyu zhilku i pokhvastatsya svoimi rabotami pered drugimi uchashchimisya.
• Sportivnyy klub — nastoyashchiy ray dlya lyubiteley borotsya i ne sdavatsya.
• Dramaticheskiy klub — pristanishche snobov, i vyzhit tam smozhet ne kazhdyy. No kto znaet, vdrug glavnaya rol v ikh sleduyushchey pese dostanetsya imenno vam?

K schastyu, vy mozhete vstupit vo vse chetyre kluba! Magicheskiy amulet pozvolit vam perekhodit v drugoy klub v kazhdoy novoy vremennoy petle.

Znakomtes i obshchaytes
V shkole «Kraken» polno yarkikh lichnostey. V odnom tolko muzykalnom klube vy poznakomites s krasavchikom Vladimirom — vedushchim vokalistom, stradayushchim ot vnimaniya neugomonnykh poklonnits, razdrazhitelnoy basistkoy-mizantropom Simonoy v tolstovke s zhirafom, a takzhe s barabanshchitsey Brokkoli, bespreryvno toskuyushchey po svoemu partnyoru posle rasstavaniya.

Skoree khvatayte svoyu shkolnuyu formu, nadevayte volshebnyy amulet dlya puteshestviy vo vremeni i ne slushayte vash vnutrenniy golos, pytayushchiysya otgovorit vas ot etoy bezumnoy zatei!

Game master Kenta's notebook holds a han:
Game master Kenta's notebook holds a handwritten RPG made just for you.
Every turn of the page brings thrills, heroics, and a whole lot of fun!

After school, the classroom transforms into the world of "The Legend of Wright," an RPG designed by young aspiring game maker Kenta.
As you make your way through the game, crafted by Kenta from drawings and cardboard and stationery, you'll see that it's so much more than "just" an RPG. Despite the name, RPG Time also features everything from action to adventure to bullet hell to turn-based battles! It's a treasure chest stuffed full of fun, and there's no telling what Kenta will pull out next.
Nostalgic yet modern, this game is sure to shake up your after-school routine!

First dreamed up 15 years ago, then brought to fruition through more than 9 years in development, RPG Time has been praised for its boundless innovation and creativity, receiving several awards from game development festivals around the world such as Tokyo Game Show, Taipei Game Show, BitSummit, and more.

Glavnogo geroya vyrezali vmeste so vsey derevney bandity, no ego vozrodili Norny, chtoby on unichtozhil Yotunov i tem samym ne dal by sluchitsya Ragnaryoku
Vas vstretit stilizatsii pod komiksy, syuzhetnye vstavki, ochen interesnaya interpretatsiya fekhtovaniya v Hack’n’Slash mekhanike i vozmozhnost reshat sudby nekotorykh sopernikov, tem samym menyaya okonchanie igry!
Unsouled is a 2D action RPG game requiri: Unsouled is a 2D action RPG game requiring immense elaborate control. Take a break from repetitive attack and dodge action by challenging yourself with the world of Unsouled.
Bolshe, chem prosto parkur ili friran!... Eto nastoyashchiy istochnik adrenalina: kombo, polety naperekor gravitatsii i oshchushchenie svobody… do tekh por, poka vy ne padaete s vysoty 30 metrov.
V odinochku ili s druzyami issleduyte masshtabnye karty, sozdannye spetsialno dlya parkura. Doberites do trudnodostupnykh mest, nakhodite skrytye uchastki i prokhodite ispytaniya — na vremya, tryukovye zadachi ili drugoe.
Vas zhdut takie formaty, kak: «Metki», «Zakhvat flaga», «Bitvy tryukov», a takzhe svobodnoe peremeshchenie po otkrytomu miru v kompanii druzey.
Hello Goodboy — это добрая и интересная:
Hello Goodboy — eto dobraya i interesnaya istoriya pro priklyucheniya malchika Iko, kotoryy sovsem nedavno v zagrobnom mire. On sovershenno ne pomnit, kak zdes okazalsya. Ostaetsya polagatsya na Koko — udivitelno znakomogo psa, kotoryy pomozhet razgadat tayny ego novogo sushchestvovaniya. 

Puteshestvuyte, po neizvestnym, no takim znakomym mestam, znakomtes s drugimi dushami, u kazhdoy iz kotorykh — svoi priklyucheniya v drugoy zhizni. Pomogayte im i poprobuyte razobratsya, kak zhe samogo Iko ugorazdilo popast na tot svet. No ne zabyvayte o vremeni: ego ne tak mnogo!

- Prozhivite sobstvennuyu dobruyu i atmosfernuyu skazku o puteshestviyakh Iko i Koko po zagrobnomu miru.
- Razgadyvayte tayny i sobirayte nabory radosti.
- Cheshite Koko zhivotik stolko, skolko zakhochetsya! 

- Podruzhites s desyatkami obitateley zagrobnogo mira: odinokim rebenkom, trevozhnoy paroy, ustavshim drovosekom i mnogimi drugimi.
- U kazhdogo iz nikh — svoya interesnaya istoriya i svoya zadacha, s kotoroy mozhet pomoch Iko.
- A kogda problema reshitsya, mozhno vmeste pokushat i nemnogo otdokhnut.

No vremeni u vas ne tak mnogo. Reshayte, s kem provodit vremya: obshchayas s odnimi personazhami, vy ne uspeete podruzhitsya s drugimi. V igre neskolko kontsovok, i imenno vash vybor opredelit final istorii Iko.

- Koko — khoroshiy malchik i vash luchshiy drug v zagrobnoy zhizni! 
- Ego ostryy nyukh i umelye ruki Iko pomogut vam raskryt metafizicheskie tayny mira vokrug.
- Ne zabyvayte chesat psu puziko i rezvitsya s igrushkami, chtoby podderzhivat uroven «Shkaly khoroshego malchika».
Ваше альтер-эго в игре — Проклятый гольф:
Vashe alter-ego v igre — Proklyatyy golfist. On okazalsya v Golfochistilishche iz-za nelepoy sluchaynosti v tot samyy moment, kogda gotov byl vypolnit pobednyy udar na mezhdunarodnom turnire! Legenda glasit, chto vernutsya v mir zhivykh (i k vozhdelennoy pobede na turnire!) mozhno, esli proyti kovarnye polya Golfochistilishcha. Kazhdoe pole okhranyaet prizrak Legendarnogo keddi, kotoryy posvyatit vas v misticheskie tayny golfa i pomozhet na puti k svobode i zhizni.

Cursed to Golf — eto novaya interpretatsiya zhanrov golfa i roguelike. Zagonite myach v lunku, ulozhivshis v par, ili proklyate vernet vas k nachalu polya! Malo togo, chto na polyakh est bunkery i rafy, tam eshche polno bezumnykh prepyatstviy vrode moshchnykh ventilyatorov, shipov, vzryvchatki, teleportov — i chego tam tolko net. V etoy bezumnoy versii klassicheskoy igry sluchitsya mozhet chto ugodno!

U proklyatya vechnoy igry v golf v Golfochistilishche est i svoi plyusy! Ispolzuyte Ptichiy polet, chtoby okinut vzglyadom vse pole i otsenit, chto vas zhdet. Ne ukladyvaetes v par? Ne beda: po vsemu polyu rasstavleny zolotye i serebryanye golf-idoly. Esli ikh razbit, udary vosstanovyatsya. Tuzy povysyat shansy na uspekh: oni pozvolyat vashey potustoronney sile menyat pravila igry. Drobnyy myach, Razvorot, Myach-raketa, Vtoroy shans — vot lish neskolko iz bolee chem 20 tryukov, kotorye pozvolyat vam krutanut koleso Fortuny v nuzhnuyu storonu!

V pervyy zhe den raboty mezhprostranstvennyy server vykhodit iz stroya, i tselaya galaktika bessledno ischezaet! Vstroennaya sistema zadaniy podskazhet, kak uluchshit rezultat: soedinit elementy odnogo tsveta, vysadit nuzhnoe kolichestvo derevev ili uchest osobye pravila konkretnoy planety. Zdes mozhno rasslabitsya i eksperimentirovat s formami, a mozhno i stremitsya k idealnomu schyotu po ochkam.
Mezhdu rabochimi sessiyami Bubblegum Galaxy predlagaet issledovat vash ofis: poobshchatsya s kollegami, osmotret okruzhenie i postepenno otkryt sotni syuzhetnykh stsen. «Пазлы и Драконы» — игра, в которой вопл:
«Pazly i Drakony» — igra, v kotoroy voploshcheny raznye zhanry, sochetayushchaya klassicheskuyu boevuyu sistemu takikh golovolomok, kak Puzzle Quest, s sistemoy okhoty za raznymi sushchestvami, kak Pokemon – i vse eto dopolneno interesnoy rolevoy istoriey.

Do pyati iz sushchestv mozhno napravit v podzemelya, brosiv vyzov vragam. Vazhno pomnit, chto raznye sushchestva imeyut razlichnye sily i sposobnosti, kotorymi mozhno vospolzovatsya vo vremya bitv. V etoy versii net vnutriigrovykh pokupok.
Обычный парень Юма внезапно обнаруживает:
Obychnyy paren Yuma vnezapno obnaruzhivaet, chto ego skuchnaya zhizn stala namnogo interesnee, povstrechav zagadochnuyu moloduyu devushku po imeni Eva. Otkroyte dlya sebya radost zhizni s milovidnoy gornichnoy v etom trogatelnom vizualnom romane!
Yuma Kitami — tipichnyy naemnyy rab: prosypaysya, rabotay, spi, povtorit. Iz-za rutinnoy raboty on pochti lishilsya ambitsiy, a ego povsednevnaya zhizn napolnena beskonechnymi sverkhurochnymi, iz-za chego ostayotsya tak malo vremeni dlya lichnoy zhizni, ne govorya uzhe o zhenitbe. No vse menyaetsya odnoy tikhoy zimney nochyu. Uspev na posledniy sinkansen do doma, vy nakhodite u vkhodnoy dveri devushku vsego v neskolkikh mgnoveniyakh do moroznoy smerti.
Vy zavodite eyo v svoy dom i delaete vsyo, chto v vashikh silakh, chtoby vernut prekrasnuyu neznakomku k zhizni. Kogda ona nakonets prikhodit v sebya, devushka predstavlyaetsya kak Eva i ochen khochet poblagodarit vas za svoyo spasenie. I eshchyo ona predlagaet stat vashey gornichnoy!
Далёкая планета. Умирающая колония. Смер:

Действие этого хоррора на выживание прои:
Deystvie etogo khorrora na vyzhivanie proiskhodit v mrachnom budushchem, v kotorom chelovechestvo otkrylo strashnuyu taynu. Razgaday zagadku, sbegi ot koshmarnykh tvarey i obyshchi vneplanetnyy zavod vmeste s tekhnikom-replikoy Elster, kotoraya pytaetsya nayti svoi poteryannye sny.
Poiski snov vnutri koshmara — probudis oto sna i issleduy syurrealisticheskiy retrotekhnicheskiy mir vmeste s tekhnikom-replikoy Elster, kotoraya ishchet svoyu naparnitsu i poteryannye sny. V etom klassicheskom psikhologicheskom khorrore na vyzhivanie tebya zhdet napryazhennaya i melankholicheskaya atmosfera kosmicheskogo uzhasa, a takzhe zhutkie tayny, neprostye golovolomki i koshmarnye tvari.
Это симулятор культа, занимающегося чело: Eto simulyator kulta, zanimayushchegosya chelovecheskimi zhertvoprinosheniyami. Vam predstoit vzyat na sebya rol glavnogo svyashchennika kulta, k kotoromu prinadlezhat vse zhiteli nebolshogo gorodka. Oni zhdut, poka prosnyotsya ikh tyomnyy bog i ochistit mir ot greshnikov i skverny. Kazhdyy gorozhanin generiruetsya programmno, u nego est skrytye cherty kharaktera: i dobrodeteli, i grekhi. Vasha zadacha kak dukhovnogo lidera — iskat i ubivat eretikov, ne teryaya doveriya i uvazheniya aristokratii.

Ary and the Secret of Seasons — удостоен:
Ary and the Secret of Seasons — udostoennaya nagrad priklyuchencheskaya igra, gde devochka po imeni Aryelle (Ariel) ili Ary (Ari) puteshestvuet po ogromnomu miru Valdi. Stav Strazhem Zimy, Ary poluchaet sposobnost menyat sezony, i ey predstoit nauchitsya upravlyat imi, pobezhdat vragov, preodolevat prepyatstviya i reshat slozhnye golovolomki po vsemu miru.

Davnym-davno miru Valdi ugrozhal zloy mag. Posle dolgoy borby Legendarnyy Voin pobedil ego i zaper v sklepe na veka. Chtoby mag ne vybralsya, chetyre velikikh mudretsa poklyalis okhranyat sklep. Oni stali pervymi Strazhami Sezonov — taynoy organizatsiey, o kotoroy nyne ostalis lish legendy.

Posle togo kak zagadochnaya sila povredila sklep, Ary reshila pomoch Strazham Sezonov i otpravilas iskat istochnik nepriyatnostey. Ey pridyotsya proyavit otvagu i smekalku, odolet moguchikh vragov, taynye zagovory i ustarevshie traditsii, chtoby spasti mir i privesti ego v ravnovesie.

V igre:
— Priyatnye issledovaniya. Polzuyas siloy sezonov, geroinya mozhet peremeshchatsya po samym raznym landshaftam i reshat interesnye prirodnye golovolomki, chtoby prodvinutsya po syuzhetu.
— Uvlekatelnaya istoriya. Devochka dolzhna pomoch Strazham Sezonov: starinnoy organizatsii s ukorenivshimisya traditsiyami. Puteshestvuya po neizvedannym zemlyam, Ary raskroet tayny Strazhey Sezonov i poymyot vsyo znachenie dannoy organizatsii.
— Menyayushchiesya lokatsii. Peremeshchaytes mezhdu ekosistemami i menyayte okruzhayushchuyu sredu i sezony s pomoshchyu sily Ary, chtoby poluchit nuzhnoe.
— Plavnye srazheniya. Ary pridyotsya primenit vse svoi sposobnosti, potomu chto ey postoyanno budut meshat vragi: ot mestnykh zhiteley do ogromnykh ispolinov. Ey pridyotsya primenyat ves svoy arsenal dlya preodoleniya tyazhkikh prepyatstviy.
— Privlekatelnyy tryokhmernyy mir. Krasivaya grafika i ocharovatelnoe muzykalnoe soprovozhdenie sozdayut priyatnuyu atmosferu, blagodarya kotoroy igra zapomnitsya nadolgo.
Выделяйтесь на поле боя со вкусом в свое:
Vydelyaytes na pole boya so vkusom v svoem kostyume Crossbreed — spetsialnom skafandre, sozdannom s ipolzovaniem chelovecheskikh i vnezemnykh tekhnologiy. Vse dvizhetsya na vas!

V igre predstavleny elementy vertikalnykh i gorizontalnykh skroll-shuterov, a takzhe perspektiva relsovykh shuterov, kotorye bezuprechno sochetayutsya drug s drugom v blestyashche vylozhennykh izobrazheniyakh 2,5D.

В послевоенные годы Япония переживает бу:
V poslevoennye gody Yaponiya perezhivaet burnyy ekonomicheskiy rost, za tempami kotorogo ne uspevaet nasha yunaya geroinya. Ne vidya perspektiv na budushchee, ona khvataetsya za edinstvennuyu nit nadezhdy — nachalo novoy zhizni v roli sluzhanki pri dome Ivakura. No semeystvo skryvaet kakie-to sekrety. I klyuch k razgadke tayn — Ariya, doch khozyaina. Vskore Itiko okazyvaetsya vtyanuta v peripetii budney osobnyaka.
Eto istoriya o, kazalos by, obychnom lete 1966 goda, kotoroe opredelilo dalneyshee budushchee ne tolko semeystva Ivakura, no i ikh sluzhanki. Istinnoe prednaznachenie Itiko i Arii rastvorilos gde-to v potoke chuzhikh nadezhd i ozhidaniy. Komu na samom dele prinadlezhat zhizni dvukh devushek, chto tak staratelno igrayut navyazannye roli? Vernut sudbu v svoi ruki ne tak prosto. Dlya etogo neobkhodimy khrabrost i ogromnaya sila voli. Byt mozhet, sudbonosnaya vstrecha yunykh dush pomozhet im raskrepostitsya i sbrosit okovy?

Pretty Odd Bunny — это стелс-платформер:
Pretty Odd Bunny — eto stels-platformer v 2D o krolike, kotoromu nravitsya est sviney. Tebe predstoit igrat za krasnoglazogo krolika, kotoromu nuzhno dobratsya do svini v kontse kazhdogo urovnya i pri etom ostatsya nezamechennym drugimi krolikami! 
 
Vybiray put, na kotorom tebya ne uvidyat drugie kroliki. Oni ne odobryayut tvoi predpochteniya v ede i postarayutsya pomeshat, esli razgadayut tvoi namereniya. 
 
Khodi, begay i prygay po etomu yarkomu i opasnomu miru, polnomu krasivoy grafiki i kachestvennoy animatsii. On sozdan pokadrovo s lyubovyu i entuziazmom.
 
Issleduy bolee 80 urovney v 4 unikalnykh mirakh, nakhodi spryatannye monetki i otkryvay novye chellendzhi s milymi personazhami, zhutkovatymi stsenami, krovyu i kuchey otrezannykh svinykh golov.
 
DOBAV V SPISOK IZBRANNYKh IGR UZhE SEYChAS! Chtoby sredi pervykh sygrat v igru posle ee zapuska.
Nu a tem, kto dochital do syuda, zhelayu krolichyu lapku na udachu!
 
Vsem lyubov!

Ob igre Pretty Odd Bunny
 - 80 urovney v 4 unikalnykh mirakh.
 - Otkryvay novye chellendzhi s milymi personazhami.
 - Krasivaya grafika i kachestvennaya animatsiya.
 - Uznay, khorosho li tebe dayotsya stels!
 - Chyotkoe upravlenie, kotoroe pomozhet tebe dobitsya tseli - sest vsekh sviney!
Transistor — научно-фантастическая игра:
Transistor — nauchno-fantasticheskaya igra v zhanre Action RPG ot sozdateley Bastion, v kotoroy vam predstoit puteshestvovat po zavorazhivayushchemu futuristicheskomu gorodu, zashchishchaya svoyu zhizn pri pomoshchi neveroyatnogo oruzhiya neizvestnogo proiskhozhdeniya. Transistor organichno sochetaet tshchatelnoe strategicheskoe planirovanie i dinamichnye boevye stolknoveniya, produmannyy igrovoy protsess i uvlekatelnyy atmosfernyy syuzhet. Po mere razvitiya sobytiy vam predstoit sobrat golovolomku Tranzistora iz razroznennykh fragmentov, presleduya byvshikh vladeltsev etogo oruzhiya.

Klyuchevye osobennosti

Unikalnyy mir ot komandy sozdateley Bastion
Nastroyka moshchnykh vozmozhnostey Tranzistora s pomoshchyu tysyach vozmozhnykh kombinatsiy Funktsiy
Dinamichnye boevye stolknoveniya v realnom vremeni i rezhim tshchatelnogo strategicheskogo planirovaniya
Originalnoe muzykalnoe soprovozhdenie menyaetsya po khodu igry
Zakadrovoe zvukovoe soprovozhdenie na protyazhenii vsey igry sozdaet masshtabnuyu i atmosfernuyu istoriyu
Rezhim povtornogo prokhozhdeniya, dostupnyy posle zaversheniya istorii, vklyuchaet protsedurnuyu generatsiyu boya i novye kombinatsii Funktsiy
From gameplay to visuals to music and im:
From gameplay to visuals to music and imagination, BIT.TRIP BEAT is inspired by classic games in every way. Get sucked into a whole new world of sights and sounds as you juggle beats and ride the vibe in this modern look at the beginning of it all.
Originally released for the Nintendo Wii™ in 2009, BIT.TRIP BEAT makes its triumphant return to Nintendo platforms.

- Brain-melting visuals!

Train Station Simulator is a station bui:
Train Station Simulator is a station builder and manager game. Be a creative engineer by planning flooring tiles, building walls and creating emergency routes. Install ticketing machines, monitors, appliances, place benches and dozens of other public space related objects. Hire your staff for a more reliable operating ecosystem. The demand for rail travel is evident: setup the complete timetable for your central station and deploy all local and national bus, tram and taxi connections. Ride the rails and operate your ultimate grand central empire!

Full game interface supported in the following languages: 
* English

* 63+ different objects to place
* 30+ types of trains, locomotives, engines and carriages
* 25+ different staff members in 5 settable categories and an extra 2 categories of shoe-shiners and shop assistants (assistants are part of each cafes and restaurants by default)
* 24+ types of passengers including vandal persons and homeless persons and disabled persons
* 25 different cars from the 70s and 90s and bicycles
* 16+ types of shops/restaurants and other facilities to place

*  5 flooring
*  4 platform types

Hire your staff and manage salaries and working shifts:
Keep your station clean of debris, secure all areas by police officers and never ran a train off the track by employing system engineers. Hire your staff for a more reliable operation. A cleaner station makes passengers happy that increases income.

Deliver more tracks and manage all schedules:
As time flies by your terminal hub starts to expand. Set up restaurants, bars and cafés and allow them to grow and bloom into successful businesses. Open up new building wings and connect all areas with corridors so passengers can easily access all spaces.

Select from campaign modes to endless game play
Train Station Simulator will be shipping with over 25 uniquely designed game modes ready to be played not only for days but weeks and months. The game includes "Campaign", "Ready", "Mission", "Survival" and "Endless" play modes.

Rampage Knights is a cooperative beat 'e:
Rampage Knights is a cooperative beat 'em up game mixed up with randomized dungeon crawling and exploration which you can play alone or with a friend.

You play as a hero trapped by a spell in a magical forest. All paths lead you to a nearby ruined castle, infested with goblins, skeletons and other foul creatures. Gear up with awesome and ridiculous weapons and spells and descend into the deep labyrinth below the ruin to face its sinister master!

Try to get as far as possible in a dungeon with randomized items, spells, traps and encounters. Your hero is upgraded along the way (both visually and gameplay-wise) as you find better weapons, items, magic powers and fight harder and harder monsters.

The main features:
- Frenetic action
- Singleplayer campaign or local co-op for two players
- Randomly generated environments with rogue-like elements
- Hero visually evolving with new abilities
- Dozens of spells and weapons with game changing properties
- Long term progress with new classes and features to unlock
- Mighty foot included!

So what do you say? Are you ready to start the rampage?
Комедийная ролевая игра в нарочито японс:
Komediynaya rolevaya igra v narochito yaponskom stile, vdokhnovlennaya vsem izvestnymi igrami so strategicheskimi poshagovymi boyami, geroyami i shtab-kvartiroy — v sobstvennom zamke!..
Prisoedinyaytes k Khikari, ozornoy i bezzabotnoy devushke, izuchayushchey magiyu v etom absurdnom priklyuchenii, podruzhites s desyatkom druzey, chtoby v itoge vosstanovit mir Bestannii!
Правьте ночью! Управляйте самым глубоким:
Pravte nochyu! Upravlyayte samym glubokim i temnym boevym iskusstvom, kogda-libo vidennym prezhde. Srazhaytes 21-im unikalnym personazhem, vklyuchaya sovershenno novogo s originalnymi dvizheniyami, istoriey, stsenoy i muzykoy. Vy stanete masterom razrushitelnykh kombo i oslepitelnykh spetsialnykh atak v rezhimakh arkady, istorii i obucheniya. Komanduyte boytsami s razlichnymi metodami drak, demonstriruya bolee 12 000 potryasayushchikh kadrov animatsii!
Sovershenstvuyte svoy boevoy stil s pomoshchyu pochti 1000 nastroek balansa personazha!..
Deystvie igry razvorachivaetsya v vymyshlennom sovremennom XXI veke. Yavlenie Poloy nochi okhvatyvaet otdelnye rayony odin raz v mesyats v techenie neskolkikh stoletiy. Kazhdaya oblast, okhvachennaya Poloy nochyu, okruzhena tenepodobnymi sushchestvami, nazyvaemymi Pustotami, kotorye ispolzuyut i pitayutsya siloy, izvestnoy kak «Sushchestvovanie». Normalnye lyudi ne mogut videt ili vstupat v kontakt s Pustotami, no nekotorye vsyo zhe mogut ikh vosprinimat..Vtoruyu chast, «UNDER NIGHT IN-BIRTH II Sys:Celes» sm. tut.
Эротический карточный рогалик-декбилдер:
Eroticheskiy kartochnyy rogalik-dekbilder — imenno to, chto vam nuzhno!.. Sozdayte kolodu, kotoraya spaset ves Tokio: razrabatyvayte strategiyu, chtoby pobedit vragov, stoyashchikh na vashem puti, i prodvigaytes po masshtabnoy karte mira. Soberite svoyu kolodu i ispolzuyte eyo, chtoby zashchitit gorod ot vtorzheniya Podzemnogo mira!
Tolko izbrannye devushki mogut protivostoyat razrazivsheysya Anomalii. Dnyom oni vedut obychnuyu zhizn starsheklassnits; a nochyu oni otpravlyayutsya v Podzemnyy mir kak voitelnitsy, srazhayas s monstrami.
Chtoby zapechatat Podzemnyy mir, neobkhodimo vytashchit Proklyatyy Mech, istochnik ego sily, chtoby ochistit skvernu. Sleduyte instruktsiyam Artezii, chtoby ostanovit vtorzhenie sil zla.
PAN-PAN is an open plain adventure that:
PAN-PAN is an open plain adventure that expands on the concept of environmental narrative storytelling with puzzle solving and exploration elements at its core. 

Set against a backdrop of soothing ambient sounds crafted by renowned sound composer Simon Viklund, your task is to fix your downed spaceship and begin the pilgrimage home. 

In a world littered with world shifting riddles and sprinkled with the memorable characters - how you solve these riddles is firmly in your hands. 

Main features:

Set in an open world: Unlock new areas by collecting items and solving puzzles.
Stellar soundtrack created by acclaimed sound producer – Simon Viklund.
A balanced blend of exploration and puzzle solving game mechanics.
Story beats told through environmental interactions.
Use a mix of tools, gadgets and devices to solve puzzles and uncover the path home.
«Черная книга» - слияние карточной RPG и:
«Chernaya kniga» - sliyanie kartochnoy RPG i klassicheskoy priklyuchencheskoy igry. V tsentre syuzheta - rasskaz o molodoy koldune, boryushcheysya za spasenie svoego pogibshego vozlyublennogo. Pogruzites v zagadochnyy mir russkikh skazok - i raskroyte tayny, skryvayushchiesya vo tme.

Yunoy krestyanke Vasilise sudboy prednachertano stat kolduney. Idya naperekor svoey uchasti, ona reshaet brosit koldovstvo i obvenchatsya so svoim vozlyublennym. No ee mechtam ne suzhdeno sbytsya - kak uznala Vasilisa, kogda ee suzhenyy tragicheski pogibaet pri neizvestnykh obstoyatelstvakh.

Ne zhelaya smiritsya s utratoy, Vasilisa obretaet Chernuyu Knigu - drevniy artefakt, kotoryy, esli verit mifam, nastolko silen, chto ispolnit lyuboe zhelanie togo khrabretsa, chto otkroet vse 7 pechatey Knigi.

Otpravtes v polnoe tayn priklyuchenie po derevnyam i selam Rossii! Vyruchayte otchayavshikhsya krestyan, izgonyayte besov i nechistuyu silu, i smelo stoyte protiv sil Tmy.

- Otkroyte pechati Chernoy Knigi
Sobirayte zaklinaniya i otkryvayte novye navyki po mere prodvizheniya po igre.
- Istoricheskoe priklyuchenie
Rasputyvayte tainstvennye istorii i razgadyvayte zagadki, chtoby uznat bolshe o Rossii proshlogo.
- Vozglavte stayu besov
No osteregaytes — esli vy ne naydete, chem ikh zanyat, prazdnye demony nachnut muchat samu Vasilisu!
- Mify i legendy
Issleduyte mir, osnovannyy na severnoy russkoy mifologii. Poznavayte novoe pri pomoshchi vnutriigrovoy entsiklopedii, sozdannoy s pomoshchyu opytnykh antropologov - i naydite vse narodnye skazki, spryatannye v igre!
Crazy adventures of YouTube legend Boris:
Crazy adventures of YouTube legend Boris await!

Jump into the hilarious world of YouTube personality Boris the Slav King in the official game of Life of Boris! In Super Slav you will learn about the life of the Slav phenomenon Boris and his adventures. Meet his unique family such as cousin Anatoli and babushka, or his neighbour Vadim, and find out what it means to be Cheeki Breeki!

Features

• EXPERIENCE a true Slav life with one and only Boris. He will show you the true way!
• COMPETE with other Slavs in SlavOlympics. Show the gopniks how much mayonez you can intake.
• COLLECT all of the Boris’ favorite HardBass hits from Uamee, Gopnik McBlyat and DJ Blyatman.
• LEARN special recipes from Boris’ babushka’s kitchen.
• CUSTOMIZE Boris’ appearance with specially made balaclavas.
• DISCOVER all the possible endings of Boris’ adventures. Some may let you continue, some will leave you scratching your head.
The cult classic Zombies Ate My Neighbor:
The cult classic Zombies Ate My Neighbors and its sequel make their long awaited return in Zombies Ate My Neighbors and Ghoul Patrol! Play these classics from the golden age of 16-bit gaming with new enhancements and never before seen museum features.
 
Zombies Ate My Neighbors
Hey, where's that scary music coming from? Yikes! It's Zombies Ate My Neighbors, where you appear in every demented horror flick ever to make you hurl ju-jubes.
 
What are Zeke and Julie, our two wholesome teenage stars doing in a 16-bit game like this?! Trying to save the nice neighbors, cheerleaders and babies from a fate worse than polyester!
 
Who could put this SLICE of suburbia in such goose-pimply hysteria? Zombies, relentless Chainsaw Maniacs, Mummies, Evil Dolls that just won't die, Lizard Men, Blobs, Vampires, Giant Ants, Martians and more.
 
Will these crazy kids survive the night? Find your way through 55 horror-filled levels like a grocery store gone bad, a shopping mall awry, a mysterious island and your own back yard. Don't miss "Weird Kids on the Block", "Mars Needs Cheerleaders" and "Dances With Werewolves".
 
You can fend off the freaks with a virtual candy counter of weapons like uzi squirt guns, exploding soda pop, bazookas, weed wackers and ancient artifacts. Also grab power ups-o-rama like secret potions and bobo clown decoys. Does this game ever end?!
 
Ghoul Patrol
Zeke and Julie, our intrepid teenagers, visit the Ghosts and Ghouls exhibit at the city library, where they find an old treasure chest containing an ancient spirit book. Naturally, they cannot resist reading it. Suddenly, a horrific snaggle-toothed spirit emerges.

Now, this snarling phantom and his dastardly minions are infesting Metropolis and slithering their way into the history books, where they plan to rewrite history with their spooky ways. Only you have the power to go back in time to de-spook an encyclopedia of zombified historic dudes.

Terminate, with prejudice, using crossbows, ping-pong ball machine guns, Martian "Heatseeker" guns, and more.

Vaporize garbage can ghosts and ninja spirits, rescue bug-eyed librarians and wigged-out pirates, dodge flying books and adolescent-eating plants!

Only our two heroes have the power to get the mighty beastly spirit back into his book and stop the madness. Ghoul Patrol to the rescue!


NEW FEATURES
•	Save Feature: Quickly save your progress in either game and continue your adventure wherever and whenever you want
•	Museum Features: Watch a video interview with one of the original Zombies' developers or explore numerous galleries containing game art, previously unreleased concept images and marketing assets
•	2 Player Mode: Play the game with two player local co-op
•	Achievements: Track your game progress with a set of achievements covering both games

Eden's Last Sunrise is a retro tactical:
Eden's Last Sunrise is a retro tactical RPG like no other. Choose between the magic-wielding surface dwellers or the high-tech spacefarers, train and befriend your troops, and choose your path as the final days of the world wind down. 

-Enjoy classic turn-based isometric tactical RPG combat with adjustable difficulty and a unique action point system that let you make the most of every turn.
-A rich story full of colourful characters and multiple story paths and endings.
-Engage with your allies personally through visual novel-like story skits. Gain their trust and unlock their personal stories as you grow closer.
-Create custom units, choose their colours/costume/voices, and lead them to victory alongside the main cast.
MX Nitro: Unleashed приглашает вас погру: MX Nitro: Unleashed priglashaet vas pogruzitsya v gonochnuyu nirvanu! Pronesis skvoz novyy gorod na zapredelnoy skorosti. Vypolni v vozdukhe 55 smertelno opasnykh tryukov, chtoby popolnit zapas Nitro v vashikh bitvakh s novymi khardkornymi bossami. Poprobuy novye ili uzhe znakomye urovni, zapolnennye rampami i prepyatstviyami. MX Nitro: Unleashed dopolnyaet originalnuyu igru novymi trekami, bossami i skinami. Igra takzhe vklyuchaet v sebya neskolko uluchsheniy, v tom chisle apgreyd vizualnykh effektov, i novyy uroven slozhnosti.
Ultracore - 16-битная игра в жанре «беги:
Ultracore - 16-bitnaya igra v zhanre «begi i strelyay», nastoyashchee lyubovnoe poslanie k klassicheskim  dvukhmernym shuteram so slozhnym dizaynom, mnogochislennymi sekretami i mnozhestvom protivnikov srednego i finalnogo urovnya.
Igra byla razrabotana v 90-kh godakh legendarnoy kompaniey Digital Illusions! Iznachalno predpolagalos, chto igra budet nazyvatsya Hardcore, no v posledniy moment reshenie bylo izmeneno.

- Potryasayushchaya uskorennaya obrabotka igrovogo protsessa
- 5 dlitelnykh urovney s prokhozhdeniem v borbe s protivnikami
- sobirayte novoe oruzhie i povyshayte ego uroven
- Tvin-stik shuter
- Dopolnitelnyy novyy sintveyv saundtrek 

Spustya dolgikh 25 let, kogda  iskhodnye dannye videoigry  prosto vosstanavlivayut so starogo zhestkogo diska i portiruyut ikh dlya vosproizvedeniya na sovremennoy platforme, my rady predstavit vam rezultaty usiliy po sokhraneniyu nashego obshchego naslediya videoigr.

Ne tolko idealnoe kachestvo video v igrakh , predlagayushchikh razvlechenie dlya uma i dushi, no i bolshoe raznoobrazie ekshn-syuzhetov vyvodyat klassicheskie 16-bitnye igry v zhanre «begi i strelyay» na novyy uroven interesa publiki, predlagaya ey dazhe nechto bolshee.  Eto ULTRACORE!
Аркада нового поколения\nSkybolt Zack —:
Arkada novogo pokoleniya
Skybolt Zack — eto unikalnoe sochetanie platformera s mekhanikoy sovmeshcheniya tsvetov. 

Napravlyayte Zaka i ispolzuyte ego raketnye udary, ryvok, vozmozhnost pritselivatsya, menyat napravlenie i unichtozhayte vragov. Igra mozhet predlozhit gorazdo bolshe, chem mozhno uvidet na pervyy vzglyad, sleduya pri etom formule: «legko nauchitsya, no slozhno osvoit».

Eto platformer, gde nelzya prygat, i muzykalnaya igra, gde vy sami zadaete ritm. Takogo eshche ne bylo!

Osobennosti
●	48 bezumno slozhnykh urovney, kotorye mozhno proyti, ni razu ne stupiv na zemlyu.
●	Marshruty raznoy slozhnosti.
●	Bolee 15 okruzheniy v 5 mirakh.
●	Vizualnyy stil, sochetayushchiy 3D-grafiku i risovannye tekstury so mnozhestvom spetseffektov i vzryvov!
●	Progressiruyushchiy saundtrek, sozdannyy pod vdokhnoveniem izvestnykh platformerov 90-kh.
●	Desyatki vrazheskikh robotov, sozdayushchie nepovtorimye ispytaniya.
●	Igrovye rezhimy na luchshee vremya i luchshiy schet.
●	2 raznykh reytinga na kazhdom urovne: na luchshiy schet i luchshee vremya.
●	Nastraivaemoe upravlenie i osobye vozmozhnosti dlya daltonikov.
●	Nikakikh skuchnykh dialogov! (Vy by ikh i tak propustili...).

Raznye marshruty
Nakhodite raznye sposoby proyti uroven — igrayte v Skybolt Zack snova i snova!

Zdes net urovney slozhnosti: bolee legkie marshruty podoydut novichkam, no tolko samye luchshie igroki smogut proyti zamyslovatymi marshrutami i otkryt samye trudnye urovni!

Rezhim superigry
Pomimo osnovnogo syuzheta v Skybolt Zack est dva dopolnitelnykh igrovykh rezhima — ispytanie dlya osobo azartnykh igrokov!
 ‎
Rezhim «Ataka na vremya»— dlya tekh, kto khochet proyti uroven kak mozhno bystree. Na pomoshch pridut osobye instrumenty, pozvolyayushchie uskoritsya.
Rezhim «Ataka na ochki» podkhodit tem, kto khochet nabrat kak mozhno bolshe ochkov.

Reytingi
Chtoby poluchat ochki ili proyti uroven kak mozhno skoree, nuzhny raznye strategii. V Skybolt Zack 2 mirovykh reytinga: na luchshiy schet i na luchshee vremya. Ispytayte sebya!
Synopsis\nСлим-сан занимался своими дела:
Synopsis
Slim-san zanimalsya svoimi delami, slizko polzaya po tikhomu lesu, kak vdrug... Otkuda ni vozmis poyavilsya gigantskiy cherv i proglotil ego! Slim-san okazalsya v utrobe chervya, i teper emu nado prinyat reshenie. Otdatsya sudbe i rastvoritsya v nadvigayushcheysya stene zheludochnogo soka... Ili vybratsya iz chervya na svobodu, slizko prygaya i skolzya po ego kishkam obratno ko rtu.

Features
- Neveroyatno bystryy i sudorozhno sumasshedshiy platformer!
- Net vremeni stoyat na meste, ved za kazhdym uglom tebya podzhidaet stena zheludochnogo soka! Begi, begi, begi!
- Slim-san ves takoy slizkiy, i v etom est svoi preimushchestva. Proskalzyvay skvoz treshchiny v stenakh i drugikh poverkhnostyakh!
- Proryvaysya skvoz khrupkie prepyatstviya i napryazhennye situatsii, vypolnyaya skorostnye ryvki.
- Skolzi, chtoby zamedlit vremya, ili rvis vpered, chtoby uskorit ego.
- Igra do kraev polna kontentom: 100 urovney iz 400 komnat vdobavok k 100 urovnyam v rezhime "Novaya Igra+", a eto znachit, chto tebe predlagaetsya neveroyatnye 200 urovney i azh 800 komnat!
