Трансильвания, Румыния, 1451 год. Армия:
Transilvaniya, Rumyniya, 1451 god. Armiya Drakuly prodolzhaet rasprostranyatsya po Karpatam, stanovyas silnee s kazhdoy zhertvoy, kotoruyu ona zabiraet. Tekh, kto pytaetsya soprotivlyatsya, zhdet odna uchast — i ona khuzhe smerti. Esli Drakulu ne ostanovit, on prineset v mir vechnuyu noch!
Lish dva otvazhnykh geroya brosayut vyzovu zlu i khotyat unichtozhit ego istochnik — voin-monakh Abbat Dorin i vampir-piromant, Irina Drakul.
V khode prokhozhdeniya srazites s raznoobraznymi vidami vragov, vklyuchaya zombi, vampirov, oborotney, prizrakov, demonov — i ne tolko!
TRIANGLE STRATEGY — новая тактическая ро:
TRIANGLE STRATEGY — novaya takticheskaya rolevaya igra ot Square Enix, kotoraya vyydet na Nintendo Switch v 2022 godu.
V roli Serenoa, naslednogo printsa korolevstva Glenbruk, komanduyte otryadom voinov. Vy okazhetes vtyanuty v pautinu intrig i zagovorov, a ot vashikh resheniy budet zaviset sudba korolevstva. Klyuchevye resheniya vliyayut na tri ubezhdeniya: moral, svobodu i polzu. Imenno oni formiruyut zhiznennye vzglyady Serenoa i povliyayut na razvitie syuzheta. Pri prinyatii poistine sudbonosnykh resheniy mnozhestvo personazhey golosuyut na Vesakh ubezhdeniy. V takie momenty privlechennye vami soyuzniki i prinyatye vami resheniya mogut opredelit sudbu tselykh natsiy i vsego kontinenta.
Vybor luchshey pozitsii mozhet sklonit khod boya v vashu polzu. Razmeshchayte otryady na vozvyshennosti, chtoby poluchit takticheskoe preimushchestvo i uvelichit dalnost atak. Vy takzhe mozhete okruzhat vragov s dvukh storon i nanosit im s tyla sereznyy uron. Krome togo, kombinatsii atak mogut vnesti sushchestvennyy vklad v pobedu. Naprimer, rasplavte led ognem, a zatem udarte v eto mesto molniey. Teper ostaetsya lish podtolknut tuda vraga, chtoby u nego iskry iz glaz posypalis.
Vedite strategicheskie boi na mnogourovnevykh lokatsiyakh — i vyigryvayte!..Octopath Traveler sm. zdes.
Katana ZERO представляет из себя ураганн:
Katana ZERO predstavlyaet iz sebya uragannyy neonuarnyy ekshn-platformer s mgnovennoy smertyu. Rubite, uvorachivaytes i upravlyayte vremenem, razgadyvaya sekrety sobstvennogo proshlogo.

Neveroyatnaya boevaya sistema: K kazhdomu vragu nuzhen svoy podkhod. Otrazhayte puli, uvorachivaytes ot udarov, zamanivayte protivnikov v lovushku — i ne ostavlyayte svideteley.

Adaptiruytes pod situatsiyu: Kazhdyy uroven mozhno proyti dobroy dyuzhinoy raznykh sposobov. Unichtozhayte vragov tak, kak sochtete nuzhnym.

Neobychnoe povestvovanie: Zaputannaya istoriya s postoyannymi neozhidannymi povorotami organichno vpletena v igrovoy protsess.
Метроидвания, которая с первых же минут:
Metroidvaniya, kotoraya s pervykh zhe minut udivlyaet i porazhaet. Eyo tsel — zastavit vas vyyti za ramki privychnogo, a nelineynost prokhozhdeniya — ne prosto marketingovyy khod, a neotemlemaya chast geympleya.
Syuzhet razvorachivaetsya vokrug protivostoyaniya prirody i zhestokogo industrializma. Glavnaya geroinya, Alruna, — molodaya i energichnaya driada, kotoraya predstavlyaet sily prirody, boryushchiesya za vyzhivanie protiv bezdushnykh mashin i korporatsiy, olitsetvoryayushchikh neumolimuyu ekspluatatsiyu i razrushenie okruzhayushchey sredy. Eto protivostoyanie ne prosto abstraktnaya ideya — ono materializuetsya v chetyryokh razlichnykh mirakh, kazhdyy iz kotorykh predstavlyaet soboy spets. biom, porazhyonnyy vliyaniem nekro-industrialistov. My vidim ne prosto bezdushnye fabriki i zavody — eto tselye ekosistemy, iskazhyonnye tekhnologiyami, gde priroda mutirovala i stala vrazhdebnoy, a mashiny ozhili i stali groznymi vragami.
Dizayn urovney otrazhaet etot konflikt. Igrok puteshestvuet cherez zavorazhivayushchie, no v to zhe vremya mrachnye i opasnye lokatsii — ot zarosshikh ruin do grotesknykh industrialnykh kompleksov. V kazhdom meste chuditsya ekho proshlogo, rasskazyvayushchee o borbe prirody i tekhnologiy. Eto ne prosto krasivye fony — oni igrayut vazhnuyu rol v rasskazyvanii istorii i pogruzhenii v atmosferu.
Muzyka v nashey igre imeet vazhnuyu rol v sozdanii atmosfery. Stil retro-sinteza s grubymi zvukami i gnetushchimi melodiyami podchyorkivaet mrachnuyu atmosferu i bezzhalostnost mira.
Eto — proekt dlya tekh, kto ne boitsya vyzova i gotov issledovat i nestandartnye mekhaniki, i istorii..
Много лет назад человечество выиграло на: Mnogo let nazad chelovechestvo vyigralo nashu pervuyu zhestokuyu bitvu s ordami inoplanetyan. No zlobnye zhuki nanosyat otvetnyy udar — seyut dozhd smerti s nashikh nebes i zaryvayutsya u nas pod nogami. My dolzhny protivostoyat etomu vragu. Ispolzuyte pererabotannoe inoplanetnoe oruzhie, chtoby pobedit ikh. Vyberite svoy klass soldat i obedinites s drugimi. Upravlyayte moguchimi boevymi mashinami ili moshchnymi reaktivnymi rantsami v boyu. Radi nashey strany i nashego mira vy dolzhny unichtozhit etikh nasekomykh!Eshchyo igry Earth Defense Force
Путешествуйте по острову в старом поезде:
Puteshestvuyte po ostrovu v starom poezde, periodicheski uluchshayte ego i ispolzuyte dlya borby so zlym paukom po imeni ChARLZ!
Zaputannye puti mogut legko sbit tebya s tolku, tak chto tshchatelno planiruy kazhduyu vylazku. Staraysya ne khodit po dolgu peshkom i bystro pereklyuchat strelku: Charlz mozhet podzhidat tebya za blizhayshim derevom.
Animal Crossing: Pocket Camp (с англ. —:
Animal Crossing: Pocket Camp (s angl. — «Perekryostok Zhivotnykh: Karmannyy Lager») — iznachalno uslovno-besplatnaya mobilnaya, pozzhe stavshaya polnotsennoy odinochnoy igroy bez vnutriigrovykh pokupok — simulyator zhizni, razrabotannaya NDcube i izdannaya Nintendo dlya mobilnykh ustroystv na baze iOS i Android. Pocket Camp razrabatyvalas parallelno s neskolkimi drugimi mobilnymi igrami ot Nintendo — naprimer Super Mario Run. Togda yaponskaya kompaniya khotela vyyti na mobilnyy igrovoy rynok. V Pocket Camp trebuetsya upravlyat personazhem-chelovekom v mire, naselyonnom antropomorfnymi zhivotnymi. On mozhet sobirat prirodnye resursy, lovit zhivnost, obshchatsya s zhivotnymi. Osnovnoe otlichie ot osnovnoy lineyki igr Animal Crossing — mesto obitaniya. Igrovoy personazh popadaet v kemping i dolzhen vypolnyat prosby zhivotnykh-posetiteley. V otlichie ot osnovnoy serii igr, geympley v Pocket Camp lineen, a igrovoy protsess zavisit ot togo, vypolnit li igrok postavlennye zadachi.
Srazu posle vykhoda, Pocket Camp stala odnoy iz samykh skachivaemykh igr na iOS i Android i populyarnykh mobilnykh igr v Yaponii. Pocket Camp zanimaet vtoroe mesto po dokhodnosti sredi uslovno besplatnykh igr ot Nintendo. Takoy uspekh obuslovlen prezhde vsego populyarnostyu franshizy Animal Crossing i dostupnostyu Pocket Camp, kak uslovno besplatnoy mobilnoy igry.
22 avgusta 2024 goda bylo obyavleno o skorom zakrytii serverov igry i razrabotke platnoy avtonomnoy versii na zamenu. 28 oktyabrya 2024 goda, nakanune zakrytiya serverov igry, byla obyavlena data vypuska platnoy avtonomnoy versii igry Animal Crossing: Pocket Camp Complete — 3 dekabrya 2024 goda. Bylo takzhe obyavleno, chto vse uspekhi i dostizheniya v originalnoy Pocket Camp v techenie ogranichennogo vremeni mozhno budet perenesti v platnuyu igru pri nalichii privyazki k akkauntu Nintendo. Iz igry byli udaleny mikrotranzaktsii, platnaya podpiska, rynok, podarki i vozmozhnosti poseshchat kempingi drugikh igrokov. Byla dobavlena lokatsiya «Svistyashchiy pereval» (Whistle Pass). V razdache nakhoditsya eta, poslednyaya, Complete-versiya igry.
Давайте выберемся из ада, войдя в свой р:
Davayte vyberemsya iz ada, voydya v svoy ritm!
Eto prostaya dlya osvoeniya yaponskaya ritmicheskaya muzykalnaya igra, v kotoroy vy smozhete igrat za kazhdogo iz strannykh personazhey, naselyayushchikh krugi ada, poskolku vse oni podchinyayutsya ritmu neobychnoy muzyki..
The Way Remastered — это история космиче:
The Way Remastered — eto istoriya kosmicheskogo issledovatelya, kotoryy poteryal svoyu vozlyublennuyu i ne mozhet smiritsya s eyo smertyu. Vo vremya odnoy iz ekspeditsiy on obnaruzhivaet drevnie pisaniya, v kotorykh skryty tayny vechnoy zhizni. V nadezhde vernut svoyu lyubimuyu on vozvrashchaetsya na chuzhuyu planetu. On eshchyo ne znaet, skolko tayn i opasnostey ego zhdyot.

Platformer-golovolomka s uvlekatelnym syuzhetom, potryasayushchey grafikoy i muzykoy ot Panu Talus.

Glavnye osobennosti:
- Pogruzites v prorabotannyy do melochey mir — vas zhdut 200 igrovykh zon, zapolnennykh predstavitelyami inoplanetnoy flory i fauny. 
- Oshchutite napryazhenie i pritok adrenalina — eta zakhvatyvayushchaya priklyuchencheskaya igra staroy zakalki ne raz poshchekochet vam nervy.
- Raskroyte vse zagadki chuzhoy planety i nasladites uvlekatelnym syuzhetom, krasivoy kartinkoy i atmosfernoy muzykoy.
- Zadeystvuyte svoi novye sposobnosti, chtoby preodolevat prepyatstviya i reshat slozhnye golovolomki.

Glavnye novovvedeniya v obnovlyonnoy versii:
- Ozvuchenie
- Uluchshennaya grafika
- Podderzhka vibrosistemy HD Rumble
- Muzykalnyy proigryvatel
- Izmeneniya v igrovom protsesse i dizayne urovney na osnove otzyvov igrokov
Чтобы сыграть в 12 orbits, не нужно гото:
Chtoby sygrat v 12 orbits, ne nuzhno gotovitsya ili pokupat lishnie kontrollery. Levyy i pravyy Joy-Con™ (ili dazhe odin tolko sensornyy ekran) — vot i vsyo, chto ponadobitsya dlya lyubogo chisla igrokov. Razve chto potesnitsya pridetsya.

12 orbits — yarkaya, veselaya i inogda slegka sumatoshnaya igra. Vy budete zabivat goly, krasit sfery, zashchishchat territoriyu i otrashchivat khvost v 4 igrovykh rezhimakh, kazhdyy za sebya ili po komandam.

Nauchitsya igrat mozhno pochti momentalno, ved zdes prostye pravila i vsego po odnoy knopke na igroka. Dazhe partiyu na 12 igrokov mozhno sozdat i nastroit bukvalno za neskolko sekund. A poskolku kazhdyy raund obychno idet ne dolshe 5 minut, to nayti vremya na raund-drugoy mozhno vsegda!

Osobennosti igry:
◦ Mozhno igrat vsem srazu na odnom ustroystve. Gde ugodno. Kogda ugodno.
◦ 4 rezhima igry, 1 na 1 ili po komandam.
◦ 20 kart i 5 modifikatorov.
◦ Bystraya nastroyka partii dazhe dlya 12 igrokov.
◦ Prostaya i bystraya v osvoenii bazovaya mekhanika.
◦ ... no chem dolshe vy igraete, tem bolshe taktik i vozmozhnostey otkryvaete dlya sebya.
◦ Rezhim dlya daltonikov, chtoby poigrat mogli vse.
Одиночная покерная видеоигра, разработан:
Odinochnaya pokernaya videoigra, razrabotannaya kompaniey Telltale Games. V ney uchastvuyut chetyre personazha: Tikho iz komiksa Penny Arcade, Maks iz franshizy Sam & Max, Pulemyotchik Khevi iz Team Fortress 2, i Strong Bed iz Homestar Runner.
«The Inventory» — eto super-sekretnyy klub, postroennyy pod skladom dlya khraneniya videoigr. On byl sozdan v 1919 godu, posle togo, kak gruppa podklyuchennykh igrokov priobrela pervyy proekt 18-y popravki. Bylo obnaruzheno, chto ona mozhet ne tolko zapreshchat vozliyanie, no i razvlecheniya, kotorye mogut snizit proizvoditelnost natsionalnoy rabochey sily. Klub sushchestvuet s tekh por v tayne, na sluchay, esli Kongress popytaetsya ustanovit zapret v zakone. Vpervye vas privetstvuet Redzhinald Van Uinslou, byvshiy kapitan Krichashchego Narvala, i pomoshchnik Gaybrasha Tripvuda v Tales of Monkey Island. On obyasnyaet predystoriyu inventarya i podnimaet blayndy.
Simulyator tekhasskogo kholdema mezhdu igrokom kak nevidimym uchastnikom i chetyrmya drugimi personazhami. Kazhdyy igrok nachinaet s bay-inom v $10,000 i ostaetsya do tekh por, poka ne razoritsya, tsel igroka — ostatsya poslednim. Tut ispolzuyutsya stavki bez ogranicheniy i postepenno uvelichivayushchiesya slepye stavki v techenie neskolkikh raundov. Sluchayno odin iz chetyrekh personazhey ne smozhet poluchit dengi, no predlozhit odno iz svoikh vladeniy v kachestve bay-ina. Telltale otslezhivaet statistiku v techenie neskolkikh igr, i, vypolniv opredelennye tseli, naprimer, kolichestvo ruk ili vyigrannykh igr mozhno razblokirovat razlichnye karty i risunki stola, chtoby nastroit vneshniy vid.
SAMURAI WARRIORS: новое начало!\n7 лет о:
SAMURAI WARRIORS: novoe nachalo!
7 let ozhidaniya proshli ne zrya! Vstrechayte novuyu chast serii takticheskikh boevikov SAMURAI WARRIORS!

Igrokam predstoit vnov pogruzitsya v istoricheskuyu epokhu samoy pervoy igry SAMURAI WARRIORS, kotoraya vyshla v 2004 g.
Pomimo razitelnogo uluchsheniya vneshnego vida igry, novykh ofitserov i pererabotannykh boevykh priemov, vas zhdet eshche bolee zakhvatyvayushchaya istoriya voyuyushchikh provintsiy.
Eta chast povestvuet o zhizni ofitserov Ody Nabunagi i Akechi Mitsukhide, podrobno i zhivo peredavaya atmosferu perioda Sengoku s momenta okonchaniya Smuty godov Onin do Intsidenta v khrame Khonno-dzi. Igra takzhe znamenuet soboy nachalo novoy serii, v kotoroy polnostyu peresmotreny istorii i personazhi SAMURAI WARRIORS.

Osobennosti SAMURAI WARRIORS 5
■Igra vklyuchaet 27 voinov-samuraev.
Molodoy Oda Nobunaga, izvestnyy po klichke «bolshoy durak iz Ovari», i Imagava Eshimoto priobreli novyy vneshniy vid, sootvetstvuyushchiy istoricheskomu periodu igry.
Takzhe k bitve prisoedinyatsya novye personazhi, takie kak Sayto Toshimittsu, vassal Akechi Mitsukhide, i Koga nindzya Mitsuki. Sudby 27-mi geroev perepletutsya v slozhnoy i polnoy napryazheniya istorii perioda Sengoku.

■Boevye priemy WARRIORS stali eshche bolee vpechatlyayushchimi.
V etoy chasti igroki vnov smogut nasladitsya vizitnoy kartochkoy serii WARRIORS: kogda ot udarov vragi razletayutsya v raznye storony.
Bitvy WARRIORS zakhvatyvayut dukh blagodarya novym priemam i vizualnoy peredache atmosfery istoricheskoy Yaponii.
Кроссовер Gundam Wing, Gundam Seed, Gund:
Krossover Gundam Wing, Gundam Seed, Gundam 00, i Gundam Iron-Blooded Orphans.

Vas zhdut unikalnye dizayn, atmosfera i geympley znamenitoy serii igr, a takzhe mnozhestvo strategicheskikh elementov. Soberite svoy otryad i otpravte ego v boy!..Drugie Gundam na Switch.
Kine — это трехмерный платформер-головол: Kine — eto trekhmernyy platformer-golovolomka pro trekh otvazhnykh robotov, mechtayushchikh stat muzykantami. Thea 2: The Shattering is a follow-up to:
Thea 2: The Shattering is a follow-up to the successful Thea: The Awakening, which brings the idea of innovative genre hybrid, with elements of turn-based, 4X strategy, survival, RPG and a card game, to entirely new and thoroughly polished level.

The player takes on the role of a deity from the Slavic mythology-inspired pantheon and as such, controls the fate of a small flock of believers struggling for survival. This goal can be achieved in many ways, from diplomacy to war, from exploring to conquering, but any playstyle will surely lead to completely unique adventures thanks to the procedurally generated environments. Rich options, from crafting to town-building system, as well as the co-op multiplayer gameplay, make Thea 2 an ideal choice for tactically minded players, who are up for a challenge.

Otpravlyaytes v 12 originalnykh lokatsiy i uznayte vse sekrety zemli Omeriki (vo mnogom skhozhey s realno sushchestvuyushchey Amerikoy, no ne tochno takoy zhe). Ambary – eto lish nachalo. Chto skazhete naschet poseshcheniya zabroshennoy voennoy bazy ili dazhe... luny?

На планете, полностью покрытой водой, ес:
Na planete, polnostyu pokrytoy vodoy, est vsego odin ostrov, tam rastet derevo Kukoo i zhivet veselyy i predpriimchivyy narodets Kukoos. Posle neudachnogo eksperimenta, v khode kotorogo Kukoos pytalis sdelat domashnikh zhivotnykh bolee poslushnymi, Kukoos dolzhny otyskat sbezhavshikh agressivnykh pitomtsev i vernut sebe kontrol, vosstanoviv garmoniyu i poryadok na nekogda bezmyatezhnom dereve Kukoo.

Puteshestvuyte po taynym miram vnutri ogromnogo dereva Kukoo, chtoby nayti svoikh druzey i polozhit konets vosstaniyu domashnikh zhivotnykh! Etot ocharovatelnyy 3D-platformer provedet vas po bolshoy krasochnoy vselennoy, v kotoroy vy smozhete upravlyat mnozhestvom pitomtsev i ispolzovat ikh sposobnosti dlya bitv s unikalnymi bossami, nakhodit spryatannye predmety kollektsionirovaniya i reshat drevnie golovolomki. Mozhno puteshestvovat v odinochku ili vmeste s druzyami, chtoby prozhit eto ne pokhozhee ni na odno vidennoe ranee priklyuchenie dlya chetyrekh igrokov!

Osnovnye kharakteristiki
• Sotrudnichestvo – vot v chyom smysl igry! Igrayte za dvenadtsat raznykh Kukoos i sozdayte komandu s pyatyu unikalnymi pitomtsami, ispolzuya ikh nepovtorimye sposobnosti dlya resheniya golovolomok i pobed nad vragami.
• Priglasite druzey otpravitsya vmeste s vami v eto puteshestvie! Igrayte v mnogopolzovatelskom rezhime do 4 igrokov, chtoby v chetyre raza uvelichit vpechatlenie ot igry!
• Zhivopisnye lokatsii. Izuchayte obshirnye, krasochnye miry, kazhdyy so svoim unikalnym biomom, kotoryy polon chudes okruzhayushchey sredy, naselen opasnymi sushchestvami i imeet svoi sekrety.
• Obayatelnyy akterskiy sostav. Puteshestvie po miram Kukoos poznakomit vas s gruppoy ocharovatelnykh i zapominayushchikhsya personazhey. Istoriya voplotitsya v zhizn na vashikh glazakh blagodarya velikolepno prorisovannoy grafike i polnostyu ozvuchennym geroyam.
• Vesele prodolzhaetsya! Vy smozhete razblokirovat dopolnitelnye urovni, sobiraya opredelennoe kolichestvo monet v kazhdom mire. Prozhivayte priklyuchenie povtorno s raznymi pitomtsami i raskryvayte novye sekrety!
Новая экшен-платформенная игра\nПрямо из:
Novaya ekshen-platformennaya igra
Pryamo iz 16-bitnoy epokhi

Igrayte za Gareta, rytsarya korolevskoy gvardii, i pobedite zlye sily Asteborga.
Izuchayte moshchnye zaklinaniya i ispolzuyte ikh, chtoby otkryt svoy put ili pobedit vragov.
Sobirayte zoloto s ostankov svoikh protivnikov i pokupayte uluchsheniya, chtoby raskryt ves svoy potentsial!
Prigotovtes k vstreche s vliyatelnymi bossami, kotorye ne dadut vam pokoya.
Lesa, gory, bolota i mnogoe drugoe — issleduyte mir Asteborga i otkroyte dlya sebya tainstvennoe proshloe Gareta...
No budte ostorozhny, Zadimus vsegda gde-to ryadom.
Добро пожаловать в Chasm, приключенчески:
Dobro pozhalovat v Chasm, priklyuchencheskiy boevik, gde nuzhno rassledovat slukhi o zakrytii korolevskoy shakhty: iz glubin prishli nekie sushchestva i pokhitili rabochikh.

Geroy otpravlyaetsya v priklyuchenie, srazhaetsya s chudovishchami, issleduet katakomby i zamki i nakhodit snaryazhenie. Syuzhet odin, no kazhdaya igra budet unikalnoy: pomeshcheniya sozdany vruchnuyu, iz nikh sostavlyaetsya karta, kotoroy ne budet ni u kogo bolshe.
Спустя сотни лет после начала межзвездно:
Spustya sotni let posle nachala mezhzvezdnoy epokhi, chelovechestvo teper zhivyot sredi dalyokikh zvezd. No oni byli daleko ne pervymi, mnogie zhivye sushchestva sushchestvovali i do nikh. S tekh por chelovechestvo proshlo cherez gornilo.
Stante kapitanom sobstvennogo zvezdoleta, sformiruyte svoyu komandu i naydite sobstvennyy put vo Vselennoy!
No vash novyy korabl — ne obychnoe yunkerskoe sudno, a odin iz poslednikh ostatkov I.E.R., stoletnego pravitelstva, kotoroe ischezlo, zabrav s soboy peredovye tekhnologii. Sudya po vsemu, etot korabl yavlyaetsya odnim iz poslednikh prototipov toy epokhi i osnashchen pochti mifologicheskoy sistemoy giperprivoda, kotoraya pozvolyaetm gnovenno peremeshchatsya mezhdu sistemami pryamo skvoz kvantovoe prostranstvo.
Sdelayte sebe zvyozdnoe imya i zaymite tsentralnoe mesto vo vselennoy etoy kosmicheskoy vizualnoy novelly!..Eshchyo vizualnykh novell na Switch (renpy).
Маленькая девочка пытается убежать от св:
Malenkaya devochka pytaetsya ubezhat ot svoikh strakhov, preodolevaya razlichnye prepyatstviya na svoem puti.

Fobia - eto slozhnaya priklyuchencheskaya igra-golovolomka, v kotoroy vam predstoit priklyuchenie v zagadochnom mire, polnom opasnykh situatsiy, vragov i slozhnykh golovolomok. Vse v igre pytaetsya vas ubit. Vse yavlyaetsya ne tem, chem kazhetsya.

Osobennosti:
- Prekrasnyy mir, gde oploshnost oznachaet smert.
- Unikalnaya i svoeobraznaya risovannaya 2D grafika i 2D animatsii.
- Bolshoe raznoobrazie golovolomok, razrabotannykh s razlichnymi urovnyami slozhnosti.
- Atmosfernoe zvukovoe oformlenie.
- Dva raznykh okonchaniya.
Оддмару никак не удается найти себя в жи:
Oddmaru nikak ne udaetsya nayti sebya v zhizni i zasluzhit svoe mesto v Valkhalle. On rastratil ves svoy potentsial i ostalnye vikingi ego plemeni prezirayut ego. Odnazhdy u nego poyavlyaetsya vozmozhnost proyavit sebya, no za vse pridetsya zaplatit...

NASLADITES epicheskoy istoriey pro vikingov, podannoy v vide animirovannogo komiksa.

IGRAYTE na 24 zhivopisnykh urovnyakh, narisovannykh vruchnuyu. Reshayte razlichnye golovolomki, postroennye na zakonakh fiziki.

OTKROYTE svoyu istinnuyu silu s magicheskim oruzhiem i shchitami.

VSTREChAYTE novykh druzey i vragov v volshebnykh lesakh, zasnezhennykh gorakh i opasnykh peshcherakh.
В этом трёхмерном ролевом боевике вам пр:
V etom tryokhmernom rolevom boevike vam predstoit stat rytsarem portalov, povyshat uroven personazha, delat groznoe oruzhie i unichtozhat vragov.

- Raznye klassy geroev.

- Ozhivlennye takticheskie boi.

- Epicheskie skhvatki s bossami.

- Znakomtes s koloritnymi zhitelyami i dazhe privodite domoy!

- V tvorcheskom rezhime mozhno bystro vozvodit UDIVITELNYE postroyki.

- Sobirayte do 3-kh druzey i uchastvuyte v mnogopolzovatelskikh komandnykh igrakh.
Cложный и странный музыкальный платформе: Clozhnyy i strannyy muzykalnyy platformer s tyazheloy elektronnoy metallicheskoy muzykoy. Vy — neizvestnoe sushchestvo, prokhodyashchee cherez adskiy mir, ritmichno dvigayas pod muzyku. Odno nevernoe dvizhenie oznachaet smert, no kontrolnye tochki vstrechayutsya chasto, i poetomu vasha smert ochen korotka.
Хватайте оружие, собирайте отряд и покаж:
Khvatayte oruzhie, sobirayte otryad i pokazhite armii, kto zdes glavnyy.
Metal Slug Tactics — svezhiy vzglyad na kultovye srazheniya serii METAL SLUG. Privedite svoy otryad k pobede, ispolzuya khitrost i ognevuyu moshch v luchshikh traditsiyakh boevikov. Ispolzuyte moshchnye spetsialnye ataki, chtoby opredelit iskhod kazhdoy skhvatki!
Nabiraytes opyta, otkryvayte novoe oruzhie ili dopolnitelnye umeniya i prokachivayte ognevuyu moshch i navyki komandy. Sobirayte otryad i perepishite pravila v sovremennoy igre po kultovoy klassike! Vam predstoit stolknutsya so mnogimi ispytaniyami, poetomu prigotovtes k beschislennym smertyam, no ne smeyte sdavatsya.
Безумно очаровательный охотник за голова:
Bezumno ocharovatelnyy okhotnik za golovami po imeni Fantasticheskiy Sparki (Spectacular Sparky) mozhet lovko preodolevat prepyatstviya, strelyat v lyubom napravlenii i dazhe zavisat v vozdukhe, khlopaya svoimi dlinnymi ushami, kak krylyami. Vsyakiy raz, kogda Sparki (Sparky) unichtozhaet ocherednogo bossa, ego vernyy tovarishch Svinula (Shigg) — napolovinu svinya, napolovinu akula — ukazhet vam put k sleduyushchemu begletsu ot kosmicheskogo pravosudiya.

Podobno geroyam iz igr devyanostykh, Sparki (Sparky) ne tolko besstrashnyy, no i ochen derzkiy geroy. On ne boitsya shutit i ostroumno podnachivaet svoikh vragov. A vselennaya, v kotoroy on obitaet, zapolnena shipami, lavoy, tsirkulyarnymi pilami, yarkimi nasyshchennymi tsvetami, stilnymi effektami vrode mnogourovnevogo skrollinga i shestnadtsatibitnoy muzykoy — razve ne tak dolzhny vyglyadet vse videoigry?

Osobennosti igry
• 5 igrovykh mirov i 24 urovnya, v kontse kazhdogo iz kotorykh vas zhdyot krutaya bitva s bossom
• Desyatki voskhititelnykh syuzhetnykh stsen s polnoy ozvuchkoy i mnozhestvom epatazhnykh personazhey.
• 5 moshchnykh vidov oruzhiya — blastery, ognemyoty, samonavodyashchiesya rakety i ne tolko
• 5 unikalnykh vidov transporta, kotorymi mozhet upravlyat Sparki (Sparky) — kosmicheskiy korabl, deltaplan, lavokhod i ne tolko
• 5 urovney slozhnosti — ot superlyogkogo (Supercasual) do superkoshmarnogo (Supernightmare)
• Tri rezhima igry (Chto?! Tri? Pochemu ne pyat?)
The First Tree — это приключенческая игр:
The First Tree — eto priklyuchencheskaya igra ot tretego litsa, v kotoroy parallelno razvivayutsya dve istorii: lisy, pytayushcheysya otyskat svoyu propavshuyu semyu, i malchika, kotoryy stremitsya vosstanovit svyaz s ottsom na Alyaske. Igroki upravlyayut lisoy v prekrasnom i trogatelnom priklyuchenii, kotoroe vedet ee k istochniku zhizni i, vozmozhno, ponimaniyu smerti. Po puti igroki smogut nayti predmety i epizody iz zhizni malchika, i ona perepletetsya s puteshestviem lisy k Pervomu derevu.

Osobennosti:
● Eto ne «simulyator lisy», a napisannaya odnim chelovekom emotsionalnaya i dushevnaya istoriya s nezabyvaemym finalom.
● Velikolepnyy saundtrek ot izvestnykh ispolniteley, takikh kak Message to Bears, Lowercase Noises i Josh Kramer.
● Korotkaya (okolo 2 chasov) syuzhetnaya igra bez vragov, no s elementami golovolomok i platformerov.
The game with its visual form and plot r:
The game with its visual form and plot refers to the old silent movies. It takes us to the surreal, black-and-white world where we play as a character named Ignatius.

Main character is a boy a bit bored with his current monotonous life. One moonlit night something unexpected happened, something that turn his orderly life upside down. He encountered a mysterious theater director named Vigo, who moves him to oneiric film reality.

The player’s task is to find his way in this strange world and escape from it.
We traverse interesting locations, discovering this mysterious universe and trying to unravel its mystery. On our way stands various obstacles, logical puzzles and specific oponents.
Легкая и милая игра-побег.\nЖили-были дв:
Legkaya i milaya igra-pobeg.
Zhili-byli dve fei chuchela zhivotnykh: Nyanzo i Kumakichi.
Защити человечество и реши судьбу цивили:
Zashchiti chelovechestvo i reshi sudbu tsivilizatsii.  Stroy goroda i oboronitelnye sooruzheniya, chtoby zashchititsya ot neustanno atakuyushchikh monstrov, a zatem spustis v ikh logova s mechom i parochkoy zaklinaniy za pazukhoy, chtoby pokonchit s nimi raz i navsegda. Issleduy paryashchie ostrova, drevnie peshchery i zabroshennye goroda. Mir u tvoikh nog!

SolSeraph ot ACE Team, avtorov Rock of Ages i Zeno Clash, sochetaet ekshn i strategiyu v nasyshchennom unikalnom geymplee, napominayushchem o 16-bitnoy ere.
Игра содержит 27 уровней. 20 из них откр:
Igra soderzhit 27 urovney. 20 iz nikh otkryty srazu, 4 otkryvaetsya za sbor monet, skrytykh vnutri urovney. Eshchyo 4 urovnya nakhodyatsya v «Bashne», gde urovni otkryvayutsya posledovatelno. Kazhdyy uroven — nabor razlichnykh prepyatstviy, kotorye neobkhodimo proyti igroku, ispolzuya raznye, smenyayushchie sebya rezhimy igry. Polosa prepyatstviy sinkhronizirovana s saundtrekom urovnya, v kachestve kotorogo vystupayut elektronnye muzykalnye treki takikh kompozitorov, kak Waterflame, DJ-Nate, F-777, DJVI, MDK i drugikh. Upravlyaetsya personazh nazhatiem ili zazhatiem knopki A. Stolknuvshis s prepyatstviem, igrok nachinaet prokhozhdenie urovnya zanovo.
Pomimo klassicheskogo rezhima igry, prisutstvuet i rezhim platformera — rezhim s neogranichennym vremenem prokhozhdeniya i vozmozhnostyu upravlyat personazhem. Vnutri oboikh rezhimov sushchestvuet rezhim praktiki, v kotorom mozhno stavit tochki sokhraneniya posredi urovnya, s kotorykh igrok nachinaet svoy pust posle smerti. Personazh igroka mozhet prinimat sleduyushchie formy:
МЫСЛЬНАЯ ИСТОРИЯ\nВы играете роль специа:
MYSLNAYa ISTORIYa
Vy igraete rol spetsialista, nanyatogo krupnoy kompaniey. Vy obnaruzhili nechto ochen trevozhnoe v budushchem vsey planety. A soobshchit plokhie novosti reshat vam.

The Last Survey - eto igra vybora. Prinimayte vazhnye resheniya, chtoby napravit razgovor v storonu progressivnykh deystviy, pobuzhdaya vashego rabotodatelya peresmotret posledstviya svoikh deystviy.

MENShE - BOLShE
Unikalnyy graficheskiy stil, sozdannyy s pomoshchyu narisovannykh vruchnuyu tsifrovykh, grafitovykh i ugolnykh risunkov, vydelyaet The Last Survey. Otlichnoe zvukovoe soprovozhdenie Lyuisa Kopenkhafera tolko podcherkivaet atmosferu kritiki sovremennogo mira.

Smozhete li vy povliyat na sudbu mira?

Klyuchevaya osobennost:
■ bolee 1500 risunkov, narisovannykh vruchnuyu - tsifrovymi, grafitovymi i ugolnymi risunkami.
■ Vyberite svoe sobstvennoe priklyuchenie - vedite istoriyu s pomoshchyu monologa i dialogovykh okon.
■ kak zakonchitsya istoriya, reshat vam - neskolko kontsovok v zavisimosti ot togo, kak vy sebya vedete
■ Dinamicheskiy saundtrek, sozdannyy izvestnym khudozhnikom Lyuisom Kopenkhaferom.
■ syuzhetnoe povestvovanie - s takimi temami, kak globalizm, ekstraktsionistskiy kapitalizm i zhadnost rukovoditeley
Возглавьте группу героев, чтобы они выро:
Vozglavte gruppu geroev, chtoby oni vyrosli iz obychnykh fermerov v legendarnykh voinov. Borites s neozhidannymi ugrozami i dikovinnymi chudishchami na interaktivnykh polyakh srazheniy. Razgadyvayte tayny i delites perezhivaniyami v fentezi-settinge, v kotorom surovaya realnost i stradaniya garmonichno perepletayutsya s yumorom i lichnymi istoriyami. Kakoy mif sotvorite vy? Zavisit tolko ot vas!
V kazhdoy igre v raznoobraznykh usloviyakh rozhdayutsya geroi — kak i v nastolnykh rolevykh igrakh. Oni stareyut, menyayutsya, vlyublyayutsya, ssoryatsya i idut na uzhasnye zhertvy. Kazhdyy geroy neset v sebe svoyu sobstvennuyu istoriyu i individualnost, no imenno vash vybor i boevye navyki opredelyayut ego put i iskhod. Vse geroi kogda-nibud umrut... No u vas budet vozmozhnost spasti svoikh lyubimchikov. Vy smozhete vernut ikh v sleduyushchem priklyuchenii. A s techeniem mnogikh zhizney mify, kotorye vy sotvorite, obrazuyut vash sobstvennyy legendarnyy panteon.
You are Pixel Girl, a superhero with the:
You are Pixel Girl, a superhero with the power of "pixel puzzle-solving." Turn your problems into nonograms, then solve 'em to save the day!

Join the Puzzle League and date up to four of your fellow puzzle-themed superheroes, before the Villain third-wheels you with his doomsday plot!

FEATURES
• Dating sim meets puzzle game in this heartfelt superhero adventure
• Join and date the Puzzle League: a group of 4 superheroes based on crossword, sudoku, chess and jigsaw puzzles
• Over 250 pixel puzzles to solve: your superpowers make puzzles a part of the narrative
• A supernatural plot weaving in multiple dates with each character
• Exotic date locations: a café, the library, mountain climbing, and the center of the earth?!
• Twists, turns, thrills, chills, puzzle fun, and puzzle puns! It's not over until the ending!
• D A T E A G I A N T P U Z Z L E P I E C E

MEET THE LEAGUE
• Sudoku: the most logical of the group, magical girl outfit was made by a friend
• Chess: careful planner, but tends to think in black-and-white
• Pixel Girl (that's you!): surrounded by cuties and blessed with the power of attraction
• Crossword: rarely gets cross, always has a way with words
• Piecea: an alien from the Puzzle Planet who wants to get handsy with you... wait...
**Погрузитесь в захватывающий мир местны:
**Pogruzites v zakhvatyvayushchiy mir mestnykh novostey ot pervogo litsa!**

Kliff Rokslayd — vladelets krupneyshego v Batterflyay-Velli servisa potokovoy peredachi novostey s ogromnym chislom semi podpischikov. Vasha zadacha — pomoch emu razvit svoy kanal, zapisyvaya na kameru vse, chto dazhe otdalenno interesno.

V tikhom malenkom gorodke skoro proizoydet krupneyshee novostnoe sobytie, kotoroe on kogda-libo videl, prevoskhodyashchee dazhe neudachnyy intsident s barsukom i gorodskoy liniey elektroperedach neskolko let nazad.

Local News with Cliff Rockslide — eto komediynaya priklyuchencheskaya igra ot pervogo litsa, v kotoroy vy derzhite kameru. Vladenie etim oruzhiem massovoy informatsii — otvetstvennaya zadacha. Vera kanala lezhit na vashikh velikolepnykh plechakh.

Klyuchevaya osobennost:
- Ispytayte tshchatelno sozdannuyu komediyu o kultakh, ovoshchakh i geometrii, napisannuyu professionalami komedii.
- Nauchites byt uspeshnym zhurnalistom, mediynym litsom, sozdatelem kontenta i vliyatelnym litsom v odnom pakete.
- Eto kak FPS, no s kameroy! Vy upravlyaete translyatsiey
- Nikakikh boev (nu, vrode), smertey (po krayney mere, ne okonchatelnykh), bystrykh posledovatelnostey deystviy (eto naglaya lozh), bystrykh sobytiy (vsego neskolko, izvinite!)
Super Mega Baseball 2: Ultimate Edition:
Super Mega Baseball 2: Ultimate Edition iz serii Super Mega Baseball,  poluchivshey samye vysokie otsenki i mnozhestvo polozhitelnykh otzyvov igrokov, teper dostupna na Nintendo Switch™.

Nevazhno, novichok vy ili professionalnyy igrok, v SMB2 naydetsya rezhim dlya kazhdogo. Sorevnuytes odin na odin s drugimi igrokami, igrayte onlayn so svoimi druzyami  v rezhimakh 1v1, 2v1 ili 2v2, vystupite protiv II (odinochnyy rezhim, kooperativnyy rezhim s odnoy ili raznykh konsoley), nasladites igrovoy adaptatsiey dlya komandy i ligi. Vasha igra vsegda budet spravedlivoy blagodarya Ego, samoy gibkoy sisteme rascheta slozhnosti v etom zhanre.

Setevye sorevnovaniya:

• 2-4 igroka (1 protiv 1, 2 protiv 1, 2 protiv 2, 2 protiv kompyutera).
• Podbor blizkikh po urovnyu setevykh protivnikov.
• Sovmestnoe prokhozhdenie sezona po seti (2 igroka protiv kompyutera).
• Vydelennye servery.

Vasha komanda, vasha liga, vasha igra:

• Izmenyaemye imena, vneshnost, ekipirovka, animatsii i umeniya igrokov.
• Individualizatsiya nazvaniy, emblem i formy komand.
• Ligi proizvolnogo razmera i struktury.
• Vozmozhnost nastraivat dlitelnost matcha i sezona, a takzhe razmer setki pley-off.

Pererabotannaya model igry:

• Teplo prinyataya kritikami 100-urovnevaya sistema slozhnosti.
• Realistichnaya simulyatsiya matchey i tochno vyverennaya fizika.
• Intuitivnoe upravlenie i dinamichnyy igrovoy protsess.
• Podrobnyy uchet statistiki za neskolko sezonov.
• Odinochnaya, sovmestnaya i sorevnovatelnaya igra v lokalnom i setevom rezhimakh.
Играя за мастера-некроманта, соберите св:
Igraya za mastera-nekromanta, soberite svoyu kolodu cherepov, voskresite armiyu nezhiti i odoleyte oskvernennye zhiznyu poseleniya. Tron Nekrokorolya vash po pravu!
V goroda prishli smuta i upadok, derevni pogryazli v bezumii, i zhiteli postoyanno ishchut povody dlya stychek, chtoby vyplesnut svoyu agressiyu.
Vy — Nekrokorol. Nadente koronu mogushchestvennoy magii nekromantii i otpravtes v izvilistoe priklyuchenie s tselyu poseyat khaos i pogibel v poseleniya, oskvernennye samoy zhiznyu. Soberite armiyu iz skeletov i drugikh merzkikh sushchestv, chtoby pobedit vragov i ustanovit svoe gospodstvo!
QQQbeats!!! — это совершенно новая кавай:
QQQbeats!!! — eto sovershenno novaya kavaynaya muzykalnaya ritm-golovolomka, sozdannaya TATIO spetsialno dlya Nintendo Switch, sochetayushchaya prostoy igrovoy protsess strelby po puzyryam s mekhanikami ritm-igr. Naslazhdaytes igroy po maksimumu, ispolzuya lichnosti kazhdogo personazha! Tri igrovykh rezhima! Best Day Ever is a narrative game in whi:
Best Day Ever is a narrative game in which you will play 4 characters. Your goal? Manage their daily life and help them overcome their difficulties to create their best day ever.

EXPERIENCE 4 RICH STORIES
In Waters City, the picture is not all bright. Emma, Jordan, Paul and Jenny won't say otherwise: they face many injustices on a daily basis and need your help to face these trials. Get to know them and achieve their goals by making good decisions with them.

YOUR CHOICES HAVE A REAL IMPACT
Each story has multiple endings. It is YOUR decisions that will change the events experienced by the characters and trace their path to their best day ever. And what if these seemingly independent stories were finally linked together?

ENDEARING CHARACTERS
• Emma Nadger: Manager in the food company KraKer, Emma provides quality work and doesn't count her hours. However, she regularly receives sexist remarks from some of her peers and can no longer stand it.
• Jordan Neal: Jordan is a key player in the Waters University basketball team. The team has qualified for the big university tournament, a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for the team members. His partner feels this is the perfect opportunity for Jordan to finally introduce him to his teammates.
• Jenny: As a student at the prestigious Waters University, Jenny has always had good grades. However, a few weeks before her midterms, she can no longer focus on her studies and is anxious about getting to class.
• Paul Hitik: Paul is one of the 5 candidates in the Waters mayoral election. He is aware that his city is the place of many injustices and intends to defend his candidacy to change things on a large scale.

KEEP IN TOUCH WITH THEIR RELATIVES
With dozens of side characters, Best Day Ever deepens many relationships of friendship, love and rivalry. To stay in touch with Emma, Jordan, Jenny and Paul's friends, the phone is your best ally. You can send and receive calls, messages or keep an eye on important appointments.

Вы задумывались когда-нибудь, как выгляд:
Vy zadumyvalis kogda-nibud, kak vyglyadit mir glazami muravya?

AntVentor — eto pervaya korotkaya glava iz serii igr AntTrilogy o murave i ego neobychnykh priklyucheniyakh v fotorealistichnom makromire.

Glavnyy geroy — muravey-izobretatel, kotoryy, nesmotrya na svoy kroshechnyy razmer, stremitsya k bolshoy mechte.

On zhil prostoy i razmerennoy zhiznyu, poka ne poyavilis vy, i ne slomali ego mekhanizm, tem samym narushiv ego plany. Teper vam pridetsya sdelat vse vozmozhnoe, chtoby Florantin ne tolko vernulsya k svoey privychnoy zhizni, no i poluchil vozmozhnost osushchestvit svoyu zavetnuyu mechtu.

Vmeste s nim vam predstoit preodolet nemalo trudnostey i pouchastvovat vo mnogikh priklyucheniyakh, kotorye tolko nachinayutsya v etoy pervoy glave.

A vy khotite:
- Pochuvstvovat, kakovo eto — byt razmerom s muravya?
- Okunutsya v unikalnyy i udivitelno fotorealistichnyy makromir?
- Sovershenno bespardonno vorvatsya v zhizn glavnogo geroya?
- Poznakomitsya s Florantinom, zabavnym, no nemnogo nadmennym muravem-izobretatelem?
- Posmeyatsya nad vsemi komichnymi momentami igry?
- Povstrechat strashnykh i milykh, ogromnykh i malyusenkikh, zhiteley makromira?
- Nasladitsya skrupulezno sozdannoy animatsiey, sostoyashchey iz bolee chem 15 000 kadrov?
- Poradovatsya otsutstviyu nudnykh pazlov, obychno sozdannykh dlya togo, chtoby potyanut vashe vremya?
- Ne propuskat dlinnykh dialogov prosto potomu, chto ikh tut net?
- Naslazhdatsya spetsialno sozdannoy atmosfernoy muzykoy kontrabasa?
- Uvlechsya lakonichnym, no ochen zakhvatyvayushchim syuzhetom s sovershenno neozhidannym finalom?

Esli khot na odin vopros vash otvet «da», to eta igra dlya vas!
Чарующая, неторопливая история, рассказа:
Charuyushchaya, netoroplivaya istoriya, rasskazannaya cherez izgotovlennye vruchnuyu derevyannye dekoratsii. Nikakoy speshki — tolko uyutnyy mir detskikh vospominaniy..
Milaya golovolomka, gde igrokam nuzhno po kusochkam sobirat derevyannye dekoratsii. Kogda vse chasti okazhutsya na svoem meste, dekoratsiya ozhivet i napolnitsya kraskami. V kazhdoy stsene zhdut svoi sobytiya i malenkie syurprizy. Uznay istoriyu Foksi i lyagushki Bena cherez seriyu dekoratsiy, v kazhdoy iz kotorykh zapechatleny chudesnye momenty ikh priklyucheniy.
Неугомонный мальчишка по имени Рэд немно:
Neugomonnyy malchishka po imeni Red nemnogo ne v meru uvlechen videoigrami. Odnazhdy, usnuv pod utro posle dolgoy igry, Red prosypaetsya i vidit, chto ego staraya pristavka vklyuchilas sama soboy, i vnezapno ego zatyagivaet v televizor, v sobstvennuyu igru! Vspomnite epokhu platformerov 90-kh vmeste s Redom!
Dasti — eto pristavka Reda, kotoraya vnezapno obrela soznanie. Dasti dobryy, no rugaetsya kak sapozhnik. Mozhet, ego taktovaya chastota uzhe ne ta, chto ranshe, no nedostatok gertsev on kompensiruet opytom i neobychnym podkhodom!
Zakhvatyvayushchie priklyucheniya Reda i Dasti — eto bystryy khardkornyy platformer, pronizannyy tematicheskim yumorom. V kogda-to prekrasnykh dzhunglyakh votsarili upadok i razrushenie, i teper neobychnomu duetu Reda i Dasti predstoit spasti mestnykh obitateley i vosstanovit Velikoe drevo, chto dolzhno okhranyat eti zemli.


Oruzhie. Blagodarya Dasti u Reda est tselyy arsenal krutogo oruzhiya. Naprimer, prostoy v ispolzovanii boltblaster s neogranichennymi boepripasami i solidnoy ognevoy moshchyu ili pushka «Feniks», strelyayushchaya ognennymi ptitsey, chi siyayushchie krylya podzhigayut vragov.
Muzyka i zvuki. Kompozitoru Endryu Khalshulyu udalos neveroyatnym obrazom sovmestit gody svoego muzykalnogo opyta (kak vystupleniy, tak i sozdaniya proizvedeniy) i lyubov k igram v stile retro: on napisal dlya igry nepovtorimyy saundtrek, napolnennyy muzykoy v stile starykh MIDI-zapisey i sintezatorami.
Pikselennaya. Red i Dasti stali otlichnoy komandoy, no iz nikh dvoikh tolko Dasti mozhet popast v Pikselennuyu — opasnoe mesto na zadvorkakh igrovogo mira, kotoroe ignoriruet zakony prostranstva i vremeni. Zdes Dasti mozhet ispravit bagi igrovogo mira, v kotorom oni s Redom nakhodyatsya, chtoby prodolzhit svoi priklyucheniya.
Paskhalki. Igra napolnena kollektsionnymi predmetami i klassicheskimi taynymi komnatami, poisk kotorykh zaymet nemalo vremeni i potrebuet ot vas proyavit vse svoe masterstvo v platformerakh.

Heroes I byla razrabotana i vypushchena 31 avgusta 1995 goda kompaniey New World Computing, kotoraya na tot moment yavlyalas samostoyatelnoy kompaniey (pozzhe ona stala podrazdeleniem The 3DO Company). Pervaya chast Heroes of Might and Magic zalozhila fundamentalnye osnovy geympleya vsey serii, budushchie igry kotoroy preterpevali, po bolshey chasti, lish evolyutsionnye izmeneniya. Zdes razvorachivaetsya borba za vlast mezhdu chetyrmya pravitelyami: lordom Morglinom «Zheleznym Kulakom» (rytsarem), korolevoy Lamandoy (volshebnitsey), vozhdyom Sleyerom (varvarom) i koldunom Alamarom (chernoknizhnikom). V syuzhetnoy kampanii, sostoyashchey iz devyati missiy, igrok mozhet igrat za lyubuyu iz storon.
Heroes of Might and Magic II: The Succession Wars + The Price of Loyalty (sokrashchyonno Heroes II ili HoMM2) — kompyuternaya igra v zhanre poshagovoy strategii s elementami RPG, vtoraya chast v serii fenteziynykh igr Heroes of Might and Magic. Igra byla razrabotana kompaniey New World Computing i izdana The 3DO Company 1 oktyabrya 1996 goda.

Na vystavke artefaktov mayya odin iz eksponatov neozhidanno prishel v dvizhenie. Byl pozdniy vecher i muzey byl pochti pust. Teper Diane neobkhodimo vyyasnit, gde ona, kak syuda popala i kak ey vernutsya nazad. Devushka stolknulas s tsivilizatsiey, vneshne ochen pokhozhey na indeytsev mayya, i, tem ne menee, eto ne proshloe i ne parallelnaya realnost. Pokémon Red Version i Blue Version (yap. ポケットモンスター 赤・緑 poketto monsuta: aka midori, «Pokemon: Krasnaya versiya» i «Sinyaya versiya», v Yaponii «Krasnaya» i «Zelyonaya versiya») — yaponskie rolevye videoigry, razrabotannye Game Freak i vypushchennye Nintendo na portativnoy igrovoy konsoli Game Boy. Oni yavlyayutsya pervymi igrami v serii Pokémon. Prodazhi nachalis 27 fevralya 1996 goda v Yaponii, a v techenie tryokh sleduyushchikh let i v Amerike, Evrope i Avstralii. Pokémon Yellow, dopolnenie igr, vyshla primerno cherez god posle severoamerikanskogo reliza.
Igrok puteshestvuet kak trener pokemonov po vymyshlennomu regionu Kanto, obshchayas i srazhayas s drugimi trenerami. Tsel igry — stat velichayshim trenerom pokemonov v regione, pobediv drugikh luchshikh trenerov regiona — Elitnuyu Chetvyorku. Drugaya tsel zaklyuchaetsya v tom, chtoby poymat vsekh 151 pokemona i zapolnit informatsiey o nikh Pokedeks — elektronnuyu entsiklopediyu o pokemonakh. Igry prakticheski nichem ne otlichayutsya drug ot druga, krome pokemonov dlya lovli — v kazhdoy igre dlya polnoy kollektsii ne khvataet primerno dvadtsati vidov, i, chtoby sobrat polnuyu kollektsiyu, igroku odnoy versii pridyotsya obmenivatsya s obladatelem drugoy versii.
Igry poluchili khoroshie otsenki u kritikov; oni khvalili ikh vozmozhnost mnogopolzovatelskoy igry, osobenno kontseptsiyu obmena pokemonami. Red i Blue poluchili 89% ot GameRankings i uderzhivali postoyannoe mesto v reytinge «Top 100 luchshikh igr vsekh vremyon» po versii IGN. Reliz igry polozhil nachalo mnogomillionnomu franchayzu «Pokemon» i prodazhe millionov kopiy igry po vsemu miru, poetomu v 2009 godu igra popala v Knigu rekordov Ginnessa v razdele «Samaya prodavaemaya RPG na Game Boy» i «Samaya prodavaemaya RPG vsekh vremyon».

Semblance — это уникальный платформер в:

Razbivayte strannuyu kristallicheskuyu infektsiyu iz zhestkogo materiala, osvobozhdaya zhiznennuyu essentsiyu i raskryvaya prichinu vozniknoveniya etoy skverny.

Со времён Древнего Египта (первое описан:
So vremyon Drevnego Egipta (pervoe opisanie vstrechaetsya v Kakhunskom meditsinskom papiruse ~1950 goda do nashey ery), mnogie zhenskie bolezni schitalis boleznyami matki, khotya o rasstroystvakh povedeniya ili emotsiy tam eshchyo ne govoritsya, razve chto upominaetsya «lechenie zhenshchiny, kotoroy nravitsya byt v posteli» s diagnozom spazmy matki. Diagnoz «isteriya» vpervye poyavlyaetsya v Drevney Gretsii i opisan u Gippokrata. Ego sovremennik, Platon opisyvaet «beshenstvo», v kotoroe vpadaet zhenshchiny, ne imeya vozmozhnosti zachat, on byl krayne populyaren v meditsine kontsa XIX — nachala XX veka; na materiale isterii Zh. M. Sharko i Zigmund Freyd sdelali ryad vazhnykh otkrytiy v terapii psikhicheskikh rasstroystv. Iskhodya iz predstavleniy drevnikh o prirode, predpolozheniy o vozmozhnosti isterii u muzhchin dolgoe vremya ne dopuskalos, no s XVII veka byl vvedyon termin i muzhskoy isterii.
Poprobuete spasti ot «beshenstva matki» svoyu lyubimuyu devushku.. Pryamo v to vremya, kogda vasha blagovernaya razyarena?.. Esli, konechno, smozhete! Usmirite eyo gnev, spasyote i svoyo polozhenie! Ved kogda vasha zhenshchina zlitsya, ves mir naturalno sodrogaetsya — okna razbivayutsya, vulkany izvergayutsya, a vzroslye muzhiki syozhivayutsya ot strakha! Osnovnaya zadacha — spasti mir, usmiriv eyo isteriki.

Paprium — это homebrew-видеоигра в жанре:
Paprium — eto homebrew-videoigra v zhanre beat 'em up, razrabotannaya i izdannaya indi-studiey WaterMelon dlya Sega Mega Drive v 2020-om godu; nachalnaya razrabotka nachalas v ~2013-2014 godakh. Pered vypuskom Paprium proshyol vosmiletniy tsikl razrabotki, vo vremya kotoroy WaterMelon i kakie-libo otdelnye razrabotchiki prakticheski ne obshchalis s pressoy i ne govorili nichego o razrabotke igry. Iz-za etogo do pervykh postavok igry v kontse 2020 goda igra schitalas otmenyonnoy.
Proekt pokhodit po stilyu na drugie igry beat 'em up, kotorye vykhodili na Sega Mega Drive v kontse 80-kh i nachale 90-kh, takie kak Golden Axe i Streets of Rage, s vizualnymi effektami, stilizovannymi pod razlichnye media v zhanre kiberpank. Igra predlagaet tri rezhima: «originalnyy», «arkadnyy» i «arena», iznachalno nedostupnaya dlya zapuska. Originalnyy i arkadnyy rezhimy dostupny pri pervom zapuske igry, ikh ne trebuetsya otkryvat v protsesse prokhozhdeniya, pri etom v originalnom rezhime est kat-stseny i vybrannyy igrokom khod igry (dalneyshee razvitie syuzheta i smena lokatsiy), v to vremya kak v arkadnom rezhime igra idyot v strogo ustanovlennom razrabotchikami marshrute povestvovaniya. Rezhim areny otkryvaetsya posle prokhozhdeniya originalnogo rezhima, predstavlyaet soboy rezhim vyzhivaniya.
Syuzhet nachinaetsya s tryokh igrovykh personazhey: Taga, Aleksa i Daysa, kazhdyy so svoey siloy i skorostyu, a takzhe s neskolkimi drugimi igrovymi personazhami, kotorykh igrok mozhet razblokirovat po khodu igry. Igra sleduet za tremya personazhami v Papriume, vymyshlennom gorode, postroennom posle masshtabnoy yadernoy voyny, raspolozhennom «gde-to v ravnoudalyonnoy tochke mezhdu Shankhaem, Tokio i Pkhenyanom» v 8A2 godu, shestnadtsaterichnom znachenii dlya 2210 goda.
Apparatnoe obespechenie kartridzha Paprium unikalno kak sredi kommercheski vypushchennykh igr Sega Mega Drive, tak i sredi samodelnykh vypuskov. Kartridzh soderzhit spetsialnyy nabor mikroskhem pod nazvaniem «DATENMEISTER» ili upominaemyy WaterMelon kak nabor mikroskhem «DT128M16VA1LT». Eto ne pervyy raz, kogda igra dlya Sega Mega Drive vypuskaetsya s dopolnitelnym oborudovaniem dlya uluchsheniya graficheskikh vozmozhnostey apparatnogo obespecheniya konsoli, odnako eto pervyy raz, kogda chipset Sega Virtua Processor (SVP), sozdannyy dlya versii Virtua Racing na Sega Mega Drive ispolzuetsya dlya vypuska kartridzha dlya homebrew igry s sobstvennym chipsetom. Etot nabor mikroskhem nakhoditsya pod metallicheskim radiatorom na pechatnoy plate kartridzha (PCB). Polzovateli, snyavshie radiator, obnaruzhili epoksidnuyu smolu, pokryvayushchuyu chipset DATENMEISTER, nanesyonnuyu tuda kompaniey WaterMelon dlya predotvrashcheniya obratnoy razrabotki chipseta. Udalenie epoksidnoy smoly pokazyvaet neskolko dopolnitelnykh mikroskhem, takikh kak Altera FPGA (10M02SCU169C8G), mikrokontroller STMicroelectronics (STM32F446ZEJ6), mikrokontroller Spansion (GL064N90FFIS2), poluprovodnikovoe OZU ISSI (IS42S16100H) i dva logicheskikh elementa ot ON Semiconductor (74LCX245 i 74LCX257), kotoryy ispolzuetsya dlya obrabotki dopolnitelnykh audiokanalov, a takzhe dlya pomoshchi konsoli v razlichnykh igrovykh zadachakh (upravlenie VRAM, sozdanie tablitsy spraytov i proch.). Kartridzh ispolzuet flesh-pamyat dlya sokhraneniya dannykh, emu ne nuzhno polagatsya na funktsiyu sokhraneniya parolya ili ekonomit zaryad batarei, kak vo mnogikh igrakh Sega Mega Drive, vypushchennykh v techenie sroka sluzhby konsoli. On imeet 64 megabita pamyati = 8 megabayt, chto delaet ego odnim iz samykh bolshikh kartridzhey Sega Mega Drive, kogda-libo vypushchennykh v prodazhu.

Hours after receiving an urgent call in:
Hours after receiving an urgent call in his Paris apartment, the protagonist of D/Generation, a nameless courier, arrives in London via his Jet-Pack, touching down on the 80th floor of Genoq Biolabs' medical research facility with an important package for lead Genoq scientist Jean-Paul Derrida. As soon as he enters, however, the doors shut and seal themselves behind him. This, however, proves to be the least of his problems, as the receptionist soon informs him of Genoq's dire state. All lines of communication to the outside world have been severed, and furthermore the building's security systems and dangerous Neogens have run amok. Despite the perils within and the receptionist's adamant warnings, the courier chooses to proceed, perhaps believing that the item in his possession holds the key to stopping the chaos which grips Genoq.
Over the course of his journey into the building's upper reaches, the courier learns that Genoq had been steeped in the realm of illegal bioweapon development for some time, and that their medical research, which had long ago become unprofitable for them, was little more than a front for their more lucrative practice of creating and selling biological weapons called Neogens. Derrida had been brought on by the company to spearhead a project which would create the ultimate Neogen, and the fruit of his efforts, an artificial organism dubbed D/Generation, was ultimately the source of the disturbances within the building. Further complicating matters, he also learns that Genoq's corporate leaders have authorized an airstrike against the building in order to prevent details of their activities from going public.
Gameplay
The main gameplay of D/Generation consists of traversing interconnected rooms (called "scenes" within the game), accomplishing various tasks within them in order to ascend to the next level of the tower. Each level is comprised of multiple scenes, and each scene typically presents a particular challenge which must be overcome in order to progress. The game alternates between action-based and puzzle-based gameplay, with many scenes requiring some combination of both. On the action side of things, players are constantly harassed by hostile Neogens and security systems, which frequently require quick reflexes in order to defeat. Certain doors will only unlock when an area has been cleared of dangerous entities, and furthermore it is usually not feasible to rescue survivors (who grant additional lives) until an area has been completely cleared of enemies. 

As the game reaches its climax, the tone becomes unexpectedly surreal.

At the same time, there are cases where it is more advantageous to manipulate an enemy rather than killing it outright, which leads into the game's more cerebral leanings. Trackers can be used to kill other Trackers without firing a shot, for instance, and a Neogen that collides with a plasma barrier will permanently disable it. These are just two examples of instances in which the player is rewarded for thinking before they shoot. Most areas contain switches which can open and close doors, activate and deactivate security measures, or both, and success in many scenes comes down to manipulating these switches (as well as other devices, such as computer terminals and teleporters) in such a way as to provide safe passage for ones' self and any civilians. Timing and pattern recognition is also a crucial element throughout the game, since tougher puzzles can require that a series of deliberate actions be performed quickly.

Issledovatelskiy korabl podletaet k zabroshennoy planete. No vse idet ne tak, i vskore situatsiya vykhodit iz-pod kontrolya. Smozhet li ekipazh vyzhit i vernutsya domoy? 

SYMMETRY — eto igra v zhanre taym-menedzhera na vyzhivanie, deystvie kotoroy razvorachivaetsya v postapokalipticheskom mire. Vasha osnovnaya tsel – upravlyaya utselevshimi, pomoch im vyzhit na pustynnoy ledyanoy planete, pochinit svoy korabl i sbezhat. Glubokiy i uvlekatelnyy syuzhet v sochetanii s atmosfernoy muzykoy i graficheskim dizaynom pogruzhayut igroka v surovyy i tainstvennyy mir. 

V khode igry vy budete znakomitsya s zagadochnym mirom simmetrii i raskryvat peripetii syuzheta. Vse personazhi — eto uchastniki issledovatelskoy ekspeditsii, chey korabl razbilsya na neizvestnoy planete. Teper im nuzhno ne tolko vyzhit, no i pochinit korabl, chtoby vernutsya domoy. Ekstremalno nizkaya temperatura i smertelno opasnye paranormalnye yavleniya sdelayut ikh zadachu nastoyashchey borboy za vyzhivanie. 

Vy dolzhny budete upravlyat kriticheski vazhnymi dlya utselevshikh deystviyami — ot vas zavisit ikh pitanie, otdykh, dushevnoe zdorove i lichnye navyki. Vam nuzhno kak mozhno bystree pochinit korabl, sobiraya neobkhodimye detali. Vam predstoit prinimat neprostye moralnye resheniya, vliyayushchie na sudbu vsey ekspeditsii. 

Vektornaya grafika peredaet atmosferu surovogo pustynnogo mira. Priglushennye i pastelnye tsveta sozdayut oshchushchenie otstranennosti i nerealnosti landshafta.

LOOPERS is science fiction story told th:
LOOPERS is science fiction story told through the enthralling writing of Ryukishi07 and the fascinating visuals of Kei Mochizuki.
Follow an ensemble of young people as they try to escape a world in which they relive August 1st over and over again.
Enjoy a visual novel so full of friendship, love, madness, laughs, and emotion it'll leave you breathless!

Available in three languages!
The text can be set to Japanese, English, or Simplified Chinese (audio is in Japanese only). This includes in-game text, options, and the digital manual. Language settings can be changed at any time.

Summary
Tyler is a high schooler with only one thing on his mind—geohunting (GPS-assisted scavenger hunts). One day, while absorbed in a hunt during summer vacation, he and his friends find themselves embroiled in a mysterious phenomenon.
Fantasy and real life become intertwined. Is this the past or the present? Is it reality...or madness?
Sucked into an abnormality known as the Temporal Spiral, Tyler and his friends are forced to relive the same day over and over.
They soon meet others stuck in the same cycle. Along with the leader Simon and the mysterious Mia, this group call themselves the Loopers.
Will Tyler and the others find a way out, or are they doomed to remain in this never-ending loop forever?

*There are no choice-based story branching elements in this game.

In a hundred-year long battle with the a:
In a hundred-year long battle with the alien hordes the humans finally have a game changing weapon system at their disposal: the War Titans. These are some extraordinary battle machines that transform in order to be more effective against the enemy. Each War Titan comes as a combination of a mechanized war robot and an armored vehicle, and they each serve different roles on the battlefield. It's up to your skills and your strategic mind to decide when is the best time to play as a Mech and when the situation demands an armored vehicle on the field.

The Mech - a powerful robot that packs an explosive punch with it's twin machine guns and shoulder-mounted rocket launcher. The Mech is most effective against heavy enemies such as tanks, turrets and enemy mechs. However, the light attacks from the droids will damage the mech more, since thy often hit between the armored plating. The Mech has 3 upgrades: Machineguns, Rockets and Armor.

The Vehicle - your armored vehicle is perfect for running down hordes of droids, It is unarmored so it's not effective against heavy enemies. You can upgrade the vehicle's armor and Nitro which gives you a short but powerful boost in speed and acceleration.

As you progress in the level you will reach certain areas where the enemies will overwhelm you - fear not! Each attempt earns you coins from the distance you cover and the enemies you eliminate. You will also win different types of prize chests which give you more gold and Parts. Collect enough parts and unlock stronger Mechs and Vehicles.

Get ready soldier and who everyone what you're made of. Transform into the Mech and the Vehicle as the situation demands it and make your way through desert bases, alien jungles and remote lunar facilities and become the ultimate War Titan!

Claybook — это уникальный мир, полностью:

LISA: The Painful - Definitive Edition –:
LISA: The Painful - Definitive Edition – eto igra v zhanre RPG, napolnennaya chyornym yumorom, bezumnymi syuzhetnymi povorotami i koshmarnymi istoriyami. Otpravtes v uzhasayushchee puteshestvie po postapokalipticheskoy Oleyte. Za ocharovatelnym fasadom skryvaetsya mir, polnyy otvrashcheniya i moralnogo razlozheniya, gde vam pridyotsya uznat, kto vy na samom dele, prinimaya resheniya, vliyayushchie na ves posleduyushchiy igrovoy protsess. Zhertvuyte soboy, chtoby sokhranit zhizn chlenov svoey komandy: prinimayte na sebya udary, teryayte konechnosti i podvergaytes drugim beschelovechnym pytkam. Zdes vam pomogut vyzhit tolko egoizm i zhestokost...

V etoy versii igry vy smozhete pogruzitsya v novye koshmarnye istorii i razgadat eshchyo bolshe sekretov s uluchshennoy HD-grafikoy, novymi zadushevnymi razgovorami u kostra, obnovlyonnymi boyami, fonovymi temami, novoy muzykoy i muzykalnym pleerom (vklyuchayushchim treki iz LISA: The First), a takzhe syuzhetnym rezhimom «bez boli». 


OSNOVNYE VOZMOZhNOSTI:
- Srazhaytes s bolee chem 100 raznymi personazhami.
- Poluchayte povrezhdeniya, vliyayushchie na kharakteristiki i ataki vashego personazha (poterya ruk i glaz, tsarapiny).
- Nabirayte v komandu do 30 personazhey, kotorykh mozhno nayti v gorodakh i mestakh stoyanki.
- Delayte slozhnye vybory, kotorye navsegda izmenyat goroda, personazhey i vashu zhizn...
- Uchastvuyte v zakhvatyvayushchikh gonkakh na telezhkakh iz supermarketa, ispytaniyakh tyazheloatletov i drugikh mini-igrakh.
- Stavte na kon zhizni chlenov svoey komandy v russkoy ruletke, chtoby khorosho zarabotat. No esli oni umrut, vy poteryaete ikh navsegda.
- Slushayte svoi lyubimye kompozitsii v pleere, vklyuchaya muzyku iz LISA: The First.
- Nakhodite beschislennye sekrety, zapryatannye po vsey Oleyte.
- Broste sebe vyzov i srazhaytes s unikalnymi vragami v «rezhime boli» ili igrayte v rezhime «bez boli», chtoby polnostyu pogruzitsya v syuzhet.

Elea: Paradigm Shift is a game that take:
Elea: Paradigm Shift is a game that takes the player on the deeply personal journey of a woman, whose life is marked by loss, grief, and self-accusation in the aftermath of a global pandemic. 
Luckily, an Earth-like exoplanet within an achievable distance from the Solar system had been discovered. Pooling volunteers from around the globe, a first-of-a-kind interstellar spaceship was built and sent to colonize the yet unexplored planet. The gargantuan vessel was named Pilgrimage, embodying the hopes of all of humanity. To everyone’s dismay, shortly after a successful arrival, the Pilgrimage went on total radio silence. What caused it remains a mystery.
13 years later, research starship Recovery has arrived on-site to investigate the fate of the expedition. The player takes the role of the space scientist River Elea Catherine Jones. She is driven above all by a personal goal – to find her husband Ethan, who occupied a prominent position on the Pilgrimage’s scientific crew.

После того, как шесть лет назад животные:
Posle togo, kak shest let nazad zhivotnye Goroda Fakelov byli pobezhdeny vtorgshimsya Legionom Robotov v Voyne soprotivleniya, krolik Rayton, byvshiy boets Soprotivleniya, derzhalsya v teni. Arest ego druga oznachal, chto u nego ne bylo drugogo vybora, krome kak nadet svoy gigantskiy metallicheskiy kulak i borotsya protiv tekh, kto ego ugnetaet. On ne znal, chto vskore popadet v vodovorot zagovorov s uchastiem Legiona, Soprotivleniya i Krysinoy Bandy.

● Nepreryvnye karty s mnozhestvom zadaniy dlya issledovaniy

Otkroyte dlya sebya bolee desyatka unikalnykh oblastey na karte v stile ekshn-platformera (Metroidvaniya). Osnovnye boevye deystviya, reshenie golovolomok i mekhanika platformy dopolnyayutsya beschislennymi potaynymi komnatami, sekretnymi prokhodami i korotkimi putyami so vsevozmozhnymi nagradami za vypolnenie zadaniy. 
Karty zagruzhayutsya na letu, chtoby izbezhat chastykh perekhodov, chto delaet massivnyy Gorod Fakelov eshche bolee detalizirovannym i zhivym.

● Arkadnaya boevaya sistema s plavnym pereklyucheniem mezhdu tremya vidami oruzhiya.

Kulak, Sverlo i Molniya – eto tri oruzhiya s sovershenno raznymi stilyami boya, kotorye predlagayut plavnoe pereklyuchenie mezhdu silnym kombo, bolshim uronom i dalnimi atakami. Nanosite udary protivniku, vybrav naibolee podkhodyashchuyu formu ataki dlya situatsii.
Igroki stolknutsya s desyatkami razlichnykh tipov vragov, kazhdyy so svoim oruzhiem i atakami, kotorye rabotayut vmeste, chtoby sbit igroka s tolku. Unikalnye bossy s neobychnymi boevymi stilyami prepodnesut novyy i unikalnyy igrovoy opyt.

● Estetika dizel-panka, sozdannaya s pomoshchyu Unreal Engine 4

Estetika dizel-panka v igre byla vdokhnovlena dizelnymi dvigatelyami sgoraniya, a takzhe vostochnym gorodskim peyzazhem ushedshey epokhi, chtoby pridat Gorodu Fakelov unikalnoe vizualnoe oshchushchenie. Rezkiy kontrast mezhdu pushistymi zhivotnymi i sterilnymi mekhanicheskimi soldatami privnosit temu konflikta v istoriyu igry.
Realistichnye trekhmernye vizualnye effekty Unreal Engine 4 v sochetanii s fizicheski korrektnym renderingom vyvodit zhanr ekshn-platformera (Metroidvaniya) na sovershenno novyy uroven kachestva grafiki.

After Burner Climax (яп. アフターバーナー クライマック:
After Burner Climax (yap. アフターバーナー クライマックス Afuta: Ba:na: Kuraimakkusu) — igra serii After Burner, vypushchennaya cherez 14 let posle vypuska After Burner III, v 2006 godu. Igra byla iznachalno razrabotana Sega AM2 dlya arkadnykh avtomatov i pristavok Xbox 360 i PlayStation 3, dlya poslednikh dvukh dostupna cherez servisy Xbox Live i PlayStation Network. V 2013 godu igra byla izdana na mobilnye ustroystva pod upravleniem iOS i Android.
Albom After Burner Climax Sound Track (yap. アフターバーナー クライマックス サウンドトラック Afuta: Ba:na: Kuraimakkusu Oridzinaru Saundotorakku) byl vypushchen 9 noyabrya 2006 goda leyblom Wave Master; soderzhit 20 pesen.
V After Burner Climax dobavleny dva novykh samolyota: F/A-18E Super Hornet i F-15E Strike Eagle. F-14 Tomcat iz predydushchikh igr byl zamenen na F-14D Super Tomcat. Igrok vybiraet samolyot na startovom ekrane. Pri vybore samolyota, igrok mozhet ispolzovat pedal gaza, chtoby vybrat odnu iz chetyryokh razlichnykh krasok dlya samolyota: «Standart», «Kamuflyazh», «Osobaya» i «Plokhaya vidimost». Posle vybora samolyota, igrok mozhet proslushivat muzyku iz igry ili originalnyy saundtrek iz After Burner II. Takzhe v igre prisutstvuet rezhim trenirovki, kotoryy predstavlyaet soboy pereigryvanie lyuboy missii v otdelnosti zhelaemoe kolichestvo raz, no ne nesyot v sebe obuchayushchikh ili razyasnyayushchikh elementov. Vpervye bylo dobavleno zamedlenie vremeni.

Teper, chtoby vernut dukh Khelloina i vozmozhnost zanimatsya svoim lyubimym delom, Zhutiku nuzhno likvidirovat «FeysBu!» i 3 ego podrazdeleniya — Darkchat, Dyavol-Tyub i RIP-tok.

Death or Treat — dvukhmernyy gibrid uproshchyonnogo ekshen-«rogalika» i sleshera s narisovannym vruchnuyu okruzheniem i traditsionnoy animatsiey. Issleduyte unikalnye miry i pobezhdayte ordy vragov, ispolzuya raznoe oruzhie i sposobnosti.

Vam predstoit sygrat za Zhutika, vladeltsa «PrizraMarta» — glavnogo proizvoditelya khellouinskikh sladostey.

Otkryvayte dlya sebya novye ogromnye miry, issleduyte novye karty i staraytes vyzhit v skhvatkakh s polchishchami vragov. Eto stanet vesma neprostoy zadachey, poskolku kazhdyy mir budet kovarnee predydushchego. Vy pobyvaete v Darkchate, RIP-toke, Dyavol-Tyube i, nakonets, glavnom oplote svoego protivnika — «FeysBu!».

V osnove Death or Treat lezhit tshchatelno prorabotannaya boevaya sistema. Vybrav podkhodyashchiy vam tip oruzhiya (bystroe, tyazhyoloe ili dalnoboynoe), vy okazhetes litsom k litsu s tselymi ordami vragov i pereydyote v rezhim chistogo sleshera: vam nuzhno budet nositsya po vozdukhu i obrushivat vsyu svoyu moshch na mnogochislennykh vragov, ne zabyvaya pri etom manevrirovat i otyskivat ikh uyazvimye mesta.

V Khellou-Taune vy naydyote neskolko magazinchikov, tovary iz kotorykh budut raznymi sposobami pomogat vam na puti k tseli. Naprimer, v kuzne Franka vy smozhete masterit novoe oruzhie, a v «Detoksbakse» — pokupat lechebnye zelya. Vladelets eshchyo odnogo magazina, vampir Dzho Kusayden, pomozhet uvelichit mesto dlya nosimykh vami s soboy zapasov, a druzhelyubnye Tykvy nauchat sozdavat volshebnye zaklinaniya. Nu i, nakonets, u glavnogo Tykvy vy smozhete obmenyat imeyushchiesya ingredienty na sladosti!
\"На дворе 1936 год: уволенный со службы:

Heidelberg 1693 — сложный 2D экшн-платфо:
Heidelberg 1693 — slozhnyy 2D ekshn-platformer, sobytiya kotorogo proiskhodyat v alternativnoy versii Germanii 17 veka, navodnennoy zombi. Igrok beret na sebya upravlenie odnim iz znamenitykh mushketerov korolya Frantsii Lyudovika XIV. Igra dopolnyaet zhanr takticheskim elementom, predostavlyaya igroku glavnoe oruzhie mushketera: mushket. Periodicheski igrok mozhet sdelat odin moshchnyy, no chrezvychayno effektivnyy vystrel iz mushketa, odnako oruzhiem nuzhno polzovatsya s umom iz-za dovolno dolgoy perezaryadki. Znakomya igroka s nastoyashchimi istoricheskimi mestami i lyudmi, Heidelberg 1693 raskryvaet mrachnyy syuzhet, imeyushchiy neskolko kontsovok i putey razvitiya. 

Osobennosti igry:
- Klassicheskiy 2D ekshn-platformer
- Deystvie proiskhodit v vymyshlennoy versii 17 veka 
- Unikalnaya mekhanika ispolzovaniya mushketa dobavlyaet v ekshn-igru takticheskiy element
- Dostovernye istoricheskie mesta i lichnosti 
- Velikolepno animirovannye «sprayty»
- Animirovannye kat-stseny, vdokhnovlennye epokhoy nemogo kino
- Neskolko kontsovok

BACKGROUND\nWhile chasing the fortune wo:
BACKGROUND
While chasing the fortune worthy criminal Lamos on their Alloy Ranger, Space Hunters Kelly and Rambos were trapped by the protective field of the abandoned planet Tanwada. Just as they were struggling to find a way out, robot sisters “No.2” and “No.3” appeared out of nowhere and had asked to join them on their adventure!
Meanwhile, a mysterious program infected the mechanical army on planet Tanwada and led to their continuous self-evolution.

MAIN FEATURES

Classic 2D Action Platform Levels
Utilize various movement techniques to conquer the challenging levels; running, jumping, dashing, mid-air dash, wall climbing and double jumps. Use them wisely to track down the wanted criminal; this could be in sunken cities, the freezing Sea of Frost, the endless Abyssal Mines and many more places. Whatever it takes, you will find out the truth and head back with victory!

Multiple Combat Methods
Shooting expert Kelly can shoot different bullets based on the Attribute chip he was equipping. He can also enhance the effect of ammunition through charging! The energy core on his combat uniform can slowly increase the energy needed for special weapons!
Combat Robot No.2 has more attack methods than you think! Claws, swords, spears and many more, find out what it can do by unlocking various Attribute Chips. It will also collect energy from every hit made on the enemy. Once they have accumulated enough energy, a powerful deathblow will be released based on the Attribute Chip it was equipping. You never know how helpful this could be; it may even turn the situation around!

Gigantic Boss Enemies
Mechanical Aircraft, Aggressive Underwater Robots, a Battle Fortress that is digging towards the core of the planet and an enormous Humanoid that was produced in the Machine Arsenal… At the end of each level, there is always a dangerous mutant Machine Boss waiting for you to challenge. Try your best to defeat them in the barrage!

Dynamic Pixel Animation
With references to beautiful pixel arts such as the Metal Slug and Mega Man, Super Alloy Ranger seek to strive for details when it comes to this relatively abstract form of art. At the same time, strive to create a world that is more fun and exquisite!

Features
Classic side-scrolling mode of operation, dodge the bullets while jumping, dashing and climbing to progress with the level. · Many hidden pathways are waiting for you to explore.
Both characters have many weapons and combat styles up for selection.
Challenge gigantic boss enemies in dangerous barrages.
Incorporated the main features of Mega Man and Metal Slug. On top of that corresponding combat mechanism is added to the game!
Fun and exquisite pixel animations.

Видеоигра о личных разговорах\n \nTellin:
Videoigra o lichnykh razgovorakh
 
Telling Lies — eto novaya igra ot Sema Barlou, sozdatelya igr Her Story i Silent Hill: Shattered Memories. Telling Lies — eto igra-triller pro rassledovanie s nelineynym syuzhetom, kotoryy vertitsya vokrug mnozhestva razgovorov, zapisannykh na skrytuyu kameru. V ozvuchke prinimali uchastie Logan Marshall-Grin, Aleksandra Shipp, Kerri Bishe i Anzhela Safaryan.
 
Kak igra vyglyadit?
 
V Telling Lies pered vami pomestyat nekiy noutbuk, na kotoryy zagruzhena ukradennaya baza dannykh ANB s videozapisyami. Videozapisi okhvatyvayut dva goda lichnoy zhizni chetverykh lyudey, svyazannykh uzhasnym proisshestviem. Vvodite poiskovye zaprosy, chtoby issledovat bazu dannykh i smotret video, gde byli proizneseny vvedennye vami slova. Tak vy smozhete slozhit iz otdelnykh kusochkov golovolomki tselnyy syuzhet. 
 
Telling Lies nepokhozha na vse te igry, v kotorye vy igrali ranshe: eto ochen lichnyy i intimnyy protsess. Igra, v kotoryy vy reshaete, gde tut pravda.

I AM DEAD – душевная приключенческая игр:
I AM DEAD – dushevnaya priklyuchencheskaya igra-golovolomka o zagrobnoy zhizni ot sozdateley Hohokum i Wilmot’s Warehouse.

Morris Lapton – nedavno umershiy kurator muzeya na kroshechnom ostrovke Shelmerston. Vstretivshis s prizrakom svoego psa Sparki, on uznaet, chto ego lyubimyy ostrov skoro budet unichtozhen stikhiyami.

Vmeste im predstoit raskryt drevnie tayny Shelmerstona, predotvratit izverzhenie vulkana i spasti to mesto, chto oni nazyvayut domom.

Morrisu i Sparki nuzhno otyskat zateryannykh i pozabytykh prizrakov Shelmerstona. Dlya etogo pridetsya pobyvat tam, gde oni provodili vremya prezhde, pogruzitsya v vospominaniya o svoikh dobrykh znakomykh, izuchit istoriyu ikh zhizni.

Zadachu oblegchaet obretennaya Morrisom sposobnost zaglyadyvat v glub predmetov i dush, poznavat ikh soderzhanie i pamyat – svoego roda sverkhestestvennyy rentgen!

V svoikh iskaniyakh vy uznaete mnogo interesnogo ob istorii i folklore Shelmerstona, o ego zhitelyakh i priezzhikh gostyakh, o pereletnykh vyurkakh, morskom narodtse i morlo, a eshche legendu ob Aggi – toy zhenshchine, chto nekogda utikhomirila vulkan...

«Сказ о Бистуне» приглашает вас в яркий,:
«Skaz o Bistune» priglashaet vas v yarkiy, zhivoy mir, osnovannyy na persidskoy mifologii, vdokhnovlyonnyy klassicheskim tragicheskim literaturnym proizvedeniem XII veka «Khosrov i Shirin» (pers. خسرو و شیرین‎) — vtoroy po schyotu poemoy Nizami Gyandzhevi iz sbornika «Khamse», napisannoy s 1175 po 1191 god. Ona povestvuet o lyubvi sasanidskogo shakha Khosrova, pravivshego Iranom s 591 do 628 goda, k arameyskoy printsesse Shirin.
Glavnyy geroy poemy Khosrov, sasanidskiy tsarevich, zatem shakhinshakh Irana Khosrov II Parviz (590—628), v molodosti posle vosstaniya shakhinshakha Bakhrama Chubina bezhit v Armeniyu, vo dvor Mekhin Banu. Uvidev tam kupayushchuyusya prekrasnuyu Shirin, printsessu iz Bardy, plemyannitsu Mekhin Banu — moguchey pravitelnitsy Arrana, vlyublyaetsya v neyo. Shirin takzhe lyubit Khosrova, no politicheskie soobrazheniya zastavlyayut Khosrova zhenitsya na vizantiyskoy printsesse Mariam, Shirin zhe otvergaet vnebrachnuyu blizost.
V Shirin vlyublyon zodchiy Farkhad. Uznav ob etom, Khosrov nachinaet revnovat, prizyvaet Farkhada, sporit s nim, no Farkhad ne mozhet otrechsya ot mechty o Shirin. Togda Khosrov predlagaet Farkhadu vo slavu Shirin probit prokhod skvoz granitnuyu goru Bisutun. Farkhad soglasen, no pri uslovii, chto Khosrov otkazhetsya ot Shirin. Nesmotrya na nelyogkiy trud, master nachinaet rabotat. Shirin naveshchaet Farkhada u gory Bisutun, privetstvuet, podaet emu chashu s molokom. A kogda kon Shirin ostupaetsya v gorakh, Farkhad nesyot Shirin vmeste s eyo konyom do samogo zamka i vnov vozvrashchaetsya k svoey rabote. Khosrov byl razgnevan izvestiem o vstreche Shirin s Farkhadom, emu donosyat, chto trud blizok k zaversheniyu. Vam predstoit issledovat udivitelnye biomy i podnimatsya po zhivopisnym sklonam gory Bistun. A PLANET'S LAST HOPE\nGlitch is chilling:
A PLANET'S LAST HOPE
Glitch is chilling at his favorite local haunt when he sees something impossible in the sky: his home planet’s moons seem to be hemorrhaging life-giving Moon Juice—and what are those giant breweries sucking it all up? If Glitch doesn’t find out what’s going on and put a stop to it soon, all of the Moon Juice will be siphoned away and his own world won’t survive . Take control of the lovable hero in an action-packed, twitch-paced platformer that’s equal parts relentless and charming.

EXPLORE THE MOONS
Travel around planet Verdo’s four unique moons, each boasting extravagant environments and trippy themes. With 100 handcrafted levels, there’s a lot to experience.

WATCH OUT
Explosive platforms, snipers, gravity wells, charging brutes, lava, lasers, spikes, and so much more. With over 40 unique hazards and 16 killer enemies, you’ll never run out of danger.

GLITCH OUT
Glitch has a unique ability to get out of crazy near-death situations through becoming intangible. Use the ability to affect the environment in wild ways through toggling hidden blocks, flipping gravity, or making areas weightless.

EPIC BOSSES
4 epic bosses stand in your way to save Verdo. Liberate each moon from the tyrant occupying it and unlock the story of how they were corrupted by Moon Juice many years ago.

NO NEED TO WAIT
The four moons are dangerous environments but nothing will deter Glitch from saving his planet. Instant respawns and fast load times make it easier to get you back into the game and improve your progress.

THE RIGHT CHALLENGE
We designed the game to be challenging but with 3 standards of difficulty, you can progress Glitch through our challenges at your own pace. Mastered Glitch's ability? Raise the stakes, play on our highest difficulty and top the leaderboards!

V budushchem 2011 godu Zeta Rik, dobryy i krotkiy korol ksenoliytsev, budet svergnut mogushchestvennym tiranom po imeni Ksenoganner.

Ksenoganner — eto tainstvennoe sushchestvo, sposobnoe na mnogochislennye ustrashayushchie podvigi, ispolzuya dlya etogo silu, izvestnuyu kak «Ksenopriroda». Eto moshchnaya energiya, kotoraya daet cheloveku, umeyushchemu ee ispolzovat, mnozhestvo elementalnykh i neelementalnykh sil.

Zeta tozhe odaren silami Ksenoprirody. Zeta dolzhen svergnut Ksenogannera i vernut sebe tron...

...no deystvitelno li vsem etim zapravlyaet Ksenoganner...?

Korotkie etapy, effektnye, raznoobraznye i opasnye bossy, a eshche my dadim vam stolko zhizney, skolko potrebuetsya... potomu chto vam potrebuetsya stolko zhizney, skolko mozhno poluchit! Smozhet li Zeta pobedit Ksenogannera...? Tolko vy mozhete privesti ego k pobede!

V skorom vremen, natykaetsya on na neobychnyy ostrov posredi okeana. Vykhodya na bereg, vy ponimaete, chto sami stali chastyu bolshoy golovolomki, i razgadat eyo smozhet tolko istinnyy lyubitel priklyucheniy!..

Banjo-Kazooie — 3D-платформер, разработа:
Banjo-Kazooie — 3D-platformer, razrabotannyy kompaniey Rare i iznachalno vyshedshiy na Nintendo 64 v 1998 godu.
Eto pervaya igra v serii Banjo-Kazooie, kotoraya rasskazyvaet o medvede Bandzho i ptitse Kazui i o tom, kak oni pytayutsya ostanovit plany vedmy Gruntildy, kotoraya namerena ukrast krasotu u sestry Bandzho, Tuti. V igre sushchestvuet 9 raznykh igrovykh mirov, gde igrok dolzhen sobrat zhyoltye pazly pod nazvaniem «Jiggies». Igroku neobkhodimo reshat golovolomki, pereprygivat cherez prepyatstviya, sobirat predmety i unichtozhat vragov.
Igra dobilas znachitelnogo kommercheskogo uspekha: v SShA bylo prodano pochti 2 milliona kopiy. Ona poluchila vysokuyu otsenku za detalnuyu grafiku, vpechatlyayushchiy zvuk i slozhnyy dizayn urovney. V 1999 godu Banjo-Kazooie nagrazhdena dvumya nagradami ot Academy of Interactive Arts & Sciences: «Konsolnaya ekshn-igra goda» i «Vydayushchiesya dostizheniya v iskusstve/grafike».

Ishchite lyubov dlya sebya ili svoikh druzey. Pomogite pokoyniku dobitsya pravosudiya. I osteregaytes letuchikh myshey.

Dobro pozhalovat v Padshiy London — voskhititelno mrachnyy podzemnyy mir, gde smert yavlyaetsya lish vremennym neudobstvom, krysy razgovarivayut, a rasstoyanie do ada ne prevyshaet pary shagov.

V rezultate tainstvennoy sdelki London okazyvaetsya gluboko pod zemley. Syuda ne pronikayut luchi solntsa, a zdanie parlamenta pogruzilos na dno Temzy. Puritanskie normy Viktorianskoy epokhi nachinayut treshchat po shvam.

Gorodom upravlyayut Novye Khozyaeva. Pochemu oni takie... vysokie? A ikh litsa vsegda skryty? I pochemu ikh tak volnuyut lyubovnye istorii?

Teper mozhno ustanavlivat lichnye kontakty sovershenno po-drugomu. Vy mozhete podruzhitsya ili zavesti roman so mnozhestvom personazhey, vstrechayushchikhsya u vas na puti — ot naporistoy sosedki Griz do dzhentlmena s obzhigayushchim rukopozhatiem iz Latunnogo Posolstva.

Dazhe smert v etom gorode neordinarna: pervaya so vremen Padeniya zhertva ubiystva chuvstvuet sebya gorazdo luchshe i s neterpeniem zhdet pravosudiya. K sozhaleniyu, vash sosed Archi — glavnyy podozrevaemyy...

VOSKhITITELNYE OSOBENNOSTI

- Pridumayte svoyu istoriyu: kem vy byli do Padeniya? Kem vy stanete teper?
- Sozdavayte obrazy, chtoby poluchit dostup k novym vozmozhnostyam istorii;
- Vlyublyaytes v stol nepokhozhikh drug na druga londontsev s ikh udivitelnymi taynami;
- Pomogite svoim druzyam nayti lyubov ili obretite ee sami; - Igrayte v zakhvatyvayushchie mini-igry, chtoby zarabotat i popolnit resursy. Naskolko khorosho vy sochinyaete lyubovnye istorii?
- Raskroyte ubiystvo s pomoshchyu zhertvy;
- Poznakomtes s uyutnymi, tainstvennymi i potryasayushchimi ugolkami voskhititelno mrachnoy versii viktorianskogo Londona;
- Pogruzhaytes vsyo glubzhe v tayny s kazhdym prokhozhdeniem.
