Super Mario War — это фанатская кросспла:
Super Mario War — eto fanatskaya krossplatformennaya, besplatnaya fayting-videoigra s otkrytym iskhodnym kodom, vypushchennaya 16 dekabrya 2006 goda. Ona osnovana na elementakh igrovogo protsessa i audiovizualnykh media, skopirovannykh iz igr serii Super Mario Bros ot Nintendo.
V tsentre igry nakhodyatsya igroki, srazhayushchiesya drug s drugom, prygaya na golovu drugogo libo ispolzuya predmety, kotorye mozhno podobrat vo vremya srazheniy. V igre prisutstvuyut mnozhestvo gibko nastraivaemykh parametrov.
Калифорния, 1986 год. Компания друзей на:
Kaliforniya, 1986 god. Kompaniya druzey nakhodit tainstvennyy rozovyy kamen, pozvolyayushchiy peremeshchatsya mezhdu mirami. Etim prekrasnym letom rebyata popadut v istoriyu, kotoraya okazhetsya pravitelstvennym zagovorom. Pod vashim upravleniem pyat podrostkov s osobymi sposobnostyami, kotorym predstoit srazhatsya i reshat golovolomki, chtoby spasti svoi semi i ves mir.

Crossing Souls — igra v zhanre action-adventure s elementami RPG, deystvie kotoroy proiskhodit v pikselnoy Kalifornii. Pod vashim upravleniem pyat personazhey: Kris, Mett, Charli, Bolshoy Dzho i Kevin. U kazhdogo iz nikh unikalnye navyki i stil boya. Srazhaytes v realnom vremeni, reshayte raznoobraznye golovolomki, pobezhdayte moshchnykh bossov i igrayte na spetsialnykh urovnyakh po motivam arkad 80-kh. V techenie igry vy smozhete razblokirovat novye predmety i sposobnosti, kotorye pomogut vam v etoy missii po spaseniyu mira. Boi i zagadki stanut slozhnee, tak chto vam pridetsya razrabotat khoroshuyu strategiyu.
Уютная аркадная гоночка с солнечным пово:
Uyutnaya arkadnaya gonochka s solnechnym povorotom. Naslazhdaytes igroy do 4 igrokov na razdelennom ekrane, bezumnym tyuningom v stile bosodzoku, tablitsami liderov, grafikoy v stile tsellyuloznaya zalivka, muzykoy v stile sintveyv i rasslablennoy atmosferoy. Gran-pri zhdet vas!
Prokatites po zakhvatyvayushchim dukh dorogam, pogruzhayas v ritmy muzyki synthwave, v etom edinstvennom v svoem rode, neprinuzhdennom Gran-pri. Pobeyte rekordy vremeni, poluchite zakhvatyvayushchie prizy i izmenite vneshniy vid svoikh lyubimykh avtomobiley, vdokhnovlennykh evropeyskoy klassikoy.
Ваша задача — поразить противника мячом:
Vasha zadacha — porazit protivnika myachom 
S kazhdym popadaniem myach uskoryaetsya vse silnee.

Igrayte po seti vchetverom! Vklyuchayte usileniya, chtoby ustroit nastoyashchee bezumie!

Otkrytyy rezhim, «Udarnaya moshch», «Komandy», «Smertelnyy zalp», «Arkada» i «Syuzhet».

- Mnogopolzovatelskaya igra:
Zovite druzey na zakrytye i bystrye matchi. 

- Muzyka:
Bezumno krutoy saundtrek.
Спуститесь в мрачный мир от ума SUDA51!\:
Spustites v mrachnyy mir ot uma SUDA51!

V 24 palatakh Kanto sostavlyayut, kazalos by, idillicheskaya gorod, khotya zloveshchie tayny skryvayut nizhe ee poverkhnosti. Raskryt taynu ubivaniya zhestokikh ubiystv v kachestve chlena iz palat Heinous Crimes Unit v The Silver Case. Vozvrashchenie v gorod Kanto v 25-Uord: The Silver Case s novym pravitelstvom proekta za utopicheskogo 25 podopechnogo goroda. Kogda neskolko predpolagaemykh samoubiystv v Bayside Tower Land zhilom komplekse ugrozhayut narushit prikaz podopechnogo, vy budete prizvany rasporyazhatsya prestupnikami, otvetstvennykh za zagadochnye smerti. Opyt etu istoriyu s trekh razlichnykh tochek zreniya, chtoby sobrat etu mrachnuyu tusovku golovolomki.
8Doors is a story-driven Metroidvania-st: 8Doors is a story-driven Metroidvania-style action platformer heavily influenced by Korean folktales. Play as ‘Arum’, a brave girl that has entered the realm of the afterlife in search of her father’s soul and guide her through the '8 Doors of Purgatory' to solve the mysteries that lie deep within.
Платформер-головоломка, действие которог:
Platformer-golovolomka, deystvie kotorogo proiskhodit v antiutopicheskom mire, gde izobretenie ustroystva dlya klonirovaniya silno isportilo situatsiyu. Vooruzhennomu pushkoy dlya klonirovaniya i roskoshnymi usami, vam predstoit rabota po spaseniyu VSEY TsIVILIZATsII. Ne podvedite.

Shagnite v eticheski skomprometirovannoe budushchee, gde tekhnologiya klonirovaniya nanesla ushcherb chelovechestvu – i v etom otchasti VAShA vina! Kak sotrudnik gnusnoy mega-korporatsii i izobretatel Ustroystva Kvantovogo Vosproizvedeniya Materii (ono zhe UKVM, ono zhe prichina togo, chto mir katitsya k chertyam), vy dolzhny razobratsya v besporyadke, kotoryy vy sami i pomogli sozdat.

Khvatayte pushku dlya klonirovaniya i mchites po miru, pogruzhayushchemusya v khaos. Sozdavayte svoikh klonov i ispolzuyte ikh, chtoby reshat golovolomki i spasti chelovechestvo. No sdelayte eto s umom!

Osobennosti igry:
Sozdavayte klonov! Klepayte beskonechnye kopii samogo sebya s pomoshchyu pushki dlya klonirovaniya i ispolzuyte svoikh dvoynikov — do chetyrekh odnovremenno — dlya preodoleniya prepyatstviy i resheniya golovolomok

Zhertvuyte klonami! Antiutopii — ochen opasnye mesta, i mnogie klony budut stradat ot umoritelnykh i uzhasnykh smertey po puti. Podzharen! Razdavlen! Pokalechen! Splyushchen! RIP-klony :(

Issleduyte mir strannostey! Ot podozritelno druzhelyubnogo II i religioznykh fanatikov do modifitsirovannoy kukuruzy i klonirovannykh pand. V etom prichudlivom budushchem est (pochti) vse!

Podumayte ob etike! Kem vy pozhertvuete — soboy ili svoim klonom? Podumayte o morali klonirovaniya, poskolku vy obrekaete beschislennye versii sebya na smert

Usy! Igrayte za geroya s roskoshnymi usami. Ochen shelkovistymi. Kruche ne byvaet
В «Логово Дракона» вы играете героическо:
V «Logovo Drakona» vy igraete geroicheskogo Dirka Dardzhinga, doblestnogo rytsarya v poiskakh spaseniya spravedlivoy printsessy iz lap zlogo drakona!

«Space Ace» zastavit vas vzyat pod kontrol Ace - Zashchitnika spravedlivosti, pravdy i planety Zemlya! Tuz atakuet zloy komandir Borf. Borba s Deksterom, chtoby vosstanovit ego muzhestvennost. Unichtozhte Infanto-Ray. Porazhenie zlogo borfa! Bud doblestnym kosmicheskim voinom, sudba Zemli v tvoikh rukakh!

«Logovo Logova II II: Vremya Varpa» snova u vas est vedushchiy Dirk v opasnom kvete! Uvolennaya vovremya morshchin zlym volshebnikom Mordrokom, printsessa Dafna budet vynuzhdena vyyti zamuzh za zlobnogo Mordroka, esli Dirk ne smozhet ee spasti. Kak tolko shkatulka obrechena otkrylas, Mordrok pomestit koltso smerti na paltse Dafni v brake, i ona budet poteryana navsegda v Vremennoy voyne.

Vozmite vse tri iz etikh retro-arkadnykh klassikov segodnya!
В Death, Soul & Robots вы играете за оба:
V Death, Soul & Robots vy igraete za obayatelnogo kotika, kotoryy otpravlyaetsya na poiski dushi Planety-42, chtoby spasti Zemlyu ot gibeli. Srazhaytes s unikalnymi vragami, reshayte uvlekatelnye golovolomki i issleduyte interesnye urovni, chtoby dostich svoey tseli.
V igre vas zhdut shest bolshikh urovney biomov dlya issledovaniya, sem vidov oruzhiya, mnozhestvo raznoobraznykh kvestov i bolee desyati personazhey — kazhdyy so svoey istoriey. Krome togo, vy vstretite shesterykh interesnykh bossov, kazhdyy iz kotorykh budet dlya vas ispytaniem.
Vy budete natykatsya na razlichnykh personazhey, kazhdyy iz kotorykh imeet svoyu udivitelnuyu istoriyu. V kontse igry vam predstoit prinyat slozhnyy moralnyy vybor, kotoryy povliyaet na finalnuyu kontsovku.
V Death, Soul & Robots vas zhdut uvlekatelnye priklyucheniya i zakhvatyvayushchiy geympley. Gotovy li Vy spasti Zemlyu?
Вам предстоит исследовать огромный мегап:
Vam predstoit issledovat ogromnyy megapolis, ispolzovat tainstvennye sily i raskryt sekrety Vechnogo Mayaka..
Ispolzuyte prodvinutuyu mekhaniku fekhtovaniya, chtoby lomat stoyku protivnikov, otkryvayte skrytye tekhniki i poluchayte sily ot tainstvennoy sushchnosti, chtoby pomoch raskryt vse sekrety.
Игра для тех, кто всегда мечтал построит:
Igra dlya tekh, kto vsegda mechtal postroit dom s nulya! Razrabotayte sobstvennyy proekt, zakupite neobkhodimye materialy i postroyte luchshiy dom v mire bukvalno svoimi rukami.
Prosto li eto? Sperva – prosto, ved ponachalu vy igraete za nachinayushchego stroitelya. My obuchim vas azam stroitelstva, no po mere nakopleniya opyta vam pridetsya reshat vse bolee slozhnye zadachi.
Another Metroid 2 Remake (AM2R) — неофиц:
Another Metroid 2 Remake (AM2R) — neofitsialnyy remeyk igry 1991-go goda c Game Boy Metroid II: Return of Samus v stilistike Metroid: Zero Mission (2004) ot Milton Guasti, dlya proekta sozdateli takzhe zaimstvovali elementy iz drugikh chastey serii.
«V Project AM2R vy uznaete elementy geympleya, prisushchie Metroid: Zero Mission, atmosferu, kotoroy slavilas Super Metroid, a takzhe nakhodki iz drugikh chastey franshizy. Project Another Metroid 2 Remake — eto odin iz samykh ambitsioznykh proektov v istorii Metroid», — zayavili avtory. Etot reliz — port etoy igry ot Nikity 'tijesef' Krapivina na Switch, bez meshayushchego prokhozhdeniyu baga i s podderzhkoy russkogo yazyka, perevod ivanproff.
Chip And Dale Rescue Rangers Remastered, neofitsialnyy remeyk na GameMaker sm. zdes.

Классическая сетевая многопользовательск:
Klassicheskaya setevaya mnogopolzovatelskaya igra s uluchshennym upravleniem teper i na Nintendo Switch™! Ispytayte sebya v roli novogo uchenika, kotoryy zhazhdet obuzdat Silu pod rukovodstvom velikogo dzhedaya Lyuka Skayuokera.

- V vashem rasporyazhenii 6 setevykh rezhimov (v tom chisle osada, borba za flag i kazhdyy za sebya), v kotorykh mozhet odnovremenno uchastvovat do 16 igrokov.

- Prezhde chem otpravitsya v Akademiyu izuchat prelesti i opasnosti Sily, vam predstoit izmenit personazha na svoy vkus, vklyuchaya kak vneshnost, tak i pol.

- Sozdayte sobstvennyy svetovoy mech ot rukoyati do klinka. Po mere razvitiya personazha vy smozhete nauchitsya upravlyat srazu dvumya mechami ili ovladet prevoskhodnym dvustoronnim mechom, sozdannym znamenitym Dartom Molom.

- Vzaimodeystvuyte s mnogochislennymi populyarnymi personazhami «Zvezdnykh voyn» v klassicheskom okruzhenii. I tolko vam reshat, srazhatsya li za dobro i svobodu ili pereyti na temnuyu storonu.
Управляйте самой технологичной армией Им: Upravlyayte samoy tekhnologichnoy armiey Imperiuma – Adeptus Mekhanikus – v poshagovykh takticheskikh boyakh. Vas zhdut 50+ zadaniy (vklyuchaya zadaniya iz DLC Heretek). Deystvuyte ostorozhno i ne podvedite Imperium.
Жила-была Маленькая Принцесса, которая н:
Zhila-byla Malenkaya Printsessa, kotoraya ne khotela stanovitsya korolevoy. Odnazhdy ona sbezhala iz dvortsa na poiski zagadochnogo amuleta. Printsessa verila, chto amulet predast ey magicheskikh sil i pomozhet stat nastoyashchey volshebnitsey. 

Tem vremenem Bessmertnyy Prints sosednego korolevstva uznal o propazhe printsessy. On otvazhno otpravilsya na eyo poiski. S proklyatym oruzhiem emu predstoyalo preodolet mnogochislennye pregrady i polchishcha goblinov. 

Vas zhdet klassicheskiy platformer so mnozhestvom urovney, goblinov, shipov, lovushek i zagadok. Neozhidanno dlya sebya Malenkaya Printsessa i Bessmertnyy Prints naydut novykh druzey sredi goblinov v svoikh puteshestviyakh. Neobychnye zaklinaniya i magicheskoe oruzhie pozvolyat ostanavlivat vremya, letat nad zemley, prokhodit skvoz steny, stanovitsya gigantom, smetayushchim vse na svoem puti, zamorazhivat vragov, koldovat oblaka-stupenki, dyshat pod vodoy i mnogo drugoe. No ne volnuytes: vse vokrug ostayutsya tselymi i nevredimymi. 

The StoryTale rasskazhet vam dobruyu i miluyu skazku ob udivitelnykh priklyucheniyakh printsa-voina i printsessy-volshebnitsy, i napomnit o zamechatelnoy epokhe klassicheskikh videoigr.
В Сайпресс-Ридже — субботняя ночь, а это:
V Saypress-Ridzhe — subbotnyaya noch, a eto znachit, chto gorod lezhit v ruinakh, ordy plotoyadnoy nezhiti ryshchut po okruge, i vsya arkada v vashem rasporyazhenii! Vyberite svoego vyzhivshego i prokladyvayte sebe put k spaseniyu, poka gorod gorit vokrug vas, v etom priklyuchencheskom boevike uzhasov na vyzhivanie. O, i ne zabudte vzyat s soboy druga, chtoby pokormit zombi vmeste!
Railbreak sochetaet klassicheskuyu arkadnuyu igru na relsakh s ultrasovremennym dvizhkom u vas budet vozmozhnost poznakomitsya s dostoprimechatelnostyami i zvukami Saypress-Ridzha i podvergnutsya napadeniyu odnogo ili chetyrekh zombi! Srazites s gorodom v odinochku ili privedite s soboy druga. Na protyazhenii vsey igry podderzhivaetsya kooperativ dlya dvukh igrokov.
Куратора искусства держит в заложниках п:
Kuratora iskusstva derzhit v zalozhnikakh portretist, kotoryy ugrozhaet vzorvat bombu, esli trebovaniya ne budut vypolneny. The Gallery soderzhit dva povestvovaniya, kotorye proiskhodyat v 1981 godu (s glavnym geroem zhenshchinoy) i 2021 godu (s glavnym geroem muzhchinoy). Obe epokhi yavlyayutsya znachitelnymi periodami sotsialno-politicheskikh volneniy v Britanii, i mezhdu etimi dvumya istoriyami est skhodstva i razlichiya. Zritel dolzhen prinimat resheniya v popytke ponyat pokhititelya i izbezhat svoego pokhishcheniya. Odnako vskore stanovitsya ponyatno, chto ot etikh resheniy zavisit ne tolko zhizn glavnogo geroya, no i zhizni drugikh.

Osobennosti igry s zhivymi deystviyami interaktivnogo filma

- Mekhanizm osnovan na vybore, vklyuchaya 150 putey resheniy i 18 unikalnykh kontsovok.
- Otslezhivanie otnosheniy, kotorye vliyayut na obshchuyu istoriyu razlichnymi sposobami.
- Otslezhivanie yspekhov/neudach syuzhetnykh liniy vtorostepennykh personazhey, kotorye vliyayut na obshchuyu istoriyu razlichnymi sposobami.
- Dva igrovykh rezhima – «Vybory s Limitom Po Vremeni» dlya bolee zakhvatyvayushchego opyta pod davleniem vremeni i «Vybory s Pauzoy» dlya igry v gruppakh / uchastiya auditorii vo vremya zhivoy translyatsii.
- Razblokiruemaya funktsiya propuska stseny dlya soderzhimogo, kotoroe uzhe bylo prosmotreno.
- Izvestnyy akterskiy sostav, v tom chisle Anna Poppluell («Khroniki Narnii») i Dzhordzh Blagden («Vikingi» i «Versal») v glavnykh rolyakh.

Krome togo, stsenarist-rezhisser Pol Rashid yavlyaetsya odnim iz samykh tvorcheski plodovitykh tvortsov v zhanre videoigr c zhivymi deystviyami. Ego predydushchie filmy «Kompleks» i «Pyat svidaniy» byli vypushcheny v 2020 godu.
Вылупитесь из своего цветка и погрузитес:
Vylupites iz svoego tsvetka i pogruzites v prekrasnyy, mestami pugayushchiy mir Animal Well, pikselnogo chuda, polnogo zamyslovatykh zvukovykh i vizualnykh resheniy. Vstrechayte zhivykh sushchestv, bolshikh i malykh, dobrykh i zloveshchikh, otkryvaya nestandartnye uluchsheniya i razgadyvaya sekrety kolodtsa.
Eto poistine transtsendentnyy opyt, kotoryy mozhet zastavit vas smeyatsya — ot strakha li, udivleniya ili vostorga.
Вы просыпаетесь в холодной тусклой комна:
Vy prosypaetes v kholodnoy tuskloy komnate i medlenno privykaete k obstanovke, kotoraya neozhidanno kazhetsya znakomoy. Strannoe oshchushchenie ne pokidaet vas, ved chto-to zdes tochno ne tak. Potom vashe vnimanie privlekaet neobychnyy predmet, lezhashchiy na polu. Eto bloknot s nadpisyu CLeM. Pokopavshis v ego stranitsakh s zamyslovatymi risunkami nasekomykh i strannymi simvolami, vy obnaruzhivaete zapisku s poslaniem: «Day mne krasotu». Vy pytaetes ponyat, chto proiskhodit, no vdrug slyshite strannyy golos.
Otpravtes v tainstvennoe priklyuchenie!
Kanon (яп. カノン Канон) — японский визуаль:
Kanon (yap. カノン Kanon) — yaponskiy vizualnyy roman, razrabotannyy kompaniey Key i vpervye vypushchennyy dlya PK 4-go iyunya 1999 goda VisualArts. Pozzhe byli vypushcheny versii igry, ne soderzhavshie eroticheskikh stsen (tut soderzhatsya), a takzhe osushchestvleno portirovanie na drugie platformy, naprimer, na Dreamcast, PlayStation 2 i PlayStation Portable. «Kanon» stal pervoy igroy, vypushchennoy kompaniey Key. Vizualnyy roman stal odnim iz pervykh predstaviteley osobogo podzhanra podobnykh igr, poluchivshikh nazvanie «nakige», na volne populyarnosti kotorogo kompaniya Key prodolzhila vypusk analogichnoy produktsii.
«Kanon» posvyashchyon neskolkim devushkam, svyazannykh proshlym s Yuiti Aydzavoy, kotoryy spustya sem let otsutstviya vozvrashchaetsya v rodnoy gorod. U nego ne sokhranilos vospominaniy o tom vremeni, kogda on zhil zdes.
Roditeli daleko za granitsey, poetomu geroy ostanavlivaetsya v dome svoey tyoti Akiko Minase i dvoyurodnoy sestry, Nayuki. Ponemnogu, den za dnyom, k Yuiti vozvrashchaetsya pamyat o starykh znakomykh i o tom, chto proizoshlo v ego detstve..Ofitsialnaya versiya igry na Switch nakhoditsya tut.

Khardkornyy ekshn s grafikoy, vdokhnovlennoy GBA, i potryasayushchim tekhno-saundtrekom, Critadel predlagaet prakticheski bezgranichnoe raznoobrazie variantov konfiguratsii oruzhiya i predmetov. S obnovlyaemymi igrovymi personazhami i postoyanno izmenyaemymi vetvyashchimisya putyami, eta igra menyaetsya kazhdyy raz, kogda vy v nee igraete!

• Dva rezhima slozhnosti, a takzhe rezhim Boss Rush dlya vosproizvedeniya bitv s bossami.
Игра The Liar Princess and the Blind Pri: Igra The Liar Princess and the Blind Prince, soshedshaya so stranits starinnoy skazki, povestvuet ob istorii dvukh odinokikh serdets, obedinennykh vzaimnym nedorazumeniem. Prevrashchayas to v volka, to v printsessu, reshayte golovolomki, izbegayte lovushek, sobirayte tsvety i lepestki, otkryvayte fragmenty vospominaniy i probiraytes skvoz temnyy i opasnyy les, chtoby napravit printsa k izlecheniyu. No budte ostorozhny... vsevidyashchiy les ne luchshee mesto dlya slepogo printsa.
Небольшой стильный хоррор, в котором вы:
Nebolshoy stilnyy khorror, v kotorom vy upravlyaete kroshechnoy podvodnoy lodkoy, plyvya cherez okean krovi po inoplanetnoy Lune..
Vse zvyozdy i planety v etoy Vselennoy ischezli), ostalis lish asteroidy, da bezzhiznennye luny. Chelovechestvo yutitsya temi, kto ostalsya na kosmicheskikh stantsiyakh-korablyakh. Na odnoy iz takikh territoriy byl obnaruzhen bio-okean.

Eldritch — rogue-like stealth-шутер, осн:
Eldritch — rogue-like stealth-shuter, osnovannyy na proizvedeniyakh Govarda Fillipsa Lavkrafta. Igra sozdana dvumya bratyami, Devidom i Dzheem Kaylami Pittmanami, rabotavshimi nad dvumya pervymi BioShock i The Bureau XCOM Declassified.
Deystviya Eldritch razvorachivaetsya v dekoratsiyakh uzhasov Drevnikh Bogov. Ves mir igry generiruetsya sluchaynym obrazom. Igru mozhno prokhodit kak naprolom, unichtozhaya vsyo zhivoe i nezhivoe, tak i skrytno, izbegaya vragov.
Po slovam razrabotchikov, oni khotyat pokazat vse luchshee, chto bylo v seriyakh Bioshock i Deus Ex — naskolko eto vozmozhno silami dvukh chelovek.

Ваша космическая станция вот-вот взорвёт:
Vasha kosmicheskaya stantsiya vot-vot vzorvyotsya, i u vas est vsego 60 sekund do togo, kak vsyo poydyot naperekosyak. Chto (ili kogo) vy zakhvatite s soboy pered otchayannym ryvkom k spasatelnomu shattlu i puteshestviem v velikuyu neizvestnost?

60 Parsecs! — eto komediynoe nauchno-fantasticheskoe priklyuchenie s chyornym yumorom, deystvie kotorogo proiskhodit v atomno-kosmicheskuyu eru — s paranoyey po povodu kholodnoy voyny, khromirovannoy otdelkoy sten i tarakanami v germoshlemakh.

Stante liderom ekipazha uzhasayushche nepodgotovlennykh astronavtov, ekipirovannykh lyubym khlamom — prostite — «pripasami», zakhvachennymi pered tem, kak vy otpravilis v puteshestvie cherez kosmos, kotoroe luchshe vsego opisyvaet slovo «bestolkovoe». Stoyko perenosite neschastya, boryas s nedostatkom supa i drugimi uzhasami otkrytogo kosmosa. Khvatit li vashikh sposobnostey dlya togo, chtoby nayti novyy dom i vyzhit?

Schastlivogo puti!

KhVATAYTE PRIPASY I EVAKUIRUYTES
Ostalos vsego 60 sekund do togo, kak yadernye rakety prevratyat kosmicheskuyu stantsiyu v chastitsy, letyashchie cherez kosmicheskiy vakuum, poetomu begite, v sumatokhe zakhvativ pervye popavshiesya pripasy i chlenov ekipazha. Nikogda ne znaesh, kogda mozhet prigoditsya kukla iz noska.

VYZhIVAYTE I REShAYTE
Pokhorony v kosmose — neudobnoe delo, poetomu postaraytes po vozmozhnosti ne umirat. Ispolzuyte svoi ogranichennye pripasy i (nadeemsya, ne ochen ogranichennye) umstvennye sposobnosti, chtoby prinimat slozhnye resheniya i obespechivat svoyo vyzhivanie, nesmotrya na to, chto vse obstoyatelstva yavno deystvuyut protiv vas.

ISSLEDUYTE I MASTERITE
Esli skotchem mozhno vsyo skleit, to kak skleit (ili khotya by sdelat) sam skotch? Otpravlyayte ekspeditsii, chtoby nayti resursy, masterite predmety pervoy neobkhodimosti i issleduyte strannye novye miry vo vremya etogo metodichnogo priklyucheniya v rezhime «odnoy zhizni».

KOMANDUYTE I ZAShchIShchAYTE
Obyazannost kapitana — delat ekipazh schastlivym. Tak snizhaetsya veroyatnost togo, chto oni vas ubyut. Sledite za tem, kak razvivayutsya otnosheniya v komande, v nadezhde na to, chto nikto nikogo ne vykinet iz shlyuza.

Собирайте оружие везде, где только можно:

The archaeological research mission face:
The archaeological research mission faced some unexpected difficulties. Your spaceship crashed. Can you escape from this planet? But how? No one can help you. You are here all alone. Or not? Do you have a plan? Will you find what it takes to be a hero?

Star Story: The Horizon Escape is a turn-based, adventure game with text-rpg elements. Tune into the story of the aspiring space-archaeologist Van Klik on his mission to the mysterious planet of Horizon!

Non-linear plot development, 24 alternative endings
Your choices define the story. Totaly. Some will turn out better than others, some will be worse, and some will be straight up hilarious. You are here to find the real true ending among all of your possible destinies and become a hero. Or maybe something more...

Text-based gameplay
The core classic. Dive into the storie and find a way to exploit EVERY possible situation. Did you know that if you throw a lockpick at an attack droid, it will decide that you are stupid and will deactivate? Build your character, choose your alignments, learn the lore of the world. You will need it all to succeed.

Game mechanics
The story will throw a mix of dialogues, choices, turn-based battles, puzzles, weapon and resource crafting, technology research and more at you. You will use all you can to survive the challenging world of Horizon.

Turn-based philosophy
The player decides on the pace he wants to play the game at. Everything is turn-based. There is no time-limit for making decisions, no quick-time events, no rush: you can take any amount of time to make your move.

Beautiful world
Enjoy the wild and crazy sceneries of the Horizon world. Deserts, jungles, cities, underground caverns… the list goes on.

Colorful characters
Meet the locals! Who is more to your liking? Side with “Bullet King” and uncover an ancient cryptic artifact. Or choose to undermine his brutal regime and make the local revolutionary your friend. Or leave them and go try to play romance with the alien girl? Or blow up the planet? Or… You get it!

Красочный файтинг в формате настольной к:
Krasochnyy fayting v formate nastolnoy kollektsionnoy kartochnoy igry: vmesto nazhatiy knopok i provedeniya kombinatsiy zdes vy prinimaete resheniya s pomoshchyu kart ataki, blokov, broskov, ukloneniya i osobykh spets. sposobnostey. Otlichitelnye elementy sistemy boya:
Tomb Raider («Расхитительница гробниц»):
Tomb Raider («Raskhititelnitsa grobnits») — kultovaya kompyuternaya igra v zhanre priklyuchencheskogo boevika, pervaya igra odnoimyonnoy serii igr.
Tomb Raider — eto odin iz rodonachalnikov zhanra shutera ot tretego litsa! Igra byla nastolko populyarna, chto porodila mnozhestvo podrazhaniy i v tselom okazala znachitelnoe vliyanie na razvitie dannoy vetvi igrovoy industrii. Do sikh por Tomb Raider i Lara Kroft ostayutsya odnimi iz samykh uznavaemykh simvolov kultury kompyuternykh igr, a za 20 let sushchestvovaniya serii bylo prodano svyshe 58 millionov ekzemplyarov igr po vsemu miru.
Ekstsentrichnaya biznes-ledi Zhaklin Natla nanimaet Laru Kroft dlya poiskov drevnego artefakta Stsiona. Arkheolog otpravlyaetsya v gornuyu ekspeditsiyu v Peru, gde nakhodit potaynoy vkhod v zhilishche inkov. Provodnik Lary pogibaet ot ataki volkov, i dalshe — ey prikhoditsya idti odnoy..
Квинн очнулся в закрытой комнате, где ес:
Kvinn ochnulsya v zakrytoy komnate, gde est tolko kompyuter, podklyuchennyy k chatu, v kotorom nakhodites vy. Vy stali ego edinstvennoy nadezhdoy. Vashi bystro prinyatye resheniya pomogut emu sbezhat... ili povedut ego po doroge, gde vsyo zakonchitsya raz i navsegda.

Chasy ne ostanavlivayutsya
STAY — igra v rezhime realnogo vremeni, a znachit, provodya vremya vne ee, vy ostavlyaete Kvinna v odinochestve. Posledstviya ne zastavyat sebya zhdat, esli vy vyydete iz razgovora ili nadolgo ostavite Kvinna.

Razvivayte empatiyu
Kvinn na grani, poetomu znachenie imeet kazhdyy otvet. Sochuvstvuyte emu i budte khoroshim soyuznikom, chtoby on nauchilsya doveryat vam: togda on rasskazhet vam obo vsyom, chto obnaruzhit, i podelitsya samymi sokrovennymi myslyami. No ego emotsii srabotayut protiv vas, esli vy ne opravdaete ego ozhidaniy.

Interaktivnyy syuzhet
24 glavy, sem raznykh kontsovok, desyatki potentsialnykh smertey i mnozhestvo vozmozhnykh variantov vedeniya razgovora spodvignut vas igrat v STAY snova i snova. Issleduyte raznye komnaty, i posledovatelno otkryvayte sekrety, chtoby uznat vsyu istoriyu tselikom. 

Otkroyte pravdu
Blagodarya veb-kameram vy smozhete nablyudat za Kvinnom, videt ego reaktsiyu na vashi kommentarii, a takzhe ego deystviya, kogda on ne za klaviaturoy. Uznayte, kogda on lzhet, i obernite eto znanie sebe na polzu.

Reshayte golovolomnye zadachi
Pomogite Kvinnu razgadat rebusy, s kotorymi on stolknetsya v svoey tyurme. V razdele golovolomok vy smozhete napryamuyu upravlyat ego deystviyami.
С незапамятных времен существуют те, кто:
S nezapamyatnykh vremen sushchestvuyut te, kto obladaet sverkhchelovecheskimi sposobnostyami. Etikh sushchestv, pokhozhikh na nechto srednee mezhdu chelovekom i zverem, nazyvayut polulyudmi. Oni deystvovali kak sinobi i sluzhili tem, kto stoyal u vlasti.
Yura i Tama. Eti koshki-nindzya sdelali svoy dinamichnyy vkhod. Ikh ocharovanie i volya zastavlyayut glav. geroya prinyat ikh. No kak on budet ikh podderzhivat? Kak v nashe vremya ispolzovat nindzya? Po mere togo, kak on razmyshlyaet nad etim voprosom, v nashem geroe zarozhdayutsya chuvstva..
No kto zhe shpionit za nimi iz teni?.. Eto — dushevnaya istoriya o devushkakh-koshkakh-nindzya!Eshchyo vizualnykh novell na Switch (renpy).

Bloodstained®︎: Ritual of the Night — см:

Igrayte za Miriam — sirotu, che telo medlenno prevrashchaetsya v kristall iz-za alkhimicheskogo proklyatiya. Chtoby spasti chelovechestvo i samu sebya, Miriam dolzhna budet probitsya skvoz zamok i pobedit maga-prizyvatelya Dzhibelya. 
Sobirayte, sozdavayte i otkryvayte raznye vidy oruzhiya, snaryazheniya i dobychi, kotorye pomogut pobedit beschislennykh slug tmy i adskikh bossov!
Планка только что поднялась! В этом высо:

«Vy slyshali pro derevnyu Inunaki? Eto proklyataya derevnya, kotoroy net ni na odnoy karte. Tot, kto osmelitsya v nee voyti, zhivym ne vyydet!»

Legenda glasit, chto po druguyu storonu realnogo tonnelya Inunaki v regione Kyusyu lezhit samoe zhutkoe mesto v Yaponii — derevnya, gde ne deystvuyut zakony etogo mira. Te, kto v nee zakhodyat, ne vozvrashchayutsya. Prosto legenda? Ili... realnost?

Mladshiy brat Kaede propal, i u nee ne ostaetsya drugogo vybora, kak proverit legendu. No, pytayas nayti ego v starom tonnele Inunaki, ona stalkivaetsya s nevoobrazimym uzhasom.

Shest chelovek prishli v derevnyu Inunaki — kazhdyy po svoey prichine. No est mesta, kuda luchshe ne khodit, i derevnya Inunaki iz ikh chisla, ved ee uzhasy nikogda ne spyat...

◆ Originalnaya igra v zhanre «priklyucheniya/uzhasy»
Issleduyte vse ugolki derevni, spasayas ot zhutkikh prizrakov, kotorye khotyat ostanovit vas... naveki! Reshayte zagadki i doberites do nastoyashchey kontsovki, ispolzuya naydennye predmety! Srazhaytes v mini-igrakh, kogda na vas napadayut!

◆ Novaya uzhasnaya istoriya
Igrayte za shesterykh personazhey i otkroyte bolee 50 kontsovok. Issleduyte derevnyu s ikh tochek zreniya. Ikh deystviya mogut navredit drugim, spasti ikh ili pomoch otkryt pravdu. Tolko uvidev vsyo, vy smozhete otkryt istinnuyu istoriyu derevni Inunaki!

◆ Muzyka ot legendarnogo kompozitora Akira Yamaoka
Vsemirno priznannyy avtor muzyki dlya igr Akira Yamaoka (seriya Silent Hill) sochinil dlya igry novuyu temu i fonovuyu muzyku, kotoraya vselit v vashe serdtse uzhas, poka vy pytaetes vyzhit lyuboy tsenoy.

◆ Vnimanie
V igre est materialy, kotorye mogut okazatsya slishkom pugayushchimi i nepriyatnymi dlya nekotorykh igrokov. Igrayte na svoy strakh i risk. Sozdateli igry ne nesut otvetstvennosti za moralnye travmy v rezultate igry.
Перенеситесь в мир музыки благодаря этом:
Perenesites v mir muzyki blagodarya etomu izbavlennomu ot nasiliya tvorcheskomu platformeru. V Symphonia vam predstoit sobrat orkestr i ozhivit mir muzykalnykh mashin, preodolevaya prepyatstviya s pomoshchyu lovkosti i zvukov skripki.
V mire Symphonia muzyka sluzhit istochnikom zhizni i energii. No posle ischeznoveniya osnovateley i ikh orkestra v nego prishel razlad, i mir postepenno umolkaet. No chto esli sobrat novyy orkestr? Otvet na etot vopros predstoit nayti Filimonu, tainstvennomu muzykantu iz mira Symphonia.

Tomb of the Мask - это увлекательная арк:
Tomb of the Mask - eto uvlekatelnaya arkada s zaputannym labirintom, gde za kazhdym povorotom vas zhdyot novaya golovolomka. V poiskakh priklyucheniy vy zabiraetes vnutr drevney grobnitsy. Issleduya samye potayonnye eyo ugolki, vy nakhodite neobychnuyu masku. Nadev masku, vy obretaete sposobnost vzbiratsya na steny legko i bystro. I eto tolko nachalo istorii.

Vy stolknyotes litsom k litsu s khitroumnymi lovushkami i zleyshimi vragami, proverite svoi silu i lovkost v razlichnykh igrovykh mekhanikakh i usilite vashi sposobnosti. Naberites khrabrosti i pogruzites v mir maski s tremya uvlekatelnymi igrovymi rezhimami:

•	Istoriya. V tsentre sobytiy - misticheskaya istoriya drevney maski. Vyberite vernyy put i priderzhivaytes ego. Izbegayte iskusno sozdannykh lovushek, tayashchikhsya na kazhdom shagu zaputannykh koridorov labirinta. Proydite 450+ urovney i pobedite svoikh vragov, imeya v rasporyazhenii tolko skorost i pytlivyy um.
•	Arkada. Rezhim na vyzhivanie, v kotorom vam nuzhno prodvinutsya nastolko daleko, naskolko eto vozmozhno i sobrat naibolshee kolichestvo tochek i zvyozd. Vyigraete vy eto srazhenie ili zhe proigraete - vsyo v vashikh rukakh.
•	Duel. V rezhime dueli vy srazites s drugim igrokom v smekalke i skorosti reaktsii. Preodoleyte vse prepyatstviya i oderzhite verkh nad vashim sopernikom. Stavki nikogda ne byli tak vysoki.

Calico — это онлайн-сим с важной и милой:
Calico — eto onlayn-sim s vazhnoy i miloy tselyu: perestroit gorodskoe kotokafe i napolnit ego milymi pushnymi sozdaniyami! Vy popadete v derevushku, v kotoroy zhivut volshebnye devchonki i prochie fantasticheskie sushchestva, i nachnete zanovo otstraivat zabroshennoe kotokafe. Nachnite s nulya: pokupayte prikolnuyu mebel i milye ukrasheniya, gotovte deserty i snova napolnite vashe kafe zhivotnymi vsekh mastey!

U nas v Calico — tolko milota i dobrota. Igrovoy protsess lish pomogaet rasslabitsya i poluchat udovolstvie ot issledovaniya mira igry.

Глубокой ночью над Северным Уэльсом бушу:
Glubokoy nochyu nad Severnym Uelsom bushuet svirepaya burya. Za mnogo mil ot lyubogo goroda Kris Selvud ishchet ubezhishcha v otdalennom pridorozhnom kafe.
Tam on stanovitsya svidetelem uzhasnogo zrelishcha: nechto so svirepo goryashchimi glazami raspinaet ofitsiantku na potolke. Srazu posle etogo Kris teryaet soznanie, a zatem probuzhdaetsya v pylnykh razvalinakh zabroshennogo kafe.

Vdokhnovlennaya nauchno-fantasticheskim khorrorom 80-kh i sovremennym syurrealisticheskim kinematografom, igra Chasing Static realizuet unikalnyy podkhod v zhanre povestvovatelnykh priklyucheniy s pomoshchyu novoy audialnoy igrovoy mekhaniki i nelineynogo issledovaniya.


Kharakteristiki:

* Ultrazvukovoe issledovanie — Igrovoy protsess s uporom na zvuk: ishchite anomalii pri pomoshchi eksperimentalnogo ustroystva dlya nablyudeniya za smeshcheniem chastot.

* Lou-fay, khay-fay — Uglovatye nizkopoligonalnye modeli, napominayushchie o grafike, polnaya ozvuchka, vysokokachestvennoe zvukovoe oformlenie i sovremennyy podkhod k igrovomu protsessu.

* Nelineynyy igrovoy protsess — Issleduyte mir Chasing Static kak dushe ugodno, otkryvaya ego sekrety v lyubom poryadke, v kotorom vam tolko zablagorassuditsya.
Ты — охотник за головами с Дикого Запада:
Ty — okhotnik za golovami s Dikogo Zapada, kotoromu nuzhno nayti legendarnoe poteryannoe sokrovishche. Po puti tebe pridetsya pobedit mnogikh prestupnikov, chtoby zavladet ikh zolotom i poleznymi predmetami, chtoby uluchshat svoi sposobnosti. 

No igra predlagaet nechto bolshee, chem prosto byt odinokim reyndzherom. Ty takzhe mozhesh igrat protiv chetyrekh druzhbanov-kovboev — malo ne pokazhetsya! 


OSOBENNOSTI
* Epicheskoe kovboyskoe priklyuchenie na Dikom Zapade
* 12 raznoobraznykh i slozhnykh etapov
* Lokalnyy multipleer dlya 1-4 igrokov
* Elementy RPG, takie kak oruzhie i uluchsheniya
Оказавшись на острове, вы должны научить:
Okazavshis na ostrove, vy dolzhny nauchitsya vyzhivat. Ispolzuyte svoyu snorovku, chtoby ubivat ili priruchat pervobytnykh sushchestv, brodyashchikh v okruge. Vzaimodeystvuyte s drugimi igrokami, chtoby vyzhivat, vlastvovat... i izbezhat vernoy gibeli!

PRIRUChAYTE, TRENIRUYTE, RAZVODITE PITOMTsEV I EZDITE VERKhOM NA DINOZAVRAKh V ZhIVOY EKOSISTEME
V igre mozhno priruchit okolo 80 sushchestv. Priruchiv sushchestvo, vy smozhete im komandovat nastolko, naskolko khorosho vy ego priruchili i obuchili. Pitomets rastyot i povyshaet svoy uroven, potreblyaet pishchu, a takzhe perenosit vashi veshchi. Letayte na pterodaktile, gonyayte po dzhunglyam so svoey staey raptorov ili presleduyte dobychu na tirannozavre reks! Nablyudayte za dinamicheskoy ekosistemoy so svoey sobstvennoy ierarkhiey khishchnikov i zhertv. Razvodite svoikh pitomtsev putyom posledovatelnogo skreshchivaniya pokoleniy, chtoby uluchshit ikh cherty i osobennosti. 

PIShchA, VODA, TEMPERATURA I POGODA
Chtoby vyzhit, neobkhodimo pitatsya razlichnymi vidami pishchi (v tom chisle chelovecheskim myasom!). Vse deystviya v igre istoshchayut zapasy edy i vody, a dalnie puteshestviya — sily. Ves inventarya zamedlyaet vas, a okruzhayushchaya sreda menyaetsya v zavisimosti ot vremeni sutok i pogodnykh usloviy. Izgotovlyayte odezhdu, stroyte ukrytiya i ispolzuyte ogon, chtoby zashchititsya ot raneniy i nepogody.

SBOR, KRAFT I POKRASKA PREDMETOV
Rubite derevya, sobirayte rudu i tak dalee, chtoby stat umelym remeslennikom. Ispolzuyte razlichnye prisposobleniya, chtoby sozdat moshchnoe snaryazhenie. Postroyte bazu iz razlichnykh materialov i izmenyayte ee s pomoshchyu kraski i tablichek, na kotorykh mozhno risovat. Oruzhie, odezhdu, bronyu i drugoe snaryazhenie takzhe mozhno izmenyat.

ROLEVAYa SOSTAVLYaYuShchAYa
Povyshaya uroven svoego personazha i nakaplivaya opyt v igre, vy smozhete sozdavat novye «engrammy» dlya izgotovleniya predmetov i nakhodit slozhneyshie chertezhi v samykh opasnykh ugolkakh. Izmenyayte vneshniy vid svoego personazha s pomoshchyu kompleksnoy sistemy kastomizatsii.

Depraved cultists have opened a portal to the Dark Realm and a demonic invasion has begun! Pandora ventures into the depths of Hell to slay the dark powers who threaten to conquer the World of Light. Run, jump and slash your way through frozen wastelands, lava filled chambers and living caverns made of putrefying flesh as you do battle with hordes of condemned monstrosities. Defeat the many merciless masters of each stage to reach the final showdown with the Devil Herself!

Leap, duck and dodge through countless murderous traps. Use your trusty Viper Sword and magical ranged weapons to tear through demonic denizens who thirst for your blood in this classic style linear side-scrolling action game.

From the duo at MagicShotGames comes Dire Vengeance; a side-scrolling action platformer with gothic-themed visual designs and high-resolution graphics. This game is the spiritual successor to many 16-bit all time greats and features several gameplay mechanics inspired by Castlevanina, Ninja Gaiden, Mega Man and Gradius. Other influences come from 80s and 90s horror film franchises such as Alien, Hellraiser and A Nightmare on Elm Street. 

The inclusion of big boss battles, challenging levels, customizable power-up system, unlockable bonuses as well as a djent-tastic soundtrack adds both quality and freshness that modern day gamers expect.

GAME FEATURES
- Gorgeous hand-painted sprites and colorful animations. Beautiful high-resolution visuals with 60 fps in a modernized retro 2D action platformer!
- Flexible powerup system that lets you tailor your upgrades to your own style of play
- 20 unique subweapons
- Over 60 unique enemies and 21 challenging bosses
- Unlockable bonuses including Bestiary and Boss Rush Modes
- Demonic mechanisms and platforming obstacles that will push your skills to the limit
- Heart pounding metal soundtrack keeps the action in high gear! Composed by “Master of Metal”, Hooman Ahmadi, the music of Dire Vengeance is just as good for headbanging as it is for crushing zombie skulls!
Angry Birds (с англ. — «Рассерженные пти:
Angry Birds (s angl. — «Rasserzhennye ptitsy», «engri byordz») — videoigra-golovolomka, razrabotannaya finskoy kompaniey Rovio Entertainment, pervaya igra odnoimyonnoy serii. Iznachalno byla vypushchena dlya ustroystv na iOS i Maemo 11 dekabrya 2009 goda. Posle uspekha igry v App Store byli vypushcheny versii dlya Android, Symbian, Windows Phone i BlackBerry 10. Vposledstvii poyavilis versii igry dlya drugikh platform, a v 2022 vyshel remeyk Rovio Classics: Angry Birds. Geympley igry takov: igrok dolzhen zapuskat ptits v sviney pri pomoshchi rogatki. Uroven budet proyden, esli igrok unichtozhit vsekh sviney, v protivnom sluchae ego pridyotsya prokhodit zanovo. Chashche vsego svini ispolzuyut stroeniya iz blokov v kachestve ukrytiya.
V igru voshli sleduyushchie epizody-urovni: «Varyonye yaytsa» (angl. Poached Eggs), «Velichayshiy obman» (Mighty Hoax), «Opasnost sverkhu» (Danger Above), «Bolshaya perestroyka» (The Big Setup), «Vetchina vyshe nikh» (Ham 'Em High), «Shakhta i uzhin» (Mine and Dine), «Vecherinka v chest dnya ptits» (Birdday Party), «Priboy i bereg» (Surf and Turf; ranee predstavlena v versii igry na Facebook), «Plokhie svini» (Bad Piggies), «Moguchie perya Reda» (Red's Mighty Feathers; est urovni s otlichnym ot drugikh geympleem), «Korotkoe zamykanie» (Short Fuse), «Lyubimtsy stai» (Flock Favorites), «Pyatyy den rozhdeniya v chest ptits» (Birdday 5) i bonusnyy epizod «Red spasaet zhizni» (Red Saves Lives; byl dostupen 2 nedeli posle ego vypuska). V dopolnenie k urovnyam Surf & Turf poyavilis bonusnye aktivatory. Takzhe poyavilis dopolnitelnye urovni-novye rezhimy igry Angry Birds. Zolotoe yaytso «Korol sviney» (King Pig), kotoroe daetsya za prokhozhdenie vsekh zolotykh yaits, vklyuchaet neskolko takikh rezhimov: «Korol sviney» (King Pig), «Zamena materiala» (Material Mix Up), «Ptiche beshenstvo» (Bird Frenzy), «Polnoe unichtozhenie» (Total Destruction).
Proekt byl vysoko otsenen ekspertami. Kris Kholt iz Macworld skazal, chto ona «uvlekatelnaya, zakhvatyvayushchaya, umnaya». Dzhonatan Lyu iz Wired News napisal, chto igrovoy protsess napominaet «popytki poluchit maksimalnoe kolichestvo zvyozd». Khvalebnyy kommentariy otpustil i Keyt Endryu iz Pocket Gamer. Igra byla neodnokratno polozhitelno rassmotrena spetsializirovannymi izdaniyami po vsemu miru.

Worms вернулись в самой разрушительной и:
Worms vernulis v samoy razrushitelnoy igre, chto vy kogda-libo videli. Worms W.M.D — luchshaya igra iz serii Worms, kotoraya otlichaetsya potryasayushchey 2D-grafikoy s risunkami ot ruki, polnym arsenalom oruzhiya, bolshim vyborom transporta i zdaniy, a takzhe vozmozhnostyu sozdaniya veshchey!

S Worms W.M.D dlya Nintendo Switch™ igroki poluchat vozmozhnost poznakomitsya so vsemi missiyami kampanii, urovnyami, nastroykami i obnovleniyami, vklyuchaya «Osvobozhdenie» i lyubimyy fanatami rezhim krepostey, igraya doma ili na khodu. Krome etogo, vladeltsy Nintendo Switch pervymi uvidyat tonny novykh materialov!

• Sovershenno novaya tema: kosmos!
• Novye kreposti: grib i derevo
• Novye nastroyki: tri novykh kostyuma, a takzhe tri novykh mogilnykh plity, u kotorykh vy smozhete oplakat svoikh ushedshikh bespozvonochnykh tovarishchey.

Neveroyatno smeshnaya takticheskaya igra o voyne chervyakov Worms W.M.D dlya Nintendo Switch™ podderzhivaet odin dzhoystik Joy-Con™, a takzhe lokalnuyu besprovodnuyu mnogopolzovatelskuyu igru i mnogopolzovatelskuyu igru po seti.

Klyuchevye kharakteristiki:

Prekrasnaya 2D-grafika. Luchshee voploshchenie formuly Worms — teper s polnostyu obnovlennym chervyakom i velikolepnym khudozhestvennym oformleniem, vypolnennom v tsifrovoy 2D-grafike.

Transport. Vpervye v igrakh Worms chervi poluchat podkreplenie v vide transporta. Pokorite lyuboy landshaft v zakalennykh v voynakh tankakh, obrushte na vraga ognennyy dozhd, vzletev vysoko v nebesa na vertolete, i mnogoe drugoe! 

Zdaniya. Poluchite takticheskoe preimushchestvo, spryachte svoikh chervey v zdanii i zashchitite ikh ot pryamykh udarov!

Sozdanie. Bolshe ne nuzhno zhdat khoda protivnika! Khvatayte yashchiki sozdaniya, padayushchie s neba vo vremya igry, i sozdavayte chudovishchno uluchshennye versii takikh predmetov, kak elektricheskaya ovtsa, pirog iz bazuki i svyataya ruchnaya granata, chtoby razgromit svoikh vragov!

Klassicheskie fizicheskie i igrovye printsipy Worms. Nash polnostyu obnovlennyy dvizhok vossozdaet samykh populyarnykh personazhey serii i snova predlagaet vsemi lyubimuyu klassicheskuyu verevku nindzya.

Novoe i klassicheskoe oruzhie. V vashem rasporyazhenii bolee 80 vidov oruzhiya i sredstv i kucha novinok, kak, naprimer, khitraya telefonnaya batareyka, nezhelannyy podarok i udar OMG.
The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky:
The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky (yap. 英雄伝説 空の軌跡, Eiyuː Densetsu sora no kiseki) — rolevoy ekshn, razrabotannaya yaponskoy studiey Nihon Falcom v 2004-om godu; iznachalno igra izdavalas pod nazvaniem The Legend of Heroes VI: Trails in the Sky FC. Eto pervaya igra v podserii Trails serii igr The Legend of Heroes.
V 2006 ona byla portirovana na PlayStation Portable, versiya igry s uluchshennym razresheniem vyshla v 2012 godu na PlayStation 3, a v 2015 godu na PlayStation Vita vyshlo izdanie s novymi vozmozhnostyami, pererisovannymi animirovannymi portretami, peredelannym interfeysom i ozvuchkoy dialogov poluchivshee nazvanie The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky FC Evolution. Proekt poluchila polozhitelnye otsenki pressy, usrednyonnaya otsenka na Metacritic sostavlyaet 85 ballov iz 100. Redaktor IGN otsenil igru na 8 ballov iz 10 i otmetil, chto ona predlagaet zabavnyy stsenariy, dinamicheskie bitvy, interesnye zadaniya i zakhvatyvayushchee povestvovanie na protyazhenii mnogikh chasov igry. Sayt Hardcore Gamer pokhvalil glubinu prorabotki personazhey, kazhdyy iz kotorykh imeet svoyu istoriyu, stremleniya i sotsialnye svyazi, otmetiv, chto dazhe neigrovye personazhi imeyut svoi imena, motivy i vzaimootnosheniya s drugimi personazhami.
Sobytiya igry proiskhodyat v vymyshlennom mire na kontinente Zemuriya. Lyudi zhivut na oskolkakh drevney, nekogda ochen razvitoy tsivilizatsii, ot kotoroy ostalis neveroyatnye artefakty, chto lyudi nazyvayut arkhaizmami. Zhiteli Zemurii veryat v boginyu neba, kotoruyu predstavlyaet Septianskaya tserkov. Za pyatdesyat let do sobytiy igry byl otkryt novyy istochnik energii i proizoshla tekhnicheskaya revolyutsiya.
Neposredstvennye sobytiya igry proiskhodyat v korolevstve Liberl, kotoroe raspolozheno v yugo-zapadnoy chasti kontinenta i granichit s respublikoy Kalvard na vostoke i imperiey Ereboniya na severe. Za desyat let do sobytiy igry imela mesto stodnevnaya voyna mezhdu Ereboniey i Liberlom, vo vremya kotoroy Ereboniya pochti zakhvatila Liberl, no byla otbroshena s pomoshchyu vozdushnykh korabley i takticheskikh resheniy. Poslevoennyy Liberl razdelyon na pyat regionov razdelyonnykh stenami i vorotami.

Продолжение нашумевшей ATOM RPG! ТРУДОГР:
Prodolzhenie nashumevshey ATOM RPG! TRUDOGRAD — eto poshagovaya postapokalipticheskaya rolevaya igra, sleduyushchaya traditsiyam klassicheskikh igr, takikh kak Fallout, Wasteland i Baldur’s Gate.
22 goda nazad SSSR i strany Zapadnogo bloka unichtozhili drug druga v rezultate obmena yadernymi udarami. Milliardy lyudey pogibli, obshchestvennye ustoi pali, nauchnyy i tekhnologicheskiy progress byl otbroshen nazad, v Srednevekove. Sochetanie nauchno-fantasticheskogo priklyuchencheskogo ekshena i rolevoy igry na Lune v 30xx godakh! Glavnaya geroinya, Bella, puteshestvuet po sputniku v poiskakh sposoba spasti chelovechestvo ot komety Koda. Perezhivite istoriyu o nauke, pravde, spravedlivosti i doverii vmeste!
Rolevoy priklyuchencheskiy ekshen v stile anime, deystvie kotorogo razvorachivaetsya na Lune! Tysyachu let nazad chelovechestvo zhilo na nyne bezzhiznennoy vulkanicheskoy planete Terra. Posle planetarnoy katastrofy ASTRA lyudi byli vynuzhdeny iskat novyy dom. Uvy, v predelakh dosyagaemosti ne sushchestvovalo ni odnoy prigodnoy dlya zhizni planety, poetomu lyudi otpravilis na Lunu, sputnik Terry.
Chelovechestvo, preispolnennoe optimizma, nadezhd i reshimosti, prodolzhalo zhit i protsvetat v novom dome. Spustya sotni let, v 30XX godakh, Luna stala domom dlya odnikh iz samykh vydayushchikhsya umov v istorii chelovechestva (a takzhe dlya ikh tvoreniy). Odnako zhizni lyudey snova okazalis pod ugrozoy: k Lune priblizhaetsya kometa iz antimaterii, podobnaya toy, chto unichtozhila zhizn na Terre tysyachu let nazad!
Prisoedinyaytes k lunnomu voinu Belle, kotoraya probivaet sebe dorogu po poverkhnosti Luny v poiskakh sposoba unichtozhit kometu prezhde, chem nastanet konets zhizni v privychnom vide! Srazhaytes s zagadochnymi monstrami, myorkami, ispolzuya gibridnuyu boevuyu sistemu, sochetayushchuyu poshagovyy rezhim. Raskroyte sekrety ischeznuvshey tsivilizatsii i spasite Lunu!
Space Grunts сочетает в себе динамичную:
Space Grunts sochetaet v sebe dinamichnuyu arkadnuyu igru s poshagovym igrovym protsessom.

THE GRANDFATHER OF A GENRE\n\nAction Sup:
THE GRANDFATHER OF A GENRE

Action SuperCross is the first of its kind - a physics-based motorbike simulator, inspiring many famous franchises. It is the direct predecessor of Elasto Mania, showcasing the evolution of countless fascinating, unique and experimental concepts and gameplay mechanics.

A CHALLENGE OF SKILL AND STYLE

Maybe you can get through the levels, but can you beat world records? Compete with your friends or watch the replays of the world's top players. Going fast is easy, but being the best of the best is the real challenge.

A TIMELESS EXPERIENCE FOR ALL AGES

Dive into the world of Action SuperCross, where the classic gameplay that captivated a generation awaits players both old and new. The timeless appeal of its physics-based motorbike simulation and thrilling level designs continue to entertain and challenge gamers of all ages. Rediscover the excitement of mastering each level, honing your skills, and striving for personal bests. Embrace the nostalgia, or embark on this adventure for the first time, and join the global community of Action SuperCross enthusiasts.
Популярный симулятор разработки игр, поз:
Populyarnyy simulyator razrabotki igr, pozvolyayushchiy vam vossozdat istoriyu razvitiya igr i vozglavit sobstvennuyu kompaniyu po razrabotke igr, nakonets-to poyavilsya na Nintendo Switch™. Optimizirovannaya kak dlya sensornykh ekranov, tak i dlya kontrollerov Joy-Con™, igra Game Dev Tycoon stala luchshe, chem kogda-libo prezhde.

Game Dev Tycoon pozvolyaet vam perezhit istoriyu razrabotki igr ot pervykh potug entuziastov v garazhakh v 80-kh godakh do sovremennykh studiy urovnya AAA. Na svoe usmotrenie vy mozhete nanimat luchshie komandy, sozdavat luchshie igry i issledovat luchshie tekhnologii, chtoby ostavit svoy sled v industrii igr.

Sozdavat igry na svoy lad: v Game Dev Tycoon imeyut znachenie resheniya, prinimaemye vami v khode razrabotki. Nuzhen li vashey igre bolee ostryy geympley, uluchshennyy zvuk ili vy sobiraetes sosredotochitsya bolshe ne kvestakh i priklyuchencheskikh igrakh? Vam reshat!

Rastite svoyu kompaniyu: vypustiv neskolko uspeshnykh igr, vy smozhete pereekhat v sobstvennyy ofis i splotit sobstvennuyu komandu mirovogo klassa. Nanimayte personal, upravlyayte im i otkryvayte novye vozmozhnosti razrabotki. Sozdavayte sobstvennye igrovye dvizhki, izobretayte novye tekhnologii i ne tolko.

Myslite masshtabno: s krupnoy fanatskoy bazoy i zamechatelnoy komandoy vy smozhete sozdavat vse bolee krutye igry i gresti pribyl i slavu. No ambitsioznye zamysly prinosyat i novye ispytaniya, i vam potrebuetsya upravlyat svoey komandoy.

Piratskiy rezhim: sozdanie uspeshnoy igrovoy kompanii samo po sebe yavlyaetsya neprostym delom, no esli vy khotite «pogoryachey», vy mozhete poprobovat sygrat v (optsionalnom) piratskom rezhime, v kotorom raznuzdannoe igrovoe piratstvo soblaznyaet vashikh fanatov ne platit za igry vovse, i vam prikhoditsya srazhatsya s nim, chtoby ostavatsya na plavu.

Krossplatformennye sokhraneniya: uzhe igraete v Game Dev Tycoon na drugikh platformakh? Ne problema! Blagodarya vozmozhnosti krossplatformennogo sokhraneniya vy mozhete importirovat uzhe imeyushcheesya sokhranenie i prodolzhit igrat na toy platforme, na kotoroy vam udobnee.

Pikuniku — потрясающе абсурдная игра, в:

EarthNight is a painting brought to life:
EarthNight is a painting brought to life and a love letter to classic arcade games.  Dragons have taken over the Earth, and humanity has fled to space. You must help Stanley and Sydney skydive back to Earth while careening across the backs of massive, snake-like dragons as they soar high above the planet, all while an original chiptune soundtrack pounds away in the background. Every moment is intense and layered with intricacy.  

Game Features:
• Jump and dash your way across the backs of dragons on your way down to Earth in classic 2D side-scrolling action.

• Unlock more than 25 gameplay-altering powerups that will aid you on your journey as you slay dragons and discover secrets.

• Experience a unique run no matter how many times you play thanks to near-infinite variations of hand designed, procedurally generated levels. 

• Explore five layers of the atmosphere with more than 40 enemies, more than 15 unique dragons and hundreds of scraps and items, all brought to life by artist Mattahan, who meticulously painted each of EarthNight’s 10,000+ frames of art and animation.

• Enjoy an original, exciting soundtrack intertwined into gameplay, including more than 20 songs written and performed by chiptune musician Chipocrite.

GamesRader:

PC Gamer:
"EarthNight feels like a game with a fiery heart and formidable talent in every facet of development."

Comicsbeat:

TechnoBuffalo:

"Every moment is intense and layered with intricacy, from the look of the game to the glorious soundtrack, it's premise and how it controls.”

Puzzle games must be addictive. That's why we designed 200 levels to not only challenge your skills but also your imagination. With its tight controls, Art of Balance is easy to pick up and hard to put away.

The goal sounds simple at first: Build a balanced stack from all given shapes, but there are plenty of challenges. Some shapes break under load, while others can even reverse gravity and literally turn the stack upside down. With practice, some experimentation and a little bit of luck however you'll quickly master even the most difficult challenges.

Packed with 5 unique game modes, online play and local split-screen, Art of Balance is the ultimate test for aspiring puzzle masters. Three additional players can join in at any time and help you solve the puzzles.

Puteshestvuyte po yarkim biomam etogo mira, razrabotayte strategiyu oborony ot uymy robotov i spasite chelovechestvo!

> Podvizhnye vragi 
Ogromnye tolpy robotov mogut menyat napravlenie dvizheniya, a igroki i tureli mogut ikh tolkat, pikhat i raskidyvat.

> Strategiya i draki
Unikalnoe sochetanie zhanrov: zashchita kreposti, strategiya i massovaya draka. Oruduyte ogromnym molotom, begayte i prygayte po yarkim urovnyam. Uznayte, kak luchshe vsego primenyat tureli protiv nadvigayushchikhsya tolp vragov.

> Igra s druzyami ili v odinochku
Mozhno odinakovo interesno igrat v odinochnom ili kooperativnom rezhime. Igrayte po seti ili lokalno v komande do 4 igrokov. Lokalnykh i setevykh igrokov mozhno sochetat kak ugodno.

> Raznoobraznye urovni 
Puteshestvuyte po futuristichnomu miru iz 32 yarkikh raznoobraznykh urovney. Spravlyaytes s unikalnymi ispytaniyami v 8 biomakh — ot vulkana, kotoryy peregrevaet tureli, do rasteniy-mutantov, utyagivayushchikh igrokov v dzhungli.

> Novye tekhnologii
Po mere prodvizheniya cherez mir dobavlyayte v kollektsiyu novye tureli i gadzhety. Ispolzuyte ikh v bitvakh s naborom unikalnykh robotov. Vypolnyayte ispytaniya, chtoby otkryvat novye ukrasheniya.

> Neskonchaemoe vesele
Igrokam nekogda otdykhat, i oni ne prosto zhdut, kak razvernutsya sobytiya. Stroyte i uluchshayte tureli, sobirayte metallolom, beyte robotov i polzuytes unikalnymi turelyami v bitve za spasenie mira.

Generations after the collapse, its surv:
Generations after the collapse, its surviving descendants have chosen you to become The Bellwielder of the magical Audros Bell. Go forth, battle monsters, solve puzzles, and restore Anuchard to its former skyward glory! 

Anuchard was known as a place of wonder and peace, a land of limitless bounty suspended in the heavens above. Five ancient Guardians gave the island their blessings... Until one day they left without a word. The Anuchardian paradise fell from the skies, crashing onto the world below. Only a tiny speck of an island survived the fall. The rest has been coalesced underground into a twisted mass of winding passages full of wild magic and vicious monsters, known simply as The Dungeon.

Generations passed as few survivors eked out an existence in the Orchard, the sole village on the surviving island, which maintains  the few remains of Anuchardian magic. Farmers tend to the fields while scavengers pick through the bones of the kingdom. 

All await the Chosen One, the Bellwielder, who will take up the Audros Bell and enter the Dungeon, wake the Guardians from their slumber, and bring back paradise.

Be judged worthy and take up the mantle of the Bellwielder. The Dungeon awaits!

The Bell Tolls

For everyone and everything. You are the Bellwielder and the Audros Bell is your best friend.

Master the Bell! Not just as a weapon, but as a most vital tool for overcoming puzzles and obstacles.

A bell can be more than just a blunt instrument of mayhem. Use its knock-back ability to smash enemies into obstacles, reposition them, and clear the way forward.

Solve challenges throughout the Dungeon with the Bell. Launch projectiles, move puzzle pieces, and utilize them creatively!

Enter the Dungeon

The warped, magical Dungeon houses the Guardians needed to restore the lost kingdom of Anuchard.

Explore handcrafted, unique dungeons. Each was changed by magic to match the personality and aspect of its owner.

Each is a unique challenge as a result. Master their unique mechanics to reach the slumbering Guardians - and unlock the deepest reaches of the greater Dungeon.

Remember your duty: Confront and defeat the Guardians in set piece boss battles, to make them return to serve the people of Anuchard.

Restoring Paradise

Assist the Orchard along the path of a Bellwielder’s legendary quest.

Rescue the souls of lost villagers trapped in the Dungeon, returning them to Orchard through the ritual of revival.

Each revived villager contributes to your quest. Farmers, chefs, herbalists, all will help you and the rest of the village to restore Anuchard.

Prepare for ever deeper ventures into the Dungeon. Cook up meals using ingredients provided by village residents, then head back into the fray!

Sonic the Hedgehog '06 (яп. ソニック・ザ・ヘッジホッ:
Sonic the Hedgehog '06 (yap. ソニック・ザ・ヘッジホッグ Sonikku dza Kheddzikhoggu, rus. «Yozh Sonik»), takzhe izvestna kak Sonic 2006 i Sonic Next-Gen — ofitsialnaya videoigra v zhanre 3D-platformera iz serii Sonic the Hedgehog na igrovye konsoli Microsoft Xbox 360 i Sony PlayStation 3, razrabotannaya studiey Sonic Team i vypushchennaya Sega osenyu 2006 goda, pervyy proekt franshizy, izdannyy dlya konsoley sedmogo pokoleniya. Deystvie igry proiskhodit v mire, pokhozhem na Zemlyu. Syuzhet posvyashchyon ezham Soniku, Shedou i Silveru, kotorykh obedinyaet odna tsel — spasti planetu ot monstra po imeni Solyaris. Geympley razdelyon na dve chasti: osnovnuyu, gde igrok prokhodit urovni, i otkrytyy mir, po kotoromu mozhno svobodno peremeshchatsya.
Igra priurochena k 15-letiyu vykhoda pervoy igry Sonic the Hedgehog. Proekt byl anonsirovan v mae 2005 goda na vystavke Electronic Entertainment Expo. Studiya planirovala vypustit platformer na Wii i Windows, no ikh reliz tak i ne sostoyalsya.
Deystvie proiskhodit na planete, pokhozhey na Zemlyu, na «Adventure Fields», Polya Priklyucheniy. Kazhdoe takoe «pole» predstavlyaet soboy nelineynyy etap igry, po bolshey chasti prednaznachennyy dlya resheniya zagadok, issledovaniy i prodvizheniya po syuzhetu. «Adventure Fields» svyazany mezhdu soboy, i v kazhdom iz nikh est po neskolko serebryanykh medaley. Glavnuyu rol v syuzhete igraet raspolozhennyy na vode gorod Soleanna, yap. ソレアナ Soreanna, Soleanna.Drugie igry pro Sonic'a zdes.

My uznaem, chto dom osnashchyon peredovoy sistemoy monitoringa, i nas prosyat vzyat eyo pod kontrol, a zatem spasti zhiteley, atakuya vorov i prestupnikov, pokushayushchikhsya na zdanie, i nayti kod, otkryvayushchiy podval. Situatsiya oslozhnyaetsya prisutstviem tainstvennogo ubiytsy...
V glavnykh rolyakh: Kamilla Kuper, R. Li Ermi, Vendi Gazel, Kori Khaim, Debbi Garri, Irvin Kiz, Teylor Negron, Devid Paker, Kimberli Odzha, Bruk Makkarter.Eshchyo FMV-igry.

Final Fantasy III (yap. ファイナルファンタジーIII faynaru fantadzi: suri: ili faynaru fantadzi: san) — yaponskaya rolevaya igra, razrabotannaya i izdannaya kompaniey Square v 1990 godu dlya platformy Nintendo Family Computer. Eto tretya chast v serii videoigr Final Fantasy.
V tsentre syuzheta igry istoriya chetyryokh Voinov Sveta, v originale nazvannykh obshchim terminom Lukovye rytsari i poluchivshikh lichnye imena (Lyunet, Ark, Refiya i Ingus) v 3D-remeyke. Kogda oni nakhodyat Kristall Vetra, on nadelyaet ikh osoboy siloy i poruchaet vosstanovit v mire ravnovesie.
V 2006 godu ona byla pereizdana dlya Nintendo DS v sovremennoy tryokhmernoy grafike i s uchyotom sovremennykh tekhnologiy, i v etom formate byla vypushchena v SShA i evropeyskikh stranakh v dalneyshem na Android.Drugie igry serii Final Fantasy na Switch.
Hypnospace Outlaw is a '90s internet sim:
Hypnospace Outlaw is a '90s internet simulator in which you scour Hypnospace's wide variety of weird and wonderful websites to hunt down wrongdoers, while also keeping an eye on your inbox, avoiding viruses and adware, and downloading a plethora of apps that may or may not be useful.

As part of your job as a Hypnospace Enforcer, you'll be watching out for copyright infringement, internet bullying and more, with reports and rewards coming direct from the Hypnospace Patrol Department to your inbox. In your spare time, you can customize your HypnOS desktop however you see fit, with a variety of downloads, wallpapers, screen savers and helper bots to keep you company.

So slip on your Hypnospace Headband™, and keep these key directives in mind:

- Crawl through Cyberspace: Scour the darkest corners of the Web for scumbag users who violate Hypnospace law!
- Dangers and delights: Download groovy GIFS and MIDI files, but watch out for adware, toolbars and hackers!
- Treasure hunting: Do your job to earn Hypnocoins, or ignore your inbox and go hunting for hidden pages, downloads and secrets!
- Relive your childhood: Equip obnoxious screensavers and skins for your desktop, and wiggle your mouse pointer around to make pages load faster!

Planiruyte kazhdyy khod i sochetayte razlichnye ataki, chtoby pobedit vragov v srazheniyakh-golovolomkakh. Uluchshayte geroev i sushchestv, chtoby sokrushit protivnika, i produmyvayte strategiyu, kotoraya privedet vashi voyska k pobede.

SYuZhET

Deystvie igry Might & Magic: Clash of Heroes razvorachivaetsya za 40 let do sobytiy sagi Heroes of Might & Magic V. Vy poznakomites s pyatyu geroyami iz raznykh regionov Askhana. Kazhdomu iz nikh predstoit preodolet opasnye ispytaniya, chtoby stat silnee, raskryt demonicheskiy zagovor i spasti svoy mir ot gibeli.

OSVOYTE UNIKALNYE I DINAMIChNYE BOEVYE MEKhANIKI!

Ispytayte svoi takticheskie navyki v unikalnykh boyakh Clash of Heroes, sochetayushchikh golovolomki i strategiyu. Proydite syuzhetnuyu kampaniyu, dlyashchuyusya bolee 20 chasov, i broste vyzov drugim igrokam v setevom i lokalnom rezhimakh. Produmayte idealnuyu strategiyu i stante nastoyashchim liderom, kotoryy privedet svoi voyska k pobede!

Eksperimentiruyte, chtoby nayti nailuchshee sochetanie sushchestv, artefaktov i zaklinaniy. Sostavlyayte bezumnye kombo i proryvayte ryady vragov. Kazhdoe dopolnitelnoe kombo mozhet stat reshayushchim!

Poluchayte opyt posle kazhdoy bitvy i povyshayte uroven svoego geroya i sushchestv, chtoby sobrat nepobedimuyu komandu. Nakhodite artefakty i pribegayte k uslugam naemnikov, kotorye pomogut vam spasti mir ot gibeli.

SETEVOY I LOKALNYY MNOGOPOLZOVATELSKIY REZhIM

Vyberite lyubimogo personazha iz 15 geroev, prinadlezhashchikh k 5 fraktsiyam. Povyshayte moshch svoey armii v boyakh 1 na 1, mudro sochetaya artefakty, zaklinaniya i sushchestv!

Obedinites s soyuznikom v boyakh 2 na 2 i proyavite chudesa slazhennosti! Izvlekayte maksimalnuyu vygodu iz sokrushitelnykh kombo, chtoby odolet vragov i prinesti svoey komande kak mozhno bolshe pobed!"

Chto vyberet ta, v chikh rukakh nakhoditsya sudba vsego sushchego i Ordena Khraniteley vremeni?

Vo vremya svoego puteshestviya Yui:
- Poznaet tayny Vsesveta, kotorye pomogut ey ochistit mir ot Teney.
- Budet peremeshchatsya mezhdu dvumya vremennymi liniyami, naslazhdayas spokoystviem proshlogo i prodirayas cherez peripetii budushchego.
- Issleduet Vcherazavtrie, sostoyashchee iz 4 takikh raznykh ostrovov: posetit zelenye lesa, zabytye pustyni i promerzshuyu ledyanuyu tundru, a v kontse stupit na sam Ostrov vremeni, gde reshitsya sudba ee mira!
- Srazitsya so mnozhestvom neobychnykh sushchestv i brosit vyzov lyutym bossam.
- Reshit golovolomki i naydet novye sposoby ispolzovaniya okruzheniya!
- Naydet potaynye oblasti, prokachaet umeniya i soberet vse svitki etogo mira, rasskazyvayushchie o Vcherazavtrii i ego obitatelyakh.
- Pogladit vsekh zhivotnykh!
Kids Vs Parents - это семейная игра с му:
Kids Vs Parents - eto semeynaya igra s multyashnym dizaynom, kotoraya skrasit vashu povsednevnuyu zhizn doma! Posuda, kotoruyu nuzhno pomyt, sobaka, kotoruyu nuzhno vygulyat, komnaty, kotorye nuzhno privesti v poryadok... Vsegda est obyazannosti, no nekomu ikh vypolnyat... Deti VS Roditeli - eto igra, kotoraya reshit za vas, kto budet ikh vypolnyat! Sorevnuytes vsey semey: Roditeli protiv detey, i pust pobedit silneyshiy! Vy pobedili? Vybirayte!

Roditeli boyatsya proigrat protiv svoikh umelykh detey? Ne volnuytes! Upravlenie v igre ochen prostoe i chasto ispolzuet upravlenie dvizheniem: vstryakhivayte, tseltes, povorachivayte Joy-Con™ vashey Nintendo Switch™, chtoby pobedit v igre! U vsekh odinakovye shansy na pobedu!

Vas zhdut 50 mini-igr v chetyrekh razlichnykh rezhimakh:

"Semeynyy" chellendzh: smeyatsya ne stoit, ved pobedivshaya komanda poluchit nagradu, a proigravshaya - zheton! Dostupno neskolko variantov idey dlya smeshnykh i razdrazhayushchikh zadaniy, no tolko ot vas zavisit, kakoy iz nikh bolshe vsego podkhodit vashey seme! 
Primer: Shtraf "Nakryt na stol" / Preimushchestvo "Vybrat film po televizoru".
Kazhdaya komanda sorevnuetsya tolko v mini-igre, pobediteli/proigravshie dayut obeshchanie!

Dom mechty: Podnimites na etazhi doma mechty, chtoby poluchit samuyu krasivuyu komnatu i nasladitsya otlichnym snom! Mini-igry sleduyut odna za drugoy, komanda, vyigravshaya mini-igru, podnimaetsya na odin etazh... Pervaya komanda, dostigshaya vershiny doma, pobezhdaet v igre!
Osteregaytes, dom mechty inogda ozornichaet! Malus i bonusy mogut byt primeneny k komandam bez prichiny: vybor sleduyushchey mini-igry, igra na odnoy noge v sleduyushchem raunde... Vse mozhet sluchitsya!

Turnir: Komanda mozgov ili myshts? V rezhime "Turnir" vy igraete tolko v mini-igry vybrannoy kategorii. Dostupny chetyre razlichnykh turnira:
- Lyubitel risovaniya: Dlya igrokov s tvorcheskim myshleniem i kistochkoy!
- Vopros dlya chempiona: Kto okazhetsya samym umnym?
- Master golovolomok: Tolko dlya samykh lovkikh!
- Vse protiv vsekh: Zdes net komand, kazhdyy sam za sebya, i pust pobedit silneyshiy.

Praktika: Praktikuytes vo vsekh mini-igrakh "Deti protiv roditeley" v etom rezhime, chtoby sklonit chashu vesov v svoyu polzu i obespechit pobedu.
В этом безумном аркадном шутере-боевике,:
V etom bezumnom arkadnom shutere-boevike, polnom pul, botov i vzryvov, vy smozhete pokazat svoi navyki i refleksy! Vy igraete za Erin Seyver, pomogaya ey osushchestvit lichnuyu vendettu protiv prestupnoy gruppirovki Dikikh botov i vosstanovit spravedlivost.

V Bot Vice est avtomaticheskaya sistema pritselivaniya, kotoraya polnostyu pereopredelyaet etot zhanr i pozvolyaet vam sosredotochitsya na tom, chto deystvitelno vazhno: strelyat, uvorachivatsya i veselitsya! Osvaivayte dvizheniya i knopki upravleniya do tekh por, poka vy ne VOYDETE v ritm samogo intensivnogo shutera iz kogda-libo sozdannykh. Erin ne mozhet povysit svoy uroven, no VY smozhete… Gotovy k ispytaniyu?

– Superintensivnyy arkadnyy shuter!
– Na kazhdom etape vash zhdut novye vragi, opasnosti i bossy!
– Vozmozhnost otkryt rezhim dopolnitelnykh missiy.
– Tri urovnya slozhnosti: «Bezumie», «Voin» i «Novichok».
– Prevoskhodnaya krasochnaya pikselnaya grafika.
– Otlichnyy saundtrek iz 90-kh v stile «sint-rok».
В том, что в тихом омуте черти водятся,:
V tom, chto v tikhom omute cherti vodyatsya, Keyiti prishlos ubeditsya na svoyom sobstvennom opyte. Pereekhav s roditelyami iz goroda v zhivopisnuyu derevushku Khinamidzavu i podruzhivshis v malenkoy mestnoy shkole s ocharovatelnymi odnoklassnitsami, on dazhe ne podozreval, naskolko obmanchivo ego predstavlenie ob etom bezmyatezhnom krae i ego obitatelyakh. No, kak pozdnee vyyasnil Keyiti, za fasadom derevenskoy idillii skryvaetsya tyomnaya istoriya zverskikh ubiystv i besslednykh ischeznoveniy, a pod pokrovom blagostnoy tishi deystvuyut kakie-to uzhasnye sily..
«Kogda plachut tsikady» (yap. ひ ぐ ら し の な く 頃 に, Khigurasi no Naku Koroni), sozdannaya 07th Expansion, rasskazyvaet o gruppe molodykh druzey, zhivushchikh v vymyshlennoy derevne, i o strannykh sobytiyakh, proiskhodyashchikh tam v 1983 godu. Mnogie poklonniki svyazyvayut uspekh igry s neobyknovennoy neizvestnostyu i uzhasom, kotorye izobrazhaet etot vizualnyy roman. Populyarnost igry rosla v geometricheskoy progressii, tak kak mnogie zainteresovalis otlichnym stsenariem i istoriey, v rezultate chego obshchiy obem prodazh v Yaponii sostavil 908 391 kopiy.
Versiya poluchila obshchuyu otsenku 31/40 (iz chetyrekh individualnykh otsenok 9, 8, 8 i 6) ot yaponskogo igrovogo zhurnala Famitsu. Po rezultatam oprosa, provedennogo v avguste 2007 goda, chitateli zhurnala Dengeki G's Magazine priznali igru v desyatke samykh interesnykh iz sushchestvuyushchikh igr-bisyodzyo. Ego angloyazychnyy sobrat takzhe poluchil polozhitelnuyu otsenku kritikov: Hardcore Gamer napisali, chto «stsenariy neveroyatno zhutkovatyy i udivitelno effektnyy», i prishel k vyvodu, chto «nemnogie videoigry mogut priblizitsya k iskusnomu postroeniyu syuzheta, prisutstvuyushchemu v serii igr «Kogda plachut tsikady».
Ofitsialnyy yaponskiy port dlya Nintendo Switch pod nazvaniem Higurashi no Naku Koro ni Hou vklyuchaet ves vypushchennyy na dannyy moment kontent vizualnykh novell v serii, a takzhe nekotorye dopolnitelnye materialy.

Наступил апокалипсис…\n\nВ безрассудной:
Nastupil apokalipsis…

V bezrassudnoy popytke ostanovit voynu, sotryasayushchuyu mir desyatiletiyami, magi ustroili Kataklizm. Ogromnye sgustki chistoy magii unichtozhili prakticheski vse. Mir obvolok tainstvennyy fioletovyy tuman, v kotorom zatailis krovozhadnye monstry, vykhodyashchie naruzhu po nocham.

Nasha edinstvennaya nadezhda — Poslednee zaklinanie, kotoroe izbavit obrechennyy mir ot magii. Ego podgotovka zaymet neskolko dney, i v eto vremya gorstka otchayannykh geroev dolzhna zashchishchat neschastnykh magov ot lyubykh ugroz.

The Last Spell — eto takticheskaya rolevaya igra s elementami roguelite, v kotoroy vam predstoit oboronyat gorod ot polchishch smertonosnykh vragov

V techenie dnya vam nuzhno gotovit geroev k boyu, tshchatelno produmyvat vosstanovlenie oplota i razmeshchat oboronitelnye sooruzheniya. A nochyu vy dolzhny istrebit vsekh vragov, atakuyushchikh vashi steny, primenyaya raznoobraznoe oruzhie i navyki. Istselyayte ranenykh, povyshayte uroven i povtoryayte ves protsess snova i snova, poka Magicheskaya pechat ne budet razbita.
Сюжет игры основан на скандинавской мифо:
Syuzhet igry osnovan na skandinavskoy mifologii. Glavnaya geroinya — valkiriya po imeni Lennet, kotoraya nabiraet i treniruet dushi pogibshikh voinov-eynkheriev pered tem, kak otpravit ikh v Valkhallu, gde oni ozhidayut Ragnaryoka: posledney bitvy mezhdu Asami i Vanami. Krome togo, Lennet postepenno uznayot sobytiya svoey proshloy zhizni.
Bolshuyu chast igry valkiriya ishchet dushi pogibshikh voinov i vidit poslednie chasy ikh zhizni, treniruet ikh pered otpravkoy v Asgard, gde oni ozhidayut Ragnaryoka — posledney bitvy mezhdu asami i vanami. Poslednie chasy zhizni mnogikh voinov opisyvayutsya kak otdelnaya, zachastuyu emotsionalnaya i tragichnaya istoriya; v Asgarde eynkherii obshchayutsya s bogami i vypolnyayut ikh zadaniya samostoyatelno — valkiriya mozhet periodicheski uznavat proveryat progress ikh razvitiya, no vernut otpravlennogo eynkheriya v svoy otryad ona ne mozhet. Kazhdyy voin imeet svoyu Znachimost geroya, kotoraya otobrazhaet stepen ikh poleznosti. Lennet dolzhna otpravlyat eynkheriev tolko s trebuemoy Znachimostyu, kotoruyu ey periodicheski soobshchaet boginya Freyya — pomoshchnitsa verkhovnogo boga Odina i podruga Lennet.
Obozrevateli vstretili Valkyrie Profile khorosho, igra poluchila 83,39% na GameRankings i 81% na Metacritic. Internet-portal GameSpot dal igre 7 ballov iz 10, nazvav eyo «slozhnoy, ambitsioznoy i velikolepnoy», otmetiv estetichnost settinga, interesnuyu boevuyu sistemu, tseplyayushchikh personazhey, a takzhe tshchatelno sbalansirovannye razvetvleniya stsenariya, pokhvaliv «fantasticheskuyu muzyku» i «yarkiy syuzhet». Yaponskiy zhurnal Famitsu prisudil Valkyrie Profile 35 ballov iz 40, v 2000 godu vklyuchiv eyo v spisok 120 velichayshikh igr vsekh vremyon dlya pristavki PlayStation. V tom zhe godu, v sootvetstvii s golosovaniem obozrevateley zhurnala, igra byla pomeshchena na 30-e mesto v spiske 100 luchshikh igr konsoli. V 2006 godu Famitsu oprosil chitateley s tselyu vyyavit luchshuyu igru iz vsekh kogda-libo sozdannykh — skazanie o valkirii v itogovom spiske zakrepilos na 27-y pozitsii. Internet-portal IGN v 2006 godu nazval Lenneth luchshey rolevoy igroy dlya sistemy PSP.
В роли суперсобак Крипто и Туза готовьте:
V roli supersobak Kripto i Tuza gotovtes vzmyt v nebesa i zashchitit ulitsy Metropolisa! Eto priklyuchencheskaya igra po motivam filma, v kotoroy nado spasat domashnikh zhivotnykh. 

Lyubimye geroyskie sobaki Supermena i Betmena uznali o sekretnykh planakh Leksa Lyutora pokhitit bezdomnykh zhivotnykh Metropolisa, i oni ne sobirayutsya sidet slozha lapy! Tuz s ego atakami betarangami i vsem korpusom i Kripto s ego sposobnostyami zharkogo vzglyada i arkticheskogo laya pomogut vam ukrotit zlykh leksbotov. Podgotovtes k reshayushchey bitve s Leksom, kotoryy uzhe oblachaetsya v innovatsionnyy boevoy kostyum, i poputno spasayte zhivotnykh, poka ikh ne zaperli v zooparke LexCorp. 

Superpitomtsy ne tyanut kota za khvost! Ukhazhivayte za pushistymi druzyami v priyute, pomogite im obresti novyy dom i poluchite osobye nagrady. Vashi druzya — Chip, Merton i PiBi — pokazhut novye supersposobnosti. Superpitomtsy vosstanovyat spravedlivost! 


VZRYVAYTE BOTOV. Zashchishchayte ulitsy Metropolisa, obkhodite pregrady i srazhaytes so zlymi leksbotami. 

VYBIRAYTE GEROYa. Vy mozhete igrat za Kripto s lazernym vzglyadom ili za vooruzhennogo betarangami Tuza. Menyayte geroya i usileniya, chtoby poluchit novye vpechatleniya ot zadaniy. 

SPASAYTE BEZDOMNYKh ZhIVOTNYKh. Pomogite zhivotnym iz priyuta obresti dom, okruzhite ikh zabotoy i poluchite supernagrady!
Решайте совместные головоломки и развязы:
Reshayte sovmestnye golovolomki i razvyazyvayte zhestokie predatelstva v etom kooperativnom platformere-golovolomke! Poteryavshis gluboko pod zemley, zastryav v drevnikh ruinakh, vy dolzhny rabotat vmeste, chtoby preodolet ispytaniya zabytykh glubin — i uspeshno sbezhat. No sotrudnichestvo i komandnaya rabota eshchyo ne konets — kazhdyy iz vas dolzhen popytatsya sbezhat s Nefritovoy statuey, tainstvennoy i drevney relikviey neischislimeyshey tsennosti.
Tolko odin iz vas mozhet poluchit relikviyu, i kto zhe eto budet?..
Ispolzuyte Joy-Con'y, chtoby issledovat skrytye glubiny Dyadic s drugom ili podrugoy, otkryvaya novye vozmozhnosti dlya nedobrosovestnykh taktik. No esli vy druzya, ne volnuytes — vmesto etogo vy smozhete ispolzovat dva kontrollera po otdelnosti, chtoby vybratsya iz podzemelya sovmestno.*
*My ne nesem otvetstvennosti za lyubye slomannye kontrollery libo razorvannye druzheskie otnosheniya, voznikshie v rezultate prokhozhdeniya etoy igry!
Сюжетная RPG, сочетающая полностью вручн:
Syuzhetnaya RPG, sochetayushchaya polnostyu vruchnuyu narisovannuyu grafiku i animatsiyu s sistemoy teleportatsii, poshagovymi boevymi mekhanikami i elementami roguelite. Pogruzites v fantasticheskiy mir s glubokim narrativom, desyatkami neobratimykh posledstviy i alternativnymi kontsovkami, gde igrovoy protsess legko ponyat, no slozhno osvoit v sovershenstve.
V VED vy igraete za Kira, molodogo geroya, kotoryy priezzhaet v gorod Mikropol v poiskakh novoy zhizni. Tam on vnezapno otkryvaet v sebe sposobnost teleportirovatsya mezhdu dvumya parallelnymi mirami, polnymi zagadochnykh letayushchikh ostrovov, strannykh sushchestv i opasnykh monstrov. Razvernite interaktivnuyu istoriyu, gde kazhdoe reshenie imeet znachenie, i pomogite Kiru raskryt pravdu ob etom magicheskom meste, chtoby reshit sudbu dvukh mirov. Chtoby preuspet v svoem prednaznachenii, vam pridetsya ovladet mogushchestvennoy magiey Vedov.
Ogromnyy fenteziynyy mir igry, personazhi i esteticheskiy dizayn kotorogo, vdokhnovleny razlichnymi kulturami i mifologiyami. Na protyazhenii priklyucheniya Kir stolknyotsya s mnozhestvom fraktsiy, kazhdaya iz kotorykh imeet svoy vzglyad na proiskhodyashchie sobytiya. Pomogaya zhitelyam volshebnykh zemel i realnogo mira, Kir budet uznavat bolshe o sebe, o dvukh mirakh i, chto samoe vazhnoe, o tom, kak spasti ikh vsekh… Ili stat ikh pogibelyu.
Freaky Awesome - это rogue-lite со случа: Freaky Awesome - eto rogue-lite so sluchaynoy generatsiey okruzheniya, neobratimoy smertyu i bolshim kolichestvom postepenno otkryvayushchegosya kontenta. Freaky Awesome vzvinchivaet gradus bezumiya! Ty pryamo vo vremya boya mozhesh mutirovat v novuyu formu s unikalnoy mekhanikoy, k kotoroy pridetsya bystro prisposobitsya. «99Vidas» (с бр. португальского «99 жизн:
«99Vidas» (s br. portugalskogo «99 zhizney») otdayot dan kak klassike, tak i novinkam igrovoy bitemap-industrii, napolnen otsylkami ne tolko k skhozhim igram, no i k pop-kulture 80-kh i 90-kh godov.
6 bolshikh urovney otpravyat vas v puteshestvie po raznym chastyam mira, gde vy stolknyotes s polchishchami svirepykh vragov i bezzhalostnykh bossov pri pomoshchi 3-kh drugikh igrokov v sovmestnoy igre lokalno, ili v odinochku.
U kazhdogo iz 11 igrovykh personazhey est svoi sobstvennye otlichitelnye atributy, takie kak skorost i sila, a takzhe mirovozzrenie stikhii (Ogon, Voda, Veter i Molniya), kotorye izmenyayut obychnuyu ataku, kombo-priyomy i spetsdvizheniya. Poluchayte ochki opyta, pobezhdaya vragov i sobiraya predmety, kotorye zatem mogut byt ispolzovany dlya uluchsheniy i kombo — ili dazhe dlya otkrytiya novykh vozmozhnostey!..
Fight alone or with your friends, master:
Fight alone or with your friends, master the art of battle and bring peace back to the land in this arcade inspired epic brawler!

Clan N is a hack'n'slash game which combines the classic arcades gameplay with today's modern brawlers. With a fast paced nature, you have to dodge, block and use your light, heavy and special attacks wisely to progress. With an ancient far east theme, you'll get challenged across 7 different levels with many different enemies, Mid/End level bosses and casual mini games integrated into main gameplay.

About Clan N:

Clan N is an ancient samurai group in the region of “Far East”, sworn to protect the realm from all who seek its destruction. The four group members consist of the shinobigatana-wielding ninja Akira, the staff-striking Reina, the dual sword-swinging Daiki, and the sickle-slashing monk Tarou.

After years of training and dedication to their respective craft, each character has uncovered their own unique magical abilities. Akira shoots pulse-filled lightning bolts, Reina controls the ground with vicious earthquake shocks, Daiki swirls up brutal tornado waves, and Tarou can call for the help of Dragons.

Story:

Akuji is a former samurai of the Clan N that discovered the balance of the world lies in three areas: Peace, Knowledge, and Time. Akuji found that if you knock the world of one of these, you can harness the powers of “spiritual imbalance” and grow stronger from it. As a result of pursuing spiritual imbalance, he was shunned from the samurai temple and kicked out of Clan N.

What Akuji didn’t know was that attaining spiritual imbalance would not only give you dark powers, it consumed your light and the purity of your life. Following his banishment from the temple and Clan N, Akuji was able to destroy peace by slaughtering villages and retain the power of those he killed, thus absorbing conflict and electric sorcery abilities, becoming the most powerful sorcerer warrior in the Far East. While he continued to grow, Akuji formed Seishin Gun, the spirit group, to join his conquest and remove anyone standing in their path.

Once his actions were discovered by Clan N, they set on a journey to stop the villainous pillaging by Akuji and Seishin Gun.

About the Characters:

Reina and Daiki grew as siblings in a southern samurai clan. Reina was not taught the teaching of the clan like her brother Daiki but still observed and learned the ways mastering the staff. She eventually took onto Shamanism as well becoming one of the first shinobi shamans in the land as a young woman.

Akira was a childhood friend adopted into the clan as a lost child wandering in the outer lands chased by a pack of wolves, barely making it to the village. Daiki’s father took the child in and raised them, although Akira typically covers himself from head to after severe scarring.

Tarou was from the same monastery as Akuji (prior to his joining of Clan N) and learned under the same teachers. Akuji returned to the Monk’s temple many years later and stole an ancient scroll that explained how to destroy the pillars of balance and extract their spiritual imbalance. In pursuit of Akuji, Tarou traced his steps to Clan N. After explaining the situation to the existing three members, they all decided to team up and take down Akuji.

В комедийном экшн-приключении «Стаббс-Зо:
