Сражения\nИгра являет собой уникальную с:
Srazheniya
Igra yavlyaet soboy unikalnuyu smes rogue-like s issledovaniem podzemeliy, RPG, poshagovoy taktiki i kollektsionnoy kartochnoy igry. V osnove poshagovoy sistemy lezhat ne khody, a vremya. Nakhodite i prokachivayte novykh geroev i dobyvayte monety dlya pokupki novykh zaklinaniy. Odnako pomnite, chto smert geroya budet fatalna.

Geroi
Kazhdyy geroy, pomimo trekh kharakteristik (sila, lovkost, vynoslivost) mozhet vladet osobym perkom, a takzhe zaklinaniem. Soberi svoyu komandu geroev, pridumay unikalnuyu taktiku dlya bitv. Traditsionnye Tank, Khiler i Voiny? Ili oboytis lish gruboy siloy?

Vo vremya bitv, v kolodu podmeshivayutsya vybrannye zaranee 20 kart s zaklinaniyami. Kazhdye 6 sekund boya vy berete novuyu kartu v ruku. Vo vremya obychnogo khoda, u vas budet takoy vybor deystviy:
- Obychnaya ataka;
- Oborona;
- Smena pozitsii;
- Primenenie zaklinaniya geroya (odno na kazhdogo);
- Primenenie zaklinaniya iz ruki.

Kazhdoe zaklinanie, bud ono geroyskoe, libo iz kolody, imeet svoyu stoimost many. Mana obshchaya dlya vsekh geroev, i nakaplivaetsya v techenii boya. Takim obrazom igroku predstoit vybirat kakoe zaklinanie nuzhno ispolzovat seychas, ved na sleduyushchee mozhet ne khvatit many.

Podzemelya
Otpravlyayte svoikh geroev v samoe opasnoe priklyuchenie — Podzemelya Neksorii. Sluchayno generiruemye podzemnye etazhi s bossom v kontse kazhdogo. Daleko ne vse smogut vernutsya, a te, kto vernutsya obretut velikuyu slavu!

Sobytiya
Issledovanie podzemeliy tait v sebe ne tolko tolpy vragov, kotorye nuzhno unichtozhit, a mnozhestvo sluchaynykh sobytiy i lovushek, iskhod kotorykh mozhet byt fatalnym.

Берлин, 2048 год. Мир на грани катастроф:
Berlin, 2048 god. Mir na grani katastrofy. Nekhvatka resursov, bolezni, vyzvannye zagryaznennym vozdukhom i vodoy, vysokiy uroven prestupnosti, voyna. Pravitelstva i korporatsii obeshchayut reshit problemy s pomoshchyu dostizheniy tekhnicheskogo progressa. Drony i chelovekopodobnye roboty zamenyayut lyudey v gosudarstvennom sektore, vse vzaimosvyazano, povsyudu ustanovleno nablyudenie.

Richard Nolan — odin iz nemnogikh zhurnalistov, kotoryy ne boitsya otkryto kritikovat sushchestvuyushchuyu sistemu. Prosnuvshis v bolnitse posle vzryva i obnaruzhiv zagadochnoe ischeznovenie zheny i syna, Richard ponimaet, chto on i ego semya stali ne prosto sluchaynymi nablyudatelyami protivostoyaniya idey o spasenii chelovechestva na granitse mezhdu mrachnoy realnostyu i tsifrovoy utopiey. Oni okazalis v samom tsentre etogo uragana.

Eta lokalnaya drama postepenno razvivaetsya v triller o mirovom zagovore, tsel kotorogo — opredelit sudbu chelovechestva. Mozhet li idealnaya tsifrovaya utopiya stat otvetom? Virtualnyy ray, v kotorom net mesta materialnym nuzhdam i konfliktam? Mozhet li iskusstvennyy superintellekt stat nashim spaseniem? Ili on prosto obyavit nashe sushchestvovanie netselesoobraznym — ved ego nelzya nauchit chelovekolyubiyu?

Kak budet vyglyadet mir posle etogo uragana, i chto ostanetsya ot chelovechestva?

· Zaglyanite v trevozhnoe i realistichnoe blizhayshee budushchee.
· Pogruzites v mnogogrannyy nauchno-fantasticheskiy triller, gde perepletayutsya mrachnaya realnost i tsifrovaya utopiya.
· Raskroyte mirovoy zagovor v obshchestve povsemestnogo rasprostraneniya tsifrovykh tekhnologiy, slezhki i transgumanizma.
· Issleduyte mir s bogatym i unikalnym vizualnym stilem, sochetayushchim realistichnoe okruzhenie s nizkopoligonalnymi personazhami.
· Okazhites v roli zhurnalista Richarda Nolana i pyati dopolnitelnykh igrovykh personazhey.
· Ispolzuyte svoe masterstvo, deduktivnye i issledovatelskie sposobnosti, chtoby vossozdat proshloe Richarda.
Эдвард «Нед» Келли (3 июня 1854 — 11 ноя:
Edvard «Ned» Kelli (3 iyunya 1854 — 11 noyabrya 1880, Melburn) — avstraliyskiy bushreyndzher XIX veka, razboynik, izvestnyy svoimi derzkimi ogrableniyami bankov, kaznyon cherez poveshenie za mnogochislennye narusheniya zakona. Predaniya i ballady o podvigakh Neda Kelli, gde on predstayot kak «blagorodnyy razboynik», poyavilis eshchyo pri ego zhizni i stali neotemlemoy chastyu avstraliyskogo narodnogo folklora. Otnoshenie k Nedu Kelli na udalyonnom materike daleko ot odnoznachnogo: chast avstraliytsev schitaet ego bezzhalostnym ubiytsey, a chast — simvolom soprotivleniya kolonialnym vlastyam i voploshcheniem osobennostey natsionalnogo kharaktera.
Prorvites skvoz polchishcha vragov v obraze Zheleznogo Neda v zakhvatyvayushchem priklyuchencheskom platformere, deystvie kotorogo razvorachivaetsya v bogatoy na istoricheskiy bekgraund avstraliyskoy derevenskoy glubinke.
2D-platformer pod DOOM, osnovannyy na dokumentalnoy biografii odnogo iz samykh pechalno izvestnykh prestupnikov Avstralii: probiraytes skvoz beskonechnye polchishcha vragov, ispolzuya originalnoe, umasshedshee oruzhie; issleduyte zakruchennyy vzglyad na realnye sobytiya s uchastiem legend Strany Kenguru!

This is the long-awaited sequel to the legendary N+, rewritten from scratch to be bigger, better, and more beautiful in every way.

N++ is a fast-paced, momentum-based platformer about darting around obstacles, narrowly evading enemies and collecting gold in a beautiful minimalist landscape.

N++ is all about using your momentum to complete levels and get high scores, but in this sci-fi world, there’s a slew of inadvertently homicidal enemy robots trying to prevent you from completing your goal.

Through the hand-crafted (NOT procedurally generated) levels, you’ll experience platforming at its most intense. Using only your fluid movement, you need to ‘solve’ each level and get to the exit.

In addition to the lengthy and challenging single player campaign, we’ve packed a ton of features into this one last entry in the N series including:

-4340 hand-made levels
-Custom Levels, Level Editor & Global Level Sharing
-Leaderboards and replays for every level (even the ones you make)
-Local Co-op Mode (up to 4 players)
-Local Competitive Mode (up to 4 Players)
-Hardcore Mode, an intense single-player challenge which only the best ninjas will survive
-Intense, hidden Secret challenges to discover
-63 tracks by top electronic artists
-119 different color palettes let you customize the game’s look and keep it fresh every time you play
-and more!

V tselom, u etoy igry est odna tsel: vernut vse te neveroyatnye chuvstva, kotorye my ispytyvali v detstve, igraya s mashinkami.
Как-то раз безымянный, но крутой пацан п:
Kak-to raz bezymyannyy, no krutoy patsan podnyalsya s samykh nizov, nakidal zlodeyam i nashel ottsa, i vse byli dovolny. No potom nastupilo budushchee: vse vokrug prodalis, vmesto tualetnoy bumagi rakushki, polnyy kiberpank. A tebya uzhe zhdut te zhe samye ulitsy, tolko zalitye neonovym svetom, yumorom, nostalgiey po 80-m.
20 dolgikh let ty tomilsya v tesnom garazhe, a tvoy otets tainstvennym obrazom propal eshche do tvoego rozhdeniya. Vsyo eto vremya ty neustanno tyagal zhelezo i mechtal o mirskikh chudesakh. Po pravde govorya, tvoey zhizni ne pozaviduesh: lyudi pitayutsya kakim-to shlamom, korruptsiya protsvetaet i vse vokrug khotyat tebe napoddat… No mozhet, ty vsyo-taki smozhesh nayti ottsa i stat tem samym «temnym kulakom», o kotorom vse sudachat? Vdrug imenno tebe suzhdeno stat spasitelem chelovechestva, kto raskroet sverkhsekretnye sekrety Korporatsii dobra? Nu ili net. Mozhesh ostavatsya v svoem ukromnom garazhe, esli khochesh: kuda idti — reshat tebe.
Tut mozhno bit, pinat, dubasit i dazhe zhulnichat. Stat luchshim boytsom oy kak neprosto — nuzhno vremya, uporstvo, mnogo praktiki i denzhat! Povyshay svoi kharakteristiki, ottachivay priemy i produmyvay taktiku boya. Sozday svoyu shkolu boevykh iskusstv! Eto namnogo kruche, chem produt i terpet nasmeshki vsekh vokrug. Krov, pot i slezy — proverennaya formula uspekha, no eshche stoit poprobovat neyrotrenirovki i zapreshchennoe PO. Pered takimi prodvinutymi metodami trudno ustoyat dazhe nesmotrya na risk togo, chto obman raskusyat — nu ili chto poslednie zdorovye neyrony vozmut i otomrut.
V beskonechnoy sumatokhe zhizn proletaet stremitelno, vremya ukhodit bezvozvratno. Chtoby vyzhit, nuzhno umet effektivno planirovat. V igre Punch Club 2 vsyo kak v zhizni — na to ona i simulyator! Planiruy svoe vremya i byudzhet i probeysya v vysshuyu ligu! Raskryvay prestupleniya, rabotay na politsiyu, na mafiyu — da na kogo ugodno. Vypolnyay zadaniya i poluchay priglasheniya v shkoly, uchi novye priemy, zarabatyvay dollary i ochki reputatsii. Dazhe film Lion Queen na VHS mozhet stat tvoim!

Hang on function: This is definitely the highlight of the project. It allows the egg to regain its composure after rolling around restlessly for a while. Simply put, it's a brake function.

Beautiful stage: Let's have a pleasant adventure on a fantastic and graceful stage of the world.

Hidden items: Fried eggs will require a toast. The toast is hidden somewhere on the stage.

Growth system: The more you move, the more durable the raw eggshell will be. Even if goal is difficult, if you play without giving up, eggs will become more and more strong and it will be easier to clear. You will be fascinated by the dependable eggs.
Добро пожаловать в мир, испорченный край:
Dobro pozhalovat v mir, isporchennyy krayney lenyu, gde personazhi nastolko lenivy, chto dazhe igrok ne v sostoyanii imi upravlyat. Vozmite delo v svoi ruki i kontroliruyte okruzhayushchuyu sredu s pomoshchyu nashey innovatsionnoy igrovoy mekhaniki!
Predstavte sebe kazhdyy uroven kak krasivo nakrytyy stol. Ne imeya vozmozhnosti napryamuyu upravlyat personazhami, skhvatite stsenu za eyo nedra i perevernite stol vverkh dnom.
UNABLES soderzhit v sebe svezhie aspekty igrovogo protsessa i dizayna, kotorye vy nikogda ranshe ne videli, a takzhe nekotorye idei, kotorye, veroyatno, videli chasto. Ispolzuyte kachestvennuyu fiziku, chtoby reshat golovolomki i vypolnyat kvesty, otkryvaya vsyo bolee neobychnye urovni i raskryvaya vse sekrety!
Ролевая игра в жанре «данжн кроулера», г:
Rolevaya igra v zhanre «danzhn kroulera», gde vy issleduete proklyatyy podzemnyy labirint «Zatmenie». Proklyatiya izmenyayut sposobnosti i deystviya chlenov vashey gruppy, i vam neobkhodimo postoyanno sledit za sostoyaniem komandy, umeya bystro prinimat resheniya, kak deystvovat.
Upravlyayte i korrektiruyte effekty spellov, chtoby so vremenem sozdavat vsyo bolee silnykh personazhey, i pokorit zlo!..
V gorode Ekho, raspolozhennom u zhivopisnogo berega morya, zhiteli nachali boyatsya napadeniy iz podzemnogo labirinta. V roli iskatelya priklyucheniy, vy poluchaete poluchaete novoe zadanie — issledovat labirint i pobedit vsekh chudishch.. Otstupat ili prodolzhat — tolko vash vybor: resheniya napryamuyu povliyayut na uspekh issledovaniy, takzhe kak i na zhizn (ili smert) vashikh podopechnykh.
Устройтесь поудобнее и погрузитесь в мир:
Ustroytes poudobnee i pogruzites v mir God of Light – eta igra perevernet vashe predstavlenie o zhanre fizicheskikh golovolomok! Issleduyte mir, naslazhdaytes velikolepnoy grafikoy i originalnoy muzykoy.
Pomogite simpatyage Shayni spasti vselennuyu ot nadvigayushcheysya tmy. Vas zhdut zakhvatyvayushchie igrovye miry i desyatki urovney s umopomrachitelnymi golovolomkami. Issleduyte urovni, ishchite otrazhayushchie obekty, rasseivayte, kombiniruyte, perekrashivayte, sgibayte i teleportiruyte luchi sveta dlya aktivatsii Istochnikov Zhizni i vozvrashcheniya sveta vo vselennuyu.
Посетите город-лабиринт, где боги даруют:
Posetite gorod-labirint, gde bogi daruyut lyudyam neveroyatnye sily. Syuzhet vertitsya vokrug Bella Kranelya — yunoshi, kotoryy mechtaet stat velikim iskatelem priklyucheniy, — i umeloy mechnitsy Ays Vallenshtayn, chi sudby perepletayutsya i vliyayut na ves Orario!

Sledite za khitrospleteniyami syuzheta, kotorykh ne bylo v anime!

Issleduyte podzemelya: pobezhdayte monstrov v opasnom labirinte pod gorodom!

Prokhodite dopolnitelnye ispytaniya: posle zaversheniya syuzheta vy smozhete popast v novye podzemelya, kotorye generiruyutsya sluchaynym obrazom!

Khodite na svidaniya i razvivayte otnosheniya s neskolkimi personazhami. Eti vstrechi est tolko v igre!
FINAL FANTASY CRYSTAL CHRONICLES Remaste:
FINAL FANTASY CRYSTAL CHRONICLES Remastered Edition — uvlekatelnaya rolevaya igra, v kotoroy gruppa molodykh lyudey otpravlyaetsya na poiski «mirra», tsennoy i redkoy zhidkosti, neobkhodimoy dlya ochistki kristalla, kotoryy zashchishchaet mir ot smertelnykh ispareniy miazmy.
Soberite gruppu druzey i srazhaytes s ustrashayushchimi vragami! Vasha komanda otpravitsya issledovat novye zemli, polnye chudes. Dazhe esli vy igrali v original, zdes vas budut zhdat syurprizy, vklyuchaya novye oblasti v podzemelyakh!
THE JOURNEY OF A LITTLE GHOST\nHow to sa:
THE JOURNEY OF A LITTLE GHOST
How to say Goodbye tells the story of a person who has recently been turned into a ghost, lost in an unfamiliar world populated by disoriented spirits. In this narrative puzzle game, move the decor to allow the characters to escape from the parallel reality in which they are lost.
Help them find their friends who are trapped by a mysterious wizard and accompany them on their journey to the other side.

A PUZZLE GAME BASED ON WORLD MANIPULATION
Move the decor elements on a grid to lead the ghosts to the exit
Travel through more than 15 chapters, from the kitchen of your home to the moon. 
Solve numerous puzzles in a universe inspired by illustration and great classics of children's literature (Tomi Ungerer, Tove Jansson, Antoine de Saint-Exupéry, Maurice Sendak...)

A STRONG AND UNIQUE THEME
- A poignant puzzle game that deals with grief with kindness and subtlety
- Save your friend before he disappears forever
- Guide the ghosts out of the liminal space they are trapped in 
- Help the characters you meet to find peace and mourn their own lives
- Unlock the secret of the Wizard and the spleens, the misguided spirits that haunt the other side
Игра Plague Inc: Evolved – это уникально: Igra Plague Inc: Evolved – eto unikalnoe sochetanie slozhneyshey strategii i uzhasayushche realistichnogo simulyatora. Vash patogen uzhe zarazil «nulevogo patsienta», i teper vy dolzhny zavershit istoriyu chelovechestva, povsemestno rasprostranyaya smertelnoe zabolevanie, v to vremya kak lyudi pytayutsya prisposobitsya k novoy opasnosti i vyzhit.
Действие Flat Kingdom Paper's Cut Editio:
Deystvie Flat Kingdom Paper's Cut Edition razvorachivaetsya v krasivoy dvumernoy strane, no teper ey ugrozhayut zloba i khaos tretego izmereniya.

Mudryy volshebnik sozdal shest volshebnykh kamney, chto smogli uderzhat silu effektov tretego izmereniya, podariv mir i protsvetanie ostavshimsya dvum. No vot odnazhdy zlobnyy vor v maske po imeni Geks narushil balans, iz-za chego khaos vernutsya.

I etot khaos mozhet ostanovit tolko Flet, malenkiy geroy, sposobnyy prevrashchatsya v krug, treugolnik ili kvadrat, chtoby reshat golovolomki, preodolevat prepyatstviya i pobezhdat gigantskikh bossov! 


KhARAKTERISTIKI
* Okunites v prekrasnyy, slovno sdelannyy iz bumagi, mir.
* Ispytayte sebya v grandioznykh i zakhvatyvayushchikh srazheniyakh s gigantskimi bossami.
* Raskroyte vse tayny igry! Vas podzhidayut pobochnye kvesty, uluchshalki i vsevozmozhnye syurprizy.
* Poznakomtes s bogatoy istoriey i legendami korolevstva, nakhodya sokrytye svitki.
* Muzyka ot legendarnoy Manami Matsumae!
Место действия расположено на изолирован:
Mesto deystviya raspolozheno na izolirovannom, selskom i tikhom ostrove vo Vnutrennem more Syoto pod nazvaniem Torisirodzima, naselenie kotorogo sostavlyaet okolo 2000 chelovek. Glavnyy geroy — Khayri Takakhara, molodoy chelovek, ne urozhenets ostrova. Khayri vyros v gorodskoy srede, no posle nepriyatnogo intsidenta on ispolzuet nedavnyuyu smert svoey babushki kak predlog, chtoby priekhat na ostrov, chtoby pozabotitsya o prodazhe ee pomestya.
Okazavshis tam, on znakomitsya s chetyrmya devushkami.
Sredi nikh Shirokha Naruse, kotoraya zabyla o svoikh letnikh kanikulakh; Ao Sorakado, kotoraya presleduet legendy etogo ostrova; Kamome Kusima, devushka vysokogo klassa, ishchushchaya piratskiy korabl; i Tsumugi Venders, yunaya baryshnya, pytayushchayasya nayti sebya..Eshchyo vizualnykh novell na Switch (renpy).
Уже доступно полное издание «Персефоны»!:
Uzhe dostupno polnoe izdanie «Persefony»! Bolee 100 urovney v 10 glavakh. 3 polnye istorii Persefony, Demetry i Aida i mnogoe drugoe dlya issledovaniya!

«Persefona» — eto igra-golovolomka, v kotoroy issleduyutsya sleduyushchie vozmozhnosti: chto esli smert ne konets, v klyuch k resheniyu golovolomok? Gde, kogda i kak vy khotite umeret, chtoby prodolzhit razvitie? 

Otkroyte dlya sebya bolee 100 golovolomok v 10 razlichnykh vidakh obstanovki, kazhdaya s unikalnymi mekhanizmami. 

Perenesites v etot volshebnyy mir s krasivoy grafikoy i charuyushchey muzykoy.
Ведомый саморазрушительным чувством вины:
Vedomyy samorazrushitelnym chuvstvom viny, vy otpravlyaetes v puteshestvie, chtoby vosstanovit magicheskie stikhii v davno umirayushchem mire.
Ovladeyte silami magii i ispolzuyte ikh dlya borby s vnutrennim vragom, reshaya ekshn-golovolomki i issleduya obshirnye krasoty zdeshnego mira, napolnennogo nevidannymi drevnimi silami.
В раздаче находится настроенный эмулятор:
V razdache nakhoditsya nastroennyy emulyator Neo Geo Pocket + Color na baze yadra Beetle NeoPop v0.9.36.1 Mednafen dlya Nintendo Switch, rabotayushchaya pod Retorach plyus 90 igr s vklyuchennymi oblozhkami i polnym pleylistom; bonusom dobavleny 138 khoumbryu dlya platformy Neo Geo Pocket Color.
Neo Geo Pocket (Color), sokrashchyonno NGP(S) — portativnaya igrovaya pristavka, sozdannaya kompaniey SNK Playmore i vypushchennaya v 1998 godu, tsvetnaya versiya, Neo Geo Pocket Color, vypushchena v mae 1999 goda. U konsoli byl tsvetnoy zhidkokristallicheskiy ekran, sposobnyy vosproizvodit 146 odnovremennykh tsvetov iz 4096-tsvetovoy palitry, zapas v 40 chasov avtonomnoy raboty i otdelnaya vstroennaya batareya dlya sokhraneniy. Na portativnom ustroystve takzhe byli predusmotreny nekotorye funktsii karmannykh personalnykh kompyuterov, takie kak chasy i kalendar.
Nesmotrya na to, chto eta portativnaya igrovaya sistema prosushchestvovala nedolgo, na ney bylo vypushcheno sotnya igr, iz nikh takikh, kak eksklyuziv dlya platformy — Sonic The Hedgehog: Pocket Adventure, a takzhe SNK Vs. Capcom, Samurai Shodown, King of Fighters, Metal Slug, Pac-Man, Rockman Battle i drugie, a prodvinutaya 16-bitnaya pikselnaya grafika pridayot osobyy sharm posledney igrovoy konsoli yaponskoy korporatsii SNK.
Ofitsialno perenesyonnye igry na Switch ot SNK sm. zdes.
В этой игре, состоящей из пяти частей, в:

Kogda-to sushchestvoval Orden Kamnya: Gabriel-voin, Elgard - inzhener krasnogo kamnya, Magnus-razboynik i Soren-arkhitektor. Davnym-davno, Orden sumel pobedit Drakona Endera i stat legendoy. V nastoyashchem vremeni zhe, molodoy stroitel (Vy), druzya Oliviya, Aksel i vash domashniy pitomets — porosyonok Ruben uchastvuyut v Stroitelnom Konkurse Enderkona, gde oni proigryvayut kazhdyy god. Nesmotrya na to, chto im udalos pobedit, chlen vrazhdebnoy komandy «Otseloty» — Ayden spetsialno vypuskaet lavu, podzhigaya kostyum Rubena...
Izdanie «The Complete Adventure» dlya Nintendo Switch vklyuchaet v sebya vse 8 epizodov sezona: 5 + 3 epizoda iz serii dopolneniy Adventure Pass.Drugie Minecraft-igry sm. zdes.
Caveblazers это платформер \"рогалик\" с:
Caveblazers eto platformer "rogalik" s fokusom na ekshn, deystviya kotorogo razvorachivayutsya v fenteziynom mire. Kazhdaya igra unikalna s protsedurno generiruemymi urovnyami dlya vashego issledovaniya i ogromnym kolichestvom predmetov, oruzhiy i ekipirovki.

Pogruzhayas glubzhe v peshcheru, vy nayd te novye zony dlya issledovaniya, novye oruzhiya i novykh monstrov, na kotorykh vy smozhete ispytat vashe oruzhie.

Umnye Personazhi!
Na protyazhenii vashego puteshestviya vy stolkn tes s II personazhami. Kak s druzhelyubnymi, tak i s vrazhdebnymi. My ispolzuem prodvinutuyu sistemu poiska puti. Eto znachit, chto druzhelyubnye personazhi smogut sledovat za vami kuda by vy ne shli, v to vremya, kak vrazhdebnye smogut nayti vas gde by vy ne pryatalis. Vykhoda net. Boytes!

Platformer "rogalik"!
Caveblazers eto sovremennyy platformer, kotoryy ispolzuet nekotorye elementy "rogalikov" i nekotorye elementy RPG, takie kak permanentnaya smert, randomizirovannye effekty zeliy, RPG sistema inventarya i ogromnoe kolichestvo predmetov, snaryazheniya i uluchsheniy.

Ezhednevnye Ispytatelnye Zabegi!
Kazhdyy den generiruetsya novoe priklyuchenie! Ono budet odinakovym dlya vsekh i u vas budet tolko odin shans! Eti ispytaniya nachinayutsya s opredel nnymi nachalnymi predmetami i imeyut nabor raznykh osobennostey.

Epichnye Srazheniya s Bossami!
Mezhdu zonami vy budete stalkivatsya s bossom. Kazhdyy boss unikalen i vse oni trebuyut raznykh strategicheskikh podkhodov. V osnovnom, bossy eto chudovishcha ogromnykh razmerov, polosa zhizni kotorykh rastyagivaetsya na ves ekran. Udachi!

Kastomizatsiya Personazhey! 
Tselaya kucha razblokiruemykh shlyap, tunik, shtanov, rubashek i mnogo drugogo! Ili, byt mozhet, vy predpocht te razdetsya i napravitsya v peshcheru golym? Togda vper d!

Uvlekatelnaya Boevaya Sistema!
V osnovnom ignoriruemo v drugikh sovremennykh "rogalikakh", Caveblazers pytaetsya otdalitsya ot uproshch nnykh boevykh sistem, kotorye my videli v drugikh igrakh etogo zhanra i smeshivaet v sebe veseluyu, podvizhnuyu i dinamichnuyu bo vku, kotoraya vydelyaetsya blagodarya brutalnym effektam krovi.

Ispytaniya!
V sluchae esli etogo kontenta nedostatochno, Caveblazers mozhet predlozhit kuchu ispytaniy dlya opytnykh igrokov. Eti ispytaniya voznagradyat vas novymi predmetami, oruzhiyami i perkami!
Наделайте шума и окунитесь в захватывающ:
Nadelayte shuma i okunites v zakhvatyvayushchiy mir etogo ekshn-platformera! Spetsialnogo agenta Damzel zhdut desyatki napryazhennykh zadaniy, ved ona — nash pervyy i posledniy rubezh oborony v borbe s zhutkimi obitatelyami mira vampirov. Spasayte zalozhnikov, obezvrezhivayte bomby, vzlamyvayte servery i izbavlyaytes ot nezhiti akkuratno, bystro i elegantno. Soblyudayte ravnovesie mezhdu beshenoy gonkoy i molnienosnymi i tochnymi resheniyami, no budte ostorozhny! Nikto ne znaet, otkuda vyskochit ocherednoy vampir.
Atakuyte vragov s pomoshchyu moshchnogo ultrafioletovogo drobovika, bystrykh refleksov, oglushitelnykh priemov rukopashnogo boya i stremitelnykh ryvkov. Tochnoe i chuvstvitelnoe upravlenie pozvolyaet peremeshchatsya po urovnyam, obkhodya smertelno opasnye prepyatstviya, stoyashchie na vashem puti. Eksperimentiruyte na kazhdom zadanii, chtoby nayti idealnuyu posledovatelnost dvizheniy i udarov. Ottachivayte skorost i tochnost udarov Damzel i otyshchite bezuprechnyy put cherez uroven, kotoryy pozvolit nabrat maksimalnoe kolichestvo ochkov i zanyat verkhnyuyu strochku v spiske liderov. Damzel — eto balet, a vy — ee khoreograf. 


Klassicheskaya arkadnaya atmosfera
- Igra razbita na nebolshie zadaniya, kotorye zastavyat vas povtoryat «Nu, eshche odin razok!» (i nichego, chto tak vy govorili i neskolko popytok nazad...)

Kampaniya v mire komiksov
- Raskroyte sekrety «Krasnogo Tumana» i rasstroyte ikh zhutkie plany.

Tablitsa luchshikh igrokov
- Ottachivayte masterstvo, uluchshayte vremya prokhozhdeniya zadaniy i stante luchshim agentom.

Vremya rasslabitsya
- Rezhim igry «na rasslabone» pozvolyaet nemnogo peredokhnut i nasladitsya igroy, ne bespokoyas o takikh melkikh nepriyatnostyakh, kak smert.

Rezhimy povyshennoy slozhnosti
- Zadaniya povyshennoy slozhnosti — dlya samykh trebovatelnykh i neugomonnykh ubiyts!

Saundtrek zhanra Synth
- Uboynye goticheskie melodii stanut idealnym fonom dlya rezni!
«Страх — это часть смелости.»\nШестнадца:
«Strakh — eto chast smelosti.»
Shestnadtsatiletnyaya zemnaya devushka Blum vstrechaet volshebnitsu Stellu, ot kotoroy uznayot, chto, kak i ta, yavlyaetsya feey. Postupiv v Alfeyu — shkolu dlya fey, raspolozhennuyu v izmerenii Magiks, inache izvestnom kak Volshebnoe izmerenie, Blum uznayot o sushchestvovanii shkoly spetsialistov, osvaivayushchikh volshebnye boevye iskusstva i shkoly vedm.
Stolknuvshis s agressiey tryokh vedm — Aysi, Darsi i Stormi, nazyvayushchikh sebya Triks, — Blum s podrugami obrazovyvayut komandu «Klub Vinks», chtoby vmeste srazhatsya so zlom!.. Igrayte za vsekh shesterykh uchastnits «Kluba Vinks», u kazhdoy iz kotorykh imeyutsya svoi magicheskie sposobnosti.
TINY METAL marks its return with FULL ME:
TINY METAL marks its return with FULL METAL RUMBLE packed to the brim with bigger, better, and more metal content.  A new engrossing wartime narrative and beloved tactical gameplay return as TINY METAL: FULL METAL RUMBLE revisits the core of what made the first franchise entry a beloved and intense, turn-based strategy experience.

TINY METAL: FULL METAL RUMBLE follows a familiar face but new protagonist, the fiercely independent leader of the White Fangs, Commander Wolfram. Search for her brother and stage defenses on multiple fronts against the Dinoldans to stop their excavation of dangerous, ancient technology and restore peace to a land ravaged by the horrors of war.

FULL METAL RUMBLE cranks things up a notch from the original TINY METAL, offering 77 skirmish maps, 21 of which are available for intense multiplayer showdowns.  An expanded army fields more than 21-unit types, with additional Hero and Commander units, to lead into battle across 39 campaign missions. The addition of bonus challenge conditions on every map encourages commanders to fight for goals outside of the main objective. Four new difficulty modes enable veterans and recruits alike to find thrills in the heat of battle

AREA35 has crafted an engaging world with rich history, adding intrigue to every firefight. The writing talent of Hiro Inaba and composing genius of Tomoki Miyoshi bring the characters, world, and action to vibrant life.
Minecraft – это игра с упором на строите:
Minecraft – eto igra s uporom na stroitelstva i priklyucheniya.

Issleduyte sluchaynym obrazom generiruemye miry i stroyte iz blokov samye neveroyatnye sooruzheniya – ot prostykh domov do grandioznykh zamkov. Igrayte v tvorcheskom rezhime, imeya v svoem rasporyazhenii neogranichennye resursy, ili zaberites v debri mira v rezhime vyzhivaniya, izgotavlivaya oruzhie i bronyu dlya zashchity ot mobov.

Sozdavayte neobychnye predmety, stroyte i issleduyte miry v odinochku ili v kompanii druzey (do chetyrekh igrokov v rezhime razdelennogo ekrana ili do vosmi v setevom rezhime).
Любимый симулятор возвращается в улучшен: Lyubimyy simulyator vozvrashchaetsya v uluchshennom vide dlya novogo pokoleniya rytsarey. V 1980-e gody igra Defender of the Crown opredelila novyy tip kinematografichnykh strategicheskikh igr. Nyne ona vozvrashchaetsya, pererabotannaya dlya sovremennykh platform i predlagayushchaya sovershenno novyy tip igrovogo protsessa.
Как новый менеджер, создайте счастливое:
Kak novyy menedzher, sozdayte schastlivoe soobshchestvo i torguyte s drugimi rasami... radi deneg. Da, vse verno, nam nuzhno ikh schaste, chtoby my mogli aktivirovat portaly. Lingi, vashi rabochie, budut podchinyatsya i pomogat v derevne. No budte ostorozhny, oni mogut vyzvat nemalo problem. Esli vam etogo eshche nedostatochno, est i drugie sushchestva, kotorye popytayutsya sdelat to zhe samoe - torgovat, srazhatsya ili pomogat. O, i ne zabyvayte pro pogodu i neozhidannye sobytiya.

POSTROYTE DEREVNYu

Postroyte svoyu sobstvennuyu derevnyu s mnozhestvom tipov zdaniy, i reshayte, kakie obekty vy khotite pomestit vnutri. Zdes mozhno izgotovit bolee 150 predmetov, i u kazhdogo est svoe naznachenie. Naprimer, sozdayte derevyannyy shkaf i razmestite ego v dome, chtoby uvelichit mesto dlya khraneniya. Dorogi mogut zastavit rabochikh idti bystree... i dazhe bolshe.

VAShI RABOTNIKI

Lingi rabotayut na vas. Vzamen vy dolzhny platit im zarplatu, davat edu, odezhdu i sozdavat «zdorovuyu» obstanovku. Vam reshat, kak oni rabotayut i gde. Ostorozhno, oni mogut vstupat v konflikty drug s drugom i dazhe podzhech vashu derevnyu. Sledite, o chem oni govoryat, i ne spuskayte glaz s ikh statistiki. Kazhdyy iz nikh imeet unikalnye cherty i kharakteristiki, kotorye vy mozhete kontrolirovat.

ISSLEDUYTE

Karta – eto pesochnitsa so sluchayno sgenerirovannoy prirodoy na osnove vashego iskhodnogo profilya. Est i polzovatelskie karty, kotorye vy mozhete postroit samostoyatelno. Obshchaytes, torguyte ili srazhaytes s drugimi rasami. Sobirayte sokrovishcha i prodavayte ikh ili ispolzuyte v svoem soobshchestve. Sluchaynye sobytiya, kotorye mogut prevratit vsyu vashu derevnyu v koshmar. Uznayte, kak pogoda vliyaet na vashu edu i rabotnikov.

I DAZhE BOLShE!

Dozhd i sneg izmenit ne tolko vneshniy vid, no i to, kak vy upravites so svoey derevney. Sdelayte luchshuyu odezhdu, inache rabotniki mogut zabolet. Sozdavayte luchshee oruzhie i dospekhi, chtoby protivostoyat zlym sushchestvam ili sluchaynym voram. Zaklyuchayte sdelki i poluchayte dostatochno deneg, chtoby uvelichit vashe soobshchestvo. Dungeon of the Endless is the award-winn:
Dungeon of the Endless is the award-winning Rogue-Like Dungeon-Defense game, in which you and your team of heroes must protect the generator of your crashed ship while exploring an ever-expanding dungeon, all while facing waves of monsters and special events as you try to find your way out...

WHAT’S BEHIND THE DOOR?

A few hundred condemned criminals were being shipped to the Auriga system on board the prison hulk “Success”. While this was presented as a chance to earn back their place in society by working hard for the common good, they understood that in fact they would be slave labour, sent to colonize an unexplored planet. All they knew about Auriga Prime was what the probes told them: it had water, temperate zones, plant life, and plenty of metals in the crust.

In fact, the planet Auriga once hosted a major settlement of the galaxy-travelling ancestors known as the Endless. In addition, the planet was still orbited by a functioning (and well cloaked) defensive system, which sprang eagerly to life upon the arrival of the Success. Within a few minutes, the ship was nothing but a few large chunks of metal falling toward the planet.

Luckily, every set of holding cells also functioned as an escape pod, so the ship let itself disintegrate and the surviving prisoners fell bruised but (temporarily) alive and (momentarily) safe to the planet below. Safe, that is, until they realized that they had crashed through some sort of Endless facility, all the way down to a sub-basement so deep and ancient it might as well be called a dungeon…

Build Your Defenses

Open the Door
• Each door is a danger; prepare yourself and your team for anything
• Explore and discover an infinity of levels and layouts
• Carry your crystal through waves of monsters to the exit of each level
• Fight your way to the surface to discover the truth about Auriga

Ispytayte svoyu logiku raznoobraznymi golovolomkami, naydite razlichnye predmety, no ne poteryaytes – ved sama orientirovka stanet prepyatstviem na vashem puti!

Raskroyte tayny i zabytye sobytiya mesta, kishashchego privideniyami sekretami, nakhodya zagadochnye dokumenty, kotorye lish namekayut na ego tragichnoe i mrachnoe proshloe... Karty i pomoshchi net. Tolko vy, alkhimicheskaya lampa i... “chto-to” eshche…

- “Chudovishche”. Ono mozhet poyavitsya gde ugodno i v lyuboe vremya. Da, vy mozhete pytatsya sbezhat... no kak dolgo? Vyklyuchite li vy lampu i primenite li teni i estestvennoe osveshchenie sebe na polzu? Obnaruzhit li “ono” vas, esli vy budete stoyat vsego v pare santimetrov absolyutno nepodvizhno? Vy slyshite ego priblizhayushchiesya shagi… Chto vy predprimete?!

- Slozhnye golovolomki. Pri reshenii neordinarnykh i unikalnykh golovolomok, ne imeyushchikh ochevidnykh i prostykh otvetov, vam ponadobitsya ispolzovat vse podskazki iz okruzhayushchey obstanovki, chtoby nayti skrytyy otvet.

- Predmety i inventar. Nakhodite i ispolzuyte raznoobraznyy i nestandartnyy nabor predmetov dlya prodvizheniya v priklyuchenii. Produmannyy inventar akkuratno uporyadochivaet vashi veshchi i daet opisaniya, kotorye v nekotorykh sluchayakh dazhe soderzhat podskazki...

- Neskolko kontsovok. Luchshaya, “KhOROShAYa” kontsovka, yavlyaetsya ne normoy, a isklyucheniem. Eto nagrada dlya igrokov, kotorye myslyat nestandartno, issleduyut kazhduyu ten i zagadku, i dlya tekh, komu ulybnulas udacha...

- Originalnyy i potryasayushchiy audio- i videoryad. Eto sozdannoe vruchnuyu priklyuchenie s vysokokachestvennoy 16-bitnoy pikselnoy grafikoy. Produkt truda odnogo khudozhnika, vlozhivshego v nego dushu. Soderzhit absolyutno unikalnyy dostupnyy dlya issledovaniya osobnyak, v kotorom net dvukh odinakovykh komnat: kazhdaya imeet individualnyy dizayn so svoimi osobennostyami. Vse pikseli, detali i treshchiny v stene razmeshcheny umyshlenno i tshchatelno razrabotany vruchnuyu, chtoby rasskazat igrokam istoriyu bez ispolzovaniya slov. Nasha vydayushchayasya grafika v stile 90-kh usilena svetovymi effektami, trevozhnym pozitsionirovannym 3D-zvukom i absolyutno originalnym atmosfernym saundtrekom.

Carmageddon (Кармагеддон) — видеоигра в:
Carmageddon (Karmageddon) — videoigra v zhanre arkadnykh gonok na vyzhivanie na dvizhke BRender, razrabotannaya kompaniey Stainless Games i izdannaya dlya personalnykh kompyuterov pod Windows, MS-DOS i Mac OS v 1997 godu. V Carmageddon tselyu igroka yavlyaetsya gonka na avtomobile protiv ryada drugikh kontroliruemykh kompyuterom sopernikov v razlichnykh usloviyakh, takikh kak gorodskie, shakhtnye i promyshlennye rayony. U igroka est ogranichennoe kolichestvo vremeni dlya zaversheniya kazhdoy gonki, no mozhno poluchit bolshe vremeni, sobiraya bonusy, nanosya ushcherb avtomobilyam konkurentov i sbivaya peshekhodov.
Igra, kotoraya stala Carmageddon, nachalas kak 3D Destruction Derby, gonochnyy simulyator so stalkivayushchimisya avtomobilyami, kotoryy byl sdelan kompaniey Stainless Software v 1994 godu v kachestve prototipa. Razrabotkoy zanimalis khudozhniki Terri Leyn i Rassel Khyuz, programmist Mett Edmunds, vedushchiy programmist Patrik Baklend i vedushchiy geymdizayner Nil Barnden. Avtory obrashchalis k razlichnym izdatelyam, kotorye otkazalis finansirovat razrabotku proekta. Finansirovanie bylo polucheno ot nebolshogo izdatelstva SCi v 1995 godu, no pri uslovii, chto proekt budet peredelan v igru na osnove litsenzii s tem, chtoby garantirovat eyo populyarnost.
Pervonachalno v SCi khoteli ispolzovat «Bezumnogo Maksa», no oni ne smogli vyyasnit, kto vladeet pravami na franshizu. Vmesto etogo oni poluchili litsenziyu na film «Smertelnye gonki 2000», poskolku v eto vremya planirovalos prodolzhenie originalnogo filma. Snachala razrabotchiki khoteli shtrafovat igroka za sbitie peshekhodov, poskolku boyalis, chto igra mozhet vyyti slishkom zhestokoy. Odnako Rob Khenderson iz SCi posmotrel igru i predlozhil nachislyat ochki za nikh, dlya togo chtoby podnyat eyo spornost.
«Бейблэйд» (яп. ベイブレード бэйбурэ:до), в ор:
«Beybleyd» (yap. ベイブレード beybure:do), v originale Bakuten Shoot: Beyblade (yap. 爆転シュート ベイブレード) — manga yaponskogo avtora Takao Aoki, vykhodivshaya v kodomo-zhurnale CoroCoro Comic s 2000 po 2002. Izdana v 14 tomakh (tankobonakh) kompaniey Shogakukan. Po motivam mangi bylo sdelano tri anime-seriala: pervyy sezon, sostoyashchiy iz 51 serii, translirovalsya po yaponskomu telekanalu TV Tokyo v 2001 godu. Vtoroy sezon, Beyblade V-Force, byl pokazan v 2002 godu. On takzhe sostoit iz 51 serii. Tretiy sezon, Beyblade G Revolution, translirovalsya s yanvarya po dekabr 2003 goda. V aprele 2009 goda vyshel novyy serial, s sovershenno novymi personazhami.
Istoriya povestvuet o priklyucheniyakh gruppy shkolnikov, sorevnuyushchikhsya s pomoshchyu dvukh volchkov («bleydov») na kruglom pole. Zadacha — vytolknut za predely kruga bleyd protivnika, ispolzuya skorost i massu bleyda.
Igra osnovana na anime Beyblade X, syuzhet igry polnostyu originalen i takzhe vklyuchaet v sebya originalnykh personazhey. Glavnyy geroy unasleduet nozh Beyblade Shinobi ot svoego ottsa. Zatem glavnyy geroy vstretitsya s chlenami Team Persona.

при помощи смертоносных ловушек, оборони:
pri pomoshchi smertonosnykh lovushek, oboronitelnykh barrikad, a takzhe oruzhiya blizhnego i dalnego boya.

Est lovushki ustoychivye k atakam opredelennykh vidov zombi.

Vybirayte optimalnuyu strategiyu vyzhivaniya. Dlya naibolee uspeshnoy igry vam neobkhodimo sledit za pravilnym raskhodom zarabotannykh resursov. Ot etogo zavisit naskolko dolgo vy smozhete vyzhivat.
Adventures of Mana предлагает вам отправ:
Adventures of Mana predlagaet vam otpravitsya v puteshestvie dlya pobedy nad Lordom Tmy i spaseniem Dereva Many, analoga Dereva Zhizni. Nash glavnyy geroy — yunyy rytsar i zaklyuchyonnyy gladiator iz korolevstva Gleyv. Vospolzovavshis udobnym sluchaem, vnezapnym khaosom v zamke, emu udayotsya sbezhat. No vo vremya pobega pogibaet tovarishch, zaveshchav lish odno: nayti odnogo iz poslednikh rytsarey drevnego ordena i spasti Derevo Many, kotoroe vskore okazhetsya v smertelnoy opasnosti. Po doroge Sumo vstrechaet yunuyu devushku-tselitelnitsu, kotoraya ishchet togo zhe rytsarya i stremitsya spasti vsyo to zhe Derevo.
Geroy tut zhe vlyublyaetsya v prelestnuyu neznakomku s zolotymi lokonami i vyzyvaetsya stat eyo lichnym rytsarem..
Vizualno remeyk Adventures of Mana vyglyadit ochen priyatno. Tut skryvaetsya nebolshoy, no polnyy tepla podarok dlya poklonnikov klassicheskikh Action jRPG iz devyanostykh godov. Milaya i nemnogoslovnaya istoriya s pechalnymi notkami, uvlekatelnyy igrovoy protsess s neslozhnymi golovolomkami i issledovaniem mira, priyatnaya grafika i prostenkaya sistema prokachki — vsyo eto sozdayot prokhladitelnyy igrovoy kokteyl, kotoryy s lyogkostyu utolit zhazhdu priklyucheniy na lyuboe vremya!
Вам предстоит ощутить себя в шкуре второ:
Vam predstoit oshchutit sebya v shkure vtorogo luchshego sledovatelya v mire: nakhodite uliki, oprashivayte chudakovatykh podozrevaemykh i razglyadyvayte predmety s pomoshchyu lupy. Nekotorye schitayut uvelichitelnoe steklo «bespoleznym». Da chto oni ponimayut?
 
V dele №1 — «Ostrove s privideniyami» — bednyagu-lenivtsa uzhe neskolko nedel presleduet zagadochnyy prizrak, kotorogo nikomu ne udayotsya vysledit. Dazhe komanda prizrachnykh uchyonykh ne priblizilas k razgadke. K schastyu dlya tropicheskogo lenivtsa i neschastyu nadoedlivogo privideniya, detektiv Erzhab Kvaro pomozhet prolit svet na pravdu! «Ostrov s privideniyami» — pervyy shedevr serii, udostoennoy mnogikh nagrad. Na pervyy vzglyad prostenkaya zagadka polozhila nachalo vsemirnoy oderzhimosti mirom detektiva Kvaro.
 
Vo vtoroy igre, «Dele o nevidimom volshebnike», vmeste s detektivom my otpravimsya na ulitsy Kolduntauna, gde nekto verolomno prerval prazdnichnyy parad v chest novogo soseda. Teper i gorod razrushen, i soseda nigde ne vidno. Smozhet li detektiv Kvaro dokopatsya do suti? Ochen nadeemsya, inache istoriya nikomu ne budet interesna.
 
V zakhvatyvayushchem finale serii pod nazvaniem «Korruptsiya v kovboyskom krae» detektivu i politseyskomu Lobstvudu predstoit reshit zagadku goroda, v kotorom net sherifov. No ne vsyo tak, kak kazhetsya na pervyy vzglyad, kogda udivitelno prostoe reshenie raskryvaet zloveshchuyu skhemu. Vozmozhno, prestuplenie i pravda bylo soversheno...
 Poslednyaya zagadka perepolnena neozhidannymi povorotami i otdayot dan vernym poklonnikam detektiva Kvaro.
 
«Detektiv Kvaro: polnaya tayna» — eto ostroumnaya seriya dlya vsey semi, kotoraya pozvolit po-novomu vzglyanut na detektivnyy zhanr. Razgadyvayte zagadki samostoyatelno ili igrayte vmeste s druzyami, po ocheredi ozvuchivaya zabavnye dialogi geroev. Gotovy raskryt delo?

Root Film — это захватывающая приключенч:
Root Film — eto zakhvatyvayushchaya priklyuchencheskaya igra s elementami graficheskoy novelly. Rintaro Yagumo — novyy rezhisser teleseriala «Zagadki Simane», otmenennogo po neizvestnoy prichine 10 let nazad. Ponachalu Rintaro okhvachen entuziazmom, no ego voodushevlenie rezko idet na spad, kogda protsess poiska mest dlya semok preryvaet zagadochnoe ubiystvo. 

Sledite za priklyucheniyami zapominayushchikhsya unikalnykh personazhey, vtyanutykh v etu zagadochnuyu i uvlekatelnuyu istoriyu. Raskroyte svoi detektivnye sposobnosti, dokopavshis do istiny s pomoshchyu igrovoy simulyatsii rassledovaniya, dobavlyayushchey novye grani formatu graficheskoy novelly.

Velikolepnye illyustratsii, narisovannye ot ruki 
I personazhi, i okruzhenie v Root Film predstavlyayut soboy velikolepnye proizvedeniya iskusstva. Kazhdaya stsena graficheski sovershenna do melchayshikh detaley i ottenkov palitry. 

Puteshestvuyte po prefekture Simane 
V popytkakh uznat pravdu o «Zagadkakh Simane» vy pobyvaete v kazhdom ugolke prefektury Simane!

Raskroyte svoi detektivnye sposobnosti
Mekhanika «Intuitsiya» pozvolyaet igrokam nakhodit v igrovykh dialogakh klyuchevye slova. Aktivirovav «Intuitsiyu», vy smozhete raspoznavat slova, vazhnye dlya rassledovaniya i konfrontatsiy.

Protivostoyanie s podozrevaemymi 
Sobrav dostatochno klyuchevykh slov, vy smozhete vstupit v konfrontatsiyu s podozrevaemymi v rezhime «Maksimum» i razgadat zagadku. Pered etimi protivostoyaniyami, napominayushchimi rukopashnyy boy, vam nuzhno budet sobrat dostatochno dokazatelstv, chtoby vyvesti prestupnika na chistuyu vodu.
Прогуляйтесь вместе с ним по красивым ни: Progulyaytes vmeste s nim po krasivym nizkopoligonalnym lokatsiyam i on rasskazhet vam, kak nauchilsya zhit so svoim vnutrennim demonom. Istoriya beret nachalo v sedmom klasse sredney shkoly i prodolzhaetsya na protyazhenii neskolkikh let. So vremenem bolezn stanovitsya pokhozha na cheloveka, kotoryy postoyanno nakhoditsya ryadom i pytaetsya unizit ego. V igre est neskolko raznykh putey, chtoby poluchit odnu iz kontsovok, poetomu tolko ot vas zavisit razvitie etoy istorii.
Out Run (яп. アウトラン, Ауто Ран), также изв:
Out Run (yap. アウトラン, Auto Ran), takzhe izvestnaya kak OutRun i Outrun — avtosimulyator 1986 goda, razrabotannyy Yu Sudzuki i Sega AM2 iznachalno dlya rynka videoarkad. Vposledstvii igra byla portirovana na mnogie drugie populyarnye platformy. V retrospektivnykh intervyu Yu Sudzuki nazyval Out Run «ne gonochnoy, a voditelskoy igroy».
Igrok upravlyaet voditelem, sidyashchim za Ferrari Testarossa (prototip Testarossa Ferrari Mythos), kotoryy edet so svoey lyubimoy svetlovolosoy podrugoy. Nachinaya poezdku po Kokosovomu plyazhu, on dolzhen proekhat cherez chetyre kontrolnykh tochki za zadannoe vremya.
V moment svoego vypuska igra byla unikalna vozmozhnostyu vybora puti dvizheniya. Pered kazhdoy kontrolnoy tochkoy est razvilka, kotoraya dayot vozmozhnost igroku vybrat odin iz dvukh putey (podobnaya vetvyashchayasya sistema takzhe ispolzovalas v igre TX-1 Atari/Tatsumi 1983 goda, no v toy igre vybor chetvyortogo puti opredelyal i pyatyy put).
Исследуйте подводный город Восторг, став:
Issleduyte podvodnyy gorod Vostorg, stavshiy pristanishchem dlya velichayshikh umov chelovechestva i nizvedyonnyy do koshmarnoy antiutopii iz-za gordyni odnogo cheloveka. Sredi zalitykh vodoy razvalin voznik novyy mir, v kotorom bezumnye mutanty okhotyatsya na Malenkikh Sestrichek — bespomoshchnykh detey, soprovozhdaemykh povsyudu Bolshimi Papochkami. Chtoby vyzhit, vam ponadobyatsya smekalka, improvizirovannoe oruzhie i neveroyatnye sposobnosti, kotorymi vas nadelyat perezapisyvayushchie DNK plazmidy. Chtoby pobedit utrativshikh chelovecheskiy oblik chudovishch, vam pridetsya stat odnim iz nikh.

Vmeste s igroy vy poluchite:

• Muzey pokinutykh idey: vernites k istokam serii BioShock, posetiv etot virtualnyy muzey so mnozhestvom eksponatov, ot rannikh khudozhestvennykh nabroskov do ne voshedshikh v igru tryokhmernykh modeley. 

• Komnaty ispytaniy: proverte vashi boytsovskie navyki i sposobnost reshat golovolomki v etoy serii ne vkhodyashchikh v originalnuyu igru komnat s prepyatstviyami.

• Kommentarii rezhissera: BioShock v nashem voobrazhenii — otyshchite ryad novykh kollektsionnykh predmetov, chtoby razblokirovat seriyu videorolikov s uchastiem khudozhestvennogo direktora Kena Levina i vedushchego animatora Shona Robertsona.

Феликс работает в Министерстве Смерти, а:
Feliks rabotaet v Ministerstve Smerti, a ego vozlyublennaya, Deva Betti, — v Ministerstve Zhizni. Feliks nadeetsya, chto, okazavshis v mire lyudey pod lichinoy Mrachnogo zhnetsa, on obyazatelno vstretitsya s ney. Glavnaya zadacha Feliksa na novom meste — obrekat lyudey na smert. A chtoby pokorit lyubov vsey svoey zhizni, on uchitsya tantsevat.

Poskolku Feliks mozhet dvigatsya tolko v teni, emu prikhoditsya manipulirovat okruzhayushchim mirom. K schastyu, Feliks, kak i drugie zhnetsy, sposoben upravlyat solntsem i menyat ugol padeniya teni. Tak on sozdaet dlya sebya neobkhodimye temnye tropinki. Feliks vynuzhden delat eto, chtoby vypolnyat syuzhetnye zadaniya, v kontse kotorykh lyudi umirayut. Ved vse dolzhno idti soglasno planam Ministerstva.

• Poprobuyte spravitsya s neordinarnymi golovolomkami.
• Pogruzites v uzhasno prekrasnyy mir etoy istorii.
• Vyberite dlya sebya melodiyu v pleere Feliksa iz repertuara bolee 10 indi-artistov.
• Soberite dostizheniya-cherepa, chtoby otkryt zadaniya na vremya.
• Posmotrite, kak Feliks osvaivaet novye dvizheniya, nad kotorymi rabotali professionalnye tantsory.

Po mere togo, kak tayna raskryvaetsya, personazhi uznayut vazhnye uroki o druzhbe, sotrudnichestve i vazhnosti zaboty ob ikh obshchem dome.
Eta polnaya priklyucheniy istoriya polna zabavnykh, iskrennikh i mudrykh....

Tucked away from the outside world by th:
Tucked away from the outside world by the impenetrable haze of the Misty Woods, the village of Adam has mostly lived in peace since the days of the Wraith War. The dark power that fueled that war has vanished, but darkness is descending once more and Adam's legendary hero, Orazio, is no more. 

10 years ago he left without explanation and never returned, leaving his son and adopted daughter to wrestle with the dark secret he left behind—a secret that must now be revealed if the children hope to save both Adam and their departed father, though its revelation could unhinge the world. 

Shadows of Adam is a creative, humorous and exciting take on the 16-bit JRPG era, but with its own twists and style for the modern day gamer. Fast-paced battles, gorgeous graphics, an awesome soundtrack and the convenience to save anywhere you like make it tough to resist! Whether playing on the TV or in handheld mode, the game’s glorious pixels will immerse you in the adventure and its memorable scenes.

Features:

•	Compelling Character Driven Story: Shadows of Adam’s story is one with a deep narrative and an interesting plot. The story revolves around 4 main characters: Asrael, Kellan, Curtis and Talon.
•	A Strategic AP Management Battle System: AP is restored between each round of battle automatically and through defeating enemies. This allows a unique attrition system that encourages skill use and fast combat.
•	Beautiful Visuals: Shadows of Adam features beautifully modernized visuals inspired by classic JRPGs of the '90s.
•	Original Soundtrack With Over 44 Tracks: An original soundtrack by Tyler Mire that’s inspired by music from the genre's greatest games. This soundtrack includes unique themes for each area and character and has an emphasis on strong melodies and an emotional connection.

Fusing elements of a traditional RPG wit:
Fusing elements of a traditional RPG with investigation, exploration and moral decision-making, it invites players take on the role of a man who must seek a signed confession from those he is about to put to death.

With a predominantly text-based interface unfolding engaging story, The Executioner promises a dark and unsettling atmosphere, and a world filled with moral ambiguity

With the threat of revolution on the cards will you fight for monarchy and tradition or revolt in the name of progress? Do you support emerging science or follow the mystical path? Will you desensitize yourself to the violence you have to inflict or try to preserve your humanity?

The decision is yours. So are the consequences.

Features: 
- The torture chamber: study your victims, find their weak spot, and use your extensive arsenal (or their loved ones) to break them
- An occult underground: a town filled with mysticism built around Medieval artefacts, such as the Hand of Glory and Mandrake Root
- A dark economy: a market in dead flesh with you as its main supplier
- Synesthesia: your character's unique perceptive abilities make him a walking lie detector
- Staying sane: as a professional torturer you'll need to constantly manage your sanity to survive

Form your party (a group of secret agent:
Form your party (a group of secret agents) from among 
four races: Human, Oni, Tengu, and Nekomata. Then 
conquer the terrifying and mysterious Yokai-filled castle!

■The Yokai in Hyakki Castle
The game reproduces Yokai from ancient Japanese 
literature, including the giant skeleton Gasha Dokuro 
and a Yokai made up of a woman's head and arm.
Many creepy and terrifying monsters will appear.
They await your secret agents (players) in Hyakki 
Castle.
Powerful bosses will be unleashed at certain points as 
you make your way up through the castle. Aim for the 
tower, where the master of the castle awaits!

■Main Theme: Dan no Ura
Dan no Ura, an original song by the Biwa player Sae 
Ishida, creates a creepy atmosphere.

■About Real Time Dungeon RPGs
"Real time dungeon RPGs play like an action game, in 
which you move around and fight on a floor with a grid 
layout. With the exception of some portions, the game 
plays out in real time.

When in combat, the enemy won't wait for your attack.

Battle by avoiding enemy attacks and timing your own 
attacks at the right moment."

■A Yokai-Filled Castle with Death Looming Around the 
Corner
The player's secret agents will storm Hyakki Castle, 
where formidable Yokai and terrifying traps await.
Be careful. One miss will cost you your life.
Eat the food you find in the castle to survive. An empty 
stomach will lower your stats.

There's nowhere to relax in this castle. Eat, sleep, 
destroy Yokai, and search the castle.

In the Yokai-filled Hyakki Castle, you're always one step 
away from death.

■The 2 Party System
"The game has a split party system that uses the 
Tokugawa treasure item Ishin no Ofuda.
The player can freely split up into two parties at any 
time (the game will go into split screen mode).
When necessary, split into two teams to deal with the 
traps and challenges in the room.
In addition, the party you aren't controlling will use 
spells to temporarily harden themselves, increasing their 
stamina.
Attack enemies from the rear to deal massive damage. 
Use the hardened party with high stamina as a decoy, 
and send the other around to the back."

Kuda by Kholland ni otpravilsya, chtoby popytatsya uyti, vse prikovany k svoim ekranam. Ey ponadobitsya pomoshch starykh druzey i novykh znakomykh - i im ponadobitsya ee pomoshch, - chtoby izbezhat bezumiya v seti i, nakonets, na vremya otklyuchitsya ot seti. Okunuvshis (ili spotknuvshis) v novyy opyt, novye otnosheniya i sluchaynye priklyucheniya, Gollandiya mozhet poluchit shans izbezhat vezdesushchey dramy v sotsialnykh setyakh.

Pomnite, kak priyatno govorit pri nastoyashchikh litsakh?

V mire, zastryavshem na tsifrovykh soedineniyakh, edinstvennyy sposob, kotorym Gollandiya sobiraetsya perezhit etot razryv s sokhraneniem svoego rassudka, - eto pereyti na analogovuyu svyaz. K schastyu, ona skoro uznaet, skolko zamanchivykh priklyucheniy sushchestvuet, vdali ot postoyannykh kommentariev v sotsialnykh setyakh. Konechno, ona mogla by zatsiklitsya na seti mneniy o ee razryve, kak obychno, no, mozhet byt, est drugoy sposob ...

Sobirayte snaryazhenie, izuchayte zaklinaniya i prodvigaytes kak Zhnets, chtoby srazitsya s uzhasnymi vragami i pobezhdat epicheskikh bossov.
В игре Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes:

Raundy prokhodyat bystro, napryazhenno, inogda smeshno i pochti vsegda gromko.

Mighty Mike (также известная как Power P:
Mighty Mike (takzhe izvestnaya kak Power Pete) — dvukhmernaya 2D-ekshn-videoigra s vidom sverkhu, razrabotannaya kompaniey Pangea Software i izdannaya Interplay pod brendom MacPlay v 1995-om godu; postavlyalas v komplekte vmeste s Mac OS System 7 Big Bang dlya kompyuterov Macintosh Performa. Glavnyy geroy dolzhen byl spasat pushistykh krolikov iz otdela kukol ot plokhikh igrushek, prokhodya pyatnadtsat nasyshchennykh ekshn-urovney.
Igra poluchila nagradu «Luchshaya arkadnaya igra goda» ot Macworld i zanyala vtoroe mesto v nominatsii «Luchshaya ekshn-igra» ot MacUser.
Posle zakrytiya magazina vse igrushki ozhivayut, i nachinaetsya khaos. Gruppa plyushevykh krolikov sbegaet iz svoego konteynera i razbredaetsya po vsemu magazinu, bespomoshchnye pered ordami bolee opasnykh tovarok. Spasti ikh mozhet tolko samaya populyarnaya igrushka v magazine — figurka Moguchego Pita/Mayka. Moguchiy Pit (Mayk) nachinaet svoy pokhod, chtoby spasti vsekh krolikov.
V izdanii «Biblii Macintosh» ot 1996 goda Power Pete nazvana «po-nastoyashchemu uvlekatelnoy» i «ochen vesyoloy». V svoey state dlya Computer Games Strategy Plus Piter Smit zametil: «U vladeltsev kompyuterov Mac ne tak uzh i mnogo kachestvennykh, polnoekrannykh i dinamichnykh arkadnykh ekshn-igr, iz kotorykh mozhno vybirat, no dazhe esli by oni byli, ya by vsyo ravno dal Power Pete svoe samoe goryachee odobrenie».

Рилаккума (яп. リラックマ Рираккума, от яп. リ:
Rilakkuma (yap. リラックマ Rirakkuma, ot yap. リラックス rirakusu — transliteratsii slova «relaks» i yap. クマ kuma — medved) — personazh, pridumannyy yaponskoy khudozhnitsey Aki Kondo; vpervye knigi o Rilakumme vypushcheny kompaniey San-X v 2003 godu. Rilakkuma stal ochen izvestnym kak i v samoy Yaponii, tak i za eyo predelami, imeet tseluyu set magazinov «Rilakkuma Shop», pod brendom Rilakkuma vypuskayutsya takzhe kantstovary, posuda, ryukzaki i plyushevye igrushki.
Vymyshlennaya istoriya poyavleniya Rilakkumy nachinaetsya s togo, chto ego vnezapno obnaruzhivaet u sebya v kvartire ofisnaya rabotnitsa Kaoru, vidimo, medved reshil poselitsya u neyo. Na spine u nego est molniya, skryvayushchaya beluyu tkan v goluboy goroshek. So vremenem Rilakkuma stal takzhe polzovatsya zhyoltoy podushkoy Kaoru. Personazh byl vpervye pokazan v serii illyustrirovannykh knig «Rilakkuma Seikatsu», vypushchennoy San-X, no vnezapno stal takzhe populyaren kak igrushka. V knigakh on chasto izobrazhyon v raznykh kostyumakh, takikh kak kostyum kappy. Krome togo, podrazumevaetsya, chto vsyo ego tulovishche — eto tozhe kostyum, kotoryy Rilakkuma snimaet, kogda tot stanovitsya starym ili gryaznym, ego chasto videli sidyashchim i nablyudayushchim za kostyumami, poka te sushatsya. Tem ne menee, neizvestno, yavlyaetsya li ego golova chastyu kostyuma.
Ego lyubimaya eda — mitarasi-dango, keksy, omuraysu, karamelnyy puding i vinograd. V sootvetstvii s imenem (kotoroe na yaponskom oznachaet doslovno «relaksiruyushchiy medved»), predpochitaet vsyo vremya otdykhat — spat, valyatsya, smotret televizor, slushat muzyku i kupatsya v goryachikh istochnikakh. Zhivite spokoynoy zhiznyu s Rilakkumoy!.. Ne uspeete oglyanutsya, kak Rilakkuma, Korilakkuma i Kiiroytori uzhe budut zhit u vas doma.
V etoy igre vy mozhete zabotitsya o nikh, kormit ikh lakomstvami, igrat v mini-igry i dazhe zanimatsya vmeste vesyolym fitnesom.
Pochemu by ne otdokhnut doma vmeste s Rilakkumoy i druzyami, sdelav pereryv v vashem plotnom slozhnom rabochem grafike?..

A new compilation of the critically-accl:
A new compilation of the critically-acclaimed, multi-award winning noir puzzle games FRAMED and FRAMED 2.
Rearrange the panels of an animated comic book to craft the story of a noir-styled spy adventure. Presented in an extensive series of visual puzzles, requiring logic and imagination, each panel move changes the current narrative, leading to all kinds of comedic blunders, untimely deaths--and when solved correctly--stylish heists, fast getaways and nail-biting escapades.

The FRAMED Collection for Nintendo Switch™ includes a completely updated UI, but retains the intuitive tactile controls of FRAMED and FRAMED 2. Perfectly suited for the portable play that the Nintendo Switch™ is renowned for, the puzzle format of the FRAMED Collection can turn a quick train trip into a pleasurable escape, or a night away on holiday into an adventure.

FEATURES

The Complete FRAMED experience
The FRAMED Collection is a new compilation of the award-winning, noir puzzle games FRAMED and FRAMED 2. Escape effortlessly into the stylish, pulp-noir spy world of FRAMED, before delving deeper with the more challenging prequel FRAMED 2.

Simple, but uniquely clever puzzle design
Select animated comic panels and move them around using your logic skills and your imagination to craft the best outcome. Getting the story ‘wrong’ is as much part of the experience as getting it ‘right’, with every rearrangement telling a different, satisfying--and sometimes very comedic--story.

Hand-crafted noir art and animation
From the first frame to the last, the FRAMED collection oozes with stylish, noir, award-winning art and animation. Unique, hand-drawn silhouetted characters, incredibly fluid animations, and beautiful, mysterious settings all bring the FRAMED world to life with a wink of mischievous personality.

Multi-award winning, genre-bending design
FRAMED Collection features a fusion of unique game mechanics and clever narrative puzzles that bend genres and constantly deliver a satisfying experience with every panel arrangement. A winner of multiple game awards, and a finalist of IGF 2015’s ‘Excellence in Design’ Award, Hideo Kojima named FRAMED his Game of the Year in 2014--“without any doubt”.

An all-original live jazz soundtrack
Featuring live jazz performances fused with modern themes and funky beats, the soundtracks to FRAMED and FRAMED 2 are as mesmerising as they are evocative, setting the mood and upping the mystery-laden tension.

Now as a new remastered version, rebuilt from the ground up and enhanced with local co-op mode.

They Breathe is a critically acclaimed indie gem. In thirty short minutes, the game leaves it up to you to figure out every part of its increasingly bizarre universe, in order to survive the onslaught of unexpected creatures and ultimately comprehend their true nature. «Рудольф, красноносый северный олень» —:
«Rudolf, krasnonosyy severnyy olen» — personazh literatury i kinematografa, vpervye poyavivshiysya v proizvedenii Roberta L. Meya v 1939 godu. Rudolf, pridumannyy v ramkakh reklamnoy kampanii univermaga Montgomery Wards, priurochennoy k rozhdestvenskim rasprodazham, s tekh por stal personazhem, v pervuyu ochered assotsiiruemym s Rozhdestvom i Santa-Klausom. V 1948 godu na ekrany vyshel korotkometrazhnyy animatsionnyy film po stikhotvoreniyu Meya, a v 1949 godu poyavilas rozhdestvenskaya pesnya Dzhonni Marksa na slova Meya, stavshaya rozhdestvenskim standartom. Obraz Rudolfa byl populyarizovan kukolnym animatsionnym telefilmom 1964 goda i polnometrazhnym risovannym animatsionnym filmom 1998 goda.
Okunites v nepovtorimuyu atmosferu multfilma «Priklyucheniya olenenka Rudolfa» po-novomu! Ochutites v yarkoy interaktivnoy zimney skazke, polnoy prazdnichnogo ocharovaniya, interesnykh issledovaniy i uvlekatelnykh priklyucheniy, gde vsemi lyubimaya rozhdestvenskaya istoriya ozhila v sovershenno novom formate. Otpravtes v puteshestvie po chetyrem prazdnichnym oblastyam pryamikom iz lyubimoy klassiki, kazhdaya iz kotorykh napolnena prazdnichnym nastroeniem, prichudlivymi syurprizami i trogatelnymi priklyucheniyami!
Открыв глаза в незнакомой лаборатории, т:
Otkryv glaza v neznakomoy laboratorii, ty ponimaesh, chto sovershenno nichego ne pomnish. Tebe predstoit sovershit grandioznoe priklyuchenie po zabroshennomu, no vse eshche polnomu opasnostey regionu Isur, raskryt ego sekrety i uznat mrachnuyu taynu svoego proshlogo.

Vo vremya puteshestviya ty ovladeesh alkhimicheskimi znaniyami, kotorye pozvolyat soedinyat v moshchnye zelya chetyre stikhii — ogon, vodu, vozdukh i zemlyu. Dobavlyaya razlichnye ingredienty, ty smozhesh preodolevat pregrady na svoem puti, reshat golovolomki i srazhatsya s monstrami.

Issleduy Isur
Nekogda protsvetayushchiy kontinent lezhit v ruinakh sobstvennogo velichiya. Issleduy oblasti, polnye sekretov, raskroy tayny mogushchestvennykh alkhimikov i naydi svoy put v etikh opasnykh zemlyakh.

Pochuvstvuy dukh priklyucheniy
Alchemist Adventure pobuzhdaet k nestandartnym resheniyam blagodarya unikalnoy sisteme alkhimicheskoy sinergii elementov. Sozdavay samye raznye zelya — vozmozhnosti ogranicheny tolko tvoey fantaziey!
Chem dalshe ty prodvigaeshsya, tem silnee stanovyatsya vragi i tem rezhe ty smozhesh sokhranyatsya. Tshchatelno produmyvay taktiku i vybiray zelya, chtoby spravlyatsya s vragami i pregradami.

Osobennosti

Issleduy zagadochnyy mir
vo vremya puteshestviya ty posetish samye raznye lokatsii: ot laboratoriy i podzemeliy do zabroshennykh fabrik v samom zherle vulkana!

Sozdavay zelya iz kombinatsiy elementov
v tvoem rasporyazhenii chetyre stikhii, kotorye pri soedinenii sozdayut razlichnye zelya, bomby, eliksiry i masla dlya oruzhiya.

Menyay mir vokrug sebya
alkhimiya pozvolyaet izmenyat mir vokrug: podnimay uroven vody v ozere, sozdavay ledyanye platformy, dvigay predmety pri pomoshchi vetra i mnogoe drugoe!

Razgadyvay alkhimicheskie golovolomki
pri pomoshchi alkhimii ty mozhesh otkryvat sunduki, nakhodit taynye tropy i pronikat v samye potaennye mesta kontinenta.

Uznavay slabosti svoikh vragov
nakhodi uyazvimosti monstrov i vyrabatyvay naibolee podkhodyashchuyu taktiku boya.

Kooperativnyy rezhim
issleduy zemli Isura vmeste s drugom, vernym soratnikom Mii gomunkulom!
Never Give Up — это напичканный жуткими: Never Give Up — eto napichkannyy zhutkimi lovushkami i opasnostyami platformer, starayushchiysya prevratit vas v krovavye oshmetki. Kogda idti vpered stanovitsya kruto, krutye ne sdayutsya! Predstavlyaem vam khardkornyy, zatochennyy pod navyki platformer ot sozdateley serii zhestkikh brauzernykh igr, polyubivshikhsya millionam igrokov po vsemu miru. Posle kazhdogo prokhozhdeniya urovnya dobavlyaetsya novyy element dlya bolshey slozhnosti. Tsirkulyarnye pily? Est. Upravlyaemye rakety? Ugu. Gigantskie roboty-nosorogi? Estestvenno. V Never Give Up naydetsya vse eto i dazhe bolshe, vklyuchaya bolee 150 urovney, bitvy s ogromnymi bossami i golos Arina Khansona.
Splasher — это увлекательная игра в арка:
Splasher — eto uvlekatelnaya igra v arkadnom stile.

VIDY KRASKI
Ispolzuyte razlichnye tsveta kraski, chtoby prilipat k stenam i krysham, vysoko podprygivat i obmanyvat svoikh vragov!

MASTER ZAKhVATYVAYuShchIKh UROVNEY
Ne popadites v lovushki i obezvredte ustroystva, otvechayushchie za bezopasnost gigantskogo zavoda.
Проложите себе путь к вершине кулинарног:
Prolozhite sebe put k vershine kulinarnogo iskusstva i stante pravitelem restorannogo biznesa! Vstupite v dinamichnyy mir Buffet Boss, gde vy ne prosto gotovite, no i stroite svoyu kulinarnuyu imperiyu. Nachnite kak skromnyy predprinimatel i prodvigaytes po karernoy lestnitse, chtoby stat, odnovremenno, luchshim shef-povarom, barmenom i menedzherom.
Po mere rosta vashego restorana rastut i ego problemy. Udovletvoryayte svoikh lyubimykh klientov, upravlyayte perepolnennymi obedennymi zalami i sledite za tem, chtoby vasha komanda vsegda byla na vysote! Chem uspeshnee vy stanovites, tem bolshe prepyatstviy predstoit preodolet, no ne volnuytes: s pravilnoy strategiey vy stanete liderom svoey otrasli.
ATOMIK: RunGunJumpGun - это крутой двухм:
ATOMIK: RunGunJumpGun - eto krutoy dvukhmernyy platformer, v kotorom u vas est moshchneyshee, otritsayushchee zakony fiziki oruzhie. Vas zhdut bezumnye personazhi, prostoy, no udivitelno slozhnyy igrovoy protsess i pulsiruyushchiy saundtrek. ATOMIK: RunGunJumpGun - shumnaya i bezbashennaya igra, staryy dobryy platformer.

Upravlenie obezoruzhivaet svoey prostotoy. Odna klavisha - vystrel vniz, kotoryy pozvolyaet vam letet. Drugaya - vystrel vpered, unichtozhayushchiy vse na vashem puti. Ostanovok v etom prekrasnom, syurrealistichnom mire net. Na kazhdom shagu vas podsteregayut smertelno opasnye lovushki i prepyatstviya. Urovni razrabotany ochen tshchatelno, tak chto vam postoyanno pridetsya cheredovat rezhimy strelby, iskusno manevriruya. Smert zdes ne prosto vozmozhna, a neizbezhna. Begite, strelyayte, prygayte, strelyayte, izo vsekh sil staraytes vyzhit, chtoby umeret snova.

Osobennosti igry:
•Voskhititelnaya slozhnost: kazhdaya sekunda na schetu. Eta igra stanet idealnoy proverkoy vashikh refleksov
 • Beskonechnyy ekshen: blagodarya vozrozhdeniyam vy mozhete bystro umirat i eshche bystree vozvrashchatsya v igru
 •Upravlenie s pomoshchyu dvukh klavish. Odna klavisha pozvolyaet letat, vtoraya prevrashchaet prepyatstviya v razvaliny.
 • Tri unikalnykh igrovykh mira, kazhdyy so svoimi zadachami, kotorye zastavyat igrokov menyat taktiku
 • Bolee 120 bezumnykh urovney: kazhdyy uroven prorabotan ochen tshchatelno, chtoby ispytat skorost reaktsii i uporstvo igroka.
 • Rezhim "Marafon": dlya igrokov, kotorye khotyat ustanovit mirovoy rekord.
 • Syurrealistichnaya grafika: bezumnye, do predela nasyshchennye tsvetom izobrazheniya
 • Gipermotornyy saundtrek: pulsiruyushchie kompozitsii, obedinyayushchie v sebe khip-khop, elektroniku i saundtreki k kinofilmam.
 •Nemyslimaya kosmicheskaya epopeya: vas zhdut sumasshedshie, prekrasno illyustrirovannye personazhi.
 • Predmety dlya mazokhistov: zadanie, v kotorom nuzhno sobirat razbrosannye po urovnyam "atomiki", delaet urovni eshche bolee besposhchadnymi. Nastoyashchiy podarok dlya perfektsionistov, kotorye nenavidyat sebya.
 • Upravlenie odnoy rukoy: podkhodit dlya igrokov s ogranichennymi vozmozhnostyami.
 • Igra sozdana vyrashchennymi v estestvennykh usloviyakh razrabotchikami, kotorykh kormili chistoy smesyu iz VVVVVV, Hotline Miami i Super Meat Boy.
Waking Violet — классическая двухмерная:
Waking Violet — klassicheskaya dvukhmernaya golovolomka s vidom sverkhu, kotoraya otlichaetsya neveroyatnymi zaklinaniyami i mekhanikoy peremotki vremeni.

Vy igraete za Violettu — skromnuyu devochku, kotoraya tak khochet vyrasti, no ne mozhet vybratsya iz sna, v kotorom ona zabludilas. 
S kazhdoy reshennoy golovolomkoy vy na shag blizhe k tomu, chtoby prosnutsya i vernutsya k zhizni, no u vashego bluzhdaniya vo sne est prichina, i vybratsya budet ne tak-to legko…

– 42 urovnya, kotorye zastavyat vas popotet.
– Izuchayte interesnye zaklinaniya.
– Issleduyte volshebnyy mir i uznayte kto (ili chto) vas v nem uderzhivaet.
– Sobirayte manu, kolduyte, no ne otchaivaytes, esli vam chto-to ne udalos — nachinayte snachala!
– Krasochnaya i nepovtorimaya grafika, narisovannaya vruchnuyu.
– Neveroyatnaya umirotvoryayushchaya muzyka pomozhet vam sosredotochitsya.
Пройди все препятствия и доставь принцес:
Proydi vse prepyatstviya i dostav printsessu k eyo tseli! 

Mir Light Tracer: 7 glav: Mir Gravitatsii i Mekhanicheskiy Mir, ledyanye stupenki i Gorod Angelov.

Raznoobrazie deystviy: ot platform do zagadochnykh golovolomok, kotorye ispytayut ne tolko tvoyu reaktsiyu, no i myshlenie.

Bashni i tayny: printsessa s missiey, zagadochnyy geroy i istoriya s izyuminkoy! Uznay o printsesse i misticheskoy bolezni, porazivshey eyo stranu.
«От Алушты до Жулебино, Нарьян-Мара и до:
«Ot Alushty do Zhulebino, Naryan-Mara i do Kemerovo —
Altushkam nadoelo dratsya za kavalerov.

No est odna problema…» ©
U vas net zheny, khorosho za sorok, mirovozzrenie uzhe krepko sformirovano, no schastya v zhizni vsyo eshchyo net?.. Ne grusti, tebe prosto nuzhno vspomnit parol ot svoego akkaunta na Skufuslugakh i bukvalno cherez paru klikov ty smozhesh poluchit ot gosudarstva svoyu zakonnuyu altushku!
Immersivnyy simulyator skufa ot pervogo litsa v formate vizualnoy novelly, sobrannyy na kolenke za mesyats — luchshee, chto mozhno poluchit v zhanre za eti megabayty. Okey, mozhno nayti i poluchshe. Tut vy pravy. Kstati, a chto takoe 'immersivnyy'?
Старейшина посёлка, где вырос молодой па:
Stareyshina posyolka, gde vyros molodoy pastukh Link prosit yunoshu posetit korolevskiy zamok strany Khayrul. Link otpravlyaetsya v put, ne znaya o tom, chto eti zemli okutany tmoy. V Sumerechnom tsarstve on perevoploshchaetsya v volka i vskore popadaet v plen. Zagadochnoe sushchestvo po imeni Midna, obladayushchaya magicheskimi sposobnostyami, pomogaet emu sbezhat. Vmeste oni otpravlyayutsya navstrechu priklyucheniyam, chtoby osvobodit svoyu stranu ot zla..
The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess (yapon. ゼルダの伝説 トワイライトプリンセス Dzeruda no Densetsu Tovayrayto Purinsesu) — konsolnaya videoigra v zhanre Action-adventure iz serii The Legend of Zelda, razrabotannaya i izdannaya kompaniey Nintendo dlya platform GameCube, Wii v 2006 godu, Wii U v 2016-om. Iznachalno zaplanirovannaya na noyabr 2005 goda dlya GameCube, igra byla otlozhena, dlya togo chtoby razrabotchiki sbalansirovali igru i sozdali variant pod Wii.
Na konferentsii E3 v 2006 godu prezident Nintendo of America Redzhi Fis-Eme nazval Twilight Princess luchshey igroy iz serii Zelda. V yanvare 2007 goda chitateli populyarnogo igrovogo veb-sayta GameSpot udostoili Wii-versiyu The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess zvaniya «luchshey igry dlya platformy Nintendo Wii» i «luchshey igry v zhanre Action Adventure». V fevrale 2007 goda Akademiya interaktivnykh iskusstv i nauk ofitsialno prisudila igre The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess glavnyy priz v nominatsii «Vydayushcheesya dostizhenie v razrabotke syuzheta i kharakterov». Krome togo, igra byla nominirovana na poluchenie prestizhnogo priza v igrovoy industrii Game Developers Choice Awards v kachestve luchshey videoigry goda. V yanvare 2007 goda bylo ofitsialno zayavleno, chto prodazhi The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess perevalili za otmetku 1 million ekzemplyarov. Po dannym agregatora Metacritic, remaster «The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess HD» imeet reyting 86/100 na osnovanii 74 retsenziy.
Kitaria Fables — это очаровательная прик:
Kitaria Fables — eto ocharovatelnaya priklyuchencheskaya RPG s fermerstvom i vozmozhnostyu sozdaniya predmetov! V vashem rasporyazhenii budut mech, luk i kniga zaklinaniy. Srazhaytes s tmoy, kotoraya ugrozhaet miru! Puteshestvuyte po samym raznym oblastyam, ishchite relikvii i resursy, razvivayte svoyu fermu i vyrashchivayte produkty. Vypolnyayte zadaniya v odinochku ili vmeste s drugom v lokalnom sovmestnom rezhime!

Ocharovatelnaya priklyuchencheskaya RPG s fermerstvom i vozmozhnostyu sozdaniya predmetov! V vashem rasporyazhenii budut mech, luk i kniga zaklinaniy. Srazhaytes s tmoy, kotoraya ugrozhaet miru! Spuskaytes v podzemelya, ishchite relikvii i resursy, razvivayte svoyu fermu i vyrashchivayte produkty. Sotrudnichayte s sosedyami iz vashey derevni, chtoby izgotovit novoe snaryazhenie. 

Privetstvuem vas v Kitarii, mirnoy zemle, gde do nedavnego vremeni tsarila garmoniya. Dikaya priroda vokrug derevni Po stala chereschur agressivna, i Imperiya obratilas k vam: vy dolzhny uznat, chto proiskhodit, i zashchitit zhiteley.

Boi v realnom vremeni. Srazhaytes kholodnym oruzhiem, strelyayte iz luka i izobretayte novye zaklinaniya. Vybirayte predustanovki, podkhodyashchie vashemu stilyu boya. Izobretayte magicheskie zaklinaniya, izgotavlivayte oruzhie i bronyu, kotorye prigodyatsya vam v igre. 

Izuchayte drevnyuyu magiyu. K vam v ruki popadet staraya kniga zaklinaniy. Vospolzuytes eyu, chtoby izuchit davnym-davno zapreshchennuyu Imperiey magiyu i poluchit preimushchestvo v bitve! 

Sobirayte resursy, izgotavlivayte predmety i zanimaytes fermerstvom! V Kitarii est mnozhestvo resursov, kotorye nepremenno vam prigodyatsya! Ubivayte monstrov i poluchayte ingredienty, sazhayte semena i ukhazhivayte za vskhodami, sobirayte materialy i rudu, chtoby izgotovit moshchnoe oruzhie, krepkuyu bronyu i aksessuary. 

Postroyte sobstvennyy dom v derevne Po. Kitariya polna druzhelyubnykh (i ne ochen druzhelyubnykh!) obitateley. Poznakomtes s sosedyami i vypolnyayte ikh prosby. Chem krepche vy podruzhites s novymi znakomymi, tem bolshe nagrad poluchite za razvitie otnosheniy! 

Lokalnyy sovmestnyy rezhim. Vypolnyayte zadaniya v odinochku ili vmeste s drugom! Udvoyte svoyu moshch i ispolzuyte gibkuyu sistemu boya Kitaria Fables, chtoby silnye storony kazhdogo igroka dopolnyali drug druga.
Жестокая, тёмная экшен-RPG, действие кот:
Zhestokaya, tyomnaya ekshen-RPG, deystvie kotoroy proiskhodit v koshmare, napolnennom uzhasayushchimi monstrami i nekhoroshimi lyudmi.
Igraya za Kristiana, obedinites, chtoby brosit vyzov kultu, kotoryy ego vospital. Unichtozhiv chetyre stolpa Sanktuma: Ottsa, Sestru, Kardinala i Svyashchennika, vy izmenite poryadok etogo izvrashchyonnogo mira.
Ваш герой — Рейк, находчивый представите:
Vash geroy — Reyk, nakhodchivyy predstavitel lisego plemeni. Tsepochka tragicheskikh sobytiy vtyagivaet vas v nastoyashchee priklyuchenie, iskhod kotorogo vazhen dlya vsekh mirolyubivykh obitateley strany. Chtoby nabratsya sil dlya borby so zlom, vam pridyotsya ostavit rodnuyu derevnyu i otpravitsya skitatsya po svetu.
Po mere priklyucheniy vy budete nabiratsya opyta i poluchat novye sposobnosti. Ne vse obitateli etogo mira k vam druzhelyubny. Kto-to podelitsya s vami poleznoy informatsiey, nekotorykh interesuet lish torgovlya, a ostalnye mogut i napast. Chtoby poluchit reshayushchee preimushchestvo v bitve, uluchshayte snaryazhenie i sobirayte poleznye resursy, kotorye mozhno vstretit povsyudu.
— Neobychnaya vselennaya razumnykh zhivotnykh, vypolnennaya v yarkom pikselnom stile,
Новая игра от Ясухиро Вады, создателя Ha:
Novaya igra ot Yasukhiro Vady, sozdatelya Harvest Moon, v kotoroy polno appetitnykh blyud, interesnykh mest, volshebnykh personazhey... i dazhe est drakone yaytso?! Blagodarya volnuyushchey smesi ingredientov Little Dragons Café yavlyaetsya poistine vkusneyshey igroy na svete!
Yuntsy-bliznyashki vdrug uznayut, chto na nikh vozlozheno upravlenie semeynym kafe. Chto mozhet byt luchshe? Im predstoit ne tolko obsluzhit klientov, no i raskryt taynu vnezapnoy bolezni materi i dazhe vzrastit malyutku-drakona! Issleduyte ostrov, rastite i lovite ingredienty, ukhazhivayte za drakonom i zavodite novykh druzey! I kto znaet, mozhet, vam udastsya prevratit Little Dragons Café v samoe primechatelnoe mesto v okruge!
Протего, ведущее мировое шпионское агент:
Protego, vedushchee mirovoe shpionskoe agentstvo, na grani unichtozheniya. Tolko odin chelovek sposoben vzyat v svoi ruki upravlenie C.A.R.D.S, sobrat vse razbrosannye otryady Protego i spasti mir.

Eto vy.

S pomoshchyu poslednego analitika Protego Dzhima Rasklada (Greg Miller) vy osvoite unikalnye sposobnosti kazhdogo otryada v igre takticheskogo pasyansa «Soliter». Tak v pasyans vy eshche nikogda ne igrali. Vypolnite svoyu missiyu i vernite vse otryady na bazu v etoy istorii, polnoy obmana i intrig. I pomnite: nikomu nelzya doveryat. Sokhranyayte khladnokrovie v mire shpionov II i agentov s kiberprimochkami.

Poluchiv polnyy kontrol nad Protego, vy smozhete beskonechno igrat v rezhime «Srazhenie» ili ispytat svoi navyki na vremya v rezhime «Obratnyy otschet»: etot rezhim vyzhivaniya potrebuet ot vas vsekh takticheskikh navykov.

Osobennosti igry:
* Tri rezhima. Eto samaya masshtabnaya korotkometrazhka Bithell! V rezhime kampanii vas zhdet napryazhennaya i nasyshchennaya istoriya, a takzhe obuchenie mekhanikam igry. Rezhim «Obratnyy otschet» ispytaet vas na prochnost s tsunami unikalnykh kolod, a v rezhime «Srazhenie» vy smozhete v svoe udovolstvie sygrat so vsemi otkrytymi otryadami.
* Prekrasnyy originalnyy dizayn personazhey i prorabotannaya atmosfera pogruzyat vas v serdtse futuristicheskogo zagovora.
* I, razumeetsya, v etom epicheskom pasyanse vas zhdut polnye vnutriigrovye video s Gregom Millerom i Inelem Tomlinsonom v glavnykh rolyakh v originalnoy istorii ot avtorov Thomas Was Alone, Volume, Subsurface Circular i John Wick Hex.
* A saundtrek dlya vashikh priklyucheniy sozdan kompozitorom Dzhonom Everistom.
Streets of Rogue — это облегченный рогла:
Streets of Rogue — eto oblegchennyy roglayk o vybore, svobode i bezuderzhnom vesele. Vdokhnoveniem dlya igry posluzhili dinamichnye roglayk-igry s vidom sverkhu, k kotorym avtory dobavili svobodu eksperimentov, glubokiy geympley i legkost pogruzheniya simulyatorov i rolevykh igr.

Deystvie proiskhodit ne v privychnom podzemele, a v zhivom protsedurno generiruemom gorode, gde slozhnyy II rukovodit personazhami iz vsekh sloev obshchestva, kotorye prosto zhivut svoey zhiznyu.

Dlya prodvizheniya vpered igroku pridetsya vypolnyat razlichnye zadaniya — kakim ugodno sposobom, ispolzuya osobennosti personazha, predmety i okruzhayushchuyu obstanovku.
Ty mozhesh sygrat za soldata, kotoryy snachala strelyaet, a potom zadaet voprosy.
Ili — za skrytnogo doktora, kotoryy razbiraetsya s protivnikami s pomoshchyu khloroforma i ruzhya-trankvilizatora.
A kak naschet gorilly, kotoraya osvobozhdaet svoikh sorodichey iz kletok i skolachivaet nebolshuyu armiyu?
\"Experience a slice of off-grid life, a:
"Experience a slice of off-grid life, and the bittersweet taste of love...

You live in the mountains, spending your days tending a vegetable garden, looking after chickens, and working remotely as a computer programmer. You don't participate in society - or whatever's left of it. You're fine with being alone.

But when a young woman appears on your secluded property, injured and lost on a stormy night, you're understandably torn. Are you obligated to help her? Is it even safe to help her?

You have no idea what to do. Your brain is mush. And the fact that she's so pretty doesn't help...

Cabin Fever is a sweet, funny, romantic visual novel that's sure to give you all the feels. Experience a budding friendship - and a blossoming romance - as you open up, make choices, and explore multiple endings. The world may seem bitter and bleak… But your story doesn't have to be.

Arkadnyy avtomat (arcade machine, coin-op) — stoyka s apparaturoy dlya zapuska igr, obychno arkadnogo zhanra. Mnogie izvestnye kompyuternye igry vpervye poyavilis na igrovykh avtomatakh i lish spustya nekotoroe vremya byli portirovany na pristavki i domashnie kompyutery. S drugoy storony, igrovye avtomaty inogda sobirayutsya na osnove obychnykh kompyuterov i igrovykh pristavok.
MAME 2003 Plus + 4859 igr («mnozhestvo arkadnykh mashin», Full Non-Merged Reference Set 2018) sm. zdes.

Приключенческий roguelite-хоррор от трет:

Derevnya predstavlyaet soboy zaputannyy labirint, kotoryy menyaetsya s kazhdym prokhozhdeniem — issledovat derevnyu i iskat otvety vam pridyotsya samostoyatelno.
Vashe oruzhie? Korobok spichek....

Vokrug sgushchaetsya tma, i vsyo chto u vas est — nemnogo spichek. Sumeete li vy proyti cherez tuman i uznat pravdu? Ili vas poglotyat mrachnye tayny, kotorye derevnya ne khochet vam raskryvat?

● Nelineynyy syuzhet, dinamicheskaya i adaptivnaya istoriya.
● Rassleduyte ritual, vokrug kotorogo stroitsya vsya igra, i ispolzuyte vsyo, chto smozhete nayti, chtoby ostanovit ego.

A BOOKWORM BATTLE MAGE: Make the most out of Sayri´s unique spell casting and combat systems! Use them to traverse each story level however you want, with the weapons and magic you want, and customize prince Sayri´s gameplay to your liking.

YOUR KNOWLEDGE IS POWER: Use knowledge as a currency to enhance Sayri´s abilities. Collect knowledge hidden inside each level to unlock more powerful magic and items.

EXOTIC MYTHOLOGIES TO DISCOVER: Become part of whimsical settings with a distinct native Latin American flavour. Through each story, experience art, characters and mythologies that expand upon the fantasy genre in unexplored directions.

STORY BRANCHING THAT CHANGES EACH LEVEL: The amount of story details you have recovered inside every level changes it on your play-through. Replay each story to see your impact on its ending and the world it paints on your screen.
