Thomas Was Alone is the award winning, c:
Thomas Was Alone is the award winning, critically acclaimed platformer about friendship and jumping and floating and anti-gravity. Guide a group of sentient rectangles through a series of obstacles, combining their skills to reach the end of each level.

Discover the story of the world’s first sentient AIs, and how they worked together to, well not escape… “escape” is a strong word. Perhaps “emerge” might be better. “Emerge” has an air of importance about it, while keeping the various plot twists and origin stories you’ll discover under wraps. We didn’t even mention the bouncing. That would be overkill.

Listen to reactive and atmospheric music originally composed by David Housden. Negotiate puzzles meticulously designed by Mike Bithell, and immerse yourself in the characters journey with a BAFTA award winning voiceover read wistfully and amusingly by Danny Wallace.

Also includes Thomas Was Alone: Benjamin’s Flight, the additional level pack that follows the tale of Benjamin and his father’s incredible invention. Meet a new companion and a familiar face in the events leading up to Thomas’ emergence.

* Beat 100 levels carefully designed to test your puzzle-solving skills and uncover the story of the AIs.
* Utilize the unique skills of 12 different characters, each as unique as the AIs themselves.
* Immerse yourself in David Housden’s critically acclaimed procedural score.
* Join Danny Wallace for a BAFTA award winning performance of the story’s narration.
* Includes Director’s Commentary by creator Mike Bithell.
* Includes the “Benjamin’s Flight” additional level pack – join new characters and utilize new abilities in 20 additional levels in a story about hope and the wild impetuosity of youth.

Baki Hanma: Blood Arena — аркадный 2D-фа:
Baki Hanma: Blood Arena — arkadnyy 2D-fayting po motivam mangi i anime «Boets Baki». Serial rasskazyvaet o Baki Khanme, kotoryy raz za razom pytaetsya pobedit svoego zhestokogo ottsa, schitayushchegosya silneyshim boytsom v mire. V marte 2024 goda avtory shou anonsirovali prodolzhenie pod nazvaniem «Put Baki».
Fayting po motivam odnoimyonnogo anime! Igraem my za samogo Baki, kotoryy khochet dokazat, chto on kruche vsekh v mire boevykh iskusstv. Geympley napominaet staryy dobryy Super Punch-Out!! — nuzhno vovremya bit i zashchishchatsya, nikakikh slozhnykh kombinatsiy iz desyati knopok.
Sami boi prokhodyat na raznykh arenakh — ot podvalnykh boytsovskikh klubov do krupnykh stadionov. Vizualno igra staraetsya vosproizvesti stil originalnogo anime. Nu a konechnaya tsel — srazitsya s samym silnym sushchestvom na planete i stat novym «bogom srazheniy».
Главным героем игры является молодой пут:
Glavnym geroem igry yavlyaetsya molodoy puteshestvuyushchiy voin po imeni Adol Kristin. V nachale istorii on tolko chto pribyl v gorod Minea zemli Esteriya po prosbe predskazatelnitsy Sary, kotoraya rasskazyvaet emu o velikom zle, rasprostranyayushchemsya po zemle.
Adol uznayot, chto dolzhen nayti shest knig, v kotorykh napisana istoriya drevney zemli Is. Takim obrazom on smozhet uznat, kakim sposobom mozhno raspravitsya so zlymi silami. Sara vruchaet Adolu kristall dlya opoznaniya i poruchaet nayti eyo tyotyu v derevne Zepik, u kotoroy est klyuch k odnoy iz knig. S etogo momenta puteshestvie nachinaetsya..
Представляем вам живую и дышащую настоль:
Predstavlyaem vam zhivuyu i dyshashchuyu nastolnuyu videoigru. V ney igrok popadaet v miniatyurnuyu vselennuyu, napolnennuyu malenkimi priklyucheniyami, prokhodyashchimi na detalizirovannykh dioramnykh polyakh boya, sozdannykh na osnove skandinavskoy mifologii vo slavu vikingov!

Igra Wartile osnovana na vosstanovlenii khodov, v ney ne prekrashchayutsya deystviya i u vas est mnozhestvo vozmozhnostey planirovat svoi khody. Khotya v igre imeyutsya strategicheskie elementy poshagovykh igr, ee smes zamedlennykh deystviy i vosstanovleniya khodov postoyanno podderzhivayut napryazhenie bitvy i dayut vam vozmozhnost podumat i prinyat takticheskie resheniya. A v tsentre igry Wartile — pravilnoe razmeshchenie i takticheskie resheniya.
Далеко-далеко, в каком-то волшебном царс:
Daleko-daleko, v kakom-to volshebnom tsarstve mag izo vsekh sil pytaetsya sbezhat. Mrachnyy Zhnets na nego. K schastyu dlya nego, neuklyuzhiy zhnets nikuda ne toropitsya. No kak dolgo?

V Running on Magic vy upravlyaete otchayavshimsya magom, preodolevayushchim polosu prepyatstviy, chtoby izbezhat Mrachnogo Zhnetsa. Pereprygivayte cherez sushchestv-kapli, ispolzuya svoi sposobnosti poleta, i vyzhivayte do kontsa v etom platformere-rannere s yarkoy pikselnoy grafikoy i dinamicheski sozdavaemymi urovnyami.

Problemy s pryzhkami. Prolozhite svoy put, pereprygivaya cherez yamy i platformy v igre, kotoraya dolzhna byt dostupna kazhdomu igroku.

Vozdushnoe deystvie. Prygayte, plavayte i topayte, chtoby preodolet vse prepyatstviya. Sobirayte magiyu, razbrosannuyu po vsemu urovnyu, chtoby pitat eti sposobnosti i adaptirovatsya k lyuboy situatsii.

Krasivye peyzazhi v pikselnoy grafike i zapominayushchayasya muzyka. Otkroyte dlya sebya kazhdyy iz 5 tematicheskikh mirov.

Nebolshoy rasskaz s yumoristicheskim ottenkom. Poznakomtes s Mrachnym Zhnetsom, kogda oni pytayutsya ubedit maga poyti s nimi i kazhdyy raz terpyat neudachu.

Vy mozhete nasladitsya legkim i uyutnym priklyucheniem, no esli vy khotite poprobovat sebya...

4 raznykh slozhnosti! Podnyat vyzov!

Kazhdyy rezhim uskorit igru, i vy budete vstrechat menshe pikapov na svoem puti. Vash volshebnik takzhe budet imet menshe khp.

V samom slozhnom rezhime u vas budet tolko odin udar, chtoby zavershit svoe puteshestvie!

Beskonechnyy rezhim, gde skorost budet postoyanno uvelichivatsya! 

Tak ty ubezhish ili protyanesh ruku pomoshchi nashemu magu? Prikhodi i otpravlyaysya v malenkoe volshebnoe priklyuchenie!

Linelight - изящная, минималистская игра:
Linelight - izyashchnaya, minimalistskaya igra-golovolomka, ustanovlennaya vo vselennoy liniy. Ee golovolomki probudyat vash um, kogda muzyka techet cherez vashe telo, pridavaya emu myagkuyu, rasslablyayushchuyu eyforiyu. Linelight prednaznachena dlya igrokov lyubogo vozrasta ili urovnya opyta.

DLYa LYuBOGO IGROKA
Dvizhenie - eto vashe edinstvennoe vzaimodeystvie. Pereigrali li vy sotni igr ili eto vasha pervaya igra, Linelight predostavit vam intuitivnyy i poleznyy opyt.

BOGATOE SODERZhANIE
Proydite cherez 6 mirov i bolee 200 unikalnykh golovolomok, kazhdyy novyy mir napolnen raznoobraziem i glubinoy, lyubopytnaya seriya otkrytiy i syurprizov. Prazdnik zhdet igrokov, ishchushchikh sekrety i bolshie problemy.

MUZYKA POGRUZhENIYa

ISTORIYa POGRUZhENIYa

Vstrechayte Kingdoms of Amalur: Re-Reckoning! Vozvrashchenie rolevoy igry ot pisatelya R. E. Salvatore, stsenarista Todda Makfarleyna («Spaun») i dizaynera Kena Rolstona (Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion). Vas zhdut obnovlennaya grafika, uluchshennyy igrovoy protsess i ogromnyy mir!

You play as Sydney Hunter, an explorer w:
You play as Sydney Hunter, an explorer who gets trapped inside a Maya pyramid while he is out exploring the region of Yucatan.
Sydney soon discovers that Kinich Ahau (the Maya sun god) and Kukulkan (the feathered serpent god) have broken up the sacred Maya Haab calendar into seven separate pieces, has taken four precious idols, and are hiding them throughout the pyramid.
This all comes during the time of Wayab; the five unlucky days of the year. This has caused great chaos, and time to freeze if the Haab calendar isn’t found and put back together in time.
The local Maya now ask Sydney to go out and find all seven pieces of the Haab calendar, reclaim the important idols, defeat the Maya gods, and bring peace and balance back to the Maya civilization.
In doing so restoring time to continue…
Гигантские существа, расплодившиеся под:
Gigantskie sushchestva, rasplodivshiesya pod poverkhnostyu planety, ugrozhayut ostatkam chelovecheskoy tsivilizatsii. Vasha zadacha – otrazit ugrozu, komanduya moguchimi mekhami iz budushchego. V etoy poshagovoy strategii ot sozdateley FTL kazhdaya popytka spasti mir – eto novaya situatsiya, sozdavaemaya sluchaynym obrazom.

Klyuchevye osobennosti:

Zashchishchayte goroda: energiya dlya vashikh mekhov postupaet iz grazhdanskikh zdaniy. Zashchishchayte ikh ot vekkov i ne palite kuda popalo!

Ishchite idealnuyu strategiyu: v minimalistichnom poshagovom boyu vy predvidite vse khody protivnika. Eto pozvolit vam proanalizirovat vrazheskie ataki i nayti optimalnoe reshenie v lyuboy obstanovke.

Postroyte idealnyy mekh: sobirayte novye vidy oruzhiya i unikalnykh pilotov, srazhayas s vekkami na ostrovakh Korporatsii.

Novyy shans: porazhenie – eto ne prigovor. Esli vas razgromyat, vy smozhete otpravit podmogu v proshloe i popytatsya spasti mir zanovo!
Теперь игра про RWBY доступна на Nintend:
Teper igra pro RWBY dostupna na Nintendo Switch™ v polnom obeme – vklyuchaya obnovleniya kontenta i skachivaemye dopolneniya za tri goda, vosem novykh kostyumov i lokalnyy kooperativnyy rezhim "na divane" dlya dvukh igrokov.

RWBY: Grimm Eclipse – rasschitannaya maksimum na chetyrekh igrokov kooperativnaya igra v zhanre hack-and-slash po motivam populyarnogo vo vsem mire seriala "RWBY" ot Rooster Teeth. Prisoedinyaytes k druzyam i igrayte za odnogo iz vosmi kursantov Akademii Bikon, kotorym predstoit ostanovit sily Grimm i doktora Merlo. Prokachivayte lyubimogo personazha RWBY i puteshestvuyte po Remnantu, otkryvaya novye syuzhetnye linii i rezhim "Perchatka Grimm". 

• Soberite nepobedimuyu komandu: obedinyaytes s druzyami, igraya v lokalnom kooperativnom rezhime "na divane" dlya dvukh igrokov ili v rezhime onlayn, rasschitannom maksimum na chetyrekh igrokov.
• Igrayte za svoego lyubimogo personazha: vy mozhete igrat za Rubi, Vayss, Bleyk, Yan i za komandu JNPR, otkryvaya unikalnye sposobnosti i novye vozmozhnosti kazhdogo personazha.
• Vybirayte stil po svoemu vkusu! Khotite oprobovat novye kostyumy 7-go toma? Zhelaete znat, kakovo eto – begat po Remnantu v pizhamakh? Ili predpochitaete novuyu eksklyuzivnuyu silovuyu bronyu? Kakoy by stil vy ni vybrali, v igre naydetsya mnozhestvo naryadov dlya kazhdogo poklonnika RWBY!
• Pogruzites v mir RWBY: otkryvayte eksklyuzivnyy i v to zhe vremya polnostyu sootvetstvuyushchiy kanonu syuzhet, polnostyu ozvuchennyy akterami seriala, s originalnym saundtrekom ot kompozitora RWBY!
• Osvaivayte rezhimy "Perchatka Grimm" i "Orda": dokazhite, chto vy luchshiy Okhotnik, gromya polchishcha vragov i vozvodya oboronitelnye tureli v alternativnykh rezhimakh igry!
Ключевые особенности:\n\nАртефакты:\nДаж:
Klyuchevye osobennosti:

Artefakty:
Dazhe esli ochen khochetsya vzyat artefakt, pomnite: vy potom pozhaleete.

Syuzhetnyy rezhim:
Probeytes cherez polchishcha vragov — i otpravte etikh tvarey tuda, otkuda oni vylezli. Vybirayte rezhim igry: normalnyy, sluchaynyy, ezhednevnyy — ili rezhim zadaniy.

Turnirnyy rezhim:
Na arene v lokalnom mnogopolzovatelskom rezhime mozhno srazitsya s druzyami.

Syuzhetnyy rezhim (sovmestnaya lokalnaya igra):
S druzyami dazhe vragov kromsat interesnee! Osobenno — esli vy delaete eto po syuzhetu.

10 igrovykh personazhey:
Unikalnye sposobnosti kazhdogo personazha delayut igrovoy protsess eshche bolee raznoobraznym.

Mnogie chasy veselya:
Sluchayno generiruemye urovni i vypadayushchie iz poverzhennykh vragov predmety delayut kazhdoe prokhozhdenie nepovtorimym.

Rezhimy igry:

Syuzhetnyy rezhim (1-2 lokalnykh igroka): vzryvnoe priklyuchenie, v kotorom vam predstoit srazitsya s zakhvatchikami v poiskakh istochnika zla. Vas zhdet besprestannyy napor vragov: strelyayte, vzryvayte, beyte molniyami i raspylyayte zlodeev na atomy! Simpatichnyy yarkiy mir so slozhnymi urovnyami tait mnozhestvo syurprizov.

- Normalnyy rezhim: kazhdyy uroven vsegda sozdaetsya zanovo, tak chto ni odna igra ne budet pokhozha na druguyu.

- Sluchaynyy rezhim: igrayte so sluchaynymi igrokami vashego urovnya.

- Ezhednevnyy rezhim: kazhdyy den sostyazaytes s drugimi igrokami na novoy karte.

- Rezhim zadaniy: popytaytes vypolnit samye raznye (vesma izoshchrennye!) zadaniya.

Turnirnyy rezhim (2-4 lokalnykh igroka): Zharkiy boy, kotoryy pokazhet, kto v vashey kompanii samyy surovyy voitel.

- Boy na vybyvanie: kazhdyy sam za sebya. Kto ostanetsya na nogakh, tot i pobedit.

- Rezhim odnoy pushki: vse igroki nachinayut boy s odinakovym (sluchayno vybrannym) oruzhiem, kotoroe nelzya menyat na protyazhenii vsego raunda.

- Rezhim upavshikh serdechek: pri ranenii igroki teryayut serdechki, kotorye zatem mozhet podobrat kto ugodno (dazhe sam ranenyy).

- Rezhim khranitelya cherepa: khvatayte zolotoy cherep i staraytes ne upustit ego v techenie opredelennogo vremeni, chtoby vse vashi protivniki poteryali 1 ochko zdorovya.

- Rezhim okhoty: na nachalo igry vse vooruzheny kopyami. Chtoby sdelat novyy brosok, snachala pridetsya podobrat uzhe broshennoe kope!
Мирная приключенческая игра, посвященная:
Mirnaya priklyuchencheskaya igra, posvyashchennaya issledovaniyu terraformirovannoy Evropy (Yupitera II), shestogo po otdalyonnosti ot planety sputnika Yupitera, naimenshego iz chetyryokh galileevykh sputnikov. Glavnym geroem vystupaet android «Zi». Vizual igry otchyotlivo napominaet stil Studio Ghibli.
Primechatelno to, chto v osnovnom proekt razrabotal odin chelovek — Khelder Pinto, dizayner Overwatch, kotoryy na moment razrabotki rabotaet v Blizzard. Vam predstoit puteshestvovat po planete, polnoy raznykh biomov, zon i tainstvennykh postroek!
Po razmeram Evropa nemnogo ustupaet Lune, sredniy radius sostavlyaet 9/10 lunnogo. Yupiter II sostoit v osnovnom iz silikatnykh porod, a v tsentre soderzhit zheleznoe yadro. Poverkhnost sostoit izo lda i yavlyaetsya odnoy iz samykh gladkikh v Solnechnoy sisteme; na ney ochen malo kraterov, no mnogo treshchin. Veroyatno, okean ne zamerzaet blagodarya prilivnym silam, periodicheskie izmeneniya kotorykh vyzyvayut deformatsiyu sputnika i, kak sledstvie, nagrev ego nedr. Eto zhe sluzhit prichinoy endogennoy geologicheskoy aktivnosti Evropy, napominayushchey tektoniku plit. U sputnika est krayne razrezhyonnaya atmosfera, sostoyashchaya v osnovnom iz kisloroda.
Джесси Салливан – детектив по паранормал:
Dzhessi Sallivan – detektiv po paranormalnym yavleniyam, rabotavshaya na Upravlenie po Borbe s Re.Surs-Anomaliyami (UBRA) goroda Modern-Siti.

Kholodnym vecherom, Detektivu prikhodit soobshchenie ot davnego kollegi Cuperintendanta.
Soobshchaetsya, chto proizoshel neschastnyy sluchay, kotoryy narushil rabotu vazhnogo predpriyatiya po pererabotke Re.Sursa – sovershennogo istochnika energii.

Kak raz imenno eto strannoe proisshestvie i povlechet za soboy obnaruzhenie ochen opasnogo prestupnika, kotoryy khochet posyagnut, v pryamom smysle etogo slova, na shatkiy mir v Modern-Siti i vo vsem Kontinente.

Osobennosti:
◆ Syuzhetnaya igra s boyami v raznykh mestakh, vas zhdet tekhnologichnyy Modern-Siti i laboratorii Bashni Svyazi, piramidy v Sakhara-Siti, a takzhe zabroshennye mesta Endzhoy-Siti – goroda udovolstviy.
◆ Ispolzuyte neskolko vidov oruzhiya dlya srazheniya s armiyami vragov.
◆ Ispolzuyte arsenal i sposobnosti geroev v srazhenii s bossami, kotorye budut vstrechatsya na vashem puti.
◆ Podkhodite k boyu s umom, vovremya zamenyayte geroev i primenyayte ikh super-sposobnosti dlya odoleniya vashikh vragov.
◆ Raskroyte sekrety Re.Sursa – osobogo istochnika temnoy energii i pomeshayte mezhprostranstvennomu vtorzheniyu demonov.

Unikalnye Geroi:
◆ Detektiv Dzhessi imeet navyki dlya bystrogo peremeshcheniya, chto pozvolyaet ey zanimat bolee vygodnye pozitsii, a ee super-sposobnost pozvolyaet unichtozhit neskolko vragov odnovremenno!
◆ Beyzil Bi imeet sposobnosti kontrolya: u vragov net ni edinogo shansa priblizitsya k nemu, a super-sposobnost pozvolyaet primenit etot effekt massovo!
◆ Khelga Goft mozhet legko peremeshchatsya vertikalno, a takzhe ey pomogaet ruchnaya turel-dron v srazhenii, chto delaet ee naibolee tsennym geroem v srazheniyakh protiv bolshogo skopleniya vragov!

Prosnites, Detektiv. Vas snova zhdut.
Good morning and welcome to the Monorail:
Good morning and welcome to the Monorail Transit System connecting the Cities of M and L. This spectacular feat of engineering allows thousands to commute between the Cities each day in the timeliest of mannersEvery day a hundred new stories are born in these cars running on the track suspended above the Bay.
Every day extraordinary things happen to ordinary people.

Silvie and Ahmal, from the City of M and the City of L. Two strangers who unknowingly affect each other's lives through the monorail they share each day.
Commuting between the cities each day at different times, they choose who to talk to on the monorail, how to treat their fellow commuters, and what to do as the monorail makes its run over the Bay. 
Each day is a new chapter in their shared story, one you can write on your own or with a friend, through an asynchronous multiplayer mode.

As Ahmal and Silvie, you'll meet dozens of people during their commute. How they interact with them is up to you.
The choices made on the monorail affect the course of their stories - or rather, the one shared story they inhabit. Every decision and every interaction leads to one of the multiple endings for the traveling pair.
When their story ends, your own can begin. The Season story mode offers you the ability to create an original commuting character and experience the city from another perspective.

As the Monorail Stories unfold, so does the tale of the two cities linked by the track. The two city-states face upheaval and uncertainty, just like the people who pass between them on the monorail each day. Destinies may very well be decided not by what the people do, but by how they treat one another, or rather, how you interact with those around yourself.
Control Ahmal and Silvie in single player, or find a friend to experience a non-linear story through an iconic asynchronous multiplayer mode. Explore each city’s monorail station as you both await for the monorail, each of you immersing in your own interactions and secrets to keep (or share).

Persival ""Persi"" Bilkins - okhotnik za sokrovishchami, kotoromu predstoit nayti mamu i dedushku, tainstvenno propavshikh mnogo let nazad. Tak v chyom problema? Ego korabl poterpel krushenie vo vremya shtorma, i emu nuzhno nayti novyy put. Vmeste s psom Dreytonom, lyubimtsem semi, Persi dolzhen nayti novyy korabl, vossoedinitsya so svoey komandoy i raskryt semeynye tayny, kotorye navsegda izmenyat ego zhizn. I, konechno zhe, nayti sokrovishcha.

Bilkins' Folly - eto syuzhetnaya priklyuchencheskaya igra o malchike i ego sobake. Vmeste so svoim luchshim drugom-psom vy smozhete issledovat kazhdyy ugolok etogo regiona. Persi masterski obrashchaetsya s kartoy, poetomu vy mozhete nastroit eyo tak, chtoby ona pomogala vam reshat golovolomki i raskryvat drugie sekrety. No imeyte v vidu: nekotorye golovolomki v etom mire slozhnee drugikh, i, vozmozhno, vam pridetsya vernutsya k nim pozzhe.

Druzhba s Dreytonom stanet vashim glavnym preimushchestvom v puteshestvii po miru igry Bilkins' Folly. Provodya vremya vmeste, vy smozhete luchshe ponimat drug druga i zarabatyvat ochki. Ikh mozhno potratit na novye navyki, kotorye pomogut preodolet prepyatstviya. Razyshchite semyu, naydite bogatstva i posetite ne vidannye ranee mesta.

Na dvore 5000-y god, i vse velikie dostizheniya chelovechestva zabyty. Piramidy, Mona Liza — zabyto vse.

Zabyto vsemi, krome Anri Dizhona i ego raznosherstnoy komandy arkheologov. Oni uletayut s Marsa na dikuyu i negostepriimnuyu planetu Zemlya. I vse u nikh tam idet khorosho, poka professora Anri ne pokhishchayut, a vokrug nachinayut proiskhodit... strannye veshchi.

Prisoedinites k Anri v etom bezbashennom priklyuchenii na ruinakh nashey tsivilizatsii. Otvechayte na voprosy tipa: "Kto takoy byl etot Soni Volkman i vystupal li on v tsirke?". Raskopayte neobychaynye relikvii, spasite professora Totelya i pervymi popadite v legendarnyy gorod Mutropolis.
A, i vot eshche chto: bogi Drevnego Egipta na samom dele sushchestvuyut i pytayutsya unichtozhit chelovechestvo. Udachki!

Welcome to Elk is a biographical adventu:
Welcome to Elk is a biographical adventure set on an island like no other, where every character you encounter has a story to tell. From the weird and wonderful to the dark and desperate, all the tales told on Elk are based on true stories of life on the road less traveled.

Tales of real stories
Welcome to Elk, an adventure game set on a fictional island stitched together with true stories and tall tales, and inhabited by the people who lived them.

Story
You play as Frigg, a young carpenter trading their busy life in the city for an apprenticeship in a small town. When she arrives in Elk, Frigg worries that the slower pace of life will be boring (they don’t even have the internet), but quickly discovers nothing could be further from the truth!

Tragic stories told with love and sometimes humour
The stories reflect the drama of our lives, on Elk it’s known that humour, love and death go hand in hand. Life may seem hard sometimes, but it is always followed by laughter.

Make new friends
On Elk, you will meet weird and wonderful characters - people whom the world has either ignored or forgotten. Follow their ups and downs, their odd drinking rituals and their unique ways of tackling whatever life throws at them.

Unique mini games 
Help your new friends on Elk through playful mini games. All games are uniquely tailored to underline the story and the mood of the game.

Meet the people who told the original stories
We value the importance of storytellers, those who carry the tales of others and share them. That's why, in Elk, you will also meet the living storytellers who inspired us to make this game.

How we used true stories in the game?
True stories? how to use a true story in an ethical way? This is how we have dealt with it in Welcome to Elk:
The stories in Welcome to Elk, are told by the people who we know and/or were there when the events took place. All are told from memory. The way they are used both on our webpage and in the game is true to the core story but everything like names, locations and other details are changed, renamed and often re-framed to protect the real people behind them, therefore, we call them tall tales. The stories are not one to one like you would experience in true crime for example. They are rewritten and combined to one linear narrative. Characters may play a role in one story where they where not a part of originally and only us who designed it will ever know – or come close to the real truth of the stories.

Welcome to Elk might look like a “fun” game but it’s about telling stories – some are filled with humour others are dark, but they go hand in hand.

Olimpiyskie igry vozvrashchayutsya – eto vash shans vzoyti na pedestal! Igrayte s druzyami i rodnymi ili srazhaytes za zoloto na mirovom urovne – eta igra dlya vecherinok podoydet dlya vsekh! 

Razbudite v sebe dukh sopernichestva, sozdayte svoikh atletov, vybirayte ikh navyki podbirayte odezhdu. Zachem ogranichivatsya skuchnoy sportivnoy formoy, esli mozhno vydelitsya kostyumom pirata, kosmonavta ili kovboya?

Vybirayte iz 18 uvlekatelnykh sportivnykh sorevnovaniy: vas zhdut tennis, futbol, beg na 100 m, basketbol, boks i mnogoe drugoe. Pobit novyy rekord nikogda ne pozdno!

Borba za zoloto eshche ne byla takoy zakhvatyvayushchey!
Следите за историей Фредди, и вы погрузи:
Sledite za istoriey Freddi, i vy pogruzites s golovoy v istoriyu ispytaniy i prepyatstviy. Sozdannyy v laboratorii blistatelnogo doktora P. Starra, Freddi popadaet v neobychnoe priklyuchenie.

Freddi ispolzuet dvizheniya veryovki dlya imitatsii gibkogo, elastichnogo, verevochnogo personazha. Khodba, beg, pryzhok, skolzhenie, shlepok, sokrushenie, udar, uklonenie i polnyy proval – vot vash put k tseli. Preodolevayte slozhnye usloviya, stante masterom svoikh spagetti!

Osnovnye momenty
* Vesele i prostota upravleniya
* Dvizheniya povsyudu
* Unikalnye urovni
* Veselaya i zakhvatyvayushchaya istoriya
* Professionalnoe povestvovanie
* Mnogo individualnosti
Найти свое место – не так-то просто \nНо:
Nayti svoe mesto – ne tak-to prosto 
No chto esli eto mesto – ne tolko tvoe? I kak byt, esli ni odin iz vas ne khochet ustupat? 
Bolshaya Medveditsa - eto romanticheskaya istoriya o tom, kak dva cheloveka vstretilis v kanun Novogo Goda pri ne samykh obychnykh obstoyatelstvakh. 

Glavnye personazhi

Andrey 
Iz-za semeynykh problem Andreyu prishlos rano povzroslet i pokinut otchiy dom. Sudba zakinula ego daleko na sever, gde ot kholodnoy i golodnoy smerti ego spas staryy mebelshchik. Obuchivshis u nego remeslu, Andrey bystro voshel v rabochuyu koleyu i spustya gody upornogo truda priobrel dom v lesnoy glushi. Glavnyy urok on usvoil krepko-nakrepko: zhizn bez kryshi nad golovoy – ne zhizn vovse. 

Yulya
Vse detstvo Yulya provela s dedushkoy. Roditeli godami propadali v komandirovkakh, a devochka rosla, zasypaya u kamina pod zavyvaniya vetra i postukivanie dedovskikh instrumentov. Kogda Yule ispolnilos dvenadtsat, roditeli uvezli ee za tysyachi kilometrov, no ona znala, chto obyazatelno vernetsya domoy, kogda pridet vremya.

Osobennosti
-Prodolzhitelnost 2-4 chasa
-Novella dostupna na russkom i angliyskom
-10+ CG
-Zhivopisnaya, neobychnaya khudozhestvennaya chast v vysokom razreshenii
-Chudesnaya istoriya o lyubvi, sudbe i resheniyakh, vedushchikh nas po zhizni.
И вообще, мы постарались максимально точ: I voobshche, my postaralis maksimalno tochno peredat realnye tseny na realnye komplektuyushchie. Davayte, samoe vremya ispolzovat poluchennuyu v igre informatsiyu i sobrat sebe zver-kompukter, a potom eshche i zamerit benchmark!
Юная Елена Элкхорн отправляется на поиск:
Yunaya Elena Elkkhorn otpravlyaetsya na poiski propavshego ottsa v osobnyak semeystva Uillous, gde eyo zhdyot mnozhestvo tayn. V puti ey pomogaet papin podarok: amulet, kotoryy pozvolyaet eyo dukhu vykhodit iz tela i obshchatsya s dukhami umershikh. Igrayte v roli Eleny i pomogite ey otyskat ottsa! Reshayte golovolomki i zagadki osobnyaka, vykhodya v astral, pomogayte zabludivshimsya dusham... I eto daleko ne vsyo, chto vy naydyote v igre Whispering Willows.

Osobennosti
• Funktsiya vibratsii HD — pochuvstvuyte prisutstvie prizrakov cherez amulet Eleny s unikalnymi vibratsiyami druzhestvennykh i agressivnykh dukhov.
• Pogruzhenie v neveroyatno krasivyy, s lyubovyu narisovannyy 2D-mir osobnyaka i sada vokrug nego.
• Zavorazhivayushchaya muzyka i zvukovye effekty, ot kotorykh murashki begut po kozhe. 
• Polnaya neozhidannykh povorotov i predatelstv istoriya semeystva Uillous. 
• Zagadki starinnogo osobnyaka, kotorye vam predstoit otgadat, chtoby nayti svoego ischeznuvshego papu.
Игра создана скейтером для скейтеров — T:
Igra sozdana skeyterom dlya skeyterov — The Ramp udivit vas uvlekatelnym igrovym protsessom, a eshche tryukami, kotorye legko vyuchit, no ochen trudno dovesti do sovershenstva.
 
Nikakikh kvestov, sorevnovaniy i dostizheniy — tolko vy i vasha doska: zdes u vas budet i graynd, i flip, i katanie v khafpaype bez lishnikh zabot.
Аркадия – легендарный рыцарь, сражавшаяс:
Arkadiya – legendarnyy rytsar, srazhavshayasya v beschislennykh bitvakh v isterzannykh voynoy zemlyakh Talii. Svoim mechom ona srazila sotni vragov Talii… No est odna legenda ob Arkadii, o kotoroy nikto ne govorit.

Bolee desyatiletiya nazad rogatyy drakon napal na derevnyu Freykross. On spalil vsyu derevnyu dotla, i pochti vse ee zhiteli sginuli.

Vozmozhno, Arkadiya i geroy, no te, kto perezhil napadenie na derevnyu Freykross, negoduyut v ee adres. Oni nenavidyat ee.

Oni dazhe zhelayut ey smerti.

Kharakteristiki
* Prisoedinites k Arkadii v etoy dinamichnoy vizualnoy novelle
* Perezhivite volnuyushchuyu fenteziynuyu istoriyu
* Igra dostupna na angliyskom, ispanskom, nemetskom, yaponskom i kitayskom yazykakh
* Prekrasnaya grafika illyustriruet vsyu istoriyu
Погрузитесь в постапокалиптический мир,:
Pogruzites v postapokalipticheskiy mir, gde misticheskoe sushchestvo udarilo po vsemu chelovechestvu. V ScourgeBringer vy — Kyhra, samaya besposhchadnaya voitelnitsa klana. Pomogite ey izuchit neizvestnoe i prolozhit put cherez antichnye mashiny, okhranyayushchie pechat ee proshlogo, a vozmozhno, i spasti chelovechestvo.

- Vas zhdet dinamichnyy platformer-rogalik, «smes Dead Cells i Celeste», po slovam izdaniya Eurogamer.
- Prokladyvayte sebe put s pomoshchyu superplavnogo upravleniya.
- Ottachivayte svoi navyki s fantasticheskoy boevoy sistemoy, napravlennoy tolko na ataki.
- Brosaytes vpered na paranormalnye adaptivnye zvuki Joonas Turner (Nuclear Throne, Downwell, Broforce...).
- Brosayte vyzovy ordam bezmolvnykh vragov i gigantam-bossam, khranyashchim sekrety Scourge.
- Izuchayte beskonechnye glubiny postoyanno menyayushchikhsya temnits.
- Raskryvayte tayny i nakhodite napominaniya o predydushchikh issledovatelyakh, chtoby razblokirovat sekrety, opredelyayushchie realnost.
Оживите свое королевство с помощью фишек:
Ozhivite svoe korolevstvo s pomoshchyu fishek, kvadratov i takticheskikh resheniy!

Populyarneyshaya nastolnaya igra vykhodit na Nintendo Switch™!

Peremeshchayte i vykladyvayte kvadraty, chtoby sozdavat goroda, dorogi, monastyri i polya. Formiruyte razrastayushchiysya landshaft i razmeshchayte fishki v vygodnykh mestakh. Eti fishki stanut rytsaryami, razboynikami ili krestyanami i smogut perekhvatyvat kontrol nad luchshimi gorodami i dorogami.
Budte vnimatelny — vam potrebuyutsya smekalka i takticheskie navyki, chtoby poluchit maksimum ochkov! Sryvayte plany sopernikov, zashchishchaya svoi sobstvennye interesy. 

Versiya Carcassonne dlya Nintendo Switch soderzhit poslednie obnovleniya i uluchsheniya, a takzhe dva dopolneniya s novymi fishkami, kvadratami i pravilami:
• Dopolnenie The River
• Dopolnenie The Abbot

Eti dopolneniya mozhno sovmeshchat s drugimi, chtoby dobavit v igru eshche bolshe raznoobraziya!

Osobennosti:
Polnaya tsifrovaya versiya Carcassonne soderzhit vazhnye uluchsheniya, naprimer spisok ostavshikhsya kvadratov.
Prostoy igrovoy protsess i taktika igry, legkaya dlya ponimaniya, pozvolyayut igrat v Carcassonne vsey semey.
Sorevnovatsya mogut do 6 igrokov — kak po seti, tak i na odnom ustroystve.
Zapuskayte lyubimuyu nastolnuyu igru na Nintendo Switch v nastolnom rezhime ili v rezhime TV.
Vklyuchite trekhmernoe otobrazhenie landshafta ili rassmatrivayte ego sverkhu, chtoby vybrat optimalnuyu strategiyu.
Новая полировка — в версии для западных:
Novaya polirovka — v versii dlya zapadnykh igrokov teper mozhno vybirat iz 7 igrovykh personazhey, kazhdyy s unikalnymi atakami, oruzhiem i sposobnostyami!

Upravlenie chetyrmya sferami — vladenie Lunagear pozvolyaet igrokam kombinirovat dve iz chetyrekh elementarnykh sfer (ogon, voda, veter, zemlya), chtoby reshat golovolomki, manipulirovat okruzheniem i vzryvat lyubogo protivnika.

Bazovye preimushchestva — sozdayte svoyu bazu i pobedite! Sobirayte otryady voysk, pokupayte snaryazhenie i sozdavayte obekty dlya usileniya atak i izucheniya novykh sposobnostey.

Predmety i obmen — ishchite spryatannye povsyudu sokrovishcha. Naydennye predmety pomogut ekipirovat i ukrepit svoyu gruppu. Obmenivayte materialy na eshche bolee moshchnoe oruzhie!
Возьмите под контроль самых безумных мул:
Vozmite pod kontrol samykh bezumnykh multyashnykh voditeley i pobedite svoikh druzey, ispolzuya unikalnoe oruzhie na arenakh, polnykh opasnostey i priklyucheniy!

Cel Damage HD — eto lokalnaya multipolzovatelskaya igra, poetomu zovite druzey ili rodnykh, ustraivaytes poudobnee na divane i poluchayte udovolstvie.
Treniruytes v rezhime odinochnoy igry, chtoby pobedit v sorevnovanii.

* Odinochnaya igra / 2–4 igroka s razdelennym ekranom.
* Bolee 30 vidov multyashnogo oruzhiya, naprimer gigantskiy molotok, dinamit i umenshayushchiy luch.
* 10 unikalnykh personazhey i avtomobiley s razlichnymi khodovymi kharakteristikami.
* 13 razlichnykh mest deystviya: ot Dikogo Zapada s gorodom privideniy do lunnogo kratera.
* 3 rezhima igry: gonki, vse protiv vsekh, zakhvat flaga
* More udovolstviya (Ostorozhno!!!)
Songbringer – это научно-фантастический:
Songbringer – eto nauchno-fantasticheskiy ekshen s elementami RPG s mechami, zagadkami, podzemelyami, bossami i mnogim drugim.

Vy igraete za Roka Epimeteos, stavshego geroem po nevole. On – lyubitel vecherinok i muzykant, borozdyashchiy prostory galaktiki vmeste s robotom po imeni Dzhib na bortu korablya Songbringer v poiskakh zelenykh planet, do kotorykh eshche ne dobralas galakticheskaya politsiya.

Kogda Rok nashel nanomech, spryatannyy v peshchere na Ekzerre, on sluchayno probudil drevnee zlo..

• Vvedite 6-bukvennoe znachenie dlya protsedurnoy generatsii vashego mira. Podelites vashim mirom s druzyami ili sozdayte sovershennoy novyy, chtoby udivit sebya.
• Issleduyte 10 podzemeliy v kazhdom mire, gde vas zhdut golovolomki, kvesty i bossy.
• Nakhodite uteryannye artefakty, kotorye pomogut v vashikh priklyucheniyakh, i obedinyayte ikh vmeste, chtoby sozdavat novoe oruzhie.
• Eshte kaktusy i meditiruyte, chtoby poluchit osobye vozmozhnosti i raskryt sekrety.
You start on your own inherited piece of:
You start on your own inherited piece of land. Work as a craftsman to clean, repair, build and decorate medieval, renaissance and baroque buildings and castles. Visit beautiful locations, breathe new life into old rooms and as you know - hard work pays off - so maybe one day you will become the King?

Explore new locations
Do you want to see what the castle chambers look like in different locations? By completing quests you will have the opportunity to visit many beautiful lands where in addition to castles you will have the opportunity to clean, clean, build, renovate, repair and decorate sheds, barns, huts, houses, mansions, palaces and even pirate ships!

Become a designer!
Design the surroundings of the castle. Choose and plant trees in the courtyard, place animals in the crofts. Choose the shapes and designs of flags and pennants.

Destroy the walls!
Don't like what you've already managed to build? Don't worry! Destroy the walls and start over!

Manage reconstruction!
It takes a lot of effort to rebuild a conquered castle. Repair shattered walls, bridges or towers. You will have to put a lot of work into the reconstruction of the conquered castle.

The game takes place at the turn of the 16th and 17th centuries, so in addition to the usual Medieval buildings, you will also find some Baroque and Renaissance elements that add variety to the gameplay and give you more options for interior decoration.
Вирус-мутант вторгся в его ядро и угрожа:
Virus-mutant vtorgsya v ego yadro i ugrozhaet unichtozhit ego. Vam reshat, srazitsya s etimi volnami virusov i zashchitit yadro kiberprostranstva takim obrazom, chtoby ni odin iz nikh ne dostig ego. No ne nuzhno bespokoitsya — u vas budet beschislennoe kolichestvo uluchsheniy i dron-ubiytsa s razdvoeniem lichnosti, kotoryy (bolee ili menee) pomozhet vam! Dumaete, u vas est vse neobkhodimoe dlya spaseniya kiberprostranstva?
Nash proekt beret klassicheskiy opyt zashchity bashni i sochetaet ego s elementami roguelite, sozdavaya zakhvatyvayushchuyu smes. S kazhdym povysheniem urovnya vy budete otkryvat novye uluchsheniya i poluchat dostup k dopolnitelnym vozmozhnostyam dlya nastroyki zashchity v sootvetstvii s vashim sobstvennym unikalnym stilem. Khotya izuchit prostuyu mekhaniku igry neslozhno, vam nuzhno budet pridumat slozhnuyu strategiyu, esli vy khotite dostich rekordnoy territorii. Vy budete razvlekatsya v techenie bolshogo kolichestva vremeni v poiskakh luchshikh uluchsheniy i taktiki, i vy poluchite somnitelnuyu podderzhku ot vyshedshego na pensiyu bespilotnika-ubiytsy s dvumya derzkimi lichnostyami.
Отправляйтесь в эпическое ранскейт-путеш:
Otpravlyaytes v epicheskoe ranskeyt-puteshestvie — ot polnogo novichka do Legendarnogo Skeytera!
Probiraytes cherez vrazheskuyu territoriyu bomzhey, pobezhdaya ikh odnogo za drugim. No budte ostorozhny — vragi igrayut nechestno! Chtoby podnyatsya na vershinu, vam nuzhno budet osvoitsya v okruzhayushchey srede, perekhitrit sopernikov i s bleskom pronestis po slozhnym, mnogourovnevym lokatsiyam v stile 90-kh i 80-kh godov XX veka.
«Skate Bums» sochetaet v sebe bystruyu, vyrazitelnuyu 2D ranner-arkadu s oldskulnym koloritom, vsyo eto v yarkom art-stile. Gotovy li vy dokazat, chto kazhdyy bomzh mozhet prolozhit sebe put k velichiyu — na skeytborde?..
Качественный фанатский неофициальный рем:
Kachestvennyy fanatskiy neofitsialnyy remaster-vozrozhdenie 4-kh originalnykh igr serii «Super Mario Bros» iz Nintendo Entertainment System!.. Tut budut: prezhnie i novye urovni, raznoobraznye rezhimy, achivki, drugie personazhi plyus sistema sozdaniya sobstvennykh urovney.
Igrok, upravlyaya Mario ili ego bratom Luidzhi, issleduet Gribnoe korolevstvo i spasaet printsessu Toudstul (Pich) ot Korolya Kupy (pozdnee poluchivshego imya Bouzer).
Super Mario Bros.: The Lost Levels — videoigra v zhanre platformera, razrabotannaya i izdannaya Nintendo. Yaponskaya versiya igry vyshla pod nazvaniem Super Mario Bros. 2 (yap. スーパーマリオブラザーズ2 Su:pa: Mario Bradza:su tsu:) ili Super Mario Bros. 2: For Super Players na platforme Family Computer Disk System 3 iyunya 1986 goda. Igra yavlyaetsya pryamym prodolzheniem bestsellera Super Mario Bros. Razrabotchiki ukazali, chto iznachalno prodolzhenie igry dolzhno bylo byt drugim: sushchestvoval prototip igry, kotoryy pozdnee byl vypushchen v Yaponii v neskolko nezavershyonnom vide pod nazvaniem Doki Doki Panic. Iz-za vysokoy slozhnosti a takzhe skhodstva eyo s predshestvennikom, amerikanskoe podrazdelenie Nintendo vmesto vypuska eyo kak prodolzheniya Super Mario Bros. nanyalo yaponskikh razrabotchikov dlya zaversheniya iskhodnogo prototipa Mario 2.
Two adorable bouncing blobs are lost far:
Two adorable bouncing blobs are lost far from home, and only teamwork, communication and a whole lot of hilarious mistakes will guide them back. Sitting side-by-side on the couch, you and a friend will glide, bounce, squish and swing your way through a vibrant cartoon landscape, solving puzzles, avoiding danger and uncovering hidden secrets.

PURE CO-OP GOODNESS
Putty Pals isn’t just a single-player game that two people can play together. It’s been designed from the ground up to be a cooperative two-player experience.
- Color-based puzzles mean both players have important jobs to do
- Flatten yourself into a trampoline to bounce your friend to new heights
- Communication is key: you won’t get anywhere if you don’t talk to each other

A WHIMSICAL WORLD!
You know what Putty Pals isn’t? BROWN! Play as colorful characters in a colorful world and enjoy a fun, feel-good experience that will leave you smiling.
- Featuring cute characters with adorable animations
- Hilarious character voices that will make you giggle
- Explore locations from explosive Mt Puttuvius to frozen Puttarctica

SO MUCH TO EXPLORE
Share hours of fun with your co-op buddy as you bounce your way through a bonanza of challenges and collectibles.
- 28 full-sized levels, plus 25 unlockable bonus mini-levels for extra challenge
- Cunningly hidden secrets and taxing time trials will keep you coming back for more
Масштабный ролевой экшн-боевик от мастер:
Masshtabnyy rolevoy ekshn-boevik ot masterov zhanra — nastoyashchey yaponskoy studii Nihon Falcom! Kogda shkolniku Kou Tokisake prikhoditsya stolknutsya s koshmarnym mirom pod nazvaniem «Zatmenie», ego zhizn menyaetsya navsegda. Poslednyaya versiya igry Tokyo Xanadu s novymi stsenariyami, igrovymi personazhami, modifikatsiyami i mnogim drugim teper idet s chastotoy 60 kadrov v sekundu!
Obychnyy 17-letniy starsheklassnik, Kou Tokisaka sluchayno stalkivaetsya s tsarstvom koshmarov, izvestnym kak Zatmenie, i ego mir menyaetsya navsegda. Vas zatyagivaet vodovorot, unosyashchiy v koshmarno-prekrasnoe tsarstvo. Kou vnezapno obnaruzhivaet, chto umeet vladet mechom, kotoryy siyaet tak zhe yarko, kak samo adskoe plamya...
V to zhe vremya, Aska Khiiragi, starosta klassa, tolko chto perevelas obratno v shkolu v aprele. Privlekatelnaya i zhizneradostnaya devushka imeet svoi tayny i kakim to obrazom svyazana s Zatmeniem...
Все начинается, когда Венди решает устро:
Vse nachinaetsya, kogda Vendi reshaet ustroit doma novogodnyuyu vecherinku dlya druzey. No prezhde chem ona uspevaet sprosit razresheniya u roditeley, ee nevynosimaya mladshaya sestra Morin kradet ee ideyu i sprashivaet pervoy! K sozhaleniyu, roditeli razreshayut tolko odnu vecherinku...

Morin i Vendi nachinayut bezumnye sostyazaniya, chtoby reshit, komu iz nikh ustraivat prazdnik. Sestra protiv sestry — eto garantiya nepriyatnostey! 

Otpravtes v mir sestrenok Sisters, u kotorykh nikogda ne zakanchivayutsya idei dlya shalostey! 

Issleduyte gorod Sisters, vypolnyayte zadaniya i prokhodite ispytaniya v rezhime priklyucheniy.

Veselites vmeste s semey i druzyami v odnom iz chetyrekh rezhimov dlya neskolkikh igrokov:
– Sostyazanie: sygrayte s druzyami v lyubuyu mini-igru po vyboru!
– Turnir: poprobuyte vyigrat turnir, oderzhav pobedu v kazhdom raunde!
– Vse ili nichego: sygrayte vo vse mini-igry podryad!
–Vokrug sveta: po ocheredi vybirayte lyubimuyu mini-igru!

U nas est 24 bezumnye mini-igry, poyavivshiesya na svet pryamo iz voobrazheniya sestrenok Sisters, — naprimer, «Brosok edinoroga», «Fabrika keksov» i «Ekstremalnyy ping-pong».
Вдохновлённая вестернами роуд-муви игра,:
Vdokhnovlyonnaya vesternami roud-muvi igra, deystvie kotoroy razvorachivaetsya v postapokalipticheskom krayu. Eto istoriya ob ugnetyonnom zakhvatchikami plemeni i ob istorii materi, baykera, voitelnitsy i koyota, kotoraya stanovitsya na beskonechnyy put mesti, chtoby vernut to, chto poteryal eyo narod.
Osedlayte svoego vernogo zheleznogo konya, prygayte, likhachte i srazhaytes s mnogochislennymi vragami v ogromnom prorisovannom vruchnuyu mire. Gonyayte po Pustoshi, vypolnyayte opasnye pryzhki, strelyayte vo vragov v zamedlennom rezhime i perezaryazhayte oruzhie, delaya salto nazad! Ispolzuyte usileniya na osnove navykov i beytes s bolshimi zlymi bossami!
Concordia — стратегическая настольная иг:
Concordia — strategicheskaya nastolnaya igra, gde igroki berut na sebya roli mogushchestvennykh rimskikh torgovtsev i sledyat za rasshireniem imperii s ikh torgovymi putyami i proizvodstvennymi predpriyatiyami!
Postroyte velichayshuyu torgovuyu imperiyu Drevnego Rima! Tochnaya adaptatsiya strategicheskoy nastolnoy igry, voshedshey v 20 luchshie iz luchshikh. Planiruyte i prinimayte vazhnye resheniya kazhdyy khod. Vsegda budte gotovy poyti na kompromiss — ved vashi deystviya mogut prinesti polzu ne tolko vam, no i drugim igrokam.
1936 год. Влияние нацистов растет, и все:

Welcome to Staxel, a quaint island full:
Welcome to Staxel, a quaint island full of charming characters, with bugs and fish to catch, fossils to excavate and quests to complete! Settle into your new home on the farm, fix it up, fill it with crops and animals, then change it up across the seasons of the year. When you’re not farming, take up a range of hobbies to earn some extra cash, or spend some time befriending the locals!

Nurture Your Farm
Put down roots in Staxel as you settle into your new life. It’s your job to fix up, improve and maintain your homestead. Work the fields, tend to your crops, and adopt a variety of adorable animals such as cows, sheep, cats, and dogs! Make sure to adapt with the changing seasons so you can enjoy the fruits (and vegetables!) of your labour all year round!

Make The World Your Own
With an extensive supply of resources available and a tool catered to every job, you’re tasked with handling all construction in the Staxel world, from your own farm to your neighbours’ houses, the general store and even the town hall!. Will you grow the village while keeping it’s rustic charm, or take it in an entirely new direction? Perhaps you’d rather focus on your own projects? It’s all up to you, and your creativity is just the tool for the job!

Two Ways To Play
In Staxel, there are two options to tailor your gameplay! You can start from scratch and work your way up, earning money and growing your town as your farm expands or you can start out in Creative Mode, in which money and resources are no object! Build, destroy and expand all you like, without worry.

Experience Village Life
The local village is inhabited by all sorts of characters and there are plenty of fun activities to get involved in! You could be making new friends, taking up new hobbies, hitting the shops, finishing one of many collections or just catching up on the latest news with your neighbours. Village life is rich and rewarding, there's nothing quite like it!

Festivals
Changing weather isn’t the only thing that the seasons bring. Take part in yearly festivals that transform the town. Collect new items, help out the locals, and have some fun!

Make Friends, Become Roomies
Advance your friendship with the villagers through hand-crafted quests that unlock new items, crafting, and town amenities! Learn about each villager’s likes and dislikes and help them with day-to-day problems, and eventually one of them could become your roomie!

Explore Far-Off Lands
By befriending villagers, you’ll visit far-off islands across the ocean, with new resources to collect, crops to grow, animals to raise and friends to make! Or check out the portals that frequent the festival grounds. These allow you to visit special resource islands that reset every season, allowing you to gather resources without needing to dig up your village!

Breathedge – eto ironichnaya priklyuchencheskaya igra pro vyzhivanie v otkrytom kosmose. Vam predstoit primerit na sebya rol prostogo parnya, kotoryy vsego-to vyoz dedushkiny ostanki na kosmicheskie pokhorony, a okazalsya v vodovorote mezhgalakticheskogo zagovora.

- Dobro pozhalovat v kosmos.

Gigantskiy kosmicheskiy katafalk terpit krushenie v glubokom kosmose, razbrasyvaya po vsey okruge svoi oblomki, groby, mertvykh passazhirov i vas. 

- Sozdavayte nenuzhnoe barakhlo.

Drevnie lyudi razvivalis tak dolgo lish potomu, chto u nikh ne bylo siney izolenty. U vas zhe ona est. S pomoshchyu etoy volshebnoy sily, primotannoy k razlichnym resursam, vy smozhete sozdat lyuboy bespoleznyy predmet i vybrosit ego pryamo v shlyuzy! Vy takzhe mozhete sozdat mnozhestvo poleznykh predmetov, no eto mozhet privesti k prokhozhdeniyu igry.

- Stroyte i delayte remont.

Kogda edinstvennye vashi sosedi bestselno boltayutsya v vakuume, izobrazhaya trupy – vy mozhete smelo poshumet drelyu. Sozdayte unikalnuyu kosmicheskuyu stantsiyu, obespechte ee kislorodom, elektroenergiey, ustanovite vsevozmozhnoe oborudovanie ot solnechnykh paneley do khomyakovoy fermy i zabeyte vsyo eto mebelyu vperemeshku s musorom, vossozdav uyutnuyu atmosferu kholostyatskogo zhilishcha.

- Bip-Bip!

Da da, vy ne oslyshalis, eto byl signal vashego lichnogo avtomobilya! Pomimo mashiny vy smozhete sobrat nebolshuyu raketu, prokatitsya na mertvetse ili postroit bolshoy kosmicheskiy chelnok. Lyuboy vid transporta pomozhet vam bystree peredvigatsya, preodolevat prepyatstviya i uvidet ekran smerti pri lobovom stolknovenii.

- Prolog, epilog i drugie neponyatnye slova.

Vyzhivat v kosmose veselo, a vyzhivat s syuzhetom eshche veselee, ved ego mozhno ne prokhodit nazlo stsenaristam! V Breathedge vas zhdet zanimatelnaya istoriya, chernyy yumor, tsinichnye dialogi, bessmertnaya kuritsa, bezumnyy vrag, zastavki s plokhoy animatsiey i drugie atributy otlichnoy igry.
Steamburg — лавроносный квест-головоломк:
Steamburg — lavronosnyy kvest-golovolomka s unikalnym igrovym protsessom i syuzhetnoy liniey, privyazannoy k poisku predmetov. Razrabotchik igry — kompaniya Telehorse, rabotayushchaya nad sozdaniem igr v zhanre stimpanka. V marte 2017 goda na Mezhdunarodnom konkurse v oblasti mobilnykh igr (IMGA) v San-Frantsisko Steamburg byla priznana samoy ozhidaemoy igroy.

Glavnyy geroy, professor Vinsent Mur, srazhaetsya s robotami, zakhvativshimi gorod Stimburg. Igrovoy protsess mozhno nazvat unikalnym, ved Vinsent bezoruzhen i dolzhen tshchatelno produmyvat kazhdyy svoy shag. V ego arsenale — lish malenkie elektrobomby, kotorye primanivayut i nenadolgo zamedlyayut robotov. Vinsent dolzhen peredvigatsya po ulitsam takim obrazom, chtoby zamanit robotov v lovushku — transformator Tesla, kotoryy sposoben ikh unichtozhit. Postepenno igra uslozhnyaetsya: Vinsentu protivostoyat neskolko robotov srazu, pri etom oni stanovyatsya vse bolee bystrymi, a nekotorye iz nikh umeyut letat i reagiruyut na kazhdoe dvizhenie geroya.

Otdelnogo vnimaniya zasluzhivaet sposob podachi syuzheta. V 2016 godu na mezhdunarodnoy biznes-konferentsii White Nights v Khelsinki Steamburg udostoilas nagrady za luchshuyu tekhniku povestvovaniya. Iz dialogov igrok uznayot o tom, chto Vinsent — eto uchenyy, kotoromu poruchili provesti ispytanie novogo oruzhiya v Stimburge. Krome togo, on zanyat poiskami svoey nevesty, kotoraya, predpolozhitelno, byla v gorode, kogda ego atakovali roboty. Nekotorye elementy syuzheta neposredstvenno svyazany s igrovym protsessom. Igrok takzhe mozhet sobirat pisma i fotografii, kotorye rasskazhut ob istorii lyubvi Vinsenta i ego nevesty.


Osobennosti:

• Unikalnyy, zakhvatyvayushchiy igrovoy protsess.
• 32 urovnya, oformlennykh v stile stimpanka.
• Neskolko potaynykh mest i sotni predmetov, raskryvayushchikh syuzhet igry.
• Ozvuchivanie s uchastiem znamenitykh amerikanskikh i britanskikh akterov, v tom chisle Bryusa Glovera (ozvuchival filmy «Brillianty — navsegda» i «Kitayskiy kvartal»).
• Muzyka iz originalnogo alboma Silver Rocket.

A znaete, kto stoit za etoy armiey golodnoy nezhiti? VY! Rasprostranyayte epidemiyu, stirayte chelovechestvo s litsa zemli. Edinstvennyy sposob vyzhit v zombi-apokalipsise - VOZGLAVIT ego!

Chtoby preuspet v zavoevanii mirovogo gospodstva, vam nuzhno budet pomoch im polakomitsya chelovechinkoy. No budte ostorozhny! Lyudi ne stanut teper vashi temnye zamysly, oni budut srazhatsya.
 
Seyte uzhas na 50 urovnyakh, sobirayte zombi v svoyu lichnuyu armiyu nezhiti. Krov, slezy, neseksualnye stony, neumestnyy smekh i kucha golovolomok, ot kotorykh mozhno i v samom dele slomat golovu - eto Zombie Night Terror!

Igrovye vozmozhnosti

Unikalnaya sistema mutatsiy. Imet lichnuyu armiyu zhutkikh zombi - eto zamechatelno. Imet armiyu zombi-mutantov - eshche luchshe! Vospolzuytes nashey sistemoy mutatsiy, chtoby odolevat oboronu vraga, sozdavaya novye vidy zombi. U kazhdogo vida zombi svoi unikalnye vozmozhnosti i silnye storony, kotorye polezny v tekh ili inykh situatsiyakh.

Sistema kombo. Vy dumali, chto mutatsii - edinstvennyy vash sposob raznoobrazit boynyu, no my dopolnili ikh vozmozhnostyu obedinyat ikh drug s drugom i proveryat potom, iz chego sdelany vashi vragi (bukvalno). Pokazhem etim merzkim lyudishkam, chto takoe nastoyashchee vesele!

Princess Farmer is a match3 puzzle and v:
Princess Farmer is a match3 puzzle and visual novel game with easy to learn action mechanics and different difficulty levels that let you breeze through the game or challenge you to earn more rewards. The story is played in episodes, much like magical-girl anime, with each lasting between 20 minutes to 1 hour, depending on your chosen difficulty level, your skills, and whether you decide to skip dialogue interactions. Different level goals keep you on your toes and bring a fresh approach to the match3 genre. Dialogue options let you choose how Princess Farmer interacts with her friends, affecting your relationships with them. Make them your BFF and they may reward you with gifts!

Princess Farmer was just an ordinary farmer when one day she woke up under the Gaia Tree. Now through the magic of Mother Gaia, she can hoist up whole rows of veggies with ease to make matches and smash obstacles by herself, in co-op, or even with an AI companion! Something mysterious is happening in the woods and it's your job to puzzle your way to uncover it! Shadowgate — одна из самых известных и в:
Shadowgate — odna iz samykh izvestnykh i vsemi lyubimykh priklyuchencheskikh igr v istorii. Ona bystro ocharovala igrokov svoim neveroyatnym atmosfernym saundtrekom, opasnymi ispytaniyami, beskonechnymi golovolomkami i takim kolichestvom vozmozhnykh smertey, kakoe lyubiteli igr i predstavit sebe ne mogli. Igroki primeryali na sebya rol «Semeni prorochestva» i otpravlyalis v puteshestvie po zamku, chtoby pobedit zhivushchee vnutri zlo — uzhasayushchego vladyku koldunov.

My pererabotali etu legendarnuyu priklyuchencheskuyu igru, dobavili mnozhestvo slozhnykh golovolomok, neveroyatnoe kolichestvo novykh komnat s oshelomlyayushchimi narisovannymi ot ruki detalyami v formate 2D i obektami, s kotorymi mozhno vzaimodeystvovat.
Eta novaya versiya dlya konsoley osnovyvaetsya na polnostyu pererabotannoy Shadowgate. V ney prisutstvuet uluchshennyy polzovatelskiy interfeys i intuitivno ponyatnaya sistema znachkov dlya upravleniya, kotoraya pomozhet igrokam v puteshestvii.

Gotovtes, khrabrye puteshestvenniki: ozhivshiy zamok zhdet vas!

Priklyuchencheskaya igra ot pervogo litsa: ispolzuyte inventar, sistemu kart i intuitivnyy interfeys, chtoby vypolnit zadanie.
Opasnye podzemelya: mnozhestvo prekrasno narisovannykh komnat, novye ili uzhe znakomye mesta, a takzhe novyy igrovoy opyt.
Slozhnye golovolomki: novye i pererabotannye starye golovolomki, kotorye rasshiryayut staruyu igru.
Urovni slozhnosti: chetyre razlichnykh urovnya slozhnosti (ot novichka do eksperta), kotorye polnostyu menyayut igrovoy protsess i strukturu golovolomok.
Esli vy gotovy k slozhneyshemu ispytaniyu, to vyberite rezhim «Zheleznyy chelovek», gde nedostupny sokhraneniya, i poprobuyte zavershit igru s pervoy popytki.
Retro-rezhim: igrayte tak, budto vy v 1989 g.! Vklyuchite ego, chtoby proslushat originalnye chiptyuny Khiroyuki Masuno, peremeshchatsya mezhdu pikselnymi komnatami i chitat tekst v retro-formate.
Syuzhet: v Shadowgate vas zhdut volnuyushchie videostseny i velikolepnyy syuzhet ot sozdateley iznachalnoy igry.
Kinematograficheskaya muzyka: kompozitor Rich Duglas napisal k igre elektronnyy dinamichnyy saundtrek, kotoryy menyaetsya v khode syuzheta.
Zvukovaya sreda: atmosfernoe zvukovoe okruzhenie so mnozhestvom zvukovykh effektov, poyavlyayushchikhsya vo vremya resheniya golovolomok.

Za rabotu, detektiv. 

O Tails Noir 

Tails Noir – eto postnuarnaya detektivnaya RPG, gde vam predstoit stat detektivom-enotom po imeni Govard Lotor i issledovat pikselnyy antiutopichnyy Vankuver. 

Gody odnotipnykh rassledovaniy, odinokie vechera i samaya obyknovennaya zhizn Govarda Lotora v korne menyaetsya, kogda k nemu popadaet delo, kakikh eshche ne bylo v ego praktike. Govard okazyvaetsya vynuzhden vyyti za ramki svoego obychnogo rabochego protsessa i v itoge nachinaet protivostoyat zhestkomu avtoritarnomu pravitelstvu goroda. 

GEYMPLEY 

Geympley Tails Noir – eto svezhiy vzglyad na point-and-click adventure, sochetayushchiy v sebe elementy «stelsa», issledovaniya i slozhnye razvetvlennye dialogi, vdokhnovlennye klassicheskimi CRPG. 

V roli Govarda vam pridetsya: 
•  V poiskakh pravdy vystraivat otnosheniya s samymi raznymi personazhami 
• Issledovat tsvetushchie i zabroshennye rayony obnesennogo stenoy Vankuvera 
• Razgadyvat zagadki i sobirat uliki 
• Reshat golovolomki i vsyudu sovat svoy nos 
• I, konechno, byt nastoyashchim enotom

OSOBENNOSTI 

Antiutopiya v zhanre postnuar 
Vankuver v Tails Noir – temnyy i mrachnyy, polnyy opasnostey gorod, no i v nem naydetsya mesto nadezhde. Otpravlyaytes v etot kholodnyy ekzistentsialnyy mir i otyshchite tekh, kto pomozhet vam izmenit ego k luchshemu. V svoem stremlenii vy budete ne odinoki: mnogie uvereny, chto Vankuver dolzhen izmenitsya, no vot predstavleniya o «luchshem» u vsekh svoi. 

Potryasayushchaya grafika 
Zakhvatyvayushchee sochetanie pikselnoy grafiki v vysokom razreshenii i trekhmernykh effektov: dinamicheskie molnii, lyushchiy dozhd, obemnyy tuman i neonovoe osveshchenie delayut gorod na ekrane zhivym. 

Zapominayushchiysya saundtrek 
Originalnyy saundtrek ot Nikity Danshina (Danshin) i Aruzh Aftab (Arooj Aftab) i kachestvenno podobrannyy zvukovoy fon sozdayut nezabyvaemuyu atmosferu, napominayushchuyu o starom kino. Takogo dark-dzhaza vy eshche ne slyshali.
Инопланетному миру иногда нужна хозяйств:
Inoplanetnomu miru inogda nuzhna khozyaystvennaya ruka, chtoby vsyo tsvelo i pakhlo. V etom nauchno-fantasticheskom simulyatore zhizni kolonizatora vy podnimete bezzhiznennuyu tselinu: prevratite pustoshi v tsvetushchie peyzazhi, issleduete i obstroite neobychnuyu novuyu planetu i razgadaete eyo tayny.
Vy – pervootkryvatel, stupivshiy na poverkhnost besplodnogo chuzhogo mira, pustoshey, prostirayushchikhsya do samogo gorizonta. Vasha zadacha prosta: Vozmite kosmotreyler, zaryadite svoyu mnogofunktsionalnuyu tekhnoperchatku i ispolzuyte vse semena v gruzovom otseke, chtoby nachat novuyu zhizn v etom mire. So vremenem vy sdelaete planetu prigodnoy dlya zhizni dlya sebya i desyatkov budushchikh kolonistov. No do tekh por eto budet odinokiy forpost...
Syobon Action (яп. しょぼんのアクション), также из:
Syobon Action (yap. しょぼんのアクション), takzhe izvestnaya kak Cat Mario (NekoMario) i Mario from Hell, — yaponskaya videoigra v zhanre ironichnogo platformera, vypushchennaya v fevrale 2007 goda. Ona stala izvestna i populyarna blagodarya svoim, kazhushchimisya na pervyy vzglyad, prostymi urovnyam; priznayotsya parodiey na igru ot kompanii Nintendo Super Mario Bros. 1985 goda. Nesmotrya na neozhidannost lovushek v igre, urovni ne menyayutsya posle proigrysha, chto pozvolyaet igroku zapominat ikh mestopolozhenie i v konechnom itoge propuskat ikh. V otlichie ot Super Mario Bros., gde posle tryokh popytok ves progress sbrasyvaetsya, — tut beskonechnoe kolichestvo zhizney. Takzhe mozhno sobirat monety, pravda, ikh schyotchik ne pokazyvaetsya.
Igrok upravlyaet podobnym kotu personazhem, kotoryy dolzhen proyti cherez platformennye urovni, podobnye Super Mario Bros. Igra sostoit iz urovney, pronizannykh lovushkami, prednaznachennymi dlya obmana igroka, v tom chisle obychnyy na vid kirpich, kotoryy padaet ili provalivaetsya pod igroka; bloki, iz kotorykh pri prikosnovenii vyrastayut shipy; vragi, sprygivayushchie s vysoty ili vyletayushchie iz trub; bloki s monetami, ustanovlennye na krayu yamy, zastavlyayushchie personazha udaritsya ob nikh i upast; oblaka-ubiytsy; zvyozdy, kotorye v originalnoy igre pridayut sposobnosti, tut — unichtozhayut igroka; i flagshtok v kontse urovnya, gde geroy takzhe mozhet umeret dvumya sposobami.
Po priznaniyu sozdatelya igry, nezavisimogo yaponskogo razrabotchika «Chiku» — bolshinstvo idey on cherpal u Flash-igry «Bolshoe priklyuchenie Ovaty», osnovnaya ideya kotoroy — mnozhestvo vnezapnykh prepyatstviy, vstrechayushchikhsya po khodu urovnya. Khotya sam vneshniy vid igrovogo protsessa sozdan pod vidnym vliyaniem igroy Super Mario Bros. kompanii Nintendo 1985 goda vypuska. Saundtrek Syobon Action — sbornik muzyki iz razlichnykh igr, vykhodivshikh v 1980-e i 1990-e gody. Muzykalnaya tema pervogo urovnya byla vzyata iz igry, popavshey v nelitsenzirovannyy sbornik videoigr Action 52 — The Cheetahmen. Glavnyy geroy, podobie kota, pokhozh na talisman Sony v Yaponii — Toro Inoue. Samyy pervyy variant Syobon Action byl sozdan za tri dnya i predstavlen na kulturnom festivale, provodivshemsya v kampuse ego kolledzha, stav samoy populyarnoy iz predstavlennykh rabot. K fevralyu 2007 goda Syobon Action nachal rasprostranyatsya po Seti.
Syobon Action byla vosprinyata polozhitelno, a v obzorakh otmechaetsya intensivnaya i chasto razocharovyvayushchaya vysokaya slozhnost igry. Ona byla priznana igroy, kotoraya «sistematicheski narushaet vse pravila igrovogo protsessa 2D-platformera», i chto uspekh v igre chasto zavisit kak ot «metoda prob i oshibok», tak i ot sposobnosti igroka ispolzovat nelogichnye strategii, chtoby izbegat prepyatstviy. Po mneniyu datskogo igrovogo zhurnalista Povla Rasmussena, Syobon Action «nastolko plokha i v to zhe vremya nevozmozhna, chto v segodnyashnie dni dostigla kultovogo statusa».

The year is 2030. Business is as usual i:
The year is 2030. Business is as usual in the isolated research city of Rokumei–that is until several explosions suddenly go off in the nuclear research facility known as “LABO.” The city sends in “Sirius,” an elite rescue squad, to deal with the situation. But the situation only gets worse when LABO’s nuclear reactor melts down, –with members of Sirius and survivors still trapped inside. With radiation leaking everywhere and not enough anti-radiation medication to last until lockdown lifts, the survivors make more and more grim discoveries. In their struggle for survival, they learn that doubt is their greatest enemy, and trust their greatest asset.

The key to survival lies in the player’s hands with the Senses Sympathy System (SSS). Your emotions projected upon the characters, particularly your trust in them, shape the progression of the story. Only with effective use of this system and completion of both protagonists’ stories can the player piece together the truth.

«A chya eto krov na stenakh?» – Dzhozi

Dzhozi ne boitsya probovat novoe. Ee otets, supergeroy na pensii, pochinil svoy geroyskiy trenazher i razreshil Dzhozi s nim poigrat. Kakoy otets ne khochet sdelat iz docheri supergeroya?

Vot tolko trenazher vdrug sletaet s katushek, i dlya Dzhozi stavkoy stanovitsya ee zhizn. V nashem neprostom tonko nastroennom platformere vy igraete za Dzhozi po prozvishchu Sunblaze, pytayas proyti kurs obuchenie supergeroev. V trenazhere chego tolko net: golovolomki, prepyatstviya, vzryvchatka, shipy, drony... Zato u vas est zamurchatelnyy drug — kot. A kogda est kot, chto eshche nuzhno?

Nu, naprimer, lovkost ruk. Ona vam tochno ponadobitsya. Trenazher postoyanno menyaetsya, i s nim menyayutsya i zadachi – nekotorye iz nikh mozhno prokhodit chasami.

Byt roditelem voobshche neprosto, no u nas tut eshche slozhnee.

Tak, roditeli, kotorye nikogda ne teryali svoikh detey, podnimite ruki! To-to zhe. No vy khotya by ne teryali ikh v bezzhalostnom trenazhere dlya supergeroev s lazerami, zlymi robotami, shipami i... Sami uvidite, chto eshche u nego vnutri!

VNIMANIE: igra v Sunblaze mozhet vyzvat rezkoe razvitie intellekta.

Realpolitiks is a streamlined real-time grand strategy game that allows you to become the leader of any contemporary nation. Dive deep into the issues of the modern world, with its current geopolitical borders, using your country’s power and economic strength to engage in military conflicts and international affairs. Choose your own method of coping with other nations' interests, unexpected events, global threats and various crises. Deal with the disintegration of the European Union, terrorism, the aftermath of World War III and many other real and fictional scenarios.

Based on three main political systems (democracy, authoritarianism, totalitarianism), Realpolitiks allows you to extend the influence of your country through various means, all in order to win the race for global domination. Use your diplomatic skills, economic advantages, military power and the full freedom of moral and ethical decision-making to become a world superpower and ensure the well-being of your citizens.

Grow and develop your nation to the highest possible levels of economic power, technological competitiveness and military supremacy in globally-ranked charts. The choice is yours as to whether you become a valued member of the United Nations, or a nuclear tyrant, bullying all those around you. Expand your territory any way you like with the whole-world sandbox gameplay of Realpolitiks, even creating colonies out at sea. And if that's not enough, try spreading the seed of our civilization to outer space...
Features:
Lead any country in the world to global domination in various game scenarios.
Shape your country's political system and determine its relations with other nations.
Deal with internal and external affairs and face threats from natural disasters, terrorism, financial crises and more.
Make use of common political instruments in your international relations, including spy tactics and espionage to directly influence other nations’ internal affairs.
Take the moral and ethical high road in your dealings with others, or not...
High replay value ensured by a broad decision tree in all matters, as well as diverse mini-scenarios and random events.

New Power injects fresh content and realism into the world of Realpolitiks. A mini-scenario featuring an actual nuclear threat, Non-Governmental Organizations that try to influence politics and new features for creating larger territorial units are all highlights of this DLC.

In Urbek, you will be able to build a ci:
In Urbek, you will be able to build a city of your own design! Manage its natural resources, improve the quality of life of the population, and build its neighbourhoods in your own way.

Neighbourhoods
Breathe life into your city by building different neighbourhoods. Do you want a bohemian neighbourhood? Build bars, parks and libraries, but keep a low population density nearby. Do you want a bourgeois neighbourhood? You need parks and luxury shops.

Manage
There is no money in Urbek. Instead, you will have to build everything with your own resources, such as food, coal, or skilled work. There are more than 30 different resources to manage! Manage your natural resources well, so that they do not run out before they can be replaced. How will you choose to produce the energy for your inhabitants and industries?

Educate
Education is fundamental! By producing enough qualified work and scientific work, you will be able to build more advanced buildings.

Observe
Move around at street level in order to get a more intimate sense of the city you are creating. See and feel the differences between neighborhoods the way your city’s residents do!

Organic growth
The growth of your city will be organic. Some constructions will appear according to the surrounding conditions. For example, buildings with more than two floors will appear in densely populated areas and with basic services.

You can place other buildings by yourself, but they need some conditions. For instance, the local market needs to be close to the farms. The university should have some high schools nearby, which, in turn, require nearby schools.

When it comes to designing your city, you have a variety of viable options. There are no buildings that are superior to others. Every decision will have its pros and cons. Bourgeois houses consume more food and need resources that cost more to produce, but will improve the quality of life of the residents there. On the other hand, improving the productivity of industries will produce more resources, but will diminish the quality of life for residents living in the area.

• Story

End of Lines is an interactive graphic novel, set in the near future. Following a climate-induced apocalypse, a group of survivors centered around a small family wanders in the devastated countryside of Southern Europe, looking for a livable place to settle.

A well-researched, environmental tale that acts as a warning about climate inaction and the collapse of ecosystems.

• Features

— A poignant vision of what may lie ahead: the story is set at the end of the 21st century, in a world where nothing has been done to counteract climate change.
— A family unit at the core: follow Camille, Nora, their son Sam, the lively “Uncle” Rafik and the diverse cast of characters they befriend on the trail.
— A beautifully illustrated storybook: with each playthrough, experience a novel-sized adventure and a portion of the hundreds of hand-painted illustrations created for the game.
— An immersive and finely-crafted soundtrack.

Fight back in turn-based battles, manage:
Fight back in turn-based battles, manage character relationships, collect dangerous artefacts, and hopefully restore a world torn apart by oathbreakers, warmongers, and wielders of forbidden arcane secrets.

A world on its last strand of hope brought to its knees by a Calamity centuries ago that tore down its mighty civilizations. Petty kings rule in place of grand emperors of old that wage fruitless, ill-advised wars picking over ancient ruins like glorified scavengers.

Lead a team of four students in the Brookstead Military Academy, who are shut down on the mysterious orders of King Varic. The ruler of the Kingdom of Delia is preparing to break a millennium-old treaty and Brookstead students make for fine cannon fodder... However, these four soldiers are destined for more than just acting as unwilling meat for another grinder.

They may not know it yet, but they will make their mark on history.

A World Plagued by War

Lead soldiers into the fray across a world torn apart by endless war and magical cataclysms.

Fight through hand-crafted, turn-based combat scenarios spread out across 28 chapters, as rookies become veterans.

Test your tactical mettle. Maneuver, attack, break through, and - maybe - turn the tide of the war.

Engineer the rise of legends, from a pile of raw conscripts to a band of mythical heroes.

Heroes in the Making

Carefully nurture your squad to ensure survival through long bouts to make a difference in a seemingly hopeless world.

Assemble the squad from 30 playable characters, with their own background, personality, and motivations, then train them and pick from 54 distinct classes, with their own iconic attacks and skills. 

Outfit each team with hundreds of weapons and spells, from simple blades and missiles to ancient, eldritch artefacts that produce world-ending magic.

Defeat doesn’t mean permadeath, but there is a price to pay: Every time a warrior falls, it means a grave wound, a stat penalty, and weakening your squad.

A Glimmer of Hope

Hope is a rare commodity in a world ruined by Calamity, good thing these heroes are filled to the brim.

Defy the fates and make a difference as the head of this unlikely band of heroes.

Watch characters bond together on the battlefield and their relationships evolve through 400 individual conversations.

Remember: Any hero can make a difference - if they live long enough.

OB IGRE
Infliction — interaktivnyy koshmar, v kotorom vy uznaete, chto mozhet taitsya v samom obychnom dome v spalnom rayone. Pogruzites v istoriyu nekogda schastlivoy semi, chitayte pisma i dnevniki, slushayte golosovye soobshcheniya i soberite vse podskazki voedino, chtoby uznat o tom, chto privelo vas syuda i posluzhilo prichinoy stol uzhasnykh sobytiy.

No vy ne odin v etom dome. V samoy ego glubine taitsya chto-to eshche, i ono polno zlosti i otchayaniya. Poka vy ishchete nuzhnye uliki, za vami po pyatam sleduet nechto, gotovoe v lyuboy moment obrushit na vas ves svoy gnev.

Smozhete li vy vyzhit i obresti iskuplenie?

OSOBENNOSTI:

Vy ne odin — za vami sleduet myatezhnyy dukh, s kotorym vy tochno ne zakhotite vstretitsya litsom k litsu. Ubezhite li vy, spryachetes ili dadite otpor?

Izmenennaya realnost — issleduyte realistichnyy, vechno menyayushchiysya dom v prigorode.

Soberite vse voedino — chitayte pisma, nakhodite dnevniki i issleduyte vospominaniya razbitoy semi, chtoby ponyat, chto privelo vas syuda.

Polnoe pogruzhenie  — osnovu syuzheta sostavlyaet dovolno zhiznennaya istoriya, znakomaya pochti kazhdomu iz nas: razbitye serdtsa, predatelstvo, gore i poteri.

Svet i tma — fotorealistichnaya grafika, sozdannaya s pomoshchyu dvizhka Unreal, mozhet pokhvastatsya dinamichnymi istochnikami sveta, sposobnymi oslepit vas ili pogruzit v neproglyadnuyu tmu.
