ABOUT THIS GAME\nShibukawa, capital of J:
ABOUT THIS GAME
Shibukawa, capital of Japan, 2054. Water drips from the cracked ceiling onto the edge of your bed as the incessant rain masks the whine of a refrigerator and the neon hum of the city outside. You don’t recognise the heavy breath in your ear nor the warmth of the body lying next to you...

The world’s gone to hell, and it’s taking you down with it.

Welcome to Shibukawa

You are Anna Isobe, a cybernetically enhanced cop in a world that’s left you behind. Once a shining hope for the future, cyborgs have become taboo, replaced by drones and automata that make even your heightened abilities obsolete. Stuck in a thankless job surrounded by indifferent eyes you still have a duty to protect and serve, and that’s just what you’re going to do.

The Sundew is a dark adventure game set in the aftermath of a devastating future war, where the world as we know it was twisted by flames into a terrifying new dystopia. What begins as a normal day quickly becomes something else, and soon a lonely beat cop will hold the fate of the world in her hands.

The dark future, realised

The Sundew pays homage to classic adventure games of old while reflecting contemporary issues and gameplay. Beautifully drawn pixel-art and stunning sound design brings this dark future to life and grounds you in a vision of humanity’s progress that is both alien and strangely familiar...

Brave New World

Japan lies in ruins, save for the bustling haven of Shibukawa. Guide Anna through this new megalopolis and beyond in her search for the mystery behind a growing conspiracy. Travel from the backstreets of the city to far-flung isles, and the most notorious prison this side of the Steppe.

Choose your fate and that of the world

Alongside classic point-and-click gameplay The Sundew will ask you to make decisions that will change the future of humanity. Playing off contemporary issues, the choices offered are never black and white. Where do you believe mankind’s interests lie, and what means are acceptable to achieve them?

Features

- Guide Anna Isobe, a cyborg cop with a dark past, through the unravelling of a global conspiracy.
- Experience a diverse cast of characters, each with their own secrets and history.
- Explore Shibukawa and the remnants of the old world.
- Make decisions that will change the fate of humanity, for better or worse.
UNDERTALE — это дружелюбная ролевая игра: UNDERTALE — eto druzhelyubnaya rolevaya igra, gde umirat neobyazatelno. Tantsuy so sliznem, poglad shchenka, otkroy tayny rytsaryu ili krushi vragov. No khvatit li u tebya reshitelnosti, chtoby vyzhit?
Millie and Molly — платформер в стиле ре:
Millie and Molly — platformer v stile retro, kotoryy brosit vam vyzov i zastavit polomat golovu. Sumeete li vy provesti besstrashnykh geroin po sotne tematicheskikh urovney i pobedit kovarnykh chudovishch na ikh puti?

Proyavite smekalku, chtoby nayti luchshiy put i proyti kazhdyy uroven. Vossoedinite sester i pereklyuchaytes mezhdu nimi, chtoby spravlyatsya s neprostymi golovolomkami. Dopustili oshibku? Prosto otmotayte vremya nazad i poprobuyte zanovo.

V Millie and Molly vas zhdyot nezabyvaemoe priklyuchenie v pyati unikalnykh mirakh s grafikoy i muzykoy v stile retro.

OSOBENNOSTI:

– 100 urovney v pyati tematicheskikh mirakh.
– Prostoy i rasslablyayushchiy igrovoy protsess. 
– Khitroumnyy dizayn urovney.
– Unikalnaya vozmozhnost otmatyvat vremya nazad.
– Rezhimy 8-bitnoy i 16-bitnoy grafiki.
– Priyatnyy saundtrek v stile retro.
MEET THE SIX COOL SUPERHERO KIDS WHO ARE:
MEET THE SIX COOL SUPERHERO KIDS WHO ARE HERE TO SAVE PLANET EARTH

Wherever and whenever they are needed, you’ll find the MeteoHeroes! Our super-powered friends are ready to solve any problem that may affect the environment – anywhere on Earth! Travel with them from Rome to the South Pole, as they take on incredible missions, visiting nine amazing places on our planet until they reach their final destination – and a showdown with their fearsome arch-enemies Doctor Makina and the Maculans!

Help our heroes to use their unique weather-controlling powers to defeat the Maculans. Come with them to nine famous locations threatened by chaos and pollution and help them to fight for a clean, safe planet. You’ll travel through Rome, Cape Town, Sydney, Seattle, Harbin, Buenos Aires, the South Pole and the Amazon until you reach the Gran Sasso and the MEC, the MeteoHeroes’ base. But the MEC has been taken over by Dr. Makina's evil Maculans! Can you help the team to get it back?

Get ready for a fun-filled action platform game in which you must find the hidden items that will help you clean up every city and get the MeteoHeroes’ back to their home – while keeping out of reach of the many enemies that want to stop you. It’s fabulous fun for children of all ages – and, of course, features all the characters from the popular TV series MeteoHeroes!

Features:

•	All six members of the fabulous MeteoHeroes team: Fulmen, Nix, Nubess, Pluvia, Thermo and Ventum
•	 Use the powers of each of the MeteoHeroes to overcome the different dangers and defeat the Maculans in lots of exciting scenarios!
•	Play as two different MeteoHeroes in each mission!
•	Nine exciting adventures, nine locations, all continents!
Проживите эпическое приключение из ориги:
Prozhivite epicheskoe priklyuchenie iz originalnogo multseriala Avatar: The Last Airbender, igraya za Aanga i ego druzey, a takzhe ovladevaya stikhiyami, issleduya vydayushchiesya lokatsii, reshaya slozhnye golovolomki i perezhivaya samye trogatelnye momenty istorii Aanga. Prokhodite syuzhet samostoyatelno ili s drugom v unikalnom kooperativnom rezhime dlya dvukh igrokov. Primite svoyu sudbu i otpravlyaytes v originalnoe priklyuchenie Aanga. Igrayte v lyubuyu iz 18 uvlekatelnykh glav, chtoby snova perezhit lyubimye momenty iz multseriala.

Issleduyte mir «Avatara» i puteshestvuyte po chetyrem natsiyam v kooperativnom priklyuchenii na 1-2 igrokov, sostoyashchem iz 18 glav. 

Igrayte za 9 kultovykh personazhey, sredi kotorykh Aang, Tof, Sokka i Katara. 

Raskryvayte tayny i reshayte slozhnye golovolomki, ispolzuya unikalnye sposobnosti vody, zemli, ognya i vozdukha; uluchshayte sposobnosti na protyazhenii syuzheta, chtoby raskryt ves potentsial Avatara!
Blood — легендарный циничный, атмосферны: Blood — legendarnyy tsinichnyy, atmosfernyy i zhestokiy shuter. Esli vam nravitsya mrachnaya atmosfera, zombi, vampiry i temnaya magiya, pripravlennye svintsovym gradom i litrami krovi, to Blood — eto dlya vas.
СОБЫТИЯ С СОРЕВНОВАНИЯМИ\nУничтожьте гиг:
SOBYTIYa S SOREVNOVANIYaMI
Unichtozhte gigantskiy plyazhnyy myach, stante politseyskim i poymayte grabiteley, ukradite koronu korolya — eto tolko nekotorye iz 10 veselykh sobytiy, kotorye est v igre. Prinimayte uchastie v sluchaynykh konkursakh, obgonyayte sopernikov, chtoby zarabotat bolshe deneg i kupit zamechatelnye novye mashiny i nastroyki.

BEZUMNAYa PROKAChKA AVTOMOBILEY
Ispolzuya nitro-usiliteli, vy mozhete uvelichit nitro-vmestimost mashiny, a razgonyayas do predelnykh skorostey vy povyshaete predelnuyu skorost... ponyali logiku? Dovedya do maksimuma vse kharakteristiki mashiny, vy povysite svoy uroven i smozhete kupit novye mashiny ili nastroyki. Soberite bolshe 50 avtomobiley i izmenite vneshniy vid mashiny s pomoshchyu smeshnykh antenn, usiliteley i unikalnykh nomernykh znakov s vashim igrovym imenem. Doberites do maks. urovnya, chtoby poluchit rang «Prestizh» i pokazat, kto nastoyashchiy pobeditel v mire Crash Drive 3! Kto-nibud khochet mashinu iz chistogo zolota?

ISSLEDOVANIE OTKRYTOGO MIRA
Na Lunu i obratno! Sadites za rul i issleduyte bezgranichnyy otkrytyy mir v svoe udovolstvie. Zapustite raketu na Lunu, osadite korolevskiy zamok v lesu, otpravtes v salun sredi kanonov Dikogo Zapada ili driftuyte sredi arkticheskikh snegov. Nadoel kholod i led? Mozhet, prokatites na parome do tropikov? Kazhdaya oblast unikalna i napolnena sekretnymi zonami, kollektsionnymi predmetami i osobymi paskhalkami... Vy nikogda ne issleduete etot mir do kontsa!

TANKOVYE SRAZhENIYa DOSTAVYaT VAM MORE OGLUShITELNOGO UDOVOLSTVIYa!
Strelyayte v protivnikov i sokrushayte ikh, srazhayas na paryashchey arene! Nabirayte ochki i pobezhdayte! Oderzhite verkh nad sopernikami, chtoby kupit novye tanki s unikalnymi kharakteristikami. Vam nepremenno ponravitsya rezhim tankovykh srazheniy!

IGRAYTE S DRUZYaMI NA LYuBOY PLATFORME!
Nevazhno, na kakoy platforme igrayut vashi druzya: vy vsegda smozhete k nim prisoedinitsya blagodarya podderzhke mezhplatformennogo MP-rezhima. A eshche vy mozhete vypolnyat tryuki bez podklyucheniya k seti, v lyuboe vremya bez truda pereklyuchayas v odinochnyy rezhim!
Die for Valhalla! – игра в жанре action:
Die for Valhalla! – igra v zhanre action RPG. Rubi, rezh i sokrushay protivnikov! Ovladevay i beri pod svoy kontrol geroev, monstrov i mnogo kogo eshchyo, chtoby pomoch vikingam zashchitit svoyo korolevstvo!

Ty – Valkiriya, chto znachit “vybirayushchaya ubitykh”. Tvoy put lezhit cherez neobychnye zemli, gde skandinavskaya mifologiya stalkivaetsya s mifami Lavkrafta. Zvuchit stranno? Tak i est!

Igra podderzhivaet odinochnuyu igru i lokalnyy kooperativnyy rezhim (do 4 igrokov).

Dva sposoba nasladitsya istoriey:
V igre est dva rezhima: Beat ‘Em Up i “slegka rogue” (Rogue-lite).

V rezhime Beat ‘Em Up protsedurno generiruetsya ogromnyy mir s postepenno uvelichivayushcheysya slozhnostyu. Soyuznikov mozhno voskresit, a zelya imeyut poleznye, smeshnye effekty, ili to, i drugoe.

V rezhime Rogue-lite generiruetsya malenkiy mir s bystro vozrastayushchey slozhnostyu i mgnovennoy smertyu. Zelya mogut imet vredonosnyy effekt, poetomu igroku pridyotsya poznavat na opyte, kakie iz nikh izbegat.

Osobennosti:
- Sluchayno generiruemye urovni iz podobrannykh vruchnuyu moduley.
- Igrovoy protsess vdokhnovlyon klassicheskimi predstavitelyami zhanra “Beat ‘Em Up”.
- Bolee 10 klanov vikingov. U kazhdogo klana est spetsialnyy bonus i dostup k razlichnym klassam.
- Kazhdyy iz 7 vikingov imeet svoy unikalnyy stil boya i kombo.
- Bolee 80 sposobnostey dlya prokachki Valkirii.
- Milye, no krovozhadnye sushchestva s unikalnymi sposobnostyami stanut vashimi sputnikami.
- Lokalnyy ko-op rezhim (do 4).
- Ispytanie “Deathmatch”: Srazhaytes v rezhime “kazhdyy sam za sebya”.
- Ispytanie “Vyzhivanie”: Proverte svoi navyki i sorevnuytes s druzyami.
Final Fantasy — серия японских ролевых и:
Final Fantasy — seriya yaponskikh rolevykh igr s razlichnymi geympleem, settingom i syuzhetami, no sokhranyayushchaya obshchie syuzhetnye i geympleynye elementy. Deystviya igr razvorachivayutsya v fantasticheskikh i fenteziynykh mirakh.
Igry, sluzhivshie vdokhnoveniem dlya tselykh pokoleniy, vozvrashchayutsya v chudesnom pikselnom 2D-pereizdanii! Vas zhdut polnostyu pererabotannaya pikselnaya 2D-grafika i novyy chudesnyy saundtrek. Igrovoy protsess uluchshen za schet modernizirovannogo interfeysa, a dopolnitelnye funktsii vrode bestiariya, galerei illyustratsiy i proigryvatelya pozvolyayut glubzhe prochuvstvovat mir igry!
— Uluchshennye vozmozhnosti kontrolya, v tom chisle sovremennyy interfeys, funktsiya avtoboya i mnogoe drugoe!
Хоррор-головоломка в стиле поиска предме:
Khorror-golovolomka v stile poiska predmetov «Istinnyy strakh: Otryokshiesya dushi» sochetaet v sebe vsyo luchshee zhanra psikhologicheskogo trillera. Esli vy ishchete uvlekatelnyy pazl v zhanre uzhasov s interesnym syuzhetom, to vy ego nashli!..
Igra rasskazyvaet pro devushku, kotoraya ostalas odna. Nochyu k ney stuchitsya strannyy pochtalon i otdayot pismo, yakoby ot sestry, chtoby ona priekhala k ney i ta vydast vsyu pravdu o sebe. Priekhav v staryy, zabroshennyy dom, okazyvaetsya, chto v tam nikogo net...
Мир демонов населяют самые разные плохие:
Mir demonov naselyayut samye raznye plokhie parni, i bolshinstvo iz nikh sobirayutsya v bandy pod rukovodstvom silnykh i naglykh bossov.
Osobennosti igry
•	Unikalnyy vizualnyy stil, sochetayushchiy v sebe ekspressiyu 2D-illyustratsiy s glubinoy i shirokimi vozmozhnostyami issledovaniya trekhmernoy sredy.
•	Zabavnyy mir, gde vasha geroinya chitaet rep pod fonovuyu muzyku, a kazhdyy personazh staraetsya sozdat sebe samyy yarkiy obraz!
•	Novyy podkhod k razvitiyu syuzheta: vy vsegda mozhete vernutsya na uzhe proydennye urovni, chtoby uznat, kak oni izmenilis posle osvobozhdeniya ikh zhiteley iz-pod vlasti Korolya Demonov. Esli eto zanyatie vam naskuchit, to v stolichnom gorode vas vsegda zhdut dopolnitelnye zadaniya i ispytaniya.
•	Osobaya boevaya sistema, osnovannaya na fizicheskikh kharakteristikakh predmetov, pozvolyaet ispolnyat zamyslovatye akrobaticheskie tryuki ili ustroit nastoyashchiy khaos vo vremya srazheniya. Tolkayte, tyanite i raskruchivayte vsekh, kto vstanet u vas na puti!
•	Tochki sokhraneniya mozhno razmeshchat v lyuboe vremya i v lyubom meste po vashemu zhelaniyu. Prodemonstriruyte svoi navyki, zavershiv uroven bez edinoy smerti, ili, naprotiv, sokhranite igru pered slozhnym momentom, chtoby ne teryat lishnee vremya na povtornye prokhozhdeniya.
•	V igre vas zhdet mnozhestvo unikalnykh ispytaniy, naprimer v rezhime «Fotookhota» vam predstoit fotografirovat skrytye ot chuzhikh glaz mesta i yarkie igrovye momenty! Vprochem, fotografirovatsya i delat selfi prosto dlya publikatsiy v sotssetyakh nikto ne zapreshchaet.
•	V igrovom magazine predstavlena obshirnaya podborka modifikatsiy, s pomoshchyu kotorykh mozhno polnostyu izmenit stil igry, a esli vas ustraivayut imeyushchiesya mekhaniki, to mozhete potratit dengi na kosmeticheskie predmety i pitomtsev!
•	Sozdannye vruchnuyu urovni s menyayushchimisya mekhanikami ne dadut zaskuchat, a mnozhestvo yarkikh i zhivykh bossov so svoimi unikalnymi kharakterami tolko i zhdut vozmozhnosti postavit Bibz na mesto... No ona ne privykla otstupat!
•	Sozdateli igry Slime-san predstavlyayut svoe novoe tvorenie! V etot proekt razrabotchiki vlozhili ves svoy opyt, nakoplennyy za vremya raboty nad 2D-platformerom, i otkryli tseloe novoe izmerenie vozmozhnostey!
Отправляйтесь в путешествие вместе со св:
Otpravlyaytes v puteshestvie vmeste so svoim Tkachom: issleduyte drevnie podzemelya, reshayte golovolomki, broste vyzov prichudlivym sushchestvam i raskroyte velikie tayny davno zabytogo proshlogo! Weaving Tides – eto ocharovatelnoe priklyuchenie dlya odnogo igroka v mire magii i tkachestva. Prokatites verkhom na kovrovykh drakonakh i issleduyte potryasayushchiy peyzazh, vzletaya nad tkushchimsya polotnom i opuskayas pod nego.

Spletayte velikolepnyy igrovoy mir
Razrezayte i sshivayte polotno, issleduya mir igry. Ispolzuyte sposobnosti Tkacha, chtoby oputat vragov i stat nastoyashchim pokoritelem kovarnykh podzemeliy i golovolomok. Vyberite Tkacha, sootvetstvuyushchego vashemu stilyu igry, i ukraste ego misticheskoy vyshivkoy, chtoby eshche bolshe usilit ego sposobnosti.

Issleduyte yarkiy tkanyy mir
Pogruzites v nezabyvaemyy peyzazh, sozdannyy iz tkani, pochuvstvuyte ocharovanie krasochnykh personazhey, narisovannykh ot ruki portretov i zakhvatyvayushchey muzyki.

Raskroyte vse tayny etoy ocharovatelnoy istorii
Naydite neobychnykh soyuznikov, pomogite Tassu nayti roditeley, soberite fragmenty proshlogo i raskroyte davno zabytye tayny etogo mira.

Podruzhites s tremya Tkachami i prokatites na nikh verkhom
Prichudlivye druzya-drakony pomogut vam orientirovatsya v mire i reshat neobychnye golovolomki. Vyberite, s kem vy razdelite priklyuchenie.

Potryasayushchiy tvorcheskiy rezhim
Razblokiruyte novye krasochnye lenty dlya svoikh Tkachey v kampanii i ispolzuyte ikh, chtoby sozdat svoyu sobstvennuyu tsifrovuyu vyshivku.
Таинственный незнакомец нарушил спокойст:
Tainstvennyy neznakomets narushil spokoystvie Kheven-Tor, i tolko samye neozhidannye geroi smogut vsekh spasti! Znakomtes so zmeem Makaronom i ego giperaktivnym luchshim drugom — kolibri Bolvanom. Vmeste oni dolzhny vernut uteryannye klyuchevye kamni k magicheskim vratam, daruyushchim Kheven-Tor tainstvennuyu silu. Snake Pass — neobychnaya golovolomka-platformer s fizikoy obektov: igrokam predstoit nauchitsya myslit po-zmeinomu, chtoby reshat khitroumnye golovolomki, dostupnye tolko zmeyam. Skolzite v vysokoy trave, svorachivaytes vokrug bambuka i zabiraytes povyshe, chtoby izbezhat opasnosti. Vse eto v novoy igre ot zasluzhennoy nezavisimoy studii Sumo Digital!

• 15 golovolomnykh zmeezaklinatelnykh urovney.
• Unikalnye sposobnosti zmeya Makarona.
• Sovershenno novaya muzyka avtorstva lyubimtsa fanatov Devida Vayza.
• Razblokiruyte rezhim «Ispytanie vremenem» i stante samym skolzkim pronyroy v mire!
• V tom chisle sovershenno novyy arkadnyy rezhim!
«И сгустились черные тучи» – интерактивн:
«I sgustilis chernye tuchi» – interaktivnyy psikhologicheskiy triller s elementami fantastiki i neskolkimi syuzhetnymi liniyami.
Posle samoubiystva podrugi Kristina vozvrashchaetsya v svoy rodnoy gorod. V popytke razgadat strashnye tayny, kotorymi okutana ee smert, ona podvergaet sebya i svoikh blizkikh strashnoy opasnosti. Pravda okazyvaetsya namnogo slozhnee, chem ona mogla sebe predstavit.
Posle perezhitoy tragedii Kristina pytaetsya smiritsya s proizoshedshim i vpadaet v depressiyu. Ona pridumyvaet raznye versii etogo rokovogo sobytiya, chtoby dobratsya do istiny. Na pokhoronnoy tseremonii, kotoraya prokhodila v ee rodnom gorode, Kristina vstrechaet svoyu luchshuyu podrugu Sharlottu (Reychel Dzhekson) i otpravlyaetsya v zagadochnoe puteshestvie k samopoznaniyu.
Vybor, kotoryy vy delaete v igre, vliyaet na razvitie syuzheta, na to, kuda privedet vas eto puteshestvie i gde vy okazhites v kontse puti.


• Interaktivnyy kinematograficheskiy psikhologicheskiy triller, snyatyy v Velikobritanii.
• V zavisimosti ot prinimaemykh vami resheniy syuzhet mozhet izmenitsya kardinalno.
• Otslezhivayte v realnom vremeni status otnosheniy, kotoryy vliyaet na ves syuzhet igry.
• Otslezhivayte v rezhime realnogo kharakteristiki lichnosti, kotorye mogut menyatsya v zavisimosti ot sdelannogo vami vybora.
• Vy mozhete razblokirovat funktsiyu propuska stsen i otsenki lichnosti.
• V rezhime strimminga dostupna priostanovka vybora uchastiya auditorii vo vremya pryamykh translyatsiy.
Все ли заслуживают второй шанс? Возможно:
Vse li zasluzhivayut vtoroy shans? Vozmozhno li prostit cheloveku ego prestupleniya? Mnozhestvo voennykh prestupnikov, byvshikh mafiozi i drugikh narushiteley zakona skryvayutsya ot nakazaniya, lovko pryachas sredi obychnykh lyudey. No tut v dele poyavlyaetes Vy. Vasha zadacha, kak chlena zagadochnogo taynogo obshchestva, poklyavshegosya izbavit mir ot Plokhikh Parney – pomoch spravedlivosti vostorzhestvovat v samom krovavom vide, ispolzuya v svoikh interesakh element neozhidannosti.

Vysledite Plokhikh Parney, budte bezzhalostny, no umny, planiruya svoyo delo i ustranyaya ikh odin za odnim. No pomnite: kazhdaya smert dolzhna vyglyadet, kak neschastnyy sluchay.  Na kazhdom urovne Vam predstavitsya shans izbavitsya ot Plokhogo Parnya s pomoshchyu razlichnogo oruzhiya i lovushek. Tolko Vam dano sdelat tak, chtoby on okazalsya ne v tom meste, ne v to vremya.

 V etoy originalnoy golovolomke bolshuyu rol igraet fizika, a takzhe trezvyy raschet i soobrazitelnost. Plokhie Parni ne zasluzhivayut miloserdiya! “Dlya vsekh ostalnykh my ne sushchestvuem. Esli ty provalish zadanie, ty edinstvennyy, kto ponesyot otvetstvennost, a my budem otritsat vse svyazi s toboy.”

Osobennosti
VYSLEDI SVOYu TsEL na 60 urovnyakh, kazhdyy iz kotorykh eshchyo interesnee, chem predydushchiy, i otkroy 6 novykh potryasayushchikh bonusnykh urovney.
ISPOLZUY VOOBRAZhENIE, kogda budesh ubivat prestupnikov odin za drugim. Dozhdis podkhodyashchego momenta, i proley stolko krovi, skolko smozhesh! 
STAN POSLANNIKOM SMERTI i pokazhi, kak nuzhno rasporyazhatsya nashim arsenalom lovushek. Vzlamyvay avtomobili, prevrashchay obychnye predmety v smertelnoe oruzhie ili kombiniruy raznye elementy, chtoby sozdat chto-to unikalnoe.
OSTAVAYSYa V TENI. Ne stoit privlekat k sebe vnimanie. Kamery, prokhozhie, politseyskie i telokhraniteli Plokhikh Parney ne dolzhny tebya zapodozrit. Nikto ne dolzhen dazhe zasomnevatsya v sluchaynosti etikh intsidentov.
TERPENIE I TRUD VSYo PERETRUT. Ispolzuy funktsiyu povtora, chtoby poluchit rekordnoe kolichestvo ochkov, vypolnit dopolnitelnye zadaniya, nayti novye sposoby ubit Plokhogo Parnya ili ottochit svoyo smertelnoe remeslo.
Добро пожаловать в киберпанковое будущее:
Dobro pozhalovat v kiberpankovoe budushchee Neon Blight. Kak novyy vladelets oruzheynogo magazina v stile kiberpank, vasha zadacha - obespechit tolpu podrazhateley geroyami oruzhiem, kotoroe im nuzhno, chtoby dobitsya uspekha v borbe s megakorporatsiyami, pravyashchimi mirom. Voydite v mir besposhchadnoy konkurentsii, besposhchadnogo sopernichestva i bezgranichnykh issledovaniy v roli remontnika.
Vy obespechivaete kiberpankov svoego vozrasta oruzhiem i snaryazheniem, v kotorykh oni nuzhdayutsya. Upravlyayte sobstvennym oruzheynym magazinom, srazhaytes s, kazalos by, beskonechnymi volnami vragov i dobudte sovershennoe oruzhie, probirayas cherez Vneshnyuyu granitsu i tolpy vragov, stremyashchikhsya uderzhat vas ot vashey konechnoy tseli.

Fiksator, kak nikto drugoy
- Upravlyayte sobstvennym oruzheynym magazinom: nastraivayte magazin, kotorym vladeete, i prodavayte priobretennoe oruzhie kiberpankam, stremyashchimsya uluchshit svoyu zhizn.
- Torgovlya oruzhiem budushchego: prodayte sotni moderniziruemykh vidov oruzhiya klientam, kotorye khotyat poluchit preimushchestvo nad konkurentami.

Risk versus reward guides your journey t:
Risk versus reward guides your journey through the full-length single player campaign and local/online multiplayer. Vigilance is key as environmental tells such as footprints and other disturbances will point out careless cadets. A massive amount of lovingly-made environments, maps, modes, and abilities – all obsessively balanced – combine for high replayability and a deep path to mastery.

★ Single Player Campaigns
Challenge yourself in the Hero’s Journey: individually tailored hero campaigns filled with puzzle rooms, skill challenges, and boss fights. The unique abilities have entire journeys built specifically to teach you to properly use that hero’s playstyle – all while the art of stealth and mastery of movement becomes second-nature.

★ Multiplayer Battles - Local and Online
Once you’ve honed your skills in the Hero’s Journey and defeated all of your friends, you’ll want to challenge the world! Online matchmaking, crossplay with the PC community, and public or private matches with join keys allow you to find a foe anytime, anywhere.

★ Choose your Main
With 12 different heroes – each with their own unique ability – there is a perfect strategy for every playstyle. From meticulously sneaky to ruthlessly aggressive, find your favorite ability and shock your friends when you appear out of thin air and surprise them!

★ Competitive, Deep Hide and Seek
Count your steps to find the perfect hiding spot, wait for your foes to reveal themselves, then pounce! While counterintuitive at first, invisibility becomes your most versatile tool, leading to intense moments of complete silence. Invisigun’s core mechanics reward patience, forethought, trickery, and awareness.

★ Easy to Learn, Tough to Master
The depth is nearly unlimited with intentional baits, undetectable direction changes, powerup drops, and accidental bumps (that may not be so accidental). The chess dance is infinite and evolving, and all of the deceit is only heightened by the fact that your opponents could be lurking ANYWHERE!
While True: learn() — это головоломка/си:
While True: learn() — eto golovolomka/simulyator, posvyashchennaya eshche bolee golovolomnym veshcham: mashinnomu obucheniyu, neyrosetyam, iskusstvennomu intellektu i bolshim dannym. No glavnym obrazom, eto igra o tom, kak ponyat kota.

Vy okazhetes v roli programmista, kotoryy neozhidanno uznal, chto ego kot gorazdo luchshe razbiraetsya v kompyuterakh, chem on sam (no pri etom ne ochen-to razbiraetsya v chelovecheskom yazyke). Teper etot programmist dolzhen vsestoronne osvoit mashinnoe obuchenie, chtoby sozdat sistemu-perevodchik s koshachego yazyka na chelovecheskiy.

Uznayte, chto zhe takoe mashinnoe obuchenie
Igra osnovana na realno primenyaemykh printsipakh mashinnogo obucheniya: ot nelovkikh ekspertnykh sistem do moguchikh sverkhtochnykh neyrosetey, sposobnykh predskazyvat budushchee. Ne pugaytes: eto vse eshche vyglyadit i igraetsya kak zabavnaya golovolomka.

Stante titanom v mire bolshikh dannykh!
Peretaskivayte obekty po ekranu myshkoy! Soedinyayte ikh liniyami (o da!). Pytaytes. Terpite krakh. Pytaytes snova. Zatem nazhimayte knopku «Opublikovat» i nablyudayte za tem, kak dannye stroynymi ryadami proplyvayut po vashemu ekranu.

Okunites v polnuyu adrenalina zhizn spetsialista po mashinnomu obucheniyu!
Chtoby sozdat proryvnuyu tekhnologiyu, pridetsya porabotat frilanserom i pochuvstvovat na sebe vse tyagoty i lisheniya etoy zhizni. Poluchayte imeyly! Prinimayte zadaniya! Sidite tselymi dnyami v komnate v polnom molchanii! Nastoyashchie spetsialisty po obrabotke dannykh tak i zhivut!

Progaem po-tsarski
Nashi zadaniya osnovany na realnykh problemakh, reshaemykh s pomoshchyu mashinnogo obucheniya. Naprimer, u nas mozhno postroit mashinu s avtopilotom (i usadit za rul kota). A esli zakhotite proverit sebya po-vzroslomu, stante tekhnicheskim direktorom startapa: tolko vy i vashi navyki protiv dikikh zakonov rynka! 

Prokachivayte zhelezki, prokachivayte zhizn!
Kak tolko nachnete zarabatyvat stabilnye dengi, nastanet vremya zakupitsya moshchneyshim oborudovaniem. No ne odnimi zhelezkami syt programmist! Kupite kotiku klassnyy kostyum! Chert, vy dazhe mozhete kupit sebe nastoyashchiy kustik aloe!

Zabavnyy fakt: chem-to takim spetsialisty po mashinnomu obucheniyu i zanimayutsya. Teper vy mozhete stat odnim iz nikh (pravda, bez ikh zarplat)!

FreeSpace 2 целиком разворачивается в ко:
FreeSpace 2 tselikom razvorachivaetsya v kosmicheskom prostranstve. Igrovaya zona po svoim masshtabam znachitelno prevoskhodit razmery nebolshikh istrebiteley, kotorymi upravlyaet igrok, a takzhe effektivnuyu dalnost ikh vooruzheniya. Kosmos naselyon razlichnymi mezhzvyozdnymi obektami, takimi kak zvyozdy, planety, asteroidy i drugie nebesnye tela. Odnoy iz naibolee otlichitelnykh osobennostey FreeSpace 2 yavlyaetsya realizatsiya tumannostey kak interaktivnoy igrovoy sredy. Polyoty vnutri tumannostey soprovozhdayutsya ukhudshennoy vidimostyu i periodicheskimi sboyami bortovoy elektroniki. Blagodarya etomu tumannosti priobreli reputatsiyu zloveshchey i napryazhyonnoy areny dlya srazheniy. Peremeshcheniya mezhdu zvyozdnymi sistemami osushchestvlyayutsya posredstvom «pryzhkov» cherez pryzhkovye uzly s prokhozhdeniem cherez podprostranstvo, togda kak peremeshcheniya vnutri odnoy sistemy vypolnyayutsya putyom kratkovremennogo «skachka» v podprostranstvo v lyuboy moment. Vse korabli v missiyakh ispolzuyut libo «pryzhok», libo «skachok» pri vkhode i vykhode iz zony boya.
Dizayn korabley v igre chyotko razlichaetsya mezhdu tremya rasami. Terranskie korabli otlichayutsya prostotoy i praktichnostyu, vasudanskie — plavnymi liniyami i khudozhestvennoy vyrazitelnostyu, a korabli protivnikov — shivanov — imeyut ostrye, asimmetrichnye formy i vypolneny v zloveshchey chyorno-krasnoy tsvetovoy gamme. Syuzhet FreeSpace 2 raskryvaetsya posredstvom povestvovatelnykh predrenderennykh kat-stsen, brifingov do i posle missiy, a takzhe vnutriigrovykh dialogov mezhdu neigrovymi personazhami i zaskriptovannykh sobytiy. Struktura povestvovaniya lineyna i ne soderzhit alternativnykh syuzhetnykh vetok, odnako prisutstvuyut neobyazatelnye taynye missii, rasshiryayushchie lor igry. Prodvizhenie po syuzhetu vozmozhno tolko pri uspeshnom prokhozhdenii missiy kampanii. Odnako igroku predostavlyaetsya vozmozhnost propustit missiyu posle pyati neudachnykh popytok.
Igrok beryot na sebya rol pilota v ryadakh Galakticheskogo terrano-vasudanskogo alyansa (GTVA). Nesmotrya na vozmozhnost nastroyki imeni i vneshnosti personazha, igrok ne vzaimodeystvuet s drugimi personazhami napryamuyu, a sam pilot nikogda ne poyavlyaetsya v kat-stsenakh ili drugikh mediamaterialakh. Podobno glavnomu geroyu, bolshinstvo personazhey ostayutsya namerenno sderzhannymi i malovyrazitelnymi. Zashchishchaya chelovechestvo i ego soyuznikov — inoplanetnuyu rasu vasudan, — igrok takzhe okazyvaetsya vovlechyon v podavlenie masshtabnogo myatezha. Igra otlichaetsya uchastiem bolshogo kolichestva istrebiteley i gigantskikh korabley klassa «kapital», vedushchikh boi v detalizirovannykh zvyozdnykh sistemakh i tumannostyakh s ispolzovaniem luchevogo oruzhiya, snaryadov i raket.
FreeSpace 2 poluchila isklyuchitelno polozhitelnye otzyvy ot profilnoy igrovoy pressy. Kritiki vysoko otsenili masshtabnost kosmicheskikh srazheniy, slozhnuyu i dramatichnuyu syuzhetnuyu liniyu, a takzhe vysokoe kachestvo zvukovogo i muzykalnogo oformleniya. Igra chasto upominalas kak odin iz luchshikh predstaviteley zhanra simulyatorov kosmicheskikh boyov kontsa 1990-kh godov. Zhurnal PC Gamer nazval FreeSpace 2 «odnim iz samykh vpechatlyayushchikh kosmicheskikh simulyatorov svoego vremeni», osobo otmetiv prorabotku kapitalnykh korabley i napryazhyonnuyu atmosferu boevykh operatsiy. Obozrevateli IGN podcherknuli, chto igra «udachno sochetaet arkadnuyu dostupnost s takticheskoy glubinoy, redko vstrechayushcheysya v zhanre». Polozhitelnye otzyvy takzhe kasalis iskusstvennogo intellekta i struktury missiy, kotorye, po mneniyu kritikov, trebovali ot igroka ne tolko bystroy reaktsii, no i umeniya analizirovat obstanovku i prioritety tseley. Muzykalnoe soprovozhdenie poluchilo otdelnye pokhvaly za sposobnost usilivat emotsionalnoe vozdeystvie klyuchevykh stsen.

Yaponiya do sikh por oshchushchaet na sebe posledstviya krizisa poteryannogo desyatiletiya. V 90-kh v strane lopnul rieltorskiy puzyr, kotoryy medlenno i uverenno naduvalsya vo vremya podema ekonomiki strany voskhodyashchego solntsa. Togda mestnye biznesmeny tratili tonny kesha na vsyakie plyukhi i drugie udovolstviya. Nu, a potom… Na ostrove stalo mnogo dolgozhiteley; pensionerov ~29,1 % ot vsego naseleniya, trudosposobnykh grazhdan — 59,4%, eshche 11,5% — deti do 14 let iz 124,6 milliona chelovek, a starikov iz nikh pochti 36 millionov. Molodye yapontsy prakticheski zhivut na rabote 50+ chasov v nedelyu, a vmesto detey zavodyat — pyosikov. V tom chisle i potomu, chto deti — ochen dorogoe udovolstvie.
A ko vsemu vysheopisannomu dobavlyaetsya bulling (ili «idzime») v shkole. Zhizn s malykh let namekaet — budet tyazhko. Nekotorye detki vybirayut put sycha, prosizhivaya zhizn doma, ne vlivayas v bolshoe obshchestvo. Nasha igra — kak raz pro shkolu, uchenikov starshikh klassov. Tochnee, pro khuliganov i lyubiteley pomakhat kulakami. Tekh, kto priznaet tolko silu.
Bancho — lider bandy khuliganov v yaponskoy shkole. Esli liderom okazyvaetsya devushka, eyo zovut sukeban. Obychno eto krepkiy paren ili devushka s silnoy svyazyu so svoey bandoy. V nekotorykh shkolakh banchu vybirayut putem golosovaniya. Kak i vse shkolniki, eti parni nosyat chyornuyu formu gakuran. Potomu chto po-drugomu nelzya, dazhe esli ty megakrut ili gigakhorosh, vypnut iz shkoly, i vsyo. V redkikh sluchayakh dopuskaetsya tsvet, slegka otlichnyy ot chyornogo, naprimer, tyomno-siniy i korichnevyy.
U glavgeroya dazhe est plan na zhizn. Khoroshaya novost — on est. Plokhaya — on ne opravdal ozhidaniy ot slova sovsem. V techenie neskolkikh let shla krovavaya borba mezhdu tremya srednimi shkolami. V etom bezumii uchastvuyut: srednyaya shkola Sakae, srednyaya tekhnicheskaya shkola Nakamura i srednyaya shkola Minato. Vy lichno uchastvovali vo mnogikh zhestokikh bitvakh stenka na stenku, chtoby pokazat, kto v etom gorode khozyain.
I vot, pri poyavlenii Kitagava Seyiti, korolya khuliganov sredney shkoly Minato, balans trekh sil snova okazalsya pod somneniem.
Chto budet dalshe — zavisit tolko ot vas!..

In the future, giant city-states have em:
In the future, giant city-states have emerged, separated from each other by indestructible barriers. Most professions have been taken over by machines. People work mainly as mechanics, programmers or operators.


Split is a first-person puzzle game with the unique mechanics of creating copies of yourself and manipulating time. The gameplay combines many different types of puzzles from more and less famous puzzle games and takes them to a whole new perspective.

After the recent war, engineers from Epsilon Energy created the Split indestructible shield system. It was to protect individual giant cities covering almost the entire planet from armed conflicts. Different cities have different policies for their citizens. In West Ulrage, every citizen gets a guardian robot at birth. In Hal'Tor, pairs of robots raise several children each. Whereas in Dievez, people are raised in large centers. Most jobs have been taken over by machines. People work mainly as mechanics, programmers, or operators.

The Split control panel is riddled with numerous traps that will require both good reflexes and composure. You can try to destroy enemies or escape from them by using time manipulation and your own clones to distract them.

The game's design refers to Brutalism, an architectural style popular around the 1970s. The levels are full of nooks and crannies, which may seem empty at first glance, but lead to interesting places.

FUZE4 Nintendo Switch™ is an all-in-one:
FUZE4 Nintendo Switch™ is an all-in-one coding application. Developed by a team of gamers, programmers, artists and educators, the end result is a powerful yet accessible application and unique programming language suitable for absolute beginners, professionals and everything between!

Features
• Real, text-based coding language
• Program sharing – download games made by other FUZE users and share your programs!
• Showcase Gallery – see the best creations made by the FUZE community! Get your games features for the whole world to play!
• Vast library of game assets to create with – over 10,000 assets across 2D, 3D and Audio. Features contributions from over 30 artists and musicians
• 2D sprite engine with extensive functionality for creating fast and powerful 2D games
• 3D engine with lighting, camera, shadows, 3D terrain and animated 3D models
• Audio engine to allow music and sound effects creation using the synthesizer functions
• Use Joy-Con™ Controllers, Touchscreen, USB Keyboards, Mouse and IR Motion Camera in your games
• Advanced maths functions & Quaternion support
• Image and Map editors to create your own custom assets, tilesheets and 2D game levels
• Group and attach 3D objects to customise 3D models

Documentation
• Comprehensive reference guide featuring detailed descriptions for each function complete with code examples
• Over 30 extensive tutorials to take total beginners from simple programs such as ‘Hello World’ to creating your own games!
• Learn and understand crucial coding concepts such as iteration, variables, conditions, input/output, functions, algorithms and use them in your creations!
• Join the growing community of coders and game enthusiasts to learn and improve your coding skills, no matter where you are in your journey!

FUZE4 Nintendo Switch™ uses a unique programming language created by Team FUZE specifically to lower the barrier to entry to real coding. It is dynamically typed, case insensitive, uses simple English words in place of cryptic symbols to facilitate easy understanding and does not enforce a particular style of formatting.

Unmatched: Digital Edition is an adaptat:
Unmatched: Digital Edition is an adaptation of the critically acclaimed board game, where two (or more) opponents command characters from myth, history, or fiction in a battle for the ages! Have you ever wondered who would win, King Arthur (aided by Merlin) or a sword-wielding Alice of Wonderland? How would Sinbad and his trusty porter fare against Medusa and the three harpies? The only way to find the truth is in battle with a quick game of Unmatched!

In Battle The Are No Equals!

What is Unmatched?
Unmatched: Digital Edition is a tactical game where each player commands their hero and sidekick(s), using a unique deck of cards, to defeat their opponent on the field of battle.

The rules are simple. On your turn, take two actions which can be:
- Maneuver: Move your fighters and draw a card!
- Attack: Play an attack card!
- Scheme: Play a scheme card (cards that have a special effect).

Get your opponent's hero to zero health, and you win the game.

What makes the game special is that each hero has a unique deck and ability. Alice grows big and gets small. King Arthur can discard a card to power up his attack. Sinbad gets stronger as he goes on more voyages. Medusa can damage you with just a glance.

What makes Unmatched great?
Unmatched is one of those easy-to-learn games with an incredible amount of depth. The tactical insight and knowledge of your hero and your opponents will determine the outcome of the fight. Games are quick – but play out very differently! Your decisions will determine your fate, and your skill (and just a bit of luck) will win the day.

What can you expect?
* Epic duels between the most unlikely opponents!
* Huge tactical depth!
* Stunning artwork by legendary artists!
*Three levels of AI for solo play!
* Near infinite replayability!
* Easy to learn, hard to master!
* In-game tutorial and rulebook!
* Online multiplayer!
* Synchronous and asynchronous game modes!
* Official Unmatched rules consulted with the designers of the board game!
* Multiple expansions to come - bringing new heroes and maps!
* Unique experience of a board game with the convenience of a digital platform!

The original board game was awarded the following honors:
* 2019 Board Game Quest Awards Best Two Player Game Nominee
* 2019 Board Game Quest Awards Best Tactical/Combat Game Nominee

The application was recognized by the BoardGameGeek community:
* Best Board Game App Winner of the 18th Annual Golden Geek Awards for 2023

Kogda vy podruzhites s zhitelyami doliny i poluchite nasledstvo, ostavsheesya ot ottsa, vy budete zhit bezzabotnoy zhiznyu na ferme, vyrashchivat urozhay i razvodit zhivotnykh. So vremenem vy naydete svoego lyubimogo cheloveka i budete vmeste vospityvat detey.
Kogda zhe vy peredelaete vsyu rabotu na ferme, to smozhete poyti na rybalku, otpravitsya na poiski drevnikh sokrovishch na mestakh raskopok ili poobshchatsya s mestnymi druzyami, chtoby sozdat priyatnye vospominaniya. A kogda proydut gody i vash rebenok stanet dostatochno vzroslym, chtoby vybrat sebe zanyatie po dushe... Unasleduet li on fermu ili naydet svoe prizvanie v chem-to drugom? Vremya pokazhet.
Etot rimeyk lyubimoy klassicheskoy igry vklyuchaet v sebya mnozhestvo novykh sobytiy, bolee yarkie prazdniki, dopolnitelnye retsepty i tseluyu goru nevidannykh zlakov i klubney. Razmyshlyaete, chem by eshche zanyatsya na ferme? Ustroyte fotosessiyu svoey seme s pomoshchyu fotorezhima, pereodentes v lyubimye naryady ili pomogite sosedyam reshit ikh problemy. I tekh, kto otpravilsya v pervoe puteshestvie v serii Story of Seasons, i tekh, kto v ocherednoy raz posetil Zabytuyu dolinu, zhdet chudesnaya zhizn..
Приключение в духе старых добрых тактиче:
Priklyuchenie v dukhe starykh dobrykh takticheskikh RPG s elementami roguelite. Otpravlyaytes na poiski priklyucheniy na poluostrove Draytir, razorennom voynoy mezhdu raznymi fraktsiyami drakonov. Vam predstoit primerit na sebya rol elfiyskogo voitelya, kotorogo nanyala Drakonitsa: vozglavte ee armii i navedite poryadok v mire. 

Staraya stolitsa Voven-Sal byla poteryana v svirepoy bitve s alchnym Shai-Va, i teper vam nuzhno zanovo sobrat armiyu v novom sredotochii vlasti Drakonitsy — Nivenbore.  

Puteshestvuyte po poluostrovu, sobirayte v svoyu armiyu moguchikh chudovishch, kopite dragotsennye resursy i gotovtes k gryadushchim ispytaniyam. Klyuch k pobede — strategicheskoe myshlenie i takticheski vernye resheniya! 

Issleduyte razrushennyy voynoy mir
Puteshestvuyte po poluostrovu Draytir, razorennomu voynoy mezhdu tsarstvuyushchimi drakonami i kovarnym Shai-Va. Otpravte svoyu armiyu v pokhod cherez chashchoby Graskholta, zasnezhennye vershiny Frostkhilla, zasushlivye pustyni Vatana i porochnuyu Zildariyu. 

Masshtabnaya kampaniya bolshe chem na 30 chasov
Nachnite epicheskuyu kampaniyu s 16 zadaniyami: u kazhdogo — svoya tsel i sredstva. Dobyvayte tsenneyshie resursy, zashchishchayte strategicheski vazhnye tochki i srazhaytes s protivnikami, kotorye stanovyatsya vsyo opasnee.     

40 unikalnykh boevykh edinits, kotorykh mozhno nanyat
Nanimayte boevye edinitsy: vy naydete ikh v lageryakh stolitsy ili vstretite vo vremya zadaniy. Ispolzuyte sposobnosti boevykh edinits, chtoby razrabotat slozhnye sinergii i strategii. Obedinyayte boevye edinitsy odnogo tipa, chtoby sozdat eshche bolee moguchikh sushchestv!     

Takticheskie poshagovye boi
srazhaytes s armiyami protivnika, vstupaya v takticheskie poshagovye skhvatki. Vystraivayte strategiyu, peremeshchayte boevye edinitsy, razrushayte shchity protivnika i aktiviruyte sposobnosti, chtoby perelomit khod bitvy.   

6 tipov magii, kotoruyu mozhno osvoit
Ispolzuyte magicheskie zaklinaniya shesti shkol: nekromantiya, nevidimost, vosstanovlenie, ulovki, kontrol i sila. Vypolnyayte zadaniya i poluchayte opyt, chtoby popolnit knigu zaklinaniy! 

Vernite byluyu slavu stolitse
Perestroyte Nivenbor — novoe mesto obitaniya Drakonitsy. Raskhoduyte resursy, chtoby stroit i uluchshat zdaniya, a takzhe uluchshat boevye edinitsy, talanty i umeniya.
«I'll Show You Who's The Boss Of This Du:
«I'll Show You Who's The Boss Of This Dungeon!» ©
Vashe temneyshee podzemele v opasnosti! Stroyte, razvivayte i zashchishchayte bashni v satiricheskoy vselennoy Dungeon of Naheulbeuk. Nachnite s zakhudalogo podvala i postroyte protsvetayushchee logovo zla!
Stante Reyvaksom, usluzhlivym — ili ne ochen — smotritelem podzemelya Nayulbyuk. Za neskolko let do pervoy ataki besstrashnykh iskateley priklyucheniy vy poluchaete zadanie: postroit, razvit i zaselit shatkuyu bashnyu. Tolko ne navlekite na sebya gnev khozyaina, zlogo volshebnika Zangdara. Vy gotovy?
Jim is Moving Out! – игра с реальной физ:
Jim is Moving Out! – igra s realnoy fizikoy, gde nuzhno otsenivat okruzhayushchuyu obstanovku, tshchatelno planirovat kazhdoe dvizhenie i byt gotovym ko vsemu! 

Iz betonnykh dzhungley cherez zemli solntsa i peska k severnym pustosham – JIMO stanet nezabyvaemym puteshestviem, osobenno v kooperativnom rezhime. Esli lyubite reshat golovolomki, slushat klassicheskuyu muzyku i igrat slazhennoy komandoy, vam opredelenno stoit poprobovat etu igru.

Pomogite Dzhimu pereekhat i povidat mir!

Sobirayte Vinil v rezhime «Istoriya» i otkryvayte novye urovni v rezhimakh «Laboratoriya» i «Boy nasmert». Krome togo, est rezhim «Gonka na vremya» dlya semeynykh sostyazaniy. Uvidimsya v JIMO!
Мертвецы не рассказывают историй!\nИстор:
Mertvetsy ne rasskazyvayut istoriy!
Istoriya o legendarnom korable - Proklyatoy Roze - stoila, vozmozhno, znamenitomu moreplavatelyu Meysonu Ouensu zhizni. Ty mozhesh pomoch ego docheri tolko odnim sposobom - nayti proklyatyy korabl i uznat o sudbe ee ottsa.
Nordlicht — это приключенческая игра, в: Nordlicht — eto priklyuchencheskaya igra, v kotoroy vam predstoit soprovozhdat neobychnuyu semyu v ikh udivitelnom puteshestvii na kholodnyy Sever. Vy upravlyaete deystviyami lyubopytnoy Avrory, Pitera Petrushkina (ee morskoy svinki i luchshego druga, kotoryy ne pokidaet ee ni na minutu) i mudrogo papy Ruperta. Na svoem puti geroi otkryvayut zagadochnye sozvezdiya severnogo nochnogo neba i preodolevayut opasnye prepyatstviya, sozdannye materyu-prirodoy i ikh sobstvennymi strakhami. Inogda pridetsya ispolzovat i sochetat razlichnye naydennye vami predmety, kak v traditsionnykh igrakh zhanra «point-and-click». Inogda nuzhno budet prodemonstrirovat lovkost i bystrotu reaktsii, chtoby uberech svoyu malenkuyu lodku ot aysbergov, gigantskikh voln i bur. Intuitivnoe upravlenie, atmosfernaya muzyka i ocharovatelnaya eskiznaya grafika delayut Nordlicht nezabyvaemoy igroy, podkhodyashchey dlya vsekh vozrastov.
Любите серию «Paper Mario»? Тогда вам по:
Lyubite seriyu «Paper Mario»? Togda vam ponravitsya nasha igra!.. Kogda megakorporatsiya pogloshchaet skazki radi deshyovoy rabochey sily, novoprinyatyy geroy dolzhen podnyatsya po karernoy lestnitse, obedinit nedovolnykh sotrudnikov i dat otpor.
Kogda Flint Bakler, klassicheskiy iskatel priklyucheniy iz skazok, shturmuet zamok svoego zaklyatogo drakonego vraga Tinder, on obnaruzhivaet, chto nekogda ustrashayushchaya krepost prevratilas v... korporativnyy ofis? Zlodeyki-drakona nigde net, a eyo zamok zabit bezdumnymi rabotyagami, potyagivayushchimi kofe i zapolnyayushchimi otchyoty. Chto zhe proizoshlo?
Okazalos, chto knigi skazok — eto neosvoennyy rynok, polnyy tsennykh resursov, deshyovoy rabochey sily i potentsialnoy pribyli: estestvenno, konglomerat realnogo mira Ever After Inc. nashyol sposob vmeshatsya! Zamok Tinder stal ikh novoy shtab-kvartiroy, i teper Ever After Inc. namerena zakhvatit vse istorii, do kotorykh dotyanetsya. Ne imeya drugogo vybora, krome kak ustroitsya k nim na rabotu, Flint Bakler vynuzhden obedinitsya so svoim byvshim vragom Tinder, chtoby podnyatsya po korporativnoy lestnitse i unichtozhit Ever After Inc. iznutri!
Главная героиня, Мадлен, возвращается на:
Glavnaya geroinya, Madlen, vozvrashchaetsya na goru Selesta spustya nekotoroe vremya posle sobytiy pervoy igry. Pribyv v zabroshennyy Zabroshennyy gorod, ona vstrechaet Babushku; ona rasskazyvaet o knige, kotoruyu pishet Madlen, i sprashivaet o eyo motivakh vozvrashcheniya. Snachala Madlen govorit, chto prosto khochet predatsya vospominaniyam, no pozzhe priznayotsya, chto planiruet sdelat «bolshoy shag» v svoey zhizni, na chto Babushka eyo uspokaivaet i rekomenduet Madlen pogovorit so svoey «drugoy chastyu tebya», Badelin.
Celeste 64 — eto tryokhmernaya platformennaya priklyuchencheskaya videoigra, deystvie kotoroy razvorachivaetsya na vymyshlennoy gore Selesta. Igrok upravlyaet Madlen, glavnoy geroiney pervoy igry; ona mozhet begat, prygat, ottalkivatsya ot sten i karabkatsya po stenam, chto pozvolyaet izbegat opasnostey, takikh kak yamy i shipy. Krome togo, ona mozhet ispolzovat sposobnost sovershat ryvki kak po zemle, tak i v vozdukhe, khotya mozhno vypolnit tolko odin ryvok, posle chego trebuetsya perezaryadka pri kasanii zemli. Sovershiv ryvok po zemle, a zatem pryzhok, Madlen mozhet vypolnit pryzhok s ryvkom, kotoryy ispolzuetsya dlya dostizheniya bolshikh rasstoyaniy.
Fragments of the Mountain otlichaetsya nizkopoligonalnym khudozhestvennym stilem, napominayushchim 64-bitnuyu epokhu videoigr, takikh kak Super Mario 64.V otlichie ot lineynykh urovney Celeste, deystvie Fragments of the Mountain proiskhodit isklyuchitelno v zabroshennom gorode, kotoryy vystupaet v kachestve otkrytogo mira, pozvolyayushchego igroku vrashchat kameru na 360 gradusov. Po vsey lokatsii razbrosany kontrolnye tochki, kotorye mogut vozrodit igroka posle smerti.Ot sozdateley «Celeste».
Беглый волшебник встречает лесного слизн:
Beglyy volshebnik vstrechaet lesnogo sliznyaka, i zarozhdaetsya strannaya druzhba.

Uvlekatelnyy platformennyy geympley etoy igry sochetaetsya s prichudlivoy i nelepoy istoriey, v kotoroy kruto zameshany vesele i epichnost.

• Ispolzuyte igrovoy redaktor personazha, chtoby nastroit svoy avatar!
Поле битвы со множеством врагов и союзни:
Pole bitvy so mnozhestvom vragov i soyuznikov. Vashi soldaty budut srazhatsya ili otstupat v boyu po svoemu usmotreniyu. Vy — nablyudaete za deystviyami svoikh voysk i mozhete libo peremestit personazhey, nakhodyashchikhsya v opasnosti, v bezopasnoe mesto libo otpravit silnogo personazha, chtoby on pomog pobedit vragov — i privesti svoyu armiyu k pobede!
Igra byla vpervye vypushchena v 1988 godu na yaponskiy PC-9800 pod nazvaniem «First Queen». V novoy versii igrovoy ekran byl uvelichen, i v boyakh teper mozhno ispolzovat 2-y batalon voysk, a obshchiy igrovoy protsess byl modernizirovan!
Pervaya koroleva, rodivshayasya v Ornike. Koroleva polna ambitsiy po kontrolyu nad mirom i nachala pokhod na yug. Strany, kotorye stolknulis s ney, ne byli obedineny i pali pered ee armiey, idushchey k Orniku. S padeniem svoey strany graf Richmont nachinaet kontrataku s soldatami Krusibla. Pobeda nad vrazheskim liderom mozhet prevratit sootvetstvuyushchie vrazheskie voyska v soyuznikov!
Увлекательная головоломка про вышивание:
Uvlekatelnaya golovolomka pro vyshivanie na pronumerovannoy setke. Osnovnaya tsel — zapolnit oblasti urovnya bez probelov, chtoby zavershit pyaltsy, ona pozvolyaet vam sozdavat krasivye vyshitye uzory, reshaya urovni i zavershaya pyaltsy razlichnoy slozhnosti i razmerov. Nauchitsya igrat legko, a vot dostich masterstva — trudno!
Vyshivayte krasivye peyzazhi, rasteniya, zhivotnykh, predmety i mnogoe drugoe! Stitch predlagaet shirokiy spektr igrovogo kontenta i tysyachi urovney — ot prostykh do chrezvychayno slozhnykh. Vyberite shablon, razmer i kategoriyu pyalets, kotorye vam nravyatsya, i prodvigaytes po urovnyam, chtoby sozdat shedevr vyshivki.
Где большая скорость и крупные ставки. Г:
Gde bolshaya skorost i krupnye stavki. Gde zhestkiy boy, gromkaya elektronnaya muzyka i vyzyvayushchiy privykanie vybros adrenalina smeshivayutsya, chtoby otdelit pobediteley ot proigravshikh. Gde gravitatsiya - ne bolee chem pustoe slovo. Primite uchastie v zakhvatyvayushchey borbe do pobednogo kontsa! Imenno zdes mir FLASHOUT 3 dovedet vas i vashu mashinu do absolyutnogo predela!

FLASHOUT 3 predlagaet vam sverkhskorostnoy transport, petli, pryzhki i vnezapnye, rezkie povoroty! Proverte svoi navyki na samykh vpechatlyayushchikh fantasticheskikh gonochnykh trassakh i postaraytes ne otstat! No esli eto proizoydet, ne perezhivayte! Zadeystvuyte potentsial raket, oruzhiya, bomb i min, chtoby pomoch vam srovnyat s zemley vashikh sopernikov!

Primite uchastie v zakhvatyvayushchey borbe do pobednogo kontsa! Stante svidetelem zakhvatyvayushchikh krusheniy, agonii porazheniya i sladkogo vkusa pobedy! No ne promorgayte! Vse mozhet zakonchitsya v odno mgnovenie!

> REZhIM RAZDELNOGO EKRANA
Optsiya, kotoraya nikogda ne ustarevaet, no otsutstvuet vo mnogikh igrakh. Igrayte v igru s drugom na odnom displee! FLASHOUT 3 podderzhivaet kak gorizontalnyy, tak i vertikalnyy rezhim razdelennogo ekrana. Vyberite tot, kotoryy podkhodit vam bolshe vsego!

> UDIVITELNAYa ELEKTRONNAYa MUZYKA

- I mnogoe drugoe!
Динамичный игровой процесс с напряженным:
Dinamichnyy igrovoy protsess s napryazhennymi yarostnymi bitvami
Vstupite v yarostnoe srazhenie s moguchimi zveryami, chtoby vernut svoyu silu. Zapolnite demonicheskuyu shkalu, chtoby ispolzovat sovershennuyu ataku demona-vladyki mechey i rasshirit raznoobrazie boevykh strategiy. 

Otpravlyaytes navstrechu epicheskim priklyucheniyam, chtoby probudit svoyu istinnuyu silu!  
Issleduyte fantasticheskiy mir Eusdeal i primerte na sebya rol Killizzerk muzhskogo ili zhenskogo pola. Demon-vladyka mechey obnaruzhivaet, chto lishilsya svoey sily i ostalsya poslednim demonom iz svoego vida. Issleduyte mir i pytaytes spasti svoy vid ot vymiraniya. 

Sozdavayte i nastraivayte sotni predmetov oruzhiya
Sozdavayte magicheskoe oruzhie i uluchshayte ego, chtoby ono podkhodilo vashemu igrovomu stilyu! Nastroyka podarit vam beskonechnye preimushchestva v bitve. S pravilnymi materialami mozhno povysit silu ataki, poluchit novye zvukovye effekty i dazhe izmenit svoyu lichnost! 
 
Stroyte otnosheniya i ishchite lyubov sredi mnozhestva chudesnykh personazhey
Est tolko odin sposob izbezhat ischeznoveniya vashego vida: vstupit v brak! Vstrechennye personazhi smogut povysit vashi shansy na pobedu v bitvakh! Podruzhites s nimi ili dazhe priglasite ikh na svidanie, chtoby vernut byluyu silu! 

Neveroyatno talantlivye razrabotchiki 
Ot D3PUBLISHER, razrabotchika FELISTELLA i stsenarista Keya Miyakodzuki, izvestnogo po serii Summon Night, a takzhe s porazitelnymi illyustratsiyami i dizaynom personazhey ot lack — sozdatelya Okada Izo v igre Fate Grand Order!
В The Dark Crystal: Age of Resistance -:

20XX — это Rogue-подобный экшн-платформе:

Прыгайте, катитесь и планируйте над Вели: Prygayte, katites i planiruyte nad Velikimi Glubinami — podvodnym mirom, naselennym motami. Eti biolyuminestsentnye sushchestva vsyu svoyu zhizn provodyat v glubine Bioversa, pulsiruya v ritm elektronnoy muzyki zvukovogo landshafta. Contract Killer is fast and hard top dow:

«Stranded Sails - Explorers of the Curse:
«Stranded Sails - Explorers of the Cursed Islands» — eto igra v otkrytom mire, s issledovaniyami, vyrashchivaniem edy, vypolneniem zadaniy i udivitelnymi otkrytiyami! Vy poterpeli krushenie na tainstvennom arkhipelage. Vam predstoit vyzhit, razgadat lezhashchie v glubinakh ostrovov tayny, i nakonets spastis!

Vy berete na sebya otvetstvennost za stroitelstvo lagerya poterpevshikh krushenie. Chtoby vyzhit, vam nuzhno vyrashchivat edu, izgotavlivat nuzhnye predmety i gotovit pishchu. Vasha tsel — postroit novyy korabl i uplyt na nem, poetomu vy otpravlyaetes v puteshestvie po ostrovam — v poiskakh sokrovishch i predmetov, kotorye mogut prigoditsya!

Vas zhdut zakhvatyvayushchie zadaniya, a takzhe mnozhestvo opasnostey i ugroz. Raskroete li vy taynu proklyatykh ostrovov? Eto vasha edinstvennaya vozmozhnost spastis. Probudite v sebe iskatelya priklyucheniy!

Klyuchevye osobennosti

Ваш отряд под руководством командира по:

Osobennosti igry

Поклонники Патрика, настал ваш час! Бики:
Poklonniki Patrika, nastal vash chas! Bikini Bottom prevratilsya v ogromnuyu igrovuyu ploshchadku! Pora stat zvezdoy predstavleniya i voplotit samye bezumnye idei v zhizn — pust vokrug votsaritsya polnyy khaos. Zaprygivayte v shorty Patrika — i begom ustraivat idealnyy besporyadok na igrovoy ploshchadke Bikini Bottom!
Vesele zhdet v kazhdom ugolke vselennoy Gubki Boba — ot «Krasti Kraba» do «Mira perchatok». Zdes mozhno prygat s zontikom vmesto parashyuta (ili dazhe bez nego), iskat zarytye v gore musora sokrovishcha i besitsya v Komnate gneva missis Paff. Prevratit okruzhayushchiy mir v ploshchadku mechty pomogut samye raznye podruchnye predmety — ot podvodnogo pylesosa do banki s kraskoy!
Otvazhtes na to, chto mozhet priyti v golovu lish Patriku, v kompanii luchshikh druzey: Gubki Boba, Sendi Chiks, mistera Krabsa i... Planktona. Ili zhe ustanovite rekord v nichegonedelanii, ved tolko vam reshat, kakim Patrikom byt segodnya.
Pora stat odnim iz samykh nepredskazuemykh obitateley Bikini Bottom, pozabyt o pravilakh i ustroit samoe veseloe i neveroyatnoe sumasshestvie v istorii podvodnogo mira.Drugie igry pro Gubku Boba.
Heart of Darkness («Сердце Тьмы») — виде: Heart of Darkness («Serdtse Tmy») — videoigra, razrabotannaya Amazing Studio v techenie 6 let i izdannaya Interplay v 1998 godu. V eyo sozdanii uchastvoval Erik Shayi, avtor Another World, muzyka spetsialno napisana gollivudskim orkestrovikom (Emmy, Academy Awards) Bryusom Brotonom.
Вас ждут сотни уровней в подземельях, гд: Vas zhdut sotni urovney v podzemelyakh, gde nuzhno osvobozhdat druzey-geroev, spasat pitomtsev, sobirat zoloto, zelya i drugie volshebnye tsennosti. Polchishcha goblinov popytayutsya vam pomeshat, strashnye chudovishcha — sest vas, a zvyozdnye portaly budut kazhdyy raz ispytyvat vashi sily. Terpenie i uporstvo pomogut sobrat komandu muzhestvennykh iskateley priklyucheniy, u kotorykh khvatit sil na boy s Chervyom-zavoevatelem!
Looking for a 2D action-adventure mixed:
Looking for a 2D action-adventure mixed with super-powered urban gangs in a post-cyberpunk neon scenario? Well, if you do, Neon City Riders is right for you!

Assume the role of Rick, a rad masked vigilante in search of superpowers and companions to defeat hordes of vicious enemies, solve defiant puzzles, unlock new paths, complete engaging side-quests, and finally, free the decaying futurist Neon City that has been seized by a group of superpowered gangs!

Features

• Fight in a deep and fast-paced combat based on unlockable super-abilities.

• Explore the open-ended progression and the lots of optional side-quests to complete the game through one of the four different endings.

• Immerse in the retro-futuristic graphics and sounds inspired in the 80's pop-culture and video game consoles.
As a lone cop armed only with bare wit,:
As a lone cop armed only with bare wit, a large-calibre sniper rifle and bullets coated in a zombie-exploding pathogen, you are the last man standing at the epicentre of a zombie outbreak. Your mission? To succeed where the police and army failed by clearing the streets of 8 different strains of bloodthirsty zombies and stop Armageddon in its tracks!

For cool and unimportant reasons these suckers literally explode when shot, showering their zombie brethren with gore and causing chain reactions of showering zombie gibs with just a single bullet!

Use your sharpshooting skills to vanquish 100 branching levels of zombie hell across 40 unique environments in this hugely addictive chain reaction shooter. Earn 400 shiny medals and cold hard cash to buy 100 different upgrades, all designed to MAKE THOSE ZOMBIES EXPLODE!

OMG Zombies! is an awesome reimagining of a genuine classic: the critically acclaimed OMG-Z! The guys at Push Square gave it 89% and called it: “a must buy” game. Escape Rope claimed it’s: “...one of the best zombie games in recent memory” and Defunct Games gave it an A rating saying it’s “so addictive... I still can't get enough of watching the explosive chain reaction caused from a well-placed bullet.”

This even newer and 'improved-er' OMG Zombies! features a brand new sniper scope view, improved touch control, a fast-forward feature, instant restart feature and all the zombie-splattering action you could ever want! Get your trigger finger at the ready!
Винсент — искусный вор, решивший украсть:
Vinsent — iskusnyy vor, reshivshiy ukrast tsennoe ozherele iz osobnyaka staroy odinokoy zhenshchiny po imeni Beatris. I vse by proshlo uspeshno, vot tolko zhenshchina okazalas mogushchestvennoy drevney vedmoy i poymala ego za ruku.

V nakazanie Beatris otpravila ego v parallelnyy mir, sozdannyy eyu dlya zatocheniya svoikh vragov. Pervye obitateli etogo strannogo mira prozvali ego Davseravnoniya, i nazvanie prizhilos.

Vinsent obedinyaet usiliya s milym, no nemnogo nadoedlivym prizrakom po imeni Nik, i teper im vmeste predstoit nayti vykhod.

Udastsya li vam vybratsya? Vse zavisit ot vas!

Osobennosti:
- Point'n'click s osobym podkhodom.
- Mozhno vorovat, mozhno i ne vorovat — delo vashe.

Otpravlyaytes v priklyuchenie ILLa. Pomogite mame vosstanovit zdorove i istselite svoyu planetu. Uznayte 2 finala istorii. Vyberites iz 50 razlichnykh komnat. Ispolzuyte verevki, kataytes, prygayte, letayte, nyryayte, otbivaytes, sobirayte galaktiki i energiyu. Mame nuzhno bolshe energii. Prinesite ee.

От Лас-Вегаса до Орландо, соревнуйтесь с:
Ot Las-Vegasa do Orlando, sorevnuytes s opytnymi pilotami v gonkakh po drag-reysingu i sorevnovaniyakh po fristaylu! Drift na meste, ezda na zadnikh ili bokovykh kolesakh — v igre vy smozhete vypolnit vse eti tryuki, no prezhde dovedite svoyu mashinu do sovershenstva. Eti vpechatlyayushchie svoimi razmerami mashiny trebuyut masterskoy tekhniki vozhdeniya. Igra v tochnosti vosproizvodit vse trebovaniya k pilotam monstr-trakov, vklyuchaya umenie otdelno upravlyat privodami, uspeshno zakhodit na povoroty i predugadyvat dvizhenie mashiny posle pryzhka.
No chego stoyat presnye kharakteristiki bez stilya? Sozdayte monstr-trak, kotoryy otrazhaet vash stil, i pokhvastaytes im pered 7 sopernikami v onlayn-rezhime.
• 16 monstr-trakov
• Bolee 50 nastraivaemykh elementov
• 25 aren
• 3 ligi
Graveyard Keeper — новая игра от создате:
Graveyard Keeper — novaya igra ot sozdateley Punch Club.
Ukhazhivayte za starym kladbishchem, issleduyte podzemele, razvivayte personazha, propoveduyte v tserkvi i szhigayte vedm. 
Unikalnyy simulyator smotritelya srednevekovogo kladbishcha.. 

Prinimayte slozhnye resheniya. Neuzheli vy budete tratit dengi na zakupku myasa dlya khotdogov vo vremya prazdnika, kogda vokrug stolko beskhoznogo... syrya? 
Sobirayte tsennye resursy i zapustite proizvodstvo. Prevratite kladbishche v uspeshnyy biznes: vperyod, nuzhno lish ne stesnyatsya i sobirat tsennye resursy po vsey okruge, issledovat okrestnosti i ispolzovat vsyo chto mozhno. 
Podpisyvayte vygodnye kontrakty. Mertvetsam zhe ne nuzhna krov, tak? Tak pochemu by ne prodat eyo tomu, kto pustit eyo v delo? A eshchyo est raznye organy... Da eto zhe prosto effektivnaya pererabotka! 
Issleduyte tainstvennye podzemelya. Bez nikh eta igra ne imela by pravo nazyvatsya srednevekovoy. Izuchayte starinnye retsepty, chtoby razdobyt poleznye ingredienty, kotorye, pravda, mogut zaprosto potravit tselye tolpy lyudey v sosednikh derevnyakh. Kapitalizm.

Na dvore post-sovetskie 90-e, a vy snova rebyatyonok. Da, seychas vy znaete, kak bylo slozhno: banditizm, razrukha, nishcheta, no… Tak li eto vazhno dlya vas, semiletnego?.. Zabudte pro problemy i okunites v istoriyu obreteniya pervykh druzey i razbitykh kolenok!
Kataytes na velike, zabottes o malenkom shchenochke, naslazhdaytes poslednimi letnimi denkami, ostavshimisya do shkoly. No ne dumayte, chto vsyo budet legko — i deti poroy stalkivayutsya so vpolne vzroslymi problemami. Eta igra — dlya kazhdogo, kto byl rebenkom. Dlya kazhdogo, kto uzhe vyros.
Игра Submerged («Погруженный в воду») –:
Igra Submerged («Pogruzhennyy v vodu») – neboevaya igra ot tretego litsa, v kotoroy vy issleduete tainstvennyy zatoplennyy gorod i otkryvaete krasotu ogromnogo zabroshennogo prostranstva. Vy igraete ot litsa Miku, molodoy devushki, kotoraya na malenkoy rybatskoy lodke privezla svoego ranenogo brata v etot gorod. Plyvite po navodnennomu gorodu na lodke, vzbiraytes na zatoplennye zdaniya i ishchite pripasy po vsemu gorodu s pomoshchyu podzornoy truby, chtoby spasti svoego umirayushchego brata. Issleduya gorod v udobnom dlya vas tempe, vy okunetes v krasochnuyu atmosferu roskoshnoy prirody etogo mesta i naydete spryatannye artefakty, kotorye vossozdadut istoriyu razorennogo mira i razrushennoy semi.

Kharakteristiki igry

- Ogromnoe otkrytoe prostranstvo s bogatoy, yarkoy i koloritnoy prirodoy – vy mozhete netoroplivo issledovat eto mesto dnem i nochyu i vstrechatsya s ostavshimisya v zhivykh - zagadochnymi sushchestvami, kotorye smotryat na vas s krysh.
- Bezmyatezhnaya i rasslablennaya obstanovka. Ne nado nikuda speshit, naslazhdaytes voskhodami i prekrasnymi vidami, slushayte zvuki okeana ili nablyudayte za zhivushchimi zdes zabavnymi zhivotnymi. V etoy igre est tolko odin temp – vash sobstvennyy.
- Nakhodite spryatannye artefakty, kotorye vossozdadut istoriyu iskupleniya, zhertvennosti i ustremlennosti, i uznayte podrobnosti togo, kak gorod priobrel takoy vid.
- Plyvite po gorodskim ulochkam na nebolshoy rybatskoy motornoy lodke, s pomoshchyu podzornoy truby nakhodite zdaniya, v kotorykh est chto-to poleznoe, i otmechayte ikh na karte.
- Nakhodite luchshiy marshrut do otmechennykh vami obektov, prichalivayte k vysokim zdaniyam ili pamyatnikam i zabiraytes po lianam, lestnitsam, karnizam i trubam – navigatsionnye golovolomki stanovyatsya vse slozhnee i interesnee.
-  Sozdana na nezavisimoy studii v Avstralii opytnymi razrabotchikami igr klassa AAA, rabotavshimi nad seriey igr BioShock. Muzyka kompozitora Dzheffa Van Dika, poluchivshego premiyu BAFTA.
Дни мира и спокойствия превратились в пе:
Dni mira i spokoystviya prevratilis v pepel - vot uzhe 2 000 let s nachala vremyon imperskoe korolevstvo, upravlyaemoe edinstvennoy liniey imperatorov, nakhoditsya v rukakh varvarov. Kazhdyy den odno za drugim rushitsya to, chto kogda-to schitalos samo soboy razumeyushchimsya. Lyudey shvyryaet techeniem vremeni, no oni uporno prodolzhayut iskat budushchee.
Edinstvennyy ostavshiysya naslednik trona, Miyakuni Syuri, stremitsya k vlasti. On dolzhen unichtozhit svoikh vragov i vernut sebe stranu. Tokita Munekhito, voin, poteryavshiy svoe proshloe, nakhoditsya v poiskakh mastera. Belyy klinok, kotoromu on obuchilsya, dolzhen byt ispolzovan vo imya vernosti.
Sudba svodit ikh v etot den. Privedet li ikh put k razocharovaniyu ili blagosloveniyu? Otveta ne znaet nikto..Eshchyo vizualnykh novell na Switch (renpy).
Nastali trudnye vremena, Vasha Svetlost. Trebovaniya prosyashchikh prevyshayut kolichestvo nashikh resursov, ne govorya uzhe o voyne. Neobkhodimo ustanovit pravilnyy balans v delakh. Tron zhdyot Vas!  

- Vyslushayte kazhdogo prositelya po ocheredi i reshite, komu iz nikh nuzhna podderzhka.
- Pomogite svoey seme s ikh lichnymi problemami i reshite ikh sudbu.
- Naymite generalov, vedm i okhotnikov, chtoby pomoch svoemu korolevstvu.
- Podgotovtes k bitve i naydite sposoby udovletvorit prikhoti lordov i koroley, s kotorymi khotite zaklyuchit soyuzy.
- Stante svidetelem istoriy tekh prichudlivykh i nastoychivykh personazhey, kotorye budut poseshchat Vash zamok.

Igra "Da, Vasha Svetlost" - eto istoriya o Daverne, srednevekovom korolevstve, kotorym pravit korol Erik. Deystvie igry razvorachivaetsya v vymyshlennom mire, dlya kotorogo chudovishcha i misticheskie praktiki, vdokhnovlennye slavyanskim folklorom - eto v poryadke veshchey. Zhiteli derevni budut prosit vas pomoch s razlichnymi problemami: nachinaya ot chudovishch, napadayushchikh na derevnyu, i zakanchivaya nekhvatkoy mest, gde mozhno rasslabitsya i poveselitsya. Nekotorye lyudi vnesut notki radosti v Vash Tronnyy zal, a nekotorye postavyat pered trudnym vyborom. Vasha semya tozhe vazhna, poetomu, buduchi korolem, Vam pridetsya pomogat im spravlyatsya s ikh trudnostyami.

Vy stolknetes s lordami razlichnykh kharakterov; Vam ponadobitsya ikh podderzhka, chtoby vyigrat predstoyashchee srazhenie, no nekotorye mogut poprosit Vas sovershit gryaznye postupki, chtoby ukrepit soyuz. Yasno odno: budet neprosto sokhranit so vsemi khoroshie otnosheniya.
Уютный фермерский симулятор о сборе и вы:
Uyutnyy fermerskiy simulyator o sbore i vyrashchivanii lyagushek, selskom khozyaystve i sokhranenii prirody.
Vy igraete za dobruyu dushu, pomogayushchuyu staromu drugu vosstanovit vodno-bolotnye ugodya vashego detstva, prevrativ ikh v bezopasnoe ubezhishche dlya druzhelyubnykh malenkikh lyagushek.
S pomoshchyu druzhelyubnykh personazhey vy budete fotografirovat i razvodit lyagushek, chtoby povysit svoyu reputatsiyu, ukrashat svoe ubezhishche i sazhat mestnye kultury, chtoby pomoch vashey obiteli zemnovodnykh protsvetat!
Действие Super Meat Boy Forever разворач:
Deystvie Super Meat Boy Forever razvorachivaetsya spustya neskolko let posle sobytiy igry Super Meat Boy. Meat Boy i Bandage Girl uzhe neskolko let zhivut schastlivoy zhiznyu, ikh spokoystviyu ne ugrozhaet Dr. Fetus, a eshche u nikh rodilas chudesnaya malyshka po imeni Nugget. Nugget — siyayushchiy komochek radosti, dorozhe nee dlya Meat Boy i Bandage Girl net nikogo i nichego. Odnazhdy nashi geroi otpravilis na piknik, no Dr. Fetus zastal ikh vrasplokh, vyrubil Meat Boy i Bandage Girl lopatoy i pokhitil Nugget! Kogda nashi geroi prishli v sebya i ponyali, chto Nugget ischezla, oni znali, chto delat. Razmyav kulaki, oni poobeshchali, chto doydut do kontsa, chtoby spasti svoyu malyshku, a Dr. Fetus poluchit ochen vazhnyy urok. Urok, kotoryy zapominaetsya tolko pod gradom pinkov i udarov.
 
 Legendarnaya slozhnost Super Meat Boy vozvrashchaetsya v Super Meat Boy Forever. Igrokam predstoit proyti adski slozhnye urovni, gde smert neizbezhna, zato ikh ozhidaet sladkoe chuvstvo pobedy po zavershenii kazhdogo urovnya. Oni budut begat, prygat, bit i pinat kak v uzhe znakomykh dekoratsiyakh, tak i v sovershenno novykh mirakh.
 
 Chto mozhet byt luchshe, chem proyti razok Super Meat Boy Forever? Otvet prost: proyti Super Meat Boy Forever neskolko raz, igraya kazhdyy raz v novye urovni. Oni generiruyutsya sluchaynym obrazom: posle kazhdogo prokhozhdeniya vy mozhete nachat igru zanovo, i vash opyt budet sovershenno nepokhozhim na pervoe prokhozhdenie, ved igra sgeneriruet novye urovni s unikalnymi sekretnymi lokatsiyami. Vy smozhete pereproyti Super Meat Boy Forever ot nachala i do kontsa neskolko raz, prezhde chem vam popadetsya odin i tot zhe uroven dvazhdy. Vot nastoyashchiy podvig igrovoy razrabotki i vnushitelnyy primer togo, kak pereyti vse razumnye granitsy v dizayne i proizvodstve igry.

Grafik

Nastraivayte

Issledovaniya

Razvitie mira

Soulblight is a dark, unforgiving, top-d:
Soulblight is a dark, unforgiving, top-down action roguelike luring you to cross the thin line between good and evil. Instead of XP grinding, it introduces a Tainting Mechanics. While traveling through the shattered reality of the Sanctuary, you will receive personality traits based on your choices. These will be the main source of your strength. To harness them, you will have to act accordingly. Becoming an alcoholic means that you will be rewarded for getting drunk, but from that point being sober might prove to be unbearable.

FEATURES
- A unique Tainting Mechanic designed to encourage role playing
- Tons of weapons, armor, and utility items
- Dynamic and tactical combat build around stamina management and distance control
- Optional stealth approach that complements fighting
- Randomly generated, visually breathtaking levels
- High difficulty level emphasized by permadeath mechanics
- Gameplay­-driven narrative

GAMEPLAY
Before entering each level of the Sanctuary you get to choose a Taint that represents a certain personality trait. That choice will shape your future experiences as each Taint unlocks a new way of gaining power - a custom mechanic designed to encourage role-playing. Tainting Mechanics channels your will to survive into actions that are aligned with your hero’s personality. Let’s have a look at some examples:

Greed
- Receive "Scrooge" penalty for overpaying
- The bigger fortune you Acquire the stronger you are

Fierce
- Receive "Rage" boost after being wounded
- Receive permanent passive bonus for killing enemies during "Rage"

As you go deeper into the Sanctuary you’ll be able to add more Taints to your character’s personality making the shifting levels of the dungeon itself a skill tree of a kind. However with each new Taint you’re a step closer to the point of no return. Are you sure you know where it is?

«Umineko no Naku Koro ni» (yap. うみねこのなく頃に Umineko no naku koro ni, bukv. «Kogda plachut chayki» / «Kogda krichat chayki») — seriya vizualnykh romanov, sostavlyaet tretyu i chetvyortuyu chast tsikla When They Cry. Data vykhoda pervogo epizoda igry (Legend of the Golden Witch) — 17 avgusta 2007, vtoroy epizod vyshel 31 dekabrya 2007 i nazyvaetsya Turn of the Golden Witch. S 22 dekabrya 2007 goda po 22 iyunya 2015 goda vypuskalas odnoimyonnaya manga. V Umineko no Naku Koro ni rasskazyvaetsya o seme Usiromiya, vse chleny kotoroy vmeste s prislugoy okazyvayutsya na krokhotnom ostrove v izolyatsii ot vneshnego mira iz-za silnogo tayfuna, a zatem nachinayut umirat ili bessledno ischezat odin za drugim; podrobnee.
Ofitsialnyy yaponskiy port dlya Nintendo Switch pod nazvaniem Umineko no Naku Koro ni Saku Nekobako to Muso no Kokyokyoku vklyuchaet ves vypushchennyy na dannyy moment kontent vizualnykh novell v serii, a takzhe 2 dopolnitelnykh stsenariya.

The Mortuary Assistant — strashnaya simulyator-advenchura pro prostogo rabotnika morga. Mrachnaya atmosfera igry pogruzhaet v deyatelnost sotrudnika mertvetskoy, zanimayushchegosya svoey rutinnoy rabotoy. Glavnyy geroy pribyvaet na predstavlennuyu dolzhnost v River Filds, chtoby obuchatsya i poluchat trudovoy opyt. Nastavnikom vystupaet chelovek po imeni Morttik, kotoryy pomogaet razobratsya v tonkostyakh povsednevnykh zadach i rasskazyvaet pro pravilnoe balzamirovanie trupov, a takzhe pro ukhod i kachestvennoe obrashchenie s telami umershikh lyudey.
Zanimayas bytovymi delami, vy uznaete istorii o paranormalnykh sluchayakh, svyazannykh s pogibshimi. Predstoit razbiratsya v slukhakh bespokoynykh grazhdan, nachinaya stalkivatsya so strannymi yavleniyami. V odin den na svyaz vykhodit Mortik, soobshchayushchiy o pravdivosti proiskhodyashchikh uzhasov. V morg postupayut novye tela, za kotorymi predstoit nablyudat protagonistu, razbirayas v proyavleniyakh demonicheskikh sil.
Vy budete osmatrivat mertvykh, analiziruya i zapisyvaya sobstvennye nablyudeniya v bloknot. Igra sovmeshchaet zhanry khorrora i simulyatora, gde neobkhodimo prinimat trupy i provodit sortirovku. Zabiraya na issledovanie umershikh, geymery budut vnimatelno nablyudat za reaktsiyami na eksperimenty, kotorye reshaetsya osushchestvit vash personazh. V oskvernennykh organizmakh nakhodyatsya potustoronnie sushchnosti, zhelayushchie vyrvatsya na svobodu i podchinit sebe fiziologicheskikh nositeley.Eto repak-versiya igry s mashinnym perevodom, original zdes.

Summary
Urashima is a tropical island paradise that was lush with life, but along with a complicated past, it suffered from an endemic disease that threatened to quietly wipe it from history.
A young man claiming to be a time traveler washes ashore. All he remembers is that he must complete some "mission". He ends up meeting three girls belonging to the Three Families who prove to be the key to saving the island and starts his journey to change the future. How will he end up altering the fate of the girls, the island, and the world?

Gameplay
Gameplay in this visual novel involves reading through the story while making choices at certain key points. Different decisions may lead to different outcomes, story branches and endings. 
Features such as the Flowchart System, which allows you to review your progress or jump to previous scenes, make for a pleasant gaming experience.

Landscapes evolve according to the creature's emotions

ВОССТАНЬТЕ\nВосстаньте и приготовьтесь к:
VOSSTANTE

Politicheskaya obstanovka nestabilna, fraktsii vrazhduyut drug s drugom, i vsya Solnechnaya sistema okhvachena konfliktami. Vedite v poshagovyy takticheskiy boy udarnuyu silu: smertonosnykh mekhanoidov.

KOMANDUYTE
Vybirayte odnogo iz chetyrekh voenachalnikov, kazhdyy iz kotorykh predstavlyaet otdelnuyu fraktsiyu i obladaet unikalnymi silami, chertami i stilem igry. Prizovite na pomoshch takticheskoe myshlenie i razmeshchayte boevye edinitsy na pole boya, srazhaytes s mekhanoidami protivnika i nablyudayte za rezultatom: dramatichnymi stsenami srazheniy, vdokhnovlennymi yaponskoy animatsiey devyanostykh.

RAZMEShchAYTE VOYSKA
Zovite na pomoshch podkrepleniya s orbity, vybiraya boevye edinitsy massovogo proizvodstva s unikalnymi boevymi umeniyami. Sobirayte otryady, chtoby vesti ikh v boy i vselyat strakh v serdtsa vragov. Protivniki zadrozhat ot strakha, kogda uvidyat vnushitelnuyu mekhanicheskuyu bronyu vtorogo pokoleniya, nosit kotoruyu mozhet tolko voenachalnik.

SRAZhAYTES
Nakladyvayte otritsatelnye effekty, razmeshchayte lovushki, podderzhivayte soyuznikov. Vse vidy mekhanicheskoy broni snabzheny osobym snaryazheniem i obladayut unikalnymi umeniyami, kotorye pozvolyat vam napast na protivnika, primenyaya razlichnye sposoby borby. 

KAMPANIYa
WARBORN prokhodit v sisteme Auros, kotoraya zakhlebyvaetsya v voyne i politicheskikh intrigakh. Poka fraktsii voyuyut drug s drugom, nablyudayte za proiskhodyashchim s tochki zreniya chetyrekh raznykh voenachalnikov. Pered vami razvernetsya syuzhetnaya kampaniya s bolee chem 40 zadaniyami.

REZhIM SKhVATOK I M/P REZhIM
Nastroyte parametry matcha i razrabotayte novuyu taktiku, sorevnuyas v rezhime skhvatok s II. Takzhe vy mozhete vyyti v set i popytatsya perekhitrit voenachalnikov protivnikov so vsego mira v napryazhennykh matchakh odin na odin.

REDAKTOR KART
Khotite dat volyu fantazii? Sozdavayte sobstvennye polzovatelskie karty s pomoshchyu vstroennogo redaktora kart. Igrayte na svoikh kartakh v rezhime skhvatok, chtoby ispytat svoi sily v boyu s kompyuterom, ili priglasite druzey i sygrayte na sobstvennoy karte po seti.
Названная в честь популярнейшего развлеч:
Nazvannaya v chest populyarneyshego razvlecheniya v vo vsem alternativnom Londone, Circus Electrique obedinyaet syuzhetnuyu rolevuyu igru, strategiyu i upravlenie tsirkom v uvlekatelnoe stimpank-priklyuchenie. Obychnye zhiteli Londona ni s togo ni s sego prevratilis v zlobnykh ubiyts, i lish talantlivym artistam Circus Electrique pod silu ostanovit eto sumasshestvie. Nevidannaya prezhde sistema predannosti v Circus Electrique budet vliyat ne tolko na povedenie artistov v boyu, no i na tsirkovye vystupleniya v pereryvakh mezhdu geroicheskimi pokhozhdeniyami v shesti rayonakh.

Nesmotrya na nizkiy status, u Taokhua est sobstvennaya lichnaya spalnya, ona nikogda ne khodit v tserkov s drugimi slugami, i redko kogda s kem svyazyvaetsya. Eyo otchuzhdyonnyy, pochti koshachiy kharakter vkupe s neobychnym vidom, glazami, i imenem, porodili ne odin i ne dva slukha v shropshirskoy okruge o tom, chto ona mozhet byt vedmoy. Sonic the Hedgehog (yap. ソニック・ザ・ヘッジホッグ Sonikku dza Khedzikhoggu, russ. «Yozh Sonik») — vosmibitnaya videoigra-platformer, vypushchennaya korporatsiey SEGA v 1991 godu, pervaya v odnoimyonnoy serii dlya 8-bitnykh pristavok tretego pokoleniya Sega Master System i portativnoy Game Gear. Po syuzhetu zlodey igry, doktor Robotnik, stremitsya zakhvatit ves mir, a glavnyy geroy, yozh Sonik sobiraetsya narushit plany zlogo uchyonogo. Igroku predlagaetsya proyti ryad urovney, sobiraya po puti zolotye koltsa s izumrudami khaosa, atakuya vragov.
Sonic the Hedgehog dlya SMS byla razrabotana yaponskoy kompaniey Ancient Corp. po zakazu SEGA, i dovolno silno otlichaetsya ot svoego 16-bitnogo predshestvennika. 8-bitnaya versiya poluchila polozhitelnye otzyvy ot kritikov. Posle eyo vykhoda Sega polnostyu prekratila podderzhku konsoli Master System v Severnoy Amerike.Sonic the Hedgehog 2 (8 bit) yavlyaetsya sikvelom 8-bitnoy Sonic the Hedgehog. Po syuzhetu zlodey doktor Robotnik na glazakh u Sonika pokhishchaet Teylza, i yozh speshit na pomoshch drugu. Igrovoy protsess Sonic the Hedgehog 2 prakticheski ne podvergalsya kardinalnym izmeneniyam i identichen svoemu predshestvenniku: igrok dolzhen proyti ryad urovney, sobiraya po puti zolotye koltsa i atakuya vragov.
V marte 2018-go goda Creative Araya sotovarishchi vossozdal s nulya blizkiy k originalu rasshirennyy fan-remeyk igry s uluchsheniyami, kotoryy zatem byl portirovan MDashK na Nintendo Switch. Personazhi sdelany PixelMarioXP i AnderSonicTH, dopolnitelnyy dizayn HidroGeniuns, muzyka — ValleyBell's, Akira Ishihara, McTravisYt i Nostalgic Sound.
Drugie igry o Sonic'e na Switch.
