Battle for control of the afterlife in E:
Battle for control of the afterlife in Epitaph, a competitive, fast-paced tactical game. Pick three Reapers, the aspects of death, and fight your opponent in real-time, cooldown-based combat. You'll control all three characters at once, sequencing their abilities and setting up explosive combos to decimate your opponent. But be careful - every time a Reaper dies, they come back stronger, so moving closer to victory will make your opponents even more deadly.

Fast-Paced Tactical Combat:
Epitaph’s combat is a unique mix of strategy and timing. You’ll have to outwit and outsmart your opponent in real time, planning and sequencing your abilities carefully to land devastating combos and counter your opponent’s intentions.

Battle Among Deaths:
Epitaph takes place in the afterlife, where the many faces of Death are fighting against one another in a battle for souls. There are 13 different Reapers in Epitaph's roster, and you’ll draft a team of three to fit your personal strategy. Will you take Becilla, the Commander, who charges into battle and calls her allies to her side, or Ezzim the Executioner, who relentlessly hunts down his victims with his mighty ax? Stylish abstract character designs add to Epitaph's ambiance and make it look and feel like to no other competitive game.

Death is a Strategy:
You can kill a Reaper, but in Epitaph, nothing stays dead for long. If your Reapers die six times, you’ll lose the match - but dead Reapers come back bigger and angrier, making them even more threatening. You may be down early, but are you actually on the verge of losing, or just setting up an amazing comeback for your empowered squad?

Features:
• Local Multiplayer
Capture the souls of your friends in intense fast-paced tactical combat.
• 13 Unique Reapers
There's a reaper for every kind of player, from the brutal, in-your-face style of Unch, The Glutton, to the evasive and supportive strategies of Ziyan, the Martyr.
• Single-Player Puzzle Mode
If you’re looking for a more individual challenge, try and solve over 150 puzzles in a single set of moves, ranging from introductory and informative to devilishly hard.

Tribal Pass – это сложный тактический ра:
Tribal Pass – eto slozhnyy takticheskiy ranner s upravleniem resursami i vzaimodeystviem s okruzheniem – i vse eto na begu. 

Plemya nepreryvno dvizhetsya po vrazhdebnoy zemle, vstrechaya pregrady i rasteniya, raznoy stepeni opasnosti zhivotnykh i lyudey. Igrok reagiruet na eti vstrechi, razbivaya plemya na gruppy, vooruzhaya ego kopyami i fakelami, – delaya vse, chtoby lyudi byli zhivy, a edy bylo vdovol.

Prosim uchest, chto eto deystvitelno RANNER (pravda, takogo rannera vy eshche ne vstrechali) – nikakikh ostanovok, poka solntse ne syadet i zabeg ne konchitsya.

Zabegi stroyatsya protsedurno i ne zhaleyut novykh igrokov, no v itoge vse zavisit ot vashego sobstvennogo masterstva i znaniy o tom, chto vstretitsya vam na puti, a vovse ne ot raboty generatora.
RISE: Race The Future is a racing game s:
RISE: Race The Future is a racing game set in a near future where a new kind of wheel technology will let you drift on all type of terrains and especially on water. 

Game content
- 60 FPS
- 2 Player Mode
- 64 Challenge races with multiple goals
- 8 Championships (64 races)
- Time Attack with ghost
- 10 cars (with 3 decals and 5 colors per car)
- 4 worlds (with 3 track types : fast, intermediate, twisty / 16 combinations per world)
- 4 ambiances per world (day, sunset, rain, fog...)
- 3 boost modes
- 5 camera views
- 4 difficulty levels
- approx. 40 km / 25 miles of road

“Precision drifts, jumps and water zones"
The unique gameplay defined as "precision drifting" will suit every player looking for technical and precise controls combined with the immediate fun and ease of an arcade game.

“Wide and technical tracks"
Natural environments are enriched and reimagined to create technical racetracks mixing multi-paths water zones and jumps. Inspired by retro arcade rally games the wide surfaces let the player enjoy long powerslides.

“New boost system"
Players can master different techniques for overtaking and exiting a corner thanks to the combination of several boost systems which set the game appart from usual rally games.

“The most addictive racing gameplay"
The vehicle dynamics is based on realistic physics tweaked to enhance the player's drifting ability. The result makes the handling extremely natural, smooth and precise for the most rewarding driving experience.

“Unlock futuristic race cars"
In addition to the arcade and championship mode, a challenge mode will let the player unlock the futuristic racing cars exclusively designed by Anthony Jannarelly.

Всем нам надоели эти стандартные миры, н:
Vsem nam nadoeli eti standartnye miry, nabitye fenteziynymi klishe: otvazhnymi rytsaryami, zhenopodobnymi elfami i karlikami, oderzhimymi strastyu k zolotu i brilliantam. Tipichiya — sovershenno inoy mir. K schastyu, tut est zlobnye varvary, chtoby bylo komu grabit, nasazhivat golovy na kopya, pit pivo i nepristoyno vyrazhatsya — v obshchem, chtoby zhizn ne davala skuchat. I znaete chto? Ikh vozglavite vy!

Vernites v te dalekie dni, kogda vykhodili potryasayushchie strategii v realnom vremeni. No na sey raz vam ne pridetsya tratit tselyy chas na odnu stychku. Srazu v boy — stryakhnite pyl so svoikh strategicheskikh i takticheskikh navykov, chtoby sokrushit sotni vragov za paru minut! Crush Your Enemies — eto vse, chto vy lyubite v strategiyakh: planirovanie, shirokiy vybor yunitov razlichnykh tipov, upravlenie resursami, zakhvat vrazheskoy territorii i vozmozhnost perekhitrit protivnika neobychnym postroeniem otryadov. No vse eto strategicheskoe bogatstvo tak zdorovo upakovano, chto vam obespecheny zakhvatyvayushchie vpechatleniya nezavisimo ot togo, skolko vremeni u vas naydetsya na igru.

Osobennosti igry

- Polnotsennaya strategiya v kompaktnom formate: na vsekh urovnyakh vam budut predlozheny neochevidnye strategicheskie resheniya, no proyti urovni mozhno ochen bystro.
- Ochen prostoe upravleniya: ne smotrya na slozhnuyu strukturu igry, dlya upravleniya budet dostatochno odnogo kontrollera Joy-Con™.
- Grandioznaya odinochnaya kampaniya: igra predlagaet mnogo chasov naslazhdeniya strategiey v odinochnom rezhime.
- Setevoy i lokalnyy multipleer: igrayte s druzyami i blizkimi. Bitva ne dolzhna zakanchivatsya!
- Raznye tipy yunitov: u kazhdogo iz nikh svoya rol na pole boya.
- Trofei: iskusno primenyayte osobye predmety, kotorye pri umelom ispolzovanii mogut perelomit khod bitvy.
- Bitvy s neobychnymi bossami: srazhalis li vy kogda-nibud s Gigantskim Sliznem, kotoryy obozhaet bodatsya? Net? Tak chego zhe vy zhdete?
- Syuzhet, polnyy sochnogo yumora: vasha mamochka ne pereputaet etu igru s ee lyubimym poiskom skrytykh predmetov v srednevekovoy derevne!
- Nasilie, pivo, rugan: khvatit slov...

-Car and combat upgrades

Игра Conglomerate 451: Overloaded уже до:
Igra Conglomerate 451: Overloaded uzhe dostupna!
Vstrechayte rolevoy kiberpank «rogalik», osnovannyy na issledovanie podzemeliy ot pervogo litsa.

Vy — generalnyy direktor spetsialnogo agentstva. Pravitelstvo goroda Konglomerat poruchilo vam vernut kontrol nad sektorom 451, gde seychas vedut voynu prodazhnye korporatsii. Blagodarya posledney popravke v konstitutsiyu vy mozhete ispolzovat chelovecheskie klony. Podbirayte personal, redaktiruyte DNK, obuchayte agentov, ekipiruyte ikh samym peredovym oruzhiem i osnashchayte kiberprotezami, a potom otpravlyayte na zadaniya radi odnoy tseli: likvidirovat prestupnost i vosstanovit zakonnyy poryadok.

Upravlenie resursami
Rukovodite sobstvennym nauchno-issledovatelskim otdelom dlya razrabotki peredovykh tekhnologiy, otkryvayushchikh dostup k novym funktsiyam, preimushchestvam i variantam prokhozhdeniya.

Bolshe chem protezy
Vy mozhete ne tolko uluchshat oruzhie i bronyu svoikh agentov, no i vzhivlyat v ikh tela raznoobraznye kiberimplantaty, radikalno izmenyayushchie ikh sposobnosti.

Sistema boli i travm
Dazhe melkie tsarapiny ne vsegda zazhivayut bez posledstviy. Lyuboy uron, poluchennyy vashim agentom v boyu, mozhet zakonchitsya neizlechimoy travmoy.

Syuzhetnyy i beskonechnyy rezhimy — vybor za vami!
V syuzhetnom rezhime vas zhdet nasyshchennaya sobytiyami borba s prodazhnymi korporatsiyami i ikh propagandoy. V beskonechnom rezhime igra budet postoyanno stavit pered vami novye zadachi, trebuyushchie resheniya.

Osobennosti i mutatsii
Vashi agenty mogut priobretat osobennosti i mutatsii kak polozhitelnogo, tak i otritsatelnogo svoystva.

Uluchsheniya i rasstroystva
Priobretayte uluchsheniya, chtoby vremenno usilit svoikh agentov. No! Vy riskuete «nagradit» ikh mentalnymi rasstroystvami.

Protsedurnye kiberpodzemelya
Nepovtorimye rayony zadaniy, generiruemye protsedurnym metodom, obedinyayut cherty podzemeliy iz rolevykh igr s vysokotekhnologichnoy atmosferoy budushchego.

Smert v igre
Lyuboe zadanie mozhet okazatsya poslednim. Tshchatelno obdumyvayte kazhdyy shag: esli vash agent pogibnet v boyu, vy uzhe ne smozhete vernut ego.

Vzlomayte ves mir!
Vo vremya zadaniy vy mozhete vykhodit v kiberprostranstvo i poluchat preimushchestva, vzlamyvaya tsifrovye resursy protivnika.
Хиган — бывший ниндзя, который сбежал от:
Khigan — byvshiy nindzya, kotoryy sbezhal ot svoego klana v Soedinyonnye Shtaty, gde obzavyolsya semyoy i poselilsya v otdalyonnoy derevushke. Odnazhdy nochyu byvshie «kollegi» napadayut na dom Khigana i ubivayut ego vmeste s zhenoy i rebyonkom. Ochnuvshis v morge, Khigan reshaet zhestoko otomstit...
Po motivam ekshn-anime! Igrayte za ten po imeni Tsukumo, prokladyvaya sebe put skvoz ordy prispeshnikov, smertonosnykh nindzya, raskryvaya istoki istorii, no budte ostorozhny s tem, komu vy doveryaete: vasha zhizn bukvalno mchitsya, a chasy otschityvayut sekundy do kontsa.
На дворе 1996 год, и до Рождества остало:
Na dvore 1996 god, i do Rozhdestva ostalos vsego chetyre dnya. Rebekku, sezonnogo sotrudnika GLDB, vernuli, chtoby ona pomogala otvechat na zvonki po telefonu doveriya v eto napryazhennoe i smertelno opasnoe vremya goda. Vo vremya prazdnikov poyavlyaetsya mnogo novykh strannykh bytovykh opasnostey, i nekotorye iz nikh mogut oznachat konets vsego, chto nakhoditsya nad i pod zemley. Dobro pozhalovat obratno v GLDB.
Goryachaya Liniya Domashney Bezopasnosti — eto «analogovyy» khorror pro vas, telefonnogo operatora, gde vy budete otvechat na voprosy zvonyashchikh vam o tom, kak spravitsya s opasnostyami v ikh dome. Oznakomtes s obshirnym katalogom rasprostranennykh vrediteley i bytovykh opasnostey i sdelayte vse vozmozhnoe, chtoby stat ekspertom v oblasti domashney bezopasnosti. Vy budete nesti otvetstvennost za to, chto proizoydet.
My vse rasschityvaem na tebya, Rebekka.
Eta versiya igry dlya Nintendo Switch uzhe vklyuchaet v sebya predustanovlennoe DLC «Seasonal Worker».Drugie khorrory ot Puppet Combo.
1873 год - времена беззакония и жестокос:
1873 god - vremena bezzakoniya i zhestokosti na Dikom Zapade. Ty sbezhal s katorgi i napravlyaeshsya v Tekhas. No derzhi pushku nagotove, ved za tvoyu golovu obyavlena krupnaya nagrada i naemniki poydut na vse, chtoby ostanovit tebya.


Vysokaya slozhnost:
Puli razletayutsya v storony, a beschislennye vragi ne razdumyvayut pered vystrelom.

Autentichnoe oruzhie:
Ispolzuy realnoe oruzhie, chtoby dostich svoikh tseley. Vintovka, dvustvolnoe oruzhie, revolver, luk i dazhe pulemyot sistemy Gatlinga.

Lokatsii:
Realnye goroda - San-Antonio, Albukerke i Khyuston, indeyskie poseleniya, dukh pustyni i samye otchayannye banditos peredayut atmosferu nastoyashchego Dikogo Zapada.

Vybor stilya:
Stels-elementy dayut tebe pravo vybora, ved ne vsegda est zhelanie riskovat svoey zhiznyu. Bolshuyu chast igry mozhno proyti, ostavayas nezamechennym. Put vybiraesh tolko ty.

Zakhvatyvayushchaya istoriya:
Bolee shesti chasov syuzhetnoy kampanii o puteshestvii sbezhavshego meksikanskogo katorzhnika, kotoryy boretsya za vyzhivanie i svobodu v seredine XIX veka v Soedinennykh Shtatakh.
Исполните великую миссию в Bravely Defau:
Ispolnite velikuyu missiyu v Bravely Default II dlya Nintendo Switch — vosstanovite ravnovesie mira vmeste s Geroyami sveta!

Peresekite pyat korolevstv so svoim otryadom, naydite kristally i vernite ikh na zakonnoe mesto. Zvezdy pomogut vam otkryt dostup k zadaniyam i sposobnostyam, kotorye neobkhodimy dlya srazheniy s mnogochislennymi monstrami. Primenyayte komandy Brave (Khrabrost) i Default (Bezdeystvie), chtoby soblyudat khrupkoe ravnovesie mezhdu riskom i nagradoy za bitvu!
2080-ый год. В Эджик-Сити ты — совершенн:
2080-yy god. V Edzhik-Siti ty — sovershenno chuzhoy: neskolko dney nazad vas spasli na plyazhe, gde vy poteryali vsyo, dazhe svoi sobstvennye vospominaniya. Chelovechek, kotoryy vas spas — Darsi, vot uzhe 30 let vladelets edinstvennogo v gorode odnoimyonnogo lombarda «Darsi». On naznachil vas menedzherom svoego mutnogo zavedeniya, dav vam imya svoego pochivshego syna, Boba.
Odnako, eto vesma i vesma mrachnoe mesto. Lyudi, kazhetsya, ne znayut, kak rasskazyvat o svoikh myslyakh i chuvstvakh, a mozhet byt, oni chto-to skryvayut. Kazhetsya, chto pochti vse iz nikh oderzhimy, v polozhitelnoy ili otritsatelnoy forme, chem-to pod nazvaniem «Fixerain». A nekotorye iz nikh, v tyomnoy uniforme nazyvayut sebya grazhdanskimi aktivistami — a vse ostalnye nazyvayut ikh khunveybinami.
Добро пожаловать в полный приключений и:
Dobro pozhalovat v polnyy priklyucheniy i opasnostey mir Radiation City!
 
Otpravsya v kropotlivo vossozdannyy gorod Pripyat cherez sorok let posle katastrofy na Chernobylskoy atomnoy elektrostantsii. Raskroy vse tayny etogo mesta, chtoby uznat pravdu i spasti svoyu lyubimuyu.
 
Uchti, budet neprosto. Ogromnyy otkrytyy mir igry kishit opasnostyami i anomaliyami. Golodnye khishchniki i chelovekopodobnye sushchestva zhazhdut tvoego myasa. Eto krasivoe, no stol negostepriimnoe mesto teper vo vlasti radiatsii i raznykh neobyasnimykh fenomenov. Stoilo li tebe syuda zabredat? Net, no inache bylo nelzya.
 
Ishchi resursy v razlichnykh zdaniyakh, v tom chisle v dostoprimechatelnostyakh Pripyati: gostinitse "Polese", dvortse kultury, kinoteatre "Prometey", basseyne i zabroshennykh mnogoetazhkakh. Sozdavay i vybiray podkhodyashchee snaryazhenie. Nakhodi zashchishchennye stoyanki, chtoby perezhit noch. Pomni, vse vokrug — vragi, i tolko snaryazhenie, oruzhie i transport — tvoi druzya.
 
Udachi!
DEAD IN VINLAND — это игра на выживание/:
DEAD IN VINLAND — eto igra na vyzhivanie/upravlenie poseleniem s elementami rolevoy igry i priklyucheniy semi Vikingov, pytayushchikhsya vyzhit na zagadochnom ostrove. Eta versiya True Viking idet v komplekte so vsem vypushchennym zagruzhaemym kontentom!

Vam predstoit napravlyat Eyrika, izgnannogo iz svoey semey v dalekie i neizvedannye kraya, v ego borbe za vyzhivanie. Upravlyayte ego fizicheskim i dushevnym zdorovem, issleduyte ostrov, obustraivayte lager i nalazhivayte svyazi s drugimi zhitelyami. Nekotorye iz nikh pomogut vam, drugie okazhutsya menee... druzhelyubnymi. Proleyte svet na ezotericheskie tayny Vinlanda. Oni mogut spasti vam zhizn... ili svesti v mogilu.
Eta versiya True Viking vklyuchaet 3 zagruzhaemykh dopolneniya k Dead In Vinland: The Valhund, Battle of the Heodenings i Norse Side Stories.

OSNOVNYE OSOBENNOSTI
Prorabotannyy simulyator vyzhivaniya: nakhodite i sobirayte resursy, popolnyayte zapasy edy, zabottes o dushevnom i fizicheskom zdorove svoikh personazhey, borites s boleznyami i ranami, raspredelyayte vodnye resursy, vstupayte v protivostoyanie so stikhiyami (shtormy, zasukhi, dozhdi...).

Vyzovy: poshagovaya igra daet vremya na prinyatie resheniy, no tsena oshibki budet vysoka! K krizisam, odin za drugim podbrasyvaemym igroy, pridetsya adaptirovatsya, iskhodya iz sobstvennoy logiki.

Valkhund! Zavedite v lagere psa, kotoryy vo mnogom pomozhet vashim personazham.

Rezhim Kheodeninga: beskonechnyy rezhim vyzhivaniya-pesochnitsy, pozvolyayushchiy nastraivat iskhodnuyu gruppu geroev i dazhe navyki i kharaktery personazhey!

Vybirayte, kak igrat! Tri standartnykh urovnya slozhnosti (priyatnyy otpusk, vyzhivanie i ekstremalnye usloviya), a eshche mozhno sozdavat sobstvennye pravila blagodarya zadavaemym nastroykam slozhnosti! Gotovy li vy prinyat vyzov istinnykh vikingov?

Postroyte lager: rasshirte svoe ubezhishche 18 aktivnymi lokatsiyami, kazhdaya iz kotorykh imeet sobstvennuyu mekhaniku. Sozdayte bolee 130 apgreydov i desyatki predmetov, dayushchikh tsennye bonusy. Vybirayte tshchatelno, vse sozdat nevozmozhno.
Super Robot Wars — тактическая боевая RP:
Super Robot Wars — takticheskaya boevaya RPG na setke, gde roboty i piloty iz raznykh anime srazhayutsya s obshchimi vragami. Vospryante, obedinites i pobedite!
Razmeshchayte boytsov strategicheski i komanduyte imi tak, chtoby oni oderzhivali verkh!
Na uluchshenie robotov i obuchenie pilotov nuzhny kredity i resursy, vydayushchiesya za vypolnenie kazhdogo zadaniya. V chasti Super Robot Wars Y poyavilas sistema Assist Link, pozvolyayushchaya personazham, obychno derzhashchimsya v teni, uchastvovat v boyu i narashchivat silu. Delayte geroev silnee, chtoby im byla po plechu lyubaya zadacha!
Vas zhdut neveroyatnye velikie bitvy, gde srazyatsya roboty i piloty iz serialov. Otpravlyaytes v novoe priklyuchenie s bogatym syuzhetom v mire Super Robot Wars!..
Automachef — это головоломка и менеджер:
Automachef — eto golovolomka i menedzher resursov. V etoy igre vam predstoit meblirovat kukhni, programmirovat ustroystva i nablyudat, kak ozhivaet vash genialnyy povar. Stroyte kukhni budushchego uzhe seychas!

Planiruyte. Razmeshchayte. Programmiruyte. Stroyte avtomatizirovannye restorany, zatem programmiruyte ikh, chtoby oni rabotali, kak otlazhennye mekhanizmy! Vy schitaete, chto spravites s lyuboy zadachey, i znaete, kak zavoevat mir avtomatizirovannykh restoranov? Togda za delo!

Slozhnye golovolomki. Reshayte zaputannye prostranstvennye golovolomki, stsenarnye zadachi i problemy s upravleniem resursami. Nedostatochno khot-dogov? Vy razberetes! Na kukhne pozhar? Dlya cheloveka s intellektom eto ne problema! 

Neskolko slozhnykh intellektualnykh rezhimov. Prokhodite urovni kampanii, prokladyvayte put v mire biznesa v rezhime kontraktov ili okunites v testovyy rezhim i igrayte, poka ne nasytites.

More ocharovaniya i strannovatyy yumor. I vsyo eto blagodarya bespomoshchnomu rasteryavshemusya glavnomu geroyu: Robertu Individu. On tochno chelovek. Ne zadavayte voprosov.
В этой доработанной версии игры Pressure: V etoy dorabotannoy versii igry Pressure Overdrive ty vnov okuneshsya v bezumnyy mir s yumorkom i chudakovatymi personazhami. Zdes tvoe masterstvo prigoditsya kak nikogda — nosis kak ugorelyy, taran vsekh podryad i probivaysya pod gradom pul cherez nesmetnye polchishcha vragov. Sobiray svoy baggi pod raznuyu taktiku igry i poprobuy sygrat vmeste s drugom v lokalnom rezhime. «Lya-Protest» rasschityvaet na tebya! Ne podvedi zhe.
Собирайте свою колоду, выигрывайте оружи:
Sobirayte svoyu kolodu, vyigryvayte oruzhie i predmety v avtomate, srazhaytes s vragami, a takzhe otkryvayte moshchnye navyki i sozdavayte iz nikh neveroyatnye kombinatsii, kotorye pomogut probitsya cherez podzemele!..
Ishchite novye predmety i dobavlyayte ikh v avtomat-kleshnyu, chtoby zatem sozdavat silneyshie kombinatsii. Zarabatyvayte zolotye monety, chtoby uluchshat i preobrazovyvat predmety vo chto-to novoe i poleznoe. Vam pridetsya ispolzovat vse tuzy v rukave, chtoby dobratsya do logova zlogo khozyaina podzemelya i vernut ukradennuyu lapku.
Вы - неназванный морской пехотинец США,: Vy - nenazvannyy morskoy pekhotinets SShA, kotoryy sbroshen s vozdukha na tropicheskiy ostrov vo vremya sverkhsekretnoy missii, chtoby ostanovit zlogo doktora Khellmana, kotoryy planiruet vypustit svoyu armiyu zombi po vsemu miru. Vmeste s Uinstonom i Dzhuliey vasha missiya sostoit v tom, chtoby proniknut v sostav Khellmana i spasti chetyrekh vashikh tovarishchey i pomeshat doktoru Khellmanu vypolnit ego plan.
Сражайся с безжалостными врагами и побеж:
Srazhaysya s bezzhalostnymi vragami i pobezhday zhestokikh bossov — kazhdoe prokhozhdenie otlichaetsya ot predydushchego. K tvoim uslugam ogromnyy vybor oruzheynykh mekhanik i nerealnoe chislo modifikatsiy. Desyatki vidov oruzhiya, predmetov, moduley i uluchsheniy dlya personazha.

TAKAYa STRELBA TEBE I NE SNILAS
> V SYNTHETIK tebe predstoit osvoit unikalnuyu sistemu izvlecheniya magazina i aktivnoy perezaryadki!
> Oruzhie mozhet zaklinit i peregretsya. Ne obozhgis!
> Pri strelbe na khodu otdacha rastyot — nauchis eyo kontrolirovat. Menyay vidy patronov v goryachke boya.
> Prokachay vladenie oruzhiem i strelyay s bezuprechnoy metkostyu professionala!
> My pervymi dobavili khedshoty v shuter s vidom sverkhu — vot tak!

EKSPERIMENTIRUY
Naydi svyshe 85 vidov oruzhiya. U kazhdogo vida kucha modifikatsiy, usiliteley i apgreydov! Popolni arsenal — tebya zhdut 125 predmetov, chtoby po-novomu atakovat i zashchishchatsya. Riskuy, otkroy dlya sebya massu variantov — kazhdyy iz nikh mozhet srabotat!

NAYDI SVOY STIL
Igray za odin iz 8 klassov: strazha, shturmovika, snaypera, assasina, nalyotchika, tyazhyologo pekhotintsa, inzhenera ili razrushitelya. Kazhdyy klass — eto unikalnyy boevoy stil. U kazhdogo klassa svoyo oruzhie, snaryazhenie i navyki, plyus umeniya, kotorye mozhno nastroit. Posle smerti geroya ves progress sokhranyaetsya!

KONSTRUKTOR UROVNYa SLOZhNOSTI
11 modifikatorov slozhnosti, iz kotorykh mozhno sobrat lyubuyu kombinatsiyu. Riskuy po polnoy — i poluchish bolshe nagrad. Ili ostorozhnichay.
В городе, полном супергероев, прибытие к:
V gorode, polnom supergeroev, pribytie k mestu prestupleniya - samo po sebe sorevnovanie. K schastyu, po puti est dostatochno raket, bomb, kryukov-koshek, shipov i drugikh prelestey. Dobro pozhalovat v SpeedRunners!

SpeedRunners - sorevnovatelnyy platformer dlya 4-kh igrokov, s kryukami-koshkami usileniyami i interaktivnymi obektami. Begite, prygayte, letayte na kryukakh, strelyayte raketami, prityagivayte igrokov - delayte vsyo, chtoby oni vybyli.
Они жуткие, они странноватые, и таинстве:
Oni zhutkie, oni strannovatye, i tainstvennyy gost khochet zakhvatit ikh zloveshchiy osobnyak! Tolko vy i vashi druzya mozhete pomoch Uenzdi, Pagsli, Gomesu i Mortishe Addams spasti semeynyy osobnyak Addamsov v etom novom veselom priklyuchencheskom 3D-platformere dlya 1–4 igrokov.

Issleduyte samye temnye glubiny osobnyaka i volshebnye tayny, kak nikogda ranshe, chtoby raskryt sekrety i spasti legendarnyy dom. Ispolzuyte osobye sposobnosti kazhdogo znakovogo personazha, takie kak mazurka s sablyami Gomesa ili domashniy osminog Uenzdi Sokrat, chtoby reshat golovolomki i nakhodit relikvii, raskryvayushchie neveroyatnuyu istoriyu osobnyaka. Igrayte s druzyami i protiv nikh v sorevnovatelnykh mnogopolzovatelskikh mini-igrakh, v kotorykh vy budete tolkat i pereprygivat drug druga dlya pobedy. Vecher semeynykh igr skoro stanet uzhasayushche zakhvatyvayushchim!

Eto strakh, eto uzhas, eto lyubimyy dom! Skoree soberites vmeste i spasite semeynyy osobnyak Addamsov, chtoby zhutko veselo provesti vremya!
When a talented roboticist goes missing,:
When a talented roboticist goes missing, archaeologist Aliya Elasra and her robot assistant Six are sent onto the rivers of the Nebula to find him. Their search soon has them piecing together an ancient trail of artefacts, inscriptions, and lost knowledge that leads thousands of years into the past...

From the creators of the award-winning "80 Days" comes an engrossing narrative adventure with an entire hieroglyphic language to decipher. Sail the massive open world of the Nebula, tracking down distant moons. 

Translate inscriptions written in an ancient language, in a massive interlocking puzzle where every solution - right or wrong - becomes part of your story. 

* "EXCEPTIONAL" - Wired 

Meet, charm, outwit, and befriend a diverse range of characters who remember everything you say and do. Will you make friends, or enemies? 

Unearth the Nebula's buried history in a fluid, ever-changing story that adapts in real-time around your actions and your choices. 

Explore sites in any order you want. Dig as deep as you choose. Heaven's Vault is adventure game filled with secrets - but where you can never get stuck.

* "EXQUISITE" - PC Gamer

Every player's journey through the Nebula will be different, and New Game Plus mode enables further adventures, harder translations, and deeper exploration into the mysteries of the Nebula. 

* Golden Joysticks GOTY 2019 Nominee
* TIGA RPG of the Year 2019 Nominee

The Nintendo Switch™ edition of Heaven's Vault is the definitive version, containing over 3,000 words to decipher, a main story lasting 20+ hours, fifteen worlds, and thousands of secrets.

Will you uncover the path to Heaven's Vault?
Dead Dungeon это хардкорный 2D платформе:
Dead Dungeon eto khardkornyy 2D platformer v luchshikh traditsiyakh klassicheskikh igr, s otlichnym chiptyun saundtrekom. Igra proverit vashi nervy na prochnost i prineset massu emotsiy.

O syuzhete:
U Vas byla bezzabotnaya zhizn poka ne yavilsya zlodey i ne lishil Vas sladostey zabrav dushi u vsego zhivogo. Teper Vam trebuetsya otpravitsya v trudnoe puteshestvie, chtoby vernut vse dushi i sladosti iz tainstvennogo podzemelya.

Osobennosti:
-Khardkornyy geympley 
Postepenno narastayushchaya slozhnost i obuchenie igre bez nadoedlivykh tutorialov, tolko blagodarya stroeniyu urovney - kak v starye dobrye vremena.

-Prostaya i krasivaya grafika
Prostoy graficheskiy stil budet priyaten glazu, a kvadratnye sprayty pridut po dushe lyubitelyam kvadratnykh spraytov.

-Otlichnyy saundtrek
Originalnyy chiptyun saundtrek, napisannyy spetsialno dlya igry avtorom HateBit izvestnym po igre Dungeon Escape i drugim.

-Obilie zagadok i paskhalok
Nalichie zagadok i paskhalok sdelayut igru eshchyo interesnee i zagadochnee.

-Nostalgicheskie chuvstva
Приготовьтесь бегать, прыгать, сражаться:
Prigotovtes begat, prygat, srazhatsya i issledovat! Sun Wukong VS Robot — eto pikselnaya mini-retro-igra v stile metroidvaniya, vdokhnovlennaya klassikoy «staroy shkoly».

Sun Wukong ochnulsya. Nash geroy okazyvaetsya v tsentre mekhanicheskogo labirinta i derzhit v rukakh legendarnoe oruzhie.

Odnako ego po-prezhnemu sderzhivaet «blokirator uma», nadetyy emu na golovu. Chtoby polnostyu vernut sebe svobodu, Wukong dolzhen pobedit chetyrekh robotov.

Kharakteristiki
* Klassicheskaya mekhanika platformerov.
* Razblokiruyte sposobnosti, ispolzuya ochki opyta.
* 3 uluchshaemykh navyka.

Super Mario World, v Yaponii izvestnyy kak Super Mario Bros. 4, Su:pa: Mario Va:rudo: Su:pa Mario Buradza:dzu Fo: — platformer, vypushchennyy kompaniey Nintendo dlya Super Nintendo Entertainment System (SNES) v 1990 godu. Proizvodstvom igry zanimalas studiya Nintendo Entertainment Analysis and Development pod rukovodstvom Sigeru Miyamoto i Takasi Tedzuki; igra voshla v startovuyu lineyku igr SNES.
..Po syuzhetu, Mario i Yoshi dolzhny spasti Stranu Dinozavrov (angl. Dinosaur Land) ot tiranii Bouzera — glavnogo antagonista serii. Mario i ego bratu, Luidzhi, predstoit puteshestvie cherez sem mirov, v kontse kazhdogo iz kotorykh oni dolzhny pobedit bossa. Igrovoy protsess Super Mario World skhozh s predydushchimi igrami franshizy. Odnako poyavilis novye, uvelichivayushchie sposobnosti glavnogo geroya, bonusy, kotorye byli pereneseny v posleduyushchie igry serii. V Super Mario World vpervye poyavilsya dinozavr Yoshi, sputnik i skakun glavnogo geroya vo mnogikh posledovavshikh igrakh s uchastiem Mario.
Igra byla teplo vstrechena kritikami i imela ogromnyy uspekh sredi geymerov, stav bestsellerom — po vsemu miru bylo prodano bolee 20 millionov kartridzhey. Soglasno prodazham, Super Mario World zanimaet pervoe mesto sredi vsekh igr, vypushchennykh dlya SNES, mnogie profilnye izdaniya nazyvali eyo odnoy iz luchshikh igr v istorii. Blagodarya svoey populyarnosti, Super Mario World byla portirovana na razlichnye igrovye platformy neskolkikh pokoleniy i vkhodila v sostav mnogochislennykh sbornikov.
V razdache nakhoditsya Switch-versiya dekompilirovannogo porta originalnoy igry s assemblera W65C816S na yazyke C, vypolnennyy komandoy snesrev.

Attention: The dark and twisted themes of My Lovely Daughter are a commentary on child labor, abusive parenting, and ignorant societies. This game is intended to make people sad and uneasy but there is a deeper meaning behind the horror. 

My Lovely Daughter is inspired by the hardships experienced by members of our team growing up. The game is designed to upset and disturb you.

My Lovely Daughter is a game about overcoming the loss of a loved one through forbidden alchemy experiments ... and murder. You are Faust, an amnesiac alchemist and father, who wakes up alone and confused only to discover that your lovely daughter has died. As you enter the first stages of grief, you do what everyone wishes they could do but can’t: bring back the dead with the power of alchemy.

To revive your daughter, you must perform forbidden alchemy experiments to restore her soul. You will have to create dozens of homunculi, raise them as if they were your own daughter, build relationships with them ... and then murder them to harvest their souls!

To support your experiments, you will also need to assign jobs to your homunculi, even sacrifice their bodies in order to sell their remnants, all to keep your income flowing and your research progressing. Perhaps, along the way, you will even recover your own memories and come to understand how this terrible situation came about.

Features:
- A dark, twisted story about love and family.
- Dozens of “daughters” to raise, each with their own traits and characteristics.
- Simulation-based gameplay that directly impacts the story.
- Unique art style emphasizing the dark theme of the game.
- High replay value with multiple endings, secrets to unlock, and letters to collect.
- Gothic-style soundtrack inspired by the immersive world of My Lovely Daughter.

Endurance - это приквел Ailment (еще одн:
Endurance - eto prikvel Ailment (eshche odna nauchno-fantasticheskaya piksel art igra strelyalka s syuzhetom).

Syuzhet igry
Endurance rasskazhet vam istoriyu, kotoraya proizoshla do sobytiy v Ailment (Vam ne obyazatelno igrat v Ailment do Endurance). Vy uchenyy na kosmicheskom korable pod nazvaniem Endurance, i odnazhdy chleny vashego ekipazha, vashi druzya zarazhayutsya kakoy-to boleznyu, stanovyatsya bezumnymi i nachinayut vesti sebya kak zombi. Vasha tsel - vyzhit na etom kosmicheskom korable i vyyasnit, chto sluchilos s komandoy, razobratsya kak eta bolezn ili infektsiya rasprostranilas vokrug etogo kosmicheskogo korablya Endurance, a takzhe spasti vashikh druzey, popavshikh v bedu, i ne dat im zabolet etoy boleznyu. Vy budete srazhatsya so svoey byvshey komandoy, kollegami i druzyami, poskolku oni khotyat Vas ubit, vy budete pomogat svoim druzyam, kotorye vse eshche v zdravom ume i eshche ne zarazilis, i budete pytatsya vyzhit v etoy smertonosnom adu ispolzuya raznoobraznye pushki.

Atmosfera igry
U Endurance, kak i u ee cikvela Ailment, fantasticheskaya atmosfera v retro stile staroy shkoly, tak kak eto pikselnaya igra, a takzhe indi igra. V nem takzhe est elementy khorora i inogda pugayushchie momenty, chto delaet syuzhet  bolee privlekatelnym i inrtiguyushchim. Vam opredelenno ponravitsya prokhodit eto priklyuchenie. Khot Vy i nakhodites na kosmicheskom korable, Vy vse ravno okunetes v eti urovni sdelannye v stile rolevykh igr i rogalikov. A takzhe eta priklyuchencheskaya strelyalka takzhe soderzhit ssylki na nauchno-fantasticheskie filmy.

Personazhi
V etom prikvele Ailment Vy okunetes v temnuyu atmosferu i pri etom tochno polyubite zhivykh i razgovorchivykh personazhey, ikh zabavnye shutki i khoroshiy yumor, kotorye nemnogo razbavlyayut etot khoror i mrachnuyu atmosferu, chtoby vy rasslabilis i prigotovilis vstupit v boy v sleduyushchikh khardkornykh skhvatkakh s zarazhennymi i bezumnymi vragami.

A teper prosto, chtoby podvesti itog vsekh zamechatelnykh fich Endurance:
* Tonny raznogo oruzhiya
* Razlichnye igrovye mekhaniki
* Brutalnye animatsii
* RPG elementy 
* Atmosfernaya muzyka i zvukovye effekty khorora

* Zhivye i razgovorchivye personazhi

* Priklyuchencheskiy syuzhet

Pravila, ispolzuemye v Blobby Volley, vzyaty iz standartnykh pravil voleybola. V otlichie ot nastoyashchego sporta, dvizheniya igrokov ogranicheny dvukhmernym prostranstvom ekrana, granitsy ekrana deystvuyut kak nevidimaya stena, ot kotoroy myach otskakivaet, a poskolku na kazhdoy storone polya nakhoditsya tolko odin igrok, razresheno, v otlichie ot standartnogo voleybolnogo myacha kasatsya myacha neskolko raz podryad.
Igra zakanchivaetsya, kogda odin iz dvukh igrokov nabiraet 15 (ili bolee) ochkov, a takzhe imeet preimushchestvo v dva ochka nad drugim. Ochki mozhet nabrat tolko igrok, podayushchiy myach. Poetomu kazhdyy iz igrokov pytaetsya zastavit drugogo sovershit oshibku, chtoby oni mogli podavat i nabirat ochki.

Proyavite svoyu nepokolebimost v polnom izdanii, kotoroe obedinyaet Chasti 1, 2 i 3 v odnom nabore. Prozhivite istorii Dzheka i Karen ot nachala do samogo vzryvnogo kontsa.

Chast 1:
 V pervoy chasti vy igraete za Dzheka Kattera — ottsa, kotoryy izo vsekh sil pytaetsya sokhranit semyu. A eshche on vsegda gotov pomoch sosedyam po rodnomu Greyvillyu. Issledovaniya, provodimye na raspolozhennoy nepodaleku voennoy baze, pridayut gorodu oreol zagadochnosti. Mestnye zhiteli predpochitayut derzhatsya ot bazy podalshe. Dela priobretayut neozhidannyy povorot, kogda odin iz eksperimentov idet ne po planu i zonu zakryvayut na karantin. Tem vremenem nekaya tainstvennaya zhenshchina presleduet begletsa…

Chast 2:
Igrayte za Karen — raschetlivuyu ubiytsu, kotoraya okhotitsya na zagadochnuyu devushku v otdalennom gorodke Greyville. Zhizni nemnogochislennykh mestnykh zhiteley tesno perepleteny mezhdu soboy, i chem blizhe vy k tseli, tem bolshe zaputyvaetes v sotsialnoy pautine. Prostaya zadacha «nayti i unichtozhit» prevrashchaetsya v koshmar, ot kotorogo Karen ne smozhet prosnutsya.

Chast 3:
V tretey chasti vy mozhete vybirat mezhdu Dzhekom i Karen. V finalnom epizode serii vskroyutsya krovavye vnutrennosti Greyvillya. Vam pridetsya prinyat bolee 200 resheniy, kazhdoe iz kotorykh povliyaet na razvitie syuzheta, poetomu vybirayte obdumanno. Chto vazhnee: spasti chelovechestvo ot vspyshki zombi-infektsii ili pozabotitsya o sebe i svoikh blizkikh? Net nepravilnogo otveta. Tolko pomnite, chto kazhdyy sleduyushchiy shag mozhet privesti vas na kray propasti.
Гомез – это двумерное существо, живущее: Gomez – eto dvumernoe sushchestvo, zhivushchee v dvumernom mire. Uznav o sushchestvovanii zagadochnogo tretego izmereniya, Gomez otpravilsya v puteshestvie, kotoroe privedet ego na samyy kray prostranstva i vremeni. Ispolzuyte svoyu sposobnost orientirovatsya v trekhmernom mire po chetyrem storonam sveta s pomoshchyu dvumernykh proektsiy. Issleduyte prekrasnyy bezoblachnyy mir, polnyy tayn, zagadok i skrytykh sokrovishch. Raskroyte tayny proshlogo i otkroyte istinu, stoyashchuyu za realnostyu i vospriyatiem. Smenite svoyu tochku zreniya i vzglyanite na mir po-drugomu.
Взгляните в лицо кошмарам, которые вы ра:
Vzglyanite v litso koshmaram, kotorye vy ranshe schitali dosuzhim vymyslom. Vospolzuytes logikoy i karmannym fonarikom, chtoby uznat, kak i pochemu propala vasha sestra. Pribegnite k pomoshchi somnitelnykh druzey, chtoby uznat strashnuyu taynu, — vam pridyotsya prinimat nelyogkie resheniya, chtoby vyzhit. Sdelannyy vami vybor opredelit vashu sudbu i uchast lyudey vokrug vas.

Eta zloveshchaya istoriya dopolnyaet otmechennuyu nagradami igru Spirit Hunter: Death Mark. Vash dom perestal byt bezopasnym pristanishchem — ispugannye dukhi ne tolko vtorgayutsya na ulitsy i v gorodskie parki, no i posyagayut na zhilishcha lyudey. Pogruzites v atmosferu strakha blagodarya zloveshchim shumam i zapominayushchimsya kartinam khudozhnika Fumii Sumio.

\"Серия Turrican была создана компанией:
"Seriya Turrican byla sozdana kompaniey Factor 5 eshche v 1990 godu. Pervye dve igry iz etoy podborki, Turrican i Turrican 2, byli vypushcheny na Amiga i polozhili nachalo naslediyu izvestnoy serii. Obyazatelnaya igra dlya lyubogo fanata retro-igr! Super Turrican vyshla v 1992 godu s novym razvitiem nekotorykh osnovnykh osobennostey serii. Igroki teper takzhe mogut oznakomitsya s versiey Super Turrican Director’s Cut, kotoraya dobavlyaet novyy kontent s rasshireniem sushchestvuyushchey stseny i dobavleniem odnogo sovershenno novogo dopolnitelnogo urovnya. Poslednyaya igra v sbornike Turrican Anthology Vol. 1, novaya Mega Turrican Score Attack postavlyaetsya s dopolnitelnym urovnem, zavershayushchim etot polnyy priklyucheniy turrikanskiy opyt! 

Sensatsionnaya seriya Turrican byla otmechena kak novatorskaya seriya videoigr, sochetayushchaya v sebe issledovatelskiy opyt s neprekrashchayushchimsya ekshnom i odnim iz luchshikh saundtrekov k videoigram, sozdannym legendarnym nemetskim kompozitorom Krisom Khyulsbekom. 

Igrayte v istoriyu luchshikh momentov Turrican i otkryvayte dlya sebya novye, dopolnitelnye funktsii!

Super Haxagon — открытый и свободный кло:
Super Haxagon — otkrytyy i svobodnyy klon igry Super Hexagon dlya Nintendo Switch.
Super Hexagon — nezavisimaya igra v zhanre Action/Arcade, razrabotannaya Terri Kavana, sozdatelem VVVVVV na dvizhke Adobe Flash. Igra byla vypushchena 31 avgusta 2012 goda, sozdana na osnove dvenadtsatichasovogo geymdzhema.
V Super Hexagon igroku predstoit upravlyat nebolshim treugolnikom, kotoryy mozhet vrashchatsya vokrug tsentralnogo shestiugolnika (angl. «Hexagon»). Tselyu igry yavlyaetsya izbezhanie kontakta treugolnika s nadvigayushchimisya «stenami». Esli igrok stalkivaetsya s peredney storonoy odnoy iz etikh sten (kasaniya bokovykh storon razresheny), to igra zakanchivaetsya. Posle togo, kak igrok proigraet, emu pokazhut ego vremya vyzhivaniya za poslednyuyu popytku, a takzhe ego luchshee vremya na etom urovne. Vse rekordy otslezhivayutsya na doske liderov. U igry est urovni slozhnosti: nabor «normalnykh» rezhimov — Hexagon, Hexagoner i Hexagonest — i nabor «giper»-versiy predydushchikh urovney, kotorye otkryvayutsya posle 60 sekund vyzhivaniya v «normalnykh» rezhimakh.
Сатирический битэмап для 4-х с элементам:

Igra sleduet istorii globalnoy pandemii, okhvativshey mir i ignoriruemoy fanatikami, ne veryashchimi v realnost etoy bolezni. Glavnye geroi, zashchishchennykh perchatkami i maskami, dolzhny razobratsya s etimi neveruyushchimi i reshit situatsiyu — dlya ikh zhe bezopasnosti!
ABZÛ — это красочное приключение в подво: ABZÛ — eto krasochnoe priklyuchenie v podvodnom mire, gde vam predstoit zanimatsya dayvingom. Pogruzites v zhivopisnyy mir okeana, polnyy zagadok i yarkikh krasok. Otkroyte unikalnye vidy zhivotnykh i sozdayte moshchnuyu svyaz s morskimi zhitelyami. Pogruzites v samoe serdtse okeana, gde drevnie sekrety lezhat v zabvenii. Budte ostorozhny, v morskikh puchinakh vas zhdet opasnost. Nazvanie «ABZÛ» vzyato iz drevnikh mifologiy. «AB» oznachaet «voda», a «ZÛ» oznachaet «znat». ABZÛ — eto okean mudrosti.

Встречайте старых знакомых — сержанта Ко:

Chesterfield) i kaprala Blatcha (Blutch): vas zhdet remaster igry, v kotoroy pokhodovaya strategiya sochetaetsya s dinamichnymi srazheniyami v realnom vremeni. Eta versiya poraduet poklonnikov originalnoy igry, vyshedshey na Amiga v 1980-kh godakh!

Stante masterom pokhodovoy strategii, chtoby oderzhat pobedu. Zakhvatyvayte novye shtaty, uderzhivayte forty i zheleznye dorogi, chtoby nakaplivat resursy, i vedite v boy podkrepleniya, kotorye pribyvayut iz Evropy. Otkroyte dlya sebya v pervyy raz ili perezhivite zanovo vse vpechatleniya ot originalnoy igry The bluecoats North and South v odinochku ili v rezhime dlya dvukh igrokov. V etoy obnovlennoy versii vas zhdet pererabotannyy igrovoy protsess.

Vy mozhete byt novichkom ili opytnym igrokom v strategii — etu igru vy mozhete nastroit pod sebya, aktiviruya razlichnye optsii.
Prokhodite razlichnye epizody grazhdanskoy voyny v SShA, vybrav god, v kotorom nachnetsya igry. Vy mozhete sokhranit status-kvo — ili perepisat khod istorii!

Osobennosti:

3 razlichnykh rezhima igry:

  – Pokhodovaya strategiya na karte: komanduyte operatsiyami i vedite svoi batalony, chtoby zakhvatyvat novye shtaty, atakovat vragov i ukreplyat svoi pozitsii.

  – Bitvy v realnom vremeni: otpravlyaytes na pole boya i srazites s vragom litsom k litsu. Ispolzuyte pekhotu, kavaleriyu i artilleriyu, chtoby oderzhat pobedu. Polzuytes silnymi storonami kazhdogo roda voysk, chtoby sokrushit protivnika.

  – Atakuyte i zashchishchayte forty v rezhime shutera ot pervogo litsa. Etot polnostyu peredelannyy rezhim pozvolit vam sygrat rol odnogo iz soldat. Zashchishchayte svoi pozitsii ot zakhvatchikov ili perekhvatite initsiativu, atakovav vraga.

Forager — eto 2D-igra s otkrytym mirom, vdokhnovlennaya mekhanikoy issledovaniya, fermerstva i sozdaniya predmetov.

- Ishchite, sobirayte i khranite resursy.

Mobsters, monsters, and mysteries — welc:
Mobsters, monsters, and mysteries — welcome to Shadows Over Loathing, the shady side of an already black-and-white world, and a follow-up to the award-winning West of Loathing.

Your Uncle Murray has requested your aid at his antique shop in Ocean City, but upon your arrival the old man is nowhere to be found. Your investigation into his disappearance and the artifacts he’s been collecting takes a turn when you stumble across some shadowy plots (and a bunch of squirming eldritch tentacles) that threaten to bring about the end of the world.

Explore a sprawling open world chock full of danger, quests, puzzles, and stick figures in this single-player comedy adventure/RPG set in the prohibition era of the Loathing universe. See how many enemies you can stuff into a phone booth as the athletic Pig Skinner, control the curds and whey of the cosmos as the cunning Cheese Wizard, or march to the beat of your own inscrutable purposes as the hip Jazz Agent.

Features:
Thousands and thousands of jokes, gags, and goofs
A bunch more locations, items, friends, foes, and familiars than West of Loathing
The same quality line art you’ve come to expect, but way more of it
Superior stick-figure customization
Strategic turn-based combat (but only if you want it)
A corrupt government for you to overthrow at your leisure
Authentically baffling 1920s slang
Multiple cursed antiques
Inappropriate fishing
Non-Euclidean horrors from beyond the edges of the screen
A time-travel side-quest given to you by your future-self
An infinitely tall building
Sentient math, talking frogs, and pettable cats
No booze, as far as the feds know
Вы – искусственный интеллект, ведущий од:
Vy – iskusstvennyy intellekt, vedushchiy odinokogo ksenobiologa po tainstvennomu inoplanetnomu okeanu. Izuchayte nevoobrazimykh sushchestv v raznoobraznykh mestakh obitaniya cherez unikalnyy interfeys i raskryvayte sekrety istorii etoy planety. Kakie otkrytiya sdelaete vy vmeste?

ISSLEDUYTE INOPLANETNYY OKEAN: Svobodno peremeshchaytes mezhdu lokatsiyami i otkryvayte novye territorii vdali ot protorennykh trop. Eti otkrytiya dadut uluchsheniya i obraztsy, kotorye zatem pomogut popast v novye zony uzhe issledovannykh lokatsiy, proyti dopolnitelnye kvesty i otkryt unikalnye dialogi s Elleri.

POSMOTRITE NA MIR GLAZAMI II: Upravlyayte elegantnym intuitivnym interfeysom s pomoshchyu kasaniy ili myshi. Schityvayte signaly, vybirayte marshrut i sostavlyayte kartu okeana s pomoshchyu intuitsii i eksperimentov.

STANTE KSENOBIOLOGOM: Otkryvayte i katalogiziruyte vidy, nablyudayte, skaniruyte, berite proby i vzaimodeystvuyte s inoplanetnoy zhiznyu. Chitayte zametki Elleri, smotrite ee zarisovki i pomogayte ey klassifitsirovat absolyutno neznakomuyu ekosistemu.

PLANIRUYTE POGRUZhENIYa: Vybirayte, kogda izuchat sushchestv, a kogda rassledovat tayny ili nyryat v novye zony. Zatem vozvrashchaytes na bazu, chtoby izuchit vzyatye obraztsy v laboratorii, pogovorit s Elleri ili prochest ee dnevniki, chtoby bolshe uznat ob etom mire.

STROYTE KREPKIE OTNOShENIYa: Polzuyas ogranichennymi sredstvami obshcheniya, uznayte bolshe o cheloveke, v chem akvalange vy zhivete, i pomogite ey prinimat slozhnye resheniya. Sovmestnye perezhivaniya sblizyat vas.
Мир бокса у вас в кармане: динамичный и:
Mir boksa u vas v karmane: dinamichnyy i bezumno uvlekatelnyy simulyator sportivnogo menedzhera. Uproshchennyy interfeys i bolee ponyatnaya sistema prinyatiya resheniy obespechivayut bolee korotkie igrovye sessii v komfortnom tempe i bez lishnego ozhidaniya.

Nanimayte luchshikh boytsov i personal, chtoby poluchit vseobshchee obozhanie i odobrenie. Nablyudayte, kak vashi boytsy pobezhdayut na ringe ili zhe... otpravlyayutsya v nokaut.

Ofitsialnoe prodolzhenie populyarnoy igry 1991 goda World Championship Boxing Manager™, v kotorom sokhranyaetsya dukh originala i razvivaetsya novaya istoriya. Uluchshennaya grafika, bolee produmannyy geympley i novye personazhi, kotorye prodolzhayut franshizu World Championship Boxing Manager™. World Championship Boxing Manager™ 2 poraduet kak davnikh poklonnikov, tak i novykh igrokov. Otpravlyayte na ring vymyshlennykh personazhey ili proydite karernyy put legendarnykh boytsov, sredi kotorykh Rokki Marchiano, Shugar Rey Robinson i mnogie drugie!

Napishite svoyu istoriyu boksa

Pomogite svoim boytsam proyti put ot samogo niza do priznaniya i slavy. Formiruyte raspisanie ikh trenirovok i vydelyayte dni na otdykh; obespechivayte im silovye i kardionagruzki, chtoby podderzhivat ikh v idealnoy forme. Ishchite mnogoobeshchayushchikh novichkov, nanimayte luchshiy personal, reklamiruyte poedinki i povyshayte reputatsiyu boksyorov. Pomozhete luchshim boytsam ostavatsya v idealnoy forme — oni privedut vas k uspekhu. No esli ne spravites — vmeste otpravites v nokaut.

Pogruzites v budni luchshego boksyorskogo menedzhera.

Eto bolshe chem bitva

U kazhdogo boytsa svoya istoriya i unikalnyy opyt, chto zastavlyaet ikh vsyakiy raz podnimatsya snova i byt silnee s kazhdym udarom. Probivayte dorogu derzkim novichkam ili proydite neveroyatnyy karernyy put legendarnykh boytsov v tyazhyolom vese. V syuzhetnom rezhime World Championship Boxing Manager™ 2 vy smozhete pogruzitsya v eti istorii.

Porkhat kak babochka

Reshili otkryt dlya sebya simulyatory? Lyubite ekonomicheskie simulyatory, no ishchete chto-to bolee dinamichnoe i podkhodyashchee dlya translyatsiy? Udobnyy interfeys i sistema menedzhmenta v World Championship Boxing Manager™ 2 pozvolit bystro pogruzitsya v igru. Lish neskolko klikov, i vashi boksyory treniruyutsya ili byutsya na ringe.
Feel the thrill of horror mixed with a d:
Feel the thrill of horror mixed with a dose of humor, beauty, ugliness, and weirdness in the surreal world of Earthworms - brought to Nintendo Switch™ specially for you to delve into! Play as Daniel White, a private detective endowed with parapsychic abilities, and solve investigations with the help of his visions. GINSHA - это уникальный атмосферный прик:
GINSHA - eto unikalnyy atmosfernyy priklyuchencheskiy platformer s pikselnoy grafikoy i osoboy mekhanikoy Gravity Shield i Dash. Ona sochetaet v sebe universalnuyu platformernuyu osnovu s elementami RPG, Souls i Crafting i yavlyaetsya anomaliey sredi igr zhanra Metroidvania. Issleduyte ogromnye vzaimosvyazannye planety, polnye sekretov, luta, prepyatstviy, razlichnykh tipov vragov i epicheskikh bossov. Povyshayte uroven, ekipiruyte i nastraivayte svoego klona, sozdavayte dronov-kompanonov i naslazhdaytes postoyanno razvivayushchimisya vozmozhnostyami po mere togo, kak vy budete spasat svoy vid.

Issleduyte 6 razlichnykh planet i naydite svoy sobstvennyy put k spaseniyu svoego vida. Kazhdoe reshenie imeet znachenie i vliyaet na vashe okruzhenie i karmu dlya novykh vozmozhnostey i kontsovok. Zavodite novykh druzey ili vragov na svoem puti, nakhodite epicheskoe snaryazhenie i otkryvayte novye puti.

Vybirayte iz mnozhestva vidov oruzhiya i kombiniruyte navyki, umeniya v tire i gravitatsionnyy shchit, chtoby osvoit bystro razvivayushchuyusya boevuyu sistemu GINSHA. Zashchishchaytes ot podavlyayushchikh sil protivnika i srazhaytes na zemle, v vozdukhe, pod vodoy i v kosmose v sotnyakh slozhnykh usloviy.

Vybirayte dobro ili zlo v unikalnoy istorii GINSHA "Chuzhaya para" i pogruzites v epicheskoe puteshestvie, dvizhimoe voznagrazhdeniem za issledovanie. Igrayte za dvukh inoplanetnykh sushchestv "Dzhin" i "Gon" i raskroyte taynu nashey umirayushchey planety v dalekom budushchem.

Vstrechaytes i vzaimodeystvuyte s neizvestnymi formami zhizni, izuchayte novye yazyki, zavodite novykh druzey ili vragov. Vashi resheniya imeyut znachenie i okazhut ogromnoe vliyanie na budushchee vashego vida. Naydite skrytye oblasti vnutri skrytykh oblastey, paskhalnye yaytsa i legendy nauchnoy fantastiki 80-kh...

Vash klon osnashchen skanerom, kotoryy pozvolit vam skanirovat vse, chto vy naydete v svoem puteshestvii. Sobrannye dannye budut khranitsya vo vnutriigrovoy viki i mogut byt ispolzovany dlya razblokirovki obnovleniy, sozdaniya usovershenstvovannogo snaryazheniya i sozdaniya i modelirovaniya sobstvennykh mirov, kogda vy poluchite dostup k betaversu.
In Roller Drama, you (Joan) live with &:
In Roller Drama, you (Joan) live with & coach five kickass athletes: Anne, Portia, Lily, Cordelia, and Juliet. Together they form a top Roller Derby team, a full contact sport on quad skates!

Your job is to act as a keeper of the team, managing both their personal and professional lives. Try to balance everyone’s emotions as they navigate rivalries, friendships, and love.

REAL-TIME FULL-CONTACT SPORT!
While personal dramas rage on, you’ll also need to manage Roller Derby matches in real time! Plan strategies, give orders, and manage the match using arcade-inspired controls.

SURVEILLANCE
Roller Drama is set in a dystopian alternative world where things are going… slightly worse than they are here. Political and environmental upheavals interfere with daily life.

KEY FEATURES
- Interactive narrative with meaningful choices (100!) and multiple endings
- Vivid, explorable universe
- Replayable narrative and matches: every championship is unique, several different endings
- Replay a specific chapter
- Real-time roller derby matches
- Coach a team of five athletes with wildly different personalities
- Hand drawn character art by award winning illustrator Vic Macioci
- Play with controller or mouse + keyboard

Note: this is not a Roller Derby simulator: match gameplay is inspired by Roller Derby but it then defines its own kind of game.

Not just the looks of a classic game, al:
Not just the looks of a classic game, also the gameplay of a classic platformer. This game is NOT EASY! you have an endless amount of lives, so you can quickly restart a level when you miss a jump, get hit by an enemy, get bitten by a plant, get hit by a spiky-ball, crushed by big statues, run onto spikes, get hit by a wasp, or any of the other many ways you'll get stopped in your run.


BUT when you do complete a level, the rush you get will keep you coming back for more, and more, and more, and.. 

Unlock special temple levels by finding hidden keys, unlock a flip-mode by completing a level both within the time set, and also by collecting all the coins in a level.

Indygo tells the story of a painter who:
Indygo tells the story of a painter who suffers from depression. One of the symptoms is proceeding isolation. The main character hasn’t left his room for more than 3 months. The person who helps him live through this hard time is his girlfriend Anna. It became obvious for both of them, that this situation can’t last forever. The time has come to look for a solution. It’s up to the player to decide how the story will progress.

Features:
- Deep, melancholy atmosphere thanks to high quality handmade art and originally composed soundtrack.
- Intriguing story evolving at every subtle, seemingly trivial decision.
- Engaging narrative with multiple endings depending on the decisions made by the player.
- Unique, ever-changing room which reacts to the mental state of the main character.

Povestvovatelnyy kvest v mire, gde vospominaniya tuskneyut i smeshivayutsya. Igra o pomutnenii rassudka i o tom, chto byvaet, kogda ot vas uskolzaet vsyo, chto vy delali, i vse, kogo vy lyubili.
Pode — это приключенческая игра с элемен:
Pode — eto priklyuchencheskaya igra s elementami golovolomok. Eto istoriya o kamne i upavshey zvezde, kotorye vmeste reshayut drevnie zagadki i puteshestvuyut po nezabyvaemomu miru, vdokhnovlennomu norvezhskoy kulturoy i iskusstvom.
Osnovnye osobennosti:
Puteshestviya. Otpravlyaytes v put po drevnim peshcheram i raskryvayte ikh sekrety odin za drugim, chtoby dostich svoey tseli.
Golovolomki. Vas zhdut raznoobraznye golovolomki, zagadki i tayny. Dlya preodoleniya prepyatstviy ponadobyatsya sposobnosti oboikh personazhey.
Sovmestnyy i odinochnyy rezhim. Igrayte vmeste s drugom ili samostoyatelno.
Unikalnyy stil. Mir igry vdokhnovlen norvezhskoy prirodoy i traditsionnym iskusstvom.
Королевство в опасности, и лишь старейши:
Korolevstvo v opasnosti, i lish stareyshiy i mudreyshiy volshebnik mira yavlyaetsya siloy, sposobnoy sderzhat zlodeya, che imya neizvestno. Tri geroya, opirayas na mnozhestvo silnykh soyuznikov, kotorye prisoedinyatsya k missii dlya zashchity korolevstva, otpravlyayutsya na poiski Drevnego, chtoby pomoch emu v borbe s tainstvennym uzhasom.

Srazhaysya s merzkimi tvaryami i monstrami vsekh sortov na svoem puti po raznym ugolkam korolevstva. Ot Velikogo Lesa, naselennogo kovarnymi goblinami i neuklyuzhimi trollyami, do vysokikh Utesov Otchayaniya, gde ty povstrechaesh zlobnykh garguliy i neuderzhimykh kamennykh golemov. Poznakomsya s otvazhnymi i silnymi geroyami etogo mira i dalekikh prostranstv i vremen. Kazhdyy iz nikh privneset v srazheniya sobstvennye unikalnye sposobnosti, moshchnye zaklinaniya i razrushitelnoe oruzhie. Volshebniki, voiny, drakony i demony, samurai i kolduny gotovy otpravitsya v puteshestvie i vstupit v boy.

Battle Hunters predlagaet tvoemu vnimaniyu unikalnuyu boevuyu sistemu, kotoraya sochetaet elementy strategicheskogo upravleniya geroyami i ekshen v realnom vremeni. Ispolzuy osobye sposobnosti i predmety dlya vyzhivaniya, vybiray podkhodyashchie momenty dlya ataki, oborony ili otstupleniya. Kazhdyy sdelannyy vybor imeet reshayushchee znachenie, kogda rech idet o porazhenii ili pobede. Priklyuchenie, sozdannoe s oglyadkoy na klassiku, no s novym podkhodom k vedeniyu boya, klassam personazhey i ikh sposobnostyam.

Chego zhe ty zhdesh? Vybiray geroev, pobezhday v boyu, spasi korolevstvo.
A world controlled by darkness.\nIn game:
A world controlled by darkness.
In game, the darkness constantly advances from the left side of the screen, swallowing up the map. If you are swallowed by the darkness, it's game over. You cannot turn back.

The screen will continue to scroll right even while shopping or fighting enemies. You must keep advancing and save the world. In One Way Heroics, if the player moves or attacks enemies will do the same.

In essence, it is a rogue-like game.
To clear the game, you must defeat the Demon Lord, who will appear after a set time. One round is around 30 minutes play time, and some parts of your legend carry over into the next round. See if you can overcome the challenges of this one way adventure.

Features:

・Controls optimized for Nintendo Switch.
・Eleven classes to choose from for your player character.
・Allies and NPC's which aid your character.
・Over 260 items.
・9 different endings.
・Replay function to play back your adventures.
Grim Fandango (с англ. — «Мрачное фандан:
Grim Fandango (s angl. — «Mrachnoe fandango», ispanskiy narodnyy tanets, ispolnyaemyy v pare pod penie fandango v soprovozhdenii gitary i kastanet) — videoigra v zhanre graficheskogo kvesta, sozdannaya i vypushchennaya v 1998 godu dlya Windows kompaniey LucasArts pod rukovodstvom amerikanskogo geymdizaynera Tima Sheyfera.
Mir «Grim Fandango» predstavlyaet iz sebya neobychnuyu smes idey atstekskikh mifov i legend o zagrobnoy zhizni, a takzhe depressivno-pessimistichnogo stilya klassicheskiikh proizvedeniy zhanra «film-nuar» — «Maltiyskiy sokol», «Kasablanka» i «V portu».
Usurper – это экшн-RPG в стиле Metroidva:
Usurper – eto ekshn-RPG v stile Metroidvania. Zloveshchaya Tsitadel vysvobodila drevnie uzhasy, i teper vy dolzhny ochistit London ot chudovishch i pobedit Navigatora! Imperatritsa Eleonora, nedavno vernuvshaya sebe koronu, sobrala korolevskie voyska, a takzhe chetyrekh svoikh samykh predannykh rytsarey, chtoby voyti v Tsitadel, raskryt ee tayny i izbavit London ot monstrov. Tem vremenem Valtkhem, pravitel Veymara, idet vverkh po Tsitadeli so svoimi voyskami, chtoby brosit vyzov ee khozyainu Navigatoru, presleduya... lichnye tseli...

In ancient times of war in the Far East, the lands of Exilia were overrun by creatures of the night and samurais. Amidst this cruel conflict, only a bloodthirsty cursed knight can bring hope and vanquish the darkness.

Key features

Levels

Explore 8 levels of classic linear design, each featuring challenging obstacles and enemies to overcome. At the end of each level, you'll face off against a powerful boss that will put your skills to the test. And as Gabriel, you'll receive an extra skill after defeating each boss, allowing you to progress even further and take on greater challenges.

Gameplay Variety

Experience a range of mechanics, from throwing weapons to melee combat, down stabs, jumping, and dashing. Unlock the powers of Gabriel's curse to enhance your abilities. Play as both Gabriel and Lyria, each offering a unique and distinct gameplay experience for endless replayability.

Plus, once you've beaten the game with Gabriel, unlock two additional game modes: Speedrunner mode and Boss Rush mode. And the best part? You can play both of these modes with either Gabriel or Lyria for even more variety and fun!

Retro-aesthetic and sound design

Relive the glory days of classic gaming with retro-inspired 16-bit physics and perfectly polished controls. The game's stunning handcrafted 8-bit pixel art and fast anime-style animations, the 8-bit SFX and OST, enriched with sounds from the Megadrive sound chip, complete the immersive retro experience.

RIOT – Civil Unrest — это долгожданная с:
RIOT – Civil Unrest — eto dolgozhdannaya strategiya: simulyator vosstaniy v realnom vremeni, blagodarya kotoromu igrok smozhet popast v samuyu gushchu vsemirno izvestnykh stolknoveniy. Vas zhdut sleduyushchie kampanii: Vozmushchennye (Ispaniya), Arabskaya vesna (Egipet), Kerateya (Gretsiya) i NoTAV (Italiya). Semnadtsat odnourovnevykh stsenariev privedut vas v Rim, Oklend, Parizh, London i Ukrainu. 

Leonard Menchiari, sozdatel igry RIOT – Civil Unrest, ne ponaslyshke znakom s vosstaniyami, poskolku uchastvoval v protestakh NoTAV v Italii. On sozdal etu igru, chtoby podelitsya s drugimi temi istoriyami i chuvstvami, kotorye znakomy uchastnikam protestov. Chto zastavlyaet tolpu vesti sebya tak gnevno i agressivno? Chto chuvstvuyut ofitsery politsii, stalkivayas vo vremya konfliktov s tolpoy, prevoskhodyashchey ikh chislom? RIOT — Civil Unrest daet igrokam vozmozhnost prinyat lyubuyu storonu v bitvakh, gde ne mozhet byt pobeditelya. Kto prav, a kto oshibaetsya? Igrayte v RIOT — Civil Unrest i delayte svoi sobstvennye vyvody.

Igrayte na storone politsii

•	Primenyayte razlichnye metody sderzhivaniya tolpy: kak passivnye, tak i agressivnye.
•	Upravlyayte shturmovymi i takticheskimi otryadami, a takzhe otryadami strelkov.
•	Vyzovite podmogu: politseyskie gruzoviki, vodyanuyu pushku ili dazhe tank!
•	Reshayte, budete li vy ispolzovat dymovye shashki, rezinovye i plastikovye puli ili dazhe nastoyashchie boepripasy.

Igrayte na storone protestuyushchikh

•	Davayte instruktsii protestuyushchim (vooruzhennym ili passivnym) i zhurnalistam
•	Podstrekayte narod k yarostnym napadeniyam ili popytaytes uregulirovat situatsiyu s pomoshchyu takticheskikh peregruppirovok i otstupleniy.
•	Napadayte na predstaviteley vlasti, ispolzuya kokteyli Molotova, feyerverki, bumazhnye bomby, kamni, ulichnuyu mebel i silu SMI.

Mnozhestvo rezhimov

•	Shestnadtsat urovney kampanii razdelyayutsya na chetyre stsenariya: Kerateya (Gretsiya), NoTAV (Italiya), Vozmushchennye (Ispaniya) i Arabskaya vesna (Egipet).
•	Nablyudayte za syuzhetom s obeikh storon: sygrayte na vsekh 32 urovnyakh za protestuyushchikh ili politsiyu.
•	Rezhim odinochnoy igry: igrayte protiv iskusstvennogo intellekta.
•	Rezhim protivostoyaniya: igrayte s druzyami ili protiv nikh i iskusstvennogo intellekta na odnom i tom zhe kompyutere.

Sonic Generations (yap. ソニックジェネレーションズ Sonikku Dzhenere:syondzu, s angl. — «Sonik: Pokoleniya») — videoigra serii Sonic the Hedgehog v zhanre platformer, razrabotannaya studiey Sonic Team i izdannaya kompaniey Sega v 2011 godu dlya igrovykh konsoley Xbox 360, PlayStation 3, Nintendo 3DS i PK. V Yaponii igra byla izdana pod dvumya variantami nazvaniya: versiya dlya PlayStation 3 i Xbox 360 imeet podzagolovok Shiro no Jikū (白の時空 Siro no Dziku:, «Beloe vremennoe-prostranstvo»), togda kak 3DS versiya — Ao no Bōken (青の冒険 Ao no Bo:ken, «Sinee priklyuchenie»). Yavlyaetsya smesyu igr serii Sonic the Hedgehog, kotorye byli vypushcheny dlya raznykh pokoleniy konsoley. Eyo syuzhet stroitsya vokrug peremeshcheniya nazad vo vremeni ezha Sonika i ego vstrechi s samim soboy iz proshlogo, a takzhe ikh borbe s novym vragom pod imenem Pozhiratel vremeni. Igroku predstoit vozmozhnost vybrat klassicheskogo ili sovremennogo Sonika dlya igry, stil prokhozhdeniya za kotorykh razlichaetsya. Igra za klassicheskogo Sonika nasleduet igrovuyu mekhaniku starykh igr serii, vypushchennykh v 90-e gody, v to vremya kak igra za sovremennogo Sonika napominaet takie igry serii, kak Sonic Unleashed i Sonic Colors.
Shadow Generations (yap. シャドウ ジェネレーションズ Syado Dzhenere:syondzu, s angl. — «Shedou: Pokoleniya») — videoigra v zhanre platformera, razrabatyvaemaya studiey Sonic Team i izdavaemaya kompaniey Sega. Eto vtoraya igra serii Sonic the Hedgehog, v kotoroy glavnym geroem vystupaet Yozh Shedou. Syuzhet igry razvivaetsya parallelno sobytiyam Sonic Generations i povestvuet o protivostoyanii Shedou i ego zaklyatogo vraga, Blek Duma.Eshchyo Sonic-igry.

Features the 2020 official teams, drivers, cars and schedule from the three NASCAR National Series as well as the Xtreme Dirt Tour, racing on 39 authentic tracks.

• Gameplay Enhancements – Improved AI, more player camera options and DNFs.  
• Brand-new Testing Mode – Perfect your racing lines and experiment to find the best car setup for each track.  
• Challenge Mode – Brand-new Online Challenge Mode gives you unique race scenarios to complete with a variety of gameplay.

• Multiplayer – Race online with up to 16 players or enjoy local split-screen multiplayer with a friend.  
• Paint Booth – Even more enhancements, including new number fonts and schemes.

\"Monster Prom 3: Monster Roadtrip\" fin:
"Monster Prom 3: Monster Roadtrip" finally answers the age-old question: "What if we added survival mechanics to a beloved dating sim franchise?"

Monster Roadtrip adds a twist to its predecessors Monster Prom and Monster Camp, multiplayer dating sims brimming with beautiful art and unapologetic humour.

This sequel takes you on an unforgettable road trip along with fan-favourites Scott and Polly. On the way, you will stay at crummy motels, engage in dark cult rituals, help out strangers on the road and pick up more hitchhikers than Scott can count. Bump into old friends and meet plenty of new faces on your way to one of six destinations!

Monster Roadtrip adds three difficulty levels to customise your road trip, and two different multiplayer modes: cooperate with other players or compete to see who the Ultimate Prank Master is! And if it's romance you're looking for, don't fret: we've got you covered! More than 15 characters are waiting for you on the road. Meet them, sit together by the benches at the rest stop, and hold intimate conversations that may lead to love. 

But that's not all! The XXL version includes ALL of the extra playable characters: Zoe, Juan, Hazel and Glitch!

Monster Roadtrip has everything you love about the "Monster Prom" formula, and adds new mechanics for a road trip you will remember forever! ;)

In Epistory you play the muse, a fictional character in a world where everything is untold. Your adventure begins on a blank page, but the world will soon become larger and livelier as you gather inspiration, solve its mysteries and defeat its enemies. From movement to opening chests and fighting in epic battles. 

As you progress and explore the fantasy origami world, the story literally unfolds in the writer’s mind and the mysteries of the magic power of the words are revealed.

Epistory immerses you in an atmospheric action/adventure game where you play a girl riding a giant fox who fights an insectile corruption from an origami world. As you progress and explore this world, the story literally unfolds and the mysteries of the magic power of the words are revealed.


Features:

- Every element in the game can be controlled by typing words on a external keyboard!
- Explore a beautiful paper craft world: play as the muse riding a giant three tailed fox, lost in a fantasy 3D world,
- More than just typing: solve mysterious puzzles, unlock magic powers and defeat enemies in adrenaline pumping epic combats,
- A writer’s block? Collect fragments and inspirations points to unfold the story as you explore the origami world in the writer’s head. But there is more to the story than meets the eye…
- All in same style from movements, combats to even menus, control everything with a one,

After abandoning her high-powered tech c:
After abandoning her high-powered tech career and a mysterious three-year absence, Evelyn Ishino-Aubrey resurfaces working as a proxy for a virtual counseling app called Eliza. Her job consists solely of reading a script provided to her in real-time by an AI, leaving her no autonomy over what she says. Is Eliza a technological marvel that brings therapy to those who otherwise couldn’t access it? Or is it an ineffective replacement and another vector for technology companies to gain control over our lives and humanity?

As she reconnects with people from her past and gets to know the ordinary people of Seattle who use Eliza for counseling, Evelyn finds herself caught in the middle between differing sides of the argument— and as she begins to question everything about her past life and future purpose in the world, it becomes clear she must confront the turmoil and darkness inside.

• A thought-provoking story told in the form of a visual novel from an award-winning indie team.

• Follow Evelyn’s journey through a present-day Seattle brought to life with beautiful hand-painted art.

• Get to know Eliza’s clients and the employees of Skandha, the technology giant behind it, with over a dozen fully-voiced characters and powerful performances from a highly regarded cast.

• An evocative, ambient original score by the composer for Infinifactory, SHENZHEN I/O, Opus Magnum, and EXAPUNKS.

• Is AI-driven counseling better than nothing? Is it worse than nothing? What responsibilities come with technical skills? Consider your own answers to these questions and more.

• Counseling sessions getting a little too real? Relax with Kabufuda Solitaire, a new take on solitaire using Japanese kabufuda cards.

In Gravity Rider Zero, you will be climb:
In Gravity Rider Zero, you will be climbing over obstacles, discovering trials to overcome in each level. Giant ramps, lasers, spikes, or good old gravity will try to get in your way.

Enjoy a classic solo career progression system: after 3 trails you move onto the next stage. Each of them introduces a new gimmick and every planet has a unique environment!

Collect dozens of unique racing vehicles with futuristic designs. Unlock new bikes by completing tasks, beating challenges or breaking track records: there’s always a new reward to look forward to! From trials bikes to ATVs, WW2 era motorbikes to space rockets, they're all in there. You can customize your vehicle collection too. Give your motorbike a new paint job or upgrade your kart with a neon lights trail - upgrade your style!

The controls in Gravity Rider Zero are simple and precise. Accelerate and tilt your bike in the right places to pass over obstacles faster. Brake in time to avoid traps. Always tilt after a jump to touch the ground earlier and gain more traction. Brake before a jump to minimize your air time, try and try again. Or, just focus on making sure you pass obstacles, don't crash and beat the level.

Deystvie Final Fantasy IV: The After Years razvorachivaetsya cherez semnadtsat let posle sobytiy Final Fantasy IV i opisyvayut pribytie vtoroy luny.
Proshlo 17 let s tekh por, kak Sesil i ego tovarishchi pobedili Zemusa na Krasnoy lune, i na Zemlyu vernulis mir i pokoy. Seodor, syn Sesila i Rozy, prokhodit obuchenie na korable «Krasnykh krylev» i pytaetsya spravitsya s ozhidaniyami i trebovaniyami, vozlozhennymi na nego, kak naslednika svyashchennoy krovi. Na obratnom puti iz ekspeditsii, v kotoroy Seodor dolzhen byl poluchit Dokazatelstvo o rytsarstve, «Krasnye krylya» podvergayutsya napadeniyu stai monstrov…
Final Fantasy IV: The After Years (ファイナルファンタジーIV ジ・アフターイヤーズ -月の帰還-, Fainaru Fantajī IV Ji Afutā Iyāzu - Tsuki no Kikan, bukv. «Vozvrashchenie Luny») — yaponskaya rolevaya igra, razrabotannaya i vypushchennaya Square Enix dlya mobilnykh telefonov FOMA 903i operatora NTT Docomo v 2008 godu, pryamoy sikvel igry Final Fantasy IV. Povtornye relizy mobilnoy versii v Yaponii sostoyalis 15 maya 2008 goda v EZ Web i 4 noyabrya 2008 goda v Yahoo! Keitai. Kak vyshedshaya do neyo mobilnaya igra Before Crisis -Final Fantasy VII-, The After Years imela epizodicheskuyu strukturu i predstavlyala soboy posledovatelnost iz trinadtsati glav, ili devyati istoriy v versii dlya Wii, vykhodivshikh s 18 fevralya po 24 dekabrya 2008 goda. Ispolnitelnyy prodyuser Takasi Tokita zayavil, chto dannyy sposob realizatsii byl vybran dlya togo, chtoby igroki zhdali vykhoda novykh glav, kak v sluchae s mangoy ili anime.Drugie igry serii Final Fantasy na Switch.

TowerFall – самая полная версия любимого:
TowerFall – samaya polnaya versiya lyubimogo multipleera so strelboy iz luka. Zdes est ves kontent iz Ascension i Dark World, a v pridachu eshche i dopolneniya tolko dlya Switch!

Igra TowerFall sleduet kanonam «zolotogo veka multipleera na divane» i stavit vo glavu ugla veselye i skorostnye sostyazaniya. V nee luchshe vsego igrat v shumnoy kompanii, sidya na polu i pokhlopyvaya drug druga po plechu.

Osnovnaya mekhanika prosta i ponyatna, no ovladet eyu ne tak prosto, ved tut shirochayshiy vybor variantov geympleya, urovney, usileniy i vidov strel. A kogda zakhochetsya otdokhnut ot sopernichestva, mozhno sobrat komandu ot 1 do 4 igrokov i srazhatsya s raznymi chudishchami, zlymi luchnikami i bossami.

V versiyu dlya Switch dobavleno neskolko novykh, unikalnykh osobennostey: srazheniya dlya 6 igrokov na shirokoekrannykh urovnyakh, novye vozmozhnosti geympleya, a takzhe «priglashennye zvezdy»: luchnitsa Medlin i ee zerkalnoe otrazhenie Bedlin iz polyubivshegosya igrokam platformera Celeste!

Reshayte kovarnye golovolomki, chtoby priotkryt emotsionalnuyu istoriyu Kholli i eyo druzey, istoriyu, ot kotoroy vy budete v zakhvate do samogo kontsa!
Десятилетия назад известный художник-пей:
Desyatiletiya nazad izvestnyy khudozhnik-peyzazhist byl zhestoko ubit vo vremya nochnoy raboty nad kartinoy. V khode rassledovaniya byli obnaruzheny nesootvetstviya, a glavnyy podozrevaemyy pogib pri zagadochnykh obstoyatelstvakh, pokhozhikh na samoubiystvo. Delo zakryli i so vremenem pochti zabyli.
Tridtsat let spustya vash universitetskiy klub, «Klub issledovateley tayn», reshaet vskryt starye rany, vzyavshis za eto neraskrytoe delo v kachestve issledovatelskogo proekta. Neozhidanno poyavlyayutsya novye uliki, a vy ispolzuete svoyu taynuyu sposobnost zaglyadyvat v proshloe, chtoby po-novomu vzglyanut na klyuchevye predmety i sobytiya. Ispolzuyte poluchennye znaniya, chtoby napravlyat besedy s svidetelyami i potentsialnymi podozrevaemymi. Khranite svoi sekrety, raskryvaya seriyu davno zabytykh tayn, kotorye privedut vas k nastoyashchemu ubiytse..
Misticheskaya detektivnaya vizualnaya novella deystvie kotoroy razvorachivaetsya v vymyshlennom gorodke Narumizave, gde 30 let nazad v pomeste Yamabiki byl ubit znamenityy khudozhnik Mizuru Uchida, telo kotorogo bylo naydeno ryadom s prudom v strannom sostoyanii.
V tsentre syuzheta — obychnyy student pervogo kursa Doppo Akazava, kotoryy prisoedinyaetsya k universitetskomu «Klubu issledovaniya tayn», kotorye reshayut rassledovat eto zagadochnoe delo. Kazalos by, uzhe proshlo slishkom mnogo vremeni, i raskryt delo nevozmozhno, odnako Doppo obladaet tem, chego ne bylo u togdashnikh sledovateley — sposobnostyu zaglyadyvat v proshloe…

Everything — это интерактив, наполненный:
Everything — eto interaktiv, napolnennyy vsevozmozhnymi obektami i shtukovinami, v kotorye mozhno prevrashchatsya: zhivotnye, planety, galaktiki i vsyo chto ugodno eshchyo. Naprimer, mozhno puteshestvovat mezhdu mezhzvyozdnym i mezhplanetnym prostranstvami i issledovat ogromnuyu svyaznuyu veshchestvennuyu vselennuyu, v kotoroy net navyazannykh tseley, ochkov, ili zadach, trebuyushchikh ispolneniya. Everything — eto protsedurnaya simulyatsiya prirodnykh sistem, osnovannaya na iskusstvennom intellekte, s perspektivy vsekh obektov vo vselennoy.

Everything uchit prevrashchatsya i sozdavat miry vnutri mirov vnutri mirov, razdvigat grani vremeni, i rezhissirovat neskonchaemyy dokumentalnyy film o mire, v kotorom zhivyosh.

Rasskaz, osnovannyy na vdokhnovlyayushchey filosofii Alana Uottsa, i moshchnoe zvukovoe soprovozhdenie ot Bena Lukasa Boysena usilivayut effekt Everything i raskryvayut pered zritelem novye rakursy zhizni.
Сюжет игры практически полностью повторя:
Syuzhet igry prakticheski polnostyu povtoryaet sobytiya filma «Zvyozdnye voyny: Probuzhdenie sily», ne schitaya nekotorykh izmeneniy, vnesyonnykh s tselyu razbavit povestvovanie yumorom i adaptirovat proekt pod kooperativnuyu igru dlya dvukh igrokov. Epizod VI: Vozvrashchenie dzhedaya», a imenno bitvu pri Endore, porazhenie imperatora Palpatina i unichtozhenie vtoroy «Zvezdy Smerti».
V igre adaptirovano ne tolko «Probuzhdenie sily» — takzhe prisutstvuet prolog, pereskazyvayushchiy kontsovku filma «Zvyozdnye voyny. Epizod VI: Vozvrashchenie dzhedaya», zatem bylo dobavleno neskolko urovney i personazhey, osnovannykh na filmakh i multserialakh po motivam «Zvyozdnykh voyn». V igre personazhi govoryat golosami aktyorov Deyzi Ridli, Oskara Ayzeka, Dzhona Boyegi, Adama Drayvera, Kerri Fisher, Kharrisona Forda, Entoni Denielsa, Donala Glisona, Gvendolin Kristi i Maksa fon Syudova, sygravshikh ikh v «Probuzhdenii sily»; krome togo, Bill Kipsang Rotich ozvuchil Niena Nunba, Kristian Simpson — K’ai Trenalli, a Tom Keyn, ozvuchivavshiy admirala Akbara v nekotorykh predydushchikh igrakh po motivam «Zvyozdnykh voyn», vernulsya k roli svoego personazha. V dialogakh zvuchat repliki, vzyatye neposredstvenno iz filma.Eshchyo LEGO-igry, i Star Wars na Switch.
Discover new planets, chart incredible w:

Recover stolen disks, defend probes, repair crashed craft and complete missions to earn loot and unlock awesome gear and skills. Features: 

• Discover new galaxies & explore incredible worlds
• Action-packed gameplay

• Upgrade your weapons and skills
