Peaky Blinders: Mastermind — головоломка:
Peaky Blinders: Mastermind — golovolomka-priklyuchenie po motivam teleseriala ot BBC i Netflix.

Sobytiya igry predvaryayut pervyy sezon seriala. Tommi Shelbi predstoit raskryt zloveshchiy zagovor i dokazat, chto on dostoin vozglavit «Ostrye kozyrki». 

Slovo «Mastermind» v nazvanii oznachaet «geniy prestupnogo mira». Rech idet o Tommi i ego sposobnosti planirovat stsenarii v ume. 

Kombiniruyte umeniya personazhey i navyki skrytnosti, chtoby reshat slozhnye zadachi v kratchayshee vremya.

NA OSNOVE SERIALA
Upravlyayte Tommi, Arturom, Polli, Dzhonom, Eydoy i Finnom v znakomoy obstanovke: vas zhdut pab «Garnizon», sklady Charli Stronga, dom Shelbi i drugie mesta.

LIDER TOMMI
Odin iz «Ostrykh kozyrkov» zameshan v ubiystve kitayskogo torgovtsa opiumom. Tommi nameren dokopatsya do istiny. Postepenno on stanovitsya nastoyashchim ideynym vdokhnovitelem bandy.

PRESTUPNYY GENIY
Primenyayte sposobnost Tommi planirovat v ume slozhnye stsenarii, upravlyaya osnovnymi chlenami klana Shelbi i koordiniruya ikh deystviya.

VLAST NAD VREMENEM
Deystviya kazhdogo personazha avtomaticheski zapisyvayutsya v khronike, kotoruyu mozhno svobodno perematyvat, dobivayas sovershenstva plana.

SKRYTNOST I STRATEGIYa
Kazhdoe zadanie slozhnee predydushchego i trebuet punktualnosti i nezametnosti. Vybirayte podkhodyashchikh personazhey i sposobnosti, chtoby splanirovat i voplotit optimalnyy stsenariy.
2048 — JavaScript-пазл, написанная в мар:
2048 — JavaScript-pazl, napisannaya v marte 2014-go goda 19-letnim italyanskim razrabotchikom Gabriele Chirulli. Igrovoe pole imeet formu kvadrata 4x4. Tselyu igry yavlyaetsya poluchenie plitki nominala «2048», khotya pri zhelanii mozhno prodolzhit dalshe; kod igry polnostyu otkryt po razreshitelnoy litsenzii Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT).
Igra «2048» byla napisana menee chem za dva dnya v kachestve uprazhneniya v programmirovanii; po slovam avtora, privedyonnym gazetoy Los Angeles Times, Chirulli poschital svoyo tvorenie «sluchaynym vtorzheniem v igrovuyu industriyu» i ne planiruet v dalneyshem zanimatsya razrabotkoy igr. Proobrazom «2048» yavlyaetsya kommercheskaya igra Threes.
Po podschyotam, maksimalnoe kolichestvo ochkov, kotoroe mozhno nabrat pri nailuchshem khode igry — 3 932 100 (pri etom kazhdaya vypavshaya «4» umenshaet etu otsenku na 4. Maksimalnyy vozmozhnyy nominal plitki na standartnom pole 4kh4 sostavlyaet 131 072, na pole m*n maksimalnyy nominal plitki — 2(mn+1). Zadacha polucheniya zadannoy konfiguratsii po pravilam 2048 na bolshem pole yavlyaetsya PSPACE-polnoy; zadacha opredeleniya dostizhimosti zadannogo chisla iz tekushchey konfiguratsii na doske m*n yavlyaetsya NP-slozhnoy.
V razdache predstavlen eyo originalnyy khoumbryu-port s pomoshchyu nx.js.
В Epic Chef вы примеряете на себя роль З:
V Epic Chef vy primeryaete na sebya rol Zesta, kotoryy otpravlyaetsya v kulinarnoe puteshestvie, chtoby vyrastit, smasterit i prigotovit sekret uspekha, dostoynogo legend.

Sozdavayte izumitelnye blyuda!
Blagodarya dinamicheskim retseptam vy mozhete eksperimentirovat s tysyachami kombinatsiy produktov, chtoby poluchit unikalnoe menyu, polnoe voskhititelnykh vkusnostey.

Povarskie poedinki!
Broste vyzov sopernikam v sedobnykh srazheniyakh i uznayte, kto iz vas dostoin zvatsya kulinarnym korolem! Blyuda otsenivayutsya po raznym parametram, i ni u odnoy pary zhyuri ne okazhetsya odinakovykh vkusov, a znachit, kazhdaya bitva budet osobennoy.

Dom na prirode
Obespechivayte sebya vsem neobkhodimym, vyrashchivaya frukty i ovoshchi i ukhazhivaya za myslimymi i nemyslimymi zhivotnymi, ot korov do edinorogov! Sdelayte remont i obustroyte vse po svoemu vkusu v svoem obvetshalom osobnyake, gde pochti ne vodyatsya privideniya.

Gotovte s umom!
Povaru ne oboytis bez podkhodyashchey utvari, tak chto sobirayte resursy i masterite oborudovanie dlya obrabotki ingredientov. Vy dazhe mozhete poluchit sovershenno novye sostavlyayushchie retseptov! 

Issleduyte Ambroziyu!
Ves gorod v vashem rasporyazhenii: posetite tavernu, ustroyte sebe spa-protsedury ili poprobuyte svoi sily v rybalke. Poznakomtes s privetlivymi gorozhanami i popytaytes khot nemnogo podnyatsya v ikh glazakh, umeriv ikh nepriyazn siloy ugoshcheniya.

Siya istoriya stara, kak pir
Pogruzites v ostroumnyy syuzhet i obshchaytes s prichudlivymi personazhami, stav chastyu mira, sozdannogo po proizvedeniyam sera Terri Pratchetta.

Khvatayte svoyu vernuyu lopatku i otpravlyaytes v put, chtoby stat legendoy... kulinarii.

Vsya seriya BLUE REFLECTION v odnoy igre — trogatelnye istorii o reflektorakh i ikh sudbakh! Novye funktsii podarili vtoroe dykhanie, a spravochnik pomozhet vam s legkostyu pogruzitsya v igrovuyu vselennuyu — chasti mozhno prokhodit v lyubom poryadke!

Захватывающие аркадные лоуполи-ретро-гон:
Zakhvatyvayushchie arkadnye loupoli-retro-gonki, v kotorykh vam predstoit vozglavit sobstvennuyu komandu i vystupat v eyo sostave na znamenitykh trassakh po vsemu miru s 1980-kh do nashikh dney.

You really don't like wizards. Yet one o:
You really don't like wizards. Yet one of them decided to bring you back to life through necromancy so you will do their bidding. That's really not your thing! Your loved one is likely still waiting for you, after all. Time to ditch this wizard and go home!

However...

Something's not quite right back home. Your partner is missing, the old king is a dragon now, and that wizard keeps pestering you. Nothing is as it was, and only you can do something about it. Good thing you've got this magical axe!

Orcen Axe is a 2d pixel metroidvania. As the orc Drak, you'll have to face a world that's not at all like you remember it. Use your magical axe in creative ways -- learn new attacks, wield elemental powers and dash high into the skies. Отправьтесь в ужасную лесную чащу в фант:
Otpravtes v uzhasnuyu lesnuyu chashchu v fantasmagoricheskoy syuzhetno-priklyuchencheskoy igre, gde ni odno vashe reshenie ne ostaetsya bez posledstviy!
Zhila-byla krasivaya i vesma chestolyubivaya devochka Eliza, mechtavshaya o skazochnom bogatstve. Uvy, raspolozhenie zvezd okazalos dlya nee ne slishkom udachnym. Vyrosshaya v bednoy seme, nasha geroinya byla vynuzhdena tselymi dnyami rabotat na sosedey radi propitaniya.Odnazhdy ona otkopala u sebya vo dvore paru krasiveyshikh krasnykh tufelek. Kakoy syurpriz! Popav pod ikh chary, Eliza otpravilas v uzhasnoe puteshestvie, kotoroe velo eyo vse blizhe i blizhe k serdtsu tainstvennykh lesov!
Risknet li ona vsem radi ispolneniya mechty — ili vernetsya k unyloy povsednevnosti? Final etoy skazki predstoit dopisat vam..
Вернитесь назад во времени, чтобы спасти:
Vernites nazad vo vremeni, chtoby spasti budushchee v etom umoritelnom priklyuchenii!.. Cherez shest chasov Nebesam pridet konets. Esli tolko vy ikh ne spasete. Ispolzuyte sposobnost puteshestvovat vo vremeni, chtoby peremeshchatsya mezhdu proshlym i budushchim na Nebesakh, v Adu, na Zemle i v Khelkheyme. Uznavayte chto-to v odnom vremeni, chtoby izmenit drugoe, v popytke predotvratit gibel sobstvennoy vselennoy. Snova.
Eto — povestvovatelnoe priklyuchenie s puteshestviyami vo vremeni: vy igraete za angela Kasielya, kotoryy dolzhen spasti Nebesa ot nashestviya armii fantomov, chto bylo by vesma nepriyatno, potomu chto tam zhivete i vy. Uznav o sushchestvovanii Chertovski svyashchennoy shtukoviny — tainstvennogo artefakta, sozdannogo Bogom tysyachi let nazad, — vam pridetsya nadet svoi vnevremennye chasy i otpravitsya v proshloe, budushchee i snova v nastoyashchee, po puti poznakomivshis s kuchey umoritelnykh personazhey v dinamicheski menyayushchikhsya lokatsiyakh, v popytke uznat sekrety zhizni, vselennoy i... nu, vsego ostalnogo.
Umoritelnoe priklyuchenie skvoz raznye epokhi i zhanry, chto dast otvety na vazhneyshie voprosy mirozdaniya, naprimer: pochemu posle skachkov vo vremeni nachinaet toshnit; pochemu tolko angelam mozhno rugatsya matom i pochemu propuskat dialogi — eto norma, kogda na spasenie Nebes u tebya est vsego shest chasov. Vas zhdet skandalnyy yumor, izobretatelnye golovolomki i umoritelnye stseny s progressiey v stile metroidvanii — vse ot masterov iz Perfectly Paranormal.
Два мира столкнутся в безумном стратегич: Dva mira stolknutsya v bezumnom strategicheskom priklyuchenii «Mario + Rabbids: Bitva za korolevstvo» dlya Nintendo Switch. Soberite raznosherstnuyu komandu geroev, vosstanovite poryadok v Gribnom korolevstve i puteshestvuyte po chetyrem izmenivshimsya do neuznavaemosti miram, gde vas podzhidayut dinamichnye poshagovye bitvy, golovolomnye zagadki i nepredskazuemye vragi.

Witchtastic – динамичная кооп-игра для 2:
Witchtastic – dinamichnaya koop-igra dlya 2-4 igrokov na temu prigotovleniya i dostavki magicheskikh zeliy na skorost. Igrayte vmeste s druzyami sidya na odnom divane ili cherez Internet. Primerte na sebya rol ambitsioznykh vedmochek i ispytayte zavorazhivayushchie priklyucheniya. Zakhotelos otdokhnut ot krikov svoikh druzey? Vy takzhe smozhete potrenirovatsya v rezhime odinochnoy igry! Sobirayte ingredienty, takie kak belladonna, chesnok ili griby, i brosayte ikh v kipyashchiy kotel. Klyuch k uspekhu – eto bystraya i slazhennaya kommunikatsiya. Osvoyte desyatki retseptov i otpravlyaytes v magicheskoe puteshestvie. Esli vam ponadobitsya pomoshch, to vash nadezhnyy kompanon Filin vsegda gotov dat poleznyy sovet vam i vashim druzyam. No osteregaytes opasnostey na svoem puti: vas zhdut lesa, kishashchie prizrakami, golodnye volki, smertonosnye bolota i mnogoe drugoe.

Koop-igra dlya 2-4 igrokov na divane i onlayn!
Varit magicheskie zelya v odinochku byvaet nelegko. Skooperiruytes s druzyami i igrayte vdvoem, vtroem ili tselym otryadom shustrykh vedmochek. Setevaya igra dostupna cherez vstroennuyu multipleer-sistemu.


Ovladeyte iskusstvom zelevareniya!
Stante pervoklassnoy vedmoy, izuchiv i osvoiv vse vidy zeliy. 
Issleduyte mir Witchtastic!
Puteshestvuyte po derevnyam, lesam, bolotam, gorodam i zasnezhennym ruinam. Okunites v zagadochnoe puteshestvie, polnoe ispytaniy i opasnostey.
Otkroyte dlya sebya vse mnogoobrazie ingredientov!

Osobennosti
• Koop-igra dlya 2-4 igrokov na divane i onlayn!
• Nastoyashchiy onlayn-multipleer dlya druzey

• Rezhim odinochnoy igry dlya trenirovki
Duck Souls+ - это динамичная игра-платфо:
Duck Souls+ - eto dinamichnaya igra-platformer o malenkoy utke s neveroyatnoy izvorotlivostyu i umeniem vypolnyat zadaniya, nakhodit vse yaytsa, chtoby spasti svoy utinyy vid.

Duck Souls+ razvorachivaetsya v milom i smertelno opasnom mire fentezi, gde mnozhestvo lovushek mogut otorvat krylya, poka ty izo vsekh sil pytaeshsya skhvatit khrupkoe yaytso.

Begay, prygay i proryvaysya cherez krasochnyy i kovarnyy geympley, chtoby spasti vsekh i stat geroem, esli smozhesh, konechno.

Kharakteristiki:

Очередной клон Vampire Survivors!\nБроди:
Ocherednoy klon Vampire Survivors!
Brodite po zemlyam, slovno soshedshim s kholstov khudozhnika, vdokhnovlyonnogo Akiroy Toriyamoy i Dzhimom Khensonom. Kazhdyy kust mozhet okazatsya portalom v novoe priklyuchenie, za kazhdym uglom — libo sokrovishche, libo udar sudby.

The game tells the story of your second:
The game tells the story of your second uncle, who has been hospitalized unexpectedly and entrusted you with replacing him as the temporary Village Head. The village is in a sparsely populated wilderness where years of mismanagement have led to most residents becoming unruly. The game features multiple endings, but only one automatic save slot is available. Your choice will determine the fate of the villagers. Disabling the Save/Load feature aims to provide a unique gaming experience with each save, forcing players to seize every moment. 

Key Features
● Retro cartoon style
● Multiple endings, unique experience with each playthrough
Dr. Robotnik's Ring Racers — любительска:
Dr. Robotnik's Ring Racers — lyubitelskaya videoigra v zhanre karting-gonok, iznachalno osnovannaya na 3D-fanatskoy igre Sonic the Hedgehog Sonic Robo Blast 2, kotoraya, v svoyu ochered, osnovana na modifitsirovannoy versii Doom Legacy. Osnovnoy igrovoy protsess Dr. Robotnik's Ring Racers pokhozh na igrovoy protsess tipichnoy gonki na kartakh, vklyuchaya vozmozhnost driftovat i ispolzovat predmety, poluchennye iz yashchikov, razmeshchennykh na trasse. Chto eshche bolee neobychno dlya svoego zhanra, v igre delaetsya silnyy aktsent na impulse i igrovom protsesse, osnovannom na navykakh. Vvedeny novye mekhaniki, v tom chisle koltsa, kotorye mozhno sobirat, dayut prirost skorosti pri ispolzovanii, sistema tryukov, zapuskayushchaya igroka v opredelennom napravlenii na osnove vvoda QTE, i Spin Dash, kotoryy rabotaet analogichno svoemu voploshcheniyu v klassicheskikh platformerakh Sonic.
V Ring Racers est rezhim Gran-pri s 30 kubkami, gde igrok sorevnuetsya s igrokami II i unichtozhaet tyuremnye yaytsa na etapakh Prison Break. V igre takzhe est spetsetapy (nazyvaemye Sealed Stars), dostup k kotorym mozhno poluchit, dostignuv ranga A v kubke na Normal ili vyshe, ili vyigrav kubok na Master. V igre takzhe est mnozhestvo besplatno razblokiruemogo kontenta, takogo kak personazhi, muzyka, dopolneniya i kosmeticheskie predmety, kotorye paryat ryadom s igrokom.Sonic Robo Blast 2 + SRB2 Kart sm. zdes.
Исследуйте мир, где головоломки велики,:
Issleduyte mir, gde golovolomki veliki, a ispytaniya eshche bolshe! Chelovek umenshilsya!

Peredvizhenie po tikhomu sadu — pochti nepreodolimaya problema dlya kroshechnogo cheloveka na noveyshem BESPLATNOM urovne «Miniatyura».

Zaberites na gigantskuyu igrushechnuyu pozharnuyu mashinu, gonyayte na modelke avtomobilya, upravlyayte uzhasayushche ogromnym pylesosom i naduyte gigantskiy vozdushnyy shar!

Igrayte v odinochku ili zovite druzey: v rezhime sovmestnoy igry mozhno zanimatsya melkimi glupostyami vvosmerom.

Human: Fall Flat — eto umoritelno smeshnoy platformer v izmenchivom mire snov.

Chelovecheskoe telo tak neuklyuzhe! Lyuboe dvizhenie mozhet prinesti sovershenno ne tot rezultat, — no on neizmenno budet smeshnym. Boyatsya tozhe nechego: vo sne ne byvaet smertelnoy opasnosti.

Bolshe lyudey — bolshe khaosa!
Nuzhna pomoshch, chtoby zaryadit katapultu ili slomat stenu? Podderzhka mnogopolzovatelskoy setevoy igry (do 8 igrokov) menyaet vzglyad na prokhozhdenie Human: Fall Flat.

Aktivnoe soobshchestvo
Strimery i yutubery lyubyat Human: Fall Flat za unikalnye vpechatleniya i iskrometnyy yumor. Video s prokhozhdeniyami prosmatrivali bolee 3 milliarda raz!

Chistyy list
Personazha mozhno polnostyu izmenyat! Vyberite, kak budut vyglyadet ego golova i tulovishche, naryadite v kostyum stroitelya, parashyutista, shakhtera ili nindzya, poeksperimentiruyte s tsvetom!

KRUTOY BESPLATNYY KONTENT
S momenta vypuska igry vyshlo uzhe chetyre novykh besplatnykh urovnya, a skoro poyavyatsya i drugie. Chto zhe eshche gotovit nam mir snov?

Chempion!
Zavoevav uzhe bolee 10 nagrad, Human: Fall Flat prodolzhaet radovat svoikh fanatov uvlekatelnym igrovym protsessom i neuklonno nabiraet populyarnost.

Академия Святого Иоахима для благородных:
Akademiya Svyatogo Ioakhima dlya blagorodnykh devits organizovala dlya svoikh uchenits poezdku na novom podvodnom poezde «Morskoy ekspress», kursiruyushchem po dnu okeana mezhdu Kaliforniey i Yaponiey. Eta poezdka – dolgozhdannaya vozmozhnost dlya devochek otdokhnut ot shkolnykh budney, uvidet podvodnyy mir vo vsey krase i uznat bolshe o podvodnoy flore i faune. No prekrasnoe puteshestvie prevrashchaetsya v ad, kogda odnogo iz uchiteley nakhodyat v komnate mertvym. Kto mog ubit samogo lyubimogo i uvazhaemogo uchitelya vo vsey akademii?

Ranko Togava i ee podruga Astrid reshayut rassledovat krovavoe prestuplenie i ochistit imya glavnoy podozrevaemoy. Konechno, legko ne budet. Kogda kolichestvo zhertv nachinaet neuklonno rasti, strakh stolknutsya s seriynym ubiytsey litsom k litsu zastavlyaet panikovat. Ranko pridetsya pospeshit, chtoby razgadat zagadku i ne dat tainstvennomu ubiytse napast snova. Chem bolshe zagadok razgadano, tem silnee geroinyu oburevayut somneniya.

Raskroy taynu «Morskogo ekspressa» i naydi ubiytsu. V novelle tebya zhdut tragedii, syurprizy i mnogo khoroshego yumora!

► Dopolnitelnaya boltovnya po telefonu Ranko dlya luchshego ponimaniya obstanovki v poezde i istoriy uchenits iz Svyatogo Ioakhima.
Sonic the Hedgehog Time Twisted — это не:
Sonic the Hedgehog Time Twisted — eto nekommercheskaya fanatskaya igra, sozdannaya Overbound Game Studio s entuziastami po motivam Sonic CD i drugikh klassicheskikh 2D-proektov s Sonikom na SEGA MegaDrive 2 / Genesis. Ona razrabatyvalas 12 let, nachinaya s 2005-go goda, reliz sostoyalsya v 2017-om s poslednim tekushchim obnovleniem v marte 2022-go, poluchiv bolshoe priznanie pressy, igrokov i kritikov (GameJolt 5/5, IndieDB 9.8/10, i dr.).
Proekt vpolne mozhet schitatsya neofitsialnym prodolzheniem i eyo dukhovnym preemnikom, v kotoroy Sonik, lisyonok Maylz «Teylz» i ekhidna Naklz puteshestvuyut v 3-kh raznykh variatsiyakh vremeni vnutri obshirnykh urovney (vsego 28 novykh aktov v 8 zonakh), boryas s 10-yu bossami, ispolzuya 6 elementalnykh shchitov-sfer: puzyrkovyy, ognennyy, molnievyy, vetryanoy, skalnyy i ledyanoy. Saundtrek k igre, Dueling Ages napisan v osnovnom v aranzhirovke Hinchy.

Eto Paratopic — eksperimentalnaya igra ot pervogo litsa v zhanre khorror, nazvannaya Rock, Paper, Shotgun odnoy iz luchshikh igr 2018 goda, i, po mneniyu FACT mag, yavlyayushchayasya obladatelem odnogo iz 10 luchshikh saundtrekov za tot zhe god. 

• Syuzhetnaya priklyuchencheskaya igra s primesyu uzhasov otpravit vas v puteshestvie po bezzhalostnomu miru likhoradochnykh grez.

• Vyyasnite, kak peresekayutsya istorii trekh otdelnykh personazhey, prorezaya svoy put cherez mnogochislennye mnogoobraznye i detalizirovannye stseny.

• Issleduyte ostanki zapretnoy industrii, ubivayte, puteshestvuyte skvoz noch, zavedite besedu s nekotorymi ochen ekstsentrichnymi lichnostyami.

• Bolee chasa velikolepnoy mrachnoy obvolakivayushchey muzyki sozdayut iskusnuyu dinamiku nashey zvukovoy palitry. Anakhronichnaya smes sovremennogo i ustarevshego, kogda glitchi i teksturnye podklady vstrechayutsya s semplingom i sintezom zvuka, blizka po dukhu saundtrekam Unreal Engine perioda 1990-kh godov.

'Death end re;Quest – классическая пошаг:
'Death end re;Quest – klassicheskaya poshagovaya rolevaya igra, perevernutaya s nog na golovu. U vas budet vozmozhnost po zhelaniyu pereklyuchatsya mezhdu rolevym ekshenom v virtualnom mire i vdumchivym izucheniem graficheskoy novelly o mire realnom.

Versiya igry dlya Nintendo Switch™ vklyuchaet v sebya vse besplatnye i platnye dopolneniya, iznachalno dostupnye v predydushchikh versiyakh, a takzhe kontent, ranee dostupnyy tolko v yaponskoy versii.

Syuzhet

Programmist videoigr Arata Midzunasi poluchaet elektronnoe pismo ot svoey kollegi Sini Ninomii, kotoraya propala okolo goda nazad. V proshlom oni vmeste rabotali nad sozdaniem World’s Odyssey (W.O.D.) – uvlekatelnogo virtualnogo mira, opirayushchegosya na velikolepnuyu i edinstvennuyu v svoem rode tekhnologiyu. Po krayney mere tak bylo, poka Sina ne ischezla pryamo v razgare raboty. V protsesse rassledovaniya Arata vyyasnyaet, chto Sina Ninomiya vse eto vremya byla zaperta vnutri W.O.D. Togda on s golovoy pogruzhaetsya v strochki koda zabroshennogo proekta i vskore vyyasnyaet, chto igru navodnili oshibki, a Sina – ee edinstvennyy aktivnyy polzovatel.

Kak zhe malo oni znayut o tom, kakie uzhasy podzhidayut po obe storony ekrana...

Klyuchevye osobennosti 

Izuchayte realnyy mir v formate graficheskoy novelly, chtoby razgadat taynu World Odyssey, ili pogruzites v virtualnyy mir dlya issledovaniya ego podzemeliy. Kazhdoe reshenie, prinyatoe v lyubom iz dvukh rezhimov, okazhet vliyanie na to, komu predstoit vyzhit, i kto smozhet raskryt mrachnye tayny World’s Odyssey.

Poshagovaya boevaya sistema pozvolit igrokam svobodno peremeshchatsya i srazhatsya. «Ottalkivayte» vragov v napravlenii sten i tovarishchey po komande dlya realizatsii sumasshedshikh kombo. Perelomite khod bitvy, polnostyu smeniv zhanr. Ispolzuyte «polevye oshibki», raskidannye vokrug, chtoby povysit uroven Corruption – klyuchevogo pokazatelya dlya perekhoda v rezhim Glitch Mode!  

World’s Odyssey gotova privetstvovat iskateley priklyucheniy v portativnom rezhime dlya Nintendo Switch™! Novichki i veterany serii smogut pogruzitsya v pervuyu versiyu giperrealistichnogo igrovogo mira, dopolnennogo vsemi besplatnymi i platnymi nadstroykami dlya predydushchikh versiy, vklyuchaya dopolnitelnogo personazha Ripuku!
Ninja Five-O (в Европе — Ninja Cop) пода:
Ninja Five-O (v Evrope — Ninja Cop) podarit vam vozmozhnost vnov pogruzitsya v mir igry, kak v GameBoy Advance v 2003-m, stavshey klassikoy!.. Podderzhivayte spravedlivost pri pomoshchi yarostnykh priyomov Ninjutsu – teper ofitsialno na Nintendo Switch!
Ninja Five-O pozvolit vam lichno perezhit grandioznoe, khotya i vesma surovoe priklyuchenie detektiva Dzyo Osugi s pozyvnym «Nindzya Five-O». Vy dolzhny zashchitit gorod ot Zipangu i pobedit gnusnykh bossov Mad Mask.
Соревнуйтесь на игровом поле в многополь:

Podprygivayte i vypolnyayte pryzhok na meste, chtoby perevernut blizlezhashchie plitki i perekrasit ikh v svoy tsvet. Vybivayte sopernikov, perekrashivaya plitki, na kotorykh oni nakhodyatsya, no vsegda vnimatelno sledite za svoimi peremeshcheniyami, ved vashi soperniki tozhe mogut vybit vas s igrovogo polya! Ne dayte drugim igrokam zakhvatit blizlezhashchie plitki i poprobuyte zastignut ikh vrasplokh, menyaya v polete mesto prizemleniya ili vypolnyaya lozhnyy pryzhok.

Pogruzites v atmosferu priklyuchencheskoy igry, stavshey kultovoy klassikoy. Blagodarya revolyutsionnym dlya svoego vremeni grafike i syuzhetu, Another World™ po-prezhnemu sulit igrokam neveroyatnye vpechatleniya v glubokoy, unikalnoy nauchno-fantasticheskoy vselennoy. Seychas, spustya bolee 25 let posle vykhoda originalnoy versii, shedevr Erika Shayi po-prezhnemu schitaetsya klassicheskoy priklyuchencheskoy igroy i prodolzhaet vdokhnovlyat krupneyshikh razrabotchikov videoigr. 

Another World™ — eto neveroyatnaya istoriya uchenogo Lestera Nayta Chaykina, sluchayno perenesshegosya v drugoy mir vo vremya raboty nad uskoritelem chastits. Okazavshis na strannoy planete i ne znaya, kak vernutsya obratno, Lester vynuzhden vyzhivat vo vrazhdebnoy srede, srazhatsya s opasnymi aborigenami i reshat golovolomki: khitroumnye i unikalnye dlya igr takogo zhanra. Imenno tam on osoznaet istinnoe znachenie druzhby.

Pomogite Lesteru vyzhit v etom nepovtorimom mire! Vas zhdut:
 
● Neveroyatnaya nauchno-fantasticheskaya vselennaya
● Zakhvatyvayushchiy priklyuchencheskiy syuzhet
● Obnovlennaya grafika i muzyka
● Vozmozhnost vybora mezhdu originalnoy i sovremennoy HD-grafikoy.
● 3 rezhima slozhnosti: normalnyy (proshche, chem v originale), slozhnyy (takoy zhe, kak v originale) i zhestkiy (slozhnee, chem v originale)

Chip, Deyl (ili srazu oba v rezhime sovmestnoy igry), spasateli-burunduki, nachinayut spasatelnuyu operatsiyu, tsel kotoroy — nayti poteryavshegosya kotyonka, i v khode poiskov obnaruzhivayut sebya vovlechyonnymi v intrigu, podgotovlennuyu kotom Tolstopuzom. Однажды группа ученых создала четырех кр:
Odnazhdy gruppa uchenykh sozdala chetyrekh kroshechnykh monstrov. Zachem oni eto sdelali? Chtoby ispytat ikh umenie deystvovat soobshcha! Dlya etogo monstrov svyazali vmeste kroshechnoy tsepochkoy i poruchili preodolet polosu yarkikh, kovarnykh i strannykh prepyatstviy – takoe mogli pridumat tolko uchenye!

Kto skazal, chto syuzhet igry ploskiy, kak dvukhmernaya grafika? Vse verno! Tak ono i est. Sut v tom, chto chudovishcha – eto vy, a uchenye – eto my. Privyazhite sebya k druzyam, a my proverim, kak khorosho vy rabotaete drug s drugom i umeete reshat slozhnye zadachi! A eshche my ispytaem vashu druzhbu na prochnost...

Odinokie igroki nikogda ne spravyatsya s ispytaniyami monstrov. Krome togo, s druzyami igrat veselee, chem odnomu, tak ved? Rabotaya drug s drugom, vam pridetsya slazhenno peremeshchatsya, sovershat pryzhki i tseplyatsya za steny i pol, chtoby preodolevat polosy prepyatstviy i prokhodit urovni. Eto gorazdo trudnee, chem mozhet pokazatsya na pervyy vzglyad – i vo mnogo raz veselee! Kogda chto-to idet ne tak, nachinaetsya sushchiy khaos – a v komnate razdaetsya gromkiy khokhot.

Nu chto, podopytnye? Gotovy ispytat svoyu druzhbu i umenie rabotat odnoy komandoy?

Zabavnye osobennosti:

- V igre net nasiliya, tolko vesele dlya vsekh chlenov semi – ot babushek do samykh malenkikh!
- Bolee 40 neprostykh urovney v parnom rezhime (dlya 2 igrokov)
- Bolee 20 slozhnykh urovney v gruppovom rezhime (dlya 3 ili 4 igrokov)
- Zavershayte urovni kak mozhno bystree, chtoby zarabatyvat zolotye, serebryanye ili bronzovye medali v zavisimosti ot vremeni prokhozhdeniya!
- Privyazhite sebya k druzyam i veselites vmeste!
Archetype Arcadia — мрачная визуальная н:
Archetype Arcadia — mrachnaya vizualnaya novella v zhanre fantastiki. V postapokalipticheskom mire pochti vse chelovechestvo pogiblo ot zagadochnoy bolezni pod nazvaniem «pervorodnyy grekh». V tsentre istorii — Rast i ego sestra, kotorye borozdyat obezlyudevshie strany v otchayannom poiske vyzhivshikh. Bolezn, porazivshaya lyudey, vyzyvaet pomeshatelstvo, iskazhennye oshchushcheniya i neupravlyaemuyu tyagu k samorazrusheniyu. Edinstvennyy sposob kontrolirovat simptomy — nakhoditsya v virtualnoy igre Archetype Arcadia.

Zaraza obkhodila Rasta storonoy, no odnazhdy ego sestra po kakoy-to prichine teryaet soznanie. Togda geroyu prikhoditsya samomu pogruzitsya v virtualnuyu igru v poiskakh lekarstva. V igre emu otkroetsya tselyy mir lyudey i monstrov. V etom mire mozhno borotsya s pomoshchyu igrovogo ustroystva, ispolzuya dragotsennye vospominaniya i svoikh avatarov. Odnako, khotya virtualnaya realnost zamedlyaet bolezn, bez sereznykh posledstviy ne oboydetsya.

Proryvayas skvoz strannyy novyy mir, Rast vstretit lichnostey s samym nepredskazuemym proiskhozhdeniem, naydet vernykh druzey i — kak bez etogo — vragov. Archetype Arcadia — istoriya, polnaya nepredskazuemykh i trogatelnykh povorotov syuzheta. Otpravtes v priklyuchenie, polnoe tayn i gorkogo razocharovaniya, druzhby i spaseniya.

Your objective is to battle terrorism around the world! Nothing stands in your way. From vast outdoor environments to narrow bunker corridors, you are deployed to take out targets in the middle east and snowy mountains. В детстве ты стал свидетелем кровавого у:
V detstve ty stal svidetelem krovavogo ubiystva svoego ottsa i byl razluchen s bratom. Ty poobeshchal umirayushchemu ottsu, chto smozhesh postoyat za sebya! Teper tebe pridetsya usilenno trenirovatsya, est steyki i prokladyvat svoimi kulakami sebe put na vershinu boytsovskoy karery. Nu i konechno, nayti ubiytsu ottsa i otomstit.

Punch Club - eto menedzher ulichnogo boytsa, v kotorym ty sam vybiraesh put, po kotoromu pridesh k svoey zavetnoy tseli. Po khodu dela otkryvaya dlya sebya vse peripetii syuzheta v luchshikh traditsiyakh boevikov 80-90kh godov.

Tolko ot tebya zavisit, kakoy stil boya i taktiku ty vozmesh na vooruzhenie. Budesh li ty sledovat Puti Tigra ili otpravishsya v dolgiy put posledovatelya Stilya Cherepakhi, a mozhet, reshish kombinirovat vse vozmozhnye shkoly. Vybor za toboy. No ne zabyvay, chto boets - eto ne tolko stil boya, no i prekrasnaya fizicheskaya forma. Begay, zhmi shtangi, rabotay s grushey i, konechno zhe, ne zabud vovremya podkrepitsya! 

Lyuboe reshenie budet imet posledstviya. Byt khoroshim parnem ili plokhim? Kupit steyk ili pitstsu? Poyti otrabatyvat levyy v golovu ili pobezdelnichat s drugom? Pobit nindzya krokodilov ili snyatsya v filme pro inoplanetyan? Reshat tebe! I ne zabud, chto khorosho by udelit vremya svoey devushke...

- Menedzhment/sim ulichnogo boytsa s elementami RPG i taykuna
- Naydi ubiytsu svoego ottsa, a mozhet byt dazhe uznay o sebe chto-to novoe
- Glubokiy syuzhet s neskolkimi razvilkami i neskolkimi kontsovkami
- Kachay staty, izuchay novye priemy i izuchay 4 vetki skillov
- Krutoy pikselart s bolshim kolichestvom otsylok k filmam i igram 80-90kh gg.
Дело об убийстве в отеле «Лиссабон» — иг:
Delo ob ubiystve v otele «Lissabon» — igra, vdokhnovlennaya klassicheskimi point-and-click igrami 80-kh i 90-kh. Ona perenimaet kharakternyy dizayn etogo perioda i sozdana isklyuchitelno pri pomoshchi tekhniki piksel-arta. Eto — Det Ektiv, Robot-Kloun i ubiystvo v otele «Lissabon»!
Tainstvennoe ubiystvo sluchilos v otele, muzhchina sovershil samoubiystvo, nanesya sebe nozhom 14 udarov v spinu v tot samyy moment, kogda on mirno popival kofe. Eto delo s protivorechivymi faktami okazalos slishkom slozhnym dlya politseyskogo Garsiya, tak chto on reshil nanyat edinstvennyy na ves gorod duet, kotoryy sposoben raskryt ego: Detektiva Det Ektiva i Robota-Klouna.
Всё по классике: бегаем, прыгаем, проход:
Vsyo po klassike: begaem, prygaem, prokhodim komnatu za komnatoy, lupim vrazhin, nakhodim bossov, i posle opredelyonnogo akta genotsida poslednikh, poluchaem novuyu sposobnost, pozvolyayushchuyu zabiratsya tuda, kuda ranshe ne pushchali.

— Karta bolshaya, mesta vpolne khvataet. Na puti budut popadatsya bolshie altari, mezhdu kotorymi mozhno teleportirovatsya, a takzhe altari pomenshe, ot kotorykh mozhno teleportirovatsya, no tolko k bolshim altaryam, ne k malym.
— Bossy interesnye, nuzhen podkhod, s pervoy popytki ne kazhdyy valitsya, prikhoditsya poizuchat ataki i taymingi.
— Pervonachalno u nashego glavnogo geroya-mukhomorchika vsego 3 zhizni na kharde, a bossov prikhoditsya bit dolgo. Vot pryam udovolstvie poluchaesh ot pobedy nad ocherednym bossetskim. Ni slabee, ni silnee bossov ne nado - samoe to!
Мир Hirilun — тёмный и странный город, п: Mir Hirilun — tyomnyy i strannyy gorod, polnyy neboskryobov i ukromnykh mest. Popast tuda mozhet lyuboy, no lish samye bystrye zavoyuyut tam slavu... 3D-platformer ot pervogo litsa, v kotorom vazhnuyu rol igraet kontrol vremeni i prokhozhdenie ispytaniy. Phantom Doctrine — это стратегический по:
Phantom Doctrine — eto strategicheskiy poshagovyy shpionskiy triller, deystvie kotorogo prokhodit vo vremena razgara kholodnoy voyny. Igra imeet mnozhestvo otsylok i peredaet izoshchrennuyu intrigu klassicheskikh shpionskikh filmov. Igrok pogruzhaetsya v tainstvennyy mir spetsoperatsiy, kontrrazvedki, zagovorov i paranoyi.
 
 Buduchi rukovoditelem sekretnoy organizatsii pod nazvaniem «Klika», vy poluchaete zadanie predotvratit mirovoy zagovor, kotoryy pytaetsya possorit mirovykh liderov i poseyat konflikt mezhdu natsiyami. Vypolnyaya sekretnye missii, izuchaya kartoteki, doprashivaya vrazheskikh agentov, vy smogli raskryt zloveshchiy zagovor. A poskolku vremya ne zhdet, vam neobkhodimo pomeshat ego ispolneniyu, chtoby spasti mir ot pechalnoy uchasti.
 
 OSOBENNOSTI
 
 - Obshirnaya syuzhetnaya kampaniya dlya odnogo igroka: bolee 40 chasov v rezhime kampanii s bogatym zakhvatyvayushchim syuzhetom, sotkannym iz raznykh istoricheskikh sobytiy i personazhey i peredayushchim uzhasayushchuyu realnost kholodnoy voyny so svoeobraznoy tochki zreniya.
 - Poshagovye boi novogo pokoleniya: nevidannaya gibkost dvizheniy i deystviy (v tom chisle rezhimy nablyudeniya i sposobnost prodelyvaniya prokhodov), neobkhodimaya dlya shturma.
 - Masshtabnoe pole boya: obekty mozhno raspolagat po vsemu miru, blagodarya chemu v khode boya vy mozhete pozvat na pomoshch. No vrag takzhe mozhet privlech podkreplenie, v tom chisle tyazheloe oruzhie i dazhe podderzhku s vozdukha. Ne stoit vooruzhatsya odnim nozhom, kogda vas zhdet strelkovyy boy.

A grim new threat looms over The Central:
A grim new threat looms over The Central Kingdoms. The borders protected by the fierce King’s Knights are no longer secure. The fearsome orc clans, more numerous than ever, lurk on all roads. Chaos seizes the World. Only the memory of the oldest recalls the exploits of a hero and a few warriors, who in other times fought against the forces of Chaos. Ianna, the mother of all living beings, gave the hero a powerful sword to enter the abyss and defeat evil. But that happened a long time ago. A new hero is needed, a chosen one who is worthy to wield the Sword and destroy the enemy... this time forever.

FOUR PLAYABLE CHARACTERS
Pick your Champion of Ianna — Tukaram, the Barbarian; Naglfar, the Dwarf; Sargon, the Knight; or Zoe, the Amazon — each with unique strengths, weaknesses, and fighting skills, as you hack ‘n slash your way through a blood-drenched quest to save the world from the forces of Chaos.

Learn devastating combo attacks and use them to slice your opponents into pieces. Hack off your foes’ limbs, then use them as weapons!

A DETAILED & DARK FANTASY WORLD

INTERACTIVE ENVIRONMENTS
Destroy in-game objects with fire or your fists as you solve puzzles and disarm traps that combine physics, hydraulic systems, and lethal traps!

RE-RELEASE OF A TRUE GENRE-DEFINING GAME
We are happy to bring Blade of Darkness back to life, an enduring classic that, at the time of its release, inspired many games in the action-adventure genre through its approach to combat.

«Герои меча и магии» — фэнтезийная серия:
«Geroi mecha i magii» — fenteziynaya seriya videoigr v zhanre poshagovoy strategii s elementami RPG, na dannyy moment vklyuchayushchaya v sebya sem osnovnykh chastey. Vymyshlennaya vselennaya Heroes of Might and Magic osnovana na vselennoy Might and Magic. Sobytiya vsekh igr serii do pyatoy razvorachivayutsya v vymyshlennom mire Enrot.
Deystvie Heroes of Might and Magic III razvivaetsya v mire pod nazvaniem Enrot, posle sobytiy igry Might and Magic VI: The Mandate of Heaven, kotorye, v svoyu ochered, sleduyut za «Heroes of Might and Magic II». Syuzhet perenosit vas na kontinent Antagarich i nachinaetsya so smerti korolya Nikolasa Grifonkharta, pravitelya dobrogo korolevstva Erafiya. Ego doch Katerina, pravyashchaya koroleva Enrota i zhena Rolanda Zheleznogo Kulaka, otpravilas na rodinu dlya uchastiya v pokhoronakh ottsa. Odnako po pribytii flot Kateriny uznayot, chto bez svoego korolya Erafiya pala pod vtorzheniem zlykh sil iz podzemeliy ostrova Nigon i demonicheskoy zemli Eofol. Teper rodina Kateriny nakhoditsya v shirokomasshtabnoy voyne, razoryaemaya vragami i marodyorami iz drugikh stran.
Kak i v predydushchikh igrakh serii, igrovoy protsess Heroes III proiskhodit v fentezi-mire, gde igrok upravlyaet osnovnymi personazhami — geroyami. V strategicheskoy sostavlyayushchey igry geroi vozglavlyayut otryady voinov i puteshestvuyut po igrovomu miru, issleduya ego i zakhvatyvaya vsevozmozhnye obekty. Takticheskaya chast igry zaklyuchaetsya v srazheniyakh geroev s vrazheskimi voyskami na otdelnom ekrane. Osnovnym izmeneniem po sravneniyu s Heroes of Might and Magic II stala grafika, kotoraya byla polnostyu pererisovana. Mnogie izmeneniya i novovvedeniya kosnulis igrovogo protsessa. V Heroes III byli vpervye vvedeny podzemnyy uroven i artefakt Graal. Rezhimy igry pozvolyayut v odinochku srazhatsya s II-protivnikom na otdelnykh kartakh i v vide prokhozhdeniya igrovykh kampaniy.
V razdachu vklyuchena polnaya «Complete»-versiya igry plyus dva addona k ney: Vozrozhdenie Erafii, Klinok Armageddona, Dykhanie smerti (The Restoration of Erathia, Armageddon’s Blade, The Shadow of Death).Predydushchie chasti: HOMM 2 tut, HOMM 1 tam.
Зигги просыпается однажды с странной мет:
Ziggi prosypaetsya odnazhdy s strannoy metkoy na ruke, ne imeya ponyatiya, chto proizoshlo nochyu. Posle neskolkikh minut, poteryannykh sredi znakomykh ulits svoego prigoroda, Orten, vzryv vozvrashchaet ego tochno tuda, gde on prosnulsya mgnoveniya nazad... On zastryal vo vremennoy petle. Bez obuvi ili vospominaniy o proshlom, on otpravlyaetsya v missiyu, chtoby vyyasnit, chto, chert vozmi, proiskhodit i kak izbezhat unichtozheniya ego goroda. Eto ne budet legko, potomu chto chem bolshe on vyiskivaet ne tam, gde nado, tem bolshe on uznaet, chto ego rodnoy gorod skryvaet mnogo sekretov. Ego strannye sosedi stanovyatsya eshche strannee, i on mozhet polagatsya tolko na svoikh druzey i na svoy vysokonadezhnyy mozg.
Esli den povtoryaetsya snova i snova, to kak mozhno prodvigatsya vpered? Vot v chem podvokh: znanie — vash klyuch k progressu v Ortene. Kazhdyy tsikl, kotoryy vy prokhodite, vy uznaete chto-to novoe, chto pozvolit vam prodvinut syuzhet dalshe. Blagodarya mekhanike vremennoy petli vy sokhranyaete podskazki, zametki i sobytiya na vremennoy osi, v konechnom itoge uznav, kak vy mozhete izmenit budushchee vsego za 12 minut v obychnoe voskresene.
Kto oni? Polunochnyy Sovet, ya imeyu v vidu. Kazhetsya, oni edinstvennye, kto v odnom shage vperedi vas. Chto na samom dele proizoshlo v etom gorode 40 let nazad i kak vybratsya iz vremennoy petli i izbezhat smerti? Sleduyte za ulikami, reshayte golovolomki i issleduyte zagadochnyy prigorod Ortena v etoy priklyuchencheskoy igre v stile 2.5D, vypolnennoy vruchnuyu!
Ёж Со́ник (яп. ソニック・ザ・ヘッジホッグ Соникку дза:
Yozh Sónik (yap. ソニック・ザ・ヘッジホッグ Sonikku dza Khedzikhoggu, angl. Sonic the Hedgehog) — glavnyy personazh serii videoigr Sonic the Hedgehog, a takzhe sozdannykh na eyo osnove komiksov, multserialov i polnometrazhnykh filmov.
Sonik — siniy antropomorfnyy yozh, sozdannyy khudozhnikom Naoto Osimoy, programmistom Yudzi Nakoy i dizaynerom Khirokadzu Yasukharoy. Vo vremya razrabotki bylo predlozheno mnozhestvo obrazov glavnogo geroya budushchey igry, no razrabotchiki ostanovilis na yozhike sinego tsveta. Svoyo imya Sonik poluchil za sposobnost begat na sverkhzvukovykh skorostyakh (angl. sonic — «zvukovoy; so skorostyu zvuka»). Geympley za Sonika v bolshinstve igr serii Sonic the Hedgehog zaklyuchaetsya v bystrom prokhozhdenii urovney i bitvakh s vragami, dlya ataki kotorykh Sonik svorachivaetsya v shar vo vremya pryzhka. Nemalovazhnuyu rol dlya Sonika igrayut zolotye koltsa, sluzhashchie emu v kachestve zashchity. Glavnym antagonistom geroya yavlyaetsya doktor Eggman, kotoryy khochet zakhvatit mir i postroit svoyu imperiyu «Eggmanlend».
V razdache nakhoditsya originalnoe khoumbryu na igrovom dvizhke Unity, sozdannoe po motivam franshizy.Drugie igry pro Sonic'a zdes.
Игра-платформер с простым и интуитивным:
Igra-platformer s prostym i intuitivnym upravleniem, grafikoy v stile «retro» i zubodrobitelnoy slozhnostyu, kotoraya prodolzhaet rasti po mere prokhozhdeniya.
Vy prinyali komandovanie otryadom soldat s raznym vooruzheniem. Zadacha: ostanovit prevoskhodyashchie sily protivnika pri podderzhke bronetekhniki i aviatsii.
Vy dolzhny otyskat i unichtozhit ryad tseley, posle chego evakuirovat otryad v kontse zadaniya. 
Vas zhdut 15 etapov v 5 goryachikh tochkakh po vsemu miru, dopolnitelnye urovni i srazheniya s bossami.
A eshchyo... Ne byvaet platformerov bez sekretov.

Glavnye osobennosti

5 soldat s raznym oruzhiem dlya vypolneniya raznykh zadach i vozmozhnost razblokirovat legendarnogo supersoldata.
Srazheniya s bossami, kazhdyy iz kotorykh po-svoemu unikalen.
Dopolnitelnye urovni s upravleniem transportnymi sredstvami.
Monokhromnaya pikselnaya grafika v stile klassicheskikh igr zhanra.
Куро Хабаки вступил в общество охотников:
Kuro Khabaki vstupil v obshchestvo okhotnikov za sokrovishchami i sobiraetsya iskat relikvii, chto tvoryat chudesa! Novaya zadacha privela ego v tokiyskuyu starshuyu shkolu Kamiyosi, ryadom s kotoroy raspolozheno tainstvennoe kladbishche i razvaliny. Khabaki dolzhen obedinitsya s odnoklassnikami i otkryt taynu shkoly.

Sotrudnichayte s okruzhayushchimi, chtoby dobitsya uspekha. U vas est devyat emotsiy, s pomoshchyu kotorykh mozhno vzaimodeystvovat s odnoklassnikami v shkole. Ot vashikh resheniy zavisyat otnosheniya s personazhami. Nekotorye iz nikh mogut prisoedinitsya k vam v poiskakh! Poznakomtes so mnozhestvom ocharovatelnykh i interesnykh geroev!

Issledovanie podzemeliy. Posle nastupleniya temnoty issleduyte razvaliny pod shkoloy i vstupayte v poshagovye RPG-srazheniya! Reshayte golovolomki, minuyte lovushki i srazhaytes s chudovishchnymi protivnikami vmeste s odnoklassnikami, chtoby nayti sokrovishcha i raskryt taynu razvalin.

Otkroyte dlya sebya klassicheskuyu igru! Igra Kowloon High-School Chronicle pererabotana: teper ona otlichaetsya kachestvennoy grafikoy, k tomu zhe osnovnoy syuzhet teper ozvuchen. Ne propustite legendarnuyu igru!
Fight against waves of creatures to beef:
Fight against waves of creatures to beef up your Whispike and use its seeds to create even stronger hybrids! 

Whispike Survivors blends two trendy game genres: horde survivor and farm simulator.
Features:

- Defeat hordes of enemies to make your Whispike stronger.
- Use the seeds that Whispikes drop when dying to grow them in your Whispike farm and make even stronger hybrids!
- Turn your foes into manure to accelerate the Whispike's growth!


In this game you will control one of Sword of the Necromancer's monsters and make it fight other critters to make it the strongest! Were you defeated? Don't worry! You can take your last monster's seed, plant it and get it back...

Only "adult" Whispikes are eligible to fight, so you will have to wait and take care of your farm until they grow (or play with a default one in the meantime). Also, you might not get exactly what you expect: by planting seeds in neighboring slots you can get hybrids that combine the original seeds' attributes!
Слышали про Хагги Вагги? В этом хоррор-п: Slyshali pro Khaggi Vaggi? V etom khorror-priklyuchenii tseley dve — reshit vse golovolomki i vyzhit. Za vami budut okhotitsya krovozhadnye igrushki, obitayushchie na zabroshennoy fabrike. Ispolzuyte khvatatel, chtoby manipulirovat provodami i dostavat do dalnikh predmetov. Issleduyte territoriyu i izbegayte lap monstrov.
В один судьбоносный день наш главный гер:
V odin sudbonosnyy den nash glavnyy geroy sluchayno vstretil strannuyu koshechku. S krasivoy lavandovoy sherstyu i sovershenno pustym zheludkom. I reshili podelitsya s ney svoim risovym sharikom, kotoryy derzhal v rukakh.
Na sleduyushchiy den vy prosypaetes, i obnaruzhivaete u sebya pod odeyalkom… Miluyu devushku s koshachimi ushkami, mirno spyashchuyu tam zhe, gde i vy. Ona govorit vam, chto ey nekuda idti, i vy nachinaete zhit vmeste. Prigotovtes k trogatelnoy istorii o zhizni s Nekomatoy Okayu!
S poyavleniem tainstvennoy Okayu, razmerennaya zhizn nashego glavnogo geroya uzhe nikogda ne budet prezhney. Kakie sekrety ona khranit? Kak budut razvivatsya vashi otnosheniya? Eto istoriya o zarozhdayushcheysya svyazi mezhdu dvumya geroyami, kotorye vmeste preodolevayut zhiznennye trudnosti, razdelyaya kak slyozy, tak i smekh..Eshchyo vizualnykh novell na Switch (renpy).
Став свидетельницей смерти своих родител:
Stav svidetelnitsey smerti svoikh roditeley, svoeobraznaya malenkaya devochka Fren popadaet v psikhiatricheskuyu kliniku Osvalda. Chtoby vyzhit v zhestokom mire lechebnitsy, Fren nachinaet pit tabletki i poluchaet sposobnost videt alternativnyy mir — ultrarealnost.

Otpravlyaytes v puteshestvie v ultrarealnosti vmeste s Fren, chtoby raskryt taynu smerti eyo roditeley, nayti eyo kotika mistera Polnoch i vernutsya domoy k edinstvennoy rodstvennitse, tyote Greys.

OSOBENNOSTI:
•Syuzhetnaya psikhologicheskaya igra-priklyuchenie. 
•Tabletki, pogruzhayushchie v strannyy alternativnyy mir, pomogayushchie reshat zagadki i nakhodit predmety.
•Golovolomki raznykh urovney slozhnosti.
•Kotik mister Polnoch, s kotorym mozhno vzaimodeystvovat, a inogda dazhe igrat za nego.
•Zhutkaya, no milaya 2D-grafika, napominayushchaya detskie knizhki. 
•Bolee 70 lokatsiy, narisovannykh vruchnuyu.
•Vzaimodeystvie s bolee chem 50 personazhami v raznykh mirakh.
•Neobychnoe chuvstvo yumora Fren.
•Tri arkadnye mini-igry s grafikoy v raznom stile mezhdu osnovnymi glavami igry.
•Originalnyy saundtrek.
Каждый раз, когда вы умираете, что-то в:
Kazhdyy raz, kogda vy umiraete, chto-to v igre menyaetsya. Kazhdoe izmenenie osnovano na tom, gde i kak vy umerli. Otpravlyaytes v epicheskoe priklyuchenie, vooruzhivshis tolko svoim proverennym drobovikom, ostroumiem i krepki zheludkom dlya zakhvatyvayushchikh issledovaniy. Smozhesh li ty perezhit noch v bare, Udilshchik?..
Dobro pozhalovat v Anglerfish, uedinyonnyy bar v gorakh Mols. Zdes vy ispytaete nastoyashchiy uzhas vyzhivaniya, pytayas perezhit svoyu samuyu dikuyu noch. Dlya etogo vam nuzhno raskryt vse sekrety, spryatannye gluboko v nedrakh Udilshchika, issleduya kazhdyy zdeshniy ugolok i razgadyvaya zateryannye tayny.. No trevozhashchie tyomnye sily popytayutsya uderzhat vas ot pravdy, poetomu budte gotovy dat otpor, otstreliv im vsem golovy.
Osnovano na realnoy psikhologicheskoy istorii uzhasov.
Очередной клон Vampire Survivors!\nОхоть:
Ocherednoy klon Vampire Survivors!
Okhottes dnyom, okhottes na noch! Derevya talantov, klassy, familyary i mnogoe drugoe:
«Пить просто водку, даже из горлышка, —:
«Pit prosto vodku, dazhe iz gorlyshka, — v etom net nichego, krome tomleniya dukha i suety.
Smeshat vodku s odekolonom — v etom est izvestnyy kapriz, no net nikakogo pafosa.
A vot vypit stakan «Khanaanskogo balzama» —
v etom est i kapriz, i ideya, i pafos, i sverkh togo eshchyo — metafizicheskiy namyok…» ©
Delat spirtnoe — samo po sebe udovolstvie, a eshchyo i zarabatyvat na etom dengi — neplokhoy obraz zhizni. Odnako dlya etogo nuzhno proyavit smekalku, gramotno upravlyat svoey bazoy i ne zlit strazhey zakona..
Delo butlegera my postaralis peredat maksimalno realistichno! Upravlyayte rabochimi, kotorye sozdayut i obsluzhivayut oborudovanie, zakupayte ingredienty, izuchayte tekhnologii, planiruyte postavki i raskhody, a takzhe sledite za tem, chtoby vsegda ostavatsya v teni. Tolko vam reshat, komu doveryat i s kem rabotat. Esli biznes budet protsvetat, vy smozhete otkryt bazy v 5 raznykh regionakh, v kazhdom iz kotorykh zhdut vsyo bolee slozhnye istorii. Proydite put ot rodnykh gor cherez lesnuyu chashchu i tinu bolot do tsivilizatsii, pokoriv bolshie goroda..
Начните путешествие в роли Рика Граймса,:
Nachnite puteshestvie v roli Rika Graymsa, chto prosnulsya odin v bolnitse v okruzhenii mertvetsov. Sobirayte soyuznikov i prokladyvayte put skvoz zasile khodyachikh v kultovykh lokatsiyakh seriala The Walking Dead, sredi kotorykh Atlanta, ferma semi Grinov, tyurma i Vudberi. V perelomnye momenty vybora vy navsegda budete opredelyat sudbu komandy iz personazhey seriala. Geroi i zlodei, zhivye i mertvye — tolko vam reshat, ostavatsya na puti istorii ili prolozhit svoy sobstvennyy v mire The Walking Dead ot AMC. 

• Vopreki sudbe: menyayte istoriyu The Walking Dead ot AMC, prolozhiv sobstvennyy put sobytiyami seriala. Spasite zlodeya, ubeyte geroya... i zhivite s posledstviyami. 

• Rubite, beyte i strelyayte po mertvetsam: istreblyayte ordy khodyachikh v ekshene ot tretego litsa s pomoshchyu raznoobraznogo oruzhiya blizhnego i dalnego boya, v tom chisle bit, katan, revolverov, drobovikov i arbaletov. 

• Igrayte za 13 kultovykh personazhey: soberite svoyu komandu iz geroev seriala The Walking Dead ot AMC, vklyuchaya Rika, Sheyna, Mishon, Kerol, Derila i drugikh. 

• Vyzhivayte v apokalipsise: upravlyayte ogranichennymi resursami, ishchite oruzhie s boepripasami i maksimiziruyte vozmozhnosti komandy, chtoby ostatsya v zhivykh. 

• Prochuvstvuyte napryazhenie: zashchishchayte lager, spasayte vyzhivshikh i srazhaytes, ispolzuya kak skrytnost, tak i otkrytyy boy. Poluchite posledniy shans na vyzhivanie v «razrushennom shtate», prezhde chem zombi odoleyut vas.
Друзей Райана украли злодеи — Титан Тьмы:
Druzey Rayana ukrali zlodei — Titan Tmy, Robo-Kombo i Krysolyud, i spasti ikh mozhete tolko vy! Otpravlyaytes v priklyuchenie, polnoe slizi, bossov na kosmicheskikh korablyakh i yaits s syurprizami. Sobirayte solnechnye monetki i yaytsa s syurprizami, chtoby otkryt novye predmety v magazine i ukrasit svoego geroya smeshnymi inoplanetnymi shapkami, geymerskimi aksessuarami i drugimi veshchichkami. Chtoby spasti mir, vam prigodyatsya superudary i navyki platformennoy akrobatiki.

V odinochku so zlodeyami ne spravitsya, i v etom puteshestvii vas prikroyut zabavnye personazhi Ryan’s World. Bochki Dzhilla, korabl Mo, sliz Klyuvika — vragam nesdobrovat! Zdes dazhe mozhno budet osedlat gigantskogo Sheldona! Vse eti sposobnosti stanut dostupny po mere izucheniya udivitelnykh mirov igrushek, piratov, prisheltsev i dinozavrov, v kazhdom iz kotorykh nuzhno spasti kogo-to iz druzey Rayana.

Vybirayte svoego geroya — Rayana, Kombo-Pandu, Alfa-Leksu ili Krokodilchika Gusa — i otpravlyaytes v mir Ryan’s World. Druzya i vzroslye tozhe mogut igrat vmeste s vami v rezhime dlya dvukh igrokov — dlya etogo my pridumali rezhimy «Polet na kosmicheskom korable» i «Pol — eto lava». Smozhete li vy odolet Titana Tmy i ego uzhasnykh soyuznikov?

•	VYBERITE PERSONAZhA: stante Rayanom, Kombo-Pandoy, Alfa-Leksoy ili Krokodilchikom Gusom

•	RABOTAYTE V KOMANDE: dostupna igra vdvoem po lokalnoy seti

•	IGRAYTE V MINI-IGRY: vy smozhete sygrat v «Metkogo strelka», «Polet na kosmicheskom korable», «Pol — eto lava» i «Beglyy ogon»!

•	SOBIRAYTES S SILAMI: eshte pitstsu Mo, chtoby stat neuyazvimym!

•	KOLLEKTsIONIRUYTE I UKRAShAYTE SEBYa: razblokiruyte neveroyatnye novye kostyumy dlya geroya i sozdayte svoy stil
Broken Age («Потерянное детство») — прик:
Broken Age («Poteryannoe detstvo») — priklyuchencheskaya igra ot Tima Sheyfera, sozdatelya klassicheskikh istoriy The Secret of Monkey Island, Full Throttle, Grim Fandango, Psychonauts, Brütal Legend, The Cave. Igra sozdana kompaniey Double Fine Productions i razdelena na 2 deystviya.
Vyglyadit igra kak ozhivshaya illyustratsiya detskoy knigi, v kotoroy napisana khot i optimistichnaya, no daleko ne prostaya istoriya. I istoriya — eto imenno to, chto zdes vazhno. Vernee, dve istorii, kotorye, konechno, okazhutsya chastyami odnoy. Vella zhivet v mire, v kotorom ey ugotovana sudba stat ukrasheniem na torte dlya morskogo monstra. Shey — kapitan kosmicheskogo korablya, i chereschur zabotlivyy iskusstvennyy intellekt kormit ego s lozhechki i oberegaet ot lyubykh, dazhe maleyshikh, opasnostey. Vellu malo ustraivaet ugotovannoe ey budushchee, a Shey ne v vostorge ot chrezmernoy opeki.
Glavnye geroi voobshche kazhutsya edinstvennymi razumnymi lyudmi sredi tvoryashchegosya vokrug bezumiya. Eto po-prezhnemu dobraya i veselaya skazka, kotoruyu vse i ozhidali ot Double Fine, no u nee est i sereznaya storona, edva razlichimaya notka melankholii...
Пачками косить порождений ночи и дожить:
Pachkami kosit porozhdeniy nochi i dozhit do rassveta! Vampire Survivors — kazualnaya igra v stile goticheskogo khorrora s elementami uproshchyonnogo rogalika. Zdes kazhdoe vashe reshenie mozhet vyzvat lavinu posledstviy dlya ord monstrov, s kotorymi vam predstoit stolknutsya.
Ad opustel, a vse demony prishli syuda, i teper uzhe nekuda bezhat ili pryatatsya. Vam ostaetsya tolko vyzhivat, skolko smozhete, no odnazhdy smert obyazatelno polozhit konets i vashim potugam. Sobirayte zoloto v kazhdyy zakhod, chtoby kupit uluchsheniya i pomoch sleduyushchemu vyzhivshemu. Indi-fenomen so sverkhestestvennym mirom, gde vy i grad pul stanovites ediny!
V versii dlya Nintendo Switch igrayte vchetverom na odnoy konsoli!.. Bolshe igrokov > bolshe monstrov > eshchyo bolshe veselya!..
Igru Vampire Crawlers sm. tam.

Car Mechanic Simulator Pocket Edition 2:
Car Mechanic Simulator Pocket Edition 2 challenges players to repair, paint, tune and drive cars. Find classic, unique cars in the new Barn Find module and Junkyard module. Game also includes car auctions where old cars are available for resale or purchased for your collection!

Each mission offers its own unique challenge of varying difficulty and time constraints to meet. Additional tools are available for purchase if needed. You can eventually upgrade your garage to include specific equipment such as lacquer sprayer or a parts warehouse.

It’s time to roll up your sleeves and get to work!

Features:
- 40+ cars to get your hands dirty with
- 10+ tools to help you check out cars
- 1000+ parts waiting for you
- Start from a small workshop and upgrade it to a full sized 3-lifter gem
- Mix of randomly generated jobs to fulfill
- Endless gameplay
- Multilevel car parking in which you can store you cars
- Path Test to test car suspension
- Test Track to test car condition (or just fool around
- Race Track to test car performance
- Car Auctions where you can compete with other bidders and try to outbid them
- Advanced Upgrades System 
- Car Paint Shop with different paint types and car liveries (or you can just paint one part to save money)
- Barn Finds, where you search for abandoned cars in barns - make sure to look there for parts
- Junkyard (scavenge for parts and rusty cars)
In the year of 18XX, the west is overrun:
In the year of 18XX, the west is overrun by thugs and outlaws. A group of bandits have kidnapped Mayor Johnsons daughter and are spreading havoc across the land.  Gunman Clive must rescue the girl and and bring order to the west, then finish the fight in Gunman Clive 2. His battle against the bandits takes him all around the world and beyond.

Jump and shoot your way across diverse and challenging levels and fight massive bosses. Gunman Clive is an old-school sidescrolling action platform game set in the old west.  Bring out your inner cowboy and get ready for some real gunslinger action.
STRATEGY MEETS ACTION: a fresh take on a:
STRATEGY MEETS ACTION: a fresh take on a classic genre. Dynamic track-based battlefield where tactile mechanics meet turn-based card battling.

FROM BEGINNER TO WINNER: rules can be learned in minutes, opening the doors for players of all ages and skill levels. Strong customisation and a complex meta provide long-term depth, making it much harder to master.

ENDLESS CHOICE: design your own COMBAT CASE from over 140 CARDS (across 5 categories), 20 GUNS (with stat modifiers) and over 25 CHARMS (each with battle-altering perks).

DISTRICT RUN: a deep Roguelike single-player mode where you’ll build a collection, make key decisions and battle across 5 procedurally generated Districts. Will you survive the elusive SHADOW DISTRICT and conquer the city?
Swordship — футуристическая скоростная в:
Swordship — futuristicheskaya skorostnaya variatsiya traditsionnogo arkadnogo shutera. Obratite protivnikov drug protiv druga, uklonyaytes ot atak, vikhlyayte i nyryayte, chtoby nenasytnye vragi vas ne nastigli. 

Etot uvlekatelnyy ekshn-rogalik zastavit vas prinimat molnienosnye resheniya, chtoby libo pobedit tiraniyu i stat simvolom nadezhdy dlya izgnannikov, libo vstretit svoy besslavnyy konets na dne okeana. Energichnyy saundtrek momentalno pereneset vas v mrachnoe okeanicheskoe budushchee. 
 
Osobennosti: 

Strelyat — eto kruto, no uvorachivatsya eshche kruche! Vysokaya manevrennost pozvolyaet perekhitrit vragov, strategicheski uklonyayas ot ikh atak. 
 

Sposobnosti: Sobirayte usiliteli i eksperimentiruyte s raznymi stilyami igry. 
 

Risk i voznagrazhdenie: Kradite konteynery, chtoby nabrat bolshe ochkov, ili spokoyno sobirayte passivnye uluchsheniya i dopolnitelnye katera — v zavisimosti ot vashego stilya igry. 
 

Pogoda: Privykayte k razlichnym pogodnym usloviyam i sluchaynoy generatsii urovney. 

 
Syuzhet: 

Mir nastiglo globalnoe poteplenie. Chelovechestvo ukrylos v trekh gigantskikh podvodnykh gorodakh na dne okeana. 
 
Tem, komu ne nashlos mesta v gorodakh, pytayutsya vyzhit na obozhzhennoy zemle. A megapolisy ezhednevno obmenivayutsya millionami konteynerov s proviziey. 
 
Neskolko zhiteley podvodnykh gorodov vzyali na sebya upravlenie sverkhskorostnymi katerami i nachali krast dragotsennye konteynery, chtoby pomoch izgnannikam. 
 
Komu-to iz nikh vezet. Komu-to — net.
В игре \"Подводный мир. Симулятор дайвин:
V igre "Podvodnyy mir. Simulyator dayvinga" vy smozhete poznakomitsya s rabotoy sovremennogo dayvera. Nespeshno izuchayte neizvedannye ugolki mirovogo okeana, vnimatelno sledya za zapasom kisloroda i ne dopuskaya dekompressii. Sobirayte relikvii proshlogo, poseshchayte zatonuvshie korabli i otkryvayte novye vidy morskikh zhivotnykh, chtoby poluchat nagrady ot professora Adamsa. V khode pogruzheniy u vas budet vozmozhnost raskryt mnozhestvo intriguyushchikh, a poroy i zhutkikh tayn, vklyuchaya zagadku legendarnoy Atlantidy.

Klyuchevye osobennosti
Potryasayushchaya grafika - lyubuytes fantasticheskoy krasotoy mirovogo okeana i ego obitateley, nyryaya sredi arkticheskikh ldov i tropicheskikh korallovykh rifov.

Uvlekatelnyy igrovoy protsess - kazhdoe pogruzhenie uchit vas tomu, chto dolzhen znat i umet professionalnyy dayver. Uznayte, kak sledit za zapasom kisloroda i predotvrashchat kovarnuyu kessonnuyu bolezn.

Podvodnye opasnosti - v mire, kotoryy vy poseshchaete vo vremya pogruzheniy, vstrechayutsya nezametnye skaty, golodnye akuly i mnozhestvo drugikh smertelnykh ugroz.

Okhota za taynami - pomogaya professoru Adamsu issledovat zatonuvshie obekty, vy uznaete mnogo interesnogo o nashikh okeanakh.

Karernyy rost - s kazhdym uspeshnym pogruzheniem vy budete poluchat bolee kachestvennoe snaryazhenie, pozvolyayushchee posetit ranee zakrytye rayony.

Games Beyond™ - uchastvuyte v spasenii morey i okeanov Zemli, znakomyas s podvodnym mirom i ego zagadochnymi obitatelyami.


Deep Diving Adventures sostoit iz bazovoy igry Deep Diving Simulator + Adventure Pack
Очень жуткое исследование мира культовых:
Ochen zhutkoe issledovanie mira kultovykh filmov uzhasov, prokhodyashchee cherez shest epizodov, kazhdyy iz kotorykh imeet svoyu sobstvennuyu tematiku i geympleynye osobennosti. Igrayte za chetyrekh personazhey, i ispolzuyte vsyo, chto popadetsya pod ruku chtoby popytatsya tut vyzhit.
V etu ofitsialnuyu kollektsiyu ot Rupe Tamminena vklyucheny vse 6 vykhodivshikh igr serii:
Готовы добавить острых ощущений в свою ж:
Gotovy dobavit ostrykh oshchushcheniy v svoyu zhizn? Do nachalnika otryada Matchbox doshli slukhi, chto vy — luchshiy voditel v okruge. Komande nuzhna vasha pomoshch v vypolnenii zakhvatyvayushchikh zadaniy. Sadites za rul i otpravlyaytes vypolnyat missii ili vyigryvat gonki! Prokatites po neveroyatno krasivym lokatsiyam, zarabatyvayte medali i upravlyayte svoim priklyucheniem.
Okazhites za rulem nastoyashchego avtomobilya Matchbox, prodemonstriruyte svoi navyki vozhdeniya i otpravlyaytes na neveroyatnye missii v shesti potryasayushche krasivykh lokatsiyakh. Mchites bystree vetra, chtoby pomoch zhitelyam, vypolnyayte zakazy po dostavke, ostanavlivayte vyshedshie iz-pod kontrolya mashiny i prinimayte uchastie v uvlekatelnykh spasatelnykh missiyakh. Promchites po tsentru goroda, a posle nasladites morskim brizom na plyazhe.
Polyubuytes vidami na gory i postaraytes ne zamerznut v Arktike. Poprobuyte perezhit zharu, tsaryashchuyu v dzhunglyakh, i ne popadite pod potoki lavy okolo vulkana. Issleduyte zhivopisnye lokatsii v rezhime «Priklyuchenie» ili vyberite odnu iz 14 trass s chetyrmya variatsiyami v rezhime «Sorevnovanie» i srazhaytes za mesto v spiske liderov. Odinochnaya ili mnogopolzovatelskaya igra — vybirayte, chto dushe ugodno.
Vypolnyayte zadaniya i zarabatyvayte medali, chtoby otkryt novye mashiny, uluchshit ikh i sdelat chastyu svoey kollektsii, kotoruyu mozhno budet posmotret v garazhe. Vas zhdut bolshe desyati vidov avtomobiley i gruzovikov — podberite transport, kotoryy luchshe vsego podkhodit dlya missii. Sadites za rul nastoyashchikh avtomobiley i gruzovikov Matchbox, prazdnuyte pobedy i upravlyayte svoim priklyucheniem!
Пошаговые тактические битвы\nCoromon — и:
Poshagovye takticheskie bitvy
Coromon — igra ob ukroshchenii dikikh sozdaniy i vyzove vsemu ostalnomu miru: drugim dikim sozdaniyam, treneram i titanicheskim bossam!

Sozdayte komande iz bolee chem 100 ocharovatelnykh sushchestv, kotorye obladayut raznymi elementami, talantami i navykami. Lovite ikh, treniruyte, a potom spuskayte na svoikh vragov!

Izuchite vse tonkosti vynoslivosti v bitvakh, v kotorykh kazhdoe deystvie stoit energii, chto zastavlyaet ostorozhno podkhodit k vyboru umeniy i atak. Nanosite uron, snizhayte vynoslivost protivnika s pomoshchyu effektov statusa ili zhe polnostyu vyvodite ego iz stroya s pomoshchyu desyatkov sostoyaniy, chtoby v itoge oderzhat pobedu. 

Brosayte druzyam vyzov onlayn, chtoby uznat, chey otryad koromonov silnee.


Zakhvatyvayushchiy syuzhet
Pervyy den v Lyuks Solis — lish pervyy shag v nachale epicheskogo puteshestviya. Sovsem skoro vy stanete chastyu istorii mirovogo znacheniya, v tsentre kotoroy — zagadochnaya inoplanetnaya ugroza. Imenno vam predstoit pomoch Lyuks Solis pomeshat kovarnym planam prisheltsev.

Presleduyte antagonistov v shesti ogromnykh zonakh i gorodakh, kotorye peresekayutsya desyatkami marshrutov. Na kazhdom iz nikh — uyma zadaniy, taynikov i predmetov.

Issleduyte samye dalnie ugolki Velua: ot ledyanykh peshcher do raskalyonnykh pustyn.
Sygrayte reshayushchuyu rol v klassicheskom JRPG syuzhete, napolnennom neozhidannymi povorotami i otkroveniyami…


Igrayte tak, kak vam khochetsya
Coromon pozvolyaet vam poluchit ot igry imenno to, chto vy khotite. 

Izmenenie slozhnosti vlechyot za soboy ne prosto izmenenie kharakteristik. Kazhdaya slozhnost izmenyaet fundamentalnye mekhaniki, delaya igru nastolko slozhnoy, naskolko vam nuzhno.

Khotite igrat rasslablenno i bez stressa? Pogruzites v syuzhet na samoy prostoy slozhnosti, ne trebuyushchey napryazhyonnogo obdumyvaniya taktik, kontsentratsii, podschyotov i upravleniya resursami.

Interesno ispytanie s bolee vysokimi stavkami? Ispolzuyte vstroennye rezhimy Sluchaynogo generirovaniya i Nuzlocke, chtoby ispytat izlyublennye modifikatsii poimki sushchestv.

Sozdayte unikalnogo trenera, ispolzuya sotni modifikatsiy vneshnosti, vrode prichyosok, odezhdy i t.d.
ПРЕДУПРЕЖДЕНИЕ: BPM содержит быстро мига:
PREDUPREZhDENIE: BPM soderzhit bystro migayushchie izobrazheniya.
Esli u vas uzhe nablyudalis sudorogi ili poterya soznaniya pod vozdeystviem opredelennykh svetovykh effektov ili migayushchego sveta, nemedlenno prekratite igru i prokonsultiruytes s vrachom, prezhde chem prodolzhit.

Srazites za mogushchestvennuyu Valkiriyu i otrazite vtorzhenie armii Preispodney v Asgard.

Igrovoy protsess
V BPM vse deystviya igroka i vragov privyazany k ritmu muzyki. Pod zvuki epichnogo roka vragi sovershayut serii atak, pokhozhie na tanets. Igra vdokhnovlena retro-shuterami 90-kh godov, i potomu ona bystraya, ritmichnaya i bezbashennaya. Dlya ukloneniya ot atak protivnikov igrok mozhet vypolnyat dvoynoy pryzhok, ryvok, roket-dzhamp i banni-khop.

Tsel igry — proyti do kontsa sluchayno sgenerirovannykh podzemeliy, poluchaya raznoobraznoe oruzhie, predmety i sposobnosti v protsesse igry. Oruzhie i sposobnosti mogut kardinalno menyat khod igry, delaya kazhdoe prokhozhdenie unikalnym.

Na puti k glavnomu bossu nuzhno pobedit 7 promezhutochnykh bossov. U kazhdogo bossa svoya nepovtorimaya manera dvizheniya i ataki, poetomu vazhno znat ikh uyazvimosti, chtoby oderzhat verkh. Vo vremya atak bossov pridetsya pereprygivat cherez ozera lavy, uklonyatsya ot bystro letyashchikh snaryadov ili neukosnitelno soblyudat ritm.

Prigotovtes brosit sebe vyzov s obnovleniem Overdrive: novye personazhi, bolshe oruzhiya, eshche odna glava i dopolnitelnye urovni slozhnosti Trenirovochnyy i Chudovishchnyy.

Osobennosti
•	Strelyayte, prygayte i uklonyaytes ot atak v takt muzyke vo vremya srazheniy s ordami vragov.
•	Srazhaytes s mogushchestvennymi bossami na predele svoikh vozmozhnostey.

Deystvie v igre Dr. Fetus’ Mean Meat Machine razvorachivaetsya srazu posle sobytiy Super Meat Boy Forever. Pristalno nablyudaya za Meat Boy na protyazhenii vsey Super Meat Boy Forever (pomnish te kamery na urovnyakh?), gnusnyy Dr. Fetus poluchil vse neobkhodimye dannye, chtoby sozdat idealnogo klona Meat Boy! No est odin nyuans: sobrannaya im DNK ne sovsem idealna, i iz neyo poluchayutsya… sovsem ne idealnye klony… 

No ne boysya, Dr. Fetus znaet, kak reshit etu problemu. On nadelal ispytatelnykh kamer i progonyaet cherez nikh vsekh sozdannykh klonov, chtoby otseyat neudachnye obraztsy. Pervye klony niskolko ne pokhozhi na Meat Boy, no so vremenem oni nachinayut vsyo bolshe napominat tu chereschur miluyu mordashku, kotoruyu tak nenavidit Dr. Fetus. Do idealnykh klonov uzhe rukoy podat, a kogda oni poyavyatsya… kto znaet, chto nas zhdyot? Vozmozhno, vesyoloe kroshilovo s mochilovym!

Dr. Fetus’ Mean Meat Machine — eto idealnoe sochetanie klassicheskoy golovolomki i khapdkornogo platformera, kotorym byl Super Meat Boy. Preodolevay prepyatstviya i probiraysya skvoz krasivye samodelnye miry. Tebya zhdut bolee 100 urovney, polnye opasnostey i khitrykh lovushek, i glavnoe ispytanie v kontse kazhdogo mira — boy s zhutkim bossom.
Probiraysya cherez znakomye lokatsii Super Meat Boy i Super Meat Boy Forever: zhivopisnyy les, bolnitsu i solyanoy zavod. V igre Dr. Fetus’ Mean Meat Machine malo sozdavat krutye kombo iz 4 i bolee klonov — nuzhno eshchyo uvorachivatsya ot smertelnykh ugroz i lovushek vrode pil, raket i mayatnikov. Znakomyy i lyubimyy zhanr «tri v ryad», tolko v bezumnoy khardkornoy versii!
Lyubuysya oslepitelnymi fonami i animatsiey ot khudozhnikov Super Meat Boy i Super Meat Boy Forever i slushay zamechatelnyy saundtrek ot RIDICULON s unikalnymi remiksami trekov iz Super Meat Boy Forever i novymi melodiyami.

●	Bolee 100 samodelnykh urovney, nabitykh unikalnymi smertelnymi lovushkami
●	Neistovye boi s bossami, s dopolnitelnymi mekhanikami dlya pushchego nakala
●	Edinstvennoe i nepovtorimoe sochetanie golovolomki i ekshena
●	Pomogi Dr. Fetus sozdat idealnogo klona Super Meat Boy
●	Vernis v miry Super Meat Boy i Super Meat Boy Forever
Family Man is a dark, story-led RPG that:
Family Man is a dark, story-led RPG that asks the question: When pushed to the limits of your own morality, how far would you go for the sake of your family?

You owe money to the mob, and you've got three weeks to pay it back. Will you flip burgers and earn an honest living while scraping the money together... or will you take on some dirty jobs for more cash, but potentially push your family away?

Every decision you make affects everyone around you. The neighbourhood will blossom or perish under the weight of your decisions, while the path you choose may lead to your household becoming stronger than ever... or the breakdown of your marriage and relationship with your child.

- Unlock unique perks that suit your gameplay style
- Multiple different endings based on the decisions you made

Relive the fun of classic RPG games insp:
Relive the fun of classic RPG games inspired by dungeons and dragons, realised in rich 3D environments, and with a deep, captivating story. Discover an enigmatic realm, saturated with ancient magic and myths - epic legends are forged as you venture into this offline role-playing game!

Your adventure will lead you beneath ruined towns, through grim, eerie dungeons... and towards monsters lurking in the ghostly half-light. Forces of darkness have invaded the realm, but some survivors from the kingdom of Harten still resist their fate, preserving the secrets of their ancestors' magic. Join the mission to restore liberty and enlightenment to this fantasy land! The kingdom's glory may be faded and its treasures buried, but hope for changing the course of history has not been completely lost in the darkness of the dungeons... and the rewards for your efforts will be great!

In the Moonshades RPG:
- Epic adventures where mythical beasts and fantasy creatures come to life roaming a massive, cryptic dungeon environment.
- Equip yourself for battle and find the best strategies to attack your enemies' weak spots.
- Thousands of upgradable items (weapons, armor, accessories) - and use miraculous artifacts to make them stronger!
- Action and story-telling both play vital roles as you complete quests and puzzles, just as in classic role-playing games.
- Fight in real-time combat for fabulous loot, magical items, and otherworldly abilities!
- Learn devastating, protective or healing spells and skills, and master their status effects in order to advance!
- Roam around a fantasy world, follow your insights, and keep a close watch out - sometimes help might come from surprising sources, so don't leave any paths unexplored!
- Discover the traces of other adventurers... talk and trade with NPCs during your quests, and search for hints to solve puzzles. 
- Reimagine a mythical past through uncovering the haunting memories of fallen heroes! Find the scrolls of Harten and Aesthirya to unearth legendary episodes from the history of a great empire.
- Beware of cunning and deadly traps in the labyrinths!
- Experiment with the wonders of the Magic Forge: make powerful potions, enchant your equipment, and craft epic  legendary items and relics!
- When the moons align, experience adventures in the grim labyrinth of the Arcane Dungeons, questing for marvelous treasures!

I believe we don't have to say farewell to the gems of classic dungeon crawlers and role-playing games - even in our hectic modern world - and with Moonshades I am trying my best to deliver their spirit and charm, while bringing them up-to-date.

Being the long-held dream of an indie developer, Moonshades is constantly shaping and growing with the aim of reviving the excitement of those memorable RPGs. I have a myriad of ideas for quests, puzzles, and various adventures for this old-school RPG that I would love to share with you. I'm keen to avoid the common mistake of focusing only on my favourite aspects and so potentially miss the goal of creating something great along the way! As such, I'm always open to your views and ideas!

So, step into the teleport, and have fun in this adventure game!

The game currently includes 30 hand crafted dungeons and the procedurally generated Pits. New levels will be added in the form of free patches.

Retsenzenty otmechayut, chto ZeroRanger izobiluet otsylkami k drugim shmapam, no pri etom sokhranyaet svoyu individualnost. Dominik Tarason iz «Rock, Paper, Shotgun» nazval ZeroRanger «lyubovno sobrannym miksteypom, vklyuchayushchim luchshie fragmenty za vsyu istoriyu shmapov». Mark Golding iz HonestGamers nazval zeleno-oranzhevuyu tsvetovuyu skhemu neobychnym dizaynerskim resheniem, kotoroe pomogaet ey vydelitsya sredi drugikh igr zhanra; on takzhe otmetil otsylki k shmapam, razrabotannykh v Qute. Gabriel Dzhons iz Cubed3 zametil, chto tut otlichnaya dinamicheskaya sistema «rangov slozhnosti», garantiruyushchaya, chto igroki v lyubom sluchae poluchat otlichnye vpechatleniya, nezavisimo ot urovnya ikh opytnosti.Osnovnuyu kollektsiyu ShootEmUp arkad, 191 sht. sm. zdes.
Thy Sword — это отчаянная круширубилка в:
Thy Sword — eto otchayannaya krushirubilka v stile retro s protsedurno-generiruemymi urovnyami. Vybiray sredi raznykh igrovykh personazhey, takikh kak Varvar ili Valkiriya, chtoby slomat tiraniyu Temnogo Povelitelya!

Vybiray odin iz trekh rezhimov slozhnosti v sootvetstvii so svoim stilem igry. Novichok v takikh priklyucheniyakh? Togda vybiray obuchayushchiy rezhim s beskonechnymi kreditami. Nu a esli ty tertyy kalach — tebe bolshe podoydet geroyskiy rezhim s odnim edinstvennym kreditom. 

Na protyazhenii puteshestviya mozhno razblokirovat dopolnitelnykh personazhey! Pozovi druga sygrat vmeste v rezhime dlya 2 igrokov, chtoby spasti zemli ot Temnogo Povelitelya. Ty smozhesh sobrat vse kristally?

Kharakteristiki:
 * Dinamichnaya, strategicheskaya bitva na mechakh i lukakh
 * Odinochnaya ili sovmestnaya lokalnaya igra
 * Mnozhestvo personazhey na vybor i vozmozhnost razblokirovat novykh
 * Tri rezhima slozhnosti na vybor v sootvetstvii s sobstvennym stilem igry
Follow the Journey of the Little Firefly:
Follow the Journey of the Little Firefly to seek The Mother deep inside the heart of the unknown forest! Though, this journey won't be easy for such a bug. The Little Firefly has to earn the forest trust and prove their worth by solving riddles, challenges, and puzzles.
Deeper into the forest, Our Little Firefly will learn the sacrifice of the forest, the horror of the Devourers, and the secret to awaken Mother.

Ultra Kaiju Monster Rancher — это соверш:
Ultra Kaiju Monster Rancher — eto sovershenno novoe sotrudnichestvo mezhdu Ultraman, izvestnoy yaponskoy rabotoy Tokusatsu, i Monster Rancher, populyarnoy seriey rolevykh simulyatorov. V etoy novoy igre kultovye Ultra Kaydzyu, takie kak Chuzhoy Baltan, Zetton i Gomora, znakomyatsya s populyarnoy igrovoy mekhanikoy vyrashchivaniya monstrov i srazheniy s nimi iz igry Monster Rancher.
Osobennosti:
Судьбоносная встреча запускает цепную ре: Sudbonosnaya vstrecha zapuskaet tsepnuyu reaktsiyu, izmenivshuyu zhizn Marka. Lyudi propadayut, a vospominaniya okazyvayutsya lozhnymi. V etoy priklyuchencheskoy igre vy dolzhny vmeste s Markom i ego druzyami dobratsya do pravdy i raskryt taynu, poka ne pozdno.
Лэйн Ивакура — тихая и замкнутая девочка:
Leyn Ivakura — tikhaya i zamknutaya devochka, u kotoroy v 12 let nachalis slukhovye i zritelnye gallyutsinatsii, a pozzhe i nochnye koshmary. Roditeli zapisali eyo na priyomy k psikhologu Toko Yonere, rabotayushchey v Tatibane — tsentre issledovaniy psikhicheskikh rasstroystv i psikhologii kommunikatsiy. Leyn okazalas pervym patsientom v karere Toko, ona iskrenne pytaetsya pomoch ey, no v to zhe vremya sama ispytyvaet stress iz-za zagruzki rutinnymi zadachami na rabote i problem v lichnoy zhizni..
Serial Experiments Lain («Eksperimenty Leyn») — videoigra po kultovomu anime-serialu, razrabotannaya SR-12W i izdannaya Pioneer LDC 26 noyabrya 1998 goda dlya konsoli PlayStation eksklyuzivno dlya yaponskogo rynka. Igra predstavlyaet soboy interaktivnuyu BD dannykh audio- i videofaylov, v kotorykh nelineyno rasskazyvaetsya istoriya stradayushchey dushevnymi rasstroystvami devochki, a igrok dolzhen osmyslit i sobrat syuzhet voedino.
Glavnaya tema — kem zhe yavlyaetsya Leyn na samom dele. Poskolku istoriya podayotsya cherez lichnye zapisi geroev, mnogie dannye mogut byt libo lozhyu, libo nevernym vospriyatiem proiskhodyashchego. Tut ne budet chyotkikh otvetov na otdelnye voprosy, iz-za chego syuzhetnye momenty mozhno interpretirovat po-raznomu.
Zatragivaya mnozhestvo filosofskikh voprosov, naprimer, realnost, identichnost i obshchenie, «Eksperimenty Leyn» takzhe kasayutsya obedineniya analogovogo mira kontsa XX veka s tsifrovym, chelovecheskogo sushchestvovaniya v Internete i «pokloneniya Bogu cherez tekhnologii».
Большая кинетическая визуальная новелла,:
Bolshaya kineticheskaya vizualnaya novella, napisannaya Yukito Urushibaroy i Sayne o tom, kak chelovecheskoe serdtse vyderzhivaet vsyo, vklyuchaya neumolimoe nasilie i bezgranichnuyu zhestokost.
Say stradaet ot postoyannogo onemeniya i zhivyot tolko radi zashchity svoey mladshey sestryonki. Do tekh por, poka ne proiskhodit sudbonosnaya vstrecha s nekoey devushkoy po imeni Matsuri. V sumerechnom mire, tam, gde smeshivayutsya myortvye i zhivye gruppa yunoshey i devushek stalkivaetsya s nadvigayushcheysya ugrozoy ot zhutkikh sushchestv, izvestnykh kak Maledikty. Oni poznayut kak gorko-sladkuyu storonu zhizni, tak i teplo chelovecheskikh otnosheniy.
Skeletal Avenger — игра в жанре hack'n's: Skeletal Avenger — igra v zhanre hack'n'slash s elementami rogalika. Voskresayte, sobirayte dobychu, issleduyte i provodite kombo. Sozdavayte bezumnye kombinatsii umeniy i pokazyvayte vragam, na chto sposoben vash cherep!
Наберитесь смелости и сделайте шаг в тем:
Naberites smelosti i sdelayte shag v temnotu…
I vot vy v Mariupolise. Povsyudu temno, i vy sbity s tolku strannoy muzykoy, istochnik kotoroy vy ne mozhete opredelit. Vrode by vy detektiv i vam nuzhno chto-to rassledovat, no zachem? Eto vam tozhe predstoit uznat... ili ne uznat. Vse zavisit ot vas i ot slepoy prikhoti Pentakulyusa, mrachnogo bozhestva, kotoroe rasprosterlo svoi ruki nad gorodom.
Soprotivlyaytes tletvornomu dukhu Mrachnogo Temnogo Mariupolisa, vedite rassledovanie i razgadyvayte zagadki. Budte sarkastichnym i nadmennym, chtoby ogradit sebya ot dushelomnogo vozdeystviya etogo proklyatogo mesta. Budte ostorozhny - vash personazh mozhet pogibnut.

- Pokhishchayte chuzhuyu sobstvennost, chtoby dokopatsya do istiny.
- Reshayte golovolomki i provodite rassledovanie.
- Podbirayte pravilnyy stil obshcheniya, chtoby dostich svoikh tseley.
- Inogda vy smozhete sovershat moralnyy vybor.
- Napuskayte tuman, chtoby skryt svoi istinnye motivy.
- Zhaluytes na zhizn, rabotu i obshchestvo.
Ninjin: Clash of Carrots — аниме-боевик:
Ninjin: Clash of Carrots — anime-boevik so mnozhestvom urovney, vragov i vozmozhnostyu menyat personazha. Vam nuzhno vernut ukradennuyu syogunom morkov, chtoby kupit za neyo snaryazhenie v magazine «Korgi» ili oruzhie, maski i pr. v «Taynoy» lavke. Igrat mozhno vdvoyom po internetu ili LS.

V igre bolee 150 orudiy, snaryadov, uluchsheniy i pr. veshchey dlya nastroyki personazha, interesnyy syuzhet, stilnye lokatsii i rezhim na vyzhivanie, gde nuzhno otbivat beskonechnye volny vragov v odinochku ili s tovarishchami po seti.
Исследуйте то, что осталось от человечес:
Issleduyte to, chto ostalos ot chelovechestva, v etom charuyushchem podvodnom priklyuchenii. Vas zhdut vse krasoty morskikh glubin, vstrechi s ikh prekrasnymi obitatelyami i srazheniya s chudovishchnymi tvaryami, a eshche — istoriya o neotvratimoy sudbe i vymiranii.

Iz-za izmeneniya klimata uroven vody podnyalsya neozhidanno vysoko. Poverkhnost Zemli pokrylas ldom, i lyudyam prishlos poselitsya pod vodoy: tolko tam oni vse eshche mogli vyrabatyvat energiyu i vyrashchivat pishchu. 

V 2971 godu resursy nachali istoshchatsya, i kosmicheskie korabli otpravilis k blizhayshim chervotochinam v poiskakh prigodnykh dlya zhizni planet. No vse poshlo ne tak — i korabl «Argo-9» vernulsya tysyacheletiya spustya… 
Melankholichnaya atmosfera: nablyudayte krasotu morya i vliyanie cheloveka na nee.
Povestvovanie i issledovanie: syuzhet podaetsya igroku khudozhestvennymi sredstvami i tekstovymi podskazkami.
Unikalnye boi: srazhaytes i uchites pobezhdat opasnykh morskikh sozdaniy. 
Kontrastnyy geympley: igra rasslablyaet — no tolko poka ne nuzhno srazhatsya za svoyu zhizn!
