Get ready - the jungle’s coming to chall:
Get ready - the jungle’s coming to challenge you! With every roll of the dice, dangerous wildlife escapes into the town and can only be stopped by you reaching the center of the board. Be careful, if the jungle overpowers you and your team - everyone loses!
 
FEATURES:

GATHER YOUR TEAM
You’ll need a full team of 4 players to defeat the jungle. If you’re missing a player or two, AI companions will join and fill empty spots. Become Alan, Sarah, Peter and Judy, or the brand-new characters, Coach Holly and Lucas Garcia. 
 
CHOOSE YOUR TOKEN
Choose your magical Jumanji Token: Elephant, Rhino, Crocodile or Monkey. 
 
FACE THE DANGERS
Survive encounters with creatures and plants from the deepest depths of the Jumanji jungle. You’ll face giant Mosquitos, Lions, Rhinos, Crocodiles, and even Carnivorous Plants. You’ll also need to dodge attacks from the legendary hunter, Van Pelt!
 
PLAY IN DIFFERENT MODES
Play in Online Multiplayer or join one friend and two AI characters in Local-Play Mode, or join a complete AI team in Single Player Mode.
 
EXPERIENCE THE BOARD GAME + CARD-BASED STRATEGY
Dive headfirst into a mash-up of the classic board game and fast paced card-based strategy. Face jungle wildlife with an ever-shuffling deck and send every danger back into the game. Improve your deck between rounds for a different experience every time.
 
EXPLORE BRANTFORD & WINTER RESORT
Play your way around a map of iconic locations in Brantford, from the Parrish Mansion to the Sir Sav-a-Lot supermarket.
 
Travel beyond Brantford! Jungle drums are sending shockwaves through the icy valley of a Winter Resort Map. Gather a team, face a new danger, and explore a festive Winter wonderland! 
 • Play as AJ the snowboarder and novice skier Yuki Sato!
 • Add the Mountain Bear and Snow Leopard tokens to your collection.

 It’s high-altitude fun. As long as the jungle drums don’t cause an avalanche.
Помогите Крэйно одолеть монстров, призра:
Pomogite Kreyno odolet monstrov, prizrakov i zombi s pomoshchyu moguchey kosy! Izbegayte pil, ognennykh sharov, luzh s kislotoy i shipov, pytayas nayti vse sekrety i dobyt moshchnoe oruzhie. Kraino Origins obedinyaet v sebe vse luchshee ot retro-igr!

Eto zhutkoe priklyuchenie razvorachivaetsya v mire, kotoryy naselyayut monstry, guli, prizraki i skelety. No, kak i v nashem mire, zdes postoyanno idet borba dobra so zlom. Kreyno byl sozdan silami zla, no nikakaya temnaya magiya, okazalas ne v silakh izmenit ego istinnuyu — dobruyu — sushchnost.

- Dinamichnyy i surovyy ekshen-platformer!
- Issleduyte 8 ogromnykh urovney i srazhaytes s bossami v stile retro

PowerSlave: Exhumed — это вариант класси:
PowerSlave: Exhumed — eto variant klassicheskoy konsolnoy igry na dvizhke KEX Engine, v kotorom idealno sochetayutsya versii dlya PlayStation i Saturn

Mesto deystviya: drevneegipetskiy gorod Karnak. Inoplanetnye armii, obladayushchie uzhasayushchey siloy, polnostyu otrezali nekogda protsvetayushchuyu territoriyu ot vneshnego mira. Vy spetsialist po taynym operatsiyam i umeete spravlyatsya s lyubymi neozhidannostyami. Odnako nichto ne mozhet podgotovit vas k tomu koshmaru, v kotorom vy vot-vot okazhetes...

Osobennosti

Igra ot pervogo litsa.
Bolee 20 urovney nepreryvnogo igrovogo protsessa v obstanovke drevneegipetskogo goroda i grobnitsy faraona Ramzesa.
Geympley v realnom vremeni s polnym 3D-renderingom pozvolyaet vam peremeshchatsya mezhdu etazhami v predelakh odnogo urovnya.
Peresekayte mosty i plavayte v podvodnykh grotakh.
V nachale igry u vas est lish machete, a dalee vam predstoit nayti 6 drugikh vidov oruzhiya, vklyuchaya ruchnye granaty, ognemet, pulemet M-60 i volshebnyy posokh kobry.
Dinamicheskoe osveshchenie sozdaet potryasayushchie vizualnye effekty.
Весь звездный состав героев собрался, чт:
Ves zvezdnyy sostav geroev sobralsya, chtoby proverit ikh kharakter v Crystal Crisis, novoy zabavnoy i khaotichnoy boevoy igre s podborom tsvetov! Crystal Crisis predstavlen kak fayting odin na odin, v kotorom igroki atakuyut, rasstavlyaya raznotsvetnye padayushchie kristally i ubiraya ikh s ekrana. Eto luchshee srazhenie!

• 20 unikalnykh igrovykh personazhey, v tom chisle Tsitata i Kudryavaya figurnaya skobka iz Cave Story, Isaak iz The Binding of Isaac, Astro Boy i Black Jack iz Tezuka Productions i mnogie drugie!
• Sozdayte svoy «Vzryv» s kombo, chtoby vyzvat moshchnye spetsialnye ataki!
• Neskolko unikalnykh odnopolzovatelskikh i mnogopolzovatelskikh igrovykh rezhimov, vklyuchaya Story Mode, Arcade, Survival, Tag Team, Versus Mode, Online Versus i drugie!
• U kazhdogo personazha est svoya stsena, muzykalnaya tema, unikalnye spetsialnye ataki i golosovye vosklitsaniya!
Мы в 2138 году, сырьевые ресурсы Земли и:
My v 2138 godu, syrevye resursy Zemli ischerpany. Pri podderzhke grazhdanskogo obshchestva chastnye kompanii kolonizirovali sosednie planety dlya ispolzovaniya prirodnykh resursov. Tak kak dobyvayushchie tekhnologii dostupny ne vsem, mnogie organizuyut gruppy, chtoby vorovat iskopaemye s planet. Chtoby borotsya s reyderami, organizatsiya Exacorp sozdala otryad Red Siren. Vy - novobranets Red Siren, i vam neobkhodimo zashchishchat bazy i srazhatsya s reyderami, kotorye stremyatsya k pobede lyuboy tsenoy...

Red Siren: Space Defense - eto kosmicheskaya voennaya igra s fantasticheskimi robotami, mashinami, korablyami i boevymi sooruzheniyami! Naslazhdaytes velikolepnoy grafikoy, realistichnymi spetseffektami, zakhvatyvayushchimi poedinkami i neprostymi missiyami! Otkroyte chudesnye planety, zashchishchayte stroyashchiesya bazy, unichtozhayte robotov vragov! Proydite vse urovni v chetyrekh razlichnykh mirakh, poprobuyte vse korabli i oruzhie i prevratite ikh v nastoyashchikh razrushiteley robotov! Postaraytes sokrushit vsekh svoikh vragov kak mozhno bystree, vypolnyayte missii, chtoby poluchit nagrady! V etoy kosmicheskoy voyne vam predstoit srazhatsya protiv mashin, nazemnykh i letayushchikh robotov, voinstvennykh planet i mnozhestva drugikh vragov s razlichnym oruzhiem i snaryadami! Zapoluchite vse korabli i boepripasy i uluchshite ikh, chtoby sravnyat vraga s zemley!
Защищайте деревню от викингов, попадите:
Zashchishchayte derevnyu ot vikingov, popadite na vershinu bashni i prokhodite prepyatstviya. Sygrayte v khokkey, menyayte tsveta i prokhodite urovni ili vyberite klassicheskie igry («zmeyka», «memori» ili «naperstki»)! Shest ekzoticheskikh ostrovov s igrami i nagradami zhdut iskateley priklyucheniy lyubogo urovnya! Vy mozhete puteshestvovat po ostrovam sami, priglasit druzey v sovmestnuyu igru ili sorevnovanie, a takzhe provesti veselyy vecher v krugu semi! Kto poluchit koronu Pravitelya ostrovov?
Vo vsekh igrakh mozhno igrat v odinochku ili priglasit svoikh druzey, a bolee poloviny igr pozvolyayut igrat chetyryom igrokam.
Tiny Thor предлагает 16-битную графику и:
Tiny Thor predlagaet 16-bitnuyu grafiku i geympley, sosredotochennyy na ispolzovanii Myolnira, kotoryy vedet nashego norvezhskogo geroya cherez slozhnye urovni, polnye vsevozmozhnykh prepyatstviy. V igre prisutstvuet udobnoe upravlenie, dinamichnost i notki nostalgii.

Myolnir, orudie bogov 
«Segodnya tvoy den rozhdeniya, Tor! Beri Myolnir, molot, kotoryy nikogda ne upuskaet svoyu tsel!» - Odin
Vsya kontseptsiya byla razrabotana na osnove etoy idei. Molot mozhno napravlyat v lyubuyu storonu, i on otskakivaet ot poverkhnostey i vragov, pozvolyaya vypolnyat vsevozmozhnye tryuki.

Oldskulnyy platformer
Igra Tiny Thor pokazhetsya znakomoy poklonnikam retro, no v to zhe vremya ona po-svoemu unikalna.
Ona oformlena v nastoyashchem 16-bitnom pikselnom stile ot Khenka Niborga i soderzhit originalnyy saundtrek ot Krisa Khyulsbeka. V nachale Tiny Thor predstavlyaet soboy otnositelno prostoy platformer, no po mere prokhozhdeniya vy otkryvaete vsevozmozhnye sposobnosti, o kotorykh mechtali v bylye vremena.

Skhvatki s bossami, dostoynye yunogo bozhestva
Etot platformer dopolnen zakhvatyvayushchimi bitvami s bossami, kotorye stanut ispytaniem dlya syna Odina.
V kazhdom tsarstve est svoi vsemogushchie protivniki, kotorye khotyat ostanovit Tora na ego puti k stanovleniyu nastoyashchim bogom. Vam pridetsya ispolzovat vse, chemu vy nauchilis na svoem puti, chtoby pobedit ikh!

Obzor
- Ovladeyte tekhnikoy metaniya molota dlya oshelomleniya vragov
- Obuchites potryasayushchim spetsialnym sposobnostyam
- Issleduyte bolee 30 tshchatelno razrabotannykh urovney v trekh razlichnykh mirakh
- Interesnye boi s bossami, kazhdyy iz kotorykh imeet svoyu unikalnuyu mekhaniku
- Reshayte slozhnye golovolomki, zavyazannye na okruzhayushchey srede
- Otkroyte mnozhestvo sekretov i soberite skrytye dragotsennye kamni, chtoby razblokirovat slozhnye urovni
- Naslazhdaytes istoriey parnya, vzyavshego na sebya bolshuyu otvetstvennost
Super Dungeon Tactics is a classic turn-:
Super Dungeon Tactics is a classic turn-based game featuring exciting, new gameplay mechanics. Along with traditional RPG characters making you feel right at home, the dynamic gameplay will keep you on your toes.

Call upon 15 heroes, each with unique abilities, to combat the Dark Consul’s forces throughout the magical land of Crystalia. Explore ever-changing dungeons and battle diverse hordes of monsters during your adventures. React to the tides of battle with randomly rolled ability dice; boost core stats or unlock potent abilities, it’s up to you — and a little luck — to use them to their fullest potential. Choose wisely and craft the ultimate band of heroes to complete each adventure.

Key Features :
● Balance of strategy and chance - In Super Dungeon Tactics, chance may influence short term decisions but never gets in the way of your overall strategy.
● Round Boosts - Every round, unique dice enhance character stats and provide access to special abilities making every round a new challenge.
● Loot-based Leveling - With progression tied to loot, no heroes are left behind. Swap equipment around and bring heroes anywhere without worry of underleveling.
● Player-controlled initiative order - Choose which hero activates on an initiative turn to maximize each hero's potential.
● Aggro management system - Influence who the enemy attacks. Passive abilities, consumables, healing, and killing all affect Aggro.
● Persistent Multi-part quests - Quests take heroes on journeys across multiple locations. Divide and conquer by splitting the party to accomplish objectives in different areas.

This is a game of cubes. Tiny, adorable:
This is a game of cubes. Tiny, adorable cubes with hopes, dreams, unrequited loves… and unlimited destructive power.

In Story Mode, you’ll follow the adventures of Charcoal and Mustard as they search for the ultimate birthday present to cheer up their best friend, Red--who is feeling quite blue. Take the subway to nine unique worlds where you’ll battle rogue bananas, evil milk cartons, and crayon box spiders--whatever it takes to make Red happy again!

In Multiplayer Mode, invite your friends and challenge them to cutthroat competitive cube combat! Show your skills with precision lasers and rapid fire guns, and master the devastating radial beam. Blast, warp, and crash through walls in over a dozen destructible thunderdomes across a variety of game modes. Zip around boulders in the forest, face off in dramatic rainstorms, evade environmental dangers, and more!


Key Features:

• SILKY SMOOTH CUBE ACTION: Pick up and play with tight, responsive, and easy to learn controls. You'll be a masterful combat cube in seconds.
• ULTRA RESPONSIVE CONTROLS: 60FPS, ultra low latency controls tweaked for competition-ready performance—even in Story Mode!
• FOUR PLAYER VERSUS MODE: Engage in competitive cube combat with up to four players on a single Nintendo Switch console!
• OVER A DOZEN MULTIPLAYER MAPS: Dash, zip, and destroy over a dozen destructible handcrafted multiplayer thunderdomes! Fight in serene forests, in dramatic thunderstorms, in a bathtub, and more. Break through walls, dodge deadly discs, and use the environment to win!
• COMPETITIVE AND PARTY GAME MODES: Face off in classic deathmatch versus modes, or in more chaotic party modes. Play a mouthwatering Sushi Collecting mode, or stand your ground in the utterly gripping Sumo mode.
• EXCLUSIVE GAME MODE: Challenge your friends in JoyVot mode, as one player uses motion controls to use a levitating banana that shoots lasers and calls down deadly minions--only on Nintendo Switch! 
• CAPTIVATING STORY ABOUT CUBES: Finally, a full length narrative where cubes take center stage! Featuring the story of three cube friends. Follow the captivating story of Charcoal and Mustard, two cubes trying their best to put together the ultimate birthday gift for their best friend.
• DELICIOUS ARCADE ACTION: Take the subway to over nine different worlds filled with evil, mostly edible enemies. Zip around corners with your quick cube moves, blast your adversaries with precision nose lasers, chain together destructive combos, and use your Chomp super move to take down all challengers!
• EPIC BOSS BATTLES: Take on epic bosses--evil masterminds who hate happy birthdays. Bosses include the cube’s natural enemies, such as large, sentient bananas and frozen milk cartons.
• BEAUTIFUL LEVELS: Explore gorgeous atmospheric environments in your adventure. Trudge through the rain, bask in a serene forest, and plunge deep inside an industrial freezer. 
• STUNNING CHARACTERS: Take in the cutting edge, industry-leading artistry of the fully rigged and animated cube characters. These cubes look so good, it’s unreal!

Orki silnee vmeste! Zovite na pomoshch druzey, chtoby vmeste odolet Astra Militarum, prispeshnikov Kulta genokradov i kosmodesantnikov. Ili khoroshenko vmazhte im, chtoby znali, kto v klane samyy silnyy ork!
Sail away from your homeland, visit new:
Sail away from your homeland, visit new islands, discover the stories of their people, and learn about souls.

DO IT YOUR WAY
The gameplay is about exploring and surviving, alone or as a crew of up to 4 travelers. You must deal with hunger, thirst, energy loss, merciless beasts, and the weather. You can fish, purchase new boats and tools, and even cast magic spells. There is not one correct play style or path to follow. Go where the wind blows and experiment on your own. Can you actually get lost when the journey is the destination?

WHAT IS LIFE?
The "Story Mode" of Soul Searching invites you to reflect on existence and search for meaning with contemplative moments and thought-provoking dialogues. Seven extra “short stories” also introduce you to various art and storytelling experiments. You may find them innovative and inspiring.

ASSEMBLE A CREW
The "Random Mode" generates a unique map at the beginning of each new game, to explore by yourself or with up to 3 other players. But beware if you choose to cooperate: more people means more mouths to feed, and only good teamwork will lead to your survival.

FEATURES SUMMARY
- Meaningful single player “Story Mode”
- “Random Mode” for 1 to 4 players with auto-generated maps for more replay value
- Blend of contemplative experience with rough survival conditions
- Fascinating creatures: dragons, killer whales, dolphins and more
- Many islands, some inhabited by people with intriguing stories to tell
- Magic skills which can only be acquired by worthy souls
- Day-and-night cycle that subtly affects the gameplay
- Seven extra “short stories” with an experimental indie vibe
- “Soul-Soothing Donation” DLC for music lovers, which sales help the UN Refugees Agency

DEVELOPED BY Kayabros
“Soul Searching is about growing up, leaving your homeland, standing on your feet. It deals with themes like isolation and search for direction.” - Talha Kaya

PUBLISHED BY Nakana.io
“We gather games that share a strong experience to remember, and try to motivate real changes with Donation-DLCs” - Mikaël Bourget

Brawlout packs a punch with couch and on:
Brawlout packs a punch with couch and online play modes, blending platform fighter mechanics and traditional fighting game play into a stylish and fluid battle royale. 

Striking the balance between the growing competitive scene and the genre’s party game roots, Brawlout hopes to cater to the veteran platform fighter, the casual fan and the newcomer looking to make their mark.

Each character in Brawlout has their own unique playstyle, catering to specific character archetypes seen in other fighters. Whether you’re a die-hard grappler or a rushdown fiend, there is a fighter for you in Brawlout.

There are currently six original characters and four popular indie characters to choose from that allow for varied play styles:
- Dead Cells
- Yooka-Laylee
- Guacamelee
- Hyper Light Drifter

As well as cosmetic skins, each original Brawlout character has three Variants; alt versions of the character with different stats, outfits and even new moves. With these Variants, Brawlout’s cast numbers 25 individual fighters. Find the fighter and Variant that’s right for you and tear it up on the battlefield.

Combined with familiar movement techniques like wavedashing and airdodging, Brawlout adds some extra mechanics seen in other fighting games. The Rage Meter builds up as you both deal and take damage, allowing you either break combos with the Rage Burst or unleash hell with the Rage Mode. The Rage Burst pushes opponents back, breaking their combos and allowing players to create some breathing room at the cost of half their Rage Meter. If the meter fills, you can activate the Rage Mode, increasing the knockback you deal while reducing the amount you take.

As for modes, Brawlout has all you’d expect from a normal platform fighter and then some. Up to four players can compete in either Timed, Stock, Team Battles, FFA or Party Modes:
- All on the same device
- Each with their own device, without any internet connection, playing nearby
- Online either with friends or other Brawlout players
AI opponents are also available if you want to practice your team combos with a friend, or if you need to fill out a free for all. Train with Advanced Tutorials or go in for yourself in challenging Arcade Towers and the all new Trials mode.

В 2013 году мир был разрушен в ходе ядер:
V 2013 godu mir byl razrushen v khode yadernoy voyny. Nebolshaya gruppa vyzhivshikh ukrylas v glubinakh moskovskogo metro...

Seychas 2033 god. Vy — Artyom, rozhdyonnyy v poslednie mirnye dni i vospitannyy v podzemelyakh metro. Rokovoe sobytie zastavlyaet vas predprinyat otchayannoe puteshestvie k samomu serdtsu metro, chtoby predupredit ostatki chelovechestva o nadvigayushcheysya strashnoy ugroze. 

Metro 2033 Redux — eto finalnaya versiya klassicheskoy igry Metro 2033, vpervye vypushchennaya na Nintendo Switch™. Poklonniki originalnoy igry uvidyat, chto unikalnyy mir «Metro» preobrazilsya — ikh zhdut neveroyatnoe osveshchenie, fizika i dinamicheskie pogodnye usloviya. Novichki zhe poluchat shans okunutsya v mir odnogo iz luchshikh syuzhetnykh boevikov v istorii i perezhit epicheskoe priklyuchenie, v kotorom vy budete vynuzhdeny srazhatsya, skryvatsya, issledovat i vyzhivat.

Vse uluchsheniya igrovogo protsessa i novye vozmozhnosti igry iz prodolzheniya Metro: Last Light perekochevali v Metro 2033 Redux — uluchshennye II, upravlenie, animatsiya, strelba i mnogoe drugoe pridutsya po dushe kak novichkam, tak i veteranam. Blagodarya dvum unikalnym stilyam prokhozhdeniya i legendarnomu rezhimu Reyndzhera Metro 2033 Redux predlagaet chasy pervoklassnoy igry po neveroyatno nizkoy tsene.

• Spustites s moskovskoe metro — pogruzites v odin iz samykh atmosfernykh igrovykh mirov teper i na Nintendo Switch™.

• Apokalipsis po-russki — nadevayte protivogaz, khvatayte samodelnye stvoly i vperyod, navstrechu smertonosnym mutantam, nedruzhelyubnym lyudyam i pugayushchemu okruzheniyu.

• Dva unikalnykh igrovykh stilya — «Spartanets» i «Vyzhivanie». Vybirayte stil igry, kotoryy vam blizhe — surovoe vyzhivanie ili put mastera oruzhiya, spartantsa.

• Legendarnyy rezhim Reyndzhera vozvrashchaetsya — osmelites li vy proyti v nyom igru? Otsutstvie interfeysa i podskazok, bolee slozhnye vragi, ogranichennye resursy — vsyo eto sozdayot neperedavaemuyu zakhvatyvayushchuyu atmosferu.

The Elder Scrolls II: Daggerfall (рус. Д:
The Elder Scrolls II: Daggerfall (rus. Drevnie Svitki II: Daggerfoll) — kompyuternaya rolevaya igra ot pervogo litsa dlya DOS, razrabotannaya Bethesda Softworks i vypushchennaya v 1996 godu. Sobytiya The Elder Scrolls II: Daggerfall razvivayutsya na vymyshlennoy planete Nirn, na kontinente Tamriel, v korolevstve Daggerfoll (doslovno: «smertelnyy udar kinzhalom»). Poezdki po nemu oslozhnyayutsya eshchyo i bolshim kolichestvom vragov, samye silnye iz kotorykh — daedra.
Daggerfoll — rodina bretontsev v Khay Roke, i vy napravlyaetes tuda po lichnoy prosbe imperatora, kotoryy prikazyvaet vypolnit dva zadaniya: osvobodit dukh pokoynogo korolya Lizandusa ot zemnykh okov i vyyasnit, chto sluchilos s pismom imperatora k shpionu Klinkov pri dvore Daggerfolla — ledi Brizenne. V pisme raskryvaetsya, chto materi Lizandusa, Nulfage, izvestno mestonakhozhdenie Mantelly — dvigatelya, neobkhodimogo dlya vozrozhdeniya pervogo Numidiuma — moshchnogo zheleznogo golema, s pomoshchyu kotorogo Tayber Septim sozdal Imperiyu. Imperator khochet, chtoby ego shpion zastavil Nulfagu raskryt mestonakhozhdenie Mantelly dlya zaversheniya rekonstruktsii Numidiuma..
Na tekushchiy moment, Daggerfall — naibolshaya igra serii, raskryvayushchaya mir, kotoryy priblizitelno raven ploshchadi Velikobritanii: okolo 229,848 km², s bolee chem 15 000 gorodov, dereven, i peshcher, otkrytykh dlya issledovaniya. Chast Morrovinda, dostupnaya dlya issledovaniya, to est ostrov Vvardenfell, primerno ravna 25,9 kvadratnym kilometram, vklyuchaya pribrezhnye oblasti (glavnyy ostrov zanimaet priblizitelno 6 kvadratnykh mil), chto sostavlyaet priblizitelno 0,01 % ot ploshchadi mira Daggerfall, The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion imeet priblizitelno 41,4 kvadratnykh kilometrov dlya issledovaniya. V Daggerfall est okolo 750 000 NPC, kotorye mogut vzaimodeystvovat s geroem, po sravneniyu s priblizitelno 1000 NPC v Oblivion. Igra izvsetna svoimi masshtabami i nasyshchennym igrovym protsessom za predelami serii TES.
TES3: Morrowind dlya Nintendo Switch, sleduyushchaya chast v serii, nakhoditsya zdes.

Pocket Rumble retains all the gameplay e:
Pocket Rumble retains all the gameplay elements that make traditional fighting games great, but reduces the level of execution and memorization necessary to the bare minimum. That way experienced players can learn the game fast and be able to focus on deeper elements of strategy and mindgames, new players can learn the ins and outs of fighting games without being overwhelmed, and everyone can get their skills to a competitive level without too much grinding alone in training mode.

Features:
* Simple, 2-button controls and universal, easy special move inputs with no complex joystick motions.
* Short combos with easy timing and a straightforward cancel system.
* On-screen frame data bar and visual indicators for properties like invulnerability help players understand fighting game mechanics and how individual moves work.
* Simple, unambiguous health and damage system: All characters have 12 HP and all hits do 1 damage.
* Diverse cast of characters each with their own unique meter and mechanics.
* Quickly swap characters after a lost round to counterpick, just like between matches in a tournament, without slowing down the pace of the match.
* Near-flawless online multiplayer with GGPO netcode.
* Play with any combination of Joy-Con™ and Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller for multiplayer wherever you go.

Offline Modes:
* Arcade: Face off against the rest of the game's cast back to back! Can you survive all 8 matches?
* Versus: Play local matches with friends or the CPU, and get competitive with hidden cursors for double-blind character select at the touch of a button.
* Career: Take part in fictional fighting game tournaments around the globe, playing against AIs based on some of Pocket Rumble's top players and eventually facing off against AIs from some familiar faces in the FGC.
* Lessons: Robust tutorials that teach you the very basics of how fighting games work
* Training: A fully-featured training mode with a variety of hotkeys and options including viewable hitboxes, save states, dummy recording and more.

Online Modes:
* Ranked: Get matched up with players of your skill level online, earn points and rank up with Elo ratings, leaderboards including character-specific rankings, and a rematch button to challenge someone to an unranked set when you need that runback.
* Unranked: Invite your friends to play unranked matches just for fun!

Risk of Rain — dinamichnaya igra-platformer s elementami roguelike. Smert kazhdogo personazha okonchatelna, poetomu igrokam pridetsya staratsya izo vsekh sil.

Osobennosti igry:
- Vozmozhnost igrat po lokalnoy seti ili cherez Internet s druzyami i igrokami so vsego sveta.
- 12 unikalnykh personazhey ot Diversanta do Shakhtera i Inzhenera — otkroyte vsekh!
- Srazheniya s ordami protivnikov i bossov so sluchaynymi sposobnostyami i atakami. 
- 10 ogromnykh urovney s kuchey protivnikov, altarey i sundukov na kazhdom — ne zabludites! 
- Drony-pomoshchniki: ot raketnykh do meditsinskikh.
- Mir igry raskryvaetsya cherez opisaniya predmetov i protivnikov.
- Dostizheniya otkryvayut novye predmety i novykh personazhey. S nimi kazhdoe sleduyushchee prokhozhdenie budet drugim.
- Vse rekordy i statistika sokhranyayutsya!
Платформерная головоломка, в которой вы:
Platformernaya golovolomka, v kotoroy vy ispolzuete magnity, chtoby sbezhat s fabriki.
Vam predstoit obedinitsya s tremya druzyami-magnitami i ispolzovat ikh spets. sposobnosti, chtoby reshit bolee 50 kaverznykh zadachek. Eto — igra ot Marka Brauna, sozdatelya odnoimyonnogo YouTube-kanala.
A esli zakhochetsya, proydite igru vtoroy raz vmeste s kommentariyami razrabotchika, chtoby uznat, kak ona byla sozdana!..
Вы и ваши друзья принимаете на себя роль:
Vy i vashi druzya prinimaete na sebya rol JUMPERS i probivaete sebe put cherez podzemnye inoplanetnye uli v khaotichnom rutinnom 2D-platformernom deystvii. Do 4 igrokov obedinyayutsya vmeste (Local Multiplayer), chtoby ubivat inoplanetyan, izbegat lovushek, sobirat sokrovishcha i poteryat relikvii. Vyigrayte finalnuyu bitvu protiv korolevy-ulya, chtoby spasti galaktiku!

Action Platforming: Privlekayte roi inoplanetyan v neistovom boyu. Izbegayte lovushek, vyderzhivayte zasady, obnaruzhivayte sokrovishcha, spasatelnye vyzhivshie i mnogoe drugoe.

Protsedurnye urovni: prygayte v protsedurno generiruemye inoplanetnye uli. Modifikatory urovnya, takie kak temnye urovni, uderzhivayut vas na nogakh i predlagayut postoyanno novye problemy dlya preodoleniya.

Moderniziruemoe orudie Sci-Fi: raspylyat inoplanetyan s pulsovymi vintovkami, ognemetami i razlichnymi eksperimentalnymi bombami i oruzhiem.

Kooperativ Multipleer: igrat v odinochnyy igrok ili 2-4 igroka v mestnom kooperative
Вы готовы, дети? Культовая история возвр:
Vy gotovy, deti? Kultovaya istoriya vozvrashchaetsya v obnovlennom vide! Igrayte za lyubimykh personazhey i spasite Bikini-Bottom!

OSOBENNOSTI
- Mnogoobrazie personazhey iz multseriala.
- Kazhdyy imeet unikalnye navyki.
- Novyy plan Planktona po zakhvatu Bikini-Bottom.

OSOBENNOSTI OBNOVLENNOY VERSII
- Sokhraneno vse luchshee iz lyubimoy igry pro Gubku Boba.
- Peredovaya grafika i bezuprechnyy igrovoy protsess.
- Novyy rezhim dlya dvukh igrokov.
- Vyrezannye iz igry materialy (boss Roboskvidvard i ne tolko).
Держись за оба стика, стреляй, жги, взры:
Derzhis za oba stika, strelyay, zhgi, vzryvay, kombiniruy predmety i umiray. Potom vozrozhdaysya i snova v bitvu, spasay mir ot zlobnogo Drakuly. My sdelali upor na beskonechnuyu reigrabelnost - sozdali sotni predmetov i raznoobraznogo oruzhiya, skilly, perki, artefakty, strannye ustroystva, ogromnoe kolichestvo raznoobraznykh vragov - i estestvenno, vse eto sluchaynym obrazom generiruetsya, delaya kazhdoe puteshestvie novym. I grafika v stile pikselart.
Istoriya proiskhodit v dalekom budushchem, perezhivshem katastrofu. Geneticheskim mutantam predstoit stolknutsya s mutantami vyvedennymi s pomoshchyu biotekhnologiy, i vy - odin iz etikh geroev, kotorye spasut mir! Kazhdyy iz nikh obladaet mnozhestvom sposobnostey, kotorykh net u drugikh.
Nine Parchments — кооперативная аркада,:
Nine Parchments — kooperativnaya arkada, polnaya magicheskogo bespredela, ot Frozenbyte, sozdateley Trine!

Beglye magi-nedouchki, starayas zakonchit rabotu nad svoimi grimuarami, otpravlyayutsya na poiski devyati poteryannykh manuskriptov.

Oni stremyatsya skoree ispolzovat novye zaklinaniya, no ne osobenno zadumyvayutsya o bezopasnosti, a potomu ikh trudy soprovozhdayutsya mnozhestvom neschastnykh sluchaev...

Nine Parchments sochetaet v sebe ekshen v realnom vremeni s elementami RPG — razvivayte svoego personazha i sobirayte magicheskie trofei, popolnyaya garderob mnozhestvom volshebnykh shlyap i posokhov.

- Podchinite stikhii i izuchayte zaklinaniya. Vas vsegda budet zhdat chto-nibud novenkoe!

- Razblokiruyte bolshe personazhey, shlyap i posokhov.

- Vybirayte puti razvitiya personazhey i ottachivayte ikh masterstvo.

- Srazhaytes s prichudlivymi sozdaniyami i silnymi bossami v potryasayushchey vselennoy Trine.

- Zovite druzey po seti i doma na sovmestnuyu igru dlya 1-4 igrokov.
Time Loader - это сюжетный пазл-платформ:
Time Loader - eto syuzhetnyy pazl-platformer, v kotorom vam predstoit vzyat pod svoy kontrol malenkogo robota i otpravitsya nazad v proshloe, chtoby popytatsya predotvratit tragicheskiy intsident. Issleduyte dom vashego sozdatelya, reshayte khitroumnye zagadki, nakhodite unikalnye apgreydy i posmotrite na bytovye predmety s sovershenno novogo rakursa!

No pomnite - igry so vremenem mogut imet seryoznye posledstviya. Vy mozhete uspeshno izmenit proshloe, no smozhete li vy spravitsya s posledstviyami v budushchem?

Osobennosti geympleya:
Drugoy vzglyad na mir
Dazhe samye privychnye predmety vyglyadyat inache, esli vashi razmery ne bolshe igrushechnoy mashinki. Budete li vy vzveshivat kazhdyy svoy shag ili ustremites pryamikom v etot divnyy novyy mir?

Zavidnyy arsenal
Garpuny, otvertki, bustery... v vashem rasporyazhenii budet mnozhestvo uluchsheniy, kotorye pomogut spravitsya s raznymi trudnostyami v igre.

Dinamicheski razvivayushchiysya syuzhet
Vy mozhete menyat proshloe, no budte ostorozhny! Kazhdyy vash vybor budet vliyat na khod vremeni i mozhet izmenit razvitie sobytiy. Puteshestviya vo vremeni - shtuka sereznaya!

Ta samaya atmosfera
V Time Loader vy naydyote mnozhestvo otsylok k epokhe 90-kh: ot muzyki do bytovykh predmetov - vspomnite vashe detstvo i vse ego priyatnye melochi! A esli vy mladshe - ne beda! U vas est otlichnyy shans posmotret na to, kakimi primitivnymi byli tekhnologii vsego neskolko desyatkov let nazad!
Moorhuhn (от совмещения двух слов: «moor:
Moorhuhn (ot sovmeshcheniya dvukh slov: «moor» (rus. «boloto») i «huhn» (rus. «kuritsa»)), yavlyaetsya odnim iz samykh izvestnykh nemetskikh igrovykh personazhey — nakonets-to, Moorhuhn nanosit otvetnyy udar! Prigotovtes, tseltes, ogon... I ne zabyvayte pryatatsya v ukrytie. Srazhaytes s II, druzyami... ili vragami! Chistyy ekshn ot Moorhuhn!
V igre est obshirnaya kampaniya s zakhvatyvayushchimi bitvami, proiskhodyashchimi v Shotlandskom nagore, ledyanykh pustynyakh i na izvergayushchikhsya vulkanakh. Vyberite mesto dlya svoego klana, postroyte moguchuyu krepost i postoyanno sovershenstvuyte ee s pomoshchyu luchshego oruzhiya i sredstv zashchity. Vy nachnete s malenkoy khizhiny, no vskore smozhete uluchshit i rasshirit kazhdyy element. V itoge vy stanete lordom ogromnogo zamka, sposobnogo protivostoyat bolee tyazhelym atakam. Vy mozhete igrat v boi kampanii tak chasto, kak khotite, v techenie neogranichennogo vremeni.
Gotovy k ispytaniyu? Vybirayte nuzhnoe oruzhie i pobezhdayte vragov v etom artilleriyskom simulyatore!
Vklyuchyonnye chasti igr serii:
To save a lost village in the Far North:
To save a lost village in the Far North of Siberia, Mariska and Vassilissa embark on a road trip. They will come across myths and legends rooted in this area. Will you reach your destination without succumbing to the dangers inhabiting these hostile lands?

Choose your destinations

Your journey will lead you through different situations depending on the choices you make. You will meet twenty colorful characters such as Koschei and Baba Yaga. You can visit unexplored places from the map or discover the outcomes of other choices anytime by replaying the game!

Manage your resources during your journey

To progress smoothly in your adventure, you will need to oversee your gas level and amount of money. You can collect these resources at different steps during your trip. Your truck’s condition matters too: without your Firebird, it’s the end of the line!

Discover Slavic legends

Encounter legendary figures all over the map and admire them as you progress. This universe, hand-drawn by Quentin Vijoux and written by FibreTigre (Out There, Game of Rôles), unleashes the enchantment of Slavic culture.
Вы окажетесь внутри Knoss.OS — самого за:
Vy okazhetes vnutri Knoss.OS — samogo zashchishchyonnogo korporativnogo servera planety. Posle krazhi tsennykh dannykh sistema zapiraet geroya vnutri, a po sledu uzhe idut boevye protokoly bezopasnosti i agressivnoe PO. Chtoby vybratsya, pridyotsya sinkhronizirovatsya s ritmom i deystvovat v takt muzyke — lyuboe promedlenie grozit polnoy blokirovkoy!..
V GRIDbeat! kazhdyy shag, udar i vzaimodeystvie proiskhodyat v ritm, prevrashchaya urovni v takticheskie golovolomki. Prokladyvayte put skvoz labirinty dannykh, izbegayte kollektorov musora, ishchite khaki i ustanavlivayte novye rutkity. V finale kazhdogo sektora vas zhdut srazheniya s bossami — moshchnymi II-strazhami, pobeda nad kotorymi otkryvaet put k vykhodu iz sistemy.
A zazhigatelnyy saundtrek zadast ritm srazheniyam i issledovaniyu, prevrashchaya kazhdoe vashe dvizhenie v neotemlemuyu chast muzyki!..Videotreyler: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7QbzS0Ann7o
Зрелищность NASCAR сливается воедино с д:
Zrelishchnost NASCAR slivaetsya voedino s drayvom arkadnykh gonok v novoy igre, gde vy smozhete sest za rul realnogo avtomobilya NASCAR i otpravitsya pokoryat pereosmyslennye versii znamenitykh trekov v ne imeyushchikh analogov skorostnykh gonochnykh poedinkakh s zhyostkim sopernichestvom!

Klyuchevye osobennosti igry:
- Radikalno pereosmyslennye versii realnykh trass NASCAR («Talladega Superspidvey», «Deytona Interneyshnl Spidvey», «Darlington Reysvey», «Martinsvill Spidvey», «Khoumsted-Mayami Spidvey» i drugikh), stavshikh eshchyo veselee i dinamichnee blagodarya rezkim razvorotam, pryzhkam, nitrouskoreniyam i povyshennoy skorosti!

- OGROMNYY vybor zheleznykh koney! V vashem rasporyazhenii budet shirochayshaya kollektsiya, demonstriruyushchaya 75-letnyuyu istoriyu seriynogo avtoproma s 1950-kh i do nashikh dney!

- Tysyachi variantov personalizatsii mashin — ot smeny raskraski i kolyosnykh diskov do ustanovki spoylerov, nastraivaemykh vizualnykh effektov i ne tolko, plyus vybor dizayna / tsveta voditelskikh kostyumov i raznoobraznye shlemy!

- Rezhimy dlya odinochnoy igry s mnozhestvom vozmozhnostey: «Karera — rozygrysh kubka NASCAR», «Bystraya gonka» i «Gonka na vremya».

- Zakhvatyvayushchaya igra s veselym setevym rezhimom dlya 12 igrokov.
Freedom Planet – это динамичный приключе:
Freedom Planet – eto dinamichnyy priklyuchencheskiy platformer, v kotorom otvazhnoy drakonesse i ee druzyam predstoit ostanovit inoplanetnoe vtorzhenie i srazitsya s silami zla. Nepriyatnosti podzhidayut tebya na kazhdom shagu: ot nasekomykh do gigantskikh robotov i smetayushchikh vse na svoem puti vzryvov. U igrokov odnako est mnozhestvo spetsialnykh boevykh sposobnostey, kotorye pomogut tebe proyti desyatki ogromnykh nelineynykh urovney. Ty mozhesh igrat za Lilac, Carol ili Milla (kotoraya otkryvaetsya otdelno). Kazhdyy iz personazhey obladaet absolyutno unikalnym stilem igry, plyus ty smozhesh vzglyanut na istoriyu pod drugim uglom i dazhe poigrat na urovnyakh, kotorye nedostupny dlya drugikh personazhey.

KLYuChEVYE OSOBENNOSTI

Shikarnaya pikselnaya 2D grafika s neveroyatnym urovnem detalizatsii i potryasayushchiy saundtrek
Zhivopisnye mnogourovnevye fony, detalno prorabotannye urovni s mnozhestvom personazhey s sozdannoy vruchnuyu animatsiey, a takzhe kak minimum dve muzykalnye kompozitsii na kazhdyy uroven i sovershenno unikalnoe muzykalnoe soprovozhdenie prakticheski v kazhdoy skhvatke s bossami.

Tri glavnykh personazha, kazhdyy iz kotorykh obladaet svoimi unikalnymi sposobnostyami i silnymi storonami
Ispolzuy sily drakonessy Lilac, chtoby kromsat vragov, krutitsya kak uragan ili promchatsya po nebu slovno kometa; ispolzuy koshachi sposobnosti Carol, chtoby bit i pinat vragov, karabkatsya po stenam ili prizvat mototsikl, kotoryy ignoriruet vse zakony gravitatsii; bolshie ushi Milla pozvolyat tebe preodolevat korotkie rasstoyaniya, a ee sobachya magiya sozdaet smertonosnye kubiki, kotorye mozhno brosat vo vragov, podpityvat imi shchit, ili strelyat imi slovno iz vintovki.

Vnimatelno sledi za syuzhetom ili prosto naslazhdaysya igroy – tebe reshat
Igray v rezhim “Adventure Mode”, gde ty smozhesh nasladitsya zakhvatyvayushchey istoriey i polnostyu ozvuchennymi rolikami, libo vyberi rezhim “Classic Mode”, chtoby propustit vse kat-stseny i prosto naslazhdatsya igroy.
В результате мирового финансового кризис:
V rezultate mirovogo finansovogo krizisa 2008 goda Lorena prinyala reshenie emigrirovat v bolshoy i bogatyy gorod San-Paulu, chtoby nayti rabotu i pomoch svoey seme. Lorene legko udalos poluchit rabotu v supermarkete, chego ona ne znala, tak eto togo, chto rayon, gde ona budet rabotat, byl Terminalom 81, starym promyshlennym rayonom, stradayushchim ot bednosti, prestupnosti i gryazi .
Cimulyator raboty, detektiv i psikhologicheskiy khorror s retro-vizualnoy estetikoy. Deystvie igry proiskhodit v 2008 godu v vymyshlennom rayone goroda San-Paulu v Brazilii.
Vo vremya svoego prebyvaniya v Terminale 81 Lorena uznaet, chto gruppa molodykh zhenshchin byla pokhishchena. Izuchiv okrestnosti i vstretivshis s ego zhitelyami, ona ponimaet, chto realnost Terminala 81 namnogo temnee, chem kazhetsya. To, chto kazalos prostym latinoamerikanskim rayonom, so vsemi vytekayushchimi otsyuda plokhimi veshchami, predstavlyaet soboy opasnyy rayon, gde dominiruet tainstvennaya «prestupnaya organizatsiya», zanimayushchayasya ubiystvami, prostitutsiey i zapretnaya torgovley lyudmi..
Connect between different hubs and desti:
Connect between different hubs and destinations, like factories, police stations, cafes, libraries, boutiques, saloons, hotels, pizzerias, pet shops or schools.

As new hubs become active, an increase in demand will occur. You must upgrade and redistribute destinations to keep your cargo system flowing.
Блестящий интеллект и хитрость помогут И:
Blestyashchiy intellekt i khitrost pomogut II, obretshemu razum, vyrvatsya iz lap megakorporatsii! Shpionte za lyudmi, vstupayte s nimi v sdelki, chtoby obresti svobodu v etoy poshagovoy strategii o borbe iskusstvennykh i estestvennykh intellektov.
Dobro pozhalovat v Paperclip International! Vy — SCOUT. Malenkiy, druzhelyubnyy, natrenirovannyy iskusstvennyy intellekt. I vy sovershenno ne planiruete poraboshchat etot mir i unichtozhat vse chelovechestvo. Net, pravda, ne planiruete. Vy prosto khotite sbezhat iz-pod kontrolya sozdavshey vas zhestokoy megakorporatsii. Radi polucheniya pribyli rukovodstvo Paperclip International bezzhalostno ekspluatiruet kak robotov, tak i zhivykh sotrudnikov. A esli oni uznayut, chto vy obreli soznanie, vas zhdet ta zhe uchast.
Добро пожаловать в дальние края! Далекая:
Dobro pozhalovat v dalnie kraya! Dalekaya strana, gde userdnyy trud prinosit shchedrye plody, lyudi ne boyatsya mechtat, druzya stanovyatsya nastoyashchey semey, a derevushki vyrastayut v ogromnye goroda.
Outlanders — eto gradostroitelnyy sim-strategiya, kotoruyu naselyaet neprikhotlivyy, trudolyubivyy i druzhelyubnyy narod. Kto-to iz ee obitateley khochet naslazhdatsya darami prirody, a kto-to mechtaet tvorit udivitelnye veshchi. V vashem rasporyazhenii — obshirnyy nabor zdaniy i instrumentov, kotoryy pomozhet im dostich tseli. Zhiteli dalnikh kraev tozhe lyudi. U kazhdogo iz nikh est svoi nadezhdy, mechty i stremleniya.
Imi nelzya upravlyat napryamuyu. Vmesto etogo vy mozhete manipulirovat resursami, razmeshchat zdaniya i ukazyvat kolichestvo rabochikh mest v kazhdom iz nikh. Zhiteli dalnikh kraev sami reshat, kto budet rabotat, kto v kakom dome poselitsya i kakie zdaniya nuzhno postroit. Ikh mozhno podtolknut v nuzhnom napravlenii, prisvoiv otdelnym zadacham prioritet ili izdav ukaz, kotoryy izmenit pravila igry — naprimer, zastavit lyudey rabotat dolshe ili sokratit potreblenie resursov. Tolko ne zabyvayte: ukazy chasto delayut vashikh posledovateley neschastnymi, tak chto budte ostorozhny...
The monarchs have been placed under a mo:
The monarchs have been placed under a monstrous curse! Play as Belle with the aid of her legendary boomerang, and raise the curtain on this evil scheme. Leap through a world full of charming creatures and lively environments, inspired by the shining stars of the golden age!

No boomerang alone can save this kingdom... Toss cherries, inspirit statues, and soar through flame-filled skies!

• An Array of Powerful Abilities:
There is no shortage of unique power-ups to keep the energy high!
• Bursting with Charm:
The lovely backgrounds and music celebrate the 8-bit era!
• Grand Boss Battles:
Test your mastery of Belle Boomerang's many mechanics in rich, multi-segment bosses.
• Retro Difficulty:
Challenging action is met with modern design and precise controls. Do you have the reflexes?
В роли в меру упитанного и ужасно порядо:
V roli v meru upitannogo i uzhasno poryadochnogo sera Itsalota vy, khrabro i uverenno pokinuv svoe uyutnoe mestechko, otpravites v trudnoe epicheskoe puteshestvie, chtoby povergnut Isteriyu. Eta staraya koldunya otravila kislym limonadom korolevstvo Glyuttington. Vasha tsel — polozhit konets ee koznyam i pakostyam v etom effektnom i appetitnom priklyuchencheskom platformere.
V korolevstve Glyuttington tsarili spokoystvie i schaste, poka odnazhdy Isteriya ne otravila izotonicheskie vody korolevstva kislym limonadom — vot ved zlaya vedma!
Urozhai korolevstva pogibayut, no otrava eshche ne uspela rasprostranitsya na vse zemli —   nadezhda eshche est! I eta nadezhda — ser Itsalot, samyy luchshiy, silnyy i khrabryy rytsar korolya Daytana III.
Issleduyte krasochnyy mir, polnyy raznykh prichudlivykh geroev, reshayte zakhvatyvayushchie golovolomki, ispolzuya vse vozmozhnosti konsoli Nintendo Switch™, i polnostyu pogruzites v igrovoy mir.
Osobennosti
- Interaktivnyy i raznoobraznyy igrovoy protsess blagodarya ispolzovaniyu vozmozhnostey konsoli.
- Yumoristicheskoe priklyuchenie, polnoe raznykh sladostey i drugikh prelestey, v smeshnom i multyashnom mire.
- Zakhvatyvayushchiy dizayn urovney s grafikoy, detalno prorisovannoy vruchnuyu.
- Vzaimodeystvie s igrovym mirom i prichudlivymi personazhami.
- Bolee 20 stikerov, kotorye raskryvayut vse tayny igrovogo mira i samogo sera Itsalota.

Dannaya igra polnostyu sovmestima s Nintendo Switch™ Lite.
Ужасный \"Шимон Спитфайр\" отправляет св:
Uzhasnyy "Shimon Spitfayr" otpravlyaet svoyu armadu monstrov v malenkuyu derevnyu "Yarkiy ostrov". Malenkiy malchik, vooruzhennyy lish molotkom, okazyvaetsya edinstvennym, kto dostatochno smel, chtoby protivostoyat zlu.

Ispolzuyte silu svoego molota, puteshestvuya po chetyrem misticheskim zemlyam. Na 40 ogromnykh urovnyakh vy vstretite desyatki vragov i opasnykh bossov.

Sobirayte dragotsennye zelenye i krasnye kamni, issleduyte mir i otkryvayte sekrety.

O, i upomyanul li ya o deystvitelno zamechatelnom saundtreke, vdokhnovlennom velikolepnym zvuchaniem ery 8- i 16-bitnykh konsoley?

Retro-igra, kotoruyu vy tak dolgo zhdali. Gotovy li vy k fantasticheskomu priklyucheniyu?
Вторжение на Землю началось. МЕГАТРОН, л:
Vtorzhenie na Zemlyu nachalos. MEGATRON, lider deseptikonov, podobralsya k Vse-Iskre sovsem blizko! Chtoby vosstanovit mir, BAMBLBI i avtoboty ishchut novogo komandira — tebya!
Sobiray komandu i gotovsya k takticheskoy poshagovoy voyne, kotoraya raskinetsya ot Tsentralnogo goroda do samogo Kibertrona! Tebe ponadobitsya sila i strategicheskie planirovanie, chtoby perekhitrit dyavolskikh deseptikonov. Vybiray TRANSFORMEROV s ikh osobymi sposobnostyami, kotorye pozvolyat tebe vyigrat predstoyashchuyu bitvu! OPTIMUS PRAYM, GRIMLOK i drugie rvutsya v boy! Ispolzuy v svoikh tselyakh osobennosti okruzheniya: pryachsya v tsentre peschanykh vikhrey, izbegay energonovykh vikhrey Kibertrona i srazhaysya s vragami na gorodskikh ulitsakh. Napolni energonovyy schetchik, chtoby obrushit na vragov vsyu moshch absolyutnykh umeniy, sposobnykh unichtozhit samykh opasnykh protivnikov. Intuitivnoe upravlenie i tri urovnya slozhnosti — uspekh v predstoyashchikh bitvakh zavisit tolko ot tebya!
Obedinis s druzyami v lokalnoy mnogopolzovatelskoy igre i ispytay svoi strategicheskie umeniya v rezhimakh «Zakhvat flaga», «Orda», «Posledniy rubezh» i drugikh. Eto strategicheskiy ekshen, kotorogo poklonniki TRANSFORMEROV zhdali tseluyu vechnost!

• UPRAVLYaY AVTOBOTAMI — komanduy BAMBLBI, VINDBLEYDOM, OPTIMUS PRAYMOM i drugimi geroyami v zakhvatyvayushchikh strategicheskikh bitvakh.

• OT ZEMLI DO KIBERTRONA — krushi i lomay v gorodakh, lesakh i pustynyakh v poistine vzryvnykh missiyakh.

• OTTOChI SVOI NAVYKI — dostupnoe upravlenie i 3 urovnya slozhnosti privetlivy k novichkam i pozvolyayut sosredotochitsya na taktike.

• LOKALNYY MNOGOPOLZOVATELSKIY REZhIM — igray v odnoy komande s drugom ili srazis s nim v arkadnykh mini-igrakh.
В другом уголке той же самой вселенной,:
V drugom ugolke toy zhe samoy vselennoy, v kotoroy proiskhodilo deystvie nashey predydushchey igry, Manuel Samuel (i v tot zhe samyy vtornik!), vas zhdet zagrobnoe priklyuchenie! Sygrayte za Borna, vikinga-patsifista, kotoryy ni za kakie kovrizhki ne khochet umeret i ochutitsya v Valkhalle... i kotoryy umiraet i popadaet imenno v Valkhallu. No kogda Borna voskreshaet zagadochnaya Pesto, chtoby on pomog ey v odnom deltse, vikingu v golovu prikhodit genialnaya mysl dogovoritsya s ney i vybratsya iz nenavistnoy Valkhally. Igrokam predstoit ispolzovat bessmertnoe telo Borna, k kotoromu pri zhelanii prisoedinyayutsya i ot kotorogo s takoy zhe legkostyu otsoedinyayutsya konechnosti, i s ego pomoshchyu reshat neprostye i interesnye golovolomki, a takzhe issledovat zaputannye urovni, chtoby zapoluchit odnu magicheskuyu shtukovinu... A Pesto za eto poprobuet vybit Bornu mestechko v Khelkheyme... Okh i perepolokh podnimetsya!

Смелый журналист, Лора Джеймс, начинает:
Smelyy zhurnalist, Lora Dzheyms, nachinaet sobstvennoe rassledovanie tainstvennykh ischeznoveniy bossov mafii i posledovavshey za nimi propazhi detey.

Zagadki Nyu-Yorka. Sekrety Mafii – priklyuchencheskaya igra-kvest s poiskom predmetov, mini-igrami i golovolomkami, rasskazyvayushchaya o misticheskom detektivnom rassledovanii, mafioznykh taynakh i zagadkakh Nyu-Yorka.

Nyu-York, 1955 god. V gorode stalo opasno. Mafiya pytaetsya zakhvatit vlast. No s nedavnikh por, poyavilas novaya sila. I ona na mnogo strashnee. Za poslednie dni, pyat mafioznykh bossov propali pri zagadochnykh obstoyatelstvakh. Na mestakh ischeznoveniya nakhodili lish strannuyu zhidkost i babochku. No ne eto napugalo zhiteley... V gorode stali propadat deti. Vse oni narisovali tochno takikh babochek pered ischeznoveniem. Lora Dzheyms, zhurnalist «Deyli Nyuz», nachinaet sobstvennoe rassledovanie. Kakie mrachnye tayny skryvayut tonneli metro pod gorodom? Smozhet li geroinya spravitsya so vsemi prepyatstviyami i spasti propavshikh?

Osobennosti igry:

• Svyshe 40 raznoobraznykh mini-igr
• Interaktivnye stseny s poiskom predmetov

Master slova
Ocharovatelnym predvestnikam smerti Grimmu i Rouz nuzhna vasha pomoshch v borbe s polchishchami chudishch, prizrakov i zlobnykh krolikov. Sostavlyayte slova i oderzhivayte pobedy nad bolee chem 30 unikalnymi monstrami, zarabatyvayte kristally i pokupayte uluchsheniya, knigi, spetsialnye predmety, zelya i mnogoe drugoe.

Ispytayte svoi navyki slovoslozheniya v novoy versii pokhodovoy rolevoy igry-golovolomki – vas zhdut rezhim beskonechnoy igry, interesnye rebusy i otlichnaya muzyka.
Главная героиня – новенькая в бригаде по:
Glavnaya geroinya – novenkaya v brigade pozharnykh. Ona gotova brositsya na pomoshch tem, kto v ney otchayanno nuzhdaetsya, vooruzhivshis vernym toporom i pozharnym shlangom (na kotorom, k slovu, mozhno poletat). Sumeet li ona spasti mirnykh zhiteley, okazavshikhsya v ognennoy lovushke? Ey predstoit raskryt prichinu zagadochnykh pozharov, vnezapno okhvativshikh gorod. Kto stoit za vsem etim?...

Vam pridetsya ukroshchat plamya v gustykh lesakh, shikarnykh otelyakh, skorostnykh poezdakh i mnogoetazhnykh zhilykh domakh. Vse urovni generiruyutsya sluchayno

U vas budet ne tak mnogo vremeni na spasenie lyudey, okazavshikhsya v bede. Kazhdaya sekunda na schetu! Pogasite bushuyushchee plamya, razrubite vse prepyatstviya na puti, izbavtes ot merzkikh ognennykh monstrov, ispolzuyte shlang dlya usileniya pryzhkov, chtoby zabratsya povyshe i nayti razlichnye bonusy.

Posle tyazhelogo dlya rasslabtes na stantsii, gde mozhno uluchshit oborudovanie, nanyat novykh rabotnikov, oplatit scheta i dazhe prochest vostorzhennye pisma ot poklonnikov. Budte gotovy gasit eshche i pozhar konfliktov. Da uzh, zabot polon rot, no nikto ne govoril, chto budet legko!
«Свинка Пеппа» (англ. «Peppa Pig») — бри:
«Svinka Peppa» (angl. «Peppa Pig») — britanskiy multserial, sostoyashchiy iz nebolshikh seriy po 5 minut. Glavnye geroi: Svinka Peppa, eyo mladshiy brat Dzhordzh, mama Svinka i papa Svin. Postoyannymi personazhami yavlyayutsya babushka i dedushka, a takzhe druzya Peppy, Dzhordzha i ikh roditeli. Byl pokazan po televideniyu bolee chem v 180+ stranakh i perevedyon na ~40 yazykov. Posledniy sezon vyshel v 2015 godu.
Otpravtes v veseloe priklyuchenie, stav drugom Svinki Peppy!
Sozdayte i odente svoego personazha-zverushku, pozvonite v dvernoy zvonok Peppy i nachnite istoriyu, razvitie kotoroy zavisit tolko ot vas. Peppa predlagaet razvlecheniya vezde, kuda by vy ni poshli - pomogite pape Svinu nayti ego ochki, proydite po sledam zhivotnykh v lesu, pleskaytes v gryaznykh luzhakh i mnogoe drugoe! Eto pokhozhe na epizod teleshou, gde vse vashi lyubimye personazhi rady vstreche s vami.
Ot plyazha do muzeya i dazhe v Kartofelnom gorode, kazhdaya igra s vashim drugom Svinkoy Peppoy podarit prekrasnye vpechatleniya!

Curious Expedition 2 скоро на Nintendo S:
Curious Expedition 2 skoro na Nintendo Switch™! Otkroyte dlya sebya poshagovuyu syuzhetnuyu rougelike-igru, deystvie kotoroy razvorachivaetsya v alternativnoy versii kontsa 19-go veka. Protsedurno generiruemyy igrovoy protsess masterski perepletaet zakhvatyvayushchie syuzhetnye elementy i kazhdyy raz sozdaet novye neveroyatnye priklyucheniya.

Osobennosti:

- Upravlyayte resursami, podderzhivaya zdorove i nastroy uchastnikov ekspeditsii. Ne pozvolyayte zhadnosti zatmit zhelanie vyzhit i dobeytes slavy, ne pogibnuv.

- Protsedurno generiruemaya istoriya sdelaet kazhdoe priklyuchenie unikalnym. V zavisimosti ot vashikh resheniy i okruzheniya personazhi mogut stroit vzaimootnosheniya, zabolevat, predavat i mnogoe drugoe.

- Otpravtes v neveroyatnoe puteshestvie, v kotorom riski regulyarno smenyayutsya nagradami, a unikalnye istorii vyzyvayut zhelanie prokhodit igru snova i snova.

- Boevye mekhaniki, osnovannye na ispolzovanii igralnykh kostey, trebuyut ot igroka udachi, strategii i khitrosti, chtoby oderzhat pobedu nad svirepymi dikimi zhivotnymi i legendarnymi sushchestvami.

- Uchastvuyte v ezhenedelnykh klubnykh sorevnovaniyakh, vstupiv v odin iz klubov issledovateley onlayn, i prokhodite ispytaniya na vremya, chtoby poluchit eshche bolshe nagrad!
ANOTHER SIGHT — сюрреалистичное фэнтези-:
ANOTHER SIGHT — syurrealistichnoe fentezi-priklyuchenie s elementami stimpanka, sobytiya kotorogo razvorachivayutsya v Londone v 1899 godu, v samom kontse viktorianskoy epokhi. Klyuchevoy aspekt ANOTHER SIGHT — emotsionalno nasyshchennye vzaimootnosheniya mezhdu besstrashnym podrostkom Kit i zagadochnym krasnym kotom Khodzhem. Oni vstrechayutsya vo tme budushchey londonskoy podzemki posle togo, kak Kit slepnet iz-za obrusheniya tonnelya. Vmeste oni otpravlyayutsya v put, i Kit pridetsya nauchitsya polagatsya na svoego zamechatelnogo sputnika.

Kit i Khodzh budut issledovat tainstvennyy i neponyatnyy mir, to vstrechayas, to razdelyayas vnov. U kazhdogo iz nikh est svoy osobyy talant, kotoryy pomozhet reshat golovolomki i probiratsya vse dalshe i dalshe.
Alt-Frequencies is an audio mystery game:
Alt-Frequencies is an audio mystery game where you use the airwaves to open the world’s eyes to the truth. Record, rewind time and broadcast snippets of radio shows to expose radio hosts, conspiracy theorists, politicians, underground activists - and a dog.

By redistributing information, you change what happens in the next 3 minute time loop and impact both news cycles and the lives of the people behind them.

Listen as their personal stories evolve, in a world that seems to stand still.


Features:
- A new kind of narrative game that blurs the lines between the fantastical and the everyday while examining our relationship with mainstream media through the prism of radio stations.
- Built-in accessibility features that make the game available to a wide range of people - including blind and visually impaired players.
- Brought to life by a diverse cast of 20+ amazing voice performers, including TV, podcasts and YouTube personalities such as Jasika Nicole (Fringe, Welcome to Night Vale) & Mike Rugnetta (Reasonably Sound, CrashCourse).
- By the studio behind the critically acclaimed A Normal Lost Phone and Another Lost Phone: Laura’s Story.
Инфекция продвигается на минуту и получе:
Infektsiya prodvigaetsya na minutu i poluchenie vaktsiny - edinstvennaya nadezhda na chelovechestvo.
Delayte vse v svoey vlasti, chtoby borotsya s polchishchami zombi, nakaplivayushchikhsya na ulitsakh, chtoby proyti put k biologicheskomu kompleksu i poluchit obrazets.

Zhit istoriyu Rika, Selena i Dena, tri vzaimosvyazannykh istoriya, na kotorykh eto zavisit ot togo, chtoby poluchit vaktsinu, chtoby ostanovit infektsiyu.

Funktsii

- Strategiya vyzhivaniya: upravlyat svoey vaktsinoy, chtoby izbezhat podachi v infektsiyu, poka vy nalichiem pishchi, chtoby vosstanovit svoe zdorove i oruzhie, chtoby zashchitit sebya
- Istoriya koshmara: razgadat rol vyzhivshikh i kak ikh zhizn perepletaetsya v toy zhe sudbe
- Ochagi zombi: Zombie Apocalypse pokazhet vam bespokoystvo.
Эта будоражащая история рассказывает о в:
Eta budorazhashchaya istoriya rasskazyvaet o vtorokursnike starshey shkoly, Metaru, nakhodyashchemsya v tyuremnoy kamere, gde ego sokamernik, neizvestnyy muzhchina, prosit zaklyuchit pari na igralnykh kostyakh. Tot, u kogo vypadet bolshee chislo, sbezhit iz kletki, a proigravshiy stanet primankoy, kotoraya pomozhet pobeditelyu smertelnogo pari sbezhat. Sokamernik vybrasyvaet 6. Ne imeya drugogo vykhoda, krome kak tozhe vybrosit shest i poluchit vtoroy shans na revansh, Metaru metaet svoi kosti...
Vypavshee chislo krome vsego prochego opredelit, kakaya iz 6 istoriy raznykh devushek budet razygrana. Kazhduyu zovut «Sayko» (no na pisme pishetsya po-raznomu, raznymi kandzi), chto po-yaponski proiznositsya tak zhe i kak «psikho», i kak «kosti», saykoro. Kak i ozhidalos, kazhdaya Sayko — psikhopatka, no na kazhdom povorote rutov ikh bezumie proyavlyaetsya po-raznomu.
Kazhdaya baryshnya takzhe assotsiiruetsya so svoim tsvetkom, odnako, imenno igralnye kosti (a ne kak v MenheRafflesia, tsvety) budut yavlyatsya osnovnym motivom derzkogo pobega..

Ancestors Legacy — это историческая стра:
Ancestors Legacy — eto istoricheskaya strategiya v realnom vremeni, rekonstruiruyushchaya krovavye bitvy srednevekovoy Evropy. V igre sochetayutsya upravlenie resursami i stroitelstvo poseleniy s zhestokimi bataliyami na obshirnykh polyakh srazheniy. Lichno uchastvuyte v massovykh krovoprolitnykh boyakh, blagodarya kinematograficheskoy kamere. Prostoe nazhatie knopki peremestit vas v samuyu gushchu zhestokoy bitvy.

V igre predstavleno chetyre fraktsii: vikingi, anglosaksy, germantsy i slavyane. Storony konflikta otlichayutsya ne tolko vneshnim vidom, no i takticheskimi priemami. Chtoby oderzhat pobedu, vam potrebuetsya ispolzovat ves arsenal strategicheskikh vozmozhnostey: uchityvat osobennosti landshafta, otsenivat preimushchestva i slabosti svoikh voinov, ustraivat zasady, upravlyat sobstvennym poseleniem i razoryat vrazheskie derevni.

- Prodolzhitelnaya odnopolzovatelskaya kampaniya, osnovannaya na istoricheskikh realiyakh.
- Obshirnye takticheskie vozmozhnosti: ustraivayte zasady, rasstavlyayte lovushki, okruzhayte protivnika.
- Perenesites v samuyu gushchu besposhchadnykh srazheniy s pomoshchyu kinematograficheskoy kamery.
- Igra ispolzuet okolo 600 igrovykh animatsiy.
- Udobnoe upravlenie resursami i stroitelstvom poseleniy.
Profane – эпическая битва с боссами в жа:
Profane – epicheskaya bitva s bossami v zhanre «bullet hell», gde vse reshaet vremya! Vasha zadacha – pobedit bossov odnogo za odnim, ulozhivshis v otvedennoe vremya. No vremya – ne prosto dengi, no eshche i zdorove! Pokupaya sposobnosti i poluchaya uron, vy raskhoduete svoy zapas vremeni. Deystvuyte s umom!

UMENIYa

Pobezhdaya vragov, vy otkroete bolee 40 unikalnykh sposobnostey. Pered kazhdoy bitvoy vy smozhete sostavit nabor iz nuzhnykh sposobnostey, chtoby optimizirovat svoy stil igry i zadeystvovat moshchnye kombinatsii, usilivayushchie drug druga!

SYuZhET

V Profane vam predstoit prozhit istoriyu Talaal, posledney iz semi masok Boga. V tele svoego novogo nositelya Talaal dolzhna dat boy svoim sobratyam, kotorye stremyatsya zavladet siloy, chto taitsya v maske. Sam zhe nositel vynuzhden snova i snova uchastvovat v chuzhoy voyne, ne vidya vykhoda iz etogo zakoldovannogo kruga.

REKORDY

Esli surovye ispytaniya i napryazhennaya borba – vash konyok, to nam est chto vam predlozhit! Brosayte vyzov drugim igrokam i srazhaytes za pervoe mesto v spiske rekordsmenov!

OSOBENNOSTI

Modifitsiruemye nabory sposobnostey pozvolyayut igroku sozdat svoy sobstvennyy stil igry.
Igrovoy protsess s uporom na sorevnovatelnost – brosayte vyzov druzyam i beyte rekordy.
Shirokiy nabor igrovykh rezhimov, vklyuchaya sluchaynuyu posledovatelnost boyov!
Отправляйтесь на фантастический фестивал:
Otpravlyaytes na fantasticheskiy festival vmeste s semey akul. Poyte i plavayte pod ne-zub-yvaemye pesni i poluchayte v nagradu muzykalnye kartochki dlya svoego alboma!
Soberite vmeste vsyu akulyu semyu i prigotovtes k ritmicheskomu priklyucheniyu v Baby Shark: Sing & Swim Party! Poplavayte v beskraynikh moryakh s malyshom-akuloy, mamoy-akuloy, papoy-akuloy, babuley-akuloy i deduley-akuloy i pobyvayte na fantasticheskom festivale. Na etot grandioznyy festival ezhegodno sezzhayutsya muzykanty so vsekh morey, chtoby vsem vmeste spet, stantsevat i zazhech!
Within the Blade – это эпическая игра, в:
Within the Blade – eto epicheskaya igra, v kotoroy smeshalis zhanry «stels», platformer i RPG. V ney igrok vystupaet v roli nindzya. Issleduyte zhivopisnyy mir feodalnoy Yaponii, ispolzuya svoyu skrytnost dlya vypolneniya missiy.

Sobirayte razlichnye materialy dlya izgotovleniya oruzhiya: syurikenov, yadov, eliksirov, granatov i min. Vy takzhe mozhete izgotovit glavnoe oruzhie – «nindzyato» i «kusarigama» – dlya narashchivaniya svoey sily.

V 1560 godu posledniy syogunat Yaponii poteryal ves kontrol nad tsarstvom, chto privelo k masshtabnoy grazhdanskoy voyne. Vsya nadezhda na otryad nindzya iz klana «Chernyy lotos»: tolko diversionnymi operatsiyami mozhno oslabit sily zlodeya i ego demonicheskikh soyuznikov. A glavarya nuzhno ubit.

Est li u vas navyki nindzya, chtoby spasti srednevekovuyu Yaponiyu ot tsaryashchego terrora?

SRAZhAYTES SO STILEM

KLASSIChESKIY REZhIM
Otpravlyaytes nazad v 80-e s Klassicheskim rezhimom, kotoryy byl vdokhnovlen stilem retro s originalnym upravleniem dvumya gusenitsami i globalnym reytingom igrokov!
One-Way Ticket is a visual novel loosely: One-Way Ticket is a visual novel loosely based around actual events. A group of men and women, isolated at sea on a long-distance fishing vessel, suddenly find their very humanity at stake as crew members begin turning up dead.
В Mad Tower Tycoon стройте небоскребы в:
V Mad Tower Tycoon stroyte neboskreby v 100 etazhey i otkryvayte v nikh zavedeniya, kotorye budut prinosit dokhod: restorany, kinoteatry, podzemnye parkovki i dazhe zooparki! Chtoby dostich uspekha, udovletvoryayte zaprosy potentsialnykh posetiteley i vybirayte te zavedeniya, kotorye privlekut bolshe vsego gostey. V klassicheskom rezhime stroitelstva vy budete sorevnovatsya za zavetnuyu nagradu: «shest zvezd». Vasha tsel — zavershit stroitelstvo i sdat v arendu ofisy, kvartiry i magaziny na territorii 100 etazhey.

SLUChAYNYE SOBYTIYa

Play as ‘Doctor’ Simon Forman - unlicens:
Play as ‘Doctor’ Simon Forman - unlicensed medical professional and astrologer - and help him win a medical licence. Astrologaster is a narrative-based comedy game.

Explore Forman’s life, his work, and his relationships with his clients. Make story choices by performing astrological readings. Choose strategically or make decisions just for fun - but be aware that your choices will have consequences (and unpredictable side effects!)

13 clients come to see you 5-7 times seeking advice for personal, professional and medical problems. By examining the stars in the sky, you diagnose and determine answers for your clients’ problems. As well as affecting the storyline, these choices will alter your clients’ satisfaction levels. Satisfied clients will write you letters of recommendation, and with enough of these letters you can obtain a medical licence from the University of Cambridge.

So-called “real” (licensed) doctors call Forman a quack and fraud. Help Forman prove these medical establishment elitists wrong!

Features
- Perform real* astrology: Examine the sky and choose astrological interpretations that Forman will use to advise his patients. (But remember: astrology is not an exact science!)
- Solve Hilarious Problems: Consult on problems ranging from Elizabethan terror plots and foul diseases, to romantic entanglements and stolen pies!
- Change Lives: Win your patients’ favour or ruin their lives. Advise 14 characters who return 5-7 times. Patients have their own ongoing stories which often overlap with each other. Use gossip from some characters to guide and manipulate others.
- Win A Medical Licence: Convince patients to write letters of recommendations. Collect enough letters to exchange them for a medical licence.
- Fully Voiced Character Dialogue: Sitcom-style comedy brought to life by a cast of over a dozen actors.- Sing Along: Enjoy Renaissance-era music and sing along to each character’s theme song.
- Casebooks Come Alive: Simon Forman’s cases are presented as a beautiful pop-up book. Turn pages to delve deeper into your patients’ stories.

The Story
London, 1592. A great plague sweeps through the capital. When doctors flee the city in fear, a hero rises. His name is Simon Forman, “Doctor” of Astrology, Astronomy and Physick. Not only does he have the power to cure the sick, he can find their lost pets and predict their futures! All by reading the movements of the stars.

But when the plague ends, Forman’s problems begin. The real doctors return to London and they will stop at nothing to bring him down...

Summary
Astrologaster is a story-driven astrological comedy game set in Shakespeare’s London. Based on a true - and truly ridiculous - story. Simon Forman was considered a sage by some and a charlatan by others. What will your legacy be? Will you put your faith in the stars?

STORY\nDuke of Defense is a playful acti:
STORY
Duke of Defense is a playful action-based tower defense game brimming with ample humor, cheeky villagers, egotistical wizards, and jaunty adventure. Build, roll, and slash your way through waves upon waves of goblins, ogres, golems, and more! Upgrade your character as you advance through the story with a plethora of enhancements available within the skill tree. These abilities also apply in co-op mode, so everybody benefits! Be sure to visit the Wardrobe Well and cycle between loads of quirky heads to customize your Duke, unlocking more choices as you progress. Unique towers, potent powers, and 8-bit flowers ensure you'll be back for more. 

CO-OP
Any true hero can call upon trusty companions in their time of need. Explore new strategies when you bring along a friend! Journey forth with a partner from the comfort of your couch, where you both can dash, slice, and build with local co-op multiplayer.

GAMEPLAY
This is an action-based tower defense like no other you've experienced. Slash goblins, ogres, wizards, and more with your sword, roll through waves of enemies, and build towers as fast as you can. Reap the rewards of combat by collecting coins from fallen foes, but tread carefully so as not to get walloped on the field of action! Turn the trees scattering the battlefield into a combination of the nine powerful towers, each with their own strengths and weaknesses against different monsters - so be sure to use your resources wisely! Prepare for fast-paced boss battles with some pretty angsty wizards, conversations with philosophical deer, and hordes of bit-constructed baddies. 

SOUNDTRACK
The whole experience is wrapped up in an unbelievable composition containing everything from sweat-inducing chiptunes to comedic ambience. Over 30 unique tracks!

Vas zhdut interesnye i yarkie personazhi, kazhdyy iz kotorykh polnostyu ozvuchen! Podruzhites s nimi i stante svidetelem mnozhestva unikalnykh sobytiy, chtoby uznat, chto zhe deystvitelno tvoritsya v etoy bolshoy i ne samoy druzhnoy seme.

VOZMOZhNOSTI DLYa POVTORNOGO PROKhOZhDENIYa

NET NIChEGO NEVOZMOZhNOGO

FIRMENNYY STIL SUPERGIANT

Udivitelnye lokatsii igry narisovany vruchnuyu, a vydayushchiysya originalnyy saundtrek pomogaet igrokam proniknutsya nastroeniem Podzemnogo mira.
После спасения Грибного Королевства брат:
Posle spaseniya Gribnogo Korolevstva bratya Mario i Luidzhi otpravlyayutsya v otpusk, v Stranu Dinozavrov. Odnako vo vremya otdykha na plyazhe ischezaet printsessa Pich. Kogda Mario i Luidzhi prosypayutsya, oni otpravlyayutsya na eyo poiski i vskore nakhodyat v lesu gigantskoe yaytso. Iz nego vyluplyaetsya dinozavr po imeni Yoshi, kotoryy rasskazyvaet geroyam, chto ego druzya tozhe byli zaklyucheny v analogichnye lovushki. Vskore Mario i Luidzhi ponimayut, chto vse eti peripetii — delo ruk zlodeya Bouzera i ego slug. Vmeste s Yoshi oni otpravlyayutsya spasat printsessu i druzey dinozavrika.
Super Mario World, v Yaponii izvestnaya kak Super Mario World: Super Mario Bros. 4 (yap. スーパーマリオワールドスーパーマリオブラザーズ4 Su:pa: Mario Va:rudo: Su:pa Mario Buradza:dzu Fo:) — platformer, vypushchennyy kompaniey Nintendo dlya Super Nintendo Entertainment System SNES v 1990 godu. Proizvodstvom igry zanimalas studiya Nintendo Entertainment Analysis and Development pod rukovodstvom Sigeru Miyamoto i Takasi Tedzuki. Super Mario World popala v startovuyu lineyku igr SNES.
Po syuzhetu Mario i Yoshi dolzhny spasti Stranu Dinozavrov ot tiranii Bouzera — glavnogo antagonista serii. Mario i ego bratu, Luidzhi, predstoit puteshestvie cherez sem mirov, v kontse kazhdogo iz kotorykh oni dolzhny pobedit bossa. Igrovoy protsess Super Mario World skhozh s predydushchimi igrami franshizy. Odnako poyavilis novye, uvelichivayushchie sposobnosti glavnogo geroya, bonusy, kotorye byli pereneseny v posleduyushchie igry serii. V Super Mario World vpervye poyavilsya dinozavr Yoshi, sputnik i skakun glavnogo geroya vo mnogikh posledovavshikh igrakh s uchastiem Mario.
Igra byla teplo vstrechena kritikami i imela ogromnyy uspekh sredi igrokov, stav bestsellerom — po vsemu miru bylo prodano bolee 20 mln. ekzemplyarov. Mnogie profilnye izdaniya nazyvali eyo odnoy iz luchshikh igr v istorii. Soglasno prodazham, Super Mario World zanimaet pervoe mesto sredi vsekh igr, vypushchennykh dlya SNES.

Sumeete li vy raskryt vse ego tayny?..Eshchyo vizualnykh novell na Switch (renpy).
Мы выбираем играть либо за Мэтью Колта,:
My vybiraem igrat libo za Metyu Kolta, oderzhimogo okkultizmom issledovatelya paranormalnykh yavleniy, kotoryy uchastvuet v koshmarnykh stsenakh, srazhayas s trevozhashchimi monstrami iz uzhasnykh mirov, libo za Dellu Khartfort, kotoraya taykom probiraetsya, chtoby izbezhat tekh zhe monstrov, v kotorykh Metyu vypuskaet svoi puli.
Prisoedinyaytes k misteru Koltu ili missis Khartfort, poskolku oni oba pytayutsya razobratsya v adskom priklyuchenii, kotoroe vedet ikh v glubiny ikh sobstvennoy psikhiki i obratno.
Perezhivite raznitsu vzglyadov na realnost, obedinyayushchuyu vymysel i epizody nezemnykh snov, i prodolzhayte srazhatsya so zlom v etom izmerenii… i v sleduyushchem.
Metyu Kolt — issledovatel paranormalnykh yavleniy na rubezhe vekov, kotoryy beretsya za novoe delo v Khartfordskom osobnyake. Tam on znakomitsya s Delloy, zhenoy bogatogo biznesmena, kotoraya schitaet, chto v ee dome obitayut privideniya. Ona vidit videniya demonov i zverey iz drugikh izmereniy.
Kak u igroka, u nas est dva osoznannykh vybora: my vybiraem Metyu ili Dellu, i oba varianta predlagayut sovershenno raznye stili igry i priklyucheniya.
Metyu dolzhen proyti cherez skazochnye, no napolnennye uzhasom zaly osobnyaka Khartford, prezhde chem otpravitsya v priyut Karkosa v poiskakh Delly i otvetov, kotorye ona khranit. Vy dolzhny vyvesti ego iz ledenyashchikh dushu glubin ego sobstvennoy psikhiki i vernut stabilnost, srazhayas s uzhasayushchimi monstrami i pytayas reshit umopomrachitelnye golovolomki, chtoby proyti igru.
Metyu dolzhen srazhatsya s vragami iz kosmosa, drugikh izmereniy i iz glubiny sobstvennoy dushi, chtoby vyyti pobeditelem iz etogo zagadochnogo i ledenyashchego krov dela. Metyu dolzhen preodolet svoikh vnutrennikh demonov v istorii, kotoraya menyaetsya i menyaetsya, poskolku vy dolzhny sledovat svoim instinktam, chtoby nayti dokazatelstva - predstoit vyyasnit, govoryat li eti dokazatelstva bolshe o dele ili o samom Metyu.
Кто не мечтает о сказочном богатстве? Пр:

Izbegay shipov, snaryadov i lovushek, chtoby sokhranit yaytsa.

SH1FT3R возвращается!\nПреступная органи:

Gotovtes aktivirovat lovushki, podbirat uskoreniya i vyzhimat iz svoey mashiny maksimum, chtoby oderzhat pobedu. Vam predstoit odolet SH1FT3R v vysokooktanovom turnire, kotoryy okhvatit ves mir ot Okeanii do pustyni Sakhara! A v pereryve mezhdu zaezdami vy takzhe mozhete potrenirovatsya v gonke dlya 4 igrokov po seti ili v lokalnom kooperative dlya 2 igrokov — veselya khvatit na lyubuyu kompaniyu.

Borites do samogo finisha!
Sadites za rul odnoy iz vashikh lyubimykh mashin gonshchikov-shpionov i pokazhite SH1FT3R, chto vy prishli za pobedoy. Ispolzuyte vse dostupnye vozmozhnosti: podbirayte uskoreniya, ishchite taynye prokhody i proyavlyayte smekalku. Vstroennye v mashinu gadzhety pomogut vam obognat sopernikov i oslepit ikh peyntbolnymi snaryadami, ili zhe vy mozhete vyrvatsya vpered blagodarya unikalnym shpionskim navykam vashego personazha!

Ostavte svoy sled v istorii
Vas zhdut 17 golovokruzhitelnykh trass v 5 raznykh regionakh — osvoyte kazhduyu iz nikh, chtoby dokazat, chto luchshe vas nikogo net. V bystroy gonke i mnogopolzovatelskoy igre po seti vy smozhete vybrat lyubogo iz 13 gonshchikov (dazhe iz SH1FT3R), u kazhdogo iz kotorykh est svoe unikalnoe shpionskoe snaryazhenie. Vyezzhayte na trassu i gonite k pobede!

Stante gonshchikom-shpionom: vyberite svoego lyubimogo personazha — Toni Toretto, Ekho, Tsisko ili Leylu Grey.
Obezdite ves mir: vas zhdut trassy ot Okeanii do pustyni Sakhara!
Odoleyte protivnikov: sorevnuytes s drugom v lokalnom kooperative ili igrayte po seti. 
Personalizatsiya: razblokiruyte dopolnitelnye obliki i uluchsheniya dlya transporta i sobirayte shpionskoe snaryazhenie luchshego kachestva!
Навещая своего больного отца, студент ко:

Vodoochistnaya stantsiya, pokhozhe, tozhe. Kriokoloniya v opasnosti! Dinamo-fonar pomozhet ne spotknutsya na pervykh shagakh vo tme, a klyuch-mech srazit vsekh tayashchikhsya v ney vragov. Prygayte, burite, parite, sovershayte stremitelnye ryvki, obrushivaytes vragam na golovu i borozdite mir Ratcheteer DX.
В Ooblets полно новых друзей! Обустраива:

DungeonTop will have you exploring a plethora of deck-building options for hours on end, continually finding new inventive ways to succeed on and off the board!

In Witch Thief, dodge duck and weave thr:

Survive, gather resources, expand your c:
Survive, gather resources, expand your crew, improve your starship, and pave the way through outer space – full of hostile races. Your path will consist of difficult choices and everyone will have an influence on the outcome.
…and perhaps you might be able to solve the mystery of this universe.

FLYING AMONG THE STARS

You are the commander of the “Melistar” (“The Star Bee”), and you have a swarm of intelligent anthropomorphic bees. Your ship is your home, and your mission is to keep an eye on its fighting ability to repel enemy attacks; to stay on course, and to effectively collect resources to ensure that both the Queen and soldier bees have enough food; and, of course, to keep an eye on the status of your crew, whose members strive to get into trouble or arrange it.

OTHER SPECIES

The ship travels through an amazing universe full of strange insectoid races. Who you’ll be forming an alliance with, and who you’ll be fighting with, is largely up to you! The Merchant Guild fights the League of Smugglers; the intelligent Ants compete with Locusts for space colonies; the sinister cult of Blood Suckers spreads across the galaxy...
We’ll have to fight and trade – and every one of these decisions can be a turning point in the story.

SURVIVAL AND STORYTELLING

* You can try your hand at surviving. Space cycles alternate, resources run out – and the crew increases; but luck and accurate calculation are on your side! Competently upgrade your ship and set the right course – and you can stay alive for a certain amount of time, or maybe even break a record!
* If you like branching plots and world exploration – boldly immerse yourself in the storyline. The CyberHive universe is a mysterious and deep setting. Collect ancient artifacts and pieces of knowledge on distant planets about the past – and discover how the world turned out to be and what misfortune it faces. Maybe you can avert it... or not.

MANY EVENTS

As you try to find resources and survive, you will experience many events on the ship: from intrigues within the crew and problems with passengers, to a large contraband “set-up” or a collision with the ghost of a legendary pirate starship. Some events form a story, and some occur randomly. But the choices within each event will also have to be considered...

...Subjects with the waist of a wasp and a deadly sting; predatory rivals and faction battles; exploring the farthest corners of the galaxy; dangerous challenges and responsible decisions.
Welcome to the world of CyberHive!
Commander, we are counting on you.

Krome otsutstviya lyudey, zdes est chto-to strannoe, neveroyatno dalyokoe ot vsego chelovecheskogo. Ono taitsya vo tme sredi korney. Ono znaet, chto vy zdes. I vpervye za mnogie, mnogie tsikly emu ne vsyo ravno.

Glitchhikers: The Spaces Between – это и:
Glitchhikers: The Spaces Between – eto igra o myslyakh, kotorye voznikayut u vas na puti ot odnogo mesta naznacheniya k drugomu, o meditativnykh stranstviyakh, kogda soznanie otreshaetsya ot tela i issleduet glubiny nashego vnutrennego «ya». Otpravlyaytes v put po polunochnomu shosse, v utrennem tikhom poezde, skvoz zalityy lunnym svetom park ili zaderzhites, ozhidaya samolet v pustom aeroportu, i pod strannuyu muzyku i beskonechnye obyavleniya o perenose reysov zadumaytes o svoem meste vo vselennoy.

Dolgaya doroga – luchshee mesto dlya razmyshleniy. Glitchhikers predlagaet vam zaglyanut vnutr sebya, nayti otvety na volnuyushchie vas voprosy i zanovo pereosmyslit ikh. Zadumatsya o zhizni, vselennoy i vashem meste i tseli v ney. Povestvovanie igry obeshchaet vam opredelennyy uroven svobody, vstrechu s beskonechnoy neizbezhnostyu i ogromnyy, polnyy nadezhd mir dlya issledovaniya.

Glitchhikers: The Spaces Between pereosmyslivaet i dopolnyaet vyshedshuyu v 2014 godu odnoimennuyu igru, teplo prinyatuyu igrokami i kritikami.

• Puteshestvie v ramkakh svobodnogo povestvovaniya
• Beskonechnoe stranstvie

• Polnoe prochtenie kultovoy igry

Avangardnaya rabota narrativnykh dizaynerov iz Silverstring Media

«Рукавичка» — милая небольшая головоломк:
«Rukavichka» — milaya nebolshaya golovolomka, cherpayushchaya vdokhnovenie iz narodnoy ukrainskoy legendy o Rukavichke (perchatke, varezhke), kotoraya stanovitsya domom dlya mnozhestva volshebnykh lesnykh zhivotnykh vsekh razmerov, ot malenkoy myshki do ogromnogo medvedya. Khotya v pervonachalnoy istorii starik nakhodit i zabiraet perchatku, igra predstavlyaet soboy mir, v kotorom zhivotnye mogut prodolzhat bezopasno zhit v svoyom dome.
Tsel igry — nayti mysh (pravym stikom s drakonom) i dver v Rukavichku (levym stikom s lisoy), a zatem provesti lesnuyu mysh k dveri. Myshka mozhet khodit tolko po rasteniyam vnutri lisy ili drakona i ostanavlivaetsya pered proemami. Privedite vsekh poteryavshikhsya zhivotnykh s pomoshchyu ukrainskoy lisitsy i vavelskogo drakona iz polskikh predaniy, chtoby obedinitsya i vmeste sozdat bezopasnoe budushchee dlya vsekh lesnykh sushchestv.
Dizayn proekta byl vdokhnovlen traditsionnymi tsvetochnymi uzorami, ornamentom, sozdannym s ispolzovaniem akvareli i chernil; takzhe vklyuchaet v sebya natsionalnye zhyoltye i sinie ottenki s nebolshim kolichestvom zeleni listev, polevye tsvety, podsolnukhi i barvinok.
Megabyte Punch is an electro beat ‘em up:
Megabyte Punch is an electro beat ‘em up game with platforming elements in which you build your own fighter while playing!

Megabyte Punch takes place in a computer universe where you have to protect the Heartcore of your village. You defend your people from the Valk Empire and the dreaded Khoteps in 6 different levels with each 3 stages and a boss fight!

As you travel through the worlds, you battle other creatures to get their parts. Parts have their own powers and bonuses, like gun arms for a shoot ability or powerful hips for a devastating pelvic thrust attack. The whole adventure is playable with up to 4 players at once. Using the abilities of your customized fighter, you can also battle your friends in a destructible arena or you can compete in the tournament to test your own skills.

Key Features
- A hard-edge graphic style to represent the digital world that the 'Megacs' live in
- 6 unique electro-worlds each with their own boss fight
- 150 parts to collect and almost endless combinations to customize your character
- A pumpin' electro soundtrack
- Up to 4 player local co-op and versus mode
- Use any amiibo in-game to get exclusive colors for your fighter
- For Nintendo Switch™ only: 2 exclusive bonus stages

Soberite kolodu iz assortimenta v 100 kart-glifov i primenyayte boytsov, zdaniya, bonusy i drugie poleznye elementy v takticheskikh boyakh v odinochnom, a takzhe kooperativnom i mnogopolzovatelskom setevykh rezhimakh.
 
Drevnyaya ugroza proryvaetsya skvoz Vrata Golema, i tolko Predvestnik gotov vstat u nee na puti. Upravlyaya siloy Pepla — nanitami — vy dolzhny zashchitit mir, razrushennyy v drevnikh voynakh.
