Elegantnaya taktika: ispolzuyte karty-glify neposredstvenno vo vremya boya i podstraivaytes pod situatsiyu, vybiraya zashchitu, napadenie ili ukreplenie.

Unikalnyy kontent: odinochnaya kampaniya, rezhim stsenariev, odinochnyy i sovmestnyy setevoy rezhim vyzhivaniya, sorevnovatelnye setevye matchi i mnogoe drugoe.

Daisenryaku (大戦略, англ. «Great Strategy»: Daisenryaku (大戦略, angl. «Great Strategy») — stareyshaya seriya globalnykh voenno-strategicheskikh simulyatorov, razrabotannaya SystemSoft, debyutirovavshaya v 1985 godu v Yaponii pod nazvaniem Gendai Daisenryaku Modern Great Strategy 現代大戦略 eksklyuzivno dlya NEC PC-98.
Вы - Гарри Хсу, молодой человек, недавно:
Vy - Garri Khsu, molodoy chelovek, nedavno unasledovavshiy kartochnyy magazin ot svoego ottsa, byvshego chempiona znamenitoy kartochnoy igry """"Chernoknizhnik"""". .Vy Garri Khsu, molodoy chelovek, nedavno unasledovavshiy kartochnuyu magazin ot ottsa, byvshego chempiona po znamenitoy kartochnoy igre ""Chernoknizhnik"". .
Vash provodnik, Dzhuzeppe, bystro govoryashchiy kakadu, pomozhet vam v vashem puteshestvii po pokupkam i prodazham — dobudet karty razlichnoy redkosti dlya luchshikh kollektsionerov ili pomozhet vostorzhennomu pokupatelyu po sosedstvu».

Osobennosti

- Pokupayte, obmenivayte, prodavayte ili sobirayte - Pokupayte v nuzhnoe vremya i pereprodavayte bolshe ili polozhite svoi karty v papku dlya demonstratsii.

- Karty, karty, karty - Otkryvayte konverty ili otpravlyaytes v magaziny, chtoby nayti bolee sotni kart raznoy stepeni redkosti (i blestyashchikh variatsiy!), illyustrirovannykh talantlivymi khudozhnikami.

- Nepredskazuemyy rynok - Perevypuski, zapreshchennye karty, podarki v detskom menyu, krazhi, tserkovnye osuzhdeniya... vse eti sobytiya mogut povliyat na tsenu vashego inventarya.

- Zarabotayte lyubov svoego soobshchestva - Podruzhites s zhitelyami rayona, prislushivaytes k ikh prosbam i pomogite im udovletvorit ikh oderzhimost, popolnyaya svoyu kollektsiyu ili stanovyas luchshimi igrokami. Oni mogli by pomoch vam stat luchshim magazinom v gorode.

- Sozdayte idealnyy magazin - Smena menedzhera - eto tozhe smena imidzha. Sozdayte magazin svoey mechty s vyborom sten, polov i drugikh ukrasheniy. Vse lyubyat terrakotovye figurki, verno?

- Intriguyushchaya istoriya - U morya vneshnost obmanchiva! Vnezapnoe poyavlenie zagadochnogo klienta zastavlyaet zadumatsya, pochemu on gotov doveryat vam bolshe, chem prosto informatsiyu.
В этом карточном «рогалике» вы будете ид:
V etom kartochnom «rogalike» vy budete idti vperyod po sluchayno generiruemym putyam, napolnennym sokrovishchami, taynami i opasnostyami, chtoby zashchitit lyudey ot mogushchestvennogo zla, okhvativshego Put. Vashim pomoshchnikom stanet unikalnyy kubik so smennymi granyami.
V kachestve chlena tainstvennogo ordena Osetrovoy Lozhi, tselyu kotorogo postavlena borba so zlobnoy sushchnostyu, poselivsheysya na Tamarakskom Puti, vam predstoit razobratsya s opasnostyami i vypolnit svoyu rabotu — vernut mir v doma lyudey.

V Void Bastards vas zhdet kampaniya na 12–15 chasov, kotoruyu mozhno proyti s beskonechnym zapasom zaklyuchennykh, u kazhdogo iz kotorykh svoi osobye cherty. Esli odin umret — nichego strashnogo, prosto podgotovte drugogo. Ne perezhivayte, vse sozdannye veshchi ostanutsya i posluzhat preemniku.

As a player you play as a current. Flow anywhere you want to find for ways to transport healing energy for other corals and heal entire reefs, watching realtime how the seafloor becomes colorfull again and vibrant with life and diversity.
От золотой эпохи до современности, мчите:
Ot zolotoy epokhi do sovremennosti, mchites skvoz vremya s Formula Legends. Osvoyte pereosmyslennye trassy, upravlyayte legendarnymi avtomobilyami i stremites k slave cherez desyatiletiya istorii avtosporta. Pismo lyubvi k Formulnym gonkam, gde tolko skorost, masterstvo i strategiya opredelyayut nastoyashchego chempiona.
Formula Legends otpravlyaet vas v uvlekatelnoe puteshestvie po samym znakovym epokham avtosporta. Ot revushchikh mashin 60-kh godov do peredovykh tekhnologiy segodnyashnego dnya — perezhivite evolyutsiyu gonok na otkrytykh kolesakh v stilizovannom mire, polnom adrenalina.
Sadites za rul legendarnykh avtomobiley, okhvatyvayushchikh bolee shesti desyatiletiy istorii avtosporta. 16 raznoobraznykh modeley, vdokhnovlennykh kultovymi tvoreniyami s 60-kh godov do nashikh dney.
В роли рыболова-любителя вместе с друзья: V roli rybolova-lyubitelya vmeste s druzyami, semyoy i sosedyami ottochite navyki rybnoy lovli, ukrepite otnosheniya i vosstanovite raskolotoe obshchestvo vsemi zabytogo gorodka.
Save Koch — однопользовательская тактиче: Save Koch — odnopolzovatelskaya takticheskaya igra-simulyator, v kotoroy igrok primeryaet na sebya shkuru materogo mafiozi, chyu imperiyu v gorode Nyu-Kandinski podryvaet neizvestnyy «krot». U vas est tolko shest dney, chtoby raskryt zagovor, ustanovit zakazchika i otpravit predatelya na korm rybam.
Острову Фаранга нужен новый герой. Кто ж:
Ostrovu Faranga nuzhen novyy geroy. Kto zhe otkliknetsya na zov?

Okunites v zhestkiy i atmosfernyy mir Risen, gde kazhdoe deystvie imeet svoi posledstviya. Stante voinom-mechnikom, masterom posokha, ili mogushchestvennym magom. Otpravtes v unikalnoe stranstvie po zemlyam, polnym zagadochnykh zemletryaseniy, uzhasnykh monstrov i nesmetnykh sokrovishch.

Zagadochnyy vulkanicheskiy ostrov.

Tolchki, chto sotryasayut ostrov Faranga, ne sulyat dobra ego obitatelyam. Na poverkhnost iz nedr podnyalis drevnie khramy, a s nimi poyavilis i strannye sushchestva, kotorye navodyat uzhas na zhiteley etikh zemel.

Konets nadezhdam?

Mogushchestvennaya gruppa, nazyvayushchaya sebya Inkvizitorami, tverdo namerena polozhit konets etim strannym sobytiyam. Oni otpravili na ostrov ekspeditsionnyy otryad, no vo vremya plavaniya shtorm unichtozhil korabl.

Geroy obyazatelno yavitsya.

Vam poschastlivilos vyzhit v korablekrushenii, i vy okazalis na ostrove Faranga sovsem odni. Vam predstoit uvidet tiraniyu, vosstaniya i misticheskie ritualy i reshit, v kakuyu zhe storonu kachnetsya mayatnik sudby.

Sonic Triple Trouble 16-Bit — фанатская:
Sonic Triple Trouble 16-Bit — fanatskaya platformennaya igra 2022 goda, sozdannaya amerikanskim indi-razrabotchikom i kompozitorom Noa Kouplendom, sdelana kak neofitsialnyy obnovlyonnyy remeyk ofitsialnoy igry Sonic the Hedgehog: Triple Trouble 1994 goda dlya Game Gear v stile igr Sonic the Hedgehog, vypushchennykh dlya Sega Genesis. Igra sokhranyaet osnovnuyu syuzhetnuyu liniyu originala, no deystvie proiskhodit posle sobytiy Sonic 3 & Knuckles. V otlichie ot originalnoy igry, igrok upravlyaet Sonikom i Teylzom odnovremenno i dolzhen provesti ikh cherez seriyu urovney. Vklyucheny sposobnosti i bonusy kak iz originalnoy igry, tak i iz drugikh igr Sonic.
Kouplend zadumal Triple Trouble 16-Bit v 2017 godu. Imeya nebolshoy opyt razrabotki igr, on samostoyatelno osvoil razlichnye navyki dlya sozdaniya remeyka, cherpaya vdokhnovenie iz igr vsey serii Sonic, a takzhe iz fanatskikh igr i drugikh igr dlya Genesis. Khotya znachitelnaya chast remeyka byla sozdana Kouplendom, emu pomogali mnogochislennye soavtory, rabotavshie nad razlichnymi aspektami igry. Triple Trouble 16-Bit byla vypushchena dlya Windows v avguste 2022 goda, a dlya macOS i Android — v mae 2023 goda. Kritiki vysoko otsenili eyo prezentatsiyu, dizayn urovney i oshchushchenie autentichnosti.
Sonic the Hedgehog Triple Trouble, na territorii Yaponii izvestnaya kak Sonic & Tails 2 (yap. ソニック＆テイルス２ Sonikku ando Teirusu 2, rus. Sonik i Teylz 2) — videoigra serii Sonic the Hedgehog v zhanre platformer, izdannaya kompaniey Sega dlya portativnoy konsoli Game Gear v noyabre 1994 goda. Pozzhe proekt byl portirovan na igrovye platformy neskolkikh pokoleniy i vkhodil v sostav nekotorykh sbornikov. Sonic Triple Trouble yavlyaetsya sikvelom Sonic Chaos (Sonic & Tails v Yaponii). Po syuzhetu glavnye geroi igry, yozh Sonik i lis Teylz, sobirayut na Yuzhnom Ostrove Izumrudy Khaosa, kotorye byli razbrosany doktorom Robotnikom vo vremya testirovaniya svoego novogo izobreteniya. Igrovoy protsess prakticheski ne otlichaetsya ot predydushchikh chastey serii: igrok dolzhen proyti ryad urovney, sobiraya po puti zolotye koltsa i atakuya vragov. Igra byla sozdana kompaniey Aspect pri podderzhke Sega. Posle vykhoda Sonic Triple Trouble poluchila v osnovnom polozhitelnye otzyvy ot pressy. Iz dostoinstv proekta zhurnalisty nazyvali grafiku i nebolshie novovvedeniya v geymplee.Eshchyo igry s Sonic'om.

Mstitelnye dukhi shkolnikov ugrozhayut zhizni i razumu Ayumi i ee druzey, i edinstvennyy shans geroev spastis i sbezhat — eto raskryt zhutkie detali ubiystv tekh neschastnykh, kto okazyvalsya v etoy lovushke do nikh.

OSOBENNOSTI IGRY
Atmosfernaya grafika v stile «retro»
Shikarnaya 16-bitnaya grafika, shokiruyushchie opisaniya i napryazhennoe zvukovoe soprovozhdenie — koshmary v vashem voobrazhenii razvernutsya na polnuyu.

Vazhno kazhdoe reshenie
Issleduyte vse ugolki nachalnoy shkoly Heavenly Host Elementary v igre, sochetayushchey elementy point-and-click priklyucheniya i neboevoy RPG. Kazhdoe vashe reshenie vliyaet na khod istorii i sudbu personazhey.

Eshche bolshe materialov
Pomimo pyati osnovnykh syuzhetnykh i chetyrnadtsati dopolnitelnykh glav, v igre est dve novye glavy, kotorye posvyashcheny otnosheniyam mezhdu lyubimtsami publiki — Ayumi i Yoshiki, a takzhe predstavlyayut Miku Shirayume i Ryoka Iwami, dvukh personazhey, kotorye sygrayut svoyu vazhnuyu rol v strashnoy istorii shkoly Heavenly Host Elementary.

Novoe izmerenie uzhasa
Nadente naushniki i pogruzites v mir polnogo yaponskogo ozvuchivaniya i beskonechno strashnykh stereofonicheskikh zvukovykh effektov. Tut vsyo zvuchit nastolko po-nastoyashchemu, chto vy to i delo budete oborachivatsya cherez plecho.
Встречайте захватывающую ретро-футуристи:
Vstrechayte zakhvatyvayushchuyu retro-futuristichnuyu istoriyu, udachno sochetayushchuyu v sebe elementy 2.5D-platformera i trekhmernoy advenchury.
Dva raznykh personazha pozvolyayut vzglyanut na igru pod sovershenno raznym uglom. Kogda vy igraete za Trevora, pered vami klassicheskiy 2.5D-platformer. A kogda pereklyuchaetes na Anzhelu, igra prevrashchaetsya v golovolomku ot pervogo litsa s elementami vzloma. Tolko vmeste nashi geroi smogut pobedit sistemu i obresti svobodu!
Trevor Khills gordilsya tem, chto on chelovek absolyutno normalnyy. Nepylnaya rabotenka v ofise, vechera pered telikom v kompanii lyubimoy ruchnoy cherepashki, chto moglo poyti ne tak? Uvy, mirnaya obyvatelskaya zhizn prishlas ne po vkusu zritelyam American Arcadia. Chtoby povysit reytingi, rukovodstvo shou reshilo sdelat iz Trevora geroya igry na vyzhivanie, finalom kotoroy dolzhna stat samaya nastoyashchaya smert. Ili zhizn – esli emu udastsya obmanut sistemu.
K schastyu dlya Trevora, emu est komu pomoch. Vot tolko ni Anzhela, ni Trevor i znat ne znayut, chto ikh borba za svobodu dlya kogo-to vsego lish ostryy syuzhet, polnyy lzhi, nedomolvok i «vot-eto-povorotov».
Vas zhdet firmennyy mnogosloynyy narrativ, vylizannyy geympley i professionalnaya angliyskaya ozvuchka ot legend industrii Yuriya Loventalya (Spider-Man 1 & 2, Call of the Sea), Krizii Bayos (Cyberpunk 2077, League of Legends), Sissi Dzhons (Firewatch, Call of the Sea) i drugikh.
Выход PROJECT ZERO: MAIDEN OF BLACK WATE:
Vykhod PROJECT ZERO: MAIDEN OF BLACK WATER na Nintendo Switch priurochen k dvadtsatiletiyu serii priklyuchencheskikh khorrorov PROJECT ZERO.

[Syuzhet]
Kogda-to goru Khikami schitali svyashchennoy.
V svoe vremya tam protsvetala neobychnaya religiya, klyuchevoe mesto v kotoroy zanimalo poklonenie vode — a eshche, kak govoryat, v etikh mestakh proizoshlo mnozhestvo strashnykh neschastnykh sluchaev i ne raz nablyudali zagadochnye yavleniya.
Tainstvennyy i zaputannyy syuzhet rasskazhet istoriyu trekh personazhey — Yuri Kodzukaty, Myu Khinasaki i Rena Khodzyo. Vse oni reshayutsya otpravitsya na zloveshchuyu goru, gde mnogie prinyali smert, i popytatsya raskryt ee tayny.

[Igrovoy protsess]
Chtoby issledovat goru Khikami i ee proshloe s tayashchimisya v nem neschastyami, vam predstoit vooruzhitsya kameroy-obskuroy — osoboy kameroy, kotoraya otgonyaet mstitelnykh prizrakov i lishaet ikh sily.
Syuzhet razdelen na otdelnye zadaniya, kazhdoe iz kotorykh dolzhen vypolnit otdelnyy personazh.
Kamera-obskura ne tolko zapechatyvaet zlykh dukhov, kotorye na vas napadayut, no i pomogaet uvidet veshchi, nerazlichimye dlya chelovecheskogo vzglyada, a takzhe otyskat poteryannye tsennosti.

ISTORIYa
Davnym-davno byla velikaya bitva. BOSS KAZZ iskal pyat misticheskikh talismanov, chtoby izgnat vsekh teplokrovnykh v STRANU SNOV.

No nashelsya smelchak, kotoryy vystupil protiv KAZZA i pomeshal emu zavladet talismanami. On risknul vsem radi spaseniya svoey semi i druzey.

I v kontse kontsov... emu eto udalos. KAZZA izgnali, i na zemlyu snova vernulsya mir. Vse blagodarya nashemu geroyu — TY the Tasmanian Tiger — i ego druzyam po operatsii SPASENIE V BUShE.

Seychas zlo snova podnimaet golovu — gorodok KURRAVONG podvergsya napadeniyu, i nam opyat nuzhna pomoshch geroya...

Добро пожаловать в игру, которая сочетае:
Dobro pozhalovat v igru, kotoraya sochetaet v sebe elementy vizualnoy novelly i adskoy strelby s shutemapom! Dnem vy budete nablyudat za shkolnoy zhiznyu glavnoy geroini s ee tochki zreniya. Nochyu vy prevrashchaetes v sekretnogo operativnika, pilotiruya "Razrushitelya snov" po razlichnym skazochnym mestam. Chtoby nayti svoyu propavshuyu sestru, glavnaya geroinya Mu Den kazhduyu noch pogruzhaetsya v raznye sny v poiskakh podskazok, kotorye ostavila ee sestra. Po puti ona vstrechaet raznykh poputchikov i postepenno raskryvaet sekrety ischeznoveniya svoey sestry.
Istoriya voploshchena v zhizn s pomoshchyu mnozhestva krasivykh kompyuternykh i 2D-animatsionnykh illyustratsiy, naglyadno pokazyvayushchikh otnosheniya mezhdu devushkami. Eti dinamichnye illyustratsii ozhivlyayut kazhdogo personazha, ot ikh povsednevnykh vzaimodeystviy do klyuchevykh syuzhetnykh momentov, obespechivaya igrokam zakhvatyvayushchiy vizualnyy opyt. Vyrazheniya lits i dvizheniya personazhey tshchatelno prorabotany, chtoby zapechatlet kazhdyy emotsionalnyy moment.
Osnovnaya mekhanika igry zaklyuchaetsya v uklonenii ot pul i zadevanii ikh. Kogda vy stalkivaetes s plotnymi pulevymi atakami, tochnoe uklonenie pozvolyaet vam bezopasno prokhodit skvoz puli. Kazhdoe uspeshnoe uklonenie i zadevanie ne tolko pozvolyaet vam izbezhat atak, no i nakaplivaet energiyu. Eta energiya mozhet byt ispolzovana dlya vysvobozhdeniya moshchnykh atakuyushchikh navykov, pereloma khoda bitvy i naneseniya sokrushitelnykh udarov po vashim vragam.
Pomimo traditsionnykh atak adskimi pulyami, v igre est razlichnye spetsialnye etapy ispytaniy. Eti etapy ne tolko proveryayut vashi operativnye navyki, no i trebuyut strategicheskogo myshleniya. Kazhdyy etap ispytaniya imeet svoy igrovoy protsess i mekhaniku; nekotorye iz nikh mogut potrebovat ot vas unichtozhit vsekh vragov za opredelennoe vremya, v to vremya kak drugie mogut poprosit vas ubit opredelennykh vragov v opredelennoe vremya i v opredelennykh mestakh. Prokhozhdenie etikh etapov pozvolyaet vam razblokirovat razlichnye moshchnye navyki, kotorye eshche bolshe rasshiryayut vozmozhnosti vashey mashiny i dayut vam znachitelnoe preimushchestvo v srazheniyakh.
Naprimer, nekotorye navyki mogut uvelichit silu vashey ataki, delaya kazhduyu ataku bolee smertonosnoy; drugie mogut povysit vashu zhivuchest, delaya vas bolee ustoychivym k silnym protivnikam. Nekotorye navyki obladayut osobymi sposobnostyami, takimi kak mgnovennoe obezvrezhivanie vsekh pul ili nanesenie udarov na bolshom rasstoyanii. Blagodarya postoyannym ispytaniyam i modernizatsiyam vasha mashina budet stanovitsya vse silnee, chto pozvolit vam protivostoyat vse bolee groznym vragam i bolee slozhnym ispytaniyam..Eshchyo vizualnye novelly / shmapy.

When small-town handyman Harper Pendrell meets a dying woman in the street, he unwittingly stumbles into a diabolical conspiracy – a mystery only he can solve. An unknown disease is spreading across the country, and between them a scientist, a reporter and a reclusive artist hold the key to stopping it. A perilous journey awaits, and every step brings Harper closer to a cabal of dangerous fanatics. Before he knows it, he finds himself in a fight for the future of humankind armed only with his trusty multi-tool. 

Can Harper find the courage to expose the truth and prevent an epidemic, even if it means succumbing to contagion himself? Join Harper and experience a challenging investigation, smart dialog and a rich cast of characters in this thrilling new adventure game from Backwoods Entertainment and Application Systems Heidelberg.

FEATURES
• Uncover and solve the dark mysteries behind the ongoing catastrophe and try and save the human race!
• Explore plenty of intriguing locations with challenging puzzles
• Enjoy a classical style mystery adventure game
• Behold beautiful, lovingly hand-painted 2D graphics with over 60 backgrounds
• Meet lots of interesting characters

Choosing between good and evil, Pip learns the laws of Karma, and his choices define the outcome of the game.

V 1962 godu dvenadtsat astronomov iz observatorii dalnego kosmosa byli naydeny mertvymi. Iz-za blizosti vazhnoy voennoy bazy dva federalnykh agenta byli otpravleny dlya rassledovaniya… I to, chto oni nashli, bylo za predelami etogo mira!
Uznayte, chto na samom dele proizoshlo toy nochyu, issleduya gorod, polnyy podozrevaemykh, kotorym est, chto skryvat, i ne dopustite, chtoby eto kogda-libo povtorilos.
Igrayt za federalnogo agenta Ketrin Armstrong, molodogo rekruta s otlichnymi nauchnymi sposobnostyami ili za Styuarta Rossa, opytnogo veterana ulichnoy rabote «na zemle», i ikh osobye navyki i individualnost izmenyat khod istorii..

«Зайчик» — нелинейная визуальная новелла:
«Zaychik» — nelineynaya vizualnaya novella v zhanre uzhasov, po motivam odnoimyonnogo rasskaza Dmitriya Mordasa. Igra predstavlyaet soboy vizualnuyu novellu v zhanre khorror. Setting igry mozhno opisat kak tayozhnuyu, kholodnuyu i mrachnuyu novogodnyuyu skazku, deystviya kotoroy razvorachivayutsya v 1990-ykh godakh v dalney glubinke, v posyolke posredi dremuchikh lesov, gde na protyazhenii dolgikh let proiskhodili tainstvennye i misticheskie sobytiya.
Vsyo zasypaet s prikhodom zimy, no etot les ne spit. Chto-to brodit po ego zasnezhennym tropinkam, sledit iz-za chyornykh derevev i zabiraet to, chto emu prichitaetsya. Ono ostavlyaet posle sebya lish strannye slukhi o golosakh, zovushchikh iz chashchi, o litsakh, zaglyadyvayushchikh v okna, o strannykh sledakh na snegu... i fotografii detey na obyavleniyakh o propazhe.
Tomu, kto uslyshal golos lesa, uzhe ne pomozhet nichego. Emu ostayotsya lish vsyo glubzhe pogruzhatsya v kholodnye obyatya uzhasa, chtoby tam, v ledyanoy chernote, sdelat posledniy vybor: ostatsya zhivym ili ostatsya chelovekom.
Khudozhestvenno igra vypolnena v polurealistichnom stile v chyorno-belykh tonakh khudozhnikom i prodyuserom razrabotki Saikono Joker'om. Stsenariy i geymdizayn prorabotan Evgeniem Sokarevym. Muzyka napisana kompozitorami Vladimirom Bulaevym, Nikitoy Kryukovym, Nikitoy Lagunovym, Eichon, El-Metallico, _Blacksmith_ i zvukodizaynerom Egorom Apreltsevym, podrobnee.Vklyucheny 3 uzhe dostupnykh epizoda iz vsego 5 zaplanirovannykh: «Prileti, sova», «Vremya poigrat», i «Dybom volchya sherst».Eshchyo vizualnykh novell na Switch (renpy).

This Strange Realm Of Mine is a First Pe:
This Strange Realm Of Mine is a First Person Shooter mixed with Poetry and Psychological Horror.

In REALM you explore your afterlife. On your quest you'll find characters in different situations, with their problems and thoughts on life. You can invite them to your tavern, a safe-haven in the midst of all the chaos. You'll also meet Ulrich, a spiritual guide who'll take you through your experience as a lost soul.

You'll come across monstrous beings who are eager to put their teeth in you. There are several ways to rid yourself of them, ranging from guns to melee weapons. Be ready to get your hands dirty and watch the blood drip slowly from the roof and walls.

В «This War of Mine» вы играете не за со:
V «This War of Mine» vy igraete ne za soldata elitnykh voysk, a za gruppu mirnykh zhiteley, pytayushchikhsya vyzhit v osazhdennom gorode, ispytyvaya nekhvatku edy, lekarstv i postoyannuyu opasnost so storony snayperov i maroderov. Igra daet vozmozhnost prochuvstvovat voynu s absolyutno novoy perspektivy.

Igrovoy protsess v «This War of Mine» zavisit ot smeny dney i nochey. Snaypery ne pozvolyayut vam pokinut ubezhishche dnem, poetomu vam prikhoditsya zanimatsya drugimi delami — otstraivat svoe ukrytie, torgovat, zabotitsya o vyzhivshikh. Nochyu, vybrav odnu iz unikalnykh lokatsiy, vy mozhete otpravit kogo-nibud na poiski provizii, kotoraya pomozhet vam ostatsya v zhivykh.

Prinimayte resheniya, rukovodstvuyas svoimi moralnymi printsipami. Poprobuyte sberech vsekh svoikh lyudey ili pozhertvuyte kem-nibud, chtoby povysit shansy ostalnykh. Vo vremya voyny net khoroshikh ili plokhikh resheniy, est tolko zadacha — vyzhit. Chem skoree vy poymete eto, tem luchshe.

Hotspot finder.

2111 год. Миром правят технологические к:

Vy agent OPT — otdela peredovykh tekhnologiy. V mire, gde vse reshayut tekhnokorporatsii, deystvuet tolko odno pravilo: libo vzlomaesh ty, libo vzlomayut tebya. Современный Париж. На улицах орудует неу:
Sovremennyy Parizh. Na ulitsakh oruduet neulovimyy seriynyy ubiytsa. Chislo zhertv rastet, a politsiya po-prezhnemu ne mozhet nayti ni odnoy zatsepki. Vy — voditel taksi, i vam udalos vyzhit posle napadeniya bezzhalostnogo ubiytsy. U vas est sem nochey, chtoby pomoch v ego poimke: potom politsiya povesit vse prestupleniya na vas. Tak chto gotovtes, blizhayshie nochnye smeny budut tyazhelymi...
 
Night Call — nelineynaya igra-rassledovanie s zakhvatyvayushchim syuzhetom v zhanre nuar. Vy ne sledovatel i ne politseyskiy, no u vas est dar: v salone vashego taksi lyudi rasslablyayutsya. Nachinayut govorit. Delyatsya s vami myslyami, emotsiyami, rasskazyvayut istorii svoey zhizni — i svoi sekrety. Dlya passazhirov vy bolshe, chem prosto voditel: na vremya vy stanovites ikh drugom, doverennym litsom, pomoshchnikom — ili molchalivym nablyudatelem, chto sposoben razglyadet istinu za lyuboy maskoy. Chtoby poymat ubiytsu, vam predstoit v polnoy mere vospolzovatsya svoim darom.
 
Vashe vremya ogranicheno: vam pridetsya dobyvat uliki i v to zhe vremya zarabatyvat, chtoby oplachivat scheta. Berite passazhirov, vyslushivayte ikh i budte ostorozhnee s otvetami: nekotorye iz vashikh klientov — obychnye lyudi s udivitelnymi istoriyami, togda kak rasskazy drugikh mogut prolit svet na khod vashego rassledovaniya. Vospolzovavshis pravilnymi zatsepkami, postaraytes uznat kak mozhno bolshe svedeniy o podozrevaemykh. I ne zabyvayte, chto vam nuzhny dengi, chtoby zapravit avtomobil i oplatit scheta!
 
Uspeete li vy vychislit tainstvennogo ubiytsu, poka ne pozdno? Potoropites! Taksometr uzhe vklyuchen, a vremya poshlo!

OSOBENNOSTI IGRY:

YaRKIE, ORIGINALNYE PERSONAZhI: poznakomtes s bolee chem 70 strannymi, udivitelnymi, realistichnymi lyudmi i nenadolgo okunites v ikh zhizn. Nekotorye istorii tronut vas, vdokhnovyat — ili opechalyat. Slushayte eti rasskazy vnimatelno: oni mogut okazatsya ochen poleznymi.

VOSKhITITELNAYa IGRA V STILE NUAR: vse personazhi i lokatsii narisovany vruchnuyu v stile klassicheskogo cherno-belogo nuara.

RASSLEDOVANIE ILI RABOTA: vy otkazhetes ot informatsii, esli za nee pridetsya platit? Ili pozhertvuete zarabotannym, chtoby poluchit nuzhnye svedeniya? Reshayte bystree, vremya idet!
The Binding of Isaac («Жертвоприношение:
The Binding of Isaac («Zhertvoprinoshenie Isaaka») — kompyuternaya igra v zhanre action-adventure s elementami roguelike i shutera s vidom sverkhu, razrabotannaya Edmundom Makmillenom i Florianom Khimslom, muzyku k igre napisal Denni Baranovski, kompozitor Super Meat Boy.
Nazvanie igry i eyo syuzhet otsylayut k izvestnomu bibleyskomu syuzhetu s tem zhe nazvaniem: glavnyy geroy, rebyonok po imeni Isaak, pryachetsya v podvale doma ot materi, kotoroy «golos Boga» povelel ubit syna. Upravlyaya Isaakom ili drugim iz shesti personazhey na vybor, igrok dolzhen proyti cherez neskolko urovney podvala, sostoyashchikh iz mnozhestva protsedurno generiruemykh komnat i naselennykh vrazhdebnymi sushchestvami. Vnutri komnat igrovoy protsess oformlen v vide shutera — personazh dolzhen, «strelyaya» sobstvennymi slezami, porazit vragov, odnovremenno izbegaya stolknoveniy s nimi. Smert v The Binding of Isaac yavlyaetsya neobratimoy — esli personazh poteryaet vse svoe zdorove, igrok budet vynuzhden nachat igru s samogo nachala. Po slovam Makmillena, igra zatragivaet takie temy, kak zhestokoe otnoshenie k detyam, polovaya identichnost, detoubiystvo, prenebrezhenie, samoubiystvo, abort, a takzhe kak religiya mozhet navredit rebyonku — temy, kotorykh obychno starayutsya izbegat.
Khotya The Binding of Isaac byla sozdana kak eksperimentalnaya igra v khode Game Jam, ona poluchila vysokie otsenki pressy i sniskala nemalyy kommercheskiy uspekh: na 2014 god bylo prodano bolee 3 millionov kopiy igry. The Binding of Isaac takzhe nazyvali igroy, kotoraya privlekla interes kak igrokov, tak i razrabotchikov k ranee nishevomu zhanru roguelike, i vklyuchaet v sebya:

A neon-lit dystopian cityscape becomes t:
A neon-lit dystopian cityscape becomes the stage for thrilling adventure and deep yuri romance in this cyberpunk-themed visual novel. The complex personalities and experiences of more than 20 characters are interwoven across multiple paths and possible endings. Your choices matter, not only to you, but to all those with whom you struggle to connect.

Cila, a veteran cop with a sour outlook and anger issues expects nothing more from life besides the smell of ozone, blinding neon lights and the ever-present manhole steam. That is, until a shady friend replaces her broken-down housedroid as a favour. Advanced, more efficient and remarkably perceptive, unit M.A.R.A. begins to penetrate Cila's toughened exterior and possibly even heal her new owner's old wounds – if Cila can decipher the recurring nightmare the process brings. Soon Cila and Mara forge a unique, if sometimes uneasy bond.

Unbeknownst to Cila, just as her life begins to find its new normal, the technological giant Velta Labs gets wind of Mara's existence and takes a mysterious interest in the android. A war unlike any before is brewing on the horizon, its players are silently being selected and one android's fate may spell the difference between peace, war, the blossoming of a new religion or a technological singularity beyond comprehension.

----

Plus, one year after the events of the Synergia Incident, Cila and Mara's lives have drastically changed, as have the lives of all those around them. This edition includes SUNRISE, a small glimpse into their future outside of The Empire, and the repercussions of their actions during the main game.

Bathed in the ultraviolet lights of the European Travel Union, Yu, the Emperor's right-hand, prepares to reunite with the reviled Cila and Mara and finally settle things with The Empire's most wanted terrorist: Yoko. 

Features:
• Journey through a cyberpunk setting of neon-lit corruption.
• Explore 100s of unique backgrounds and CGs between SUNRISE & the main game
• Meet 20+ characters with personal histories woven into the narrative.
• Experience a vivid soundtrack composed by Andy Andi Han.
• Make key choices that impact the story and lead to multiple endings.
• Features in-game artbook & bonus comic, with 64 pages of content
• In-game Music Room featuring the full OST
• Includes the full "SUNRISE" expansion
• High resolution graphical remaster

Merrily Perilly is a game about crisis. You play as Perry, a severely dehydrated man who stumbles into a remote village in search of help, but the inhabitants respond with strange detachment to your trouble. You may think that the nearby fountain is a safe means to quench your dire thirst, but you would soon find yourself in search of aid for a snake bite. And before you know it, you will be chased by bees, fending off bears, cursed by thaumaturges, and most likely set on fire. Will the crises ever end!?

Merrily Perilly plays like a top down adventure game where you must resolve the perpetual perils that afflict Perry by interacting with the townsfolk and environment. Through exploration and experimentation, the nonlinear narrative branches and intersects into many paths leading to several distinct endings.

Бермудский тайфунник (лат. Pterodroma ca:
Bermudskiy tayfunnik (lat. Pterodroma cahow) — odin iz nemnogikh vidov otryada burevestnikoobraznykh, kotoryy obitaet ne na territorii Tikhogo okeana. Eta nochnaya gnezdyashchayasya na zemle morskaya ptitsa — natsionalnaya ptitsa Bermudskikh ostrovov, a takzhe simvol nadezhdy na zashchitu prirody: ego dramaticheskoe «pereotkrytie» (effekt Lazarya), to est otkrytie vida posle togo, kak on schitalsya vymershim stoletiya, vdokhnovilo mnozhestvo naturalistov. Obshchaya populyatsiya etikh ptits na 2005 god sostavila okolo 250 osobey.

Kazhduyu noch iskusstvennoe osveshchenie dezorientiruet burevestnikov, ostavlyaya molodykh ptits na milost zataivshikhsya krys i khishchnykh brodyachikh koshek. Soberite khrupkuyu, no polnyy nadezhd tsepochku i privedite ikh k bolshomu okeanu, gde oni nakonets-to smogut letet k svobode.
Poetichnyy, neobychnyy i dushevnyy 2D stels-golovolomka, vdokhnovlennyy realnymi eko-problemami, pomestit vas v perya starogo pirata s nezhnym serdtsem, stavshey posledney nadezhdoy dlya nakhodyashchegosya pod ugrozoy ischeznoveniya vida ptits.

Transportnyy magnat) — kompyuternaya igra, ekonomicheskaya strategiya v realnom vremeni, v kotoroy igrok vystupaet v kachestve upravlyayushchego transportnoy kompanii i pytaetsya poluchit maksimalnuyu pribyl za schyot perevozki passazhirov i raznoobraznykh gruzov po avtodorogam, zheleznym dorogam, monorelsovym dorogam, a takzhe vodnym i vozdushnym transportom. Razrabotchik igry — Kris Soyer (angl. Chris Sawyer).
Sut igry v sozdanii i uspeshnom razvitii transportnogo predpriyatiya, kotorym rukovodit igrok. Razvitie proiskhodit blagodarya izvlecheniyu pribyli, kotoraya poluchaetsya ot perevozok gruzov i passazhirov raznoobraznym transportom (zheleznodorozhnym, avto, avia i vodnym).
Igrok nachinaet igru v nachale XX veka s parovozami i samolyotami tipa «Kukuruznik» ili Yunkers, prodolzhaet igrat s dizelyami i «Boingami» i zakanchivaet igrat v kontse XXI veka s maglevami, monorelsami i «Konkordami», mozhno prokladyvat mosty i tonneli, stroit dorogi, zheleznye dorogi, stantsii, aeroporty, kanaly i akveduki. V obshchem igrovoy protsess polnostyu povtoryaet original — est proizvodstvennye tsepochki, a takzhe goroda, kotorye neobkhodimo svyazat transportom, ne zabyvaya ego obsluzhivat, i pri etom osushchestvlyat konkurentnuyu borbu. V igre vozmozhna pokupka aktsiy firm-konkurentov.

Deystvie igry prokhodit na razlichnykh obektakh-shakhtakh PTMC, razbrosannykh po Solnechnoy sisteme — ot Luny do Kharona, sputnika Plutona. Posle likvidatsii poslednego robota-bossa v shakhte na Kharone, geroyski srazhavshiysya MD1032, stanovitsya lishnim v etom zhestokom mire, gde stavki slishkom vysoki, chtoby khranit obeshchaniya, i pilota blagorodno proinformiruyut, chto MD1032 «ne smozhet vernutsya» v shtab PTMC na lunnoy orbite iz-za yakoby vysokoy veroyatnosti ego zarazheniya tem zhe opasnym virusom, nad kotorym on edva oderzhal pobedu.

V poiskakh linz i drugikh sokrovishch v Runnykh katakombakh nepodaleku nashi geroi uznayut, chto gorod s trudom pytayutsya otstroit zanovo posle zemletryaseniya, i prinimayut reshenie pomoch. Vy uznaete, chto Runnye katakomby skryvayut bolshuyu taynu, sudbonosnuyu dlya odnogo iz personazhey. To, chto nachinaetsya kak prostye poiski sokrovishch, prevrashchaetsya v tainstvennyy zagovor, kotoryy potryaset mir i povliyaet na glavnyy syuzhet Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes.

Oni vynashivayut svoi chyornye zamysly… Vtoraya — «Kanon sotvoreniya», originalnaya syuzhetnaya liniya Shin Megami Tensei V, kotoraya povestvuet o vechnoy vrazhde angelov s demonami, gde geroy boretsya za sudbu mira.
— V Tokio sluchilos uzhasnoe ubiystvo. Vozvrashchayas domoy iz shkoly, glavnyy geroy reshaet oboyti mesto proisshestviya cherez tonnel, no tot neozhidanno obrushivaetsya. Geroy prikhodit v sebya uzhe v inom Tokio — pustyne, nyne izvestnoy kak Da'at. Na malchika tut zhe napadayut krovozhadnye demony, no v posledniy moment emu na pomoshch prikhodit tainstvennyy neznakomets. Obedinivshis, oni prevrashchayutsya v nakhobino — mogushchestvennoe sushchestvo, kotoroe nelzya nazvat ni demonom, ni chelovekom.
— Obretya novuyu silu, geroy otpravlyaetsya v puteshestvie po Da'atu. Etot zagadochnyy mir naselyaet mnozhestvo mificheskikh bogov i zhestokikh demonov, kotorye neprestanno boryutsya drug s drugom za vyzhivanie. V poiskakh otvetov geroyu predstoit sygrat svoyu rol v protivostoyanii angelov i demonov, a zatem reshit sudbu vsego mira.
— Potryasayushchaya grafika, adaptirovannaya dlya sovremennykh konsoley, mrachnaya vselennaya s pugayushchey atmosferoy, zloveshchie i prekrasnye demony, novaya muzyka i oblasti, kotorykh ne bylo v originalnoy igre, — vsyo eto zhdyot vas v etoy rasshirennoy versii Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance. Oprobuyte uproshchyonnyy igrovoy protsess, uluchshennuyu boevuyu sistemu, a takzhe novye varianty vzaimodeystviya s demonami i vozmozhnosti issledovaniya mira.
— Istoriya o vozmezdii… ili sotvorenii. Kakoy put vyberete vy? Otkroyte dlya sebya novuyu istoriyu o mesti padshikh ili sygrayte po originalnomu stsenariyu Shin Megami Tensei V. Obe syuzhetnye linii polny neprostykh i podchas riskovannykh resheniy, kotorye zastavyat vas zadumatsya o tom, za kakie ubezhdeniya stoit srazhatsya. Proydite svoy put v mire, gde khaos i poryadok rassypayutsya v prakh, i reshite sudbu chelovechestva.
Issleduyte mrachnyy postapokalipticheskiy mir! Srazhaytes v razrushennom Tokio, kotoryy prevratilsya v beskonechnuyu pustynyu i nyne sluzhit domom mificheskim demonam. Issleduyte beskraynie otkrytye prostory, sobirayte poleznye predmety, srazhaytes ili nakhodite obshchiy yazyk s demonami, mnogie iz kotorykh vam uzhe znakomy.Shin Megami Tensei V i Shin Megami Tensei III: Nocturne HD REMASTER sm. zdes.
Исследуй огромный и прекрасный мир Valle:
Issleduy ogromnyy i prekrasnyy mir Valley, ispolzuya vsyu silu L.E.A.F kostyuma: neveroyatno moshchnogo ekzoskeleta, nadelyayushchego svoego vladeltsa ne tolko sverkhchelovecheskoy skorostyu i lovkostyu, no i absolyutnoy vlastyu nad zhiznyu i smertyu vsekh zhivykh sushchestv. Valley eto priklyuchenie ot pervogo litsa, ravnogo kotoromu  eshche ne bylo. Ty by udivilsya, obnaruzhiv sebya v taynoy doline, spryatannoy v glubine otdalennykh oblastey Skalistykh gor? Blagodarya moshchi nedavno obnaruzhennogo L.E.A.F. kostyuma ( Leap Effortlessly though Air Functionality), prokladyvay sebe put s pomoshchyu bega i pryzhkov cherez prekrasnye lesa, opasnye ruiny i raznoobraznye sredy obitaniya; ne zabyvay primenyat svoi vozmozhnosti upravleniya zhiznyu i smertyu dlya raskrytiya udivitelnykh tayn zagadochnoy doliny.

-  Dvigaysya bystree, prygay vyshe: ispolzuy vsyu moshch L.E.A.F kostyuma i peremeshchaysya po miru Valley so sverkhchelovecheskoy skorostyu i lovkostyu.
-  Kontrol zhizni i smerti: L.E.A.F. kostyum pozvolyaet tebe reshat, komu zhit, a komu umeret.
-  Kazhdaya smert – novyy stezhok. S kazhdoy tvoey smertyu pogibaet i nebolshaya chast doliny.
-  Razvivaysya: uluchshay svoy kostyum i poluchay novye vozmozhnosti i umeniya.
-  Issleduy: Valley - eto neobyatnyy mir s dremuchimi lesami, dikimi prostorami, drevnimi ruinami, ocharovatelnymi sozdaniyami i opasnymi vragami. Eto mir, polnyy tayn...

Vas zhdet mnozhestvo uluchsheniy, dopolneniy i obnovleniy: chetkaya i yarkaya HD-grafika, eksklyuzivnyy tsifrovoy artbuk, novye rezhimy odinochnoy i setevoy igry, novye personazhi i mnogoe drugoe.
Ryu, Ken, Chun Li i prochie personazhi originalnoy igry snova s stroyu — i blagodarya obnovlennoy grafike oni vyglyadyat velikolepno!
Улитки — медленные. Но только не эта ули:
Ulitki — medlennye. No tolko ne eta ulitka! Slippi — bryukhonogiy mollyusk v kosmose, i on nauchilsya letat, ispolzuya otdachu svoego oruzhiya i dvigateley! Strelyayte v odnom napravlenii, letayte v drugom. No, o bozhe, esli by eto bylo tak veselo, Slippi stalkivaetsya s vse bolee slozhnymi prepyatstviyami na svoem puti — ulitki ne rady, kogda stalkivayutsya s shipami v kosmose...
Slippi i mister MakFlay predany svoey rabote. Kak kurery dlya krupneyshego mezhgalakticheskogo torgovtsa tovarov, oni podchinyayutsya vysokim standartam. Odnako ikh obydennaya ezhednevnaya smena i shans stat sotrudnikami mesyatsa stalkivayutsya s bolshoy problemoy, kogda iz-za mekhanicheskoy neispravnosti ikh korabl sovershaet avariynuyu posadku na planete, kazhushcheysya paryashchey v kosmose! Chto eshche khuzhe, oni poteryali vse posylki, kotorye teper razbrosany po poverkhnosti planety...
Neizvestno vsem prisheltsam v blizlezhashchey galaktike, sudba ikh ozhidaemykh postavok na sleduyushchiy den zavisit ot shchupalets Slippi i MakFlaya. Smozhete li vy provesti ikh cherez planetu i vosstanovit vse poteryannye posylki po puti? Vy (ulitka Slippi) dolzhny letat cherez urovni, polnye vse bolee slozhnykh prepyatstviy, ispolzuya tolko otdachu ot vashego oruzhiya. Sobirayte posylki, dostavlyayte tovary i pobezhdayte bossov na svoem puti. Stante luchshim kosmicheskim kurerom i vyigrayte kosmicheskuyu gonku v pochtovoy rabote.
В игре Thief of Thieves: Season One («Во:
V igre Thief of Thieves: Season One («Vor iz vorov – pervyy sezon») ty — vor-fortochnik,  organizuyushchiy gromkie ogrableniya po vsemu miru s pomoshchyu khitrostey, razvodilova i komandy podelnikov.

Igra razrabotana po motivam serii komiksov Roberta Kirkmana, udostoennoy mnogikh nagrad. Eto uvlekatelnaya istoriya o grabezhakh i lyudyakh, stoyashchikh za nimi. Seliya — nachinayushchaya grabitelnitsa i protezhe pochyotnogo vora Redmonda.  Ona reshaet, chto prishlo vremya prodelat put ot uchenitsy do znatnogo vora. Posle provala na rodine Seliya otpravlyaetsya v Evropu i primykaet k novoy shayke, chtoby provesti s ney seriyu grabezhey. 

Tvoya zadacha: uznat svoikh podelnikov poblizhe i razrabotat konkretnyy plan deystviy na meste dlya vypolneniya dela. No ne teryay bditelnosti! Tvoi deystviya mogut byt chrevaty tyazhkimi posledstviyami.

Udastsya li tebe proyti ispytanie delom na novom kontinente i s novymi lyudmi, i opravdat ozhidaniya svoego pokrovitelya?

- Syuzhet razvivaetsya v kadrakh komiksa, gde glavnaya geroinya Seliya perekhodit ot igrovoy stseny k sleduyushchey — bud to vecherinka ili stroyploshchadka — prodvigayas k tseli s pomoshchyu svoego umeniya razvesti drugikh lyudey i konspiratsii, no nikogda ne pribegaya k nasiliyu.
- Snogsshibatelnaya grafika, gde komiksy, narisovannye ot ruki, plavno peretekayut v tryokhmernye igrovye urovni, sozdavaya nepovtorimyy igrovoy syuzhet.
- Zhivye, realistichnye igrovye personazhi ozvucheny takimi izvestnymi aktyorami ozvuchki, kak Frida Vulf (igra Mass Effect: Andromeda), Stefen Stenton (film «Izgoy-odin»), Emili O’Brayen (igra Death Stranding), Sissi Dzhons (igry Firewatch, The Walking Dead: Season 1), Fred Tataskor («Kung-fu panda 2») i Ilays Tufeksis (igra Deus Ex: Human Revolution).
- Individualnyy geympley — deystviya, sovershaemye v igre, vliyayut na razvitie igrovogo syuzheta i otnosheniya s podelnikami.

Potentsialnye magnaty marikhuany dolzhny budut tshchatelno rasstavlyat prioritety v resursakh, poskolku oni upravlyayut proizvodstvom i rasprostraneniem svoey travki. Reshite, kogda i gde vzyat na sebya dopolnitelnyy risk, chtoby maksimizirovat pribyl, no budte ostorozhny, politseyskie i politiki deystvuyut po-svoemu.

No so vremenem odinochestvo nachinaet vse silnee davit ne tolko na vashe telo, no i na vashu psikhiku – i vasha bitva za zhizn oborachivaetsya voynoy na istoshchenie. Skolko vy smozhete proderzhatsya v odinochku protiv neizvestnosti?

V dzhunglyakh vasha zhizn vse vremya pod ugrozoy: v lyuboy moment vas mogut prikonchit dikie zhivotnye i tropicheskie bolezni. SYuZhET
Vy okazalis v samom serdtse buynykh, neprokhodimykh dzhungley Amazonki. Tekh samykh, chto po pravu nosyat nazvanie «zelenyy ad». Igrovoy protsess
V protivostoyanii s terroristicheskoy organizatsiey «Front osvobozhdeniya» vam predstoit koordinirovat komandu v sbore informatsii, pravilno raspredelyat byudzhet i reshat voprosy s zhazhdushchey novostey pressoy. No eto —lish chast raboty.
Vasha glavnaya zadacha — vesti rassledovanie i doprashivat podozrevaemykh. Izuchiv ikh proshloe i motivatsiyu, vy smozhete podobrat k kazhdomu luchshiy podkhod, bud to ugrozy, obman ili soperezhivanie. V chem slozhnost? Universalnogo resheniya net, a na poiski personalnogo podkhoda tratitsya stol dragotsennoe vremya. 
Chem blizhe vy podbiraetes k prestupnikam, tem bolee nesgovorchivymi budut podozrevaemye i neprostymi doprosy. Chtoby raskryt delo, pridetsya proyavit vse masterstvo vedeniya peregovorov, a takzhe pribegnut k manipulyatsiyam i drugim priemam. 
Nayti i unichtozhit «Front osvobozhdeniya» budet sovsem ne prosto.

Альтернативный 1997 год. Человечество пе:
Alternativnyy 1997 god. Chelovechestvo perezhilo globalnyy krizis. Vyzhivshie lyudi vynuzhdeny borotsya za edinstvennuyu tsennost — pitevuyu vodu. Syuzhet povestvuet o parne-podrostke, kotoryy zhivyot v odinochestve v bunkere v meste, nazyvaemom «Pustosh». Na etoy territorii pravit despotichnyy golovorez po imeni Zevs, kotoryy obladaet ustroystvom, sposobnym vyzhimat iz lyudey vodu. Vsyo svoyo vremya paren zanyat lish tem, chto lazit po razlichnym razvalinam v poiskakh chego-nibud tsennogo, a svoi nakhodki on vymenivaet u staryovshchika na pitevuyu vodu. Odnazhdy patsan, sidya na pustyre na detskoy ploshchadke i chitaya komiksy pro Turbo gonshchika, vstrechaet devushku po imeni Eppl. Paren pugaetsya eyo strannogo povedeniya i agressivnykh popytok podruzhitsya. On pryachetsya ot neyo v svoyom bunkere, no devushke udayotsya proniknut i tuda..
V «Turbo Kid» vy budete igrat za Patsana, odinokogo voina, otpravlyayushchegosya v stranstvie po Pustoshi v priklyuchencheskom retro-stile. Nasha istoriya nachinaetsya srazu posle okonchaniya odnoimyonnogo kinofilma. V svoyom puteshestvii vy vstretite chudakov i chudakov, druzey, vragov i posrednikov, kotorye budut predlagat sovety, kvesty, draki i shutki (mnogo shutok!) v dushevnoy istorii.
Vdokhnovlennaya legendarnymi metroidvaniyami, takimi kak «Mega Man X» i «Super Metroid», Turbo Kid dast vam poissledovat razlichnye zony i pobezhdat bossov v tom poryadke, v kotorom vy schitaete nuzhnym.
Issleduyte urovni i pobezhdayte bossov v tom poryadke, v kotorom vy schitaete nuzhnym, delayte vybory, vliyayushchie na khod istorii, pozvolyaya proyti neskolko prokhozhdeniy igry s raznymi putyami — i rezultatami.
Кейси просыпается на острове, принадлежа:
Keysi prosypaetsya na ostrove, prinadlezhashchem Lune, tainstvennomu dukhu v obliche lisy. Cherez neskolko mgnoveniy ona poluchaet zadanie: sozdat samyy bolshoy sad!

Luna's Fishing Garden - mirnaya igra pro rybalku i stroitelstvo. Lovi rybu, torguy s dukhom lisitsy i stroy sad svoey mechty. Ukras svoy sad raznymi derevyami, vodnymi obektami i rasteniyami, a takzhe zaselyay zhivotnykh na raznye ostrova.

Igray tak, kak sam pozhelaesh:
Bez ogranicheniy vo vremeni i bez speshki, v Luna's Fishing Garden mozhno sledovat syuzhetu radi kontsovki, a mozhno ego prosto ignorirovat. Proigrat nevozmozhno. Igray v svoyom tempe i naslazhdaysya lovley ryby, stroitelstvom i rasseleniem zhivotnykh na arkhipelage. 

Chuvstvo uyuta:
S ocharovatelnym piksel-artom i umirotvoryayushchim zvukovym soprovozhdeniem, Luna's Fishing Garden sdelana dlya togo, chtoby pogruzit tebya v svoy krasochnyy mir i zabrat pechali i nevzgody. Vstrechay ostrovnykh dukhov i vypolnyay ikh zadaniya, ili prosto rasslabsya i nablyuday za okruzhayushchim mirom.

Osobennosti igry:

The Queen of the Old World calls upon yo:
The Queen of the Old World calls upon you! As Her Majesty's domain expands, we require a capable administrator to guide Her latest colonies to prosperity. We will provide you with ships, colonists, and other tools necessary to tame these wild, virgin lands, and turn them into a prosperous colonial enterprise, all under the Queen's watchful eye.

Naturally, the Crown will expect you to share the bounty of these new lands, pay your taxes on time, and continue expanding the boundaries of Her Majesty’s colonial possessions. Obedience may earn you rewards, but refusing to pay your dues or worse, declaring independence, will have dire consequences.

So, governor: Are you ready to colonise One More Island?

A New Frontier 
You are called upon to explore the frontiers of Her Majesty’s colonial empire, claim territory, then exploit it to its fullest to gain riches for the throne!

Set sail for the New World to plant Her flag and establish a new colony - as well as ensuring it thrives.
Each exploration is never the same, thanks to a world map generated dynamically from a combination of hand-crafted map elements.
Customize the challenge to your tastes, adjusting island size, land fertility, amount of natural resources and more, to make it as easy or as hard as desired.

A New Colony
As governor, you're in charge. Plan out the colony, take care of your residents, and turn a small outpost into an overseas metropolis bustling with commerce!

Construct the buildings you want: The freeform building designer allows fine-tuning workshop placement and colonist’s paths to optimize the holy colony plan.
Look after the colonists' needs. Happy colonists work harder and faster, growing your, err, Her Majesty's colonial empire.
Harness this legendary colony and these dedicated colonists to create production chains,  producing necessary goods on the spot and growing the community.

A New Empire
There's always One More Island to conquer. Explore the world, find new spots to establish more colonies, then tie them together into a self-sufficient network: An empire of your own making.

Build a new fleet to explore the archipelago, claim new islands for your domain, then link them together with overseas trade routes.
Optimize your production chains and increase their complexity to create entire industries independent of the Old World.
Research new ways to develop your fledgling colony into a New World superpower. Each civilization tier brings with it new challenges, new requirements - and new opportunities.

A New Nation?
The Queen wants her share of New World's bounty. Taxes are expected, as is ordained. But there's always another option, one that your colonists might look upon favourably.

Manage your reputation at the royal court. Pay your taxes on time and meet their expectations or...

Do you dare to commit the unthinkable? Do you dare to disobey the monarch?

Do you dare try to form a new nation, breaking free of Old World tyranny?

Well? Where do you stand?

Being the captain of a spaceship can be:
Being the captain of a spaceship can be hard, especially when there’s a price on your head. Bounty hunters, space pirates, and even the Galactic Union are trying to hunt you down. All that stands between you and oblivion is your wits, your crew, and your trusty ship.

The Galactic Junkers is a comedic action-adventure space combat game that puts you in the role of a space captain on the run. Your ship might be falling apart and your crew isn’t the best but with a little luck you can keep everything ship-shape. Upgrade your ship, hire new crew, steal supplies and equipment, and keep searching for the truth of why everyone wants you dead.

Explore

Take a journey across the solar system exploring all nine planets and their neighboring sectors. Discover mysterious asteroids, creaking space stations, abandoned shipwrecks, deadly pirates and much more.

Mine, Salvage, Steal, and Trade

Running a spaceship is never easy and there’s always bills to pay. Keep your bank balance looking healthy by mining asteroids, salvaging derelicts, and trading with disreputable characters. Maybe you’ll even partake in a little theft, but don’t worry - we don’t tell anyone.

Battle and Board Enemy Ships

Space is a deadly place so you’ll have to fight for your life. Set your crew to operate the guns and show those pesky pirates what you are made of! Board enemy ships to smash and grab essential resources or hack systems from the shadows.

Hire and Maintain your Crew

A happy ship needs a happy crew, so look after your band of useful idiots. Nurture their skills to keep everything running smoothly, or if you don't like them, show them the airlock and hire new crew.

Buy, Upgrade, and Repair Ships

Maybe you need a little more juice in the engine department or your guns are falling short. Upgrade your ship to take control of the sector and make a name for yourself. Or if you prefer something a little fancier, trade in your ship for a better model. Just don’t forget your maintenance routines!

Protect You and Your Ship at all Costs

Try not to get yourself blown up, captured, or otherwise incapacitated. We’re counting on you to find the truth behind the bounty on your head and see if there’s a bigger destiny for you out there. Explore strange new worlds, meet weird new people, try dodgy food, and boldly fumble where no space captain has fumbled before, just don't get your exhaust ports blown off!

Since its humble beginnings as a PC game:
Since its humble beginnings as a PC game, the "Little Busters!" visual novel has continued to evolve. In the past decade, we have seen spin-off games and console adaptations, as well as the release of comic, novel, and anime adaptations.
It's easy to see why; the underlying theme of friendship in this romantic adventure game has had players hooked from the very start.
Now, get ready to laugh and cry your way through the "Little Busters!" story as the game comes to Nintendo Switch™!

Play in English or the original Japanese!
Both English and Japanese text is available in-game (audio is Japanese-only). This option is not only available in the main game, but in the settings menu, and digital manual too, with the option to switch between the two whenever you like.
Don't worry if you come across a cultural reference you don't understand; you can check out their explanations in the "Busterpedia!"

Play using only the touch screen! Play with one hand!
Play in handheld mode with the Nintendo Switch™ Joy-Con™ controllers attached, or detach them and play with just the touch controls!
While in tabletop mode or TV mode, everything can be controlled using one Joy-Con™ (R), allowing you to play with only one hand!
"Little Busters!" is also compatible with the Nintendo Switch™ Lite.


Summary
When he lost his parents as a child, protagonist Riki Naoe was plunged into despair.
However, someone was there to lend him a helping hand—Kyousuke Natsume, the leader of a group of youths who called themselves the "Little Busters."
Through many happy hours spent with the Little Busters, slowly but surely, Riki's pain and loneliness began to fade.

Now, we fast-forward a few years to the present—

While Riki and the other Little Busters have remained friends through the years, they now face brand new obstacles—job hunting, university applications, and thinking about their future!
Painfully aware that he only has a little more time left with his friends, Riki suggests they do all the things they won't be able to do in future.
One day, having seemingly taken this to heart, Kyousuke blurts out a sudden declaration.

"We're forming a baseball team. The team name will be... Little Busters!"


Gameplay
"Little Busters!" has multiple endings. The choices you make during the story will have an effect on which ending you get.
In addition, the gameplay includes plenty of minigames for you to enjoy! Try your skills at Batting Practice and Matches with the Little Busters members, or serve up food in the Cafeteria! Too tame for your tastes? Then try out the Underground Dungeon or the Shooting Game instead!
While winning/losing minigames does affect the following gameplay, it does not have much of an influence on the storyline. If minigames aren't your style, you can turn them on and off in the game's settings, allowing you to play through the story without them.

Time passes on Runersia in seasons, each one consisting of an Organization Phase and an Attack phase.
During the Organization Phase, knights and monsters with various classes and skills are organized into platoons in preparation for the upcoming battles.
During the Attack Phase, turn-based platoon battles take place on a map made up of hexagonal spaces. Make use of unit skills, elements, enclosure effects, terrain advantages, and other battle tactics to lead your side to victory!
All nations, knights, and monsters in the game will continue to battle and grow as you do.
The game is also packed with other ways to grow your armies such as class changes, equipment, and various items.
■Immersive gameplay with high replayability
Enemy nations aim to conquer the continent as well and will attack your bases to do so. The battle for the continent will differ with each playthrough.
Accumulate stories and events from the six nations in the Records. After clearing the main mode, The Legend of Runersia, the Alternate Chapter challenge mode will be unlocked, allowing for even more replayability.
■World settings
Runersia - a continent blessed with mana showers from times of old.
Five Mana Stones discovered long ago have been embedded into special armor called Brigandine, each one representing the ideology of the nation possessing it.
These have come to be known as the Brigandine of Justice, Sanctity, Freedom, Glory, and Ego.
The time now is Runersia 781, and a war looms on the horizon for five nations and a small tribe with incompatible ideologies.
Six rulers and their rune knights will throw themselves into the conflict, each with their own hopes and expectations.
Once the land has been unified under a single banner, memories from The Legend of Runersia will be reclaimed and the truth of what happened here on Runersia shall be revealed.

Counter-Strike, также известная как Half:
Counter-Strike, takzhe izvestnaya kak Half-Life: Counter-Strike — mnogopolzovatelskaya kompyuternaya igra v zhanre shutera ot pervogo litsa, razrabotannaya i vypushchennaya amerikanskoy kompaniey Valve. Pervonachalno Counter-Strike predstavlyala soboy polzovatelskuyu modifikatsiyu k igre Half-Life, razrabotannuyu entuziastami Minem Le i Dzhessom Kliffom v 1999 godu; v dalneyshem Valve nanyala oboikh razrabotchikov na rabotu i priobrela u nikh prava intellektualnoy sobstvennosti na igru, v 2000 godu vypustiv dorabotannuyu versiyu Counter-Strike uzhe kak samostoyatelnuyu igru.
Igrovoy protsess Counter-Strike prokhodit v formate razbitogo na neskolko raundov matcha mezhdu dvumya komandami igrokov, odna iz kotorykh igraet rol «terroristov», a drugaya — kontrterroristicheskogo spetsnaza; pered nachalom kazhdogo matcha igroki vybirayut «kartu», na kotoroy budet proiskhodit srazhenie. Komanda mozhet dobitsya pobedy v raunde, prosto perebiv vsekh protivnikov libo vypolniv opredelennye zadaniya, kotorye mogut otlichatsya dlya raznykh kart. V nachale kazhdogo raunda igroki mogut kupit oruzhie i vspomogatelnoe snaryazhenie za igrovuyu valyutu; po itogam kazhdogo raunda igroki poluchayut opredelennuyu summu virtualnykh deneg, kotorye mogut ispolzovat dlya priobreteniya bolee moshchnogo i effektivnogo oruzhiya v sleduyushchem raunde.

About Bears\n\nBear and Breakfast is a l:
About Bears

Bear and Breakfast is a laid-back management adventure game where you play as a well-meaning bear trying to run a B+B in the woods. Hank and his friends find an abandoned shack and, equipped with their teenage ingenuity, turn it into a money-making bed and breakfast scheme for unsuspecting tourists. As your business expands so do the mysteries of the forest, and Hank soon finds himself uncovering a plot deeper than the wilderness itself.

Build and Manage

- Build and personalize your inn with dozens of guest rooms, bathrooms, parlours, and entertainment. 
- Each room can be individually customized completely from furniture to fixtures.
- Bring guests into the forest to stay at your inn. Keep 'em happy to maintain your reputation, earn money and attract new customers!
- Complete quests and story lines to collect new items and perks for your inn.
- Uncover a world rich in lore, side quests, characters, and secrets.

Friends, Foes, Forage

Moving through the story-rich world of Bear and Breakfast will have you stumbling on dozens of interesting folks and weirdos, much like yourself.
Most of them have something to say about your endeavours and if you take some time out of your day to listen, they might help your build your shack to new heights!

Explore the Woods

Not everyone is as helpful or as needy though. Are you bear enough to search deep within the forest and your soul to find the mysteries that lie within?

KhOTYaT: Mertvye i zhivye! Dante, Melis i Elliot byli brosheny kak prestupniki, i vam reshat, chtoby oni razyasnili svoi imena. V mire, kotoryy zhivet kak mertvym, tak i zhivym, net pokoya dlya zhivykh, a ne dlya zhivykh. Pereklyuchites mezhdu etimi tremya unikalnymi personazhami, ovladeyte ikh khodami i atakami i provedite ikh po istorii.

Igrayte v odinochnyy ili kooperativ, chtoby reshat golovolomki! Ispolzuyte svoikh druzey, chtoby upravlyat vsemi tremya personazhami lokalno i poluchat maksimalnuyu otdachu ot nikh. Esli vy ne mozhete igrat s drugom ili khotite imet polnyy opyt odinochnogo igroka, eto tozhe normalno, tak kak vy mozhete pereklyuchatsya mezhdu kooperativami ili odinochnym igrokom v lyuboe vremya.

Komandnaya rabota vazhna v Grave Danger. U kazhdogo personazha est svoi lichnye navyki, chtoby obespechit mir bezopasnosti. Dante kovboy mozhet podnyatsya na vertikalnye steny. Malice the Grim Reaper mozhet parit gorizontalno nad propastyami i cherez uzkie i opasnye rayony. Elliot koldun plavaet i mozhet prygat v vozdukh!

Sonic the Hedgehog 3 (яп. ソニック・ザ・ヘッジホッグ３:
Sonic the Hedgehog 3 (yap. ソニック・ザ・ヘッジホッグ３ Sonikku dza Khedzikhoggu Suri:, rusc. «Yozh Sonik 3») — tretya videoigra v zhanre platformer iz serii Sonic the Hedgehog na igrovuyu pristavku Sega Mega Drive, razrabotannaya i vypushchennaya 2 fevralya 1994 goda kompaniey Sega Technical Institute — amerikanskim podrazdeleniem kompanii Sonic Team. Po syuzhetu igry glavnyy geroy yozh Sonik, vmeste so svoim drugom lisyonkom Teylzom, prodolzhayut borbu protiv zlodeya doktora Robotnika na misticheskom, paryashchem v oblakakh ostrove. V Sonic the Hedgehog 3 vpervye poyavlyaetsya personazh ekhidna Naklz, khranitel ostrova, nastroennyy doktorom Robotnikom protivostoyat glavnym geroyam.
Sonic & Knuckles (yap. ソニック＆ナックルズ Sonikku ando Nakkurudzu, russ. «Sonik i Naklz») — videoigra v zhanre platformer, yavlyayushchayasya chetvyortoy v serii igr Sonic the Hedgehog na igrovoy pristavke Sega Mega Drive/Genesis. Igra byla razrabotana komandoy Sonic Team i Sega Technical Institute (STI) — podrazdeleniyami kompanii Sega, vypustivshey eyo osenyu 1994 goda.

Vykhodi na okhotu v gordom odinochestve ili okazyvay ognevuyu podderzhku druzyam  v kooperativnom rezhime. Begay, prygay i pryachsya v propitannom neonom i raspisannom graffiti gorode, sozdannom pod vpechatleniem ot gorodskikh landshaftov 80-kh.

Otrisovannye vruchnuyu 16-bitnaya pikselnaya grafika i animatsiya, energichnyy geympley, 60 kadrov v sekundu i uboynyy sintezatornyy saundtrek.

Vyslezhivay i unichtozhay vragov: dikikh pankov, organizovannykh khokkeynykh khuliganov i drugikh 16-bitnykh zlodeev i kriminalnykh bossov! U kazhdogo iz nikh budet svoya territoriya i tselyy arsenal oruzhiya dlya konfiskatsii.

You play as Emyr realm’s - probably - most famous hero. That is, until his career was destroyed by a dreadful wound. And that right before he had a chance to kill his Archenemy; whom, as 100% credible prophecy has said: “No hero can defeat”. 
If that’s not enough, one day he wakes up only to find out that he spent all his money on a shabby tavern. Life as an innkeeper? That’s no role for a leading hero, right? That’s a commoner’s job! And to make things even worse, suddenly some teenager claims to be his daughter. Will Emyr be able to get his adventuring career back on track? Will he defeat his dreadful foe? And finally, can he answer the challenges of responsible parenthood? As they say, old habits die hard.

Features: 

- Play in a single and cooperative mode.

- 5 unique taverns, each in a different place, visited during Emyr’s travels; 

- 60 engaging levels with unique gameplay experience; 

- 120 in-game cutscenes (intro and outro for every level) with some depth mixed with tons of humorous references.

Kak i prezhde, vedushchim stsenaristom vystupaet Tadasi Satomi, sozdavshiy bogatyy mir Persona 2: Innocent Sin i Persona 2: Eternal Punishment, chto chuvstvuetsya i vo vselennoy The Caligula Effect: Overdose s eyo shkolnikami, prevrashcheniyami i sotsialnymi svyazyami. Neskolko «popadantsev» iz nashego mira okazyvayutsya v chudesnom virtualnom prostranstve, gde vechno svetit solntse, bezzabotnaya shkolnaya zhizn obeshchaet shirokie perspektivy i vse zhivut v sladkoy garmonii. No skoro glavnyy geroy ponimaet, chto okruzhayushchie ego studenty podverzheny promyvke mozgov, poka ikh nastoyashchie tela medlenno ugasayut v realnom mire, a vyrvatsya iz volshebnogo sna ne tak i prosto.

Mnogie iz mestnykh obitateley prosto ne mogut vyzhit v realnom mire, stradaya ot bolezney i urodstv, a pobeg gruppy edinomyshlennikov iz volshebnogo prostranstva mozhet sprovotsirovat neveroyatnuyu po masshtabam katastrofu.The Caligula Effect 2 sm. zdes.

Grand Theft Auto: Vice City (sokrashchyonno GTA: Vice City ili GTA:VC) — videoigra, razrabotannaya britanskoy studiey Rockstar North, chetvyortaya po schyotu i vtoraya tryokhmernaya igra v serii igr Grand Theft Auto. Sobytiya Grand Theft Auto: Vice City proiskhodyat v vymyshlennom amerikanskom gorode Vays-Siti, prototipom dlya kotorogo posluzhil Mayami, shtat Florida v 1986 godu — vizualnyy stil igry, osobenno odezhda, muzyka i transport, otrazhaet eto, inogda s elementami izyashchnoy parodii. Protagonistom igry vystupaet Tommi Versetti, stavshiy zhertvoy sgovora svoego kriminalnogo bossa Sonni Forelli.
Kontseptsiya igry i geympley v sochetanii s ispolzovaniem 3D-dvizhka igry sposobstvovali tomu, chto Grand Theft Auto: Vice City stala samoy prodavaemoy videoigroy 2002 goda i odnoy iz naibolee pribylnykh kompyuternykh igr v istorii.Grand Theft Auto III (GTA 3) na re3-nx sm. zdes. The story is set in an isolated village:
The story is set in an isolated village on the edge of the world.
The only gate leading outside is heavily guarded by a castle, and the villagers are not allowed to leave.
Most of the villagers don't give it a thought, and happily go on with their everyday lives.
However, the protagonist is a little different from the others - he wants to see the world outside.
One day, a "Monster" appears in the village, shocking everyone because until then, no one knew such creatures existed.
The protagonist is able to fight it using a mysterious Red stone he found in the coalmines.
In the course of his defense of the village, he gradually unravels secrets of how the stones and the monsters came to be…
　
Unlike most RPGs, there is no need to fight weak monsters repeatedly to level grind in "Little Town Hero".
Instead, you will need to have a good strategy to fight each boss monster one on one.
...Will the protagonist live the adventure he craves and escape the humdrum village life?
- A challenging battle system which relies heavily on coming up with new Ideas and strategies.
- Compact story progression designed with the busy gamer in mind.
- Soundtrack by Toby Fox, composer of the background music for UNDERTALE.

CAVYHOUSE, creators of Forget Me Not: My:
CAVYHOUSE, creators of Forget Me Not: My Organic Garden and The Midnight Sanctuary, presents their latest “Clicker-style Dungeon Agriculturalization Rogue-like Game”!

Level-up not only your character, but your dungeon itself to score huge bumper crops of items and Magic Circles galore!

By continuously exploring deeper and deeper into the dungeon, you can remake (agriculturalize) your dungeon, increasing your strategic efficiency and gradually transforming it into a bountiful and profitable farm in this extremely unique and original Rogue-like game combining elements of dungeon exploration and clicker-style gameplay.

▼ Story
There once was a novice alchemist named Irene.
Having recently lost her beloved mother, she decided to start her own business as a way to help take her mind off of her grief and become more independent.
One day, she found a cheap secondhand dungeon for sale in an online alchemist shop called "Mercuri", and bought it immediately.
However, if a deal seems too good to be true, well...
The dungeon turned out to be full of strange enemies, which Irene must defeat before gathering items for her alchemy practices.
Upon finally reaching the deeper depths of the dungeon, exhausted, she encounters a doll-like set of twins and the mysterious dead body of an unknown man.
This is where Irene's dodgy dungeon murder mystery begins...

▼ Game System
The basic game system is pretty simple: Explore the dungeon > Harvest items > Go back home and handle various “preparations” > Explore the dungeon some more.

During the preparation phase, you can develop and expand your dungeon or acquire new skills for Irene. Learning new skills will allow you to dive deeper into the dungeon and fight against tougher enemies and bosses.

▼ Dungeon Agriculturalization
There are two distinct “levels” for each dungeon floor: Farm level and Magic level.

Increasing Farm level will increase the number of items made available; Increasing Magic level will increase the number of useful magic circles.

Ultimately, if you manage to maximize both levels for a particular floor, you can then agriculturalize it. Once agriculturalized, the floor becomes a veritable paradise, providing large amounts of items and free of any enemies.

▼ Various Skills
There are over 100 types of skills, such as Attack, Heal, Enchant, Item Management, etc. Each player can develop their own unique play style based on how they manage and combine their various skills.

Prepare yourself well, go out and explore the dungeon, and level up both your character and your dungeon...

It’s an all-new type of Rogue-like exploration and adventure!

Duke Nukem 3D — kompyuternaya igra v zhanre shutera ot pervogo litsa, sozdannaya kompaniey 3D Realms v 1996 godu. Tretya chast serii Duke Nukem vypolnena v populyarnom na to vremya stile Doom (psevdotrekhmernye koridory, vid ot pervogo litsa, srazheniya s primeneniem razlichnogo vida kholodnogo, ognestrelnogo, a takzhe vymyshlennogo oruzhiya). Fakticheski, Duke Nukem 3D byl otvetom kompanii Apogee na seriyu igr Doom, a takzhe na Heretic i Hexen ot kompanii Raven Software.
«Novaya», tryokhmernaya chast Duke Nukem ne stala ocherednym klonom Doom, ona sumela sostavit konkurentsiyu vyshedshemu v to zhe vremya bolee tekhnicheski sovershennomu Quake. Bolee togo, ona prinesla v igrovuyu industriyu stolko novovvedeniy i neozhidannykh resheniy, chto po pravu mozhet osporit zvanie praroditelya mnogikh sovremennykh shuterov, vklyuchaya legendarnuyu seriyu igr Half-Life.

Otlichitelnoy osobennostyu epizoda stal dizayn urovney i atmosfera — parki razvlecheniy, bolshoe kolichestvo dekorativnykh robotov, kotorye vneshne vyglyadyat kak lyudi.Ofitsialnaya igra Duke Nukem 3D: 20th Anniversary World Tour tut.

Na dvore 50-y god do n.e. Vsya Galliya okkupirovana rimlyanami... Vsya? Net! Odna derevushka, naselennaya nepokornymi gallami, do sikh por soprotivlyaetsya zakhvatchiku. I garnizonam rimskikh legionerov v ukreplennykh lageryakh Babaorum, Aquarium, Laudanum i Petitbonum zhivetsya ochen nesladko.

Mir tsaril v malenkoy armorikanskoy derevushke, gde zhiteli predavalis svoim obychnym zanyatiyam. Nashi geroi, Asterix i Obelix, okhotyatsya na kabana, kuznets i torgovets ryboy ssoryatsya, a vozhdya nosyat na shchite po derevenskoy ploshchadi.

Posle slavnogo denka, provedennogo na okhote, Asterix i Obelix vozvrashchayutsya v derevnyu — i vidyat, kak dogorayut razgrablennye rimlyanami doma! Oni otpravlyayutsya spasat odnoselchan, i s nimi otpravlyaetsya ikh vernyy pesik Dogmatix. Puteshestvie privedet ikh v Normandiyu, Gretsiyu, Gelvetsiyu, Egipet i, nakonets, Rim, gde oni dolzhny spasti zhiteley derevni iz lap imperatora Tsezarya...

Otkroyte dlya sebya zanovo pervoe XXL-priklyuchenie vashikh lyubimykh gallov v etoy polnostyu rimasteringovoy versii!

Pereklyuchaytes mezhdu Asterix i Obelix, issleduya razlichnye regiony mira, takie kak Gretsiya i Egipet, chtoby osvobodit Impedimenta, Panacea, Getafix i vsyu gallskuyu derevnyu.

Srazhaytes s rimlyanami, piratami i vikingami, kotorye osmelyatsya vstat u vas na puti! Glotnite volshebnogo zelya, i nichto ne smozhet ostanovit vas.

Сюжет\nВ мире, где над землей возвышаютс:
Syuzhet
V mire, gde nad zemley vozvyshayutsya kosti drevnego chudovishcha...

Rytsar Zefi sostoyal v ordene, kotoryy zanimaetsya okhotoy na vedm - proklyatoe i otverzhennoe plemya, dayushchee zhizn drakonam.

Odnazhdy on silno postradal v skhvatke s drakonom, no v samyy posledniy mig ego spasli dve vedmy, napoiv drakoney krovyu. Eta sverkhestestvennaya substantsiya ne tolko sokhranila emu zhizn, no i nadelila ego charodeyskimi sposobnostyami. 

Ikh sudby pereplelis. Zefi perestupil cherez sebya i prisoedinilsya k vedmam. Teper emu protivostoyat groznye vragi: Imperiya, kotoraya stremitsya unichtozhit vsekh emu podobnykh, bezzhalostnye okhotniki na drakonov i samaya mogushchestvennaya vedma v istorii.

Sumeyut li ego novye soyuzniki ostatsya v zhivykh, ili im suzhdeno stat zhertvami drakonego proklyatiya?..

Klyuchevye osobennosti
3 epizoda opasnostey i priklyucheniy - uchastvuyte v pokhodovoy rolevoy igre, strazhayas s gigantskimi drakonami i drugimi vragami na trekh vertikalno orientirovannykh kartakh. Vystraivayte svoikh personazhey v raznye boevye poryadki, kotorye mogut usilivat fizicheskie ili magicheskie ataki, a takzhe davat dopolnitelnuyu zashchitu. 

Tolko v versii dlya Nintendo Switch™: dopolnitelnoe oruzhie, dospekhi i urovni personazhey, kotorye na drugikh platformakh priobretalis za dengi, teper dostupny BESPLATNO!

Probudite svoego drakona - zapolnyayte shkalu drakona vo vremya boya, chtoby ispolzovat sverkhestestvennuyu silu, ukreplyayushchuyu vashu bronyu i pozvolyayushchuyu primenyat osobye sposobnosti! Transformatsiya pri malom zapase zdorovya otkryvaet dostup k bolee silnym atakam, no oslablyaet zashchitu.

Pora obedat - pozhiraya oslablennykh drakonov, vy mozhete prisvaivat sebe ikh sposobnosti. V etom mire dostatochno vragov, chtoby nadelit kazhdogo personazha unikalnym naborom navykov!

Bezumie ili bogatstvo? - tri vedmy zhdut, chtoby vy kormili iz drakoney krovyu. Ot goloda oni mogut soyti s uma. Esli zhe ikh perekormit, oni sami prevratyatsya v drakonov! Vy gotovy podderzhivat ikh zhizn? Ili, mozhet byt, vy pozhertvuete imi radi tsennykh artefaktov? Ot vashego vybora zavisit razvitie syuzheta!

Hidden in Plain Sight is a set of local:
Hidden in Plain Sight is a set of local multiplayer (2-4 players) game modes that share a common theme: trying to accomplish goals without drawing attention to yourself.

In each game mode, players control characters in a sea of identical NPCs. Players are given a task, but also the means to eliminate each other from the game. The goal is to blend in with the NPCs, accomplish the task at hand, and take out other players before they get you.

One of the simplest game modes is called "Death Race." Players and NPCs are racing to be the first to cross a finish line. Each player has a gun with one bullet, and can eliminate one person from the race. Do you sprint ahead, calling attention to yourself but maximizing you chances of winning? Or do you hang back with the pack?

Other game modes create similar tension by putting players in a conflicted position of wanting to accomplish a goal, but risking elimination by doing so.

Rounds are quick and lively, and always end in laughter and friendly shouting. So grab your controllers and friends and give it a shot!

Undead & Beyond is a game where you rean:
Undead & Beyond is a game where you reanimate the death and cause chaos!

 Use the products of your research to create an army of the undead and cause havoc in the complex while you aim to accomplish your objectives to reach the next area. Use a wide range of methods to advance further, from creating undead that will attack the facility staff, to using gadgets or simply using stealth to pass through the guards without being noticed. But careful, the facility guards could call for reinforcements.

- Revive your enemies as fierce undead!
- Use items to support your undead forces or carefully killing key targets.
- Increase the hazard level to spawn deadlier mutants!
- Watch the undead rip apart the opposition with brutal death animations
- The NPCs are AI driven, every time you play is a different experience.
- Use stealth, carefully plan your moves to overwhelm your enemies with the hordes!

Создатели CONARIUM и серии DARKNESS WITH:
Sozdateli CONARIUM i serii DARKNESS WITHIN predstavlyayut TRANSIENT ― triller, obedinyayushchiy istoriyu v dukhe G. F. Lavkrafta i zhanr kiberpank.

V dalekom postapokalipticheskom budushchem ostatki chelovecheskoy tsivilizatsii zhivut v zakrytoy tsitadeli ― gorode pod kupolom, sozdannom dlya zashchity ot vneshnikh ugroz. Vy okazyvaetes v mire mrachnoy antiutopii. Nechto strannoe tvoritsya vokrug. Reshayte golovolomki, vzlamyvayte sistemy i issleduyte inye izmereniya. Dokopaytes do istiny, kotoraya riskuet poshatnut vash rassudok.
Pogruzites v neizvedannye grani TRANSIENT (Extended Edition). Vyydite za predely izvestnogo: vas zhdet mnozhestvo uluchsheniy, dopolnitelnyy igrovoy protsess i sovershenno novyy final. 

«Vse techet, vse menyaetsya». ― Geraklit

Ot zabytykh pustoshey Kor Shera do neprivetlivykh ulits Provideniya: Transient polon nezabyvaemykh mest, ozhidayushchikh, kogda vy na nikh stupite. Issleduyte privychnyy mir, sobstvennye sny i virtualnuyu realnost. Vas zhdut vstrechi s druzyami, nedobrozhelatelyami i sushchestvami mezhdu mirami.

Милый симулятор энтомолога!.. В этом уют:

Bolee 175 samykh nastoyashchikh, realnykh nasekomykh! Razrabatyvaemyy nebolshoy komandoy razrabotchikov iz dvukh chelovek, Bug & Seek - eto rasslablyayushchiy, beskonechnyy simulyator po lovle nasekomykh i kollektsionirovaniyu sushchestv s elementami tayny. V Bug & Seek vy tolko chto vlozhili svoi sberezheniya v pokupku zabroshennogo Insektariya (muzey nasekomykh)! Kogda-to eto bylo zhiznennoy siloy goroda i ego ekonomiki, no kto-to ukral vse nasekomye v glubokoy nochi. Teper na vas lezhit zadacha lovit i prodavat nasekomykh, vypolnyat zakazy iz mestnykh magazinov i vosstanovit Insektariy kak simvol goroda. Stante masterom po lovle nasekomykh povyshayte svoi navyki lovli nasekomykh, uluchshayte oborudovanie i rasshiryayte svoy Insektariy. Znakomtes s mestnymi zhitelyami, vypolnyayte zadaniya dlya polucheniya spetsialnykh predmetov i raskroyte taynu Velikogo ogrableniya nasekomykh. I rasslabtes! Zdes net nevernykh vyborov, ne nuzhno bespokoitsya ob urovnyakh energii, i u vas mnogo vremeni dlya vypolneniya zadaniy i raboty.

POSTAL Redux - это HD ремейк печально из:

Glavnyy geroy pobezhdaet v loteree rabochikh mest i poluchaet rabotu sotrudnika pogranichnogo kontrolya migratsionnoy sluzhby. Chem bolshe lyudey vy obsluzhite, tem bolshe zarabotaete kreditov — vnutriigrovoy valyuty. V kontse kazhdogo dnya vy vybiraete, na chto potratit zarabotannye kredity, no nelzya zabyvat o tom, chto vy takzhe dolzhny kormit i soderzhat svoyu semyu.

SiN — polnostyu tryokhmernyy boevik ot pervogo litsa, sozdannyy na baze modifitsirovannogo dvizhka QII devyatogo noyabrya 1998 goda. Soglasno syuzhetu, desyat let nazad, v 2027 godu, gorod Friport byl na grani krakha. Maloeffektivnye i nedoukomplektovannye sily politsii proigryvali v dolgoy i trudnoy borbe s prestupnostyu.
Gorod nuzhdalsya v pomoshchi, no pravitelstvo ne moglo spravitsya s podderzhaniem poryadka na ulitsakh. Poetomu byl predlozhen zakonoproekt, dayushchiy pravo chastnym korporatsiyam sformirovat sobstvennuyu politsiyu — sily bezopasnosti, kotorye, v svoyu ochered, dolzhny predostavit zashchitu kompaniyam i grazhdanam goroda. Dannyy zakon byl prinyat, chto pomoglo v ustanovlenii poryadka i podderzhanii zakonnosti.
Razroznennye otdely politsii reorganizovalis v edinuyu i moshchnuyu strukturu, nazvannuyu «HardCorps», stavshuyu osnovnoy v rassledovanii i preduprezhdenii prestupleniy. Khaos otstupil, poskolku sily bezopasnosti postepenno vosstanavlivayut zakon i poryadok v gorode. Odnoy iz takikh kompaniy, imeyushchey sobstvennye vooruzhyonnye sily, yavlyaetsya SinTEK — bolshaya transnatsionalnaya biotekhnologicheskaya korporatsiya, prinadlezhashchaya krasivoy i kharizmatichnoy Eleksis Sinkler, osnovannaya v 2005 godu doktorom Trellom Sinklerom, ottsom Eleksis. Posle tainstvennogo ischeznoveniya eyo ottsa Eleksis vozglavila korporatsiyu.
V 2037 godu, spustya desyat let, polkovnik Dzhon R. Bleyd, glava HardCorps i po sovmestitelstvu glavnyy geroy igry, to est vy pytaetes razyskat istochnik preparata U4, poyavivshegosya na ulitsakh goroda ne tak davno..
