Densha de Go! («Let’s Go by Train!») — с:
Densha de Go! («Let’s Go by Train!») — seriya yaponskikh igr v zhanre simulyatora poezda, razrabotannaya kompaniey Taito. Istoriya serii nachalas s versii dlya igrovykh avtomatov v 1996 godu, a pervyy vypusk dlya domashnikh igrovykh sistem sostoyalsya na platforme PlayStation v 1997 godu. Yaponskiy izdatel Unbalance takzhe vypuskal versii dlya personalnykh kompyuterov. Vse igry serii vypuskayutsya isklyuchitelno na yaponskom yazyke.
Kontseptsiya videoigry o poezdakh voznikla v kompanii Taito primerno v 1991—1992 godakh, odnako pervonachalno proekt byl otlozhen, poskolku rukovodstvo schitalo tematiku poezdov skuchnoy i neinteresnoy. Programmist Akira Sayto razrabotal ideyu na osnove nablyudeniy za populyarnym trenazherom linii Yamanote v Muzee transporta v tokiyskom rayone Akikhabara, kotoryy neizmenno privlekal posetiteley vsekh vozrastov. Kogda Sayto ofitsialno predlozhil kontseptsiyu okolo 1996 goda, v Taito mneniya razdelilis mezhdu storonnikami proekta i skeptikami, kotorye somnevalis v privlekatelnosti simulyatora poezdov na rynke arkadnykh igr, gde dominirovali faytingi i gonki. Podderzhka so storony sotrudnikov Taito, uvlekayushchikhsya poezdami, pomogla poluchit odobrenie proekta. Ofitsialnaya razrabotka nachalas v iyule 1996 goda v szhatye sroki — tri-chetyre mesyatsa. Nebolshaya komanda sostoyala iz Akiry Sayto v kachestve vedushchego programmista i planirovshchika, programmistov Masayuki Kikuti i Masai Kinosity, Yukikhiro Moriyamy, otvechavshego za grafiku, i Tetsuyu Yamaro, sozdavavshego vstupitelnuyu demonstratsiyu. Komanda s samogo nachala reshila ispolzovat realnye yaponskie zheleznodorozhnye linii i stantsii vmesto vymyshlennykh lokatsiy, i vlozhila znachitelnye sredstva v sozdanie autentichnoy paneli upravleniya, nesmotrya na obespokoennost rukovodstva otnositelno raskhodov. Sayto utverzhdal, chto panel upravleniya predstavlyaet soboy «80% igry», i nastaival na funktsionalnykh elementakh, takikh kak rabochie manometry i autentichnye rychagovye mekhanizmy. V protsesse razrabotki neskolko funktsiy byli isklyucheny, vklyuchaya «rezhim bezrassudnogo vozhdeniya», kotoryy pozvolil by igrokam propuskat stantsii, a fantasticheskie elementy byli otbrosheny v polzu realizma. Igra byla vypushchena v yaponskikh arkadakh v 1997 godu i poluchila polozhitelnyy otklik.
Kazhdaya igra serii Densha de Go! soderzhit realnye zheleznodorozhnye marshruty, osnovannye na deystvuyushchikh transportnykh liniyakh Yaponii. Osnovnaya zadacha igroka zaklyuchaetsya v upravlenii poezdom s soblyudeniem strogogo raspisaniya, vklyuchaya ostanovku na stantsiyakh s tochnostyu do 30 sm ot zadannoy tochki ostanovki i pribytie v predelakh polusekundy ot zaplanirovannogo vremeni. Khotya konkretnye trebovaniya neznachitelno razlichayutsya mezhdu versiyami, ot igroka ozhidaetsya soblyudenie skorostnykh ogranicheniy i drugikh signalnykh znakov, podacha zvukovogo signala pri proezde mimo putevykh rabochikh, svoevremennoe prokhozhdenie promezhutochnykh kontrolnykh tochek mezhdu stantsiyami i vypolnenie drugikh podobnykh zadach.
Путешествуйте с командой девушек-полузом:

S pomoshchyu chlena Soprotivleniya Barni Kalkhuna Gordon otpravlyaetsya v laboratoriyu doktora Ayzeka Klyaynera, no po puti ego zaderzhivayut i izbivayut soldaty Alyansa..
«Half-Life 2», s angl. period poluraspada — videoigra v zhanre nauchno-fantasticheskogo shutera ot pervogo litsa, vtoraya igra serii, razrabotannaya kompaniey Valve, izdavaemaya imi zhe i Sierra Entertainment. Igra byla vypushchena v 2004 godu, poluchila vseobshchee priznanie i sobrala mnozhestvo nagrad i bolee 45 titulov «Igra goda 2004». V 2012 godu Half-Life 2 byla nagrazhdena na Spike VGA 10 (Spike Video Game Awards) kak luchshaya igra desyatiletiya.
Half-Life 2 poluchila vseobshchee priznanie. Igra stala odnoy iz samykh uspeshnykh i poluchila 96 % iz 100 vozmozhnykh na GameRankings i Metacritic. Po dannym na 2008 god igra byla prodana v kolichestve bolee 6.5 millionov, ne uchityvaya prodazhi cherez servis Steam. Letom 2018 goda, blagodarya uyazvimosti v zashchite Steam Web API, stalo izvestno, chto tochnoe kolichestvo polzovateley servisa Steam, kotorye igrali v igru khotya by odin raz, sostavlyaet 8 877 286 chelovek. V retsenzii IGN bylo otmecheno, chto «Half-Life 2 otvoevala u DOOM 3 mesto samoy krasivoy igry na PK» i chto igra geympleyno yavlyaetsya «prakticheski bezuprechnoy realizatsiey shutera ot pervogo litsa». V retsenzii The New York Times byla polozhitelno vosprinyata atmosfera antiutopii, realizatsiya mimiki personazhey, detalizirovannye i «pochti fotorealistichnye» vizualnye effekty. Retsenzentom bylo otmecheno, chto Half-life 2 imeet «samyy raznoobraznyy geympley sredi vsekh shuterov so vremen pervoy Half-Life». Podvodya itogi, retsenzent govorit, chto ni v odnoy igre ne bylo realizovano na kachestvennom urovne stolko raznykh elementov, kak v Half-Life 2.

STORY
//TOKYO, IN THE NEAR FUTURE: Whispers and rumors are spreading through the city like wildfire. Murmurings of a bizarre website have started to pique the interest of more than a few people—people willing to take extreme risks in order to fulfill their darkest desires.

Corpse Girl's Website supposedly allows users to request the death of someone they know. All that is required is a photo of the proposed victim. Once an image is uploaded, the website promises to snuff out the victim's soul within a matter of days.

Victims of the website apparently receive a photograph of their own corpse before they are killed. Photos are time stamped with a date... Perhaps a predicted time of death? The website's authenticity is questionable at best. It has become an interesting topic of conversation and nothing more.

And yet... When people start dying in odd ways across the city, the website instantly returns to the limelight. All of the recent victims were found in possession of strange photos—photos of their own corpses, received only hours before they died...

Sonic the Hedgehog (яп. ソニック・ザ・ヘッジホッグ Со:
Sonic the Hedgehog (yap. ソニック・ザ・ヘッジホッグ Sonikku dza Khedzikhoggu, rusc. «Yozh Sonik») — videoigra v zhanre platformer, v kotoroy vpervye poyavilsya personazh yozh Sonik, i s kotoroy nachalas karera eyo razrabotchika Sonic Team, odnogo iz podrazdeleniy korporatsii Sega. Igra byla vypushchena letom 1991 goda dlya konsoli Sega Mega Drive/Genesis i pozzhe byla portirovana na razlichnye igrovye platformy neskolkikh pokoleniy i vkhodila v desyatki sbornikov. Po syuzhetu yozh Sonik khochet pomeshat zlodeyu doktoru Robotniku zapoluchit dragotsennye kamni Izumrudy Khaosa i osvobodit svoikh druzey ot robotov-vragov.
Sonic the Hedgehog 2 (yap. ソニック・ザ・ヘッジホッグ２ Sonikku dza Khedzikhoggu: Tsu, rucs. «Yozh Sonik 2») — videoigra v zhanre platformer iz serii Sonic the Hedgehog, razrabotannaya studiey Sonic Team v soavtorstve s eyo podrazdeleniem Sega Technical Institute. Igra byla vypushchena kompaniey Sega dlya igrovoy pristavki Sega Mega Drive/Genesis v kontse noyabrya 1992 goda. Igra yavlyaetsya sikvelom Sonic the Hedgehog. Half-Life («период полураспада») — компь:
Half-Life («period poluraspada») — kompyuternaya igra v zhanre nauchno-fantasticheskogo shutera ot pervogo litsa, razrabotannaya kompaniey Valve Software i izdannaya Sierra Studios 19 noyabrya 1998 goda, pervaya v svoey serii.
Half-Life stala odnoy iz pervykh igr, v kotorykh syuzhet razvivaetsya polnostyu vnutri igrovogo prostranstva bez ispolzovaniya videozastavok. Igrovye izdaniya vysoko otsenili novatorskiy stil povestvovaniya, yavlyayushchiysya glavnym dostoinstvom igry. Drugoy silnoy storonoy Half-Life nazyvayut iskusstvennyy intellekt protivnikov, osobenno na tot moment vremeni. Mnogie kritiki otmechayut, chto ona proizvela revolyutsiyu v zhanre shutera ot pervogo litsa i polozhila nachalo novomu etapu razvitiya videoigr.
Spisok vklyuchyonnykh modov (11 sht.):
Сколько шагов нужно, чтобы заменить ламп:
Skolko shagov nuzhno, chtoby zamenit lampochku? Esli vash otvet 10 ili bolee, to vy gotovy k «Contraptions» - igre, tsel kotoroy sostoit v tom, chtoby ispravit prichudlivye khitrosti, kotorye vypolnyayut prostye zadachi nepryamymi i zaputannymi sposobami, v stile Rube Goldberg.

Ispolzuyte verblyudov v kachestve batutov, butylok shampanskogo v kachestve pushek, vozdushnykh sharov dlya podema predmetov, koles feyerverkov dlya privoda konveyernykh lent, magnitov dlya privlecheniya metallicheskikh predmetov i mnogikh drugikh gadzhetov dlya resheniya golovolomok i prokhozhdeniya urovney.

Kharakteristiki
+ Reshite bolee 100 duratskikh golovolomok v 5 raznykh mirakh.
+ Sozdayte neogranichennoe kolichestvo vashikh sobstvennykh urovney i broste vyzov drugu, chtoby popytatsya pobedit ego.
+ Ispolzuyte mnozhestvo tupykh gadzhetov ot nozhnits do kolyshkov linii stirki.
+ Proydite urovni neskolkimi sposobami ... stante pomeshannymi i kreativnymi, kak vam nravitsya.

Igrovoy protsess
Na kazhdom urovne est mnozhestvo obektov i monstrov ... Tsel sostoit v tom, chtoby izbavitsya ot urovnya monstrov.

Eto mozhet byt dostignuto razlichnymi sposobami ... Na obekty vliyayut zakony fiziki, i oni igrayut klyuchevuyu rol v reshenii golovolomki. Obekty obrazuyut «Contraptions», raspolozhennuyu takim obrazom, chto sozdaet tsepnuyu reaktsiyu, kotoraya unichtozhit vsekh monstrov. Zagvozdka v tom, chto khitroe ustroystvo slomano - nekotorye predmety nakhodyatsya ne v nuzhnom meste. Vasha tsel sostoit v tom, chtoby ispravit ustroystvo. Vy delaete eto, peremeshchaya, perevorachivaya ili soedinyaya razlichnye obekty.

Kogda uroven nachinaetsya «vremya zamorozheno», gravitatsiya ne vliyaet na obekty, i vse mashiny ili gadzhety ne rabotayut. V techenie etogo vremeni vy mozhete peremeshchat veshchi, soedinyat veshchi, perevorachivat veshchi, chtoby zastavit tsepnuyu reaktsiyu rabotat. Kogda vy zakonchite, vy privodite veshchi v dvizhenie (vremya razmorazhivaniya), nazhimaya knopku «Vosproizvedenie», i smotrite, kak vse proiskhodit.

Esli vy vse sdelali pravilno, tsepnaya reaktsiya unichtozhit vsekh monstrov, i vy pereydete na sleduyushchiy uroven. Esli vashe reshenie ne pravilnoe, vy mozhete priostanovit khitrost i snova vozitsya s obektami.
Explore space, conquer asteroid fields t:
Explore space, conquer asteroid fields to mine and extract resources. Build a fleet of spaceships and destroy the enemies in this new space action strategy adventure. Defend Humanity against an alien invader who aims to freeze Earth. 

The Story Mode is divided into campaigns with several missions each. Completing a campaign will unlock others so you can play in a non-linear way. You decide the path to victory.

The Skirmish Mode allows you to configure the match: map size, goal, initial fleet and upgrades, etc. The world will then be procedurally generated, offering a unique experience everytime!

Extinction Eclipse is a space action strategy game, where you are in command of the human forces in their effort to find the necessary resources to build a fleet. You start with only a couple of miner ships and a probe, and your mission is to find and conquer asteroid fields that can be mined, in order to extract their precious metals and water.

You will build your fleet gradually, and before each mission, you can choose which ships to use. After you build your ships, any of them that manage to survive during the mission will become part of the available fleet.

You will also accumulate unused metal and water to trade for upgrades and power ups in the store. These upgrades will make your ships faster and stronger, increasing your chances of succeeding.

But be careful, the aliens will not sit back and relax while you expand. They will attack your bases by surprise, so be prepared to defend them constantly!

Коллектив inkle раз за разом доказывает,:
Kollektiv inkle raz za razom dokazyvaet, chto IF — eto ne tolko novelly, i zhanr yavlyaetsya bolshim polem dlya eksperimentov. Vo vsekh relizakh etoy studii upor sdelan na povestvovanii, kotoroe my lepim sobstvennoruchno — reshaya arkheologicheskie zagadki v «Heaven’s Vault», filosofski lazaya po goram v «A Highland Song», reshaya zagadki Stiva Dzheksona v «Sorcery», ili puteshestvuya po miru v nesravnennoy «80 Days». Pri etom igry nepokhozhi drug na druga, i «Overboard!» okazalas poistine unikalnym priklyucheniem, idei kotorogo spustya chetyre goda poluchili razvitie v nashey «Expelled!». Khotya so storony proekty kazhutsya skhozhimi, istorii v nikh sovershenno raznye.
V «Expelled!», prestuplenie tozhe soversheno v samom nachale — Luiza vypala iz okna, — no pochemu eto proizoshlo i kto vinovat — zagadka. A glavnoy podozrevaemoy schitaetsya Veriti, kotoruyu za sluchivsheesya vygonyayut iz prestizhnoy shkoly dlya devochek.
Geroinya pereskazyvaet situatsiyu ottsu, s kotorym oni sidyat v sosednem pabe, i ponachalu vsyo deystvitelno ukazyvaet na to, chto vinovata Veriti. Kogda proizoshyol neschastnyy sluchay, ona nakhodilas v toy zhe komnate, a ryadom s razbitym oknom lezhala eyo khokkeynaya klyushka — v etoy shkole devushki aktivno zanimayutsya sportom, i Luiza yavlyaetsya samoy yarkoy zvezdoy khokkeynoy komandy. Baryshnya ne pogibla, no rukovodstvo shkoly, kazhetsya, bolshe zabotit ne sudba uchenitsy, a tot fakt, chto bylo razbito starinnoe vitrazhnoe okno, kotoroe schitaetsya chut li ne svyashchennym. I my znaem, chto my nichego ne delali. Vot tolko svideteley net, da i motiv ne sovsem ponyaten..
Nam nuzhno dokazat svoyu nevinovnost! Tut budet vsyo: intriguyushchaya istoriya s elementami detektiva; ochen vysokaya reigrabelnost; shkala buntarstva, kotoraya delaet povtornye prokhozhdeniya interesnee, otkryvaya novye varianty vo vremya issledovaniya i dialogov; kharizmatichnye personazhi; simpatichnyy vizualnyy stil; priyatnaya dzhazovaya i klassicheskaya muzyka.Ot sozdateley 80 Days, Overboard!, Heaven's Vault, Sorcery!, A Highland Song

В раздаче находится официальный эмулятор:
V razdache nakhoditsya ofitsialnyy emulyator Virtual Boy Nintendo Classics, rasprostranyaemyy Nintendo cherez platnuyu podpisku NSO Nintendo Switch Online.
Virtual Boy (yap. バーチャルボーイ Ba:tyaru Bo:y) — 32-bitnaya nastolnaya portativnaya igrovaya sistema, razrabotannaya i proizvedyonnaya kompaniey Nintendo. Vypushchennaya v 1995 godu, ona reklamirovalas kak pervaya igrovaya konsol, sposobnaya otobrazhat stereoskopicheskuyu tryokhmernuyu grafiku. Igrok ispolzuet eyo kak navesnoy displey, prikladyvaya golovu k okulyaru, chtoby uvidet krasnyy monokhromnyy ekran, ispolzuetsya effekt parallaksa dlya sozdaniya illyuzii glubiny. Prodazhi ne dostigli zaplanirovannykh kompaniey pokazateley, sostaviv ~770 tysyach shtuk, i Nintendo prekratila rasprostranenie i razrabotku igr v 1996 godu, vypustiv vsego 22 igry.
Razrabotka Virtual Boy dlilas chetyre goda i nachalas pod proektnym nazvaniem VR32. Nintendo zaklyuchila litsenzionnoe soglashenie s amerikanskoy Reflection Technology na ispolzovanie tekhnologii stereoskopicheskikh svetodiodnykh okulyarov Scanned Linear Array, kotoraya razrabatyvalas s 80-kh godov. Korporatsiya postroila zavod v Kitae, kotoryy dolzhen byl ispolzovatsya isklyuchitelno dlya proizvodstva Virtual Boy. V khode razrabotki kharakteristiki konsoli mnogokratno uproshchalis iz-za vysokoy stoimosti i potentsialnykh problem so zdorovem igrokov, ukachivaniya i morskoy bolezni. Vedushchiy igrovoy dizayner Sigeru Miyamoto prakticheski ne uchastvoval v razrabotke PO dlya Virtual Boy.
Spisok vklyuchyonnykh proektov:
В далёком 4122 году на Земле снова правя:
V dalyokom 4122 godu na Zemle snova pravyat dinozavrovy — nanozavry. Ikh tsivilizatsiya voznikla blagodarya gruppe lyudey-uchyonykh, eksperimentirovavshikh s gennoy inzheneriey. V rezultate eksperimentov im udalos vozrodit vymershiy vid gruppa arkhozavrov iz klady avemetatarzaliy. Odnako, ikh pobeda okazalas nedolgoy, poskolku katastroficheskaya epidemiya polozhila konets samoy chelovecheskoy tsivilizatsii.
Nemnogie vozrozhdyonnye dinozavry poluchili ot lyudey neobychaynyy intellekt, pozvoliv im rasshiryat svoyu rastushchuyu kladu. Odnako, poskolku nanozavry byli edinstvennym vidom na Zemle, inbriding stal edinstvenno vozmozhnym sposobom razmnozheniya. Etot metod znachitelno povliyal na intellekt potomkov i postepenno nachal predstavlyat ugrozu dlya ikh nekogda razumnogo obshchestva.
Verkhovnoe pravitelstvo nanozavrov predlagaet Vam zadanie, vklyuchayushchee puteshestvie vo vremeni v 65 millionov let do nashey ery, gde neobkhodimo nayti pyat yaits drevnego vida dinozavrov i pomestit ikh vo vremennoy portal, vedushchiy v nastoyashchee vremya. Dlya uchastiya v etoy missii vybran vysokopostavlennyy agent, buryy nanozavr deynonikh. V den missii on teleportiruetsya v proshloe s pomoshchyu mashiny vremeni v laboratorii nanozavrov…
Igra postavlyalas vmeste s i byla predustanovlena na kompyuterakh iMac G3 s MacOS 8.1.
Cuccchi is the first artist archive crea:
Cuccchi is the first artist archive created in the form of a video game.
It’s the official playable archive of Enzo Cucchi's works of art.

Cuccchi is a game where you explore beautiful dioramas and go through dangerous and trippy labyrinths, in a journey inside the paintings of Enzo Cucchi.

Since the late ’70s, Enzo Cucchi has worked with many kinds of techniques and materials, creating a wide and diverse imaginary that has now been transformed into an impossible videogame chimera.

Find your way through 10 unique areas and collect 78 hidden objects to unlock an archive gallery displaying the different artworks that inspired the visuals for the game.
Children of Zodiarcs — сюжетно-тактическ:
Children of Zodiarcs — syuzhetno-takticheskaya rolevaya igra, deystvie kotoroy razvorachivaetsya v skazochnom korolevstve Lyumus — mire, razobshchyonnom bogatstvom i bednostyu. Nami i eyo shayka otverzhennykh avantyuristov zhdut vashikh komand. Ispolzuyte dlya etogo noveyshuyu boevuyu sistemu na osnove kartochek i kubikov. Nanesite udar po nenasytnym appetitam alchnoy znati!

Syuzhet
V pogone za drevney relikviey banda professionalnykh vorov pronikaet v roskoshnye pokoi prodazhnogo dvoryanina, edva izbezhav gibeli ot ruk razyaryonnoy gorodskoy strazhi, podsteregayushchey ikh na kazhdom uglu. Otchayavshis nayti vykhod, oni ishchut pristanishcha v gorodskikh trushchobakh i otvazhno spuskayutsya v neproglyadnuyu tmu podzemnogo mira. Za nashimi geroyami otkryvayut okhotu vooruzhyonnye do zubov voiny gorodskoy strazhi, vrazhdebnye bandy golovorezov i klany bezumnykh podzemnykh kannibalov. Vypav iz sistemy i vynuzhdennye pomogat zhadnym do nazhivy prestupnikam, yunye geroi dolzhny primiritsya s novoy dlya sebya realnostyu. No pomnite! V mire Children of Zodiarcs nikomu ne udastsya uyti nevredimym.

Osobennosti
Boevye kartochki
Ataki i umeniya vsekh vashikh tovarishchey privyazany k boevym kartochkam. Ispolzovanie razlichnykh kartochek vo vremya kazhdogo poedinka daet vam beschislennye varianty ataki.

Stepen vozdeystviya karty opredelyaet brosok kubika
Kak tolko vyberete tip ataki, broste virtualnye kubiki dlya polucheniya bonusov. Vmesto tsifr na nikh vypadayut simvoly, kotorye otvechayut za modifikatory ataki, zashchity, lecheniya i osobykh umeniy.

Ispytayte Gospozhu Udachu
Esli khotite vnesti dopolnitelnye urovni strategii v Children of Zodiarcs, kombiniruyte kubiki v sootvetstvii so svoim stilem igry. Vy mozhete perebrosit do dvukh kubikov za kazhdyy khod. Ne boytes polozhitsya na blagosklonnost Gospozhi Udachi!

Mir, polnyy yarkikh personazhey
V khode igry vy poznakomites s Nami, kotoruyu v detstve pokhitili iz rodnogo doma; Brays, vynuzhdennoy vyzhivat na polnykh opasnostey ulitsakh Tora; kharizmatichnym prestupnym liderom Zirkkhoffom, nanimayushchim v usluzhenie detey-sirot, — a takzhe mnogimi drugimi opasnymi negodyayami.
ROOFTOP RENEGADE – это платформер-экшн д:
ROOFTOP RENEGADE – eto platformer-ekshn dlya istinnykh lyubiteley skorosti. Ubegay ot presledovateley sredi futuristicheskikh neboskrebov, ispolzuya supersposobnosti svoikh khoverbleydov.

Prokhodi urovni, spasayas ot postoyannykh bombardirovok, izbegay opasnostey i prinimay molnienosnye resheniya, ot kotorykh budet zaviset, ustanovish li ty novyy rekord ili besslavno pogibnesh.

NEVEROYaTNO DINAMIChNYY GEYMPLEY
Chtoby proniknut v zonu, tebe pridetsya v sovershenstve ovladet tochnym upravleniem i razobratsya s fizikoy igry. Prokhodi urovni na maksimalnykh skorostyakh, sozdavaya tsepochki iz svoikh sposobnostey i prinimaya molnienosnye resheniya. Ubegay ot pogoni iz Globacorp, obkhodya lovushki i opasnosti i uvorachivayas ot ognya strelkov.

VSE BEGUT I VSE STRELYaYuT
Prokhodi slozhnye urovni v odinochku ili priglasi druzey, chtoby srazitsya v mnogopolzovatelskom oflayn-rezhime. Igrayte po ocheredi (maksimalnoe chislo igrokov – troe protiv odnogo). Tvoya zadacha – pokazat luchshee vremya, a zadacha ostalnykh – pomeshat tebe. A potom vse menyayutsya!

BOLShE RAZNOOBRAZIYa
Sozdavay novye urovni s pomoshchyu rezhima konstruktora s podborom igrokov. Vvedi klyuchevoe slovo, chtoby poluchit dinamicheski sgenerirovannyy uroven iz ogromnogo raznoobraziya mirov, skhem, opasnostey i sochetaniy vragov. Vyberi oruzhie po svoemu vkusu i vykhodi na start novogo urovnya.
Основанная на реальных событиях игра 197:
Osnovannaya na realnykh sobytiyakh igra 1979 Revolution: Black Friday — eto interaktivnaya istoricheskaya drama o vybore i posledstviyakh, khaose i poryadke. Deystvie proiskhodit v 1978 godu v stolitse Irana Tegerane. Vy — fotozhurnalist, popavshiy v samuyu gushchu protesta protiv shakhskoy vlasti, i teper vam predstoit vooruzhitsya kameroy i pogruzitsya v opasnyy mir revolyutsii i narodnogo bunta.
• Vybor: vashi resheniya otrazhayutsya na sudbakh lyudey na fone revolyutsii.
• Povestvovanie: yarkaya grafika s ispolzovaniem tekhnologii motion capture i prekrasnoy ozvuchkoy.
• Issledovanie: vzglyanite na gorod na voennom polozhenii iznutri, okazhites v taynom revolyutsionnom shtabe i sredi protestushchikh, a takzhe proydites po bushuyushchim ulitsam.
• Fotosemka: delayte snimki i sravnivayte ikh s realnymi arkhivnymi kadrami.
• Mnogoobrazie: bolee 80 unikalnykh istoriy, rasskazyvayushchikh ob islamskoy revolyutsii v Irane.
• Osnovano na realnykh sobytiyakh: uznayte podlinnuyu istoriyu bortsov za svobodu, ochevidtsev i zhertv revolyutsii.
Благодаря отзывам критиков нам удалось с:
Blagodarya otzyvam kritikov nam udalos sozdat neprevzoydennuyu versiyu dlya Nintendo Switch™.
Smes kosmicheskikh anime i arkad vosmidesyatykh s sovremennoy fizikoy i II - vot chto ozhidaet vas v etom priklyuchenii s protsedurno-generiruemymi missiyami, trebuyushchimi nemalogo masterstva. Stante geroem v mire, kotoryy napominaet klassicheskoe anime, no igraetsya kak zhestkiy sovremennyy takticheskiy shuter. Postaraytes vyzhit vo vrazhdebnom glubokom kosmose, srazhayas protiv vrazhduyushchikh gruppirovok i unikalnykh khitrykh vragov. Otkryvayte moshchnye uluchsheniya, postepenno uznavaya taynu GALAK-Z, i umirayte snova i snova, doblestno pytayas stat luchshim pilotom, kotoryy smozhet spravitsya so vsemi trudnostyami v GALAK-Z!
•	Novyy rezhim: v "Bezdne" vas zhdut beskonechnye igry, setevoy reyting igrokov i ezhednevnye sostyazaniya.
•	Lyubiteley nasyshchennykh srazheniy poraduet uluchshennyy II.
•	Rezhim "Arkada" otlichno podoydet dlya tekh, kto ne lyubit chrezmernoy zhestokosti.
V GALAK-Z mozhno igrat v portativnom i nastolnom rezhimakh, a takzhe v rezhime TV. Igra podderzhivaet  kontroller Nintendo Switch™ Pro i kontrollery Joy-Con™.
Возьмите на себя роль молодого студента,:
Vozmite na sebya rol molodogo studenta, brodite po kampusu i vypolnyayte zadaniya, dannye vam professorom. Zvuchit skuchno? Professor predstavlyaet soboy neyronnuyu set, a kampus raspolozhen na neskolkikh plavuchikh ostrovakh i zapolnen obektami i rasteniyami prichudlivoy formy iz etogo mira. Krome togo, vy mozhete letat.

No podozhdite, a kak naschet zadaniy? Chto nuzhno risovat?
Zhivopis, vmeste s issledovaniem mira, yavlyaetsya samym vazhnym v etoy igre. Inogda vam budet predlozheno perenesti opredelennyy obekt iz igrovoy oblasti na virtualnyy kholst, inogda vam nuzhno budet narisovat loshad… No obychno vy mozhete prosto dat volyu svoemu voobrazheniyu - eto igra, kotoraya probudit vashe tvorchestvo. Ne volnuytes, esli dumaete, chto ne vy ne khudozhnik. Art Sqool dokazhet obratnoe.

No ved bez kistey ne byvaet zhivopisi? Vy mozhete sobirat novye, no snachala ikh nuzhno budet nayti! Na territorii kampusa spryatano bolee desyatka kistey. Poluchite ikh vsekh!

Klyuchevye osobennosti:
BUD KREATIVNYM. Professor deystvitelno klassnyy chuvak. A zhivopis - eto razvlechenie, tak chto skhodite s uma! Bolee 200 vdokhnovlyayushchikh podskazok pomogut preodolet lyuboy tvorcheskiy blok.
ISSLEDUY UDIVITELNYY MIR. Vy nikogda ne videli nichego podobnogo.
RASSLABLYaYSYa. Konechno, v igre est zadaniya, no ona takzhe pozvolyaet igrokam rasslabitsya: oni mogut otdokhnut pod priyatnuyu muzyku i rasslablennyy temp igry.
BUD KOLLEKTsIONEROM. Naydite i soberite neobychnye kisti, kotorye pomogut vam v tvorcheskom protsesse. Po vsey karte est skrytye instrumenty, takie kak figurnaya kist, raduzhnyy karandash i… vodnaya kist.
Cooking Mama: Cookstar - ВСЕ НОВОЕ для N:
Cooking Mama: Cookstar - VSE NOVOE dlya Nintendo Switch™ s bolee chem 80 zabavnymi i udivitelnymi retseptami.
Vpervye Cooking Mama: Cookstar predlagaet kak standartnye, tak i vegetarianskie retsepty!
Ot klassicheskikh retseptov do edy Edinoroga vy mozhete sozdavat svoi sobstvennye udivitelnye retsepty s pomoshchyu mamy.

Mekhanika mini-igr sama po sebe variruetsya ot bystrogo risovaniya parallelnykh liniy dlya narezki predmetov do ritmicheskoy igry, v kotoroy ingredienty dobavlyayutsya v skovorodu ili teplo reguliruetsya v nuzhnoe vremya. Kogda eto proiskhodit, otobrazhaetsya izobrazhenie serditoy «mamy» s plamenem iz ee glaz, a takzhe nadpis «Ne volnuysya, mama vse ispravit!
TumbleSeed — это обманчивая глубокая и ш:
TumbleSeed — eto obmanchivaya glubokaya i shutlivaya igra o balansirovanii semyan na opasnykh i postoyanno menyayushchikhsya gorakh.

Izbegayte otverstiy i pobezhdayte zlobnykh sushchestv v etoy priklyuchencheskoy igre dlya dvukh dzhoystikov. Na vashem opasnom puti vam pridetsya ispolzovat strategiyu, razvivat moshchnye uluchsheniya i ovladet iskusstvom podkata, chtoby izbezhat mnogochislennykh opasnostey na gore.

TumbleSeed raspolagaet 5 protsedurno-generiruemymi mirami i bolee chem 30 unikalnymi silami semyan. Pobeyte svoy luchshiy lichnyy rekord ili posostyazaytes s mirom v ezhednevnom ispytanii. Na gore mnogo syurprizov, tayn i priklyucheniy, kotorye zhdut svoego chasa, — uvidimsya na sklonakh!
1989-й год. Тебя зовут Генри, и ты уехал: 1989-y god. Tebya zovut Genri, i ty uekhal ot tyazheloy zhizni v lesa Vayominga, chtoby rabotat tam dozornym. Raspolozhivshis na samoy vershine gory, ty dolzhen sledit za sokhrannostyu okruzhayushchey prirody. No kogda chto-to strannoe zastavlyaet tebya pokinut post i otpravitsya v les, ty nachinaesh issledovat neznakomyy mir vokrug, zadavat voprosy i prinimat resheniya, kotorye mogut kak ukrepit, tak i razrushit edinstvennye vazhnye na dannyy moment otnosheniya.
«Ridge Racer» — серия видеоигр в жанре а:
«Ridge Racer» — seriya videoigr v zhanre arkadnykh avtogonok, razrabotannaya kompaniey Namco. Pervaya igra serii byla vypushchena v 1993 godu v vide arkadnogo igrovogo avtomata. Vposledstvii ona poluchila ryad prodolzheniy dlya igrovykh avtomatov i domashnikh sistem. Bolshinstvo igr serii vykhodili eksklyuzivno dlya nekotorykh igrovykh konsoley.
Vse igry serii, nachinaya s samoy pervoy, ispolzuyut tryokhmernuyu poligonalnuyu grafiku s teksturami. Vse avtomobili v igrakh serii vymyshlennye. Vizualnye povrezhdeniya pri stolknoveniyakh otsutstvuyut. Drift v igre ne sootvetstvuet zakonam fiziki i yavlyaetsya vazhnoy chastyu igrovogo protsessa, pozvolyaya ratsionalnee prokhodit povoroty i popolnyat zapas sistemy zakisi azota.
Deystvie igr serii proiskhodit v vymyshlennom gorode Ridge City, nakhodyashchemsya v odnoimyonnom shtate v neizvestnoy strane. Gonochnye trassy prolozheny cherez gorod i ego okrestnosti. V novykh igrakh serii poyavlyayutsya novye trassy, no sokhranyayutsya trassy iz pervykh dvukh igr. Osobennostyu serii yavlyayutsya virtualnye «korolevy gonok» — modeli devushek, vypolnennye s pomoshchyu tryokhmernoy grafiki, stavshie simvolami-maskotami serii igr. Naibolee populyarnoy iz nikh stala Reiko Nagase, sozdannaya shtatnym dizaynerom Namco Kei Yoshimizu. Muzyka k igram serii sozdayotsya vnutrennimi studiyami Namco i vypolnena v razlichnykh podzhanrakh elektronnoy muzyki — tekhno, eysid-dzhaz i drugikh.
Просто, но сложно! Собираться с друзьями:
Prosto, no slozhno! Sobiratsya s druzyami, srazhatsya s bossami — eto vsyo kruto, no vydelit nemnogo vremeni dlya sebya eshchyo kruche. Kazhdomu nravitsya provodit vremya v odinochestve, a prinyat vyzov v etoy igre — otlichnyy sposob eto sdelat!
Mozhet byt, prishlo vremya otdokhnut ot igr dlya drugikh lyudey.
Landflix Odyssey is an action platformer:
Landflix Odyssey is an action platformer in which players play as Larry, a lazy binge-watcher who, after using special batteries, finds himself trapped inside the streaming service he was watching, Landflix!
In order to return home, his mission will be to recover all five batteries that ended up inside the TV shows of the Landflix platform.
Главная героиня игры – юная девочка. Вам:
Glavnaya geroinya igry – yunaya devochka. Vam predstoit issledovat ot ee litsa syurrealistichnyy i strannyy mir ee snovideniy. Vse proiskhodyashchee v etom mire – zagadka. V igre net chetkogo syuzheta ili kakikh-libo podskazok.

Ubegaya ot napadayushchikh monstrov, ishcha primenenie naydennym predmetam, reshaya golovolomki, stavshie prepyatstviem na puti, razgadyvayte zagadki, razbrosannye v mire snovideniy.

V mire snovideniy est sem dverey. S ikh pomoshchyu mozhno svobodno i bez kakoy-libo ocherednosti puteshestvovat v razlichnye miry.
Tam vas zhdut nakhodki i sobytiya, kotorye prolyut svet na svyaz etikh mirov mezhdu soboy. Vozmozhno, eto i est luchshaya strategiya dlya prokhozhdeniya.

Dannaya igra razrabotana po motivam besplatnoy igry Yume Nikki, sozdannoy nezavisimym avtorom Kikiyama s pomoshchyu programmy RPG Maker. Igra byla vypushchena v 2004 godu i nabrala bolshuyu populyarnost. Vashemu vnimaniyu predlagaetsya rimeyk etogo proizvedeniya, sozdannyy s soglasiya i pri podderzhke g-na Kikiyama pod ego neposredstvennym rukovodstvom. 
Originalnyy mir igry i personazhi pereneseny v mir 3D i pererabotany s pomoshchyu novoy igrovoy sistemy.
СОЗДАЙТЕ СВОЮ КИБЕРСПОРТИВНУЮ КОМАНДУ\nП:
SOZDAYTE SVOYu KIBERSPORTIVNUYu KOMANDU
Produmayte vse do melochey po svoemu vkusu: sozdayte gerb, sproektiruyte kibersportivnoe snaryazhenie, sozdayte avatar i igrokov s nulya... Soberite komandu svoey mechty i srazhaytes za pobedu v chempionate!

PODPIShITE KONTRAKT S LUChShIMI ZVEZDAMI
Pervoklassnoy komande nuzhny pervoklassnye igroki. Esli vy deystvitelno khotite stat velichayshim menedzherom v istorii, vashey komande nuzhny zvezdy. Nanimayte perspektivnykh igrokov i ubezhdayte deystvuyushchikh chempionov prisoedinitsya k vashey komande. I esli kto-to iz nikh podvedet... Vam predstoit prinyat reshenie: ostavit ikh v komande ili iskat zamenu. Nikto ne govoril, chto stat chempionom budet legko. 

TRENIRUYTE IGROKOV I ZABOTTES OB IKh ZDOROVE 
Superzvezdy ne poyavlyayutsya niotkuda: dazhe samym talantlivym igrokam nuzhno mnogo truditsya, chtoby razvivat svoi navyki! Vyrashchivayte chempionov, ukreplyayte komandnyy dukh, nablyudayte za sopernikami... I ne propuskayte zavtrak! V kontse kontsov, luchshie komandy — ne prosto kuchki igrokov, a slazhennoe vzaimodeystvie (i pravilnyy obraz zhizni) — to, chto otlichaet khoroshuyu komandu ot deystvitelno velikoy.

OT EDINITs K MILLIONAM…
Vyigryshnye matchi privlekut bolshe poklonnikov, uvelichat dokhod i otkroyut novye vozmozhnosti! Uluchshayte svoy igrovoy dom i otkroyte dlya sebya zhizn superzvezdy. Psikhologi, trenery, menedzhery po marketingu... Professionaly svoego dela prisoedinyatsya k vam na vashem puti k slave!

STANTE LEGENDOY SPORTAOtsenite rezultaty vashikh tyazhelykh trenirovok, sorevnuyas s professionalnymi kibersportivnymi komandami. Reshite, stanete li vy nablyudatelem matcha ili budete rukovodit komandoy, gotovit chempionov i prinimat resheniya v rezhime realnogo vremeni vo vremya simulirovannykh kibersportivnykh matchey. I pomnite: uspekh prinadlezhit vashim igrokam, no za neudachi otvechaet trener.
Splatter — это динамичный шутер с видом:
Splatter — eto dinamichnyy shuter s vidom sverkhu, vypolnennyy v estetike nuar-filmov. Vstupayte v neprostye skhvatki s zombi i monstrami, naslazhdayas krovavymi effektami i razrushaemym okruzheniem. S boem proryvaytes cherez apokalipticheskiy gorod v syuzhetnom rezhime dlya odnogo igroka ili ispytayte vashi navyki v rezhime vyzhivaniya.

Eto vam ne kakaya-to tam zauryadnaya strelyalka. My otpravlyaem vas v put s ogromnym arsenalom uluchshaemogo oruzhiya, kotoroe pomozhet pobedit ordy vragov. Vstrechayte interesnykh personazhey, vypolnyayte desyatki pobochnykh zadaniy i uchastvuyte v zapominayushchikhsya bitvakh s bossami.

Vsegda derzhite vash vernyy fonar pri sebe, ved zombi boyatsya sveta. Ispolzuyte ego, chtoby sozdat prostranstvo mezhdu soboy i vragami i obnaruzhit ikh skrytye slabosti.

Syuzhetnyy rezhim sostoit iz 16 urovney, napolnennykh polnostyu ozvuchennymi NIP i animirovannymi vstavkami.

Beyte rekordy v rezhime vyzhivaniya ili sobirayte komandu iz 4 druzey, chtoby vmeste dat boy orde!

Klyuchevye osobennosti:
Slozhnye skhvatki s raznogo roda zombi i monstrami.
Nuarnaya syuzhetnaya kampaniya dlya odnogo igroka s polnostyu ozvuchennymi dialogami i vstavkami.
Unikalnye bossy, tekhnika i mnozhestvo pobochnykh zadaniy.
Svet i teni dobavlyayut v boi takticheskuyu sostavlyayushchuyu.
Razrushaemoe okruzhenie i uluchshaemoe oruzhie, kotoroe s kazhdym urovnem poluchaet novye funktsii i sposobnosti.
Arkadnye rezhimy igry s onlayn-tablitsami liderov, gde mozhno posorevnovatsya s druzyami.
Lokalnyy mnogopolzovatelskiy rezhim do 4 igrokov.
I poslednee, no ne menee vazhnoe: mnogo i mnogo ekshna
Открытая, бесплатная и свободная кросс-п:
Otkrytaya, besplatnaya i svobodnaya kross-platformennaya igra s publichno dostupnym iskhodnym kodom, v kotoroy mozhno skladyvat bloki! Chto otlichaet Apotris ot drugikh Tetrisov, tak eto eyo obshirnye vozmozhnosti nastroyki, dopolnennye sverkhchuvstvitelnym upravleniem, kotoroe pozvolyaet vam vypolnyat vashi dvizheniya s tochnostyu.
Blagodarya 14 igrovym rezhimam i mnozhestvu fich vy smozhete nastroit igru v sootvetstvii so svoimi predpochteniyami, garantiruya slozhnye zadaniya kazhdyy raz, kogda vy igraete. JULY, 1935. A MURDER HAS BEEN COMMITTED:
JULY, 1935. A MURDER HAS BEEN COMMITTED aboard the SS Hook, eight hours out from New York.

Only one problem: you did it.

Can you get away with murder?

GAMEPLAY

Blackmail a spy. Fall in love. Murder a rival. Cheat at cards. Drug a witness. Lie, befriend, betray, console, sneak, seduce, steal, borrow, pray, eavesdrop, kill...

There are clues, evidence, suspects, accusations, secrets and lies.

You’ll need all your cunning, coercion and charisma to ensure that someone else takes the fall.

DYNAMIC NARRATIVE CLOCKWORK

* Next-gen visual novel: go where you want, when you want, and say what you want
* Simulated story-world: other characters move and act independently, remember everything they see and hear, and everything you do

Built using the award-winning ink narrative engine, Overboard!'s narrative twists itself around every choice you make.

Play once for a thrill, or multiple times to uncover all the secrets and achieve an ideal ending.

HIGHLY REPLAYABLE

One play-through lasts about 30 - 45 minutes, but achieving the perfect crime run will take a lot longer...

CAN YOU GET AWAY WITH MURDER?

Путешествуйте по древней Японии в роли н:
Puteshestvuyte po drevney Yaponii v roli nindzya Syukuti, izgnannogo iz svoego byvshego klana za stremlenie k bolee blagorodnomu obrazu zhizni. Puteshestvuyte po obshirnym territoriyam, pobezhdaya novogo vraga nindzya Syukuti, chtoby prinesti mir i protsvetanie vo vremena besporyadkov.
Vas zhdet zakhvatyvayushchee priklyuchenie s bolee chem 70 urovnyami, 7 vrednymi bossami, vdokhnovlyayushchey syuzhetnoy liniey i unikalnym sensornym upravleniem — drugoy takoy igry prosto net!

Syukuti v bukvalnom perevode oznachaet «metod szhatiya zemli», sposobnost puteshestvovat s bolshoy skorostyu, sposobnost, kotoruyu nash geroy usovershenstvoval za gody trenirovok. Vozmite pod svoy kontrol nindzya Syukuti i letayte po vozdukhu s neveroyatnoy skorostyu pri pomoshchi odnogo dvizheniya paltsa, atakuyte vragov svoim nindzyato, brosayte syurikeny (zvezdy nindzya) v trudnodostupnykh vragov i mgnovenno teleportiruytes, chtoby bystro otrazit vrazheskie ataki. Obladaya siloy istseleniya, vy takzhe dolzhny pomoch nindzya Syukuti, chtoby on ne umer.

Blagodarya krasivoy i sovremennoy pikselnoy grafike, a takzhe polnostyu sochinennoy traditsionnoy yaponskoy muzyke s sovremennymi elementami, nindzya Syukuti istochaet elementy 1600-kh, 90-kh i 2020-kh godov!
Пять лет назад экспедиция на корабле «Ви:
Pyat let nazad ekspeditsiya na korable «Vikont» otpravilas cherez Belyy prokhod (Pale Passage) na poiski yuzhnogo magnitnogo polyusa i propala vo ldakh. Teper novaya ekspeditsiya na korable «Temperans» sleduet po tomu zhe marshrutu, nadeyas nayti otvety tam, gde «Vikont» poterpel neudachu.

ZAMERZShAYa PUSTOSh
Igra pro polyarnuyu ekspeditsiyu, gde vam predstoit uvlekatelnoe i opasnoe puteshestvie cherez ledyanye pustoshi i Beluyu pustynyu (Pale Beyond) po potryasayushchemu i bezzhalostnomu landshaftu, kotoryy mozhet izmenitsya v lyuboy moment.

Led ravnodushen, no kazhdoe vashe reshenie budet imet znachenie.

Po mere prodvizheniya ekspeditsii i nastupleniya polyarnoy zimy lyuboy vash vybor mozhet okazat printsipialnoe vliyanie na syuzhet.

VY NE KhOTELI BYT LIDEROM
Vy nikogda ne mechtali vozglavit polyarnuyu ekspeditsiyu, no, pokhozhe, vybora u vas net. Sudno zastryalo vo ldakh, kapitan propal, krugom tolko led i sneg. Kto-to dolzhen vzyat na sebya otvetstvennost.

Raspredelyayte resursy, zabottes o bezopasnosti ekspeditsii i podderzhivayte boevoy dukh ee uchastnikov. Gotovy li vy prinimat trudnye resheniya na puti cherez Beluyu pustynyu?

Obespechit bezopasnost, pitanie i teplo dlya komandy (i ezdovykh sobak) vo vremya ekspeditsii krayne vazhno. No esli komanda vzbuntuetsya, o vyzhivanii ne mozhet byt i rechi. Dobivaytes podderzhki svoikh lyudey, vam ponadobitsya kazhdyy golos.

IMMERSIVNOE AUDIO
Originalnye muzykalnye kompozitsii, morskie pesni shanti i potryasayushchie akkordeonnye solo sozdayut unikalnuyu atmosferu i neizmenno soprovozhdayut vashu ekspeditsiyu.

Igrayte za Niks, moloduyu vedmochku, popavshuyu v okutannyy tmoy mir. Razyshchite pravdu i soberite soyuznikov, kotorye pomogut vam v vashem puteshestvii!..

Cooperative

Difficulty
Four different difficulty levels are designed for players of all skill levels.  

Leaderboards

Voice cast

Играли ли вы когда-нибудь в ручную совет:
Igrali li vy kogda-nibud v ruchnuyu sovetskuyu igru-labirint s malenkim metallicheskim sharikom vnutri (perpleksus), kotoryy bylo neobkhodimo provesti iz odnoy tochki v druguyu?..
Eta kollektsiya peredayot vsyu ~149-letnyuyu istoriyu podobnykh igr, nachinaya s 1870-kh — v ruki entuziastov!
V sbornike predstavleny polnostyu simulirovannye tsifrovye reproduktsii istoricheskikh realnykh igr i golovolomok na lovkost, dopolnennye originalnymi risunkami, fotografiyami i spravochnoy informatsiey dlya kazhdoy igrushki iz arkhivov «The Strong National Museum of Play», nakhodyashchimsya v gorode Rochestere, shtat Nyu-York, SShA.
Пройдите более 100 уровней в 11 разных э:
Proydite bolee 100 urovney v 11 raznykh etapakh, kotorye polny raznoobraznykh zadach na logiku i skorost reaktsii. Sledite za dvizhushchimisya prepyatstviyami, ispolzuyte portaly i ubegayte ot prizraka, poka vremya ne vyshlo.

Kazhdyy etap dobavlyaet novye zadachi s vozrastayushchey slozhnostyu. Uzhe k seredine igry Spiral Splatter udivit dazhe samykh iskusnykh poklonnikov golovolomok.

Sokhranyayte spokoystvie, rasslabtes i proverte, smozhete li vy pobedit v Spiral Splatter!

Osobennosti:
- Bolshe 100 raznoobraznykh urovney
- 11 etapov s novymi zadachami na kazhdom iz nikh
- Krasochnaya i stilnaya grafika
- Slozhnyy igrovoy protsess
Dies irae (яп. デ ィ エ ス ・ イ レ) — визуальн:
Dies irae (yap. デ ィ エ ス ・ イ レ) — vizualnaya novvella, razrabotannaya Light, pervonachalno vypushchennaya v 2007 godu v Yaponii. Premera anime-adaptatsii sostoyalas v oktyabre 2017 goda.
«Den gneva» (imeetsya v vidu, den Strashnogo suda) — sekventsiya (ili tserkovnyy khoral, tekstomuzykalnaya forma i zhanr bogosluzhebnogo obikhoda), v katolicheskoy messe — odin iz samykh populyarnykh grigorianskikh raspevov.
Ord. - это уникальный взгляд на текстовы:
Ord. - eto unikalnyy vzglyad na tekstovye priklyuchencheskie igry s minimalistichnym ispolzovaniem slov, vizualnykh effektov i zvuka. Igrayte v unikalnye istorii vsego iz 3 slov! Svoim originalnym podkhodom k povestvovaniyu i igrovomu dizaynu Ord. zastavit vas smeyatsya i plakat. Sygrayte v Ord., chtoby ubeditsya v etom sami! 

Igra Ord. poluchila mnozhestvo nagrad kritikov i otraslevykh premiy za novatorskiy podkhod k povestvovaniyu. Igra voshla v ofitsialnyy otbor AdventureX Narrative Games Convention v 2019 godu, stala finalistom konkursa TIGA Games Industry Awards, a takzhe pobeditelem premii FutureZone Award v 2019 godu.
Sygrayte v Ord. i uznayte, pochemu vokrug nee stolko shumikhi!

Kharakteristiki
* Pyat unikalnykh istoriy dlya igry
* Minimalistichnye grafika, teksty i zvuk
Winter Games 2023 — захватывающая спорти:
Winter Games 2023 — zakhvatyvayushchaya sportivnaya igra v sovremennoy 3D-grafike. Igrok poprobuet sebya v desyati sportivnykh distsiplinakh, v tom chisle biatlone, pryzhkakh s tramplina na lyzhakh, ski-krosse, skeletone i supergigante. Vpered za novymi rekordami, trofeyami i slavoy! Pomimo otdelnykh vidov sporta, v igre dostupny na vybor kubki, v kotorykh mozhno proyti neskolko distsiplin odnu za drugoy. A eshche vy mozhete pridumyvat svoi sorevnovaniya. Igrayte protiv iskusstvennogo intellekta ili sorevnuytes s druzyami po seti. Stante chempionom zimnikh igr!

Lokalnaya setevaya igra do 4 igrokov.
Polzovatelskiy rezhim dlya svoikh sobytiy.
Neskolko urovney slozhnosti dlya novichkov i profi.
Desyat zakhvatyvayushchikh sportivnykh distsiplin.
 * Biatlon

 * Supergigant
 * Skeleton
 * Short-trek
 * Parnyy bobsley

Персонажи Doraemon возвращаются! \n\nИгр:
Personazhi Doraemon vozvrashchayutsya! 

Igrayte za malchika s zolotym serdtsem Nobitu! Issleduyte mir igry, nakhodite novykh druzey i vozdelyvayte zemlyu vmeste so svoimi tovarishchami: Doraemonom i drugimi! 

Peredovye tekhnologii! 

Vyrashchivayte urozhay, ukhazhivayte za zhivotnymi na ferme, masterite mebel i issleduyte gorod. A osobye ustroystva Doraemona pomogut vam sdelat fermu eshche luchshe!
В Into A Dream вы просыпаетесь в загадоч:
V Into A Dream vy prosypaetes v zagadochnom lesu. Vy ne pomnite, kto vy takoy, i edinstvennaya vestochka iz realnogo mira – audiokasseta s poslaniem. Iz zapisi vy uznaete, chto vash razum podsoedinili k razumu Lyuka Uilyamsa, cheloveka s sereznoy depressiey. Vy – poslednyaya nadezhda Lyuka, i tolko vy mozhete ne dat emu… ugasnut.

Pogruzites v sny Lyuka, gde splavleny voedino mechty i vospominaniya, i raskroyte tsepochku sobytiy, privedshikh ego k krayu propasti. Vy vstretite ego druzey i blizkikh; ubedite ego raskryt svoi samye mrachnye sekrety i proydete volnitelnyy, tragicheskiy i vdokhnovlyayushchiy put ego zhizni.

Zhizn Lyuka v vashikh rukakh. Vy dolzhny pomoch emu sdelat pervyy shag k vyzdorovleniyu i otkryt emu glaza na istinnuyu tsennost zhizni. Vy – ego poslednyaya nadezhda.

Klyuchevye osobennosti
- Polnoe emotsiy i tragizma dushevnoe povestvovanie o lyubvi, otchayanii i depressii
-Originalnyy, charuyushchiy saundtrek i atmosfera skazochnogo sna
-Golovolomki, neposredstvenno svyazannye s syuzhetom
-Polnaya ozvuchka dialogov (angliyskiy yazyk)
-Zhivye, mnogogrannye personazhi i otnosheniya
Когда насилие и преступность захлестнули: Kogda nasilie i prestupnost zakhlestnuli ulitsy goroda, nachalnik politsii Anders Panch reshilsya na kraynie mery: unichtozhit kriminalnuyu gruppirovku golymi rukami!
Совершенно новая увлекательная приключен:
Sovershenno novaya uvlekatelnaya priklyuchencheskaya igra, kotoraya vernet vas vo vremena rastsveta retro-igr.
Vash rabotodatel otpravlyaet vas na issledovanie i perenosit v proshloe, no voleyu sudby vy popadaete v sereznoe zatrudnitelnoe polozhenie. Neispravnost vashego korablya vynuzhdaet vas prizemlitsya v Egipte 1300 g. do n. e., gde, po schastyu, vy obnaruzhivaete ogromnuyu piramidu.
ibb & obb — это кооперативная игра для д:
ibb & obb — eto kooperativnaya igra dlya dvukh chelovek v napolnennom golovolomkami mire, gde gravitatsiya rabotaet v dvukh napravleniyakh. Dobitsya uspekha smozhet tolko splochyonnaya komanda.

Vy mozhete kak igrat s drugom, sidya doma na divane, tak i nayti partnyora onlayn.

Padayte vverkh i prygayte vniz na protyazhenii 15 urovney, napolnennykh golovolomkami dvoynoy gravitatsii. Naydite 8 skrytykh mirov, kotorye budut nastoyashchim ispytaniem dlya vashikh novykh navykov, rabotayushchikh vopreki zakonam Nyutona.

Kazhdyy uroven imeet svoyu unikalnuyu melodiyu, sochinyonnuyu Kettel — priznannym avtorom tyoploy melodichnoy elektronnoy muzyki.
Игра The Adventure Pals создана по мотив:
Igra The Adventure Pals sozdana po motivam klassicheskikh platformerov i multyashnykh igr. Vam s luchshimi druzyami (zhirafom i kamnem) predstoit spasat mir i papochku, chtoby oni ne prevratilis v khot-dogi! Poluchayte novye urovni, chtoby izuchat osobye sposobnosti, brosat bomby i orudovat mechom. Ishchite keksy, razblokiruyte kostyumy i zapolnyayte albom s sekretnymi nakleykami v pyati originalnykh bolshikh oblastyakh s unikalnymi urovnyami. Issleduyte tainstvennye lesa Lesnoy doliny, vzbiraytes na lunnye kratery s privideniyami i pogruzhaytes v glubiny okeana, chtoby nayti zateryannyy gorod Krablantidu. 

Eto smes s lyubovyu sozdannykh urovney-platform i lokatsiy, kak v rolevykh igrakh, s gorozhanami, kotorye dayut zadaniya i prodayut predmety i vsyakie poleznosti, kotorye prigodyatsya v puteshestvii. Igra The Adventure Pals vkusnaya, kak vash lyubimyy buterbrod, i podarit massu udovolstviya. Ona polna legkogo veselya, kotoroe pridetsya po vkusu igrokam vsekh vozrastov.

Da! Dva glavnykh slova: zhiraf. Yazyk- vertolet.
Интересный приключенческий экшен в ретро:
Interesnyy priklyuchencheskiy ekshen v retro-stile o vyzhivanii sestyor Mad i Frei v dremuchikh debryakh postapokalipticheskoy Skandinavii, gde votsarilis chudovishcha iz drevnikh mifov i legend.
Na oblomkakh razrushennoy tsivilizatsii probuzhdaetsya novaya zhizn. Drevnie sushchestva vosstayut iz prakha i stanovyatsya khozyaevami obezlyudevshikh zemel. Vstupite v skhvatku s chudovishchami iz skandinavskogo folklora i issleduyte ruiny pogibshey tsivilizatsii.
Yoko & Yuki: Dr. Rat's Revenge is a fami:
Yoko & Yuki: Dr. Rat's Revenge is a family game suitable for kids of all ages. Yoko and Yuki are two adorable cats in love with each other. But the devious doctor Rat stole Yuki from Yoko. Now it’s time to do some cat business — to save the girlfriend, using helpful gadgets and finding the solution for any puzzle.

That is no ordinary cat — our hero is equipped with scissors to cut ropes, gravitron to flip the world and spray can to find hidden objects. And the game gets harder and harder with new puzzles and challenges. Daring players would be handsomely rewarded for using their wits and helping two cats to achieve their happiness!
UNWORTHY — хардкорный боевой платформер:
UNWORTHY — khardkornyy boevoy platformer bez pryzhkov!
Igrayte za voina, vosstavshego iz mogily. Osnashchennyy mechom i shchitom, vy dolzhny peresech unylyy i vrazhdebnyy mir, kishashchiy koshmarnymi sushchestvami.
Vashe terpenie, reshitelnost i masterstvo prigodyatsya vam dlya srazheniy s epicheskimi bossami, kak i moshchnoe oruzhie i osobye sposobnosti..
Сразитесь с культом, члены которого хотя: Srazites s kultom, chleny kotorogo khotyat osushchestvit zloveshchiy plan: voskresit drevnee bozhestvo i prinesti apokalipsis. Borites s ordami kultistov, nezhiti, demonov i drugikh porozhdeniy nochi i otpravlyayte ikh obratno v mogily! Kazhdyy vrag — eto golovolomka, trebuyushchaya svoego resheniya. Vremeni na razmyshlenie malo, ved na vas idut tselye polchishcha podobnykh zadachek!
Игра Motorsport Manager for Nintendo Swi:
Igra Motorsport Manager for Nintendo Switch™ stala debyutom serii na etoy platforme. Vam predstoit oderzhat pobedu v devyati urovnyakh na mashinakh trekh razlichnykh klassov, sozdavaya i podgotavlivaya dlya etogo sobstvennuyu gonochnuyu komandu. Zalog pobedy v etom zakhvatyvayushchem simulyatore — strategicheskoe planirovanie i prinyatie vernykh resheniy pryamo v protsesse gonki.

Novyy gonshchik ne vnushaet doveriya? Ishchite novye talanty. Khotite uluchshit pokazateli avtomobiley? Sozdavayte i pokupayte novye komplektuyushchie. Vy upravlyaete vsem: avtomobilyami, inzhenerami, mekhanikami, sobstvennoy shtab-kvartiroy, sponsorami i ne tolko. Glavnoe, sledite za oborotom sredstv! Sumeete osvoit vse aspekty upravleniya gonochnoy komandoy? Sledite za denezhnym balansom, ispolzuya pri etom peredovye gonochnye tekhnologii, rasshiryayte svoyu imperiyu i dobivaytes otlichnykh rezultatov na trasse, chtoby vasha komanda vsegda ostavalas v poul-pozitsii.

EKSKLYuZIVNYE OSOBENNOSTI IGRY NA NINTENDO SWITCH™:
- Blagodarya 17 unikalnym marshrutam po vsemu miru, vklyuchaya eksklyuzivnuyu novozelandskuyu trassu dlya Nintendo Switch™, vam dostupny gonki v samykh raznykh chastyakh sveta.
- Trekhmernye gonki na Nintendo Switch™ otlichayutsya nevidannoy realistichnostyu blagodarya teksturam vysokogo razresheniya i graficheskim usovershenstvovaniyam.
- Vam dostupna polnotsennaya nastroyka kharakteristik lyubogo gonshchika, inzhenera ili mekhanika v komande: ot vneshnosti do kharaktera i navykov!
- Joy-Con™ i sensornoe upravlenie pozvolyat privesti komandu k triumfu kak v uyutnoy domashney obstanovke, tak i v doroge.
Приручайте, собирайте и сражайтесь! В эт:
Priruchayte, sobirayte i srazhaytes! V etoy kartochnoy rolevoy o sbore sushchestv vy sozdadite nepobedimuyu komandu montabi. Nauchites ispolzovat ikh krutye umeniya, sochetat silnye storony i zashchiayte goroda, pobezhdaya v poshagovykh takticheskikh boyakh!
Khotite stat nastoyashchim geroem v bitve protiv okkupantov svoego rodnogo goroda? Togda vam tochno ponadobyatsya montabi! Kazhdyy iz nikh obladaet svoim naborom navykov, a znachit, u vashego otryada iz tryokh sushchestv budet uyma vozmozhnostey dlya kombinatsiy. Sobirayte gadzhety, ispolzuyte amulety — i prolozhite put k pobede!
Попадите в мир, зараженный пузырьковой п:
Popadite v mir, zarazhennyy puzyrkovoy psikhodeliey. Pogruzites v glubiny novoy ekologii, izobiluyushchey mnozhestvom prokhodov, svetyashchimisya urovnyami i slozhnymi prepyatstviyami. Vyydite za predely materialnoy vselennoy, primite svoyu estestvennuyu formu giperpodvizhnogo organizma Spincha i spasti svoe poteryannoe potomstvo ot beskonechnogo nashestviya besformennykh i urodlivykh strannostey i neordinarnostey.

V Spinch ispolzuetsya oldskulnaya sistema slozhnosti, pri kotoroy vam pridetsya pereigryvat mnogie uchastki, poka vy ne ottochite vremya reaktsii i refleksy. Brosaytes, uklonyaytes, karabkaytes, plavayte, prygayte i dazhe zapuskayte svoikh sobstvennykh detey kak snaryady, chtoby pobedit shesterykh ekstsentrichnykh bossov v shesti yarkikh mirakh. Sobirayte predmety, chtoby poluchit preimushchestvo v poiske svoikh poteryannykh detey. Osteregaytes svoego kuzena — on prismatrivaet za detmi nekotorykh vashikh rodstvennikov, no on nemnogo strannyy. Tolko taymer i bystrye perezapuske — bez kontsa igry ili zhizney. Igra budet interesna dlya lyubykh igrokov, no ona stanet nastoyashchim vyzovom dazhe dlya samykh opytnykh spidrannerov.

Osobennosti
• Vizualnyy stil v stile retro s psikhodelicheskimi tsvetami, sozdannyy zasluzhennym khudozhnikom-multiplikatorom iz Kanady Dzhessi Dzheykobsom.
• Tochno vyverennaya igra, gde nuzhno delat ryvki, uklonyatsya i otprygivat ot poverkhnostey, chtoby spastis ot neonovykh paukov, gigantskikh raduzhnykh chervey i bombyashchikh lunopsov.
• Pogruzites v neobyknovennye psikhodelicheskie miry: neonovye ravniny, eksperimentalnye basseyny, zamorozhennye ostrova i dazhe otkrytyy kosmos.
• Srazites s zagadochnymi bossami i rasstrelyayte ikh svoimi detishkami — ikh mozhno ispolzovat kak boepripasy.
• Podkhodit igrokam lyubogo urovnya; idealno dlya spidranov.
• Saundtrek kanadskogo ispolnitelya Dzheymsa Kirkpatrika, sostoyashchiy iz trekov, napisannykh ili izmenennykh na Gameboys, a takzhe s ispolzovaniem izognutykh ili sozdannykh s nulya instrumentov.
Новая музыкальная ритм-игра, в которой м:
Novaya muzykalnaya ritm-igra, v kotoroy mozhno ispolnyat khity populyarnykh artistov na gitare, basu, klavishnykh ili udarnykh instrumentakh v polnotsennom gruppovom formate, pryamo kak v Rock Band!.. Blagodarya rezhimu sovmestnoy igry i bolee chem 120 000 variantov aranzhirovok, igra pozvolyaet kak novichkam, tak i opytnym igrokam oshchutit azart zhivogo vystupleniya na yaposkoy stsene.
V proekte predstavleny mnogochislennye khity populyarnykh ispolniteley, vklyuchaya YOASOBI, AKB48, Omoinotake i drugikh, a takzhe treki: «Bling-Bang-Bang-Born», «Idol», «Mela!», «Ao no Sumika», «Some Like It Hot!!», «Ikuokukonen», «FREEDOM», «Apollo», «Koyoi no Tsuki no Youni», «Koi Suru Fortune Cookie», «Blue Bird» …i mnogie drugie!
Prosto predstavte, chto zazhimaete struny pravoy rukoy, a levoy — bete po nim — pochti kak v realnosti!..
Высоко оценённая критиками, завоевавшая: Vysoko otsenyonnaya kritikami, zavoevavshaya mnozhestvo nagrad priklyuchencheskaya igra s otkrytym mirom, posvyashchyonnaya zagadkam solnechnoy sistemy vo vremennoy kosmopetle. Vy — novyy uchastnik programmy Outer Wilds Ventures, nachatoy nedavno programmy kosmicheskikh issledovaniy, kotoraya prizvana nayti otvety na zagadki strannoy, neprestanno menyayushcheysya solnechnoy sistemy.
Гоняйте по Бухте Приключений со всеми ва:
Gonyayte po Bukhte Priklyucheniy so vsemi vashimi lyubimymi shchenkami Shchenyachego patrulya do 4 igrokov odnovremenno, no sledite za prepyatstviyami, ostavlennymi ozornym merom Khamdingerom!
Shchenyachiy patrul na svoey samoy bystroy missii — vyigrat Kubok Shchenkov! Obezzhayte znamenitye mesta, v tom chisle Bukhtu Priklyucheniy, Kurort Dzheyka dlya snouborda i Dzhungli, chtoby uznat, kto stanet pobeditelem.
Необычная ошибка проявляется 4 апреля, в:
Neobychnaya oshibka proyavlyaetsya 4 aprelya, v den, kotoryy povtoryaet zagadochnyy kod 404. V otchayannom poryve nevinnosti rebenok otkazyvaetsya ot svoego imeni radi priglasheniya na den rozhdeniya, nadeyas na slabuyu vozmozhnost nayti svoego brata. Tem vremenem Aleks, nedavniy vypusknik kolledzha, vozvrashchaetsya domoy i obnaruzhivaet, chto ego realnost razmatyvaetsya, kak nityanoy gobelen. Vedomyy koshkoy, kotoraya probiraetsya skvoz tkan ego razuma, Aleks spuskaetsya v glubiny svoego soznaniya, gde stanovitsya svidetelem nevozmozhnogo: zhenshchina, zapertaya v zheleznoy deve, ischezaet v vozdukhe. Videnie, kotoroe razzhigaet v nem neistrebimuyu oderzhimost i grozit razrushit granitsy ego mira.

- Boy v YIIK: A Post-Modern RPG - eto arkannyy tanets, poshagovaya sistema, gde igroki ispolzuyut obychnoe oruzhie protiv prichudlivykh sushchestv, kotorym pomogaet sila Karty. Kogda igroki ili vragi poluchayut uron, oni nachinayut krovotochit, i kazhdoe deystvie, sovershennoe vo vremya krovotecheniya, priblizhaet ikh k porazheniyu. Eto gonka so vremenem - perezhit vraga i ostanovit potok krovi.

- Peremeshchaytes po landshaftam, kotorye stirayut gran mezhdu realnostyu i snom. Eti prostranstva napolneny slozhnymi golovolomkami, smertelnymi lovushkami i strannymi protivnikami, kotorye brosayut vyzov vashemu vospriyatiyu, razdvigaya granitsy togo, chto vy schitaete realnostyu.

- Povestvovanie pereklyuchaetsya mezhdu tochkami zreniya Aleksa i Bezymyannogo rebenka, uvlekaya vas v ikh otdelnye, no perepletayushchiesya realnosti, kazhdyy povorot kotorykh raskryvaet bolee glubokie sloi ikh sudeb.
Представьте, что в 1983 году не было кри: Predstavte, chto v 1983 godu ne bylo krizisa industrii videoigr. V takom mire i nachinaetsya deystvie vizualnogo romana Arcade Spirits. 20XX god. Arkady vsyo eshche neveroyatno populyarny. Vash personazh nakhodit rabotu v mestnoy arkade pod nazvaniem Funplex sredi ekstsentrichnykh geroev...
Помогите Коулу отомстить злому «Скауту»:
Pomogite Koulu otomstit zlomu «Skautu» i nagloy kiberneticheskoy kompanii, kotoraya uvolila ego s raboty. Reshayte golovolomki, vzlamyvayte akkaunty i ne pozvolyayte otdelu kiberbezopasnosti zakhvatit razvivayushchuyusya sistemu iskusstvennogo intellekta. No vskore to, chto nachinaetsya kak prostoy akt mesti, pererastaet v nechto, ot chego Koul bolshe nikogda ne mozhet uyti..
Golovolomki vklyuchayut v sebya bystroe obedinenie tsepochek chisel, chtoby oboyti mery bezopasnosti i pozaimstvovat dengi korporatsiy. Po mere togo, kak II «Razvedchik» uznayot vsyo bolshe tryukov, Chained brosit vyzov vashey lovkosti i predpolozheniyam o tom, chego mozhet stoit kholodnaya mest.
One Piece: Pirate Warriors 4 — часть сер:
One Piece: Pirate Warriors 4 — chast serii boevikov Pirate Warriors! Okazhites na nastoyashchem pole boya One Piece, gde rushatsya zdaniya i ataki podnimayut oblaka pyli, i pochuvstvuyte sebya chastyu mira One Piece!
Seriya Pirate Warriors — eto rezultat uspeshnogo sliyaniya populyarnogo anime ONE PIECE s zakhvatyvayushchim igrovym protsessom serii Warriors. Na segodnyashniy den prodano uzhe bolee chetyrekh millionov kopiy igr serii!
Srazhaytes s ordami vragov i puteshestvuyte vmeste s predannymi soyuznikami po detalno vossozdannomu miru anime One Piece!
Novye elementy, kotorye nevozmozhno bylo realizovat v predydushchikh igrakh serii, vyvodyat boi v Pirate Warriors na kachestvenno novyy uroven!
Египет, 1930-ый год. Стёртая из памяти ч: Egipet, 1930-yy god. Styortaya iz pamyati chelovechestva i pogrebyonnaya v bezymennoy grobnitse vedma-tsaritsa Seteki vnov vernulas s togo sveta..
KAMIKO is a game styled around Japanese:
KAMIKO is a game styled around Japanese Shinto beliefs.
Fight as priestesses called "KAMIKO" and battle against demons while solving puzzles to make your way through the stages. 
Look no further if you are looking for an arcade action game with a twist!

Each stage has several Torii (gates) which are magically sealed. 
Find a way to break all the seals to make your way to the stage boss.

Another fun and easy original created by indie games SKIPMORE.
Станьте спутником плюшевого медведя Тэдд:
Stante sputnikom plyushevogo medvedya Teddi, kotoryy vynuzhden otpravitsya v mrachnoe priklyuchenie, chtoby spasti svoyu khozyayku Alisiyu iz mira grez i izvrashchennykh detskikh fantaziy. Komu, kak ne davno zabytoy pylnoy igrushke, borotsya za zhizn povzroslevshey devochki?

The Darkest Tales — slozhnaya i uvlekatelnaya avantyura, polnaya uznavaemykh personazhey i skazochnykh peyzazhey. Zdes vam ne raz pridetsya zadumatsya nad neodnoznachnymi zhiznennymi voprosami.


Skazka — lozh
Vas zhdut khorosho znakomye s detstva geroi, tolko vryad li eta vstrecha budet khot skolko-nibud radostnoy: pryanichnye chelovechki zhazhdut raspotroshit vse zhivoe, Spyashchaya krasavitsa yavno ne vysypaetsya poslednie paru stoletiy, a Rusalochka bolshe pokhodit na morskuyu vedmu, nezheli na nevinnoe ditya morey.


Teddi Ruki-Nozhnitsy
Glavnyy geroy — tot eshche master na vse ruki. Iz nozhnits smasteril sebe i oruzhie blizhnego boya, i luk, a iz igolok u nego poluchilis moshchnye strely i kryuk dlya obkhoda prepyatstviy. V borbe so zlom vse podruchnye sredstva khoroshi.


Tma vperedi
Kazhdyy uroven igry — eto uznavaemyy, no iskazhennyy skazochnyy mir, napolnennyy bitvami, prepyatstviyami i sekretami. V etom puteshestvii vam predstoit nabratsya opyta, razvit parochku vetok talantov i proyti mnozhestvo ispytaniy — ot srazheniy s krovozhadnymi rezinovymi utochkami do issledovaniy zamka velikanov v oblachnom korolevstve.


The Darkest Tales — igra s glubokim i tainstvennym syuzhetom. Pobezhdaya monstrov, vy budete raskryvat zagadki mira nochnykh koshmarov. Chem zhe zakonchitsya eta skazka? Reshat vam.
Split your attention in Damaged In Trans:
Split your attention in Damaged In Transit!

This brain-splitting action-puzzler will leave you cross-eyed! Simultaneously pilot your two drones and help them deliver their precious cargo. Spikes, pitfalls, flamethrowers and enemy robots will threaten your shipment as you trek across 125 levels of desert oases, coal mines, ports, oil rigs, and the core of the Earth!!! Deftly pilot your drones around the map and use the items you find to open pathways and get those packages delivered safely!

Embrace the miracle of automated delivery!

Features
• Single Player - Juggle both drones by yourself
• Local Co-Op - Juggle both drones with a friend! Each player takes half the controls
• 125 levels over 5 Worlds
• Spikes!
• Lava!
• Traps!
• Spikes!
• Evil Robots!
• More Spikes!
\"El Hijo - A Wild West Tale\" – это увл:
"El Hijo - A Wild West Tale" – eto uvlekatelnaya igra v stile spagetti-vestern, v kotoroy shestiletniy malchik s vashey pomoshchyu razyskivaet svoyu mat.

V shestiletnem vozraste "El Khidzho" dolzhen proyti i oboyti opasnosti svoego mira. Po mere togo, kak on preodolevaet vse ispytaniya, on obretaet uverennost v sebe i khitrost, a vmeste s etim i drugie skhemy, pozvolyayushchie oboyti svoikh vragov. Ego epicheskoe puteshestvie vedet v dalniy monastyr, surovuyu i neumolimuyu pustynyu i pogranichnyy gorod, izobiluyushchiy prestupnostyu i zlodeyaniem.

Puteshestvie nachinaetsya, kogda na fermera i ee syna napadayut bandity, kotorye razrushayut ikh fermu do osnovaniya. Mat reshaet ostavit malchika v uedinennom monastyre, chtoby spasti ego. Odnako tam proiskhodit chto-to neladnoe, i on planiruet svoy pobeg. 

"El Khidzho – skazka o dikom zapade" – eto nenasilstvennaya stels-igra, v kotoroy vy igraete ozornogo igrivogo malchika. V etoy igre na osnove Shadowplay El Khidzho chasto prikhoditsya pryatatsya. Bez nenuzhnogo dobavleniya novoy mekhaniki, igrovoy protsess estestvennym obrazom rasshiryaetsya, tak kak variatsii sushchestvuyushchey mekhaniki postepenno vvodyatsya, a zatem obedinyayutsya dlya uvelicheniya slozhnosti. Eti povoroty znakomoy mekhaniki chasto yavlyayutsya rezultatom raznoobraznykh, vse bolee opasnykh sred, kotorye El Khidzho dolzhen proyti, chtoby dostich svoey konechnoy tseli.

– Vyzhivayte na Dikom Zapade s umom yunogo geroya.
– Issleduyte temnye monastyri, pustyni i goroda v mire spagetti-vesterna.
– Obedinyaysya s tenyami, chtoby spryatatsya ot prestupnikov.
– Reshayte igrivo khitrye zagadki okruzhayushchey sredy.
– Ispolzuyte igrivyy arsenal takticheskikh igrushek, chtoby obkhodit i otvlekat raznykh desperado.
– Vdokhnovlyayte drugikh detey, stremitsya k svobode.
– Naslazhdaytes zakhvatyvayushchim syuzhetom otvazhnogo syna, razyskivayushchego svoyu mat.
RAZED — быстрый как молния одиночный ран:
RAZED — bystryy kak molniya odinochnyy ranner-platformer dlya tekh, kto lyubit skorostnye prokhozhdeniya. Stavte rekordy skorostnykh zabegov po dinamichnym neonovym urovnyam, primenyaya takie sposobnosti, kak maksimalnoe uskorenie, zatyazhnye pryzhki, ukhody v zanos, moshchnye udary i stremitelnye uvoroty, chtoby preodolevat prepyatstviya i nakhodit srezki v borbe za pervye mesta v onlayn-reytinge igrokov. No pomnite: sposobnosti raskhoduyut energiyu, a esli ona upadet do nulya, vashi bashmaki vzorvutsya (vmeste s vami)... 

KAZhDYY UROVEN SLOZhNEE PREDYDUShchEGO 
Sovershayte zabegi na 60 dinamichnykh urovnyakh v 6 unikalnykh mirakh, u kazhdogo iz kotorykh svoy sobstvennyy vizualnyy stil, razblokiruemaya sposobnost i napryazhennaya bitva s bossom. 

PROKLADYVAYTE SVOY MARShRUT 
Otklonyaytes ot protorennoy dorozhki i prokladyvayte svoy marshrut, ustanavlivaya rekordy skorosti prokhozhdeniya i poluchaya otsenku S. 

ONLAYN-REYTING I GONKI S PRIZRAKAMI 
Sorevnuytes s igrokami vsego mira i beyte ikh rekordy iz onlayn-reytinga ili broste vyzov prizrakam svoikh druzey v ramkakh asinkhronnogo pervenstva.

SKOROSTNYE PROKhOZhDENIYa BEZ LIShNEY SUETY
Kogda rech idet o pogone za sovershenstvom, ozhidanie neumestno. Uzhe yasno, chto tselevogo vremeni ne dostich? Zhmite knopku perezapuska, chtoby vernutsya v nachalo urovnya, ne tratya vremeni na ego zagruzku. 

SEKRETNYE UROVNI DLYa SAMYKh LOVKIKh
Zadeystvuyte polnyy nabor sposobnostey, chtoby otyskat i proyti samye slozhnye urovni RAZED.
Приготовьтесь к скоростным и ярким развл:
Prigotovtes k skorostnym i yarkim razvlecheniyam v Trailblazers — pervuyu posekundnuyu arkadnuyu gonku dlya neskolkikh igrokov. Razukraste trassu svoimi dinamichnymi gonochnymi liniyami, uskortes s tsvetom komandy i perekhitrite protivnika v stremlenii k finishnoy linii. Chem bolshe krasite, tem bystree nesetes!

Trailblazers — innovatsionnaya kooperativnaya gonochnaya igra s neprevzoydennym protsessom prokhozhdeniya trassy. Gonyayte v komandakh do trekh igrokov v kazhdoy. Risuyte luchshie gonochnye linii i uskoryaytes do beshenykh skorostey. Zarabotayte ochki umeniya za stilnoe vozhdenie i prolozhite put k pobede! Okunites v stremitelnye skorostnye gonki dlya 6 igrokov po seti ili 4 igrokov na lokalnom razdelennom ekrane s dobavochnymi protivnikami po seti i II. 

• Razukraste trassu vo vremya gonki i sozdayte dinamichnye gonochnye linii dlya uskoreniya... Ni odna gonka ne pokhozha na druguyu!

• Risuyte, uskoryaytes i gonyaytes vmeste s tovarishchami po komande, obgonyaya protivnikov i nabiraya ochki za stilnoe i effektnoe vozhdenie.

• Raznye igrovye rezhimy: 3 na 3, gonki s partnerom, odinochnye zaezdy i ne tolko! A eshche vas zhdet polnotsennaya syuzhetnaya kampaniya.

• Igrayte v odinochku, a takzhe na razdelennom ekrane lokalno s druzyami ili po seti s igrokami so vsego mira — dazhe s drugikh platform!

• Eksklyuzivnyy kontent dlya Nintendo Switch™! Gonyayte drug protiv druga lokalno vmeste s novym personazhem i avtomobilem libo prinimayte uchastie neposredstvenno v kubkovykh turnirakh, chtoby vernutsya domoy s zolotom!
Remnant: From the Ashes – шутер на выжив:
Remnant: From the Ashes – shuter na vyzhivanie ot tretego litsa, deystvie kotorogo proiskhodit v postapokalipticheskom mire, zakhvachennom monstrami. V roli odnogo iz poslednikh predstaviteley chelovechestva, v odinochku ili v kompanii odnogo-dvukh tovarishchey, vam predstoit srazitsya s ordami monstrov i epicheskimi bossami, pytayas zakrepitsya na chuzhoy zemle, otstroitsya i vernut sebe utrachennoe.

OSTATKI ChELOVEChESTVA
Mir byl vvergnut v khaos s prikhodom drevnego zla iz drugogo izmereniya. Lyudi proigryvayut voynu za vyzhivanie, no nadezhdu daet tekhnologiya ustanovki portalov v drugie vselennye i parallelnye miry. V portaly otpravlyayutsya poslednie geroi chelovecheskoy rasy s tselyu proniknut v tayny proiskhozhdeniya khlynuvshego na Zemlyu zla, odnovremenno vedya borbu za resursy i territoriyu...

BESKRAYNIE PROSTORY
Dlya issledovaniya dostupny dinamicheski generiruemye miry, vidoizmenyayushchiesya pri novom prokhozhdenii: vas zhdut drugie karty, skhvatki, potentsialnye zadaniya i sobytiya. Vrazhdebnaya sreda i monstruoznye obitateli chetyrekh unikalnykh mirov igry obespechat vse novye ispytaniya s kazhdym vashim prikhodom. Vash deviz zdes – adaptatsiya ili smert.

SOBIRAYTE RESURSY. RAZVIVAYTES. SPETsIALIZIRUYTES.
Pobedy nad smertonosnymi protivnikami i epicheskimi bossami na inoplanetnykh landshaftakh prinesut vam opyt, tsennuyu dobychu i materialy, ispolzuyushchiesya dlya izgotovleniya tselogo arsenala oruzhiya, dospekhov i uluchsheniy, pozvolyayushchikh menyat strategiyu ot skhvatki k skhvatke.

VMESTE MY SILNEE
Vtorzhenie v drugie miry s namereniem polozhit konets kornevoy ugroze – delo opasnoe, i garantii vyzhivaniya net. Chtoby povysit shansy na uspekh, obedinyayte usiliya s drugimi igrokami (do 2). Slazhennaya komandnaya rabota obyazatelna dlya preodoleniya trudneyshikh ispytaniy v igre… i polucheniya tsenneyshey dobychi.
После сильного потрясения оказалось, что:
Posle silnogo potryaseniya okazalos, chto vash mladshiy brat Daniel vladeet telekinezom, iz-za chego vam prishlos bezhat iz doma i spasatsya ot politsii! 

Teper za bezopasnost i vospitanie brata otvechaete vy — shestnadtsatiletniy Shon. No kogda zhizn pytaetsya nauchit kogo-to stol yunogo i vladeyushchego neveroyatnoy siloy tomu, chto khorosho, a chto plokho, posledstviya mogut byt nepredskazuemymi i katastroficheskimi...

Doberites do meksikanskoy granitsy — i vy spaseny. No vot tolko put k ney polon prepyatstviy — a eshchyo radosti, vostorga i opasnostey. Eto puteshestvie splotit bratev… ili razluchit navsegda.

• Syuzhet i aktyorskaya igra byli otmecheny mnozhestvom nagrad.
• Daniel postoyanno uchitsya u Shona, i vashi uroki skazhutsya na dalneyshikh sobytiyakh.
• Vas zhdut potryasayushchaya grafika i prorisovannye vruchnuyu tekstury.
• Originalnyy saundtrek ot kompozitora Life is Strange Dzhonatana Morali sozdayot v igre osobuyu atmosferu, podchyorkivaemuyu litsenzionnymi kompozitsiyami takikh ispolniteley, kak Phoenix, The Streets, Bloc Party, First Aid Kit i t. d.
When an intergalactic crew of sports-lov:
When an intergalactic crew of sports-loving aliens challenges you and your friends to a music-infused pentathlon there’s only one thing to do – grab the nearest garden gnome and take the field! Swing, volley, and score to the music in order to come out on top. 

Add instant multiplayer excitement to any party with FIVE MUSICAL MINI GAMES
Test your rhythmic reflexes with 5 mini games inspired by familiar sports like tennis, hockey, golf, and volleyball.
• Buddy Ball (1-4p): Prepare to put your rhythmic reflexes to the test as you and up to three friends engage in this ball-bashing battle.
• Whacky Bat (1-2p): Go for gold by hitting these Muzicalians' pitches back at them. Build your streak by swinging in-time with the music for maximum points!
• Gobble Golf (1-2p): Match musical patterns to feed some hungry aliens! The more you feed, the higher your score.
• Net Ball (1-2p): Keep the volley going with perfect timing. Don't let these Squibzes psych you out!
• Rhythm Racket (1-4p): It’s a free for all! Protect your goal and knock out the competition with radical rhythmic ricochets.

PLAY ANYWHERE, ANY STYLE
The Nintendo Switch™ gives you the freedom to play Super Beat Sports how you want: inside or outside, single or multiplayer, one controller or two, vertical or horizontally, motion controls or buttons.

MULTIPLAYER EVERYWHERE
Team up or face-off! Add instant multiplayer excitement to any party by playing with up to 3 friends! Whether it is handheld or docked, the competition will be out of this world.

UNLOCK MORE FUN
Unlock new difficulty levels, bats and outfits as you play! Customize your slugger before a match - go traditional or try something ‘special’.
Квест Супер-Момбо - это экшн-платформер!:
Kvest Super-Mombo - eto ekshn-platformer! Metroidvaniya s klassicheskoy arkadnoy mekhanikoy, sumasshedshimi boyami, slozhnymi kombo i mnozhestvom kollektsionnykh predmetov - i vsyo eto v ogromnom vzaimosvyazannom mire!

Poluchayte idealnye kombo na sotnyakh urovney!

Puteshestvuyte po gigantskomu vzaimosvyazannomu miru, sostoyashchemu iz soten oblastey, v kazhdoy iz kotorykh prisutstvuet mnozhestvo slozhnykh vragov. Kto-to budet presledovat vas, kto-to poprobuet zastrelit, a kto-to stanet letat vokrug… A nekotorye iz vragov ochen opasny! Smozhete li vy byt dostatochno bystrymi, chtoby pobedit ikh vsekh v idealnom kombo? 

Nastroyte svoy igrovoy protsess pod svoi nuzhdy s pomoshchyu osobykh sposobnostey!

Razblokiruyte razlichnye formy Mombo, chtoby dostich neveroyatnoy skorosti! I ispolzuyte ikh v svoikh interesakh, chtoby raskryt sekrety i sdelat moshchnye kombo!

Obshchaytes s NPC, pokupayte predmety i poluchayte obnovleniya!

Esli vy perenapryazheny i ustali, rasslabtes i poboltayte so strazhami Subrozy. Oni obyazatelno predlozhat predmety i uluchsheniya, chtoby vy mogli eshche luchshe ispytat sebya.

Spasite zemli Subrozy!

Ne dayte groznomu Korolyu Koshmarov unichtozhit Subrozu. Proyavite sebya davno predskazannym geroem. Vse rasschityvayut na vas i vash gigantskiy yazyk! Gotovy li vy vyyti na ulitsu?
Действие игры происходит на континенте А:
Deystvie igry proiskhodit na kontinente Antariya, gde vy smozhete razdelit radosti i pechali beschislennykh chelovecheskikh sudeb, perepletayushchikhsya vokrug printsessy Iolin, chyu stranu pytaetsya zakhvatit zlobnaya imperiya Geysira.
Razvivaytes i srazhaytes yunitami raznykh klassov! Pobezhdayte vraga vezde, gde tolko mozhete, v polnoy mere ispolzuya superpriyomy i boevoy mekhanizm Magical Gear.
Zdes razvernyotsya potryasayushchaya epicheskaya drama! Naslazhdaytes polotnom istorii, kotoraya po pravu schitaetsya luchshey v sonme rolevykh koreyskikh videoigr.Videotreyler igry.
Отправьтесь в атмосферное нарративное пр: Otpravtes v atmosfernoe narrativnoe priklyuchenie, chtoby nayti lekarstvo dlya gibnushchego goroda. Pogruzites v istoriyu izmuchennoy pary, kotoraya pytaetsya otlichit realnost ot koshmarov i spastis ot ugroz, tayashchikhsya vo tme.
В этом ураганном 2D-экшене вы превратите:
V etom uragannom 2D-ekshene vy prevratites v kung-fu mastera, kotoromu predstoit pobedit mnozhestvo vragov. U vas budet shans otkryt bolee chetverti sotni umeniy, oprobovat raznoobraznoe oruzhie i proyti neprostye ispytaniya.
Vmeste s masterom boevykh iskusstv vam udastsya odolet ogromnoe kolichestvo razyarennykh protivnikov. Vy smozhete pomakhat raznoobraznym oruzhiem, postrelyat iz vsevozmozhnykh pushek, pokatatsya na boevom kone i otkryt krutye sposobnosti!
Upravlenie personazhem proiskhodit s pomoshchyu dvukh knopok-udarov, poetomu vam ne pridetsya zauchivat slozhnye kombo ili zaputannye priemy!
Группа из десяти друзей собирается на уе:
Gruppa iz desyati druzey sobiraetsya na uedinennom gornom kurorte, chtoby vmeste provesti noch v kanun Vsekh Svyatykh.

Odnako to, chto iznachalno zadumyvalos kak veselaya vecherinka na Khellouin, bystro prevrashchaetsya v nastoyashchuyu noch uzhasov. Kogda odnogo iz uchastnikov nakhodyat mertvym, sredi gruppy rasprostranyayutsya strakh i podozritelnost, poskolku druzya ponimayut, chto oni poymany v lovushku vmeste s ubiytsey.

Rassleduyte, doprashivayte i predstavlyayte dokazatelstva, razgadyvaya razlichnye tayny v techenie nochi.

Mozhet byt, vam dazhe udastsya spasti zhizn! Ili vashi vyvody zastavyat vas obvinit kogo-to sovershenno nevinovnogo...?

Kharakteristiki:
* Zagadochnyy vizualnyy roman na 150 000 slov
* 5 razlichnykh kontsovok, v tom chisle 4 plokhikh i 1 s istinnym vinovnikom
* Bloknot s ulikami, chtoby otslezhivat fakty po delu
* Detektivnaya sistema ranzhirovaniya
* Razblokiruemyy bonusnyy kontent
* Originalnyy saundtrek
Inertial Drift — это аркадная гоночная и: Inertial Drift — eto arkadnaya gonochnaya igra, deystvie kotoroy proiskhodit v retro-budushchem v stile devyanostykh. Model upravleniya i potryasayushchaya mekhanika gonok s parnymi stikami obyazatelno ponravitsya!
Become an aquatic animal and join these:
Become an aquatic animal and join these frenetic fights in the depths of the Ocean.
Complete the missions and defeat each boss in this arcade retro game.
Эйва – молодая дочь доктора Кейвора, пож:
Eyva – molodaya doch doktora Keyvora, pozhilogo genialnogo uchenogo, i Seleny, byvshey korolevy Luny. Zhizn Seleny zavisit ot osoboy energii, kotoruyu ey dayut tolko lunnye kristally. No kristally zakonchilis, i vremya na iskhode. Doktor Keyvor poruchaet Eyve otpravitsya na lunu i prinesti kak mozhno bolshe kristallov!

Eyve nuzhno vyzhit v opasnykh katakombakh gluboko pod poverkhnostyu i dat otpor legionu prisheltsev, zakhvativshikh kontrol nad Lunoy i okazavshikhsya ne takimi uzh primitivnymi. Ikh mir polon uzhasayushchikh tekhnologiy, smertonosnykh lovushek i vooruzhennykh boytsov. Vskore Eyva osoznaet, chto edinstvennyy sposob spasti mat – eto spasti Lunu ot samoy sebya.

 Osobennosti:

 - Issleduyte raznoobraznyy mir ruchnoy raboty, kotoryy ne naskuchit ot nachala do kontsa
 - Nakhodite spryatannye uluchsheniya i potaynye oblasti
 - 10 krasochnykh urovney
 - 11 epichnykh srazheniy s bossami
 - Lokalnyy kooperativnyy rezhim dlya dvukh igrokov
The mountain awaits.\n\nSnowboard your w:
The mountain awaits.

Snowboard your way down the dizzying Descent! Face complex, tricky courses as you make your way further and further down the Mountain's slopes. Meet the ghosts of those who have braved its slopes before you. And maybe - just maybe - you can reach the End.

Are you fast enough? Are you skilled enough?

There's only one way to find out.
Layers of Fear 2 делает упор на исследов:
Layers of Fear 2 delaet upor na issledovanie i syuzhet, a vse obektivy napravlyaet na vas. Vy ne prosto vzhivaetes v svoego personazha — vy i est personazh. Eta rol prinadlezhit vam. Ona napisana spetsialno dlya vas. No budte ostorozhny, ved realnost obmanchiva.

Proshloe predopredelilo vashu lichnost i darovalo neobkhodimye dlya vashego remesla navyki. Eto zhe proshloe obezobrazilo vas glubokimi shramami — skrytymi oto vsekh, pokhoronennymi v glubine vashey dushi. Vy zaryvaete eti vospominaniya vse glubzhe, no ispolzuete priobretennyy opyt, ved on pozvolyaet vam sygrat kogo — ili chto — ugodno.

Svet prozhektora vykhvatyvaet iz temnoty vash bezmolvnyy siluet. Vokrug ni zvuka — lish bienie serdtsa i plesk voln, razbivayushchikhsya o bort. Izdali donositsya nizkiy vlastnyy golos:

«Igrayte!»

Студия Sunsoft возвращется, чтобы познак:
Studiya Sunsoft vozvrashchetsya, chtoby poznakomit igrokov s 8-bitnoy yaponskoy klassikoy! V retro-kollektsii SUNSOFT is Back! Retro Game Selection vas zhdut tri igry legendarnogo yaponskogo izdatelstva epokhi 8 bit plyus odin madzhong, kotorye vpervye byli perevedeny na angliyskiy yazyk! Krome perevodov na drugie yazyki, vse igry takzhe poluchili ryad uluchsheniy, kotorye sdelayut igrovoy protsess bolee priyatnym i shchadyashchim dlya sovremennogo pokoleniya igrokov.
