Добро пожаловать на Дикий Запад, каким в:
Dobro pozhalovat na Dikiy Zapad, kakim vy ego eshche nikogda ne videli. Zaglyanite vmeste s Uorrenom v samye temnye ugolki chelovecheskoy dushi i popytaytes vyzhit v mire, polnom slozhnogo vybora i eshche bolee tyazhelykh posledstviy. Potomu chto v etom mire smert vsegda khodit ryadom, a chernye pakty, kotorye vy zaklyuchaete s silami za granyu chelovecheskogo ponimaniya, vsegda budut presledovat vashikh blizkikh.

Sovershite puteshestvie vglub mira Hard West i poznakomtes s yarkimi igrovymi personazhami, chi sudby tesno perepletayutsya s vashey. V khode igry vmeste vam nuzhno budet prinyat protivorechivye resheniya, chtoby raskryt velikie plany drevnikh sil. Vy smozhete obnaruzhit glubokiy povestvovatelnyy syuzhet s neskolkimi kontsovkami, kotorye zavisyat ot vybora, sdelannogo v khode igry.

OSOBENNOSTI

- Unikalnyy «potustoronniy» mir Dikogo zapada: issleduyte mir, v kotorom zapadnye legendy vstrechayutsya s demonami, zagadochnymi ritualami i satanistskimi kultami, i gde mertvetsy mogut snova khodit po zemle. Za platu.
- Uvlekatelnyy boy: upravlyayte chlenami komandy (ot 1 do 4) v poshagovoy skhvatke i ovladeyte razlichnymi spetsialnymi navykami na osnove vesternov.
- Vybor i sudba: pogruzites v glubokuyu syuzhetnuyu liniyu, v kotoroy resheniya, prinyatye vo vremya boevykh stsenariev i mezhdu nimi, otrazyatsya na budushchikh sobytiyakh i izmenyat velikie sudby protivorechivoy gruppy yarkikh personazhey.
- Delo sluchaya: ispolzuyte sistemu boya, kotoraya ne zavisit ot chistoy sluchaynosti. Udacha — vot edinstvennyy strazh, pozvolyayushchiy vstupit v boy i vyigrat ego. 
- Dinamicheskaya zashchita: izmenite khod boya blagodarya rasshirennoy sisteme zashchity ot obektov okruzhayushchey sredy.
- Obnaruzhenie teney: nakhodite vragov vne zony vidimosti po tenyam, kotorye oni otbrasyvayut, i zvukam, kotorye oni izdayut.
- Rikoshety: ispolzuyte metallicheskie predmety dlya strelby za predely zony vidimosti. Eto pozvolyaet uluchshit takticheskie parametry boya i vypolnyat planirovanie na raznykh urovnyakh.

Один взгляд в глаза смерти заставил силь:
Odin vzglyad v glaza smerti zastavil silnogo i mudrogo voina Gallara iskat sposob vechno naslazhdatsya radostyami zhizni. V drevnikh pisaniyakh skazano, chto v Doline Vechnosti est misticheskaya peshchera, gde khranitsya uteryannaya relikviya, sposobnaya podarit nashedshim ee khrabretsam vechnuyu zhizn. Vooruzhennyy toporom i vernoy kirkoy, Gallar otpravlyaetsya v severnye gory v poiskakh epicheskogo priklyucheniya, kotoroe mozhet stoit emu zhizni ili podarit emu zhizn vechnuyu.

Osnovnye kharakteristiki:

• Issleduyte sluchayno sgenerirovannye urovni! Etot platformer v stile roguelite i v zhanre ekshn predlozhit vam novye zakhvatyvayushchie vpechatleniya kazhdyy raz, kogda vy igraete.

• Pobezhdayte vragov i razvivayte svoego personazha! Srazhaytes s vragami i bossami, chtoby otkryvat novye marshruty i nakaplivat opyt, sovershenstvovat i nastraivat svoego personazha po svoemu zhelaniyu.

• Sobirayte mineraly, chtoby sozdavat luchshee snaryazhenie! Soberite rudy i chertezhi oruzhiya, kotorye vy naydete v glubinakh peshchery, i otnesite ikh derevenskomu kuznetsu, chtoby vykovat bolee sovershennoe snaryazhenie. I srazhaytes s eshche bolee silnymi i mogushchestvennymi monstrami. 

• Nastroyte svoy igrovoy protsess s pomoshchyu run i predmetov!Naydite v okrestnostyakh peshchery runy, kotorye pridadut vashemu geroyu dopolnitelnye vozmozhnosti. Sobirayte nabory iz trekh run, sozdavayte predmety i nastraivayte svoego personazha v predpochtitelnom stile. Vyberite strategiyu i nastroyte svoy igrovoy protsess!

• Srazites s bossami v epicheskikh bitvakh! Vam predstoit srazitsya so zlymi bossami, kotorye brosyat vyzov vsem vashim silam i taktike. No budte ostorozhny: poskolku urovni generiruyutsya sluchaynym obrazom, vy mozhete srazu otkryt dveri bossov. Imeyte mudrost v osoznanii svoikh predelov i ponimanii, v kakoy imenno moment ikh stoit ispytat.

• Dostignite bessmertiya! Pomogite Gallaru prodolzhit ego dolgoe i slavnoe puteshestvie v vechnost. Smozhete li vy do kontsa srazhatsya za uteryannuyu relikviyu?

Землю захватили пришельцы! Качайся, стре:
Zemlyu zakhvatili prisheltsy! Kachaysya, strelyay i probivaysya cherez ordy monstrov-mutantov na puti k otvratitelnym bossam. Na planetu napali Zvyozdnye Spory, prevrashchayushchie zemnykh sushchestv v zlobnykh superzhukov. Khuzhe togo, naglyy prishelets ustroil sebe novyy dom pryamo u tebya na golove. Vprochem, eto ne tak uzh i strashno, ved novoyavlennyy «luchshiy drug» podaril tebe silu dlya srazheniy s tolpami mutantov i umenie obrashchatsya s oruzhiem, kotoroe sposobno perelomit khod voyny v polzu lyudey.
Skitayas po syurrealisticheskim peyzazham, ty vstretish bratev po oruzhiyu, byushchikhsya protiv lyutykh vragov. Chto zhe delat? Spasat boevykh tovarishchey ili, poslushavshis inoplanetnogo golosa v tvoey golove, pozhirat ikh radi samouluchsheniya? Esli budesh stoykim i pobedish Zvezdnye Spory, to, byt mozhesh, spasesh vsekh… i sebya samogo.

Pirate heroine Nelly Cootalot takes on the villainous Baron Widebeard in this point and click adventure game. Meet a cast of outlandish characters and face perplexing challenges in your quest for the Treasure of the Seventh Sea.
What is Baron Widebeard planning? Can he be stopped? In what way is a frozen volcano involved?
To answer these questions comes Nelly Cootalot: pirate heroine and defender of endangered and adorable creatures. Nelly’s journey will take her from Port Rubicund in the South Seas to the lonely isle of Gloomholm in the icy north. She’ll meet outlandish characters and face perplexing challenges in her quest for the Treasure of the Seventh Sea.
Explore a beautiful hand-drawn world, created by award-winning comedian & filmmaker Alasdair Beckett-King.
Meet outlandish characters voiced by talented & hilarious actors and comedians, with credits including Doctor Who, Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy & Broken Sword 5.
Help Nelly foil Baron Widebeard by tackling a variety of original & challenging puzzles. Race aristocrats, charter an airship & lie to strangers with no consequences.

Команда лесорубов отчаянно пытается выпо:
Komanda lesorubov otchayanno pytaetsya vypolnit svoyu rabotu, no bukvalno vse vokrug stavit im palki v kolesa. Vypolnyayte zakazy, ukladyvaytes v sroki, tushite pozhary, srazhaytes s piratami i vrednymi obezyankami! Puteshestvuyte v prostranstve i vremeni, igraya v odinochku, s druzyami ili protiv nikh!
Lesoruby protiv khaosa — topory natocheny, komanda nagotove, rubashki otglazheny! Vse sily prirody obedinilis protiv vas, i edinstvennyy put k pobede — slazhennaya komandnaya rabota. V etoy bezumnoy gonke so vremenem vam nado valit les i zagonyat skotinu v khlev... Zvuchit prosto? Akh da, my zabyli skazat pro meteority, dinozavrov i samu matushku-prirodu, gotovykh ostanovit vas lyuboy tsenoy. Vremya ogranicheno, tak chto prokladyvayte nestandartnye marshruty, rabotayte soobshcha, a glavnoe — budte gotovy ko vsemu!
Cherez prostranstvo i vremya! Esli gde-to vyroslo derevo, lesorubu vsegda est rabota. Eto neveroyatnoe puteshestvie privedet vas v samye raznye epokhi i ugolki Zemli — i ne tolko! Chem dalshe vy prodvinetes, tem bolshe vstretite novykh dekoratsiy, unikalnykh sobytiy i igrovykh mekhanik. Vas budut zhdat novye zhivotnye: bolshie i malenkie, milye i ne ochen — odnikh zakhochetsya potiskat, a ot drugikh spryatatsya v kustakh. V obshchem, skuchat ne pridetsya! A chtoby na pamyat ostalis zabavnye skrinshoty, my prigotovili mnozhestvo smeshnykh oblikov dlya personazhey.
Наступил 2084 год, и мир склонился перед:
Nastupil 2084 god, i mir sklonilsya pered gruppoy korporatsiy — Sindikatom. V siyayushchem neonom gorode zhiteli paralizovany strakhom pered armiyami naemnikov i ikh gospodami. Tayny zdes prinyato tshchatelno pryatat. Tayny, kotorye nuzhno raskryt. Vy upravlyaete «Alfoy» — geroem, kotoryy ne pomnit proshlogo. 

- Neveroyatno dinamichnoe priklyuchenie v zhanre «stels», v kotorom klassicheskie shpionskie koshki-myshki a-lya Metal Gear proiskhodyat v neonovom kiberpankovom mire s puteshestviyami vo vremeni! Pryachtes v teni i manipuliruyte vremenem, chtoby odolevat protivnikov i obkhodit sistemy bezopasnosti.

- Primerte na sebya rol «Alfy» — bezhentsa, kotoryy skryvaetsya i nichego ne pomnit o sebe. Vy dolzhny proniknut v tenevuyu pravitelstvennuyu organizatsiyu, chtoby vernut svoi vospominaniya i organizovat vosstanie v gorode, chto stradaet pod pyatoy diktatora.

- Issleduyte kiberpankovyy mir i ishchite otvety na voprosy o svoem proshlom. Razblokiruyte oruzhie, ustroystva i sposobnosti, s pomoshchyu kotorykh vy budete skryvatsya, obkhodit sistemy bezopasnosti i odolevat protivnikov, kotorye stanovyatsya vsyo silnee.

- Pyat razlichnykh rayonov, v kazhdom iz kotorykh zhdut unikalnye ispytaniya i vidy. Ot gryaznykh ulits i krysh, kotorye okhranyaet politsiya, do vysokotekhnologichnykh laboratoriy so slozhnymi sistemami bezopasnosti, — preodolevayte vse prepyatstviya i budte na shag vperedi protivnika blagodarya otlichnym refleksam i ostromu umu.

- V kazhdom rayone vas zhdut surovye bossy i protivniki. Sobirayte ustroystva i menyayushchie vremya sposobnosti, chtoby nayti unikalnye strategii dlya pobedy nad vragami.

- Quantum Replica — igra-antiutopiya, v kotoroy na tyomnykh ulitsakh totalitarnogo gosudarstva vspykhivaet siyayushchiy neon, a sobytiya igrovogo protsessa smenyayut drug druga s golovokruzhitelnoy skorostyu.
Вынужденная переехать, молодой и мятежны:
Vynuzhdennaya pereekhat, molodoy i myatezhnyy podrostok - Violett, pereezzhaet vmeste s semyoy v staryy, strashnyy dom posredi nichego. Vynuzhdennaya pokinut svoikh druzey i proshluyu zhizn v gorode, Violett predstavlyaet naskolko skuchna budet zhizn v selskoy mestnosti. Provodya den za dnyom, skuchaya v svoey komnate, v kotoroy absolyutno nechego delat. No chto ona ne mogla sebe predstavit, tak eto to,

Inc. vpervye dlya PlayStation Portable. Igra vyshla 1 sentyabrya 2011 goda v Yaponii, a 15 yanvarya 2013 goda byla vypushchena v Severnoy Amerike (23 yanvarya v Evrope) izdatelem-lokalizatorom XSEED Games. V Yaponii izvestna pod abbreviaturoy BS, v ostalnom mire - BoS.
Nekotorye studenty akademii Kisaragi posle vypolnennogo rituala Sachiko-san, vyzhivayut i vozvrashchayutsya v svoy mir. Vospominaniya ob umershikh stirayutsya s litsa Zemli, oni ostayutsya tolko u vyzhivshikh. Bolshe vsekh opechalena Naomi: ona pala v depressiyu i nakhodyas v svoey komnate, ey kazhetsya, chto ona razgovarivaet so svoey podrugoy. Eyo mama, posle obshcheniya s psikhologom po telefonu, pytalas obyasnit docheri, chto umershikh odnoklassnikov ne sushchestvovalo, no eto tolko vyvodit Naomi iz sebya. V rezultate mama nasilno dayot Naomi kakie-to tabletki — predpolozhitelno, uspokoitelnoe..
Razrabotchiki pozitsioniruyut igru ne tolko kak sikvel Corpse Party: Blood Covered, no i kak prikvel, midkvel i prosto «alternativnaya vselennaya».Corpse Party: Blood Drive i Corpse Party: Blood Covered ...Repeated Fear sm. zdes.

Watara Supervision (также известная как:
Watara Supervision (takzhe izvestnaya kak «QuickShot Supervision» v Velikobritanii) — portativnaya naladonnaya vosmibitnaya igrovaya konsol IV pokoleniya, eksklyuzivno razrabotannaya i vypushchennaya kompaniey Watara v nachale 90-kh v Gonkonge po $49.95 (~$106 v tsenakh 2022-go) s kartridzhami ot $8.95 do $14.95 ($19—$32) za odnu igru, a pozzhe byla litsenzirovana i vo vsyom mire: v Danii kompaniey Vini Spil (pod nazvaniem «Vini Supervision»), Hartung v Germanii i Niderlandakh («Hartung SV-100 Supervision»), Audiosonic («Audio Sonic Supervision») vo Frantsii, Italii i ryade drugikh stran Evropy, a takzhe pod markami «Travell Mate», «Electrolab» i dr.
«Watara Supervision» poyavilas v 1992 godu i byla dlya svoego vremeni dostatochno prodvinutoy v tekhnicheskoy chasti. Na korpuse konsoli raspolagalis razyomy dlya kartridzha, naushnikov, sprava nakhodilsya regulyator gromkosti, sleva — kontrasta ekrana, razyom adaptera i D-subminiature dlya podsoedineniya vtoroy konsoli i igry vdvoyom i TV Link — s pomoshchyu kotorogo mozhno bylo podklyuchat konsol k televizoru, kak igrovuyu TV-pristavku, a v standartnom komplekte s Supervision postavlyalas igra Crystball, klon arkanoida, 4 batareyki i naushniki.Tekhnicheskie kharakteristiki

PlataGO! — невероятно простой конструкто:
PlataGO! — neveroyatno prostoy konstruktor igr v zhanre «platformer», kotoryy ponravitsya vsem tvorcheskim naturam nezavisimo ot vozrasta!

Vam ne pridetsya programmirovat ili pisat slozhnye skripty: 100% deystviy v PlataGO! vypolnyaetsya s pomoshchyu peretaskivaniya myshyu, a znachit, vy s khodu mozhete pristupit k sozdaniyu igr v zhanre «platformer». Nikakikh slozhnostey, nikakogo obucheniya — prosto zapustite konstruktor i tvorite!

Bolee togo, vy mozhete tut zhe poigrat v sozdannyy vami uroven po nazhatiyu odnoy knopki, chto krayne uproshchaet testirovanie vashego platformera! Dazhe esli u vas net nikakogo opyta, vsego za neskolko minut vy smozhete sozdat prostoy uroven.

Razmestit platformu mozhno prostym peretaskivaniem gotovogo obekta iz menyu. Poluchilos ne to, chto khoteli? Ispravte oshibku s pomoshchyu instrumenta «lastik»! Khotite dobavit na uroven vragov? Prosto perenesite myshyu ponravivshegosya monstra iz menyu!

Konstruktor predlagaet shirokiy vybor gotovykh stroitelnykh blokov, vragov i obektov, tak chto vashemu voobrazheniyu budet gde razgulyatsya! Ispolzuyte trampliny, teleporty i pushki, padayushchie i podvizhnye platformy, lazernye lovushki i reaktivnye rantsy.

Krome togo, v PlataGO! est tselyy nabor retro-stiley, imitiruyushchikh populyarnye igrovye sistemy: vash platformer budet vyglyadet, kak igra iz epokhi NES, SNES, Amiga, Commodore 64 ili Game Boy. Odin shchelchok myshyu — i u vashey igry uzhe drugoy vizualnyy stil!

Cтаньте пилотом легендарного робота Грен:
Ctante pilotom legendarnogo robota Grendayzera i zashchitite vsyu Zemlyu ot sil zla! Prigotovtes k nezabyvaemomu priklyucheniyu so znamenitym boevym robotom Grendayzerom. Eto ekshn-priklyuchenie, osnovannoe na legendarnom anime-seriale, pogruzit vas v mir, sozdannyy Go Nagai, gde vy smozhete stat pilotom samogo moshchnogo robota i dat otpor silam zla.
Posle togo kak planeta Flid byla unichtozhena imperiey Vega, prints Daysuke Umon nashel ubezhishche na Zemle. Doktor Gendzo Umon usynovil printsa, i teper Daysuke zhivet na rancho «Belaya bereza». No vtorzhenie Vegi – lish vopros vremeni, i Daysuke Umon gotov zashchishchat Zemlyu s pomoshchyu Grendayzera – gigantskogo robota, spryatannogo v observatorii Gendzo Umona. Zaruchivshis pomoshchyu Kodzi Kabuto, Daysuke Umon budet otrazhat napadeniya Vegi i srazhatsya s opasnymi robotami-monstrami, kotorym dan prikaz ubit printsa planety Flid.
Igrayte za Daysuke Umona i upravlyayte gigantskim robotom v epicheskikh srazheniyakh s raznoobraznym geympleem. Vy smozhete upravlyat speyserom, letayushchim modulem, v kotorom khranitsya Grendayzer; letayushchey tarelkoy Kodzi Kabuto, igraya v vertikalnom rezhime; a takzhe samim Grendayzerom v srazheniyakh ot 3-go litsa. Provodite legendarnye moshchnye ataki, chtoby unichtozhit uzhasayushchikh monstrov i spasti Zemlyu. Obshchaytes s klyuchevymi personazhami seriala v dialogovykh stsenakh v uznavaemom okruzhenii, vossozdannom v polnom sootvetstvii s originalom. I nakonets, vypolnyayte zadaniya i zarabatyvayte ochki opyta, chtoby poluchat novye umeniya i uluchshat sposobnosti.
Legendarnyy anime-serial «Grendayzer» vpervye pokazali po frantsuzskomu televideniyu bolee 40 let nazad, i s tekh por eta uvlekatelnaya istoriya uspela polyubitsya neskolkim pokoleniyam zriteley. Milliony chelovek po vsemu miru do sikh por pomnyat perevoploshcheniya Grendayzera i ego moshchnye kulaki.

Celestian Tales is a beautifully hand-pa:
Celestian Tales is a beautifully hand-painted JRPG set in a world of questionable morals where opposing views clash, with no clear right or wrong. 
Follow the journey of six Companions, knights sworn to serve and protect the heir of a noble house, as they rise and fall in their struggle to survive a world where one's true enemies are often their closest allies. 
Celestian Tales is full of lush hand-painted environments, emotive portraits, memorable characters and a sprawling engaging moralistic storyline that is told through the eyes of six protagonists. 
The game features a turn-based combat system with plenty of character and party customization options, allowing you to play the game at your own pace and in your own style. 

Features:

Moral Confrontations - Situations are presented to the player throughout the game that force players to face moral questions and beliefs.
Unique Story – By avoiding genre cliches, the story brings a fresh approach to RPG storytelling by allowing players to feel the weight of their character’s actions.
Multiple Story Arcs - 6 Selectable Characters allow you to play the game from 6 different perspectives. Play through the game as all 6 characters for a full experience, and enjoy the twists and secrets unmasked as you follow each of their personal journeys and intrigues.
Traditional RPG Gameplay - Inspired by classic JRPGs with a turn-based RPG battle system, players can develop a personal combat style.
Beautiful Art - Lush hand-painted background visuals and environments with detailed emotive character portraits and animated pixel-art characters create a full and complete world experience.
Epic Music - A sweeping score that captures the pace and emotion of the story as it unfolds.

Zengeon — это ролевая экшн-игра в жанре:
Zengeon — eto rolevaya ekshn-igra v zhanre Roguelite s unikalnymi personazhami, u kazhdogo iz kotorykh est svoy igrovoy stil. Prorubayte put skvoz polchishcha demonov i ustrashayushchikh bossov, ispolzuya sotni kombinatsiy i umeniy!
Sotni let Nebesnaya akademiya zashchishchala pechat v Blagoslovennoy zemle, ne davaya Tyomnoy pustote vtorgnutsya v mir. No... vsyo kogda-nibud zakanchivaetsya. Vo vremya lunnogo zatmeniya chary pechati razorvala velikaya sila, i mir zapolonila Tyomnaya pustota.

Teper zdes snova votsaritsya bog-demon... Vybirayte odnogo iz shesti personazhey, u kazhdogo iz kotorykh est unikalnye ataki, umeniya i predmety.

Imenno vy, student Nebesnoy akademii, dolzhny razognat Tyomnuyu pustotu i vosstanovit pechat v Blagoslovennoy zemle!

- Vybirayte odnogo iz shesti personazhey, kazhdyy iz kotorykh obladaet unikalnymi umeniyami, sposobnostyami i igrovym stilem. 

- Ni odno prokhozhdenie ne pokhozhe na drugoe. Igru mozhno prokhodit beskonechnoe kolichestvo raz, ved karty i razmeshchenie protivnikov postoyanno menyayutsya. Adaptiruyte strategiyu k raznym situatsiyam, sochetayte sotni umeniy i srazhaytes, chtoby poluchit ochki varpa. 

- Vystraivayte personazhey pryamo na khodu. Prinimayte slozhnye resheniya, vybiraya unikalnye usileniya, i pryamo v igre sozdavayte bildy, kotorye idealno podkhodyat vashemu igrovomu stilyu. 

- Soberite do trekh druzey, chtoby igrat vmeste. Obedinites s tovarishchami i vmeste vykhodite na boy s legionami tmy. Chem bolshe igrokov vy soberete, tem slozhnee budet igrat v Zengeon, ved igra dinamicheski nastraivaet uroven slozhnosti.
Может ли плоский мир, стоящий на трёх де:
Mozhet li ploskiy mir, stoyashchiy na tryokh demonakh-medvedyakh, zhit spokoyno? Konechno zhe net! Pogruzites vo vselennuyu tyomnogo slavyanskogo eposa i issleduyte istorii personazhey, prinimaya slozhnye resheniya, vliyayushchie na khod sobytiy. A kot Bayun vam pomozhet. Esli povezyot…
narrativnoe priklyuchenie s rolevymi elementami v settinge vostochnoevropeyskogo i slavyanskogo temnogo fentezi. Samobytnaya vselennaya na osnove skazov i legend. Zakhvatyvayushchie istorii s neozhidannymi syuzhetnymi povorotami. Spletennye v tesnyy klubok sudby personazhey. Tyazhelye moralnye resheniya i ikh posledstviya. Spravites li vy s surovymi ispytaniyami sudby ili besslavno sginete, poluchiv nozh v spinu? Davayte uznaem!
Storona — mesto neprostoe, ne zrya na spinakh trekh demonov-medvedey stoit. Zdes geroi mifov i legend zhivut bok o bok s prostymi lyudmi. Zdes iskrennost i chestnost sosedstvuyut s predatelstvom i kovarstvom. Inomu sudba ulybnetsya — vmig iz krestyan v boyare vzletit. A drugomu plyunet v litso da v chashchobe volkam na sedenie ostavit. Gore i radost, bogatstvo i bednost, zlo i dobro - vse voedino smeshalos, i nozhom ne razdelish. Ty, vprochem, ne boysya. Chuzhie sudby menyat - delo nekhitroe. So svoey by spravitsya. Glavnoe - pervyy shag sdelat. A esli otvety na vazhnye voprosy otyskat vzdumal — togda k Bayunu tebe doroga. No za znaniya poroy i zhiznyu platyat, uchti. Skharchit tebya kot i ne podavitsya, esli vdrug chto ne tak poydet…
Dead End Job — это процедурно генерируем:
Dead End Job — eto protsedurno generiruemyy shuter, kotoryy pozvolit vam pochuvstvovat sebya nastoyashchim okhotnikom na nechist.

Vy igraete za Gektora Plazma — sotrudnika kompanii «Bes-I-zydi» i eksperta po paranormalnym yavleniyam. Vasha zadacha — lovit prizrakov v ofisakh, restoranakh i prochikh zavedeniyakh.

Okhottes na fantomov v odinochku ili s drugom v rezhime sovmestnogo prokhozhdeniya.

Pri sozdanii igry razrabotchiki cherpali vdokhnovenie iz lyubimykh vsemi umoritelnykh i sumasshedshikh multfilmov 90-kh.

Oshchutite azart: kazhdyy pobezhdennyy prizrak i spasennyy gorozhanin uvelichivaet schet, kotoryy vy vystavlyaete klientu. Postigayte azy okhoty na nechist pod chutkim rukovodstvom nastavnitsy, a tochnee, ee fantoma: vam predstoit spasti ee dushu, inache ona riskuet navsegda ostatsya privideniem (samaya nezavidnaya uchast po mneniyu chitateley zhurnala «Okhotnik na prizrakov»).
Без сомнения, Стамбул - одна из лучших н:
Bez somneniya, Stambul - odna iz luchshikh nastolnykh igr iz kogda-libo opublikovannykh. Dlinnyy spisok eyo nagrad i pochyotnykh zvaniy govorit sam za sebya:

2015 Nederlandse Spellenprijs - nominant Best Expert Game

Nominant «Vybor Meeples 2014»
Pobeditel Kennerspiel des Jahres 2014 g.
Mezhdunarodnaya nagrada geymerov (International Gamers Award) 2014 goda - Obshchaya strategiya: Mnogopolzovatelskaya nominatsiya
Nominant premii Hra roku za 2014 g.
Pobeditel Gouden Ludo 2014 g.
Nominant nastolnoy igry Golden Geek 2014 goda
Nominant na luchshuyu strategicheskuyu nastolnuyu igru Golden Geek 2014 g.
Nominant «Luchshaya semeynaya nastolnaya igra Golden Geek 2014»

V nashey tsifrovoy versii my sokhranili vse funktsii, kotorye sdelali Stambul izlyublennym u poklonnikov, no takzhe rasshirili eyo s pomoshchyu ryada instrumentov i funktsiy, dostupnykh tolko na tsifrovoy platforme. My sokhranili oshchushchenie podlinnosti nastolnoy igry s tem udobstvom, kotoroe mozhno ozhidat ot elektronnogo ustroystva.

Tak o chem igra?

V Stambule vy vozglavlyaete gruppu iz 1 torgovtsa i ego 4 pomoshchnikov na 16 torgovykh mestakh na bazare. V kazhdom takom meste vy mozhete vypolnit opredelennoe deystvie. Odnako zadacha sostoit v tom, chto dlya togo, chtoby sovershit deystvie, vy dolzhny otkomandirovat tuda svoego torgovtsa i pomoshchnika, a zatem ostavit pomoshchnika, kotoryy budet zanimatsya vsemi podrobnostyami, poka vy sosredotocheny na bolee vazhnykh delakh. Esli vy khotite ispolzovat etogo pomoshchnika pozzhe, vash prodavets dolzhen vernutsya tuda, chtoby zabrat ego. Takim obrazom, vy dolzhny tshchatelno planirovat zaranee, chtoby ne ostatsya bez pomoshchnikov i, sledovatelno, byt ne v sostoyanii chto-libo delat.

Chego mozhno ozhidat?
- Stambul - 100% originalnye pravila
- Adaptatsiya nastolnoy igry TOP 100 vsekh vremen po reytingu BGG
- Igray s II, s druzyami ili s oboimi
- Otlichnoe khudozhestvennoe oformlenie Andreasa Resha (Andreas Resch)
- Rezhim Hotseat
- Krossplatformennyy onlayn-multipleer
- Vosproizvedenie poslednikh khodov
- 3 urovnya slozhnosti II
- Predustanovlennye ili sluchayno sgenerirovannye igrovye polya
- Atmosfernaya muzyka
- Unikalnye, originalnye vpechatleniya ot nastolnoy igry
- Rezhim daltonika
- Bolee 70 dostizheniy

Tak chego vy zhdyote? Stanovites luchshim torgovtsem v Stambule!
Briana has been craving some time off al:

Summer Days is a yuri visual novel story of fun and sun at the lake, with multiple routes and choices to explore.

See the girls relax in the lake and maybe do some dipping too.

Features

Battle & challenge your human friends on: Battle & challenge your human friends on this multiplayer robot party game: 52 ways to customize your bots & 14 game modes. From knights and dinosaurs, to bounty hunters and space warriors. Choose, customize and crush tons of different bots.

Pomogite vladyke Morgaz'khanu zanyat prinadlezhashchee emu po pravu mesto v ryadu Drevnikh bogov s pomoshchyu naydennykh vami sokrovishch. Ispolzuyte ego kollektsiyu sverkhestestvennykh chasov, chtoby poluchit novye navyki!

Войдите в совершенно новый мир Space Bla: Voydite v sovershenno novyy mir Space Blast Zom - A Matching Game. Gde zlye inoplanetnye bossy vidyat vlast v galaktike! Four nerds, drawn into a fantasy world a:
Four nerds, drawn into a fantasy world and mistaken for heroes, have to battle their way through a massive, crazy adventure and defeat a preposterous villain!

Doom and Destiny is a turn based hilarious jrpg where you take control of a party of four everyday friends. Journey through an unpredictable story filled with parodies and cameos. Start your adventure in a classic dungeon with dragons, save princess with the help of green-dressed elf and then fly to manga-themed city with the help of a famous italian plumber. This is Doom and Destiny, the flying-spaghetti fantasy adventure!

Main Features:
- 20 hours of story and 20 hours of extra adventure

Испытайте одиночество самого удалённого:
Ispytayte odinochestvo samogo udalyonnogo cheloveka na Zemle!
Okazavshis na kroshechnom ostrove, vasha missiya — zhdat na nyom kazhdyy den, poka ne vernetes domoy. Sledite za golodom, snom i nastroeniem vashego personazha vo vremya rybalki, otdykha i prigotovleniya pishchi.
No opasaytes morskikh chudovishch, dobavlyayushchikh eshchyo bolshe azarta v vashe smertelnoe priklyuchenie!..
Ни один великий путь не был пройден без: Ni odin velikiy put ne byl proyden bez velikogo truda. V Outward kholod nochi ili zagnoivshayasya rana mogut byt tak zhe opasny, kak skryvayushchiesya vo tme khishchniki. Issleduyte ogromnyy mir Aurayi v odinochku ili v rezhime sovmestnoy igry. Definitive Edition vklyuchaet v sebya oba dopolneniya i obshchie uluchsheniya.
That’s right, it’s back! The Dungeon Def:
That’s right, it’s back! The Dungeon Defenders franchise is finally making its glorious return with Dungeon Defenders: Awakened from Chromatic Games.

Dungeon Defenders: Awakened is a co-operative Action RPG/Tower Defense game that brings loot, leveling, pets, and character customization to a legendary 4 player co-op experience.

The past has been changed! Choose your hero and construct an epic defense to fight off hordes of enemies while you jump into the fray to protect Etheria. Team up with up to four players as you level up, claim legendary loot, and take on the armies of enemies that await you!

Protect your Eternia Crystal!
Master the Squire, Huntress, Apprentice, and Monk to fight off hundreds of minions bent on mayhem!. Build and utilize your arsenal of blockades, towers, traps, and auras to keep the Eternia Crystals safe. The only requirement is to win, but it’s up to you to choose how!

Party Up
Defending Etheria is better with friends! Bring three of your friends online to jump into the fray with you!

Make It Rain Loot
Gain a plethora of loot while fighting off waves of foes that approach! Swords, crossbows, staves, polearms, axes, grenade launchers, beam sabers, and so much more are yours for the taking. 

Customize Customize Customize
Everything about Dungeon Defenders: Awakened is chosen by you. The gear you use, the way your hero looks, where you build your defenses, which defenses you build — you are the master of your destiny in Etheria!
A faithful adaptation of the past retro:
A faithful adaptation of the past retro classic that improves on the original in every way. You have just 6 hours to find all the pieces to solve a mad scientist’s puzzle while avoiding devious human-seeking robots and deadly black orbs. Includes three versions, the C64 original classic , a re-skinned classic and the totally updated new version.

The object of the secret mission is to put a stop to the evil genius, Professor Elvin Atombender, who is suspected of hacking into National Security computers. You must penetrate Atombender’s Secret Island bunker. In a race against time, you must search for pieces of a secret password that will shut down the deadly missiles of the deranged Professor. 

Using the elevator system, make your way through the maze of corridors of the secret hideaway, but beware, you will have to outwit the hordes of deadly robots that patrol each area.

The robots all react in different ways, so observe each robot in turn and try and learn its patrol parameters and attack methods.

Once into a safe area, check all objects, furniture and computer terminals for pieces of the Secret Password. 

If you fail to find the Password, life on Earth as we know it will change forever...Atombender has Nuclear missiles pointed at strategic targets around the globe...The count down has begun...you have a matter of hours to save the planet...you have been chosen to undertake the Impossible Mission!

"…another visitor, stay a while, stay forever."
Джазз Джекреббит — игра с зелёным антроп:
Dzhazz Dzhekrebbit — igra s zelyonym antropomorfnym krolikom po imeni Jazz; odin iz pervykh uspeshnykh eksklyuzivnykh saydskroll-platformerov na IBM PK, byl udostoen premii «Arkadnaya igra goda» (angl. Arcade of the Year) zhurnalom «PC Format».
Osnovnoy syuzhetnoy liniey igry yavlyaetsya konflikt cherepakh i krolikov, dlyashchiysya uzhe na protyazhenii 3 tysyach let so vremyon sobytiy, opisannykh Ezopom v «Cherepakhe i Zaytse».
Добро пожаловать в Find Love or Die Tryi:
Dobro pozhalovat v Find Love or Die Trying — virtualnoe shou znakomstv, gde ostatsya odinokim oznachaet vernuyu smert! Sumeete li vy nayti zdes svoyu svoyu lyubov, ili zhe otpravites na svidanie — s samoy smertyu?
Ponyatiya ne imeyu, chto vas syuda privelo, no raz uzh vy zdes, u vas est rovno 7 dney na to, chtoby uvesti na uedinyonnyy tropicheskiy ostrov odnu iz milykh dam, i zastavit eyo vlyubitsya v sebya. Esli ona soglasitsya nadet zavetnoe kolechko, vy oba smozhete pokinut rayskiy ostrov. V protivnom zhe sluchae… chego ne sdelaesh radi shou?!..
Tangledeep combines the 16-bit graphics:
Tangledeep combines the 16-bit graphics and polish of classic RPGs with elements from roguelikes and dungeon crawlers to create a magical experience for players of all skill levels. Trapped in underground villages with no memory of the world at the surface, you must survive an ever-changing labyrinth to discover what lies above. 

Experience rich, tactical, turn-based gameplay as you explore a sprawling dungeon that’s different each time you play. Tangledeep features a customizable job system and hundreds of collectible items that allow you to approach each playthrough in a totally new way!

** Now includes the LEGEND OF SHARA expansion content for free! **

KEY FEATURES

* Master deep, tactical turn-based combat across 13 unique jobs with over 100 skills.

* Choose between three game modes – including Adventure Mode, which removes the pain of permadeath.

* Capture nearly any monster in the game and raise them in the Monster Corral as a pet, or breed them with other monsters!

* Make your experience easier, harder, or just plain wackier with over 15 included Game Modifiers.

* Share some of your progress between characters by using the banking system and planting magic trees.

* Explore ITEM DREAMS, randomized mini-dungeons where anything goes, and power up your gear!

* Take in the scenery – comprised of beautiful 16-bit graphics and carefully handcrafted maps!

* Relax to a beautiful soundtrack inspired by the most legendary RPGs of the 16-bit era, composed by award-winning composer Andrew Aversa – joined by Hiroki Kikuta, Grant Kirkhope, and Norihiko Hibino!

LEGEND OF SHARA EXPANSION CONTENT

* Shara's Story: A new tale in the world of Tangledeep with a unique story, boss encounters, and new gameplay!

* A 13th job, the Calligrapher, armed with two weapons, elemental scrolls, and devastating combo attacks!

* Increased level cap: from 15 to 20! With this new level cap comes even more powerful items and challenges to discover.

* Dozens of new monsters with new powers! You can capture and tame them, too!

* Begin your ascent in Riverstone Waterway instead of Cedar Caverns: a new early-game path with slightly more challenge and greater rewards.

* Challenge the Realm of the Gods, a new post-game area with the hardest monsters and champions imaginable!

* Encounter the Mysterious Wanderer and explore Wanderer's Journeys: entirely new dungeons with bizarre creatures, scenarios, and treasure.

* Discover ancient Relics, rare items with limitless combinations of legendary powers and bonuses!

* Strange new Item Dreams that twist and warp areas you've already visited with new events, monsters, items, and objects.

* Unearth Runes of Knowledge, a set of tablets that teach special abilities not found anywhere else!

* New monster sprites, tile sets, layouts, item graphics, effects, and music!

NINTENDO SWITCH™ EXCLUSIVE CONTENT

Redesigned controls and interface specifically for Joy-Con™ and Nintendo Switch™ Pro Controller!
Burnstar — это динамичная экшен-головоло:
Burnstar — eto dinamichnaya ekshen-golovolomka, kotoraya kak sleduet raskalit vash mozg i zastavit paltsy zudet ot zhara! Ispolzuyte vzryvchatku i umeniya, chtoby nanesti maksimum urona ploshchadkam korporatsii «Zlo», che nazvanie otlichno otrazhaet sut ee deyatelnosti — razrushenie doma nashego geroya i ego druzey. Prolozhite ognem svoy sobstvennyy put ili zazhgite vmeste s druzyami!

POVELEVAYTE PLAMENEM Prokhodite 80 urovney chetyrmya raznymi personazhami s unikalnymi sposobnostyami, zapuskaya tsepnye reaktsii i obrashchaya tekhniku korporatsii «Zlo» protiv nee samoy. Tolko luchshie virtualnye podzhigateli smogut spasti eti zemli!

S OGONKOM Prozhigayte kratchayshie puti k pobede, chtoby razblokirovat sekretnye etapy, vozglavit spiski liderov i zadat vsem zharu.

ZhGITE VMESTE, DERZhITES VMESTE Pokoryayte ispytaniya vmeste s drugom blagodarya kontrolleram Joy-Con™. Probuyte raznye sochetaniya personazhey, chtoby vyzhech dotla vse urovni!
Присоединяйтесь к трём скелетонам — Левт: Prisoedinyaytes k tryom skeletonam — Levti, Midi i Rayti — v ikh grandioznom puteshestvii. Ponyav, chto vse oni zrya potratili svoyu edinstvennuyu zhizn na prosmotr filmov uzhasov, troyka reshayut otpravitsya v bolshoe priklyuchenie po miru myortvykh!.. Poznakomtesya s raznymi kostlyavymi nelyudmi i popadite v kuchu nepriyatnostey..
F-Zero X (яп. エフゼロ Эфу дзэро X) — автоси:
F-Zero X (yap. エフゼロ Efu dzero X) — avtosimulyator, razrabotannyy i izdannyy Nintendo dlya igrovoy pristavki Nintendo 64 v 1998 godu.
Eto prodolzhenie originalnoy F-Zero (1990) i pervaya igra serii F-Zero s 3D-grafikoy. Igra otlichaetsya krutoy krivoy obucheniya, a igrovoy protsess pokhozh na original. V 2000 godu v Yaponii byl vypushchen F-Zero X Expansion Kit — dopolnenie dlya 64DD, vklyuchayushchee 12 novykh trass, a takzhe redaktory trass i transportnykh sredstv, kotoroe takzhe vklyucheno v razdachu.
V F-Zero X poyavilas vozmozhnost atakovat drugikh gonshchikov, rezhim «Smertelnaya gonka» i generator sluchaynykh trass pod nazvaniem «X Cup». V rezhime «Smertelnaya gonka» tsel igroka — bystro unichtozhit ili obognat 29 drugikh gonshchikov, a v rezhime «X Cup» kazhdyy raz generiruetsya novyy nabor trass. Kritiki khvalili F-Zero X za dinamichnyy igrovoy protsess, obilie trass i transportnykh sredstv, dizayn trass i vysokuyu chastotu kadrov.
Приключенческая зомби-игра, действие кот: Priklyuchencheskaya zombi-igra, deystvie kotoroy proiskhodit v antropomorfnom soobshchestve zhivotnykh. Pomogite Khenku i Larri nayti edu, chtoby vyzhit na surovykh ulitsakh, kishashchikh zombi. Ispolzuyte starinnye metody vnedreniya prodazh i rieltorskiy opyt Khenka, chtoby ubedit drugikh personazhey pomoch vam.Vo vtorom epizode, prisoedinyaytes k byvshemu prodavtsu-kroliku Khenku i ego sobako-priyatelyu Larri, gde oni ispolzuyut svoi znaniya o marketinge, psikhologii vliyanii i ubezhdeniya, chtoby probitsya skvoz zombi-apokalipsis, ne silno-to i riskuya sobstvennoy shkuroy. Smozhete li vy ubedit ostalnoy sotsium zhivotnykh i dogovoritsya s nimi, chtoby razdelit dobychu vmeste? Eta mrachnaya komediynaya satira postavit vas na slozhnyy put vybora metodov prokhozhdeniya igry.
Нерадивый отец старается успеть спасти с:
Neradivyy otets staraetsya uspet spasti svoyu doch-podrostka ot predstaviteley religioznogo kulta, kotorye sobirayutsya provesti tseremoniyu v poslednyuyu noch raboty otelya “Ostrov Prilivov”. Igrokam etoy interaktivnoy igry-zagadki, gde lyubye resheniya igroka vliyayut na razvitie syuzheta, predstoit rassledovat strannye sobytiya, chtoby spasti Eleanoru Maloun.

Kak proniknut v otel? Udastsya li vam stat chlenom organizatsii? Smozhete li vy raskryt zagadochnuyu istoriyu, vypolnit dopolnitelnye zadaniya i posmotret vse kontsovki? Izuchayte syuzhet s mnogochislennymi variantami spaseniya docheri, kotoruyu vy nikogda ne videli.

Трилогия загадочного приключения «A Cloc:
Trilogiya zagadochnogo priklyucheniya «A Clockwork Leyline», deystvie kotorogo razvorachivaetsya v neobychnoy shkole, gde sushchestvuet nastoyashchaya magiya teper dostupno v Full HD-kachestve na Nintendo Switch!
Glavnogo geroya napravlyayut v «Otdel rassledovaniya osobykh situatsiy» v pervyy zhe den ego postupleniya v «Akademiyu Tenbin Ruri». Rol etogo filiala — reshat magicheskie proisshestviya, proiskhodyashchie v starshey shkole. Raskryvaya razlichnye dela, glavnyy geroy (to est, vy) s druzyami stolknutsya litsom k litsu s tainstvennoy charodeyskoy siloy, sokrytoy v obyknovennoy yaponskoy shkole...
Sbornik vklyuchaet v sebya vse 3 vyshedshie chasti igry:
Серия Last Ninja - одна из любимых франш:
Seriya Last Ninja - odna iz lyubimykh franshiz svoego vremeni. Blagodarya innovatsionnomu geympleyu, zapominayushcheysya grafike, atmosfernoy muzyke i khitu kritikov, seriya zakhvatila serdtsa geymerov po vsemu miru i zadala novyy standart dlya ekshen-priklyucheniy. Dan uvazheniya zolotoy epokhe retro-geyminga, obedinivshaya sem klassicheskikh igr v odnoy kollektsii. Eto — prazdnovanie istorii videoigr i sokhranenie znakovykh igr 80-kh i 90-kh.
Vpervye v istorii vy poluchaete vsyu seriyu Last Ninja v versiyakh dlya Commodore 64, a takzhe, gde dostupno, versii dlya Amiga i Spectrum; eti igry stali vekhami v industrii, rasshiryaya tekhnicheskie vozmozhnosti svoego vremeni.
Spisok vklyuchyonnykh 7-mi igr:
Герой бросается в древний лабиринт, в ко:
Geroy brosaetsya v drevniy labirint, v kotorom on dolzhen stolknutsya s psikhicheskim i psikhologicheskim vyzovom na svoyom puti k ego tsentru - mestu, gde bylo obeshchano nayti znanie - v to vremya, kak mificheskiy Minotavr presleduet ego.

Unikalnyy geympley
Odin vrag: prakticheski neuyazvimyy minotavr - igrok dolzhen nayti sposob pobedit ego k kontsu svoego puteshestviya.
Uluchsheniya, sekrety i nagrady razbrosany po vsemu labirintu i igrok mozhet ikh sobrat, no khitrost v tom, chto eto trebuet nekotorogo vremeni, za kotoroe Minotavr stanovitsya vsyo blizhe i blizhe.

Tyomnaya atmosfera
Igra vdokhnovlena grecheskim mifom o labirinte i borboy mezhdu Teseem i Minotavrom. Tyomnaya tema vizualno vyrazhena piksel-artom v stile retro, obogashchena golosovym ozvuchivaniem i metaforicheskim povestvovaniem, sozdayushchim (my nadeemsya) zakhvatyvayushchuyu atmosferu.

Labirint
Puteshestvie sostoit iz 6 glav, kazhdaya iz kotorykh s sobstvennymi zadachami, strukturoy, dizaynom i nagradami. V obshchey slozhnosti 42 urovnya, 5 urovney uluchsheniya navykov (s kazhdymi tremya urovnyami), 3 skrytykh uluchsheniya, 2 unikalnykh uluchsheniya, sekretnye prokhody i paskhalnye yaytsa. 

Dobrosovestnoe preduprezhdenie
Eta igra ne yavlyaetsya roguelike dungeon crawler'om. Skoree, eto opyt, kotoryy v konechnom itoge dast vam otvet na vopros: osmelivaetes li vy poznat sebya? Konechno, vy mozhete smotret na neyo kak na prostuyu arkadu, no vozmite na zametku: permanentnaya smert besposhchadna.
Приключенческий шутер с побочными миссия:
Priklyuchencheskiy shuter s pobochnymi missiyami, mnozhestvom kontsovok i otkrytym mirom v kiberpank-stilistike, smes filmov «Krushenie» Dzhoela Shumakhera i stilya «Khardkor» Nayshullera s «Dzhonom Uikom» Stakhelski v arkadnoy retro-stilizovannoy grafike s sovremennymi post-effektami i dinamicheskim originalnym saundtrekom! Vam predstoit uznat istoriyu muzhchiny po imeni Dzho, kotoryy dnem, kak i vse ostalnye, khodit na rabotu i zhivet obychnoy zhiznyu, a nochyu otpravlyaetsya na okhotu — vsyo legalizatsii narkotikov dlya povysheniya rabotosposobnosti.
Mir, kotoryy vy znali, podkhodit k kontsu. Posetite pervyy megapolis novogo mira: Bagrovyy priliv. Svobodnyy gorod, Bagrovyy Priliv byl vozveden kak simvolicheskaya vershina dostizheniy chelovechestva. Proshli vremena politicheskikh partiy — ikh zamenili golosovanie koshelkom za korporativnoe obrazovanie, kotoroe obespechivaet povsednevnuyu zhizn maksimalnymi preimushchestvami. Bolshuyu chast resursov razdayut vedushchie dzaybatsu, kontroliruya svoikh grazhdan psikhotropnymi preparatami.
Gde-to v rayone Lakk u obychnogo grazhdanina srednego klassa vot-vot nachnyotsya ocherednoy rutinnyy den. Dnyom vy vedete svoyu obychnuyu korporativnuyu zhizn s lyubimoy devushkoy ryadom, khorosho oplachivaemoy rabotoy i fletom s potryasayushchim vidom. Chego eshche mozhet zhelat prostoy paren? Tem ne menee nochyu vy vnosite svoy vklad v razvitie obshchestva kak samoprovozglashennyy vershitel pravosudiya, raspravlyayas so vsyakoy nechistyu... Ili, po krayney mere, vy tak dumaete.
Challenge your family and friends to a f:

Easy to learn, hard to master. Play with your kid on the easier tracks or challenge your friends to become the champion of this difficult racing game!
Остров за гранью реальности. Цивилизация:
Ostrov za granyu realnosti. Tsivilizatsiya buntarey, mechtayushchaya voskresit drevnikh inoplanetnykh bogov. Ubiystvo v zakrytoy komnate.
 
 Rayskiy ostrov vozrozhdaetsya raz v tysyachu let. Sluzhiteli kulta inoplanetyan vypuskayut v mir psionicheskuyu energiyu, kotoraya dolzhna voskresit pavshikh bogov. Odnako eta sila privlekaet demonov, kotorye neizmenno oskvernyayut ostrov. Nadezhda gasnet – poka Sovetnik ne porozhdaet novuyu realnost.
 
 Sistema ne idealna, no ona stanet takoy – na novoy modeli ostrova: Ideal-25. Odnako nakanune pererozhdeniya Sovetnika ubivayut. Kto-to pogubil Rayskiy ostrov.
 
 Chtoby nayti prestupnika, iz izgnaniya prizyvayut ledi Lav Dayz, «choknutogo detektiva». Svershilos prestuplenie, kotoroe pokonchit s prestupleniyami.
 
 Kakovy fakty? Kakova pravda? V chem raznitsa mezhdu nimi?

RAY POTERYaN... SNOVA
Vozvrashchaytes na Rayskiy ostrov v dopolnennoy i uluchshennoy versii Paradise Killer s novym saundtrekom, novymi tainstvennymi sushchestvami, dopolnitelnymi kvestami i nagradami, novymi oblikami Starlight i kollektsionnymi predmetami. I ne zabudte ob uluchshenii proizvoditelnosti, rezhime bez HUD i dostizheniyakh dlya Steam. Besplatnoe obnovlenie vyydet 16 marta 2022 goda.

VERNITE ZhIZN RAYSKOMU OSTROVU
Vasha zadacha – poymat prestupnika v nadezhnuyu set ulik. Dokazhite svoyu pravotu v sude. Chtoby raskryt delo i spasti Rayskiy ostrov, nuzhno dobitsya prigovora.

FAKTY I PRAVDA – NE ODNO I TO ZhE
Vot «pravda»: podozrevaemykh mnogo, i delo mozhno postroit po-raznomu. Vasha tsepochka dokazatelstv mozhet ubedit sud... no raskroet li ona zagadku?

ETOT OSTROV POLON TAYN
Rayskiy ostrov – porozhdenie alternativnogo budushchego i nevedomogo proshlogo. Strannye relikvii mogut mnogoe povedat o prichudlivoy istorii etogo mira.

RAY U KAZhDOGO SVOY
Vy sami vybiraete, komu predyavit obvinenie, i vasha zadacha – vystroit tsepochku dokazatelstv dlya suda. U kazhdogo na Rayskom ostrove est svoi sekrety i svoi interesy. V podozrevaemye popadut vashi starye druzya, i vam pridetsya vybirat mezhdu faktami, vysshim blagom i sobstvennymi printsipami. Vozmozhnykh ubiyts mnogo. Vashe reshenie opredelit vashu sobstvennuyu pravdu.
События игры разворачиваются во вселенно: Sobytiya igry razvorachivayutsya vo vselennoy, razdelennoy na mir smertnykh lyudey (Sanktuariy), rayskiy mir i goryashchiy ad. Spustya stoletiya voyny mezhdu angelami i demonami tri vladyki Ada — Mefisto, Baal i Dyablo — reshili dobitsya pobedy nad protivnikom cherez vliyanie na mir smertnykh. Oni seyali khaos, nenavist i nedoverie v Sanktuarii, poka gruppa magov vo glave s verkhovnym magom Khoradrimom ne zaklyuchila vladyk Ada v kristally pod nazvaniem «Kamni dushi». Kamen dushi s zaklyuchennym Dyablo byl pokhoronen gluboko v katakombakh pod zemlyoy, nad kotorymi vposledstvii byl vozvedyon monastyr.
История Raji: an Ancient Epic начинается:
Istoriya Raji: an Ancient Epic nachinaetsya s vtorzheniya demonov, gnev kotorykh ugrozhaet vsemu chelovechestvu. Zashchitniki lyudskikh gorodov pali, i teper demony pokhishchayut detey. Sredi nikh okazyvaetsya i mladshiy brat yunoy Radzhi. No milostivye bogi ne dremlyut - oni nadelyayut devochku silami i oruzhiem dlya neizbezhnogo srazheniya. Teper, na puti k spaseniyu brata, Radzhi predstoit stat edinstvennoy zashchitnitsey chelovechestva.

Istoriya brata i sestry

Demony razluchili Radzhi i Golu. Teper u Radzhi est tolko odin shans snova uvidet mladshego brata - proyti put pod pokrovitelstvom bogov do kontsa i brosit vyzov ordam demonov vo glave s khitroumnym Makhabalasuroy.

Zrelishchnaya grafika

Raji: an Ancient Epic zavorazhivaet svoey krasotoy. Indiyskaya mifologiya i drevnyaya arkhitektura Indii nadelili mir igry nepovtorimym stilem. Svoim vneshnim vidom igra obyazana sochetaniyu 3D-grafiki i narisovannykh vruchnuyu izobrazheniy v klassicheskom stile pakhari.

Lovkost i bozhestvennaya sila

Bogi nadelili Radzhi magicheskimi sposobnostyami i svyashchennym oruzhiem. Sochetayte ikh s akrobaticheskimi navykami Radzhi i menyayte svoyu taktiku na letu, i vam pokoritsya lyuboy vrag. Primite boy i pomogite Radzhi vernut brata!

Atmosfera Drevney Indii

Lokatsii igry berezhno vossozdayut indiyskuyu arkhitekturu. V kazhdyy zhivopisnyy ugolok etogo mira zakhochetsya pogruzitsya s golovoy. Dazhe vne neravnogo boya s demonami vas zhdet potryasayushchee zrelishche.
Лес Нибель умирает. Сильнейшая буря пора: Les Nibel umiraet. Silneyshaya burya porazila ego v samoe serdtse, i teper ego sudba zavisit ot togo, smozhet li malenkiy geroy po imeni Ori nayti v sebe muzhestvo i brosit vyzov uzhasnomu vragu. «Ori and the Blind Forest», umopomrachitelno prekrasnyy platformer dlya ot studii Moon Studios, povestvuet o molodom sirote, kotoromu prednachertana sudba geroya. Narisovannye vruchnuyu peyzazhi, tshchatelno animirovannye dvizheniya personazhey, muzyka v ispolnenii orkestra i desyatki novykh vozmozhnostey vypuska Definitive Edition — vsyo eto sluzhit obramleniem dlya prochuvstvennoy istorii o lyubvi, samopozhertvovanii i nadezhde, chto zhivet v serdtse kazhdogo iz nas.
Новый аркадный твин-стик шутер в стиле я:

Assault Android Cactus+ ispolzuet mekhaniku razryazhaemoy batarei vmesto zhizney, zastavlyaya vas dumat bystro i strelyat eshche bystree. Okunaytes v srazheniya s armiey pereoborudovannykh robotov, transformiruyushchikhsya etapov i masshtabnykh skhvatok s bossami.

• Podderzhka lokalnogo multipleera do chetyrekh igrokov vo vsekh igrovykh rezhimakh.
• Igrayte s lyubymi ustroystvami, vklyuchaya kontroller Nintendo Switch™ Pro i odinochnyy kontrollery Joy-Con™ s rezhimom avtopritselivaniya.
What makes a saint? Fire to one’s face,:
What makes a saint? Fire to one’s face, wounds on one’s body, dying slowly from disease — history paints a grim picture. When Holly Beltran attends a religious recollection, she discovers the dark secrets that haunt the convent’s past. At night, broken faced statues and whispered prayers haunt Holly’s dreams — before the recollection is over, Holly may have to face more than her own demons to come out alive.

What happens when the faithful go too far?

FEATURES

✟ Religious Horror: Experience a horror story rich with eerie religious iconography and psychological scares.

✟ A Short and Haunting Story: At around 60,000 words and with 4-6 hours of estimated gameplay, Saint Maker is perfect to play on a dark and stormy night.

✟ Fully Voiced: A cast of professional English voice actors has breathe life into the characters and their struggles.

✟ Interactive Dialogue Choices: As the horror unfolds, your choices will help Holly discover more about herself during this ordeal. A normal ending and a (secret) bonus scene await you depending on your choices.

✟ Bone-chilling Visuals: Witness the haunting setting of Saint Idelora's Convent, with detailed backgrounds, CGs, and animated illustrations adding to an immersive and terrifying experience.

✟ Original Soundtrack: Originally composed soundtracks which add both horror and heart to the story.

Продолжающийся апокалиптический метеорит:
Prodolzhayushchiysya apokalipticheskiy meteoritnyy dozhd zastavil naselenie Zemli ukrytsya pod zemley. V roli Shell, koshko-rebyonka, prosnuvshegosya i obnaruzhivshego propazhu svoey materi, vy budete spuskatsya vglub zemli, chtoby otkryt dlya sebya skrytyy podzemnyy mir i ego obitateley: muchimykh sushchestv s neopredelennym proshlym.

RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 — компьютерная иг:
RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 — kompyuternaya igra v zhanre ekonomicheskoy strategii, pro upravlenie parkom razvlecheniy. Roller Coaster 2 rodilas v kardinalno drugie vremena: kogda slovo «Tycoon» ne nosilo pozabytoy negativnoy konnotatsii, monetizatsionnye skhemy byli nemyslimy i voobshche - strategii pokhodili na strategii!
Eta - samaya udachnaya versiya Tycoon posvyashchalas mechte kazhdogo rebyonka do desyati let: postroyke svoego parka razvlecheniy. My obustraivali neukhozhennyy uchastok: stavili klumby, zelenye ograzhdeniya i nanimali shtaty uborshchikov - chtoby gazon strigli. Sredi zelenogo massiva petlyali korichnevye i issinya-chernye dorozhki - po nim vyshagivali dovolnye deti: oni pokupali v kioskakh edu, zhalovalis na vysokuyu tsenu sakharnoy vaty i sinkhronno vytaskivali zontiki, kogda lil dozhd. Kazhdogo posetitelya mozhno bylo skhvatit za shkirku i uznat pro vse-vse: skolko on deneg ostavil v vashem karmane, i skolko ostalos v svoem; pochemu on ne poshel na «Smertelnye gorki 2» i chto dumaet po povodu moey novoy obzornoy bashni.
Naladiv minimalno funktsionirovavshuyu mashinu po dobyvaniyu schastya i deneg, my ukhodili stroit svoi gorki. Ukhodili s golovoy - do nochi, do utra. Instrumentariy pozvolyal soorudit neveroyatnye neboskreby iz stali, trossov i proletayushchikh pod luchami solntsa vagonetok. Na kazhdom spuske deti orali tak, chto ushi zakladyvalo, zato vykhodili vse kak na podbor: zelenye, blednye, no schastlivye.
Погрузитесь в мир олдскульной ролевой иг: Pogruzites v mir oldskulnoy rolevoy igry v virtualnoy realnosti (est vozmozhnost podklyuchit VR Labo), ili v obychnom rezhime. Stante geroem eyo velichestva Korolevy, issleduya vokselnyy mir, chtoby pobedit porochnogo Korolya-Demona!..
Молодая мать с сыном собирались уезжать:
Molodaya mat s synom sobiralis uezzhat iz letnego domika v lesu. Syuzan vsego na sekundu otvleklas na telefonnyy zvonok. Tem vremenem ee syn, igravshiy nepodaleku, uslyshal strannye golosa i otpravilsya iskat istochnik zvuka. Kogda Syuzan zametila chto proiskhodit, Dzhimmi uzhe zatyagival portal. Teper Syuzan neobkhodimo nayti prokhod v etot udivitelnyy mir i otyskat syna. Vse okazhetsya namnogo slozhnee i opasnee, chem ona mogla predpolozhit. Na svoem puti Syuzan stolknetsya s mnozhestvom zagadok i golovolomok, vstretit neobychnykh obitateley Zateryannykh Zemel, takzhe ey budut protivostoyat sily zla. Chtoby vernut Dzhimmi, ey pridetsya pobedit Temnogo Vladyku, kotoryy derzhit v strakhe ves mir!
Smozhet li otchayannaya mat spasti syna i osvobodit tselyy mir ot zla?

Osobennosti igry
• Issleduyte bolee 50 potryasayushchikh lokatsiy.
• Proydite svyshe 40 raznoobraznykh mini-igr.
• Okunites v udivitelnyy podvodnyy mir v bonusnoy glave!
• Proyavite smekalku v interaktivnykh stsenakh s poiskom predmetov.
• Sobirayte kollektsii, morfing-obekty, poluchayte dostizheniya.
Игрок становится участником двух историй: Igrok stanovitsya uchastnikom dvukh istoriy: odna proiskhodit v povsednevnom mire, drugaya - v mrachnom i strashnom Glume. Razgadyvayte zagadki, raskryvayte sekrety, chtoby vyyasnit, kak zhe svyazany eti dve istorii...

Vyberite udobnyy sposob upravleniya: s pomoshchyu kontrollera Joy-Con™ ili sensornogo ekrana. Takzhe v komplekte: interaktivnyy komiks «Dogs of War» i galereya illyustratsiy.
Pizza Tower («Башня пиццы») — видеоигра:
Pizza Tower («Bashnya pitstsy») — videoigra v zhanre 2D ekshn-platformera, razrabotannaya nezavisimoy studiey Tour De Pizza iz dvukh chelovek i vypushchennaya v 2023 godu; vdokhnovlena seriy igr Nintendo pro Vario i multfilmami 90-kh.
Po priznaniyu glavnogo sozdatelya igry, McPig (ili Pizza Tower Guy), on zaimstvoval idei iz nikh iz-za nedostatka opyta, a samo nazvanie otsylaet k Pizanskoy bashne.
Glavnyy geroy Peppino Spaggetti, po ushi v dolgakh, sidit na kresle svoey zabegalovki, no posle prikhodit Pitstselikiy, glava tainstvennoy Bashni Pitstsy. Tot zayavlyaet, chto unichtozhit restoran italyanskoy kukhni glavnogo geroya potekhi radi. V yarosti Peppino vtorgaetsya v bashnyu, chtoby eyo razrushit. Na puti emu vstrechayutsya vesma vysokogo o sebe mneniya khudozhnik Pepper-Men, syr-kovboy Vidzhilante, maskot Noyz — otsylka na Domino’s Pizza Noyda, i zloy klon Peppino — Lzhe-Peppino...
Ne rabotaet na FW 19.x i vyshe.Videoobzor.
Eto — kastomnaya khoumbryu-versiya igry. Ofitsialnaya igra nakhoditsya zdes.
Изометрическая ролевая игра по мотивам а:
Izometricheskaya rolevaya igra po motivam anime «Ubiytsa goblinov».
Pogruzites v tyomnyy fenteziynyy mir, vzyav na sebya roli otvazhnykh avantyuristov, srazhayushchikhsya s polchishchami goblinov i prochikh zloveshchikh sushchestv. V khode igry ispolzuyte razlichnye strategii i navyki, chtoby vypolnyat zadaniya, issledovat opasnye podzemelya i zashchishchat nevinnykh!..
V boevoy chasti ispolzuetsya takticheskiy stile RPG, kotoryy sootvetstvuet mirovozzreniyu Goblin Slayer. Vo vremya boya mestnost i skhodstva atributov opredelyayut pole bitvy, a lovushki mogut ispolzovatsya dlya upravleniya situatsiey, a moshchnye vysokourovnevye zaklinaniya ispolzovatsya dlya ataki na shirokiy spektr vragov ili usileniya soyuznikov.
Takzhe zdes mnogo avantyuristov s osobymi spets. zadaniyami; sformirovyvayte svoyu sobstvennuyu gruppu, i igrayte!..
Добро пожаловать в лучший аквапарк в мир:
Dobro pozhalovat v luchshiy akvapark v mire! Na etom kurorte, polnom priklyucheniy i zakhvatyvayushchikh vodnykh gorok, tolko vy i vasha sestra smozhete ostanovit zlogo doktora Fishera! Ispolzuya silu tainstvennoy maski, etot zlobnyy zlodey ocharoval ves park, chtoby nakonets zamanit v lovushku vashikh roditeley. Pochemu? Potomu chto oni ne kto inoy, kak vsemirno izvestnye shpiony Shtorma!

Prygayte, skolzite i mchites po serii slozhnykh vodnykh gorok 2.5D, chtoby srazit doktora Fishera i spasti svoikh roditeley! No ne zhdite progulki po parku. Iz-za proklyatiya vse slaydy polnostyu VNE KONTROLYa! Kazhdaya oblast napolnena opasnostyami, prepyatstviyami i vragami, podzhidayushchimi vas v kazhdom uglu, tak chto prigotovtes, prezhde chem vas unichtozhat. K schastyu, vy ne odinoki v etom, tak kak vas budet soprovozhdat vash spetsialnyy shpionskiy dron dlya videoblogov B.U.D.D.Y.

FUNKTsII:
• Igrayte za Mikki ili Dzhenni Storm i stante geroem (inoy), spasayushchim vashikh roditeley!
• Platforma, skolzite i vybirayte svoy sobstvennyy marshrut cherez 74 priklyuchencheskikh urovnya.
• Stolknutsya s problemami, svyazannymi s gryzt nogti vo vsekh zonakh akvaparka. Ot tropicheskikh sokrovishch i vulkanicheskikh prostorov do strany budushchego i zabytykh dzhungley
• Razblokiruyte 16 dikikh attraktsionov: v tom chisle samokat-shpion, vodnyy mototsikl, pingvina, Roborku (potryasayushchiy robot-kosatku) ... i mnogie drugie!
• Bud gotov! Vam predstoit srazitsya s doktorom Fisherom v razlichnykh skhvatkakh s bossami!
• Obedinyaytes v komandu oboikh Shtormov v lokalnom kooperativnom mnogopolzovatelskom rezhime!
• Rabotayte vmeste s vashim spetsialnym shpionskim dronom dlya videoblogov B.U.D.D.Y.

 - Razlichnye vidy transporta v vashem rasporyazhenii

Buried Stars is a mystery adventure game:
Buried Stars is a mystery adventure game from Studio LARGO—the creators of the beloved Korean titles Panic Room and City of Mist—in collaboration with LINE Games.

◆ Murder at a Survival Audition Gone Wrong
During a live broadcast of a survival audition show, the studio building suddenly collapses. Trapped beneath the rubble, the remaining contestants and crew face something even more terrifying: a murder among them.

Who is the culprit? Why did this happen? And how?

◆ Striking Visual Presentation with 3D x 2D Harmony
Dynamic 2D character illustrations are blended into detailed 3D environments to create an atmospheric and cinematic visual experience.

◆ Immersive Gameplay through Social Media Mechanics
Keep track of real-time public reactions via the in-game “Social Media” and “Timeline.”
These systems not only deepen the immersion but also provide crucial hints to help uncover the truth.

◆ Branching Scenarios and Multiple Endings
Your dialogue choices and actions shape the story.
With multiple routes, endings, and hidden stories, each playthrough reveals new truths—and new fates for the survivors.

◆ Powerful Soundtrack and Performances
Dive into the emotional intensity of the story with an original soundtrack, environmental sound design, and the gripping main theme, “Be Honest.”

◆ Stellar Voice Acting in Korean and Japanese
Featuring passionate performances by seasoned voice talent from both Korea and Japan:

Korean Cast
Park Sungtae, Ryu Seunggon, Nam Dohyoung, Kim Yeonwoo, Kim Haru, Lee Kyoungtae, Lim Yoonsun, and more

Japanese Cast
Tetsuya Kakihara, Takuya Eguchi, Hiro Shimono, Yoko Hikasa, Rina Sato, Soichiro Hoshi, Eri Kitamura, and more

Однажды в старый храм Некофуку прибывает:
Odnazhdy v staryy khram Nekofuku pribyvaet ochen nevezuchiy paren, rol kotorogo i vozmyote na sebya Vy. Tam vas vstrechayut dva bozhestva v obraze devushek-sluzhitelnits khrama s koshachimi ushkami i khvostikami.
Po legende, oni obe kogda-to pomogli vozrodit tselyy gorod, sgorevshiy dotla. V khram uzhe mnogo let nikto ne prikhodil, a potomu devushki reshili vo chto by to ni stalo pomoch vam reshit vse problemy. I dlya etogo oni predlagayut vam zhit vmeste; so vremenem vashi otnosheniya mogut pererasti v nechto bolee blizkoe i dazhe.. Intimnoe. Kak imenno budut razvivatsya sobytiya — zavisit ot vas!

In a dead colony on Mars a corporate mar:
In a dead colony on Mars a corporate marine is left far behind enemy lines. With the unlikely help of an insurgent drone, he faces a battle for survival against an army of murderous, mindless mutants... and worse things.

This isometric action shooter includes key strategic decisions. Your drone has vital abilities and you need to strategize as you fight; should you scavenge for supplies or push forward to face the enemy?

Decimate the mutant onslaught with upgradeable weaponry, including shotguns, rocket launchers and more, as well as special Heavy weapons like the autocannon and flamethrower, which will obliterate everything in their path. Develop your own skill tree from across four classes - Assault, Demolition, Hellfire, and Terminator - to become the ultimate instrument of destruction.

Tackle the Story, with 20 levels of intense action and entertaining cutscenes. Or head into Survival, where you battle wave after wave of enemies.

Whatever the mode you can also team up with a friend in local co-op, a Nintendo Switch™ exclusive feature; it’s perfect for playing with a buddy anytime, anywhere!

Features:

•	Fluid and exciting twin-stick combat against fiendish foes on Mars.
•	Key tactical decisions to be made with your accompanying drone.
•	A variety of weapons, each with fantastic effects for killing enemies.
•	Develop your skills with Assault, Demolition, Hellfire or Terminator classes – find the style that suits you best!
•	Play the Story or have a quick fight in Survival mode.
•	Re-designed for Nintendo Switch, including exclusive local co-op to share the battle!

Following the passing of Bernard Mason,:
Following the passing of Bernard Mason, the patriarch of the family, all the remaining Masons return to their childhood home for one last time.
As Aspen, the cat of the household, players will take a journey across the hopes, disappointments and regrets of the enigmatic Mason family, traversing through a rich narrative that spans over decades.
The game embraces a simple yet intuitive point and click play style, celebrating a design approach based on the behaviours of common house cats living all around the world.
Is the cat just a pet, or does this creature play a more mysterious role in our lives?

Features:
- Be a charming but ordinary house cat. Aspen is neither the witty talking cat nor a supernatural creature. Play as the domestic cat of the Mason household.
- Unravel the decades-spanning story of the Mason Family by witnessing the relations of the surviving family members and tracking ghosts of the past.
- Explore the mysterious Mason Manor to every nook and cranny in beautiful 2D pixel art supported by modern cinematic lighting.
-  Experience gameplay sequences inspired by naturalistic cat behaviour. Track the scents of different family members throughout the house or cause total mischief in an already tense dinner!
- Start as the silent witness and eventually become a force of change in the lives of the family members throughout the three chapters of the game.

Intrinsic challenges face our heroine, as she struggles against a pushback on emancipation, leading to many doubts, both internal and external. Uncover the truth in a mystery full of deception!

Play as 2 dots and travel through the ages of typographic styles and techniques. 
From the rock paintings of prehistoric times to Pixel art of the 2000’s, solve all the riddles by riding the most popular fonts and characters (Garamond, Helvetica, Times New Roman, Pixel, Comic Sans...) in a very captivating musical and visual environment. 

Type:Rider is an adventure puzzle game produced by AGAT – EX NIHILO and ARTE that brings gaming experience to a whole new daring level.

Key Features:

•• Breath-taking artworks and musical vibes 
•• Immersive and intriguing atmosphere 
•• Great historical archives and paintings
Погрузитесь в мир Decay of Logos и раскр:

Dive through four hundred years of techn:
Dive through four hundred years of technological advancements into the underwater city of Royla, where humanity once found a new home. That is until this future Atlantis was beset by fierce monsters mutated by toxic marine waste. Take on this unprecedented threat as the sea guardian Pronty, and fight alongside your javelin partner Bront to take down the mutants, discover the truth behind the creatures' sudden invasion, and uncover the secrets behind Pronty's origins.

◆Unique “javelin” combat system
Control the inexperienced Pronty and Bront the Javelin, a weaponized robotic swordfish that can fend off the sea creatures corrupted by toxic waste. Use Bront to repel enemies, remove obstacles, and shield Pronty from harm.

◆A terrifying array of hostile and mutated sea life
Encounter all sorts of creatures formed from a ghastly fusion of sea critters and marine debris. While some might look easy to defeat, there’s always a bigger fish…Fight giant bosses to bring back hope to the once-thriving Royla and reveal the truth behind the monsters and pollution.

◆Swappable upgrades for customized combat
Unlock new abilities and upgrades in Pronty’s Memory Board to put together strategies that work for every situation and play style.

◆Explore this magnificent but perilous underwater city
Explore the fallen underwater city, Royla, in an underwater Metroidvania experience.

◆Challenge all difficulty and Boss Rush mode
Replay again and again, with post-launch updates including the boss rush mode in Neptune’s Hall.
Oliver's Adventures in the Fairyland от: Oliver's Adventures in the Fairyland ot studii Hoodoo Bear — eto indi-priklyuchenie, kotoroe vdokhnovleno etalonnymi proektami v zhanre Metroidvania. Syuzhet takzhe ne podkachal — podrostok iz sovremennogo mira okazyvaetsya v fentezi-korolevstve, kuda ego perenes mogushchestvennyy volshebnik s odnoy konkretnoy tselyu: razyskat ukradennye sokrovishcha korolya v ogromnom i ne ochen-to privetlivom mire.
Conarium — это леденящая душу игра по мо:
Conarium — eto ledenyashchaya dushu igra po motivam zakhvatyvayushchey istorii. V ney chetvero uchenykh pytayutsya postich to, chto schitaetsya «absolyutnoy» granyu vozmozhnogo. Igra v dukhe novelly «Khrebty bezumiya» G. F. Lavkrafta, no na osnove originalnoy istorii.

Vy sygraete za Frenka Gilmena, kotoryy okazyvaetsya v komnate, napolnennoy strannymi, pulsiruyushchimi zvukami. Plyaskoy smerti po stenam raspolzayutsya uzory sveta ot neobychnogo ustroystva na stole. Vam udaetsya vspomnit lish to, chto vy na Upuaute, polyarnoy stantsii, chto pochti u samogo Yuzhnogo polyusa. I vot vy uzhe v bezlyudnom meste, i chto-to vam podskazyvaet, chto vse eto ne k dobru. Ponyav, chto vspomnit nichego ne udastsya, vy nachinaete chuvstvovat v sebe neobyasnimuyu bezzashchitnost — kakoe-to znakomoe, no v to zhe vremya chuzhdoe oshchushchenie, budto vy ne prinadlezhite sebe… Vskore vy obnaruzhite, chto ispolzovav eto ustroystvo vo vremya ekspeditsii, vy pogibli, no vernulis kakim-to drugim. Vas nachinayut terzat strannye vospominaniya o neobychnykh mestakh. Vy poymete, chto utratili koe-chto ochen vazhnoe i obreli nechto gubitelnoe...

Issleduyte polyarnuyu stantsiyu, a vmeste s ney — svoi sny i videniya. Izuchayte zatsepki, uznavayte sekrety, no izbegayte zloveshchie sushchestva tsenoy.

Perfect Dark («Кромешная Тьма») — видеои:
Perfect Dark («Kromeshnaya Tma») — videoigra v zhanre ekshen shutera ot pervogo litsa, razrabotannaya britanskoy kompaniey Rare i izdannaya Nintendo dlya konsoli Nintendo 64; schitaetsya dukhovnym preemnikom vyshedshey ranee igry «GoldenEye 007» togo zhe razrabotchika. Perfect Dark vpervye vypushchena v Severnoy Amerike 22 maya 2000 goda.
Igrok beryot na sebya rol Dzhoanny Dark, agenta Karringtonskogo instituta, pytayushcheysya ostanovit zagovor konkurentov iz korporatsii dataDyne. S tekhnicheskoy tochki zreniya Perfect Dark byla odnoy iz samykh sovremennykh igr, razrabotannykh dlya Nintendo 64, s vysokim razresheniem, podderzhkoy shirokoekrannogo rezhima i zvukom sistemy Dolby Surround Sound.
«Perfect Dark» razrabatyvalas v techenie tryokh let i ispolzuet modernizirovannuyu versiyu dvizhka ot GoldenEye 007; igra poluchila priznanie kritikov, zasluzhiv vysokie otsenki u mnogikh izdaniy, i kommercheskiy uspekh, prodazhi po vsemu miru prevysili tri milliona edinits. Kritiki vysoko otsenili eyo shiroko nastraivaemye mnogopolzovatelskie rezhimy i tsennost pereigrovki, uspekh igry privyol k razrabotke tseloy serii igr.Goldeneye 007 s emulyatorom N64 sm. tut.

V razdache nakhoditsya nastroennyy simulyator Game & Watch-podobnykh igr (Elektronika IM i proch.) na baze yadra gw-libretro pod Retorach plyus 59 igr (.mgw) s vklyuchennymi oblozhkami i polnym pleylistom.
Game & Watch (russ. igra i chasy) — seriya portativnykh elektronnykh igr s ZhK-ekranom. Seriya byla sozdana razrabotchikom igr Gumpeem Yokoi v kompanii Nintendo, igry vypuskalis s 1980 goda. Bolshinstvo ustroystv pozvolyalo igrat tolko v odnu igru — eto ogranichenie bylo vyzvano ispolzovaniem segmentirovannogo ZhK-ekrana. Na mnogikh igrakh nakhodilis knopki «Igra A» i «Igra B», prichyom igra B obychno byla prosto bolee bystroy i slozhnoy versiey igry A.
«Elektronika» — seriya sovetskikh elektronnykh igr, v osnovnom obedinyonnykh v edinuyu seriyu «IM» — igra mikroprotsessornaya. Chast igr etogo semeystva yavlyalis kopiyami, analogami i variatsiyami Game & Watch serii «Wide Screen», vypushchennykh kompaniey Nintendo v 1981—1982 godakh (EGG, Octopus, Mickey Mouse, Chef i drugie); vypuskalis s serediny vosmidesyatykh zavodami «Angstrem», «Mikron» (Zelenograd), «Arzamasskim zavodom radiodetaley» (Arzamas), «Billyur» (Gyandzha), «Evistor» (Vitebsk), «Kamerton» (Pinsk), «Oktyabr» (Vinnitsa), «Proton» (Oryol), «Severodonetskim priborostroitelnym zavodom» (Severodonetsk), «Voskhod» (Kaluga), «Ellar» (Riga), i nekotorymi drugimi.
gw-libretro — eto yadro dlya frontenda Retroarch, zapuskayushchee simulyatory, konvertirovannye iz koda opisaniya raboty portativnykh igr serii Game & Watch (Handheld Electronic Game), sozdannogo MADrigal. Kazhdyy simulyator obrabatyvaetsya s pomoshchyu pas2lua, napisannyy spetsialno dlya etoy tseli, ispolzuya obfuskator Lua bstree po zaprosu avtora...Pochemu byla vybrana simulyatsiya igr, a ne emulyatsiya? Spustya chetyre goda posle pobedy nad Drakuloy Rikhter Belmont tainstvennym obrazom ischez, a zamok Krovavogo Grafa, Kaslvaniya, vnezapno materializuetsya iz tumana. Mariya Renard, devochka-volshebnitsa, kotoruyu Belmont spas chetyre goda nazad, otpravlyaetsya v zamok na poiski Rikhtera. Takzhe vneplanovoe poyavlenie Kaslvanii privlekaet vnimanie eshchyo odnogo geroya — Alukarda, syna Drakuly. Vooruzhivshis klinkom svoey materi i oblachivshis v imennye dospekhi, Alukard otpravlyaetsya v zamok ottsa.
Igra vkhodit v seriyu Castlevania i sluzhit prodolzheniem Castlevania: Rondo of Blood i bolee ranney Castlevania III: Dracula's Curse. V Rondo of Blood glavnyy antagonist serii graf Drakula byl poverzhen, no ego pobeditel Rikhter Belmont propal bez vesti, a chetyre goda spustya zamok Drakuly vnov vosstal iz niotkuda. Syn Drakuly Alukard — dampir-polukrovka, stavshiy okhotnikom na vampirov — otpravlyaetsya v zamok, chtoby unichtozhit eto mesto okonchatelno.
V otlichie ot predydushchikh igr serii, razrabotannaya pod rukovodstvom Toru Khagikhary i Kodzi Igarasi Symphony of the Night predstavlyaet soboy pervuyu v serii igru-metroidvaniyu. Ona predlagaet igroku slozhno ustroennyy nelineynyy mir so mnozhestvom sekretov i skrytykh prokhodov; po khodu igry Alukard priobretaet novye sposobnosti i nakhodit raznye predmety, pomogayushchie emu srazhatsya s vragami i popadat v ranee nedostupnye mesta. Imenno Symphony of the Night vmeste s Super Metroid zalozhila osnovy zhanra metroidvaniy, i kak posleduyushchie igry serii Castlevania, tak i mnogochislennye igry-metroidvanii drugikh razrabotchikov podrazhali geympleyu Symphony of the Night. Khotya pervonachalnye prodazhi igry byli skromnymi, so vremenem Symphony of the Night obrela kultovyy status; razlichnye obozrevateli nazyvali eyo luchshey v serii i vklyuchali v spiski luchshikh igr v istorii.
Создайте свой Мир юрского периода впервы:
Sozdayte svoy Mir yurskogo perioda vpervye ili otpravtes v puteshestvie po znakomym mestam s polnym izdaniem igry! V polnoe izdanie Jurassic World Evolution dlya Nintendo Switch™ vkhodit ves dostupnyy na dannyy moment zagruzhaemyy kontent: tri krupnykh syuzhetnykh dopolneniya («Jurassic World Evolution: Vozvrashchenie v Park Yurskogo perioda», «Jurassic World Evolution: Zapovednik Kler», «Jurassic World Evolution: Sekrety doktora Vu»), chetyre nabora dinozavrov i kollektsiya okrasov «Otryad raptorov».   

Vozglavte shtab na arkhipelage Sinko-Muertes i vernite k zhizni chudesnykh i opasnykh dinozavrov. Stroyte nauchnye, razvlekatelnye i zashchitnye kompleksy v izmenchivom mire, gde zhizn vsegda naydet put.

Bioinzheneriya pomozhet sozdat bolee 60 razlichnykh dinozavrov, sposobnykh myslit i chuvstvovat. Igrayte s samoy prirodoy, nadelyaya yashcherov unikalnymi svoystvami, i poluchayte pribyl, chtoby finansirovat poiski novykh obraztsov DNK dinozavrov.

Kontroliruyte situatsiyu s pomoshchyu sredstv upravleniya ili lichno reshayte problemy na zemle i v vozdukhe. Pokupayte ostrova i sleduyte svoim putem v igre s personazhami, izvestnymi po mnogoletney istorii «Mira Yurskogo perioda».

Otpravtes v puteshestvie s tremya syuzhetnymi dopolneniyami, gde vas zhdut uvlekatelnye istorii, slozhnye ispytaniya i udivitelnye dinozavry:

«Jurassic World Evolution: Vozvrashchenie v Park Yurskogo perioda». Vskore posle sobytiy filma 1993 goda vam predstoit snova vernutsya na ostrov, s kotorogo nachalas vsya istoriya, i vosstanovit Park Yurskogo perioda. Otvoyuyte park u dinozavrov, vosstanovite zdaniya i poprobuyte spravitsya s novymi ispytaniyami pod rukovodstvom Alana Granta, Elli Settler i Iena Malkolma. V angliyskoy versii eti personazhi ozvucheny akterami iz filma.

«Jurassic World Evolution: Zapovednik Kler». Vremeni malo! Spyashchiy v nedrakh gory Sibo vulkan mozhet probuditsya v lyuboy moment, otpraviv dinozavrov Isla-Nublar obratno v nebytie. Vas zhdet zakhvatyvayushchaya missiya po spaseniyu velikolepnykh sozdaniy pod rukovodstvom Kler Diring.

«Jurassic World Evolution: Sekrety doktora Vu». Na ostrovakh Las-Cinko-Muertes razvorachivaetsya novaya syuzhetnaya kampaniya. Vam predstoit rabotat pod nachalom doktora Genri Vu, kotoryy issleduet gibridnykh dinozavrov.

Abuse от Crack dot Com — это экшен-платф:
Abuse ot Crack dot Com — eto ekshen-platformer v zhanre «Hit & Run», izdannyy Electronic Arts v 1996 godu dlya MS-DOS i pozzhe dlya Mac OS. Kompaniya CDC osnovana byvshimi programmistami id Software, Deyvom Teylorom i Dzhonatanom Klarkom, iskhodnyy kod igry vmeste s nekotorym uslovno-besplatnym kontentom nakhodilsya v obshchestvennom dostoyanii s kontsa 1990-kh godov, byl perenesen na Linux i mnogie drugie platformy.
Computer Game Review postavil ey 86 ballov iz 100; kritiki iz Next Generation pisali, chto v igre «..est vsyo, chto nuzhno dlya klassicheskogo ekshen-platformera — intuitivnoe upravlenie, raznoobrazie oruzhiya, vragov, ustroystv i lovushek, plyus mnozhestvo sekretov, kotorye nuzhno razgadyvat. Samaya silnaya storona igry — eto mrachnaya vizualnaya atmosfera i glubina slozhnykh golovolomok», pokritikovav otsutstvie razvitiya syuzheta. Zvuk — ot Bobbi Prinsa.
Glavnyy geroy, Nik Vrenna, nespravedlivo zaklyuchyon v tyurmu, gde eyo sotrudniki provodyat neetichnye meditsinskie eksperimenty nad zaderzhannymi. Vspykhivaet tyuremnyy bunt, i opyty idut ne po planu — lyudi vnutri tyurmy (za isklyucheniem Nika, kotoryy, kazhetsya, ostayotsya ustoychiv) stanovyatsya zarazheny veshchestvom, nazyvaemym «Abyuz», prevrashchayushchee ikh v monstrov. Vdobavok, sistema vodoprovoda uzhe nakhoditsya pod ugrozoy zarazheniya, i vy, vooruzhivshis, otchayanno brosaetes borotsya s ordoy sushchestv, stavshikh monstrami chtoby predotvratit vsemirnyy apokalipsis!

Mir v Death Howl ochen bolshoy. V poiskakh syna okhotnitsa poseshchaet raznye regiony — lesnye, gornye, snezhnye, pustynnye, maksimalno tyomnye i vpolne svetlye. Vse oni ochen zhivopisnye blagodarya prekrasnomu piksel-artu.
Polnaya metafor emotsionalnaya fabula s interesnymi personazhami i vyderzhannoy atmosferoy; uvlekatelnyy geympley, sochetayushchiy elementy soulslayka i dekbildera s takticheskimi srazheniyami; bogatye vozmozhnosti dlya eksperimentov s kolodami; atmosfernaya muzyka; vyrazitelnyy piksel-art!

Священный свиток, оберегавший гармонию н:
Svyashchennyy svitok, oberegavshiy garmoniyu nashego mira, razorvan, i veter unes ego kusochki. Teper strannye i uzhasnye sozdaniya seyut v mire smutu i khaos. Igra Unruly Heroes, sozdannaya po motivam znamenitogo kitayskogo romana «Puteshestvie na Zapad», povestvuet o priklyuchenii chetyrekh sovershenno nepokhozhikh neveroyatnykh geroev, kotorye dolzhny sobrat vse fragmenty svitka i otpravitsya v fantasticheskie miry, chtoby vo chto by to ni stalo vosstanovit balans! Igra, razvorachivayushchayasya na krasochnom i zhivom fone, yavlyaetsya shutlivoy versiey etoy istorii. Personazhi mogut prygat, vzbiratsya na pregrady, preodolevat neozhidannye prepyatstviya i uchastvovat v napryazhennykh boyakh s ordami vragov i nezabyvaemymi bossami. Vo vremya etoy odissei im pridetsya obedinit sily i nakonets-to ponyat, chto znachit byt geroem.

● Srazites s druzyami v rezhime PVP po lokalnoy seti ili onlayn.

Kogda osvoites, mozhno smelo otpravlyat svoyu armiyu protiv drugikh igrokov v multipleere. V Mushroom Wars 2 provodyatsya turniry, est sistema lig i reytingovye boi dlya neshutochnykh srazheniy. Srazhaetes li vy s ordami vragov v odnopolzovatelskoy kampanii ili sorevnuetes s druzyami za zvanie luchshego stratega v raznykh rezhimakh multipleera, Mushroom Wars 2 – eto vsegda nasyshchennye vysokoskorostnye i zakhvatyvayushchie bitvy!
Polygod is a rogue-like, randomly genera:
Polygod is a rogue-like, randomly generated, single & multiplayer FPS with a brutal difficulty curve!

Blending a fast-paced, Quake-esque feel with randomness, difficulty and our handcrafted power-up system, Polygod is a hardcore gamer and speedrunner's dream. Only the most skilled and strategic players will defeat the Trial of the Gods.

You are a Faceless One: a one-armed, gun-wielding assassin of legend. The seven deities of Polygod will test your skill with randomly generated arenas of hostile minions, followed by a boss fight against a ruthless Holy Champion.

Each of the arenas features five Altars of Worship, offering you Blessings in exchange for Souls you have collected along your journey. Blessings combine and stack to create unique gun effects, but each has consequences, so choose wisely if you wish to survive each wicked challenge. And don’t forget, death is permanent in this purgatory of the gods!

The art style is inspired by the meta-physical surrealist artist Giorgio de Chirico who is famously revered for his eerie mood and strange artificiality of cityscapes.

Main Features:
A unique, randomly generated experience every time. Randomise the levels, blessings offered and enemy placement with our seed system, or challenge others on specific seeds!

Gun customisation with 100 unique blessings. Each seed will offer you a different selection of blessings as you progress through the levels. Strategically combine and stack them to fit your personal playstyle. Ever wondered what it would be like if your bullets were bubbles? Well, what if they were bubbles AND proximity mines? And you shot 3 of them at once? AT THE SPEED OF LIGHT? The options are endless! Do you choose a lethal sniper build, or a bullet wall of death? How will you survive: lifesteal, jump-strafe dodging, tank-like health? How do you want to navigate the environment: double jump, helicopter boots, teleportation?

Additional Features:
Splitscreen co-op
Gyroscope aiming supported
35 unique enemies
15 unlockable playable characters
7 epic boss fights against Holy Champions
7 even harder Red Holy Champions
Special Boss Blessings
Experimental soundtrack
Minimalist, colourful artstyle
Quirky NPCs
