В свежем дополнении к знаменитой бойцовс:
V svezhem dopolnenii k znamenitoy boytsovskoy franshize nuzhno srazhatsya v stile «Dvoynogo drakona». Na dvore 199X god, Nyu-York v ruinakh posle yadernoy voyny, utselevshie srazhayutsya za vyzhivanie, a ulitsy navodnili myatezhniki i bandity. Gorod zakhvachen bandami, terroriziruyushchimi zhiteley i boryushchimisya za vlast, no yunye Billi i Dzhimmi Li ne zhelayut miritsya s etim i reshayut samostoyatelno osvobodit gorod ot prestupnikov.

V dannoy alternativnoy istorii rasskazano o yunosti bratev «Dvoynoy drakon», protivostoyashchim i znakomym, i novym vragam. Dopolnenie sdelano v zhanre roglayt, i kazhdoe prokhozhdenie unikalno: zdes dinamichnaya struktura urovney, a slozhnost zadaniy menyaetsya v zavisimosti ot poryadka ikh vypolneniya.

Mozhno igrat za privychnykh Billi i Dzhimmi, podklyuchit Merian i dyadyu Martina, libo razblokirovat 16 novykh personazhey, kazhdyy so svoim igrovym stilem i priyomami. Igrat mozhno vdvoyom po Internetu ili lokalnoy seti, i, kogda vy s drugom nachnyote zachishchat ulitsy, boyov stanet vchetvero bolshe.

V igre:

— DRAKI S ELEMENTAMI ROGLAYTA: dinamichnyy vybor zadaniy pozvolyaet prokhodit igru pomnogu raz. Ot poryadka vybora zadaniy zavisit ikh prodolzhitelnost, kolichestvo vragov i slozhnost. Posle kazhdogo zadaniya mozhno budet kupit sluchayno vybrannoe uluchshenie dlya personazhey ili poberech dengi na voskreshenie pavshikh na zadanii.
— 20 IGROVYKh PERSONAZhEY: v nachale budut Dzhimmi, Billi, Merian i dyadya Martin, a potom mozhno budet zarabotat zhetonov i razblokirovat eshchyo 16, kazhdyy so svoim igrovym stilem i silnymi storonami. Sostavlyayte pary s tolkom, prinimaya vo vnimanie osobennosti kazhdogo personazha.
— VLIYaYTE NA NAGRADY I KhOD IGRY: ot slozhnosti igry zavisit kolichestvo zarabotannykh zhetonov, a na te v magazine mozhno kupit personazhey, podskazki i prochee. Takzhe mozhno ispolzovat modifikator dlya vkhoda v rezhim okonchatelnykh smertey ili v beskonechnyy.
— IGRA PO INTERNETU I LOKALNOY SETI: priglashayte druga i zachishchayte ulitsy vdvoyom.
Ever Forward — это игра-головоломка о пр:
Ever Forward — eto igra-golovolomka o priklyucheniyakh devochki Mayi, chto poteryalas v strannom mire gde-to mezhdu gryozami i realnostyu. V polnom odinochestve ona dolzhna, ne poddavayas otchayaniyu i strakhu, sledovat po polnomu otkrytiy puti, gde ey nuzhno vernut svoi vospominaniya i razgadat tayny mira. Igrokam pridyotsya proyavit nablyudatelnost i soobrazitelnost , chtoby razgadat mnogochislennye golovolomki i uznat taynu proshlogo Mayi i eyo tyomnye sekrety. 

Golovolomki
Bolee tryokh let nashi dizaynery bilis nad sozdaniem golovolomok, orientirovannykh na ikh istinnykh lyubiteley. Igroki stolknutsya s seryoznymi vyzovami i poluchat otlichnuyu motivatsiyu dlya resheniya kazhdoy golovolomki, a nekotorye golovolomki mozhno reshit raznymi sposobami, sootvetstvuyushchimi raznym tipam myshleniya i logiki. 

Grafika
Sochetanie spokoynykh pastelnykh tsvetov i futuristicheskikh ottenkov prizvano imitirovat absurdnuyu prirodu mira snovideniy.

Priklyucheniya
V igrovom mire mozhno sobirat fragmenty vospominaniy, chtoby otkryt novye mesta i novye golovolomki.

Mekhanika igry
V igre predusmotreny deystviya ot prostykh dvizheniy i pryzhkov do teleportatsii i upravleniya gravitatsiey, a chtoby reshit kazhduyu golovolomku, ponadobitsya i skrytnost, i nablyudatelnost.

Stante geroem i srazites protiv velichayshikh vragov.

Blood («Кровь») — видеоигра в жанре шуте:
Blood («Krov») — videoigra v zhanre shutera ot pervogo litsa, razrabotannaya kompaniey Monolith Productions v 1997-om godu, soderzhit bolshoe kolichestvo okkultnoy simvoliki, nasiliya i chyornogo yumora, a takzhe kharakterna neobychnym dlya 3D-shutera vooruzheniem. Takzhe vklyucheny dva ofitsialnykh dopolneniya: Plasma Pak i Cryptic Passage.
Deystvie igry Blood razvorachivaetsya v mrachnom mire, pokhozhem na SShA v nachale XX veka. Glavnyy geroy po imeni Kaleb rodilsya v zapadnom Tekhase v 1847 godu, v vozraste 17 let uchastvoval v Grazhdanskoy voyne v SShA i pozzhe imel reputatsiyu besposhchadnogo strelka. Cherez 7 let on vstretil prekrasnuyu Ofeliyu i vlyubilsya v neyo. Imenno ot neyo on uznayot o nabirayushchem silu religioznom kulte Kabal, v kotoryy on s Ofeliey pozzhe vstupaet. Kaleb, Ofeliya, a takzhe dva drugikh adepta kulta — Gabriel i Ishmael — stanovyatsya izbrannymi kulta, odnako cherez nekotoroe vremya tyomnoe bozhestvo Chernobog, kotoromu poklonyaetsya kult, opasayas rastushchego vliyaniya Kaleba, obvinyaet ego v izmene i poruchaet svoim prispeshnikam ubit ego.
Spustya 20 let posle svoey smerti Kaleb voskres v vide khodyachego mertvetsa. Za dvadtsat let kult Kabal stal znachitelno silnee, on sozdal sobstvennoe voysko iz lyudey i sushchestv iz mira Tmy: monakhi-voiny kulta, vooruzhyonnye ognestrelnym oruzhiem, zavoyovyvali i razoryali goroda, besposhchadno istreblyaya drugikh lyudey i zaselyali prostranstvo nezhityu, demonami i drugimi vrazhdebnymi sushchestvami. S tselyu otomstit Kaleb nakhodit i ubivaet prispeshnikov Chernoboga, kotorym bylo porucheno ubit izbrannykh..
V novoy versii dlya Nintendo Switch, pomimo obnovleniy i uluchsheniy, dobavlennykh v izdanii «Fresh Supply» takzhe poyavilis dopolnitelnye igrovye vozmozhnosti i funktsii, zadumannye, no ne realizovannye v originale — naprimer, bolee «umnye» vragi i smena pogody; razrabotchiki takzhe perepisali kod Blood, dobaviv podderzhku multipleera dlya 4 igrokov v lokalnom rezhime.
После серьезной биологической атаки на Л:
Posle sereznoy biologicheskoy ataki na London dvoe uchenykh okazyvayutsya zapertymi v laboratorii s ogranichennym kolichestvom vremeni i vozdukha. Vashi deystviya i otnosheniya s drugimi personazhami, blagodarya igrovomu protsessu v stile «vyberi svoe priklyuchenie», privedut vas k odnoy iz vosmi zakhvatyvayushchikh kontsovok.

Doktor Emi Tenant, lechivshaya zhertv khimicheskoy ataki v totalitarnom gosudarstve Kindar,  yavlyaetsya lidiruyushchim uchenym v oblasti nanotekhnologiy. V Londone poslednie novosti rasskazyvayut o grazhdanskom litse, chya lichnost daleko ne sluchayna, s simptomami v vide krovavoy rvoty. Vmeste so svoim starym drugom Emi okazyvaetsya zapertoy v sekretnom upravlenii laboratoriyami — nastoyashchem chreve nauchnogo progressa i opasnykh tayn.

Ochki za nalazhivanie otnosheniy rasschityvayutsya ot nachala i do samogo kontsa, vliyayut na opredelennye stsenarii i imeyut ogromnoe znachenie v zaklyuchitelnykh stsenakh.

•	Otslezhivanie lichnostnykh kachestv, razvivayushchikhsya v zavisimosti ot vashego vybora, v realnom vremeni.

В центре сюжета огромная империя под наз:
V tsentre syuzheta ogromnaya imperiya pod nazvaniem Avalon, kotoraya prebyvaet v plachevnom sostoyanii posle proshedshey davnym-davno velikoy mirovoy voyny. V nastoyashchem vremeni proiskhodit vstrecha dvukh otryadov, odin iz nikh pribyl iz nebolshoy mirolyubivoy strany, togda kak drugoy — na vozdushnom korable priletel s severa i predstavlyaet interesy surovoy severnoy strany, zateryannoy vysoko v gorakh. V moment vstrechi volshebnye kristally razveivayut po miru luchi sveta, posle chego mir stanovitsya podelyonnym na svet i tmu. Povestvovanie opisyvaet priklyucheniya dvukh etikh otryadov, «voinami sveta» rukovodit malchik po imeni Sol, «voinami tmy» komanduet drugoy malchik — Nakt.
Final Fantasy Dimensions, v Yaponii takzhe izvestnaya kak Final Fantasy Legends: Hikari to Yami no Senshi (yap. ファイナルファンタジー レジェンズ 光と闇の戦士 faynaru fantadzi: redzendzu khikari to yami no sensi, «Legendy posledney fantazii: Voiny sveta i tmy») — yaponskaya rolevaya igra iznachalno dlya mobilnykh telefonov, razrabotannaya studiey Matrix Software i vypushchennaya v 2010 godu v Yaponii kompaniey Square Enix. Po analogii s vypushchennoy ranee Final Fantasy IV: The After Years igra razdelena na neskolko otdelnykh zagruzhaemykh epizodov, pervye iz nikh stali dostupnymi 6 sentyabrya v servise i-mode, 9 dekabrya poyavilas versiya dlya apparatov kompanii au. 31 avgusta igra byla portirovana na smartfony s operatsionnymi sistema iOS i Android.
Final Fantasy Legends otobrazhaet proiskhodyashchee v dvukhmernoy spraytovoy grafike, geympley osnovan na sisteme smeny professiy, skhozhey s analogichnoy sistemoy iz Final Fantasy V, professii dostupny s samogo nachala dlya vsekh vosmi personazhey, sredi nikh frilanser, voin, monakh, vor, krasnyy mag, chyornyy mag, belyy mag i prizyvatel. Kazhdyy proydennyy epizod dobavlyaet v nabor eshchyo odnu novuyu professiyu, v chastnosti, dlya voinov sveta eto dragun i bard, a dlya voinov tmy — reyndzher i tyomnyy rytsar. Boi osushchestvlyayutsya traditsionnym dlya «Posledney fantazii» sposobom — s pomoshchyu sistemy Active Time Battle (ATB), gde poshagovye khody smeshany s deystvom v realnom vremeni.
Final Fantasy Dimensions II (Toki no Suishō) – prodolzhenie zakhvatyvayushchey igry, gde vy budete puteshestvovat skvoz vremya i prostranstvo. Neveroyatna istoriya etoy igry nachalas v Navos na nebolshom ostrove, kotoryy nakhoditsya posredi mira. Na etom ostrove zhivet malchik Morrou, kotoryy i stanet glavnym geroem. Neozhidanno, on vstrechaet devushku iz budushchego, kotoraya dolzhna pomoch emu vypolnit ego opasnuyu missiyu po spaseniyu mira. Nadelyayte svoego geroya sposobnostyami k magii, i pobezhdayte vragov!..
Igra poluchila mnogo polozhitelnykh otzyvov.Drugie igry serii Final Fantasy na Switch.
Life went on as usual in the Inkland… un:
Life went on as usual in the Inkland… until the Tower fell straight from the sky! Many heroes tried to solve its mystery, but none of them succeeded. It’s your turn to prove your worth.
Choose your class - warrior, magician or rogue - each with their own strength and abilities. Loot and buy items, fight with various weapons, create and cast powerful spells. All the ingredients of a good role-playing game are there, but with a unique real-time combat based on grid movement – like on a piece of paper! The hand-drawn graphics especially fit the dark and old-school heroic fantasy settings.
Drawngeon is a RPG adventure that can also be played in short gameplay sessions, thanks to the procedural generation of dungeons, caves, forests and items you will find as you progress and develop your character. 

Features summary:
•    Everything is hand-drawn!
•    Procedural generation of locations and items.
•    Three classes of heroes - each with its own play style.
•    Short gameplay sessions.
•    Strange world and unexpected discoveries.
•    You are able to eat items!
The spirit of old-school fighting games:
The spirit of old-school fighting games is back with Dual Souls. Inspired by classic fighting game series, Dual Souls delivers it all - it’s fast; it’s full-on; it’s tactical; it’s online and it’s FUN!

With fluid animations and colorful graphics, Dual Souls is a highly tactical game with multiple unique fighters, each with their own fighting styles and moves. The game also comes stacked with an array of awesome features:

* Rollback Net-Code.
* Create and customize your fighter with "Journey" mode.
* Challenge players from around the world with "Net-play" mode.
* Learn game mechanics with "Tutorial Lessons".
* Access each character's ending and story with "Arcade" mode.
* 11 Fighters (+Free DLC) each with unique abilities. Characters include a dagger-wielding Ottoman warrior who excels in slap attacks; a giant kunai riding ninja; a Kazakh shaman who uses spirits to attack and curse opponents; a * half-beast with his pet which helps to create combination attack patterns; a Templar knight who resists and counters opponent’s attacks.
* Easy to use controls with a set-up to suit everyone.
* Multiple gameplay Modes - Arcade Mode, Story Mode, Net-play, Versus Play, Tutorials, Combo Challenges and Journey Mode (survival/customization mode).
* Tactical Features - Enhance your gameplay style and create your own combos with features like "Block" and "Counter Block" (similar to "Parry" in SF3 games), "Recovery" and "Power Recovery" (similar to Roman Cancels in GG games), "Power Escape" (similar to Burst in GG games) and "Limit Break" attacks.
* Finish off your opponent with a character-specific method when they are in low health and you are on the winning round.
\"Чемпионы бокса\" — это больше чем прос:

Zashchishchaytes ot udarov i beytes s druzyami v mnogopolzovatelskom rezhime ili voydite v istoriyu sporta, proydya vse etapy karery do zvaniya absolyutnogo chempiona mira. Ispolzuyte dzheby i kombiniruyte udary na dalney distantsii ili podoydite k protivniku blizhe i probeyte khuk ili apperkot. Pochuvstvuyte dukh boksa i "pogasite svet" soperniku.

· Odnopolzovatelskiy ili mnogopolzovatelskiy rezhim. Vozmozhnost srazhatsya protiv iskusstvennogo intellekta ili dratsya s druzyami za vse chempionskie poyasa. Prinimayte uchastie v boyakh v Las-Vegase, Nyu-Yorke, Los-Andzhelese, v gorodskom zale ili na arene chempionov boksa.
· Sozdayte boksera: Sozdavayte sobstvennykh bokserov, ispolzuya bolee 70 stiley prichesok, menyayte tsvet volos, tsvet kozhi, tip tela, perchatki, shorty i pokazateli boksera. Vozmozhnosti bezgranichny! V spiske uzhe est 30 gotovykh bokserov.
· Rezhim karery: Sozdayte svoego boksera i vmeste s vashim trenerom podnimaytes po stupenkam mirovogo reytinga. Vy mozhete prinyat uchastie v boyakh za 4 titula. Vyigrayte vse 4 poyasa, obediniv takim obrazom vse tituly.
· Polnyy kontrol udarov! Ispolzuyte sdvoennye dzhoystiki, chtoby peremeshchatsya i nanosit udary. Intuitivnoe upravlenie pozvolit pochuvstvovat kazhdyy udar — prosto peremeshchayte dzhoystik v napravlenii udara. Vibratsiya obespechivaet dopolnitelnuyu obratnuyu svyaz. Te, kto predpochitaet igrat knopkami, takzhe mogut ispolzovat ikh dlya upravleniya udarami.

Igra vklyuchaet v sebya v obshchey slozhnosti 60 programm trenirovok, khorosho podkhodyashchikh dlya tekh, komu ne khvataet uprazhneniy iz-za vozderzhaniya ot vykhoda na ulitsu i prodolzhitelnoy udalennoy raboty, a takzhe tekh, kto sidit na diete i ne mozhet khodit v trenazhernyy zal!

Ozvuchivayut trenerov Ayane Sakura, Marina Inoue, Kotono Mitsuisi i Khiro Shimono.
Igra byla razrabotana pod kontrolem FiNC, yaponskogo prilozheniya dlya zdorovya i fitnesa v Yaponii, potomu, userdno zanimayas, vy obyazatelno dolzhny uvidet khot kakie-to rezultaty!

This shield has a very important role in our adventure because it will be our only weapon and tool. It will allow you to defend yourself, to fight and to surf across the red grassland.

Take the driver's seat, grab onto the co:
Take the driver's seat, grab onto the controls of the fabulous flying Frogcopter and pilot it through beautiful maze-like levels in this challenging action puzzle game. Slip, squeeze and spin the Frogcopter though over 60 levels all while trying to avoid the walls and hazards in your flightpath.

Откройте для себя мир Nihilumbra вместе:

Odnako ego poznaniya dostigayutsya vysokoy tsenoy. Bezdna dolzhna byt edina. Ona stremitsya poglotit ego i budet prodolzhat presledovanie, unichtozhaya vse na svoem puti. Ostavayas v zhivykh, Rozhdennyy obrekaet vse mesta na svoem puti na neminuemoe unichtozhenie Bezdnoy…

Фридерик возвращается... Несмотря на то,:

Super Meat Boy – это невероятно трудный:
Super Meat Boy – eto neveroyatno trudnyy platformer, v kotorom vy igraete za animirovannyy myasnoy kubik, kotoryy pytaetsya spasti svoyu podrugu (predstavte sebe, ona sdelana iz plastyrya) ot zlogo zarodysha v smokinge vnutri steklyannoy banki.

Super Meat Boy napominaet po slozhnosti igry staroy shkoly i svodit vmeste vse osnovnye elementy lineynogo platformera, v kotorom vazhny tolko vasha skorost reaktsii i refleksy.

V etoy gonke s razdelennym ekranom dlya 2 igrokov, druzya (ili vragi) mogut sorevnovatsya drug s drugom v otdelnykh glavakh, na sluchaynykh urovnyakh libo na protyazhenii vsey igry! Vyberite svetlyy mir, temnyy mir ili oba i pristupayte k delu. Pobochnye effekty mogut vklyuchat: povyshennoe serdtsebienie, tyazheloe trevozhnoe rasstroystvo, gipertrofirovannoe samolyubie i sarkazm.
Что будет, если скрестить яркую Stardew:
Chto budet, esli skrestit yarkuyu Stardew Valley s velikolepnoy Factorio?..
My igraem za Morgan — molodogo inzhenera, chto vozvrashchaetsya v rodnoy gorodok Sent-Ambruaz. Doma eyo zhdyot nezakonchennyy semeynyy proekt — raketa, kotoruyu kogda-to nachala stroit mama. Pravda, gorodok uzhe ne tot, chto ranshe, i chtoby dovesti delo do kontsa, pridyotsya snachala razobratsya s mestnymi problemkami.
Geympley v osnovnom krutitsya vokrug stroitelstva i avtomatizatsii proizvodstva. Nachinaete s prostogo — burovykh ustanovok i pechey, potom dobavlyaete konveyery, krany, sborochnye linii. Postepenno iz dobytykh resursov poluchaete bolee slozhnye materialy, i malenkaya masterskaya ponemnogu prevrashchaetsya v nastoyashchiy zavod. Takzhe po khodu dela znakomites s mestnymi, pomogaete im s raznymi zadachami i potikhonku vnikaete v zhizn goroda. Chtoby nayti nuzhnye materialy, prikhoditsya issledovat okrestnosti — zheleznodorozhnye stantsii, karery, podzemnye territorii. A eshchyo mozhno sozdavat robotov-pomoshchnikov, kotorye berut na sebya chast raboty.
Konechnaya tsel — postroit raketu. No snachala nuzhno naladit proizvodstvo, razobratsya s elektrichestvom i vodosnabzheniem, nastroit avtomatizatsiyu i, konechno, pomoch gorodu vstat na nogi..

В нашем мире, страдающем от конфликтов,:
V nashem mire, stradayushchem ot konfliktov, zhadnosti i razdeleniya, nadezhda prikhodit izdaleka, iz zvezd. Prishli inoplanetyane na Zemlyu, i oni slushayut vse, chto vy govorite, i delayut eto realnostyu. Chto vy sdelaete s etoy vnezapnoy vlastyu? Smozhete li vy spasti mir?
Posle rasstavaniya i nedavnego izmeneniya raboty zhizn Ekii prinimaet eshche bolee rezkiy oborot, kogda ee pokhishchayut prisheltsy. Ikh lider predstavlyaetsya Ksenom i obyasnyaet, chto oni kosmicheskie puteshestvenniki s zadachey spaseniya mirov, s kotorymi oni vstrechayutsya. Ksen sprashivaet Ekiyu o problemakh na Zemle, i vse, chto Ekiya delaet, eto otvechaet na vidimo nevinnye voprosy o mire, vklyuchaya nespravedlivoe raspredelenie bogatstva. Malo kto znaet, chto ee otvety skoro povliyayut na sudbu vsego mira.
Na sleduyushchiy den Ksen delaet zayavlenie: kazhdyy den budet ubivatsya vse bolshee chislo samykh bogatykh lyudey na Zemle. Snachala est popytki protivostoyat. Odnako prevoskhodstvo tekhnologii prisheltsev bystro stanovitsya yasnym. Mir polnostyu na ikh milost - i, vozmozhno, Ekiya. Ksen, pokhozhe, doveryaet ee suzhdeniyu i prodolzhaet slushat sovety Ekii. Mozhet li Ekiya izmenit mnenie Ksena? Ubedit ikh pokinut? Ili, esli na to poydet, mozhet li Ekiya nayti sposob unichtozhit Ksena i ostalnykh prisheltsev?

Люди снесли Old Pete — судоверфь. Он пер:
Lyudi snesli Old Pete — sudoverf. On pervyy iz kompanii, kogo postigla takaya uchast. Ego bezvremennyy ukhod byl tak vnezapen... Vse zabespokoilis.

Esli vy sdelany iz kirpichey i betona, to eto ne znachit, chto vam ne o chem volnovatsya.

Eta raznosherstnaya gruppa druzey byla zdes s samogo nachala: mozhno skazat, vokrug nikh gorod stroilsya. Oni priveli s soboy titanov industrii i sotni drugikh domov; sozdali mnozhestvo rabochikh mest. No u Lnokombinata v etom godu pochti net zakazov na tkani, Sklad poteryal ocherednoy kontrakt s sosednim gorodom, a u Starogo Banka problemy s dengami.

Chto-to idet ne tak. Nastaet perelomnyy moment. A esli oni stanut sleduyushchimi?

K schastyu, za delo beretes vy — Otel. Vy tverdo namereny navesti poryadok! Snachala vy dumali, chto eto prosto podrabotka, no problemy narastayut, kak snezhnyy kom: istoriya razvivaetsya slishkom bystro, ugonites li vy za ney?

Buildings Have Feelings Too! — eto uvlekatelnaya novaya igra v zhanre «Upravlenie gorodom». Syuzhet stroitsya vokrug zdaniy i goroda, v kotorom oni obitayut.

Predstavte sebe gorod, gde zdaniya mogut peredvigatsya i razgovarivat drug s drugom. U kazhdogo svoi stremleniya, nadezhdy i strakhi. V osnovnom oni starayutsya ne razrugatsya drug s drugom i perezhit ocherednoy den. Razvivayte gorod, chtoby prevratit ego v ozhivlennyy megapolis s raznoobraznymi magazinami, biznes- i razvlekatelnymi tsentrami. Zabottes o protsvetanii vashikh zdaniy, inache ikh mogut snesti navsegda!

- Otkryvayte i razvivayte samye raznye predpriyatiya — ot viktorianskikh vremen do nashikh dney.

- Znakomtes s samymi raznymi zdaniyami: u kazhdogo — svoi stremleniya, strakhi i nadezhdy, i vse pytayutsya kak-to ustroitsya v izmenchivom mire.

- Menyayte i perestraivayte gorod, peredvigayte zdaniya i ishchite vygodnoe raspolozhenie, kotoroe pomozhet vashemu gorodu razvivatsya.

- Rasshiryaytes, zanimaya novye rayony goroda, otkryvaya novye dostoprimechatelnosti i znakomyas s novymi personazhami.
Вам предстоит примерить на себя роль ста:
Vam predstoit primerit na sebya rol stazhera v mrachnom gorode pod nazvaniem Neo-Kaskadiya. Zarplatu vam ne platyat. Vooruzhaytes ofisnym musorom i probiraytes cherez neobychnye podzemelya, sgenerirovannye protsedurno i raspolozhennye pod ofisom vashey kompanii

[Otvratnoe budushchee]
Razorivshiesya predpriyatiya ne prosto perestali sushchestvovat: oni ushli pod zemlyu, a ikh rabotniki proklyaty i teper v vide monstrov bluzhdayut po opustevshim koridoram. Vasha zadacha — izbavit etikh monstrov ot stradaniy i zabrat ikh imushchestvo, chtoby boss smog kupit sebe novuyu mashinu ili eshche chto-to priyatnoe.

[Ne vsem geroyam platyat]
Srazhaytes sredi ruin razorivshikhsya predpriyatiy. Nikogda ne ugadaete, chto vas zhdet dalshe: rabochie-frilansery? Sayty znakomstv? Kriptovalyuta? Dokopaytes do istinnykh motivov vashikh nanimateley. Eto predpriyatie, proizvodyashchee gazirovannyy napitok pod nazvaniem Fizzle, i kompaniya-uchreditel, proizvodyashchaya korobki po podpiske i obladayushchaya mnozhestvom dronov-dostavshchikov. Podruzhites s kollegami! Naymite goblina-frilansera! Otpravtes na svidanie so sliznem! Investiruyte v kriptovalyutu! Podozhgite korporativnyy avtobus!

[Gibkost sistemy boev]
V podzemelyakh igry Going Under v kachestve oruzhiya mozhno ispolzovat chto ugodno: noutbuki, metly ili ogromnye podushki. Normalnoe oruzhie zdes tozhe voditsya, no ono mozhet slomatsya v samyy nepodkhodyashchiy moment, esli vy budete neostorozhny. Igrayte ostorozhno i vybirayte podkhodyashchee oruzhie dlya kazhdoy situatsii, esli khotite perezhit ispytatelnyy srok.

[Uzhasnye bossy]
A vy-to dumali, chto vash nachalnik — prosto monstr. V glubinakh podzemeliy brodyat osnovateli predpriyatiy, kotorye bogateyut na investitsiyakh, poka ikh rabotniki srazhayutsya drug s drugom. Pobedite ikh i vernites na poverkhnost s ikh zacharovannymi relikviyami, chtoby ukrepit vashu kompaniyu.

[Mnozhestvo personazhey]
Vypolnyayte zadaniya vmeste s kollegami, chtoby poluchit vliyanie na nikh i razblokirovat ikh unikalnykh bossov. Uznayte bolshe o Neo-Kaskadii, proiskhozhdenii Fizzle i o tom, kak transportnaya kompaniya Cubicle, vladeyushchaya mnozhestvom dronov, poluchila vlast nad gorodom. Smozhete li vy spasti kompaniyu i sebya, chtoby ne uyti pod zemlyu navsegda?
The Gateway to Vespuccia, the City of Ai:
The Gateway to Vespuccia, the City of Air and Light, Lamplight City - the thriving port city of New Bretagne is a beacon of progress and industrial advancement in the New World. Yet beneath the promises of a shining 19th-century future, the city rests upon foundations of poverty, class struggle, and crime.
For police detective turned private investigator Miles Fordham, Lamplight City's shadowy corners are just part of the territory. But with his former partner constantly speaking to him from beyond the grave, his grip on sanity is slowly loosening. Can Miles find justice for his clients and track down his partner's killer before his entire world comes apart?
Lamplight City is a detective adventure set in an alternate steampunk-ish "Victorian" past.

FEATURES
• Be the detective you want to be. But prepare to face the consequences. - Investigate crime scenes, interrogate suspects, get information by any means necessary. Follow the law or make your own rules, but how you choose to act will affect people's attitudes towards you.
• Five cases to solve, with multiple suspects, false leads, and different outcomes. - Never find yourself stuck in a dead-end situation. If the case becomes unsolvable, simply move on to the next one. The story will adapt based on your choices.
• Single click interface with no inventory. - Gather clues and documents in your casebook for review. Item manipulation is handled via a context-sensitive cursor.
• A fictional city with four boroughs to explore, each with their own unique flavour. - Players will visit each of these boroughs throughout the game, exploring themes such as class divide and the public's fear of emerging steam tech.
• Inspired by the works of Edgar Allan Poe and Charles Dickens.
• Meet over 50 professionally voiced characters.
• Original score by Mark Benis.

Энтони Пратт, музыкант из Бирмингема зар:
Entoni Pratt, muzykant iz Birmingema zarabatyval na zhizn, akkompaniruya na fortepiano v nebolshikh muzykalnykh kollektivakh, obespechivayushchikh komfortnyy otdykh v feshenebelnykh kruiznykh laynerakh i v dorogikh zagorodnykh otelyakh. Odnim iz vidov razvlecheniya otdykhayushchikh v te gody byla igra v «Zagadochnoe ubiystvo», kogda, sobiraya razbrosannye tam i tut «uliki», gosti vyyasnyali, kto zhe iz prisutstvuyushchikh, gde i kak «ubil» odnogo ili neskolkikh iz otdykhayushchikh. Pri etom stremilis k maksimalnoy naturalnosti, ispolzuya mnozhestvo rekvizitov, imeyushchikhsya komnat i pomeshcheniy, i dazhe priglashaya na tu ili inuyu rol aktyorov.
Cluedo (ili Clue) — nastolnaya igra, v khode kotoroy imitiruetsya rassledovanie ubiystva. Igrovoe pole predstavlyaet soboy plan zagorodnogo osobnyaka, v kotorom proizoshlo prestuplenie. Neobkhodimo vyyasnit kto, gde i chem ubil khozyaina doma — doktora Bleka (mistera Boddi). Pod podozreniem nakhoditsya kazhdyy gost osobnyaka — igrok. Nazvanie sostavleno iz sliyaniya dvukh slov: angl. clue — ulika i lat. ludo — igrayu. Vpervye igra byla izdana v 1949 godu kompaniey iz Lidsa «Waddingtons» i postepenno stala odnoy iz samykh izvestnykh nastolnykh igr v Anglii i SShA.
Populyarnost igry u neskolkikh pokoleniy podryad sformirovala khorosho uznavaemyy torgovyy znak: vozniklo tseloe semeystvo podobnykh igr, variruyushchikh igrovoe pole, personazhey, orudiya ubiystva ili nekotorye pravila igry. Po Cluedo vremya ot vremeni provodyatsya regionalnye chempionaty — s prizami i diplomami, — uchastniki kotorykh shyut tshchatelno produmannye kostyumy svoikh lyubimykh personazhey i chitayut nemalo spetsialnoy literatury, posvyashchyonnoy etoy igre.
\"The Lion’s Song\" - это интерактивная:
"The Lion’s Song"  - eto interaktivnaya priklyuchencheskaya igra. Deystviya proiskhodyat v nachale 20 veka, istoriya povestvuet o zhizni avstriyskikh muzykantshi i uchyonogo, kotorye s kazhdym epizodom vsyo userdnee pytayutsya otyskat idei i vdokhnovenie.

"The Lion’s Song” rasskazyvaet istoriyu, kotoraya proiskhodit v 20 veke v Avstrii. Posleduyushchie epizod igry budet fokusirovatsya na raznykh geroyakh, kazhdyy iz kotorykh obladaet nezauryadnym umom. Igra pogruzit vas v istoriyu o chelovecheskikh otnosheniyakh, lichnoy borbe za kreativnost i vdokhnovenie, rasskazyvaya o: molodoy muzykantshe, ispytyvayushchey tvorcheskiy krizis, nastignuvshiy eyo nezadolgo do proryvnogo kontserta, perspektivnom khudozhnike, stolknuvshemsya s mnozhestvom problem, i genialnoy zhenshchine-matematike, kotoraya pytaetsya probitsya v mire muzhchin. Vybory, prinyatye v "The Lion’s Song", budut imet pryamoe vliyanie na syuzhetnye linii budushchikh epizodov i opredelyat uspekh protagonistov v ikh remesle.
«Свобода — это в первую очередь право вс:
«Svoboda — eto v pervuyu ochered pravo vsekh govorit vsem lyudyam to, chego oni ne khotyat slyshat.» ~©
Orwell — novaya pravitelstvennaya programma bezopasnosti, sposobnaya otslezhivat deystviya kazhdogo cheloveka v Natsii v seti. Ona mozhet fiksirovat vse zvonki i perepisku i poluchat dostup k lyubomu kompyuteru. V tselyakh zashchity personalnykh dannykh grazhdan issledovateli-lyudi izuchayut poluchennye II Orwell fragmenty i reshayut, kakuyu informatsiyu sleduet predostavit silam bezopasnosti, a kakaya ne predstavlyaet vazhnosti.
\"Игра сделана по мотивам классических а:
"Igra sdelana po motivam klassicheskikh arkad. Zdes nuzhno iskat usiliteli oruzhiya i prochie uluchsheniya, pri etom uvorachivayas ot vrazheskogo ognya, strelyaya po mezhprostranstvennym zhukam i srazhayas s ogromnymi bossami. V kampanii s vetvyashchimsya syuzhetom mozhno budet legko obuchitsya igre, no vot polnostyu osvoit eyo i podnyatsya v reytinge budet neprosto!

Ob igre:

• Novyy vzglyad na klassicheskie strelyalki: dinamichnye srazheniya, kak v starykh dvumernykh shuterakh, no v izognutom tryokhmernom prostranstve! Vzbiraytes na steny, prygayte na obratnuyu storonu mestnosti i lyubuytes zakhvatyvayushchimi vidami.

• Igrayte po-svoemu i podnimaytes v reytinge: proydite kampaniyu o puteshestvii pilota, prinimayte vsyo novye vyzovy, ispytayte svoi navyki i zaymite mesto v reytinge, uchastvuya v ezhednevnykh zabegakh, srazhayas na arene, v rezhime na vyzhivanie i v beskonechnom rezhime.

• Slushayte sintveyv: v igre energichnaya elektronnaya muzyka, napisannaya v sotrudnichestve s FiXT Neon pri uchastii takikh muzykantov kak Scandroid, 3Force i Fury Weekend.

• Stanovites luchshe i pobezhdayte: ishchite uluchsheniya dlya sposobnostey i oruzhiya! Orudiya tut samye raznye, ot lazerov do ognemyotov, i u kazhdogo svoy rezhim overdrayva!


Igrovye rezhimy:

Kampaniya: sygrayte za sborshchika energii, kotoryy ugodil vo vtorzhenie galakticheskikh paukov. Vashi resheniya privedut k odnoy iz tryokh igrovykh roley, v kotoroy pridyotsya otbivatsya ot zakhvatchikov na asteroidakh, kosmicheskikh stantsiyakh i prochikh mezhgalakticheskikh urovnyakh. Kazhdaya rol vliyaet na khod igry.

Arena: proydite bolee 60 sluchaynykh ispytaniy iz igrovoy kampanii, i, vozmozhno, popadyote v mestnyy reyting!

Vyzhivanie: otbivaytes ot voln zakhvatchikov, kazhdaya iz kotorykh vsyo slozhnee.  

Beskonechnyy: prokhodite sluchaynye ispytaniya iz kampanii i vypolnyayte dopolnitelnye zadaniya, prisposablivayas k tomu, chto predlagaet igra.

Ezhednevnyy zabeg: kazhdyy den u vas budet odin shans proyti zabeg i nabrat tam kak mozhno bolshe ochkov. Ne popali v segodnyashniy reyting? Nichego, povtorite zavtra."
Банановая Битва рассказывает о приключен:
Bananovaya Bitva rasskazyvaet o priklyucheniyakh Ay-Ay i ego druzey, ishchushchikh sem artefaktov, o kotorykh govoritsya, chto oni sostavlyayut klyuch k Legendarnomu Bananu.

Леденящая душу платформер-адвенчура в жа:
Ledenyashchaya dushu platformer-advenchura v zhanre khorrora, vdokhnovlennaya klassicheskimi animatsionnymi filmami v stile zolotykh let Disneya XX veka, sozdannaya Krisom Derrilom (seriya «Remothered»). Prosledite za poslednim izvestnym mestonakhozhdeniem Kerol Simmons i raskroyte temnuyu pravdu o priyute Banni Kholl.
Deystvie proiskhodit v nachale 1900-kh godov, v epokhu, kogda zhenskoe izbiratelnoe dvizhenie nachalo sotryasat natsiyu. Po mere pogruzheniya v zagadku Lana okazhetsya mezhdu realnym mirom i fantasticheskim korolevstvom Korolla, nakhodyashchimsya pod zhestokim vliyaniem uzhasnogo mistera Kina, beschuvstvennoy sovy Velenii i khishchnykh koloniy smolyanykh krolikov. Vam predstoit ostorozhno probiratsya mezhdu dvumya tsarstvami, chtoby nayti vykhod.
Продолжение истории после событий Trails:
Prodolzhenie istorii posle sobytiy Trails of Cold Steel IV: eta chast sluzhit zaversheniem serii Trails, arok Krossbella i Ereboniya.
Ispytayte tri razlichnye syuzhetnye linii i pereklyuchaytes mezhdu nimi v lyuboe vremya s pomoshchyu sistemy Crossroads. Krome togo, otkroyte dlya sebya pobochnye epizody, chtoby polnostyu raskryt personazhey i mir Zemurii.
«Ты проходишь своей дорогою, и руки твое:

Obnaruzhiv v snegu telo Safi, Maks Kolfild proryvaetsya skvoz tkan realnosti v parallelnyy mir. Polagayas na svoyu novuyu sposobnost perekhodit iz odnogo mira v drugoy, smozhet li Maks nayti ubiytsu i predotvratit gibel podrugi?
V nadezhde spasti eyo Maks pytaetsya vernutsya v proshloe, khotya uzhe mnogo let ne perematyvala vremya. Vmesto etogo ona nakhodit sposob peremeshchatsya v parallelnyy mir, gde Safi zhiva i ey vsyo tak zhe grozit opasnost. Maks ponimaet, chto ubiytsa skoro vnov nanesyot udar — v oboikh mirakh.

Operencia: The Stolen Sun включает в себ:

Инспектор-новичок на своем первом задани:
Inspektor-novichok na svoem pervom zadanii i ee opytnyy naparnik pribyvayut na mesto proisshestviya - roskoshnyy ostrov posredi okeana, prinadlezhashchiy molodomu millioneru, kotoryy vsemi silami khochet izbezhat oglaski.
Na pervyy vzglyad delo kazhetsya prostym: okhrannik libo sovershil samoubiystvo, libo sluchayno upal s obryva.
Obitateli ostrova - Bredfordy, - vyglyadyat druzhnoy i obraztsovoy semey, i kazhutsya napugannymi smertyu svoego sotrudnika. No pri blizhayshem rassmotrenii stanovitsya yasno, chto imi dvizhut lichnaya nepriyazn i gluboko skrytye motivy.
Chem bolshe vy issleduete etot uedinennyy ostrov i zaputannye semeynye otnosheniya, tem bolee slozhnym i neochevidnym stanovitsya delo. Obychnoe samoubiystvo oborachivaetsya klubkom makhinatsiy, pitaemykh alchnostyu, a kolichestvo zhertv rastet.
Est li na ostrove nevinovnye? Smozhete li vy predskazat sleduyushchiy shag ubiytsy?

«Battle Kid: Fortress of Peril / Battle Kid 2: Mountain of Torment» — eto homebrew-igry 2010-go i 2012-go godov, kartridzhi, sozdannye spetsialno dlya NES (Nintendo Entertainment System aka «Dendi»), vdokhnovlyonnye kultovymi, slozhneyshimi besplatnymi PK-platformerami «I Wanna Be the Guy» / «I Wanna Be the Boshy»: oni skhozhi s tochki zreniya dizayna glavnogo geroya, oruzhiya, kotorym on vladeet i podkhoda k geympleyu metodom «prob i oshibok» s mekhanikoy mgnovennoy smerti personazha, vragami i opasnostyami; takzhe vzyaty proobrazy bitv s bossami kak v serii Mega Man.
V igre naschityvaetsya bolee 500 otdelnykh komnat, 30+ razlichnykh vidov vragov i mnozhestvo (shest: Very Easy, Easy, Normal, Hard, Very Hard, Unfair; v pervyy raz luchshe vsego nachinat na slozhnosti Hard) nastraivaemykh urovney slozhnosti; vo vtoroy igre (pryamom prodolzhenii istorii pervoy igry) — bolee 650 komnat, 25 tipov razlichnykh vragov, 13 bitv s bossami, 42 muzykalnykh treka i novye mekhaniki.

Dieselpunk Wars — это игра о строительст:
Dieselpunk Wars — eto igra o stroitelstve transportnykh sredstv, deystvie kotoroy proiskhodit v otkrytom, ogromnom mire. Vy ne tolko postroite voennuyu mashinu svoey mechty, no i prokatites na ney po pustynyam, goram ili bolotam. V igre bolee 300 unikalnykh elementov, mnozhestvo razlichnykh materialov i dospekhov, kotorye mozhno pokrasit, chto pozvolit vam postroit zamechatelnuyu mashinu. Razlichnye tipy broni, pushek, motorov, koles i privodov pozvolyat vam konstruirovat dvizhushchiesya, plavayushchie i letatelnye apparaty. Stroyte istrebiteli, transportery, tanki, esmintsy, dirizhabli i mnogoe drugoe. Naslazhdaytes svobodoy tvorchestva!
Uchastvuyte v masshtabnykh srazheniyakh, raskroyte ves potentsial svoego avtomobilya i nachnite vtorzhenie, chtoby zavoevat tselye ostrova v odinochnoy kampanii. Uznayte slabye mesta korabley vashikh vragov i razgadayte ikh boevye plany. U vas budet mnogo razlichnogo oruzhiya na vybor, vklyuchaya raketnye ustanovki, pulemety, ognemety, torpednye ustanovki, bomby, glubinnye bomby i bezumnoe oruzhie blizhnego boya.
In Between — отмеченный наградами платфо:
In Between — otmechennyy nagradami platformer s nezabyvaemoy atmosferoy i zakhvatyvayushchim igrovym protsessom. Mekhanika golovolomok osnovana na vzaimodeystvii s gravitatsiey i okruzhayushchim mirom.

Vas zhdet puteshestvie po chelovecheskomu soznaniyu — miru, nepodvlastnomu zakonam fiziki, i bolee 60 unikalnykh zagadok.

Po mere prokhozhdeniya igrovoy protsess menyaetsya v sootvetstvii s emotsiyami personazha.

Uznayte, kakie ispytaniya vypali na dolyu geroya, i pomogite emu v borbe za schaste.
Ритмично-музыкальный геймплей BIT.TRIP R:

Perception is a tense psychological thri:
Perception is a tense psychological thriller where players must uncover the mysteries of a sinister estate with echolocation as their only sight. Creating sound illuminates your environment, but also agitates the house and the entities within. Use Cassie’s Delphi text-to-speech app along with her intuition to uncover the mansion’s history. Each time a mystery is solved, the mansion transforms to reflect the fate of a different generation and the torment they endured.  

Story
Play as Cassie, a young blind woman set on being independent despite the dangers she faces in her search to discover the truth. After months of research, she finds a connection to an abandoned mansion in Gloucester, Massachusetts. Once there, Cassie finds that Echo Bluff is worse than her nightmares—a ghastly Presence has tormented its inhabitants over generations, and it now hunts Cassie. The former inhabitants call out to Cassie from inside Echo Bluff’s walls, but to solve her own mystery, she must first uncover theirs.

Game Features
"See" using echolocation. Every sound creates a visual.
Uncover the truth that has affected the estate across centuries. Each mystery you solve triggers a radical change throughout the house you explore.
Engage in a deadly game of hide and seek with the menacing entities of the house, including The Presence.
Explore as Cassie, an engaging and empathetic heroine. Discover her inner demons and what ties her to Echo Bluffs.
Subtitles available in English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Japanese, Portuguese-Brazil, and Russian.

PlayStation 2 (яп. プレイステーション2 Пурэйсутэ::
PlayStation 2 (yap. プレイステーション2 Pureysute:syon Tsu:, ofitsialno PS2) — vtoraya igrovaya pristavka, vypushchennaya kompaniey Sony, naslednitsa PlayStation 1 i predshestvennitsa PlayStation 3. O nachale razrabotki bylo obyavleno v marte 1999 goda, prodazhi v Yaponii nachalas 4 marta 2000-go.
Eta domashnyaya igrovaya pristavka stala naibolee bystro prodavaemoy i samoy populyarnoy igrovoy konsolyu v istorii, na tretiy kvartal 2011 goda v mire prodano pochti 155 millionov ekzemplyarov PS2. Ottsom PlayStation nazyvayut Kena Kutaragi, kotoryy stoyal vo glave gruppy, zanyatoy razrabotkoy i vypuskom na rynok snachala PlayStation v 1994 godu, a zatem PlayStation 2, PlayStation Portable i PlayStation 3. PlayStation 2 poluchila ogromnoe priznanie kritikov i igrokov posle svoego vykhoda. Obzory khvalili eyo apparatnye i graficheskie vozmozhnosti. Zhurnal PC Magazine v 2001 godu nazval konsol vydayushcheysya, vysoko otseniv eyo primechatelnye komponenty, takie kak protsessor Emotion Engine i 32 MB operativnoy pamyati.
NetherSX2 — bystryy open-source emulyator Sony PlayStation 2 dlya Android, predstavlyaet soboy obnovlyaemuyu i uluchshennuyu versiyu zakrytogo AetherSX2.
ARMSX2 — open-source emulyator s polnostyu otkrytym iskhodnym kodom po litsenzii GPLv3, prednaznachennyy dlya zapuska na ARM-ustroystvakh. Proekt ispolzuet v kachestve osnovy emulyator PCSX2 dlya PK; PCSX2 ispolzuet translyatsiyu x86-to-Arm64.

Super Mario Bros. X, или «Супербратья Ма:
Super Mario Bros. X, ili «Superbratya Mario X» — polnostyu novaya originalnaya fanatskaya videoigra v zhanre platformera, sozdannaya Endryu 'Redigit' Spinksom i vypushchennaya vpervye v 2009 godu po motivam izvestnoy serii igr Mario. Geym-mekhaniki sovmeshchayut v sebe takie proslavlennye taytly serii, kak: Super Mario Bros., Super Mario Bros. 2, Super Mario Bros. 3 i Super Mario World.
Mesyats spustya posle publikatsii iskhodnykh kodov, nezavisimym razrabotchikom byl vypushchen kross-platformennyy port igry, polnostyu perepisannyy na C++ i nazvannyy TheXTech. On yavlyaetsya pryamym otvetvleniem ot originalnogo SMBX 1.3, sposobnyy maksimalno tochno vosproizvodit epizody, vklyuchaya bagi igrovoy fiziki s optsionalnoy vozmozhnost ikh nastraivat, novye funktsii, a takzhe ispravleniya ryada oshibok, privodivshikh k padeniyu igry s vozmozhnostyu vklyuchit ikh obratno, esli potrebuetsya.
«TheXTech» — svobodnyy igrovoy dvizhok dlya Mario-podobnykh igr-platformerov s otkrym kodom. Eto polnyy i rasshirennyy port iz iskhodnogo koda igry Super Mario Bros. X 1.3 (ili prosto «SMBX») i eyo pryamoe neofitsialnoe prodolzhenie s tekh por, kak razrabotka prekratilas v 2011-om godu. Dvizhok sokhranyaet polnuyu sovmestimost s urovnyami i epizodami, sozdannykh dlya originalnoy igry SMBX, vklyuchaya eyo perepakovannye versii. Takzhe, dvizhok pozvolyaet sozdavat sovershenno novye urovni, epizody i pakety resursov. V otlichie ot originalnoy igry SMBX, kotoraya zavisit ot Windows i x86, TheXTech mozhet rabotat na raznykh operatsionnykh sistemakh, vklyuchaya razlichnye distributiy Linux, macOS, xBSD, Android, Haiku, Nintendo Switch, i razlichnykh protsessornykh arkhitekturakh: x86_64, ARM, PowerPC, MIPS.

Vlyublennye iskateli priklyucheniy Kristofer i Klara kogda-to puteshestvovali po miru v poiskakh drevnikh sokrovishch i sekretov mirozdaniya. 

Vo vremya odnoy iz ekspeditsiy oni priyutili milogo shchenka i nazvali ego Marti. Otnyne on puteshestvoval s nimi, proyavlyaya ogromnyy interes k priklyucheniyam i raskopkam.

Idya po sledam zagadochnogo artefakta «Serdtse kosmosa», Klara tainstvennym obrazom ischezaet. Kristofer brosaetsya na poiski, no ne dobivaetsya uspekha. Obessilev ot poiskov, on vozvrashchaetsya v lager, gde ego zhdet vernyy drug. Ubityy gorem, postarevshiy iskatel priklyucheniy sobiraetsya zavyazat s arkheologiey…

Vidya ponikshego khozyaina, Marti nabiraetsya smelosti i v odinochku otpravlyaetsya iskat sledy propavshey khozyayki. Pes nakhodit drevnyuyu kartu, na kotoroy izobrazheno «Serdtse kosmosa» i chto-to pokhozhee na portal. S etoy nakhodkoy on so vsekh lap bezhit k khozyainu, u kotorogo vnov poyavlyaetsya nadezhda.

Sobravshis dukhom, Kristofer i Marti reshayut zakonchit nachatoe i nayti portal k «Serdtsu kosmosa». Kto znaet, mozhet drevniy artefakt pomozhet im uznat, chto stalo s Klaroy?

Проживите жизнь вампира в волшебном горо:
Prozhivite zhizn vampira v volshebnom gorode Munlayt Piks, polnom oborotney, vedm, rusalok i drugikh misticheskikh sushchestv! V etom milom sverkhestestvennom simulyatore zhizni vy pytaetes dokazat svoemu skepticheski nastroennomu ottsu, chto zhizn, polnaya sostradaniya, vozmozhna dazhe dlya nezhiti.
Vyrashchivayte misticheskiy urozhay, osvaivayte zaklinaniya i zelevarenie, druzhite — a mozhet, i zavodite romany — s mestnymi oborotnyami, vedmami i rusalkami v milom sverkhestestvennom simulyatore zhizni. Vechnost zhdyot vas!
Poselites v familnom dome s privideniyami i obustroyte ego v sootvetstvii so svoim goticheskim vkusom. Primite svoe bessmertie, probudite drevnie sposobnosti, osvoyte zelevarenie i popolnyayte grimuar novymi zaklinaniyami — vse radi bogatogo i neobychnogo urozhaya. Raskroyte tayny semi semey, naselyayushchikh Munlayt Piks, i prinesite nemnogo sveta v etot tainstvennyy gorodok. I glavnoe — ne zabyvayte vozvrashchatsya v grob do voskhoda solntsa!
Семейная викторина — давняя традиция, но:
Semeynaya viktorina — davnyaya traditsiya, no v etom godu Ebbi zhdet nastoyashchiy shok: kto-to otravil dyadyu Markusa! Prinimayte resheniya na protyazhenii vsey istorii, chtoby raskryt pravdu i spasti dyadyu, poka eshche ne pozdno.

Сидя в баре на самом отдалённом острове:
Sidya v bare na samom otdalyonnom ostrove mira, gruppa neznakomtsev delitsya svoimi istoriyami. Postavte sebya na ikh mesto i vzglyanite na puteshestviya s razlichnykh tochek zreniya. Wanderlust Travel Stories — eto kniga, kotoruyu sozdaete vy sami. Esli vy ishchete chto-to neobychnoe, eto to, chto vam nuzhno. I esli vy mozhete eto prochitat, u vas est vsyo neobkhodimoe, chtoby nachat. 

Chetyre dlinnye istorii i pyat korotkikh napisany otdelnymi gruppami avtorov. Kazhdoe puteshestvie predlagaet unikalnyy stil igry. Vzglyanite na puteshestviya glazami rasskazchikov. V ikh chisle student-idealist, izmotannyy zhurnalist i chelovek, ne umeyushchiy planirovat naperyod.

Nastoyashchie mesta, vdokhnovlyonnye realnymi istoriyami sobytiya. Pobyvayte u zagadochnykh statuy na ostrove Paskhi, na shumnykh ulitsakh Bangkoka, netronutykh prostorakh Antarktiki, lugakh Serengeti i vo mnogikh drugikh mestakh. Pogruzites v istorii zayadlykh puteshestvennikov i opytnykh zhurnalistov, vzglyanite na mir s pomoshchyu ikh stranstviy.

Vashi resheniya menyayut nastroenie personazhey. Ot etogo, v svoyu ochered, zavisit to, kakim vy uvidite mir. My ispytyvaem raznye emotsii. Radost i zador — eto eshchyo ne vsyo, ved grustit i ustavat — eto tozhe estestvenno.

Izyashchnaya estetika, kachestvennyy izobrazitelnyy ryad i atmosfernoe zvukovoe soprovozhdenie zadayut ton igre. To chto nado, chtoby probudit vospominaniya i vzbudorazhit voobrazhenie.

Eto spokoynyy i meditativnyy opyt, zamenyayushchiy tikhiy vecher s chashkoy chaya ili knigoy. Vam ne pridyotsya toropitsya ili srazhatsya. Ne speshite i naslazhdaytes momentom. Esli eto vam po dushe, poprobuyte to, chto my nazyvaem «medlennoy igroy».
Rhythm Heaven Groove — новая часть серии:
Rhythm Heaven Groove — novaya chast serii Rhythm Heaven. Igra razrabotna kompaniyami Nintendo i TNX dlya Nintendo Switch i stala pyatoy osnovnoy chastyu franshizy posle Rhythm Heaven Megamix, vyshedshey v 2015 godu na Nintendo 3DS. Kak i v predydushchikh igrakh serii, za muzykalnoe soprovozhdenie otvechaet yaponskiy muzykant Tsunku — eto pervaya novaya chast serii bolee chem za desyat let.
Krasochnyy nabor ritmichnykh mini-igr, gde kazhdoe deystvie podchineno muzyke. Vsyo stroitsya na tochnom popadanii v takt: ot narezki letyashchikh ovoshchey do vzaimodeystviya s okruzhayushchim mirom, kotoryy bukvalno zhivyot v ritme.
Kazhdoe ispytanie predlagaet novyy vizualnyy i geympleynyy povorot, sokhranyaya obshchiy temp i trebuya kontsentratsii. Atmosferu dopolnyaet originalnyy saundtrek s zapominayushchimisya kompozitsiyami, blagodarya kotorym igrovoy protsess prevrashchaetsya v lyogkoe i uvlekatelnoe muzykalnoe priklyuchenie.
Terrifier («Ужасающий») — американский м:
Terrifier («Uzhasayushchiy») — amerikanskiy malobyudzhetnyy slesher 2016 goda; rezhissyorom filma vystupil Demien Leone, voplotivshiy v filme obraz Arta, takzhe izobrazhyonnogo v ego korotkometrazhnykh rabotakh «Devyatyy krug» (2008) i «Nesushchiy uzhas» (2011) i filme «Kanun Dnya Vsekh Svyatykh» (2013). V kartine snimalis Dzhenna Kenell, Samanta Skaffidi, Ketrin Korkoran i Devid Khovard Tornton. Osnovnym mestom deystviya filma stanovitsya vetkhiy mnogokvartirnyy dom, predstavlyayushchiy soboy labirint, skvoz kotoryy dolzhny proyti geroi, Tara Kheyz i eyo sestra Viktoriya, srazhayas s klounom Artom.
«Terrifier: The ARTcade Game» — eto super-krovavyy retro-bitemap s beshenym ekshenom i mnozhestvom zabavnykh otsylok k franshize «Terrifier». Primerte na sebya rol klouna Arta — strashnogo i nepredskazuemogo zlodeya iz serii filmov «Uzhasayushchiy» — i dayte khaosu zavladet mirom. Deystvie kazhdogo urovnya razvorachivaetsya na syomochnoy ploshchadke filma ob Arte, i vasha zadacha — narushit vse plany!

Шелли Гаррисон по прозвищу Бомба отправл:
Shelli Garrison po prozvishchu Bomba otpravlyaetsya na ulitsy Nyu-Vashingtona, chtoby likvidirovat doktora Dzheydusa Kheskela, khitroumnogo zlodeya, oderzhimogo ideey transgumanizma. Na puti k tseli ey predstoit preodolet cheredu ogromnykh urovney, gde zemlyu postoyanno sotryasayut vzryvy chudovishchnoy sily, gde sekretnykh komnat stolko, chto ne soschitat, a za kazhdym uglom pryachutsya monstruoznye vragi. Zdes vam ne budet nikakoy regeneratsii zdorovya. Zabudte pro ukrytiya i zazhmite spuskovoy kryuchok.

Raspravitsya s vrazheskimi polchishchami Shelli pomozhet bogatyy arsenal oruzhiya, dlya kotorogo predusmotreny raznye tipy boepripasov i alternativnye rezhimy strelby.

Ion Fury smeetsya nad ideey kontrolnykh tochek i urovney-koridorov, gde vragi sami prygayut pod puli. No v svoem stremlenii sdelat shuter staroy zakalki my ne zabyli pro vse te klassnye novye nakhodki, kotorymi zhanr obogatilsya za minuvshie dva desyatiletiya. Khedshoty? Kuda zhe bez nikh. Prodvinutaya fizika i interaktivnost? A to! 3DRealms, Voidpoint i 1C Entertainment vzyali luchshee iz oboikh mirov i prigotovili dlya vas uboynuyu igrovuyu solyanku.

Coffee Crisis is an arcade-style beat 'e:
Coffee Crisis is an arcade-style beat 'em up that pays homage to the 90's era of classic arcade and 16-bit brawlers. 

The Smurglian race has come to Earth and they're not leaving until they steal our most prized commodities: our metal music, the best coffee, and all of the WiFi. Get in the shoes of the only baristas on Earth with enough heavy metal in their veins to fend off this alien assault. 

The game features:
- Single or Local Co-Op Play
- Heavy Metal
- Possessed Grannies
- Dangerous amounts of caffeine
- Random modifiers that could make you an invincible killing machine or summon a swarm of raging possessed cowgirls. Get a unique cup of beat 'em up action every time you play!

Grab a hot mug and save the world!
В своем приключении по забытому северном:
V svoem priklyuchenii po zabytomu severnomu miru zagadok i chudovishch vam predstoit zanovo otkryt dlya sebya magiyu. Sovershayte khrabrye postupki, nakhodite taynye tropy, reshayte drevnie golovolomki i probiraytes v glubiny ledyanykh zemel, chtoby dokopatsya do pravdy.

Vas s Tovoy zhdet volshebnoe priklyuchenie po spaseniyu ee semi. Vy otpravites v taynyy i davno zabytyy mir skazok i mifov, prichudlivye zemli kotorogo naselyayut ne menee prichudlivye sushchestva.

Issleduyte drevnie dikie zemli, raskroyte tayny i spasite svoyu semyu v sovremennom priklyuchenii, kotoroe pridetsya po vkusu lyubomu igroku.

Issleduyte ozhivlennyy skazochnyy les
Otpravlyaytes vmeste s Tovoy issledovat bogatyy i prityagatelnyy mir zimnikh skazok i mifov skandinavskikh narodov, kotoryy ozhivaet pered vami blagodarya nepovtorimoy grafike igry.

Zavodite druzey sredi chudovishch

7 июня 1995 года, 1:15 ночи.\n\nВозвраща:
7 iyunya 1995 goda, 1:15 nochi.

Vozvrashchaeshsya domoy posle goda zhizni za granitsey, i, kazalos by, tebya dolzhna vstrechat vsya semya. No chto-to ne tak, v dome nikogo! Gde vse? I chto tut sluchilos? Poprobuy razgadat etu taynu v Gone Home — syuzhetnoy priklyuchencheskoy igre, sozdannoy The Fullbright Company.

Igra Gone Home — eto interaktivnoe rassledovanie. Osmatrivaya detali samogo obychnogo na vid doma, uznavay istoriyu zhivushchikh zdes lyudey. Otkryvay lyubye dveri i yashchiki, beri veshchi v ruki, razglyadyvay ikh i nakhodi podskazki. Vosstanavlivay khod sobytiy v zhizni etoy semi, izuchaya to, chto oni ostavili posle sebya.

Snova doma.

Istoriya zhizni: igra Gone Home, sozdannaya opytnymi razrabotchikami serii BioShock i stsenaristami Minerva's Den, izobiluet tonkimi i bogatymi podrobnostyami istorii o tom, kak odna semya otchayanno pytalas spravitsya s neopredelennostyu, dushevnoy bolyu i peremenami. Igra udostoena tselogo ryada premiy – «Igra goda», «Luchshiy syuzhet» i «Luchshiy debyut» – po mneniyu GDC i BAFTA, a takzhe otdelnykh publikatsiy v PC Gamer, IGN, Polygon i Paste.

Udivitelnoe mesto: vernis v 90-e i pobyvay v dome, gde ta epokha vosproizvedena s tochnostyu do melochey, a dovershaet atmosferu zvuk dozhdya za oknom.

Bez srazheniy i golovolomok: v Gone Home net zhestokikh skhvatok i muchitelnykh zagadok. Ty igraesh tak, kak tebe udobno, i bez opaseniy, chto na tebya napadut, chto ty na chem-nibud zastryanesh ili chto-to ne poluchitsya. Dom prosto khochet, chtoby ego izuchali.

Tselikom interaktivnoe rassledovanie: chtoby ponyat, chto sluchilos s semey Grinbrayar, osmatrivay ikh dom, lichnye veshchi, zapiski i pisma. Nablyudatelnost pozvolit postepenno slozhit razroznennye obryvki v edinuyu istoriyu.

Nasyshchennoe povestvovanie: za 3–4 chasa tebe otkroyutsya tayny Sema Grinbrayara i doma na kholme Arbor. Kak mnogo udastsya uznat? Eto zavisit ot togo, naskolko polno ty izuchish melkie detali etogo nasyshchennogo i bogatogo syuzheta.

Kommentarii «iz-za kulis»: svyshe polutora chasov kommentariev ot razrabotchikov, muzykantov i akterov ozvuchivaniya, rabotavshikh nad Gone Home. Chtoby vklyuchit rezhim kommentariev, prosto vyberi «Modifikatory» pri nachale novoy igry!
«The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time» —:
«The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time» — fenteziynaya priklyuchencheskaya videoigra, razrabotannaya i izdannaya kompaniey Nintendo dlya igrovoy pristavki Nintendo 64 kak pyataya po schyotu chast The Legend of Zelda. Pervaya tryokhmernaya igra serii.
«The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Master Quest (Gamecube version)» — posle zaversheniya raboty nad originalnoy Ocarina of Time, komanda Nintendo razrabotala novuyu versiyu dlya togda eshchyo ne vypushchennogo periferiynogo ustroystva 64DD, poluchivshuyu rabochee nazvanie Ura Zelda, chto obychno rasshifrovyvaetsya kak «Drugaya Zelda». Ona byla opisana kak vtoraya versiya «Okariny» s izmenyonnymi podzemelyami, soderzhashchaya novyy kontent, chast kotorogo byla ranee vyrezana iz-za ogranicheniy po obyomu pamyati. Ura Zelda pozzhe byla portirovana i vypushchena dlya pristavki GameCube v 2003 godu v Severnoy Amerike i Evrope kak The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Master Quest. Eta Master Quest ispolzuet tot zhe dvizhok, chto i originalnaya Ocarina of Time, a takzhe sovpadaet s ney syuzhetno, no pri etom v igre prisutstvuyut drugie podzemelya i golovolomki, a takzhe povyshennaya slozhnost.
«The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask» — shestaya chast serii videoigr The Legend of Zelda i vtoraya 3D-igra priznannoy serii. Majora’s Mask otlichaetsya bolee mrachnym i glubokim syuzhetom, chem eyo predshestvennitsa. Glavnyy geroy Link okazyvaetsya v strane Termina, a ne v privychnom Khayrule, osnovnom meste deystviya bolshinstva igr serii. Zagadochnyy demon v maske, izvestnyy kak Cherepysh, zastavlyaet Lunu soyti s orbity i obrushitsya na Terminu. Link ispolzuet puteshestvie vo vremeni, chtoby snova i snova vozvrashchatsya na tri dnya nazad do krusheniya, chtoby popytatsya predotvratit ego..Drugie razdachi The Legend of Zelda na Switch.

Mimpi усердно метит территорию своей меч:

Zenith — это боевая игра, где дух золото:
Zenith — eto boevaya igra, gde dukh zolotoy ery rolevykh igr sochetaetsya s yumorom i parodiey. V eyo osnove lezhit seryoznaya istoriya, kotoraya proiskhodit v mire fentezi, naselyonnom desyatkami neobychnykh sozdaniy. Priklyucheniya, izuchenie ruin, rukotvornyy apokalipsis, spasenie mira… Vam eto znakomo. Argusu tozhe. I, chestno govorya, emu vsyo eto uzhe slegka nadoelo. Ranshe on byl volshebnikom. Eto bylo zdorovo i vsyo takoe. No seychas emu za 30, i on khochet obosnovatsya v kakom-nibud tikhom mestechke. No eto ne tak-to prosto iz-za fanfaronov, u kotorykh volosy torchat dybom i kotorye vlachat za soboy svoi gigantskie mechi, portya bruschatku. Osobenno kogda pytaeshsya skryt opasnyy artefakt ot shnyryayushchikh vokrug geroev s kompleksom izbrannika.

-Otkroyte dlya sebya mir vozmozhnostey v polnostyu realizovannom mire fantaziy. I odna iz tekh kart mira, kotorye my lyubim.

-Litsom k litsu s ogromnymi bossami, opasnymi vragami i zlymi podrostkami.

Shadow Warrior («Воин Тени») — видеоигра:
Shadow Warrior («Voin Teni») — videoigra v zhanre shutera ot pervogo litsa, razrabotannaya 3D Realms i vypushchennaya GT Interactive 13 maya 1997 goda dlya MS-DOS i Mac OS. Igra byla sozdana na osnove dvizhka Build Engine, razrabotannogo Kenom Silvermanom. Novovvedeniya dvizhka igry vklyuchayut v sebya vozmozhnost razmeshcheniya v igrovoy srede odnogo pomeshcheniya nad drugim, ispolzovanie dlya oruzhiya i prochikh predmetov inventarya vokselov vmesto spraytov, prozrachnost vody, vozmozhnost podyoma i spuska po vertikalnym lestnitsam, a takzhe upravlyaemye sredstva peredvizheniya, chast kotorykh mozhet byt ispolzovana dlya boya. V igre s izobiliem predstavleny nasilie, krov, chyornyy yumor i otkrovennaya seksualnaya tematika. 29 maya 2013 goda kompaniya Devolver Digital obyavila, chto igra budet dostupna dlya besplatnogo skachivaniya pozhiznenno.
Prorabotav mnogo let «voinom teni» — telokhranitelem i ispolnitelem razlichnoy gryaznoy raboty — v mogushchestvennoy korporatsii «Zilla», Lo Van uznayot o planakh korporatsii prizvat monstrov iz drugikh izmereniy i zavoevat mir, i pokidaet kompaniyu. Uznav, chto byvshiy nayomnik mozhet pomeshat eyo planam, korporatsiya posylaet svoikh podruchnykh ubit ego. V techenie igry Van obnaruzhivaet, chto lyudi Zilly ubili ego uchitelya, i zadayotsya tselyu otomstit!
V ofitsialnom dopolnenii igry, «Wanton Destruction» v 12 novykh urovnyakh opisyvayutsya priklyucheniya Lo Vana posle kontsa igry. Vy naveshchaete svoikh rodstvennikov v SShA, no vynuzhdeny snova srazhatsya s silami Zilly!.. Igra dostigaet kulminatsii v bitve s Masterom Zilloy nad ulitsami Tokio, kotoraya, estestvenno, zakanchivaetsya smertyu glavgada!..

On August 17th 2022, Volta-X will no lon:
On August 17th 2022, Volta-X will no longer be available for purchase from Nintendo Switch™, and all multiplayer servers for Volta-X will close on November 4th 2022. Your flame must weave through the storm to survive. Firefighting helicopters, planes, and little firemen will also be out to get you. The more you burn their buildings the more pissed off they get (and the more combo points you get!)

The forest is vast and unending, with a myriad of secrets hidden within her.
Features
-5 unique levels
-3 Game Modes: Main Quest, Endless Mode, and Insane Mode
-Roguelite style perma-death
-Dozens of painful bullet hell patterns
-Unlockables and persistent level-up system
-30+ Achievements and persistent stats
-Dozens of secrets; characters, monuments, and oddities

...And all this for less than the price of a kebab! Are you ready to burn?

SOVET №1: naydite sebe komandu!

Rozovykh tvarey mnogo, tak chto chem bolshe lyudey, tem luchshe! Krome togo, kto-to zhe dolzhen rasskazat, kak kruto vy smotrelis?
 
SOVET № 2: strelyayte, vzryvayte i beyte
Oruzhiya polno! Est rakety, minigany, ognemety i vse, chto dushe ugodno. Tak chto nikakikh opravdaniy — vpered, unichtozhat prisheltsev! Produmayte taktiku, ispolzuyte granaty ili miny ili zamedlite prodvizhenie vraga s pomoshchyu kolyuchey provoloki i pulemetnykh tureley. I ne zabudte obyskat trupy, vdrug tam est chto-nibud tsennoe!

SOVET № 3: vse lyudi raznye, ne zabyvayte o spetsializatsii!
Nevazhno, k kakomu tipu igrokov vy sebya otnosite: v From Space mnozhestvo personazhey, i u kazhdogo svoi unikalnye sposobnosti i oruzhie. Soberite idealno sbalansirovannyy otryad!
 
SOVET № 4: ne stoyte na meste, povyshayte uroven!
Po mere povysheniya urovnya u personazha budut poyavlyatsya novye cherty, kotorye pomogut unichtozhat vse bolee mogushchestvennykh rozovykh tvarey. Dumaete peresmotret strategiyu? Bez problem, my lyubim novatorov! Chertami mozhno dazhe menyatsya s drugimi personazhami v otryade!

SOVET №5: apokalipsis — eto veselo!
Davayte chestno. Inoplanetnaya ugroza uzhasnaya. No i uzhasno smeshnaya. Mir i bez togo vyglyadit tak sebe, tak chto nikto ne zametit, esli vy razrushite chto-nibud eshche. V kontse kontsov, strakhovye kompanii za vse zaplatyat!
Так начинается кошмар Ви: измученная мам:

Vas zhdut bezumnye srazheniya, absurdnye vragi i menyayushchiesya s kazhdym momentom pravila. Na raznykh urovnyakh vy smozhete poprobovat sebya v raznykh zhanrakh: v rukopashnoy skhvatke, ekshene s vidom sboku ili sverkhu, v skroll-bitemape. Uchites, proigryvayte, rugaytes, povtoryayte. Nikakikh instruktsiy, nikakikh podskazok. Tolko chistaya klassicheskaya arkada!

Тактический шпионаж. В роли агентов орга:
Takticheskiy shpionazh. V roli agentov organizatsii Invisible vam predstoit vnedritsya v samye opasnye korporatsii mira. Na samykh vazhnykh i pribylnykh zadaniyakh prezhde vsego tsenitsya skrytnost, tochnost i sovmestnye usiliya, ved kazhdaya oshibka mozhet stoit agentu zhizni.

Chto est v igre
— Vozmozhnost vybrat personazha. V nachale mozhno vybrat odnogo iz 10 razblokiruemykh agentov i 8 ikh variatsiy. Takzhe predlagaetsya 10 nachalnykh programm po vzlomu korporativnoy zashchity.
— Tonkaya nastroyka. Igra kazhdyy raz prokhodit inache: mozhno razrabatyvat sobstvennuyu strategiyu, ispolzovat agentov, predmety, dopolneniya i programmy, a takzhe prisposablivatsya k obstanovke.
— Sluchayno generiruemyy mir. Mesta, opasnosti i dobycha vybirayutsya sluchaynym obrazom, tak chto vy nikogda ne zaskuchaete, prokhodya igru snova i snova.
— Vybor igrovogo rezhima. Vsego ikh 5, plyus mnogochislennye nastroyki — vse smogut igrat tak, kak im bolshe nravitsya.
— Zagruzhaemoe dopolnenie Contingency Plan. Ono prodlevaet kampanii, dobavlyaet novye nagrady, agentov, programmy i opasnosti v bazovuyu igru Invisible Inc.
В Team Fortress 2 описывается мир, в кот:
V Team Fortress 2 opisyvaetsya mir, v kotorom tayno protivoborstvuyut organizatsii RED i BLU. Oni byli sozdany bratyami Mannami — Blutarkhom i Redmondom, kotorye nenavideli drug druga iz-za nepodelyonnykh gravievykh zemel ikh ottsa — Zefenayi Manna. «Tri televizionnykh kanala, odna telefonnaya kompaniya i dve korporatsii, sekretno kontroliruyushchie vse pravitelstva na planete».
RED — sokrashchenie ot Reliable Excavation Demolition — «Korolevskie raskopki i snos» (KRS). Izvestno, chto kompaniya RED spetsializiruetsya na raskopke vodokhranilishch i shakht, podryvnykh rabotakh, proizvodstve khleba i piva. Ikh komanda sostoit iz nayomnikov. RED pishetsya takzhe, kak i nazvanie krasnogo tsveta v angliyskom yazyke (angl. Red), o chyom govorit i tsvetovaya gamma organizatsii. Postroyki RED i eyo oborudovanie vypolneny v krasnykh i zhyoltykh tonakh, osnovnye stroitelnye materialy — drevesina, krasnyy kirpich i metallicheskie listy tyomno-krasnogo tsveta. V silu togo, chto dannaya organizatsiya spetsializiruetsya na snose i raskopkakh, ey prisushch «prostoy» selskiy stil postroek i neryashlivost.

Жители Лунбери всегда предпочитали лечит:
Zhiteli Lunberi vsegda predpochitali lechitsya traditsionnymi metodami. No odnazhdy doch mera zabolela, a mestnyy znakhar ne smog ey pomoch. Prishlos gorozhanam obratitsya za pomoshchyu k chuzhakam.

Vrachebnaya assotsiatsiya otpravila im na pomoshch samogo opytnogo zelevara, to est vas. Zavoyuyte doverie obitateley Lunberi i vylechite kazhdogo bolnogo v etom RPG-simulyatore s otkrytoy kontsovkoy

Osobennosti
• Zabottes o zhitelyakh gorodka. V Lunberi okolo 30 unikalnykh obitateley. Rano ili pozdno mnogie iz nikh zaboleyut i obratyatsya k vam za pomoshchyu.
• Postavte diagnoz i naydite lechenie! Khm, zamedlennoe serdtsebienie i uvelichennaya pechen... Spazm plechevoy myshtsy? Net, simptomy yavno ukazyvayut na zhzhenie v legkikh. Nuzhno svarit myatnyy eliksir!
• Sobirayte ingredienty v okrestnostyakh. Vybrav nuzhnoe zele, maz ili balzam, vospolzuytes instrumentami i soberite ingredienty. Uluchshayte molot, topor i serp: eto pomozhet vam v rabote. Sledite za pogodoy! Vy mozhete okazatsya pod dozhdem, v samom serdtse meteli ili posredi raskalennoy pustyni.
• Srazhaytes s vrednymi monstrami, chtoby poluchit chasti ikh tel. Inogda ingredienty ne rastut v sadu — pridetsya poborotsya za nuzhnye materialy.
• Varite lechebnye zelya v kotle. Povysiv opyt, vy poluchite dostup k retseptam bolee vysokogo urovnya. Uluchshayte kotel, chtoby on vmeshchal bolshe ingredientov i vy mogli sozdavat bolee effektivnye lekarstva.
• Vystraivayte otnosheniya s gorozhanami. Vy zarabotaete khoroshuyu reputatsiyu, i oni nachnut vam doveryat. Nekotorye zhiteli navernyaka vyzovut u vas osobuyu simpatiyu.
• Uluchshayte gorod i okrestnosti. Khoroshie otnosheniya s zhitelyami povyshayut uroven odobreniya, pozvolyaya vam uluchshat zdaniya, rasshiryat oblasti dlya issledovaniya!
• Pogruzites v atmosferu mirnoy derevenki. Issleduyte Lunberi i ego okrestnosti. Znakomtes s zhitelyami, otdykhayte v taverne ili lovite rybu. V Lunberi vremya budto by techet medlennee. Osveshchenie v igre menyaetsya v zavisimosti ot vremeni sutok: dnem luga zality solnechnym svetom, a vecherom na ulitsakh zagorayutsya fonari.
• Provodite vremya s vernym drugom. Za vami po pyatam sleduet vernyy pes. Pitomets mozhet nakhodit skrytye predmety i podskazyvat, gde seychas zhiteli goroda.
While seeking life on a distant planet,:
While seeking life on a distant planet, an astronaut discovers an abandoned Russian town. He suspects his mission is a hoax until a mysterious young woman saves him from a strange and deadly phenomenon.

After a hard landing on the planet, the astronaut discovers the planet that was reported to be rich with life is instead a barren wasteland. When he goes searching for his crew, he makes a more startling discovery: evidence that humans have already been to this planet years ago! When he comes upon a deserted Soviet-era Russian town, he struggles to make sense of his mission. Did his light-speed travel to the planet send him back in time? Or is this all some strange Cold War hoax?

Equipped with a limited-use jet-pack and a mobile robotic arm, the player must use wits and skill to solve puzzles, unravel the mystery, and survive the Lifeless Planet!

Когда в последний раз вы чувствовали себ:
Kogda v posledniy raz vy chuvstvovali sebya geroem? Igra Flat Heroes podarit vam staroe zabytoe oshchushchenie vyzhivaniya v sumasshedshikh urovnyakh s plavnoy sovremennoy grafikoy i minimalisticheskim dizaynom. Pobezhdayte s prostym naborom dvizheniy: beg, pryzhki, ryvki i ataka. Blagodarya udobnomu upravleniyu igra Flat Heroes vy stilno budete prokhodit i vyzhivat v bolee chem 300 rukotvornykh urovnyakh, unichtozhat samykh slozhnykh bossov i voploshchat svoyu davnyuyu mechtu — stat dvukhmernym geroem (ili geroyami!).

Etu igru prosto ustanovit, da i pravila osvoit ne slozhno, no pust eto ne vvodit vas v zabluzhdenie — chtoby stat masterom, ponadobitsya nemalo usiliy! V khode etogo priklyucheniya vy budete stalkivatsya so vse bolee slozhnymi zadaniyami, kotorye na puti k statusu geroya potrebuyut ot vas nastoyashchego masterstva v upravlenii. I khotya grafika igry Flat Heroes vypolnena v stile minimalizma, ona dopolnyaetsya neveroyatnymi vizualnymi effektami, kotorye obyazatelno poraduyut glaz.

Zastryali pri prokhozhdenii kampanii? Khotite dolshe vyzhivat v rezhimakh sorevnovaniya? Igra slishkom slozhna, chtoby spravitsya samostoyatelno? Zovite druzey na pomoshch, ved Flat Heroes idealno podkhodit dlya sovmestnoy igry s druzyami! Zakazhite pitstsu, priglasite druzey i vypolnyayte zadaniya vmeste!

Это игра родом с Урала, впитавшая в себя:
Eto igra rodom s Urala, vpitavshaya v sebya ukhodyashchiy v proshloe tekhnologicheskiy dukh rossiyskoy glubinki v zhanre stimpank kvest.

«Pnevmo-Capsula» priotkroet dver v istoriyu parallelnoy rossiyskoy realnosti, gde obshchestvo i tekhnologii razvivalis po puti kultivatsii surovoy mekhaniki. Anturazh sovetskoy epokhi, boylerpanka, vremya slovno zamerlo na razlome 1930-1960 godov. Utopicheskoe reshenie vlastey: v gorodakh ne postroili dorogi, a imeyushchiesya demontirovali i ne vypuskali avtomobiley. Gorod soedinen edinoy sistemoy rels, putey, i trub. Samoy malenkoy chastyu etoy prichudlivoy sistemy yavlyaetsya mekhanicheskaya pochta, za kotoruyu i predstoit Vam igrat.

Osnovnaya ideya igry - kroshechnye relsy, ispeshchryayushchie zavody, platformy i zhilye doma, soedinyaya ikh v edinuyu set. Imenno po nim Vam predstoit puteshestvovat, preodolevaya razlichnye golovolomki.

Po mere prokhozhdeniya igroku vstretyatsya dikovinnye zhilye prostranstva-golovolomki: «Budka smotritelya» na stolbe elektroperedach, slozhennaya iz shpal; "Aeroplatforma" c domikami na vysote; "Izba khudozhnika", zakreplennaya pryamo na LEP! Pri vsey dikosti idey, igroku na intuitivnom urovne stanet ponyatno prednaznachenie obektov i ikh funktsional.

«Задира», или «Хулиган» — видеоигра в жа:
«Zadira», ili «Khuligan» — videoigra v zhanre priklyuchencheskogo boevika s vidom ot tretego litsa v otkrytom mire, iznachalno razrabotannaya Rockstar Vancouver i vypushchennaya Rockstar Games v oktyabre 2006 goda dlya igrovoy konsoli Sony PlayStation 2. Vsego, pomimo originalnogo reliza, sushchestvuet neskolko pereizdaniy. V 2008 godu igra byla vypushchena dlya Xbox 360, Nintendo Wii i Windows pod nazvaniem Bully: Scholarship Edition. V toy redaktsii proekt byl znachitelno pererabotan — perenesyon na novyy dvizhok Gamebryo, ispolzuyutsya bolee kachestvennye modeli i tekstury plyus poyavilis novye syuzhetnye zadaniya i uroki. V 2012 godu pervonachalnaya versiya 2006 goda byla pereizdana na PlayStation 3 bez izmeneniy v serii «Klassika PlayStation 2»; v 2016 godu ona zhe pereizdana na PlayStation 4 s dobavleniem sistemy trofeev i povyshennogo razresheniya.
V 2016 godu versiya Bully: Anniversary Edition (kotoraya predstavlena v etoy razdache), byla izdana na mobilnykh ustroystvakh pod upravleniem sistem iOS i Android. Variant analogichen Scholarship Edition, no adaptirovan dlya portativnykh ustroystv. Raboty po portirovaniyu byli vypolneny Grove Street Games.

Half-Life («период полураспада») — компь:
Half-Life («period poluraspada») — kompyuternaya igra v zhanre nauchno-fantasticheskogo shutera ot pervogo litsa, razrabotannaya kompaniey Valve Software i izdannaya Sierra Studios 19 noyabrya 1998 goda, pervaya v svoey serii.
Half-Life stala odnoy iz pervykh igr, v kotorykh syuzhet razvivaetsya polnostyu vnutri igrovogo prostranstva bez ispolzovaniya videozastavok. Igrovye izdaniya vysoko otsenili novatorskiy stil povestvovaniya, yavlyayushchiysya glavnym dostoinstvom igry. Drugoy silnoy storonoy Half-Life nazyvayut iskusstvennyy intellekt protivnikov, osobenno na tot moment vremeni. Mnogie kritiki otmechayut, chto ona proizvela revolyutsiyu v zhanre shutera ot pervogo litsa i polozhila nachalo novomu etapu razvitiya videoigr.
Eto — neofitsialnaya versiya igry dlya Switch, osnovannaya na Xash3D-fwgs (gitkhab) — otkrytom igrovom dvizhke ot russkoyazychnykh programmistov, sovmestimom s GoldSource i napisannom na osnove svobodnykh iskhodnykh kodov Id Tech (Id Tech, Id Tech 2/3), a takzhe nekotorykh proizvodnykh ot etikh dvizhkov (DarkPlaces). On pozvolyaet zapuskat bazovuyu igru Half-Life i mnogie eyo modifikatsii, i pri etom obladaet sushchestvennym ryadom rasshireniy. Dannaya razdacha osnovana na vanilnoy Steam-versii ot 21.08.18, i xash3d fgsfdsfgs dlya konsoli v0.20-nx2 ot 28 maya 2021-go, a takzhe vklyuchaet v sebya standalone-dopolneniya Half-Life: Opposing Force, Half-Life: Blue Shift. Mody s kastomnym kodom (cl_dlls, dlls, napr., USS Darkstar) ne podderzhivayutsya. Versiya s ukrainskoy ozvuchkoy. Est bagi.Counter-Strike 1.6 na Xash3D sm. zdes, versiyu s modami tut.

В Red Wings: American Aces вам предстоит:

15 raznykh boevykh samolyotov s unikalnymi raskraskami: uvidev vash samolyot v pylu srazheniya, vragi neskoro ego zabudut!

REZ PLZ представляет из себя платформенн:
REZ PLZ predstavlyaet iz sebya platformennuyu golovolomku s novym podkhodom k rezhimu odinochnoy i sovmestnoy igry. Ubivayte svoego brata, chtoby razgadyvat golovolomki i prokhodit podzemelya. Srazites s silami Temnogo Arkanuma vmeste s volshebnikami-uchenikami Arkanom i Zefom, vooruzhennymi lish Svitkom voskresheniya, s pomoshchyu kotorogo oni mogut vernut drug druga k zhizni. Po mere prokhozhdeniya vy poluchite dostup k novym zaklinaniyam, dayushchim raznye sposobnosti, s pomoshchyu kotorykh vy i proydete vse bolee slozhnye ispytaniya.

OSOBENNOSTI
 
Sovmestnaya igra
REZ PLZ ispolzuet unikalnyy podkhod k traditsionnoy kontseptsii sovmestnoy igry pod drugim sousom. Vmesto togo chtoby ne dat drug drugu umeret, igroki dolzhny strategicheski ubivat drug druga pri prokhozhdenii kazhdogo urovnya, chtoby reshat golovolomki i unichtozhat protivnikov. Dlya ozhivleniya Arkana ili Zefa ispolzuetsya Svitok voskresheniya.
 
Smert za kazhdym povorotom
V REZ PLZ smert — obychno ot odnogo-edinstvennogo udara — podkaraulivaet povsyudu! Geroy mozhet byt razrublen popolam, seden chudovishchami, sozhzhen zazhivo i t. d.
 
Otkroyte magicheskie zaklinaniya
Otkryvayte novye zaklinaniya, chtoby preodolevat vse bolee slozhnye ispytaniya, no budte ostorozhny: eti bratya plokho vladeyut magiey, a kazhdoe neudachnoe zaklinanie mozhet privesti k smerti!
 
Otkryvaemye predmety
Issleduyte igrovoy mir i nakhodite mnozhestvo otkryvaemykh kosmeticheskikh predmetov, a takzhe otkryvaemye urovni, pozvolyayushchie nastroit igrovoy protsess po svoemu vkusu. Uglubites v igru eshche bolshe s pomoshchyu bonusnykh rezhimov, takikh kak PvP-sostyazaniya po begu. 
 
Syuzhet
REZ PLZ rasskazyvaet istoriyu dvukh volshebnikov-uchenikov — Arkana i Zefa. Posle togo kak ikh shkolu zakhvatyvayut sily zla, im prikhoditsya obedinit sily, chtoby pobedit zlykh koldunov Temnogo Arkanuma, no delo v tom, chto volshebniki iz Arkana i Zefa — kak sito iz sobachego khvosta. Khotya geroi postepenno uchat novye zaklinaniya, ovladevayut oni magiey medlenno. Kogda oni umirayut, ikh ozhivlyaet Svitok vozrozhdeniya.
 
Spravka
REZ PLZ byla razrabotana bratyami Dzhoshem i Neytom Pirs, osnovatelyami Long Neck Games. Na sozdanie REZ PLZ ikh vdokhnovili beschislennye chasy, provedennye v detstve za igrami v sovmestnom rezhime.

Po mere togo, kak poyavlyayutsya novye gadzhety, proizvodite vsyo bolshe raznoobraznykh predmetov, i postepenno, pod vashim upravleniem gorod nachnyot shiritsya i rastsvetat!..

УНИКАЛЬНАЯ МЕХАНИКА ЗАГАДОК С МЕЛОДИЯМИ\:
UNIKALNAYa MEKhANIKA ZAGADOK S MELODIYaMI
V Sonority igrok budet issledovat zateryannyy mir, v kotorom muzyka imeet magicheskie svoystva i pomogaet v reshenii raznykh zadach.
Zagadki reshayutsya pri pomoshchi vernogo raspolozheniya not. K resheniyu mozhno priyti, poslushav melodiyu ili ispolzovav simvoly. Muzykalnoe obrazovanie ne trebuetsya.


ISTORIYa
Vy budete igrat za yunuyu Ester, otpravivshuyusya v puteshestvie s fleytoy Pana v karmane, chtoby pomoch svoemu drugu. Ona dobiraetsya do tainstvennogo sada kamney, no vskore popadaet v tupik, i ey prikhoditsya raschishchat sebe put pri pomoshchi sily muzyki. A eto ne vsegda legko.
V mire, pogruzhennom v tishinu, Ester nakhodit poteryannye pesni i starinnye proizvedeniya iskusstva, a pomogayut ey v etom poyushchie kamni i govoryashchiy enot. No ot legendarnykh nastavnikov muzyki, pokhozhe, ne ostalos i sleda.

POSTEPENNO USLOZhNYaYuShchIESYa ZAGADKI
Chem dalshe vy prokhodite — tem khitree stanovyatsya zagadki. Sobirayte novye noty i instrumenty dlya resheniya samykh slozhnykh zagadok nastavnikov.

OSOBENNOSTI
• Novaya interesnaya mekhanika, osnovannaya na melodiyakh: prostye notnye sozvuchiya sobirayutsya v korotkie melodii, a potom i v otryvki poslozhnee.
• Trogatelnaya istoriya ob Ester, chudile-starike enote i ego poyushchikh kamennykh druzyakh.
• Atmosfernyy obemnyy saundtrek s angliyskimi i nemetskimi versiyami originalnykh pesen.
• Polnaya angliyskaya ozvuchka s subtitrami na russkom, ispanskom, nemetskom, frantsuzskom, italyanskom, portugalskom, kitayskom, koreyskom i yaponskom yazykakh.

Sovershenno novye vozmozhnosti Rune Factory 3 Special vklyuchayut rezhim molodozhyonov, otdelnye priklyucheniya, otkryvayushchiesya posle zhenitby na kazhdoy iz 11 devushek, a takzhe adskiy uroven slozhnosti, kotoryy budet nelegko proyti dazhe opytnym igrokam!

Khot vy novichok serii, khot veteran, vozvrashchayushchiysya posle dolgogo otsutstviya, pogruzites v nezabyvaemuyu intrigu Rune Factory 3 s uluchshennoy grafikoy i pererabotannymi 3D-modelyami personazhey.

■Priklyuchenie v dvukh mirakh
Deystvuyte ot imeni Miki, molodogo cheloveka s amneziey i tainstvennoy sposobnostyu prevrashchatsya v pokhozhee na barana chudovishche, kotoryy ishchet sposob primirit lyudey i monstrov.

■Zakhvatyvayushchie RPG-boi

■Vzrashchivanie novoy zhizni
Rasslablyaytes posle dolgogo dnya, polnogo priklyucheniy: zanimaytes selskim khozyaystvom, rybalkoy i mnogim drugim. Otkryvayte dlya sebya samye raznye volshebnye semena — iz nikh vyrastayut udivitelnye rasteniya, kotorye sdelayut vashi priklyucheniya vesyolymi i zakhvatyvayushchimi!

Znakomtes s 11 prekrasnymi devushkami — eto bolshe, chem v lyuboy iz igr serii! Uznavayte ikh s kazhdym dnyom vsyo luchshe i luchshe, beseduya i vypolnyaya zadaniya, vlyublyaytes, zatem zadavayte samyy glavnyy vopros — i vperyod, pod venets! Touken Ranbu Warriors — это экшн, в кото:
Touken Ranbu Warriors — eto ekshn, v kotorom obedinilis simulyator «dukhov klinkov» Touken Ranbu -ONLINE-, razrabotannyy DMM GAMES i NITRO PLUS, i potryasayushchaya seriya WARRIORS v stile «1 protiv 1000» ot KOEI TECMO GAMES.

● Touken Ranbu teper v 3D. Vas zhdet samaya krasivaya grafika v istorii serii WARRIORS.
Znakomye poklonnikam pervoistochnika personazhi Touken Dansi (Touken Danshi) brosyatsya na pole boya v 3D.

● Istoricheskaya drama, razvorachivayushchayasya vokrug pyatnadtsati voploshcheniy klinkov iz bluzhdayushchey bazy khonmaru (Honmaru) vo vremena perioda Sengoku (Sengoku). Pogruzites v unikalnuyu epicheskuyu istoriyu, dostupnuyu tolko v etoy igre.

Opisanie syuzheta:
Touken Dansi (Touken Danshi), 15 voploshcheniy klinkov, bestselno puteshestvuyushchikh bez mastera Saniva (Saniwa), podverglis vnezapnomu napadeniyu so storony Armii istoricheskikh reaktsionerov (History Retrograde Army).
Kogda boy zavershilsya, Pravitelstvo vremeni (Government of the Time) prikazalo im provesti «rassledovanie napadeniya» (onslaught investigations).
Klinkam bez khozyaina prishlos otpravitsya v sumburnyy mir perioda Sengoku (Sengoku), istoriya kotorogo uzhe nachala menyatsya.

● Khonmaru (Honmaru) sluzhit bazoy dlya Touken Dansi (Touken Danshi). Vas zhdut mnozhestvo osobykh sobytiy i elementov, unikalnykh dlya etoy igry.
Touken Dansi (Touken Danshi) mozhno svobodno razmeshchat v lyubykh mestakh trekhmernogo khonmaru (Honmaru) — bazy, gde zhivut personazhi.
Igroki mogut nablyudat za tem, chto Touken Dansi (Touken Danshi) delayut v khonmaru (Honmaru), a takzhe prosmatrivat unikalnye sobytiya, v kotorykh personazhi vzaimodeystvuyut drug s drugom.
V pereryvakh mezhdu boyami igroki mogut otdokhnut i sygrat v mini-igry, naprimer, v «skopiruy pozu» (Pose Matching) ili «dogonyalki» (Tag).
Takzhe dostupen fotorezhim (Photo Mode), v kotorom igroki smogut delat snimki Touken Dansi (Touken Danshi) i publikovat ikh v SNS.

● Dobavlen legkiy rezhim, kotoryy uprostit vzaimodeystvie s igroy tem igrokam, kto eshche ne znakom s ekshn-igrami.
Igrokam dostupno dva tipa upravleniya na vybor: «obychnyy rezhim» (Regular Mode), ispolzuyushchiy traditsionnuyu dlya igr serii WARRIORS skhemu upravleniya, i «legkiy rezhim» (Easy Mode), v kotorom ispolzuetsya skhema upravleniya, podkhodyashchaya dlya igrokov, malo znakomykh s ekshn-igrami.
V poslednem komandy vvodyatsya prostymi nazhatiyami knopok, chtoby ne otvlekat igrokov ot zavorazhivayushchego deystviya.

Killer Chambers eto gibrid ekshen-platformera/igry dlya trenirovki pamyati. Ty dolzhen vyzhit v malenkikh komnatakh, zapolnennykh lovushkami, do odnogo oborota pesochnykh chasov.

Samye smelye? Net... Eto 88 geroev!

История человечества\nPine — это приключ:
Istoriya chelovechestva
Pine — eto priklyuchencheskiy boevik s otkrytym razvivayushchimsya mirom. Puteshestvuyte po zakhvatyvayushchim dukh prostoram Evolmara v roli nakhodchivogo podrostka Khyu, kotoromu dlya vyzhivaniya pridetsya srazhatsya, torgovat i issledovat opasnye zemli, gde chelovek — ne na vershine pishchevoy tsepi.

Tvorite svoyu istoriyu
V poiskakh novogo doma dlya plemeni vam predstoit poznakomitsya s bogatoy ekosistemoy Evolmara. Issleduyte, torguyte, sozdavayte, obshchaytes i srazhaytes s obitatelyami ostrova v shesti razlichnykh biosistemakh.

Vyzhit lyuboy tsenoy
Zhizn v otkrytom mire Pine ne stoit na meste. U kazhdogo ego obitatelya tolko odna tsel — vsemi silami vyzhit. Podruzhites s ponravivshimisya vam sushchestvami i srazhaytes s nimi bok o bok ili ukradite ikh pishchu i vynudite iskat novyy dom. Postoyanno razvivayushchiysya mir igry reagiruet na vse vashi deystviya.

Vpervye v serii displey polnostyu gorizontalnyy, pozvolyaya miru muzyki zapolnit vsyo vashe pole zreniya! Vizualnoe oformlenie znachitelno uluchsheno, a nekotorye pesni dazhe soderzhat stseny iz originalnykh muzykalnykh klipov!
