Ikai — это психологический хоррор от пер:
Ikai — eto psikhologicheskiy khorror ot pervogo litsa po motivam yaponskogo folklora. Ispytayte uzhas ot vstrechi s yokayami i pogruzites v sueveriya proshlogo, issleduya igrovoy mir i prokhodya unikalnyy syuzhet.

Ikai voploshchaet v sebe dukh klassicheskogo zhanra psikhologicheskogo khorrora s bezzashchitnym glavnym geroem, nesposobnym atakovat zlykh sushchestv. Odnako igra takzhe eksperimentiruet s novym chuvstvom uzhasa, zastavlyaya igroka stolknutsya s ugrozami litsom k litsu, ne ubegaya i ne napadaya.

STRAKh: ispytayte uzhas ot pervogo litsa, stolknuvshis s yaponskimi dukhami, chudovishchami i yokayami.

ISSLEDOVANIE: progulyaytes po srednevekovomu sintoistskomu khramu i issleduyte ego, chtoby uznat istoriyu, kotoraya tam proizoshla.

RISOVANIE: sosredotochtes na nanesenii zashchitnykh pechatey, poka vokrug razdayutsya strannye zvuki i proiskhodyat neveroyatnye sobytiya.

GOLOVOLOMKI: reshite neskolko golovolomok, kotorye popytayutsya vas ostanovit.

SKRYTNOST I BEG: kradites tikho, chtoby ne potrevozhit zlo... Ili prosto begite, begite izo vsekh sil, esli smozhete…
Независимая микростудия из двух человек:

Gonyayte na svoem kosmicheskom korable v oshelomitelno stilizovannom okruzhenii, otslezhivaya poloski sveta i odnovremenno vysvobozhdaya energiyu, kotoraya prevrashchaetsya v muzyku igry. Uchastvuyte v stolknoveniyakh so strannymi vragami i epokhalnykh srazheniyakh s bossami pod akkompanement neveroyatnoy litsenzirovannoy zvukovoy dorozhki, v kotoroy otmetilis takie ispolniteli, kak Noisia, Flux Pavilion, Katy B, The Prototypes, Neosignal i mnogie drugie.
The Legacy\nFantasy General II: Invasion:
The Legacy
Fantasy General II: Invasion is the reimagination of the strategy game classic from the 90s! Armies once again draw battle-lines on the war-torn land of Keldonia, and a new generation of commanders will test their bravery and tactics against each other. Fantasy wargaming is back!
The Battles
True to the tradition of the original game, Fantasy General II is all about turn-based battles. Lead over 75 different unique unit types, including powerful heroes. Take into consideration terrain, weapons and armour, magical effects, morale, and the balance of forces, make a plan, execute it, and vanquish your enemy, forging your reputation as a savage war-leader.
The Campaign
Battle after battle, you will need to make decisions and develop your army. The young clan members will need to be trained, and as they gain enough experience, even the greenest recruits can be turned into champions. But beware: costly victories can be worse than a defeat… when battle-hardened units perish, so does their progression and experience. Each unit comes with their specific abilities, arms and armour, and they can be equipped with magic artefacts you find during battle and upgraded with gold and resources that you need to plunder from your enemy.
The Clans
A confederation of autonomous hill-land tribes, who value their independence and will fight fiercely for it. Field axemen, berserkers, spearmaidens, trolls and shamans, summon ancestor spirits and mighty elementals or train nimble stag riders and deadly werebears or recruit mercenaries from longbowmen to centaurs.
The Empire
The most powerful realm on the face of Aer. Face the mighty Legions of the Empire and their magical creations from dragon cannons to golems as well as the Undead hordes they bring to battle, or fight harpies, lizard people and great dragons on your way.
The World
The world of Aer is filled with beauty and wonders. From the cold, magic-rich highlands of Fareach, home to the player’s Barbarian Clans, to the Borderlands with their fertile river valleys and deep woods where witches and monsters still roam free; from the Sunken Land, submerged through a great Cataclysm and filled with treacherous swamp and Lizardfolk, to the refined and temperate Empire to the South, home to wondrous cities and built upon undead labour. Your campaign will see you fight across very different battlefields, requiring variable tactics and army composition.
Wrapped in a mind-bending tale, the game:
Wrapped in a mind-bending tale, the gameplay of “MIND” focuses on changing the very weather in order to solve puzzles: the player will cycle between day and night, modify the levels of fog and rain and even travel in time between seasons, changing the environment to advance the gameplay-driven story —indeed, the mechanics are directly related to who the protagonist is, what has happened to him and everything he is doing: a man trapped in his own mind, he must use all the tools at his disposition to escape to reality. Accompanied by the snarky yet heartfelt narration of this comatose patient, the player will guide him through fantastical forests, dark caverns and deceptive worlds of water and ice that directly relate to his emotional state at each point in his journey.

Features

• 4 secret levels, redesigned interactive ending, narration and also an alternative ending.
• More than 40 different, creative puzzles seamlessly integrated into the environment.
• 6 ways to affect the environment in order to solve the puzzles.
• More than 25 distinct landscapes into with which you will be able to interact.
• Turn day to night, make it so everything is covered by a blinding fog, summon incredible storms, travel to the past and make use of even more as of yet unknown mechanics.
• More than an hour of voice acting that, while integrated into the gameplay itself, will tell you a whole story that is not about saving the world but about living through the pain of a father broken by his mistakes.
• Face down imposing enemies by using your creativity and everything you have learnt along the way.

NEC PC-8800 (неформально PC-88) — семейс:
NEC PC-8800 (neformalno PC-88) — semeystvo vosmibitnykh kompyuterov kompanii NEC na baze Z80-sovmestimogo protsessora. Kompyutery semeystva yavlyalis odnimi iz samykh populyarnykh v Yaponii blagodarya sbalansirovannomu sootnosheniyu «tsena-kharakteristiki». Nachinaya s modeli mkII SR kompyutery postavlyalis takzhe v SShA, no tam bolshoy populyarnosti im poluchit ne udalos. Pervye modeli semeystva pozitsionirovalis kak biznes-resheniya, no posle vykhoda v 1982 godu PC-9801 kompyuter stal prodvigatsya kak ustroystvo dlya khobbi i igr. Model PC-8801 mk IISR, seryozno uluchshennaya v plane grafiki i zvuka, okonchatelno zakrepila eto napravlenie. Upadok semeystva nachalsya v 1987 godu, kogda vychislitelnykh moshchnostey dlya igr stalo ne khvatat. Igroki stali perekhodit na bolee moshchnye PC-98 i Sharp X68000.
MSX (Machines with Software eXchangeability) — nazvanie standarta dlya bytovykh kompyuterov 1980-kh godov. On yavlyalsya popytkoy sozdaniya edinykh standartov dlya razrabotchikov apparatnogo obespecheniya, initsiirovannoy yaponskim otdeleniem kompanii Microsoft i Kadzukhiko Nisi, vozglavlyavshim ego na tot moment. Takzhe v razrabotke standarta uchastvovala yaponskaya kompaniya ASCII Corporation, osnovannaya Nisi sovmestno s Kadzuya Vatanabe spetsialno dlya etoy tseli. Kompyutery standarta MSX poluchili bolshuyu populyarnost v Yaponii i ryade drugikh stran, odnako, nesmotrya na podderzhku Microsoft, pochti ne poluchili izvestnosti v SShA i Evrope. Vsego v mire bylo prodano bolee 7,5 milliona ekzemplyarov MSX-sovmestimykh kompyuterov, iz nikh 5 mln — v Yaponii.
Project EGG (プロジェクトEGG, Purojekuto EGG, EGG oznachaet «Zakhvatyvayushchaya galereya igr») — eto osnovannaya na emulyatsii sluzhba dostavki igrovogo kontenta dlya operatsionnykh sistem dlya Windows, orientirovannaya na igry, iznachalno vypushchennye dlya starykh yaponskikh domashnikh kompyuterov, takikh kak NEC PC-9801 ili Sistemy Fujitsu FM-7. S 2010 goda servis takzhe vklyuchaet igry dlya domashnikh konsoley (takikh kak Famicom ili Sega Mega Drive), a takzhe arkadnye igry. Khotya nazvanie EGG yavlyaetsya abbreviaturoy, ono takzhe otsylaet k talismanu servisa, yaytsu, rodom iz odnoimennoy igry Bothtec 1985 goda.

To The Rescue! — симулятор приюта для со:
To The Rescue! — simulyator priyuta dlya sobak, v kotorom ot vas zavisyat zhizni desyatkov zamechatelnykh bezdomnykh sobak. Odnako vam predstoit ne tolko gladit ikh i umilyatsya. Derzhat priyut — neprostaya zadacha. Vam pridyotsya udovletvoryat nuzhdy sobak, chtoby uvelichit ikh shansy byt prinyatymi v semyu.

Kazhdyy den budet prinosit novye ispytaniya i nagrady. U sobak est predpochteniya, oni mogut zarazitsya razlichnymi boleznyami, a takzhe priobresti negativnye cherty. No s drugoy storony, vy smozhete ustraivat blagotvoritelnye vstrechi i poluchat sluchaynye pozhertvovaniya. A esli postaraetes — nayti komu-to novogo luchshego druga. K neschastyu, mesta vsegda ne khvataet, a sobak stanovitsya vsyo bolshe i bolshe.

Nekotorykh sobak zabirayut bystree drugikh, no esli u vas poluchitsya prozhdat dostatochno dolgo, vdrug poluchitsya nayti dom dlya kazhdoy.



Priobshchites k realnoy blagotvoritelnosti. 20% pribyli razrabotchikov ot prodazh To The Rescue! napravlyaetsya v nastoyashchie priyuty dlya sobak pri posrednichestve nashego partnyora PetFinder Foundation.
Kazhdaya sobaka unikalna. Kazhdaya sobaka sozdayotsya so svoimi predpochteniyami i osobennostyami, chto delayut kazhdogo pyosika neobychnym i zapominayushchimsya.
Podbirayte sobak pod nuzhdy usynoviteley. Lyudi, zhelayushchie zavesti sobaku, chasto budut iskat chto-to konkretnoe. Podberite zhivotnoe, sootvetstvuyushchee ikh predpochteniyam, chtoby maksimalno uvelichit ego shansy na usynovlenie.
Uluchshayte i ukrashayte svoy priyut. Esli u vas budut lishnie sredstva, vy smozhete uluchshit priyut, postaviv v nyom roskoshnye volery, nanyav pomoshchnikov i mnogoe drugoe!
Dveri priyuta dolzhny byt otkryty. Poroy budet slozhno ukhazhivat za vsemi sobakami v priyute. Vam pridyotsya proyavlyat berezhlivost i inogda prinimat trudnye resheniya, chtoby prodolzhat pomogat sobakam nakhodit semi.


... i da, konechno zhe, sobachek mozhno pogladit!

Polnyy geympley dlitsya bolee 4 chasov, no s onlayn-tablitsami liderov sushchestvuet bolshoy potentsial povtornogo prokhozhdeniya.

Fizicheskiy dvizhok Simcade dlya oshchushcheniya nastoyashchego avtomobilya, no s prostym podkhodom i upravleniem.

• 4 kategorii avtomobiley, ot mikroavtomobiley do F1.
• 12 chempionatov
• 17 unikalnykh lokatsiy, v obshchey slozhnosti 50 trass (variatsii iz 17 trass vklyuchayut obratnyy segment i slalom).
• Upravlyayte fantasticheskimi avtomobilyami 60-kh godov.
• Kross-platformennye mirovye onlayn-tablitsy liderov dlya kazhdoy trassy. Svobodnyy rezhim dlya uluchsheniya vashego vremeni v spiskakh liderov.
• Avtomobil krichit, a vykhlopnye gazy polykhayut plamenem! Maksimum slukhovykh oshchushcheniy.
• Sbalansirovannyy geympley s prostymi mashinami dlya upravleniya v nachale chempionata i moshchnymi monstrami blizhe k kontsu.
Эпическая история о чудесах, приключения:
Epicheskaya istoriya o chudesakh, priklyucheniyakh i... rybalke? Zlo ugrozhaet zakhvatit Azerim, a vse geroi kuda-to ischezli! Prostoy rybak Beylin vynuzhden zashchishchat Khanivud po-svoemu! No chto-to izmenilos... Beylin bolshe ne NPC, a... geroy! Spravitsya li on s takoy otvetstvennostyu?! Srazhaytes s rybami, ispolzuya tochnyy raschet i magiyu, prokachivayte sposobnosti, pobedite zlo i vosstanovite Khanivud.
Utrechka! Otlichnyy denyok dlya rybalki!
HOLYHUNT is a roguelike shooter game tha:
HOLYHUNT is a roguelike shooter game that unites the nostalgic and fun 8-bit aesthetic with modern and deep shooting mechanics. 

Make your way into the church hall to shoot and dash-holy-punch through different species of demons and bosses with unique mechanics that keeps challenging your abilities each run. 

Buy improvements and different bullets suited to exploit your enemies weakness and recieve blessings from angels as you keep fighting to get even stronger. 

Trust your faith and keep shooting to save the world from the doomsday prophecy!

Feature

8-Bit Love Letter
Relive the nostalgia of an 8-bit game with a modern and challenging arena gameplay.

Roguelite meets Old School
Shoot your way through a large variety of demons in a fast-paced roguelike structure that encourages the player to improve and understand enemies in each run while keeping its 8-bit feel.

Bullet-Driven Strategic Gameplay 
Earn and change on-the-fly the different types of bullets that best fits your enemies weakness.

Holy Risk-Reward 
Finish staggered enemies with a risky melee Holy Punch to earn bullets, and use bullets to get enemies Staggered. Maybe you'll even receive blessings from angels?
Познакомьтесь с 3 лучшими играми от студ:
Poznakomtes s 3 luchshimi igrami ot studentov programmy magistratury razvlekatelnykh iskusstv i inzhenerii universiteta Yuty, samogo bolshogo i znachitelnogo vysshego uchebnogo zavedeniya shtata Yuta, Solt-Leyk-Siti, SShA!

Vklyucheny 3 igry:
Играй, ломай, круши, не читай инструкций:
Igray, lomay, krushi, ne chitay instruktsiy, ignoriruy podskazki i - samoe glavnoe! - zatkni rasskazchika. Tak emu i nado. Ty ved luchshe znaesh, kak igrat.

Naprimer, odnoy iz zadach mozhet byt ne chitat etot abzats. Prosto propusti ego. Idi dalshe, von zhe sleduyushchiy. Nachinaesh nadoedat. I… molodets. Pozdravlyayu. Ty narushil svoyo pervoe pravilo. I ved dazhe eshchyo ne kupil igru! Da ty u nas odaryonnyy! Ne dumal zanyatsya etim professionalno?

Soberi vse nagrady i dostizheniya i begi khvastatsya svoim podruzhkam, chto ty tolko chto byl v internete, bessovestno razyaril razrabotchika kakoy-to kompyuternoy igry i zastavil ego krichat na tebya pryam kak v rolike.
V obshchem, delay kak luchshe. Ili khuzhe. Ili vsyo srazu. Kak khochesh.
Osobennosti:
 • Okunis v besschyotnoe* kolichestvo urovney, s userdiem sobrannykh razrabotchikami. Nekotorye pokazhutsya tebe ochen zhiznennymi, nekotorye net. Kakaya raznitsa, kupi uzhe chyortovu igru
 • Polnostyu ozvuchennye khoroshie i plokhie prokhozhdeniya. Mozhesh slushat i ot smekha nadryvat zhivotik, a mozhesh vyklyuchit i sidet v polnoy tishine, preryvayushcheysya razve chto tikhim plachem nashego zvukovika
 • Mnogo raznoobraznykh nagrad i dostizheniy, narisovannykh golodnym nizkooplachivaemym khudozhnikom – my ne skupimsya na to, chtoby ty, opyat sdelav chto-to kaverznoe i pokhikhikav paru sekund, poluchil za eto krasivyy (khot i nevkusnyy) pryanik
 • Khvataet i momentov, kogda budesh vosklitsat: "Aa?", "Chyo?" i "Luchshe poydu Dom2 posmotryu"… Shutim-shutim, nichego takogo ne budet. Ty prosto budesh klikat po vsemu ekranu i shvyryat predmety vo vse storony
 • Lomayushchiy chetvyortuyu stenu yumor, s kotorym my yavno pereborshchili. Syuda zhe vkhodyat i vsevozmozhnye otsylki, kotorye ponimaet tolko nash programmist-botan. Chto-to vrode "42" i "Lozhki net". Vot zadrot, a?

Dragon Marked For Death is a side-scroll:
Dragon Marked For Death is a side-scrolling 2D action RPG that can played solo or with up to four players in local or online multiplayer.

The playable characters in Dragon Marked for Death: Frontline Fighters are the Empress and Warrior.

You play as the survivors of the Dragonblood Clan who set out to take revenge on the Kingdom of Medius, who destroyed their home and captured the Dragonblood Oracle, Amica. To obtain the power they need to enact their revenge, they forge a pact with the Astral Dragon Atruum.

Use your newly acquired powers to take on quests from villagers and raise your status in the kingdom. How you perform in these quests can have a direct effect on the game's final outcome. 

Quests aren't all about defeating enemies, though. You'll guard a ship's passengers from monsters, search for hidden treasure, rescue a princess from a castle under siege, and a lot more!

Choose from four playable characters (Empress, Warrior, Shinobi, or Witch) and defeat your enemies to gain experience and level up. You'll receive points as you level up that can increase your attack power, defense, agility, and other parameters. Customize your character in a way that best suits your individual playstyle!

Team up with up to four players in co-op multiplayer action via local wireless, or go online with Nintendo Switch™ Online and use worldwide matchmaking system to play with adventurers all over the world. By strategizing and working together with your party, you'll be able to achieve even greater results and reap even better rewards!

Get ready to experience the unique, dark fantasy world of the Dragonblood Clan in this intense 2D action-RPG!
В Shakedown: Hawaii тебя ждёт открытый 1:
V Shakedown: Hawaii tebya zhdyot otkrytyy 16-bitnyy mir s tremya protagonistami, kuchey osnovnykh i pobochnykh zadaniy, a takzhe arkadnymi mini-igrami i stroitelstvom imperii. Issleduy ostrov peshkom, na mashine ili na lodke. Ty smozhesh zakhodit v razlichnye magaziny, grabit doma, razgovarivat s prokhozhimi i otkryvat sekrety.

Ty generalnyy direktor kompanii... na grani krakha. Internet magaziny ubivayut tvoi larki, prilozheniya dlya poiska voditeley vredyat tvoemu taksoparku, a servisy potokovogo veshchaniya – tvoim videosalonam. Kak vidish, dela plokhi, tak chto tebe pridyotsya izuchit «sovremennye metodiki vedeniya biznesa».

Chtoby postroit svoyu «zakonoposlushnuyu» korporatsiyu, ty mozhesh vypolnyat zadaniya, vykupat drugie kompanii, stroit kozni konkurentam, a takzhe zanimatsya reketom i makhinatsiyami s zemlyami pod stroitelstvo.

Ves ostrov mozhet byt u tvoikh nog... nuzhno lish razrabotat pravilnuyu model biznesa.
Фабула строится на предыстории злого кол:
Fabula stroitsya na predystorii zlogo kolduna Vaati: presleduya korystnye tseli, on obrashchaet printsessu Zeldu v kamen. Okazat pomoshch v snyatii proklyatiya mogut lish kroshechnye sozdaniya — Pikori, takzhe nazyvaemye Minishi. Poskolku uvidet ikh mozhet tolko rebyonok, spasenie printsessy poruchaetsya Linku. On otpravlyaetsya na poiski chetyryokh elementov, neobkhodimykh dlya pochinki mecha pikori, kotoryy smozhet snyat zaklyatie. V puti emu pomogaet Ezlo — govoryashchaya zelyonaya shlyapa, spasyonnaya im v Lesu Minishey..
The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap (yap. Dzeruda no Densetsu Fusigi no Bo:si, ゼルダの伝説 ふしぎのぼうし) — videoigra iz serii The Legend of Zelda, razrabotannaya dlya portativnoy konsoli Game Boy Advance i vypushchennaya v 2004 godu v Yaponii i Evrope. The Minish Cap yavlyaetsya syuzhetnym prodolzheniem igr The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past and Four Swords.
Igra poluchila polozhitelnye otzyvy v presse: GameSpot aktsentiroval vnimanie na klassicheskom geymplee, kharakternom dlya serii Zelda, i v to zhe vremya obladayushchem svoey izyuminkoy, GameSpy obrashchaet vnimanie na muzykalnoe soprovozhdenie igry, nazyvaya ego odnim iz naibolee kachestvennykh na GBA. IGN vklyuchil The Minish Cap v spisok 20 luchshikh igr dlya Game Boy Advance, a GameSpot prisvoil igre zvanie «Luchshaya igra 2005 goda dlya GBA».

Lone Wolf is back, as a video game with:
Lone Wolf is back, as a video game with a brand-new story, a deep combat system, stunning graphics and much more! Make meaningful choices and carve your own path through this epic non-linear adventure. Test your strength in dynamic turn-based battles, prove your skill with the lock-picking minigame and accept the challenge of wits posed by the mysterious Shianti Cube!
The author Joe Dever has played an active role in the development of the game. The story he has written fits with the original continuity, but it also sheds a new light on Lone Wolf’s world, Magnamund!
For Sommerlund and the Kai!

KEY FEATURES
• A brand-new adventure written by Joe Dever, with a deep and dark redesign of Lone Wolf, his world and his enemies.
• A seamless experience that includes all 4 acts of the story. Discover what happened at the frontier village of Rockstarn, explore the Sunken Forest and unveil the secrets of the Shianti Temple. Then, take the fight to the enemy storming the fortress of V’taag. Are you ready to write your own destiny?
• A real medieval tome with hand-drawn illustrations.
• Create your character and try out different combinations of Kai Disciplines, traits and gear.
• Write your own story through multiple choices.

• 3 different difficulty levels to make the fighting experience more accessible -or more challenging!
• Play again, make different choices and explore new paths and fighting styles!
Brace yourself for the ultimate action!\:
Brace yourself for the ultimate action!
The shadow of evil looms over the peaceful realm of Elysium once more. The Destiny of Light calls upon you to become the savior of Elysium.

Play your role as Gladiator, Assassin, Wizard, and Fighter to avenge the innocent and bring an end to the tragedy for good. Fight to survive and survive to fight.

Вам одиноко. И вам предстоит собрать сущ:
Vam odinoko. I vam predstoit sobrat sushchestvo, komplekt kostey, tovarishcha s chutkim i goryachim serdtsem.
Birth — eto point & click pazl-advenchura, v kotoroy vam predstoit sobirat kosti i organy, chtoby sozdat iz nikh sushchestvo, sposobnoe skrasit vashe odinochestvo. Vas zhdut ocharovatelnye narisovannye lokatsii, polnye zagadok i sekretov.
Rock of Ages II: Bigger and Boulder прод:
Rock of Ages II: Bigger and Boulder prodolzhaet sokrushitelnye traditsii velichayshey igry v zhanre Tower Defense pro istoriyu, iskusstvo i gigantskie valuny. Samo nazvanie namekaet, chto v Bigger and Boulder eshche bolshe absurda i drayva. Vas zhdut novye bezumnye mnogopolzovatelskie batalii dvoe na dvoe i novye epokhi, a takzhe ulushennye grafika, fizika i razrushaemost na dvizhke Unreal Engine 4. Prigotovtes krushit i lomat so svistom v ushakh. Prigotovtes k... BIGGER AND BOULDER!

Rock of Ages II: Bigger and Boulder — eto: 

- Firmennye prichudy ACE Team. Absurdnyy yumor v stile parney iz "Monti Payton" prosto zashkalivaet, poka igroki v bukvalnom smysle katyatsya naprolom cherez raznye epokhi. Krome togo, shutlivykh animirovannykh figurok stalo eshche bolshe, tak chto beregites, istoricheskie lichnosti! 
- Aktsent na mnogopolzovatelskikh srazheniyakh. Nemnogo druzheskogo sopernichestva ne povredit, poetomu komanda ACE Team reshila dorabotat mnogopolzovatelskuyu sostavlyayushchuyu igry. Vyberite znamya i tsvet dlya svoego "personazha" i sostyazaytes vchetverom v smertelnykh srazheniyakh dvoe na dvoe. I eshche — protivopolozhnye trassy teper mogut peresekatsya. 
- Komichnoe khudozhestvennoe oformlenie. Kak i v pervoy igre, pri sozdanii urovney komanda ACE Team cherpala vdokhnovenie v velichayshikh periodakh iskusstva. Naslazhdaytes izyskannymi rabotami vremen Drevnego Egipta, pozdney gotiki, Rannego Vozrozhdeniya i epokhi syurrealizma, poka te razletayutsya na melkie kusochki pod sokrushitelnymi udarami besposhchadnykh valunov!  
- Uluchshennaya fizika i razrushaemoe okruzhenie. My usovershenstvovali fiziku i dobavili eshche bolshe obektov, kotorye mozhno razbit, slomat, razdavit i sokrushit, chtoby vy mogli s absolyutnym upoeniem spuskat pod goru ogromnye valuny!
- Polneyshee bezumie. V igre poyavilis sovershenno novye oboronitelnye yunity i unikalnye valuny s osobymi svoystvami, poetomu prigotovtes k bezuderzhnomu khaosu — i ostorozhnee na povorotakh!
The Long Return is a casual third-person:
The Long Return is a casual third-person puzzle adventure game telling the story of an orphaned cub that retraces his steps from the last journey he took with his mother. Along the way you will be challenged by fun and unique puzzles, explore beautiful scenery full of life and relive past memories of your mother.

Key Features
- For fans of casual puzzle games with relaxing gameplay.
- Unique puzzles with varying range of difficulty.
- Grow from a pup into an adult through your journey.
- An amazing Original soundtrack by Dale North.
- No stressful elements, focus is on relaxing gameplay in beautiful scenery.
- A short game with satysfying story (roughly 2-3 hours of gameplay).

«Tenement» — eto dinamichnyy i zakhvatyvayushchiy ekshn, v kotoroy odnoznachno mozhno poymat fan!
Любительская процедурно-генерируемая rog:
Lyubitelskaya protsedurno-generiruemaya roguelike-brodilka v stile «A Link to the Past».
Polnostyu sozdannaya v GameMaker Studio s nulya s ispolzovaniem originalnykh resursov, v igru bylo dobavleno mnozhestvo novykh funktsiy i materialov, a osoboe vnimanie bylo udeleno tomu, chtoby ona vyglyadela, oshchushchalas i igralas tak zhe, kak khoroshaya igra ot Nintendo.
Tsel — spustitsya cherez mnozhestvo kishashchikh vragami podzemeliy i pobedit antagonista Linka, Aganima. Po puti vy naydete mnozhestvo oruzhiya, poleznykh predmetov i sokrovishch, kotorye pomogut vam v vashikh poiskakh!..
Вдохновлённая ранними Ultima тайловая по:
Vdokhnovlyonnaya rannimi Ultima taylovaya poshagovaya rolevaya igra s elementami roguelike.
Pyat vekov nazad zemlya Kaldery pogruzilas v kromeshnuyu tmu. Spustya desyatiletiya na nebe vzoshli pyat lun, prinesshikh v mir svet, a s nim i strannykh bogov. S bogami prishli Sny — prizyvy k pokloneniyu, v obmen na kotoroe obeshchany neveroyatnye Dary.
Snake Core is an Arcade game with simple:
Snake Core is an Arcade game with simple and familiar gameplay but twisting and turning the setting and variation into an inter-galactic war against an alien threat with a variation of mission types and army units.

Command your army of different soldier units as they attack aliens, take out bombs, retrieve soldiers, defend key locations, and hunt down big Snake like creatures.  The game plays in different game-modes, with a multi-route map that allows the player to decide the best route to the Alien Overlord.

Grab power-ups to improve your soldiers skills, wipe out aliens, and increase your score with combo's and tactics!


- Simple to understand game-loop – The game is easy to understand, and it allows everyone to enjoy the commanding of an off-world army with different units and strengths.
- Node based mission map – A randomized mission screen, allows you to choose which path you take to reach the end boss.
- Upgrades – Recruit new units, and upgrade your units for a stronger army.
- Short game sessions – Snake Core is designed for short gaming sessions, a great game to pick up at any time for a quick go!
Король Кейк, монарх с десертом, решил, ч:

IZOBRAZhENNYY arkadnyy geympley Stanovites bolshe, kak vy edite. Barf szhat do razmerov. Barf na vse, chto dvizhetsya. Pozhinat plody.

IZUChITE ZAPISNYE MIRY Gigantskie vzaimosvyazannye miry napolneny strannoy zhiznyu i sekretnymi nagradami. Otpravlyaytes v pyat sovershenno unikalnykh rayonov, vklyuchaya Sushi-Gardens, Kukhonnyy khaos i Astro-Farm.

Vyzov vruchnuyu

Massovye, dikie bossy Na vashem puti pridet pochti dyuzhina sumasshedshikh bossov. Kak ty pobesh Akkordeonnuyu Mnogonozhku? Ili zhivaya kucha nachos? Ispolzuyte svoy mozg, svoi navyki i rot!

NEVEROYaTNYY ZVUKOVOY OTVET

Edinstvennye v svoem rode bonusy Vo vsem korolevstve kosmicheskoy stantsii est desyatki spetsialnykh maskirovok. Oni vyglyadyat zdorovo, a takzhe dayut vam osobye sposobnosti! U kazhdoy maskirovki est za i protiv. Pomenyayte maskirovku, chtoby nayti luchshiy variant dlya kazhdoy situatsii.

OTKRYTYY ANTIKOM Ocharovatelnye Pillbugs brodyat eti kosmicheskie stantsii. Oni mogut zakhotet sygrat v khoroshuyu igru v tennis ili ukrast vashi yaytsa! Osteregaytes ikh drotikov, bomb, letayushchikh pirogov i traktorov! Razrezh ikh, podnimi ikh, podozhgi ili vybey v otkrytyy kosmos. Ne volnuytes, oni mogut dolgo zaderzhivat dykhanie!

ChASY PRIKLYuChENIY Osnovnaya istoriya - 8-12 chasov odnogo v pervom prokhozhdenii. Poluchenie «zolotoy medali» za bystroe prokhozhdenie na kazhdom urovne otkryvaet spetsialnyy razdel «VYZOV» v kazhdom mire!

MANIC MULTIPLAYER MAYHEM Konkursnyy rezhim divana dlya 4 igrokov - eto opredelenie PARTY TIME. Desyatki polzovatelskikh urovney dayut vam mnozhestvo tseley, chtoby poborotsya za pobedu. Kazualnye i khardkornye igroki mogut usilit eto, natykayas na zadnitsy, razbivaya kapli i otrygivaya shary!
Gophers are here to avenge their brother:
Gophers are here to avenge their brothers massacred by humans in cruel arcade machines! Your mission is simple: face the attack and take as many gophers with you as you can!

Features:

Say farewell to the living and prepare yourself to rest in peace or rest in pieces... 

See you on the battlefield!

Poised between life and death, isolated:
Poised between life and death, isolated and alone, you must unravel the poignant truths that led to your fate. Dig beneath the beautifully rendered façades and interiors of an ordinary suburban lifestyle to discover a contemporary tale crafted by an award-winning author.

Piece together this compelling story by revealing objects and memories, and decipher these clues to reveal more of the story and its secrets. From your own home to eerily deserted streets, beautiful apartment blocks to abandoned hospitals, you must search forensically for clues and the path forwards. Each new revelation takes you that one step closer to understanding, and to the people and places that surrounded you, in your all too short life.

Why are you here? Why are you trapped and alone? Will you ever move on?

• Experience an emotional and immersive story written by award-winning author Joost Vandecasteele
• Explore every nook and cranny of each beautifully rendered diorama
• Play through five compelling chapters, with each revealing more secrets and twists that will lead you to the truth
• From an unassuming sitting room, to a tent in a forest, from a police car in a tree to an abandoned hospital, a hauntingly different suburbia is yours to discover

Lanota offers a unique blend of dynamic:
Lanota offers a unique blend of dynamic music rhythm gameplay and storytelling, delivering a colorful narrative and enticing soundtrack in one package!

Complete songs to unlock new story segments and undertake this vital task!

Gameplay Features\n\nEscape the Great To:
Gameplay Features

Escape the Great Tomb of Nazarick

At first, Clementine will be unarmed and, thanks to her amnesia, unable to exercise the full extent of her abilities.
She will need to explore every inch of the Great Tomb of Nazarick in order to regain her arsenal of weapons and powers and use them to make her escape.

Action-Packed Parkour

Clementine's incredible agility allows her to perform superhuman feats of parkour that will help her navigate her environment in a variety of ways.

Martial Arts and Magic

Make use of Clementine's wide array of abilities to boost her firepower and mobility.
Mastery of different types of magic will be essential in exploring the various stages of the game.

Upgrade Weapons

Upgrade the weapons you find around the Tomb to exploit your enemies' weaknesses and hone your favorites to perfection.

Regain Clementine's Memories and Uncover the Truth

Clementine's memories will be hidden throughout the various stages of the game in the form of memory fragments.
Find them to unravel the many mysteries surrounding Clementine's current predicament.

About

The rich world of Overlord is yours to explore in this robust, story-driven metroidvania.

Play as fan-favorite Clementine and delve into an entirely new chapter in the Overlord series, brought to life under the supervision of the original creator, Kugane Maruyama.

Whether you're new to the series or a diehard fan, there will be plenty for you to discover and enjoy in this dark fantasy action-adventure that ensnares you in a web of intrigue in typical Overlord fashion.

Story

Clementine wakes to find herself imprisoned in the Great Tomb of Nazarick by none other than the Supreme Being, Ainz Ooal Gown, who forces her to participate in his brutal experiments.

Bereft of her favorite weapons and a good chunk of her memories, Clementine must defeat all of Ainz's most formidable servants as she claws her way to freedom.

The search for the exit begins now.

Take part in deadly settlings of scores:
Take part in deadly settlings of scores between rival electricity providers, inside futuristic tramways on suspended railways. In Railed Up, everything is upside down. You see the world from below, in order to give a better view of those endless railway networks as well as the oppressively enormous city through which your quest will lead you.

It's a multiplayer game for one to four players. A solo campaign will lead Iskhar on his way up the layers of the lower city, while he faces each electrical gang and discovers all the deadliest weaponry of their tramways. Each gang eliminated means having their arsenal at your disposal, a much needed help against what's coming. The tone is very dark and violent, but tries at the same time to offer a dose of offbeat, cynical humour in its dialogues, which brings some lightness between the the ruthless confrontations.

The gameplay is "on rails", literally. You need to operate your tramway along the tracks of each arena, get ammunition as quickly as you can then shoot and destroy all your opponents in order to be the last one standing. Its challenge is based on restricting the player both in his movements since he can only follow the tracks, and his firing which can only be done perpendicularly to the tramway trajectory – except for some special weapons. So the choice of positioning is crucial.

The universe tries to blend different science fiction subgenres, including steampunk, tech-noir, dystopian fiction, etc. Graphics are entirely in 2D, using a mix of realistic shadings and textures with some hand-drawn elements - such as the characters' portrait animations. As for the music, they're orchestral compositions with a distorted sound, in order to add a dramatic effect to the fights while reinforcing the impression of unease and technological nightmare.

Istoriya Artura Kristi nachinaetsya s boleznennogo probuzhdeniya geroya v temnom podvale v kompanii s neizvestnoy zhertvoy ubiystva i katastroficheskimi provalami v pamyati. Spustya mgnovenie zdanie zapolnyaet voy politseyskikh siren. I vse eto prezhde chem solntse dostiglo zenita.

Den nachalsya vesma parshivo i uluchsheniy ne predviditsya - poetomu geroyu prikhoditsya nachat sobstvennoe rassledovanie, poputno stremyas dokazat svoyu nevinovnost. Dlya etogo detektivu Kristi ponadobitsya vernut sebe poteryannuyu pamyat i pogruzitsya v mir temnoy realnosti killera po prozvishchu "Palach".

Mrachnoe srednevekove: molodogo svyashchennika posylayut v nebolshuyu derevushku, gde v mestnoy tserkvi zavelas nechist. Vam neobkhodimo budet pomoch zhitelyam derevni i provesti 7 nochnykh molitv, chtoby prognat skvernu iz svyatilishcha. Eto budet ochen neprosto, tak kak nechistaya sila ne dremlet..
Smert — vsegda tolko nachalo. Esli tyomnye sily odoleyut vas — ne nuzhno otchaivatsya, geroya s udovolstviem primut v preispodney, gde on mozhet za monetki uluchshit zdorove i vynoslivost i snova vernutsya k zhizni, chtoby poprobovat odolet porozhdeniy nochi snova!..
Skelety, privideniya, vampiry i drugie porozhdeniya dyavola budut postoyanno meshat vam. No v vashem arsenale est chem dat im otpor: svyashchennyy krest, ostryy mech, kadilo s travami i kniga s molitvami - vashi glavnye soyuzniki v borbe s tmoy! Zhiteli derevni takzhe pomogut vam tselebnymi otvarami i sredstvami, kotorye pomogut pobedit v etoy neravnoy borbe. Izuchayte i sostavlyayte blagosloveniya i chudesa iz bukv.
Ot russkogo razrabotchika, sozdatelya Unlife.

«Drevnee i silnee vsekh prochikh strakhov – strakh neizvestnosti». – G. F. Lavkraft

Zanzibar, 1896 god. Doktor Dzheyk Khantington poshel v armiyu, chtoby zabytsya posle smerti zheny. No skoro ego zhizn navsegda izmenit chto-to zloveshchee i drevnee. Teni, obitayushchie na samykh dalekikh rubezhakh realnosti, soshlis v odnoy tochke, porodiv zhutkuyu bolezn, kotoraya grozit unichtozhit ves lyudskoy rod.

I vsyo zhe eta bolezn – lish odin iz kusochkov ogromnoy mozaiki, i slozhit ee vsyu budet neprosto. Intrigi, kozni i ulovki skryvayut pravdu, i ta uskolzaet ot ponimaniya doktora.

Chtoby slozhit vsyu kartinu, Dzheyku pridetsya peresech barer, za kotorym mnogie do nego poteryali rassudok.

Vy gotovy uznat, chto za etim barerom?

Terrifying clawed beasts, the Flying Furies, clutch Elasaid and throw her through this first portal of The Seven Chambers.

• Osvoyte intuitivnoe upravlenie mashinoy, kotoroe budet ponyatno igrokam lyubogo vozrasta i s lyubym opytom.

• Otpravtes v krugosvetnoe puteshestvie po luchshim trassam mira v raznuyu pogodu. I konechno, lyubuytes idealnoy grafikoy!
