• Sovershenstvuyte svoe voditelskoe masterstvo v rezhime prizraka! Pobivayte sobstvennye rekordy i dostigayte novykh vysot na kazhdoy trasse!
Теперь Tails of Iron включает в себя нов:
Teper Tails of Iron vklyuchaet v sebya noveyshee dopolnenie Bright Fir Forest («Svetlyy elovyy les»), v kotorom vy otpravites na priklyucheniya vo vremya slavnogo Prazdnika listopada. Vas zhdet novyy borodavchatyy vrag, zhazhdushchiy mesti, dopolnitelnye protivniki na arene Krotburga, novoe oruzhie i bronya, a takzhe kosmeticheskie uluchsheniya Aloy kreposti, muzykalnye kompozitsii i novye dostizheniya. Takzhe vam budet dostupno pervoe besplatnoe dopolnenie Bloody Whiskers («Po usiki v krovi»), v kotorom Redzhi primet uchastie v starinnom turnire.
 
Tails of Iron — eto priklyuchencheskaya rolevaya igra s narisovannoy ot ruki grafikoy i beskompromissnoy boevoy sistemoy v anturazhe khmurogo, potrepannogo voynoy Srednevekovya. Igraya za Redzhi, naslednika Krysinogo prestola, vy dolzhny budete spasti svoe korolevstvo i izgnat voinstvennyy klan Lyagushek, vo glave kotorogo stoit svirepyy Borodavk Zelenyy. Stranstvuya po obmanchivo uyutnomu skazochnomu mirku, vy povstrechaete koloritnykh personazhey, gotovykh vas podderzhat. Preodoleyte svoi strakhi. Spasite svoikh bratev. Vernite sebe korolevstvo. Vashe priklyuchenie nachinaetsya...
 
Osvoyte iskusstvo zhestokikh boev
Chtoby vyzhit v opasnykh stychkakh, vam pridetsya izuchat ataki protivnika i podstraivatsya pod nikh! Vam predstoit osvoit perekaty, pariruyushchie udary i moshchnye dobivaniya, a takzhe lovko strelyat iz luka.
 
Issleduyte opasnoe korolevstvo
Otpravlyaytes v epicheskoe priklyuchenie po skazochnomu Krysinomu korolevstvu pod glubokiy khriplovatyy zakadrovyy golos Daga Kokla. Vypolnyayte pobochnye zadaniya, chtoby poluchit bolshe zolota, ili obedinite sily s ostroglazym sputnikom, chtoby uravnyat shansy.
 
Podstraivayte svoi ataki
Izmenyayte boevoy stil Redzhi v zavisimosti ot situatsii. Tyazhelye dospekhi luchshe zashchishchayut, no v nikh slozhnee uvernutsya. I ostaetsya vopros oruzhiya: topory byut silnee, no kopyami mozhno bystro atakovat. Ili zhe vy predpochtete universalnyy i nadezhnyy mech?
 
Skhvatki so svirepymi bossami
Opasnost taitsya za kazhdym gribom — vashi razum i mech dolzhny byt ostry, chtoby spravitsya so smertelno opasnymi bossami. Khladnokrovnye vo vsekh smyslakh etogo slova, kazhdoe iz etikh gigantskikh zemnovodnykh opasno na svoy unikalnyy maner.
На протяжении долгих лет Эдварда терзали:
Na protyazhenii dolgikh let Edvarda terzali bessonnitsa i strannye videniya togo, chto sokryto ot vzorov obychnykh lyudey. Zhelaya sbezhat ot samogo sebya, on otpravilsya v dolgoe puteshestvie na mototsikle. Sudba privela geroya k zabroshennomu kladbishchu, nepodaleku ot kotorogo slomalsya ego zheleznyy kon. Udastsya li Edvardu spasti neschastnye dushi, izmuchennye drevnim proklyatiem? Ili zhe on sam stanet odnim iz vechnykh uznikov grafa Orloka? Vse zavisit tolko ot vashego uma, soobrazitelnosti i nastoychivosti!

Chtoby razrushit zacharovannye pechati, priblizitsya k razgadke tayny misticheskogo kladbishcha i vstreche s ego povelitelem, vam predstoit reshit desyatki uvlekatelnykh golovolomok v stile madzhong. Udalyayte s igrovogo polya odinakovye plitki, razdrazhaya svoimi uspekhami nedovolnogo grafa, i vnimatelno slushayte rasskazy mestnykh obitateley. Neozhidannaya razvyazka uzhe blizka!

• Uvlekatelnye zadachki v stile madzhong
• Neozhidannye detali etoy mrachnoy istorii
• Vampiry, privideniya i drugie uzhasayushchie obitateli
• Krasivaya grafika i muzyka
Средняя школа окончена: ни хорошей работ:
Srednyaya shkola okonchena: ni khoroshey raboty, ni ambitsiy, ni uspekhov, sestra-kokainshchitsa — nichego osobennogo v vashey unyloy zhizni. No vot na Zemlyu napadaet inoplanetnyy kartel, kotoryy khochet ispolzovat lyudey v kachestve shireva.
Teper vam v kompanii s kharizmatichnym govoryashchim oruzhiem predstoit prinyat broshennyy vyzov i stat samym smertonosnym mezhgalakticheskim okhotnikom za sokrovishchami, kotorogo kogda-libo videla Vselennaya!
V novoy komediynoy priklyuchencheskoy igre na Unreal Engine 4 vas zhdut razlichnye miry i lokatsii na prostorakh kosmosa, srazheniya s merzkim Garmantyuozom i ego bandoy otmorozkov, trofei, vstrechi s udivitelnymi personazhami i mnogoe drugoe.
V versiyu dlya Nintendo Switch uzhe predustanovleno DLC High On Knife.
Ot sozdateley Trover Saves the Universe.
Zuma — видеоигра, относящаяся к семейств:
Zuma — videoigra, otnosyashchayasya k semeystvu arkadnykh igr «tri v ryad», vypushchennaya 12 dekabrya 2003 goda. Sushchestvuet onlayn-versiya igry Zuma i skachivaemaya versiya pod nazvaniem Zuma Deluxe dlya Windows, Android i MacOS, a takzhe mobilnaya (java) versiya «Zumy» i versii dlya magazinov Xbox Live Arcade, PSP i PlayStation Network.
Igra dala nazvanie skhodnym («zumopodobnym») igram, sut kotorykh — unichtozhit vse raznotsvetnye shary, dvigayushchiesya tsepochkami, do togo, kak shary dostignut kontsa puti. Esli eto proizoydyot, to uroven proigran. Igrok dolzhen strelyat sharami, i tsepochki sharov odnogo tsveta (tri i bolee shtuk) vzryvayutsya pri popadanii v nikh sharom takogo zhe tsveta. Prototipom igry Zuma byla vyshedshaya v 1998 godu dlya pristavok PlayStation i Game Boy Color igra Puzz Loop.
Tsel igry — unichtozhit lyagushkoy vse raznotsvetnye shariki, dvigayushchiesya tsepochkoy po ekranu v napravlenii Zolotogo Cherepa, do togo, kak shary dostignut ego. Esli eto proizoydyot, to uroven proigran. Lyagushka pozvolyaet strelyat sharikami razlichnogo tsveta. Tsepochki sharikov odnogo tsveta (dva i bolee shtuk) vzryvayutsya pri popadanii v nikh sharikom takogo zhe tsveta. Osnovnaya zadacha — vybit vse shariki na urovne i nabrat kak mozhno bolshe ochkov. Igrat mozhno dvumya sposobami: prokhodya stadiyu za stadiey (Adventure) ili v beskonechnom rezhime «Broshennaya perchatka» (Gauntlet). Rezhim Gauntlet takzhe predlagaet dva rezhima igry: Survival (Vyzhivanie) i Practice (Praktika). Igrok imeet vozmozhnost povtorno prokhodit lyuboy iz uzhe osvoennykh urovney (ikh vsego 22). Sosednie shariki odnogo tsveta vsegda smykayutsya, ottyagivaya vsyu tsepochku nazad. Eto pozvolyaet vesti bolee produmannuyu «borbu» so vsey posledovatelnostyu sharikov. V rezhime Adventure postuplenie v tsepochku novykh sharikov prodolzhaetsya do togo momenta, poka indikator v pravoy verkhney chasti ekrana ne zapolnitsya i stanet zelyonym.
Распутайте тайны запутанного лабиринта,:
Rasputayte tayny zaputannogo labirinta, ispolzuya svoy um v kachestve oruzhiya!.. Novaya mozgolomnaya priklyuchenie-golovolomka!..
Tut budut bolee 100+ urovney, zapolnennykh golovolomkami v stile «Helltaker». Pereklyuchaytes mezhdu dvumya geroinyami, Shirli i Elloy, i ispolzuyte ikh spets. navyki, chtoby preodolet osobo slozhnye ispytaniya, a intuitivno ponyatnaya sistema peremotki pozvolit vam spokoyno probovat snova i snova.
Pinball FX — новая ступень эволюции вирт:
Pinball FX — novaya stupen evolyutsii virtualnogo pinbola. Pobezhdayte na stolakh, vdokhnovlennykh krupneyshimi razvlekatelnymi franshizami. My regulyarno dobavlyaem novye stoly!
Igrayte na novykh stolakh, sozdannykh eksklyuzivno dlya Pinball FX, ili vyberite varianty sebe po dushe iz bolee chem 100 stolov, razmeshchennykh v obshirnoy virtualnoy biblioteke Zen. Kazhdyy stol otlichaetsya animatsiey. Vossozdayte kultovye stseny iz krupneyshikh razvlekatelnykh franshiz: vas zhdut Indiana Jones, Star Wars, Marvel, Universal Studios i mnogoe drugoe. Poprobuyte svoi sily za tochnymi kopiyami izvestneyshikh pinbol-avtomatov v istorii ot Williams Pinball ili igrayte na originalnykh avtomatakh Zen.
Virtualnyy pinbol vo vsey krase: Pinball FX — prodvinutyy simulyator pinbola s grafikoy v 1080p i realistichnoy simulyatsiey fiziki.Drugie pinbol-igry na Switch.
Галактическая Империя пала, а обитаемые:
Galakticheskaya Imperiya pala, a obitaemye planety pogryazli v prestupnosti. V takoe vremya stali osobenno tsenitsya nayomniki, sposobnye nayti kogo ugodno i gde ugodno.

Eyden — tryokhrukiy nayomnik, kotoryy okhotitsya na samykh opasnykh i izvorotlivykh golovorezov Galaktiki.

Za golovy odnikh on beryot dengi, za drugikh — bestsennuyu informatsiyu, kotoraya pomozhet emu dobratsya do togo, kto zastavil ego vstat na etot put i vlipnut v zagovor galakticheskogo masshtaba.

Tri ruki — eto ne tolko bolshe vragov pod pritselom, no i vesomyy argument v lyuboy perepalke. Ispolzuyte tretyu ruku dlya soversheniya napravlennykh udarov, broskov i manipulirovaniya okruzheniem, razrushayte prepyatstviya i krushite vragov.

Lovite prestupnikov na okrainakh galaktiki, v tsentralnykh mirakh i na ruinakh pogibshikh tsivilizatsiy. Uluchshayte snaryazhenie, poluchayte novye sposobnosti, stante silnee i unichtozhte kazhdogo, kto vstanet u vas na puti.

Zaputannaya istoriya organichno spletena s vysokooktanovym geympleem, a ee neozhidannye povoroty budut udivlyat tak zhe, kak udar tretey ruki iz-pod plashcha okhotnika.
Pinstripe is an emotionally charged adve:
Pinstripe is an emotionally charged adventure through Hell created entirely by a one-man team over the course of five years. Play as Teddy, an estranged ex-minister forced to venture through the frozen afterlife in search of his three-year-old daughter Bo, and her perverse kidnapper. Discover the dark secrets of Teddy's past, and confront his sleazy, demonic nemesis, Mr. Pinstripe. Thomas Brush, the creator of award-winning indie games Coma and Skinny, reveals a gorgeous art style, breathtaking score and chilling story.

Features:

- Explore six hauntingly beautiful levels of Hell.
- Listen to an immersive and unique soundtrack written by the game's creator.
- Use your slingshot to fight your way through bizarre beasts and interesting puzzles.
- Hang out with your family pet George and sniff out clues.
- Discover the mystery behind Teddy and Bo's death.
- Features a hilarious cast of professional voice actors and celebrity cameo performances!
Очередной клон Vampire Survivors!\nСража:
Ocherednoy klon Vampire Survivors!
Srazhaytes s postoyanno rastushchimi polchishchami vragov. Kazhdoe prokhozhdenie budet otkryvat novye predmety, marshruty i syuzhetnye povoroty, kotorye pomogut vam raskryt sekrety Bermudskogo treugolnika: «Bermuda Survivor» predlagaet svezhiy vzglyad na zhanr «pulevogo raya». Vasha glavnaya tsel — vyzhit i unichtozhit polchishcha vragov, no takzhe budet vremya dlya spokoynogo issledovaniya mira, razgadyvaniya zagadok i sbora razlichnykh resursov.
Otkryvayte dostup k razlichnym sposobnostyam i oruzhiyu po mere prokhozhdeniya. Vybirayte, chto podkhodit imenno vam: smertonosnye katany, bity, revolvery, droboviki, vintovki i mnogoe drugoe. Issleduyte sinergii i sozdavayte moshchnye kombo, chtoby otbivatsya ot mogushchestvennykh bossov i pobezhdat ordy vragov eshchyo bystree.
Pogruzites v taynu Bermudskogo treugolnika i raskroyte ego sekrety. Uznayte, kak i pochemu vy okazalis na etom ostrove. Vasha zatsepka — odinokaya signalnaya bashnya na gorizonte, svet kotoroy medlenno ugasaet. Prigotovtes stat zhertvoy ego mnogochislennykh opasnostey; priklyuchenie zhdyot vas!..
Hollow Knight – классическое двухмерное:
Hollow Knight – klassicheskoe dvukhmernoe priklyuchenie v ogromnom vzaimosvyazannom mire. Issleduyte izvilistye peshchery, drevnie goroda i smertonosnye pustoshi, srazhaytes s tvaryami, porazhennymi chumoy, i zavodite druzhbu so strannymi zhukami, raskryvayte drevnie tayny v samom serdtse korolevstva.

Vklyuchaet vse besplatnye dopolneniya! Sovershenno novye zadaniya, bitvy s bossami i tayny!
• Skrytye grezy: novye vragi vyshli iz nebytiya! Novye bossy. Novye uluchsheniya. Novaya muzyka.
• Mrachnaya truppa: zazhgite Fonar koshmara. Prizovite Truppu. Novaya syuzhetnaya vetka. Novye bossy. Novye amulety. Novye vragi i druzya.
• Zhivokrov: novye tovary dlya kart. Novye bossy. Prezhnie bossy stali luchshe. Novaya muzyka. Novye sekrety!

Osobennosti igry
• Issleduyte ogromnyy mir zabytykh traktov, zarosshikh pustoshey i obrativshikhsya v razvaliny zamkov, gde kazhdyy zakoulok – chast edinogo tselogo.
• Stante khozyainom svoey sudby! Mir Khallounesta ogromen i otkryt. Kakoy tropoy idti, s kakimi vragami vstrechatsya – vybor za vami!
• Otyskivayte moshchnye umeniya i navyki, chtoby stat silnee! Novye chary, stoykost i skorost pomogut vam vyzhit. Vosparyayte k novym vysotam na volshebnykh krylyakh; rassekayte tmu peshcher so skorostyu molnii; obrashchayte vragov v pepel ognem Dushi!
• Vospolzuytes siloy amuletov! V etikh drevnikh relikviyakh tayatsya neobychnye sily. Vybirayte te, chto vam po dushe – i vashe puteshestvie stanet poistine unikalnym!
• Neveroyatnoe kolichestvo milykh i strashnykh personazhey, ozhivshikh blagodarya klassicheskoy pokadrovoy 2D•animatsii.
• Svyshe 140 protivnikov! 30 velikolepnykh bossov! Vas zhdut skhvatki so svirepymi zveryami i pobedonosnye srazheniya s rytsaryami drevnosti. Vysledite vsekh chudovishch do edinogo, chtoby zapolnit zhurnal Okhotnika!
• Kazhdyy razum budet otkryt dlya vas blagodarya tainstvennomu Gvozdyu grez. Potaennye sekrety privychnykh personazhey i novykh vragov pozvolyat vam uvidet ikh s novoy storony.
• Velikolepnye risovannye mnogosloynye peyzazhi, pridayushchie miru igry osobuyu glubinu.
• Narisuyte svoyu kartu puteshestviy i zapolnite ee do melchayshikh detaley. Kompasy, perya, karty i bulavki pomogut vam nayti vernuyu dorogu khitrospleteniyakh peshcher mira Hollow Knight.
Сюжет разворачивается на Земле, которая:
Syuzhet razvorachivaetsya na Zemle, kotoraya uzhe davno nakhoditsya pod kontrolem mashin, a zhalkie ostatki chelovechestva, zataiv dykhanie, vynuzhdeny shchemitsya po uglam. Glavnyy zhe geroy igry, khladnokrovnyy kurer Dzhud Grey odnazhdy poluchaet zakaz na transportirovku androida zhenskogo tipa po imeni Filiya, kotoraya pochemu-to ne nakhoditsya vo vlasti mashin.
Ispytyvaya otvrashchenie k naivnomu povedeniyu Filii, Dzhud otpravlyaetsya v put. Inogda oni vynuzhdeny ubegat ot maroderov, inogda preodolevat opasnye zony, gde brodyat mashiny. No nevziraya na opasnosti, Dzhud stremitsya vypolnit poruchenie. Filiya chasto govorit, chto khochet stat chelovekom, kotorym po slukham android mozhet stat, dostignuv vershiny kosmicheskogo lifta, vozvyshayushchegosya vdaleke i pronzayushchego nebo.
No pravda li eto?..
Roli ozvuchivayut:
Мирной небесной деревушке Levantia угрож:
Mirnoy nebesnoy derevushke Levantia ugrozhaet opasnost! Podlyy doktor N. Forchin i ego prispeshnik Vapor pokhitili mogushchestvennyy talisman Emerix. Neuzheli vse propalo?!

Uvlekatelnoe priklyuchenie s elementami ekshna. Spasite etot neveroyatnyy mir poletov i fantazii. Veter pomozhet vam v polete, v svobodnom padenii i pri atake vragov. Dvigaytes k tseli cherez letayushchie ostrova, dzhungli, morya i pustyni.

OSOBENNOSTI
• Bolshe 10 chasov zakhvatyvayushchey igry
• Letayte padayte i srazhaytes, ispolzuya veter i propeller
• Osvoyte novye umeniya (naprimer, moshchnye ataki Dash and Bash) i ispolzuyte silu vetra, chtoby reshat golovolomki
• Ispolzuyte uluchsheniya: Shield, Hourglass, Aeroblade i mnogie drugie
• Otyskivayte skrytye sokrovishcha i sobirayte predmety
• Issleduyte chetyre potryasayushchikh mira
• Znakomtes s druzhelyubnymi personazhami
• Srazhaytes s desyatkami unikalnykh vragov i gotovtes k bitve s glavnym zlodeem
• Issleduyte ostrova derevni, igrayte v mini-igry i vypolnyayte dopolnitelnye zadaniya za osobye nagrady.
• Kachestvennaya, "konsolnaya" grafika i kadrovaya chastota v 60 kadr./s HD
• funktsiya vibratsii HD
Уникальное сочетание шутера с видом свер: Unikalnoe sochetanie shutera s vidom sverkhu i strategii v zhanre Tower Defense. Vy — zakhvatchik! Ispolzuyte oruzhie ili zamanite vraga v smertonosnyy labirint zashchitnykh bashen. Planiruyte ataku v rezhime stroitelstva, vozvodya raznoobraznye bashni, ili srazu vorvites v samuyu gushchu boya. Sooruzhayte zashchitnye bashni i pobezhdayte atakuyushchikh vas vragov na kartakh, kotorye dadut vam neveroyatnuyu svobodu planirovaniya. Razrushayte zdaniya i mosty, chtoby ukrepit oboronu ili prosto veselya radi.
Мило прибывает на Землю и обнаруживает,:
Milo pribyvaet na Zemlyu i obnaruzhivaet, chto slishkom mal dlya etogo mira, vse ego zhiteli kuda-to propali, a na dvore 1991 god!
Obedinites s udivitelnymi taynikinami, chtoby s ikh pomoshchyu stroit lestnitsy i mosty i dazhe ustraivat vzryvy!
Otyshchite dorogu domoy v ogromnom — ili vse zhe kroshechnom? — megapolise i razgadayte velichayshuyu zagadku Zemli!

- Issleduyte muravinye, pchelinye i drugie goroda, postroennye v odnom ogromnom dome.
- Zavodite novykh znakomykh i uznavayte ikh istorii.
- Sobirayte sotni taynikinov v kazhdom gorode, chtoby karabkatsya po stenam, vyshibat dveri i reshat obshchestvennye problemy s pomoshchyu ikh sposobnostey.
- Kataytes, prygayte i vypolnyayte tryuki na malenkom myloborde Milo.
- Poluchayte usileniya, chtoby uluchshat puzyranets Milo, stroit muzey Ardvina i sobirat zagadochnuyu mashinu Ridmi!
Melbits™ World — это головоломка-платфор: Melbits™ World — eto golovolomka-platformer, v kotoroy klyuch k uspekhu — eto koordinatsiya i chuvstvo ritma. Vas zhdet mnozhestvo zlodeyskikh urovney, kotorye mozhno preodolevat s druzyami.
В Shieldwall Chronicles: Swords of the N:
V Shieldwall Chronicles: Swords of the North vy vozglavite otryad naemnikov i otpravites v opasnuyu moroznuyu stranu pod nazvaniem Tarren. V poiskakh priklyucheniy vy srazites s razlichnymi vragami: nezhityu, demonami, lyudoyashcherami i mnogimi drugimi. V bitvakh, vdokhnovlennykh kak nastolnymi igrami, tak i takticheskimi RPG, vam predstoit sobrat otryad silnykh voinov i magov, chtoby izmenit balans vlasti v severnykh korolevstvakh.

Osnovnye osobennosti:
- Prorabotannaya poshagovaya boevaya sistema
- Komanda iz personazhey 15 razlichnykh klassov.
- Unikalnaya sistema boevogo dukha, obespechivayushchaya sovershenno novye takticheskie elementy boevoy sistemy.
- Sobirayte sotni moshchnykh volshebnykh predmetov dlya snaryazheniya otryada.
- Bolee 50 chasov igrovoy kampanii.
- Mrachnyy, realistichnyy mir, v kotorom srednevekovaya istoriya i kultura obedinyayutsya s fenteziynymi rasami i monstrami.
Вернитесь в мир магии и узнайте предысто:
Vernites v mir magii i uznayte predystoriyu samogo sarkastichnogo volshebnika iz videoigr!
Podrostkovaya zhizn u Saymona vesma burnaya: to iz shkoly isklyuchili, to neozhidannyy pereezd… no drevnee prorochestvo zabrosit ego v drugoy mir, gde pridetsya razgadyvat duratskie golovolomki, vozitsya s alkhimicheskimi prisposobleniyami, razuchivat moshchnye zaklinaniya i probovat omerzitelnye ragu!
В этой оригинальной ролевой игре от авто:
V etoy originalnoy rolevoy igre ot avtorov Guacamelee! bezlikiy Nikto mozhet prevratitsya v SLIZNYa, PRIVIDENIE, DRAKONA i ne tolko!

Vypolnyaya zadaniya, vy otkroete dlya sebya bolee 15 razlichnykh form i smozhete v nikh perevoploshchatsya. Neozhidannye sochetaniya ikh sposobnostey pomogut vam vypolnyat eshche bolee slozhnye zadaniya! Issleduyte obshirnyy mir v odinochku ili s drugom i zachishchayte izmenyayushchiesya podzemelya, chtoby ostanovit Napast i SPASTI MIR!

Osobennosti:
Mnogochislennye formy: v igre bolee 15 razlichnykh form, ot krysy do vorovki i robota, i u kazhdoy iz nikh svoi osobennosti igrovogo protsessa.

Kombinatsii sposobnostey: bolee 80 sposobnostey form mozhno kombinirovat drug s drugom, chtoby sozdavat nepobedimye sborki. Stante yaytsom, shvyryayushchimsya ognennymi sharami i ostavlyayushchim za soboy sliz!!!

Neobychnye zadaniya: u prichudlivykh obitateley etogo mira polno problem, i im prigoditsya vasha pomoshch. A eshche k kazhdoy forme prilagaetsya sobstvennyy nabor zadaniy, kotorye trebuyut tvorcheskogo podkhoda.

Uslozhnyayushchiesya podzemelya: vy stanovites vse silnee, i protsedurno generiruemye podzemelya v otvet narashchivayut svoyu slozhnost!

Sovmestnyy rezhim: otpravtes v priklyucheniya vmeste s drugom po seti ili na odnom ustroystve!

Zamechatelnyy saundtrek: muzyku dlya igry napisal izvestnyy kompozitor Dzhim Gatri.

Rezhim «Novaya igra +»: usilennye vragi i podzemelya s modifikatorami slozhnosti stanut nastoyashchim ispytaniem dlya vashikh form i sposobnostey!
Официальная цифровая адаптация настольно:
Ofitsialnaya tsifrovaya adaptatsiya nastolnoy igry Dzheymi Stegmayera (Jamey Stegmaier) - Charterstone!

Eto igra v strategicheskuyu kampaniyu s povyshennym interesom pri povtornom prokhozhdenii, v kotoroy igroki stroyat novyy Vechnyy Gorod!
Stroyte i delayte otkrytiya v Charterstone!

Kampaniya razdelena na seriyu otdelnykh igr. Kazhdaya igra budet imet svoi unikalnye pravila i bonusnuyu zadachu. Kazhdaya igra budet osnovyvatsya na predydushchikh i dobavlyat chto-to novoe! Vashi resheniya i stil igry povliyayut na khod kampanii i eyo okonchanie. Bolee togo, v ney net nikakikh negativnykh vzaimodeystviy mezhdu igrokami. Drugimi slovami, vy nabiraete ochki na osnove sobstvennoy strategii, a ne podryva opponentov. Eto osobenno vazhno, kogda igraesh protiv svoikh druzey ili semi v mnogopolzovatelskom rezhime onlayn ili mesta za stolom, gde igroku osobenno vezlo!

Tak o chem igra? Smozhete li vy ubedit vechnogo korolya obyavit svoyu derevnyu novym Vechnym Gorodom?
• Vyberite odnogo iz 6 unikalnykh personazhey, kotoryy vozglavit vashu khartiyu
• Otkroyte dlya sebya novye zdaniya, vozmozhnosti nabora ballov i igrovuyu mekhaniku
• Razrabatyvayte strategii i upravlenie rabochimi, zdaniyami i resursami.
• Sledite za naborom pravil, i derevney, rasshiryaytes ot igry k igre
• Opiraytes na svoyo prodvizhenie vperyod iz predydushchikh igr
• Raskryvayte istoriyu po mere prodvizheniya kampanii

Chego mozhno ozhidat?
• Igrayte s II, druzyami ili i tem i drugim - otlichnyy opyt kak dlya solnoy, tak i dlya gruppovoy igry
• Onlaynovaya krossplatformennaya mnogopolzovatelskaya igra
• Lokalnaya mnogopolzovatelskaya igra v stile mesta za stolom, gde igroku osobenno vezlo
• Protivniki II - legkiy, sredniy ili trudnyy
• Kampaniya iz 12 polnykh igr
• Rezhim odinochnoy igry - gibkiy i nastraivaemyy rezhim bystrogo matcha!
• Sokhranyayte kartu v lyuboe vremya i igrayte po ney pozzhe s druzyami
• Predvaritelno i sluchayno sgenerirovannye karty
• Udivitelnaya animirovannaya karta nastolnoy igry, zdaniya, karty, personazhi i ne tolko!
• Absolyutnyy interes pri povtornom prokhozhdenii - ne byvaet dvukh odinakovykh kampaniy
• Unikalnye vpechatleniya ot nastolnoy igry s udobstvom tsifrovoy platformy
Путешествуйте в гонке по апокалипсису зо:
Puteshestvuyte v gonke po apokalipsisu zombi, chtoby spasti svoyu semyu. Vooruzhites arsenalom moshchnogo oruzhiya i cdelayte vse vozmozhnoe, chtoby vyzhit. Izuvechte, perestrelyayte i ubeyte Mertvetsov - vse chto ugodno, lish by dvigatsya dalshe! V mire, gde vse pod ugrozoy, naskolko daleko vy poydete, chtoby vyzhit? 

Osobennosti:
• 60 urovney syuzheta raspredeleny po 7 glavam, kazhdaya iz kotorykh soderzhit osobye zadaniya, kotorye neobkhodimo vypolnit
• 3 raznykh finala igry
• 8 predannykh zhivotnykh-kompanonov - ot simpatichnykh sobak do svirepykh tigrov, eti kompanony obladayut osobymi sposobnostyami i pomogut vam v boyu povysit uroven
• 25 unikalnykh vidov oruzhiya 8 klassov - do 7 razlichnykh usileniy dlya ekipirovki 
• Vtorostepennye istorii - 36 dopolnitelnykh urovney rasshiryayut istoriyu s unikalnoy obstanovkoy, oruzhiem i kompanonami 
• Missii v arkadnom rezhime - pobedite zombi s kazhdym oruzhiem i stremites k vysokim pokazatelyam, chtoby razblokirovat sleduyushchee zadanie
• Absolyutno novoe oruzhie metatel pilnogo polotna i kompanon-medved dayut sposobnost naneseniya uvechiy dlya prodolzheniya borby
• Podderzhka funktsiya vibratsii HD, Joy-Con™ i kontroller Pro
Сыграйте за Воздухоголового — маленькое:
Sygrayte za Vozdukhogolovogo — malenkoe Telo i napolnennoe vozdukhom sushchestvo, kotoroe sluzhit emu Golovoy. I poka Golova medlenno, no verno sduvaetsya, u vas est shans spasti ee zhizn. Chtoby sdelat eto, vy dolzhny ispolzovat vozdushnye emkosti, chtoby podkachivat Golovu, poka vy issleduete mir Vozdukhogolovykh v stile metroidvanii. Ishchite udivitelnye umeniya i obnovleniya: oni otkroyut vam novye oblasti i golovolomki, kotorye vam predstoit preodolet. V vashem priklyuchenii vam nuzhno raskryt istinnuyu svyaz mezhdu Golovoy, vozdushnymi emkostyami i zasoryayushchey mir tekhnologiey, chtoby lyuboy tsenoy spasti Golovu.
Ne vsegda legko nayti svoy put v mire Vozdukhogolovykh. Vam predstoit otvazhno issledovat temnye peshchery, drevnie sooruzheniya i drugie zagadochnye lokatsii, chtoby spasti Golovu. Na svoem puti vy otkroete novye sposobnosti, novye oblasti i golovolomki. A esli vy poydete eshche dalshe, kto znaet, chto vy naydete v skrytykh ugolkakh etogo mira.
Возьмите на себя роль командира гуманоид:
Vozmite na sebya rol komandira gumanoidnogo otryada, otpravlyayushchegosya na sverkhsekretnoe zadanie po spaseniyu vyzhivshikh iz issledovatelskogo tsentra na Marse, s kotorym vnezapno propala svyaz.
Marshruty k tselyam protsedurno generiruyutsya pri kazhdom novom prokhozhdenii. Chtoby dobitsya uspekha, vy dolzhny prinimat tochnye resheniya, iskhodya iz sostoyaniya vashey gruppy i ostavshegosya zapasa resursov.
Prokladyvayte svoy put, kotoryy vsegda razvetvlyaetsya na neskolko marshrutov. Vashim soldatam trebuetsya zaryad batarey dlya raboty, srazheniy s vragami i raboty issledovatelskogo tsentra. Po mere prodvizheniya ona budet medlenno razryazhatsya, nezavisimo ot togo, chto vy delaete. Opiraytes na svoi znaniya i delayte slozhnyy vybor — pogruzites na samyy glubokiy uroven i natseltes na bossa ili otstupite ot boya, chtoby sobrat novye predmety i snaryazhenie? Sledite za urovnem zaryada i otsenite, kakoy podkhod luchshe vsego podoydet vam!
Окажитесь в городе будущего, полном ганг:
Okazhites v gorode budushchego, polnom gangsta-band, mafiozi i drugikh tyomnykh lichnostey. Stante Linchevatelem, mirno rabotayushchim dnyom i vpadaet v ubiystvennoe bezumie nochyu! Sadites v mashinu, vybirayte punkt naznacheniya i issleduyte kazhdyy ugolok Bagrovogo Zaliva.
Esli khotite pochuvstvovat priliv adrenalina, issleduyte gorod peshkom, no budte ostorozhny -- i ne zadavayte slishkom mnogo voprosov..
Zdes chto ugodno mozhet byt oruzhiem! Ishchite vokrug vsyakoe, chto vyglyadit kapelku smertelno opasnym, i ispolzuyte ego, chtoby zashchitit sebya. Kidayte vo vragov butylki, nozhi i pistolety. Vokrug nichego net?
Primite kolyosa i lomayte dveri, chtoby oglushat protivnikov, ili prosto tseltes nogami v litso. Poprobuyte nayti i liznut lyagushku – effekt vam ponravitsya!
On Halloween Island, engineers test the:
On Halloween Island, engineers test the innovative way of generating heat. The roots of the power plant reach deep into the earth, all the way to the heart of Hell, where the reactors obtain energy from burning souls. When an accident happens, the infernal radiation contaminates the earth. Inhabitants living in defiled areas struggle with numerous possessions. An exorcist is needed.

Game features:
- Very simple gameplay, very difficult opponents.
- Dynamic clashes.
 -20 demons with unique abilities and battle patterns.
- A dark history of the island hidden in the reports of the possessed.
- Help of the rescued residents.
- Free exploration of the rich world.
- A lot of dark humour. 
- The choice of the order of exorcisms.
Starlight Shores – это «островной» визуа:
Starlight Shores – eto «ostrovnoy» vizualnyy roman, v kotorom ispolzuetsya unikalnyy romanticheskiy stil «korotkikh rasskazov».
 
V nem est neskolko kontsovok, zavisyashchikh ot vashego vybora po khodu razvitiya syuzheta.
 
Istoriya:
 
Posle togo, kak vasha podruga detstva Teo priglashaet vas na uik-end v kottedzh v gorodke Sisayd, vy gotovites provesti svoy den rozhdeniya v rayu. Proshlo neskolko mesyatsev s tekh por, kak vy v posledniy raz videli Teo, i ona neveroyatno rada provesti vykhodnye vmeste.
 
Ona takzhe priglashaet svoyu sosedku po komnate Lenu i vashego druga Aleka. Posle togo, kak vy rasstalis, razekhavshis na uchebu po raznym kolledzham, teper samoe vremya soedinitsya vmeste snova.
 
Kazhetsya, vse skladyvaetsya idealno... poka Alek ne nastaivaet na tom, chto doberetsya odin na svoey mashine. Vy pribyvaete v kottedzh ranshe nego v uverennosti, chto on brosil vashu kompaniyu. Cherez nekotoroe vremya on zvonit i soobshchaet, chto vezet s soboy eshche odnogo gostya.
 
Khotya Erika mozhet byt iz togo zhe gorodka, chto i bolshinstvo gruppy, eto edinstvennoe, chto u vas obshchego...
 
Vy poluchite udovolstvie ot nochi s Teo i zagadaete zhelanie, glyadya na zvezdu?
Постепенно раскрывайте историю того, что:
Postepenno raskryvayte istoriyu togo, chto s vami proizoshlo, lezha v kolybeli nevinnym i neporochnym rebenkom. S kazhdoy minutoy vy budete vspominat novye podrobnosti. Uzhasy stanut realnymi i yasnymi.
Okhotilsya li za vami lish strakh neizvestnogo, ili eto bylo nechto bolshee?

Chto-to mozhet ostavatsya razmytym, no odna istoriya ostaetsya s vami vplot do segodnya.
Videt ne mogut dushi bez glaz,
I v tishine podzhidayut lish nas.
Svetly i chisty tak rebenka glaza,
Ulybkoy zamanit tebya navsegda.
No ne priblizhaysya, ved grekh tam taitsya,
Mladentsami khochet on tak pozhivitsya.

OSOBENNOSTI
Prostoe upravlenie
Sluchaynyy II
Svoboda peremeshcheniya
Razblokiruemye rezhimy
Присоединяйтесь к механику-отступнице Ро:
Prisoedinyaytes k mekhaniku-otstupnitse Robin i raskroyte tayny umirayushchey planety. Issleduyte ogromnyy mir, napolnennyy golovolomkami, interesnymi personazhami i opasnymi bossami v prekrasnom platformere, v kotorom povestvuetsya trogatelnaya istoriya o vere, tseli zhizni i pomoshchi lyudyam.

Robin prosto khochet byt mekhanikom i pomogat lyudyam, no bez litsenzii ona greshnitsa v glazakh «Materi». No ne vse tak prosto...

• Desyatki chasov uvlekatelnoy igry.
• Neskolko tshchatelno sozdannykh lokatsiy s golovolomkami.
• Bolshe 20 srazheniy s zhutkimi bossami.
• 3 urovnya slozhnosti s originalnoy sistemoy nastroek.
• Dusherazdirayushchaya istoriya: mozhet li odin mekhanik ispravit ves mir?

Iconoclasts (Ikonobortsy) — eto shedevr, rezultat 7-letnego truda indi-razrabotchika Yoakima Sandberga.
Super Phantom Cat is a \"Pawsome\" retro:
Super Phantom Cat is a "Pawsome" retro platformer, or what we like to call "Catformer," in which you explore quirky environments, clear purrrfect colorful levels, solve the mysteries shrouding the Phantom world and rescue your kidnapped little sister, Ina.

Key Features:

Five chapters with 35 highly imaginative storyline levels

A unique experience each chapter with tons of environments to explore: forest, meadow, lakeside, underwater, desert—you’ll even get to hop onto trains!
A progress bar for each level. If you love exploring environments, you’ll have the time of your life!

Explore in all four directions! The levels may seem short, but there’s actually lots of hidden content for you to dig up.

Collect gold coins and brew powerful potions- Scale mountains, go swimming, climb through tunnels… the world is your oyster!
Enjoy a progress bar for each level. If you love exploring environments, you’ll have the time of your life!

Gain five insane, unpredictable but super fun skills

Toss some seeds in the game world and see what sprouts out of them. Freeze your enemies… and use those poor frozen guys as traps!
Teleportation may be convenient, but you’ll never know when you’ll land in somewhere strange and unfamiliar…

Countless wacky Easter eggs to discover

A cat that walks backward, a rapping bear… 
Try skating on ice and see what craziness ensues!

Enjoy a highly acclaimed original soundtrack
Last but not least:

We’ve also got heaps of skins for you to unlock and collect!
Meet adorable cats of all shapes and sizes, each with their outrageous skills!
A production system where you brew a variety of potions for your use.
You can also produce keys using gold coins you collect from around the Phantom world!
Бесконечная война и жестокая драма: шеде:
Beskonechnaya voyna i zhestokaya drama: shedevr istoricheskikh strategicheskikh simulyatorov vozvrashchaetsya cherez 20 let!
Eto velichayshaya voennaya drama v serii Troetsarstviya s samym bolshim kolichestvom ofitserov i stsenariev.
В вашем арсенале умения наследника Бога:
V vashem arsenale umeniya naslednika Boga Groma i pushki tryokh fraktsiy - ispolzuyte ikh, chtoby rubit, vzryvat i szhigat vragov!

Glavnyy geroy pod upravleniem igroka dolzhen spasti pokhishchennuyu zlobnym baronom Vakhzonom printsessu Se'Vera. Ne tolko strazhi barona meshayut Vzertosu, no i ego soratnik Vestnik lishil ego magicheskikh sil po prikazu Boga Groma. Teper naslednik dolzhen vernut svoyu silu, probitsya v zamok Vakhzona i spasti printsessu iz zatocheniya!
(Printsessa tochno v etom zamke!)
Уберите весь беспорядок дома до того, ка:
Uberite ves besporyadok doma do togo, kak vernyotsya vash ustavshiy papa! Tolko budte ostorozhny, chtoby nichego sluchayno ne slomat.
Posle tselogo dnya veselya doma vmeste s bratom i sestroy na kukhne besporyadok, v komnatakh besporyadok, i vy ne razvesili bele: obychnyy vykhodnoy den. VNEZAPNO, vy vidite na telefone SMS o tom, chto papa vernetsya domoy poranshe — i vy uzhe slyshite, kak skripit i otkryvaetsya garazh i..
Batya idyot!..
Действие игры разворачивается в 1787 год: Deystvie igry razvorachivaetsya v 1787 godu, vo vremena ery Tenmey v Yaponii. Strana okhvachena uzhasnym zlom: ogon, razorenie i golod razrazilis po vsey strane. Sidzuka Godzen, pokoynyy dukh molodoy zhenshchiny, poymannoy v lovushku, ugrozhaet unichtozhit ves mir. Vse voiny planety skhodyatsya, chtoby srazitsya v velikoy bitve so zlymi silami i pobedit ikh!..
Following the events of Trails from Zero: Following the events of Trails from Zero, the Special Support Section find themselves with new members and new duties. However, rising tensions in Crossbell along with pressure from two neighboring political powers threaten both the safety of their home, as well as the integrity of their team.
The game begins with the main character,:
The game begins with the main character, a cat, who embarks to Rain City to find his sister. The story is both bizarre and exciting making players get lost in a mushroom field, search for a secret passage, and run experiments in a laboratory. The reason rain continues in Rain City is uncovered when players find his missing sister...

Players control the main character to look for his sister in the city. The story moves along while meeting various characters, gathering information, solving puzzles, and clearing minigames. There are elements that test skills including memory and observation, and the many items that appear add to its appeal to the game.

The picture book-like graphics and story about animals who live like humans will draw you in to the world of Rain City.
Исследуйте бесконечный океан облаков, гд: Issleduyte beskonechnyy okean oblakov, gde ukrylis poslednie predstaviteli tsivilizatsii, kotorye zhivut na ogromnykh titanakh. Poznakomtes s Reksom i ego novoy podrugoy Payroy, zagadochnym klinkom, kotoryy nadelyaet ego neveroyatnoy siloy. Vmeste otpravlyaytes na poiski Eliziuma, poteryannogo doma Payry, kotoryy mozhet stat raem dlya vsego chelovechestva.
Adventures of a Cat in Space рассказывае:
Adventures of a Cat in Space rasskazyvaet istoriyu kota, sluchayno okazavshegosya v kosmose i pytayushchegosya nayti dorogu domoy na Zemlyu. Osobuyu izyuminku proektu pridayot uchastie izvestnogo britantsa Artura Darvilla, znakomogo po serialam «Doktor Kto», «Brodchyorch» i «Legendy zavtrashnego dnya». On ne tolko ozvuchivaet bortovoy kompyuter kosmicheskogo korablya, no i ispolnyaet glavnuyu muzykalnuyu temu igry.
Vam predstoit issledovat galaktiku, reshat golovolomki i sobirat 11 pesen, napisannykh populyarnym kompozitorom Devidom Gibbom v razlichnykh zhanrakh — ot roka do dzhaza i fanka!..
Ot avtorov Lucy Dreaming.Eshchyo kotoigry.
Играйте в сумасшедшую комбинацию увлекат:
Igrayte v sumasshedshuyu kombinatsiyu uvlekatelnykh igr dlya vecherinok, postoyanno pereklyuchayas mezhdu nimi. Vy mozhete spravitsya s etim vechno menyayushchimsya khaosom? Igrayte s druzyami na divane ili po seti, zlodeyski khokhocha nad ikh neudachami, i vozvrashchaytes iz mertvykh, chtoby dokuchat im. Begayte, prygayte i proryvaytes k pobede!Bezumnaya igra dlya vecherinok! Oshchutite khaos, v kotorom polnye ekshena igry menyayutsya bez ostanovki i v samyy nepodkhodyashchiy moment, ili osilte proyti kazhduyu iz igr do kontsa. Poprobuyte proyti razlichnye tipy igr, stalkivayas s vnezapnymi bonusnymi urovnyami. 

Vyberite svoego flibustera iz kuchi nezauryadnykh otkryvaemykh personazhey i igrayte im, otkroyte bolee 70 otpadnykh vidov oruzhiya, a esli umrete… vy vernetes v etot mir v vide prizraka, chtoby dokuchat druzyam! 

Igrayte v rezhime dlya vecherinok i rezhime «Arena»: dostignite sokrovishcha pervym v rezhime dlya vecherinok ili broste vyzov svoim druzyam, chtoby opredelit korolya ringa v 25 razlichnykh igrakh i kartakh Areny. Kakoy by rezhim vy ni vybrali, ozhidayte neozhidannostey! 

Igrayte v seti i lokalno bez zaderzhek: do 6 igrokov pri lyubom sochetanii setevykh i lokalnykh polzovateley. Nabirayte uroven, otkryvayte novoe oruzhie, igrayte s polnotsennymi botami v odinochku i gruppoy, nablyudayte za partiyami, ispolzuyte ottochennyy algoritm podbora sopernikov i sistemu lobbi.

«Soderzhanie Marooners Delyuks» vklyucheno!
Omega Strike — классическая игра с откры:
Omega Strike — klassicheskaya igra s otkrytym mirom i mnozhestvom dostupnykh personazhey. Doktor Omega gotovit armiyu mutantov, chtoby pokorit mir — i tolko gruppa khrabrykh bortsov za svobodu mozhet vstat u nego na puti. 

Pobezhdayte smertonosnykh protivnikov i sovershenstvuyte svoikh geroev, puteshestvuyte, nakhodite sokrovishcha i sovershenstvuyte svoy arsenal, chtoby dat otpor zlobnomu doktoru i ego prispeshnikam.

• Issleduyte obshirnyy zhivoy mir s semyu unikalnymi regionami.
• Vyberite odnogo iz trekh geroev — kazhdyy so svoim naborom sposobnostey.
• Pereklyuchaytes mezhdu geroyami v lyuboy moment v zavisimosti ot situatsii.
• Ishchite sokrovishcha i uluchshayte svoy arsenal.
• Pobezhdayte: 12 bossov i bolee 45 vidov vragov.
• Saundtrek ot Kena «Coda» Snaydera iz Scarlet Moon Productions.
Имперская Империя Зогар во главе с беско:
Imperskaya Imperiya Zogar vo glave s beskonechno zlym (i urodlivym) Imperatorom Kenom beryot sushchestv iz raznykh mirov i pomeshchaet ikh v svoy, polnyy opasnostey labirint dlya sobstvennogo razvlecheniya. Esli oni ne vybirayutsya iz labirinta zhivymi, ikh rodnye planety tut zhe stanovyatsya uglem dlya pechey zogariantsev, proizvodyashchikh na nyom zhele. Tak vot, zogariantsy pokhitili vashu sobaku, Sparki. Oni doprosili eyo i vyyasnili, chto sobaki - odni iz samykh umnykh sushchestv vo vselennoy. I teper zogariantsy nastolko ikh boyatsya, chto reshili vmesto etogo zastait proyti labirint vas! Vam nuzhno spasti Sparki i proyti tainstvennyy labirint! Pomnite, esli vy etogo ne sdelaete, Zemlya stanet zheleynym toplivom dlya ogromnoy pechki..
«Ken's Labyrinth» — kompyuternaya igra, vypushchennaya kompaniey Epic MegaGames, Inc. v 1993 godu. Razrabotchikom igry yavlyaetsya Ken Silverman, sozdatel dvizhka BUILD Engine, kotoryy byl pozzhe ispolzovan v igre ot 3D Realms, Duke Nukem 3D.
Пьяные драки Drunk-Fu: Wasted Masters -:
Pyanye draki Drunk-Fu: Wasted Masters - eto igra-draka s yumorom, osnovannaya na zakonakh fiziki. Smeysya neistovo i pryamo v litso sumasshedshim tryapichnym kuklam kak v avtonomnoy igre, tak i v rezhime onlayn!

Topchis v pyanom beshentve i ronyay svoikh vragov s pomoshchyu mnogochislennykh priyomov boya ili kakogo-nibud kholodnogo oruzhiya. Rychi v netrezvom gneve i sozdavay komandy iz svoikh druzey, ili naoborot, pokoloti ikh tak, chtoby na nikh zhivogo mesta ne ostalos, v odnom iz mnogochislennykh rezhimov igry. 

Otkroy dlya sebya uymu raznykh barov po vsemu miru, voodushevlyayushchikhsya alkogolem, i personaliziruy svoego personazha, chtoby on stal kak s igolochki!
Atari Lynx — первая портативная система: Atari Lynx — pervaya portativnaya sistema s 4096-tsvetnym ekranom, podsvetkoy i vozmozhnostyu povorota ekrana na 180°, dlya udobstva levshey. Konsol byla vypushchena v tom zhe godu, chto i Game Boy s monokhromnym ekranom.
Продолжение (не)популярной игры Princess:
Prodolzhenie (ne)populyarnoy igry Princess.Loot.Pixel.Again! More veselya bez namekov na sereznost, protsedurno sgenerirovannoe priklyuchenie. x2 — eto gorazdo bolshe artefaktov, predmetov, lokatsiy, vragov, bossov, sekretov i lovushek! Originalnyy graficheskiy stil piksel-komiks (po slovam razrabotchika).

PLPA x2 napolnen zabavnymi veshchami, nestandartnymi situatsiyami, paskhalkami i otsylkami k drugim igram i filmam. Vy videli eto ranshe? Da, konechno!

• 3 unikalnykh personazha so svoimi osobennostyami
• Unikalnyy 8-bitnyy dram-n-beys O_o
• Vse bolshe i bolshe dostizheniy! Nu, ne slishkom mnogo, no chto-to v etom rode…
Новый тип рогалика-шутера. Rogue Star Re:
Novyy tip rogalika-shutera. Rogue Star Rescue predstavlyaet soboy unikalnoe sochetanie bullet khell i TD igr. My dobavili silnye elementy strategii v bezumie adskikh strelyalok. Eto igra, v kotoruyu ty vtyaneshsya i u tebya uydut mesyatsy na izuchenie mnozhestva khitrospleteniy i kontsovok. My khotim, chtoby ty kayfoval ot igry, dazhe posle 50+ igrovykh chasov.

Onlayn i lokalnyy kooperativ! Ty mozhesh odnovremenno issledovat galaktiku igry c drugom! Takoy funktsii net v drugikh shuterakh-rogalikakh. Issleduy miry, raskryvay sekrety i progressiruy v igre vmeste s tvoimi druzyami.

Zvezda-Izgoy. Massivnaya Zvezda-Izgoy obrazovalas iz kosmicheskoy pyli i teper nakhoditsya na puti pryamogo stolknoveniya s nami. Eto grozit ispepeleniem vsego zhivogo. Lidery planet galaktiki sobrali luchshuyu komandu voinov, chtoby lyuboy tsenoy ostanovit Zvezdu-Izgoy. 

Tvoy vybor, tvoya kontsovka. Vyberi na kakie planety otpravitsya i primi vazhnye resheniya, kotorye opredelyat sudbu vsey galaktiki! V zavisimosti ot vybrannogo toboy puti, est desyatki razlichnykh kontsovok. Zvezda-Izgoy mozhet unichtozhit vsyu galaktiku, otrazitsya na galaktiku protivnika, byt pogloshchennoy chernoy dyroy, otpravitsya v prostranstvenno-vremennye tunneli i mnozhestvo drugikh zabavnykh vozmozhnostey.

Lovushki i zashchita. Strategicheski razmeshchennye lovushki zamedlyayut, blokiruyut, tolkayut, prokalyvayut, podzhigayut, zamorazhivayut i strelyayut po vragam. Ty mozhesh apgreydit lovushki, chtoby sdelat ikh silnee. 

Geroi. Vyberi odnogo iz chlenov elitnoy komandy s unikalnym naborom spetsialnykh sposobnostey, kazhdyy iz kotorykh obladaet lichnoy motivatsiey spasti svoyu rodnuyu planetu ot unichtozheniya. Spasi novykh igrokov, dobivshis konkretnykh rezultatov.

Prokachaysya! V otlichie ot traditsionnykh rogalikov, my dobavili sistemu prokachki navykov. S kazhdym urovnem ty zarabatyvaesh atributivnye ochki, kotorye mogut uluchshit tvoyu silu, skorost, nanosimyy uron, zdorove i udachu.

Oruzhie i predmety. Razblokiruy sotni unikalnykh predmetov! Pomimo osnovnogo oruzhiya, u tebya budet arsenal granat i naparnikov. 

Tri rezhima slozhnosti. Vyberi mezhdu Prostenkim, Normalnym i Sumasshedshim rezhimov, chtoby brosit vyzov svoim navykam i pri etom prodolzhat kayfovat ot igry.
Bombslinger — это экшн-игра в стиле Дико:
Bombslinger — eto ekshn-igra v stile Dikogo Zapada, soderzhashchaya vzryvnuyu odinochnuyu igru i besposhchadnye srazheniya dlya chetyrekh igrokov.

Primer na sebya shkuru byvshego golovoreza, kotoryy stal mirnym fermerom. Ego staraya banda reshila svesti s nim schety: oni ubili ego zhenu i sozhgli rodnoy dom. 

Ovladeyte iskusstvom podryvnogo dela v etom zanimatelnom priklyuchenii s protsedurno generiruemymi urovnyami, bolshim kolichestvom vspomogatelnykh predmetov i vozmozhnostyu prokachki razlichnykh navykov vashego geroya.
Без денег и неудачи вы обнаруживаете, чт:
Bez deneg i neudachi vy obnaruzhivaete, chto serdtse razbito i nakhoditsya na grani krakha. Vash domovladelets zabral klyuch, vy ne mozhete zakonchit rukopis, a vash vozlyublennyy vykhodit zamuzh za drugogo. Ne imeya vybora, krome kak spravitsya so vsem, chto brosaet vam zhizn, vy otpravlyaetes v otkrytuyu dorogu s missiey vernut lyubov vsey svoey zhizni. Rasskaz ottuda zavisit ot vas. Mozhno li spasti vashu zhizn, ili my vsegda inogda yavlyaemsya monstrami?

Vybor
Syuzhetnyy opyt, v kotorom osnovnoe vnimanie udelyaetsya otnosheniyam i emotsionalnym svyazyam, a ne traditsionnym rolevym srazheniyam i priklyucheniyam. Nereshitelnost - vash vrag, a sochuvstvie - vashe oruzhie v poiskakh poslednego shansa vernut lyubov vsey svoey zhizni.

Obstoyatelstvo
Vybirayte iz personazhey raznogo pola, rasy i seksualnykh predpochteniy i perezhivayte obshchie perezhivaniya i unikalnye trudnosti kazhdogo v zavisimosti ot vashego vybora. NPC mogut otnositsya k vam po-raznomu v zavisimosti ot vashego pola, rasy ili seksualnykh predpochteniy, otkryvaya i zakryvaya raznye puti na svoem puti.

Posledstvie
Kazhdoe prokhozhdenie napolneno oshelomlyayushchim kolichestvom raskhodyashchikhsya putey, kotorye mozhno obnaruzhit kak s pomoshchyu yavnykh deystviy, tak i s pomoshchyu tonkogo vybora v razgovore. Puteshestvie, kotoroe vy proydete, budet adaptirovano k vashemu lichnomu eticheskomu kompasu, poskolku vashi resheniya, kak soznatelnye, tak i podsoznatelnye, izmenyat vashu sudbu.
Спуститесь на болото и отправляйтесь в н:
Spustites na boloto i otpravlyaytes v nezabyvaemoe priklyuchenie! Nachnite s malenkogo detenysha alligatora i vyrastite v samuyu bolshuyu i uzhasnuyu reptiliyu. Eshte vse, chto dvizhetsya, i dazhe bolshe, chtoby vy mogli stat bolshim i silnym, chtoby protivostoyat vsem predstoyashchim ispytaniyam.

Sudba bolota i vsego, chto v nem obitaet, lezhit na vashikh cheshuychatykh plechakh! Uzhasnye khumany zakhvatili vlast, i tolko vy mozhete ikh otpugnut! No ne boytes! Vy ne budete odinoki. Poslushayte slova Wisecroc - samogo mudrogo krokodila v gorode - poka on vedet vas po myagkomu i bolotistomu puti k velichiyu alligatora.

Ispolzuyte svoyu smekalku, svoi chelyusti i vse glupoe oborudovanie, kotoroe vy mozhete nayti, chtoby prevratit boloto obratno v veseloe ubezhishche, kakim ono bylo kogda-to! Spasite svoikh sobratev-alligatorov iz lap uzhasnykh khumanov i ikh zlobnykh eksperimentov. Otpugnite nadoedlivykh turistov, zasoryayushchikh vashe krasivoe boloto, spasaytes ot dronov, pytayushchikhsya skhvatit vas, i srazites s bolshimi zlobnymi bossami!

Vy zhazhdete priklyucheniy? Na tebya rasschityvaet vse boloto!

• Prisoedinyaytes k malenkomu alligatoru v bolshom priklyuchenii, chtoby osvobodit ego dom ot etikh uzhasnykh khumanov! Nikto ne trogaet tvoe boloto!
• Stante edinym tselym s mudrostyu Wisecroc i uznayte puti bolota.
• Issleduyte krasochnyy i ogromnyy otkrytyy mir, napolnennyy sushchestvami, kotorykh nuzhno vstrechat i est, khumanami, kotorykh nuzhno otpugnut, bossami, s kotorymi nuzhno srazhatsya, i mnozhestvom sekretov, kotorye nuzhno otkryt!
• Prevratites v samogo bolshogo alligatora v bolote i eshte vse, chto vstrechaetsya na vashem puti: ot lyagushek, ptits i dazhe medvedey do istochnika vsego zla - khumanov!
• Vybirayte iz razlichnykh alligatorov i igrayte za nikh - ili dazhe naryazhayte ikh! Kto skazal, chto alligatoram nelzya nosit shlyapy? Ili pariki?
• Delayte vse vozmozhnoe, chtoby vozitsya s etimi vonyuchimi khuliganami! Sovershayte nabegi na ikh lagerya, vytaskivayte ikh cherez tualety ili dazhe vzryvayte ikh s pomoshchyu VZRYVOV! Vremya mesti!
Cities: Skylines предлагает по-новому вз:
Cities: Skylines predlagaet po-novomu vzglyanut na klassicheskiy zhanr gradostroitelnogo simulyatora s originalnym geympleem, otrazhayushchim vse peripetii i radosti sozdaniya i podderzhki zhizni realnogo goroda. Otlichayushchayasya polnostyu realizovannoy transportnoy i ekonomicheskoy sistemami, igra Cities: Skylines podkhodit dlya lyubogo stilya igry – a teper eshche v lyuboe vremya, v lyubom meste.

Eshche bolee portativnaya, novaya versiya etogo bestsellera dlya Nintendo Switch™ imeet polnostyu pererabotannyy polzovatelskiy interfeys, rasschitannyy spetsialno na Nintendo Switch™, i vklyuchaet v sebya dva samykh populyarnykh dopolneniya Cities: Skylines - After Dark i Snowfall.

Tolko v versii dlya Nintendo Switch™: Vibratsionnyy effekt HD Rumble pomogaet nayti samuyu effektivnuyu zonu dlya razmeshcheniya zdaniy gorodskikh sluzhb. Pro-kontrollery takzhe podderzhivayutsya, i dopolnitelnoe obuchenie pomogaet legche i bystree osvoitsya v igre.

Detalnaya simulyatsiya transportnykh potokov: Obshirnyy opyt sotrudnikov studii Colossal Order, poluchennyy imi v protsesse raboty nad igrami serii Cities in Motion, pomog sozdat realistichnuyu simulyatsiyu gorodskogo transporta.

Rayony i politika: Vam neobyazatelno ostavatsya prostym byurokratom iz gorodskoy ratushi. Razbeyte gorod na otdelnye rayony, vyberite politiku dlya kazhdogo iz nikh i dobeytes dolzhnosti mera.

After Dark: V etom dopolnenii, spetsializiruyushchemsya na turizme i organizatsii dosuga dlya gorozhan, vam potrebuetsya iskusno podstraivatsya pod smenu dnya i nochi, izmeniv traditsionnyy podkhod k upravleniyu gorodom. Smozhete li vy sozdat energichnyy gorod, zhivushchiy i dyshashchiy po nocham, ili on budet podverzhen opasnostyam i neblagopoluchiyam temnogo vremeni sutok? 

Snowfall: V etom dopolnenii vvedeny novye ispytaniya i resursy, svyazannye s temperaturnym rezhimom zhizni goroda, takie kak zasnezhennye karty i otopitelnye sistemy. Vy uvidite v igre dopolnitelnye parki i tramvai i stolknetes s novoy dinamicheskoy sistemoy pogody i infrastrukturnymi problemami obespecheniya tepla i bezopasnosti gorodskikh zhiteley v surovykh zimnikh usloviyakh.
Vambrace: Cold Soul — фэнтези в жанре ro:
Vambrace: Cold Soul — fentezi v zhanre roguelike v mire vechnoy zimy. Vas i vashikh geroev zhdut podzemnye ekspeditsii i vylazki v proklyatyy gorod, unikalnye navyki, opasnye lovushki, neobychnye vstrechi i smertelnye bitvy!

Nad Ledovitsey tyagoteet proklyatie Korolya Teney. Byvshie zhiteli vosstali iz mertvykh v vide ozloblennykh prizrakov. Odnazhdy v gorode poyavlyaetsya tainstvennaya neznakomka v volshebnykh naruchakh…

Ostrosyuzhetnaya igra s razvitoy takticheskoy sostavlyayushchey. Ledovitsa kholodna i besposhchadna. Prigotovtes…
Присоединяйтесь к Флоппи — отважной прог:
Prisoedinyaytes k Floppi — otvazhnoy programme, kotoraya khochet nayti svoe mesto v tsifrovom mire, gde derzkie daemony podderzhivayut balans sistemy, vsegda ostavayas vne polya vashego zreniya. Puteshestvuyte po labirintu raznoobraznykh okon, znakomtes s zabavnymi personazhami i raskryvayte sekrety, kotorye pomogut Floppi luchshe razobratsya v svoikh funktsiyakh. Kazhdoe vzaimodeystvie napolnyaet vashe priklyuchenie yumorom i teplotoy, chto delaet ego nezabyvaemym.
V MainFrames vy pomogaete Floppi otkryvat novye marshruty v puteshestvii po tsifrovomu miru, peremeshchaya okna programm i prygaya mezhdu nimi. V kazhdoy issleduemoy oblasti vas zhdet raznoobrazie vizualnykh resheniy, novatorskikh igrovykh mekhanik i spryatannykh sekretov. Blagodarya sochetaniyu ocharovatelnykh golovolomok i platformennykh ispytaniy s rasslablyayushchey muzykoy, ot igry stanovitsya trudno otorvatsya.
Obayatelnyy platformer poznakomit vas s disketoy Floppi i otpravit v uyutnoe puteshestvie po rabochemu stolu i oknam personalnogo kompyutera. Vy zabudete o sushchestvovanii klavishi ESC i knopki B!..
Subdivision Infinity — это динамичная иг:
Subdivision Infinity — eto dinamichnaya igra s bolee chem 30 zakhvatyvayushchimi syuzhetnymi missiyami i pobochnymi zadaniyami, vo vremya kotorykh vy pobyvaete v neskolkikh galaktikakh, pouchastvuete v boyakh s bossami i izuchite vse neizvedannye ugolki kosmosa.

 - Vypolnyayte interesnye zadaniya v khode osnovnoy syuzhetnoy linii i puteshestvuyte v zagadochnye galaktiki.

- Slozhnye bitvy v kosmose: prinimayte uchastie v masshtabnykh srazheniyakh protiv samykh raznykh vragov: dronov, istrebiteley, drednoutov i mnogikh drugikh.

- Issleduyte potryasayushchie unikalnye galaktiki. 

- Nakhodite poteryannye relikvii, chtoby postroit novye korabli; vedite dobychu poleznykh iskopaemykh na asteroidakh i prodavayte mineraly radi vygody ili ispolzuyte ikh dlya sozdaniya novykh materialov.

- Bitvy s bossami: ottochite svoi boevye navyki, srazhayas s samymi mogushchestvennymi vragami

- Gotovtes k bitve: obnovite svoy korabl, vybrav dlya etogo luchshee oruzhie iz mnozhestva dostupnykh variantov.
Продолжение культовой классической RPG\n:
Prodolzhenie kultovoy klassicheskoy RPG

Prodolzhite istoriyu Bezymyannogo geroya v Gothic II Complete Classic, prodolzhenii, kotoroe vo vsekh otnosheniyakh prevzoshlo original. Teper ona vpervye dostupna na Nintendo Switch™.

V izdanii Gothic II Complete Classic igra Gothic II i dopolnenie Night of the Raven vpervye obedinyayutsya na konsoli.

Vy prorvali magicheskiy barer i osvobodili uznikov Doliny rudnikov. Teper byvshie prestupniki iz lesov i s gor tvoryat besporyadki vokrug stolitsy. Gorodskoe opolchenie malochislenno i pochti bessilno, za predelami goroda bandity oruduyut povsyudu.
В одном из государств — империи Бронк —:
V odnom iz gosudarstv — imperii Bronk — v svoyo vremya zhil-byl otvratitelnyy monarkh, narod strany zhutko stradal ot nepomernykh nalogov i rassloeniya obshchestva na «blagorodnykh» i «smerdov». No terpel narod nedolgo: vskore obyavilsya yunosha, kotoryy smog svergnut despota, podnyav vosstanie v strane, i stat zhelannym pravitelem. Sosednee gosudarstvo — Fantaziniya — takikh problem ne znalo. Da, ono tozhe ne sovsem idealno: byli i razboyniki, i ubiytsy, i moshenniki — v obshchem, vse prelesti tsivilizatsii; no korol gosudarstva slyl dostatochno khoroshim chelovekom.
Odnako istoriya neodnokratno pokazyvala, chto dazhe podloe vtorzhenie i popytki zavoevaniy eshchyo nichego ne znachat: ne kazhdyy grazhdanin budet smirenno i bezropotno vnimat uzurpatoru, a mnogie zakhotyat sbrosit gnyot nespravedlivogo pravleniya; eta igra predostavlyaet vam vozmozhnost sformirovat otryad soprotivleniya, nachinaya s nebolshikh partizanskikh vylazok i sabotazhey i zakonchit masshtabnoy operatsiey po osvobozhdeniyu strany ot voysk interventov i okkupantov.
Yggdra Union — takticheskaya rolevaya igra, v kotoroy budut tri elementa: «Sistema Soyuza», v kotoroy igrok obedinyaetsya s soyuznikami dlya provedeniya atak, zakhvatyvayushchee «Stolknovenie» v armeyskikh srazheniyakh i «Takticheskaya karta». Igry v serii Dept. Heaven obedinyaet obshchaya mifologiya, a numeruyut ikh v sootvetstvii s otkhodom ot kanonov, kotorye zadany etoy mifologiey.
Nekotorye osnovnye momenty mestnoy istorii:
Ад бушует у наших врат! Примерьте на себ:
Ad bushuet u nashikh vrat! Primerte na sebya rol odnogo iz moguchikh chasovykh ada: eto voiny drevnego ordena, obladayushchie unikalnymi silami i sposobnostyami. Oni gotovy litsom k litsu srazhatsya s demonami. Otbrasyvayte adskikh otrodiy nazad s pomoshchyu tselogo arsenala oruzhiya, srazhaytes s ikh uzhasnymi komandirami, primenyaya mogushchestvennye umeniya geroev, i razmeshchayte armiyu rytsarey, luchnikov i magov, chtoby nanesti adskim sozdaniyam otvetnyy udar!

SMES ROLEVOGO BOEVIKA I ZAShchITY BAShEN
Upravlyayte moguchimi geroyami, primenyayte razrushitelnye sposobnosti i razmeshchayte strategicheskie oboronnye boevye edinitsy v noveyshey igre neobychnogo zhanra.

POSTROYTE OBORONU
Razmeshchayte luchnikov, rytsarey, magov i katapulty. Vybirayte nailuchshee polozhenie, uluchshayte ikh sposobnosti i stroyte samuyu moshchnuyu oboronu.

SOVMESTNAYa IGRA DLYa 4 IGROKOV
Obedinyayte sily s tremya drugimi igrokami i srazhaytes s silami zla! Hell Warders podderzhivaet vozmozhnost sovmestnoy igry s druzyami, a takzhe sozdanie setevykh matchey.

GEROI OPREDELENNYKh KLASSOV
Vybirayte odnogo iz trekh razlichnykh geroev, kazhdyy iz kotorykh obladaet unikalnym oruzhiem, umeniyami i sposobnostyami.

ULUChShAEMOE SNARYaZhENIE
Prokhodite etapy, chtoby poluchit mayachki, s pomoshchyu kotorykh mozhno uluchshat navyki i razblokirovat mogushchestvennye artefakty. Srazhaytes na ravnykh s samymi moguchimi demonami!

EPIChESKIE SRAZhENIYa
Vstupayte v boy s demonicheskimi monstrami: ot malenkikh, no mnogochislennykh, do neveroyatno ogromnykh. Kazhdyy zhitel ada vybralsya naruzhu, chtoby ostanovit vas!
Стремительный, неповторимый и динамичный:
Stremitelnyy, nepovtorimyy i dinamichnyy ranner teper na Nintendo Switch!
Edinstvennaya v svoem rode igra, v kotoruyu mozhno igrat lyubym sposobom, vklyuchaya mototsikl Toy-Con! Zabudte ob ogranicheniyakh skorosti i pravilakh dorozhnogo dvizheniya, potomu chto v etikh gonkakh pravila ustanavlivaete vy!
В этой двумерной игре в жанре «стелз» ва:
V etoy dvumernoy igre v zhanre «stelz» vam predstoit ispolzovat magicheskie sily, chtoby razzhigat ogon, obrashchat vodu v led i ostavlyat suevernykh vragov v durakakh. Otbeyte rodnoy dom, spasaya po puti plennykh sootechestvennikov: umeloe upravlenie okruzhayushchey sredoy pomozhet vam dostich svoikh tseley i ostanovit protivnikov.

Magiya pochti chto ushla iz mira, i potomu vragi, opasayushchiesya vashego mogushchestva, zakleymili vas zlobnym koldunom. Ostavte v durakakh suevernye armii ertsgertsogini, ukhodya ot pogoni skvoz dremuchie chashchi, glubokie peshchery i ledyanye gornye piki. Nakhodite svoikh sootechestvennikov i osvobozhdayte ikh iz plena, chtoby vyvesti v bezopasnoe mesto i, v kontse kontsov, vernut sebe svoy dom.

Klyuchevye osobennosti
- Postavte okruzhayushchiy mir sebe na sluzhbu. Razzhigayte plamya ognennymi sharami; zamorazhivayte vodu, chtoby peresekat beskraynie ozera i ustraivat lovushki dlya vragov; povelevayte samoy zemley, vyrashchivaya travu ili krepkuyu lozu, po kotoroy mozhno vzobratsya na vysotu.
- Podchinite sebe stikhii. So vremenem vasha svyaz so stikhiyami budet rasti, otkryvaya vam novye vozmozhnosti. No pomnite: ogon sposoben poglotit vse, chto okazhetsya na ego puti, — vklyuchaya i vas!
- Deystvuyte s umom. Ispolzuyte preimushchestva okruzhayushchego mira, chtoby skryvatsya ot voysk ertsgertsogini i nanosit udary po vragu. Pomnite: vashi protivniki neglupy i umeyut deystvovat soobshcha.
- Nablyudayte, kak polykhaet mir... vmeste s drugom. Vy mozhete igrat v odinochku ili vmeste s drugom: sochetanie vashikh magicheskikh sposobnostey otkroet vam novye prokhody skvoz nasyshchennyy i detalizirovannyy mir Wildfire.
Цифровой бонус. Bewitching Band! Показыв:
Tsifrovoy bonus. Bewitching Band! Pokazyvaet raspolozhenie sundukov s sokrovishchami v podzemelyakh i uvelichivaet skorost istseleniya soyuznikov!

Osypayutsya listya, duyut kholodnye vetry, v sumerkakh proiskhodyat kakie-to strannosti.

Maysya duryu, igray na bas-gitare, shataysya po ulitsam, khodi po provodam, prygay po krysham – i pogruzhaysya v strannye, udivitelnye i uzhasnye sobytiya, o kotorykh luchshe by vovse ne znat. В давние времена, когда на месте древних:
V davnie vremena, kogda na meste drevnikh ruin stoyali protsvetayushchie goroda, a lyudi zhili ne znaya bed, mirom pravila misticheskaya zvezda. Zvezda blagoslovila svoikh vernykh posledovateley, kotorykh zvali shestigrannymi orakulami, darovav im umenie zapechatyvat nebesnye sushchnosti v zagadochnykh relikviyakh.
V mire tsarili pokoy i garmoniya. Do tekh por, poka ne vzoshla Bagrovaya zarya. V nebe zapolykhal chudovishchnyy ognennyy vikhr, v plameni kotorogo sgorela zvezdnaya sistema. Privychnyy mir perestal sushchestvovat, a dushi slabykh porazila skverna. Khaos poglotil posledovateley zvezdy, razbrosav ikh tvoreniya po miru i pokhoroniv ikh v ruinakh. Sushchestvuyut li v mire smelchaki, kotorye smogut obuzdat drevnyuyu silu? Mnogo let spustya potomki shestigrannykh orakulov vstupili v boy, chtoby zavershit bitvu, nachatuyu predshestvennikami, i spasti zvezdnuyu sistemu.
Мир давно уже стар, и тяжело болен. Жутк:
Mir davno uzhe star, i tyazhelo bolen. Zhutkoe bedstvie sdelalo vsekh zhivykh sushchestv slabymi, podavlennymi i bespomoshchnymi pered litsom otchayaniya. No etot zaraznyy paralizuyushchiy strakh ne zatronul nevinnosti malenkogo rebyonka.
Vy zabludilis v limbo. Otpravlyaytes v drugoy mir. Naydite otvety. Srazites so svoim strakhom, prinyav realnost. Issleduyte tainstvenuyu fantasmagoricheskuyu vselennuyu v etoy surovoy metroidvanii, gde v roli telesnogo voploshcheniya samoy nevinnosti vnutrennego rebyonka vy otpravlyaetes v allegoricheskoe puteshestvie, k primireniyu so smertyu. Konets neizbezhen, no otvazhites li vy na nego?..

Маленькая девочка попадает в портал в ми:
Malenkaya devochka popadaet v portal v mir fantazii pod nazvaniem Eksidus, pytayas spasti svoego lyubimogo plyushevogo druga...
V Eksiduse Korol Tarant pravit svoim korolevstvom s lyubovyu svoikh poddannykh. No eta garmoniya vyzyvaet zavist i nenavist sredi samykh zlovrednykh poddannykh. Anguis, volshebnik, reshaet uzurpirovat tron i zakhvatyvaet kontrol nad zemley. Chtoby predotvratit pobeg vsekh sushchestv iz Eksidusa, Anguis, volshebnik, zapiraet vorota i pryachet chetyre kristalnykh yaytsa, raskidyvaya ikh po vsemu korolevstvu. Devochka zaperta v Eksiduse, no ne mozhet prinyat svoyu uchast. Ona otpravlyaetsya v pokhod, chtoby spasti Korolevstvo ot vsego zla. Pomogite Korolyu Tarantu sbezhat iz ego temnitsy i vernut kristally na ikh zakonnye mesta, gde ikh obshchaya energiya pozvolyaet otkryt vorota i pobedit Anguisa.

V etom priklyuchencheskom platformere s bokovym skrollingom vam nuzhno budet uluchshit svoyo snaryazhenie i srazitsya s zloveshchimi silami Anguisa, volshebnika. Vasha missiya budet vypolnena, kogda vy naydete vykhod iz etogo koshmara.

Совет наблюдает за семьями элам, аристок:
Sovet nablyudaet za semyami elam, aristokratami, kotorye proizoshli ot pervykh lyudey v Rilfanore, i banlitami, kotorye iznachalno byli lyudmi, rozhdennymi bez magicheskikh sposobnostey. Gildiya nikogda ne prinimala banlitov iz-za otsutstviya u nikh magicheskikh sposobnostey; i oni nikogda ne dopuskali zhenshchin, potomu chto schitali, chto zhenshchiny slishkom slaboumny, chtoby kontrolirovat takuyu vlast.

Teper, mnogo pokoleniy spustya, magiya elama oslabevaet, i skrytyy magicheskiy talant snova proyavlyaetsya sredi banlitskogo naseleniya. Mnogie iz elama otritsayut eto, no nekotorye iz nikh khotyat sdelat radikalnyy shag, dopustiv banlitov, v tom chisle zhenshchin, v gildiyu.

V svoem kveste vy issleduete sluchayno sgenerirovannye podzemelya, sobiraete sokrovishcha, ovladevaete magiey, izbegaete lovushek, reshaete golovolomki i, konechno zhe, ochishchaete podzemelya ot vsekh zlykh minonov vnutri. Kazhdoe podzemele unikalno, nikakie dve lokatsii ne budut odinakovymi.

Eto ne tolko polzanie po podzemelyam. Вселенная JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure, изве:

Ключ к бессмертию лежит в сердце Сирадон:

Death's Gambit: Afterlife — eto novoe i rasshirennoe izdanie originalnogo khardkornogo 2D-platformera v zhanre RPG. Stante masterom otzyvchivoy boevoy sistemy, ispolzuya shirokiy spektr oruzhiya i sposobnostey, chtoby protivostoyat uzhasam, kotorye skryvayutsya v Siradone. Issleduyte tainstvennyy, ne proshchayushchiy oshibok mir i uznayte istinnuyu tsenu bessmertiya.

Afterlife predlagaet igrokam bolshoy vybor novogo kontenta v dopolnenie k osnovnoy igre, vklyuchaya 10 novykh urovney, bolee 30 vidov oruzhiya, 5 novykh bossov, izmeneniya v mekhanike i mnogoe drugoe. Prinyatye vami resheniya povliyayut na epicheskiy final istorii Soruna.

Glavnye osobennosti
• Obshirnyy mir. Puteshestvuyte po ogromnomu miru s bolee chem 20 prekrasno prorisovannymi urovnyami. Znakomtes s prichudlivymi personazhami iz vsekh sloyov obshchestva i raskroyte ikh sekrety.
• Metroidvaniya. Razblokiruyte unikalnye usileniya dlya peredvizheniya i boya, kotorye otkryvayut i rasshiryayut vozmozhnosti dlya issledovaniya mira.
• Klassy personazha. Vyberite odin iz 7 igrovykh klassov, otkryvayte lyubye iz bolee 100 talantov v dreve navykov i ispolzuyte vozmozhnosti sistemy multiklassirovaniya, chtoby sozdat stil boya, otvechayushchiy vashim predpochteniyam.
• Neveroyatnye bossy. Odoleyte 20 ogromnykh monstrov i drugikh legendarnykh sushchestv. Kazhdyy boss stanet ispytaniem masterstva, trebuyushchim unikalnykh strategiy dlya pobedy.
• Geroicheskiy rezhim. Pobezhdyonnye bossy obretayut vtoruyu zhizn v na poryadok bolee slozhnom geroicheskom rezhime, dostupnom srazu posle pobedy nad nimi. Broste sebe sovershenno inoy vyzov i nauchites protivostoyat ikh novym sposobnostyam.
• Nelineynoe issledovanie. Issleduyte urovni i bossov v nelineynom poryadke, otkryvayte pobochnye oblasti s novymi sekretami, kotorye nuzhno razgadat, i vragami, kotorykh nuzhno unichtozhit.
• Personalizatsiya. Ekipiruyte svoego personazha bolee 30 vidami oruzhiya, vklyuchaya luki, kosy, dlinnye mechi, alebardy i mnogoe drugoe. Sozdayte svoy sobstvennyy stil s pomoshchyu mnozhestva sposobnostey i uluchsheniy.

Game Boy Color (GBC) (яп. ゲームボーイカラー Гэ:м: Game Boy Color (GBC) (yap. ゲームボーイカラー Ge:mu Bo:y Kara:) — portativnaya igrovaya sistema, naslednitsa Game Boy, vypushchennaya kompaniey Nintendo 21 oktyabrya 1998 goda v Yaponii, v noyabre 1998 goda v Severnoy Amerike i v 1999 godu v Evrope. Igrovaya konsol osnashchalas ZhK-displeem s tsvetovoy gammoy, sravnimoy s NES. Dlya sistemy vyshlo bolee 700 igr v razlichnykh zhanrakh (arkady, RPG, strategii, simulyatory, sportivnye igry). Takzhe vykhodili igry v samykh neozhidannykh dlya portativnoy konsoli zhanrakh, naprimer, v zhanre Survival Horror.
На далёком таинственном острове на берег: Na dalyokom tainstvennom ostrove na bereg vybrosilo cherep, i mestnoe bozhestvo probudilo ego. Cherep poluchil imya Skully, i teper on dolzhen ostanovit voynu mezhdu tremya rodstvennikami bozhestva, potomu chto ona ugrozhaet ikh rodnomu ostrovu.

Однажды, ближе к началу летних каникул,:
Odnazhdy, blizhe k nachalu letnikh kanikul, Syuiti smotrel film s proklyatogo diska, kotoryy dal emu priyatel. I neozhidanno poyavilsya dukh, ovladevshiy geroem. Murasaki — podruga detstva glavnogo geroya, prinadlezhala k seme, upravlyayushchey drevnim khramom, poetomu ona popytalas izgnat dukha. Ritual okazalsya uspeshnym i podavil mstitelnogo dukha, no, iz-za neopytnosti Murasaki, forma dukha devushki sokhranilas. Etu devushku zvali Tiyako, imenno eyo ubili na ekrane televizora. Ona rasskazala, chto vnutri neyo obitayut dukhi shesti drugikh devushek.
Soglasno slovam Murasaki, dukhi mogut zhit v nashem mire tolko 49 dney, a eto znachit, chto kazhdoy iz semi devushek budet otvedeno vsego sem dney. Syuiti bylo porucheno pomoch dostich etim devushkam schastya, chtoby oni mogli pokinut etot mir bez sozhaleniy. Tem ne menee, dlya takoy zadachi dovolno malo vremeni. Krome togo, stolknuvshis s etim, Syuiti ne osoznaval, chto uznaet luchshe etikh devushek lish dlya togo, chtoby proyti cherez bol rasstavaniya rovno sem raz podryad..
Roli ozvuchivayut:
RemiLore - это «причудливое» приключение:
RemiLore - eto «prichudlivoe» priklyuchenie v stile anime, sozdannoe v krasochnom mire fantaziy, gde igroki vzlomayut i prorezayut svoy put cherez armiyu mekhanicheskikh monstrov, ispolzuya ogromnoe kolichestvo unikalnogo oruzhiya blizhnego boya i razrushitelnykh magicheskikh atak!

Remi, obychnyy uchenik sredney shkoly, probudil Loru, govoryashchuyu knigu, kotoraya yavlyaetsya samoprovozglashennoy «magistrom» magii. Vmeste oni vtyanuty v volshebnyy mir Ragnoa, kotorogo nastigli gnusnye mecha-monstry. Remi i Lore dolzhny vmeste otpravitsya vmeste i nayti dorogu domoy, no mozhet li Remi deystvitelno doveryat ozornoy magicheskoy knige «Lore»? Kto tainstvennaya devochka-android «Choux» i pochemu ona khochet zakhvatit Lore? Budet li Remi kogda-libo nayti vykhod iz volshebnogo mira i vernutsya domoy?

Osobennosti odnopolzovatelskogo syuzhetnogo rezhima s polnoy yaponskoy ozvuchkoy, dvukhpolzovatelskim rezhimom kooperativa, obnovlyaemymi zaklinaniyami i bonusnymi chertami, a takzhe protsedurno-generiruemymi urovnyami v chetyrekh krasivo oformlennykh mirakh, kazhdyy iz kotorykh osnovan na odnom iz chetyrekh sezonov. «Deus Ex GO» — пошаговая видеоигра-голов:
«Deus Ex GO» — poshagovaya videoigra-golovolomka, razrabotannaya kanadskoy studiey Square Enix Montreal i vypushchennaya yaponskoy mezhdunarodnoy kompaniey Square Enix v avguste 2016 goda. Igra yavlyaetsya svoeobraznym prodolzheniem serii igr GO. Igrok upravlyaet Adamom Dzhensenom, — glavnym geroem igr Deus Ex: Human Revolution i Deus Ex: Mankind Divided. Kak i predydushchie igry serii GO, Deus Ex GO vyglyadit kak nastolnaya igra — personazhi sdelany v vide nastolnykh figurok i v ney prisutstvuyut golovolomki. V sootvetstvii s seriey igr Deus Ex, Dzhensen mozhet vzlamyvat platformy i bashni, chtoby ubit vragov. V otlichie ot predydushchikh igr GO, v etoy chasti prisutstvuet syuzhet i rezhim sozdaniya urovney. Igra poluchila polozhitelnye otzyvy kak ot igrokov, tak i ot kritikov. Po mneniyu poslednikh, igra uspeshno svyazala v sebe vse plyusy serii, oni pokhvalili eyo atmosferu i golovolomki.
«Hitman GO» — poshagovaya videoigra-golovolomka, razrabotannaya kanadskoy studiey Square Enix Montreal i vypushchennaya yaponskoy mezhdunarodnoy kompaniey Square Enix. Igra byla anonsirovana v fevrale 2014 goda. Snachala ona vyshla na iOS v aprele 2014, zatem na Android (v iyune 2014). Versii dlya Windows i Windows Phone byli vypushcheny uzhe v sleduyushchem godu, v aprele 2015 goda. V fevrale 2016 goda igra vyshla na konsolyakh PlayStation 4 i PlayStation Vita, a takzhe pod Linux s podzagolovkom Definitive Edition. Hitman GO yavlyaetsya debyutnoy igroy studii Square Enix Montreal, osnovannoy v 2011 godu. Razrabotka igry nachalas v 2013 godu, nad ney rabotali odinnadtsat chelovek.
Добро пожаловать в Cattle Country, уютны:
Dobro pozhalovat v Cattle Country, uyutnyy pikselnyy simulyator kovboyskoy zhizni. Pora otpravlyatsya na zapad za novoy zhiznyu. Obzhivaytes v gorakh, srazhaytes s banditami, raskryvayte zagovory, obustraivayte fermu, razvivayte gorod i zavodite druzey.
Rasslablyayushchaya igra s elementami priklyucheniya. Vam predstoit zhit na granitse tsivilizatsii, zanimayas povsednevnymi delami, naprimer dobyvat poleznye iskopaemye, rybachit, masterit chto-to ili rabotat v pole. Takzhe vas zhdyot mnozhestvo zadaniy v dukhe Dikogo Zapada — prigotovtes k peregonu skota, romanticheskim priklyucheniyam, grabezham i stychkam s banditami.
Юкито Кунисаки унаследовал от матери таи: Yukito Kunisaki unasledoval ot materi tainstvennuyu silu peredvigat predmety, ne kasayas ikh, i drevnee predanie o devushke, zhivushchey v nebe. V eyo poiskakh on stranstvuet po strane, poka voley sudby ego ne zanosit v nebolshoy pribrezhnyy gorodok.
Издание The Lord of the Rings: Adventure:
Izdanie The Lord of the Rings: Adventure Card Game — Definitive Edition vklyuchaet:
– Dve dopolnitelnye kampanii: «Padenie Teni» i «Khvatka korolya vedm» i soputstvuyushchikh geroev.
– Novyy rezhim igry: «Zerkalo Galadriel», kotoryy pozvolit ispytat vashu kolodu v priklyucheniyakh, sozdavaemykh sluchaynym obrazom.

Soberite kolodu iz lyubimykh geroev i broste vyzov voinstvu Saurona v etoy zakhvatyvayushchey kartochnoy igre. Otpravlyaytes v pokhod po znakovym mestam sagi, vypolnyayte zadaniya i slozhite sobstvennuyu legendu o Sredizeme. No esli Oko Saurona zametit vas, vsyo budet poteryano…

Shagnite navstrechu beschislennym priklyucheniyam, srazites s tyomnym voinstvom Saurona i zashchitite svobodnye narody Sredizemya. Soyuzniki splachivayut ryady, vrag kopit sily — a vashe puteshestvie nachinaetsya.

Nastalo vremya sobrat i vozglavit bratstvo geroev, chtoby provesti ikh cherez ryad syuzhetnykh kampaniy, v kazhdoy iz kotorykh vas zhdut novye istorii i ispytaniya. 

Vyberite tryokh vydayushchikhsya geroev Sredizemya i soberite kolodu, osnovannuyu na ikh sposobnostyakh. Kazhdyy personazh prinadlezhit k odnoy iz chetyryokh sfer: Liderstvu, Znaniyu, Dukhu i Taktike sootvetstvuyut raznye karty. Kakie iz nikh stoit dobavit v kolodu, chtoby izvlech polzu iz umeniy geroya? Kazhdyy vybor vazhen, ved v techenie vsekh kampaniy, prokhodyashchikh po mestam znakovykh sobytiy sagi, vy sami opredelyaete, kakoy budet vasha legenda o Sredizeme.

Umelo podobrannye karty prinesut vam pobedu. Poroy klyuch k uspekhu v tom, chtoby obedinit sily geroev iz odnoy sfery ili dobavit volyu boytsov v Sferu sudby i perelomit khod boya. Zadaniya nepokhozhi drug na druga, i k pobede vedyot mnozhestvo putey — vyberite sobstvennuyu strategiyu!

Ne boytes eksperimentirovat: vam protivostoit armiya chudovishch, ot paukov do zhestokikh trolley i orkov! Tyomnyy vladyka sdelaet vsyo, chtoby vam pomeshat. Sledite za Sferoy ugrozy: ona uslozhnyaet ispytaniya, i esli ugroza vyrastet do predela, vzor Oka Saurona padyot na vas, i vy proigraete!

- Soberite bratstvo geroev i znakovykh personazhey sagi i otpravlyaytes v novye priklyucheniya na prostorakh Sredizemya. 
- Srazhaytes s opasnymi vragami iz voinstva Saurona i vypolnyayte syuzhetnye zadaniya zakhvatyvayushchikh kampaniy.
Five-star tower defense with unrivaled d: Five-star tower defense with unrivaled depth and replayability. The Bloons are back and this time they mean business! Build awesome towers, choose your favorite upgrades, hire cool new Special Agents, and pop every last invading Bloon in the best ever version of the most popular family friendly tower defense series in history.

Prisoedinyaytes k Esh v puteshestvii v mir posle smerti! Puteshestvuyte v zagadochnom mire dukhov, polnom strannykh sushchestv, interesnykh personazhey i zapominayushchikhsya momentov! Esh dolzhna nayti dorogu domoy i spasti svoyu sestru.

Ashina: The Red Witch — priklyuchencheskaya igra na issledovanie mira s interesnym syuzhetom. Ispolzuyte predmety, chtoby reshat golovolomki, i beseduyte s raznoobraznymi personazhami, chtoby glubzhe proniknut v syuzhet!

Osobennosti

Join Ebenezer Scrooge and a team of spec:
Join Ebenezer Scrooge and a team of spectral allies as they battle to save London from the clutches of the wealthy industrialist, Caspar Malthus, and his militant Private Guard. With each Ghost lending their unique abilities, explore the dark corners of London and uncover the sinister influence of the Dark Spirit and an army of Unrepentant Ghosts. Will you have the courage to confront Caspar and stop his malevolent plans before it is too late?

Features:

- Meet and unlock powerful Ghosts, each with their own stories and quests to complete, lending their powers to Ebenezer on this adventure.
- Explore Victorian-era London across multiple regions of the city and uncover the dark secrets of the Malthus family.
- Traverse the world in extraordinary ways with the help of Movement Ghosts, including trapeze artists Rose and Flossie Reed, mountaineer Victoria Peak, professor of time and space Haley Hall, and many others.
- Use each Ghost’s special ability to explore the world while fighting a legion of Unrepentant Ghosts who have descended upon London since the return of the Dark Spirit.
- Enjoy the narrative through dialogues and in-game cutscenes and learn the tragic backstories of Ghosts now tethered to the mortal world.
- Learn and master an intricate map in a classic non-linear, ability gated, Metroidvania.
- Collect limited materials such as Ether, Iron, and Mugwort to unlock new items and abilities.
- Discover secret areas and rare materials.
- All art is hand-drawn featuring frame-by-frame coloring and animations.
2v2 action • Solo Campaign • Local Co-Op:
2v2 action • Solo Campaign • Local Co-Op and versus • 7 teams/stages

Hyper Gunsport is cyberpunk volleyball with guns - it's all about that hot arcade action! You can play 2v2 or 1v1, with a co-op and single player circuit mode as well. Each of the 7 teams has a light story, unique weapons, and a stage with its own gimmick. As you progress, new rulesets change the game, and there's an unlockable AI mode as well. This is a hardcore action game, but we are hardcore about our accessibility options too, ensuring the game is playable by anyone. 

Hyper Gunsport is arcade action with fighting game vibes, a pulsing soundtrack, a unique cast of characters, and unlockables to discover. As a unique feature to Nintendo Switch™, you can play with four individual Joy-Con™ on one screen. This is Future Millennium Sporting Action!

... Story.
In 1978, a clinic closed down due to the sudden disappearance of its director.
Ten years later, a phone call to an investigator sets the story in motion.
What happened to the director?
The story takes place at a closed clinic and follows the disappearances that took place in the past.

The setting of the game.
The game takes place in an abandoned clinic, based on various abandoned buildings in Japan.

A search mode for those who are not good at horror games.
The game has a ruin exploration mode without any horror elements, which can be played even by those who are not good at horror games.
You can explore the ruins in various situations such as morning, noon and night.
