В двадцать с небольшим Келли пришлось ве:
V dvadtsat s nebolshim Kelli prishlos vernutsya v Nebrasku. K gorodishkam, zateryannym sredi kukuruznykh poley. Po doroge Kelli popadaet v obychnyy dlya Srednego Zapada silnyy shtorm.  
 
Three Fourths Home — istoriya, v kotoroy ne srazu otkryvaetsya rol Kelli v etom puteshestvii.  Na polputi domoy Kelli zvonit mama. Vy stanete uchastnikom dolgogo semeynogo razgovora posredi peyzazhey Nebraski. 
 
Three Fourths Home proiskhodit v osobyy moment zhizni geroev.  Eto istoriya vzrosleniya i otvetstvennosti.
Мимы — очаровательные создания, которые:
Mimy — ocharovatelnye sozdaniya, kotorye lyubyat est, spat i igrat. V khode igry razvivayutsya, menyayut vneshniy vid, izuchayut novye navyki i nakhodyat paru. Raznoobrazie kombinatsiy beskonechno, a vy mozhete sozdavat osobennykh personazhey, i obustraivat dlya nikh komfortnuyu zhizn.
Milaya istoriya o sushchestvakh, kotorye zhivut pod Mirovym Derevom. Magicheskiy gorshok, sposobnyy gotovit lyubuyu pishchu, razrushen, i teper Mimam ugrozhaet ischeznovenie. Pomogayte sushchestvam vosstanovit poselenie, uluchshit usloviya zhizni i vyrastit Mirovoe Derevo, pozvolyayushchee issledovat novye territorii.
Vizualno igra vyglyadit krasochno i obeshchaet geympley s elementami issledovaniya. Stroyte zdaniya, sobirayte resursy i razvivayte poseleniya, pomogaya Mimam obresti schaste i radost!..
Reigns: Game of Thrones создана на основ:
Reigns: Game of Thrones sozdana na osnove znamenitogo seriala «Igra prestolov®» kanala HBO® i khitovoy serii igr pro prinyatie resheniy ot Nerial i Devolver Digital. Sleduya plamennym prorochestvam zhritsy Melisandry, vossyadte na Zheleznyy tron v roli Sersei Lannister, Dzhona Snou ili Deyeneris Targarien — a mozhet, kogo-to eshchyo? Vam predstoit lavirovat v slozhnykh khitrospleteniyakh uz i intrig mezhdu vrazhduyushchimi domami Semi Korolevstv. Tolko khladnokrovie i kovarstvo pomogut vam pobedit politicheskikh sopernikov i vodruzit svoyo znamya nad mirom, kotoryy tak chasto menyaet vlastelinov. Sokhranyayte ravnovesie i vliyayte na lyudey, chtoby ukreplyat svoyu vlast — ved uzhasy zimy uzhe blizko.

Lyubimye personazhi: vy mozhete posadit na Zheleznyy tron Serseyu Lannister, Dzhona Snou, Deyeneris Targarien, Tiriona Lannistera, Sansu Stark ili kogo-to iz mnogikh drugikh. Otkryvaya vse novykh i novykh pretendentov na prestol, vy budete imet delo s ikh taynami i slabostyami, kotorye u kazhdogo svoi.

Diktuyte svoyu volyu: prinimayte resheniya i opredelyayte sudbu Semi Korolevstv odnim dvizheniem paltsa — vpravo ili vlevo. Lyudi Vesterosa obrashchayutsya k vam so slyoznymi molbami i neozhidannymi trebovaniyami. A komu iz nikh vnimat — reshayte sami. Esli zhe kto-to stanovitsya slishkom nazoylivym, prosto porvite kartu etogo neschastnogo popolam. K chemu Vashemu Velichestvu otvlekatsya na takie melochi? Pravda, u podobnykh deystviy byvayut posledstviya...

Perekroite istoriyu Vesterosa po svoemu razumeniyu. Videniya Melisandry pokazhut vam dorogi sudeb tekh, kto sidit na Zheleznom trone. Dazhe esli vy znaete vse serii «Igry prestolov» naizust, alternativnyy syuzhet mozhet vas udivit. V roli Sersei vosstanovite Velikuyu septu Beylora ili uznayte, kak slozhilas by sudba Semi Korolevstv, esli by Sansa Stark vyshla zamuzh za Dzheyme Lannistera.

Korolevskie razvlecheniya. Dazhe samym mogushchestvennym pravitelyam inogda neobkhodimo ne tolko dumat o sudbakh derzhavy, no i zanimatsya bolee prizemlyonnymi veshchami. Inogda prikhoditsya otvlechsya na rytsarskiy turnir, a to i na kabatskuyu draku. No pomnite: u vsekh etikh sobytiy budut posledstviya!

Tot samyy saundtrek. Reshayte sudbu Vesterosa i ego narodov pod moshchnyy saundtrek Ramina Dzhavadi iz seriala HBO.
Unlike other RTS games, there are no bas:
Unlike other RTS games, there are no bases to build - new amoebas are created through the miracle of binary fission! 

First though, your amoebas must forage for food in the beautiful yet alien environments that make up their world. Once well fed, these amoebas can replicate into two identical amoebas of the same type, doubling your army with a press of a button!

But multiplying amoebas won't always be enough. You will need to introduce mutations to evolve your weaker amoebas into stronger species. Experiment with different amoeba combinations to field a diverse force that can face any threat!
DROP is an action-strategy hacking simul:
DROP is an action-strategy hacking simulator with puzzle and roguelike gameplay elements. Challenge yourself to the unique gameplay and intensity offered by Developer Etherfield Studio.

The future is disconnected. The world has recoiled and fractured into countless digital enclaves and virtual fortresses in an era of digital isolation, suspicion, and espionage. In this world, there’s only one truth: hackers get fame, money, and dead if they’re not careful.

You are a promising hacker with huge ambitions, an empty bank account, and the burning desire to prove yourself. When your actions attract the attention of a notorious hacker group, The Swarm, life gets complicated - real quick.

Your world turns upside-down when simple jobs hurl you into a power struggle between The Swarm, different factions, and megacorporations that could decide the fate of the world’s fragmented networks. Use your cunning, stealth, and prowess to stay ahead of what lurks around the next node.

Key features
Drop is a fast-paced action-strategy hacking simulator with puzzle and roguelike gameplay elements, unique visuals and electronic soundscapes that evoke the thrill of hacking.

Hack networks to gain respect and notoriety within the community.

Find solutions to complex puzzles.

Work against time, firewalls, and other nerve-racking hazards to get paid.

Procedurally generated side quests offer unlimited playtime.

Play an unfolding story campaign through unique missions. Explore the opportunities offered by the numerous factions with their agendas and assignments.
“You just woke up but... oh, wait! This:
“You just woke up but... oh, wait! This is not right! Everything seems weird and.. where did everyone go?”

Kargast is a dark narrative exploration game with light RPG elements and branching endings.
It tells a surreal and semi-satirical story of an unwell child on the brink of death,
and his adventures through his surreal, cryptic surroundings..

You must guide him through a place of torment,
confront the unknown and make vital choices along the way. Travel
through dark and mysterious environments with your shiny little
companion, fight your way through dozens of odd and malformed creatures,
and uncover what strange truths lay hidden before it’s too late.

Features:
Explore strange worlds with odd inhabitants.
Lite-RPG elements and strange battles.
Authentic synthwave soundtrack that fits the atmosphere.
Original art with thoughtfully crafted locations.
A naive protagonist.
The ability to make friends, unlike real life.
Grab the Bottle – это необычная игра-гол:
Grab the Bottle – eto neobychnaya igra-golovolomka, v kotoroy vy reshaete zadachi, rastyagivaya sobstvennuyu ruku po vsemu urovnyu.

Vam nuzhno manevrirovat postoyanno rastyagivayushcheysya rukoy i izbegat lyubykh opasnostey na puti k prizovoy butylke. A chtoby zhizn medom ne kazalas, v Grab the Bottle takzhe est fizika i golovolomki. Vam pridetsya khvatat, tyanut i dazhe brosat raznoobraznye obekty, chtoby dobratsya do zavetnoy butylochki.

Istoriya igry nachinaetsya v 50-kh godakh, gde-to v selskoy Amerike, gde odin neordinarnyy rebenok delaet pervye shagi i obnaruzhivaet, chto net nichego nevozmozhnogo… Osobenno esli u tebya est beskonechno rastyagivayushchayasya ruka!

Grab the Bottle sleduet za zhiznyu etogo malchika ot kolybeli do mogily, reshaya mnozhestvo golovolomok, vdokhnovlennykh «povsednevnymi problemami» na puti. Tsentralnym elementom istorii yavlyaetsya nezdorovaya tyaga k butylkam, kotoruyu imeet glavnyy geroy.

Osobennosti:
- Innovatsionnyy sposob resheniya golovolomok pri pomoshchi rastyagivaniya i vtyagivaniya svoey ruki.
- Rezhim istorii s desyatkami urovney, nachinaya ot pylnykh cherdakov i zakanchivaya ogromnymi parkami razvlecheniy. Vsego ot 7 do 10 chasov geympleya.
- Raznoobraznyy saundtrek s razlichnymi stilyami muzyki, otrazhayushchiy zhiznennye fazy glavnogo geroya.
In a flooded future world, killer machin:
In a flooded future world, killer machines are plotting mankind's demise. As the sole defender of humanity's last government, only you can create the ultimate squad and save humanity in this turn based, tactical RPG with roguelike elements.

GAME FEATURES
- Explore a sunken world and build your own story 
- Familiar tactical options with a few new twists including action refunds, stealth positioning and ambushes
- Create the ultimate squad from 10 different character classes including the brand new SABOTEUR
- Outfit your team with 115 different weapons, armor, and items
- Fight 30+ unique enemies from 5 factions
- Position your team and then get the kill with stealth
- Control the leader and the other characters will follow (and pick up loot) using an advanced AI
Life has ceased. Man is but a myth. And:
Life has ceased. Man is but a myth. And now, even the machines have begun to fail. Explore a wasteland of rust and ruin, full of malfunctioning robots, mysterious devices, and ancient secrets. At its heart lies Metropol, the world’s last city, where an implacable, power-hungry foe awaits. 

The android Horatio Nullbuilt spends his days studying the Book of Man, sparring with his sarcastic sidekick Crispin, and tinkering with the airship they call home — but their peaceful existence is destroyed when a rogue robot steals the power source they need to survive. Their search for energy will reveal buried truths about Metropol, mankind, and Horatio himself. 

What happened to the humans? And what fate awaits their mechanical inheritors? The answer will depend on the path you take and the choices you make. 

The game draws inspiration from traditional point-and-click adventures, adding an integrated hint system, multi-solution puzzles, and automatic note-taking and mapping, making it a favorite of players of all experience levels. For completionists, alternate endings, a developer commentary mode, and hidden secrets await on a second playthrough.

Half Past Fate is a rom-com adventure wi:
Half Past Fate is a rom-com adventure with a charismatic 3D art-style. Follow the journey of 6 ordinary people who found each other in extraordinary ways.

From eight hours to eight years, this time-jumping saga will change the way you feel about fate forever.

Features:
- An inspiring and heartwarming slice-of-life story set in present day.
- Jump through time, witness how 6 people come together over a span of 8 years.
- Eat spicy ramen.
- Immerse in our familiar world through charming 3D pixel art visuals.
- Learn what's different between black tea and green tea.
- Change a flat tire.

Графический стиль адвенчуры Little Mouse:
Graficheskiy stil advenchury Little Mouse's Encyclopedia vdokhnovlen klassicheskimi skazkami i ... detskimi entsiklopediyami. Etot ocharovatelnyy i originalnyy stil delaet issledovanie eshche bolee priyatnym, a razlichnye animatsii vdykhayut zhizn v okruzhayushchuyu sredu.
«Little Mouse's Encyclopedia» idealno podkhodit dlya priyatnogo otdykha. Gulyaya po ozhivlennym stsenam, vy sami naydete zhivotnykh i rasteniya. Ispolzuya uvelichitelnoe steklo, vy mozhete otkryvat kartochki, soderzhashchie interesnuyu informatsiyu i risunki.
Please, Don’t Touch Anything — нелинейна:
Please, Don’t Touch Anything — nelineynaya, izobiluyushchaya neordinarnymi zagadkami igra-golovolomka, v kotoroy nuzhno nazhimat knopki.

Podmenyaya kollegu, vy okazyvaetes pered zagadochnoy konsolyu s ekranom, krasnoy knopkoy i odnim edinstvennym ukazaniem: nichego ne trogat!

Nazhimayte knopku skolko zakhotite — vashi deystviya privedut k neveroyatnym posledstviyam.

Ishchite v komnate podskazki i instrumenty dlya resheniya zagadok.

Eto obnovlennaya versiya klassicheskoy igry s massoy novshestv.

Nu zhe, nazhmite etu knopku — vam ved tak etogo khochetsya!
Dirt Trackin' 3 переопределяет стандарты:
Dirt Trackin' 3 pereopredelyaet standarty dlya budushchikh iteratsiy zhanra, predlagaya vam oldskulnoe udovolstvie ot gonok po bezdorozhyu, smeshannoe s peredovymi tekhnologiyami!
 27 tshchatelno prorabotannykh realistichnykh trass, vklyuchaya ofitsialno litsenzirovannye trassy, pereosmyslennye favority serii DT, a takzhe sovershenno novye. 5 realnykh klassov: Super Late Models, Crate Late Models, Modifieds, B-Mods i Street Stock. Bolee 100 odobrennykh realnykh voditeley na vybor. Pochuvstvuyte, kak trassa ozhivaet, poskolku variatsii stsepleniya menyayutsya v techenie dnya.
— Rezhimy igry, vklyuchaya Hotlaps s podderzhkoy Ghost, odinochnye gonki i polnotsennye gonki vykhodnogo dnya.
Cложный 2D-платформер, созданный для тог:
Clozhnyy 2D-platformer, sozdannyy dlya togo, chtoby byt veselym, uvlekatelnym i vyzyvat zdorovuyu zlost!
Tut est bitvy s bossami i neobychnye mekhaniki, s kotorymi vy stolknetes s kazhdym novym mirom.
Grafika tut v stile retro, no vyglyadit akkuratno. Poprobuyte, i poluchayte udovolstvie!
Каос обнаружил древнюю силу - Магию разу:
Kaos obnaruzhil drevnyuyu silu - Magiyu razuma - i ispolzuet ee, chtoby sozdat nepobedimuyu armiyu dumlenderov! Eon sozyvaet masterov portalov i velichayshikh misticheskikh voinov Skaylendsa, senseev, chtoby ostanovit Kaosa i vernut kontrol nad Magiey razuma. Teper vam predstoit ispolzovat silu voobrazheniya i sotvorit svoikh sobstvennykh skaylenderov, kotorye vmeste so vsemogushchimi senseyami otpravyatsya na bitvu, chtoby spasti Skaylends.

- Otpravlyaytes vmeste s senseyami i skaylenderami voobrazheniya na bitvu, chtoby spasti Skaylends

Repentant is a dramatic point & click ad:
Repentant is a dramatic point & click adventure game with hand-painted art.

Experienced criminal Oliver begins to suffer from strong remorse after the terrible deeds of which his family has suffered. Unsuccessful attempts to restore relations with his ex-wife further worsen his condition and alcohol dependence.
One day in a small shop, he becomes a witness of a robbery committed by a young girl. At this moment, he gets the opportunity to atone for his sins by helping another person. But who really needs help and who is the victim? It remains to be seen.

Repentant is partially a sequel to the game Little Kite, but it can be played by a person who is not familiar with Little Kite.

Features

Explore atmospheric hand-painted locations with challenging puzzles
Enjoy an intriguing story with an unexpected ending
Listen to an amazing soundtrack by Abstracode and full English voice acting
Serious Sam: The First Encounter (rusc. «Krutoy Sem: Pervaya krov») — syuzhet igry povestvuet ob otkrytii, dannom chelovechestvu v vide zalozhennogo v zemlyu Egipta artefakta mogushchestvennoy tsivilizatsii Sirius. Eto otkrytie pomoglo lyudyam prodvinutsya v tekhnologicheskom razvitii. Odnako, vskore na zemlyu vysadilas besposhchadnaya rasa prisheltsev vo glave s ikh predvoditelem Mentalom, unichtozhayushchaya vsyo na svoyom puti.
Spustya gody, uchyonye obnaruzhivayut drevniy artefakt pod nazvaniem «Klyuch k vechnosti», kotoryy mozhet peremestit odnogo cheloveka v dalyokoe proshloe dlya borby s zakhvatchikami. Etim chelovekom okazyvaetsya Semyuel «Krutoy» Stoun!
Serious Sam: The Second Encounter (rusc. «Krutoy Sem: Vtoroe prishestvie») — Sem terpit krushenie v dzhunglyakh Tsentralnoy Ameriki.
Teper Krutomu predstoit sovershit puteshestvie vo vremeni, pobyvat v gorode mayya Teotiuakane, drevnem Vavilone i srednevekovoy Evrope, chtoby v kontse kontsov razdobyt Svyatoy Graal, kotoryy pomozhet emu v nelyogkoy borbe s silami zla.Ofitsialnye igry v sbornike Serious Sam Collection sm. zdes.
В далеком будущем человечество рассеялос:
V dalekom budushchem chelovechestvo rasseyalos po prostoram galaktiki, a obshchestvo okazalos raskoloto na dva klassa. Vy – nishchiy izgoy, vynuzhdennyy perebivatsya tem, chto nakhodite na zabroshennykh kosmicheskikh stantsiyakh i korablyakh prisheltsev, no u vas est mechta: stat polnopravnym grazhdaninom i poselitsya na kakoy-nibud prigodnoy dlya obitaniya planete, gde vozdukh, voda i pishcha – naturalnye, a ne sintezirovannye. Legendarnyy zvezdolet-relikt, zateryavshiysya gde-to v sektore Deep sky, – vash shans obresti status grazhdanina i poluchit putevku v rayskuyu zhizn.

Sygrayte v samoe polnoe izdanie Deep Sky Derelicts, vklyuchayushchee v sebya samu igru i dva ee dopolneniya, «Novye perspektivy» i «Zhizn na stantsii». V kazhdom iz nikh vas zhdut novye igrovye mekhaniki, urovni, predmety i mnogoe drugoe!

Klyuchevye osobennosti:
* Novyy podkhod k poshagovym boyam s ispolzovaniem kart.
* Kachestvennoe oformlenie v stilistike nauchno-fantasticheskogo komiksa.
* Beskonechnye varianty kastomizatsii personazhey i otryadov.
* Raznoobrazie sposobov prokhozhdeniya blagodarya protsedurnoy generatsii urovney.
* Zakhvatyvayushchaya istoriya o vyzhivanii chelovechestva v antiutopicheskoy vselennoy.
* Dva igrovykh rezhima: «Povestvovanie» i «Arena».
В этой игре вы будете ходить по потолку: V etoy igre vy budete khodit po potolku i smotret v pol. VVVVVV — eto neobychnyy dvukhmernyy platformer s odnoy obmanchivo prostoy osobennostyu. Kapitan Viridian ne mozhet prygat, poetomu emu pridetsya manipulirovat gravitatsiey, chtoby proyti sotni komnat i po puti razgadyvat golovolomki.
Вы – пилот космического корабля, который:
Vy – pilot kosmicheskogo korablya, kotoryy ishchet i izuchaet miry, potentsialno prigodnye dlya zhizni. K sozhaleniyu, skanirovanie ocherednoy planety poshlo ne po planu. Korabl poteryal upravlenie, i vy byli vynuzhdeny sovershit avariynuyu posadku. Krome togo, bystro stalo yasno, chto vy daleko ne pervyy chelovek, pobyvavshiy na etoy planete…

Vam predstoit izuchit ruiny davno pogibshey tsivilizatsii i zabroshennye laboratorii issledovateley, okazavshikhsya na etoy planete ranshe vas. Izbegayte smertelnykh opasnostey, izuchayte mestnuyu floru, borites s gallyutsinatsiyami i naydite sposob ustranit prichinu avarii. Sdelayte vse vozmozhnoe, chtoby pokinut etu planetu i vernutsya domoy!

Osobennosti:
- Zagadochnaya planeta, polnaya sekretov i lovushek
- Mnozhestvo razlichnykh sposobov umeret
- Dve kontsovki
“Pomni...” - eto igra o prinyatii utraty. S pomoshchyu syuzheta, muzyki, intuitivno ponyatnogo geympleya i atmosfernykh mini-igr v ney sozdayotsya illyuziya vozvrashcheniya v detstvo i sleduyushchego za nim vzrosleniya, osoznaniya skorotechnosti vremeni.

Igroka ozhidaet pogruzhenie v byt provintsialnogo rossiyskogo gorodka, gde eshchyo slyshny otgoloski sovetskoy epokhi i zhizn khranit na sebe eyo sledy.

Glavnyy geroy Misha pogryaz v odnoobraznoy rabote i neotlichimykh drug ot druga budnyakh, no odnazhdy v ego rutinu vtorgayutsya staraya shkolnaya lyubov i nadezhda razorvat zamknutyy krug. Korotkiy, no perelomnyy epizod v zhizni gorodka perepletaetsya s istoriey o vnov sobravshikhsya vmeste druzyakh detstva. Im predstoit okunutsya v vospominaniya, vnov nayti obshchiy yazyk i voskresit byluyu druzhbu. Odnako pamyat rebyat o proshlom i sama svyaz mezhdu nimi okazyvayutsya pod ugrozoy.

Osobennosti
• Sentimentalnaya advenchura/kvest na 5 chasov geympleya
• Dekoratsii provintsialnogo postsovetskogo gorodka na rubezhe stoletiy
• Emotsionalnyy syuzhet s elementom nelineynosti i neskolkimi finalami
• Mekhaniki vospominaniy i mysley glavnogo geroya
• Mnozhestvo mini-igr, prizvannykh podcherknut nastroenie momenta

Студия Marvelous приготовила полноценный: Studiya Marvelous prigotovila polnotsennyy remeyk simulyatora derevenskoy zhizni Harvest Moon: Friends of Mineral Town (s vklyucheniem kontenta iz Harvest Moon: More Friends of Mineral Town). Vse igry serii Harvest Moon v tselom odinakovy: glavnyy geroy popadaet v usloviya, dalyokie ot gorodskikh, i uchitsya fermerstvovat, poputno nalazhivaya otnosheniya s odnoselchanami:
Вы — выживший в руинах цивилизации, киша:
Vy — vyzhivshiy v ruinakh tsivilizatsii, kishashchikh zombi. Vy sredi nemnogikh, kto eshche ne prevratilsya v zombi. No nadolgo li?
Palite iz vsekh stvolov, chtoby vas zametili i zhivye, i mertvye. Ili deytvuyte ostorozhno, pryachtes i otvlekayte ot sebya vnimanie. Uchites protivostoyat osobym sposobnostyam: ot nevidimosti do ognennogo dykhaniya i udarov molniyami!
When the moon does not rise over Issaria:
When the moon does not rise over Issaria, monsters to infest the land and cause chaos. You must set out alone or with the other chosen children of the Moon to solve the mystery and restore balance. You have only 5 days before King Mardokh and the Sun Cultists declare war. Multiple playthroughs uncover characters, conflicts, and decisions. Each of the five tribes responds differently to the crisis and looks for different qualities in their heroes. 

Every action and choice you make contributes to your legend as a constellation in the night sky. Future generations will build upon the mythology you create. How will you be remembered?
Samurai Jack: Battle Through Time, озвуч:
Samurai Jack: Battle Through Time, ozvuchennyy originalnymi akterami, predstavlyaet soboy platformennuyu igru, kotoraya okhvatyvaet prostranstvo i vremya, gde vashi deystviya opredelyat novuyu legendu!

Nerasskazannoe priklyuchenie, svyazyvayushchee final serii Epic
Obedinites s nadezhnymi soyuznikami iz shou, chtoby srazitsya so znakomymi vragami.

Issleduyte miry iz serii nagrad
Posetite klassicheskie miry i momenty iz vashikh lyubimykh epizodov. Puteshestvie v temnoe budushchee, chtoby osvobodit chelovechestvo. Okunis v proshloe, chtoby srazitsya s dyavolskimi monstrami. Ishchite svoyu sudbu, puteshestvuya v prostranstve i vremeni.

Sozdayte svoyu sobstvennuyu legendu
Snaryazhayte i osvaivayte bolee desyatka razlichnykh vidov oruzhiya v boyu Povyste svoyu silu eshche bolshe, obuchaya i otkryvaya novye navyki dlya podderzhki vashego stilya igry.
Инди-суперхит от Vlambeer, наконец-то на: Indi-superkhit ot Vlambeer, nakonets-to na Nintendo Switch™! Nuclear Throne — postapokalipticheskiy shuter v zhanre rouglayk. Postapokalipticheskiy v dannom sluchae znachit ne «poslednyaya nadezhda chelovechestva», a «chelovechestvo vymerlo, i mutanty i monstry teper brodyat po miru». Probeytes cherez pustynnye zemli, ispolzuya moshchnoe oruzhie i sobiraya radiatsiyu, chtoby mutirovat novye konechnosti i sposobnosti. No vse eto i mnogoe drugoe vy smozhete sdelat, tolko esli vy — khoroshiy igrok. Smozhete dobratsya do Nuclear Throne?
Vtoraya chast kollektsii MSPA Reader Saga.

Pesterquest – eto epicheskoe priklyuchenie s epicheskoy tselyu v settinge komiksov Homestuck/Hiveswap ot amerikanskogo khudozhnika Endryu Khassi (Andrew Hussie).

S kanonom vse slozhno, i, skoree vsego, eto vasha vina. No graficheskie priklyucheniya v mire Homestuck na etom otnyud ne zakanchivayutsya! Vpishite svoe imya v istoriyu polyubivshikhsya personazhey! Zakazhite stolik v Oliv-Garden (Olive Garden)!

Vas zhdut tselykh 14 tomov s novymi uvlekatelnymi istoriyami iz mira Homestuck i vstrecha s bolee chem 20 zemnymi i inoplanetnymi personazhami, znakomymi po komiksam. 

Prodolzhayte poiski druzey, nachatye v Hiveswap Friendsim, na stranitsakh MSPA Reader: v kazhdom tome vam pridetsya nalazhivat otnosheniya s novymi personazhami.

Novoe izdanie dlya konsoley vklyuchaet v sebya vse 14 tomov seriala. Priobresti ego mozhno kak otdelno, tak i v nabore Pestersim, kuda voshli Hiveswap Friendsim i Pesterquest. Eto luchshee predlozhenie, esli vas interesuet vsya kollektsiya MSPA Reader Saga.

Задумывались ли вы когда-нибудь, каково:
Zadumyvalis li vy kogda-nibud, kakovo eto — upravlyat uyutnoy malenkoy pitstseriey?
Teper u vas est takaya vozmozhnost — rasslabtes s trogatelnoy i nasyshchennoy istoriey kulinarnoy igroy ot TapBlaze, Good Pizza, Great Pizza. Along the Edge is a visual novel set in:
Along the Edge is a visual novel set in the European countryside, where your choices impact the main character's personality and appearance.

• Story:
Daphné is at a dead-end. She's unsatisfied by her personal and professional life. So, when she inherits an old family house in a remote part of the country, she jumps at the opportunity to start anew.

Does she decide to embrace her legacy or does she hang to her old way of life?
Токи отправляется в новое приключение! К:
Toki otpravlyaetsya v novoe priklyuchenie! Kultovyy platformer v zhanre ekshen, vpervye vyshedshiy na igrovykh avtomatakh v 1989 godu, vozvrashchaetsya v novoy, velikolepno «sobezyanennoy» versii! Ona polnostyu pererisovana vruchnuyu i tselikom pererabotana!

Voin Toki mirno zhivet v dzhunglyakh v kompanii svoey vozlyublennoy Mikho. Vdrug, otkuda ni vozmis, poyavlyayutsya uzhasnyy koldun vudu Vukimedlo i gnusnyy demon Bashtar, pokhishchayut Mikho i prevrashchayut bednogo Toki v shimpanze! Teper on volosat, medlitelen i nebrezhen! U ego vozlyublennoy est povody dlya bespokoystva...

Otkroyte dlya sebya Toki 30 let spustya:

Voydite v rol Toki i proydite po velikolepnym lokatsiyam, zakhvachennym merzkimi sozdaniyami! V Labirinte, na Ozere Neptuna, v Ognennoy peshchere, Ledyanom dvortse, v Sumerechnykh dzhunglyakh i Zolotom dvortse kishmya kishat podruchnye Vukimedlo. Osvobodit Mikho budet neprostoy zadachey! Eti otvratitelnye sozdaniya s milymi imenami Boloragog, Rambasha, Mogulvar, Zorzamot i Bashtar pugayut do murashek, a Toki ne bleshchet osobym geroizmom!

Poetomu vam potrebuetsya ispolzovat podruchnye sredstva, chtoby vybratsya iz etoy zavarukhi. K schastyu, Toki umeet khodit, prygat, plavat, karabkatsya i plevat! Kstati, imenno blagodarya svoemu iskusnomu obrashcheniyu so slyunoy Toki mozhet izbavlyatsya ot vragov...

Snova oshchutite legendarnuyu slozhnost Zolotogo veka videoigr:

«Vstavte monetu»… Snova i snova, chtoby proyti priklyuchenie do kontsa! Igrovye avtomaty vas razorili? Pora naverstat upushchennoe, igraya v bolee komfortabelnykh usloviyakh, no so stol zhe zhestkim geympleem. Tablitsy rekordov zhdut tolko vas!
Dlya novichkov vse zhe predusmotren novyy, menee trebovatelnyy rezhim.

You, a former gloves sales-hand, suddenl:
You, a former gloves sales-hand, suddenly find yourself alone. Your best friend Arm is no longer attached to your wrist!
“It was those nasty feet, I know them like the back of my hand!” you assured yourself.  

Let the hand do the walking and enjoy this gripping 3D platformer where you play as a handsome hand. Avoid dangerous obstacles and find your way to the magic mug at the end of each level.

Enjoy 50 plus exciting, unique levels full of challenges! Avoid saw blades, fires, and other obstacles! Enjoy a handy 5 high friction digits which will allow you to climb walls and tubes, grab objects, explode bombs, and more.

Сетевые серверы Disc Jam будут отключены:
Setevye servery Disc Jam budut otklyucheny 30 sentyabrya 2022 goda. Vse setevye funktsii etoy igry (vklyuchaya mnogopolzovatelskie setevye rezhimy) budut otklyucheny v etot den. Vy po-prezhnemu smozhete igrat i naslazhdatsya etoy igroy v odinochnom i lokalnom oflayn rezhimakh. Odnako s 30 sentyabrya 2022 goda v etoy igre bolshe ne budut dostupny vse setevye funktsii.

Disc Jam – dinamichnaya sportivnaya igra dlya 2–4 igrokov, zakhvatyvayushchaya smes aerokhokkeya s tennisom. Igroki pytayutsya zavladet osobym svetyashchimsya diskom i primenyayut uboynye navyki, chtoby zabit gol sopernikam, odnovremenno prikryvaya zonu zashchity na svoey polovine polya. Eta arkadnaya igra, uvlekatelnoe sochetanie strategii i ekshna, predostavlyaet na vybor mnozhestvo bezumnykh personazhey i pozvolyaet igrat s druzyami!
Front Mission — это классика тактических: Front Mission — eto klassika takticheskikh yaponskikh rolevykh igr so mnozhestvom personazhey, seroy moralyu i produmannym syuzhetom.
Загадочная комедия с мини-играми, действ:
Zagadochnaya komediya s mini-igrami, deystvie v kotoroy razvorachivaetsya na telestantsii!

Vy stali novym sotrudnikom obshchestvennogo televideniya okruga Salamandra (SCTV) – pozdravlyaem vas s etim! 

...K sozhaleniyu, vse lyudi v okruge vnezapno ischezli, za isklyucheniem vas, vashego bossa i eshche odnogo sotrudnika. 

No vsyo dolzhno idti svoim cheredom, poetomu v svoey novoy dolzhnosti «mastera na vse ruki» vy dolzhny vypolnyat vsyu rabotu dlya telestantsii. 

(V pervuyu ochered vam, veroyatno, sleduet popytatsya vyyasnit, pochemu vse ischezli.)

A kogda proydut gody i vash rebenok stanet dostatochno vzroslym, chtoby vybrat sebe zanyatie po dushe... Unasleduet li on fermu ili naydet svoe prizvanie v chem-to drugom? Vremya pokazhet.
Etot rimeyk lyubimoy klassicheskoy igry vklyuchaet v sebya mnozhestvo novykh sobytiy, bolee yarkie prazdniki, dopolnitelnye retsepty i tseluyu goru nevidannykh zlakov i klubney. I tekh, kto otpravilsya v pervoe puteshestvie v serii Story of Seasons, i tekh, kto v ocherednoy raz posetil Zabytuyu dolinu, zhdet chudesnaya zhizn..Eshchyo v serii Harvest Moon i Story of Seasons.

Explore the depths of Anyaroth \n\nThe Q:
Explore the depths of Anyaroth 

The Queen’s control covers planet Anyaroth in its entirety. From the forests and historical cities of its surface, stepping down to the core at the centre of the planet, the Queen has spun a complex web of barracks, factories and mines. The Queen’s Regime is aiming to exploit all of the planet’s resources, even the its population! 

  

Fight for the Rebellion! 

In Anyaroth: The Queen’s Tyranny, you will be provided with a full range of weapons, objects and abilities that will let you explore all possibilities within the game’s fighting system. Have fun combining your weapons and abilities to end with your enemies in stylish ways! 

  

Unveil the secrets of this world 

During your adventures, you will get to meet all kind of fellow rebels. Talk with them if you want to know more about the world of Anyaroth, its history or the Rebellion’s cause. 

In the time between fights, pay attention to the surroundings, as you may find artifacts containing key information or materials for crafting a secret weapon. Will you unveil all that this weird planet hides? 

  

Characteristics 

 - Classic 2D action-platformer mechanics, with a modern twist. 

- The free aim system makes for intense fights where looking for the perfect shooting angle could be a a matter of life and death. 

- The variety of weapons, objects and abilities generate impressive moments during fights. 

- Across the game’s levels, you will explore all three layers of planet Anyaroth: Surface, Mantle and Core. 

You will get through ruined cities, explosive spider nests, until you reach the Regime’s capital city. Enjoy the alien landscapes of this peculiar planet! 

- Find all helmets scattered throughout the levels and discover the secrets that this planet hides.

Program immediately anytime, anywhere with Nintendo Switch™! Execute it right away!

Откройте глаза. Прекрасное небо, верно?:
Otkroyte glaza. Prekrasnoe nebo, verno? Korotaya svoi monotonnye dni, vy neosoznanno teryaetes v yadovitom tsvetnike. Davayte zhe poprosim vse krasochnye grandiflory tsvesti zdes i seychas!
Eto vizualnaya novella, v kotoroy vy vybiraete odin iz pyati vidov tsvetkov, chtoby zavoevat lyubov odnoy iz 5 geroin s pyshnym buketom problem psikhicheskogo zdorovya raznoy stepeni tyazhesti.
Roli ozvuchivayut:
Одним злосчастным утром Лайлу и ее друзе:
Odnim zloschastnym utrom Laylu i ee druzey, gospodina Kipkhena i Doktora-Sera-Ottsa, razbudila nepriyatnaya vest: Dirizher i ego generaly vtorglis na Raduzhnyy kovcheg, chtoby ukrast vsyu muzyku i magiyu.

Vosstanovi otnosheniya dukhov ostrova i sozday moshchnoe oruzhie s pomoshchyu alkhimii, chtoby otbitsya ot vragov! Ispolzuy dushi kamney, glaza titanov, beskonechnye vetvi i drugie neobychnye predmety v srazheniyakh s bezumnymi zhivotnymi, polchishchami imperskikh soldat i bossami, surovymi, kak khevi-metal!

Po puti ty poznakomishsya s prichudlivymi personazhami, reshish zagadki i raskroesh sokrovennye tayny.

Osobennosti

Sozdavay moshchnoe oruzhie s pomoshchyu sekretov alkhimii.
Otbivaysya ot bezumnykh zhivotnykh i polchishch rozovykh soldat.
Srazhaysya s bezzhalostnymi bossami v napryazhennykh bitvakh.
Brosay vo vragov vse, chto naydesh: kamni, bochki, ovets i drugoe!
Tebya zhdet chetyre uvlekatelnykh oblasti s nepredskazuemymi vstrechami, ispytaniyami i zagadkami.
Tselaya kucha prichudlivykh personazhey.
A za vsem etim — istoriya o potere i odinochestve.
Lila’s Sky Ark — prikvel k Resolutiion, otmechennoy kritikami priklyuchencheskoy igre v dukhe Zelda. Ona rasskazhet o tom, kak zarodilas vselennaya Krasnogo Koda.
Всё начнется с детства, когда выбранные:
Vsyo nachnetsya s detstva, kogda vybrannye igrushki opredelyat nashi mechty o budushchem. Eti mechty zatem privedut vo vzrosluyu zhizn s ee mnogochislennymi vyborami i resheniyami. Vas zhdut istorii pro razbitoe serdtse, oshchushchenie chuda, radost lyubvi i tsennost pamyatnykh predmetov, s kotorymi mozhno proyti vsyu zhizn. Budte vnimatelny: nekotorye predmety mogut okazatsya bolee interesnymi, chem kazhetsya na pervyy vzglyad.
Pogruzites v priyatnyy mir taktilnykh oshchushcheniy, gde mozhno vklyuchat i vyklyuchat svet, listat knigi, gladit milykh zverushek i delat eshche mnogo interesnykh veshchey! Sobirayte predmety i mebel v rezhime syuzheta, a zatem dayte volyu fantazii v tvorcheskom rezhime (on beskonechnyy). V kontse puteshestviya vy obnaruzhite, chto vernulis v samoe nachalo, no teper vas budut zhdat novye kontsovki, neozhidannye povoroty syuzheta i postoyanno razvivayushchayasya istoriya pro lyubov i poteri.
Momento — uyutnaya igra pro ukrashenie komnaty, no s interesnoy osobennostyu: vybrannye vami predmety izmenyat khod syuzheta! Ukraste komnatu, vyberite dorogie serdtsu predmety, i vy udivites, kak vash vybor povliyaet na zhizn cheloveka. Otpravtes v puteshestvie, v kotorom vybrannye vami predmety vliyayut na dalneyshuyu zhizn.
Драк и Мэвис придадут знакомым сказкам,:

Pryzhki, ryvki, perekaty, osobye sposobnosti — vam ponadobyatsya vse vozmozhnye tryuki, chtoby spravitsya s uzhasnymi protivnikami i kovarnymi golovolomkami, kotorymi napolneny eti otnyne zhutkie istorii. Vas zhdut interesnye zadaniya i zakhvatyvayushchie ispytaniya ot znamenitykh personazhey «MONSTROV NA KANIKULAKh»: Dzhonni, Myurreya, Ueyna i mnogikh drugikh. Ne zabudte i pro tselyy grob kollektsionnykh predmetov! Drak i Mevis zhdut vashey pomoshchi!


Prisoedinyaytes k Draku i Mevis v epicheskom puteshestvii po uzhasno zanimatelnym skazochnym miram! Vypolnyayte slozhnye zadaniya i srazhaytes so smertelno opasnymi vragami, no budte ostorozhny, ved Deniska i Vinni ne proch dobavit v syuzhet chto-nibud ot sebya!

Izuchayte novye lokatsii: issleduyte unikalnye miry, ishchite khitroumno spryatannye kollektsionnye predmety i raskroyte vse sekrety kazhdoy istorii, chtoby poluchit prosto do uzhasa zanimatelnye nagrady!

Poznayte svoyu silu: Drak i Mevis mogut poluchit supersilu, vozmozhnost oglushat vragov, superpryzhki i drugie udivitelnye vozmozhnosti.
Эквадор отличает сочетание испанского ку:
Ekvador otlichaet sochetanie ispanskogo kulturnogo naslediya s kulturnymi traditsiyami korennogo naseleniya. Kogda-to territoriya strany vkhodila s sostav imperii inkov. Kito, sokhranivshiysya luchshe prochikh kolonialnykh stolits Yuzhnoy Ameriki, yavlyaet prekrasnye obraztsy ranney kolonialnoy arkhitektury. V etu epokhu vse vidy iskusstva razvivalis pod vliyaniem tserkvi i nosili otpechatok gospodstvovavshego v Evrope stilya barokko. Seychas mnogie deystvuyushchie tserkvi v Kito khranyat bestsennye khudozhestvennye proizvedeniya: kartiny, tserkovnuyu utvar, rezbu po derevu, statui i razlichnye ukrasheniya.
Shchemyashchaya nostalgiya po detstvu, polnomu volshebnykh priklyucheniy i zakhvatyvayushchego futbola v stolitse Ekvadora Kito. Vzglyanite na ulochki i parki Kito glazami vosmiletnego malchugana. Vedite myach, obvodite prepyatstviya i zabivayte goly, begaya po gorodu i peredavaya pas prokhozhim — posmotrite na ikh reaktsiyu. Nablyudayte za peremenami v gorode, poka Ekvador gotovitsya k Chempionatu Mira.

Berlin, November 2089: The Cold War neve:
Berlin, November 2089: The Cold War never ended. For 150 years both sides have used time manipulation technology to observe and counter each other’s every move. Now this fragile state of affairs is approaching a breaking point, as a rogue nuclear strike will send the world into turmoil. Both sides have scrambled to send agents back in time to find who is behind the attack and how to prevent it. If they fail, the whole world will turn to ash, forever.

All Walls Must Fall is an isometric tactics game where actions happen to the pulsing beat of the music. You control time travelling secret agents as they jump and loop through a single night in the city of Berlin. Using a pausable real-time system, carefully plan your decisions and use powerful time manipulation abilities to your advantage, as you carry out your mission in the shadows or in plain sight. Levels are procedurally recombined, giving All Walls Must Fall a highly replayable campaign structure, while still offering individually crafted components and set-pieces.

Features: 

- Isometric action-tactics game.
- Hybrid real-time / simultaneous turn-based tactical gameplay.
- Procedurally generated levels and campaign that plays different every time.
- Sci-Fi noir Berlin as a divided city in which the Cold War never ended.
- Mind-bending time manipulation abilities that allow you to experiment with possible futures and rewind to the past.
- Synaesthetic nightclub environments and audio.
- A simulation sandbox featuring crowd simulation and destructible objects.
- NEW GAME+ mode that allows you to keep upgrading your gear as you increase the challenge - forever.
- A parable that reflects on free will, moral ambiguity and the meaning of freedom.
- Developed by a team of former AAA professionals using Unreal Engine 4.
- Original Soundtrack.

All Walls Must Fall also features a killer soundtrack that reacts to the gameplay, and features original music from talented artists drawn from both the Berlin club scene and the world of video game music: Jukio Kallio, Ben Prunty, Kuedo, The Orion Correlation and Lost & Found, Mona Mur and Muuutsch.

Brick Game (или «Тетрис») — портативная:
Brick Game (ili «Tetris») — portativnaya igrovaya konsol s razdelyonnym na dvesti pikseley (s razresheniem 10x20) ekranom i vstroennymi igrami. Coderzhala v sebe igru «Tetris» (iz-za chego samu konsol takzhe nazyvayut «Tetrisom»; vposledstvii eto nazvanie pereshlo i na drugie podobnye igrovye sistemy), a sostav i kolichestvo drugikh igr razlichalis. Konsol polzovalas populyarnostyu na postsovetskom prostranstve i v mire v 1990-kh i 2000-kh godakh. Proizvodilas razlichnymi kompaniyami v Kitae. V nastoyashchee vremya eta igrovaya sistema vesma populyarna sredi lyubiteley retrokompyutinga.
V 1995 godu v kompaniyu Nokia prikhodit rabotat Taneli Armanto — programmist iz Finlyandii, so skromnym opytom v igrovoy industrii. On zhe poluchaet zadanie pridumat dlya telefona Nokia 6110 neskolko prostykh igr, kotorye podkhodili by po ego moshchnosti. Armanto, v svoyu ochered, predlagaet kompanii sdelat vsego lish 1 igru. Iznachalno Taneli byl uveren v svoyom variante — tetrise. On uzhe uspel ego adaptirovat i protestirovat, kak poluchil zhestkoe trebovanie ot kompanii Tetris — s kazhdogo prodannogo telefona ona poluchaet svoyu dolyu deneg. Odnako, v Nokia vsekh smutila fraza pro «kazhdyy prodannyy telefon», ved oni ne sobiralis vesti tochnyy schet prodazh. Okonchatelnoe reshenie nakhoditsya, kogda Armanto igraet so svoim drugom na Apple Macintosh v igru, gde kazhdyy upravlyaet svoey zmeey. Armanto ishchet pokhozhie igry i nakhodit budushchiy pervoistochnik — igru Blockade 1976 goda, ot kotoroy i poshli istoki «Zmeyki». Taneli pozdnee sam vspominal o tom, chto iznachalnaya versiya igry byla gorazdo trudnee konechnogo varianta: u nego u samogo ne poluchalos stat chempionom, i, kak on sam schitaet, edinstvennyy sposob prokhozhdeniya — trenirovki. Chtoby u igroka byl shans na spasenie pri vrezanii v stenku, on dobavil neskolko millisekund zaderzhki.

U vas est vse neobkhodimoe, chtoby prisoedinitsya k Korolevskoy akademii magov v novoy shkolnoy romanticheskoy istorii.


Kharakteristiki
* Vizualnaya novella

Вы — киборг, запрограммированный уничтож:
Vy — kiborg, zaprogrammirovannyy unichtozhit poslednie ostatki chelovechestva, i vasha edinstvennaya zadacha... mochit vse, chto dvizhetsya.

Khvatayte lyubimoe oruzhie (ot benzopily i drobovika do granatometa) i prokladyvayte sebe put skvoz podzemnye ubezhishcha, razrushennye voynoy goroda, dzhungli i tak dalee. A esli v vas prosnetsya tvorcheskaya zhilka, raspravlyaytes s protivnikami so vkusom: k vashim uslugam kryuki, yamy s lavoy, tsirkulyarnye pily... kazhdaya smert budet osobennoy.

Esli vam nravitsya stalkivat trupy v lavu i zalivat steny krovyu, to BUTCHER — eto igra dlya vas.

Samyy prostoy rezhim — 'SLOZhNYY'!
0 A.D. (с англ. «0 год нашей эры — Восхо: 0 A.D. (s angl. «0 god nashey ery — Voskhozhdenie Imperiy») — otkrytaya, besplatnaya i svobodnaya tryokhmernaya videoigra v zhanre istoricheskoy strategii v realnom vremeni. Igra pozvolyaet upravlyat drevnimi tsivilizatsiyami, sushchestvovavshimi v period 500 god do n. e.— 1 god n. e. Tsel sostoit v tom, chtoby pobedit vsekh protivnikov, unichtozhiv vse zdaniya ili igrovye edinitsy ili vypolniv opredelyonnoe zadanie: stroitelstvo chuda — osobennogo zdaniya, zakhvat vsekh relikviy, tsareubiystvo, to est unichtozhenie geroya — spetsialnogo yunita protivnika i t. p.
Действие разворачивается в старой крепос: Deystvie razvorachivaetsya v staroy kreposti, v poslednie dni velikoy bitvy. Vy — pogibli, no vasha Volya okazalas silnee samoy smerti, i vy probudilis, chtoby vernutsya v noch beskonechnoy osady. Malo chego pomniv o svoyom prednaznachenii, pokinte podzemelya i proydite po okrainam kreposti do samoy vysokoy bashni, naydite Naslednika, i nakonets, smozhete izbavitsya ot okov proklyatiya.
Вам предстоит бороться за жизнь в опасно:
Vam predstoit borotsya za zhizn v opasnom mire, kotoryy tolknyot vas somnevatsya v sobstvennom sushchestvovanii. Vas zhdyot pugayushchaya istoriya, stavyashchaya neprostye voprosy — chto takoe soznanie, lichnost, chto znachit byt chelovekom.
Radio molchit, eda na iskhode, a roboty vozomnili sebya lyudmi. Puteshestvuya po podvodnoy stantsii «Pafos II», kotoraya dolgoe vremya byla polnostyu otrezana ot vneshnego mira, vam predstoit prinimat neprostye resheniya. Chto mozhno sdelat? Chto eshchyo imeet znachenie? Ostalos li chto-to, za chto est smysl srazhatsya?..
Pogruzites v mir SOMA i vzglyanite v litso uzhasam, tayashchimsya v glubinakh okeana. Izuchayte zapisi na zablokirovannykh terminalakh i chitayte sekretnye dokumenty, chtoby uznat, kakie tayny pryachutsya pod vualyu okruzhayushchego vas khaosa. Popytaytes otyskat poslednikh vyzhivshikh na stantsii i reshite sudbu podvodnogo kompleksa. Budte predelno ostorozhny, ved opasnost podsteregaet za kazhdym povorotom: zarazhyonnye lyudi, bezobraznye sushchestva, bezumnye roboty i vezdesushchiy zagadochnyy II. Pomnite, chto soprotivlenie bespolezno: khitrost i bystrye nogi — vashe glavnoe oruzhie.Ot sozdateley Amnesia Collection.
Одинокий бродяга Вум потерял дом. Он дол:
Odinokiy brodyaga Vum poteryal dom. On dolzhen opravitsya v put i oboyti ves mir, chtoby nayti novoe mesto dlya doma. Na puti ot glavnogo pristanishcha Plopositi do peshcheristogo Blikopolisa nashego Vuma budut zhdat volshebnye mesta i vstrechi so strannymi sushchestvami. No brodyaga Vum — ne obychnyy geroy. Tolko s pomoshchyu ostroumiya i obayaniya emu udastsya dobitsya uspekha v etom bolshom puteshestvii.

Wuppo — eto proekt dvukh uvlechennykh lyudey, risovannaya vruchnuyu grafika, moshchnyy saundtrek i ogromnyy neizvedannyy mir.

Road Redemption — это полная событий гон:
Road Redemption — eto polnaya sobytiy gonka, v kotoroy vam predstoit vozglavit bandu baykerov i otpravitsya v epicheskoe puteshestvie, gde vas zhdut pogoni, skorost i more krovi. Smert — postoyannyy sputnik puteshestvennika po razorennym zemlyam, no smert — eto eshche ne konets. Vy sokhranite vsyo zarabotannoe i smozhete vernutsya k gonke, esli vas ubyut na doroge.

Caesar III — экономическая стратегия, ко:
Caesar III — ekonomicheskaya strategiya, kompyuternaya igra, razrabotannaya kompaniey Impressions Games i izdannaya Sierra Entertainment v 1998 godu.
Caesar III — dostatochno slozhnaya intellektualnaya videoigra, modeliruyushchaya bolshoe kolichestvo vzaimosvyazannykh protsessov po upravleniyu gorodskim khozyaystvom. Igroku prikhoditsya uchityvat mnozhestvo samykh raznoobraznykh faktorov: gorodskoy byudzhet, resursy, kotorymi raspolagaet provintsiya, strategicheskoe polozhenie goroda, nalichie ili otsutstvie rynkov sbyta syrya i tovarov (inogda novye torgovye partnyory poyavlyayutsya po khodu igry). Gubernator obyazan sledit za snabzheniem goroda produktami pitaniya i drugimi tovarami, obespechivat zhiteley razlichnymi razvlecheniyami, obrazovaniem i meditsinskimi uchrezhdeniyami, sledit za nastroeniem naseleniya, regulirovat zanyatost, bespokoitsya o vnutrennem poryadke i vneshnikh voennykh ugrozakh, i ne zabyvat o loyalnosti k imperatoru.
Vozmozhno podklyuchenie USB-myshki i klaviatury cherez dok-stantsiyu Switch, upravlenie geympadom libo tach-interfeysom.
Леса Сельсеты. Одно из самых загадочных:
Lesa Selsety. Odno iz samykh zagadochnykh i opasnykh mest. Te, kto tuda otpravlyaetsya, mogut poteryatsya v odin mig, a svirepye monstry, obitayushchie tam, silno umenshayut vsyacheskie shansy na blagopoluchnoe vozvrashchenie nazad. Prosto idealnye mesta dlya priklyucheniya!.. Segodnya my otpravimsya nazad po khronologii v serii i uznaem, s chem zhe nash staryy ryzhiy priklyuchenets stolknulsya na etot raz.
Imya velikogo puteshestvennika, Adola Kristina znakomo kazhdomu cheloveku vo vsekh kontinentakh etogo mira: Master mecha i beskompromissnyy issledovatel oboshel vse zemli i napisal beschislennoe mnozhestvo istoricheskikh trudov. No s chego zhe nachinalsya put znakovoy lichnosti?.. Kak vyshlo, chto obychnyy parenyok iz gornoy derevenki raskryl taynu drevnego tsarstva Is i pobedil potomkov Klana Tmy?.. Otvety na eti i mnogie drugie voprosy my naydem v vashem sleduyushchem priklyuchenii, kotoroe beryot svoyo nachalo v Velikom Lesu.

«Снежные Братья Ник и Том» — это переизд:

..Odnazhdy, staryushchiy korol Artich iz korolevstva Khottoda vnezapno vtorgaetsya v mirnyy Snoulend. Printsy-bliznetsy Snoulenda, Nik i Tom, pytayutsya ostanovit ego, no.. Dungeon Slime Collection — eto nabor iz dvukh igr: Dungeon Slime: Puzzle’s Adventure i Dungeon Slime 2: Puzzle in the Dark Forest.

Dungeon Slime: Puzzle’s Adventure — uvlekatelnaya 2D-igra-golovolomka s uchastiem sliznyaka Billi. Kazhdyy raz, udaryayas o steny, vy menyaete svoyu formu. Uvorachivaytes ot ostrykh shipov, prokhodite cherez uzkie prokhody i reshayte zanimatelnye golovolomki, chtoby nayti vykhod iz podzemelya.

«Machina» — первая в мире гиноид, прошед:
«Machina» — pervaya v mire ginoid, proshedshaya test Tyuringa. Doktor Khiro Koshino zabiraet eyo k sebe domoy i prosit porabotat domopravitelnitsey. Po mere togo, kak ona prodolzhaet uchitsya navykam etogo mira i rastsvetat, vy tozhe ponemnogu nachinaete ispytyvat k kholodnoy mashine opredelyonno tyoplye chuvstva…
Tak nachinaetsya eta romanticheskaya istoriya, gde para vdvoyom preodolevaet slozhnuyu sudbu soyuza cheloveka i robota, i v konechnom schyote obretaet svoyo schaste. Dlya tekh, komu eto interesno, est stseny dlya vzroslykh; eto pervaya novella razrabotchika, vyshedshaya s perevodom na zapade.
Naslazhdaytes vozvyshennoy kineticheskoy istoriey na 10 chasov s polnoy yaponskoy ozvuchkoy ot Ritsuki Kitami, Ryoko Tedzuki i Mikan Naki!..Eshchyo vizualnykh novell na Switch (renpy).

Аркадный симулятор дрифта, в котором вам:
Arkadnyy simulyator drifta, v kotorom vam predlagaetsya vzyat pod svoy kontrol odnu iz mnozhestva mashin, i otpravitsya stavit rekordy na mnogochislennykh trassakh, srazhayas s botami!
Neprevzoydennyy opyt drift-gonok v realistichnoy drift-igre — upravlyayte legendarnymi drift-karami na raznykh trassakh, beyte rekordy, podnimites ot novichka do gonshchika professionalnoy ligi: realistichnaya fizika, imitiruyushchaya aspekty povedeniya avtomobilya, upravlyayte bolee chem 40-ka moshchnymi i zakhvatyvayushchimi, detalizirovannymi avtomobilyami dlya drifta, nastroyte svoi avtomobili s pomoshchyu eksklyuzivnoy okraski i diskov, zvuki turbonagnetatelya, korobki peredach i shin, kazhdaya mashina vedet sebya po-svoemu — pochuvstvuyte eyo silu i ves, naydya balans! A rezhim karery pozvolit poluchit bolshe opyta v drifte, vypolnyat dostizheniya i razblokirovat osobo moshchnye, sekretnye mashiny!
Army of Ruin — это авто-шутер, в котором:
Army of Ruin — eto avto-shuter, v kotorom vy vedyote legendarnykh geroev v pokhod protiv voinstv zla.

Beschislennye vragi

Soberite smertonosnyy arsenal, sposobnyy v schitannye sekundy unichtozhat sotni vragov, i togda u vas mozhet poyavitsya shans na pobedu nad uzhasnymi generalami voinstva!

Vsya moshch v vashikh rukakh

Primenyayte unikalnye umeniya kazhdogo geroya, chtoby v samoe neozhidannoe vremya obernut khod bitvy v vashu polzu. Delayte silnee svoi artefakty i ishchite moshchnye kombinatsii, kotorye pozvolyat vashemu oruzhiyu evolyutsionirovat i preodolet lyubye predely!

Uluchshayte svoy arsenal

Povyshayte umeniya mezhdu prokhozhdeniem etapov i ispytyvayte novye kombinatsii, nakaplivayte dobychu i poluchayte novoe snaryazhenie, stanovites vsyo silnee i brosayte vyzov bolee opasnym vragam. Vas zhdut sotni ispytaniy!

Bystraya i zakhvatyvayushchaya igra

Ideya Army of Ruin v tom, chtoby bystro pogruzit vas v zakhvatyvayushchuyu igru, ne zabyvaya pri etom ob udobstve i vesele. Eta igra sposobna razvlech vas na mnogie chasy!
Бросьте вызов гравитации в мерцающем пси:
Broste vyzov gravitatsii v mertsayushchem psikhodelicheskom podzemele pod zavorazhivayushchiy ritm. Vyzyvayte svoyu platformu iz vozdukha v lyubom meste i v lyuboy moment. Otkryvayte moshchnye sposobnosti na protyazhenii 50 sozdannykh vruchnuyu urovney. 

Podzharivayte vragov lazerami, krushite steny i reshayte golovolomki. Smotrite, kak prepyatstviya i vragi takzhe dvizhutsya v ritme muzyki. Vzbiraytes na vershiny podzemnogo mira Vitragul i pogruzhaytes v glubiny velikolepnykh trekov ot Chipzel, Andre Sobota, Derek Howell i Monomirror. 

Naslazhdaytes materialami, eksklyuzivnymi dlya Transfixed Edition: novye medali na vremya, desyatki osobykh ispytaniy i novye osobennosti, dostupnye posle prokhozhdeniya igry.
«Ведьмак 3: Дикая Охота» — приключенческ: «Vedmak 3: Dikaya Okhota» — priklyuchencheskaya igra, deystvie kotoroy razvorachivaetsya v otkrytom fenteziynom mire. Vy budete igrat vedmakom Geraltom iz Rivii i zanimatsya okhotoy na chudovishch. Igra poluchila bolee 250 nagrad «Luchshaya igra goda».
Наконец-то Лорду Подземелья удалось объе:
Nakonets-to Lordu Podzemelya udalos obedinit pod svoim nachalom vse sily tmy i osnovat imperiyu zla. Prishlo vremya sdelat sleduyushchiy shag – rasshirit granitsy svoikh vladeniy!

Nichto ne mozhet pomeshat teper vlastelinu temnogo tsarstva upravlyat operatsiey po zavoevaniyu verkhnego mira. Talii zhe predstoit vozglavit obedinennye sily zla, raz i navsegda pokonchit s zhalkimi adeptami dobra, obitayushchimi na zemle!

- Iz dvukh zol… Vybirat ne pridetsya. Dungeons 3 - samyy ozhidaemyy simulyator podzemelya. Samyy masshtabnyy, detalnyy i pyshushchiy zloboy simulyator tsarstva tmy, pripravlennyy pererabotannym strategicheskim rezhimom. 

- Lyubov zla… Pridetsya polyubit i novogo predvoditelya. Pod komandovaniem Talii sily tmy gotovy vystupit i sokrushit vragov.

300 years after the Day of Calamity dest:
300 years after the Day of Calamity destroyed most modern technologies, travel to the desert community of Sandrock and take on the role of a fledgling Builder. Use your trusty toolset to gather resources, construct machines, and turn your run-down workshop into a well-oiled production facility to save the town from the jaws of economic ruin.

Features:
•	Discover over 60 hours of adventure with a deep story, sidequests, and rich character backstories
•	Engage in numerous activities and interactions with NPCs, including romance and the option to get married and have children!
•	Build your own workshop, craft hundreds of items, decorate your home, plant crops, cook recipes, raise livestock, and meet many animals with unique personalities
•	Discover treasure, relics, and resources hidden beneath the Eufaula Desert
•	Face a wide range of enemies in dungeons and experience a realistic and ever-changing desert environment.
•	Find even more fun with exciting mini-games like sand running, gun fighting, sand fishing, holiday events and many more!
•	Embark on a unique Multiplayer adventure, arriving as a free update after launch, to rebuild Sandrock with friends!
Work together as a team to complete camp:
Work together as a team to complete campsites and unlock further areas in the game world.

Each level is a race against the clock where players are required to build tents, construct a campfire, cook enough food and get into bed before darkness falls.

THE WORLD IS YOUR OYSTER
It's a wide, bountiful world out there, teeming with all the natural resources you'll need to complete your campsite. There's wood to be chopped, stone to be mined and fish to be caught - but don't leave them lying around or they might disappear...

TEAMWORK MAKES THE DREAM WORK
To set up your camp as efficiently as possible, you'll need to work together. Throw tools to a teammate in need, ferry resources to a blueprint someone else placed, duck out of the way to let a camper through; every little bit of synergy helps. And most importantly, communicate!

ROME WASN'T BUILT IN A DAY
...but your campsite must be built by nightfall! Each camper's backpack holds a tent pack, lantern, and some shared tools. There's also a cooking pot to stew a succulent meal. You choose where to place your blueprints, so choose carefully!

MEET THE CAMPERS
Quintana is the Camp Leader at Roaring Pines Summer Camp. She is the eleven year old daughter of high achieving parents. Her mother, a respected surgeon and father, a psychiatrist. As the first born of two girls, Quintana feels a sense of responsibility to protect her little sister. She’s clever and curious and having achieved leadership status in Mensa for Kids, prefers the company of books to frivolous child’s play.

Covington is ten years old and lost his father when he was only five. Coming from a creative family, Covington's father left him with music in his veins. Covington continues to teach himself to play guitar by watching online videos of his favorite bands. He loves excursions and field trips with his fellow Campers, as he feels a close bond with them and will often serenade them with melodic renditions of his favorite songs.

Saffron is ten years old and the middle child of seven children. But with her ginger locks and eyes of blue and spirit to match her dazzling appearance she has no trouble standing out amongst the crowd. Living on the expanse of the farm with her six siblings, she is constantly seeking her next adventure and with a freckle to match each of her escapades, she’s unstoppable.

Rascal is eleven years old and an only child who’s been misunderstood until he was diagnosed with ADHD. His parents had him join Roaring Pines Summer Camp when he was seven, and as his name suggests he has a tendency to create mischief between his peers. Rascal loves to build and will use any material available to bring his imagination and creations to life. Whether it be sailing through stormy seas on a raft made of driftwood or flying through space with meteorite precision, Rascal leaves those around him in the wake of his creative destruction.
Двухмерная сайд-скроллинговая ролевая иг:
Dvukhmernaya sayd-skrollingovaya rolevaya igra s poshagovymi srazheniyami!
Sobytiya igry razvorachivayutsya vo vselennoy, gde vse personazhi yavlyayutsya avatarami v virtualnom mire. Igrokam predstoit protivostoyat organizatsii pod nazvaniem "Bombyx Mori", kotoraya vystupaet protiv novykh tekhnologiy i izbavlyaetsya ot drugikh kompaniy, chto pytayutsya vystupit protiv zastoyavshikhsya 2D vselennykh.
V Super Neptunia RPG igroki mogut issledovat podzemelya i uchastvovat v poshagovykh srazheniyakh, naslazhdayas chudesnoy obnovlennoy grafikoy i animatsiey! Pora uzhe vyyasnit, kto luchshe: 2D ili 3D! PS: tride ne nuzhny.Drugie igry serii Hyperdimension Neptunia tut.
